public static class SvgTypesHelper
{
	public static SvgLineCap ToSvgLineCap(this DXLineCap lineCap)
	{
		switch (lineCap)
		{
		case DXLineCap.Flat:
		case DXLineCap.NoAnchor:
			return (SvgLineCap)1;
		case DXLineCap.Round:
		case DXLineCap.Triangle:
			return (SvgLineCap)2;
		default:
			return (SvgLineCap)3;
		}
	}

	public static SvgLineJoin ToSvgLineJoin(this DXLineJoin lineJoin)
	{
		return (SvgLineJoin)(lineJoin switch
		{
			DXLineJoin.Bevel => 3, 
			DXLineJoin.Round => 2, 
			_ => 1, 
		});
	}

	public static SvgTextAnchor ToSvgTextAnchor(this DXStringAlignment alignment)
	{
		return (SvgTextAnchor)(alignment switch
		{
			DXStringAlignment.Near => 1, 
			DXStringAlignment.Far => 3, 
			DXStringAlignment.Center => 2, 
			_ => 0, 
		});
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Charts.Native
{
	public interface ISimpleDiagramPanelInternal : ISimpleDiagramPanel
	{
		IList<Rectangle> Arrange(IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> seriesList, Rectangle diagramBounds);
	}
	public class SimpleDiagramPanel : ISimpleDiagramPanelInternal, ISimpleDiagramPanel
	{
		private ISimpleDiagram simpleDiagram;

		public const int IndentFromDomainBounds = 3;

		public SimpleDiagramPanel(ISimpleDiagram simpleDiagram)
		{
			this.simpleDiagram = simpleDiagram;
		}

		public IList<Rectangle> Arrange(IList<Series> seriesList, Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			return new List<Rectangle>();
		}

		public IList<Rectangle> Arrange(IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> seriesList, Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<IRefinedSeries> list = new List<IRefinedSeries>();
			foreach (IRefinedSeries series in seriesList)
			{
				if (series.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(series);
				}
			}
			int domainCount = ((list.Count == 0) ? 1 : list.Count);
			List<DXRectangle> list2 = SimpleDiagramLayout.Calculate(simpleDiagram, GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(diagramBounds), domainCount);
			List<Rectangle> list3 = new List<Rectangle>(list2.Count);
			foreach (DXRectangle item in list2)
			{
				DXRectangle current2 = item;
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(((DXRectangle)(ref current2)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref current2)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref current2)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref current2)).Height);
				rect = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(rect, -3, -3);
				list3.Add(rect);
			}
			return list3;
		}
	}
}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]

	public enum ChartAnimationMode
	{
		None,
		OnLoad,
		OnDataChanged
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder))]
	public enum PointAnimationOrder
	{
		Straight,
		Inverted,
		Random
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class AnimationBase : ChartElement, IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue
	{
		private const bool DefaultEnabled = true;

		private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultDuration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1200.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultBeginTime = TimeSpan.Zero;

		private EasingFunctionBase easingFunction;

		private TimeSpan duration = DefaultDuration;

		private TimeSpan beginTime = DefaultBeginTime;

		private SceneModifier sceneModifier;

		private bool enabled = true;

		protected bool EasingFunctionIsDefault => easingFunction.Equals(GetDefaultEasingFunction());

		protected SceneModifier SceneModifier
		{
			get
			{
				return sceneModifier;
			}
			set
			{
				sceneModifier = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanAnimate
		{
			get
			{
				if (Enabled)
				{
					return Duration.TotalMilliseconds > 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.EasingFunction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.EasingFunction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.EasingFunctionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public EasingFunctionBase EasingFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return easingFunction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullProperty), "EasingFunction"));
				}
				if (easingFunction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					easingFunction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.BeginTime")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.BeginTime")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan BeginTime
		{
			get
			{
				return beginTime;
			}
			set
			{
				if (beginTime != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					beginTime = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.Duration")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.Duration")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan Duration
		{
			get
			{
				return duration;
			}
			set
			{
				if (duration != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					duration = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.Enabled")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnimationBase.Enabled")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (enabled != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					enabled = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		protected AnimationBase()
		{
			easingFunction = GetDefaultEasingFunction();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEasingFunction()
		{
			return !EasingFunctionIsDefault;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDuration()
		{
			return Duration != DefaultDuration;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBeginTime()
		{
			return BeginTime != DefaultBeginTime;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEnabled()
		{
			return !enabled;
		}

		private void ResetEasingFunction()
		{
			EasingFunction = GetDefaultEasingFunction();
		}

		private void ResetDuration()
		{
			Duration = DefaultDuration;
		}

		private void ResetBeginTime()
		{
			BeginTime = DefaultBeginTime;
		}

		private void ResetEnabled()
		{
			Enabled = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeEasingFunction() && !ShouldSerializeDuration() && !ShouldSerializeBeginTime() && !ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		object IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue.Create(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.Item.Name == "EasingFunction"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		private object XtraCreateEasingFunction(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"TypeNameSerializable" => true, 
				"EasingFunction" => ShouldSerializeEasingFunction(), 
				"Duration" => ShouldSerializeDuration(), 
				"BeginTime" => ShouldSerializeBeginTime(), 
				"Enabled" => ShouldSerializeEnabled(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected void SetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			easingFunction = GetDefaultEasingFunction();
		}

		protected virtual EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new LinearEasingFunction();
		}

		protected internal abstract double GetLabelAnimationProgress(double animationTime, int pointsCount, int pointIndex);

		protected internal virtual void RestoreState()
		{
			if (SceneModifier != null)
			{
				SceneModifier.RestoreRendererState();
			}
			SceneModifier = null;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AnimationBase animationBase)
			{
				if (!animationBase.EasingFunctionIsDefault)
				{
					easingFunction = (EasingFunctionBase)animationBase.EasingFunction.Clone();
				}
				beginTime = animationBase.beginTime;
				duration = animationBase.duration;
				enabled = animationBase.enabled;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesAnimationBase : AnimationBase
	{
		internal double TotalDuration => base.BeginTime.TotalMilliseconds + base.Duration.TotalMilliseconds;

		public abstract void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress);

		internal void Apply(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle diagramDomainBounds, double progress)
		{
			if (base.CanAnimate)
			{
				ChartDebug.Assert(0.0 <= progress && progress <= 1.0);
				double num = base.EasingFunction.Ease(progress);
				base.SceneModifier = new SceneModifier(renderer);
				ApplyState(base.SceneModifier, diagramDomainBounds, (float)num);
			}
		}

		internal double CalculateAnimationProgress(double animationTime)
		{
			double num = animationTime - base.BeginTime.TotalMilliseconds;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = num / base.Duration.TotalMilliseconds;
				if (!(num2 > 1.0))
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override double GetLabelAnimationProgress(double animationTime, int pointsCount, int pointIndex)
		{
			return CalculateAnimationProgress(animationTime);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesPointAnimationBase : AnimationBase
	{
		private TimeSpan pointDelay = TimeSpan.Zero;

		private PointAnimationOrder pointOrder;

		private AnimatedPointReorderBase seriesPointReorderer;

		protected bool PointOrderIsDefault => pointOrder == DefaultPointOrder;

		protected virtual double LabelAnimationStartProgress => 0.0;

		protected virtual PointAnimationOrder DefaultPointOrder => PointAnimationOrder.Straight;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnimationBase.PointDelay")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnimationBase.PointDelay")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan PointDelay
		{
			get
			{
				return pointDelay;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pointDelay != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointDelay = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnimationBase.PointOrder")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnimationBase.PointOrder")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public PointAnimationOrder PointOrder
		{
			get
			{
				return pointOrder;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pointOrder != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointOrder = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected SeriesPointAnimationBase()
		{
			pointOrder = DefaultPointOrder;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePointDelay()
		{
			return PointDelay != TimeSpan.Zero;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePointOrder()
		{
			return !PointOrderIsDefault;
		}

		private void ResetPointDelay()
		{
			PointDelay = TimeSpan.Zero;
		}

		private void ResetPointOrder()
		{
			PointOrder = DefaultPointOrder;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializePointDelay() && !ShouldSerializePointOrder())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "PointDelay")
			{
				return ShouldSerializePointDelay();
			}
			if (propertyName == "PointOrder")
			{
				return ShouldSerializePointOrder();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected void SetDefaultPointOrder()
		{
			pointOrder = DefaultPointOrder;
		}

		internal void Apply(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF diagramBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, double progress)
		{
			if (base.CanAnimate)
			{
				float easedProgress = (float)base.EasingFunction.Ease(progress);
				base.SceneModifier = new SceneModifier(renderer);
				ApplyAnimationInternal(base.SceneModifier, diagramBounds, pointLayout, easedProgress);
			}
		}

		internal int GetAnimatingPointIndex(int pointsCount, int passIndex)
		{
			if (seriesPointReorderer == null || seriesPointReorderer.Order != PointOrder)
			{
				seriesPointReorderer = AnimatedPointReorderBase.CreatePointAnimationVisitor(PointOrder);
			}
			if (seriesPointReorderer.PointsCount != pointsCount)
			{
				seriesPointReorderer.Initialize(pointsCount);
			}
			return seriesPointReorderer.GetIndex(passIndex);
		}

		internal double CalculateAnimationProgress(double animationTime, int animatingPointIndex)
		{
			double num = animationTime - base.BeginTime.TotalMilliseconds - pointDelay.TotalMilliseconds * (double)animatingPointIndex;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = num / base.Duration.TotalMilliseconds;
				if (!(num2 > 1.0))
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal double GetTotalDuration(int pointsCount)
		{
			if (base.Enabled)
			{
				return base.BeginTime.TotalMilliseconds + base.Duration.TotalMilliseconds + Math.Max(0.0, (double)(pointsCount - 1) * PointDelay.TotalMilliseconds);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal abstract void ApplyAnimationInternal(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, float easedProgress);

		protected internal override double GetLabelAnimationProgress(double animationTime, int pointsCount, int pointIndex)
		{
			int animatingPointIndex = GetAnimatingPointIndex(pointsCount, pointIndex);
			double num = CalculateAnimationProgress(animationTime, animatingPointIndex);
			double labelAnimationStartProgress = LabelAnimationStartProgress;
			if (!(num < labelAnimationStartProgress))
			{
				return (num - labelAnimationStartProgress) / (1.0 - labelAnimationStartProgress);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesPointAnimationBase seriesPointAnimationBase)
			{
				pointDelay = seriesPointAnimationBase.pointDelay;
				if (!seriesPointAnimationBase.PointOrderIsDefault)
				{
					pointOrder = seriesPointAnimationBase.pointOrder;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SceneModifier
	{
		private readonly ChartRenderer renderer;

		private int clippingChangedCounter;

		private bool transformChanged;

		protected bool AllowChangeClipping => renderer != null;

		internal SceneModifier(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			this.renderer = renderer;
		}

		private void SaveTransformState()
		{
			if (!transformChanged)
			{
				renderer.SaveState();
				transformChanged = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreRendererState()
		{
			if (transformChanged)
			{
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
			transformChanged = false;
			if (AllowChangeClipping)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < clippingChangedCounter; i++)
				{
					renderer.RestoreClipping();
				}
			}
			clippingChangedCounter = 0;
		}

		public void Translate(PointF offset)
		{
			Translate(offset.X, offset.Y);
		}

		public void Translate(float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			if (offsetX != 0f || offsetY != 0f)
			{
				SaveTransformState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(offsetX, offsetY);
			}
		}

		public void Scale(float scaleX, float scaleY)
		{
			if (scaleX != 1f || scaleY != 1f)
			{
				SaveTransformState();
				renderer.ScaleModel(scaleX, scaleY);
			}
		}

		public void Rotate(float angle)
		{
			if (angle != 0f)
			{
				SaveTransformState();
				renderer.RotateModel(angle);
			}
		}

		public void Clip(RectangleF clipBounds)
		{
			clippingChangedCounter++;
			if (AllowChangeClipping)
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(clipBounds);
			}
		}

		public void Clip(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			clippingChangedCounter++;
			if (AllowChangeClipping)
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(path);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class BoxPlotAnimationBase : SeriesPointAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override void ApplyAnimationInternal(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, float easedProgress)
		{
			BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout boxPlotSeriesPointLayout = (BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout;
			ApplyState(modifier, diagramBounds, boxPlotSeriesPointLayout.WholeBounds, easedProgress);
		}

		public abstract void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, RectangleF pointBounds, float progress);
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BoxPlotSlideAnimation")]
	public sealed class BoxPlotSlideAnimation : BoxPlotAnimationBase
	{
		private const AnimationDirection DefaultDirection = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;

		private AnimationDirection direction;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BoxPlotSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BoxPlotSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public AnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bool easingFunctionIsDefault = base.EasingFunctionIsDefault;
					direction = value;
					if (easingFunctionIsDefault)
					{
						SetDefaultEasingFunction();
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromLeftOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, float pointBoundsRight, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Left - pointBoundsRight;
			return new PointF(num * (1f - progress), 0f);
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromRightOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, float pointBoundsLeft, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Right - pointBoundsLeft;
			return new PointF(num * (1f - progress), 0f);
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromTopOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, float pointBoundsBottom, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Top - pointBoundsBottom;
			return new PointF(0f, num * (1f - progress));
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromBottomOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, float pointBoundsBottom, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Top - pointBoundsBottom;
			return new PointF(0f, (0f - num) * (1f - progress));
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, RectangleF pointBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Translate(direction switch
			{
				AnimationDirection.FromLeft => GetSlideFromLeftOffset(diagramBounds, pointBounds.Right, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromRight => GetSlideFromRightOffset(diagramBounds, pointBounds.Left, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromTop => GetSlideFromTopOffset(diagramBounds, pointBounds.Bottom, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromBottom => GetSlideFromBottomOffset(diagramBounds, pointBounds.Bottom, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case AnimationDirection.FromLeft:
			case AnimationDirection.FromRight:
				return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
			case AnimationDirection.FromBottom:
			case AnimationDirection.FromTop:
				return new BackEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BoxPlotSlideAnimation();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BoxPlotSlideAnimation boxPlotSlideAnimation)
			{
				direction = boxPlotSlideAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarGrowUpAnimation")]
	public sealed class BarGrowUpAnimation : BarAnimationBase
	{
		private static RectangleF DecreaseTop(RectangleF rect, float percent)
		{
			return new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height * percent);
		}

		private static RectangleF DecreaseBottom(RectangleF rect, float percent)
		{
			float num = rect.Height * percent;
			return new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height - num, rect.Width, num);
		}

		private static RectangleF DecreaseLeft(RectangleF rect, float percent)
		{
			float num = rect.Width * percent;
			return new RectangleF(rect.X + rect.Width - num, rect.Y, num, rect.Height);
		}

		private static RectangleF DecreaseRight(RectangleF rect, float percent)
		{
			return new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width * percent, rect.Height);
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(barParameters.Direction switch
			{
				Direction.TopToBottom => DecreaseBottom(barParameters.Bounds, progress), 
				Direction.BottomToTop => DecreaseTop(barParameters.Bounds, progress), 
				Direction.LeftToRight => DecreaseRight(barParameters.Bounds, progress), 
				Direction.RightToLeft => DecreaseLeft(barParameters.Bounds, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BarGrowUpAnimation();
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSlideAnimation")]
	public sealed class BarSlideAnimation : BarAnimationBase
	{
		private const AnimationDirection DefaultDirection = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;

		private AnimationDirection direction;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public AnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bool easingFunctionIsDefault = base.EasingFunctionIsDefault;
					direction = value;
					if (easingFunctionIsDefault)
					{
						SetDefaultEasingFunction();
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromLeftOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Left - barParameters.Bounds.Right;
			return new PointF(num * (1f - progress), 0f);
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromRightOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Right - barParameters.Bounds.Left;
			return new PointF(num * (1f - progress), 0f);
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromTopOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Top - barParameters.Bounds.Bottom;
			return new PointF(0f, num * (1f - progress));
		}

		private PointF GetSlideFromBottomOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramBounds.Top - barParameters.Bounds.Bottom;
			return new PointF(0f, (0f - num) * (1f - progress));
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Translate(direction switch
			{
				AnimationDirection.FromLeft => GetSlideFromLeftOffset(diagramBounds, barParameters, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromRight => GetSlideFromRightOffset(diagramBounds, barParameters, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromTop => GetSlideFromTopOffset(diagramBounds, barParameters, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromBottom => GetSlideFromBottomOffset(diagramBounds, barParameters, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case AnimationDirection.FromLeft:
			case AnimationDirection.FromRight:
				return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
			case AnimationDirection.FromBottom:
			case AnimationDirection.FromTop:
				return new BackEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BarSlideAnimation();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BarSlideAnimation barSlideAnimation)
			{
				direction = barSlideAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarWidenAnimation")]
	public sealed class BarWidenAnimation : BarAnimationBase
	{
		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, BarSeriesPointLayoutParameters barParameters, float progress)
		{
			if (barParameters.Direction == Direction.BottomToTop || barParameters.Direction == Direction.TopToBottom)
			{
				modifier.Translate((barParameters.Bounds.X + barParameters.Bounds.Width * 0.5f) * (1f - progress), 0f);
				modifier.Scale(progress, 1f);
			}
			else
			{
				modifier.Translate(0f, (barParameters.Bounds.Y + barParameters.Bounds.Height * 0.5f) * (1f - progress));
				modifier.Scale(1f, progress);
			}
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new ElasticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BarWidenAnimation();
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation")]
	public sealed class CircularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation : CircularSeriesAnimationBase
	{
		private const AnimationDirection DefaultDirection = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;

		private AnimationDirection direction;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation.Direction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public AnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private RectangleF GetUnwindFormTopClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float height = (float)diagramBounds.Height * progress;
			return new RectangleF(diagramBounds.X, diagramBounds.Y, diagramBounds.Width, height);
		}

		private RectangleF GetUnwindFormRightClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = (float)diagramBounds.Width * progress;
			float x = (float)(diagramBounds.X + diagramBounds.Width) - num;
			return new RectangleF(x, diagramBounds.Y, num, diagramBounds.Height);
		}

		private RectangleF GetUnwindFormBottomClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = (float)diagramBounds.Height * progress;
			float y = (float)(diagramBounds.Height + diagramBounds.Y) - num;
			return new RectangleF(diagramBounds.X, y, diagramBounds.Width, num);
		}

		private RectangleF GetUnwindFormLeftClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float width = (float)diagramBounds.Width * progress;
			return new RectangleF(diagramBounds.X, diagramBounds.Y, width, diagramBounds.Height);
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CircularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(Direction switch
			{
				AnimationDirection.FromLeft => GetUnwindFormLeftClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromBottom => GetUnwindFormBottomClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromRight => GetUnwindFormRightClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromTop => GetUnwindFormTopClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is CircularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation circularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation)
			{
				direction = circularSeriesLinearUnwindAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularSeriesUnwindFromCenterAnimation")]
	public sealed class CircularSeriesUnwindFromCenterAnimation : CircularSeriesAnimationBase
	{
		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CircularSeriesUnwindFromCenterAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			float x = (float)diagramBounds.X + 0.5f * (float)diagramBounds.Width * (1f - progress);
			float y = (float)diagramBounds.Y + 0.5f * (float)diagramBounds.Height * (1f - progress);
			float width = (float)diagramBounds.Width * progress;
			float height = (float)diagramBounds.Height * progress;
			dXGraphicsPath.AddEllipse(x, y, width, height);
			modifier.Clip(dXGraphicsPath);
		}
	}

		{
			PointF pointF = diagramBounds.CalculateCenter();
			modifier.Translate(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
			modifier.Scale(progress, progress);
			int num = 1;
			if (direction == SweepDirection.Clockwise)
			{
				num = -1;
			}
			modifier.Rotate((float)num * rotationCount * 360f * (1f - progress));

		}

			if (obj is CircularSeriesSpinZoomInAnimation circularSeriesSpinZoomInAnimation)

	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder))]
	public enum EasingMode
	{
		In,
		Out,
		InOut
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class EasingFunctionBase : ChartElement
	{
		private EasingMode easingMode;

		private EasingMode defaultEasingMode;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.EasingFunctionBase.EasingMode")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.EasingFunctionBase.EasingMode")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public EasingMode EasingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return easingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (easingMode != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					easingMode = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		protected EasingFunctionBase()
			: this(EasingMode.In)
		{
		}

		internal EasingFunctionBase(EasingMode defaultEasingMode)
		{
			this.defaultEasingMode = defaultEasingMode;
			easingMode = defaultEasingMode;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEasingMode()
		{
			return easingMode != defaultEasingMode;
		}

		private void ResetEasingMode()
		{
			EasingMode = defaultEasingMode;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeEasingMode())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "TypeNameSerializable")
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (propertyName == "EasingMode")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEasingMode();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected abstract double EaseInternal(double normalizedTime);

		public double Ease(double normalizedTime)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(normalizedTime >= 0.0 && normalizedTime <= 1.0, "Normalized value should be greater or equal to 0 and less or equal to 1.");
			switch (easingMode)
			{
			case EasingMode.In:
				return EaseInternal(normalizedTime);
			case EasingMode.Out:
				return 1.0 - EaseInternal(1.0 - normalizedTime);
			case EasingMode.InOut:
				if (normalizedTime >= 0.5)
				{
					return (1.0 - EaseInternal((1.0 - normalizedTime) * 2.0)) * 0.5 + 0.5;
				}
				return EaseInternal(normalizedTime * 2.0) * 0.5;
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException("Invalid EasingMode: " + easingMode);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is EasingFunctionBase easingFunctionBase)
			{
				easingMode = easingFunctionBase.easingMode;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is EasingFunctionBase easingFunctionBase && easingFunctionBase.GetType().Equals(GetType()))
			{
				return easingFunctionBase.easingMode == easingMode;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BackEasingFunction")]
	public sealed class BackEasingFunction : EasingFunctionBase
	{
		private const double DefaultAmplitude = 1.0;

		private double amplitude = 1.0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BackEasingFunction.Amplitude")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BackEasingFunction.Amplitude")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Amplitude
		{
			get
			{
				return amplitude;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0.0 || MathUtils.IsNanOrInfinity(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBackEaseAmplitude), "value");
				}
				if (amplitude != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					amplitude = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal BackEasingFunction(EasingMode defaultEasingMode)
			: base(defaultEasingMode)
		{
		}

		public BackEasingFunction()
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAmplitude()
		{
			return amplitude != 1.0;
		}

		private void ResetAmplitude()
		{
			Amplitude = 1.0;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Amplitude")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAmplitude();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BackEasingFunction();
		}

		protected override double EaseInternal(double normalizedTime)
		{
			return Math.Pow(normalizedTime, 3.0) - amplitude * normalizedTime * Math.Sin(Math.PI * normalizedTime);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is BackEasingFunction backEasingFunction && backEasingFunction.amplitude == amplitude)
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BounceEasingFunction")]
	public sealed class BounceEasingFunction : EasingFunctionBase
	{
		private const int DefaultBounceCount = 3;

		private const double DefaultBounciness = 2.0;

		private int bounceCount = 3;

		private double bounciness = 2.0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BounceEasingFunction.BounceCount")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BounceEasingFunction.BounceCount")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int BounceCount
		{
			get
			{
				return bounceCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBounceEaseBounceCount), "value");
				}
				if (bounceCount != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bounceCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BounceEasingFunction.Bounciness")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BounceEasingFunction.Bounciness")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Bounciness
		{
			get
			{
				return bounciness;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 1.0 || MathUtils.IsNanOrInfinity(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBounceEaseBounciness), "value");
				}
				if (bounciness != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bounciness = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBounceCount()
		{
			return bounceCount != 3;
		}

		private void ResetBounceCount()
		{
			BounceCount = 3;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBounciness()
		{
			return bounciness != 2.0;
		}

		private void ResetBounciness()
		{
			Bounciness = 2.0;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "BounceCount")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBounceCount();
			}
			if (propertyName == "Bounciness")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBounciness();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BounceEasingFunction();
		}

		protected override double EaseInternal(double normalizedTime)
		{
			double num = Math.Pow(bounciness, bounceCount);
			double num2 = 1.0 - bounciness;
			double num3 = (1.0 - num) / num2 + num * 0.5;
			double num4 = Math.Floor(Math.Log((0.0 - normalizedTime * num3) * (1.0 - bounciness) + 1.0, bounciness));
			double y = num4 + 1.0;
			double num5 = (1.0 - Math.Pow(bounciness, num4)) / (num2 * num3);
			double num6 = (1.0 - Math.Pow(bounciness, y)) / (num2 * num3);
			double num7 = (num5 + num6) * 0.5;
			double num8 = normalizedTime - num7;
			double num9 = num7 - num5;
			double num10 = 0.0 - Math.Pow(1.0 / bounciness, (double)bounceCount - num4);
			double num11 = num9;
			return num10 / (num11 * num11) * (num8 - num9) * (num8 + num9);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is BounceEasingFunction bounceEasingFunction && bounceEasingFunction.bounceCount == bounceCount && bounceEasingFunction.bounciness == bounciness)
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircleEasingFunction")]
	public sealed class CircleEasingFunction : EasingFunctionBase
	{
		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CircleEasingFunction();
		}

		protected override double EaseInternal(double normalizedTime)
		{
			return 1.0 - Math.Sqrt(1.0 - normalizedTime * normalizedTime);
		}
	}

		}

		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{

		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ElasticEasingFunction")]
	public sealed class ElasticEasingFunction : EasingFunctionBase
	{
		private const int DefaultOscillationCount = 3;

		private const double DefaultSpringiness = 3.0;

		private int oscillationCount = 3;

		private double springiness = 3.0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ElasticEasingFunction.OscillationCount")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ElasticEasingFunction.OscillationCount")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int OscillationCount
		{
			get
			{
				return oscillationCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectElasticEaseOscillationCount), "value");
				}
				if (oscillationCount != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					oscillationCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ElasticEasingFunction.Springiness")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ElasticEasingFunction.Springiness")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Springiness
		{
			get
			{
				return springiness;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0.0 || MathUtils.IsNanOrInfinity(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectElasticEaseSpringiness), "value");
				}
				if (springiness != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					springiness = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal ElasticEasingFunction(EasingMode defaultEasingMode)
			: base(defaultEasingMode)
		{
		}

		public ElasticEasingFunction()
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOscillationCount()
		{
			return oscillationCount != 3;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSpringiness()
		{
			return springiness != 3.0;
		}

		private void ResetOscillationCount()
		{
			OscillationCount = 3;
		}

		private void ResetSpringiness()
		{
			Springiness = 3.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeOscillationCount())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSpringiness();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "OscillationCount")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOscillationCount();
			}
			if (propertyName == "Springiness")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSpringiness();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ElasticEasingFunction();
		}

		protected override double EaseInternal(double normalizedTime)
		{
			double num = ((springiness != 0.0) ? ((Math.Exp(springiness * normalizedTime) - 1.0) / (Math.Exp(springiness) - 1.0)) : normalizedTime);
			return num * Math.Sin((Math.PI * 2.0 * (double)oscillationCount + Math.PI / 2.0) * normalizedTime);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ElasticEasingFunction elasticEasingFunction && elasticEasingFunction.springiness == springiness && elasticEasingFunction.oscillationCount == oscillationCount)
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ExponentialEasingFunction")]
	public sealed class ExponentialEasingFunction : EasingFunctionBase
	{
		private const double DefaultExponent = 2.0;

		private double exponent = 2.0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ExponentialEasingFunction.Exponent")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ExponentialEasingFunction.Exponent")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Exponent
		{
			get
			{
				return exponent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (MathUtils.IsNanOrInfinity(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectExponentialEaseExponent), "value");
				}
				if (exponent != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					exponent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeExponent()
		{
			return exponent != 2.0;
		}

		private void ResetExponent()
		{
			Exponent = 2.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeExponent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Exponent")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeExponent();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ExponentialEasingFunction();
		}

		protected override double EaseInternal(double normalizedTime)
		{
			if (exponent == 0.0)
			{
				return normalizedTime;
			}
			return (Math.Exp(normalizedTime * exponent) - 1.0) / (Math.Exp(exponent) - 1.0);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ExponentialEasingFunction exponentialEasingFunction && exponentialEasingFunction.exponent == exponent)
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FinancialExpandAnimation")]
	public sealed class FinancialExpandAnimation : FinancialAnimationBase
	{
		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, FinancialSeriesPointLayoutParameters financialParameters, float progress)
		{
			bool flag = financialParameters.Direction == Direction.BottomToTop || financialParameters.Direction == Direction.TopToBottom;
			RectangleF bounds = financialParameters.Bounds;
			if (flag)
			{
				modifier.Translate(0f, 0.5f * (bounds.Bottom + bounds.Top) * (1f - progress));
				modifier.Scale(1f, progress);
			}
			else
			{
				modifier.Translate(0.5f * (bounds.Left + bounds.Right) * (1f - progress), 0f);
				modifier.Scale(progress, 1f);
			}
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new ElasticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FinancialExpandAnimation();
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FinancialSlideAnimation")]
	public sealed class FinancialSlideAnimation : FinancialAnimationBase
	{
		private const AnimationDirection DefaultDirection = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;

		private AnimationDirection direction;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FinancialSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FinancialSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public AnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private static PointF CalculateSlideFromLeftOffset(RectangleF diagramDomainBounds, RectangleF seriesPointBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramDomainBounds.Left - seriesPointBounds.Right;
			return new PointF(num * (1f - progress), 0f);
		}

		private static PointF CalculateSlideFromRightOffset(RectangleF diagramDomainBounds, RectangleF seriesPointBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramDomainBounds.Right - seriesPointBounds.Left;
			return new PointF(num * (1f - progress), 0f);
		}

		private static PointF CalculateSlideFromTopOffset(RectangleF diagramDomainBounds, RectangleF seriesPointBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramDomainBounds.Top - seriesPointBounds.Bottom;
			return new PointF(0f, num * (1f - progress));
		}

		private static PointF CalculateSlideFromBottomOffset(RectangleF diagramDomainBounds, RectangleF seriesPointBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = diagramDomainBounds.Bottom - seriesPointBounds.Top;
			return new PointF(0f, num * (1f - progress));
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeDirection())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FinancialSlideAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, FinancialSeriesPointLayoutParameters financialParameters, float progress)
		{
			RectangleF bounds = financialParameters.Bounds;
			modifier.Translate(direction switch
			{
				AnimationDirection.FromLeft => CalculateSlideFromLeftOffset(diagramBounds, bounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromRight => CalculateSlideFromRightOffset(diagramBounds, bounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromTop => CalculateSlideFromTopOffset(diagramBounds, bounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromBottom => CalculateSlideFromBottomOffset(diagramBounds, bounds, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FinancialSlideAnimation financialSlideAnimation)
			{
				direction = financialSlideAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class FunnelAnimationBase : SeriesPointAnimationBase
	{
		protected override double LabelAnimationStartProgress => 0.5;

		protected float CalculateSlideFromLeftOffset(RectangleF pointBounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Left - pointBounds.X - pointBounds.Width) * (1f - progress);
		}

		protected float CalculateSlideFromRightOffset(RectangleF pointBounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Right - pointBounds.X) * (1f - progress);
		}

		protected float CalculateSlideFromTopOffset(RectangleF pointBounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Top - pointBounds.Y - pointBounds.Height) * (1f - progress);
		}

		protected float CalculateSlideFromBottomOffset(RectangleF pointBounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Bottom - pointBounds.Y) * (1f - progress);
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyAnimationInternal(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, float easedProgress)
		{
			ApplyState(modifier, diagramBounds, new FunnelSeriesPointLayoutParameters((FunnelSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout), easedProgress);
		}

		public abstract void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, FunnelSeriesPointLayoutParameters funnelParameters, float progress);
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSlideAnimation")]
	public sealed class FunnelSlideAnimation : FunnelAnimationBase
	{
		private const AnimationDirection DefaultDirection = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;

		private AnimationDirection direction;

		protected override PointAnimationOrder DefaultPointOrder
		{
			get
			{
				if (direction != AnimationDirection.FromBottom)
				{
					return base.DefaultPointOrder;
				}
				return PointAnimationOrder.Inverted;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public AnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					bool easingFunctionIsDefault = base.EasingFunctionIsDefault;
					bool pointOrderIsDefault = base.PointOrderIsDefault;
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					if (easingFunctionIsDefault)
					{
						SetDefaultEasingFunction();
					}
					if (pointOrderIsDefault)
					{
						SetDefaultPointOrder();
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = AnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private float GetOffsetX(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case AnimationDirection.FromLeft:
				return CalculateSlideFromLeftOffset(bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
			case AnimationDirection.FromRight:
				return CalculateSlideFromRightOffset(bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
			case AnimationDirection.FromBottom:
			case AnimationDirection.FromTop:
				return 0f;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		private float GetOffsetY(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			return direction switch
			{
				AnimationDirection.FromLeft => 0f, 
				AnimationDirection.FromRight => 0f, 
				AnimationDirection.FromTop => CalculateSlideFromTopOffset(bounds, diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromBottom => CalculateSlideFromBottomOffset(bounds, diagramBounds, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case AnimationDirection.FromLeft:
			case AnimationDirection.FromRight:
				return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
			case AnimationDirection.FromBottom:
			case AnimationDirection.FromTop:
				return new BackEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FunnelSlideAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, FunnelSeriesPointLayoutParameters funnelParameters, float progress)
		{
			float offsetX = GetOffsetX(funnelParameters.Bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
			float offsetY = GetOffsetY(funnelParameters.Bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
			modifier.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FunnelSlideAnimation funnelSlideAnimation)
			{
				direction = funnelSlideAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelFlyInAnimation")]
	public sealed class FunnelFlyInAnimation : FunnelAnimationBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<RectangleF, bool> layoutAnimationsLeft = new Dictionary<RectangleF, bool>();

		private bool fromLeft = true;

		protected override PointAnimationOrder DefaultPointOrder => PointAnimationOrder.Inverted;

		private float GetOffsetX(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			if (layoutAnimationsLeft[bounds])
			{
				return CalculateSlideFromLeftOffset(bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
			}
			return CalculateSlideFromRightOffset(bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FunnelFlyInAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, FunnelSeriesPointLayoutParameters funnelParameters, float progress)
		{
			RectangleF bounds = funnelParameters.Bounds;
			if (!layoutAnimationsLeft.ContainsKey(bounds))
			{
				layoutAnimationsLeft[bounds] = fromLeft;
				fromLeft = !fromLeft;
			}
			float offsetX = GetOffsetX(bounds, diagramBounds, progress);
			float num = (((double)progress < 0.77) ? (2f / bounds.Height) : ((progress - 0.75f) * 4f));
			float offsetY = (bounds.Height / 2f + bounds.Y) * (1f - num);
			modifier.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
			modifier.Scale(1f, num);
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters
	{
		private PointF point;

		private RectangleF bounds;

		[Description("Gets or sets the boundary box of the series point marker.")]
		public RectangleF Bounds => bounds;

		[Description("Returns the location of the marker center.")]
		public PointF Location => point;

		internal MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters(PointSeriesPointLayout markerLayout, bool useZeroPointForRangeArea = false)
		{
			if (!useZeroPointForRangeArea)
			{
				point = (PointF)markerLayout.Point;
				bounds = ((markerLayout.Polygon != null) ? markerLayout.Polygon.Rect : RectangleF.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout = (RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout)markerLayout;
				point = (PointF)rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPoint;
				bounds = ((rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon != null) ? rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon.Rect : RectangleF.Empty);
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYMarkerSlideAnimation")]
	public sealed class XYMarkerSlideAnimation : XYMarkerAnimationBase
	{
		private const XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection DefaultDirection = XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeft;

		private XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection direction;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYMarkerSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYMarkerSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeft;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetToLeft(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Left - markerParameters.Bounds.Right) * (1f - progress);
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetToRight(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Right - markerParameters.Bounds.Left) * (1f - progress);
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetToTop(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Top - markerParameters.Bounds.Bottom) * (1f - progress);
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetToBottom(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			return (diagramBounds.Bottom - markerParameters.Bounds.Top) * (1f - progress);
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetToVerticalCenter(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = (diagramBounds.Top + diagramBounds.Bottom) / 2f;
			float num2 = num - markerParameters.Location.Y;
			return num2 * (1f - progress);
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetToHorizontalCenter(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = (diagramBounds.Left + diagramBounds.Right) / 2f;
			double num2 = num - markerParameters.Location.X;
			return (float)(num2 * (double)(1f - progress));
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new XYMarkerSlideAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(diagramBounds);
			float offsetX = 0f;
			float offsetY = 0f;
			switch (direction)
			{
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeft:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToLeft(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromTop:
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToTop(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromRight:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToRight(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromBottom:
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToBottom(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeftCenter:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToLeft(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToVerticalCenter(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromTopCenter:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToHorizontalCenter(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToTop(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromRightCenter:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToRight(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToVerticalCenter(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromBottomCenter:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToHorizontalCenter(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToBottom(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeftTopCorner:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToLeft(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToTop(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromRightTopCorner:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToRight(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToTop(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromRightBottomCorner:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToRight(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToBottom(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			case XYMarkerSlideAnimationDirection.FromLeftBottomCorner:
				offsetX = CalculateOffsetToLeft(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				offsetY = CalculateOffsetToBottom(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
				break;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
			modifier.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is XYMarkerSlideAnimation xYMarkerSlideAnimation)
			{
				direction = xYMarkerSlideAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularMarkerWidenAnimation")]

	{
		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			if (progress > 0f)
			{
				modifier.Translate(markerParameters.Location.X * (1f - progress), markerParameters.Location.Y * (1f - progress));
				modifier.Scale(progress, progress);
			}
			else if (progress == 0f)
			{
				modifier.Clip(Rectangle.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularMarkerSlideAnimation")]
	public sealed class CircularMarkerSlideAnimation : CircularMarkerAnimationBase
	{
		private const CircularMarkerAnimationDirection DefaultDirection = CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.ToCenter;

		private CircularMarkerAnimationDirection direction = CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.ToCenter;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularMarkerSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CircularMarkerSlideAnimation.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public CircularMarkerAnimationDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.ToCenter;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.ToCenter;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private PointF CalculateSlideFromLeftCenterOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = new PointF(diagramBounds.Left, diagramBounds.Y + 0.5f * diagramBounds.Height);
			float x = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.X - pointF.X)) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.Y - pointF.Y)) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		private PointF CalculateSlideFromRightCenterOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = new PointF(diagramBounds.Right, diagramBounds.Y + 0.5f * diagramBounds.Height);
			float x = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.X - pointF.X)) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.Y - pointF.Y)) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		private PointF CalculateSlideFromTopCenterOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = new PointF(diagramBounds.X + 0.5f * diagramBounds.Width, diagramBounds.Top);
			float x = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.X - pointF.X)) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.Y - pointF.Y)) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		private PointF CalculateSlideFromBottomCenterOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = new PointF(diagramBounds.X + 0.5f * diagramBounds.Width, diagramBounds.Bottom);
			float x = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.X - pointF.X)) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.Y - pointF.Y)) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		private PointF CalculateSlideFromCenterOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = diagramBounds.CalculateCenter();
			float x = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.X - pointF.X)) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (0f - (markerParameters.Location.Y - pointF.Y)) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		private PointF CalculateSlideToCenterOffset(RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = diagramBounds.CalculateCenter();
			if (pointF.X == markerParameters.Location.X && pointF.Y == markerParameters.Location.Y)
			{
				return CalculateSlideFromTopCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress);
			}
			double num = markerParameters.Location.X - pointF.X;
			double num2 = markerParameters.Location.Y - pointF.Y;
			double num3 = 0.5 * (double)diagramBounds.Width;
			double num4 = 0.5 * (double)diagramBounds.Height;
			double num5 = num * num + num2 * num2;
			double num6 = Math.Min(num3 * num3, num4 * num4);
			double num7 = Math.Sqrt(num6 / num5);
			num = (double)pointF.X + num * num7;
			num2 = (double)pointF.Y + num2 * num7;
			float x = (0f - (float)((double)markerParameters.Location.X - num)) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (0f - (float)((double)markerParameters.Location.Y - num2)) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, MarkerSeriesPointLayoutParameters markerParameters, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Translate(direction switch
			{
				CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.FromLeftCenter => CalculateSlideFromLeftCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress), 
				CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.FromRightCenter => CalculateSlideFromRightCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress), 
				CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.FromTopCenter => CalculateSlideFromTopCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress), 
				CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.FromBottomCenter => CalculateSlideFromBottomCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress), 
				CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.FromCenter => CalculateSlideFromCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress), 
				CircularMarkerAnimationDirection.ToCenter => CalculateSlideToCenterOffset(diagramBounds, markerParameters, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CircularMarkerSlideAnimation();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is CircularMarkerSlideAnimation circularMarkerSlideAnimation)
			{
				direction = circularMarkerSlideAnimation.direction;
			}
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters
	{
		private readonly float startAngle;

		private readonly float sweepAngle;

		private readonly PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout;

		[Description("Gets or sets the boundary box of the series point marker.")]
		public RectangleF Bounds => pieLayout.PieBounds;

		[Description("Returns the start angle of a series point’s circle segment.")]
		public float StartAngle => startAngle;

		[Description("Returns the sweep angle of a pie point’s circle segment.")]
		public float SweepAngle => sweepAngle;

		[Description("Returns the location of the pie center point.")]
		public PointF PieCenter => CalculateCenterPoint();

		internal PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters(PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			this.pieLayout = pieLayout;
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.sweepAngle = sweepAngle;
		}

		private PointF CalculateCenterPoint()
		{
			float x = pieLayout.BasePoint.X + (float)pieLayout.Pie.CenterPoint.X;
			float y = pieLayout.BasePoint.Y + (float)pieLayout.Pie.CenterPoint.Y;
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}
	}
	public abstract class PieAnimationBase : SeriesPointAnimationBase
	{
		private double sweepAngleCache;

		private double startAngleCache;

		private Pie pie;

		protected override double LabelAnimationStartProgress => 0.5;

		protected internal override void RestoreState()
		{
			base.RestoreState();
			if (pie != null)
			{
				pie.StartAngle = startAngleCache;
				pie.SweepAngle = sweepAngleCache;
				pie = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyAnimationInternal(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, float easedProgress)
		{
			pie = ((PieSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout).Pie;
			startAngleCache = pie.StartAngle;
			sweepAngleCache = pie.SweepAngle;
			double num = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(startAngleCache);
			double num2 = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(sweepAngleCache);
			float num3 = CalculateAnimatedStartAngle((float)num, (float)num2, easedProgress);
			float num4 = CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle((float)num2, easedProgress);
			pie.StartAngle = (float)MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num3);
			pie.SweepAngle = (float)MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num4);
			PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters pieParameters = new PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters((PieSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout, (float)num, (float)num2);
			ApplyState(modifier, diagramBounds, pieParameters, easedProgress);
		}

		public virtual float CalculateAnimatedStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			return startAngle;
		}

		public virtual float CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			return sweepAngle;
		}

		public virtual void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters pieParameters, float progress)
		{
		}
	}

	public sealed class PiePopUpAnimation : PieAnimationBase
	{
		private float CorrectProgress(float progress)
		{
			if (!(progress < 0.5f))
			{
				return 1f - progress;
			}
			return progress;
		}

		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuarticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PiePopUpAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters pieParameters, float progress)
		{
			float num = 1f + 0.3f * CorrectProgress(progress);
			PointF offset = PieAnimationHelper.CalculateGrowUpOffset(pieParameters.Bounds, num);
			modifier.Translate(offset);
			modifier.Scale(num, num);
		}
	}

			if (!(progress < 0.5f))

		}

		{
			float progress2 = Math.Min(1f, 2f * progress);

			PointF offset = PieAnimationHelper.CalculateDropInOffset(num, diagramBounds, progress2);
			modifier.Translate(offset);
		}

		{
			return PieAnimationHelper.CalculateWidenStartAngle(startAngle, sweepAngle, CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(sweepAngle, progress));
		}

		public override float CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			float num = CorrectProgress(progress);
			return Math.Max(1f, num * sweepAngle);
		}
	}
