	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieFanAnimation")]
	public sealed class PieFanAnimation : PieAnimationBase
	{
		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuarticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PieFanAnimation();
		}

		public override float CalculateAnimatedStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			PieAnglesTransform pieAnglesTransform = PieAnglesTransform.Create(base.Owner as PieSeriesViewBase);
			float startAngle2 = pieAnglesTransform.TransformStartAngle(startAngle, sweepAngle) * progress;
			return pieAnglesTransform.TransformStartAngleBack(startAngle2, sweepAngle * progress);
		}

		public override float CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			return sweepAngle * progress;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieFanGrowUpAnimation")]
	public sealed class PieFanGrowUpAnimation : PieAnimationBase
	{
		protected override EasingFunctionBase GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuarticEasingFunction(EasingMode.Out);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PieFanGrowUpAnimation();
		}

		public override void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, RectangleF diagramBounds, PieSeriesPointLayoutParameters pieParameters, float progress)
		{
			PointF offset = PieAnimationHelper.CalculateGrowUpOffset(pieParameters.Bounds, progress);
			modifier.Translate(offset);
			modifier.Scale(progress, progress);
		}

		public override float CalculateAnimatedStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			PieAnglesTransform pieAnglesTransform = PieAnglesTransform.Create(base.Owner as PieSeriesViewBase);
			float startAngle2 = pieAnglesTransform.TransformStartAngle(startAngle, sweepAngle) * progress;
			return pieAnglesTransform.TransformStartAngleBack(startAngle2, sweepAngle * progress);
		}

		public override float CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			return sweepAngle * progress;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PieSpinAnimationBase : PieAnimationBase
	{
		private const PieSweepDirection DefaultDirection = PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise;

		private const float DefaultRotationCount = 1.5f;

		private PieSweepDirection direction;

		private float rotationCount = 1.5f;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSpinAnimationBase.Direction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSpinAnimationBase.Direction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public PieSweepDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSpinAnimationBase.RotationCount")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSpinAnimationBase.RotationCount")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public float RotationCount
		{
			get
			{
				return rotationCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(value) || (double)value <= 0.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTurnsNumber), "value");
				}
				if (rotationCount != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					rotationCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotationCount()
		{
			return rotationCount != 1.5f;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
		}

		private void ResetRotationCount()
		{
			RotationCount = 1.5f;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeDirection())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRotationCount();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			if (propertyName == "RotationCount")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRotationCount();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		internal PieSpinAnimationBase()
		{
		}

		public override float CalculateAnimatedStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float progress)
		{
			float num = RotationCount * 360f * (1f - progress);
			float num2 = ((Direction == PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise) ? (0f - num) : num);
			return startAngle + num2;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PieSpinAnimationBase pieSpinAnimationBase)
			{
				direction = pieSpinAnimationBase.direction;
				rotationCount = pieSpinAnimationBase.rotationCount;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisCoordinate : ChartElement
	{
		private Axis2D axis;

		private object axisValue;

		private string deserializedAxisName;

		private string deserializedAxisValue;

		internal PaneAnchorPoint AnchorPoint => (PaneAnchorPoint)base.Owner;

		internal Axis2D ActualAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return axis;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != axis)
				{
					CheckAxis(value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					axis = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool Visible => CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsAxisValueVisible(axis, axisValue);

		internal double Value => axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(axisValue);

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisCoordinate.AxisValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisCoordinate.AxisValue")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(AxisValueTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public object AxisValue
		{
			get
			{
				return axisValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisCoordinateAxisValue));
				}
				if (value != axisValue)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetAxisValue(axis, value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string AxisValueSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return SerializingUtils.ConvertToSerializable(AxisValue);
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedAxisValue = value;
				AxisValue = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string AxisName
		{
			get
			{
				if (axis != null)
				{
					return axis.Name;
				}
				Axis2D defaultAxis = GetDefaultAxis();
				if (defaultAxis != null)
				{
					return defaultAxis.Name;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedAxisName = value;
			}
		}

		protected AxisCoordinate(PaneAnchorPoint owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisName()
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				return axis != GetDefaultAxis();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "AxisName")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAxisName();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		internal void SetAxisValue(Axis2D axis, object value)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			axisValue = ((axis == null || Loading) ? value : axis.ConvertBasedOnScaleType(value));
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = AnchorPoint.XYDiagram;
			if (xYDiagram != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializedAxisName))
			{
				axis = FindAxisByName(deserializedAxisName);
				deserializedAxisName = string.Empty;
			}
			if (axis == null)
			{
				axis = GetDefaultAxis();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAxisValue()
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)axis).AxisScaleTypeMap;
				if (axisValue == null)
				{
					IVisualAxisRangeData visualRangeData = axis.VisualRangeData;
					axisValue = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative((visualRangeData.Min + visualRangeData.Max) / 2.0);
				}
				else
				{
					CultureInfo culture = ((deserializedAxisValue != null && deserializedAxisValue.Equals(axisValue)) ? CultureInfo.InvariantCulture : CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					axisValue = axisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(axisValue, culture);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void CheckAxis(Axis2D axis);

		protected abstract Axis2D FindAxisByName(string axisName);

		protected abstract Axis2D GetDefaultAxis();

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AxisCoordinate axisCoordinate)
			{
				deserializedAxisName = axisCoordinate.AxisName;
				axisValue = axisCoordinate.axisValue;
				deserializedAxisValue = axisCoordinate.deserializedAxisValue;
			}
		}
	}

		private ScrollBarAnnotation valueScrollBarAnnotation;

		private string deserializedPaneName;

		internal XYDiagram2D XYDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				Annotation annotation = base.Annotation;
				if (annotation == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (annotation.Owner is DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
				{
					return chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool LabelModeSupported => true;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PaneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate")]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PaneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate")]

			{
				return pane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pane)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetPane(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]

		{
			get
			{
				if (pane != null)
				{
					return pane.Name;
				}
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = XYDiagram;
				if (xYDiagram != null)
				{
					return xYDiagram.DefaultPane.Name;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedPaneName = value;
			}

		{
			axisXCoordinate = new AxisXCoordinate(this);
			axisYCoordinate = new AxisYCoordinate(this);

			if (pane == null)

				return false;

			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = XYDiagram;
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				return pane != xYDiagram.DefaultPane;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAxisXCoordinate() && !ShouldSerializeAxisYCoordinate())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePaneName();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"AxisXCoordinate" => ShouldSerializeAxisXCoordinate(), 
				"AxisYCoordinate" => ShouldSerializeAxisYCoordinate(), 
				"PaneName" => ShouldSerializePaneName(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		internal void SetPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullPaneAnchorPointPane));
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = XYDiagram;
			if (xYDiagram != null && pane != xYDiagram.DefaultPane && !xYDiagram.Panes.Contains(pane))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPaneAnchorPointPane));
			}
			this.pane = pane;
		}

		internal void SetPosition(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY, object axisXValue, object axisYValue)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			axisXCoordinate.SetAxisValue(axisX, axisXValue);
			axisYCoordinate.SetAxisValue(axisY, axisYValue);
		}

		internal IScrollBarAnnotation GetScrollBarAnnotation(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (Pane == pane)
			{
				if (axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					if (AxisYCoordinate.Axis == axis)
					{
						if (valueScrollBarAnnotation == null)
						{
							valueScrollBarAnnotation = new ScrollBarAnnotation(base.Annotation);
						}
						valueScrollBarAnnotation.AxisValue = AxisYCoordinate.Value;
					}
					else
					{
						valueScrollBarAnnotation = null;
					}
					return valueScrollBarAnnotation;
				}
				if (AxisXCoordinate.Axis == axis)
				{
					if (argumentScrollBarAnnotation == null)
					{
						argumentScrollBarAnnotation = new ScrollBarAnnotation(base.Annotation);
					}
					argumentScrollBarAnnotation.AxisValue = AxisXCoordinate.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					argumentScrollBarAnnotation = null;
				}
				return argumentScrollBarAnnotation;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PaneAnchorPoint();
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = XYDiagram;
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializedPaneName))
				{
					pane = xYDiagram.FindPaneByName(deserializedPaneName);
					deserializedPaneName = string.Empty;
				}
				if (pane == null)
				{
					pane = xYDiagram.DefaultPane;
				}
			}
			axisXCoordinate.OnEndLoading();
			axisYCoordinate.OnEndLoading();
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint GetAnchorPoint(ZPlaneRectangle viewport)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint)
			{
				axisXCoordinate.Assign(paneAnchorPoint.axisXCoordinate);
				axisYCoordinate.Assign(paneAnchorPoint.axisYCoordinate);
				PaneName = paneAnchorPoint.PaneName;
			}
		}
	}

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnchorPoint")]
	public class SeriesPointAnchorPoint : AnnotationAnchorPoint, ISupportInitialize, IXtraSerializable
	{
		private const int defaultID = -1;

		private int seriesPointID = -1;

		private int seriesID = -1;

		private bool loading;

		private Series series;

		private SeriesPoint point;

		private ScrollBarAnnotation argumentScrollBarAnnotation;

		private ScrollBarAnnotation valueScrollBarAnnotation;

		protected internal Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (series != null)
				{
					return series;
				}
				if (base.Chart == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.Chart.Series.GetSeriesByID(seriesID);
			}
			set
			{
				series = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return base.Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool LabelModeSupported
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series != null)
				{
					return Series.View.AnnotationLabelModeSupported;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int SeriesID
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					return seriesID;
				}
				return series.SeriesID;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInternalPropertyChangeError));
				}
				seriesID = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int SeriesPointID
		{
			get
			{
				if (point == null)
				{
					return seriesPointID;
				}
				return point.SeriesPointID;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInternalPropertyChangeError));
				}
				seriesPointID = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnchorPoint.SeriesPoint")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointAnchorPoint.SeriesPoint")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.AnchorPointSeriesPointEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (point == null)
				{
					point = Series.GetPointByID(seriesPointID);
				}
				return point;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckSeriesPoint(value);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				SetSeriesPoint(value);
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointAnchorPoint()
		{
		}

		public SeriesPointAnchorPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			CheckSeriesPoint(point);
			SetSeriesPoint(point);
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			loading = true;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			loading = false;
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnStartSerializing()
		{
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnEndSerializing()
		{
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnStartDeserializing(LayoutAllowEventArgs e)
		{
			((ISupportInitialize)this).BeginInit();
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnEndDeserializing(string restoredVersion)
		{
			((ISupportInitialize)this).EndInit();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SeriesPointID"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SeriesID")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeSeriesID();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeSeriesPointID();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesID()
		{
			return SeriesID != -1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesPointID()
		{
			return SeriesPointID != -1;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesPointID())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesID();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CheckSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullAnchorPointSeriesPoint));
			}
			if (point.Series == null || point.Series.Owner == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAnchorPointSeriesPoint));
			}
		}

		internal void SetSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			this.point = point;
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				this.point.UpdateAnnotations();
			}
			Series = point.Series;
		}

		internal SeriesPoint GetUserSeriesPoint()
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint;
			if (seriesPoint == null || seriesPoint.SourcePoints == null || seriesPoint.SourcePoints.Count <= 0)
			{
				return seriesPoint;
			}
			return seriesPoint.SourcePoints[0];
		}

		internal IScrollBarAnnotation GetScrollBarAnnotation(RefinedPoint point, XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Axis2D axis)
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase = Series?.View as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
			if (SeriesPoint != null && xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase != null && xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualPane == pane)
			{
				if (axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY == axis)
					{
						if (valueScrollBarAnnotation == null)
						{
							valueScrollBarAnnotation = new ScrollBarAnnotation(base.Annotation);
						}
						valueScrollBarAnnotation.AxisValue = point.GetValue((ValueLevelInternal)xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.DefaultValueLevel);
					}
					else
					{
						valueScrollBarAnnotation = null;
					}
					return valueScrollBarAnnotation;
				}
				if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX == axis)
				{
					if (argumentScrollBarAnnotation == null)
					{
						argumentScrollBarAnnotation = new ScrollBarAnnotation(base.Annotation);
					}
					argumentScrollBarAnnotation.AxisValue = point.Argument;
				}
				else
				{
					argumentScrollBarAnnotation = null;
				}
				return argumentScrollBarAnnotation;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			if (point != null)
			{
				point.UpdateAnnotations();
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesPointAnchorPoint();
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint GetAnchorPoint(ZPlaneRectangle viewport)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint)
			{
				seriesPointID = seriesPointAnchorPoint.SeriesPointID;
				seriesID = seriesPointAnchorPoint.SeriesID;
			}
		}
	}

		public Annotation(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
			backColor = DefaultBackColor;
			border = new CustomBorder(this, visible: true, Color.Empty);
			fillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this);
			padding = new RectangleIndents(this, 3);
			shadow = new Shadow(this);
			SetShapePosition(new FreePosition());
			SetAnchorPoint(new ChartAnchorPoint());
			CreateShape();
			anchorPointSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<AnnotationAnchorPoint>(() => AnchorPoint, delegate(AnnotationAnchorPoint value)
			{
				AnchorPoint = value;
			});
			shapePositionSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<AnnotationShapePosition>(() => ShapePosition, delegate(AnnotationShapePosition value)
			{
				ShapePosition = value;
			});
		}

		bool IAnnotationShapeOwner.CanDrag()
		{
			return CanDrag();
		}

		{
			loading = true;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			loading = false;
		}

		void IAnnotationDragElement.DoSelect()
		{
			if (CanDrag() || RuntimeEditing)
			{
				RuntimeOperationSelect = true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"TypeNameSerializable" => true, 
				"ShapePosition" => true, 
				"AnchorPoint" => true, 
				"Height" => ShouldSerializeHeight(), 
				"Width" => ShouldSerializeWidth(), 
				"Shadow" => ShouldSerializeShadow(), 
				"Angle" => ShouldSerializeAngle(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"ShapeKind" => ShouldSerializeShapeKind(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"ShapeFillet" => ShouldSerializeShapeFillet(), 
				"ConnectorStyle" => ShouldSerializeConnectorStyle(), 
				"Padding" => ShouldSerializePadding(), 
				"RuntimeAnchoring" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeAnchoring(), 
				"RuntimeMoving" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeMoving(), 
				"RuntimeResizing" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeResizing(), 
				"RuntimeRotation" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeRotation(), 
				"ZOrder" => ShouldSerializeZOrder(), 
				"LabelMode" => ShouldSerializeLabelMode(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeHeight()
		{
			return !autoHeight;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWidth()
		{
			return !autoWidth;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAnchorPoint()
		{
			if (anchorPoint != null && ChartContainer != null)
			{
				return ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAnchorPoint()
		{
			AnchorPoint = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAnchorPointSerializable()
		{
			if (anchorPoint != null && ChartContainer != null)
			{
				return ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShapePosition()
		{

		}

			ShapePosition = null;

			{
				return shapeFillet != 5;

			return false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeHeight() && !ShouldSerializeWidth() && !ShouldSerializeAnchorPoint() && !ShouldSerializeAnchorPointSerializable() && !ShouldSerializeShapePosition() && !ShouldSerializeShapePositionSerializable() && !ShouldSerializeShadow() && !ShouldSerializeAngle() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeShapeKind() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeShapeFillet() && !ShouldSerializeConnectorStyle() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeAnchoring() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeMoving() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeResizing() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeRotation() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeEditing() && !ShouldSerializeZOrder() && !ShouldSerializeLabelMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePadding();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanPerformAnnotationOperation(bool runtimeOperationEnabled)
		{
			IChartContainer chartContainer = CommonUtils.FindChartContainer(this);
			if (!ActualLabelMode && chartContainer != null)
			{
				if (!chartContainer.DesignMode)
				{
					return chartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WinControl && !chartContainer.Chart.Is3DDiagram && runtimeOperationEnabled;
				}
				return chartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AssignAnchorPoint(AnnotationAnchorPoint templateAnchorPoint)
		{
			if (!anchorPoint.GetType().Equals(templateAnchorPoint.GetType()))
			{
				SetAnchorPoint((AnnotationAnchorPoint)templateAnchorPoint.Clone());
			}
			else
			{
				anchorPoint.Assign(templateAnchorPoint);
			}
		}

		private void AssignShapePosition(AnnotationShapePosition templateShapePosition)
		{
			if (!shapePosition.GetType().Equals(templateShapePosition.GetType()))
			{
				SetShapePosition((AnnotationShapePosition)templateShapePosition.Clone());
			}
			else
			{
				shapePosition.Assign(templateShapePosition);
			}
		}

		private void CreateShape()
		{
			shape = AnnotationShape.CreateInstance(this);
		}

		private void SetAnchorPoint(AnnotationAnchorPoint value)
		{
			anchorPoint = value;
			anchorPoint.Owner = this;
		}

		private void SetShapePosition(AnnotationShapePosition value)
		{
			shapePosition = value;
			shapePosition.Owner = this;
		}

		protected abstract Size CalculateInnerSize();

		protected void SaveLayout(DiagramPoint location, DiagramPoint anchorPosition)
		{
			lastAnchorPosition = anchorPosition;
			lastLocation = location;
		}

		internal bool CanDrag()
		{
			if (visible && (CanPerformMoving || CanPerformResizing || CanPerformAnchoring || CanPerformRotation))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateSize()
		{
			if (autoHeight || autoWidth)
			{
				Size innerSize = CalculateInnerSize();
				Size size = Shape.CalcOuterSize(innerSize);
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
				size.Width += dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right;
				size.Height += dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom;
				if (Border != null && Border.ActualVisibility)
				{
					size.Height += Border.ActualThickness * 2;
					size.Width += Border.ActualThickness * 2;
				}
				if (autoHeight)
				{
					height = size.Height;
				}
				if (autoWidth)
				{
					width = size.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (anchorPoint != null)
			{
				anchorPoint.OnEndLoading();
			}
			if (shapePosition != null)
			{
				shapePosition.OnEndLoading();
			}
		}

		internal void SetHeight(int value)
		{
			if (value > 0)
			{
				height = value;
				OnHeightChanged();
				autoHeight = false;
			}
		}

		internal void SetWidth(int value)
		{
			if (value > 0)
			{
				width = value;
				OnWeightChanged();
				autoWidth = false;
			}
		}

		internal void SetAngle(int value)
		{
			angle = value;
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeightChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnWeightChanged()
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract AnnotationViewData CalculateViewData(AnnotationLayout shapeLayout, AnnotationLayout anchorPointLayout);

		protected internal abstract AnnotationViewData CalculateViewData(AnnotationLayout shapeLayout, AnnotationLayout anchorPointLayout, Rectangle allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing);

		protected override bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (base.Chart != null)
			{
				UpdateSize();
			}
			return base.ProcessChanged(sender, change);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Annotation annotation)
			{
				AssignAnchorPoint(annotation.anchorPoint);
				AssignShapePosition(annotation.shapePosition);
				shadow.Assign(annotation.shadow);
				height = annotation.height;
				autoHeight = annotation.autoHeight;
				width = annotation.width;
				autoWidth = annotation.autoWidth;
				angle = annotation.angle;
				connectorStyle = annotation.ConnectorStyle;
				backColor = annotation.backColor;
				visible = annotation.visible;
				shapeKind = annotation.shapeKind;
				shapeFillet = annotation.shapeFillet;
				runtimeAnchoring = annotation.runtimeAnchoring;
				runtimeMoving = annotation.runtimeMoving;
				runtimeResizing = annotation.runtimeResizing;
				runtimeRotation = annotation.runtimeRotation;
				runtimeEditing = annotation.runtimeEditing;
				zOrder = annotation.zOrder;
				labelMode = annotation.labelMode;
				border.Assign(annotation.border);
				fillStyle.Assign(annotation.fillStyle);
				padding.Assign(annotation.padding);
				id = annotation.id;
				if (!Loading)
				{
					anchorPoint.OnEndLoading();
					shapePosition.OnEndLoading();
				}
				CreateShape();
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartCollectionSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnnotationRepository")]
	public class AnnotationRepository : DisposableChartElementNamedCollection, IAnnotationCollection
	{
		private readonly DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart;

		protected override string NamePrefix => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AnnotationPrefix);

		public Annotation this[int index] => (Annotation)base.List[index];

		public Annotation this[string name] => (Annotation)GetElementByName(name);

		ChartElement IAnnotationCollection.Owner => base.Owner;

		internal AnnotationRepository(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			base.Owner = chart;
		}

		int IAnnotationCollection.Add(Annotation annotation)
		{
			chart.ArrangeAnnotation(annotation);
			return Add(annotation);
		}

		public int Add(Annotation annotation)
		{
			annotation.Owner = chart;
			return Add((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public void AddRange(Annotation[] coll)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in coll)
			{
				Add(annotation);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(Annotation annotation)
		{
			return base.Contains((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public bool HasSeriesPointAnchoredAnnotations()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				Annotation annotation = this[i];
				if (annotation != null && annotation.AnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint && ((SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint).GetUserSeriesPoint() != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Annotation annotation)
			{
				return Contains(annotation);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void RemoveWithoutChanged(Annotation annotation)
		{
			RemoveWithoutChanged((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Annotation annotation)
		{
			return IndexOf((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Annotation annotation)
		{
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public void Remove(Annotation annotation)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public void Swap(Annotation annotation1, Annotation annotation2)
		{
			Swap((ChartElement)annotation1, (ChartElement)annotation2);
		}

		public new Annotation[] ToArray()
		{
			return (Annotation[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(Annotation));
		}

		internal IList<AnnotationViewData> CreateViewData(DiagramViewData diagramViewData, ZPlaneRectangle innerBounds)
		{
			List<AnnotationLayout> list = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Annotation annotation = (Annotation)enumerator.Current;
					if (annotation.AnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint chartAnchorPoint)
					{
						list.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, chartAnchorPoint.GetAnchorPoint(innerBounds)));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			Dictionary<Annotation, AnnotationLayout> dictionary = new Dictionary<Annotation, AnnotationLayout>();
			foreach (AnnotationLayout item in AnnotationHelper.CreateFreeAnnotationsShapesLayout(this, null, innerBounds))
			{
				dictionary.Add(item.Annotation, item);
			}
			if (diagramViewData != null)
			{
				if (diagramViewData.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(diagramViewData.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout);
				}
				if (diagramViewData.AnnotationsShapesLayout != null)
				{
					foreach (AnnotationLayout item2 in diagramViewData.AnnotationsShapesLayout)
					{
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item2.Annotation))
						{
							dictionary.Add(item2.Annotation, item2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			List<AnnotationViewData> list2 = new List<AnnotationViewData>();
			foreach (AnnotationLayout item3 in list)
			{
				Annotation annotation2 = item3.Annotation;
				RelativePosition relativePosition = annotation2.ShapePosition as RelativePosition;
				AnnotationLayout annotationLayout = null;
				if (relativePosition != null)
				{
					annotationLayout = new AnnotationLayout(annotation2, relativePosition.GetShapeLocation(item3.Position));
				}
				else
				{
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(annotation2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					annotationLayout = dictionary[annotation2];
				}
				AnnotationViewData annotationViewData = annotation2.CalculateViewData(annotationLayout, item3);
				if (annotationViewData != null)
				{
					list2.Add(annotationViewData);
				}
			}
			list2.Sort(AnnotationHelper.CompareByAnnotationZOrder);
			return list2;
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsertComplete(index, value);
			if (value is Annotation annotation)
			{
				annotation.UpdateSize();
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AnnotationCollection")]
	public class AnnotationCollection : ChartCollectionBase, IAnnotationCollection
	{
		private bool repositoryUpdateLocked;

		private AnnotationCollectionBehavior collectionBehavior;

		private AnnotationRepository AnnotationRepository => collectionBehavior.AnnotationRepository;

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateExpressions => false;

		public Annotation this[int index] => (Annotation)base.List[index];

		ChartElement IAnnotationCollection.Owner => collectionBehavior.Owner;

		internal AnnotationCollection(AnnotationCollectionBehavior collectionBehavior)
		{
			this.collectionBehavior = collectionBehavior;
			base.Owner = collectionBehavior.Owner;
		}

		string IAnnotationCollection.GenerateName(string namePrefix)
		{
			if (AnnotationRepository == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return AnnotationRepository.GenerateName(namePrefix);
		}

		int IAnnotationCollection.Add(Annotation annotation)
		{
			return Add(annotation);
		}

		Annotation[] IAnnotationCollection.ToArray()
		{
			Update();
			return ToArray();
		}

		private int Add(Annotation annotation)
		{
			collectionBehavior.ArrangeAnnotation(annotation);
			if (AnnotationRepository != null)
			{
				AnnotationRepository.Add(annotation);
			}
			if (Contains(annotation))
			{
				return IndexOf(annotation);
			}
			return AddWithoutChanged(annotation);
		}

		protected internal override void SendControlChanging()
		{
		}

		protected override void ChangeOwnerForItem(ChartElement item)
		{
		}

		protected override void DisposeItemBeforeRemove(ChartElement item)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
			if (!repositoryUpdateLocked && AnnotationRepository != null && value is Annotation)
			{
				AnnotationRepository.Remove(value as Annotation);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			if (!repositoryUpdateLocked && AnnotationRepository != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					AnnotationRepository.RemoveWithoutChanged(this[i]);
				}
			}
			base.OnClear();
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			if (AnnotationRepository == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				repositoryUpdateLocked = true;
				Clear();
				Annotation[] array = AnnotationRepository.ToArray();
				foreach (Annotation annotation in array)
				{
					if (collectionBehavior.CheckAnnotation(annotation) && !Contains(annotation))
					{
						AddWithoutChanged(annotation);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				repositoryUpdateLocked = false;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAnnotationRepository()
		{
			if (AnnotationRepository == null || base.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				Annotation annotation = this[i];
				AnnotationRepository.BeginUpdate();
				if (!AnnotationRepository.Contains(annotation))
				{
					AnnotationRepository.Add(annotation);
				}
				AnnotationRepository.EndUpdate();
			}
			try
			{
				repositoryUpdateLocked = true;
				Clear();
			}
			finally
			{
				repositoryUpdateLocked = false;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearAnnotations()
		{
			if (AnnotationRepository == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Annotation> list = new List<Annotation>();
			Annotation[] array = AnnotationRepository.ToArray();
			foreach (Annotation annotation in array)
			{
				if (collectionBehavior.CheckAnnotation(annotation))
				{
					list.Add(annotation);
				}
			}
			foreach (Annotation item in list)
			{
				AnnotationRepository.RemoveWithoutChanged(item);
			}
		}

		public TextAnnotation AddTextAnnotation()
		{
			return AddTextAnnotation(string.Empty);
		}

		public TextAnnotation AddTextAnnotation(string name)
		{
			TextAnnotation textAnnotation = new TextAnnotation(name);
			Add(textAnnotation);
			return textAnnotation;
		}

		public TextAnnotation AddTextAnnotation(string name, string text)
		{
			TextAnnotation textAnnotation = new TextAnnotation(name, text);
			Add(textAnnotation);
			return textAnnotation;
		}

		public ImageAnnotation AddImageAnnotation()
		{
			return AddImageAnnotation(string.Empty);
		}

		public ImageAnnotation AddImageAnnotation(string name)
		{
			return AddImageAnnotation(name, string.Empty);
		}

		public ImageAnnotation AddImageAnnotation(string name, string imageUrl)
		{
			ImageAnnotation imageAnnotation = new ImageAnnotation(name, imageUrl);
			Add(imageAnnotation);
			return imageAnnotation;
		}

		public ImageAnnotation AddImageAnnotation(string name, DXImage image)
		{
			ImageAnnotation imageAnnotation = new ImageAnnotation(name, image);
			Add(imageAnnotation);
			return imageAnnotation;
		}

		public bool Contains(Annotation annotation)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Annotation annotation)
		{
			return IndexOf((ChartElement)annotation);
		}

		public void Remove(Annotation annotation)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)annotation);
			if (AnnotationRepository != null)
			{
				AnnotationRepository.Remove(annotation);
			}
		}

		public void Swap(Annotation annotation1, Annotation annotation2)
		{
			Swap((ChartElement)annotation1, (ChartElement)annotation2);
			if (AnnotationRepository != null)
			{
				AnnotationRepository.Swap(annotation1, annotation2);
			}
		}

		public new void Swap(int index1, int index2)
		{
			if (index1 < 0 || index1 >= base.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgItemNotInCollection), "index1");
			}
			if (index2 < 0 || index2 >= base.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgItemNotInCollection), "index2");
			}
			if (AnnotationRepository != null)
			{
				AnnotationRepository.Swap(this[index1], this[index2]);
			}
			base.Swap(index1, index2);
		}

		public new Annotation[] ToArray()
		{
			return (Annotation[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(Annotation));
		}
	}

		protected override void OnWeightChanged()
		{

				return null;

			return new ImageAnnotationViewData(this, base.Shape, anchorPointLayout.RefinedPoint, anchorPointLayout.Position, shapeLayout.Position, allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing);
		}

			if (obj is ImageAnnotation imageAnnotation)
			{
				sizeMode = imageAnnotation.sizeMode;
				image.Assign(imageAnnotation.image);
			}
		}

		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

	{

		LeftBottom = 3,

	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(FreePositionTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition")]

		private readonly RectangleIndents innerIndents;

		private readonly RectangleIndents outerIndents;

		private IDockTarget dockTarget;

		private DockCorner dockCorner = DockCorner.LeftTop;

		private string deserializedDockTargetName;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition.DockCorner")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition.DockCorner")]

		[Browsable(false)]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition.DockTarget")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition.DockTarget")]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition.OuterIndents")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FreePosition.OuterIndents")]

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]

		public RectangleIndents OuterIndents => outerIndents;

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"DockCorner" => ShouldSerializeDockCorner(), 
				"InnerIndents" => ShouldSerializeInnerIndents(), 
				"OuterIndents" => ShouldSerializeOuterIndents(), 
				"DockTargetName" => ShouldSerializeDockTargetName(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockCorner()
		{
			return dockCorner != DockCorner.LeftTop;
		}

		private void ResetDockCorner()
		{
			DockCorner = DockCorner.LeftTop;

			return innerIndents.ShouldSerialize();

		private bool ShouldSerializeOuterIndents()

			return outerIndents.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		{
			return dockTarget != null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeDockCorner() && !ShouldSerializeInnerIndents() && !ShouldSerializeOuterIndents())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDockTargetName();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public FreePosition()
		{
			innerIndents = new RectangleIndents(this, 10);
			outerIndents = new RectangleIndents(this, 0);
		}

		private void EnsureDockTarget()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = CommonUtils.GetXYDiagram2D(this);
			if (xYDiagram2D != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializedDockTargetName))
			{
				dockTarget = xYDiagram2D.FindPaneByName(deserializedDockTargetName);
			}
		}

		private void SetDockTarget(ChartElement value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				CommonUtils.CheckDockTarget(value, this);
			}
			dockTarget = value as IDockTarget;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FreePosition();
		}

		protected internal DiagramPoint GetShapeLocation(ZPlaneRectangle viewport)
		{
			GetIndents(out var left, out var top, out var right, out var bottom);
			return DockCorner switch
			{
				DockCorner.LeftTop => new DiagramPoint(viewport.Left + (double)left, viewport.Bottom + (double)top), 
				DockCorner.LeftBottom => new DiagramPoint(viewport.Left + (double)left, viewport.Top - (double)bottom - (double)base.Annotation.Height), 
				DockCorner.RightTop => new DiagramPoint(viewport.Right - (double)right - (double)base.Annotation.Width, viewport.Bottom + (double)top), 
				DockCorner.RightBottom => new DiagramPoint(viewport.Right - (double)right - (double)base.Annotation.Width, viewport.Top - (double)bottom - (double)base.Annotation.Height), 
				_ => new DiagramPoint(viewport.Left, viewport.Top), 
			};
		}

		internal void GetIndents(out int left, out int top, out int right, out int bottom)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = innerIndents.DpiScaledThickness;
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness2 = outerIndents.DpiScaledThickness;
			left = dpiScaledThickness.Left - dpiScaledThickness2.Left;
			right = dpiScaledThickness.Right - dpiScaledThickness2.Right;
			bottom = dpiScaledThickness.Bottom - dpiScaledThickness2.Bottom;
			top = dpiScaledThickness.Top - dpiScaledThickness2.Top;
			left = ((left > 0) ? Math.Min(left, 536870911) : Math.Max(left, -536870911));
			right = ((right > 0) ? Math.Min(right, 536870911) : Math.Max(right, -536870911));
			bottom = ((bottom > 0) ? Math.Min(bottom, 536870911) : Math.Max(bottom, -536870911));
			top = ((top > 0) ? Math.Min(top, 536870911) : Math.Max(top, -536870911));
		}

		internal void SetLeftIndent(int value)
		{
			if (value > 0)
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(value, innerIndents.Top, innerIndents.Right, innerIndents.Bottom);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(0, outerIndents.Top, outerIndents.Right, outerIndents.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(0, innerIndents.Top, innerIndents.Right, innerIndents.Bottom);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(-value, outerIndents.Top, outerIndents.Right, outerIndents.Bottom);
			}
		}

		internal void SetTopIndent(int value)
		{
			if (value > 0)
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(innerIndents.Left, value, innerIndents.Right, innerIndents.Bottom);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(outerIndents.Left, 0, outerIndents.Right, outerIndents.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(innerIndents.Left, 0, innerIndents.Right, innerIndents.Bottom);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(outerIndents.Left, -value, outerIndents.Right, outerIndents.Bottom);
			}
		}

		internal void SetRightIndent(int value)
		{
			if (value > 0)
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(innerIndents.Left, innerIndents.Top, value, innerIndents.Bottom);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(outerIndents.Left, outerIndents.Top, 0, outerIndents.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(innerIndents.Left, innerIndents.Top, 0, innerIndents.Bottom);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(outerIndents.Left, outerIndents.Top, -value, outerIndents.Bottom);
			}
		}

		internal void SetBottomIndent(int value)
		{
			if (value > 0)
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(innerIndents.Left, innerIndents.Top, innerIndents.Right, value);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(outerIndents.Left, outerIndents.Top, outerIndents.Right, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				innerIndents.SetIndents(innerIndents.Left, innerIndents.Top, innerIndents.Right, 0);
				outerIndents.SetIndents(outerIndents.Left, outerIndents.Top, outerIndents.Right, -value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			EnsureDockTarget();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FreePosition freePosition)
			{
				dockTarget = freePosition.dockTarget;
				DockTargetName = freePosition.DockTargetName;
				dockCorner = freePosition.dockCorner;
				innerIndents.Assign(freePosition.innerIndents);
				outerIndents.Assign(freePosition.outerIndents);
			}
		}
	}

	{
		string Name { get; }
	}

	public class RelativePosition : AnnotationShapePosition
	{
		private const double DefaultAngle = 45.0;

		private const double DefaultConnectorLength = 40.0;

		private double angle;

		private double connectorLength;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RelativePosition.ConnectorLength")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RelativePosition.ConnectorLength")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double ConnectorLength
		{
			get
			{
				return connectorLength;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0.0 || value >= 1000.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectRelativePositionConnectorLength));
				}
				if (value != connectorLength)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					connectorLength = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RelativePosition.Angle")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RelativePosition.Angle")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return angle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != angle)
				{
					if (value < -360.0 || value > 360.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectRelativePositionAngle));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					angle = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Angle")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAngle();
			}
			if (propertyName == "ConnectorLength")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeConnectorLength();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAngle()
		{
			return angle != 45.0;
		}

		private void ResetAngle()
		{
			Angle = 45.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeConnectorLength()
		{
			return connectorLength != 40.0;
		}

		private void ResetConnectorLength()
		{
			ConnectorLength = 40.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public RelativePosition()
			: this(45.0, 40.0)
		{
		}

		public RelativePosition(double angle, double connectorLength)
		{
			this.angle = angle;
			this.connectorLength = connectorLength;
		}

		private double GetCorrectedAngleInRadian()
		{
			return MathUtils.Degree2Radian(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(0.0 - Angle));
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RelativePosition();
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
		}

		internal DiagramPoint GetShapeLocation(DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			double correctedAngleInRadian = GetCorrectedAngleInRadian();
			base.Annotation.UpdateSize();
			DiagramPoint point = new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X + connectorLength * Math.Cos(correctedAngleInRadian) - (double)base.Annotation.Width / 2.0, anchorPoint.Y + connectorLength * Math.Sin(correctedAngleInRadian) - (double)base.Annotation.Height / 2.0);
			return MathUtils.StrongRoundXY(point);
		}

		internal void SetAngle(double value)
		{
			angle = value;
		}

		internal void SetConnectorLength(double value)
		{
			connectorLength = value;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RelativePosition relativePosition)
			{
				angle = relativePosition.angle;
				connectorLength = relativePosition.connectorLength;
			}
		}
	}

		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeTextColor() && !ShouldSerializeDXFont() && !ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing() && !ShouldSerializeTextAlignment())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAutoSize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override Size CalculateInnerSize()
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat();
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)TextAlignment;
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			SimpleTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider = new SimpleTextPropertiesProvider(fontController.DXFont, dXStringFormat);
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.StringInfo stringInfo = new DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.StringInfo(text, propertiesProvider, TextMeasurer.Default);
			return new Size(MathUtils.Ceiling(stringInfo.Size.Width), MathUtils.Ceiling(stringInfo.Size.Height));
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new TextAnnotation();
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationViewData CalculateViewData(AnnotationLayout shapeLayout, AnnotationLayout anchorPointLayout)
		{
			SaveLayout(shapeLayout.Position, anchorPointLayout.Position);
			if (!base.Visible || ChartContainer == null || ChartContainer.Chart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new TextAnnotationViewData(this, base.Shape, anchorPointLayout.RefinedPoint, anchorPointLayout.Position, shapeLayout.Position);
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationViewData CalculateViewData(AnnotationLayout shapeLayout, AnnotationLayout anchorPointLayout, Rectangle allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing)
		{
			SaveLayout(shapeLayout.Position, anchorPointLayout.Position);
			if (!base.Visible || ChartContainer == null || ChartContainer.Chart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new TextAnnotationViewData(this, base.Shape, anchorPointLayout.RefinedPoint, anchorPointLayout.Position, shapeLayout.Position, allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is TextAnnotation textAnnotation)
			{
				textAlignment = textAnnotation.textAlignment;
				enableAntialiasing = textAnnotation.enableAntialiasing;
				autoSize = textAnnotation.autoSize;
				SetAutoHeightAndWidth(textAnnotation.autoSize);
				text = textAnnotation.text;
				textColor = textAnnotation.textColor;
				fontController.Assign(textAnnotation.fontController);
			}
		}

		void IXtraPartlyDeserializable.Deserialize(object rootObject, IXtraPropertyCollection properties)
		{
			SerializationUtils.ConvertFontToDXFont(properties);
		}

		internal ChartAppearance(ChartStringId nameID, string serializableName, string resourceName)
		{
			this.nameID = nameID;
			this.serializableName = serializableName;
			this.resourceName = resourceName;
			ReadFromXml();
		}

		internal ChartAppearance(ChartStringId nameID, string serializationName, string resourceName, bool isDefault)
			: this(nameID, serializationName, resourceName)
		{
			this.isDefault = isDefault;
		}

		void IChartAppearance.ReadFromXml()
		{
			ReadFromXml();
		}

		private void ReadFromXml()
		{
			using Stream stream = typeof(ChartAppearance).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Appearance.Data." + resourceName);
			using XmlReader xmlReader = SafeXml.CreateReader(stream);
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Appearance");
			paletteName = xmlReader.ReadElementString("PaletteName");
			indicatorsPaletteName = xmlReader.ReadElementString("IndicatorsPaletteName");
			wholeChartAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			legendAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			xyDiagramAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			radarDiagramAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			xyDiagram3DAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			constantLineAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			stripAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			textAnnotationAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			imageAnnotationAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			barSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			areaSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			pieSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			funnelSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			bar3DSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			pie3DSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			markerAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			seriesLabel2DAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			seriesLabel3DAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			stackedBarTotalLabelAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			pieTotalLabelAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			paneTitleAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			scrollBarAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			breadcrumbsAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			waterfallSeriesViewAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			financialSeriesAppearance.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		public virtual void Assign(ChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (appearance == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("appearance");
			}
			paletteName = appearance.paletteName;
			indicatorsPaletteName = appearance.indicatorsPaletteName;
			wholeChartAppearance.Assign(appearance.wholeChartAppearance);
			legendAppearance.Assign(appearance.legendAppearance);
			xyDiagramAppearance.Assign(appearance.xyDiagramAppearance);
			radarDiagramAppearance.Assign(appearance.radarDiagramAppearance);
			xyDiagram3DAppearance.Assign(appearance.xyDiagram3DAppearance);
			constantLineAppearance.Assign(appearance.constantLineAppearance);
			stripAppearance.Assign(appearance.stripAppearance);
			textAnnotationAppearance.Assign(appearance.textAnnotationAppearance);
			imageAnnotationAppearance.Assign(appearance.imageAnnotationAppearance);
			barSeriesViewAppearance.Assign(appearance.barSeriesViewAppearance);
			areaSeriesViewAppearance.Assign(appearance.areaSeriesViewAppearance);
			pieSeriesViewAppearance.Assign(appearance.pieSeriesViewAppearance);
			funnelSeriesViewAppearance.Assign(appearance.funnelSeriesViewAppearance);
			bar3DSeriesViewAppearance.Assign(appearance.bar3DSeriesViewAppearance);
			pie3DSeriesViewAppearance.Assign(appearance.pie3DSeriesViewAppearance);
			markerAppearance.Assign(appearance.markerAppearance);
			seriesLabel2DAppearance.Assign(appearance.seriesLabel2DAppearance);
			seriesLabel3DAppearance.Assign(appearance.seriesLabel3DAppearance);
			stackedBarTotalLabelAppearance.Assign(appearance.stackedBarTotalLabelAppearance);
			pieTotalLabelAppearance.Assign(appearance.pieTotalLabelAppearance);
			scrollBarAppearance.Assign(appearance.scrollBarAppearance);

	public sealed class AppearanceRepository : IEnumerable<ChartAppearance>, IEnumerable
	{
		private static class Appearances
		{

			public const string DefaultName = "Default";

			private static Dictionary<ChartStringId, string> appearanceNameHolder;

			internal static Dictionary<ChartStringId, string> InBoxAppearance
			{
				get
				{
					if (appearanceNameHolder == null)
					{
						appearanceNameHolder = CreateAppearanceNameDictionary();
					}
					return appearanceNameHolder;
				}
			}

			private static Dictionary<ChartStringId, string> CreateAppearanceNameDictionary()
			{

				{

			public static ChartAppearance GetAppearance(string name)
			{
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppDefault) || name == "Default")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppDefault, "Default", "Default.xml", isDefault: true);
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppNatureColors) || name == "Nature Colors")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppNatureColors, "Nature Colors", "NatureColors.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppPastelKit) || name == "Pastel Kit")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppPastelKit, "Pastel Kit", "PastelKit.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppInAFog) || name == "In A Fog")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppInAFog, "In A Fog", "InAFog.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppTerracottaPie) || name == "Terracotta Pie")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppTerracottaPie, "Terracotta Pie", "TerracottaPie.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppNorthernLights) || name == "Northern Lights")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppNorthernLights, "Northern Lights", "NorthernLights.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppChameleon) || name == "Chameleon")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppChameleon, "Chameleon", "Chameleon.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppTheTrees) || name == "The Trees")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppTheTrees, "The Trees", "TheTrees.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppLight) || name == "Light")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppLight, "Light", "Light.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppGray) || name == "Gray")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppGray, "Gray", "Gray.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppDark) || name == "Dark")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppDark, "Dark", "Dark.xml");
				}
				if (name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AppDarkFlat) || name == "Dark Flat")
				{
					return new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppDarkFlat, "Dark Flat", "DarkFlat.xml");
				}
				return null;
			}

			public static string[] GetAllNames()
			{
				string[] array = new string[InBoxAppearance.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ChartStringId, string> item in InBoxAppearance)
				{
					array[num++] = item.Value;
				}
				return array;
			}

			public static string[] GetAllLocalizedNames()
			{
				string[] array = new string[InBoxAppearance.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ChartStringId, string> item in InBoxAppearance)
				{
					array[num++] = ChartLocalizer.GetString(item.Key);
				}
				return array;
			}

			public static string GetNameByLocalizedName(string localizedName)
			{
				string[] allLocalizedNames = GetAllLocalizedNames();
				for (int i = 0; i < allLocalizedNames.Length; i++)
				{
					if (allLocalizedNames[i] == localizedName)
					{
						return GetAllNames()[i];
					}
				}
				return localizedName;
			}
		}

		private List<ChartAppearance> list;

		private readonly ChartAppearance defaultAppearance;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, ChartAppearance> repository = new Dictionary<string, ChartAppearance>();

		internal static ChartAppearance Default => new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppDefault, "Default", "Default.xml", isDefault: true);

		internal static ChartAppearance DefaultBefore19_2 => new ChartAppearance(ChartStringId.AppDefault, "Default", "DefaultBefore19_2.xml", isDefault: true);

		public ChartAppearance this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				string nameByLocalizedName = Appearances.GetNameByLocalizedName(name);
				return GetAppearance(nameByLocalizedName, useDefault: false);
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns an array of strings that are the names of all the appearances in the chart.")]
		public string[] Names => Appearances.GetAllNames();

		[Description("Returns an array of localized appearance names.")]
		public string[] LocalizedNames => Appearances.GetAllLocalizedNames();

		internal AppearanceRepository()
		{
			defaultAppearance = Appearances.GetAppearance("Default");
			RegisterAppearance(defaultAppearance);
		}

		private List<ChartAppearance> GetFullListAppearances()
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new List<ChartAppearance>();
				string[] allNames = Appearances.GetAllNames();
				foreach (string text in allNames)
				{
					if (!repository.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						RegisterAppearance(Appearances.GetAppearance(text));
					}
					list.Add(repository[text]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void RegisterAppearance(ChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (appearance == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Due to the specified 'appearance' parameter is null, the method AppearanceRepository.RegisterAppearance can not be executed.", "appearance");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(appearance.Name) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(appearance.SerializableName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Due to the specified 'appearance' parameter is incorrect, the method AppearanceRepository.RegisterAppearance can not be executed. Name='{appearance.Name}'. SerializableName={appearance.SerializableName}", "appearance");
			}
			repository.Add(appearance.Name, appearance);
			if (appearance.Name != appearance.SerializableName)
			{
				repository.Add(appearance.SerializableName, appearance);
			}
		}

		public ChartAppearance GetAppearance(string name, bool useDefault)
		{
			if (!repository.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				value = Appearances.GetAppearance(name);
				if (value != null)
				{
					RegisterAppearance(value);
				}
			}
			if (!(value == null && useDefault))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return defaultAppearance;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetFullListAppearances().GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<ChartAppearance> IEnumerable<ChartAppearance>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetFullListAppearances().GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartImage")]
	public class ChartImage : ChartElement, IDisposable, ICustomTypeDescriptor
	{
		private class ChartImagePropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
		{
			public ChartImagePropertyDescriptorCollection(ChartImage image, ICollection descriptors)
				: base(new PropertyDescriptor[0])
			{
				//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0051: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0060: Expected O, but got Unknown
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor descriptor in descriptors)
				{
					string name = descriptor.Name;
					PropertyDescriptor value = ((name == "DXImage") ? ((PropertyDescriptor)new CustomPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, image.ImageVisible)) : ((!(name == "ImageUrl")) ? descriptor : ((PropertyDescriptor)new CustomPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, image.ImageUrlVisible))));
					Add(value);
				}
			}
		}

		private DXImage dxImage;

		private string imageUrl = string.Empty;

		protected bool ImageVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartContainer != null)
				{
					return ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool ImageUrlVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartContainer != null)
				{
					return ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool Disposed { get; private set; }

		protected internal bool ShouldDisposeImage { get; set; }

		[Description("Specifies an image to be loaded to the chart control.")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Image Image
		{
			get
			{
				return SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(dxImage);
			}
			set
			{
				DXImage = SystemDrawingConverter.WrapImage(value);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartImage.DXImage")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartImage.DXImage")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[Editor("DevExpress.Drawing.Design.DXImageEditor,DevExpress.Utils.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		public DXImage DXImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (dxImage != null)
				{
					return dxImage;
				}
				if (ChartContainer == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				dxImage = ContainerAdapter.LoadBitmap(imageUrl);
				ShouldDisposeImage = true;
				return dxImage;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dxImage != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					dxImage = value;
					ShouldDisposeImage = false;
					imageUrl = string.Empty;
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache));
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartImage.ImageUrl")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartImage.ImageUrl")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ImageUrlEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Extensions, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ImageUrl
		{
			get
			{
				return imageUrl;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading && ImageVisible)
				{
					string message = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectUseImageUrlProperty);
					throw new ArgumentException(message);
				}
				if (value != imageUrl)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if (ShouldDisposeImage)
					{
						dxImage?.Dispose();
						ShouldDisposeImage = false;
					}
					else
					{
						dxImage = null;
					}
					imageUrl = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDXImage()
		{
			if (dxImage != null)
			{
				return !ImageUrlVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetDXImage()
		{
			DXImage = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeImageUrl()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageUrl))
			{
				return !ImageVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetImageUrl()
		{
			ImageUrl = "";
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeImageUrl() && !ShouldSerializeDXImage())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Image" => false, 
				"DXImage" => ShouldSerializeDXImage(), 
				"ImageUrl" => ShouldSerializeImageUrl(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && ShouldDisposeImage && !Disposed)
			{
				dxImage?.Dispose();
			}
			Disposed = true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ChartImage(null);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (ShouldDisposeImage)
			{
				dxImage?.Dispose();
			}
			dxImage = null;
			imageUrl = string.Empty;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Image)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ChartImage chartImage)
			{
				dxImage = ((chartImage.dxImage == null) ? null : chartImage.dxImage.Clone());
				imageUrl = chartImage.imageUrl;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BackgroundImage")]
	public class BackgroundImage : ChartImage
	{
		private const bool DefaultStretch = false;

		private bool stretch;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BackgroundImage.Stretch")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BackgroundImage.Stretch")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Stretch
		{
			get
			{
				return stretch;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != stretch)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					stretch = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal BackgroundImage(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStretch()
		{
			return stretch;
		}

		private void ResetStretch()
		{
			Stretch = false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeStretch();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Stretch"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeStretch();
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, bool reverseY)
		{
			if (base.DXImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!stretch)
			{
				return new TiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(rect, base.DXImage, disposeImage: false, reverseY);
			}
			return new StretchedImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(rect, base.DXImage, disposeImage: false, reverseY);
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsCommand(rect, reverseY: false);
		}

		internal bool Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (base.DXImage == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			renderer.DrawImage(base.DXImage, bounds, Stretch ? DXImageSizeMode.Stretch : DXImageSizeMode.Tile);
			return true;
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, IPolygon polygon)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath clipping = polygon.GetPath();
			renderer.SetClipping(clipping);
			Render(renderer, MathUtils.StrongRound(polygon.Rect));
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BackgroundImage(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BackgroundImage backgroundImage)
			{
				stretch = backgroundImage.stretch;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class BorderBase : ChartElement
	{
		private const int DefaultThickness = 1;

		private const DefaultBoolean DefaultVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private readonly Color defaultColor = Color.Empty;

		private bool defaultVisible;

		private Color color;

		private DefaultBoolean visibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private int thickness = 1;

		private int cachedThickness = -1;

		internal int ActualThickness => GetActualThickness(ActualVisibility);

		internal bool DefaultVisible => defaultVisible;

		internal bool ActualVisibility => GetActualVisibility(base.Owner as ISupportBorderVisibility);

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

			{
				return ActualVisibility;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Visibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(value);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BorderBase.Color")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BorderBase.Color")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
