					RaiseControlChanging();
					color = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BorderBase.Thickness")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BorderBase.Thickness")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Thickness
		{
			get
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBorderThickness));
				}
				if (thickness != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					thickness = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BorderBase.Visibility")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BorderBase.Visibility")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DefaultBoolean Visibility
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return visibility;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (visibility != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					visibility = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected BorderBase(ChartElement owner, bool visible, Color color)
			: base(owner)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			InitializeVisible(visible);
			this.color = color;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"Thickness" => ShouldSerializeThickness(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"Visibility" => ShouldSerializeVisibility(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeVisibility()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)Visibility != 2;
		}

		private void ResetVisibility()
		{
			Visibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return !color.IsEmpty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeThickness()
		{
			return thickness != 1;
		}

		private void ResetThickness()
		{
			Thickness = 1;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeColor() && !ShouldSerializeThickness() && !ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisibility();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void InitializeVisible(bool visible)
		{
			defaultVisible = visible;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = defaultColor;
		}

		private bool GetActualVisibility(ISupportBorderVisibility appearanceHolder)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				return DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(visibility, appearanceHolder.BorderVisible);
			}
			return DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(visibility, defaultVisible);
		}

		private int GetActualThickness(bool visible)
		{
			if (!visible)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return Thickness;
		}

		internal int GetActualThicknessBasedOnAppearance(ISupportBorderVisibility appearanceHolder)
		{
			if (cachedThickness < 0)
			{
				cachedThickness = GetActualThickness(GetActualVisibility(appearanceHolder));
			}
			return cachedThickness;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (obj is BorderBase borderBase && borderBase.GetType().Equals(GetType()) && color == borderBase.color && thickness == borderBase.thickness)
			{
				return visibility == borderBase.visibility;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Border)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BorderBase borderBase)
			{
				defaultVisible = borderBase.defaultVisible;
				color = borderBase.color;
				thickness = borderBase.thickness;
				visibility = borderBase.visibility;
				cachedThickness = -1;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class RectangularBorder : BorderBase
	{
		protected internal enum RectangularBorderItem
		{
			TopItem,
			BottomItem,
			LeftItem,
			RightItem
		}

		internal static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangularBorderLayout layout, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(layout.TopRect, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(layout.BottomRect, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(layout.LeftRect, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(layout.RightRect, color);
		}

		protected RectangularBorder(ChartElement owner, bool visible, Color color)
			: base(owner, visible, color)
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract RectangleF ConstructBorderedRect(RectangularBorderLayout borderLayout);

		protected internal abstract RectangleF Enlarge(RectangleF rect, RectangularBorderItem item);

		protected internal abstract RectangleF CalcBorderItem(RectangleF rect, RectangularBorderItem item, int actualThickness);

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, int actualThickness, Color actualColor)
		{
			if (base.ActualVisibility)
			{
				RectangularBorderLayout layout = new RectangularBorderLayout(this, rect, actualThickness);
				Render(renderer, layout, actualColor);
			}
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, bool borderVisible, int actualThickness, Color actualColor)
		{
			if (borderVisible)
			{
				RectangularBorderLayout layout = new RectangularBorderLayout(this, rect, actualThickness);
				Render(renderer, layout, actualColor);
			}
		}

		internal RectangleF CalcBorderedRect(RectangleF rect)
		{
			RectangularBorderLayout borderLayout = new RectangularBorderLayout(this, rect, base.ActualThickness);
			return ConstructBorderedRect(borderLayout);
		}

		internal Size CalcBorderedSize(Size size)
		{
			RectangleF rect = new RectangleF(0f, 0f, size.Width, size.Height);
			return MathUtils.StrongRound(CalcBorderedRect(rect).Size);
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.OutsideRectangularBorder")]
	public sealed class OutsideRectangularBorder : RectangularBorder
	{
		internal OutsideRectangularBorder(ChartElement owner, bool visible, Color color)
			: base(owner, visible, color)
		{
		}

		protected internal override RectangleF ConstructBorderedRect(RectangularBorderLayout borderLayout)
		{
			RectangleF topRect = borderLayout.TopRect;
			RectangleF bottomRect = borderLayout.BottomRect;
			RectangleF leftRect = borderLayout.LeftRect;
			RectangleF rightRect = borderLayout.RightRect;
			return new RectangleF(leftRect.Location.X, topRect.Location.Y, rightRect.Location.X + rightRect.Width - leftRect.Location.X, bottomRect.Location.Y + bottomRect.Height - topRect.Location.Y);
		}

		protected internal override RectangleF Enlarge(RectangleF rect, RectangularBorderItem item)
		{
			switch (item)
			{
			case RectangularBorderItem.TopItem:
				rect.Offset(-1f, -1f);
				rect.Width += 2f;
				rect.Height++;
				break;
			case RectangularBorderItem.BottomItem:
				rect.Offset(-1f, 0f);
				rect.Width += 2f;
				rect.Height++;
				break;
			case RectangularBorderItem.LeftItem:
				rect.Offset(-1f, 0f);
				rect.Width++;
				break;
			case RectangularBorderItem.RightItem:
				rect.Width++;
				break;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		protected internal override RectangleF CalcBorderItem(RectangleF rect, RectangularBorderItem item, int actualThickness)
		{
			return item switch
			{
				RectangularBorderItem.TopItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X - (float)actualThickness, rect.Location.Y - (float)actualThickness, rect.Width + (float)(actualThickness * 2), actualThickness), 
				RectangularBorderItem.BottomItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X - (float)actualThickness, rect.Location.Y + rect.Height, rect.Width + (float)(actualThickness * 2), actualThickness), 
				RectangularBorderItem.LeftItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X - (float)actualThickness, rect.Location.Y, actualThickness, rect.Height), 
				RectangularBorderItem.RightItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X + rect.Width, rect.Location.Y, actualThickness, rect.Height), 
				_ => RectangleF.Empty, 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new OutsideRectangularBorder(null, visible: true, base.Color);
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.InsideRectangularBorder")]
	public sealed class InsideRectangularBorder : RectangularBorder
	{
		internal InsideRectangularBorder(ChartElement owner, bool visible, Color color)
			: base(owner, visible, color)
		{
		}

		protected internal override RectangleF ConstructBorderedRect(RectangularBorderLayout borderLayout)
		{
			RectangleF topRect = borderLayout.TopRect;
			RectangleF bottomRect = borderLayout.BottomRect;
			RectangleF leftRect = borderLayout.LeftRect;
			RectangleF rightRect = borderLayout.RightRect;
			return new RectangleF(leftRect.Location.X + leftRect.Width, topRect.Location.Y + topRect.Height, rightRect.Location.X - leftRect.Location.X - leftRect.Width, bottomRect.Location.Y - topRect.Location.Y - topRect.Height);
		}

		protected internal override RectangleF Enlarge(RectangleF rect, RectangularBorderItem item)
		{
			switch (item)
			{
			case RectangularBorderItem.TopItem:
				rect.Height++;
				break;
			case RectangularBorderItem.BottomItem:
				rect.Offset(0f, -1f);
				rect.Height++;
				break;
			case RectangularBorderItem.LeftItem:
				rect.Width++;
				break;
			case RectangularBorderItem.RightItem:
				rect.Offset(-1f, 0f);
				rect.Width++;
				break;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		protected internal override RectangleF CalcBorderItem(RectangleF rect, RectangularBorderItem item, int actualThickness)
		{
			return item switch
			{
				RectangularBorderItem.TopItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y, rect.Width, actualThickness), 
				RectangularBorderItem.BottomItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y + rect.Height - (float)actualThickness, rect.Width, actualThickness), 
				RectangularBorderItem.LeftItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y + (float)actualThickness, actualThickness, rect.Height - (float)(2 * actualThickness)), 
				RectangularBorderItem.RightItem => new RectangleF(rect.Location.X + rect.Width - (float)actualThickness, rect.Location.Y + (float)actualThickness, actualThickness, rect.Height - (float)(2 * actualThickness)), 
				_ => RectangleF.Empty, 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new InsideRectangularBorder(null, visible: true, base.Color);
		}
	}

			polygon.Color = color;

		}

		protected internal override void RenderAnnotationShape(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillPath(path, color);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(rect, color);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderBackground(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			RenderRectangle(renderer, rect, color);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderRing(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, float thickness)
		{
			renderer.DrawRing(bounds, color, thickness);
		}

		protected internal override void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadString();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(None)";
		}
	}
	public abstract class FillOptionsColor2Base : FillOptionsBase
	{
		private const string XmlTagName_Color2 = "Color2";

		private Color defaultColor2;

		private Color color2;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FillOptionsColor2Base.Color2")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FillOptionsColor2Base.Color2")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color Color2
		{
			get
			{
				return color2;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != color2)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					color2 = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public FillOptionsColor2Base()
		{
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Color2")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeColor2();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor2()
		{
			return !color2.Equals(defaultColor2);
		}

		private void ResetColor2()
		{
			Color2 = defaultColor2;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeColor2();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected Color CalculateBackgroundColor2(Color color)
		{
			Color color2 = ((this.color2 == Color.Empty) ? color : this.color2);
			if (color2.A < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				color2 = HitTestColors.MixColors(color2, color);
			}
			return color2;
		}

		protected internal Color CalculateActualColor2(Color color, Color color2)
		{
			Color color3 = ((this.color2 == Color.Empty) ? color2 : this.color2);
			if (color3 == Color.Empty)
			{
				color3 = color;
			}
			return color3;
		}

		protected internal override void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			color2 = XmlUtils.ReadColor(xmlReader, "Color2");
		}

		internal void SetColor2AndInitDefaultColor2(Color color2)
		{
			this.color2 = color2;
			defaultColor2 = color2;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FillOptionsColor2Base fillOptionsColor2Base)
			{
				color2 = fillOptionsColor2Base.color2;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is FillOptionsColor2Base fillOptionsColor2Base && base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return color2 == fillOptionsColor2Base.color2;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private IGradientPainter GetPainter(RectangleGradientMode gradientMode, ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			return gradientMode switch
			{
				RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom => new TopToBottomGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.BottomToTop => new BottomToTopGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.LeftToRight => new LeftToRightGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.RightToLeft => new RightToLeftGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight => new TopLeftToBottomRightGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft => new BottomRightToTopLeftGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft => new TopRightToBottomLeftGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight => new BottomLeftToTopRightGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal => new FromCenterHorizontalGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal => new ToCenterHorizontalGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical => new FromCenterVerticalGradientPainter(renderer), 
				RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical => new ToCenterVerticalGradientPainter(renderer), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		internal void RotateGradientMode()
		{
			switch (gradientMode)
			{
			case RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.RightToLeft;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.BottomToTop:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.LeftToRight;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.LeftToRight:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.RightToLeft:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.BottomToTop;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight;
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void InvertGradientMode()
		{
			switch (gradientMode)
			{
			case RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.BottomToTop;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.BottomToTop:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical:
				gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical;
				break;
			case RectangleGradientMode.LeftToRight:
			case RectangleGradientMode.RightToLeft:
			case RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal:
			case RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void RestoreGradientOrientation(RectangleGradientMode gradientMode)
		{
			this.gradientMode = gradientMode;
		}

			}

				break;
			case PolygonGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight:

				break;
			case PolygonGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft:
				gradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft;
				break;

		private const HatchStyle DefaultHatchStyle = HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal;

		private HatchStyle hatchStyle = HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.HatchFillOptions.HatchStyle")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.HatchFillOptions.HatchStyle")]

		{
			get
			{
				return hatchStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != hatchStyle)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					hatchStyle = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal HatchFillOptions(Color color2)
			: this()

			SetColor2AndInitDefaultColor2(color2);
		}

		public HatchFillOptions()
		{
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "HatchStyle")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHatchStyle();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeHatchStyle()
		{
			return hatchStyle != HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal;
		}

		private void ResetHatchStyle()
		{
			HatchStyle = HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHatchStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new HatchFillOptions();
		}

		{
			base.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			hatchStyle = (HatchStyle)XmlUtils.ReadEnum(xmlReader, "HatchStyle", typeof(HatchStyle));
		}

		protected internal override void RenderRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(rect, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, LineStrip vertices, RectangleF boundedRectangle, Color color, Color color2, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			renderer.FillPolygon(vertices, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, BezierRangeStrip strip, Color color, Color color2, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			renderer.FillBezier(strip, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override void FillCircle(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float radius, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillCircle(center, radius, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override void RenderEllipse(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillEllipse(center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override void RenderPie(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath path = GraphicUtils.CreatePieGraphicsPath(new GRealPoint2D(center.X, center.Y), majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, holePercent, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			renderer.FillPath(path, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override void RenderPath(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillPath(path, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return new HatchedRectangleGraphicsCommand(rect, hatchStyle, color, CalculateActualColor2(color, color2));
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(LineStrip vertices, ZPlaneRectangle boundedRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return new HatchedPolygonGraphicsCommand(vertices);
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreatePieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return new HatchedPieGraphicsCommand(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent);
		}

		protected internal override PlanePolygon[] FillPlanePolygon(PlanePolygon polygon, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return new PlanePolygon[1] { polygon };
		}

		protected internal override void RenderAnnotationShape(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillPath(path, HatchStyle, base.Color2, color);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(rect, HatchStyle, base.Color2, color);

		protected internal override void RenderBackground(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color)

		}

		{

		}

		{
			return "(Hatch)";
		}

		{

			}

			}
			return false;
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class FillStyleBase : ChartElement, IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue
	{
		protected class OptionsCache
		{
			private List<FillOptionsBase> list = new List<FillOptionsBase>();

			public int Count => list.Count;

			public FillOptionsBase this[int index] => list[index];

			public FillOptionsBase GetInstance(Type optionsType)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (list[i].GetType().Equals(optionsType))
					{
						return list[i];
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public void AddOptions(FillOptionsBase options, FillStyleBase style)
			{
				options.SetStyle(style);
				list.Add(options);
			}

			public void Replace(FillOptionsBase options)
			{
				if (options == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("options");
				}
				FillOptionsBase instance = GetInstance(options.GetType());
				if (instance != null)
				{
					list.Remove(instance);
				}
				list.Add(options);
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				list.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected class XmlKeys
		{
			public const string FillMode = "FillMode";

			public const string Options = "Options";
		}

		private FillOptionsBase options;

		private AspxSerializerWrapper<FillOptionsBase> optionsSerializerWrapper;

		private OptionsCache optionsCache = new OptionsCache();

		protected OptionsCache FillOptionsCache => optionsCache;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FillStyleBase.Options")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FillStyleBase.Options")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public FillOptionsBase Options
		{
			get
			{
				return options;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading)
				{
					throw new MemberAccessException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgDesignTimeOnlySetting));
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				options = value;
				if (options != null)
				{
					options.SetStyle(this);
					optionsCache.Replace(options);
				}
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public IList OptionsSerializable => optionsSerializerWrapper;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now.")]
		public string FillOptionsTypeName
		{
			get
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		protected FillStyleBase(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			optionsSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<FillOptionsBase>(() => Options, delegate(FillOptionsBase value)
			{
				Options = value;
			});
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Options"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeOptionsCore();
		}

		object IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue.Create(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.Item.Name == "Options"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		private object XtraCreateOptions(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFillOptionsTypeName()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOptionsCore()
		{
			if (options != null)
			{
				return options.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOptions()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeOptionsCore() && ChartContainer != null)
			{
				return ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetOptions()
		{
			Options = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOptionsSerializable()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeOptionsCore() && ChartContainer != null)
			{
				return ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOptionsSerializable();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool FillOptionsEquals(FillOptionsBase options)
		{
			if (this.options != null)
			{
				return this.options.Equals(options);
			}
			return options == null;
		}

		protected void SetFillOptions(FillOptionsBase options)
		{
			this.options = options;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(FillStyle)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is FillStyleBase fillStyleBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < fillStyleBase.optionsCache.Count; i++)
			{
				FillOptionsBase fillOptionsBase = fillStyleBase.optionsCache[i];
				if (fillOptionsBase != null)
				{
					optionsCache.GetInstance(fillOptionsBase.GetType())?.Assign(fillOptionsBase);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is FillStyleBase fillStyleBase)
			{
				return FillOptionsEquals(fillStyleBase.Options);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum FillMode
	{
		Empty,
		Solid,
		Gradient,
		Hatch
	}
	public abstract class FillStyle2D : FillStyleBase
	{
		private FillMode defaultFillMode;

		private FillMode fillMode;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FillStyle2D.FillMode")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FillStyle2D.FillMode")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public FillMode FillMode
		{
			get
			{
				return fillMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fillMode != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetFillMode(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected FillStyle2D(ChartElement owner)
			: this(owner, Color.Empty)
		{
		}

		protected FillStyle2D(ChartElement owner, Color color2)
			: this(owner, color2, FillMode.Empty)
		{
		}

		protected FillStyle2D(ChartElement owner, Color color2, FillMode defaultFillMode)
			: base(owner)
		{
			fillMode = defaultFillMode;
			this.defaultFillMode = defaultFillMode;
			base.FillOptionsCache.AddOptions(new HatchFillOptions(color2), this);
			base.FillOptionsCache.AddOptions(new SolidFillOptions(), this);
			GradientFillOptionsBase gradientFillOptionsBase = (GradientFillOptionsBase)Activator.CreateInstance(GetGradientFillOptionsType());
			gradientFillOptionsBase.SetColor2AndInitDefaultColor2(color2);
			base.FillOptionsCache.AddOptions(gradientFillOptionsBase, this);
			SetFillOptions(base.FillOptionsCache.GetInstance(FillMode2Type(fillMode)));
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "FillMode")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFillMode();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFillMode()
		{
			return fillMode != defaultFillMode;
		}

		private void ResetFillMode()
		{
			FillMode = defaultFillMode;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFillMode();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Type FillMode2Type(FillMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				FillMode.Empty => null, 
				FillMode.Solid => typeof(SolidFillOptions), 
				FillMode.Hatch => typeof(HatchFillOptions), 
				FillMode.Gradient => GetGradientFillOptionsType(), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		private void SetFillMode(FillMode mode)
		{
			fillMode = mode;
			SetFillOptions(base.FillOptionsCache.GetInstance(FillMode2Type(fillMode)));
		}

		protected abstract Type GetGradientFillOptionsType();

		protected internal override void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			SetFillMode((FillMode)XmlUtils.ReadEnum(xmlReader, "FillMode", typeof(FillMode)));
			if (base.Options != null)
			{
				xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Options");
				base.Options.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
				xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FillStyle2D fillStyle2D)
			{
				SetFillMode(fillStyle2D.FillMode);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is FillStyle2D fillStyle2D)
			{
				return fillMode == fillStyle2D.fillMode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleFillStyle")]
	public class RectangleFillStyle : FillStyle2D
	{
		internal static RectangleFillStyle Empty => new RectangleFillStyle(null);

		internal RectangleFillStyle(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		internal RectangleFillStyle(ChartElement owner, Color color2)
			: base(owner, color2)
		{
		}

		internal RectangleFillStyle(ChartElement owner, Color color2, FillMode defaultFillMode)
			: base(owner, color2, defaultFillMode)
		{
		}

		protected override Type GetGradientFillOptionsType()
		{
			return typeof(RectangleGradientFillOptions);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RectangleFillStyle(null, Color.Empty);
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			if (base.FillMode == FillMode.Empty || rect.Width == 0.0 || rect.Height == 0.0 || gradientRect.Width == 0.0 || gradientRect.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.Options.CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(rect, gradientRect, color, color2);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			if (base.FillMode != FillMode.Empty && rect.Width != 0f && rect.Height != 0f && gradientRect.Width != 0f && gradientRect.Height != 0f)
			{
				base.Options.RenderRectangle(renderer, rect, gradientRect, color, color2);
			}
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsCommand(rect, rect, color, color2);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			Render(renderer, rect, rect, color, color2);
		}

		internal void RenderRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			if (base.Options != null)
			{
				base.Options.RenderRectangle(renderer, rect, color);
			}
			else if (!renderer.AllowLineOptimization)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(rect, color);
			}
		}

		internal void RenderBackground(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			if (base.Options != null)
			{
				base.Options.RenderBackground(renderer, rect, color);
				return;
			}
			SolidFillOptions solidFillOptions = new SolidFillOptions();
			solidFillOptions.RenderBackground(renderer, rect, color);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RectangleFillStyle)
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			}
			if (obj is FillStyle3D fillStyle3D)
			{
				return fillMode == fillStyle3D.fillMode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		private DashStyle defaultDashStyle;

		private DashStyle dashStyle;

		private LineJoin lineJoin;

		private bool antiAlias;

		internal IChartAppearance ActualAppearance
		{
			get
			{
				IChartAppearance chartAppearance = CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(base.Owner);
				if (chartAppearance == null)
				{
					chartAppearance = AppearanceRepository.Default;
				}
				return chartAppearance;
			}
		}

		internal bool AntiAlias => antiAlias;

		internal DashStyle ActualDashStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner is ConstantLine)
				{
					if (DashStyle != DashStyle.Empty)
					{
						return dashStyle;
					}
					return ActualAppearance.ConstantLineAppearance.DashStyle;
				}
				return dashStyle;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LineStyle.Thickness")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LineStyle.Thickness")]

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public virtual int Thickness
		{
			get
			{
				return lineThickness;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != lineThickness)
				{
					if (value <= 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLineThickness));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					lineThickness = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LineStyle.DashStyle")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LineStyle.DashStyle")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DashStyle DashStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return dashStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dashStyle)
				{
					if (value == DashStyle.Empty && !(base.Owner is ConstantLine))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDashStyle));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					dashStyle = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LineStyle.LineJoin")]

					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Thickness" => ShouldSerializeThickness(), 
				"DashStyle" => ShouldSerializeDashStyle(), 
				"LineJoin" => ShouldSerializeLineJoin(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeThickness()
		{
			return lineThickness != defaultThickness;
		}

		private void ResetThickness()
		{
			Thickness = defaultThickness;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDashStyle()
		{
			return dashStyle != defaultDashStyle;
		}

		private void ResetDashStyle()
		{
			DashStyle = defaultDashStyle;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLineJoin()
		{
			return lineJoin != defaultLineJoin;
		}

		private void ResetLineJoin()
		{
			LineJoin = defaultLineJoin;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeThickness() && !ShouldSerializeDashStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLineJoin();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void InitializeThickness(int thickness)
		{
			lineThickness = thickness;
			defaultThickness = thickness;
		}

		private void InitializeDashStyle(DashStyle dashStyle)
		{
			this.dashStyle = dashStyle;
			defaultDashStyle = dashStyle;
		}

		private void InitializeLineJoin(LineJoin lineJoin)
		{
			defaultLineJoin = lineJoin;
			this.lineJoin = lineJoin;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new LineStyle(null);
		}

		}

		internal void SetAntialiasing(bool antiAlias)

		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is LineStyle lineStyle && lineThickness == lineStyle.lineThickness && dashStyle == lineStyle.dashStyle)
			{
				return lineJoin == lineStyle.lineJoin;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is LineStyle lineStyle)
			{
				lineThickness = lineStyle.lineThickness;
				dashStyle = lineStyle.dashStyle;
				lineJoin = lineStyle.lineJoin;
				antiAlias = lineStyle.antiAlias;

		Repeat,

	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PaletteTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]

		internal class PaletteTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
				{
					return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					Palette palette = (Palette)value;
					int count = palette.Count;
					PaletteEntry[] array = new PaletteEntry[count];
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						array[i] = (PaletteEntry)palette[i].Clone();
					}
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(Palette).GetConstructor(new Type[3]
					{
						typeof(string),
						typeof(PaletteScaleMode),
						typeof(PaletteEntry[])
					});
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[3] { palette.Name, palette.ScaleMode, array }, isComplete: true);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private static Color ConvertColor(Color color, int cycleIndex, int cycleCount)
		{
			ColorHSL colorHSL = (ColorHSL)color;
			float num = (float)(cycleCount - 1) / (float)cycleCount;
			float num2 = colorHSL.Luminance - num * 0.5f;
			if (num2 < colorHSL.MinLuminance)
			{
				num2 = colorHSL.MinLuminance;
			}
			float num3 = colorHSL.Luminance + num * 0.5f;
			if (num3 > colorHSL.MaxLuminance)
			{
				num3 = colorHSL.MaxLuminance;
			}
			float num4 = (float)(cycleCount - 1) / 2f;
			float num5 = (float)cycleIndex - num4;
			if (num5 < 0f)
			{
				colorHSL.Luminance -= (num2 - colorHSL.Luminance) * (num5 / num4);
			}
			else
			{
				colorHSL.Luminance += (num3 - colorHSL.Luminance) * (num5 / num4);
			}
			return (Color)colorHSL;
		}

		internal static Color ChangeLuminance(Color color, float coef)
		{
			ColorHSL colorHSL = (ColorHSL)color;
			colorHSL.Luminance -= colorHSL.Luminance * coef;
			return (Color)colorHSL;
		}

		protected static void LoadPaletteFromResources(string resourceName, Palette palette)
		{
			using Stream stream = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(Palette)).GetManifestResourceStream(resourceName);
			using XmlReader xmlReader = SafeXml.CreateReader(stream);
			try
			{
				palette.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			}
			finally
			{
				xmlReader.Close();
			}
		}

		internal static Palette CreatePredefinedPalette(ChartStringId displayNameId, string resourceName)
		{
			Palette palette = new Palette(displayNameId);
			LoadPaletteFromResources(resourceName, palette);
			return palette;
		}

		private PaletteEntry GetEntryByCycle(int index)
		{
			return this[index % base.Count];
		}

		private int Add(PaletteEntry entry, bool testPredefinedFlag)
		{
			if (entry == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("entry");
			}
			if (testPredefinedFlag)
			{
				TestPredefinedFlag();
			}
			entry.SetPalette(this);
			return base.InnerList.Add(entry);
		}

		private void AssignSimpleProperties(Palette palette)
		{
			name = palette.name;
			scaleMode = palette.scaleMode;
			displayName = palette.displayName;
		}

		protected void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Palette");
			if (!(this is DefaultPalette))
			{
				name = xmlReader.ReadElementString("Name");
			}
			else
			{
				xmlReader.ReadElementString("Name");
			}
			scaleMode = (PaletteScaleMode)XmlUtils.ReadEnum(xmlReader, "ScaleMode", typeof(PaletteScaleMode));
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Items");
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			int num = XmlUtils.ReadInteger(xmlReader, "Count");
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = new PaletteEntry();
				paletteEntry.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
				bool testPredefinedFlag = false;
				Add(paletteEntry, testPredefinedFlag);
			}
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		protected internal DXImage CreateEditorImage()
		{
			return PaletteUtils.CreateEditorImage(this);
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			TestPredefinedFlag();
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			if (Name != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName)
			{
				TestPredefinedFlag();
			}
		}

		protected internal void AddDefaultColorIfEmpty()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				Add(new PaletteEntry());
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetName(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("name");
			}
			this.name = name;
			displayName = name;
		}

		protected internal void SetDisplayName(string displayName)
		{
			this.displayName = displayName;
		}

		protected internal void TestPredefinedFlag()
		{
			if (predefined)
			{
				throw new PaletteException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgModifyDefaultPaletteError));
			}
		}

		protected internal PaletteEntry GetEntry(int index, int count, int baseColorNumber)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return new PaletteEntry(Color.Empty, Color.Empty);
			}
			if (baseColorNumber != 0)
			{
				PaletteEntry entryByCycle = GetEntryByCycle(baseColorNumber - 1);
				if (count != 1)
				{
					return new PaletteEntry(ConvertColor(entryByCycle.Color, index, count), ConvertColor(entryByCycle.Color2, index, count));
				}
				return entryByCycle;
			}
			PaletteEntry entryByCycle2 = GetEntryByCycle(index);
			if (scaleMode == PaletteScaleMode.Extrapolate)
			{
				int num = (count - 1) / base.Count + 1;
				if (num > 1)
				{
					int cycleIndex = index / base.Count;
					return new PaletteEntry(ConvertColor(entryByCycle2.Color, cycleIndex, num), ConvertColor(entryByCycle2.Color2, cycleIndex, num));
				}
			}
			return entryByCycle2;
		}

		internal void SaveState()
		{
			savedState = new Palette(string.Empty);
			savedState.AssignSimpleProperties(this);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					PaletteEntry paletteEntry = (PaletteEntry)enumerator.Current;
					paletteEntry.SaveState();
					savedState.InnerList.Add(paletteEntry);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RestoreState()
		{
			if (savedState == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AssignSimpleProperties(savedState);
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			foreach (PaletteEntry item in savedState)
			{
				item.RestoreState();
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public int Add(PaletteEntry entry)
		{
			bool testPredefinedFlag = true;
			return Add(entry, testPredefinedFlag);
		}

		public int Add(Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return Add(new PaletteEntry(color, color2));
		}

		public int Add(Color color)
		{
			return Add(color, color);
		}

		public void Assign(Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("palette");
			}
			TestPredefinedFlag();
			AssignSimpleProperties(palette);
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			foreach (PaletteEntry item in palette)
			{
				Add((PaletteEntry)item.Clone());
			}
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			Palette palette = new Palette(string.Empty);
			palette.Assign(this);
			return palette;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return DisplayName;
		}

		public void SaveToXml(Stream stream)
		{
			PaletteSerializer.SaveToStream(this, stream);
		}

		public void SaveToXml(string path)
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite);
			SaveToXml(stream);
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(Stream stream)
		{
			Assign(PaletteSerializer.LoadFromStream(null, stream));
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(string path)
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			LoadFromXml(stream);
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class DefaultPalette : Palette
	{
		public const string DefaultActualPaletteName = "Module";

		private string actualPaletteName = "Module";

		private bool isPalettes_Default;

		internal string ActualPaletteName => actualPaletteName;

		public static string DefaultPaletteName => "Default";

		internal DefaultPalette(bool isPalettes_Default)
			: this()
		{
			this.isPalettes_Default = isPalettes_Default;
		}

		public DefaultPalette()
			: base(ChartStringId.PltDefault, DefaultPaletteName)
		{
			string paletteResourceName = GetPaletteResourceName("Module");
			Palette.LoadPaletteFromResources(paletteResourceName, this);
		}

		private string GetPaletteResourceName(string paletteName)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Appearance.Palettes.");
			stringBuilder.Append(Palettes.PaletteInfos[paletteName].FileName);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void LoadColorsForBackCompatibility(string actualPaletteName)
		{
			this.actualPaletteName = actualPaletteName;
			Clear();
			string paletteResourceName = GetPaletteResourceName(actualPaletteName);
			Palette.LoadPaletteFromResources(paletteResourceName, this);
		}

		public void LoadColorsFromActualPalette(string actualPaletteName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualPaletteName))
			{
				if (!isPalettes_Default)
				{
					Palettes.Default.LoadColorsForBackCompatibility(actualPaletteName);
				}
				this.actualPaletteName = actualPaletteName;
				Clear();
				string paletteResourceName = GetPaletteResourceName(actualPaletteName);
				Palette.LoadPaletteFromResources(paletteResourceName, this);
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PaletteEntryTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class PaletteEntry : ICloneable
	{
		internal class PaletteEntryTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
				{
					return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					PaletteEntry paletteEntry = (PaletteEntry)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(PaletteEntry).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(Color),
						typeof(Color)
					}), new object[2] { paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2 }, isComplete: true);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private const string XmlTagName_Entry = "Entry";

		private const string XmlTagName_Color = "Color";

		private const string XmlTagName_Color2 = "Color2";

		private Palette palette;

		private Color color;

		private Color color2;

		private PaletteEntry savedState;

		internal Palette Palette => palette;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (color == Palette.EmptyPaletteColor)
				{
					return color2 == Palette.EmptyPaletteColor;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the first color of the palette entry.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PaletteEntry.Color")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				TestPredefinedFlag();
				color = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the second color of the palette entry.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PaletteEntry.Color2")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color Color2
		{
			get
			{
				return color2;
			}
			set
			{
				TestPredefinedFlag();
				color2 = value;
			}
		}

		public PaletteEntry(Color color, Color color2)
		{
			this.color = color;
			this.color2 = color2;
		}

		public PaletteEntry(Color color)
			: this(color, color)
		{
		}

		public PaletteEntry()
			: this(Palette.EmptyPaletteColor)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return color != Palette.EmptyPaletteColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = Palette.EmptyPaletteColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor2()
		{
			return color != Palette.EmptyPaletteColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor2()
		{
			Color2 = Palette.EmptyPaletteColor;
		}

		private void AssignSimpleProperties(PaletteEntry entry)
		{
			color = entry.color;
			color2 = entry.color2;
		}

		internal void SaveState()
		{
			savedState = new PaletteEntry();
			savedState.AssignSimpleProperties(this);
		}

		internal void RestoreState()
		{
			if (savedState != null)
			{
				AssignSimpleProperties(savedState);
			}
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			PaletteEntry paletteEntry = new PaletteEntry();
			paletteEntry.Assign(this);
			return paletteEntry;
		}

		public virtual void Assign(PaletteEntry entry)
		{
			if (entry == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("entry");
			}
			TestPredefinedFlag();
			AssignSimpleProperties(entry);
		}

		internal void SetPalette(Palette palette)
		{
			this.palette = palette;
		}

		internal void WriteToXml(XmlWriter xmlWriter)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("Entry");
			XmlUtils.WriteColor(xmlWriter, color, "Color");
			XmlUtils.WriteColor(xmlWriter, color2, "Color2");
			xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
		}

		internal void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Entry");
			color = XmlUtils.ReadColor(xmlReader, "Color");
			color2 = XmlUtils.ReadColor(xmlReader, "Color2");
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		private void TestPredefinedFlag()
		{
			if (palette != null)
			{
				palette.TestPredefinedFlag();
			}
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class PaletteListBase : SortedList
	{
		[Description("Provides access to individual palettes in the list by their names.")]
		public virtual Palette this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Palette)base[name];
			}
			protected set
			{
				base[name] = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual string[] GetPaletteNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[Keys.Count];
			Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		public virtual string[] GetLocalizedPaletteNames()
		{
			int num = 0;
			string[] array = new string[Keys.Count];
			foreach (Palette key in Keys)
			{
				array[num++] = key.DisplayName;
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartDictionarySerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class PaletteRepository : PaletteListBase, IPaletteRepository
	{
		private readonly PredefinedPaletteList predefinedList;

		private readonly DefaultPalette defaultPalette;

		private PaletteRepository savedState;

		internal int PredefinedCount => predefinedList.GetPaletteNames().Length;

		internal int TotalCount => PredefinedCount + Count;

		internal Action OnPaletteRemoved { get; set; }

		[Description("Provides access to individual palettes in the repository by their names.")]
		public override Palette this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				if ((name == DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName || name == ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.PltDefault)) && defaultPalette != null)
				{
					return defaultPalette;
				}
				Palette paletteByName = GetPaletteByName(name);
				if (paletteByName == null)
				{
					throw new PaletteException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPaletteNotFound), name));
				}
				return paletteByName;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets an array of available palette names.")]
		public string[] PaletteNames
		{
			get
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				list.AddRange(predefinedList.GetPaletteNames());
				list.AddRange(GetPaletteNames());
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns an array of localized palette names.")]
		public string[] LocalizedPaletteNames
		{
			get
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				list.AddRange(predefinedList.GetLocalizedPaletteNames());
				list.AddRange(GetLocalizedPaletteNames());
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		int IPaletteRepository.PredefinedCount => PredefinedCount;

		public PaletteRepository()
			: this(new PredefinedPaletteList())
		{
		}

		internal PaletteRepository(PredefinedPaletteList predefinedPalettes, DefaultPalette palette = null)
		{
			predefinedList = predefinedPalettes;
			defaultPalette = palette;
		}

		void IPaletteRepository.ReRegisterPalette(Palette palette)
		{
			ReRegisterPalette(palette);
		}

		void IPaletteRepository.SaveState()
		{
			SaveState();
		}

		void IPaletteRepository.RestoreState()
		{
			RestoreState();
		}

		private void SaveState()
		{
			savedState = new PaletteRepository(predefinedList, defaultPalette);
			foreach (Palette value in Values)
			{
				value.SaveState();
				savedState.RegisterPalette(value);
			}
		}

		private void RestoreState()
		{
			if (savedState == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Clear();
			foreach (Palette value in savedState.Values)
			{
				value.RestoreState();
				RegisterPalette(value);
			}
		}

		internal void Assign(PaletteRepository repository)
		{
			Clear();
			foreach (Palette value in repository.Values)
			{
				RegisterPalette((Palette)value.Clone());
			}
		}

		internal Palette GetPaletteByName(string name)
		{
			Palette palette = predefinedList[name];
			if (palette == null)
			{
				palette = base[name];
			}
			return palette;
		}

		internal Palette GetAppearancePalette(string paletteName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(paletteName))
			{
				return this[paletteName];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal IList<Palette> GetPaletteList()
		{
			List<Palette> list = new List<Palette>(TotalCount);
			string[] paletteNames = PaletteNames;
			foreach (string text in paletteNames)
			{
				if (text != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName && !(predefinedList is IndicatorsPredefinedPaletteList))
				{
					list.Add(this[text]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void ReRegisterPalette(Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("palette");
			}
			int num = IndexOfValue(palette);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				string text = (string)GetKey(num);
				if (text != palette.Name)
				{
					RegisterPalette(palette);
					Remove(text);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Remove(object key)
		{
			base.Remove(key);
			if (OnPaletteRemoved != null)
			{
				OnPaletteRemoved();
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveAt(index);
			if (OnPaletteRemoved != null)
			{
				OnPaletteRemoved();
			}
		}

		public void Add(string name, Palette palette)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				palette.SetName(name);
			}
			RegisterPalette(palette);
		}

		public void RegisterPalette(Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette == null)
			{
				throw new PaletteException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArgument));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(palette.Name))
			{
				throw new PaletteException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidPaletteName));
			}
			if (predefinedList[palette.Name] != null)
			{
				throw new PaletteException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgAddExistingPaletteError), palette.Name));
			}
			if (IndexOfKey(palette.Name) >= 0)
			{
				this[palette.Name] = palette;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Add(palette.Name, palette);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Use the \"void RegisterPalette(Palette paletteInstance)\" constructor instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RegisterPalette(string name, Palette palette)
		{
			Add(name, palette);
		}
	}

		public static Palette Origin => palettes["Origin"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette Paper => palettes["Paper"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette PastelKit => palettes["Pastel Kit"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette Red => palettes["Red"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette RedOrange => palettes["Red Orange"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette RedViolet => palettes["Red Violet"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette Slipstream => palettes["Slipstream"].GetPalette();

		public static Palette Solstice => palettes["Solstice"].GetPalette();

		internal static string[] GetActualPaletteNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[palettes.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string key in palettes.Keys)
			{
				array[num++] = key;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static string[] GetActualLocalizedNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[palettes.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (PaletteInfo value in palettes.Values)
			{
				array[num++] = ChartLocalizer.GetString(value.Id);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static string[] GetNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[palettes.Count + 1];
			array[0] = DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName;
			GetActualPaletteNames().CopyTo(array, 1);
			return array;
		}

		public static string[] GetLocalizedNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[palettes.Count + 1];
			array[0] = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.PltDefault);
			GetActualLocalizedNames().CopyTo(array, 1);
			return array;
		}

		public static Palette GetPalette(string name, IChartContainer chart = null)
		{
			if (name == DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName && chart != null)
			{
				return chart.Chart.DefaultPalette;
			}
			if (palettes.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value.GetPalette();
			}
			foreach (PaletteInfo value2 in palettes.Values)
			{
				if (ChartLocalizer.GetString(value2.Id) == name || ChartLocalizer.GetDefaultString(value2.Id) == name)
				{
					return value2.GetPalette();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public sealed class Shadow : ChartElement
	{
		private const int DefaultSize = 2;

		private static readonly Color DefaultColor = Color.FromArgb(80, Color.Black);

		private bool defaultVisible;

		private int size = 2;

		private Color color = DefaultColor;

		private bool visible;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow.Size")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow.Size")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Size
		{
			get
			{
				return size;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != size)
				{
					if (value <= 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectShadowSize));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					size = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow.Color")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow.Color")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != color)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					color = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow.Visible")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Shadow.Visible")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != visible)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					visible = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal Shadow(ChartElement owner)
			: this(owner, defaultVisible: false)
		{
		}

		internal Shadow(ChartElement owner, bool defaultVisible)
			: base(owner)
		{
			visible = defaultVisible;
			this.defaultVisible = defaultVisible;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"Size" => ShouldSerializeSize(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return color != DefaultColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = DefaultColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return visible != defaultVisible;
		}

		private void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = defaultVisible;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSize()
		{
			return size != 2;
		}

		private void ResetSize()
		{
			Size = 2;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeColor() && !ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Size IncreaseSize(Size size, int shadowSize)
		{
			size.Width += GetActualSize(shadowSize);
			size.Height += GetActualSize(shadowSize);
			return size;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Shadow(null);
		}

		internal Size DecreaseSize(Size size, int shadowSize)
		{
			size.Width -= GetActualSize(shadowSize);
			size.Height -= GetActualSize(shadowSize);
			return size;
		}

		internal Size IncreaseSize(Size size)
		{
			return IncreaseSize(size, -1);
		}

		internal Size DecreaseSize(Size size)
		{
			return DecreaseSize(size, -1);
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(GraphicsCommand shadowCommand)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsCommand(shadowCommand, size);
		}

		internal void BeforeShadowRender(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			BeforeShadowRender(renderer, size);
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(GraphicsCommand shadowCommand, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (!visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new TranslateGraphicsCommand(shadowSize, shadowSize);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand3 = new PolygonAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand3);
			graphicsCommand3.AddChildCommand(shadowCommand);
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		internal void BeforeShadowRender(ChartRenderer renderer, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(shadowSize, shadowSize);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			}
		}

		internal void AfterShadowRender(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, LineStrip strip, int thickness)
		{
			Render(renderer, strip, thickness, -1);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, LineStrip strip, int thickness, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				if (shadowSize < 0)
				{
					shadowSize = size;
				}
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(shadowSize, shadowSize);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				StripsUtils.Render(renderer, strip, color, thickness);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsCommand(rect, -1);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect)
		{
			Render(renderer, rect, -1);
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (!visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (shadowSize < 0)
			{
				shadowSize = size;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new TranslateGraphicsCommand(shadowSize, shadowSize);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand3 = new PolygonAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand3);
			graphicsCommand3.AddChildCommand(new SolidRectangleGraphicsCommand(rect, color));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (!visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (shadowSize < 0)
			{
				shadowSize = size;
			}
			try
			{
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				rect.X += shadowSize;
				rect.Y += shadowSize;
				renderer.FillRectangle(rect, color);
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D center, float radius)
		{
			Render(renderer, center, radius, -1);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D center, float radius, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				if (shadowSize < 0)
				{
					shadowSize = size;
				}
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(shadowSize, shadowSize);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.FillCircle(new Point((int)center.X, (int)center.Y), (int)radius, color);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, VariousPolygon polygon)
		{
			Render(renderer, polygon, -1);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, VariousPolygon polygon, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				if (shadowSize < 0)
				{
					shadowSize = size;
				}
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(shadowSize, shadowSize);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				polygon.Render(renderer, color);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RangeStrip strip)
		{
			Render(renderer, strip, -1);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RangeStrip strip, int shadowSize)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				if (shadowSize < 0)
				{
					shadowSize = size;
				}
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(shadowSize, shadowSize);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				StripsUtils.Render(renderer, strip, color);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		internal int GetActualSize(int shadowSize)
		{
			if (!visible)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (shadowSize >= 0)
			{
				return shadowSize;
			}
			return size;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Shadow shadow)
			{
				size = shadow.size;
				color = shadow.color;
				visible = shadow.visible;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Shadow shadow && size == shadow.size && color == shadow.color)
			{
				return visible == shadow.visible;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CachedPointDataAdapter")]
	public abstract class CachedPointDataAdapter : DataSourceAdapter, ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint>, IAssignableAdapter
	{
		private List<IDataPoint> points;

		protected virtual bool NeedRecalculatePoints { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool CanUseIndexation => true;

		protected override int ItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				EnsurePoints();
				return points.Count;
			}
		}

		int ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint>.Count => ItemsCount;

		bool ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint>.CanUseIndexation => CanUseIndexation;

		IDataPoint ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint>.this[int index] => GetPoint(index);

		void ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint>.UpdateItems()
		{
		}

		IChartDataAdapter IAssignableAdapter.Assign(SeriesBase owner)
		{
			CachedPointDataAdapter cachedPointDataAdapter = (CachedPointDataAdapter)CreateObjectForClone();
			cachedPointDataAdapter.Owner = owner;
			cachedPointDataAdapter.Assign(this);
			return cachedPointDataAdapter;
		}

		private void EnsurePoints()
		{
			if (NeedRecalculatePoints)
			{
				points = RecalculatePoints();
				NeedRecalculatePoints = false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract List<IDataPoint> RecalculatePoints();

		protected virtual IDataPoint GetPoint(int index)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			return points[index];
		}

		protected override object GetSourceObject(int index)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			return ((ISeriesPoint)points[index]).Tag;
		}

		protected override double GetNumericalValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = (ISeriesPoint)points[index];
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.ConvertToDouble(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(dataMember, seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues));
			}
			return seriesPoint.ArgumentX.NumericalArgument;
		}

		protected override DateTime GetDateTimeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = (ISeriesPoint)points[index];
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.ConvertToDateTime(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(dataMember, seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues));
			}
			return seriesPoint.ArgumentX.DateTimeArgument;
		}

		protected override string GetQualitativeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = (ISeriesPoint)points[index];
			return dataMember switch
			{
				ChartDataMemberType.Argument => seriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument, 
				ChartDataMemberType.ToolTipHint => seriesPoint.ToolTipHint.ToString(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected override TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = (ISeriesPoint)points[index];
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.ConvertToTimeSpan(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(dataMember, seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues));
			}
			return seriesPoint.ArgumentX.TimeSpanArgument;
		}

		protected override object GetObjectValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsurePoints();
			return ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValue((ISeriesPoint)points[index], dataMember);
		}

		protected override void UpdateAdapter(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args, bool raiseEvent = true)
		{
			NeedRecalculatePoints = true;
			base.UpdateAdapter(args, raiseEvent);
		}

		protected override void OnDataChanged(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnDataChanged((args.UpdateType == ChartDataUpdateType.Reset) ? args : new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs());
		}
	}
