	public delegate void NotifyChartDataChangedEventHandler(object sender, ChartDataUpdateEventArgs e);
	public class ChartDataUpdateEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public ChartDataUpdateType UpdateType { get; }

		public int ItemIndex { get; }

		public int Count { get; }

		internal ChartDataUpdateEventArgs()
		{
			UpdateType = ChartDataUpdateType.Reset;
			ItemIndex = -1;
			Count = 1;
		}

		internal ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateType = GetUpdateType(args.Action);
			ItemIndex = GetRowIndex(args);
			Count = GetItemsCount(args);
		}

		internal ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(ListChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateType = GetUpdateType(args.ListChangedType);
			ItemIndex = args.NewIndex;
			Count = 1;
		}

		internal ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(DataChangedEventArgs args)
			: this()
		{
		}

		public ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(ChartDataUpdateType updateType, int rowIndex, int count)
		{
			UpdateType = updateType;
			ItemIndex = rowIndex;
			Count = count;
		}

		private ChartDataUpdateType GetUpdateType(ListChangedType listChangedType)
		{
			return listChangedType switch
			{
				ListChangedType.ItemChanged => ChartDataUpdateType.ItemChanged, 
				ListChangedType.ItemAdded => ChartDataUpdateType.Insert, 
				ListChangedType.ItemDeleted => ChartDataUpdateType.Remove, 
				_ => ChartDataUpdateType.Reset, 
			};
		}

		private ChartDataUpdateType GetUpdateType(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action)
		{
			return action switch
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add => ChartDataUpdateType.Insert, 
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove => ChartDataUpdateType.Remove, 
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace => ChartDataUpdateType.ItemChanged, 
				_ => ChartDataUpdateType.Reset, 
			};
		}

		private int GetRowIndex(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				return args.NewStartingIndex;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				return args.OldStartingIndex;
			default:
				return -1;
			}
		}

		private int GetItemsCount(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				return args.NewItems.Count;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				return args.OldItems.Count;
			default:
				return 1;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataMemberCollection")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableCollectionTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartCollectionSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class DataMemberCollection : ChartElement, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICollection<DataMember>, IEnumerable<DataMember>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<ChartDataMemberType, DataMember> dataMembers = new Dictionary<ChartDataMemberType, DataMember>();

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataMemberCollection.Count")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataMemberCollection.Count")]
		public int Count => dataMembers.Count;

		[NonTestableProperty]
		public string this[ChartDataMemberType key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!dataMembers.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return value.ColumnName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Contains(key))
				{
					Add(new DataMember(key, value));
					return;
				}
				dataMembers[key].PropertyChanged -= OnItemChanged;
				dataMembers[key] = new DataMember(key, value);
				dataMembers[key].PropertyChanged += OnItemChanged;
				OnItemChanged(dataMembers[key], null);
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)dataMembers).IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)dataMembers).SyncRoot;

		bool ICollection<DataMember>.IsReadOnly => false;

		internal event EventHandler<CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember>> CollectionChanged;

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection<DataMember>)this).CopyTo((DataMember[])array, index);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return dataMembers.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<DataMember> IEnumerable<DataMember>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return dataMembers.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection<DataMember>.CopyTo(DataMember[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)this)
			{
				array[arrayIndex + num++] = item;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(new CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember>((CollectionChangedAction)2, (DataMember)sender));
		}

		private void AddCore(DataMember item)
		{
			item.PropertyChanged += OnItemChanged;
			dataMembers.Add(item.DataMemberType, item);
		}

		internal IList<string> GetValueDataMembers(ValueLevel[] valueLevels)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < valueLevels.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(this[ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.ValueLevelToChartDataMemberType(valueLevels[i])]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void RemoveValueDataMember(int index)
		{
			switch (index)
			{
			case 0:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Value);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Low);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Value_1);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMin);
				break;
			case 1:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.High);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Weight);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Value_2);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_1);
				break;
			case 2:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Open);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMedian);
				break;
			case 3:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.Close);
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_3);
				break;
			case 4:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMax);
				break;
			case 5:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMean);
				break;
			case 6:
				Remove(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotOutliers);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void OnCollectionChanged(CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember> args)
		{
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, args);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DataMemberCollection();
		}

		public void Add(DataMember item)
		{
			AddCore(item);
			OnCollectionChanged(new CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember>((CollectionChangedAction)0, item));
		}

		public void AddRange(DataMember[] items)
		{
			foreach (DataMember item in items)
			{
				AddCore(item);
			}
			OnCollectionChanged(new CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember>((CollectionChangedAction)4, (DataMember)null));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)this)
			{
				item.PropertyChanged -= OnItemChanged;
			}
			dataMembers.Clear();
			OnCollectionChanged(new CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember>((CollectionChangedAction)3, (DataMember)null));
		}

		public bool Contains(ChartDataMemberType dataMemberType)
		{
			return dataMembers.ContainsKey(dataMemberType);
		}

		public bool Contains(DataMember dataMember)
		{
			return Contains(dataMember.DataMemberType);
		}

		public bool Remove(ChartDataMemberType dataMemberType)
		{
			if (!dataMembers.ContainsKey(dataMemberType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Remove(dataMembers[dataMemberType]);
		}

		public bool Remove(DataMember dataMember)
		{
			dataMember.PropertyChanged -= OnItemChanged;
			bool result = dataMembers.Remove(dataMember.DataMemberType);
			OnCollectionChanged(new CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember>((CollectionChangedAction)1, dataMember));
			return result;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class DataSourceAdapterBase : BaseDataAdapter, ISeriesDataAdapter, IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider, IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem, IFilteredComponent, IFilteredComponentBase, IFilteringUIClient, IFilterCriteriaBindingAware, IFilterCriteriaProvider, ISeriesProvider, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, Scale> columnActualScaleType = new Dictionary<string, Scale>();

		private readonly Dictionary<ChartDataMemberType, string> dataMemberColumn = new Dictionary<ChartDataMemberType, string>();

		private readonly Dictionary<string, DataBrowser> dataBrowsersCache = new Dictionary<string, DataBrowser>();

		private readonly DataMemberCollection dataMembers = new DataMemberCollection();

		private readonly IList<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields = new List<ICalculatedField>();

		private readonly SeriesFilterHelper filterHelper;

		private DataContextBase dataContext;

		private bool isExternalDataContext;

		private object chartDataSource;

		private object actualDataSource;

		private string chartDataMember = string.Empty;

		private DataSourceEventManagerBase dataSourceEventManager;

		private DataBrowser listBrowser;

		private CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator;

		private bool dataSorted;

		private IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> rawCalculatedFields;

		private int startPosition;

		private IEndUserFilteringViewModelProvider endUserFilteringViewModelProvider;

		private IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget bindingTarget;

		private DataSourceEventManagerBase DataSourceEventManager
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSourceEventManager;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSourceEventManager != null)
				{
					dataSourceEventManager.UnsubscribeEvents();
				}
				dataSourceEventManager = value;
				if (dataSourceEventManager != null)
				{
					dataSourceEventManager.SubscribeEvents();
				}
			}
		}

		private IEndUserFilteringViewModelProvider EndUserFilteringViewModelProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (endUserFilteringViewModelProvider == null && ChartContainer != null)
				{
					endUserFilteringViewModelProvider = ChartContainer.GetFilteringViewModelProvider(filterHelper);
				}
				return endUserFilteringViewModelProvider;
			}
		}

		protected internal object ActualDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return actualDataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualDataSource != value)
				{
					DataSourceEventManager = DataSourceEventManagerBase.CreateDataSourceEventManager(this, value);
					actualDataSource = value;
					UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(), IsOwnDataSource);
					UpdateFilterCriteria();
				}
			}
		}

		internal DataBrowser ListBrowser
		{
			get
			{
				if (listBrowser == null)
				{
					listBrowser = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(ActualDataSource, DataContext, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(ChartDataMember, (DataMembers.Count > 0) ? DataMembers.ElementAt(0).ColumnName : string.Empty));
				}
				return listBrowser;
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> CalculatedFields
		{
			get
			{
				return calculatedFields;
			}
			set
			{
				if (rawCalculatedFields == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				rawCalculatedFields = value;
				calculatedFields.Clear();
				if (value != null)
				{
					foreach (IChartCalculatedField item in value)
					{
						calculatedFields.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)new CalculatedFieldData(item, ActualDataSource));
					}
				}
				ClearDataContext();
				if (!isExternalDataContext)
				{
					DataContext = null;
				}
				ClearDataMembersCache();
			}
		}

		internal DataContextBase DataContext
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (dataContext == null)
				{
					dataContext = (DataContextBase)(object)(CalculatedFields.Any() ? new ChartDataContext(CalculatedFields) : ((ChartDataContext)new DataContextBase()));
				}
				return dataContext;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataContext != value)
				{
					if (dataContext != null && !isExternalDataContext)
					{
						dataContext.Dispose();
					}
					isExternalDataContext = value != null;
					dataContext = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string ChartDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return chartDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(chartDataMember == value))
				{
					chartDataMember = value;
					UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(), raiseEvent: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal object ChartDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return chartDataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (chartDataSource != value)
				{
					chartDataSource = value;
					if (CanSetActualDataSource)
					{
						ActualDataSource = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanSetActualDataSource => true;

		protected virtual bool IsOwnDataSource => false;

		protected virtual CriteriaOperator FilterCriteriaInternal => FilterCriteria;

		protected int ItemsCountCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (ListBrowser == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return ListBrowser.Count;
			}
		}

		protected override int ItemsCount => ItemsCountCore;

		protected override bool DataSortedCore => DataSorted;

		protected override bool ColorEnabled => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Color]);

		protected override bool ToolTipHintEnabled => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.ToolTipHint]);

		protected override bool FilteringEnabled => filterHelper.Enabled;

		{
			return DataSorted;

		{
			DataSorted = false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeFilterString() && dataMembers.Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDataSorted();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DataSourceEventManager?.UnsubscribeEvents();
			if (dataContext != null && !isExternalDataContext)
			{
				dataContext.Dispose();
			}
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			ResetExternalDataContext();
			UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(args), IsOwnDataSource);
		}

		{
			ResetExternalDataContext();
			UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(args), IsOwnDataSource);
		}

		{
			ResetExternalDataContext();
			UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(args), IsOwnDataSource);
		}

		private Scale GetValueScaleType()
		{
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)DataMembers)
			{
				if (ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.IsValueDataMember(item.DataMemberType))
				{
					return (Scale)GetScaleType(item.DataMemberType);
				}
			}
			return Scale.Numerical;
		}

		IList<string> ISeriesDataAdapter.GetSeriesValueDataMembers()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)DataMembers)
			{
				if (ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.IsValueDataMember(item.DataMemberType) && !list.Contains(item.ColumnName))
				{
					list.Add(item.ColumnName);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

		{
			return XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName);
		}

		protected virtual void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, object item)
		{
			if (propertyName == "DataMembers")
			{
				dataMembers.Add((DataMember)item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual object XtraCreateCollectionItem(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "DataMembers")
			{
				return new DataMember();
			}
			return null;
		}

		bool IFilteringUIClient.EnsureProviderInitialized()
		{
			return filterHelper.EnsureFilteringUIDataProperties();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "FilterString")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFilterString();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private void BindingTargetChanged()
		{
			if (base.Series != null && !base.Series.Loading)
			{
				IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget obj = bindingTarget;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.RaiseFilterCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetColumnName(ChartDataMemberType chartDataMemberType)
		{
			if (!dataMemberColumn.Keys.Contains(chartDataMemberType))
			{
				AddDataMember(chartDataMemberType);
			}
			return dataMemberColumn[chartDataMemberType];
		}

		private Scale GetActualScaleCore(string columnName)
		{
			if (!columnActualScaleType.Keys.Contains(columnName))
			{
				columnActualScaleType[columnName] = CalculateResultScaleType(columnName);
			}
			return columnActualScaleType[columnName];
		}

		private Scale CalculateResultScaleType(string columnName)
		{
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)DataMembers)
			{
				if (BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(ChartDataMember, item.ColumnName) == columnName)
				{
					if (item.ScaleType != ScaleType.Auto)
					{
						return (Scale)item.ScaleType;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return ScaleTypeUtils.GetScaleByType(DataContext.GetPropertyType(ActualDataSource, columnName));
		}

		private void AddDataMember(ChartDataMemberType chartDataMemberType)
		{
			string text = DataMembers[chartDataMemberType];
			string value = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(ChartDataMember, text);
			if (text == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				dataMemberColumn[chartDataMemberType] = null;
			}
			else
			{
				dataMemberColumn[chartDataMemberType] = value;
			}
		}

		private void ResetExternalDataContext()
		{
			if (isExternalDataContext)
			{
				DataBrowser obj = DataContext[ActualDataSource];
				ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((obj is ListBrowser) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ResetList();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearDataContext()
		{
			if (!isExternalDataContext)
			{
				DataContext.Clear();
			}
			listBrowser = null;
			dataBrowsersCache.Clear();
		}

		private void SetDataSourcePosition(int position)
		{
			if (ListBrowser != null && ListBrowser.Position != position)
			{
				ListBrowser.Position = position;
			}
		}

		private void DataMemberChanged(object sender, CollectionChangedEventArgs<DataMember> e)
		{
			RaiseReset();
		}

		private DataBrowser GetDataBrowser(string dataMember)
		{
			if (!dataBrowsersCache.ContainsKey(dataMember))
			{
				dataBrowsersCache.Add(dataMember, DataContext.GetDataBrowser(ActualDataSource, dataMember, true));
			}
			return dataBrowsersCache[dataMember];
		}

		private string GetString(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			object value = GetValue(index, dataMember);
			if (value == null)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.DefaultQualitativeValue;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		private bool IsHistogramDataMember(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return dataMember == ChartDataMemberType.Argument;
		}

		private object GetValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			SetDataSourcePosition(index);
			string columnName = GetColumnName(dataMember);
			if (columnName != null)
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = GetDataBrowser(columnName);
				if (dataBrowser != null)
				{
					return GetValue(dataBrowser, dataMember);
				}
			}
			if (IsHistogramDataMember(dataMember))
			{
				DataBrowser obj = ListBrowser;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return obj.Current;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object GetValue(DataBrowser browser, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotOutliers)
			{
				return browser.Current;
			}
			return browser.DataSource;
		}

		private string GetDataMemberName(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return DataMembers[dataMember];
		}

		private Scale GetScaleForHistogram()
		{
			DataBrowser obj = ListBrowser;
			Type type = ((obj != null) ? obj.DataSourceType.GetElementType() : null);
			DataBrowser obj2 = ListBrowser;
			if (obj2 != null && obj2.DataSourceType.GenericTypeArguments.Length == 1)
			{
				DataBrowser obj3 = ListBrowser;
				type = ((obj3 != null) ? obj3.DataSourceType.GenericTypeArguments[0] : null);
			}
			Scale scaleByType = ScaleTypeUtils.GetScaleByType(type);
			if (base.Series == null || !base.Series.View.CanLoadOneDimensionData((ScaleType)scaleByType))
			{
				return Scale.Auto;
			}
			return scaleByType;
		}

		private void EnsureDataSource()
		{
			ChartDataSource = base.Series?.DataContainer?.ActualDataSource;
		}

		private void ClearDataMembersCache()
		{
			dataMemberColumn.Clear();
			columnActualScaleType.Clear();
		}

		private void ClearCacheIfNeed(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args.UpdateType == ChartDataUpdateType.Reset)
			{
				ClearDataMembersCache();
			}
			ClearDataContext();
		}

		internal void EnsureIndicator(IDataSourceIndicator dataSourceIndicator)
		{
			DataSourceBasedErrorBars dataSourceBasedErrorBars = dataSourceIndicator as DataSourceBasedErrorBars;
			UpdateDataMember(ChartDataMemberType.ErrorBarsNegativeError, dataSourceBasedErrorBars?.NegativeErrorDataMember);
			UpdateDataMember(ChartDataMemberType.ErrorBarsPositiveError, dataSourceBasedErrorBars?.PositiveErrorDataMember);
		}

		internal void UpdateArgumentAndValueDataMembers(string chartDataMember)
		{
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)dataMembers)
			{
				item.ColumnName = SeriesBase.CutDataMember(chartDataMember, item.ColumnName);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			if (ListBrowser != null)
			{
				startPosition = ListBrowser.Position;
			}
		}

		internal void Restore()
		{
			if (ListBrowser != null)
			{
				ListBrowser.Position = startPosition;
			}
		}

		internal Scale GetScaleTypeCore(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			string columnName = GetColumnName(dataMember);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
			{
				return GetActualScaleCore(columnName);
			}
			EnsureDataSource();
			if (IsHistogramDataMember(dataMember))
			{
				return GetScaleForHistogram();
			}
			return Scale.Auto;
		}

		protected void RaiseReset()
		{
			UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs());
		}

		protected void UpdateFilterCriteria()
		{
			filterHelper.OnUpdateCriteria();
		}

		protected void UpdateDataMember(ChartDataMemberType dataMember, string columnName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
			{
				DataMembers.Remove(dataMember);
			}
			else
			{
				DataMembers[dataMember] = columnName;
			}
		}

		protected object GetSourceObjectCore(int index)
		{
			SetDataSourcePosition(index);
			if (ListBrowser == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ListBrowser.Current;
		}

		protected double GetNumericalValueCore(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			object value = GetValue(index, dataMember);
			return DataItemsHelper.ParseNumerical(value, DataItemsHelper.DefaultNumericValue);
		}

		protected DateTime GetDateTimeValueCore(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return DataItemsHelper.ParseDateTime(GetValue(index, dataMember), DataItemsHelper.DefaultDateTimeValue);
		}

		protected string GetQualitativeValueCore(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetString(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValueCore(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return DataItemsHelper.ParseTimeSpan(GetValue(index, dataMember), DataItemsHelper.DefaultTimeSpanValue);
		}

		protected object GetObjectValueCore(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetValue(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override object GetSourceObject(int index)
		{
			return GetSourceObjectCore(index);
		}

		protected override double GetNumericalValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetNumericalValueCore(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override DateTime GetDateTimeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetDateTimeValueCore(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override string GetQualitativeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetQualitativeValueCore(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetTimeSpanValueCore(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected virtual IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget CreateFilterCriteriaBindingTarget()
		{
			return (IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget)(object)new ChartFilterCriteriaBindingTarget(this);
		}

		protected override ActualScaleType GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			Scale scaleTypeCore = GetScaleTypeCore(dataMember);
			if (scaleTypeCore != Scale.Auto)
			{
				return (ActualScaleType)scaleTypeCore;
			}
			return ActualScaleType.Numerical;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateAdapter(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args, bool raiseEvent = true)
		{
			ClearCacheIfNeed(args);
			if (raiseEvent)
			{
				OnDataChanged(args);
			}
		}

		protected override object GetObjectValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return GetObjectValueCore(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemFit(int index)
		{
			return ((ControlFilterHelper<object>)(object)filterHelper).IsFit(GetSourceObject(index));
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers)
			{
				DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(item.DataMemberType, item.ColumnName, item.ScaleType));
			}
			FilterString = dataSourceAdapterBase.FilterString;
			DataSorted = dataSourceAdapterBase.DataSorted;
		}

		public void SetDataMembers(string argumentDataMember, string valueDataMember)
		{
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Argument, argumentDataMember));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Value, valueDataMember));
		}

		public void SetFinancialDataMembers(string argumentDataMember, string lowDataMember, string highDataMember, string openDataMember, string closeDataMember)

			dataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Value_2, value2DataMember));
		}

		}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataSourceAdapter")]
	public class DataSourceAdapter : DataSourceAdapterBase, ISeriesAdapter, IChartDataAdapter, ICloneable
	{
		private object dataSource;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataSourceAdapter.DataSource")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataSourceAdapter.DataSource")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[AttributeProvider(typeof(IListSource))]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DataSourceConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSource != value)
				{
					UpdateAdapter(new DataSourceChangedEventArgs(changing: true, value));
					dataSource = value;
					base.ActualDataSource = ((dataSource != null) ? dataSource : base.ChartDataSource);
					UpdateAdapter(new DataSourceChangedEventArgs(changing: false, dataSource));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsOwnDataSource => base.ActualDataSource == DataSource;

		protected override bool CanSetActualDataSource => DataSource == null;

		public DataSourceAdapter()
		{
		}

		public DataSourceAdapter(object dataSource)
		{
			DataSource = dataSource;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DataSourceAdapter();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DataSourceAdapter { DataSource: not null } dataSourceAdapter)
			{
				DataSource = dataSourceAdapter.DataSource;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDataSource()
		{
			if (ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.DataProvider != null)
			{
				return ChartContainer.DataProvider.ShouldSerializeDataSource(DataSource);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetDataSource()
		{
			DataSource = null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDataSource();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "DataSource")
			{
				if (base.Series?.ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.XRControl)
				{
					return DataSource != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IChartDataAdapter.get_DataSorted()
		{
			return base.DataSorted;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateAdapter")]
	public class SeriesTemplateAdapter : DataSourceAdapterBase, ISeriesTemplateAdapter, IChartDataAdapter, ICloneable, IAssignableAdapter
	{
		private CriteriaOperator drillDownCriteria;

		internal CriteriaOperator DrillDownCriteria
		{
			get
			{
				return drillDownCriteria;
			}
			set
			{
				drillDownCriteria = value;
				UpdateFilterCriteria();
				UpdateAdapter(new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(), raiseEvent: false);
			}
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator FilterCriteriaInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (DrillDownCriteria != null)
				{
					if (base.FilterCriteria == null)
					{
						return DrillDownCriteria;
					}
					return CriteriaOperator.And(DrillDownCriteria, base.FilterCriteria);
				}
				return base.FilterCriteria;
			}
		}

		IChartDataAdapter IAssignableAdapter.Assign(SeriesBase owner)
		{
			DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase = ((owner is Series) ? ((DataSourceAdapterBase)new DataSourceAdapter()) : ((DataSourceAdapterBase)new SeriesTemplateAdapter()));
			dataSourceAdapterBase.Assign(this);
			dataSourceAdapterBase.ChartDataSource = base.ChartDataSource;
			dataSourceAdapterBase.ChartDataMember = base.ChartDataMember;
			dataSourceAdapterBase.CalculatedFields = base.CalculatedFields;
			dataSourceAdapterBase.DataContext = base.DataContext;
			return dataSourceAdapterBase;
		}

		internal void EnsureColorizer(IDataSourceColorizer colorizer)
		{
			UpdateDataMember(ChartDataMemberType.SeriesColor, colorizer?.SeriesColorMember);
			UpdateDataMember(ChartDataMemberType.SeriesKey, colorizer?.SeriesKeyMember);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesTemplateAdapter();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IChartDataAdapter.get_DataSorted()
		{
			return base.DataSorted;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ResamplingDataAdapter")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public class ResamplingDataAdapter : CachedPointDataAdapter, IViewportChangedNotifiable
	{
		private const double ViewportFactor = 0.75;

		private readonly List<DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>> currentUpdates = new List<DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>>();

		private ResamplerData resamplerData;

		internal ResamplerData ResamplerData => resamplerData;

		protected bool CanUseResampling => AllowUseResamplingBindingProcedure((Series)base.Series);

		protected override bool CanUseIndexation => CanUseResampling;

		protected override int ItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!CanUseResampling)
				{
					return base.ItemsCountCore;
				}
				return base.ItemsCount;
			}
		}

		void IViewportChangedNotifiable.Notify()
		{
			currentUpdates.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>((Series)base.Series, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ViewportChanged, -1, 1));
			NeedRecalculatePoints = true;
		}

		private bool AllowUseResamplingBindingProcedure(IResamplingSupportSeries irss)
		{
			if (irss != null)
			{
				return !irss.Require2dResampling;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure CreateBindingProcedure()
		{
			IResamplingSupportSeries resamplingSupportSeries = base.Series as IResamplingSupportSeries;
			if (!AllowUseResamplingBindingProcedure(resamplingSupportSeries))
			{
				throw new Exception("Unsupported series view type for resampling");
			}
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps = GetArgumentScaleMaps(resamplingSupportSeries);
			if (argumentMaps == null)
			{
				resamplingSupportSeries.ForceInitialize();
				argumentMaps = GetArgumentScaleMaps(resamplingSupportSeries);
			}
			SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot sanpshot = new SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot((Series)base.Series);
			Func<double, IComparable> refinedToNativeCallback = (double argument) => (IComparable)((argumentMaps == null) ? ((object)argument) : ((IComparable)argumentMaps[0].RefinedToNative(argument)));
			Func<IComparable, double> argumentRefineCallback = (IComparable argument) => (argumentMaps == null) ? ((!(argument is DateTime)) ? Convert.ToDouble(argument) : 0.0) : argumentMaps[0].NativeToRefined(argument);
			return new ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure(sanpshot, resamplerData, argumentRefineCallback, refinedToNativeCallback)
			{
				MaximumAllowedPointCount = resamplingSupportSeries.MaximumPointCount
			};
		}

		private List<AxisScaleTypeMap> GetArgumentScaleMaps(IResamplingSupportSeries resamplingSeries)
		{
			RefinedSeries refinedSeries = resamplingSeries.GetRefinedSeries();
			refinedSeries?.ArgumentGroups?[0].UpdateScaleMap(forceCreate: false, shouldRecalculateArgumentScale: false);
			return refinedSeries?.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
		}

		protected override List<IDataPoint> RecalculatePoints()
		{
			ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure resamplingSeriesBindingProcedure = CreateBindingProcedure();
			resamplingSeriesBindingProcedure.ProcessUpdates(currentUpdates);
			List<IDataPoint> result = resamplingSeriesBindingProcedure.CreateBindingPoints();
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = resamplerData?.VisibleRange;
			resamplerData = resamplingSeriesBindingProcedure.ResamplerData;
			if (resamplerData != null)
			{
				resamplerData.VisibleRange = minMaxValues ?? resamplingSeriesBindingProcedure.ResamplerData.VisibleRange;
			}
			currentUpdates.Clear();
			return result;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ResamplingDataAdapter();
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			resamplerData = null;
		}

		protected override object GetSourceObject(int index)
		{
			if (!CanUseResampling)
			{
				return GetSourceObjectCore(index);
			}
			return base.GetSourceObject(index);
		}

		protected override double GetNumericalValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (!CanUseResampling)
			{
				return GetNumericalValueCore(index, dataMember);
			}
			return base.GetNumericalValue(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override DateTime GetDateTimeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (!CanUseResampling)
			{
				return GetDateTimeValueCore(index, dataMember);
			}
			return base.GetDateTimeValue(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override string GetQualitativeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (!CanUseResampling)
			{
				return GetQualitativeValueCore(index, dataMember);
			}
			return base.GetQualitativeValue(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (!CanUseResampling)
			{
				return GetTimeSpanValueCore(index, dataMember);
			}
			return base.GetTimeSpanValue(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override object GetObjectValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (!CanUseResampling)
			{
				return GetObjectValueCore(index, dataMember);
			}
			return base.GetObjectValue(index, dataMember);
		}

		protected override void UpdateAdapter(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args, bool raiseEvent = true)
		{
			currentUpdates.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(null, (ChartDataSourceUpdateType)args.UpdateType, args.ItemIndex, args.Count));
			base.UpdateAdapter(args, raiseEvent);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(ResamplingDataAdapter)";
		}
	}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter.Points")]

		bool IChartDataAdapter.DataSorted

		{
			return ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValue(points[index], dataMember);
		}

		void ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint>.UpdateItems()
		{
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(propertyName, ((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName);
		}

		protected virtual void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, object item)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Points")
			{
				Points.Add((SeriesPoint)item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual object XtraCreateCollectionItem(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Points")
			{
				return new SeriesPoint();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ActualScaleType GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return GetActualValueScaleType();
			}
			return GetActualArgumentScaleType();
		}

		private ActualScaleType GetActualValueScaleType()
		{
			return ScaleTypeUtils.ScaleTypeToActualScaleType(Series.ValueScaleType);
		}

		private ActualScaleType GetActualArgumentScaleType()
		{
			ScaleType scaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			if (points.IsBoundPoints)
			{
				if (points.BoundPoints[0] is ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
				{
					scaleType = (ScaleType)seriesPoint.ArgumentX.ArgumentScaleType;
				}
			}
			else if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				scaleType = points[0].ArgumentScaleType;
			}
			return ScaleTypeUtils.ScaleTypeToActualScaleType(scaleType);
		}

		private double GetNumericValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			double? num = ((dataMember == ChartDataMemberType.Argument) ? new double?(points[index].NumericalArgument) : points[index].GetNumericValue(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.DataMemberToValueLevel(dataMember)));
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return num.Value;
		}

		private DateTime GetDateTimeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			DateTime? dateTime = ((dataMember == ChartDataMemberType.Argument) ? new DateTime?(points[index].DateTimeArgument) : points[index].GetDateTimeValue(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.DataMemberToValueLevel(dataMember)));
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			return dateTime.Value;
		}

		private TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			TimeSpan? timeSpan = ((dataMember == ChartDataMemberType.Argument) ? new TimeSpan?(points[index].TimeSpanArgument) : points[index].GetTimeSpanValue(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.DataMemberToValueLevel(dataMember)));
			if (!timeSpan.HasValue)
			{
				return TimeSpan.MinValue;
			}
			return timeSpan.Value;
		}

		private string GetQualitativeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return dataMember switch
			{
				ChartDataMemberType.Argument => points[index].Argument, 
				ChartDataMemberType.ToolTipHint => points[index].ToolTipHint, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal void OnDataChanged(object sender, ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (DataChanged != null)
			{
				DataChanged(sender, args);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			points.Owner = (Series)newOwner;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "TypeNameSerializable")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter)
			{
				points.Assign(seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter.Points);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter))
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return ((SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter)obj).Points.Equals(points);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return points.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter)";
		}
	}

	public class SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter : SeriesTemplateAdapter, ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries>, ISummaryAdapter, ISummaryOptionsOwner

			_ => null,

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.NumericSummaryOptions")]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.DateTimeSummaryOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.DateTimeSummaryOptions")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public DateTimeSummaryOptions DateTimeSummaryOptions => dateTimeSummaryOptions;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.TimeSpanSummaryOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.TimeSpanSummaryOptions")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public TimeSpanSummaryOptions TimeSpanSummaryOptions => timeSpanSummaryOptions;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.QualitativeSummaryOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.QualitativeSummaryOptions")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public QualitativeSummaryOptions QualitativeSummaryOptions => qualitativeSummaryOptions;

		bool ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries>.CanUseIndexation => true;

		int ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries>.Count
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureSeries();
				return series.Count;
			}
		}

		ISeries ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureSeries();
				return series[index];
			}
		}

		SummaryOptionsBase ISummaryAdapter.ActualSummaryOptions => ActualSummaryOptions;

		IChartContainer ISummaryOptionsOwner.ChartContainer => ((ISummaryOptionsOwner)base.Series).ChartContainer;

		object ISummaryOptionsOwner.DataSource => ((ISummaryOptionsOwner)base.Series).DataSource;

		string ISummaryOptionsOwner.ChartDataMember => ((ISummaryOptionsOwner)base.Series).ChartDataMember;

		{
			get

				return ActualSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction;
			}

		ScaleType ISummaryOptionsOwner.ValueScaleType => ((ISummaryOptionsOwner)base.Series).ValueScaleType;

		protected override int ItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
				{
					num += series[i].ActualPoints.Count;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter()
		{
			numericSummaryOptions = new NumericSummaryOptions(this);
			dateTimeSummaryOptions = new DateTimeSummaryOptions(this);
			timeSpanSummaryOptions = new TimeSpanSummaryOptions(this);
			qualitativeSummaryOptions = new QualitativeSummaryOptions(this);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeNumericSummaryOptions()
		{
			return numericSummaryOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDateTimeSummaryOptions()
		{
			return dateTimeSummaryOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTimeSpanSummaryOptions()
		{
			return timeSpanSummaryOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeQualitativeSummaryOptions()
		{
			return qualitativeSummaryOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeNumericSummaryOptions() && !ShouldSerializeDateTimeSummaryOptions() && !ShouldSerializeTimeSpanSummaryOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeQualitativeSummaryOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		void ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries>.UpdateItems()
		{
			needRecalculateSeries = true;
			EnsureSeries();
		}

		void ISummaryAdapter.Update()
		{
			RaiseReset();
		}

		void ISummaryAdapter.CheckSummaryFunction(string functionString)
		{
			base.Series?.CheckSummaryFunction(functionString);
		}

		private void EnsureSeries()
		{
			if (needRecalculateSeries)
			{
				series = RecalculateSeries();
				needRecalculateSeries = false;
			}
		}

		private IList<ISeries> RecalculateSeries()
		{
			return CreateBindingProcedure()?.CreateBindingSeries((SortMode)base.Chart.DataContainer.BoundSeriesSorting, null) ?? new List<ISeries>();
		}

		private ChartBindingProcedure CreateBindingProcedure()
		{
			if (base.Chart.Container != null)
			{
				string functionName = new SummaryFunctionParser(ActualSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction).FunctionName;
				SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = base.Chart.Container.Chart.SummaryFunctions[functionName];
				if (summaryFunctionDescription == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new SummaryChartBindingProcedure(base.DataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Series], (SeriesTemplate)base.Series, new SummaryBindingProvider(summaryFunctionDescription.CustomFunction, summaryFunctionDescription.PredefinedFunction, ActualSummaryOptions));
			}
			return new SimpleChartBindingProcedure(base.DataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Series], (SeriesTemplate)base.Series, allowCachedUpdates: true);
		}

		private ISeriesPoint GetPoint(int index)
		{
			int i;
			for (i = 0; index >= series[i].ActualPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				index -= series[i].ActualPoints.Count;
			}
			return (ISeriesPoint)series[i].ActualPoints[index];
		}

		protected override object GetSourceObject(int index)
		{
			EnsureSeries();
			return GetPoint(index).Tag;
		}

		protected override double GetNumericalValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsureSeries();
			ISeriesPoint point = GetPoint(index);
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.ConvertToDouble(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(dataMember, point.Values.NumericalValues));
			}
			return point.ArgumentX.NumericalArgument;
		}

		protected override DateTime GetDateTimeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsureSeries();
			ISeriesPoint point = GetPoint(index);
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.ConvertToDateTime(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(dataMember, point.Values.DateTimeValues));
			}
			return point.ArgumentX.DateTimeArgument;
		}

		protected override string GetQualitativeValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsureSeries();
			ISeriesPoint point = GetPoint(index);
			return dataMember switch
			{
				ChartDataMemberType.Argument => point.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument, 
				ChartDataMemberType.ToolTipHint => point.ToolTipHint.ToString(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected override TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsureSeries();
			ISeriesPoint point = GetPoint(index);
			if (dataMember != ChartDataMemberType.Argument)
			{
				return DataItemsHelper.ConvertToTimeSpan(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(dataMember, point.Values.TimeSpanValues));
			}
			return point.ArgumentX.TimeSpanArgument;
		}

		protected override object GetObjectValue(int index, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			EnsureSeries();
			return ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValue(GetPoint(index), dataMember);
		}

		protected override void UpdateAdapter(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args, bool raiseEvent = true)
		{
			needRecalculateSeries = true;
			base.UpdateAdapter(args, raiseEvent);
		}

		protected override void OnDataChanged(ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnDataChanged((args.UpdateType == ChartDataUpdateType.Reset) ? args : new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs());
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter)
			{
				numericSummaryOptions.Assign(seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.numericSummaryOptions);
				dateTimeSummaryOptions.Assign(seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.dateTimeSummaryOptions);
				timeSpanSummaryOptions.Assign(seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.timeSpanSummaryOptions);
				qualitativeSummaryOptions.Assign(seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter.qualitativeSummaryOptions);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter)";
		}
	}

		void ISummaryAdapter.CheckSummaryFunction(string functionString)

		}

		private SummarySeriesBindingProcedureBase CreateBindingProcedure()
		{
			if (base.Series.ChartContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string functionName = new SummaryFunctionParser(ActualSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction).FunctionName;
			SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = base.Series.ChartContainer.Chart.SummaryFunctions[functionName];
			if (summaryFunctionDescription == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot seriesDataAdapterSnapshot = new SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot((Series)base.Series);
			if (base.DataSorted)
			{
				return new SummarySeriesSortedBindingProcedure(seriesDataAdapterSnapshot, new SummaryBindingProvider(summaryFunctionDescription.CustomFunction, summaryFunctionDescription.PredefinedFunction, ActualSummaryOptions));
			}
			return new SummarySeriesBindingProcedure(seriesDataAdapterSnapshot, new SummaryBindingProvider(summaryFunctionDescription.CustomFunction, summaryFunctionDescription.PredefinedFunction, ActualSummaryOptions));
		}

		protected override List<IDataPoint> RecalculatePoints()
		{
			return CreateBindingProcedure()?.CreateBindingPoints() ?? new List<IDataPoint>();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SummaryDataAdapter();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SummaryDataAdapter summaryDataAdapter)
			{
				numericSummaryOptions.Assign(summaryDataAdapter.numericSummaryOptions);
				dateTimeSummaryOptions.Assign(summaryDataAdapter.dateTimeSummaryOptions);
				timeSpanSummaryOptions.Assign(summaryDataAdapter.timeSpanSummaryOptions);
				qualitativeSummaryOptions.Assign(summaryDataAdapter.qualitativeSummaryOptions);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(SummaryDataAdapter)";
		}
	}
	public abstract class Axis : Axis2D, IAutoScaleBreaksContainer
	{
		private readonly ScaleBreakCollection scaleBreaks;

		private readonly ScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions;

		private readonly AutoScaleBreaks autoScaleBreaks;

		private bool reverse;

		protected virtual bool DefaultReverse => false;

		protected override bool ShouldCalculateRangeLimits => base.XYDiagram2D != null;

		protected override IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> ScaleBreaksEnumeration => scaleBreaks;

		protected internal override int DefaultGridSpacingFactor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsVertical)
				{
					return 50;
				}
				if (base.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
				{
					return 15;
				}
				return 30;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ActualReverse => reverse;

		protected internal override int IntervalsDistance => scaleBreakOptions.SizeInPixels + 1;

		protected internal override ScaleBreakOptions ActualScaleBreakOptions => scaleBreakOptions;

		protected internal XYDiagram XYDiagram => base.Owner as XYDiagram;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.Reverse")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.Reverse")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Reverse
		{
			get
			{
				return reverse;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != reverse)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					reverse = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.ScaleBreaks")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.ScaleBreaks")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Elements)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ScaleBreakCollectionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public ScaleBreakCollection ScaleBreaks => scaleBreaks;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.ScaleBreakOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.ScaleBreakOptions")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public ScaleBreakOptions ScaleBreakOptions => scaleBreakOptions;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.AutoScaleBreaks")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Axis.AutoScaleBreaks")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public AutoScaleBreaks AutoScaleBreaks => autoScaleBreaks;

		bool IAutoScaleBreaksContainer.Enabled => autoScaleBreaks.Enabled;

		bool IAutoScaleBreaksContainer.IsArgumentContainer => !IsValuesAxis;

		IList<IScaleDiapason> IAutoScaleBreaksContainer.ScaleDiapasons => autoScaleBreaks.ScaleBreaks;

		IAutoScaleBreaksCreator IAutoScaleBreaksContainer.Creator => autoScaleBreaks.ScaleBreaksCreator;

		int IAutoScaleBreaksContainer.MaxCount => autoScaleBreaks.MaxCount;

		protected Axis(string name, XYDiagram diagram)
			: base(name, diagram)
		{
			reverse = DefaultReverse;
			scaleBreaks = new ScaleBreakCollection(this);
			scaleBreakOptions = new ScaleBreakOptions(this);
			autoScaleBreaks = new AutoScaleBreaks(this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Reverse" => ShouldSerializeReverse(), 
				"ScaleBreakOptions" => ShouldSerializeScaleBreakOptions(), 
				"AutoScaleBreaks" => ShouldSerializeAutoScaleBreaks(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, object item)
		{
			if (propertyName == "ScaleBreaks")
			{
				scaleBreaks.Add((ScaleBreak)item);
			}
			else
			{
				base.XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(propertyName, item);
			}
		}

		protected override object XtraCreateCollectionItem(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "ScaleBreaks")
			{
				return new ScaleBreak();
			}
			return base.XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeReverse()
		{
			return reverse != DefaultReverse;
		}

		private void ResetReverse()
		{
			Reverse = DefaultReverse;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeScaleBreakOptions()
		{
			return scaleBreakOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAutoScaleBreaks()
		{
			return autoScaleBreaks.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Axis axis)
			{
				reverse = axis.reverse;
				scaleBreaks.Assign(axis.scaleBreaks);
				scaleBreakOptions.Assign(axis.scaleBreakOptions);
				autoScaleBreaks.Assign(axis.autoScaleBreaks);
			}
		}
	}

	}

		private bool showBehind;

		private AxisAlignment alignment;

		private Color color = DefaultColor;

		private IList<AxisInterval> intervals;

		private readonly CrosshairAxisLabelOptions crosshairAxisLabelOptions;

		private DefaultBoolean visibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private AxisLabelPosition labelPosition;

		private int id = -1;

		private XYDiagramAppearance DiagramAppearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).XYDiagramAppearance;

		protected bool PositionInsideDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (Alignment != AxisAlignment.Zero)
				{
					return Alignment == AxisAlignment.Center;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool AutomaticVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart != null)
				{
					if (!chart.AutoLayout)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return automaticVisibility;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal Color ActualInterlacedColor
		{
			get
			{
				Color result = base.InterlacedColor;
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return DiagramAppearance.InterlacedColor;
			}
		}

		internal RectangleFillStyle ActualInterlacedFillStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (interlacedFillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Empty)
				{
					return interlacedFillStyle;
				}
				return (RectangleFillStyle)DiagramAppearance.InterlacedFillStyle;
			}
		}

		internal XYDiagram2D XYDiagram2D => base.Owner as XYDiagram2D;

		internal AxisIntervalLayoutCache IntervalBoundsCache => intervalBoundsCache;

		internal Dictionary<IPane, Rectangle> LabelBounds => labelBounds;

		internal Rectangle MaxLabelRectCache { get; set; }

		internal IList<AxisInterval> Intervals
		{
			get
			{
				if (intervals == null || intervals.Count == 0)
				{
					ChartDebug.Fail("At least one axis interval should be defined.");
					AxisInterval[] array = new AxisInterval[1];
					IVisualAxisRangeData visualAxisRangeData = VisualRangeData;
					IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2;
					if (!XYDiagram2D.IsScrollingEnabled)
					{
						IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = VisualRangeData;
						minMaxValues2 = minMaxValues;
					}
					else
					{
						IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = WholeRangeData;
						minMaxValues2 = minMaxValues;
					}
					array[0] = new AxisInterval(visualAxisRangeData, minMaxValues2);
					intervals = array;
				}
				return intervals;
			}
		}

		internal AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache OverlappingCache { get; set; }

		internal GRealRect2D Bounds { get; set; }

		internal AxisLabelAlignmentCore ActualLabelAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (Label.Alignment != AxisLabelAlignment.Auto)
				{
					return (AxisLabelAlignmentCore)Label.Alignment;
				}
				return (AxisLabelAlignmentCore)DefaultLabelAlignment;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllowZoomByAxis => !PositionInsideDiagram;

		internal bool LabelInOutsidePosition => LabelPosition == AxisLabelPosition.Outside;

		protected abstract AxisAlignment DefaultAlignment { get; }

		protected abstract ChartElementVisibilityPriority Priority { get; }

		protected virtual AxisLabelAlignment DefaultLabelAlignment => AxisLabelAlignment.Center;

		protected override IEnumerable<IStrip> StripsEnumeration => strips;

		protected override IEnumerable<IConstantLine> ConstantLinesEnumeration => constantLines;

		protected override IEnumerable<ICustomAxisLabel> CustomLabelsEnumeration => customLabels;

		protected override AxisVisibilityInPanes ActualVisibilityInPanes => visibleInPanesBehavior;

		protected override bool CanShowCustomWithAutoLabels => labelVisibilityMode == AxisLabelVisibilityMode.AutoGeneratedAndCustom;

		protected internal bool ActualVisibility => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(Visibility, AutomaticVisibility);

		protected internal virtual int IntervalsDistance => 0;

		protected internal virtual ScaleBreakOptions ActualScaleBreakOptions => null;

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{

		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName);
		}

		protected virtual void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, object item)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Strips":
				strips.Add((Strip)item);
				break;
			case "ConstantLines":
				constantLines.Add((ConstantLine)item);
				break;
			case "CustomLabels":
				customLabels.Add((CustomAxisLabel)item);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual object XtraCreateCollectionItem(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Strips" => new Strip(), 
				"ConstantLines" => new ConstantLine(), 
				"CustomLabels" => new CustomAxisLabel(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"InterlacedFillStyle" => ShouldSerializeInterlacedFillStyle(), 
				"Tickmarks" => ShouldSerializeTickmarks(), 
				"Title" => ShouldSerializeTitle(), 
				"Label" => ShouldSerializeLabel(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"Alignment" => ShouldSerializeAlignment(), 
				"Thickness" => ShouldSerializeThickness(), 
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"VisibleInPanesSerializable" => ShouldSerializeVisibleInPanesSerializable(), 
				"CrosshairAxisLabelOptions" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairAxisLabelOptions(), 
				"Visibility" => ShouldSerializeVisibility(), 
				"LabelVisibilityMode" => ShouldSerializeLabelVisibilityMode(), 
				"ShowBehind" => ShouldSerializeShowBehind(), 
				"LabelPosition" => ShouldSerializeLabelPosition(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		{
			return new AxisPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected abstract Tickmarks CreateTickmarks();

		protected abstract AxisTitle CreateAxisTitle();

		protected override AxisLabel CreateAxisLabel()
		{
			return new AxisLabel2D(this);
		}

		protected override GRealRect2D GetLabelBounds(IPane pane)
		{
			if (labelBounds.ContainsKey(pane))
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = labelBounds[pane];
				return new GRealRect2D(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
			}
			return GRealRect2D.Empty;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ConstantLine constantLine)
			{
				return constantLines.Contains(constantLine);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			Strips.OnEndLoading();
			ConstantLines.OnEndLoading();
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			visibleInPanesBehavior.ApplyAssignedPaneIds();
		}

		internal Color GetActualColor(AxisMappingBase mapping)
		{
			Color color = this.color;
			if (color == DefaultColor)
			{
				if (mapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram)
				{
					int num = Math.Min(DiagramAppearance.InnerAxisColorAlpha, 255);
					color = Color.FromArgb((num > 0) ? num : 255, DiagramAppearance.InnerAxisColor);
				}
				else
				{
					color = DiagramAppearance.AxisColor;
				}
			}
			return GraphicUtils.GetColor(color, ((IHitTest)this).State);
		}

		internal int GetAxisTitleActualAngle()
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				if (alignment != AxisAlignment.Far)
				{
					return -90;
				}
				return 90;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetConstantLineTitleActualAngle()
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!ActualReverse)
			{
				return 90;
			}
			return -90;
		}

		internal bool VisibleInPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			return visibleInPanesBehavior.GetVisibilityInPane(pane);
		}

		internal void ResetScrollLabelSizeCache()
		{
			MaxLabelRectCache = Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		internal double? CalculateInternalValue(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, int coordinate, int length)
		{
			if (ActualReverse)
			{
				coordinate = length - coordinate;
			}
			if (XYDiagram2D.Chart.CacheToMemory)
			{
				pane.UpdateAxisIntervalBoundsCache(this);
			}
			return IntervalBoundsCache.GetAxisValue(pane, ((IAxisData)this).AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation, coordinate);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				interlacedFillStyle.Assign(axis2D.interlacedFillStyle);
				tickmarks.Assign(axis2D.tickmarks);
				title.Assign(axis2D.title);
				strips.Assign(axis2D.strips);
				constantLines.Assign(axis2D.constantLines);
				customLabels.Assign(axis2D.customLabels);
				visibleInPanesBehavior.Assign(axis2D.visibleInPanesBehavior);
				visibility = axis2D.visibility;
				alignment = axis2D.alignment;
				thickness = axis2D.thickness;
				crosshairAxisLabelOptions.Assign(axis2D.crosshairAxisLabelOptions);
				color = axis2D.color;
				labelVisibilityMode = axis2D.labelVisibilityMode;
				showBehind = axis2D.showBehind;
				labelPosition = axis2D.labelPosition;
			}
		}

		public bool GetVisibilityInPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			return visibleInPanesBehavior.GetVisibilityInPane(pane);
		}

		public void SetVisibilityInPane(bool visible, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			visibleInPanesBehavior.SetVisibilityInPane(pane, visible);
		}
	}

		}

		protected internal override NearTextPosition GetNearTextPosition(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator)
		{
			AxisLabel3D axisLabel3D = base.Label;
			if (axisLabel3D != null && axisLabel3D.Position != AxisLabel3DPosition.Auto)
			{
				return (NearTextPosition)axisLabel3D.Position;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.Project(DiagramPoint.Zero);
			if (!(coordsCalculator.Project(new DiagramPoint(0.0, coordsCalculator.Height, 0.0)).Y >= diagramPoint.Y))
			{
				return NearTextPosition.Bottom;
			}
			return NearTextPosition.Top;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint GetLabelPoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, double value, int offset)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPointForDiagram = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPointForDiagram(value, double.NegativeInfinity);
			BoxPlane boxPlane = coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes();
			diagramPointForDiagram.Y += offset - coordsCalculator.Diagram.PlaneDepthFixed;
			if ((boxPlane & BoxPlane.Back) == BoxPlane.Back)
			{
				diagramPointForDiagram.Z += coordsCalculator.Depth;
			}
			return diagramPointForDiagram;
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisY3D")]
	public class AxisY3D : Axis3D
	{
		protected internal override AxisGroup AxisGroup => AxisGroup.Value;

		protected internal override bool IsValuesAxis => true;

		protected internal override int DefaultGridSpacingFactor => 30;

		protected override bool DefaultInterlaced => true;

		protected internal override bool IsVertical => true;

		internal AxisY3D(XYDiagram3D diagram)
			: base(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.PrimaryAxisYName), diagram)
		{
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AxisY3D(null);
		}

		protected override AxisRange CreateAxisRange(RangeDataBase wholeAxisRange, RangeDataBase visibleAxisRange)
		{
			return new AxisYRange(this);
		}

		protected override GridLines CreateGridLines()
		{
			return new GridLinesY(this);
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, double axisArgument, double axisValue)
		{
			return coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPointForDiagram(axisValue, axisArgument);
		}

		protected internal override NearTextPosition GetNearTextPosition(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator)
		{
			AxisLabel3D axisLabel3D = base.Label;
			if (axisLabel3D != null && axisLabel3D.Position != AxisLabel3DPosition.Auto)
			{
				return (NearTextPosition)axisLabel3D.Position;
			}
			BoxPlane boxPlane = coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes();
			NearTextPosition nearTextPosition = (((boxPlane & BoxPlane.Right) != BoxPlane.Right) ? NearTextPosition.Left : NearTextPosition.Right);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.Project(DiagramPoint.Zero);
			if (coordsCalculator.Project(new DiagramPoint(coordsCalculator.Width, 0.0, 0.0)).X >= diagramPoint.X)
			{
				return nearTextPosition;
			}
			if (nearTextPosition != NearTextPosition.Right)
			{
				return NearTextPosition.Right;
			}
			return NearTextPosition.Left;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint GetLabelPoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, double value, int offset)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPointForDiagram = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPointForDiagram(double.NegativeInfinity, value);
			BoxPlane boxPlane = coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes();
			if ((boxPlane & BoxPlane.Right) == BoxPlane.Right)
			{
				diagramPointForDiagram.X += coordsCalculator.Width - (double)coordsCalculator.Diagram.PlaneDepthFixed - (double)offset;
			}
			else
			{
				diagramPointForDiagram.X += offset - coordsCalculator.Diagram.PlaneDepthFixed;
			}
			if ((boxPlane & BoxPlane.Back) == BoxPlane.Back)
			{
				diagramPointForDiagram.Z += coordsCalculator.Depth;
			}
			return diagramPointForDiagram;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(AxisBaseTypeConverter))]

	{

		private const bool DefaultLogarithmic = false;

		private static readonly Color DefaultInterlacedColor = Color.Empty;

		internal const double DefaultSideMarginValue = 0.5;

		[Obsolete("This constant is obsolete now. Use the AxisBase.DateTimeScaleOptions.DefaultMeasureUnit constant instead.")]
		public const DateTimeMeasurementUnit DefaultDateTimeMeasurementUnit = DateTimeMeasurementUnit.Day;

		private readonly AxisLabel label;

		private readonly AxisRange range;

		private readonly GridLines gridLines;

		private readonly NumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions;

		private readonly DateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions;

		private readonly QualitativeScaleOptions qualitativeScaleOptions;

		private readonly TimeSpanScaleOptions timeSpanScaleOptions;

		private readonly HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private readonly VisualRangeData visualRangeData;

		private readonly WholeRangeData wholeRangeData;

		private readonly VisualRange visualRange;

		private readonly WholeRange wholeRange;

		private int minorCount;

		private double sideMarginValue = 0.5;

		private bool interlaced;

		public int MinorCount
		{
			get
			{
				return minorCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 1 || value > 99)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectMinorCount));
				}
				if (value != minorCount)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					minorCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		int IAxisData.GridSpacingFactor
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (!ActualScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength.HasValue)
					{
						return MathUtils.StrongRound((float)DefaultGridSpacingFactor * HighDpiScaleFactor.Height);
					}
					return MathUtils.StrongRound((float)ActualScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength.Value * HighDpiScaleFactor.Height);
				}
				if (!ActualScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength.HasValue)
				{
					return MathUtils.StrongRound((float)DefaultGridSpacingFactor * HighDpiScaleFactor.Width);
				}
				return MathUtils.StrongRound((float)ActualScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength.Value * HighDpiScaleFactor.Width);
			}
		}

		AxisScaleTypeMap IAxisData.AxisScaleTypeMap
		{
			get
			{
				return axisScaleTypeMap;
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = axisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType != value.ScaleType;
				axisScaleTypeMap = value;
				ActualLabel.SynchronizeTextPatterWithScaleType();
				if (flag)
				{
					WholeRange.ApplyUserValuesCache();
					VisualRange.ApplyUserValuesCache();
				}
			}
		}

		IAxisGridMapping IAxisData.GridMapping
		{
			get
			{
				if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisDateTimeMap)
				{
					return new AxisDateTimeGridMapping((AxisDateTimeMap)axisScaleTypeMap, ((IDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeScaleOptions).GridAlignment, dateTimeScaleOptions.GridOffset);
				}
				if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisNumericalMap)
				{
					return new AxisNumericGridMapping((AxisNumericalMap)axisScaleTypeMap, ((INumericScaleOptions)numericScaleOptions).GridAlignment, numericScaleOptions.GridOffset, ((INumericScaleOptions)numericScaleOptions).GridAlignmentStartPoint);
				}
				if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
				{
					return new AxisQualitativeGridMapping((AxisQualitativeMap)axisScaleTypeMap, qualitativeScaleOptions.GridOffset);
				}
				if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisTimeSpanMap)
				{
					return new AxisTimeSpanGridMapping((AxisTimeSpanMap)axisScaleTypeMap, ((ITimeSpanScaleOptions)timeSpanScaleOptions).GridAlignment, timeSpanScaleOptions.GridOffset);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsGridSpacingSupported => true;

		protected AxisBase(string name, Diagram diagram)
			: base(name, diagram)
		{
			label = CreateAxisLabel();
			visualRangeData = new VisualRangeData(this);
			wholeRangeData = new WholeRangeData(this);
			wholeRange = new WholeRange(wholeRangeData);
			visualRange = new VisualRange(visualRangeData);
			axisScaleTypeMap = new AxisNumericalMap();
			range = CreateAxisRange(wholeRangeData, visualRangeData);
			gridLines = CreateGridLines();
			numericScaleOptions = new NumericScaleOptions(this);
			dateTimeScaleOptions = new DateTimeScaleOptions(this);
			qualitativeScaleOptions = new QualitativeScaleOptions(this);
			timeSpanScaleOptions = new TimeSpanScaleOptions(this);
			minorCount = DefaultMinorCount;
			interlaced = DefaultInterlaced;
		}

			return logarithmic;
		}
