		{
			Logarithmic = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLogarithmicBase()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeLogarithmic())
			{
				return logarithmicBase != 10.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetLogarithmicBase()
		{
			LogarithmicBase = 10.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeRange() && !ShouldSerializeVisualRange() && !ShouldSerializeWholeRange() && !ShouldSerializeGridLines() && !ShouldSerializeGridSpacingAuto() && !ShouldSerializeGridSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeMinorCount() && !ShouldSerializeInterlaced() && !ShouldSerializeInterlacedColor() && !ShouldSerializeLogarithmic() && !ShouldSerializeLogarithmicBase() && !ShouldSerializeNumericScaleOptions() && !ShouldSerializeDateTimeScaleOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTimeSpanScaleOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Range" => ShouldSerializeRange(), 
				"GridLines" => ShouldSerializeGridLines(), 
				"NumericOptions" => false, 
				"DateTimeOptions" => false, 
				"GridSpacingAuto" => false, 
				"GridSpacing" => false, 
				"MinorCount" => ShouldSerializeMinorCount(), 
				"Interlaced" => ShouldSerializeInterlaced(), 
				"InterlacedColor" => ShouldSerializeInterlacedColor(), 
				"Logarithmic" => ShouldSerializeLogarithmic(), 
				"LogarithmicBase" => ShouldSerializeLogarithmicBase(), 
				"NumericScaleOptions" => ShouldSerializeNumericScaleOptions(), 
				"DateTimeScaleOptions" => ShouldSerializeDateTimeScaleOptions(), 
				"TimeSpanScaleOptions" => ShouldSerializeTimeSpanScaleOptions(), 
				"QualitativeScaleComparer" => false, 
				"WorkdaysOnly" => false, 
				"DateTimeMeasureUnit" => false, 
				"DateTimeGridAlignment" => false, 
				"WorkdaysOptions" => false, 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		RangeValue IAxisData.IncreaseRange(RangeValue range, bool applySideMargins)
		{
			range = IncreaseRange(range, applySideMargins);
			if (range.Value1 == range.Value2)
			{
				range.Value1 -= 0.5;
				range.Value2 += 0.5;
			}
			return range;
		}

		GRealRect2D IAxisData.GetLabelBounds(IPane pane)
		{
			return GetLabelBounds(pane);
		}

		void IAxisData.UpdateIntervals()
		{
			UpdateIntervals();
		}

		void IAxisData.UpdateUserValues()
		{
		}

		void IAxisData.Deserialize()
		{
			RangeDataBase.Deserializer deserializer = range.GetDeserializer();
			RangeDataBase.Deserializer deserializer2 = range.scrollingRange.GetDeserializer();
			if (IsScrollingEnable())
			{
				deserializer?.TryDeserialize(visualRangeData);
				deserializer2?.TryDeserialize(wholeRangeData);
			}
			else
			{
				deserializer?.TryDeserialize(visualRangeData, wholeRangeData);
			}
			deserializer = VisualRange.GetDeserializer();
			deserializer2 = WholeRange.GetDeserializer();
			deserializer?.TryDeserialize(visualRangeData);
			deserializer2?.TryDeserialize(wholeRangeData);
		}

		void IAxisData.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit()
		{
			UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: false);
		}

		bool IAxisData.RaiseBeforeZoom(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			if (Diagram == null || Diagram.Chart == null || Diagram.Chart.ContainerAdapter == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			RangeInfo newRange = new RangeInfo(range.Min, range.Max, ScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(range.Min), ScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(range.Max));
			ChartBeforeZoomEventArgs e = new ChartBeforeZoomEventArgs(newRange, this);
			Diagram.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnBeforeZoom(e);
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		bool IAxisData.RaiseBeforeScroll(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			if (Diagram == null || Diagram.Chart == null || Diagram.Chart.ContainerAdapter == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			RangeInfo newRange = new RangeInfo(range.Min, range.Max, ScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(range.Min), ScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(range.Max));
			ChartBeforeScrollEventArgs e = new ChartBeforeScrollEventArgs(newRange, this);
			Diagram.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnBeforeScroll(e);
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		private bool IsScrollingEnable()
		{
			if (Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				if (IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return xYDiagram.EnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return xYDiagram.EnableAxisXScrolling;
			}
			if (Diagram is SwiftPlotDiagram swiftPlotDiagram)
			{
				if (IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return swiftPlotDiagram.EnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return swiftPlotDiagram.EnableAxisXScrolling;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase GetMeasureUnitsCalculator()
		{
			return ScaleType switch
			{
				ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical => NumericScaleOptions.NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore, 
				ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime => DateTimeScaleOptions.DateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore, 
				ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan => TimeSpanScaleOptions.TimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private AxisAggregationIntervalsCalculatorBase GetAggregationIntervalsCalculator()
		{
			if (ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical && NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Interval)
			{
				return NumericScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsCalculator;
			}
			if (ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime && DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Interval)
			{
				return DateTimeScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsCalculator;
			}
			if (ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan && TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Interval)
			{
				return TimeSpanScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsCalculator;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdateIntervalsWithPropertyChange()
		{
			if (Diagram != null && UpdateIntervals())
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "IntervalOptions"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
			}
		}

		internal bool UpdateIntervals()
		{
			return GetAggregationIntervalsCalculator()?.UpdateIntervals(this, Diagram.Chart.ViewController.GetRefinedSeriesByAxis(this)) ?? false;
		}

		internal void ResetAutoProperty()
		{
			if (!XtraSerializingHelper.XtraSerializing && range.SupportAuto)
			{
				VisualRangeData.Reset(needUpdate: true, resetMin: true, resetMax: true);
				if (!IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					((WholeRangeData)WholeRangeData).CorrectionMode = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
				}
				((VisualRangeData)VisualRangeData).CorrectionMode = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			}
		}

			sideMarginValue = value;
		}

		internal void UpdateMeasurementUnit(DateTimeMeasureUnit measureUnit)
		{
			if (measureUnit != dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal || dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Manual)
			{
				dateTimeScaleOptions.SetMeasureUnitsDirect(measureUnit);
			}
		}

		internal object ConvertBasedOnScaleType(object value)
		{
			return ScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		internal int GetTextSize(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (!IsVertical)
			{
				return bounds.Height;
			}
			return bounds.Width;
		}

		internal void OnWholeRangeChanged(RangeSnapshot oldRange, RangeSnapshot newRange)
		{
			if (ContainerAdapter != null && ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider != null)
			{
				AxisRangeChangedEventArgs e = new AxisRangeChangedEventArgs(this, new ValueChangeInfo<object>(oldRange.MinValue, newRange.MinValue), new ValueChangeInfo<object>(oldRange.MaxValue, newRange.MaxValue), new ValueChangeInfo<double>(oldRange.Min, newRange.Min), new ValueChangeInfo<double>(oldRange.Max, newRange.Max));
				ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider.OnAxisWholeRangeChanged(e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					((IAxisRangeData)wholeRangeData).ApplyState(oldRange);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnVisualRangeChanged(RangeSnapshot oldRange, RangeSnapshot newRange)
		{
			if (ContainerAdapter != null && ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider != null)
			{
				AxisRangeChangedEventArgs e = new AxisRangeChangedEventArgs(this, new ValueChangeInfo<object>(oldRange.MinValue, newRange.MinValue), new ValueChangeInfo<object>(oldRange.MaxValue, newRange.MaxValue), new ValueChangeInfo<double>(oldRange.Min, newRange.Min), new ValueChangeInfo<double>(oldRange.Max, newRange.Max));
				ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider.OnAxisVisualRangeChanged(e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					((IAxisRangeData)visualRangeData).ApplyState(oldRange);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailablePatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (IsValuesAxis)
			{
				return new string[1] { "V" };
			}
			return new string[1] { "A" };
		}

		internal IList<ISeries> GetSeries()
		{
			if (Diagram == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Diagram.Chart.ViewController.GetSeriesByAxis(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual RangeValue IncreaseRange(RangeValue range, bool applySideMargins)
		{
			return RangeValue.Empty;
		}

		{
		}

		protected internal void UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(bool throwUpdate)
		{
			if (Diagram is IXYDiagram iXYDiagram)
			{
				int axisXLength = iXYDiagram.GetAxisXLength(this);
				if (UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(axisXLength) && throwUpdate)
				{
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "AutoMeasureUnit"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(int axisLength)
		{
			if (Diagram == null || Diagram.Chart == null || ActualScaleOptions == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IList<ISeries> series = GetSeries();
			MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase measureUnitsCalculator = GetMeasureUnitsCalculator();
			if (measureUnitsCalculator == null || series == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return measureUnitsCalculator.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(axisLength, series);
		}

		{
			return userValue;
		}

		}

		public double GetScaleInternalValue(double numericValue)

			if (ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)

				throw new InvalidScaleTypeException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidScaleType));

		}

		}

		{

			{
				throw new InvalidScaleTypeException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidScaleType));
			}
			return ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(timeSpanValue);
		}

		public object GetScaleValueFromInternal(double internalValue)
		{

		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AxisBase axisBase)
			{
				numericScaleOptions.Assign(axisBase.numericScaleOptions);
				dateTimeScaleOptions.Assign(axisBase.dateTimeScaleOptions);
				qualitativeScaleOptions.Assign(axisBase.qualitativeScaleOptions);
				timeSpanScaleOptions.Assign(axisBase.timeSpanScaleOptions);
				minorCount = axisBase.minorCount;
				interlaced = axisBase.interlaced;
				interlacedColor = axisBase.interlacedColor;
				logarithmic = axisBase.logarithmic;
				logarithmicBase = axisBase.logarithmicBase;
				range.Assign(axisBase.range);
				visualRangeData.Assign(axisBase.visualRangeData);
				wholeRangeData.Assign(axisBase.wholeRangeData);
				visualRange.Assign(axisBase.visualRange);
				wholeRange.Assign(axisBase.wholeRange);
				gridLines.Assign(axisBase.gridLines);
				label.Assign(axisBase.label);
				axisScaleTypeMap = axisBase.axisScaleTypeMap.Clone();
				showMajorGridlines = axisBase.showMajorGridlines;
				showMajorTickmarks = axisBase.showMajorTickmarks;
				showMinorGridlines = axisBase.showMinorGridlines;
				showMinorTickmarks = axisBase.showMinorTickmarks;
				qualitativeScaleComparer = axisBase.qualitativeScaleComparer;
			}
		}

	public abstract class Range : ChartElement
	{
		private const bool DefaultAuto = true;

		private const bool DefaultAutoSideMargins = true;

		protected readonly RangeDataBase data;

		private RangeDataBase.Deserializer deserializer;

		private Tuple<object, object> userValuesCache;

		internal RangeDataBase.Deserializer Deserializer
		{
			get
			{
				if (deserializer == null)
				{
					deserializer = data.GetDeserializer();
				}
				return deserializer;
			}
		}

		internal RangeDataBase RangeData => data;

		protected virtual bool CanChangeAutoSideMargins => true;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.MinValue")]

				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();

			set

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.MaxValue")]

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.Auto")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Auto
		{
			get
			{
				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				return data.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			}
			set
			{
				ResetDeserializer(forceReset: false);
				data.CorrectionMode = ((!value) ? RangeCorrectionMode.Values : RangeCorrectionMode.Auto);
				if (!Loading && value)
				{
					deserializer = null;
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.AutoSideMargins")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.AutoSideMargins")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public bool AutoSideMargins
		{
			get
			{
				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				if (data.AutoSideMargins != SideMarginMode.Enable)
				{
					return data.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.UserEnable;
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != (data.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.Enable || data.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.UserEnable) && CanChangeAutoSideMargins)
				{
					ResetDeserializer(forceReset: false);
					data.AutoSideMargins = (value ? SideMarginMode.UserEnable : SideMarginMode.UserDisable);
				}
				if (Loading)
				{
					Deserializer.AutoSideMargins = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.SideMarginsValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.SideMarginsValue")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public double SideMarginsValue
		{
			get
			{
				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				return Math.Max(data.ActualEndSideMargin, data.ActualStartSideMargin);
			}
			set
			{
				ResetDeserializer(forceReset: false);
				data.ActualStartSideMargin = value;
				data.ActualEndSideMargin = value;
				if (Loading)
				{
					Deserializer.SideMarginsValue = new MinMaxValues(value);
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.StartSideMargin")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.StartSideMargin")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public double StartSideMargin
		{
			get

				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				return data.ActualStartSideMargin;

			set

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.EndSideMargin")]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.SideMarginSizeUnit")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Range.SideMarginSizeUnit")]

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		internal Range(RangeDataBase data)
			: base(data.Axis)
		{
			this.data = data;
		}

		public void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			ResetDeserializer(forceReset: true);
			userValuesCache = Tuple.Create(minValue, maxValue);
			data.SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
			AxisBase axis = data.Axis;
			if (!axis.IsValuesAxis)
			{
				axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: true);
				axis.UpdateIntervalsWithPropertyChange();
			}
		}

		private void ResetDeserializer(bool forceReset)
		{
			if (forceReset || !Loading)
			{
				deserializer = null;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinValueSerializable()
		{
			return data.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueSerializable()
		{
			return data.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinValue()
		{
			return !Auto;
		}

		private void ResetMinValue()
		{
			Auto = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxValue()
		{
			return !Auto;
		}

		private void ResetMaxValue()
		{
			Auto = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAuto()
		{
			return !Auto;
		}

		private void ResetAuto()
		{
			Auto = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAutoSideMargins()
		{
			if (!AutoSideMargins && CanChangeAutoSideMargins)
			{
				if (data != null)
				{
					if (data.AutoSideMargins != SideMarginMode.UserEnable)
					{
						return data.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAutoSideMargins()
		{
			AutoSideMargins = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSideMarginsValue()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetSideMarginsValue()
		{
			AutoSideMargins = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStartSideMargin()
		{
			if (!AutoSideMargins)
			{
				return CanChangeAutoSideMargins;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetStartSideMargin()
		{
			AutoSideMargins = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEndSideMargin()
		{
			if (!AutoSideMargins)
			{
				return CanChangeAutoSideMargins;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetEndSideMargin()
		{
			AutoSideMargins = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSideMarginSizeUnit()
		{
			return SideMarginSizeUnit != SideMarginSizeUnit.AxisUnit;
		}

		private void ResetSideMarginSizeUnit()
		{
			SideMarginSizeUnit = SideMarginSizeUnit.AxisUnit;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAutoSideMargins() && !ShouldSerializeSideMarginsValue() && !ShouldSerializeMinValueSerializable() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValueSerializable() && !ShouldSerializeAuto() && !ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal() && !ShouldSerializeStartSideMargin() && !ShouldSerializeEndSideMargin())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSideMarginSizeUnit();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Auto" => ShouldSerializeAuto(), 
				"MinValueSerializable" => ShouldSerializeMinValueSerializable(), 
				"MaxValueSerializable" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueSerializable(), 
				"MinValueInternal" => ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal(), 
				"MaxValueInternal" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal(), 
				"AutoSideMargins" => ShouldSerializeAutoSideMargins(), 
				"SideMarginsValue" => ShouldSerializeSideMarginsValue(), 
				"StartSideMargin" => ShouldSerializeStartSideMargin(), 
				"EndSideMargin" => ShouldSerializeEndSideMargin(), 
				"SideMarginSizeUnit" => ShouldSerializeSideMarginSizeUnit(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		internal RangeDataBase.Deserializer GetDeserializer()
		{
			return deserializer;
		}

		internal void ApplyUserValuesCache()
		{
			if (userValuesCache != null)
			{
				data.SetRange(userValuesCache.Item1, userValuesCache.Item2, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: false);
				userValuesCache = null;
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			ResetDeserializer(forceReset: true);
			if (obj is Range range)
			{
				if (range.deserializer != null)
				{
					deserializer = new RangeDataBase.Deserializer(data.Axis);
					deserializer.Assign(range.deserializer);
				}
				if (range.userValuesCache != null)
				{
					userValuesCache = range.userValuesCache;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ConstantLineCollection")]
	public class ConstantLineCollection : ChartElementNamedCollection, IEnumerable<IConstantLine>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override string NamePrefix => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ConstantLinePrefix);

		internal Axis2D Axis => (Axis2D)base.Owner;

		[Description("Returns a constant line by its name.")]
		public ConstantLine this[int index] => (ConstantLine)base.List[index];

		public ConstantLine this[string name] => (ConstantLine)GetElementByName(name);

		internal ConstantLineCollection(Axis2D axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<IConstantLine>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<IConstantLine> IEnumerable<IConstantLine>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (IConstantLine)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisValue(ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateAxisValue(constantLine, Axis.ScaleTypeMap);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, object oldItem, int oldIndex, object newItem, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, ICollection oldItems, int oldIndex, ICollection newItems, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
		}

		internal IList<ConstantLine> GetSubsetByShowBehindProperty(bool showBehind)
		{
			List<ConstantLine> list = new List<ConstantLine>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)enumerator.Current;
					if (constantLine.ShowBehind == showBehind)
					{
						list.Add(constantLine);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal IList<ILegendItemData> GetLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)enumerator.Current;
					if (constantLine.ActualShowInLegend && constantLine.ActualLegend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
					{
						list.Add(constantLine);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)enumerator.Current;
					constantLine.OnEndLoading();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			UpdateAxisValue(constantLine);
			return Add((ChartElement)constantLine);
		}

		public void AddRange(ConstantLine[] coll)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLine constantLine in coll)
			{
				UpdateAxisValue(constantLine);
			}
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
		}

		public void Remove(ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)constantLine);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			UpdateAxisValue(constantLine);
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)constantLine);
		}

		public bool Contains(ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)constantLine);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ConstantLine GetConstantLineByName(string name)
		{
			return (ConstantLine)GetElementByName(name);
		}
	}

			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<IScaleBreak>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<IScaleBreak> IEnumerable<IScaleBreak>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (IScaleBreak)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisValue(ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateAxisValue(scaleBreak.ScaleBreakEdge1, scaleBreak.ScaleBreakEdge2, Axis.ScaleTypeMap);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, object oldItem, int oldIndex, object newItem, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, ICollection oldItems, int oldIndex, ICollection newItems, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
		}

		public int Add(ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
		{
			UpdateAxisValue(scaleBreak);
			return Add((ChartElement)scaleBreak);
		}

		public void AddRange(ScaleBreak[] coll)
		{
			foreach (ScaleBreak scaleBreak in coll)
			{
				UpdateAxisValue(scaleBreak);
			}
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
		}

		public void Remove(ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)scaleBreak);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
		{
			UpdateAxisValue(scaleBreak);
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)scaleBreak);
		}

		public bool Contains(ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)scaleBreak);
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AutoScaleBreaks.Enabled")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AutoScaleBreaks.Enabled")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != enabled)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetEnabled(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AutoScaleBreaks.MaxCount")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AutoScaleBreaks.MaxCount")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int MaxCount
		{
			get
			{
				return maxCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidMaxCount));
				}
				if (value != maxCount)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					maxCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets an automatic scale breaks calculator for scale breaks.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public IAutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator AutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				return automaticScaleBreaksCalculator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != automaticScaleBreaksCalculator)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					automaticScaleBreaksCalculator = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal AutoScaleBreaks(Axis axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
			scaleBreaksCreator = new AutoScaleBreaksCreator(this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Enabled" => ShouldSerializeEnabled(), 
				"MaxCount" => ShouldSerializeMaxCount(), 
				"AutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator" => false, 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEnabled()
		{
			return enabled;
		}

		private void ResetEnabled()
		{
			Enabled = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxCount()
		{
			return maxCount != 5;
		}

		private void ResetMaxCount()
		{
			MaxCount = 5;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMaxCount();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetEnabled(bool enabled)
		{
			this.enabled = enabled;
			scaleBreaks.Clear();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AutoScaleBreaks(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AutoScaleBreaks autoScaleBreaks)
			{
				SetEnabled(autoScaleBreaks.enabled);
				maxCount = autoScaleBreaks.maxCount;
				automaticScaleBreaksCalculator = autoScaleBreaks.automaticScaleBreaksCalculator;
			}
		}

	public class AutomaticScaleBreak : IScaleDiapason
	{
		private readonly double edge1;

		private readonly double edge2;

		bool IScaleDiapason.Visible => true;

		public double Edge1 => edge1;

		public double Edge2 => edge2;

		public AutomaticScaleBreak(double edge1, double edge2)
		{
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(edge1))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDoubleValue), "edge1");
			}
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(edge2))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDoubleValue), "edge2");
			}
			this.edge1 = edge1;
			this.edge2 = edge2;
		}
	}

				"MaxValueSerializable" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueSerializable(), 
				"MinValueInternal" => ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal(), 
				"MaxValueInternal" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal(), 
				"AlwaysShowZeroLevel" => ShouldSerializeAlwaysShowZeroLevel(), 
				"SideMarginsEnables" => ShouldSerializeSideMarginsEnabled(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool IsScrollingEnable()
		{
			if (Range.Axis.Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				if (Range.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return xYDiagram.EnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return xYDiagram.EnableAxisXScrolling;
			}
			if (Range.Axis.Diagram is SwiftPlotDiagram swiftPlotDiagram)
			{
				if (Range.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return swiftPlotDiagram.EnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return swiftPlotDiagram.EnableAxisXScrolling;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ScrollingRange(null);
		}

		internal RangeDataBase.Deserializer GetDeserializer()
		{
			return wholeRangeDeserializer;
		}

		public void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			((WholeRangeData)Range.Axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
			data.SetMinMaxValues(minValue, maxValue);
		}

		public void SetInternalMinMaxValues(double min, double max)
		{
			IAxisData axis = Range.Axis;
			if (axis != null)
			{
				double num = min;
				double num2 = max;
				if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					num += ((AxisDateTimeMap)Range.Axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
					num2 += ((AxisDateTimeMap)Range.Axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
				}
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					((WholeRangeData)Range.Axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(null, null, num, num2, needUpdate: true);
				}
				else
				{
					((WholeRangeData)Range.Axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(null, null, num, num2, needUpdate: true);
					((VisualRangeData)Range.Axis.VisualRangeData).SetRange(null, null, num, num2, needUpdate: true);
				}
			}
			data.SetInternalMinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			if (obj is ScrollingRange scrollingRange)
			{
				data.Assign(scrollingRange.data);
			}
		}
	}

	public class StripCollection : ChartElementNamedCollection, IEnumerable<IStrip>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override string NamePrefix => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.StripPrefix);

		internal Axis2D Axis => (Axis2D)base.Owner;

		[Description("Returns a strip by its name.")]
		public Strip this[int index] => (Strip)base.List[index];

		public Strip this[string name] => (Strip)GetElementByName(name);

		internal StripCollection(Axis2D axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<IStrip>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<IStrip> IEnumerable<IStrip>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (IStrip)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckStripLimits(Strip strip)
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateAxisValue(strip.MinLimit, strip.MaxLimit, Axis.ScaleTypeMap);
			}
			if (strip.MinLimit.AxisValue != null && strip.MaxLimit.AxisValue != null)
			{
				strip.CorrectLimits(Axis);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, object oldItem, int oldIndex, object newItem, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, ICollection oldItems, int oldIndex, ICollection newItems, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
		}

		internal IList<ILegendItemData> GetLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Strip strip = (Strip)enumerator.Current;
					if (strip.ActualLegend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems && strip.ShowInLegend && (CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsStripVisible(Axis.ScaleTypeMap, strip) || (strip.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible && strip.Visible && strip.CheckableInLegend)))
					{
						list.Add(strip);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Strip strip = (Strip)enumerator.Current;
					strip.OnEndLoading();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(Strip strip)
		{
			CheckStripLimits(strip);
			return Add((ChartElement)strip);
		}

		public void AddRange(Strip[] coll)
		{
			foreach (Strip strip in coll)
			{
				CheckStripLimits(strip);
			}
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
		}

		public void Remove(Strip strip)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)strip);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Strip strip)
		{
			CheckStripLimits(strip);
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)strip);
		}

		public bool Contains(Strip strip)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)strip);
		}

		public Strip GetStripByName(string name)
		{
			return (Strip)GetElementByName(name);
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(StripLimitTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class StripLimit : ChartElement, IStripLimit, IAxisValueContainer
	{
		private const bool DefaultEnabled = true;

		private readonly AxisValueContainer valueContainer;

		private bool enabled = true;

		private IAxisData Axis
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner != null)
				{
					return ((Strip)base.Owner).Axis;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal Strip Strip => (Strip)base.Owner;

		internal AxisValueContainer ValueContainer => valueContainer;

		protected abstract string ValueExceptionString { get; }

		protected internal abstract double Infinity { get; }

		protected internal double ActualValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!enabled)
				{
					return Infinity;
				}
				return valueContainer.ValueInternal;
			}
		}

		double IStripLimit.ActualValue => ActualValue;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string AxisValueSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return SerializingUtils.ConvertToSerializable(AxisValue);
			}
			set
			{
				AxisValue = value;
				if (Strip == null || Strip.Axis == null || Loading)
				{
					valueContainer.ValueSerializable = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StripLimit.AxisValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StripLimit.AxisValue")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(AxisValueTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public object AxisValue
		{
			get
			{
				return valueContainer.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading && !CanSetAxisValue(value) && (ChartContainer == null || ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ValueExceptionString);
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectStripLimitAxisValue));
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				valueContainer.Value = ((Strip == null || Strip.Axis == null || Loading) ? value : Strip.Axis.ConvertBasedOnScaleType(value));
				SyncAxisValueAndEnabled();
				RaiseControlChanged(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StripLimit.Enabled")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StripLimit.Enabled")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != enabled)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					enabled = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
					RaiseControlChanged();
					if (Strip != null)
					{
						Strip.CorrectLimits(Axis as Axis2D);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAxisValueContainer.Axis => Axis;

		bool IAxisValueContainer.IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Strip.Visible)
				{
					return Enabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		CultureInfo IAxisValueContainer.Culture => valueContainer.Culture;

		object IAxisValueContainer.UserValue => valueContainer.UserValue;

		double IAxisValueContainer.Value
		{
			get
			{
				return valueContainer.ValueInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(value))
				{
					enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					valueContainer.ValueInternal = value;
				}
			}
		}

		object IAxisValueContainer.AxisValue
		{
			get
			{
				return valueContainer.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				valueContainer.SetValue(value);
			}
		}

		protected StripLimit(Strip strip, double defaultValue)
			: base(strip)
		{
			valueContainer = new AxisValueContainer(defaultValue);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisValueSerializable()
		{
			return enabled;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEnabled()
		{
			return !enabled;
		}

		private void ResetEnabled()
		{
			Enabled = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "AxisValueSerializable"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Enabled")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeEnabled();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeAxisValueSerializable();
		}

		protected abstract bool CanSetAxisValue(object axisValue);

		protected abstract bool CanSetValue(double value);

		internal void SyncAxisValueAndEnabled()
		{
			object value = valueContainer.Value;
			if (value is double)
			{
				enabled = !double.IsInfinity((double)value);
			}
			else if (value is DateTime)
			{
				enabled = (DateTime)value != DateTime.MinValue && (DateTime)value != DateTime.MaxValue;
			}
			else if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				enabled = (TimeSpan)value >= DateTimeUtilsExt.MinTimeSpan && (TimeSpan)value <= DateTimeUtilsExt.MaxTimeSpan;
			}
			else
			{
				enabled = true;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(StripLimit)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is StripLimit stripLimit)
			{
				valueContainer.Assign(stripLimit.valueContainer);
				enabled = stripLimit.enabled;
			}
		}
	}

				"CrossAxis" => ShouldSerializeCrossAxis(), 
				"Thickness" => ShouldSerializeThickness(), 
				"MinorThickness" => ShouldSerializeMinorThickness(),

		[Description("Gets or sets a value which indicates whether the Y-axis range should be automatically recalculated to make the zero level constantly visible.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisRange.AlwaysShowZeroLevel")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool AlwaysShowZeroLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return Axis.VisualRangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
				Axis.VisualRangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel = value;
				Axis.WholeRangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel = value;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now. Use AxisBase.VisualRange.AutoSideMargins instead. To calculate side margins automatically, enable the VisualRange.AutoSideMargins property. When the VisualRange.AutoSideMargins property is disabled it becomes possible to specify custom side margins values using the VisualRange.SideMarginsValue property.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Specifies whether a space should be left between the outermost series point and the diagram’s edge.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisRange.SideMarginsEnabled")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool SideMarginsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				if (Axis.VisualRangeData.AutoSideMargins != SideMarginMode.Enable)
				{
					return Axis.VisualRangeData.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.UserEnable;
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
				if (!IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					Axis.WholeRangeData.AutoSideMargins = (value ? SideMarginMode.UserEnable : SideMarginMode.UserDisable);
					if (!value)
					{
						Axis.WholeRangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
						Axis.WholeRangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
					}
				}
				Axis.VisualRangeData.AutoSideMargins = (value ? SideMarginMode.UserEnable : SideMarginMode.UserDisable);
				if (!value)
				{
					Axis.VisualRangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
					Axis.VisualRangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
				}
				if (Loading)
				{
					Deserializer.AutoSideMargins = value;
					if (!value)
					{
						Deserializer.SideMarginsValue = new MinMaxValues(0.0);
					}
				}
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now. To specify a custom range, use the AxisBase.VisualRange and AxisBase.WholeRange properties instead. For more information, see the corresponding topic in the documentation. ")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Gets the range through which it’s possible to scroll an axis.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisRange.ScrollingRange")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public ScrollingRange ScrollingRange => scrollingRange;

		protected AxisRange()
			: base(null)
		{
			data = new AxisRangeDataEx(this);
			scrollingRange = new ScrollingRange(this);
		}

		protected AxisRange(AxisBase axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
			data = new AxisRangeDataEx(this);
			scrollingRange = new ScrollingRange(this);
		}

			: base(axis)

			data = new AxisRangeDataEx(this);
			scrollingRange = new ScrollingRange(this, wholeAxisRange);
		}

		{
			this.data = data;
			scrollingRange = new ScrollingRange(this);
		}

		private bool NeedStretchWholeRange(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
			double value = Axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(minValue);
			double value2 = Axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(maxValue);
			if (Contains(Axis.WholeRangeData, value))
			{
				return !Contains(Axis.WholeRangeData, value2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Contains(IAxisRangeData rangeData, double value)
		{
			if (rangeData.Min + rangeData.SideMargins.Min <= value)
			{
				return value <= rangeData.Max - rangeData.SideMargins.Max;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsScrollingEnable()
		{
			if (Axis.Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				if (Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return xYDiagram.EnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return xYDiagram.EnableAxisXScrolling;
			}
			if (Axis.Diagram is SwiftPlotDiagram swiftPlotDiagram)
			{
				if (Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return swiftPlotDiagram.EnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return swiftPlotDiagram.EnableAxisXScrolling;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal RangeDataBase.Deserializer GetDeserializer()
		{
			return visualRangeDeserializer;
		}

		public virtual void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			if (NeedStretchWholeRange(minValue, maxValue))
			{
				((WholeRangeData)Axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
			}
			((VisualRangeData)Axis.VisualRangeData).SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
			data.SetMinMaxValues(minValue, maxValue);
		}

		public virtual void SetInternalMinMaxValues(double min, double max)
		{
			if (RangeHelper.RangeCalculationSwitch)
			{
				IAxisData axis = Axis;
				if (axis != null)
				{
					double num = min;
					double num2 = max;
					ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
					if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
					{
						num += ((AxisDateTimeMap)Axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
						num2 += ((AxisDateTimeMap)Axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
					}
					if (IsScrollingEnable())
					{
						((VisualRangeData)Axis.VisualRangeData).SetRange(null, null, num, num2, needUpdate: true);
					}
					else
					{
						((WholeRangeData)Axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(null, null, num, num2, needUpdate: true);
						if (((VisualRangeData)Axis.VisualRangeData).CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
						{
							((VisualRangeData)Axis.VisualRangeData).CorrectionMode = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
						}
						((VisualRangeData)Axis.VisualRangeData).SetRange(null, null, num, num2, needUpdate: true);
					}
				}
			}
			Axis.VisualRangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
			Axis.VisualRangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
			data.SetInternalMinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AxisRange axisRange)
			{
				data.Assign(axisRange.data);
				scrollingRange.Assign(axisRange.scrollingRange);
				visualRangeDeserializer = null;
				if (axisRange != null && axisRange.visualRangeDeserializer != null)
				{
					visualRangeDeserializer = new RangeDataBase.Deserializer(Axis);
					visualRangeDeserializer.Assign(axisRange.visualRangeDeserializer);
				}
				if (Axis != null)
				{
					((VisualRangeData)Axis.VisualRangeData).Assign(axisRange.data);
					((WholeRangeData)Axis.WholeRangeData).Assign(axisRange.scrollingRange.Data);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected AxisLabelItemBase(AxisLabel label, Point basePoint, AxisTextItem textItem)
		{
			//IL_00e2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.label = label;
			this.basePoint = basePoint;
			gridIndex = textItem.GridIndex;
			textItemVisible = textItem.Visible;
			axisValue = textItem.Value;
			object content = textItem.Content;
			text = ((content == null) ? string.Empty : content.ToString());
			CustomAxisLabel customAxisLabel = textItem.CustomAxisLabel as CustomAxisLabel;
			textColor = GetActualTextColor(customAxisLabel, label);
			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(GetActualFont(customAxisLabel, label), null);
			backColor = GetActualBackColor(customAxisLabel, label);
			fillStyle = ((customAxisLabel != null && customAxisLabel.FillStyle.ShouldSerialize()) ? customAxisLabel.FillStyle : label.FillStyle);
			border = ((customAxisLabel != null && customAxisLabel.Border.ShouldSerialize()) ? customAxisLabel.Border : label.Border);
			enableAntialiasing = label.EnableAntialiasing;
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetTextColor(Color color)
		{
			return textColor;
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetBorderColor(Color color)
		{
			return BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, Color.Empty, ((IHitTest)label).State);
		}

		bool ITextPropertiesProvider.CanWrapText(float textWidth)
		{
			int maxWidth = label.MaxWidth;
			if (maxWidth > 0)
			{
				return textWidth > (float)maxWidth;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Color GetActualTextColor(CustomAxisLabel customLabel, AxisLabel label)
		{
			if (customLabel == null || !(customLabel.TextColor != Color.Empty))
			{
				return label.ActualTextColor;
			}
			return customLabel.TextColor;
		}

		private DXFont GetActualFont(CustomAxisLabel customLabel, AxisLabel label)
		{
			return customLabel?.DXFont ?? label.DXFont;
		}

		private Color GetActualBackColor(CustomAxisLabel customLabel, AxisLabel label)
		{
			Color empty = Color.Empty;
			if (customLabel != null)
			{
				empty = customLabel.BackColor;
			}
			if (empty == Color.Empty)
			{
				empty = label.BackColor;
			}
			return empty;
		}

		internal void SetBackgroundElement(IBackground backgroundElement)
		{
			if (backColor == Color.Empty && backgroundElement != null)
			{
				backColor = backgroundElement.ActualBackColor;
			}
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			painter.Render(renderer, hitTestController, this);
		}

		internal void CreatePainter()
		{
			TextRenderingHint renderHint = AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(this);
			SizeF textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(Text, DXFont, renderHint);
			painter = CreatePainterInternal(textSize);
		}

		protected abstract TextPainterBase CreatePainterInternal(SizeF textSize);
	}
	public class AxisLabelItem : AxisLabelItemBase, IAxisLabelLayout
	{
		private readonly bool isCustomLabel;

		private readonly bool isIntersectionAutoLabel;

		private readonly bool isIntervalEdge;

		private readonly AxisMappingBase mapping;

		private int angle;

		private GRealPoint2D offset;

		private GRealPoint2D limitedOffset;

		private AxisElementLocation axisElementLocation;

		protected internal override bool Rotated => Angle % 90 != 0;

		[Description("Gets or sets the angle by which the axis label item’s text is rotated.")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public int Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return angle;
			}
			set
			{
				angle = value;
			}
		}

		GRealSize2D IAxisLabelLayout.Size => new GRealSize2D(base.TextPainter.Width, base.TextPainter.Height);

		double IAxisLabelLayout.Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return Angle;
			}
			set
			{
				Angle = (int)value;
				if (base.TextPainter != null)
				{
					base.TextPainter.Rotate(value);
				}
			}
		}

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.Pivot => new GRealPoint2D(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y);

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return base.LabelVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				base.LabelVisible = value;
			}
		}

		string IAxisLabelLayout.Text => base.Text;

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				ApplyOffset(offset, value);
				offset = value;
			}
		}

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.LimitsOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return limitedOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				ApplyOffset(limitedOffset, value);
				limitedOffset = value;
			}
		}

		GRealRect2D IAxisLabelLayout.Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Visible)
				{
					return GRealRect2D.Empty;
				}
				return base.Bounds.ToGRealRect2D();
			}
		}

		int IAxisLabelLayout.GridIndex => base.GridIndex;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsCustomLabel => isCustomLabel;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsIntersectionAutoLabel => isIntersectionAutoLabel;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsIntervalEdge => isIntervalEdge;

		internal AxisLabelItem(AxisLabel2D label, Point basePoint, AxisTextItem textItem, AxisMappingBase mapping)
			: base(label, basePoint, textItem)
		{
			this.mapping = mapping;
			angle = label.Angle;
			isCustomLabel = textItem.IsCustomLabel;
			isIntersectionAutoLabel = textItem.IsIntersectionAutoLabel;
			isIntervalEdge = textItem.IsIntervalEdge;
			axisElementLocation = ((!((Axis2D)label.Axis).LabelInOutsidePosition) ? AxisElementLocation.Inside : AxisElementLocation.Outside);
		}

		private NearTextPosition GetLabelNearTextPosition()
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = base.Label.Owner as Axis2D;
			NearTextPosition nearTextPosition = (axis2D.IsVertical ? NearTextPosition.Left : NearTextPosition.Bottom);
			if ((mapping.ActualAlignment != AxisAlignment.Far || axisElementLocation != AxisElementLocation.Inside) && (mapping.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far || axisElementLocation != AxisElementLocation.Outside))
			{
				return AxisLabelPositionHelper.Opposite(nearTextPosition);
			}
			return nearTextPosition;
		}

		internal void ApplyOffset(GRealPoint2D oldOffset, GRealPoint2D newOffset)
		{
			base.BasePoint = new Point(base.BasePoint.X - (int)oldOffset.X, base.BasePoint.Y - (int)oldOffset.Y);
			if (base.TextPainter != null)
			{
				base.TextPainter.Offset(0.0 - oldOffset.X, 0.0 - oldOffset.Y);
			}
			base.BasePoint = new Point(base.BasePoint.X + (int)newOffset.X, base.BasePoint.Y + (int)newOffset.Y);
			if (base.TextPainter != null)
			{
				base.TextPainter.Offset(newOffset.X, newOffset.Y);
			}
		}

		internal void SetAxisElementLocation(AxisElementLocation value)
		{
			if (axisElementLocation != value)
			{
				axisElementLocation = value;
				CreatePainter();
			}
		}

		protected override TextPainterBase CreatePainterInternal(SizeF textSize)
		{
			return new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, GetLabelNearTextPosition(), angle, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount, wordWrap: false);
		}
	}

	public class RadarAxisXLabelItem : AxisLabelItemBase, IAxisLabelLayout
	{
		private readonly float angleOnCircleDegree;

		protected internal override bool Rotated
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Label is RadarAxisXLabel radarAxisXLabel)
				{
					if (radarAxisXLabel.TextDirection != RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.Radial)
					{
						return radarAxisXLabel.TextDirection == RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.Tangent;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		GRealSize2D IAxisLabelLayout.Size => new GRealSize2D(base.TextPainter.Width, base.TextPainter.Height);

		double IAxisLabelLayout.Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.Pivot => new GRealPoint2D(base.Bounds.X, base.Bounds.Y);

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.LimitsOffset
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return base.LabelVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				base.LabelVisible = value;
			}
		}

		string IAxisLabelLayout.Text => base.Text;

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return default(GRealPoint2D);
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		GRealRect2D IAxisLabelLayout.Bounds => GRealRect2D.Empty;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsCustomLabel => false;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsIntersectionAutoLabel => false;

		int IAxisLabelLayout.GridIndex => base.GridIndex;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsIntervalEdge => false;

		internal RadarAxisXLabelItem(AxisLabel label, Point basePoint, AxisTextItem textItem, float angleOnCircleDegree)
			: base(label, basePoint, textItem)
		{
			this.angleOnCircleDegree = angleOnCircleDegree;
		}

		protected override TextPainterBase CreatePainterInternal(SizeF textSize)
		{
			switch (((RadarAxisXLabel)base.Label).TextDirection)
			{
			case RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.LeftToRight:
				return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleLeftToRight(angleOnCircleDegree, base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount);
			case RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.TopToBottom:
				return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTopToBottom(angleOnCircleDegree, base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount);
			case RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.BottomToTop:
				return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleBottomToTop(angleOnCircleDegree, base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount);
			case RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.Radial:
				return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleRadial(angleOnCircleDegree, base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount);
			case RadarAxisXLabelTextDirection.Tangent:
				return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent(angleOnCircleDegree, base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown text direction.");
				return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent(angleOnCircleDegree, base.BasePoint, base.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: false, base.Label.MaxWidth, base.Label.MaxLineCount);
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum DateTimeScaleMode
	{
		Manual,
		AutomaticAverage,
		AutomaticIntegral
	}
	public abstract class AxisXBase : Axis
	{
		private const bool DefaultStickToEdge = false;

		private bool stickToEdge;

		protected override int DefaultMinorCount => 4;

		protected override bool ActualStickToEdge => StickToEdge;

		protected internal override bool IsValuesAxis => false;

		protected internal override bool IsVertical => ((XYDiagram)base.Diagram).Rotated;

		protected internal override ScaleMode ActualDateTimeScaleMode => base.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode;

		protected internal override ScaleMode ActualTimeSpanScaleMode => base.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode;

		internal bool ScrollingZoomingEnabled => AxisNavigationUtils.IsScrollingZoomingEnabled(this);

		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now. Use DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public virtual DateTimeScaleMode DateTimeScaleMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic)
				{
					switch (base.DateTimeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction)
					{
					case AggregateFunction.Average:
						return DateTimeScaleMode.AutomaticAverage;
					case AggregateFunction.Sum:
						return DateTimeScaleMode.AutomaticIntegral;
					}
				}
				return DateTimeScaleMode.Manual;
			}
			set
			{
				switch (value)
				{
				case DateTimeScaleMode.Manual:
					base.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Manual;
					base.DateTimeScaleOptions.ProcessMissingPoints = ProcessMissingPointsMode.Skip;
					break;
				case DateTimeScaleMode.AutomaticAverage:
				case DateTimeScaleMode.AutomaticIntegral:
					base.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Automatic;
					base.DateTimeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Average;
					base.DateTimeScaleOptions.ProcessMissingPoints = ProcessMissingPointsMode.InsertZeroValues;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisXBase.StickToEdge")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisXBase.StickToEdge")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public bool StickToEdge
		{
			get
			{
				return stickToEdge;
			}
			set
			{
				if (stickToEdge != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					stickToEdge = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisXBase.QualitativeScaleOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AxisXBase.QualitativeScaleOptions")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public QualitativeScaleOptions QualitativeScaleOptions => base.QualitativeScaleOptionsInternal;

		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now. Use the StickToEdge property instead")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool StickToEnd
		{
			get
			{
				return stickToEdge;
			}
			set
			{
				StickToEdge = value;
			}
		}

		protected AxisXBase(string name, XYDiagram diagram)
			: base(name, diagram)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDateTimeScaleMode()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeQualitativeScaleOptions()
		{
			return QualitativeScaleOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStickToEnd()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStickToEdge()
		{
			return StickToEdge;
		}

		private void ResetStickToEdge()
		{
			StickToEdge = false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeDateTimeScaleMode() && !ShouldSerializeQualitativeScaleOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeStickToEdge();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"DateTimeScaleMode" => ShouldSerializeDateTimeScaleMode(), 
				"QualitativeScaleOptions" => ShouldSerializeQualitativeScaleOptions(), 
				"StickToEdge" => ShouldSerializeStickToEdge(), 
				"StickToEnd" => ShouldSerializeStickToEnd(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AxisXBase axisXBase)
			{
				stickToEdge = axisXBase.stickToEdge;
			}
		}

		protected override Tickmarks CreateTickmarks()
		{
			return new TickmarksX(this);
		}

		protected override AxisTitle CreateAxisTitle()
		{
			return new AxisTitleX(this);
		}

		protected override AxisRange CreateAxisRange(RangeDataBase wholeAxisRange, RangeDataBase visibleAxisRange)
		{
			return new AxisXRange(this);
		}
	}

		internal static double CalculateRandomArgument(int pointIndex, int pointCount)
		{
			if (pointCount == 0)
			{
				throw new InternalException("Invalid count of random points.");
			}
			if (pointIndex < 0 || pointIndex > pointCount - 1)
			{
				throw new InternalException("Invalid index of random point.");
			}
			return (double)pointIndex * 360.0 / (double)pointCount;
		}

		internal PolarAxisXRange(PolarAxisX axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
			((IAxisData)axis).WholeRange.UpdateRange(0.0, 360.0, 0.0, 360.0);
			((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange.UpdateRange(0.0, 360.0, 0.0, 360.0);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PolarAxisXRange(null);
		}

		public override void SetInternalMinMaxValues(double min, double max)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPolarAxisXRangeChanged));
		}

	public abstract class RadarAxis : AxisBase
	{
		private PolygonFillStyle interlacedFillStyle;

		private RadarDiagramAppearance DiagramAppearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).RadarDiagramAppearance;

		internal new RadarDiagram Diagram => (RadarDiagram)base.Diagram;

		internal Color ActualInterlacedColor
		{
			get
			{
				Color result = base.InterlacedColor;
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return DiagramAppearance.InterlacedColor;
			}
		}

		internal PolygonFillStyle ActualInterlacedFillStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (interlacedFillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Empty)
				{
					return interlacedFillStyle;
				}
				return (PolygonFillStyle)DiagramAppearance.InterlacedFillStyle;
			}
		}

		protected internal override IVisualAxisRangeData VisualRangeData
		{
			get
			{
				IVisualAxisRangeData visualAxisRangeData = base.VisualRangeData;
				if (visualAxisRangeData.Auto && (double.IsNaN(visualAxisRangeData.Min) || double.IsNaN(visualAxisRangeData.Max)))
				{
					visualAxisRangeData.UpdateRange(-1, 1, -1.0, 1.0);
				}
				return visualAxisRangeData;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RadarAxis.InterlacedFillStyle")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RadarAxis.InterlacedFillStyle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public PolygonFillStyle InterlacedFillStyle => interlacedFillStyle;

		protected RadarAxis(string name, RadarDiagram diagram)
			: base(name, diagram)
		{
			interlacedFillStyle = new PolygonFillStyle(this);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeInterlacedFillStyle()
		{
			return interlacedFillStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeInterlacedFillStyle())
			{
				return base.ActualLabel.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "InterlacedFillStyle"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeInterlacedFillStyle();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RadarAxis radarAxis)
			{
				interlacedFillStyle.Assign(radarAxis.interlacedFillStyle);
			}
		}
	}

			: base(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.PrimaryAxisYName), diagram)
		{
			tickmarks = new RadarTickmarksY(this);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return !visible;
		}

		private void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTopLevel()
		{
			return !topLevel;
		}

		private void ResetTopLevel()
		{
			TopLevel = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeThickness()
		{
			return thickness != 1;
		}

		private void ResetThickness()
		{
			Thickness = 1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return color != DefaultColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = DefaultColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTickmarks()
		{
			return tickmarks.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeTopLevel() && !ShouldSerializeThickness() && !ShouldSerializeColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTickmarks();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"TopLevel" => ShouldSerializeTopLevel(), 
				"Thickness" => ShouldSerializeThickness(), 
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"Tickmarks" => ShouldSerializeTickmarks(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RadarAxisY(null);
		}

		protected override AxisRange CreateAxisRange(RangeDataBase wholeAxisRange, RangeDataBase visibleAxisRange)
		{
			return new RadarAxisYRange(this);
		}

		protected override GridLines CreateGridLines()
		{
			return new RadarGridLinesY(this);
		}

		protected override AxisLabel CreateAxisLabel()
		{
			return new RadarAxisYLabel(this);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RadarAxisY radarAxisY)
			{
				visible = radarAxisY.visible;
				topLevel = radarAxisY.topLevel;
				thickness = radarAxisY.thickness;
				color = radarAxisY.color;
				tickmarks.Assign(radarAxisY.tickmarks);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(RadarAxisY)";
		}
	}

		private const bool DefaultYAxisScrollBarVisible = true;

		private static readonly Color DefaultBackColor = Color.Empty;

		private static readonly Color DefaultBorderColor = Color.Empty;

		private readonly ScrollBarAnnotationOptions xAxisAnnotationOptions;

		private int barThickness = 7;

		private bool xAxisScrollBarVisible = true;

		private Color barColor = DefaultBarColor;

		private Color borderColor = DefaultBorderColor;

		private ScrollBarAlignment xAxisScrollBarAlignment;

		private ScrollBarAlignment yAxisScrollBarAlignment;

		private ScrollBarAppearance Appearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).ScrollBarAppearance;

		internal int ActualBarThickness
		{
			get
			{
				SizeF highDpiScaleFactor = ChartContainer.Chart.HighDpiScaleFactor;
				float num = Math.Min(highDpiScaleFactor.Width, highDpiScaleFactor.Height);
				return MathUtils.StrongRound(num * (float)barThickness);
			}
		}

		internal Color ActualBackColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!backColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return backColor;
				}
				return Appearance.BackColor;
			}
		}

					return barColor;

				return Appearance.BarColor;
			}
		}

		internal Color ActualBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return borderColor;
				}
				return Appearance.BorderColor;
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"XAxisScrollBarVisible" => ShouldSerializeXAxisScrollBarVisible(), 
				"YAxisScrollBarVisible" => ShouldSerializeYAxisScrollBarVisible(), 
				"XAxisScrollBarAlignment" => ShouldSerializeXAxisScrollBarAlignment(), 
				"YAxisScrollBarAlignment" => ShouldSerializeYAxisScrollBarAlignment(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"BarColor" => ShouldSerializeBarColor(), 
				"BorderColor" => ShouldSerializeBorderColor(), 
				"BarThickness" => ShouldSerializeBarThickness(), 
				"XAxisAnnotationOptions" => ShouldSerializeXAxisAnnotationOptions(), 
				"YAxisAnnotationOptions" => ShouldSerializeYAxisAnnotationOptions(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeProperties()
		{
			if (base.Owner is XYDiagramPaneBase { ChartContainer: not null } xYDiagramPaneBase)
			{
				return xYDiagramPaneBase.ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeXAxisScrollBarVisible()
		{
			if (!xAxisScrollBarVisible)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetXAxisScrollBarVisible()
		{
			XAxisScrollBarVisible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeYAxisScrollBarVisible()
		{
			if (!yAxisScrollBarVisible)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetYAxisScrollBarVisible()
		{
			YAxisScrollBarVisible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeXAxisScrollBarAlignment()
		{
			if (xAxisScrollBarAlignment != ScrollBarAlignment.Near)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetXAxisScrollBarAlignment()
		{
			XAxisScrollBarAlignment = ScrollBarAlignment.Near;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeYAxisScrollBarAlignment()
		{
			if (yAxisScrollBarAlignment != ScrollBarAlignment.Near)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetYAxisScrollBarAlignment()
		{
			YAxisScrollBarAlignment = ScrollBarAlignment.Near;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBackColor()
		{
			if (!backColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetBackColor()
		{
			BackColor = DefaultBackColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBarColor()
		{
			if (!barColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetBarColor()
		{
			BorderColor = DefaultBarColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorderColor()
		{
			if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetBorderColor()
		{
			BarColor = DefaultBorderColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBarThickness()
		{
			if (barThickness != 7)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProperties();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetBarThickness()
		{
			BarThickness = 7;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeXAxisAnnotationOptions()
		{
			return xAxisAnnotationOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetXAxisAnnotationOptions()
		{
			xAxisAnnotationOptions.Reset();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeYAxisAnnotationOptions()
		{
			return yAxisAnnotationOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetYAxisAnnotationOptions()
		{
			YAxisAnnotationOptions.Reset();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeXAxisScrollBarVisible() && !ShouldSerializeYAxisScrollBarVisible() && !ShouldSerializeXAxisScrollBarAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeYAxisScrollBarAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeBarColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeBarThickness() && !ShouldSerializeXAxisAnnotationOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeYAxisAnnotationOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ScrollBarOptions();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ScrollBarOptions scrollBarOptions)
			{
				xAxisAnnotationOptions.Assign(scrollBarOptions.xAxisAnnotationOptions);
				yAxisAnnotationOptions.Assign(scrollBarOptions.yAxisAnnotationOptions);
				xAxisScrollBarVisible = scrollBarOptions.xAxisScrollBarVisible;
				yAxisScrollBarVisible = scrollBarOptions.yAxisScrollBarVisible;
				xAxisScrollBarAlignment = scrollBarOptions.xAxisScrollBarAlignment;
				yAxisScrollBarAlignment = scrollBarOptions.yAxisScrollBarAlignment;
				backColor = scrollBarOptions.backColor;
				barColor = scrollBarOptions.barColor;
				borderColor = scrollBarOptions.borderColor;
				barThickness = scrollBarOptions.barThickness;
			}
		}
	}
