	public abstract class SecondaryAxisCollection : ChartElementNamedCollection, IEnumerable<IAxisData>, IEnumerable, IEnumerable<Axis2D>
	{
		public Axis2D this[int index] => (Axis2D)base.List[index];

		internal SecondaryAxisCollection(XYDiagram2D diagram)
			: base(diagram)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<IAxisData> IEnumerable<IAxisData>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (IAxisData inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				yield return inner;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<Axis2D> IEnumerable<Axis2D>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (Axis2D inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				yield return inner;
			}
		}

		protected void AddRangeInternal(ICollection coll)
		{
			AddRange(coll);
		}

		protected void RemoveInternal(Axis2D axis)
		{
			Remove(axis);
		}

		protected abstract Axis2D CreateNewAxis(string name);

		protected internal bool ContainsInternal(Axis2D axis)
		{
			return Contains(axis);
		}

		protected internal Axis2D GetAxisByNameInternal(string name)
		{
			return (Axis2D)GetElementByName(name);
		}

		protected internal int AddInternal(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (axis.VisualRange.Auto && axis.WholeRange.Auto)
			{
				RangeHelper.SetDefaultRange(axis);
			}
			else
			{
				RangeHelper.SynchronizeVisualRange(axis.WholeRangeData, axis.VisualRangeData, needSyncWithWholeRange: true);
			}
			return Add(axis);
		}

		internal Axis2D CreateNewAxis()
		{
			return CreateNewAxis(GenerateName());
		}

		internal int AddWithoutChanged(Axis2D axis)
		{
			return AddWithoutChanged((ChartElement)axis);
		}

		internal bool ContainsWithChildren(object obj)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)enumerator.Current;
					if (obj == axis2D || axis2D.Contains(obj))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Axis2D GetAxisByIndex(int index)
		{
			return (Axis2D)base.InnerList[index];
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Use the SecondaryAxisXCollection.AddRange or SecondaryAxisYCollection.AddRange method instead.")]
		public void AddRange(Axis[] coll)
		{
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Use the SecondaryAxisXCollection.Remove or SecondaryAxisYCollection.Remove method instead.")]
		public void Remove(Axis axis)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)axis);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Use the SecondaryAxisXCollection.Contains or SecondaryAxisYCollection.Contains method instead.")]
		public bool Contains(Axis axis)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)axis);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Use the SecondaryAxisXCollection.GetAxisByName or SecondaryAxisYCollection.GetAxisByName method instead.")]
		public Axis GetAxisByName(string name)
		{
			return (Axis)GetElementByName(name);
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, object oldItem, int oldIndex, object newItem, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisCollectionUpdateInfo(this, operation, oldItem as IAxisData, oldIndex, newItem as IAxisData, newIndex));
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, ICollection oldItems, int oldIndex, ICollection newItems, int newIndex)
		{
			List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
			if (newItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object newItem in newItems)
				{
					if (newItem is IAxisData item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			List<IAxisData> list2 = new List<IAxisData>();
			if (oldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in oldItems)
				{
					if (oldItem is IAxisData item2)
					{
						list2.Add(item2);
					}
				}
			}
			return new ChartUpdate(new AxisCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, operation, list2, oldIndex, list, newIndex));
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			AxisCollectionUpdateInfo axisCollectionUpdateInfo = change.UpdateInfo as AxisCollectionUpdateInfo;
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = GetOwner<DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart>();
			if (axisCollectionUpdateInfo != null && chart != null && (axisCollectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.Reset || axisCollectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem))
			{
				chart.CheckXYDiagramBindings();
			}
			base.ProcessChanged(change);
		}
	}

		{

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAngle() && !ShouldSerializeStaggered() && !ShouldSerializeMaxWidth() && !ShouldSerializeMaxLineCount() && !ShouldSerializeTextAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingMode() && !ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingOptions() && !ShouldSerializeDateTimeOptions() && !ShouldSerializeNumericOptions() && !ShouldSerializeTextPattern() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorder())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFillStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Angle" => ShouldSerializeAngle(), 
				"Staggered" => ShouldSerializeStaggered(), 
				"MaxWidth" => ShouldSerializeMaxWidth(), 
				"MaxLineCount" => ShouldSerializeMaxLineCount(), 
				"TextAlignment" => ShouldSerializeTextAlignment(), 
				"ResolveOverlappingMode" => ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingMode(), 
				"ResolveOverlappingOptions" => ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingOptions(), 
				"NumericOptions" => ShouldSerializeNumericOptions(), 
				"DateTimeOptions" => ShouldSerializeDateTimeOptions(), 
				"TextPattern" => ShouldSerializeTextPattern(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"Border" => ShouldSerializeBorder(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private void UpdateTextPattern()
		{
			textPattern = beginText + "{" + (Axis.IsValuesAxis ? "V" : "A");
			if (Axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
			{
				textPattern = textPattern + ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(numericOptions);
			}
			else if (Axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				textPattern = textPattern + ":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(dateTimeOptions);
			}
			else if (Axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				textPattern = textPattern + ":" + PatternUtils.GetTimeSpanFormat();
			}
			textPattern = textPattern + "}" + endText;
			textPatternSynchronized = true;
		}

		internal void SynchronizeTextPatterWithScaleType()
		{
			if (textPatternSynchronized)
			{
				UpdateTextPattern();
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AxisLabel(null);
		}

		protected override Color GetTextColor(IChartAppearance actualAppearance)
		{
			return actualAppearance.XYDiagramAppearance.LabelsColor;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (sender == numericOptions || sender == dateTimeOptions)
			{
				UpdateTextPattern();
			}
			return base.ProcessChanged(sender, change);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(AxisLabel)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AxisLabel axisLabel)
			{
				resolveOverlappingOptions.Assign(axisLabel.resolveOverlappingOptions);
				angle = axisLabel.angle;
				maxWidth = axisLabel.maxWidth;
				maxLineCount = axisLabel.maxLineCount;
				textAlignment = axisLabel.textAlignment;
				staggered = axisLabel.staggered;
				resolveOverlappingMode = axisLabel.resolveOverlappingMode;
				textPattern = axisLabel.textPattern;
				backColor = axisLabel.backColor;
				fillStyle.Assign(axisLabel.fillStyle);
				border.Assign(axisLabel.border);
			}
		}
	}

				if (Axis == null || Axis.Diagram == null || Axis.Diagram.Chart == null)
				{
					return null;

			}

		{

				if (color != Color.Empty)

				return CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this)?.ConstantLineAppearance.Color ?? Color.Empty;
			}
		}

		internal HitTestController HitTestController => Axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController;

		internal bool ActualShowInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible)
				{
					return showInLegend;
				}
				if (showInLegend && visible)
				{
					return CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsAxisValueVisible(Axis, valueContainer.Value);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool RuntimeOperationSelect { get; set; }

		protected internal bool ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (Axis == null || Axis.Diagram == null || Axis.Diagram.Chart == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsAxisValueVisible(Axis, valueContainer.Value);
				bool flag2 = ((!ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible || !checkableInLegend) ? visible : (visible && checkedInLegend));
				return flag && flag2;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return base.Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectConstantLineAxisValue));
				}
				if (value != valueContainer.Value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					valueContainer.Value = ((Axis == null || Loading) ? value : Axis.ConvertBasedOnScaleType(value));
					RaiseControlChanged(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that determines whether a legend check box is checked for a constant line.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ConstantLine.CheckedInLegend")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]

		[DXDisplayNameIgnore]
		public bool CheckedInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return checkedInLegend;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != checkedInLegend)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					checkedInLegend = value;
					if (ContainerAdapter != null)
					{
						ContainerAdapter.OnLegendItemChecked(new LegendItemCheckedEventArgs(this, value));
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, Axis));
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Legend Legend
		{
			get
			{
				return legend;
			}
			set
			{
				if (legend != value)
				{
					if (value != null && Axis != null && Axis.Diagram != null && Axis.Diagram.Chart != null && !Axis.Diagram.Chart.ActualLegends.Contains(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectConstantLineLegend));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					legend = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Legend"));
				}
			}
		}

		public ConstantLine(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
			lineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antialiasing: false, DashStyle.Empty);
			title = new ConstantLineTitle(this);
			valueContainer = new AxisValueContainer(1.0);
		}

		public ConstantLine()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(string name, double value)
			: this(name, (object)value)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(string name, DateTime value)
			: this(name, (object)value)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(string name, TimeSpan value)
			: this(name, (object)value)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(string name, string value)
			: this(name, (object)value)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(string name, object axisValue)
			: this(name)
		{
			if (axisValue == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectConstantLineAxisValue));
			}
			double defaultValueInternal = 1.0;
			try
			{
				defaultValueInternal = Convert.ToDouble(axisValue);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			valueContainer = new AxisValueContainer(axisValue, defaultValueInternal);
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int y = bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 2;
			Point point = new Point(bounds.Left + 1, y);
			Point point2 = new Point(bounds.Right - 1, y);
			Color color = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(ActualColor, hitTestState);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
			renderer.DrawLine(point, point2, color, 2, lineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, this, null, new HitRegion(bounds));
		}

		bool IDragPoint.CanDrag()
		{
			return runtimeMoving;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			loading = true;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			loading = false;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"CheckedInLegend" => ShouldSerializeCheckedInLegend(), 
				"CheckableInLegend" => ShouldSerializeCheckableInLegend(), 
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"ShowInLegend" => ShouldSerializeShowInLegend(), 
				"LegendText" => ShouldSerializeLegendText(), 
				"LegendName" => ShouldSerializeLegendName(), 
				"RuntimeTitleEditing" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeTitleEditing(), 
				"RuntimeDeletion" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeDeletion(), 
				"RuntimeMoving" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeMoving(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return !visible;
		}

		private void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCheckedInLegend()
		{
			return !checkedInLegend;
		}

		private void ResetCheckedInLegend()
		{
			CheckedInLegend = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCheckableInLegend()
		{
			return !checkableInLegend;
		}

		private void ResetCheckableInLegend()
		{
			CheckableInLegend = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return color != DefaultColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = DefaultColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowInLegend()
		{
			return !showInLegend;
		}

		private void ResetShowInLegend()
		{
			ShowInLegend = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLegendText()
		{
			return legendText != "";
		}

		private void ResetLegendText()
		{
			LegendText = "";
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowBehind()
		{
			return showBehind;
		}

		private void ResetShowBehind()
		{
			ShowBehind = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLegendName()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LegendName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLegend()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetLegend()
		{
			Legend = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRuntimeTitleEditing()
		{
			return runtimeTitleEditing;
		}

		private void ResetRuntimeTitleEditing()
		{
			RuntimeTitleEditing = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRuntimeDeletion()
		{
			return runtimeDeletion;
		}

		private void ResetRuntimeDeletion()
		{
			RuntimeDeletion = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRuntimeMoving()
		{
			return runtimeMoving;
		}

		private void ResetRuntimeMoving()
		{
			RuntimeMoving = false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		private CursorType GetCursorType()
		{
			if (Axis == null)
			{
				return CursorType.None;
			}
			if (!Axis.IsVertical)
			{
				return CursorType.SizeWE;
			}
			return CursorType.SizeNS;
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (Axis != null && Axis.Diagram != null && Axis.Diagram.Chart != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(legendName))
			{
				legend = Axis.Diagram.Chart.FindLegendByName(legendName);
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Legend"));
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ConstantLine();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ConstantLine constantLine)
			{
				valueContainer.Assign(constantLine.valueContainer);
				visible = constantLine.visible;
				lineStyle.Assign(constantLine.lineStyle);
				color = constantLine.color;
				showInLegend = constantLine.showInLegend;
				legendText = constantLine.legendText;
				title.Assign(constantLine.title);
				showBehind = constantLine.showBehind;
				checkedInLegend = constantLine.checkedInLegend;
				checkableInLegend = constantLine.checkableInLegend;
				legendName = constantLine.LegendName;
				runtimeTitleEditing = constantLine.runtimeTitleEditing;
				runtimeMoving = constantLine.runtimeMoving;
				runtimeDeletion = constantLine.runtimeDeletion;
				id = constantLine.id;
			}
		}
	}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeMinorVisible() && !ShouldSerializeLineStyle() && !ShouldSerializeMinorLineStyle() && !ShouldSerializeColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMinorColor();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"MinorVisible" => ShouldSerializeMinorVisible(), 
				"LineStyle" => ShouldSerializeLineStyle(), 
				"MinorLineStyle" => ShouldSerializeMinorLineStyle(), 
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"MinorColor" => ShouldSerializeMinorColor(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		internal Color GetActualColor(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!color.IsEmpty)
			{
				return color;
			}
			return appearance?.GridLinesColor ?? Color.Empty;
		}

		internal Color GetActualMinorColor(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!minorColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return minorColor;
			}
			return appearance?.MinorGridLinesColor ?? Color.Empty;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is GridLines gridLines)
			{
				visible = gridLines.visible;
				minorVisible = gridLines.minorVisible;
				lineStyle.Assign(gridLines.lineStyle);
				minorLineStyle.Assign(gridLines.minorLineStyle);
				color = gridLines.color;
				minorColor = gridLines.minorColor;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(GridLines)";
		}
	}

		private StripAppearance Appearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).StripAppearance;

		internal LegendBase ActualLegend
		{
			get
			{
				object actualLegend = Legend;
				if (actualLegend == null)
				{
					Axis2D axis = Axis;
					if (axis == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					Diagram diagram = axis.Diagram;
					if (diagram == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = diagram.Chart;
					if (chart == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					actualLegend = chart.ActualLegend;
				}
				return (LegendBase)actualLegend;
			}
		}

		internal Color ActualColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(color == Color.Empty))
				{
					return color;
				}
				return Appearance.Color;
			}
		}

		internal RectangleFillStyle ActualFillStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (fillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Empty)
				{
					return fillStyle;
				}
				return Appearance.FillStyle;
			}
		}

		internal Axis2D Axis => (Axis2D)base.Owner;

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return base.Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (Axis == null || Axis.Diagram == null || Axis.Diagram.Chart == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsStripVisible(Axis.ScaleTypeMap, this);
				bool flag2 = ((!ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible || !checkableInLegend) ? visible : (visible && checkedInLegend));
				return flag && flag2;
			}
		}

		public Legend Legend
		{

			{
				return legend;
			}
			set
			{
				if (legend != value)
				{
					if (value != null && Axis != null && Axis.Diagram != null && Axis.Diagram.Chart != null && !Axis.Diagram.Chart.ActualLegends.Contains(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectStripLegend));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					legend = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Legend"));
				}
			}
		}

		public Strip(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
			minLimit = new MinStripLimit(this);
			maxLimit = new MaxStripLimit(this);
			minLimit.SetMaxLimit(maxLimit);
			maxLimit.SetMinLimit(minLimit);
			fillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this);
		}

		public Strip()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

			: this(name, (object)minValue, (object)maxValue)
		{
		}

			: this(name, (object)minValue, (object)maxValue)
		{
		}

		public Strip(string name, DateTime minValue, DateTime maxValue)
			: this(name, (object)minValue, (object)maxValue)
		{
		}

		public Strip(string name, object minValue, object maxValue)
			: this(name)
		{
			SetAxisValues(minValue, maxValue);
		}

		void IStrip.CorrectLimits()
		{
			CorrectLimits(Axis);
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bounds.Inflate(-1, -1);
			ActualFillStyle.RenderRectangle(renderer, bounds, ActualColor);
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			loading = true;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			loading = false;
		}

		{
			return maxLimit.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFillStyle()
		{
			return fillStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return !visible;
		}

		private void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return color != DefaultColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = DefaultColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowInLegend()
		{
			return !showInLegend;
		}

		private void ResetShowInLegend()

		private void SetAxisValues(object minAxisValue, object maxAxisValue)
		{
			if (minAxisValue is double && maxAxisValue is double)
			{
				double num = (double)minAxisValue;
				double num2 = (double)maxAxisValue;
				if (num < num2)
				{
					((IAxisValueContainer)minLimit).Value = num;
					((IAxisValueContainer)maxLimit).Value = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					minAxisValue = ((IAxisValueContainer)minLimit).Value;
					maxAxisValue = ((IAxisValueContainer)maxLimit).Value;
				}
			}
			else if (minAxisValue is string && maxAxisValue is string)
			{
				string text = minAxisValue.ToString();
				string strB = maxAxisValue.ToString();
				if (text.CompareTo(strB) == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectStripConstructorParameters));
				}
			}
			else if (minAxisValue is DateTime && maxAxisValue is DateTime)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)minAxisValue;
				DateTime value = (DateTime)maxAxisValue;
				if (dateTime.CompareTo(value) >= 0)
				{
					minAxisValue = DateTime.Now;
					maxAxisValue = DateTime.Now.AddDays(1.0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(minAxisValue is TimeSpan) || !(maxAxisValue is TimeSpan))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Types mismatch.");
				}
				TimeSpan timeSpan = (TimeSpan)minAxisValue;
				TimeSpan value2 = (TimeSpan)maxAxisValue;
				if (timeSpan.CompareTo(value2) >= 0)
				{
					minAxisValue = TimeSpan.Zero;
					TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative timeSpanMeasureUnitNative = TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second;
					maxAxisValue = DateTimeUtilsExt.AddRange(timeSpanMeasureUnitNative, timeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpan.Zero, 1);
				}
			}
			minLimit.ValueContainer.Value = minAxisValue;
			maxLimit.ValueContainer.Value = maxAxisValue;
			minLimit.SyncAxisValueAndEnabled();
			maxLimit.SyncAxisValueAndEnabled();
		}

		private void SwapLimits()
		{
			object axisValue = MinLimit.AxisValue;
			MinLimit.ValueContainer.Value = MaxLimit.AxisValue;
			MaxLimit.ValueContainer.Value = axisValue;
			double valueInternal = MinLimit.ValueContainer.ValueInternal;
			MinLimit.ValueContainer.ValueInternal = MaxLimit.ValueContainer.ValueInternal;
			MaxLimit.ValueContainer.ValueInternal = valueInternal;
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (Axis != null && Axis.Diagram != null && Axis.Diagram.Chart != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(legendName))
			{
				legend = Axis.Diagram.Chart.FindLegendByName(legendName);
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Legend"));
			}
		}

		internal void CorrectLimits(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (axis == null || !MinLimit.Enabled || !MaxLimit.Enabled || MinLimit.AxisValue == null || MaxLimit.AxisValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (axis.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
				if (MinLimit.AxisValue is double && MaxLimit.AxisValue is double && (double)MinLimit.AxisValue > (double)MaxLimit.AxisValue)
				{
					SwapLimits();
				}
				return;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				if (MinLimit.AxisValue is DateTime && MaxLimit.AxisValue is DateTime && (DateTime)MaxLimit.AxisValue < (DateTime)MinLimit.AxisValue)
				{
					SwapLimits();
				}
				return;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				if (MinLimit.AxisValue is TimeSpan && MaxLimit.AxisValue is TimeSpan && (TimeSpan)MaxLimit.AxisValue < (TimeSpan)MinLimit.AxisValue)
				{
					SwapLimits();
				}
				return;
			}
			string value = MinLimit.AxisValue.ToString();
			string value2 = MaxLimit.AxisValue.ToString();
			double num = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(value);
			double num2 = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(value2);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && num > num2)
			{
				MinLimit.ValueContainer.Value = value2;
				MaxLimit.ValueContainer.Value = value;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Strip();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Strip strip)
			{
				minLimit.Assign(strip.minLimit);
				maxLimit.Assign(strip.maxLimit);
				visible = strip.visible;
				color = strip.color;
				fillStyle.Assign(strip.fillStyle);
				legendText = strip.legendText;
				showInLegend = strip.showInLegend;
				axisLabelText = strip.axisLabelText;
				showAxisLabel = strip.showAxisLabel;
				checkedInLegend = strip.checkedInLegend;
				checkableInLegend = strip.checkableInLegend;
				legendName = strip.LegendName;
				id = strip.id;
			}
		}
	}

					return base.Chart.DataContainer.ValidateDataMembers;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

			}

			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ChartCalculatedField calculatedField)
		{
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)calculatedField);
		}

		public void Remove(ChartCalculatedField calculatedField)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)calculatedField);
		}

		public bool Contains(ChartCalculatedField calculatedField)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)calculatedField);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartElement : ICloneable, IXtraSupportShouldSerialize, IOwnedElement, IChartElementWizardAccess
	{
		private ChartElement owner;

		private object tag;

		protected internal ViewController ViewController => Chart?.ViewController;

		protected internal ChartElement Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				ChartElement oldOwner = owner;
				owner = value;
				OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, owner);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.Loading;
				}
				return WebLoadingHelper.GlobalLoading;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual IChartContainer ChartContainer
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return owner.ChartContainer;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual ChartContainerAdapter ContainerAdapter
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return owner.ContainerAdapter;
			}
		}

		internal DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart Chart
		{
			get
			{
				for (ChartElement chartElement = this; chartElement != null; chartElement = chartElement.Owner)
				{
					if (chartElement is DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart result)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartElement.Tag")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartElement.Tag")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(TagConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Misc)]
		public object Tag
		{
			get
			{
				return tag;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != tag)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					tag = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		IOwnedElement IOwnedElement.Owner => Owner;

		IChartContainer IOwnedElement.ChartContainer => ChartContainer;

		protected internal virtual bool XtraSerializing
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.XtraSerializing;
				}
				return XtraSerializingHelper.XtraSerializing;
			}
		}

		protected ChartElement()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected ChartElement(ChartElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		void IChartElementWizardAccess.RaiseControlChanging()
		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
		}

		void IChartElementWizardAccess.RaiseControlChanged()
		{
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public virtual object Clone()
		{
			ChartElement chartElement = CreateObjectForClone();
			chartElement.Assign(this);
			return chartElement;
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected virtual bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Tag")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTag()
		{
			return tag != null;
		}

		private void ResetTag()
		{
			Tag = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return ShouldSerializeTag();
		}

		protected abstract ChartElement CreateObjectForClone();

		protected virtual void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				return owner.ProcessChanged(sender, change);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged<T>(string name, T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo<T>(this, name, oldValue, newValue));
		}

		protected internal void ApplyCumulativeUpdates()
		{
			if (ViewController != null)
			{
				ViewController.ApplyChangesOnPropertyRequest();
			}
		}

		internal void LockChanges()
		{
			if (ViewController != null)
			{
				ViewController.LockAllChanges();
			}
		}

		internal void InitTag(object tag)
		{
			this.tag = tag;
		}

		internal void UnlockChanges()
		{
			if (ViewController != null)
			{
				ViewController.UnlockAllChanges();
			}
		}

		protected internal T GetOwner<T>() where T : ChartElement
		{
			if (GetType() == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)this;
			}
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				return Owner.GetOwner<T>();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanging()
		{
			if (ViewController != null)
			{
				ViewController.RaiseChanging();
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanged()
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanged(ChartUpdateInfoBase changeInfo)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(changeInfo));
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanged(ChartUpdateInfoBase changeInfo, ChartElementChange change)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(change, changeInfo));
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanged(bool resetSmartBinding, bool resetSeriesBinding)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding, resetSeriesBinding, raiseChanged: true);
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanged(bool resetSmartBinding, bool resetSeriesBinding, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			if (ViewController != null)
			{
				ViewController.RefreshData(resetSmartBinding, resetSeriesBinding, raiseChanged);
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseControlChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (ProcessChanged(this, change) && ViewController != null)
			{
				ViewController.RaiseChanged(change);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ChildCollectionChanged(ChartCollectionBase collection, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(change);
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, Action action = null)
		{
			if (object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RaiseControlChanging();
			storage = value;
			action?.Invoke();
			RaiseControlChanged();
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"({GetType().Name})";
		}

		public virtual void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("obj");
			}
			ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
			AssignTag(obj.tag);
		}

		protected void AssignTag(object tag)
		{
			this.tag = tag;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartElementNamed : ChartElement
	{
		private string name;

		protected virtual bool AllowEmptyName => true;

		protected virtual string EmptyNameExceptionText => "";

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartElementNamed.Name")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartElementNamed.Name")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Misc)]
		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckName(value);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				name = value;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeName()
		{
			if (!AllowEmptyName)
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(name);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ResetName()
		{
			if (AllowEmptyName)
			{
				Name = "";
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Name")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeName();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected ChartElementNamed(string name)
		{
			Initialize(name);
		}

		protected ChartElementNamed(string name, ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			Initialize(name);
		}

		private void Initialize(string name)
		{
			this.name = name;
		}

		private void CheckName(string elementName)
		{
			if (!AllowEmptyName && string.IsNullOrEmpty(elementName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EmptyNameExceptionText);
			}
		}

		protected void CheckName()
		{
			CheckName(name);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return name;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ChartElementNamed chartElementNamed)
			{
				name = chartElementNamed.name;
			}
		}
	}

			{
				return ShouldSerializeLinesMode();

			return true;

		private void AssignLabelPosition(CrosshairLabelPosition templateLabelPosition)
		{
			if (!commonLabelPosition.GetType().Equals(templateLabelPosition.GetType()))
			{
				SetLabelPosition((CrosshairLabelPosition)templateLabelPosition.Clone());
			}
			else
			{
				commonLabelPosition.Assign(templateLabelPosition);
			}
		}

		{
			commonLabelPosition = value;
			commonLabelPosition.Owner = this;
		}

		{
			commonLabelPosition.OnEndLoading();
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailablePatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (SnapMode == CrosshairSnapMode.NearestArgument)
			{
				return new string[2] { "A", "TV" };
			}
			return new string[2] { "V", "TV" };
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
			{
				showArgumentLabels = crosshairOptions.showArgumentLabels;
				showValueLabels = crosshairOptions.showValueLabels;
				showCrosshairLabels = crosshairOptions.showCrosshairLabels;
				showOnlyInFocusedPane = crosshairOptions.showOnlyInFocusedPane;
				snapMode = crosshairOptions.snapMode;
				crosshairLabelMode = crosshairOptions.crosshairLabelMode;
				showArgumentLine = crosshairOptions.showArgumentLine;
				showValueLine = crosshairOptions.showValueLine;
				argumentLineColor = crosshairOptions.argumentLineColor;
				argumentLineStyle = crosshairOptions.argumentLineStyle;
				valueLineColor = crosshairOptions.valueLineColor;
				valueLineStyle = crosshairOptions.valueLineStyle;
				AssignLabelPosition(crosshairOptions.commonLabelPosition);
				showGroupHeaders = crosshairOptions.showGroupHeaders;
				groupHeaderPattern = crosshairOptions.groupHeaderPattern;
				highlightPoints = crosshairOptions.highlightPoints;
				groupHeaderTextOptions.Assign(crosshairOptions.groupHeaderTextOptions);
				crosshairLabelTextOptions.Assign(crosshairOptions.crosshairLabelTextOptions);
				crosshairLabelBackColor = crosshairOptions.crosshairLabelBackColor;
				showOutOfRangePoints = crosshairOptions.showOutOfRangePoints;
				valueSelectionMode = crosshairOptions.valueSelectionMode;
				contentShowMode = crosshairOptions.contentShowMode;
				linesMode = crosshairOptions.linesMode;
				OnEndLoading();
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CrosshairFreePosition")]
	public class CrosshairFreePosition : CrosshairLabelPosition
	{
		private const DockCorner DefaultDockCorner = DockCorner.LeftTop;

		private IDockTarget dockTarget;

		private DockCorner dockCorner = DockCorner.LeftTop;

		private string deserializedDockTargetName;

		protected override bool IsMousePosition => false;

		[Description("Specifies the corner of the crosshair’s parent element to which the crosshair label is anchored.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CrosshairFreePosition.DockCorner")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DockCorner DockCorner
		{
			get
			{
				return dockCorner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dockCorner != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					dockCorner = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string DockTargetName
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockTarget != null)
				{
					return dockTarget.Name;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedDockTargetName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the element (chart or pane), to which the crosshair label’s shape is docked.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CrosshairFreePosition.DockTarget")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(CrosshairFreePositionDockTargetTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public ChartElement DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (ChartElement)dockTarget;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dockTarget)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if (value != null)
					{
						CommonUtils.CheckDockTarget(value, this);
					}
					dockTarget = value as IDockTarget;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "DockCorner"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "DockTargetName")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeDockTargetName();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeDockCorner();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockCorner()
		{
			return dockCorner != DockCorner.LeftTop;
		}

		private void ResetDockCorner()
		{
			DockCorner = DockCorner.LeftTop;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockTargetName()
		{
			return dockTarget != null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockTarget()
		{
			return dockTarget != null;
		}

		private void ResetDockTarget()
		{
			DockTarget = null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeDockCorner())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDockTargetName();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CrosshairFreePosition();
		}

		protected override GRealRect2D GetDockBounds()
		{
			if (!(dockTarget is XYDiagramPaneBase { LastMappingBounds: not null, LastMappingBounds: var lastMappingBounds }))
			{
				return GRealRect2D.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle value = lastMappingBounds.Value;
			return new GRealRect2D(value.X, value.Y, value.Width, value.Height);
		}

		protected override DockCornerCore GetDockCorner()
		{
			return (DockCornerCore)DockCorner;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = CommonUtils.GetXYDiagram2D(this);
			if (xYDiagram2D != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializedDockTargetName))
			{
				dockTarget = xYDiagram2D.FindPaneByName(deserializedDockTargetName);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is CrosshairFreePosition crosshairFreePosition)
			{
				dockTarget = crosshairFreePosition.dockTarget;
				DockTargetName = crosshairFreePosition.DockTargetName;
				dockCorner = crosshairFreePosition.dockCorner;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ZoomingOptions2D")]
	public class ZoomingOptions2D : ZoomingOptions
	{
		private const double MinPossibleZoomPercent = 100.0;

		private const double DefaultMaxZoomPercent = 10000.0;

		private double axisXMaxZoomPercent = 10000.0;

		private double axisYMaxZoomPercent = 10000.0;

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum zoom factor as a percentage for the X-axis.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ZoomingOptions2D.AxisXMaxZoomPercent")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double AxisXMaxZoomPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return axisXMaxZoomPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (axisXMaxZoomPercent != value)
				{
					if (!Loading && value < 100.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectMaxZoomPercent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					axisXMaxZoomPercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum zoom factor as a percentage for the Y-axis.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ZoomingOptions2D.AxisYMaxZoomPercent")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double AxisYMaxZoomPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return axisYMaxZoomPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (axisYMaxZoomPercent != value)
				{
					if (!Loading && value < 100.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectMaxZoomPercent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					axisYMaxZoomPercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the action used to zoom the chart into the rectangle.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ZoomingOptions2D.ZoomToRectangleMouseAction")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public ChartMouseAction ZoomToRectangleMouseAction => base.ActualZoomToRectangleMouseAction;

		internal ZoomingOptions2D(XYDiagram2D diagram)
			: base(diagram)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisXMaxZoomPercent()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeProperties())
			{
				return axisXMaxZoomPercent != 10000.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAxisXMaxZoomPercent()
		{
			AxisXMaxZoomPercent = 10000.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisYMaxZoomPercent()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeProperties())
			{
				return axisYMaxZoomPercent != 10000.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAxisYMaxZoomPercent()
		{
			AxisYMaxZoomPercent = 10000.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeZoomToRectangleMouseAction()
		{
			return ZoomToRectangleMouseAction.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetZoomToRectangleMouseAction()
		{
			ZoomToRectangleMouseAction.Reset();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAxisXMaxZoomPercent() && !ShouldSerializeAxisYMaxZoomPercent())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeZoomToRectangleMouseAction();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"AxisXMaxZoomPercent" => ShouldSerializeAxisXMaxZoomPercent(), 
				"AxisYMaxZoomPercent" => ShouldSerializeAxisYMaxZoomPercent(), 
				"ZoomToRectangleMouseAction" => ShouldSerializeZoomToRectangleMouseAction(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartMouseAction CreateZoomToRectangleMouseAction()
		{
			return new ChartMouseAction(this, ChartModifierKeys.Shift, (PortableMouseButtons)5242880);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ZoomingOptions2D(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ZoomingOptions2D zoomingOptions2D)
			{
				axisXMaxZoomPercent = zoomingOptions2D.axisXMaxZoomPercent;
				axisYMaxZoomPercent = zoomingOptions2D.axisYMaxZoomPercent;
				ZoomToRectangleMouseAction.Assign(zoomingOptions2D.ZoomToRectangleMouseAction);
			}
		}

	public class BoxPlotDrawOptions : DrawOptions
	{
		private RectangularBorder border;

		private RectangleFillStyle fillStyle;

		private Color meanAndMedianColor;

		private Shadow shadow;

		[Description("Returns border settings for Box Plot series points.")]

		[Description("Returns fill style settings for Box Plot series points.")]

		[Description("Gets or sets the color that is used to paint the mean and median of a Box Plot point.")]

		{
			get
			{
				return meanAndMedianColor;
			}
			set
			{
				meanAndMedianColor = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns shadow settings for Box Plot series points.")]
		public Shadow Shadow => shadow;

		internal BoxPlotDrawOptions(BoxPlotSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			border = (RectangularBorder)view.Border.Clone();
			fillStyle = (RectangleFillStyle)view.ActualFillStyle.Clone();
			meanAndMedianColor = view.MeanAndMedianColor;
			shadow = (Shadow)view.Shadow.Clone();
		}

		protected BoxPlotDrawOptions()
		{
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateInstance()
		{
			return new BoxPlotDrawOptions();
		}

		{

			{
				border = (RectangularBorder)boxPlotDrawOptions.border.Clone();
				fillStyle = (RectangleFillStyle)boxPlotDrawOptions.fillStyle.Clone();
				meanAndMedianColor = boxPlotDrawOptions.meanAndMedianColor;
				shadow = (Shadow)boxPlotDrawOptions.shadow.Clone();
			}
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class BreadcrumbItem : ITextPropertiesProvider, IHitTest, ISupportTextAntialiasing, IClickableElement
	{
		private readonly HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private readonly DrillDownState state;

		private readonly Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs;

		internal bool IsHot
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsActive)
				{
					return hitTestState.Hot;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		public bool IsActive => !IsLast;

		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		public bool IsLast { get; protected internal set; }

		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		public bool IsHomeItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (state != null)
				{
					return state.IsRoot;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		public string Text => state.GetBreadcrumbItemText(breadcrumbs.HomeText);

		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Elements)]
		public SeriesTemplate Template => state.SeriesTemplate;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.Rotated => false;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.DefaultAntialiasing => true;

		DefaultBoolean ISupportTextAntialiasing.EnableAntialiasing => (DefaultBoolean)0;

		Color ISupportTextAntialiasing.TextBackColor => Color.Empty;

		RectangleFillStyle ISupportTextAntialiasing.TextBackFillStyle => RectangleFillStyle.Empty;

		ChartElement ISupportTextAntialiasing.BackElement => breadcrumbs.Chart;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.CanBeDrawnOn3D => true;

		DXFont ITextPropertiesProvider.Font => breadcrumbs.ActualFont;

		RectangleFillStyle ITextPropertiesProvider.FillStyle => RectangleFillStyle.Empty;

		RectangularBorder ITextPropertiesProvider.Border => null;

		Shadow ITextPropertiesProvider.Shadow => null;

		System.Drawing.StringAlignment ITextPropertiesProvider.Alignment => System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		bool ITextPropertiesProvider.ChangeSelectedBorder => false;

		bool ITextPropertiesProvider.CorrectBoundsByBorder => false;

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.BackColor => Color.Empty;

		bool IHitTest.CanBeHot
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsActive)
				{
					return !breadcrumbs.ChartContainer.DesignMode;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		object IHitTest.Object => this;

		HitTestState IHitTest.State => hitTestState;

		internal BreadcrumbItem(Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs, DrillDownState state)
		{
			this.breadcrumbs = breadcrumbs;
			this.state = state;
		}

		bool ITextPropertiesProvider.CanWrapText(float textWidth)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetTextColor(Color color)
		{
			if (IsHot)
			{
				return breadcrumbs.ActualHoverForeColor;
			}
			if (IsActive)
			{
				return breadcrumbs.ActualForeColor;
			}
			return breadcrumbs.ActualInactiveForeColor;
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetBorderColor(Color color)
		{
			return color;
		}

		bool IClickableElement.ProcessLeftButtonClick()
		{
			return SetItemDrillDownState();
		}

		internal bool SetItemDrillDownState()
		{
			if (IsActive && !breadcrumbs.ChartContainer.DesignMode)
			{
				breadcrumbs.Chart.DataContainer.SetDrillDownState(state);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Breadcrumbs")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public class Breadcrumbs : ChartElement, IHitTest, ISupportVisibilityControlElement, IXtraPartlyDeserializable
	{
		private readonly HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private readonly Dictionary<DrillDownState, BreadcrumbItem> itemsCache = new Dictionary<DrillDownState, BreadcrumbItem>();

		private readonly List<BreadcrumbItem> items = new List<BreadcrumbItem>();

		private readonly InsideRectangularBorder border;

		private readonly RectangleIndents margins;

		private readonly RectangleIndents padding;

		private bool actualVisible = true;

		private string homeText = string.Empty;

		private Color foreColor = Color.Empty;

		private Color hoverForeColor = Color.Empty;

		private Color inactiveForeColor = Color.Empty;

		private Color backColor;

		private DefaultBoolean visibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private BackCompatibilityFontController fontController;

		private GRealRect2D bounds;

		private int id = -1;

		internal BreadcrumbsAppearance Appearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).BreadcrumbsAppearance;

		internal bool ActualVisible => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(visibility, actualVisible);

		internal DXFont ActualFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (!fontController.IsDefaultFont)
				{
					return fontController.DXFont;
				}
				DXFont dXFont = fontController.DXFont;
				float fontSize = Appearance.LinkAppearance.FontSize;
				fontSize = ((fontSize <= 0f) ? dXFont.SizeInPoints : fontSize);
				bool bold = Appearance.LinkAppearance.Bold;
				if (dXFont.SizeInPoints != fontSize || bold != dXFont.Bold)
				{
					DXFontStyle style = dXFont.Style;
					style = ((!bold) ? (style & ~DXFontStyle.Bold) : (style | DXFontStyle.Bold));
					fontController.DefaultDXFont = new DXFont(dXFont.Name, fontSize, style);
				}
				return fontController.DefaultDXFont;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeVisibility() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorder() && !ShouldSerializeMargins() && !ShouldSerializePadding() && !ShouldSerializeHomeText() && !ShouldSerializeForeColor() && !ShouldSerializeHoverForeColor() && !ShouldSerializeInactiveForeColor() && !ShouldSerializeDXFont())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Visibility" => ShouldSerializeVisibility(), 
				"Border" => ShouldSerializeBorder(), 
				"Margins" => ShouldSerializeMargins(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"Padding" => ShouldSerializePadding(), 
				"HomeText" => ShouldSerializeHomeText(), 
				"Font" => false, 
				"DXFont" => ShouldSerializeDXFont(), 
				"ForeColor" => ShouldSerializeForeColor(), 
				"HoverForeColor" => ShouldSerializeHoverForeColor(), 
				"InactiveForeColor" => ShouldSerializeInactiveForeColor(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private BreadcrumbItem CreateItem(DrillDownState state, bool isLast)
		{
			BreadcrumbItem breadcrumbItem;
			if (!itemsCache.ContainsKey(state))
			{
				breadcrumbItem = new BreadcrumbItem(this, state);
				itemsCache.Add(state, breadcrumbItem);
			}
			else
			{
				breadcrumbItem = itemsCache[state];
			}
			breadcrumbItem.IsLast = isLast;
			return breadcrumbItem;
		}

		private void CreateItems(DrillDownState state)
		{
			items.Clear();
			if (state == null)
			{
				items.Add(CreateItem(state, isLast: true));
				return;
			}
			items.Insert(0, CreateItem(state, isLast: true));
			while (!state.IsRoot)
			{
				state = state.Parent;
				items.Insert(0, CreateItem(state, isLast: false));
			}
		}

		internal void ClearItemsCache()
		{
			itemsCache.Clear();
		}

		internal BreadcrumbsViewData CreateViewData(DrillDownState state, ref Rectangle parentBounds)
		{
			CreateItems(state);
			if (items.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = margins.DecreaseRectangle(parentBounds);
			BreadcrumbsViewData breadcrumbsViewData = new BreadcrumbsViewData(this, items, rectangle);
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = margins.DpiScaledThickness;
			int num = breadcrumbsViewData.Size.Height + dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom;
			parentBounds.Y += num;
			parentBounds.Height -= num;
			Rectangle rectangle2 = margins.IncreaseRectangle(new Rectangle(breadcrumbsViewData.Location, breadcrumbsViewData.Size));
			bounds = new GRealRect2D(rectangle2.Left, rectangle2.Top, rectangle2.Width, rectangle2.Height);
			return breadcrumbsViewData;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Breadcrumbs(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs)
			{
				fontController.Assign(breadcrumbs.fontController);
				foreColor = breadcrumbs.foreColor;
				hoverForeColor = breadcrumbs.hoverForeColor;
				inactiveForeColor = breadcrumbs.inactiveForeColor;
				visibility = breadcrumbs.visibility;
				backColor = breadcrumbs.backColor;
				margins.Assign(breadcrumbs.margins);
				border.Assign(breadcrumbs.border);
				padding.Assign(breadcrumbs.padding);
				homeText = breadcrumbs.homeText;
			}
		}

		void IXtraPartlyDeserializable.Deserialize(object rootObject, IXtraPropertyCollection properties)
		{
			SerializationUtils.ConvertFontToDXFont(properties);
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class DrillDownItem
	{
		private readonly DrillDownState state;

		private readonly ReadOnlyDictionary<string, object> parameters;

		public ReadOnlyDictionary<string, object> Parameters => parameters;

		public string BreadcrumbItemText
		{
			get
			{
				return state.GetBreadcrumbItemText(string.Empty);
			}
			set
			{
				state.BreadcrumbItemText = value;
			}
		}

		internal static DrillDownItem[] CollectItems(DrillDownState state, bool shouldClearBreadcrumbItemText)
		{
			List<DrillDownItem> list = new List<DrillDownItem>();
			if (state != null)
			{
				DrillDownState drillDownState = state;
				while (!drillDownState.IsRoot)
				{
					if (shouldClearBreadcrumbItemText)
					{
						drillDownState.BreadcrumbItemText = string.Empty;
					}
					list.Insert(0, new DrillDownItem(drillDownState));
					drillDownState = drillDownState.Parent;
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private DrillDownItem(DrillDownState state)
		{
			this.state = state;
			parameters = new ReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>(state.Parameters);
		}
	}

		private static readonly Size defaultMarkerSize = new Size(20, 16);

		private readonly CustomLegendItemCollection customItems;

		private readonly LegendTitle title;

		private bool textVisible = true;

		private int horizontalIndent = 4;

		private int verticalIndent = 2;

		private double maxHorizontalPercentage = 100.0;

		private double maxVerticalPercentage = 100.0;

		private LegendAlignmentHorizontal alignmentHorizontal = LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside;

		private LegendAlignmentVertical alignmentVertical = LegendAlignmentVertical.Top;

		private LegendDirection direction;

		private bool equallySpacedItems = true;

		private int textOffset = 2;

		private int textOffsetScaled = 2;

		private int markerOffset = 2;

		private int markerOffsetScaled = 2;

		private Size markerSize = defaultMarkerSize;

		private Color backColor;

		private Color textColor;

		private BackCompatibilityFontController fontController;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAntialiasing = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private bool automaticVisibility = true;

		private DefaultBoolean visibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private LegendItemVisibilityMode itemVisibilityMode;

		private int id = -1;

		private bool loading;

		private int visibilityID = -1;

		protected bool ActualAntialiasing => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(enableAntialiasing, defaultValue: false);

		protected override bool AllowEmptyName => false;

		protected virtual bool ActualVisibleCore => textVisible;

		internal bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualVisibility)
				{
					return ActualVisibleCore;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldBeDrawn => ActualVisible;

		internal bool IsOutside
		{
			get
			{
				if (alignmentHorizontal != LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside && alignmentHorizontal != LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside && alignmentVertical != LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside)
				{
					return alignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanShowAutogeneratedItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (ItemVisibilityMode != LegendItemVisibilityMode.AutoGeneratedAndCustom)
				{
					return CustomItems.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMaxPercentagesDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (maxHorizontalPercentage == 100.0)
				{
					return maxVerticalPercentage == 100.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.LegendAppearance Appearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).LegendAppearance;

		internal RectangleIndents ActualPadding
		{
			get
			{
				RectangleIndents rectangleIndents = (RectangleIndents)Padding.Clone();
				rectangleIndents.SetHighDpiScaleProvider(base.Chart);
				RectangleIndents padding = Appearance.Padding;
				if (rectangleIndents.Left == -1)
				{
					rectangleIndents.Left = padding.Left;
				}
				if (rectangleIndents.Top == -1)
				{
					rectangleIndents.Top = padding.Top;
				}
				if (rectangleIndents.Right == -1)
				{
					rectangleIndents.Right = padding.Right;
				}
				if (rectangleIndents.Bottom == -1)
				{
					rectangleIndents.Bottom = padding.Bottom;
				}
				return rectangleIndents;
			}
		}

		internal RectangleFillStyle ActualFillStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (FillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Empty)
				{
					return FillStyle;
				}
				return Appearance.FillStyle;
			}
		}

		internal Color ActualBackColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!backColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return backColor;
				}
				return Appearance.BackColor;
			}
		}

		internal Color ActualTextColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!textColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return textColor;
				}
				return Appearance.TextColor;
			}
		}

		internal GRealRect2D Bounds { get; set; }

		internal bool AutomaticVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart == null || chart.AutoLayout)
				{
					return automaticVisibility;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool? UseCheckBoxesSetByUser { get; set; }

		internal int MarkerOffsetScaled => markerOffsetScaled;

		internal int TextOffsetScaled => textOffsetScaled;

		internal bool RenderTextByRenderer
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualVisible)
				{
					return base.Chart.RenderLegendsTextByRenderer;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ActualVisibility => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(Visibility, AutomaticVisibility);

		protected internal bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

		protected internal virtual ChartElement ActualDockTarget => null;

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return base.Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		bool ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return automaticVisibility;
			}
			set
			{

			}

		GRealRect2D ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Bounds => Bounds;

		VisibilityElementOrientation ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				if (AlignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside || AlignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside)
				{
					if (AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside || AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside)
					{
						return VisibilityElementOrientation.Corner;
					}
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Vertical;
				}
				if (AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside || AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside)
				{
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Horizontal;
				}
				return VisibilityElementOrientation.Inside;
			}
		}

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Id
		{
			get
			{
				return visibilityID;
			}
			set
			{
				visibilityID = value;
			}
		}

			}

		private static void ValidatePercentValue(double val)
		{
			if (val < 0.0 || val > 100.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPercentValue));
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateMarkerSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (value.Width <= 0 || value.Width >= 1000 || value.Height <= 0 || value.Height >= 1000)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLegendMarkerSize));
			}
		}

			: base(name)

			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(DefaultFonts.Tahoma8, this);
			Padding = new RectangleIndents(this, -1);
			Margins = new RectangleIndents(this, 5);
			FillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this);
			BackImage = new BackgroundImage(this);
			Border = new OutsideRectangularBorder(this, visible: true, Color.Empty);
			Shadow = new Shadow(this);
			customItems = new CustomLegendItemCollection(this);
			title = new LegendTitle(this);
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializePadding() && !ShouldSerializeMargins() && !ShouldSerializeFillStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBackImage() && !ShouldSerializeBorder() && !ShouldSerializeShadow() && !ShouldSerializeVisibility() && !ShouldSerializeTextVisible() && !ShouldSerializeHorizontalIndent() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalIndent() && !ShouldSerializeMaxHorizontalPercentage() && !ShouldSerializeMaxVerticalPercentage() && !ShouldSerializeAlignmentHorizontal() && !ShouldSerializeAlignmentVertical() && !ShouldSerializeDirection() && !ShouldSerializeEquallySpacedItems() && !ShouldSerializeTextOffset() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerOffset() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerSize() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeTextColor() && !ShouldSerializeDXFont() && !ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing() && !ShouldSerializeCustomItems() && !ShouldSerializeItemVisibilityMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTitle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		{

				"BackImage" => ShouldSerializeBackImage(),

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !IsDisposed)
			{
				IsDisposed = true;
				BackImage.Dispose();
				customItems.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				IsDisposed = true;
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0141: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0146: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is LegendBase legendBase)
			{
				Padding.Assign(legendBase.Padding);
				Margins.Assign(legendBase.Margins);
				FillStyle.Assign(legendBase.FillStyle);
				BackImage.Assign(legendBase.BackImage);
				Border.Assign(legendBase.Border);
				Shadow.Assign(legendBase.Shadow);
				visibility = legendBase.visibility;
				textVisible = legendBase.textVisible;
				horizontalIndent = legendBase.horizontalIndent;
				verticalIndent = legendBase.verticalIndent;
				maxHorizontalPercentage = legendBase.maxHorizontalPercentage;
				maxVerticalPercentage = legendBase.maxVerticalPercentage;
				alignmentHorizontal = legendBase.alignmentHorizontal;
				alignmentVertical = legendBase.alignmentVertical;
				direction = legendBase.direction;
				equallySpacedItems = legendBase.equallySpacedItems;
				textOffset = legendBase.textOffset;
				markerOffset = legendBase.markerOffset;
				markerSize = legendBase.markerSize;
				backColor = legendBase.backColor;
				textColor = legendBase.TextColor;
				fontController.Assign(legendBase.fontController);
				enableAntialiasing = legendBase.enableAntialiasing;
				customItems.Assign(legendBase.customItems);
				itemVisibilityMode = legendBase.itemVisibilityMode;
				title.Assign(legendBase.title);
				id = legendBase.id;
			}
		}

		{

			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LayoutDefinition.Weight")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LayoutDefinition.Weight")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Weight
		{
			get
			{
				return weight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != weight)
				{
					if (value <= 0.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPaneWeight));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					weight = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LayoutDefinition.SizeInPixels")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LayoutDefinition.SizeInPixels")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int SizeInPixels
		{
			get
			{
				return sizeInPixels;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidPaneSizeInPixels));
				}
				if (sizeInPixels != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					sizeInPixels = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		bool ILinearLayoutItem.Fixed => Fixed;

		double ILinearLayoutItem.Weight => Weight;

		int ILinearLayoutItem.SizeInPixels => SizeInPixelsScaled;

		internal LayoutDefinition(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
			: base(pane)
		{
		}

		public LayoutDefinition()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeWeight()
		{
			if (sizeMode == PaneSizeMode.UseWeight)
			{
				return weight != 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetWeight()
		{
			Weight = 1.0;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeSizeMode()
		{
			return sizeMode != PaneSizeMode.UseWeight;
		}

		internal void ResetSizeMode()
		{
			SizeMode = PaneSizeMode.UseWeight;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeSizeInPixels()
		{
			return sizeMode == PaneSizeMode.UseSizeInPixels;
		}

		internal void ResetSizeInPixels()
		{
			SizeInPixels = 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeWeight() && !ShouldSerializeSizeMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSizeInPixels();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"SizeMode" => ShouldSerializeSizeMode(), 
				"Weight" => ShouldSerializeWeight(), 
				"SizeInPixels" => ShouldSerializeSizeInPixels(), 
				_ => base.ShouldSerialize(), 
			};
		}

		private bool? IsVerticalLayout()
		{
			if (base.Owner is XYDiagramPaneBase)
			{
				GridPaneLayout gridPaneLayout = (base.Owner as XYDiagramPaneBase).Diagram?.PaneLayout;
				return gridPaneLayout.Direction == PaneLayoutDirection.Vertical;
			}
			if (base.Owner is GridPaneLayout)
			{
				return (base.Owner as GridPaneLayout).RowDefinitions.Contains(this);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int Scale(int value)
		{
			bool? flag = IsVerticalLayout();
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
			if (chart != null && flag.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag.Value)
				{
					return chart.ScaleY(value);
				}
				return chart.ScaleX(value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private int UnScale(int value)
		{
			bool? flag = IsVerticalLayout();
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
			if (chart != null && flag.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag.Value)
				{
					return chart.UnScaleY(value);
				}
				return chart.UnScaleX(value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new LayoutDefinition();
		}

		internal void SetSizeInPixelsScaled(int size)
		{
			if (size >= 0)
			{
				sizeInPixels = UnScale(size);
			}
		}

		internal void SetWeight(double weight)
		{
			this.weight = weight;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is LayoutDefinition layoutDefinition)
			{
				weight = layoutDefinition.weight;
				sizeMode = layoutDefinition.sizeMode;
				sizeInPixels = layoutDefinition.sizeInPixels;
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public class GridLayoutOptions : ChartElement
	{
		private const int DefaultRowAndColumn = -1;

		private const int DefaultSpan = 1;

		private int row = -1;

		private int column = -1;

		private int rowSpan = 1;

		private int columnSpan = 1;

		internal bool IsDefaultRowSpan => rowSpan == 1;

		internal bool IsDefaultColumnSpan => columnSpan == 1;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.Row")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.Row")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Row
		{
			get
			{
				return row;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != row)
				{
					if (value < -1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPaneGridLayoutRow));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					row = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.Column")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.Column")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return column;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != column)
				{
					if (value < -1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPaneGridLayoutColumn));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					column = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.RowSpan")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.RowSpan")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int RowSpan
		{
			get
			{
				return rowSpan;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != rowSpan)
				{
					if (value <= 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPaneGridLayoutRowSpan));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					rowSpan = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.ColumnSpan")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GridLayoutOptions.ColumnSpan")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int ColumnSpan
		{
			get
			{
				return columnSpan;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != columnSpan)
				{
					if (value <= 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPaneGridLayoutColumnSpan));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					columnSpan = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal GridLayoutOptions(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
			: base(pane)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRow()
		{
			return row != -1;
		}

		private void ResetRow()
		{
			row = -1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColumn()
		{
			return column != -1;
		}

		private void ResetColumn()
		{
			column = -1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRowSpan()
		{
			return !IsDefaultRowSpan;
		}

		private void ResetRowSpan()
		{
			rowSpan = 1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColumnSpan()
		{
			return !IsDefaultColumnSpan;
		}

		private void ResetColumnSpan()
		{
			columnSpan = 1;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeRow() && !ShouldSerializeColumn() && !ShouldSerializeRowSpan())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeColumnSpan();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Row" => ShouldSerializeRow(), 
				"Column" => ShouldSerializeColumn(), 
				"RowSpan" => ShouldSerializeRowSpan(), 
				"ColumnSpan" => ShouldSerializeColumnSpan(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new GridLayoutOptions(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is GridLayoutOptions gridLayoutOptions)
			{
				row = gridLayoutOptions.row;
				column = gridLayoutOptions.column;
				rowSpan = gridLayoutOptions.rowSpan;
				columnSpan = gridLayoutOptions.columnSpan;
			}
		}

		public void SetValues(int row, int column, int rowSpan = 1, int columnSpan = 1)
		{
			Row = row;
			Column = column;
			RowSpan = rowSpan;
			ColumnSpan = columnSpan;
		}
	}
