		private static void RenderChartAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, WholeChartAppearance chartAppearance)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(chartRect, chartAppearance.BackColor);
		}

		private static void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, WholeChartAppearance chartAppearance)
		{
			renderer.DrawRectangle(chartRect, chartAppearance.BorderColor, 1f);
		}

		private static void RenderXYDiagramAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramAppearance diagramAppearance)
		{
			RectangleFillStyle rectangleFillStyle = (RectangleFillStyle)diagramAppearance.FillStyle;
			rectangleFillStyle.Render(renderer, diagramRect, diagramAppearance.BackColor, Color.Empty);
		}

		private static void RenderRadarDiagramAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			float num = radarDiagramCenter.Y - 7f;
			renderer.FillCircle(radarDiagramCenter, num, appearance.BackColor);
			Color axisColor = appearance.AxisColor;
			float num2 = 0.7f * num;
			float num3 = radarDiagramCenter.X - num2;
			float num4 = radarDiagramCenter.X + num2;
			float num5 = radarDiagramCenter.Y - num2;
			float num6 = radarDiagramCenter.Y + num2;
			PointF p = new PointF(radarDiagramCenter.X, radarDiagramCenter.Y - num);
			PointF p2 = new PointF(radarDiagramCenter.X, radarDiagramCenter.Y + num);
			PointF p3 = new PointF(radarDiagramCenter.X - num, radarDiagramCenter.Y);
			PointF p4 = new PointF(radarDiagramCenter.X + num, radarDiagramCenter.Y);
			renderer.DrawLine(new PointF(num3, num5), new PointF(num4, num6), axisColor, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine(new PointF(num4, num5), new PointF(num3, num6), axisColor, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine(p, p2, axisColor, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine(p3, p4, axisColor, 1);
			renderer.DrawCircle(radarDiagramCenter, num, axisColor, 1);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagram3DAppearance diagramAppearance, StripAppearance stripAppearance)
		{
			Color interlacedColor = diagramAppearance.InterlacedColor;
			RectangleFillStyle fillStyle = stripAppearance.FillStyle;
			diagramAppearance.FillStyle.Options.RenderRectangle(renderer, diagram3DRect, diagram3DRect, diagramAppearance.BackColor, Color.Empty);
			RectangleF[] array = xyDiagram3DStrips;
			foreach (RectangleF rect in array)
			{
				fillStyle.RenderRectangle(renderer, rect, interlacedColor);
			}
		}

		private static void RenderBars(RectangleF[] rects, ChartRenderer renderer, BarSeriesViewAppearance barAppearance, PaletteEntry[] entries, int seriesCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (RectangleF rect in rects)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = entries[num];
				barAppearance.FillStyle.Render(renderer, rect, paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2);
				num++;
				if (num >= seriesCount || num >= entries.Length)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
			}
			Color borderColor = barAppearance.BorderColor;
			if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				foreach (RectangleF bounds in rects)
				{
					renderer.DrawRectangle(bounds, borderColor, 1f);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RenderBarAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, BarSeriesViewAppearance barAppearance, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = viewType switch
			{
				ViewType.StackedBar => stackedRects, 
				ViewType.FullStackedBar => fullStackedRects, 
				ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar => sideBySideStackedRects, 
				ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar => sideBySideFullStackedRects, 
				ViewType.SideBySideRangeBar => sideBySideRangeRects, 
				ViewType.RangeBar => stackedRangeRects, 
				ViewType.SideBySideGantt => sideBySideGanttRects, 
				ViewType.Gantt => ganttRects, 
				_ => sideBySideRects, 
			};
			RenderBars(array, renderer, barAppearance, entries, array.Length / 2);
		}

		private static void RenderWaterfallAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, WaterfallSeriesViewAppearance barAppearance, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			RenderBars(waterfallRects, renderer, barAppearance, entries, waterfallRects.Length / 2);
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				for (int i = 0; i < waterfallConnectors.Length; i += 2)
				{
					renderer.DrawLines(new Point[2]
					{
						waterfallConnectors[i],
						waterfallConnectors[i + 1]
					}, barAppearance.ConnectorColor, 1, null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private static void RenderBoxPlotAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, BarSeriesViewAppearance barAppearance, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			RenderBars(boxPlotRects, renderer, barAppearance, entries, boxPlotRects.Length);
			bool isEmpty = barAppearance.BorderColor.IsEmpty;
			int num = boxPlotLines.Length / 2;
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				while (num2 < boxPlotLines.Length)
				{
					renderer.DrawLines(new Point[2]
					{
						boxPlotLines[num2],
						boxPlotLines[num2 + 1]
					}, isEmpty ? entries[num3].Color : barAppearance.BorderColor, 1, null);
					num2 += 2;
					num3 += ((num2 % num == 0) ? 1 : 0);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private static void RenderPointAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PaletteEntry[] entries, Point[] points, Size[] sizes, DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.MarkerAppearance appearance)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(points[i], Size.Empty);
				bounds.Inflate((sizes == null || sizes.Length < i + 1) ? new Size(3, 3) : sizes[i]);
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = entries[num];
				MarkerBase.Render(renderer, MarkerKind.Circle, 0, bounds, appearance.FillStyle, paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2, appearance.BorderColor, 1);
				if (++num >= 3)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RenderPointAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, PaletteEntry[] entries, Point[] points, Size[] sizes)
		{
			RenderPointAppearance(renderer, entries, points, sizes, appearance.MarkerAppearance);
		}

		private static void RenderLineAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, Point[] points, bool isStepLine, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			PointF[] array;
			PointF[] array2;
			if (isStepLine)
			{
				array = new PointF[5]
				{
					points[0],
					new Point(points[1].X, points[0].Y),
					points[1],
					new Point(points[2].X, points[1].Y),
					points[2]
				};
				array2 = new PointF[5]
				{
					points[3],
					new Point(points[4].X, points[3].Y),
					points[4],
					new Point(points[5].X, points[4].Y),
					points[5]
				};
			}
			else
			{
				array = new PointF[3]
				{
					points[0],
					points[1],
					points[2]
				};
				array2 = new PointF[3]
				{
					points[3],
					points[4],
					points[5]
				};
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].X -= 0.5f;
				array[i].Y -= 0.5f;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
			{
				array2[j].X -= 0.5f;
				array2[j].Y -= 0.5f;
			}
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawLines(array, entries[0].Color, 2, null);
				renderer.DrawLines(array2, entries[1].Color, 2, null);
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, entries, points, new Size[0]);
		}

		private static void RenderRadarLineAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, PaletteEntry[] entries, Point[] points)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[points.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				Point point = points[i];
				array[i] = new PointF((float)point.X - 0.5f, (float)point.Y - 0.5f);
			}
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawLines(array, entries[0].Color, 2, null);
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, entries, points, new Size[0]);
		}

		}

		private static void RenderRadarScatterLineAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, PaletteEntry[] entries)

		private static void RenderScatterLineAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			Point[] array = new Point[4]
			{
				points[3],
				points[2],
				points[0],
				points[5]
			};
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawLines(array, entries[0].Color, 2, null);
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, entries, array, new Size[0]);
		}

		private static void RenderSplineAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = new BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			bezierStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[0].X, points[0].Y));
			bezierStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[4].X, points[4].Y));
			bezierStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[2].X, points[2].Y));
			BezierStrip bezierStrip2 = new BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			bezierStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[3].X, points[3].Y));
			bezierStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[1].X, points[1].Y));
			bezierStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[5].X, points[5].Y));
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawBezier(bezierStrip, entries[0].Color, 2f);
				renderer.DrawBezier(bezierStrip2, entries[1].Color, 2f);
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, entries, points, new Size[0]);
		}

		private static RectangleF GetBounds(GRealPoint2D[] polygon)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddPolygon(StripsUtils.Convert(polygon));
			return dXGraphicsPath.GetBounds();
		}

		private static void RenderAreaAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, AreaSeriesViewAppearance areaAppearance, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			GRealPoint2D[] array;
			GRealPoint2D[] array2;
			switch (viewType)
			{
			case ViewType.StackedArea:
				array = stackedAreaPolygon1;
				array2 = stackedAreaPolygon2;
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedArea:
				array = fullStackedAreaPolygon1;
				array2 = fullStackedAreaPolygon2;
				break;
			case ViewType.StepArea:
				array = stepAreaPolygon1;
				array2 = stepAreaPolygon2;
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedStepArea:
				array = stackedStepAreaPolygon1;
				array2 = stackedStepAreaPolygon2;
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedStepArea:
				array = fullStackedStepAreaPolygon1;
				array2 = fullStackedStepAreaPolygon2;
				break;
			case ViewType.RangeArea:
				array = rangeAreaPolygon1;
				array2 = rangeAreaPolygon2;
				break;
			default:
				array = areaPolygon1;
				array2 = areaPolygon2;
				break;
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(array.Length - 2);
			for (int i = 1; i < array.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(array[i]);
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip2 = new LineStrip(array2.Length - 2);
			for (int j = 1; j < array2.Length - 1; j++)
			{
				lineStrip2.Add(array2[j]);
			}
			FillOptionsBase options = areaAppearance.FillStyle.Options;
			Color borderColor = areaAppearance.BorderColor;
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			options.Render(renderer, new LineStrip(array), GetBounds(array), entries[1].Color, entries[1].Color2);
			if (viewType != ViewType.FullStackedArea)
			{
				renderer.DrawLines(lineStrip, borderColor, 1, null, LineCap.Flat);
			}
			options.Render(renderer, new LineStrip(array2), GetBounds(array2), entries[0].Color, entries[0].Color2);
			if (viewType != ViewType.FullStackedArea)
			{
				renderer.DrawLines(lineStrip2, borderColor, 1, null, LineCap.Flat);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderRadarAreaAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, IChartAppearance appearance, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			GRealPoint2D[] array = ((viewType != ViewType.RadarRangeArea) ? radarAreaPolygon : radarRangeAreaPolygon);
			PolygonFillStyle fillStyle = appearance.AreaSeriesViewAppearance.FillStyle;
			Color borderColor = appearance.AreaSeriesViewAppearance.BorderColor;
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(array);
			fillStyle.Options.Render(renderer, lineStrip, GetBounds(array), entries[0].Color, entries[0].Color2);
			renderer.DrawLines(lineStrip, borderColor, 1, null, LineCap.Flat);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			Point[] array2 = new Point[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = new Point((int)Math.Round(array[i].X), (int)Math.Round(array[i].Y));
			}
			RenderPointAppearance(renderer, entries, array2, new Size[0], appearance.MarkerAppearance);
		}

		private static void RenderSplineAreaAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, AreaSeriesViewAppearance areaAppearance, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = new BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip2 = new BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			switch (viewType)
			{
			case ViewType.StackedSplineArea:
				bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip.AddRange(splineStackedAreaPoints1);
				bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip.AddRange(splineStackedAreaZeroPoints1);
				bezierRangeStrip2.TopStrip.AddRange(splineStackedAreaPoints2);
				bezierRangeStrip2.BottomStrip.AddRange(splineStackedAreaZeroPoints2);
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedSplineArea:
				bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip.AddRange(splineFullStackedAreaPoints1);
				bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip.AddRange(splineFullStackedAreaZeroPoints1);
				bezierRangeStrip2.TopStrip.AddRange(splineFullStackedAreaPoints2);
				bezierRangeStrip2.BottomStrip.AddRange(splineFullStackedAreaZeroPoints2);
				break;
			default:
				bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip.AddRange(splinePoints1);
				bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip.AddRange(splineZeroPoints1);
				bezierRangeStrip2.TopStrip.AddRange(splinePoints2);
				bezierRangeStrip2.BottomStrip.AddRange(splineZeroPoints2);
				break;
			}
			FillOptionsBase options = areaAppearance.FillStyle.Options;
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			BezierRangeStrip[] array = new BezierRangeStrip[2] { bezierRangeStrip, bezierRangeStrip2 };
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].CompleteFilling(null, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
				options.Render(renderer, array[i], entries[i].Color, entries[i].Color2);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderFinancialAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, ViewType viewType)
		{
			Line[] array;
			Line[] array2;
			if (viewType == ViewType.Stock)
			{
				array = stockRedLines;
				array2 = stockBlackLines;
			}
			else
			{
				array = candleStickRedLines;
				array2 = candleStickBlackLines;
			}
			Line[] array3 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array3.Length; i++)
			{
				Line line = array3[i];
				renderer.DrawLine(line.P1, line.P2, Color.Red, 1);
			}
			Line[] array4 = array2;
			for (int j = 0; j < array4.Length; j++)
			{
				Line line2 = array4[j];
				renderer.DrawLine(line2.P1, line2.P2, Color.Black, 1);
			}
		}

		internal static Color GetHighlightColor(Color color, float luminance)
		{
			ColorHSL colorHSL = (ColorHSL)color;
			colorHSL.Luminance = Math.Min(colorHSL.Luminance * luminance, 1f);
			return (Color)colorHSL;
		}

		private static DXBrush GetGradientBrush(Rectangle imageRect, Color color, float luminance)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(imageRect.X - 1, imageRect.Y, imageRect.Width + 2, imageRect.Height);
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend();
			dXColorBlend.Colors = new Color[3]
			{
				GetHighlightColor(color, luminance),
				color,
				GetHighlightColor(color, luminance)
			};
			dXColorBlend.Positions = new float[3] { 0f, 0.5f, 1f };
			return new DXLinearGradientBrush(rectangle, Color.White, Color.White, DXLinearGradientMode.Horizontal)
			{
				InterpolationColors = dXColorBlend
			};
		}

		private static DXBrush GetConeGradientBrush(Rectangle imageRect, Color color)
		{
			return GetGradientBrush(imageRect, color, 1.3f);
		}

		private static DXBrush GetCylinderGradientBrush(Rectangle imageRect, Color color)
		{
			return GetGradientBrush(imageRect, color, 1.2f);
		}

		private static void RenderBar3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, Bar3DSeriesViewAppearance barAppearance, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			int val = 3;
			RectangleF[] array;
			switch (viewType)
			{
			case ViewType.Bar3D:
				array = sideBySideBar3DRects;
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedBar3D:
				array = stackedBar3DRects;
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedBar3D:
				array = fullStackedBar3DRects;
				break;
			case ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar3D:
				array = sideBySideStackedBar3DRects;
				val = 4;
				break;
			case ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar3D:
				array = sideBySideFullStackedBar3DRects;
				val = 4;
				break;
			default:
				array = manhattanBarRects;
				break;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = entries[i % Math.Min(val, entries.Length)];
				RectangleF rectangleF = array[i];
				barAppearance.FillStyle.Options.RenderRectangle(renderer, rectangleF, rectangleF, paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2);
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X, rectangleF.Location.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + rectangleF.Width, rectangleF.Location.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + rectangleF.Width + 3f, rectangleF.Location.Y - 3f));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + 3f, rectangleF.Location.Y - 3f));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, GetHighlightColor(paletteEntry.Color, 1.2f));
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + rectangleF.Width, rectangleF.Location.Y + rectangleF.Height));
				lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + rectangleF.Width, rectangleF.Location.Y));
				lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + rectangleF.Width + 3f, rectangleF.Location.Y - 3f));
				lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Location.X + rectangleF.Width + 3f, rectangleF.Location.Y + rectangleF.Height - 3f));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip2, GetHighlightColor(paletteEntry.Color, 0.7f));
			}
		}

		private static void RenderBar3DCylinderAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			int val = 3;
			int num = 3;
			bool flag = false;
			Rectangle[] array;
			Rectangle[] array2;
			Rectangle[] array3;
			switch (viewType)
			{
			case ViewType.Bar3D:
				array = sideBySideCylinderRects;
				array2 = sideBySideCylinderEllipseRects;
				array3 = sideBySideCylinderTopEllipseRects;
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedBar3D:
				array = stackedCylinderRects;
				array2 = stackedCylinderEllipseRects;
				array3 = stackedCylinderTopEllipseRects;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedBar3D:
				array = fullStackedCylinderRects;
				array2 = fullStackedCylinderEllipseRects;
				array3 = fullStackedCylinderTopEllipseRects;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar3D:
				array = sideBySideStackedCylinderRects;
				array2 = sideBySideStackedCylinderEllipseRects;
				array3 = sideBySideStackedCylinderTopEllipseRects;
				val = 4;
				num = 2;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar3D:
				array = sideBySideFullStackedCylinderRects;
				array2 = sideBySideFullStackedCylinderEllipseRects;
				array3 = sideBySideFullStackedCylinderTopEllipseRects;
				val = 4;
				num = 2;
				flag = true;
				break;
			default:
				array = manhattanCylinderRects;
				array2 = manhattanCylinderEllipseRects;
				array3 = manhattanCylinderTopEllipseRects;
				break;
			}
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					PaletteEntry paletteEntry = entries[i % Math.Min(val, entries.Length)];
					using DXBrush brush = GetCylinderGradientBrush(array[i], paletteEntry.Color);
					renderer.FillEllipse(array2[i], brush);
					renderer.FillRectangle(array[i], brush);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array3.Length; j++)
				{
					int num2 = (flag ? ((j + 1) * num - 1) : j);
					num2 %= Math.Min(val, entries.Length);
					PaletteEntry paletteEntry2 = entries[num2];
					using DXBrush brush2 = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(paletteEntry2.Color, 1.2f));
					renderer.FillEllipse(array3[j], brush2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			}
		}

		private static void RenderBar3DPyramidAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			int val = 3;
			Rectangle[] array;
			PlaneTriangle[] array2;
			switch (viewType)
			{
			case ViewType.Bar3D:
				array = sideBySidePyramidRects;
				array2 = sideBySidePyramidRightTriangles;
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedBar3D:
				array = stackedPyramidRects;
				array2 = stackedPyramidRightTriangles;
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedBar3D:
				array = fullStackedPyramidRects;
				array2 = fullStackedPyramidRightTriangles;
				break;
			case ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar3D:
				array = sideBySideStackedPyramidRects;
				array2 = sideBySideStackedPyramidRightTriangles;
				val = 4;
				break;
			case ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar3D:
				array = sideBySideFullStackedPyramidRects;
				array2 = sideBySideFullStackedPyramidRightTriangles;
				val = 4;
				break;
			default:
				array = manhattanPyramidRects;
				array2 = manhattanPyramidRightTriangles;
				break;
			}
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					PaletteEntry paletteEntry = entries[i % Math.Min(val, entries.Length)];
					using (DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(paletteEntry.Color))
					{
						GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(array[i].Left, array[i].Top + array[i].Height);
						GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(array[i].Left + array[i].Width, array[i].Top + array[i].Height);
						GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D(array[i].Left + array[i].Width / 2, array[i].Top);
						LineStrip strip = new LineStrip(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D3 });
						renderer.FillPolygon(strip, brush);
					}
					using DXBrush brush2 = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(paletteEntry.Color, 0.7f));
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = new GRealPoint2D((int)array2[i].Vertices[0].X, (int)array2[i].Vertices[0].Y);
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D5 = new GRealPoint2D((int)array2[i].Vertices[1].X, (int)array2[i].Vertices[1].Y);
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D6 = new GRealPoint2D((int)array2[i].Vertices[2].X, (int)array2[i].Vertices[2].Y);
					LineStrip strip2 = new LineStrip(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D4, gRealPoint2D5, gRealPoint2D6 });
					renderer.FillPolygon(strip2, brush2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private static void RenderBar3DConeAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, ViewType viewType, PaletteEntry[] entries)

		private static void RenderLine3DRightPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i + 1]);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i + 1].X + 2.0, vertices[i + 1].Y + 2.0));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i + 1].X + 5.0 + 2.0, vertices[i + 1].Y + 2.0 - 5.0));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i + 1].X + 5.0, vertices[i + 1].Y - 5.0));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, color);
			}
		}

		private static void RenderLine3DBottomPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i]);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i + 1]);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i + 1].X + 2.0, vertices[i + 1].Y + 2.0));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i].X + 2.0, vertices[i].Y + 2.0));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, color);
			}
		}

		private static void RenderLine3DTopPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			Color highlightColor = GetHighlightColor(color, 0.8f);
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i]);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i + 1]);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i + 1].X + 5.0, vertices[i + 1].Y - 5.0));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i].X + 5.0, vertices[i].Y - 5.0));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, (vertices[i].Y > vertices[i + 1].Y) ? highlightColor : color);
			}
		}

		private static void RenderLine3D(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			RenderLine3DRightPolygon(renderer, vertices, color);
			RenderLine3DBottomPolygon(renderer, vertices, color);
			RenderLine3DTopPolygon(renderer, vertices, color);
		}

		private static void RenderLine3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PaletteEntry[] entries, GRealPoint2D[] firstLine3D, GRealPoint2D[] secondLine3D)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			RenderLine3D(renderer, firstLine3D, entries[0].Color);
			RenderLine3D(renderer, secondLine3D, entries[1].Color);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderSpline3DPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, int deltaX, int deltaY)
		{
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = new BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D top = vertices[i];
				bezierRangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(top, new GRealPoint2D(top.X + (double)deltaX, top.Y + (double)deltaY)));
			}
			renderer.FillBezier(bezierRangeStrip, color);
		}

		private static void RenderSpline3DTopPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			RenderSpline3DPolygon(renderer, vertices, color, 5, -5);
		}

		private static void RenderSpline3DBottomPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			RenderSpline3DPolygon(renderer, vertices, color, 2, 2);
		}

		private static void RenderSpline3D(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			RenderLine3DRightPolygon(renderer, vertices, color);
			RenderSpline3DBottomPolygon(renderer, vertices, color);
			RenderSpline3DTopPolygon(renderer, vertices, color);
		}

		private static void RenderSpline3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			RenderSpline3D(renderer, firstLine3D, entries[0].Color);
			RenderSpline3D(renderer, secondLine3D, entries[1].Color);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderStepLine3D(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color)
		{
			Color highlightColor = GetHighlightColor(color, 0.7f);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			int num = vertices.Length - 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i]);
				lineStrip.Add(vertices[i + 1]);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i + 1].X + 5.0, vertices[i + 1].Y - 5.0));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(vertices[i].X + 5.0, vertices[i].Y - 5.0));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, (lineStrip[0].X == lineStrip[1].X) ? highlightColor : color);
			}
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderStepLine3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			RenderStepLine3D(renderer, firstStepLine3D, entries[0].Color);
			RenderStepLine3D(renderer, secondStepLine3D, entries[1].Color);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D Sum(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(p1.X + p2.X, p1.Y + p2.Y);
		}

		private static void RenderArea3DTopPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint)
		{
			Color highlightColor = GetHighlightColor(color, 1.1f);
			Color highlightColor2 = GetHighlightColor(color, 0.9f);
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(Sum(vertices[i], startPoint));
				lineStrip.Add(Sum(vertices[i + 1], startPoint));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(lineStrip[1].X + 5.0, lineStrip[1].Y - 5.0));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(lineStrip[0].X + 5.0, lineStrip[0].Y - 5.0));
				renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, (vertices[i].Y > vertices[i + 1].Y) ? highlightColor : highlightColor2);
			}
		}

		private static void RenderArea3DBottomPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(vertices.Length);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D p in vertices)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(Sum(p, startPoint));
			}
			renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, color);
		}

		private static void RenderArea3D(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint)
		{
			RenderArea3D(renderer, vertices, color, startPoint, 3);
		}

		private static void RenderArea3D(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint, int topAreaVertexCount)
		{
			GRealPoint2D[] array = new GRealPoint2D[topAreaVertexCount];
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 1;
			while (num < topAreaVertexCount)
			{
				array[num] = vertices[num2];
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			RenderArea3DTopPolygon(renderer, array, color, startPoint);
			GRealPoint2D[] array2 = new GRealPoint2D[2];
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = topAreaVertexCount;
			while (num3 < 2)
			{
				array2[num3] = vertices[num4];
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
			RenderArea3DTopPolygon(renderer, array2, color, startPoint);
			RenderArea3DBottomPolygon(renderer, vertices, GetHighlightColor(color, 1.1f), startPoint);
		}

		private static void RenderArea3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			RenderArea3D(startPoint: new GRealPoint2D(1.0, -6.0), renderer: renderer, vertices: firstArea3DPolygon, color: entries[0].Color);
			RenderArea3D(renderer, secondArea3DPolygon, entries[1].Color, new GRealPoint2D(-5.0, 0.0));
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderSplineArea3DTopPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint)
		{
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = new BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D p in vertices)
			{
				GRealPoint2D top = Sum(p, startPoint);
				bezierRangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(top, new GRealPoint2D(top.X + 5.0, top.Y - 5.0)));
			}
			renderer.FillBezier(bezierRangeStrip, color);
		}

		private static void RenderSplineArea3DBottomPolygon(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint)
		{
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = new BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[3]
			{
				Sum(vertices[1], startPoint),
				Sum(vertices[2], startPoint),
				Sum(vertices[3], startPoint)
			});
			bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[3]
			{
				Sum(vertices[0], startPoint),
				Sum(vertices[5], startPoint),
				Sum(vertices[4], startPoint)
			});
			renderer.FillBezier(bezierRangeStrip, color);
		}

		private static void RenderSplineArea3D(ChartRenderer renderer, GRealPoint2D[] vertices, Color color, GRealPoint2D startPoint)
		{
			Color highlightColor = GetHighlightColor(color, 0.9f);
			GRealPoint2D[] array = new GRealPoint2D[3];
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 1;
			while (num < 3)
			{
				array[num] = vertices[num2];
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			RenderSplineArea3DTopPolygon(renderer, array, highlightColor, startPoint);
			GRealPoint2D[] array2 = new GRealPoint2D[2];
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 3;
			while (num3 < 2)
			{
				array2[num3] = vertices[num4];
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
			RenderSplineArea3DTopPolygon(renderer, array2, highlightColor, startPoint);
			RenderSplineArea3DBottomPolygon(renderer, vertices, GetHighlightColor(color, 1.1f), startPoint);
		}

		private static void RenderPieAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PieSeriesViewAppearance pieAppearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			RenderPieAppearance(renderer, pieAppearance, palette, colorIndex, 19f, 0f, pieAngles);
		}

		private static void RenderDoughnutAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PieSeriesViewAppearance pieAppearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			RenderPieAppearance(renderer, pieAppearance, palette, colorIndex, 19f, 0.6f, pieAngles);
		}

		private static void RenderNestedDoughnutAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PieSeriesViewAppearance pieAppearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			RenderPieAppearance(renderer, pieAppearance, palette, colorIndex, 19f, 0.74f, outerDoughnutAngles);
			RenderPieAppearance(renderer, pieAppearance, palette, colorIndex, 12f, 0.55f, innerDoughnutAngles);
		}

		private static void RenderPieAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PieSeriesViewAppearance pieAppearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, float radius, float holePercent, float[] pieAngles)
		{
			PaletteEntry[] array = new PaletteEntry[pieAngles.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < pieAngles.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = palette.GetEntry(i, pieAngles.Length, colorIndex);
			}
			PointF center = new PointF(40f, 25f);
			RectangleF gradientBounds = new RectangleF(new PointF(center.X, center.Y), SizeF.Empty);
			gradientBounds.Inflate(radius, radius);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			float num = -90f;
			FillOptionsBase options = pieAppearance.FillStyle.Options;
			for (int j = 0; j < pieAngles.Length; j++)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = array[j];
				float num2 = pieAngles[j];
				options.RenderPie(renderer, center, radius, radius, num, num2, 0f, holePercent, gradientBounds, paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2);
				num += num2;
			}
			float innerRadius = radius * holePercent;
			RenderPieInnerBorders(renderer, pieAppearance.BorderColor, center, radius, innerRadius, pieAngles);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderPieInnerBorders(ChartRenderer renderer, Color borderColor, PointF center, float outerRadius, float innerRadius, float[] pieAngles)
		{
			float num = -(float)Math.PI / 2f;
			foreach (float num2 in pieAngles)
			{
				float num3 = (float)Math.Cos(num);
				float num4 = (float)Math.Sin(num);
				PointF p = new PointF(center.X + innerRadius * num3, center.Y + innerRadius * num4);
				PointF p2 = new PointF(center.X + outerRadius * num3, center.Y + outerRadius * num4);
				renderer.DrawLine(p, p2, borderColor, 1);
				num += (float)((double)num2 * Math.PI / 180.0);
			}
			renderer.DrawCircle(center, outerRadius, borderColor, 1);
			if (innerRadius != 0f)
			{
				renderer.DrawCircle(center, innerRadius, borderColor, 1);
			}
		}

		private static void RenderPie3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, Pie3DSeriesViewAppearance pieAppearance, ViewType viewType, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			PaletteEntry[] array = new PaletteEntry[pieAngles.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < pieAngles.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = palette.GetEntry(i, pieAngles.Length, colorIndex);
			}
			Point location = new Point(40, 20);
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(location, Size.Empty);
			rectangle.Inflate(new Size(19, 10));
			int num = rectangle.Top + rectangle.Height / 2;
			try
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPie(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top + 7, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height, 0f, pieAngles[0] - 90f);
				RectangleF bounds = dXGraphicsPath.GetBounds();
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Location.X, bounds.Location.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom));
				using (DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(array[1].Color, 0.7f)))
				{
					renderer.FillPie(new Rectangle(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top + 7, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height), pieAngles[0] - 90f, 270f - pieAngles[0], brush);
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Left, num + 7));
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Left, num));
					renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, brush);
				}
				lineStrip = new LineStrip(5);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Location.X, bounds.Location.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom));
				using (DXBrush brush2 = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(array[0].Color, 0.7f)))
				{
					renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath, brush2);
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Right, num + 7));
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Right, num));
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D((bounds.Left + (float)rectangle.Right) / 2f, bounds.Location.Y));
					renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, brush2);
				}
				if (viewType == ViewType.Doughnut3D)
				{
					PointF pointF = new PointF((float)rectangle.Location.X + (float)rectangle.Width * 0.2f, (float)rectangle.Location.Y + (float)rectangle.Height * 0.2f);
					RectangleF rectangle2 = new RectangleF(size: new SizeF((float)rectangle.Width * 0.6f, (float)rectangle.Height * 0.6f), location: new PointF(pointF.X, pointF.Y + 7f));
					float num2 = pieAngles[0] + pieAngles[1] - 90f;
					for (int j = 2; j <= 3; j++)
					{
						using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath2 = new DXGraphicsPath();
						float num3 = pieAngles[j];
						dXGraphicsPath2.AddArc(rectangle, num2, num3);
						dXGraphicsPath2.AddArc(rectangle2, num2 + num3, 0f - num3);
						using (DXBrush brush3 = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(array[j].Color, 0.7f)))
						{
							renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath2, brush3);
						}
						num2 += num3;
					}
					using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath3 = new DXGraphicsPath();
					float num4 = 90f;
					dXGraphicsPath3.AddArc(rectangle, num2, num4);
					dXGraphicsPath3.AddArc(rectangle2, num2 + num4, 0f - num4);
					using DXBrush brush4 = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(array[0].Color, 0.5f));
					renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath3, brush4);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Default);
			float num5 = -90f;
			float holePercent = ((viewType == ViewType.Doughnut3D) ? 0.6f : 0f);
			for (int k = 0; k < pieAngles.Length; k++)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = array[k];
				float num6 = pieAngles[k];
				pieAppearance.FillStyle.Options.RenderPie(renderer, new PointF(location.X, location.Y), 19f, 10f, num5, num6, 0f, holePercent, rectangle, paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2);
				num5 += num6;
			}
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private static void RenderFunnelAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, FunnelSeriesViewAppearance funnelAppearance, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(15.0, 10.0));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(65.0, 10.0));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(55.0, 20.0));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(25.0, 20.0));
			LineStrip lineStrip2 = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(25.0, 20.0));
			lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(55.0, 20.0));
			lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(45.0, 30.0));
			lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(35.0, 30.0));
			LineStrip lineStrip3 = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip3.Add(new GRealPoint2D(35.0, 30.0));
			lineStrip3.Add(new GRealPoint2D(45.0, 30.0));
			lineStrip3.Add(new GRealPoint2D(45.0, 40.0));
			lineStrip3.Add(new GRealPoint2D(35.0, 40.0));
			VariousPolygon[] array = new VariousPolygon[3]
			{
				new VariousPolygon(lineStrip, new RectangleF(0f, 10f, 80f, 10f)),
				new VariousPolygon(lineStrip2, new RectangleF(0f, 20f, 80f, 10f)),
				new VariousPolygon(lineStrip3, new RectangleF(0f, 30f, 80f, 10f))
			};
			FillOptionsBase options = funnelAppearance.FillStyle.Options;
			int num = 0;
			VariousPolygon[] array2 = array;
			foreach (VariousPolygon variousPolygon in array2)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = entries[num];
				options.Render(renderer, variousPolygon.Vertices, variousPolygon.Rect, paletteEntry.Color, paletteEntry.Color2);
				if (++num >= entries.Length)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
			}
			Color borderColor = funnelAppearance.BorderColor;
			if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				VariousPolygon[] array3 = array;
				foreach (VariousPolygon variousPolygon2 in array3)
				{
					renderer.DrawPolygon(variousPolygon2.Vertices, borderColor, 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RenderFunnel3DAppearance(ChartRenderer renderer, PaletteEntry[] entries)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			try
			{
				using (DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(entries[2].Color))
				{
					renderer.FillEllipse(smallFunnel3DEllipseRect, brush);
					renderer.FillRectangle(smallFunnel3DRect, brush);
				}
				using (DXBrush brush2 = new DXSolidBrush(entries[1].Color))
				{
					renderer.FillEllipse(middleFunnel3DEllipseRect, brush2);
					renderer.FillPolygon(new LineStrip(middleFunnel3DPolygonPoints), brush2);
				}
				using (DXBrush brush3 = new DXSolidBrush(entries[0].Color))
				{
					renderer.FillEllipse(bigFunnel3DEllipseRect, brush3);
					renderer.FillPolygon(new LineStrip(bigFunnel3DPolygonPoints), brush3);
				}
				using DXBrush brush4 = new DXSolidBrush(GetHighlightColor(entries[0].Color, 1.3f));
				renderer.FillEllipse(topFunnel3DEllipseRect, brush4);
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			int num = 4;
			PaletteEntry[] array = new PaletteEntry[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = palette.GetEntry(i, num, colorIndex);
			}
			RenderChartAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).WholeChartAppearance);
			switch (viewType)
			{
			case ViewType.Bar:
			case ViewType.StackedBar:
			case ViewType.FullStackedBar:
			case ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar:
			case ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar:
			case ViewType.SideBySideRangeBar:
			case ViewType.RangeBar:
			case ViewType.SideBySideGantt:
			case ViewType.Gantt:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderBarAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).BarSeriesViewAppearance, viewType, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Waterfall:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderWaterfallAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).WaterfallSeriesViewAppearance, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.BoxPlot:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderBoxPlotAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).BarSeriesViewAppearance, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Point:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, array, points, new Size[0]);
				break;
			case ViewType.Bubble:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, array, points, bubbleSizes);
				break;
			case ViewType.Line:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, points, isStepLine: false, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedLine:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, stackedPoints, isStepLine: false, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedLine:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, fullStackedPoints, isStepLine: false, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.StepLine:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, points, isStepLine: true, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.SwiftPlot:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderSwiftPlotAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.ScatterLine:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderScatterLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Spline:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderSplineAppearance(renderer, appearance, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Area:
			case ViewType.StepArea:
			case ViewType.StackedArea:
			case ViewType.StackedStepArea:
			case ViewType.FullStackedArea:
			case ViewType.FullStackedStepArea:
			case ViewType.RangeArea:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderAreaAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).AreaSeriesViewAppearance, viewType, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.SplineArea:
			case ViewType.StackedSplineArea:
			case ViewType.FullStackedSplineArea:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderSplineAreaAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).AreaSeriesViewAppearance, viewType, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Stock:
			case ViewType.CandleStick:
				RenderXYDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagramAppearance);
				RenderFinancialAppearance(renderer, viewType);
				break;
			case ViewType.PolarPoint:
			case ViewType.RadarPoint:
				RenderRadarDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).RadarDiagramAppearance);
				RenderPointAppearance(renderer, appearance, array, radarPoints, new Size[0]);
				break;
			case ViewType.PolarLine:
			case ViewType.RadarLine:
				RenderRadarDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).RadarDiagramAppearance);
				RenderRadarLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.PolarArea:
			case ViewType.PolarRangeArea:
			case ViewType.RadarArea:
			case ViewType.RadarRangeArea:
				RenderRadarDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).RadarDiagramAppearance);
				RenderRadarAreaAppearance(renderer, appearance, viewType, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Pie:
				RenderPieAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).PieSeriesViewAppearance, palette, colorIndex);
				break;
			case ViewType.Doughnut:
				RenderDoughnutAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).PieSeriesViewAppearance, palette, colorIndex);
				break;
			case ViewType.NestedDoughnut:
				RenderNestedDoughnutAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).PieSeriesViewAppearance, palette, colorIndex);
				break;
			case ViewType.Funnel:
				RenderFunnelAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).FunnelSeriesViewAppearance, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Bar3D:
			case ViewType.StackedBar3D:
			case ViewType.FullStackedBar3D:
			case ViewType.ManhattanBar:
			case ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar3D:
			case ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderBar3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).Bar3DSeriesViewAppearance, viewType, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Line3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderLine3DAppearance(renderer, array, firstLine3D, secondLine3D);
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedLine3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderLine3DAppearance(renderer, array, firstStackedLine3D, secondStackedLine3D);
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedLine3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderLine3DAppearance(renderer, array, firstFullStackedLine3D, secondFullStackedLine3D);
				break;
			case ViewType.StepLine3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderStepLine3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Spline3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderSpline3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Area3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderStackedArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderFullStackedArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.StepArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderStepArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.SplineArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderSplineArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.StackedSplineArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderStackedSplineArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.FullStackedSplineArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderFullStackedSplineArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.RangeArea3D:
				RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
				RenderRangeArea3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.Pie3D:
			case ViewType.Doughnut3D:
				RenderPie3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).Pie3DSeriesViewAppearance, viewType, palette, colorIndex);
				break;
			case ViewType.Funnel3D:
				RenderFunnel3DAppearance(renderer, array);
				break;
			case ViewType.ScatterPolarLine:
			case ViewType.ScatterRadarLine:
				RenderRadarDiagramAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).RadarDiagramAppearance);
				RenderRadarScatterLineAppearance(renderer, appearance, array);
				break;
			}
			RenderBorder(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).WholeChartAppearance);
			renderer.Present();
		}

		private static void Render3D(ChartRenderer renderer, ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, Bar3DModel model)
		{
			int num = 4;
			PaletteEntry[] array = new PaletteEntry[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = palette.GetEntry(i, num, colorIndex);
			}
			RenderChartAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).WholeChartAppearance);
			RenderXYDiagram3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).XYDiagram3DAppearance, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).StripAppearance);
			switch (model)
			{
			case Bar3DModel.Cylinder:
				RenderBar3DCylinderAppearance(renderer, viewType, array);
				break;
			case Bar3DModel.Pyramid:
				RenderBar3DPyramidAppearance(renderer, viewType, array);
				break;
			case Bar3DModel.Cone:
				RenderBar3DConeAppearance(renderer, viewType, array);
				break;
			case Bar3DModel.Box:
				RenderBar3DAppearance(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).Bar3DSeriesViewAppearance, viewType, array);
				break;
			}
			RenderBorder(renderer, ((IChartAppearance)appearance).WholeChartAppearance);
			renderer.Present();
		}

		private static bool Is2DType(ViewType viewType)
		{
			if (viewType != ViewType.Bar3D && viewType != ViewType.StackedBar3D && viewType != ViewType.FullStackedBar3D && viewType != ViewType.SideBySideStackedBar3D && viewType != ViewType.SideBySideFullStackedBar3D)
			{
				return viewType != ViewType.ManhattanBar;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Size GetBitmapSize(SizeF highDpiScaleFactor)
		{
			return new Size((int)(80f * highDpiScaleFactor.Width), (int)(50f * highDpiScaleFactor.Height));
		}

		private static SvgImage CreateSvgImage(Size size, Action<ChartRenderer> renderAction)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			WinUtilsSvgNativeRender winUtilsSvgNativeRender = new WinUtilsSvgNativeRender();
			ChartRenderer obj = new ChartRenderer(winUtilsSvgNativeRender);
			renderAction(obj);
			SvgImage val = SvgImage.Create(SvgRoot.Create((SvgElementProperties)null, new SvgUnit(0.0), new SvgUnit(0.0), new SvgUnit((double)size.Width), new SvgUnit((double)size.Height), new SvgViewBox(0.0, 0.0, 80.0, 50.0)));
			winUtilsSvgNativeRender.DrawToImage(val);
			return val;
		}

		private static SvgImage CreateSvgImage(Size size, ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			return CreateSvgImage(size, delegate(ChartRenderer renderer)
			{
				Render(renderer, viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex);
			});
		}

		private static SvgImage CreateSvgImage(Size size, ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, Bar3DModel model)
		{
			if (Is2DType(viewType))
			{
				return CreateSvgImage(size, viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex);
			}
			return CreateSvgImage(size, delegate(ChartRenderer renderer)
			{
				Render3D(renderer, viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex, model);
			});
		}

		public static Image CreateImage(ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			return CreateImage(viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex, new SizeF(1f, 1f));
		}

		internal static Image CreateImage(ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, SizeF highDpiScaleFactor)
		{
			Size bitmapSize = GetBitmapSize(highDpiScaleFactor);
			SvgImage svgImage = CreateSvgImage(bitmapSize, viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex);
			return new SvgBitmap(svgImage).Render(bitmapSize, null, (DefaultBoolean)2, (DefaultBoolean)2);
		}

		public static Image CreateImage(ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, Bar3DModel model)
		{
			return CreateImage(viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex, model, new SizeF(1f, 1f));
		}

		internal static Image CreateImage(ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, Bar3DModel model, SizeF highDpiScaleFactor)
		{
			Size bitmapSize = GetBitmapSize(highDpiScaleFactor);
			SvgImage svgImage = CreateSvgImage(bitmapSize, viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex, model);
			return new SvgBitmap(svgImage).Render(bitmapSize, null, (DefaultBoolean)2, (DefaultBoolean)2);
		}

		internal static SvgImage CreateSvgImage(ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex)
		{
			return CreateSvgImage(new Size(80, 50), viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex);
		}

		internal static SvgImage CreateSvgImage(ViewType viewType, ChartAppearance appearance, Palette palette, int colorIndex, Bar3DModel model)
		{
			return CreateSvgImage(new Size(80, 50), viewType, appearance, palette, colorIndex, model);
		}
	}
	public enum ControlCoordinatesVisibility
	{
		Visible,
		Hidden,
		Undefined
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class ControlCoordinates
	{
		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		private readonly ControlCoordinatesVisibility visibility;

		private readonly Point point;

		[Description("Gets the point’s pane.")]
		public XYDiagramPaneBase Pane => pane;

		[Description("Gets a value, specifying whether the point’s location can be determined, and if so - whether it is located within the diagram.")]
		public ControlCoordinatesVisibility Visibility => visibility;

		[Description("Gets the point’s coordinates.")]
		public Point Point => point;

		internal ControlCoordinates(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, ControlCoordinatesVisibility visibility, Point point)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.visibility = visibility;
			this.point = point;
		}

		internal ControlCoordinates(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, ControlCoordinatesVisibility visibility)
			: this(pane, visibility, Point.Empty)
		{
		}

		internal ControlCoordinates(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
			: this(pane, ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Undefined)
		{
		}

		internal ControlCoordinates()
			: this(null)
		{
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public sealed class DiagramCoordinates
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<AxisBase, AxisValue> axisValueDictionary = new Dictionary<AxisBase, AxisValue>();

		private AxisBase axisX;

		private AxisBase axisY;

		private XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		private ScaleType argumentScaleType;

		private ScaleType valueScaleType;

		private string qualitativeArgument;

		private double numericalArgument;

		private DateTime dateTimeArgument;

		private TimeSpan timeSpanArgument;

		private double numericalValue;

		private DateTime dateTimeValue;

		private TimeSpan timeSpanValue;

		[Description("Gets the X-axis of the diagram point.")]
		public AxisBase AxisX => axisX;

		[Description("Gets the Y-axis of the diagram point.")]
		public AxisBase AxisY => axisY;

		[Description("Gets the pane of the diagram point.")]
		public XYDiagramPaneBase Pane => pane;

		[Description("Gets the type of the argument scale.")]
		public ScaleType ArgumentScaleType => argumentScaleType;

		[Description("Gets the type of the value scale.")]
		public ScaleType ValueScaleType => valueScaleType;

		[Description("Gets the qualitative argument of the diagram point.")]
		public string QualitativeArgument => qualitativeArgument;

		[Description("Gets the numerical argument of the diagram point.")]
		public double NumericalArgument => numericalArgument;

		[Description("Gets the date-time argument of the diagram point.")]
		public DateTime DateTimeArgument => dateTimeArgument;

		[Description("Gets the diagram point’s time-span argument.")]
		public TimeSpan TimeSpanArgument => timeSpanArgument;

		[Description("Gets the numerical value of the diagram point.")]
		public double NumericalValue => numericalValue;

		[Description("Gets the date-time value of the diagram point.")]
		public DateTime DateTimeValue => dateTimeValue;

		[Description("Gets the diagram point’s time-span value.")]
		public TimeSpan TimeSpanValue => timeSpanValue;

		[Description("Checks whether the current object represents a point outside the diagram area.")]
		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (argumentScaleType == ScaleType.Qualitative)
				{
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(qualitativeArgument);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DiagramCoordinates()
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			qualitativeArgument = string.Empty;
		}

		private void SetQualitativeArgument(string argument, double argumentInternal)
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			qualitativeArgument = argument;
			numericalArgument = argumentInternal;
		}

		private void SetNumericalArgument(double argument)
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			numericalArgument = argument;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeArgument(DateTime argument, double argumentInternal)
		{
			DateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions = axisX.DateTimeScaleOptions;
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			dateTimeArgument = ((dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous) ? argument : DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(argument, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal, DateTimeUtilsExt.FirstDayOfWeek));
			numericalArgument = argumentInternal;
		}

		private void SetTimeSpanArgument(TimeSpan argument, double argumentInternal)
		{
			TimeSpanScaleOptions timeSpanScaleOptions = axisX.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			timeSpanArgument = ((timeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous) ? argument : DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(argument, (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)timeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal));
			numericalArgument = argumentInternal;
		}

		private void SetNumericalValue(double value)
		{
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			numericalValue = value;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeValue(DateTime value, double valueInternal)
		{
			DateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions = axisY.DateTimeScaleOptions;
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			dateTimeValue = ((dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous) ? value : DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(value, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal, DateTimeUtilsExt.FirstDayOfWeek));
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		private void SetTimeSpanValue(TimeSpan value, double valueInternal)
		{
			TimeSpanScaleOptions timeSpanScaleOptions = axisY.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			timeSpanValue = ((timeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous) ? value : DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(value, (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)timeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal));
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		internal void SetAxes(AxisBase axisX, AxisBase axisY)
		{
			this.axisX = axisX;
			this.axisY = axisY;
		}

		internal void SetPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
		}

		internal void SetArgumentAndValue(double argumentInternal, double valueInternal)
		{
			IScaleMap map;
			IScaleMap map2;
			if (RangeHelper.RangeCalculationSwitch && axisY != null && axisX != null)
			{
				map = ((IAxisData)axisY).AxisScaleTypeMap;
				map2 = ((IAxisData)axisX).AxisScaleTypeMap;
			}
			else
			{
				map = axisY.ScaleTypeMap;
				map2 = axisX.ScaleTypeMap;
			}
			object scaleMapNativeValue = AxisUtils.GetScaleMapNativeValue(map, valueInternal);
			object scaleMapNativeValue2 = AxisUtils.GetScaleMapNativeValue(map2, argumentInternal);
			switch (axisX.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
				SetQualitativeArgument((string)scaleMapNativeValue2, argumentInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				SetDateTimeArgument((DateTime)scaleMapNativeValue2, argumentInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				SetTimeSpanArgument((TimeSpan)scaleMapNativeValue2, argumentInternal);
				break;
			default:
				SetNumericalArgument((double)scaleMapNativeValue2);
				break;
			}
			switch (axisY.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				SetDateTimeValue((DateTime)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				SetTimeSpanValue((TimeSpan)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			default:
				SetNumericalValue((double)scaleMapNativeValue);
				break;
			}
			SetAxisValue(axisX, argumentInternal);
			SetAxisValue(axisY, valueInternal);
		}

		internal void SetAxisValue(AxisBase axis, double valueInternal)
		{
			IScaleMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)axis).AxisScaleTypeMap;
			object scaleMapNativeValue = AxisUtils.GetScaleMapNativeValue(axisScaleTypeMap, valueInternal);
			AxisValue axisValue = new AxisValue();
			switch (axis.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
				axisValue.SetQualitativeValue((string)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				axisValue.SetDateTimeValue((DateTime)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal, axis.DateTimeScaleOptions);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				axisValue.SetTimeSpanValue((TimeSpan)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal, axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions);
				break;
			default:
				axisValue.SetNumericalValue((double)scaleMapNativeValue);
				break;
			}
			AddAxisValue(axis, axisValue);
		}

		internal void AddAxisValue(AxisBase axis, AxisValue axisValue)
		{
			if (!axisValueDictionary.ContainsKey(axis))
			{
				axisValueDictionary.Add(axis, axisValue);
			}
		}

		internal void AddAxisValue(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Axis2D axis, int coordinate, int length)
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				double? num = axis.CalculateInternalValue(pane, coordinate, length);
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					SetAxisValue(axis, num.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public AxisValue GetAxisValue(AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (axis == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axisValueDictionary.TryGetValue(axis, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class AxisValue
	{
		internal object ActualValue => ScaleType switch
		{
			ScaleType.Qualitative => QualitativeValue, 
			ScaleType.Numerical => NumericalValue, 
			ScaleType.DateTime => DateTimeValue, 
			ScaleType.TimeSpan => TimeSpanValue, 
			ScaleType.Auto => throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't return actual value for the Auto scale type."), 
			_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException("Unknown scale type"), 
		};

		[Description("Gets the axis scale type.")]
		public ScaleType ScaleType { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets the axis value, if the axis scale type is qualitative.")]
		public string QualitativeValue { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets the axis value, if the axis scale type is numerical.")]
		public double NumericalValue { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets the axis value, if the axis scale type is date-time.")]
		public DateTime DateTimeValue { get; private set; }

		[Description("Returns an axis value if the axis scale type is time-span.")]
		public TimeSpan TimeSpanValue { get; private set; }

		internal AxisValue()
		{
			ScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			QualitativeValue = string.Empty;
		}

		internal void SetQualitativeValue(string value, double valueInternal)
		{
			ScaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			QualitativeValue = value;
			NumericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		internal void SetNumericalValue(double value)
		{
			ScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			NumericalValue = value;
		}

		internal void SetDateTimeValue(DateTime value, double valueInternal, DateTimeScaleOptions scaleOptions)
		{
			ScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			DateTimeValue = ((scaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous) ? value : DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(value, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)scaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal, DateTimeUtilsExt.FirstDayOfWeek));
			NumericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		internal void SetTimeSpanValue(TimeSpan value, double valueInternal, TimeSpanScaleOptions scaleOptions)
		{
			ScaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			TimeSpanValue = value;
			NumericalValue = valueInternal;
		}
	}

			secondaryAxesX = new SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisXCollection(this);
			secondaryAxesY = new SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisYCollection(this);
			selectionOptions = new SelectionOptions(this);

		protected override void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, object item)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SecondaryAxesX"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SecondaryAxesY")
				{
					SecondaryAxesY.Add((SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisY)item);
				}
				else
				{
					base.XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(propertyName, item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SecondaryAxesX.Add((SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisX)item);
			}
		}

		protected override object XtraCreateCollectionItem(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SecondaryAxesX"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SecondaryAxesY")
				{
					return new SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisY();
				}
				return base.XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName);
			}
			return new SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisX();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "AxisX"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "AxisY")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeAxisY();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeAxisX();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisX()
		{
			return axisX.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisY()
		{
			return axisY.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAxisX() && !ShouldSerializeAxisY() && secondaryAxesX.Count <= 0)
			{
				return secondaryAxesY.Count > 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			return new SwiftPlotDiagramMapping(container, layoutX, layoutY);
		}

		protected internal override bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Contains(obj) && obj != axisX && obj != axisY && !axisX.Contains(obj) && !axisY.Contains(obj) && !secondaryAxesX.ContainsWithChildren(obj) && !secondaryAxesY.ContainsWithChildren(obj))
			{
				return base.Contains(obj);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SwiftPlotDiagram();
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			axisX.OnEndLoading();
			axisY.OnEndLoading();
			foreach (SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisX item in secondaryAxesX)
			{
				item.OnEndLoading();
			}
			foreach (SwiftPlotDiagramSecondaryAxisY item2 in secondaryAxesY)
			{
				item2.OnEndLoading();
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SwiftPlotDiagram swiftPlotDiagram)
			{
				axisX.Assign(swiftPlotDiagram.axisX);
				axisY.Assign(swiftPlotDiagram.axisY);
				secondaryAxesX.Assign(swiftPlotDiagram.secondaryAxesX);
				secondaryAxesY.Assign(swiftPlotDiagram.secondaryAxesY);
			}
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneBase ActualFocusedPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (focusedPane != null)
				{
					return focusedPane;
				}
				return defaultPane;
			}
		}

		private bool ShowRangeControlGridOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Chart != null)
				{
					return base.Chart.IsRangeControlClient;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasSmartAxisX => SmartAxesUtils.HasSmartAxis(this);

		internal bool ShowRangeControlDateTimeGridOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (ShowRangeControlGridOptions)
				{
					return ActualAxisX.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowRangeControlNumericGridOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (ShowRangeControlGridOptions)
				{
					return ActualAxisX.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal XYDiagramAppearance Appearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).XYDiagramAppearance;

		internal PanesList ActualPanes
		{
			get
			{
				PanesList panesList = new PanesList();
				if (defaultPane.ActualVisible && !defaultPane.Collapsed)
				{
					panesList.Add(defaultPane);
				}
				foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in panes)
				{
					if (pane.ActualVisible && !pane.Collapsed)
					{
						panesList.Add(pane);
					}
				}
				return panesList;
			}
		}

		internal PanesList VisiblePanes
		{
			get
			{
				PanesList panesList = new PanesList();
				if (defaultPane.ActualVisible)
				{
					panesList.Add(defaultPane);
				}
				foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in panes)
				{
					if (pane.ActualVisible)
					{
						panesList.Add(pane);
					}
				}
				return panesList;
			}
		}

		internal PanesList VisibleInLayoutPanes
		{
			get
			{
				PanesList panesList = new PanesList();
				if (defaultPane.ActualVisible && defaultPane.VisibleInLayout)
				{
					panesList.Add(defaultPane);
				}
				foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in panes)
				{
					if (pane.ActualVisible && pane.VisibleInLayout)
					{
						panesList.Add(pane);
					}
				}
				return panesList;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool SupportTooltips => true;

		protected internal override bool DependsOnBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsScrollingEnabled)
				{
					return HasSmartAxisX;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanZoomIn => GetAxesManager(ActualFocusedPane)?.CanZoomIn() ?? false;

		protected internal override bool CanZoomOut => GetAxesManager(ActualFocusedPane)?.CanZoomOut() ?? false;

		protected internal override bool CanZoomWithTouch => ZoomingOptions.UseTouchDevice;

		protected internal override bool CanScroll => IsScrollingEnabled;

		protected internal override bool CanPan => ScrollingOptions.UseTouchDevice;

		protected internal override bool HasAutoLayoutElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasAutoLayoutAxes(GetAllAxesX()))
				{
					return HasAutoLayoutAxes(GetAllAxesY());
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsScrollingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultPane.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling || defaultPane.ActualEnableAxisYScrolling)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (pane.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling || pane.ActualEnableAxisYScrolling)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsZoomingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultPane.ActualEnableAxisXZooming || defaultPane.ActualEnableAxisYZooming)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (pane.ActualEnableAxisXZooming || pane.ActualEnableAxisYZooming)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<IAxisData> IXYDiagram.AllAxes
		{
			get
			{
				List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
				if (ActualAxisX != null)
				{
					list.Add(ActualAxisX);
				}
				if (ActualAxisY != null)
				{
					list.Add(ActualAxisY);
				}
				if (ActualSecondaryAxesX != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(ActualSecondaryAxesX);
				}
				if (ActualSecondaryAxesY != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(ActualSecondaryAxesY);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private RangeControlBehavior RangeControlBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				if (rangeControlBehavior == null || !rangeControlBehavior.Validate(ActualAxisX.ScaleType))
				{
					rangeControlBehavior = RangeControlBehavior.Create(this);
				}
				return rangeControlBehavior;
			}
		}

		internal ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions ActualRangeControlClientGridOptions => ActualAxisX.ScaleType switch
		{
			ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime => rangeControlDateTimeGridOptions, 
			ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical => rangeControlNumericGridOptions, 
			ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan => rangeControlTimeSpanGridOptions, 
			_ => rangeControlQualitativeGridOptions, 
		};

		protected XYDiagram2D()
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			margins = new RectangleIndents(this, 5);
			defaultPane = new XYDiagramDefaultPane(this);
