		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMargins() && !ShouldSerializeDefaultPane() && panes.Count <= 0 && !ShouldSerializeScrollingOptions() && !ShouldSerializeZoomingOptions() && !ShouldSerializeEnableAxisXScrolling() && !ShouldSerializeEnableAxisYScrolling() && !ShouldSerializeEnableAxisXZooming() && !ShouldSerializeEnableAxisYZooming() && !ShouldSerializePaneDistance() && !ShouldSerializeRangeControlDateTimeGridOptions() && !ShouldSerializeRangeControlTimeSpanGridOptions() && !ShouldSerializeRangeControlNumericGridOptions() && !ShouldSerializeDependentAxesYRange())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePaneLayout();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Margins" => ShouldSerializeMargins(), 
				"DefaultPane" => ShouldSerializeDefaultPane(), 
				"ScrollingOptions" => ShouldSerializeScrollingOptions(), 
				"ZoomingOptions" => ShouldSerializeZoomingOptions(), 
				"EnableAxisXScrolling" => ShouldSerializeEnableAxisXScrolling(), 
				"EnableAxisYScrolling" => ShouldSerializeEnableAxisYScrolling(), 
				"EnableAxisXZooming" => ShouldSerializeEnableAxisXZooming(), 
				"EnableAxisYZooming" => ShouldSerializeEnableAxisYZooming(), 
				"EnableScrolling" => ShouldSerializeEnableScrolling(), 
				"EnableZooming" => ShouldSerializeEnableZooming(), 
				"PaneDistance" => ShouldSerializePaneDistance(), 
				"RangeControlDateTimeGridOptions" => ShouldSerializeRangeControlDateTimeGridOptions(), 
				"RangeControlTimeSpanGridOptions" => ShouldSerializeRangeControlTimeSpanGridOptions(), 
				"RangeControlNumericGridOptions" => ShouldSerializeRangeControlNumericGridOptions(), 
				"DependentAxesYRange" => ShouldSerializeDependentAxesYRange(), 
				"PaneLayout" => ShouldSerializePaneLayout(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		void IIndicatorCalculator.Invalidate(ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeriesList)
		{
			indicatorsRepository.Clear();
			foreach (RefinedSeries refinedSeries in refinedSeriesList)
			{
				if (!(refinedSeries.Series is SeriesBase seriesBase) || !(seriesBase.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
				{
					continue;
				}
				seriesBase.ValidateIndicators(refinedSeries);
				foreach (Indicator indicator in ((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)seriesBase.View).Indicators)
				{
					indicatorsRepository.Add(indicator);
				}
			}
		}

		void IIndicatorCalculator.UpdateSeriesIndicators(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> pointsUpdateInfo)
		{
			if (!(refinedSeries.Series is SeriesBase seriesBase) || isUpdatingIndicators)
			{
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = seriesBase.View as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
			if (view == null || view.Indicators.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Indicator indicator in view.Indicators)
			{
				indicator.IndicatorBehavior.NotifyRefinedPointsChanging();
			}
			object lockObject = new object();
			int indicatorsForDrawingCount = 0;
			Action action = delegate
			{
				try
				{
					refinedSeries.EnsureInteractions();
					isUpdatingIndicators = true;
					List<RefinedPoint> points = new List<RefinedPoint>(((IRefinedSeries)refinedSeries).Points);
					Parallel.ForEach(view.Indicators, delegate(Indicator indicator2)
					{
						if (refinedSeries.Series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
						{
							lock (indicator2)
							{
								indicator2.IndicatorBehavior.UpdateData(refinedSeries, points, pointsUpdateInfo, lockObject);
								UpdateIndicatorColor(indicator2);
								int num = indicatorsForDrawingCount + 1;
								indicatorsForDrawingCount = num;
							}
						}
					});
				}
				finally
				{
					isUpdatingIndicators = false;
					if (indicatorsForDrawingCount > 0)
					{
						CrosshairManager.UpdateIndicatorsData();
						base.Chart.ClearCache();
						RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(view, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries));
						base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
					}
				}
			};
			if (!(ChartContainer is IChartContainerEx chartContainerEx))
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				chartContainerEx.Invoke(action, beginInvoke: true);
			}
		}

		private void PerformGestureZoom()
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (gestureZoomManager != null && base.Chart.CanZoom(gestureZoomCenter))
			{
				double num = 1.0 / gestureZoomPercent;
				gestureZoomManager.Zoom(GraphicUtils.ConvertPoint(gestureZoomCenter), num, num, ((IXYDiagram)this).DependentValueRange);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldUpdateAutomaticLayout(IEnumerable<IAxisData> axes)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)

				if ((int)((Axis2D)axis).Visibility == 2)

					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HasAutoLayoutAxes(List<Axis2D> axes)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

		private void ResizePanesRuntime(SeparatorInfo separator, int dx, int dy)
		{
			bool isVerticalRelation = separator.IsVerticalRelation;
			PanesList panesForLayoutCalculation = GetPanesForLayoutCalculation();
			ConvertLayoutDefinitionsToPX(lastPanesLayoutInfo as GridLayoutInfoList, isVerticalRelation, panesForLayoutCalculation);
			int num = (isVerticalRelation ? separator.Row : separator.Column);
			LayoutDefinitionCollection layoutDefinitionCollection = (isVerticalRelation ? PaneLayout.RowDefinitions : PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions);
			int num2 = (isVerticalRelation ? dy : dx);
			Rectangle? lastMappingBounds = panesForLayoutCalculation[separator.Item1Index].LastMappingBounds;
			Rectangle? lastMappingBounds2 = panesForLayoutCalculation[separator.Item2Index].LastMappingBounds;
			int num3 = ((!lastMappingBounds.HasValue) ? layoutDefinitionCollection[num].SizeInPixelsScaled : (isVerticalRelation ? lastMappingBounds.Value.Height : lastMappingBounds.Value.Width));
			int num4 = ((!lastMappingBounds2.HasValue) ? layoutDefinitionCollection[num + 1].SizeInPixelsScaled : (isVerticalRelation ? lastMappingBounds2.Value.Height : lastMappingBounds2.Value.Width));
			int num5 = 30;
			if (num3 + num2 > num5 && layoutDefinitionCollection[num].SizeInPixelsScaled + num2 > num5 && num4 - num2 > num5 && layoutDefinitionCollection[num + 1].SizeInPixelsScaled - num2 > num5)
			{
				layoutDefinitionCollection[num].SizeInPixelsScaled += num2;
				layoutDefinitionCollection[num + 1].SizeInPixelsScaled -= num2;
			}
		}

		private void ConvertLayoutDefinitionsToPX(GridLayoutInfoList gridInfo, bool isVerticalDirection, PanesList panes)
		{
			if (gridInfo != null)
			{
				if (PaneLayout.RowDefinitions.Count == 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < gridInfo.RowsCount; i++)
					{
						PaneLayout.RowDefinitions.Add(new LayoutDefinition());
					}
				}
				if (PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions.Count == 0)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < gridInfo.ColumnsCount; j++)
					{
						PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new LayoutDefinition());
					}
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < gridInfo.RowsCount; k++)
				{
					LayoutDefinition layoutDefinition = PaneLayout.RowDefinitions[k];
					layoutDefinition.SizeMode = PaneSizeMode.UseSizeInPixels;
					layoutDefinition.SizeInPixelsScaled = gridInfo.RowsSizes[k].Length;
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < gridInfo.ColumnsCount; l++)
				{
					LayoutDefinition layoutDefinition2 = PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions[l];
					layoutDefinition2.SizeMode = PaneSizeMode.UseSizeInPixels;
					layoutDefinition2.SizeInPixelsScaled = gridInfo.ColumnsSizes[l].Length;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				paneLayoutConvertState = new PaneLayoutConvertState
				{
					OldLayoutMode = PaneLayout.AutoLayoutMode
				};
				ConvertToPaneGridLayout(isVerticalDirection, panes);
			}
		}

		private void ConvertToPaneGridLayout(bool isVerticalDirection, PanesList panes)
		{
			PaneLayout.AutoLayoutMode = PaneAutoLayoutMode.Grid;
			LayoutDefinition[] array = new LayoutDefinition[panes.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < panes.Count; i++)
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = panes[i];
				array[i] = new LayoutDefinition(xYDiagramPaneBase)
				{
					SizeMode = PaneSizeMode.UseSizeInPixels,
					Weight = xYDiagramPaneBase.LinearLayoutOptions.Weight,
					SizeInPixels = xYDiagramPaneBase.LinearLayoutOptions.SizeInPixels
				};
				xYDiagramPaneBase.LayoutOptions.RowSpan = 1;
				xYDiagramPaneBase.LayoutOptions.ColumnSpan = 1;
			}
			PaneLayout.RowDefinitions.Clear();
			PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions.Clear();
			if (isVerticalDirection)
			{
				PaneLayout.RowDefinitions.AddRange(array);
				PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new LayoutDefinition());
			}
			else
			{
				PaneLayout.ColumnDefinitions.AddRange(array);
				PaneLayout.RowDefinitions.Add(new LayoutDefinition());
			}
		}

		private Axis2D GetAxisByPoint(Point point)
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				foreach (Tuple<Axis2D, Rectangle> axesBound in actualPane.AxesBounds)
				{
					if (axesBound.Item2.Contains(point))
					{
						return axesBound.Item1;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ControlCoordinates CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, object argument, object value)
		{
			if (pane.MappingList == null)
			{
				base.Chart.PerformViewDataCalculation(Rectangle.Empty, correctRanges: false);
				if (pane.MappingList == null)
				{
					return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
				}
			}
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = pane.MappingList.GetMappingContainer((Axis2D)axisX, (Axis2D)axisY);
			if (mappingContainer == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
			}
			double num = axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(argument);
			IMinMaxValues wholeRange = axisX.WholeRange;
			if (axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative || (!(num < wholeRange.Min) && !(num > wholeRange.Max)))
			{
				return DiagramToPointCalculator.CalculateCoords(pane, mappingContainer, num, axisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(value));
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
		}

		private ControlCoordinates CalcDiagramToPoint(object argument, object value)
		{
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = GetPaneAxesData(defaultPane);
			if (paneAxesData == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(defaultPane);
			}
			IAxisData primaryAxisX = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
			IAxisData primaryAxisY = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (primaryAxisX != null && primaryAxisY != null)
			{
				return CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(defaultPane, primaryAxisX, primaryAxisY, argument, value);
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(defaultPane);
		}

		private ControlCoordinates CalcDiagramToPoint(object argument, object value, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY)
		{
			if (AxisPaneRepository == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(defaultPane);
			}
			if (AxisPaneRepository.GetFirstPaneByAxes(axisX, axisY) is XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
			{
				return CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(pane, axisX, axisY, argument, value);
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(defaultPane);
		}

		private ControlCoordinates CalcDiagramToPoint(object argument, object value, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = GetPaneAxesData(pane);
			if (paneAxesData != null && paneAxesData.AxesX.Contains(axisX) && paneAxesData.AxesY.Contains(axisY))
			{
				return CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(pane, axisX, axisY, argument, value);
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
		}

		private ControlCoordinates DiagramToPointInternal(object argument, object value, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			return CalcDiagramToPoint(DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(argument, axisX.ScaleTypeMap), DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(value, axisY.ScaleTypeMap), axisX, axisY, pane);
		}

		}

		}

		private bool PaneSizeModeChanged(PropertyUpdateInfo info)
		{
			if (info != null && info.Sender is XYDiagramPaneBase && info.Name == "SizeMode")
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = info.Sender as XYDiagramPaneBase;
				if (xYDiagramPaneBase.ActualVisible && !Loading && !xYDiagramPaneBase.LinearLayoutOptions.Fixed)
				{
					xYDiagramPaneBase.LinearLayoutOptions.SetWeight(PaneSizeInPixelsToWeightConverter.CalculateWeight(xYDiagramPaneBase, VisiblePanes));
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ClearAxesLabelBounds()
		{
			ActualAxisX.LabelBounds.Clear();
			foreach (Axis2D item in ActualSecondaryAxesX)
			{
				item.LabelBounds.Clear();
			}
			ActualAxisY.LabelBounds.Clear();
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in ActualSecondaryAxesY)
			{
				item2.LabelBounds.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyAxesLabelBounds(XYDiagramViewData diagramViewData)
		{
			if (diagramViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewData paneViewData in diagramViewData.PaneViewDataList)
			{
				foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in paneViewData.AxisViewDataList)
				{
					IPane pane = paneViewData.Pane;
					Axis2D axis = axisViewData.Axis;
					Rectangle value = axisViewData.CalculateLabelBounds();
					if (!value.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (!axis.LabelBounds.ContainsKey(pane))
						{
							axis.LabelBounds.Add(pane, value);
						}
						else
						{
							axis.LabelBounds[pane] = value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckAxisLegend(Axis2D axis, Legend legend)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLine constantLine in axis.ConstantLines)
			{
				if (constantLine.Legend == legend)
				{
					constantLine.Legend = base.Chart.Legend;
				}
			}
			foreach (Strip strip in axis.Strips)
			{
				if (strip.Legend == legend)
				{
					strip.Legend = base.Chart.Legend;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ZoomIn(Rectangle rect, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GetAxesManager(pane)?.ZoomIn(GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(rect));
			UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(pane);
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateRelativeAxesRect(Point point, Rectangle lastMappingBounds)
		{
			point.X -= lastMappingBounds.Left;
			point.Y -= lastMappingBounds.Top;
			if (point.X < 0 || point.X > lastMappingBounds.Width || point.Y < 0 || point.Y > lastMappingBounds.Height)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			point.Y = lastMappingBounds.Height - point.Y;
			int x;
			int y;
			int width;
			int height;
			if (ActualRotated)
			{
				x = point.Y;
				y = point.X;
				width = lastMappingBounds.Height;
				height = lastMappingBounds.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				x = point.X;
				y = point.Y;
				width = lastMappingBounds.Width;
				height = lastMappingBounds.Height;
			}
			return new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private InternalCoordinates MapPointToInternal(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Point point)
		{
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = GetPaneAxesData(pane);
			if (paneAxesData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle value = pane.LastMappingBounds.Value;
			if (value.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = CalculateRelativeAxesRect(point, value);
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			InternalCoordinates internalCoordinates = new InternalCoordinates(pane);
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
			if (axis2D != null)
			{
				double? num = axis2D.CalculateInternalValue(pane, rectangle.X, rectangle.Width);
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisXValue(axis2D, num.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item in paneAxesData.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				double? num2 = item.CalculateInternalValue(pane, rectangle.X, rectangle.Width);
				if (num2.HasValue)
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisXValue(item, num2.Value);
				}
			}
			Axis2D axis2D3 = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (axis2D3 != null)
			{
				double? num3 = axis2D3.CalculateInternalValue(pane, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Height);
				if (num3.HasValue)
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisYValue(axis2D3, num3.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in paneAxesData.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				double? num4 = item2.CalculateInternalValue(pane, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Height);
				if (num4.HasValue)
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisYValue(item2, num4.Value);
				}
			}
			return internalCoordinates;
		}

		private ControlCoordinates MapInternalToPoint(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, double argument, double value)
		{
			if (pane.MappingList == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
			}
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = pane.MappingList.GetMappingContainer(axisX, axisY);
			return DiagramToPointCalculator.CalculateCoords(pane, mappingContainer, argument, value);
		}

		private CrosshairCoordinateLocation ConvertCrosshairPointToCoordinateLocation(CrosshairPointLocation crosshairLocation)
		{
			DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = PointToDiagram(crosshairLocation.Location);
			object argument = null;
			switch (diagramCoordinates.ArgumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				argument = diagramCoordinates.NumericalArgument;
				break;
			case ScaleType.Qualitative:
				argument = diagramCoordinates.QualitativeArgument;
				break;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				argument = diagramCoordinates.DateTimeArgument;
				break;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				argument = diagramCoordinates.TimeSpanArgument;
				break;
			}
			object value = null;
			switch (diagramCoordinates.ValueScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				value = diagramCoordinates.NumericalValue;
				break;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				value = diagramCoordinates.DateTimeValue;
				break;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				value = diagramCoordinates.TimeSpanValue;
				break;
			}
			return new CrosshairCoordinateLocation(argument, value, diagramCoordinates.AxisX as Axis2D, diagramCoordinates.AxisY as Axis2D, diagramCoordinates.Pane);
		}

		private IList<IPane> GetCrosshairSyncPanes(IPane focusedPane, bool isHorizontalSync)
		{
			IList<IPane> list = new List<IPane>();
			bool flag = PaneLayout.Direction == PaneLayoutDirection.Vertical;
			if (flag == isHorizontalSync)
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in ActualPanes)
				{
					list.Add(actualPane);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(focusedPane);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> GetHighlightedPointsInfo(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfos)
		{
			List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> list = new List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo>();
			foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo in crosshairInfos.CrosshairPaneInfos)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPoint item in crosshairPaneInfo.PointsForHighlight)
				{
					List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> list2 = (((Series)item.RefinedSeries.Series).ActualCrosshairHighlightPoints ? CalculateHighlightedPointInfo(item) : null);
					if (list2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo item2 in list2)
					{
						if (!list.Contains(item2))
						{
							list.Add(item2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> CalculateHighlightedPointInfo(CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairPoint)
		{
			List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> list = new List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo>();
			if (crosshairPoint != null && crosshairPoint.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase { ActualPane: { MappingList: not null } actualPane } xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)
			{
				XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = actualPane.MappingList.GetMappingContainer(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX, xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY);
				IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = crosshairPoint.RefinedSeries;
				DrawOptions drawOptions = xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.CreatePointDrawOptions(refinedSeries.Points, crosshairPoint.RefinedPoint);
				drawOptions.Initialize(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase, refinedSeries.Points, crosshairPoint.PointIndex);
				if (mappingContainer != null)
				{
					foreach (XYDiagramMappingBase item2 in mappingContainer)
					{
						HighlightedPointLayout highlightedPointLayout = xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.CalculateHighlightedPointLayout(item2, crosshairPoint.RefinedPoint, drawOptions);
						if (highlightedPointLayout != null && actualPane.SeriesClipRegions.TryGetValue(item2, out var value))
						{
							CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo item = new CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo(highlightedPointLayout, (Series)refinedSeries.Series, value);
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private CrosshairInfo GetCrosshairInfo(IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			CrosshairInfo result = null;
			List<ILegendItem> list = new List<ILegendItem>();
			foreach (Legend actualLegend in base.Chart.ActualLegends)
			{
				list.AddRange(actualLegend.LegendItemsInfo.Keys);
			}
			if (crosshairLocation == null)
			{
				result = crosshairManager.CalculateCrosshairInfoForLegends(list);
			}
			else if (crosshairLocation is CrosshairPointLocation)
			{
				CrosshairPointLocation crosshairPointLocation = (CrosshairPointLocation)crosshairLocation;
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = (base.Chart.IsPointInLegend(crosshairPointLocation.Location) ? null : GetPaneByPoint(crosshairPointLocation.Location, checkAxes: false));
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(crosshairPointLocation.Location.X, crosshairPointLocation.Location.Y);
				IList<PaneAxesContainer> paneAxisRepositories = ((paneAxesContainerRepository != null) ? paneAxesContainerRepository.Values : null);
				result = crosshairManager.CalculateCrosshairInfo(gRealPoint2D, crosshairPointLocation.Location.IsEmpty, GetChartBounds(), paneAxisRepositories, xYDiagramPaneBase, refinedSeries, list, ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			}
			else if (crosshairLocation is CrosshairCoordinateLocation)
			{
				CrosshairCoordinateLocation crosshairCoordinateLocation = (CrosshairCoordinateLocation)crosshairLocation;
				if (crosshairCoordinateLocation.Argument == null || crosshairCoordinateLocation.Value == null || crosshairCoordinateLocation.Pane == null || crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisX == null || crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisY == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double argument = crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(crosshairCoordinateLocation.Argument);
				double value = crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisY.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(crosshairCoordinateLocation.Value);
				bool outOfRange = !base.Chart.CrosshairOptions.ShowOutOfRangePoints && !IsNativeCoordinatesVisible(argument, value, crosshairCoordinateLocation.Pane, crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisX, crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisY);
				result = crosshairManager.CalculateCrosshairInfo(crosshairCoordinateLocation.Argument, crosshairCoordinateLocation.Value, outOfRange, GetChartBounds(), paneAxesContainerRepository.Values, crosshairCoordinateLocation.Pane, crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisX, crosshairCoordinateLocation.AxisY, refinedSeries, list, ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsNativeCoordinatesVisible(double argument, double value, XYDiagramPaneBase pane, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = pane.MappingList.GetMappingContainer((Axis2D)axisX, (Axis2D)axisY);
			if (mappingContainer != null)
			{
				foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in mappingContainer.IntervalsLayoutX)
				{
					if (item.ValueWithinRange(argument))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item2 in mappingContainer.IntervalsLayoutY)
					{
						if (item2.ValueWithinRange(value))
						{
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		private void CheckCrosshairUsageInControl()
		{
			if (base.Chart.Container != null && base.Chart.Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl)
			{
				throw new Exception(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectShowCrosshairUsage));
			}
		}

		private void OnCrosshairElementsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			needSynchronizeCrosshairCustomDrawCollection = true;
		}

		private void SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs crosshairEventArgs)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairEventArgs.CrosshairElementGroups)
			{
				crosshairElementGroup.SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(OnCrosshairElementsChanged);
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs crosshairEventArgs)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairEventArgs.CrosshairElementGroups)
			{
				crosshairElementGroup.UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(OnCrosshairElementsChanged);
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeCrosshairElementCollections(CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs customDrawCrosshairEventArgs)
		{
			needSynchronizeCrosshairCustomDrawCollection = false;
			CrosshairCollectionSynchronizer<CrosshairElement, CrosshairElementBase> crosshairCollectionSynchronizer = new CrosshairCollectionSynchronizer<CrosshairElement, CrosshairElementBase>();
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in customDrawCrosshairEventArgs.CrosshairElementGroups)
			{
				crosshairCollectionSynchronizer.Synchronize(crosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements, crosshairElementGroup.Elements);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxes(IEnumerable<IAxisData> axes, int axisLength, List<AxisBase> affectedAxes, bool updateIntervals)
		{
			foreach (AxisBase axis in axes)
			{
				bool flag = axis.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(axisLength);
				if (flag | (updateIntervals && axis.UpdateIntervals()))
				{
					affectedAxes.Add(axis);
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<AxisBase> UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(bool updateViewController, bool updateIntervals = false)
		{
			HashSet<AxisBase> hashSet = new HashSet<AxisBase>();
			IList<IPane> actualPanes = ActualPanes;
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase item in actualPanes)
			{
				hashSet.UnionWith(UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(item, updateViewController, updateIntervals));
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private List<AxisBase> GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			List<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			IList<IPane> actualPanes = ActualPanes;
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase item in actualPanes)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = GetPaneAxesData(item);
				if (paneAxesData == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (IAxisData argumentAxesWithAutomaticUnit in GetArgumentAxesWithAutomaticUnits(paneAxesData))
				{
					if (AxisUtils.ShouldUpdateSkippingRangesWithoutPoints(argumentAxesWithAutomaticUnit, valueRangeChanged))
					{
						list.Add(argumentAxesWithAutomaticUnit as AxisBase);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual int GetArgumentAxisLength(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane.LastMappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				if (!ActualRotated)
				{
					return pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Width;
				}
				return pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Height;
			}
			return 500;
		}

		protected virtual int GetValueAxisLength(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane.LastMappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				if (!ActualRotated)
				{
					return pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Height;
				}
				return pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Width;
			}
			return 500;
		}

		protected virtual IList<IAxisData> GetArgumentAxesWithAutomaticUnits(PaneAxesContainer container)
		{
			return container.AxesX;
		}

		protected virtual IList<IAxisData> GetValueAxesWithAutomaticUnits(PaneAxesContainer container)
		{
			return container.AxesY;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				defaultPane?.Dispose();
				panes?.Dispose();
			}
			Disposed = true;
		}

		protected override void UpdateDiagramAccordingInfo(SeriesBase seriesTemplate, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> activeSeries)
		{
			seriesTemplate?.ValidateIndicators(null);
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				foreach (Annotation annotation in actualPane.Annotations)
				{
					if (annotation.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.UpdateAxisValue();
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.UpdateAxisValue();
					}
				}
			}
			AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateAxisElementsAndIntervals(this);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate changeUpdate)
		{
			ChartElementChange change = changeUpdate.Change;
			if (ContainOnlyRangeChange(change))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (PaneSizeModeChanged(changeUpdate.UpdateInfo as PropertyUpdateInfo))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessChanged(sender, changeUpdate);
		}

		protected internal IList<AxisBase> UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, bool updateViewController = true, bool updateIntervals = false)
		{
			List<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = GetPaneAxesData(pane);
			if (paneAxesData != null)
			{
				UpdateAxes(GetArgumentAxesWithAutomaticUnits(paneAxesData), GetArgumentAxisLength(pane), list, updateIntervals);
				UpdateAxes(GetValueAxesWithAutomaticUnits(paneAxesData), GetValueAxisLength(pane), list, updateIntervals);
			}
			if (updateViewController)
			{
				base.ViewController.SendDataAggregationUpdates(list);
			}
			foreach (IAxisData allAxis in ((IXYDiagram)this).AllAxes)
			{
				AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateAxisElements(allAxis);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override void OnUpdateAutomaticLayout()
		{
			base.OnUpdateAutomaticLayout();
			UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(updateViewController: true);
		}

		protected internal override void OnUpdateBounds()
		{
			base.OnUpdateBounds();
			if (base.Chart.LockForExport && base.Chart.ActualPrintCrosshair && crosshairLocation is CrosshairPointLocation)
			{
				CrosshairCoordinateLocation location = ConvertCrosshairPointToCoordinateLocation(crosshairLocation as CrosshairPointLocation);
				UpdateCrosshairLocation(location);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Update(IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> activeSeries)
		{
			base.Update(activeSeries);
			if (paneAxesContainerRepository != null)
			{
				paneAxesContainerRepository.UpdateRanges();
			}
			if (DependsOnBounds && !Loading)
			{
				base.Chart.PerformViewDataCalculationWithoutEvents(base.Chart.LastBounds, correctRanges: true);
			}
			else
			{
				ResetPanesMappings();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearResolveOverlappingCache()
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				actualPane.ResolveOverlappingCache = null;
			}
			List<Axis2D> allAxesX = GetAllAxesX();
			foreach (Axis2D item in allAxesX)
			{
				item.OverlappingCache = null;
				item.ResetScrollLabelSizeCache();
			}
			List<Axis2D> allAxesY = GetAllAxesY();
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in allAxesY)
			{
				item2.OverlappingCache = null;
				item2.ResetScrollLabelSizeCache();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearAnnotations()
		{
			base.ClearAnnotations();
			defaultPane.ClearAnnotations();
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in panes)
			{
				pane.ClearAnnotations();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearCrosshairManager()
		{
			base.ClearCrosshairManager();
			crosshairManager.ClearCrosshairData();
		}

		protected internal override bool PerformDragging(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, ChartScrollEventType scrollEventType, object focusedElement)
		{
			if (!ScrollingOptions.UseTouchDevice)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (focusedPaneSeparator != null)
			{
				ResizePanesRuntime(focusedPaneSeparator, dx, dy);
				return true;
			}
			XYDiagramPaneBase pane = ((scrollEventType == ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys) ? (focusedElement as XYDiagramPaneBase) : focusedPane) ?? defaultPane;
			PaneAxesManager axesManager = GetAxesManager(pane);
			if (scrollEventType == ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys)
			{
				dx = -dx;
				dy = -dy;
			}
			return axesManager?.Scroll(dx, dy, useReverse: true, (NavigationType)scrollEventType) ?? false;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanSelect(Point point)
		{
			return GetPaneByPoint(point, checkAxes: false) != null;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanDrag(Point point, PortableMouseButtons button)
		{
			if (!scrollingOptions.UseMouse)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RuntimePaneResize && lastPanesLayoutInfo != null)
			{
				focusedPaneSeparator = lastPanesLayoutInfo.Separators.Find((SeparatorInfo x) => GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(x.Bounds).Contains(point));
				if (focusedPaneSeparator != null)
				{
					UpdateCrosshairLocation(null);
					return true;
				}
			}
			focusedPaneSeparator = null;
			focusedPane = GetPaneByPoint(point, checkAxes: false);
			return GetAxesManager(focusedPane)?.ScrollingEnabled ?? false;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanZoom(Point point)
		{
			focusedPane = GetPaneByPoint(point, checkAxes: true);
			if (focusedPane != null)
			{
				if (!EnableAxisXZooming)
				{
					return EnableAxisYZooming;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void Zoom(int delta, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, object focusedElement)
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase pane = ((zoomingKind == ZoomingKind.Keyboard) ? (focusedElement as XYDiagramPaneBase) : focusedPane) ?? defaultPane;
			GetAxesManager(pane)?.Zoom(delta, zoomingKind);
			UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(pane);
		}

		protected internal override void Zoom(Point location, int delta, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, object focusedElement)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (location.IsEmpty)
			{
				Zoom(delta, zoomingKind, focusedElement);
			}
			XYDiagramPaneBase pane = ((zoomingKind == ZoomingKind.Keyboard) ? (focusedElement as XYDiagramPaneBase) : focusedPane) ?? defaultPane;
			PaneAxesManager axesManager = GetAxesManager(pane);
			if (axesManager != null)
			{
				DXPoint center = GraphicUtils.ConvertPoint(location);
				double zoomPercent = PaneAxesManager.GetZoomPercent(delta);
				NavigationType navigationType = PaneAxesManager.GetNavigationType(delta);
				Axis2D axisByPoint = GetAxisByPoint(location);
				if (axisByPoint != null && axisByPoint.AllowZoomByAxis)
				{
					axesManager.Zoom(axisByPoint, center, zoomPercent, zoomingKind, navigationType);
				}
				else
				{
					axesManager.Zoom(center, zoomPercent, zoomingKind, navigationType, zoomToCenter: false);
				}
			}
			UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(pane);
		}

		protected internal override void ZoomIn(Rectangle rect)
		{
			ZoomIn(rect, ActualFocusedPane);
		}

		protected internal override void ZoomIn(Point center)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GetAxesManager(ActualFocusedPane)?.Zoom(GraphicUtils.ConvertPoint(center), 1.0 / 3.0, ZoomingKind.ZoomIn, NavigationType.ZoomIn, zoomToCenter: true);
		}

		protected internal override void ZoomOut(Point center)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GetAxesManager(ActualFocusedPane)?.Zoom(GraphicUtils.ConvertPoint(center), 3.0, ZoomingKind.ZoomOut, NavigationType.ZoomOut, zoomToCenter: true);
			UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(ActualFocusedPane);
		}

		protected internal override void UndoZoom()
		{
			ZoomCache.Pop();
		}

		protected internal override void ClearZoomCache()
		{
			ZoomCache.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override void DrawZoomRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase actualFocusedPane = ActualFocusedPane;
			if (actualFocusedPane.ActualEnableAxisXZooming && !actualFocusedPane.ActualEnableAxisYZooming)
			{
				if (ActualRotated)
				{
					actualFocusedPane.DrawZoomRectangleHorizontal(renderer, rect);
				}
				else
				{
					actualFocusedPane.DrawZoomRectangleVertical(renderer, rect);
				}
			}
			else if (actualFocusedPane.ActualEnableAxisYZooming && !actualFocusedPane.ActualEnableAxisXZooming)
			{
				if (ActualRotated)
				{
					actualFocusedPane.DrawZoomRectangleVertical(renderer, rect);
				}
				else
				{
					actualFocusedPane.DrawZoomRectangleHorizontal(renderer, rect);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				actualFocusedPane.DrawZoomRectangle(renderer, rect);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DrawSelectionRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase actualFocusedPane = ActualFocusedPane;
			actualFocusedPane.DrawSelectionRectangle(renderer, rect);
		}

		protected internal override DiagramViewData CalculateViewData(SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, Rectangle diagramBounds, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			ClearAxesLabelBounds();
			XYDiagramViewData xYDiagramViewData = new XYDiagramViewDataCalculator(this).Calculate(diagramBounds, containerDataList, performRangeCorrection, legendItems, autoLayoutUpdated);
			ApplyAxesLabelBounds(xYDiagramViewData);
			isEmpty = xYDiagramViewData == null;
			return xYDiagramViewData;
		}

		protected internal override IList<ILegendItemData> GetLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			list.AddRange(ActualAxisX.ConstantLines.GetLegendItems());
			foreach (Axis2D item in ActualSecondaryAxesX)
			{
				list.AddRange(item.ConstantLines.GetLegendItems());
			}
			list.AddRange(ActualAxisY.ConstantLines.GetLegendItems());
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in ActualSecondaryAxesY)
			{
				list.AddRange(item2.ConstantLines.GetLegendItems());
			}
			list.AddRange(ActualAxisX.Strips.GetLegendItems());
			foreach (Axis2D item3 in ActualSecondaryAxesX)
			{
				list.AddRange(item3.Strips.GetLegendItems());
			}
			list.AddRange(ActualAxisY.Strips.GetLegendItems());
			foreach (Axis2D item4 in ActualSecondaryAxesY)
			{
				list.AddRange(item4.Strips.GetLegendItems());
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal virtual void BeginZooming()
		{
		}

		protected internal void EndZooming(ChartZoomEventType eventType, RangesSnapshot oldRange, RangesSnapshot newRange, AxisBase axisX, AxisBase axisY)
		{
			if (oldRange != newRange)
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				ChartZoomEventArgs e = new ChartZoomEventArgs(eventType, oldRange.XRange, oldRange.YRange, newRange.XRange, newRange.YRange, axisX, axisY);
				chart.ContainerAdapter.OnZoom(e);
				chart.ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
				chart.InvalidateDrawingHelper();
				chart.ClearCache();
				ClearResolveOverlappingCache();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndScrolling(ChartScrollOrientation orientation, ChartScrollEventType eventType, RangesSnapshot oldRange, RangesSnapshot newRange, AxisBase axisX, AxisBase axisY)
		{
			if (oldRange != newRange)
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				ChartScrollEventArgs e = new ChartScrollEventArgs(orientation, eventType, oldRange.XRange, oldRange.YRange, newRange.XRange, newRange.YRange, axisX, axisY);
				chart.ContainerAdapter.OnScroll(e);
				chart.ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
				chart.InvalidateDrawingHelper();
				chart.ClearCache();
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected internal override bool UpdateCrosshairLocation(CrosshairLocation location)
		{
			CrosshairPointLocation crosshairPointLocation = crosshairLocation as CrosshairPointLocation;
			CrosshairPointLocation crosshairPointLocation2 = location as CrosshairPointLocation;
			crosshairLocation = location;
			if (crosshairPointLocation != null && crosshairPointLocation2 != null)
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase paneByPoint = GetPaneByPoint(crosshairPointLocation.Location, checkAxes: false);
				XYDiagramPaneBase paneByPoint2 = GetPaneByPoint(crosshairPointLocation2.Location, checkAxes: false);
				if (paneByPoint == null)
				{
					return paneByPoint2 != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void CheckUpdateMeasureUnits(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			IEnumerable<AxisBase> axes = UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(updateViewController: false, updateIntervals: true);
			List<PropertyUpdateInfo> updateInfos = base.ViewController.GetUpdateInfos(axes, "DataAggregation");
			axes = GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(valueRangeChanged);
			updateInfos.AddRange(base.ViewController.GetUpdateInfos(axes, "SkipRangesWithoutPoints"));
			base.ViewController.SendUpdates(updateInfos);
		}

		protected internal CrosshairViewData CalculateCrosshairViewData(IList<IRefinedSeries> series)
		{
			CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo = GetCrosshairInfo(series);
			CrosshairPaneViewDataFactory crosshairPaneViewDataFactory = new CrosshairPaneViewDataFactory(CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this).TextAnnotationAppearance, base.Chart.CrosshairOptions);
			List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> highlightedPointsInfo = GetHighlightedPointsInfo(crosshairInfo);
			crosshairPaneViewDataFactory.ProcessCrosshairInfo(crosshairInfo, highlightedPointsInfo, base.Chart.CrosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelMode == CrosshairLabelMode.ShowCommonForAllSeries, series, ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs customDrawCrosshairEventArgs = crosshairPaneViewDataFactory.CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs;
			if (customDrawCrosshairEventArgs != null)
			{
				SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(customDrawCrosshairEventArgs);
				ContainerAdapter.OnCustomDrawCrosshair(crosshairPaneViewDataFactory.CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs);
				UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(customDrawCrosshairEventArgs);
				if (needSynchronizeCrosshairCustomDrawCollection)
				{
					SynchronizeCrosshairElementCollections(crosshairPaneViewDataFactory.CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs);
				}
				crosshairPaneViewDataFactory.ProcessAfterCustomDraw();
			}
			return crosshairPaneViewDataFactory.CrosshairViewData;
		}

		internal int GetAxisLength(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (AxisPaneRepository != null && AxisPaneRepository.ContainsKey(axis))
			{
				IList<IPane> list = AxisPaneRepository[axis];
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase item in list)
				{
					if (item.LastMappingBounds.HasValue)
					{
						return (ActualRotated ^ axis.IsValueAxis) ? item.LastMappingBounds.Value.Height : item.LastMappingBounds.Value.Width;
					}
				}
			}
			GRealRect2D chartBounds = GetChartBounds();
			return (int)((!(ActualRotated ^ axis.IsValueAxis)) ? ((chartBounds.Width == 0.0) ? 500.0 : (chartBounds.Width * 0.8)) : ((chartBounds.Height == 0.0) ? 500.0 : (chartBounds.Height * 0.8)));
		}

		}

		internal XYDiagramPaneBase GetPaneByID(int paneID)
		{
			if (paneID == defaultPane.ActualPaneID)
			{
				return defaultPane;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in panes)
			{
				if (pane.ActualPaneID == paneID)
				{
					return pane;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool CheckIsLastNotCollapsedPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			List<XYDiagramPaneBase> list = new List<XYDiagramPaneBase>();
			if (ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl)
			{
				list = ActualPanes;
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in ActualPanes)
				{
					if (actualPane.LastMappingBounds.HasValue)
					{
						list.Add(actualPane);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0] == pane;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateIndicatorColor(Indicator indicator)
		{
			IndicatorBehavior indicatorBehavior = indicator.IndicatorBehavior;
			int num = indicatorsRepository.IndexOf(indicator);
			if (indicatorBehavior.Visible && num >= 0)
			{
				Color color = base.Chart.IndicatorsPalette.GetEntry(num, base.Chart.IndicatorsPalette.Count, 0).Color;
				indicatorBehavior.UpdateColor(color);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
			{
				margins.Assign(xYDiagram2D.margins);
				defaultPane.Assign(xYDiagram2D.defaultPane);
				panes.Assign(xYDiagram2D.panes);
				paneDistance = xYDiagram2D.paneDistance;
				dependentAxesYRange = xYDiagram2D.dependentAxesYRange;
				runtimePaneCollapse = xYDiagram2D.runtimePaneCollapse;
				runtimePaneResize = xYDiagram2D.runtimePaneResize;
				if (base.Chart == null || base.Chart.SupportScrollingAndZooming)
				{
					enableAxisXScrolling = xYDiagram2D.enableAxisXScrolling;
					enableAxisYScrolling = xYDiagram2D.enableAxisYScrolling;
					enableAxisXZooming = xYDiagram2D.enableAxisXZooming;
					enableAxisYZooming = xYDiagram2D.enableAxisYZooming;
				}
				else
				{
					enableAxisXScrolling = false;
					enableAxisYScrolling = false;
					enableAxisXZooming = false;
					enableAxisYZooming = false;
				}
				scrollingOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2D.scrollingOptions);
				zoomingOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2D.zoomingOptions);
				rangeControlQualitativeGridOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2D.rangeControlQualitativeGridOptions);
				rangeControlNumericGridOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2D.rangeControlNumericGridOptions);
				rangeControlDateTimeGridOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2D.rangeControlDateTimeGridOptions);
				rangeControlTimeSpanGridOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2D.rangeControlTimeSpanGridOptions);
				paneLayout.Assign(xYDiagram2D.paneLayout);
			}
		}

		public DiagramCoordinates PointToDiagram(Point p)
		{
			ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
			DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = new DiagramCoordinates();
			XYDiagramPaneBase paneByPoint = GetPaneByPoint(p, checkAxes: false);
			if (paneByPoint == null)
			{
				base.Chart.PerformViewDataCalculation(Rectangle.Empty, correctRanges: false);
				paneByPoint = GetPaneByPoint(p, checkAxes: false);
			}
			if (paneByPoint == null)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			diagramCoordinates.SetPane(paneByPoint);
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = GetPaneAxesData(paneByPoint);
			if (paneAxesData == null)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			Rectangle value = paneByPoint.LastMappingBounds.Value;
			if (value.IsEmpty)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = CalculateRelativeAxesRect(p, value);
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
			Axis2D axis2D2 = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (axis2D != null && axis2D2 != null)
			{
				diagramCoordinates.SetAxes(axis2D, axis2D2);
				double? num = axis2D.CalculateInternalValue(paneByPoint, rectangle.X, rectangle.Width);
				double? num2 = axis2D2.CalculateInternalValue(paneByPoint, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Height);
				if (num.HasValue && num2.HasValue)
				{
					diagramCoordinates.SetArgumentAndValue(num.Value, num2.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item in paneAxesData.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				diagramCoordinates.AddAxisValue(paneByPoint, item, rectangle.X, rectangle.Width);
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in paneAxesData.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				diagramCoordinates.AddAxisValue(paneByPoint, item2, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Height);
			}
			return diagramCoordinates;

		internal void ShowCrosshairInternal(CrosshairLocation location)
		{
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
			if (chart != null)
			{
				UpdateCrosshairLocation(location);
				if (!chart.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
				{
					chart.ForceCrosshair();
					crosshairManager.UpdateDataForSeries(base.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries);
				}
				ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(Point screenPoint)
		{
			CheckCrosshairUsageInControl();
			ShowCrosshairInternal(new CrosshairPointLocation(screenPoint));
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(ControlCoordinates coordinates)
		{
			ShowCrosshair(coordinates.Point);
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(object argument, object value, Axis2D axisX = null, Axis2D axisY = null, XYDiagramPaneBase pane = null)
		{
			CheckCrosshairUsageInControl();
			ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
			if (axisX == null)
			{
				axisX = ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (axisY == null)
			{
				axisY = ActualAxisY;
			}
			if (pane == null)
			{
				pane = DefaultPane;
			}
			ShowCrosshairInternal(new CrosshairCoordinateLocation(argument, value, axisX, axisY, pane));
		}

		public void ZoomIn(XYDiagramPaneBase pane = null)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				pane = defaultPane;
			}
			focusedPane = pane;
			if (CanZoomIn)
			{
				Zoom(1, ZoomingKind.ZoomIn, pane);
			}
		}

		public void ZoomOut(XYDiagramPaneBase pane = null)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				pane = defaultPane;
			}
			focusedPane = pane;
			if (CanZoomOut)
			{
				GetAxesManager(pane)?.Zoom(-1, ZoomingKind.ZoomOut);
				UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(pane);
			}
		}

		public void ResetZoom(XYDiagramPaneBase pane = null)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				pane = defaultPane;
			}
			focusedPane = pane;
			PaneAxesManager axesManager = GetAxesManager(pane);
			if (axesManager != null && axesManager.ResetZoom())
			{
				UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(pane);
			}
		}

		public void Scroll(HorizontalScrollingDirection horizontalDirection, VerticalScrollingDirection verticalDirection, XYDiagramPaneBase pane = null)
		{
			Scroll(horizontalDirection switch
			{
				HorizontalScrollingDirection.Right => 10, 
				HorizontalScrollingDirection.Left => -10, 
				_ => 0, 
			}, verticalDirection switch
			{
				VerticalScrollingDirection.Down => 10, 
				VerticalScrollingDirection.Up => -10, 
				_ => 0, 
			}, pane);
		}

		public void Scroll(int horizontalOffset, int verticalOffset, XYDiagramPaneBase pane = null)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				pane = defaultPane;
			}
			focusedPane = pane;
			PerformDragging(-1, -1, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys, pane);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public enum HorizontalScrollingDirection
	{
		None,
		Left,
		Right
	}
	public enum VerticalScrollingDirection
	{
		None,
		Up,
		Down
	}

	public class AreaDrawOptions : LineDrawOptions
	{
		private CustomBorder border;

		private PolygonFillStyle fillStyle;

		private PolygonFillStyle emptyPointFillStyle;

		private CustomBorder emptyPointBorder;

		private bool hitTestGDIPlusPath;

		internal bool HitTestGDIPlusPath => hitTestGDIPlusPath;

		internal PolygonFillStyle EmptyPointFillStyle => emptyPointFillStyle;

		internal CustomBorder EmptyPointBorder => emptyPointBorder;

		[Description("Gets the border settings for the area series view when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public CustomBorder Border => border;

		[Description("Gets the fill style settings of the area series view when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public PolygonFillStyle FillStyle => fillStyle;

		internal AreaDrawOptions(AreaSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			Initialize(view);
			emptyPointFillStyle = (PolygonFillStyle)view.EmptyPointOptions.GetActualFillStyle(view).Clone();
			CustomBorder actualBorder = view.EmptyPointOptions.GetActualBorder(view);
			if (actualBorder != null)
			{
				emptyPointBorder = (CustomBorder)actualBorder.Clone();
			}
		}

		internal AreaDrawOptions(RadarAreaSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			Initialize(view);
		}

		private void Initialize<TAreaView>(TAreaView view) where TAreaView : ChartElement, IAreaSeriesView
		{
			if (view.Border != null)
			{
				border = (CustomBorder)view.Border.Clone();
			}
			fillStyle = (PolygonFillStyle)view.ActualFillStyle.Clone();
			hitTestGDIPlusPath = view.ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
		}

		protected AreaDrawOptions()
		{
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateInstance()
		{
			return new AreaDrawOptions();
		}

		protected override void Assign(object obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AreaDrawOptions areaDrawOptions)
			{
				if (areaDrawOptions.Border != null)
				{
					border = (CustomBorder)areaDrawOptions.border.Clone();
				}
				fillStyle = (PolygonFillStyle)areaDrawOptions.fillStyle.Clone();
				emptyPointBorder = (CustomBorder)(areaDrawOptions.emptyPointBorder?.Clone());
				emptyPointFillStyle = (PolygonFillStyle)(areaDrawOptions.emptyPointFillStyle?.Clone());
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class FinancialDrawOptions : DrawOptions
	{
		private int lineThickness;

		private double levelLineLength;

		private ReductionStockOptions reductionOptions;

		private Shadow shadow;

		protected internal override bool ShouldUpdateColors => true;

		[Description("Gets or sets the financial series view’s line thickness value when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public int LineThickness
		{
			get
			{
				return lineThickness;
			}
			set
			{
				lineThickness = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the financial series view’s level line length (in fractions of a distance between two major values on the axis) when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public double LevelLineLength
		{
			get
			{
				return levelLineLength;
			}
			set
			{
				levelLineLength = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the financial series view’s reduction stock options when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public ReductionStockOptions ReductionOptions => reductionOptions;

		[Description("Gets the financial series view’s shadow settings when implementing custom draw in the chart control.")]
		public Shadow Shadow => shadow;

		protected FinancialDrawOptions(FinancialSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			lineThickness = view.LineThickness;
			levelLineLength = view.LevelLineLength;
			reductionOptions = (ReductionStockOptions)view.ReductionOptions.Clone();
			reductionOptions.Owner = view;
			shadow = (Shadow)view.Shadow.Clone();
		}

		protected FinancialDrawOptions()
		{
		}

		private ValueLevelInternal StockLevelToValueLevel(StockLevel level)
		{
			return ReductionOptions.Level switch
			{
				StockLevel.Low => ValueLevelInternal.Low, 
				StockLevel.High => ValueLevelInternal.High, 
				StockLevel.Open => ValueLevelInternal.Open, 
				StockLevel.Close => ValueLevelInternal.Close, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException("Impossible to convert " + level.ToString() + " to ValueLevel."), 
			};
		}

		protected override void Assign(object obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FinancialDrawOptions financialDrawOptions)
			{
				lineThickness = financialDrawOptions.lineThickness;
				levelLineLength = financialDrawOptions.levelLineLength;
				reductionOptions = (ReductionStockOptions)financialDrawOptions.reductionOptions.Clone();
				reductionOptions.Owner = financialDrawOptions.reductionOptions.Owner;
				shadow = (Shadow)financialDrawOptions.shadow.Clone();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(SeriesViewBase view, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex, bool forceMarkerVisible = false)
		{
			if (ReductionOptions.Visible)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[pointIndex];
				switch (reductionOptions.ColorMode)
				{
				case ReductionColorMode.OpenToCloseValue:
					if (refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Close) < refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Open))
					{
						SetColor(ReductionOptions.Color);
						return;
					}
					break;
				case ReductionColorMode.PreviousToCurrentPoint:
				{
					ValueLevelInternal valueLevel = StockLevelToValueLevel(reductionOptions.Level);
					if (pointIndex > 0)
					{
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = points[pointIndex - 1];
						if (refinedPoint2 != null && !refinedPoint2.IsEmpty && refinedPoint.GetValue(valueLevel) < refinedPoint2.GetValue(valueLevel))
						{
							SetColor(ReductionOptions.Color);
							return;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException("Unknown ColorMode: " + reductionOptions.ColorMode);
				}
			}
			base.Initialize(view, points, pointIndex);
		}
	}

	public class LineDrawOptions : PointDrawOptions
	{
		private LineStyle lineStyle;

		private LineStyle emptyPointLineStyle;

		private bool markerVisible;

		[Description("Gets the line series view’s marker settings when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public new Marker Marker => (Marker)base.Marker;

		[Description("Gets the line series view’s line style settings when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public LineStyle LineStyle => lineStyle;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the marker is visible in the Line Chart when implementing a custom draw.")]
		public bool MarkerVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return markerVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				markerVisible = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ActualMarkerVisible => MarkerVisible;

		internal LineDrawOptions(LineSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			lineStyle = (LineStyle)view.LineStyle.Clone();
			emptyPointLineStyle = (LineStyle)(view.EmptyPointOptions?.GetActualLineStyle(view).Clone());
			markerVisible = view.ActualMarkerVisible;
		}

		internal LineDrawOptions(RadarLineSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			lineStyle = (LineStyle)view.LineStyle.Clone();
			emptyPointLineStyle = lineStyle;
			markerVisible = view.ActualMarkerVisible;
		}

		protected LineDrawOptions()
		{
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LineDrawOptions();
		}

		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions)
			{
				lineStyle = (LineStyle)lineDrawOptions.lineStyle.Clone();
				emptyPointLineStyle = (LineStyle)(lineDrawOptions.emptyPointLineStyle?.Clone());
				markerVisible = lineDrawOptions.markerVisible;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(SeriesViewBase view, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex, bool forceMarkerVisible = false)
		{
			base.Initialize(view, points, pointIndex);
			if (forceMarkerVisible)
			{
				markerVisible = true;
			}
		}

		internal LineStyle GetActualStripLineStyle(GeometryStripStyle stripStyle)
		{
			if (!stripStyle.IsEmptyPointStyle)
			{
				return LineStyle;
			}
			return emptyPointLineStyle;
		}

		internal int GetActualStripLineThickness(GeometryStripStyle stripStyle, LineWholeSeriesLayout lineLayout)
		{
			if (!stripStyle.IsEmptyPointStyle)
			{
				return lineLayout.LineThickness;
			}
			return emptyPointLineStyle.Thickness;
		}
	}

	public class PointDrawOptionsBase : DrawOptions
	{
		private MarkerBase marker;

		private Shadow shadow;

		[Description("Gets the Point, Bubble, Line or Area series view’s marker settings when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public MarkerBase Marker => marker;

		[Description("Gets the Point, Bubble, Line or Area series view’s shadow settings when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public Shadow Shadow => shadow;

		internal PointDrawOptionsBase(PointSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			if (view.Marker == null)
			{
				throw new Exception($"The {view.GetType().Name} series view has no marker.");
			}
			marker = CreateMarkerFromPattern(view.Marker);
			shadow = (Shadow)view.Shadow.Clone();
		}

		internal PointDrawOptionsBase(RadarPointSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			marker = CreateMarkerFromPattern(view.PointMarkerOptions);
			shadow = (Shadow)view.Shadow.Clone();
		}

		protected PointDrawOptionsBase()
		{
		}

		protected MarkerBase CreateMarkerFromPattern(MarkerBase patternMarker)
		{
			MarkerBase markerBase = (MarkerBase)patternMarker.Clone();
			if (patternMarker.FillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Empty)
			{
				IChartAppearance actualAppearance = CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(patternMarker);
				if (actualAppearance != null)
				{
					markerBase.FillStyle.Assign(actualAppearance.MarkerAppearance.FillStyle);
				}
			}
			return markerBase;
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateInstance()
		{
			return new PointDrawOptionsBase();
		}

		protected override void Assign(object obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PointDrawOptionsBase pointDrawOptionsBase)
			{
				marker = (MarkerBase)pointDrawOptionsBase.marker.Clone();
				shadow = (Shadow)pointDrawOptionsBase.shadow.Clone();
			}
		}
	}
	public class RangeAreaDrawOptions : AreaDrawOptions
	{
		private Marker marker1;

		private Marker marker2;

		private CustomBorder border1;

		private CustomBorder border2;

		private bool marker1Visible;

		private bool marker2Visible;

		[Description("Provides access to the settings of first markers for the Range Area series view when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public Marker Marker1 => marker1;

		[Description("Provides access to the settings of second markers for the Range Area series view when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public Marker Marker2 => marker2;

		[Description("Provides access to the settings of the first border for the Range Area series view, when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public CustomBorder Border1 => border1;

		[Description("Provides access to the settings of the second border for the Range Area series view when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public CustomBorder Border2 => border2;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the first marker is visible in the Range Area Chart when implementing a custom draw.")]
		public bool Marker1Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return marker1Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				marker1Visible = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the second marker is visible in the Range Area Chart when implementing a custom draw.")]
		public bool Marker2Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return marker2Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				marker2Visible = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public new Marker Marker => null;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public new CustomBorder Border => null;

		internal RangeAreaDrawOptions(RangeAreaSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			Initialize(view);
		}

		internal RangeAreaDrawOptions(RadarRangeAreaSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			Initialize(view);
		}

		protected RangeAreaDrawOptions()
		{
		}

		private void Initialize(IRangeAreaSeriesView view)
		{
			marker1 = (Marker)CreateMarkerFromPattern(view.Marker1);
			marker2 = (Marker)CreateMarkerFromPattern(view.Marker2);
			if (view.Border1 != null)
			{
				border1 = (CustomBorder)view.Border1.Clone();
			}
			if (view.Border2 != null)
			{
				border2 = (CustomBorder)view.Border2.Clone();
			}
			marker1Visible = view.ActualMarker1Visible;
			marker2Visible = view.ActualMarker2Visible;
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateInstance()
		{
			return new RangeAreaDrawOptions();
		}

		protected override void Assign(object obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions)
			{
				marker1 = (Marker)rangeAreaDrawOptions.marker1.Clone();
				marker2 = (Marker)rangeAreaDrawOptions.marker2.Clone();
				if (rangeAreaDrawOptions.Border1 != null)
				{
					border1 = (CustomBorder)rangeAreaDrawOptions.border1.Clone();
				}
				if (rangeAreaDrawOptions.Border2 != null)
				{
					border2 = (CustomBorder)rangeAreaDrawOptions.border2.Clone();
				}
				marker1Visible = rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker1Visible;
				marker2Visible = rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker2Visible;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(SeriesViewBase view, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex, bool forceMarkerVisible = false)
		{
			base.Initialize(view, points, pointIndex, forceMarkerVisible: false);
			if (forceMarkerVisible)
			{
				marker1Visible = true;
				marker2Visible = true;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class NotificationBase : MultilineTitle
	{
		private static readonly DXFont initialFont = DefaultFonts.Tahoma12;

		protected override bool DefaultVisible => true;

		protected override bool DefaultAntialiasing => true;

		protected override DXFont InitialFont => initialFont;

		protected internal override Color ActualTextColor
		{
			get
			{
				Color result = base.TextColor;
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (base.Owner is DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
				{
					return GraphicUtils.XorColor(chart.ActualBackColor);
				}
				return Color.Empty;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public new bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Visible;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		protected NotificationBase(ChartElement obj)
			: base(obj, initialFont)
		{
		}
	}

	public class DataSourceBasedErrorBars : ErrorBars, IDataSourceIndicator
	{
		private string negativeErrorDataMember;

		private string positiveErrorDataMember;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public override string IndicatorName => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.IndDataSourceBasedErrorBars);

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the data field which contains negative error values of an indicator for generated series points.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataSourceBasedErrorBars.NegativeErrorDataMember")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.IndicatorDataMemberEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string NegativeErrorDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return negativeErrorDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != negativeErrorDataMember)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					negativeErrorDataMember = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: false, resetSeriesBinding: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the data field which contains positive error values of an indicator for generated series points.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataSourceBasedErrorBars.PositiveErrorDataMember")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.IndicatorDataMemberEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string PositiveErrorDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return positiveErrorDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != positiveErrorDataMember)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					positiveErrorDataMember = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: false, resetSeriesBinding: true);
				}
			}
		}

		IList<string> IDataSourceIndicator.ValueDataMembers => new string[2] { NegativeErrorDataMember, PositiveErrorDataMember };

		public DataSourceBasedErrorBars(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		public DataSourceBasedErrorBars()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeNegativeErrorDataMember() && !ShouldSerializePositiveErrorDataMember())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeNegativeErrorDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(NegativeErrorDataMember);
		}

		private void ResetNegativeErrorDataMember()
		{
			NegativeErrorDataMember = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePositiveErrorDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PositiveErrorDataMember);
		}

		private void ResetPositiveErrorDataMember()
		{
			PositiveErrorDataMember = null;
		}

		IIndicatorDataPoint IDataSourceIndicator.CreatePoint(double[] values)
		{
			return new IndicatorDataPointCore(values);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DataSourceBasedErrorBars();
		}

		protected override IndicatorBehavior CreateBehavior()
		{
			return new DataSourceBasedErrorBarsBehavior(this);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DataSourceBasedErrorBars dataSourceBasedErrorBars)
			{
				negativeErrorDataMember = dataSourceBasedErrorBars.negativeErrorDataMember;
				positiveErrorDataMember = dataSourceBasedErrorBars.positiveErrorDataMember;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ErrorBars : Indicator, IAffectsAxisRange
	{
		private const ErrorBarEndStyle DefaultEndStyle = ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap;

		private const ErrorBarDirection DefaultDirection = ErrorBarDirection.Both;

		private ErrorBarEndStyle endStyle;

		private ErrorBarDirection direction;

		private ErrorBarsBehavior ErrorBarsBehavior => (ErrorBarsBehavior)base.IndicatorBehavior;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public override string IndicatorName => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.IndErrorBars);

		[Description("Gets or sets the style of the error bar end.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ErrorBars.EndStyle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ErrorBarEndStyle EndStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return endStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != endStyle)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					endStyle = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the error bar direction.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ErrorBars.Direction")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ErrorBarDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != direction)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					base.IndicatorBehavior.ResetLinePointsByType();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAffectsAxisRange.AxisYData => ((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)base.Owner).ActualAxisY;

		public ErrorBars(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		public ErrorBars()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		MinMaxValues IAffectsAxisRange.GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			return ErrorBarsBehavior.GetFilteredMinMaxY(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEndStyle()
		{
			return endStyle != ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap;
		}

		private void ResetEndStyle()
		{
			EndStyle = ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != ErrorBarDirection.Both;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			Direction = ErrorBarDirection.Both;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeEndStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "EndStyle"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Direction")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeDirection();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeEndStyle();
		}

		protected override IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series owningSeries, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new ErrorBarIndicatorPointToStringConverter(owningSeries, crosshairShowInLegend);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ErrorBars errorBars)
			{
				direction = errorBars.direction;
				endStyle = errorBars.endStyle;
			}
		}
	}
