	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartCollectionSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.IndicatorCollection")]
	public class IndicatorCollection : ChartElementNamedCollection, IEnumerable<Indicator>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<IDataSourceIndicator> dataSourceIndicators = new List<IDataSourceIndicator>();

		protected override string NamePrefix => string.Empty;

		internal List<IDataSourceIndicator> DataSourceIndicators => dataSourceIndicators;

		internal XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase View => (XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)base.Owner;

		public Indicator this[int index] => (Indicator)base.List[index];

		public Indicator this[string name] => (Indicator)GetElementByName(name);

		internal IndicatorCollection(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<Indicator>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<Indicator> IEnumerable<Indicator>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (Indicator)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private IRefinedSeries FindRefinedSeries()
		{
			if (View == null || !(View.Owner is Series) || View.Chart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return View.Chart.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(View.Series);
		}

		private void AddDataSourceIndicator(Indicator indicator)
		{
			if (indicator is IDataSourceIndicator item)
			{
				dataSourceIndicators.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsertComplete(index, value);
			if (value is Indicator indicator)
			{
				indicator.RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(indicator));
				if (indicator is IDataSourceIndicator)
				{
					indicator.RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: false, resetSeriesBinding: true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInsert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is Indicator indicator))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectIndicator));
			}
			if (!View.Loading)
			{
				indicator.ValidateValueLevel(View);
			}
			AddDataSourceIndicator(indicator);
			base.OnInsert(index, value);
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value is IDataSourceIndicator item)
			{
				dataSourceIndicators.Remove(item);
			}
			if (value is Indicator indicator)
			{
				indicator.RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(indicator));
			}
			base.OnRemove(index, value);
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			dataSourceIndicators.Clear();
			base.OnClear();
		}

		internal void BindToChart()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Indicator indicator = (Indicator)enumerator.Current;
					indicator.BindToChart();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public new Indicator[] ToArray()
		{
			return (Indicator[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(Indicator));
		}

		public int Add(Indicator indicator)
		{
			return Add((ChartElement)indicator);
		}

		public void AddRange(Indicator[] coll)
		{
			foreach (Indicator item in coll)
			{
				Add((ChartElement)item);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Indicator indicator)
		{
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)indicator);
		}

		public void Remove(Indicator indicator)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)indicator);
		}

		public void Swap(Indicator indicator1, Indicator indicator2)
		{
			Swap((ChartElement)indicator1, (ChartElement)indicator2);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Indicator indicator)
		{
			return IndexOf((ChartElement)indicator);
		}

		public bool Contains(Indicator indicator)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)indicator);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = View;
			if (view == null)
			{
				base.Assign(collection);
				return;
			}
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			Clear();
			foreach (Indicator item in collection)
			{
				try
				{
					item.Validate(view, FindRefinedSeries());
					Indicator indicator2 = (Indicator)item.Clone();
					base.InnerList.Add(indicator2);
					AddDataSourceIndicator(indicator2);
					ChangeOwnerForItem(indicator2);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class BollingerBands : Indicator, IAffectsAxisRange
	{
		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Close;

		private const int DefaultPointsCount = 20;

		private const double DefaultStandardDeviationMultiplier = 2.0;

		private static readonly Color DefaultBandsColor = Color.Empty;

		private ValueLevel valueLevel = ValueLevel.Close;

		private int pointsCount = 20;

		private Color bandsColor = DefaultBandsColor;

		private double standardDeviationMultiplier = 2.0;

		private readonly LineStyle bandsLineStyle;

		private BollingerBandsBehavior BollingerBandsBehavior => (BollingerBandsBehavior)base.IndicatorBehavior;

		protected override int StartIndex => PointsCount - 1;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public override string IndicatorName => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.IndBollingerBands);

		[Description("Gets or sets the number of data points used to calculate the indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BollingerBands.PointsCount")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return pointsCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pointsCount)
				{
					if (value < 2)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPointsCount));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointsCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(this));
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the value specifying which series point value should be used to calculate the indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BollingerBands.ValueLevel")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return valueLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != valueLevel)
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						base.View?.CheckValueLevel(value);
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					valueLevel = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the color of the bands of the indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BollingerBands.BandsColor")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color BandsColor
		{
			get
			{
				return bandsColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != bandsColor)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bandsColor = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the style of the bands of the indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BollingerBands.BandsLineStyle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public LineStyle BandsLineStyle => bandsLineStyle;

		[Description("Gets or sets the multiplier of the standard deviation used to plot this indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BollingerBands.StandardDeviationMultiplier")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double StandardDeviationMultiplier
		{
			get
			{
				return standardDeviationMultiplier;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != (double)pointsCount)
				{
					if (value <= 0.0 || double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("The StandardDeviationMultiplier property value should be greater than 0.");
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					standardDeviationMultiplier = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAffectsAxisRange.AxisYData => ((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)base.Owner).ActualAxisY;

		public BollingerBands()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public BollingerBands(string name)
			: this(name, ValueLevel.Close)
		{
		}

		public BollingerBands(string name, ValueLevel valueLevel)
			: base(name)
		{
			this.valueLevel = valueLevel;
			bandsLineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antialiasing: true, DashStyle.Solid);
		}

		MinMaxValues IAffectsAxisRange.GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			return BollingerBandsBehavior.GetFilteredMinMaxY(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePointsCount()
		{
			return pointsCount != 20;
		}

		private void ResetPointsCount()
		{
			PointsCount = 20;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueLevel()
		{
			return valueLevel != ValueLevel.Close;
		}

		private void ResetValueLevel()
		{
			ValueLevel = ValueLevel.Close;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBandsColor()
		{
			return bandsColor != DefaultBandsColor;
		}

		private void ResetBandsColor()
		{
			BandsColor = DefaultBandsColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBandsLineStyle()
		{
			return bandsLineStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStandardDeviationMultiplier()
		{
			return standardDeviationMultiplier != 2.0;
		}

		private void ResetStandardDeviationMultiplier()
		{
			StandardDeviationMultiplier = 2.0;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"PointsCount" => ShouldSerializePointsCount(), 
				"ValueLevel" => ShouldSerializeValueLevel(), 
				"BandsColor" => ShouldSerializeBandsColor(), 
				"BandsLineStyle" => ShouldSerializeBandsLineStyle(), 
				"StandardDeviationMultiplier" => ShouldSerializeStandardDeviationMultiplier(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BollingerBands();
		}

		protected override IndicatorBehavior CreateBehavior()
		{
			return new BollingerBandsBehavior(this);
		}

		protected override IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series owningSeries, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new MovingAverageIndicatorPointToStringConverter(owningSeries, crosshairShowInLegend, MovingAverageKindInternal.MovingAverageAndEnvelope);
		}

		protected internal override void ValidateValueLevel(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			valueLevel = view.GetCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BollingerBands bollingerBands)
			{

				pointsCount = bollingerBands.pointsCount;
				standardDeviationMultiplier = bollingerBands.standardDeviationMultiplier;
				valueLevel = bollingerBands.valueLevel;
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum MovingAverageKind
	{
		MovingAverage,
		Envelope,
		MovingAverageAndEnvelope
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(MovingAverageTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class MovingAverage : SubsetBasedIndicator
	{
		private const MovingAverageKind DefaultKind = MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage;

		private const double DefaultEnvelopePercent = 3.0;

		private static readonly Color DefaultEnvelopeColor = Color.Empty;

		private MovingAverageKind kind;

		private double envelopePercent = 3.0;

		private Color envelopeColor = DefaultEnvelopeColor;

		private LineStyle envelopeLineStyle;

		[Description("Determines whether to display a Moving Average, Envelope, or both.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.MovingAverage.Kind")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public MovingAverageKind Kind
		{
			get
			{
				return kind;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != kind)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					kind = value;
					base.IndicatorBehavior.ResetLinePointsByType();
					RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(this));
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the percent for the Envelope kind of the Moving Average and Envelope technical indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.MovingAverage.EnvelopePercent")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double EnvelopePercent
		{
			get
			{
				return envelopePercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != envelopePercent)
				{
					if (value <= 0.0 || value > 100.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectEnvelopePercent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					envelopePercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(this));
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the color for the Envelope kind of the Moving Average and Envelope technical indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.MovingAverage.EnvelopeColor")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color EnvelopeColor
		{
			get
			{
				return envelopeColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != envelopeColor)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					envelopeColor = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the line style for the Envelope kind of the Moving Average and Envelope technical indicator.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.MovingAverage.EnvelopeLineStyle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public LineStyle EnvelopeLineStyle => envelopeLineStyle;

		public MovingAverage(string name, ValueLevel valueLevel)
			: base(name, valueLevel)
		{
			InitializeEnvelopeLineStyle();
		}

		public MovingAverage(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
			InitializeEnvelopeLineStyle();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeKind()
		{
			return kind != MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage;
		}

		private void ResetKind()
		{
			Kind = MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEnvelopePercent()
		{
			return envelopePercent != 3.0;
		}

		private void ResetEnvelopePercent()
		{
			EnvelopePercent = 3.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEnvelopeColor()
		{
			return envelopeColor != DefaultEnvelopeColor;
		}

		private void ResetEnvelopeColor()
		{
			EnvelopeColor = DefaultEnvelopeColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEnvelopeLineStyle()
		{
			return envelopeLineStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Kind" => ShouldSerializeKind(), 
				"EnvelopePercent" => ShouldSerializeEnvelopePercent(), 
				"EnvelopeColor" => ShouldSerializeEnvelopeColor(), 
				"EnvelopeLineStyle" => ShouldSerializeEnvelopeLineStyle(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private void InitializeEnvelopeLineStyle()
		{
			envelopeLineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antialiasing: true, DashStyle.Solid);
		}

		protected override IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series owningSeries, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new MovingAverageIndicatorPointToStringConverter(owningSeries, crosshairShowInLegend, (MovingAverageKindInternal)Kind);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is MovingAverage movingAverage)
			{
				kind = movingAverage.kind;
				envelopePercent = movingAverage.envelopePercent;
				envelopeColor = movingAverage.envelopeColor;
				envelopeLineStyle.Assign(movingAverage.envelopeLineStyle);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeparatePaneIndicator : Indicator, ISeparatePaneIndicator, IAffectsAxisRange
	{
		private string paneName;

		private string axisYName;

		private Axis2D actualAxisY;

		private XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane;

		private SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior => (SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior)base.IndicatorBehavior;

		protected override IPane CrosshairPane => ActualPane;

		protected override IAxisData AxisYData => ActualAxisY;

		protected internal Axis2D ActualAxisY
		{
			get
			{
				if (actualAxisY != null)
				{
					return actualAxisY;
				}
				return GetXYDiagram()?.ActualAxisY;
			}
			set
			{
				actualAxisY = value;
				if (actualAxisY != null)
				{
					AxisYName = actualAxisY.Name;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal XYDiagramPaneBase ActualPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (actualPane != null)
				{
					return actualPane;
				}
				return GetXYDiagram()?.DefaultPane;
			}
			set
			{
				actualPane = value;
				if (actualPane != null)
				{
					PaneName = actualPane.Name;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string PaneName
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = ActualPane;
				if (xYDiagramPaneBase == null)
				{
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
					if (xYDiagram != null)
					{
						return xYDiagram.DefaultPane.Name;
					}
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return xYDiagramPaneBase.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				paneName = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string AxisYName
		{
			get
			{
				Axis2D axis2D = ActualAxisY;
				if (axis2D == null)
				{
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
					if (xYDiagram != null)
					{
						return xYDiagram.ActualAxisY.Name;
					}
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return axis2D.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				axisYName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the pane, used to plot the separate pane indicator on an XYDiagram.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeparatePaneIndicator.Pane")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.PaneTypeEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public XYDiagramPaneBase Pane
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualPane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != ActualPane)
				{
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
					if (xYDiagram != null && value != xYDiagram.DefaultPane && !xYDiagram.Panes.Contains(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectIndicatorPane));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					PropertyUpdateInfo changeInfo = new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Pane");
					ActualPane = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(changeInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the Y-axis that is used to plot the current indicator on a XYDiagram.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeparatePaneIndicator.AxisY")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(AxisTypeConverter))]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.SeriesViewAxisYTypeEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public Axis2D AxisY
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualAxisY;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != ActualAxisY)
				{
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
					if (xYDiagram != null && value != xYDiagram.ActualAxisY && !xYDiagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY.ContainsInternal(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectIndicatorAxisY));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData> changeInfo = new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(this, "AxisY", ActualAxisY, value);
					ActualAxisY = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(changeInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		IPane ISeparatePaneIndicator.Pane => ActualPane;

		IAxisData IAffectsAxisRange.AxisYData => ActualAxisY;

		protected SeparatePaneIndicator(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		MinMaxValues IAffectsAxisRange.GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			return SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior.GetFilteredMinMaxY(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePaneName()
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = ActualPane;
			if (xYDiagramPaneBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				return xYDiagramPaneBase != xYDiagram.DefaultPane;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisYName()
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = ActualAxisY;
			if (axis2D == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				return axis2D != xYDiagram.ActualAxisY;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePane()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisY()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetPane()
		{
			Pane = null;
		}

		private void ResetAxisY()
		{
			AxisY = null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializePaneName() && !ShouldSerializeAxisYName())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "PaneName")
			{
				return ShouldSerializePaneName();
			}
			if (propertyName == "AxisYName")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAxisYName();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected internal override void BindToChart()
		{
			base.BindToChart();
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				if (paneName != null)
				{
					ActualPane = xYDiagram.FindPaneByName(paneName) ?? xYDiagram.DefaultPane;
				}
				if (axisYName != null)
				{
					ActualAxisY = xYDiagram.FindAxisYByName(axisYName) ?? xYDiagram.ActualAxisY;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ActualPane = null;
				ActualAxisY = null;
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
			{
				paneName = separatePaneIndicator.paneName;
				axisYName = separatePaneIndicator.axisYName;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class FinancialIndicatorCollection : ChartElementNamedCollection, IEnumerable, ICollection, IList
	{
		private class FinancialIIndicatorEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly IList collection;

			private readonly Type financialIndicatorType;

			private int position;

			private object current;

			public object Current => current;

			public FinancialIIndicatorEnumerator(IList collection, Type financialIndicatorType)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
				this.financialIndicatorType = financialIndicatorType;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				position = -1;
				current = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				int count = collection.Count;
				while (++position < count)
				{
					current = collection[position];
					if (financialIndicatorType.IsAssignableFrom(current.GetType()))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				current = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private IndicatorCollection actualCollection;

		protected IndicatorCollection ActualCollection => actualCollection;

		protected abstract Type IndicatorType { get; }

		int ICollection.Count
		{
			get
			{
				Type indicatorType = IndicatorType;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (Indicator item in actualCollection)
				{
					if (indicatorType.IsAssignableFrom(item.GetType()))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)actualCollection).IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)actualCollection).SyncRoot;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return actualCollection[index];
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => ((IList)actualCollection).IsReadOnly;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => ((IList)actualCollection).IsFixedSize;

		protected FinancialIndicatorCollection(FinancialIndicators financialIndicators)
			: base(financialIndicators)
		{
			actualCollection = financialIndicators.View.Indicators;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new FinancialIIndicatorEnumerator(actualCollection, IndicatorType);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)actualCollection).CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			return ((IList)actualCollection).Add(value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			((IList)actualCollection).Insert(index, value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			((IList)actualCollection).Remove(value);
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(IndicatorTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class Indicator : ChartElementNamed, ISupportInitialize, IXtraSerializable, IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue, IHitTest, ICheckableLegendItem, ILegendItem, IIndicator, ISupportID
	{
		private const bool DefaultCheckedInLegend = true;

		private const bool DefaultCheckableInLegend = true;

		private const bool DefaultShowInLegend = false;

		private const bool DefaultVisible = true;

		private const DefaultBoolean DefaultCrosshairEnabled = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private const DefaultBoolean DefaultCrosshairLabelVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private const CrosshairContentShowMode DefaultCrosshairContentShowMode = CrosshairContentShowMode.Default;

		private static readonly Color DefaultColor = Color.Empty;

		private readonly HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private readonly LineStyle lineStyle;

		private Color color = DefaultColor;

		private bool visible = true;

		private bool showInLegend;

		private IndicatorBehavior indicatorBehavior;

		private bool loading;

		private bool checkedInLegend = true;

		private bool checkableInLegend = true;

		private string legendName;

		private string legendText;

		private Legend legend;

		private IndicatorAnimationBase animation;

		private TextOptions crosshairTextOptions;

		private DefaultBoolean crosshairEnabled = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private DefaultBoolean crosshairLabelVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private string crosshairLabelPattern;

		private CrosshairContentShowMode crosshairContentShowMode = CrosshairContentShowMode.Default;

		private string crosshairEmptyValueLegendText;

		private int id = -1;

		private bool UseTemplateHit
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = View;
				if (view == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (view.Owner is Series series)
				{
					return series.UseTemplateHit;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private Indicator TemplateIndicator
		{
			get
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart == null)
				{
					return this;
				}
				if (chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)
				{
					return xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.Indicators[View.Indicators.IndexOf(this)];
				}
				return this;
			}
		}

		private bool CanUseAnimation
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartContainer != null)
				{
					return ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WinControl;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasPoints => indicatorBehavior.HasPoints;

		private bool CrosshairShowInLegend => crosshairContentShowMode == CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend;

		internal bool ShouldDrawInCrosshair
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualCrosshairEnabled && ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
				{
					return HasPoints;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal Legend ActualLegend
		{
			get
			{
				if (Legend != null)
				{
					return Legend;
				}
				return View?.Chart?.Legend;
			}
		}

		internal Series OwningSeries => base.Owner.Owner as Series;

		internal HitTestController HitTestController => View.Chart.HitTestController;

		internal IndicatorBehavior IndicatorBehavior => indicatorBehavior;

		internal bool ActualCrosshairLabelVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)CrosshairLabelVisibility != 2)
				{
					return (int)CrosshairLabelVisibility == 0;
				}
				if (base.Chart == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Chart.CrosshairOptions.ShowCrosshairLabels;
			}
		}

		internal bool ActualCrosshairContentShowInLabel
		{
			get
			{
				switch (crosshairContentShowMode)
				{
				case CrosshairContentShowMode.Label:
					return true;
				case CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend:
					return false;
				default:
					if (base.Chart != null)
					{
						return base.Chart.CrosshairOptions.ContentShowMode != CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ActualCrosshairEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (base.Chart != null)
				{
					return base.Chart.GetActualCrosshairEnabledForElement(CrosshairEnabled);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal int MaxLinePointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasPoints || OwningSeries == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return OwningSeries.ActualSeriesPoints.Count - StartIndex;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int StartIndex => 0;

		protected virtual IPane CrosshairPane => View.ActualPane;

		protected virtual IAxisData AxisYData => View.ActualAxisY;

		protected virtual bool IsStraightLine => false;

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return base.Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartContainer == null || OwningSeries == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible && checkableInLegend)
				{
					if (OwningSeries.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
					{
						return checkedInLegend;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (visible)
				{
					return OwningSeries.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool CanAnimate
		{
			get
			{
				if (Animation != null)
				{
					return Animation.CanAnimate;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

				if (value != crosshairEmptyValueLegendText)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					crosshairEmptyValueLegendText = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsCompatibleSeries(Type indicatorType, Series series)
		{
			ISeriesView view = series.View;
			if (typeof(AverageTrueRange).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return AverageTrueRangeCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(ChaikinsVolatility).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return ChaikinsVolatilityCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(CommodityChannelIndex).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return CommodityChannelIndexCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(MassIndex).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return MassIndexCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(WilliamsR).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return WilliamsRCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(MedianPrice).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return MedianPriceCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(TypicalPrice).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return TypicalPriceCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(WeightedClose).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return WeightedCloseCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			if (typeof(ErrorBars).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return ErrorBarsCalculator.IsCompatible(view);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected Indicator(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			lineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antialiasing: true, DashStyle.Solid);
			crosshairTextOptions = new TextOptions(this);
			UpdateBehavior();
			SetAnimation(GetDefaultAnimation());
		}

		Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> IIndicator.GetValuesByIndex(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			return indicatorBehavior.CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(index, cursorArgument, cursorValue);
		}

		double IIndicator.GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			if (indicatorBehavior.PointsCount <= index)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return indicatorBehavior.GetArgumentByIndex(index, cursorValue, cursorArgument);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Name" => ShouldSerializeName(), 
				"TypeNameSerializable" => true, 
				"LineStyle" => ShouldSerializeLineStyle(), 
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"CheckedInLegend" => ShouldSerializeCheckedInLegend(), 
				"ShowInLegend" => ShouldSerializeShowInLegend(), 
				"CheckableInLegend" => ShouldSerializeCheckableInLegend(), 
				"LegendName" => ShouldSerializeLegendName(), 
				"Animation" => ShouldSerializeAnimation(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		object IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue.Create(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.Item.Name == "Animation"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		private object XtraCreateAnimation(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		private void SetAnimation(IndicatorAnimationBase newAnimation)
		{
			newAnimation.Owner = this;
			if (AnimationHelper.ShouldAssignNewAnimation(ChartContainer, animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				newAnimation.Assign(animation);
			}
			animation = newAnimation;
		}

		private IndicatorAnimationBase GetDefaultAnimation()
		{
			return new IndicatorUnwindAnimation();
		}

		private IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverter()
		{
			return CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(OwningSeries, CrosshairShowInLegend);
		}

		protected abstract IndicatorBehavior CreateBehavior();

		protected void UpdateBehavior()
		{
			indicatorBehavior = CreateBehavior();
		}

		protected XYDiagram2D GetXYDiagram()
		{
			if (View == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return View.GetXYDiagram();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BindToChart()
		{
			if (View != null && View.Chart != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(legendName))
			{
				legend = View.Chart.FindLegendByName(legendName);
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Legend"));
			}
			RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(this));
		}

		protected internal virtual void Validate(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void ValidateValueLevel(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
		}

		protected virtual IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series owningSeries, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new IndicatorPointToStringConverter(owningSeries, crosshairShowInLegend);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Indicator indicator)
			{
				legendText = indicator.legendText;
				lineStyle.Assign(indicator.lineStyle);
				color = indicator.color;
				visible = indicator.visible;
				showInLegend = indicator.showInLegend;
				checkedInLegend = indicator.checkedInLegend;
				checkableInLegend = indicator.checkableInLegend;
				legendName = indicator.LegendName;
				animation = (IndicatorAnimationBase)indicator.animation.Clone();
				animation.Assign(indicator.animation);
				crosshairTextOptions = indicator.crosshairTextOptions;
				crosshairEnabled = indicator.crosshairEnabled;
				crosshairLabelVisibility = indicator.crosshairLabelVisibility;
				crosshairLabelPattern = indicator.crosshairLabelPattern;
				crosshairContentShowMode = indicator.crosshairContentShowMode;
				crosshairEmptyValueLegendText = indicator.crosshairEmptyValueLegendText;
				id = indicator.id;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SingleLevelIndicator : Indicator
	{
		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;

		private ValueLevel valueLevel;

		[Description("Specifies the value level to which the single-level indicator corresponds.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SingleLevelIndicator.ValueLevel")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return valueLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != valueLevel)
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						base.View?.CheckValueLevel(value);
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					valueLevel = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected SingleLevelIndicator(string name, ValueLevel valueLevel)
			: base(name)
		{
			this.valueLevel = valueLevel;
		}

		protected SingleLevelIndicator(string name)
			: this(name, ValueLevel.Value)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueLevel()
		{
			return valueLevel != ValueLevel.Value;
		}

		private void ResetValueLevel()
		{
			ValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ValueLevel"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeValueLevel();
		}

		protected internal override void Validate(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			ValidateValueLevel(view);
		}

		protected internal override void ValidateValueLevel(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			valueLevel = view.GetCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SingleLevelIndicator singleLevelIndicator)
			{
				valueLevel = singleLevelIndicator.valueLevel;
			}
		}
	}

		private Color ActualMarkerColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!markerColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return markerColor;
				}
				return Color.Red;
			}
		}

		private bool ActualMarkerVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (markerVisible.HasValue)
				{
					return markerVisible.Value;
				}
				if (Legend != null)
				{
					if (!Legend.MarkersVisible)
					{
						return Legend.CheckBoxesVisible;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool ActualTextVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (textVisible.HasValue)
				{
					return textVisible.Value;
				}
				if (Legend != null)
				{
					return Legend.TextVisible;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Size ActualMarkerSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (markerSize.HasValue)
				{
					return markerSize.Value;
				}
				if (Legend != null)
				{
					return Legend.MarkerSize;
				}
				return DefaultMarkerSize;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool Disposed { get; private set; }

		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)

					return base.Loading;

				return true;
			}

				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					markerImageSizeMode = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CustomLegendItem.MarkerSize")]

			: this(name, string.Empty)

			: base(name)

			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(null, this);
			markerImage = new ChartImage(this);
			this.text = text;
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			RenderMarker(renderer, bounds);

		private bool ShouldSerializeFont()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeText()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMarkerVisible()
		{
			return markerVisible.HasValue;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTextVisible()
		{
			return textVisible.HasValue;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMarkerColor()
		{
			return markerColor != DefaultMarkerColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTextColor()
		{
			return textColor != DefaultTextColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMarkerImageSizeMode()
		{
			return markerImageSizeMode != ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMarkerSize()
		{
			return markerSize.HasValue;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDXFont()
		{
			return fontController.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMarkerImage()
		{
			return markerImage.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetText()
		{
			Text = string.Empty;
		}

		private void ResetMarkerVisible()
		{
			SetMarkerVisible(null);
		}

		private void ResetTextVisible()
		{
			SetTextVisible(null);
		}

		private void ResetMarkerColor()
		{
			MarkerColor = DefaultMarkerColor;
		}

		private void ResetTextColor()
		{
			TextColor = DefaultTextColor;
		}

		private void ResetMarkerImageSizeMode()
		{
			MarkerImageSizeMode = ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize;
		}

		private void ResetMarkerSize()
		{
			SetMarkerSize(null);
		}

		private void ResetDXFont()
		{
			fontController.Reset();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeTextColor() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerColor() && !ShouldSerializeTextVisible() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerVisible() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerSize() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerImage() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerImageSizeMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDXFont();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Text" => ShouldSerializeText(), 
				"TextColor" => ShouldSerializeTextColor(), 
				"MarkerColor" => ShouldSerializeMarkerColor(), 
				"TextVisible" => ShouldSerializeTextVisible(), 
				"MarkerVisible" => ShouldSerializeMarkerVisible(), 
				"MarkerSize" => ShouldSerializeMarkerSize(), 
				"MarkerImage" => ShouldSerializeMarkerImage(), 
				"MarkerImageSizeMode" => ShouldSerializeMarkerImageSizeMode(), 
				"Font" => false, 
				"DXFont" => ShouldSerializeDXFont(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private void SetMarkerVisible(bool? value)
		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
			markerVisible = value;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		private void SetTextVisible(bool? value)
		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
			textVisible = value;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		private void SetMarkerSize(Size? value)
		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
			markerSize = value;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		private void RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(bounds.Size))
			{
				HitTestController hitTestController = Legend.Chart.HitTestController;
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, Legend, this, new HitRegion(bounds));
				if (markerImage.DXImage != null)
				{
					renderer.DrawImage(markerImage.DXImage, bounds, (DXImageSizeMode)markerImageSizeMode);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, ActualMarkerColor);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CustomLegendItem();
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				markerImage.Dispose();
			}
			Disposed = true;
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is CustomLegendItem customLegendItem)
			{
				text = customLegendItem.text;
				textColor = customLegendItem.textColor;
				markerColor = customLegendItem.markerColor;
				textVisible = customLegendItem.textVisible;
				markerVisible = customLegendItem.markerVisible;
				markerSize = customLegendItem.markerSize;
				markerImage.Assign(customLegendItem.markerImage);
				markerImageSizeMode = customLegendItem.markerImageSizeMode;
				fontController.Assign(customLegendItem.fontController);
				id = customLegendItem.id;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		void IXtraPartlyDeserializable.Deserialize(object rootObject, IXtraPropertyCollection properties)
		{
			SerializationUtils.ConvertFontToDXFont(properties);
		}
	}

					base.List[index] = value;
					ChangeOwnerForItem(value);
				}
			}

			: base(chart)

		IEnumerator<Legend> IEnumerable<Legend>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (Legend)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value is Legend legend)
			{
				Chart.CheckLegends(legend);
			}
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Legend legend = (Legend)enumerator.Current;
					if (legend != null)
					{
						Chart.CheckLegends(legend);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.OnClear();
		}

			return Contains(legend);
		}

		{
			Remove((ChartElement)legend);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Legend legend)
		{
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)legend);
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class LegendItem : ILegendItemData
	{
		private readonly bool markerVisible = true;

		private readonly bool textVisible = true;

		private readonly string text;

		private readonly Color textColor = Color.Black;

		private readonly Color markerColor;

		private readonly DXImage markerImage;

		private Size markerSize = new Size(16, 16);

		private LegendBase legend;

		bool ILegendItemData.DisposeFont => true;

		bool ILegendItemData.MarkerVisible => markerVisible;

		bool ILegendItemData.TextVisible => textVisible;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenText => false;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarker => false;

		string ILegendItemData.Text => text;

		Color ILegendItemData.TextColor => textColor;

		DXImage ILegendItemData.MarkerImage => markerImage;

		ChartImageSizeMode ILegendItemData.MarkerImageSizeMode => ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize;

		Size ILegendItemData.MarkerSize => markerSize;

		ILegendItem ILegendItemData.RepresentedObject => null;

		LegendBase ILegendItemData.Legend => legend;

		DXFont ILegendItemData.Font => legend.DXFont;

		public LegendItem(string text, Color markerColor, Color textColor, Size markerSize, bool markerVisible, bool textVisible)
		{
			this.textColor = textColor;
			this.text = text;
			this.markerColor = markerColor;
			this.markerSize = markerSize;
			this.markerVisible = markerVisible;
			this.textVisible = textVisible;
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, markerColor);
		}

		internal void SetLegend(LegendBase legend)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is LegendItem legendItem))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Equals(text, legendItem.text))
			{
				return markerColor.Equals(legendItem.markerColor);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, Color>(text, markerColor);
		}
	}

		internal void AssignInternal(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is IAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions)
			{
				allowStagger = axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowStagger;
				allowRotate = axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowRotate;
				allowHide = axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide;
				minIndent = axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.MinIndent;
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			AssignInternal(obj);
		}
	}

		{

				return MeasureUnitInternal;
			}

			{
				if (!Loading && base.Axis != null && base.Axis is AxisYBase)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgMeasureUnitCanNotBeSetForAxisY));
				}
				if (!Loading && base.Axis != null && (base.Axis.ActualDateTimeScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous || base.Axis.ActualDateTimeScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDateTimeMeasureUnitPropertyUsing));
				}
				if (value != measureUnit)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if ((int)GridAlignment < (int)value || (!Loading && measureUnit == (DateTimeMeasureUnit)GridAlignment))
					{
						gridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)value;
					}
					ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit>(measureUnit, value);
					measureUnit = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "MeasureUnit"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					if (base.Axis != null)
					{
						base.Axis.ResetAutoProperty();
					}
					OnScaleChange(null, measureUnitChange, null, null, null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal DateTimeScaleOptions(AxisBase owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			workdaysOptions = new WorkdaysOptions(this);
			workTimeRules = new WorkTimeRuleCollection(this);
			measureUnit = DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day;
			measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
			gridAlignment = DateTimeGridAlignment.Week;
			intervalOptions = new DateTimeIntervalOptions(this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"MeasureUnit" => ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit(), 
				"MeasureUnitMultiplier" => ShouldSerializeMeasureUnitMultiplier(), 
				"GridAlignment" => ShouldSerializeGridAlignment(), 
				"WorkdaysOnly" => ShouldSerializeWorkdaysOnly(), 
				"WorkTimeOnly" => ShouldSerializeWorkTimeOnly(), 
				"WorkdaysOptions" => ShouldSerializeWorkdaysOptions(), 
				"WorkTimeRules" => ShouldSerializeWorkTimeRules(), 
				"AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator" => false, 
				"GridLayoutMode" => ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode(), 
				"SkipRangesWithoutPoints" => ShouldSerializeSkipRangesWithoutPoints(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "WorkTimeRules"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new WorkTimeRule();
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "WorkTimeRules")
			{
				WorkTimeRules.Add((WorkTimeRule)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridAlignment()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAutoGrid() && gridAlignment != DateTimeGridAlignment.Week)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Automatic;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetGridAlignment()
		{
			GridAlignment = DateTimeGridAlignment.Week;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (measureUnit != DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetMeasureUnit()
		{
			MeasureUnit = DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMeasureUnitMultiplier()
		{
			if (measureUnitMultiplier != 1)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetMeasureUnitMultiplier()
		{
			MeasureUnitMultiplier = 1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWorkdaysOnly()
		{
			return workdaysOnly;
		}

		private void ResetWorkdaysOnly()
		{
			WorkdaysOnly = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWorkTimeOnly()
		{
			return workTimeOnly;
		}

		private void ResetWorkTimeOnly()
		{
			WorkTimeOnly = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWorkdaysOptions()
		{
			return workdaysOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWorkTimeRules()
		{
			return workTimeRules.Count > 0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode()
		{
			return gridLayoutMode != GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;
		}

		private void ResetGridLayoutMode()
		{
			gridLayoutMode = GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSkipRangesWithoutPoints()
		{
			return SkipRangesWithoutPoints;
		}

		private void ResetSkipRangesWithoutPoints()
		{
			SkipRangesWithoutPoints = false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit() && !ShouldSerializeMeasureUnitMultiplier() && !ShouldSerializeGridAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeWorkdaysOnly() && !ShouldSerializeWorkdaysOptions() && !ShouldSerializeWorkTimeOnly() && !ShouldSerializeWorkTimeRules() && !ShouldSerializeSkipRangesWithoutPoints())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode();
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IDateTimeScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative desiredUnit, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative desiredAlignment, double spacing)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0025: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = null;
			bool result = false;
			if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic && autoMeasureUnit != desiredUnit)
			{
				measureUnitChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit>((DateTimeMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit, (DateTimeMeasureUnit)desiredUnit);
				autoMeasureUnit = desiredUnit;
				result = true;
			}
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual && (int)measureUnit > (int)desiredAlignment)
				{
					desiredAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)measureUnit;
					spacing = 1.0;
				}
				if (autoGridAlignment != desiredAlignment || autoGridSpacing != spacing)
				{
					gridAlignmentChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment>((DateTimeGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment, (DateTimeGridAlignment)desiredAlignment);
					gridSpacingChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(autoGridSpacing, spacing);
					autoGridAlignment = desiredAlignment;
					autoGridSpacing = spacing;
				}
				if (base.AutoGrid && base.GridSpacingInternal != autoGridSpacing)
				{
					base.GridSpacingInternal = autoGridSpacing;
				}
			}
			OnScaleChange(null, measureUnitChange, null, gridAlignmentChange, gridSpacingChange);
			return result;
		}

		void IDateTimeScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticGrid(DateTimeGridAlignmentNative selectedAlignment, double selectedSpacing)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			DateTimeGridAlignmentNative dateTimeGridAlignmentNative = (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)GetActualMeasureUnit();
			if (selectedAlignment < dateTimeGridAlignmentNative || (selectedAlignment == dateTimeGridAlignmentNative && selectedSpacing < (double)MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal))
			{
				selectedAlignment = dateTimeGridAlignmentNative;
				selectedSpacing = MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal;
			}
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment && (selectedAlignment != (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)GridAlignment || selectedSpacing != base.GridSpacingInternal))
			{
				double gridSpacingInternal = base.GridSpacingInternal;
				autoGridSpacing = selectedSpacing;
				ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = ((gridSpacingInternal != selectedSpacing) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(gridSpacingInternal, selectedSpacing) : null);
				DateTimeGridAlignment dateTimeGridAlignment = GridAlignment;
				autoGridAlignment = selectedAlignment;
				PushAutomaticGridToProperties();
				ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange = ((dateTimeGridAlignment != GridAlignment) ? new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment>(dateTimeGridAlignment, GridAlignment) : null);
				OnScaleChange(null, null, null, gridAlignmentChange, gridSpacingChange);
			}
		}

		DateTimeMeasureUnitNative IScaleOptionsBase<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative>.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			return (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)automaticMeasureUnitsCalculator.CalculateMeasureUnit(EnumerateSeries(series), axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualMin, visualMax, wholeMin, wholeMax);
		}

		void IDateTimeScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged()
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		private void ValidateGridAlignment(DateTimeGridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
			if (!Loading && base.Axis != null)
			{
				if (base.Axis.ActualDateTimeScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDateTimeGridAlignmentPropertyUsing));
				}
				if (base.Axis.ActualDateTimeScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual && (int)measureUnit > (int)gridAlignment)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDateTimeGridAlignment));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnScaleChange(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> scaleModeChange, ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange, ValueChangeInfo<int> measureUnitMultiplierChange, ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, DateTimeIntervalOptionsChangeInfo intervalOptionsChangeInfo = null)
		{
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (base.Axis != null && (measureUnitChange != null || measureUnitMultiplierChange != null || gridAlignmentChange != null || gridSpacingChange != null || scaleModeChange != null || intervalOptionsChangeInfo != null) && base.Axis.ChartContainer is IChartEventsProvider chartEventsProvider)
			{
				chartEventsProvider.OnAxisScaleChanged(new DateTimeScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, (scaleModeChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode>(base.ScaleMode) : scaleModeChange, (measureUnitChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit>((DateTimeMeasureUnit)GetActualMeasureUnit()) : measureUnitChange, (measureUnitMultiplierChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<int>(MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal) : measureUnitMultiplierChange, (gridAlignmentChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment>((DateTimeGridAlignment)GetActualGridAlignment()) : gridAlignmentChange, (gridSpacingChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(base.GridSpacing) : gridSpacingChange, (intervalOptionsChangeInfo == null) ? new DateTimeIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(IntervalOptions) : intervalOptionsChangeInfo));
			}
		}

		internal DateTimeMeasureUnitNative GetActualMeasureUnit()
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (base.ScaleMode)
			{
			case ScaleMode.Automatic:
				return autoMeasureUnit;
			case ScaleMode.Manual:
			case ScaleMode.Interval:
				return (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)measureUnit;
			default:
				return (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)0;
			}
		}

		internal DateTimeGridAlignmentNative GetActualGridAlignment()
		{
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				return autoGridAlignment;
			}
			return (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)gridAlignment;
		}

		internal void SetMeasureUnitsDirect(DateTimeMeasureUnit measureUnit)
		{
			base.AutoGridInternal = true;
			base.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Manual;
			this.measureUnit = measureUnit;
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		protected override void HandleScaleModeChanged(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> changeInfo)
		{
			if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual)
			{
				measureUnit = DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day;
				measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
				gridAlignment = DateTimeGridAlignment.Week;
				OnScaleChange(changeInfo, null, null, null, null);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleGridSpacingChange(ValueChangeInfo<double> changeInfo)
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, changeInfo);
		}

		protected override void PushAutomaticGridToProperties()
		{
			gridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment;
			if (base.AutoGrid)
			{
				base.GridSpacingInternal = autoGridSpacing;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DateTimeScaleOptions(null);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMeasureUnit()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			measureUnit = (DateTimeMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit;
			measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (sender is WorkTimeRule || sender is TimeInterval)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "WorkTimeRules"));
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessChanged(sender, change);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions)
			{
				workdaysOptions.Assign(dateTimeScaleOptions.workdaysOptions);
				workTimeRules.Assign(dateTimeScaleOptions.workTimeRules);
				gridAlignment = dateTimeScaleOptions.gridAlignment;
				measureUnitMultiplier = dateTimeScaleOptions.measureUnitMultiplier;
				measureUnit = dateTimeScaleOptions.measureUnit;
				workdaysOnly = dateTimeScaleOptions.workdaysOnly;
				workTimeOnly = dateTimeScaleOptions.workTimeOnly;
				autoMeasureUnit = dateTimeScaleOptions.autoMeasureUnit;
				gridLayoutMode = dateTimeScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode;
				intervalOptions.Assign(dateTimeScaleOptions.intervalOptions);
				skipRangesWithoutPoints = dateTimeScaleOptions.skipRangesWithoutPoints;
			}
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null);
		}
	}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeIntervalOptions.UnderflowValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeIntervalOptions.UnderflowValue")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DateTime? UnderflowValue
		{
			get
			{
				return underflowValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(underflowValue == value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> underflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?>(underflowValue, value);
					underflowValue = value;
					OnScaleChanged(underflowValueChange, null);
					RaisePropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeIntervalOptions.OverflowValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeIntervalOptions.OverflowValue")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DateTime? OverflowValue
		{
			get
			{
				return overflowValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(overflowValue == value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> overflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?>(overflowValue, value);
					overflowValue = value;
					OnScaleChanged(null, overflowValueChange);
					RaisePropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private DateTimeIntervalOptions()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal DateTimeIntervalOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private void OnScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> overflowValueChange)
		{
			DateTimeIntervalOptionsChangeInfo intervalOptionsChangeInfo = new DateTimeIntervalOptionsChangeInfo((underflowValueChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?>(underflowValue) : underflowValueChange, (overflowValueChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?>(overflowValue) : overflowValueChange);
			ScaleOptions.OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null, intervalOptionsChangeInfo);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DateTimeIntervalOptions();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeUnderflowValue())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOverflowValue();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DateTimeIntervalOptions dateTimeIntervalOptions)
			{
				underflowValue = dateTimeIntervalOptions.underflowValue;
				overflowValue = dateTimeIntervalOptions.overflowValue;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeUnderflowValue()
		{
			return underflowValue.HasValue;
		}

		private void ResetUnderflowValue()
		{
			underflowValue = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOverflowValue()
		{
			return overflowValue.HasValue;
		}

		private void ResetOverflowValue()
		{
			overflowValue = null;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(NumericScaleOptionsTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions")]
	public sealed class NumericScaleOptions : ScaleOptionsBase, INumericScaleOptions, IScaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport<double>, IScaleOptionsBase<double>, IScaleOptionsBase
	{
		private const NumericMeasureUnit DefaultMeasureUnit = NumericMeasureUnit.Ones;

		private const NumericGridAlignment DefaultGridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Ones;

		private const double DefaultCustomGridAlignment = 1.0;

		private const double DefaultCustomMeasureUnit = 100.0;

		private const NumericStartPoint DefaultGridAlignmentStartPoint = NumericStartPoint.Zero;

		private readonly NumericIntervalOptions intervalOptions;

		private NumericMeasureUnit measureUnit;

		private NumericGridAlignment gridAlignment;

		private NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore;

		private INumericMeasureUnitsCalculator automaticMeasureUnitsCalculator;

		private AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo;

		private bool customGridAlignmentChanged;

		private double customGridAlignment;

		private double customMeasureUnit;

		private double autoMeasureUnit = double.NaN;

		private double oldGridSpacing = double.NaN;

		private NumericStartPoint gridAlignmentStartPoint;

		private NumericAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator aggregationIntervalsCalculator;

		internal NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore == null && base.Axis != null)
				{
					numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore = new NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore(base.Axis);
				}
				return numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore;
			}
		}

		internal NumericAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator AggregationIntervalsCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				if (aggregationIntervalsCalculator == null && base.Axis != null)
				{
					aggregationIntervalsCalculator = new NumericAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator();
				}
				return aggregationIntervalsCalculator;
			}
		}

		internal NumericMeasureUnit MeasureUnitInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Automatic)
				{
					return measureUnit;
				}
				return GetMeasureUnit(autoMeasureUnit);
			}
		}

		protected override ScaleMode DefaultScaleMode => ScaleMode.Continuous;

		protected override GridLayoutModeNative GridLayoutModeInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Interval)
				{
					return base.GridLayoutModeInternal;
				}
				return (GridLayoutModeNative)intervalOptions.GridLayoutMode;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public NumericMeasureUnit MeasureUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return MeasureUnitInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (measureUnit == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				ValidateMeasureUnit(customMeasureUnit);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				ValueChangeInfo<double> gridAlignmentChange = null;
				if (ShouldUpdateGridAlignment(value, customMeasureUnit))
				{
					double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment);
					if (gridAlignment == NumericGridAlignment.Custom)
					{
						customGridAlignment = GetActualMeasureUnit(value, customMeasureUnit);
					}
					else if (value != NumericMeasureUnit.Custom)
					{
						gridAlignment = (NumericGridAlignment)value;
					}
					gridAlignmentChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(actualGridAlignment, GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment));
				}
				ValueChangeInfo<double> measureUnitChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetActualMeasureUnit(measureUnit, customMeasureUnit), GetActualMeasureUnit(value, customMeasureUnit));
				measureUnit = value;
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "MeasureUnit"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
				OnScaleChange(null, measureUnitChange, gridAlignmentChange, null);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignment")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignment")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public NumericGridAlignment GridAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return gridAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (gridAlignment == value && !base.AutoGrid)
				{
					return;
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment);
				bool flag = value == NumericGridAlignment.Custom;
				if (flag && !customGridAlignmentChanged)
				{
					double num = GetActualMeasureUnit(measureUnit, customMeasureUnit);
					if (double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						num = 1.0;
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(actualGridAlignment))
					{
						customGridAlignment = Math.Max(actualGridAlignment, num);
					}
					else
					{
						customGridAlignment = num;
					}
				}
				if (!Loading)
				{
					base.AutoGridInternal = false;
				}
				ValidateGridAlignment(value, customGridAlignment);
				gridAlignment = value;
				customGridAlignmentChanged = flag;
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "GridAlignment"));
				OnScaleChange(null, null, new ValueChangeInfo<double>(actualGridAlignment, GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment)), null);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.CustomGridAlignment")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.CustomGridAlignment")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double CustomGridAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return customGridAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (customGridAlignment != value)
				{
					ValidateGridAlignment(gridAlignment, value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment);
					customGridAlignment = value;
					customGridAlignmentChanged = true;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "GridAlignment"));
					double actualGridAlignment2 = GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment);
					if (actualGridAlignment != actualGridAlignment2)
					{
						OnScaleChange(null, null, new ValueChangeInfo<double>(actualGridAlignment, actualGridAlignment2), null);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignmentStartPoint")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignmentStartPoint")]

				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.CustomMeasureUnit")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.CustomMeasureUnit")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double CustomMeasureUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return customMeasureUnit;
			}
			set
			{
				if (customMeasureUnit != value)
				{
					ValidateMeasureUnit(value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ValueChangeInfo<double> gridAlignmentChange = null;
					if (ShouldUpdateGridAlignment(measureUnit, value))
					{
						double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment);
						gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Custom;
						customGridAlignmentChanged = true;
						customGridAlignment = value;
						gridAlignmentChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(actualGridAlignment, GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment));
					}
					double actualMeasureUnit = GetActualMeasureUnit(measureUnit, customMeasureUnit);
					customMeasureUnit = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "CustomMeasureUnit"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					OnScaleChange(null, new ValueChangeInfo<double>(actualMeasureUnit, GetActualMeasureUnit(measureUnit, customMeasureUnit)), gridAlignmentChange, null);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Gets or sets the automatic numeric measure unit calculator.")]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericScaleOptions.IntervalOptions")]

			gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Ones;
			customMeasureUnit = 100.0;

			intervalOptions = new NumericIntervalOptions(this);
