		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"CustomMeasureUnit" => ShouldSerializeCustomMeasureUnit(), 
				"CustomGridAlignment" => ShouldSerializeCustomGridAlignment(), 
				"GridAlignment" => ShouldSerializeGridAlignment(), 
				"MeasureUnit" => ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit(), 
				"AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator" => false, 
				"GridAlignmentStartPoint" => ShouldSerializeGridAlignmentStartPoint(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridAlignment()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAutoGrid() && gridAlignment != NumericGridAlignment.Ones)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Automatic;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetGridAlignment()
		{
			GridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Ones;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridAlignmentStartPoint()
		{
			return GridAlignmentStartPoint != NumericStartPoint.Zero;
		}

		private void ResetGridAlignmentStartPoint()
		{
			GridAlignmentStartPoint = NumericStartPoint.Zero;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (measureUnit != NumericMeasureUnit.Ones)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetMeasureUnit()
		{
			MeasureUnit = NumericMeasureUnit.Ones;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCustomGridAlignment()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeGridAlignment() && gridAlignment == NumericGridAlignment.Custom)
			{
				return customGridAlignment != 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetCustomGridAlignment()
		{
			CustomGridAlignment = 1.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCustomMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit() && measureUnit == NumericMeasureUnit.Custom)
			{
				return customMeasureUnit != 100.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetCustomMeasureUnit()
		{
			CustomMeasureUnit = 100.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit() && !ShouldSerializeGridAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeCustomGridAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeCustomMeasureUnit() && !ShouldSerializeGridAlignmentStartPoint())
			{
				return intervalOptions.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool INumericScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(double selectedMeasureUnit)
		{
			ValueChangeInfo<double> measureUnitChange = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> gridAlignmentChange = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = null;
			bool result = false;
			double num = autoMeasureUnit;
			autoMeasureUnit = selectedMeasureUnit;
			if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic && num != autoMeasureUnit)
			{
				measureUnitChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(num, autoMeasureUnit);
				result = true;
			}
			if (base.AutoGrid && oldGridSpacing != base.GridSpacing)
			{
				gridSpacingChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(oldGridSpacing, base.GridSpacing);
				oldGridSpacing = base.GridSpacing;
			}
			OnScaleChange(null, measureUnitChange, gridAlignmentChange, gridSpacingChange);
			return result;
		}

		double IScaleOptionsBase<double>.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			return automaticMeasureUnitsCalculator.CalculateMeasureUnit(EnumerateSeries(series), axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualMin, visualMax, wholeMin, wholeMax);
		}

		void INumericScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged()
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null);
		}

		private double GetActualMeasureUnit()
		{
			return GetActualMeasureUnit(MeasureUnit, CustomMeasureUnit);
		}

		private double GetActualGridAlignment()
		{
			return GetActualGridAlignment(GridAlignment, CustomGridAlignment);
		}

		private double GetActualMeasureUnit(NumericMeasureUnit measureUnit, double customMeasureUnit)
		{
			if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual || base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Interval)
			{
				return measureUnit switch
				{
					NumericMeasureUnit.Ones => 1.0, 
					NumericMeasureUnit.Tens => 10.0, 
					NumericMeasureUnit.Hundreds => 100.0, 
					NumericMeasureUnit.Thousands => 1000.0, 
					NumericMeasureUnit.Millions => 1000000.0, 
					NumericMeasureUnit.Billions => 1000000000.0, 
					_ => customMeasureUnit, 
				};
			}
			return autoMeasureUnit;
		}

		private double GetActualGridAlignment(NumericGridAlignment gridAlignment, double customGridAlignment)
		{
			if (!base.AutoGridInternal)
			{
				switch (gridAlignment)
				{
				case NumericGridAlignment.Ones:
					return 1.0;
				case NumericGridAlignment.Tens:
					return 10.0;
				case NumericGridAlignment.Hundreds:
					return 100.0;
				case NumericGridAlignment.Thousands:
					return 1000.0;
				case NumericGridAlignment.Millions:
					return 1000000.0;
				case NumericGridAlignment.Billions:
					return 1000000000.0;
				case NumericGridAlignment.Custom:
					return customGridAlignment;
				}
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		private NumericMeasureUnit GetMeasureUnit(double actualMeasureUnit)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(actualMeasureUnit, 10.0));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Ones;
			}
			switch (num)
			{
			case 0:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Ones;
			case 1:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Tens;
			case 2:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Hundreds;
			case 3:
			case 4:
			case 5:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Thousands;
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Millions;
			case 9:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Billions;
			default:
				return NumericMeasureUnit.Billions;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldUpdateGridAlignment(NumericMeasureUnit measureUnit, double customMeasureUnit)
		{
			double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment();
			double actualMeasureUnit = GetActualMeasureUnit(measureUnit, customMeasureUnit);
			if (!base.AutoGrid)
			{
				if (!(actualGridAlignment < actualMeasureUnit))
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						return GetActualMeasureUnit() == actualGridAlignment;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ValidateGridAlignment(NumericGridAlignment gridAlignment, double customGridAlignment)
		{
			if (customGridAlignment <= 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNumericGridAlignment));
			}
			double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment(gridAlignment, customGridAlignment);
			double actualMeasureUnit = GetActualMeasureUnit();
			if (!Loading)
			{
				if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNumericGridAlignmentPropertyUsing));
				}
				if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual && !base.AutoGrid && actualMeasureUnit > actualGridAlignment)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNumericGridAlignment));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateMeasureUnit(double customMeasureUnit)
		{
			if (customMeasureUnit <= 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNumericMeasureUnit));
			}
			if (!Loading && (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous || base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNumericMeasureUnitPropertyUsing));
			}
		}

		internal void OnScaleChange(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> scaleModeChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> measureUnitChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridAlignmentChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo intervalOptionsChangeInfo = null)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && (measureUnitChange != null || gridAlignmentChange != null || gridSpacingChange != null || scaleModeChange != null) && base.Axis.ChartContainer is IChartEventsProvider chartEventsProvider)
			{
				NumericScaleChangedEventArgs e = new NumericScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, (scaleModeChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode>(base.ScaleMode) : scaleModeChange, (measureUnitChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetActualMeasureUnit()) : measureUnitChange, (gridAlignmentChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetActualGridAlignment()) : gridAlignmentChange, (gridSpacingChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(base.GridSpacing) : gridSpacingChange, (intervalOptionsChangeInfo == null) ? new NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(intervalOptions) : intervalOptionsChangeInfo);
				chartEventsProvider.OnAxisScaleChanged(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleGridSpacingChange(ValueChangeInfo<double> changeInfo)
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, changeInfo);
		}

		protected override void HandleScaleModeChanged(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> changeInfo)
		{
			OnScaleChange(changeInfo, null, null, null);
		}

		protected override void PushAutomaticGridToProperties()
		{
			double actualGridAlignment = GetActualGridAlignment();
			if (actualGridAlignment == 1.0)
			{
				gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Ones;
				return;
			}
			if (actualGridAlignment == 10.0)
			{
				gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Tens;
				return;
			}
			if (actualGridAlignment == 100.0)
			{
				gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Hundreds;
				return;
			}
			if (actualGridAlignment == 1000.0)
			{
				gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Thousands;
				return;
			}
			if (actualGridAlignment == 1000000.0)
			{
				gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Millions;
				return;
			}
			if (actualGridAlignment == 1000000000.0)
			{
				gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Billions;
				return;
			}
			customGridAlignment = actualGridAlignment;
			gridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Custom;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new NumericScaleOptions(null);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMeasureUnit()
		{
			measureUnit = GetMeasureUnit(autoMeasureUnit);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is NumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions)
			{
				gridAlignment = numericScaleOptions.gridAlignment;
				measureUnit = numericScaleOptions.measureUnit;
				customGridAlignment = numericScaleOptions.customGridAlignment;
				customMeasureUnit = numericScaleOptions.customMeasureUnit;
				intervalOptions.Assign(numericScaleOptions.IntervalOptions);
			}
		}
	}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStyle()

		private void ResetStyle()
		{
			Style = ScaleBreakStyle.Ragged;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return color != DefaultColor;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = DefaultColor;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeSizeInPixels() && !ShouldSerializeStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeColor();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ScaleBreakOptions(null);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ScaleBreakOptions))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions = (ScaleBreakOptions)obj;
			if (scaleBreakOptions.style == style && scaleBreakOptions.color == color)
			{
				return scaleBreakOptions.sizeInPixels == sizeInPixels;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, Color, int>((int)style, color, sizeInPixels);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions)
			{
				sizeInPixels = scaleBreakOptions.sizeInPixels;
				style = scaleBreakOptions.style;
				color = scaleBreakOptions.color;
			}
		}
	}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpanMeasureUnit MeasureUnit
		{
			get
			{
				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				return MeasureUnitInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading && base.Axis != null && base.Axis is AxisYBase)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgMeasureUnitCanNotBeSetForAxisY));
				}
				if (!Loading && base.Axis != null && (base.Axis.ActualTimeSpanScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous || base.Axis.ActualTimeSpanScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTimeSpanMeasureUnitPropertyUsing));
				}
				if (value != measureUnit)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if ((int)GridAlignment < (int)value || (!Loading && measureUnit == (TimeSpanMeasureUnit)GridAlignment))
					{
						gridAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignment)value;
					}
					ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit>(measureUnit, value);
					measureUnit = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "MeasureUnit"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					if (base.Axis != null)
					{
						base.Axis.ResetAutoProperty();
					}
					OnScaleChange(null, measureUnitChange, null, null, null);
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int MeasureUnitMultiplier
		{
			get
			{
				ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				return MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading && base.Axis != null && base.Axis is AxisYBase)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgMeasureUnitMultiplierCanNotBeSetForAxisY));
				}
				if (!Loading && base.Axis != null && base.Axis.ActualTimeSpanScaleMode != ScaleMode.Manual)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTimeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplierPropertyUsing));
				}
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTimeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplierValue));
				}
				if (value != measureUnitMultiplier)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ValueChangeInfo<int> measureUnitMultiplierChange = new ValueChangeInfo<int>(measureUnitMultiplier, value);
					measureUnitMultiplier = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "MeasureUnitMultiplier"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					if (base.Axis != null)
					{
						base.Axis.ResetAutoProperty();
					}
					OnScaleChange(null, null, measureUnitMultiplierChange, null, null);
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanScaleOptions.GridAlignment")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanScaleOptions.GridAlignment")]

		[XtraSerializableProperty]

					RaiseControlChanging();
					base.AutoGridInternal = false;
					ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment>(gridAlignment, value);
					gridAlignment = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "GridAlignment"));
					OnScaleChange(null, null, null, gridAlignmentChange, null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal TimeSpanScaleOptions(AxisBase owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			measureUnit = TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Second;
			measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
			gridAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Minute;
			intervalOptions = new TimeSpanIntervalOptions(this);
		}

		bool ITimeSpanScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative desiredUnit, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative desiredAlignment, double spacing)
		{
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = null;
			bool result = false;
			if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic && autoMeasureUnit != desiredUnit)
			{
				measureUnitChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit>((TimeSpanMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit, (TimeSpanMeasureUnit)desiredUnit);
				autoMeasureUnit = desiredUnit;
				result = true;
			}
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual && (int)measureUnit > (int)desiredAlignment)
				{
					desiredAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)measureUnit;
					spacing = 1.0;
				}
				if (autoGridAlignment != desiredAlignment || autoGridSpacing != spacing)
				{
					gridAlignmentChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment>((TimeSpanGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment, (TimeSpanGridAlignment)desiredAlignment);
					gridSpacingChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(autoGridSpacing, spacing);
					autoGridAlignment = desiredAlignment;
					autoGridSpacing = spacing;
				}
				if (base.AutoGrid && base.GridSpacingInternal != autoGridSpacing)
				{
					base.GridSpacingInternal = autoGridSpacing;
				}
			}
			OnScaleChange(null, measureUnitChange, null, gridAlignmentChange, gridSpacingChange);
			return result;
		}

		void ITimeSpanScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticGrid(TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative selectedAlignment, double selectedSpacing)
		{
			TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative actualMeasureUnit = (TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)GetActualMeasureUnit();
			if (selectedAlignment < actualMeasureUnit || (selectedAlignment == actualMeasureUnit && selectedSpacing < (double)MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal))
			{
				selectedAlignment = actualMeasureUnit;
				selectedSpacing = MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal;
			}
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment && (selectedAlignment != (TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)GridAlignment || selectedSpacing != base.GridSpacingInternal))
			{
				double gridSpacingInternal = base.GridSpacingInternal;
				autoGridSpacing = selectedSpacing;
				ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = ((gridSpacingInternal != selectedSpacing) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(gridSpacingInternal, selectedSpacing) : null);
				TimeSpanGridAlignment timeSpanGridAlignment = GridAlignment;
				autoGridAlignment = selectedAlignment;
				PushAutomaticGridToProperties();
				ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange = ((timeSpanGridAlignment != GridAlignment) ? new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment>(timeSpanGridAlignment, GridAlignment) : null);
				OnScaleChange(null, null, null, gridAlignmentChange, gridSpacingChange);
			}
		}

		TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative IScaleOptionsBase<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative>.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			return (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)automaticMeasureUnitsCalculator.CalculateMeasureUnit(EnumerateSeries(series), axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualMin, visualMax, wholeMin, wholeMax);
		}

		void ITimeSpanScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged()
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridAlignment()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAutoGrid() && gridAlignment != TimeSpanGridAlignment.Minute)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Automatic;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetGridAlignment()
		{
			GridAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Minute;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (measureUnit != TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Second)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetMeasureUnit()
		{
			MeasureUnit = TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Second;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMeasureUnitMultiplier()
		{
			if (measureUnitMultiplier != 1)
			{
				return base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetMeasureUnitMultiplier()
		{
			MeasureUnitMultiplier = 1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode()
		{
			return gridLayoutMode != GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;
		}

		private void ResetGridLayoutMode()
		{
			gridLayoutMode = GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIntervalOptions()
		{
			return intervalOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMeasureUnit() && !ShouldSerializeMeasureUnitMultiplier() && !ShouldSerializeGridAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIntervalOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ValidateGridAlignment(TimeSpanGridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
			if (!Loading && base.Axis != null)
			{
				if (base.Axis.ActualTimeSpanScaleMode == ScaleMode.Automatic)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTimeSpanGridAlignmentPropertyUsing));
				}
				if (base.Axis.ActualTimeSpanScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual && (int)measureUnit > (int)gridAlignment)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTimeSpanGridAlignment));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnScaleChange(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> scaleModeChange, ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange, ValueChangeInfo<int> measureUnitMultiplierChange, ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, TimeSpanIntervalOptionsChangeInfo intervalOptionsChangeInfo = null)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && (measureUnitChange != null || measureUnitMultiplierChange != null || gridAlignmentChange != null || gridSpacingChange != null || scaleModeChange != null || intervalOptionsChangeInfo != null) && base.Axis.ChartContainer is IChartEventsProvider chartEventsProvider)
			{
				chartEventsProvider.OnAxisScaleChanged(new TimeSpanScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, (scaleModeChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode>(base.ScaleMode) : scaleModeChange, (measureUnitChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit>((TimeSpanMeasureUnit)GetActualMeasureUnit()) : measureUnitChange, (measureUnitMultiplierChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<int>(MeasureUnitMultiplierInternal) : measureUnitMultiplierChange, (gridAlignmentChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment>((TimeSpanGridAlignment)GetActualGridAlignment()) : gridAlignmentChange, (gridSpacingChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(base.GridSpacing) : gridSpacingChange, (intervalOptionsChangeInfo == null) ? new TimeSpanIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(IntervalOptions) : intervalOptionsChangeInfo));
			}
		}

		internal TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative GetActualMeasureUnit()
		{
			switch (base.ScaleMode)
			{
			case ScaleMode.Automatic:
				return autoMeasureUnit;
			case ScaleMode.Manual:
			case ScaleMode.Interval:
				return (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)measureUnit;
			default:
				return TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond;
			}
		}

		internal TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative GetActualGridAlignment()
		{
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				return autoGridAlignment;
			}
			return (TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)gridAlignment;
		}

		internal void SetMeasureUnitsDirect(TimeSpanMeasureUnit measureUnit)
		{
			base.AutoGridInternal = true;
			base.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Manual;
			this.measureUnit = measureUnit;
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		protected override void HandleScaleModeChanged(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> changeInfo)
		{
			if (base.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Manual)
			{
				measureUnit = TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Second;
				measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
				gridAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Minute;
				OnScaleChange(changeInfo, null, null, null, null);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleGridSpacingChange(ValueChangeInfo<double> changeInfo)
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, changeInfo);
		}

		protected override void PushAutomaticGridToProperties()
		{
			gridAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment;
			if (base.AutoGrid)
			{
				base.GridSpacingInternal = autoGridSpacing;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new TimeSpanScaleOptions(null);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMeasureUnit()
		{
			measureUnit = (TimeSpanMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit;
			measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is TimeSpanScaleOptions timeSpanScaleOptions)
			{
				gridAlignment = timeSpanScaleOptions.gridAlignment;
				measureUnitMultiplier = timeSpanScaleOptions.measureUnitMultiplier;
				measureUnit = timeSpanScaleOptions.measureUnit;
				autoMeasureUnit = timeSpanScaleOptions.autoMeasureUnit;
				gridLayoutMode = timeSpanScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode;
				intervalOptions.Assign(timeSpanScaleOptions.intervalOptions);
			}
			OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null);
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanIntervalOptions")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public sealed class TimeSpanIntervalOptions : IntervalOptionsBase
	{
		private TimeSpan? underflowValue;

		private TimeSpan? overflowValue;

		private TimeSpanScaleOptions ScaleOptions => (TimeSpanScaleOptions)base.Owner;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanIntervalOptions.UnderflowValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanIntervalOptions.UnderflowValue")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan? UnderflowValue
		{
			get
			{
				return underflowValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(underflowValue == value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> underflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(underflowValue, value);
					underflowValue = value;
					OnScaleChanged(underflowValueChange, null);
					RaisePropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanIntervalOptions.OverflowValue")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TimeSpanIntervalOptions.OverflowValue")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan? OverflowValue
		{
			get
			{
				return overflowValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(overflowValue == value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> overflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(overflowValue, value);
					overflowValue = value;
					OnScaleChanged(null, overflowValueChange);
					RaisePropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private TimeSpanIntervalOptions()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal TimeSpanIntervalOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeUnderflowValue()
		{
			return underflowValue.HasValue;
		}

		private void ResetUnderflowValue()
		{
			underflowValue = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOverflowValue()
		{
			return overflowValue.HasValue;
		}

		private void ResetOverflowValue()
		{
			overflowValue = null;
		}

		private void OnScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> overflowValueChange)
		{
			TimeSpanIntervalOptionsChangeInfo intervalOptionsChangeInfo = new TimeSpanIntervalOptionsChangeInfo((underflowValueChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(underflowValue) : underflowValueChange, (overflowValueChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(overflowValue) : overflowValueChange);
			ScaleOptions.OnScaleChange(null, null, null, null, null, intervalOptionsChangeInfo);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new TimeSpanIntervalOptions();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeUnderflowValue())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOverflowValue();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is TimeSpanIntervalOptions timeSpanIntervalOptions)
			{
				underflowValue = timeSpanIntervalOptions.underflowValue;
				overflowValue = timeSpanIntervalOptions.overflowValue;
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ScaleOptionBaseConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.QualitativeScaleOptions")]
	public class QualitativeScaleOptions : ScaleGridOptionsBase
	{
		private GridLayoutMode gridLayoutMode;

		protected override ScaleMode DefaultScaleMode => ScaleMode.Continuous;

		protected override ScaleMode ScaleModeInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.AggregateFunction == DefaultAggregateFunction)
				{
					return ScaleMode.Continuous;
				}
				return ScaleMode.Manual;
			}
		}

		protected override AggregateFunction DefaultAggregateFunction => AggregateFunction.None;

		protected override GridLayoutModeNative GridLayoutModeInternal => (GridLayoutModeNative)GridLayoutMode;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.QualitativeScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.QualitativeScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public GridLayoutMode GridLayoutMode
		{
			get
			{
				return gridLayoutMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (gridLayoutMode != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					gridLayoutMode = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "GridLayoutMode"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
				}
			}
		}

		internal QualitativeScaleOptions(AxisBase owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode()
		{
			return gridLayoutMode != GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;
		}

		private void ResetGridLayoutMode()
		{
			gridLayoutMode = GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;
		}

		private void OnScaleChange(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> scaleModeChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && (gridSpacingChange != null || scaleModeChange != null) && base.Axis.ChartContainer is IChartEventsProvider chartEventsProvider)
			{
				QualitativeScaleChangedEventArgs e = new QualitativeScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, (scaleModeChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode>(ScaleModeInternal) : scaleModeChange, (gridSpacingChange == null) ? new ValueChangeInfo<double>(base.GridSpacing) : gridSpacingChange);
				chartEventsProvider.OnAxisScaleChanged(e);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new QualitativeScaleOptions(null);
		}

		protected override void HandleGridSpacingChange(ValueChangeInfo<double> changeInfo)
		{
			OnScaleChange(null, changeInfo);
		}

		protected override void PushAutomaticGridToProperties()
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeGridLayoutMode();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public abstract class CustomAggregateFunction : ICustomAggregateFunction
	{
		double[] ICustomAggregateFunction.Calculate(object nativeArgument, IEnumerable<double> values1, IEnumerable<double> values2, IEnumerable<double> values3, IEnumerable<double> values4)
		{
			return Calculate(new GroupInfo(nativeArgument, values1, values2, values3, values4));
		}

		public abstract double[] Calculate(GroupInfo groupInfo);
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public sealed class GroupInfo
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values1;

		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values2;

		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values3;

		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values4;

		private readonly object nativeArgument;

		public object Argument => nativeArgument;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values1 => values1;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values2 => values2;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values3 => values3;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values4 => values4;

		internal GroupInfo(object nativeArgument, IEnumerable<double> values1, IEnumerable<double> values2, IEnumerable<double> values3, IEnumerable<double> values4)
		{
			this.nativeArgument = nativeArgument;
			this.values1 = values1;
			this.values2 = values2;
			this.values3 = values3;
			this.values4 = values4;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ScaleGridOptionsBase : ChartElement, IScaleOptionsBase
	{
		private const bool DefaultAutoGrid = true;

		protected const ProcessMissingPointsMode DefaultProcessMissingPoints = ProcessMissingPointsMode.Skip;

		internal const double DefaultGridSpacing = 1.0;

		internal const double DefaultGridOffset = 0.0;

		internal const GridLayoutMode DefaultGridLayoutMode = GridLayoutMode.GridAndLabelCentered;

		private int? minGridSpacingLength;

		protected double GridOffsetInternal { get; private set; }

		protected double GridSpacingInternal { get; set; }

		protected bool AutoGridInternal { get; set; }

		protected CustomAggregateFunction CustomAggregateFunctionInternal { get; set; }

		protected AggregateFunction AggregateFunctionInternal { get; set; }

		protected ProcessMissingPointsMode ProcessMissingPointsInternal { get; set; }

		protected abstract ScaleMode ScaleModeInternal { get; }

		protected abstract ScaleMode DefaultScaleMode { get; }

		protected abstract AggregateFunction DefaultAggregateFunction { get; }

		protected virtual GridLayoutModeNative GridLayoutModeInternal => GridLayoutModeNative.GridAndLabelCentered;

		protected internal AxisBase Axis => base.Owner as AxisBase;

		protected internal bool IsSmartScale => ScaleModeInternal == ScaleMode.Automatic;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.AutoGrid")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.AutoGrid")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool AutoGrid
		{
			get
			{
				return ValidateAutoGrid(AutoGridInternal);
			}
			set
			{
				if (Axis != null && !Axis.IsGridSpacingSupported)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPolarAxisXGridSpacingChanged));
				}
				if (AutoGridInternal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					AutoGridInternal = value;
					if (!AutoGridInternal && !Loading)
					{
						PushAutomaticGridToProperties();
					}
					if (AutoGridInternal && !Loading && Axis != null)
					{
						Axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: false);
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(Axis, "GridAlignment"));
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.GridSpacing")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.GridSpacing")]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double GridSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return ValidateGridSpacing();
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Axis.IsGridSpacingSupported)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPolarAxisXGridSpacingChanged));
				}
				if (value <= 0.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectGridSpacing));
				}
				if (value != GridSpacingInternal)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					double gridSpacingInternal = GridSpacingInternal;
					GridSpacingInternal = value;
					if (!Loading)
					{
						AutoGridInternal = false;
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(Axis, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly));
					HandleGridSpacingChange(new ValueChangeInfo<double>(gridSpacingInternal, GridSpacingInternal));
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.GridOffset")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.GridOffset")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double GridOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return GridOffsetInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (GridOffsetInternal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					GridOffsetInternal = value;
					if (!Loading)
					{
						AutoGridInternal = false;
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(Axis, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.AggregateFunction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.AggregateFunction")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public AggregateFunction AggregateFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return AggregateFunctionInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (AggregateFunctionInternal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bool flag = AggregateFunctionInternal == AggregateFunction.Histogram || value == AggregateFunction.Histogram;
					AggregateFunctionInternal = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(Axis, "AggregateFunction"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					if (flag && base.Chart != null)
					{
						base.Chart.DataContainer.InvalidateBackCompatibilityAdapters(needResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType: false);
						RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: true, resetSeriesBinding: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the custom aggregate function callback that calculates the aggregated values.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.CustomAggregateFunction")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public CustomAggregateFunction CustomAggregateFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return CustomAggregateFunctionInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CustomAggregateFunctionInternal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					CustomAggregateFunctionInternal = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(Axis, "CustomAggregateFunction"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.MinGridSpacingLength")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleGridOptionsBase.MinGridSpacingLength")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int? MinGridSpacingLength
		{
			get
			{
				return minGridSpacingLength;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectMinGridSpacingLength));
				}
				if (minGridSpacingLength != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					minGridSpacingLength = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		ScaleModeNative IScaleOptionsBase.ScaleMode => (ScaleModeNative)ScaleModeInternal;

		AggregateFunctionNative IScaleOptionsBase.AggregateFunction => (AggregateFunctionNative)AggregateFunctionInternal;

		ProcessMissingPointsModeNative IScaleOptionsBase.ProcessMissingPoints => (ProcessMissingPointsModeNative)ProcessMissingPointsInternal;

		ICustomAggregateFunction IScaleOptionsBase.CustomAggregateFunction => CustomAggregateFunctionInternal;

		bool IScaleOptionsBase.GridSpacingAuto => AutoGrid;

		double IScaleOptionsBase.GridOffset => GridOffset;

		double IScaleOptionsBase.GridSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return GridSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (GridSpacingInternal != value)
				{
					double gridSpacingInternal = GridSpacingInternal;
					GridSpacingInternal = value;
					HandleGridSpacingChange(new ValueChangeInfo<double>(gridSpacingInternal, GridSpacingInternal));
				}
			}
		}

		GridLayoutModeNative IScaleOptionsBase.GridLayoutMode => GridLayoutModeInternal;

		internal ScaleGridOptionsBase(AxisBase owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			GridSpacingInternal = 1.0;
			GridOffsetInternal = 0.0;
			AutoGridInternal = true;
			AggregateFunctionInternal = DefaultAggregateFunction;
			ProcessMissingPointsInternal = ProcessMissingPointsMode.Skip;
			minGridSpacingLength = null;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"AutoGrid" => ShouldSerializeAutoGrid(), 
				"GridSpacing" => ShouldSerializeGridSpacing(), 
				"GridOffset" => ShouldSerializeGridOffset(), 
				"AggregateFunction" => ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction(), 
				"MinGridSpacingLength" => ShouldSerializeMinGridSpacingLength(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridSpacing()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAutoGrid())
			{
				return GridSpacingInternal != 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetGridSpacing()
		{
			GridSpacing = 1.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridOffset()
		{
			return GridOffset != 0.0;
		}

		private void ResetGridOffset()
		{
			GridOffset = 0.0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAutoGrid()
		{
			if (!AutoGridInternal && Axis != null)
			{
				return Axis.IsGridSpacingSupported;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAutoGrid()
		{
			AutoGrid = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction()
		{
			if (ScaleModeInternal != ScaleMode.Continuous)
			{
				return AggregateFunction != DefaultAggregateFunction;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAggregateFunction()
		{
			AggregateFunction = DefaultAggregateFunction;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinGridSpacingLength()
		{
			return minGridSpacingLength.HasValue;
		}

		private void ResetMinGridSpacingLength()
		{
			MinGridSpacingLength = null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAutoGrid() && !ShouldSerializeGridSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeGridOffset() && !ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMinGridSpacingLength();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ValidateAutoGrid(bool value)
		{
			if (Axis == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Axis.GetGridSpacingAutoByUserValue(value);
		}

		private double ValidateGridSpacing()
		{
			if (Axis == null)
			{
				return GridSpacingInternal;
			}
			return Axis.GetGridSpacingByUserValue(GridSpacingInternal);
		}

		protected abstract void HandleGridSpacingChange(ValueChangeInfo<double> changeInfo);

		protected abstract void PushAutomaticGridToProperties();

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ScaleGridOptionsBase scaleGridOptionsBase)
			{
				AutoGridInternal = scaleGridOptionsBase.AutoGridInternal;
				GridSpacingInternal = scaleGridOptionsBase.GridSpacingInternal;
				GridOffsetInternal = scaleGridOptionsBase.GridOffsetInternal;
				AggregateFunctionInternal = scaleGridOptionsBase.AggregateFunctionInternal;
				minGridSpacingLength = scaleGridOptionsBase.minGridSpacingLength;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ScaleOptionsBase : ScaleGridOptionsBase
	{
		private ScaleMode scaleModeInternal;

		protected override AggregateFunction DefaultAggregateFunction => AggregateFunction.Average;

		protected override ScaleMode ScaleModeInternal => scaleModeInternal;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleOptionsBase.ScaleMode")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleOptionsBase.ScaleMode")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ScaleMode ScaleMode
		{
			get
			{
				return ScaleModeInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Axis is AxisY)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgAttemptToSetScaleModeForAxisY));
				}
				if (ScaleModeInternal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if (base.Axis != null && (ScaleModeInternal == ScaleMode.Automatic || value == ScaleMode.Automatic))
					{
						base.Axis.ResetAutoProperty();
					}
					ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> changeInfo = new ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode>(ScaleModeInternal, value);
					if (ScaleModeInternal == ScaleMode.Automatic && value == ScaleMode.Manual)
					{
						ThrowMeasureUnit();
					}
					scaleModeInternal = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "ScaleMode"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					if (!Loading)
					{
						HandleScaleModeChanged(changeInfo);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleOptionsBase.ProcessMissingPoints")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ScaleOptionsBase.ProcessMissingPoints")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ProcessMissingPointsMode ProcessMissingPoints
		{
			get
			{
				return base.ProcessMissingPointsInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Axis != null && base.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgProcessMissingPointsForValueAxis));
				}
				if (ScaleModeInternal == ScaleMode.Continuous && !Loading)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgProcessMissingPointsForContinuousScale));
				}
				if (base.ProcessMissingPointsInternal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					base.ProcessMissingPointsInternal = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Axis, "ProcessMissingPoints"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ScaleOptionsBase(AxisBase owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			scaleModeInternal = DefaultScaleMode;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ScaleMode"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ProcessMissingPoints")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeProcessMissingPoints();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeScaleMode();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeScaleMode()
		{
			return ScaleMode != DefaultScaleMode;
		}

		private void ResetScaleMode()
		{
			ScaleMode = DefaultScaleMode;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeProcessMissingPoints()
		{
			if (ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Continuous)
			{
				return ProcessMissingPoints != ProcessMissingPointsMode.Skip;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetProcessMissingPoints()
		{
			ProcessMissingPoints = ProcessMissingPointsMode.Skip;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeScaleMode() && !ShouldSerializeAutoGrid())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeProcessMissingPoints();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<Series> EnumerateSeries(IEnumerable<ISeries> sourceSeries)
		{
			foreach (ISeries item in sourceSeries)
			{
				yield return (Series)item;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void HandleScaleModeChanged(ValueChangeInfo<ScaleMode> changeInfo);

		protected virtual void ThrowMeasureUnit()
		{
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase)
			{
				scaleModeInternal = scaleOptionsBase.ScaleModeInternal;
				base.CustomAggregateFunctionInternal = scaleOptionsBase.CustomAggregateFunctionInternal;
				base.AggregateFunctionInternal = scaleOptionsBase.AggregateFunctionInternal;
				base.ProcessMissingPointsInternal = scaleOptionsBase.ProcessMissingPointsInternal;
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.IntervalOptionsBase")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class IntervalOptionsBase : ChartElement
	{
		private string pattern;

		private string underflowValuePattern;

		private string overflowValuePattern;

		internal AxisBase Axis => ((ScaleOptionsBase)base.Owner).Axis;

		internal string ActualPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pattern))
				{
					return pattern;
				}
				return PatternUtils.ConstructDefaultIntervalPattern(Axis);
			}
		}

		internal string ActualUnderflowValuePattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(underflowValuePattern))
				{
					return underflowValuePattern;
				}
				return PatternUtils.ConstructDefaultUnderflowPattern(Axis);
			}
		}

		internal string ActualOverflowValuePattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(overflowValuePattern))
				{
					return overflowValuePattern;
				}
				return PatternUtils.ConstructDefaultOverflowPattern(Axis);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.IntervalOptionsBase.Pattern")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.IntervalOptionsBase.Pattern")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.AxisIntervalPatternEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Pattern
		{
			get
			{
				return pattern;
			}

		public DateTime Date
		{
			get
			{
				return date;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != date)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					date = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public KnownDate(Holiday holiday)
			: this(((KnownDateDay)holiday).DisplayName, ((KnownDateDay)holiday).Date)
		{
		}

		public KnownDate()
			: base(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public KnownDate(string name, DateTime date)
			: base(name)
		{
			this.date = date;
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is KnownDate knownDate))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = date.CompareTo(knownDate.date);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return base.Name.CompareTo(knownDate.Name);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDate()
		{
			return date != default(DateTime);
		}

		private void ResetDate()
		{
			Date = default(DateTime);
		}

		{
			return new KnownDate();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Date"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is KnownDate knownDate)
			{
				date = knownDate.Date;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is KnownDate knownDate && base.Equals(knownDate))
			{
				return date == knownDate.date;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return date.ToShortDateString() + " - " + base.Name;
		}
	}

		internal IEnumerable<DateTime> GetDateTimeEnumerable()
		{
			if (sortedList == null)
			{
				sortedList = new List<DateTime>(base.Count);
				foreach (IKnownDate item in base.List)
				{
					DateTime date = item.Date;
					if (!sortedList.Contains(date))
					{
						sortedList.Add(date);
					}
				}
				sortedList.Sort();
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			sortedList = null;
			((WorkdaysOptions)base.Owner).RaiseCollectionChange(this);
		}

		public int Add(KnownDate date)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			int result = Add((ChartElement)date);
			RaiseControlChanged();
			return result;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, KnownDate date)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)date);
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void AddRange(KnownDate[] coll)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void Remove(KnownDate date)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			Remove((ChartElement)date);
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions")]
	public class WorkdaysOptions : ChartElement, IWorkdaysOptions, IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem
	{
		private const Weekday DefaultWorkdays = Weekday.Monday | Weekday.Tuesday | Weekday.Wednesday | Weekday.Thursday | Weekday.Friday;

		private readonly KnownDateCollection holidays;

		private readonly KnownDateCollection exactWorkdays;

		private readonly CustomDateCollection customDays;

		private Weekday workdays = Weekday.Monday | Weekday.Tuesday | Weekday.Wednesday | Weekday.Thursday | Weekday.Friday;

		internal CustomDateCollection CustomDays => customDays;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions.Holidays")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions.Holidays")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.HolidayCollectionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public KnownDateCollection Holidays => holidays;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.HolidayCollectionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public KnownDateCollection ExactWorkdays => exactWorkdays;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions.Workdays")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkdaysOptions.Workdays")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.WorkdaysEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Weekday Workdays
		{
			get
			{
				return workdays;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != workdays)
				{
					if (value == Weekday.None)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUnsupportedWorkdaysForWorkdaysOptions));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					workdays = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo((ScaleOptions != null) ? ((ChartElement)ScaleOptions.Axis) : ((ChartElement)this), "Workdays"));
				}
			}
		}

		private DateTimeScaleOptions ScaleOptions => (DateTimeScaleOptions)base.Owner;

		WeekdayCore IWorkdaysOptions.Workdays => (WeekdayCore)workdays;

		IEnumerable<CustomDate> IWorkdaysOptions.CustomDates => customDays.Dates;

		IEnumerable<DateTime> IWorkdaysOptions.Holidays => holidays.GetDateTimeEnumerable();

		IEnumerable<DateTime> IWorkdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays => exactWorkdays.GetDateTimeEnumerable();

		bool IWorkdaysOptions.WorkdaysOnly => ScaleOptions.WorkdaysOnly;

		DayOfWeek IWorkdaysOptions.FirstDayOfWeek => Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;

		internal WorkdaysOptions(DateTimeScaleOptions owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			holidays = new KnownDateCollection(this);
			exactWorkdays = new KnownDateCollection(this);
			customDays = new CustomDateCollection();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWorkdays()
		{
			return workdays != (Weekday.Monday | Weekday.Tuesday | Weekday.Wednesday | Weekday.Thursday | Weekday.Friday);
		}

		private void ResetWorkdays()
		{
			Workdays = Weekday.Monday | Weekday.Tuesday | Weekday.Wednesday | Weekday.Thursday | Weekday.Friday;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && holidays.Count <= 0 && exactWorkdays.Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeWorkdays();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Workdays"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeWorkdays();
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Holidays") && !(propertyName == "ExactWorkdays"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new KnownDate();
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Holidays"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ExactWorkdays")
				{
					exactWorkdays.Add((KnownDate)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				holidays.Add((KnownDate)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		private void SyncCustomDates()
		{
			customDays.Clear();
			foreach (KnownDate holiday in holidays)
			{
				customDays.SetDate(holiday.Date, isHoliday: true);
			}
			foreach (KnownDate exactWorkday in exactWorkdays)
			{
				customDays.SetDate(exactWorkday.Date, isHoliday: false);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new WorkdaysOptions(null);
		}

		internal void RaiseCollectionChange(KnownDateCollection collection)
		{
			SyncCustomDates();
			if (collection == holidays)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo((ScaleOptions != null) ? ((ChartElement)ScaleOptions.Axis) : ((ChartElement)this), "Holidays"));
			}
			else if (collection == exactWorkdays)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo((ScaleOptions != null) ? ((ChartElement)ScaleOptions.Axis) : ((ChartElement)this), "ExactWorkdays"));
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is WorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
			{
				holidays.Assign(workdaysOptions.holidays);
				exactWorkdays.Assign(workdaysOptions.exactWorkdays);
				workdays = workdaysOptions.workdays;
				SyncCustomDates();
			}
		}

		public void LoadHolidays(string fileName, string location)
		{
			HolidayBaseCollection val = HolidaysLoaderHelper.LoadHolidaysCollection(fileName);
			holidays.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				holidays.Clear();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(location))
				{
					foreach (Holiday item in (DXCollectionBase<Holiday>)(object)val)
					{
						holidays.Add(new KnownDate(item));
					}
					return;
				}
				foreach (Holiday item2 in (DXCollectionBase<Holiday>)(object)val)
				{
					if (item2.Location == location)
					{
						holidays.Add(new KnownDate(item2));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				holidays.EndUpdate();
				SyncCustomDates();
			}
		}

		public void LoadHolidays(string fileName)
		{
			LoadHolidays(fileName, string.Empty);
		}
	}

	public class WorkTimeRule : ChartElement, IWorkTimeRule, IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem
	{
		private const Weekday DefaultWeekdays = Weekday.None;

		private static readonly DateTime? DefaultDate;

		private DateTime? date = DefaultDate;

		private Weekday weekdays;

		private readonly TimeIntervalCollection workIntervals;

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkTimeRule.Date")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkTimeRule.Date")]

		public DateTime? Date
		{
			get
			{
				return date;
			}
			set
			{
				if (date != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					date = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.WorkdaysEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkTimeRule.Weekdays")]

			{
				if (weekdays != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					weekdays = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkTimeRule.WorkIntervals")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WorkTimeRule.WorkIntervals")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public TimeIntervalCollection WorkIntervals => workIntervals;

		WeekdayCore IWorkTimeRule.Weekdays => (WeekdayCore)Weekdays;

		ITimeIntervalCollection IWorkTimeRule.WorkIntervals => WorkIntervals;

		bool IWorkTimeRule.IsActive => true;

		private bool ShouldSerializeDate()
		{
			DateTime? dateTime = date;
			DateTime? defaultDate = DefaultDate;
			if (dateTime.HasValue != defaultDate.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return dateTime.GetValueOrDefault() != defaultDate.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		private void ResetDate()
		{
			Date = DefaultDate;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWeekdays()
		{
			return weekdays != Weekday.None;
		}

		private void ResetWeekdays()
		{
			Weekdays = Weekday.None;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWorkIntervals()
		{
			return workIntervals.Count > 0;
		}

		private void ResetWorkIntervals()
		{
			workIntervals.Clear();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Date" => ShouldSerializeDate(), 
				"Weekdays" => ShouldSerializeWeekdays(), 
				"WorkIntervals" => ShouldSerializeWorkIntervals(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "WorkIntervals"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new TimeInterval();
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "WorkIntervals")
			{
				WorkIntervals.Add((TimeInterval)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		public WorkTimeRule()
		{
			workIntervals = new TimeIntervalCollection(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new WorkTimeRule();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is WorkTimeRule workTimeRule))
			{
				return;
			}
			date = workTimeRule.date;
			weekdays = workTimeRule.weekdays;
			workIntervals.Clear();
			foreach (TimeInterval workInterval in workTimeRule.workIntervals)
			{
				TimeInterval interval = (TimeInterval)workInterval.Clone();
				workIntervals.Add(interval);
			}
		}
	}

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PivotGridDataSourceOptions")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PivotGridDataSourceOptionsTypeConverter))]
	public class PivotGridDataSourceOptions : ChartElement
	{
		private struct DateTimeInterval
		{
			private DateTime start;

			private DateTime end;

			public DateTime Start
			{
				set
				{
					start = value;
				}
			}

			public DateTime End
			{
				set
				{
					end = value;
				}
			}

			public bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (start == DateTime.MinValue)
					{
						return end == DateTime.MinValue;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				start = DateTime.MinValue;
				end = DateTime.MinValue;
			}

			public bool Contains(DateTime dateTime)
			{
				if (dateTime >= start)
				{
					return dateTime <= end;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class DateTimeOptionsProvider : IDateTimeOptions
		{
			private readonly DateTimeFormat format;

			private readonly string formatString;

			DateTimeOptionsFormat IDateTimeOptions.Format => (DateTimeOptionsFormat)format;

			string IDateTimeOptions.FormatString => formatString;

			string IDateTimeOptions.QuarterFormat => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.QuarterFormat);

			{

		private static void UpdateArgumentDateTimeFormat(DateTimeMeasureUnit measurementUnit, Series series)
		{
			string formatString = string.Empty;
			DateTimeFormatUtils.GetDateTimeFormat(measurementUnit, out var format, out formatString);
			if (series.Label != null)
			{
				series.Label.TextPattern = PointOptions.ChangeArgumentDateTimeFormat(series.Label.ActualTextPattern, format, formatString);
				series.LegendTextPattern = PointOptions.ChangeArgumentDateTimeFormat(series.ActualLegendTextPattern, format, formatString);
			}
		}
