		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "AutoBindingSettingsEnabled"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeAutoBindingSettingsEnabled();
		}

		private void AddInterval(DateTime end, ref DateTimeInterval interval)
		{
			interval.End = end;
			axisLabelsIntervals.Add(interval);
			interval.Clear();
		}

		private void SetValueDataMembers()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers.Count; i++)
			{
				DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers[i] = DataSource.ValueDataMember;
			}
		}

		private void SetResolveOverlappingMode(SeriesBase series, ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (series.Label != null)
			{
				series.Label.SetResolveOverlappingMode(series.Label.IsCorrectResolveOverlappingMode(mode) ? mode : ResolveOverlappingMode.None);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateArgumentScaleType()
		{
			if (HasPivotGrid)
			{
				PivotGrid.LockListChanged();
			}
			ScaleType argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			DataContext dataContext = base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataContext;
			if (BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, DataSource, DataSource.ArgumentDataMember, ScaleType.Numerical, DataContainer.CalculatedFields))
			{
				argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			}
			else if (BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, DataSource, DataSource.ArgumentDataMember, ScaleType.DateTime, DataContainer.CalculatedFields))
			{
				argumentScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			}
			else if (BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, DataSource, DataSource.ArgumentDataMember, ScaleType.TimeSpan, DataContainer.CalculatedFields))
			{
				argumentScaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			}
			if (HasPivotGrid)
			{
				PivotGrid.UnlockListChanged();
			}
			DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.SetArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType);
		}

		private void SetAxisTitleText(Axis2D axis, IList<string> columnNames)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < columnNames.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += " ";
				}
				text += columnNames[i];
			}
			axis.Title.Text = text;
		}

		private void UpdateXYDiagram(AxisBase axisX)
		{
			//IL_00b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_014c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0173: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0178: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0187: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0190: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0212: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0194: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0196: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AxisXBase axisXBase = axisX as AxisXBase;
			if (HasPivotGrid)
			{
				axisXBase?.ScaleBreaks.Clear();
				if (PivotGrid.ArgumentColumnNames != null && axisX is Axis2D axis)
				{
					SetAxisTitleText(axis, PivotGrid.ArgumentColumnNames);
				}
				if (PivotGrid.ValueColumnNames != null)
				{
					Axis2D axisY = GetAxisY();
					if (axisY != null)
					{
						SetAxisTitleText(axisY, PivotGrid.ValueColumnNames);
					}
				}
			}
			double sideMarginValue = 0.5;
			if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal == ScaleType.DateTime)
			{
				if (DataSource.DateTimeArgumentMeasureUnit.HasValue)
				{
					DateTimeMeasureUnitNative value = DataSource.DateTimeArgumentMeasureUnit.Value;
					axisX.UpdateMeasurementUnit((DateTimeMeasureUnit)value);
					if (HasPivotGrid && axisXBase != null)
					{
						IDictionary<DateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative> dateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument = PivotGrid.DateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument;
						if (dateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument != null)
						{
							axisXBase.ScaleBreakOptions.Style = ScaleBreakStyle.Straight;
							axisXBase.ScaleBreakOptions.SizeInPixels = -1;
							if (axisX.VisualRange.Auto)
							{
								List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>(dateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument.Keys);
								list.Sort();
								DateTimeInterval interval = default(DateTimeInterval);
								for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
								{
									if (interval.IsEmpty)
									{
										interval.Start = DateTimeUtils.Floor(list[i], value);
									}
									if (i < list.Count - 1)
									{
										DateTimeMeasureUnitNative val = dateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument[list[i]];
										DateTimeMeasureUnitNative val2 = dateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument[list[i + 1]];
										if (val != value || val2 != value)
										{
											DateTime edge = DateTimeUtils.Increase(DateTimeUtils.Floor(list[i], value), value);
											DateTime edge2 = DateTimeUtils.Decrease(DateTimeUtils.Floor(list[i + 1], value), value);
											axisXBase.ScaleBreaks.Add(new ScaleBreak(edge.ToString() + " " + edge2.ToString(), edge, edge2));
											sideMarginValue = 1.0;
											AddInterval(DateTimeUtils.Floor(list[i], value), ref interval);
										}
									}
									else
									{
										AddInterval(list[i], ref interval);
									}
								}
							}
							else
							{
								DateTimeInterval interval2 = new DateTimeInterval
								{
									Start = (DateTime)axisX.VisualRange.MinValue
								};
								AddInterval((DateTime)axisX.VisualRange.MaxValue, ref interval2);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					axisX.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Automatic;
					axisX.DateTimeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.None;
				}
			}
			axisX.SetSideMarginValue(sideMarginValue);
		}

		private void UpdateSimpleSeriesViews()
		{
			//IL_0264: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int visibleInLegendSeriesNumber = GetVisibleInLegendSeriesNumber();
			bool flag = (DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries.Count == 1 || visibleInLegendSeriesNumber > -1) && base.Chart.ActualLegend != null && !base.Chart.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible;
			Legend legend = (Legend)DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ActualLegend;
			if (legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.None || legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.Marker)
			{
				DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.LegendTextPattern = "{A}";
			}
			if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label != null)
			{
				SetPivotGridTextPattern(flag);
			}
			if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
			{
				simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles.Clear();
				simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles.Add(new SeriesTitle());
			}
			if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label is PieSeriesLabel pieSeriesLabel)
			{
				pieSeriesLabel.Position = PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns;
			}
			foreach (Series item in DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries)
			{
				Legend legend2 = (Legend)item.ActualLegend;
				if (legend2.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.None || legend2.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.Marker)
				{
					item.LegendTextPattern = "{A}";
				}
				if (item.Label != null && DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label != null)
				{
					item.Label.TextPattern = DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label.TextPattern;
				}
				if (item.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase2)
				{
					simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase2.Titles.Clear();
					SeriesTitle seriesTitle = new SeriesTitle();
					seriesTitle.Text = item.Name;
					simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase2.Titles.Add(seriesTitle);
				}
				if (item.Label is PieSeriesLabel pieSeriesLabel2)
				{
					pieSeriesLabel2.Position = PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries.Count; i++)
				{
					((Series)DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries[i]).ShowInLegend = i == visibleInLegendSeriesNumber;
				}
			}
			if (base.Chart.ActualLegend != null)
			{
				base.Chart.ActualLegend.Visibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(flag || base.Chart.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible);
			}
		}

		private void SetPivotGridTextPattern(bool isLegendVisible)
		{
			string pivotGridTextPattern = (isLegendVisible ? "{V}" : "{A}: {V}");
			DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label.PivotGridTextPattern = pivotGridTextPattern;
			foreach (Series item in DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries)
			{
				item.Label.PivotGridTextPattern = pivotGridTextPattern;
			}
		}

		private int GetVisibleInLegendSeriesNumber()
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				Series series = (Series)DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < series.ActualPoints.Count; j++)
				{
					bool flag2 = true;
					for (int k = 0; k < DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries.Count; k++)
					{
						if (k != i)
						{
							Series series2 = (Series)DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries[k];
							IDataPoint dataPoint = series.ActualPoints[j];
							IDataPoint dataPoint2 = series2.ActualPoints[j];
							if (series2.ActualPoints.Count != series.ActualPoints.Count || dataPoint.Argument != dataPoint2.Argument)
							{
								return -1;
							}
							if (series.ActualPoints[j].IsEmpty && !series2.ActualPoints[j].IsEmpty)
							{
								flag2 = false;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag && num < 0)
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PivotGridDataSourceOptions(null);
		}

		internal AxisBase GetAxisX()
		{
			if (!(DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX;
		}

		internal Axis2D GetAxisY()
		{
			if (!(DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY;
		}

		internal void CheckData()
		{
			if (!HasPivotGrid)
			{
				return;
			}
			int availableSeriesCount = PivotGrid.AvailableSeriesCount;
			if (availableSeriesCount > DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries.Count && availableSeriesCount > 0)
			{
				PivotGridSeriesExcludedEventArgs e = new PivotGridSeriesExcludedEventArgs(DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries.Count, availableSeriesCount);
				base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider?.OnPivotGridSeriesExcluded(e);
			}
			IDictionary<object, int> availablePointCountInSeries = PivotGrid.AvailablePointCountInSeries;
			if (availablePointCountInSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries)
			{
				object obj = item.Tag;
				if (obj != null && availablePointCountInSeries.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					int num = availablePointCountInSeries[obj];
					if (num > item.ActualPoints.Count && num > 0)
					{
						PivotGridSeriesPointsExcludedEventArgs e2 = new PivotGridSeriesPointsExcludedEventArgs(item, item.ActualPoints.Count, num);
						base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider?.OnPivotGridSeriesPointsExcluded(e2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateDataMembers(bool canUpdateArgumentScaleType)
		{
			if (locker.IsLocked || !HasDataSource || !AutoBindingSettingsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			locker.Lock();
			try
			{
				if (HasPivotGrid && canUpdateArgumentScaleType)
				{
					UpdateArgumentScaleType();
				}
				DataContext dataContext = base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataContext;
				if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View.DateTimeValuesSupported && BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, DataSource, DataSource.ValueDataMember, ScaleType.DateTime, DataContainer.CalculatedFields))
				{
					DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
					SetValueDataMembers();
				}
				if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View.DateTimeValuesSupported && BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, DataSource, DataSource.ValueDataMember, ScaleType.TimeSpan, DataContainer.CalculatedFields))
				{
					DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
					SetValueDataMembers();
				}
				else if (BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, DataSource, DataSource.ValueDataMember, ScaleType.Numerical, DataContainer.CalculatedFields))
				{
					DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
					SetValueDataMembers();
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers.Count; i++)
					{
						DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers[i] = string.Empty;
					}
				}
				base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomizeAutoBindingSettings(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			finally
			{
				locker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAutoBindingSettings()
		{
			if (!locker.IsLocked && HasDataSource && AutoBindingSettingsEnabled)
			{
				locker.Lock();
				try
				{
					UpdateArgumentScaleType();
					base.Chart.DataContainer.SeriesDataMember = DataSource.SeriesDataMember;
					base.Chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember = DataSource.ArgumentDataMember;
					UpdateDataMembers(canUpdateArgumentScaleType: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					locker.Unlock();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAutoLayoutSettings()
		{
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (locker.IsLocked || !HasDataSource || !base.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			locker.Lock();
			try
			{
				axisLabelsIntervals.Clear();
				AxisBase axisX = GetAxisX();
				if (axisX != null)
				{
					UpdateXYDiagram(axisX);
				}
				else if (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
				{
					UpdateSimpleSeriesViews();
				}
				if (DataSource.DateTimeArgumentMeasureUnit.HasValue)
				{
					foreach (Series item in DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries)
					{
						UpdateArgumentDateTimeFormat((DateTimeMeasureUnit)DataSource.DateTimeArgumentMeasureUnit.Value, item);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				locker.Unlock();
			}
			UpdateLegend();
		}

		internal void UpdateXAxisLabels()
		{
			if (locker.IsLocked || !HasDataSource || !base.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			locker.Lock();
			try
			{
				AxisBase axisX = GetAxisX();
				if (axisX == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				SwiftPlotDiagramAxisXBase swiftPlotDiagramAxisXBase = axisX as SwiftPlotDiagramAxisXBase;
				AxisXBase axisXBase = axisX as AxisXBase;
				if (swiftPlotDiagramAxisXBase != null || axisXBase != null)
				{
					bool staggered = axisXBase?.Label.Staggered ?? swiftPlotDiagramAxisXBase.Label.Staggered;
					CustomizeXAxisLabelsEventArgs e = new CustomizeXAxisLabelsEventArgs(axisX, staggered);
					base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnPivotChartingCustomizeXAxisLabels(e);
					if (axisXBase != null)
					{
						axisXBase.Label.Staggered = e.Staggered;
					}
					else
					{
						swiftPlotDiagramAxisXBase.Label.Staggered = e.Staggered;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				locker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAxisLabelItems(AxisBase axis, AxisLabelItemList items)
		{
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0111: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0115: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!HasDataSource || !AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled || GetAxisX() != axis || axisLabelsIntervals.Count == 0 || axis.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime || !DataSource.DateTimeArgumentMeasureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			DateTimeMeasureUnitNative value = DataSource.DateTimeArgumentMeasureUnit.Value;
			IChartDataSource obj = DataSource;
			IPivotGrid val = (IPivotGrid)(object)((obj is IPivotGrid) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AxisLabelItemBase item in items)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)item.AxisValue;
				foreach (DateTimeInterval axisLabelsInterval in axisLabelsIntervals)
				{
					if (axisLabelsInterval.Contains(dateTime))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					foreach (DateTime key in val.DateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument.Keys)
					{
						if (DateTimeUtils.Floor(key, value) == dateTime)
						{
							DateTimeMeasureUnitNative val2 = val.DateTimeMeasureUnitByArgument[key];
							if (val2 != value)
							{
								item.Text = DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetValueText(dateTime, new DateTimeOptionsProvider(val2));
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					item.Text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateByDiagramBounds(Rectangle diagramBounds, IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesDataList)
		{
			if (!HasDataSource || !AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled || DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label == null || !DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label.ResolveOverlappingSupported)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResolveOverlappingMode resolveOverlappingMode = (DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ActualLabelsVisibility ? DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Label.GetResolveOverlappingMode(diagramBounds, seriesDataList) : ResolveOverlappingMode.None);
			CustomizeResolveOverlappingModeEventArgs e = new CustomizeResolveOverlappingModeEventArgs(resolveOverlappingMode);
			base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnPivotChartingCustomizeResolveOverlappingMode(e);
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData in seriesDataList)
			{
				SetResolveOverlappingMode(seriesData.Series, e.ResolveOverlappingMode);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateLegend()
		{
			if (locker.IsLocked || !HasDataSource || !AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled || base.Chart.ActualLegend == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			locker.Lock();
			try
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				LegendAlignmentHorizontal alignmentHorizontal = base.Chart.ActualLegend.AlignmentHorizontal;
				LegendAlignmentVertical alignmentVertical = base.Chart.ActualLegend.AlignmentVertical;
				bool flag = alignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside || alignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside;
				bool flag2 = alignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside || alignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside;
				bool flag3 = alignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.Center && alignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Center;
				if ((flag && flag2) || flag3)
				{
					num = 30.0;
					num2 = 30.0;
				}
				else if (flag || flag2)
				{
					num = (flag2 ? 100 : 30);
					num2 = (flag ? 100 : 30);
				}
				else
				{
					num = ((alignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.Center) ? 30 : 60);
					num2 = ((alignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.Center) ? 60 : 30);
				}
				CustomizeLegendEventArgs e = new CustomizeLegendEventArgs(base.Chart.Legend, num, num2);
				base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnPivotChartingCustomizeLegend(e);
				base.Chart.ActualLegend.MaxHorizontalPercentage = e.MaxHorizontalPercentage;
				base.Chart.ActualLegend.MaxVerticalPercentage = e.MaxVerticalPercentage;
			}
			finally
			{
				locker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(object dataSource, bool isSourceDeleted)
		{
			IChartDataSource val = (IChartDataSource)((dataSource is IChartDataSource) ? dataSource : null);
			if (val == null && this.dataSource != null)
			{
				AxisBase axisX = GetAxisX();
				if (axisX != null)
				{
					axisX.SetSideMarginValue(0.5);
					if (axisX is AxisXBase axisXBase)
					{
						axisXBase.ScaleBreaks.Clear();
					}
				}
				if (!isSourceDeleted && HasPivotGrid)
				{
					PivotGrid.RetrieveDateTimeValuesAsMiddleValues = false;
				}
			}
			this.dataSource = val;
			if (HasPivotGrid)
			{
				PivotGrid.RetrieveDateTimeValuesAsMiddleValues = true;
				bufferSettings.CopyTo(PivotGrid);
			}
			UpdateAutoBindingSettings();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PivotGridDataSourceOptions pivotGridDataSourceOptions)
			{
				dataSource = pivotGridDataSourceOptions.dataSource;
				autoBindingSettingsEnabled = pivotGridDataSourceOptions.autoBindingSettingsEnabled;
				autoLayoutSettingsEnabled = pivotGridDataSourceOptions.autoLayoutSettingsEnabled;
				pivotGridDataSourceOptions.bufferSettings.CopyTo((IPivotGrid)(object)bufferSettings);
			}
		}
	}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridSpacing()
		{
			if (IsManualGrid)
			{
				return gridSpacing != 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSnapSpacing()
		{
			if (IsManualSnap)
			{
				return snapSpacing != 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLabelFormat()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(labelFormat);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridMode()
		{
			return gridMode != ChartRangeControlClientGridMode.Auto;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSnapMode()
		{
			return snapMode != ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Auto;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLabelFormatProvider()
		{
			return labelFormatProvider != null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridOffset()
		{
			if (IsManualGrid)
			{
				return gridOffset != 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSnapOffset()
		{
			if (IsManualSnap)
			{
				return snapOffset != 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetLabelFormat()
		{
			LabelFormat = string.Empty;
		}

		private void ResetGridSpacing()
		{
			GridSpacing = 1.0;
		}

		private void ResetSnapSpacing()
		{
			SnapSpacing = 1.0;
		}

		private void ResetGridMode()
		{
			GridMode = ChartRangeControlClientGridMode.Auto;
		}

		private void ResetSnapMode()
		{
			SnapMode = ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Auto;
		}

		private void ResetLabelFormatProvider()
		{
			LabelFormatProvider = null;
		}

		private void ResetGridOffset()
		{
			GridOffset = 0.0;
		}

		private void ResetSnapOffset()
		{
			SnapOffset = 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeGridMode() && !ShouldSerializeSnapMode() && !ShouldSerializeGridSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeSnapSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeLabelFormat() && !ShouldSerializeLabelFormatProvider() && !ShouldSerializeGridOffset())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSnapOffset();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"GridSpacing" => ShouldSerializeGridSpacing(), 
				"SnapSpacing" => ShouldSerializeSnapSpacing(), 
				"LabelFormat" => ShouldSerializeLabelFormat(), 
				"GridMode" => ShouldSerializeGridMode(), 
				"SnapMode" => ShouldSerializeSnapMode(), 
				"GridOffset" => ShouldSerializeGridOffset(), 
				"SnapOffset" => ShouldSerializeSnapOffset(), 
				"LabelFormatProvider" => false, 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private double GetActualGridOffset()
		{
			if (!IsManualGrid)
			{
				gridOffset = 0.0;
			}
			return gridOffset;
		}

		private double GetActualSnapOffset()
		{
			switch (snapMode)
			{
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Auto:
				snapOffset = GridOffset;
				break;
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.ChartMeasureUnit:
				snapOffset = 0.0;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Snap Mode");
				break;
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Manual:
				break;
			}
			return snapOffset;
		}

		private double GetActualGridSpacing()
		{
			if (gridMode == ChartRangeControlClientGridMode.ChartGrid)
			{
				gridSpacing = ChartGridSpacing;
			}
			return gridSpacing;
		}

		private double GetActualSnapSpacing()
		{
			switch (snapMode)
			{
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Auto:
				snapSpacing = GridSpacing;
				break;
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.ChartMeasureUnit:
				snapSpacing = ChartSnapSpacing;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Snap Mode");
				break;
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Manual:
				break;
			}
			return snapSpacing;
		}

		protected internal abstract void UpdateAutoGridSettings(double refinedWholeRange, double scaleLengthInPixels);

		protected abstract RangeControlClientGridMapping CreateGridMapping();

		protected abstract IFormatProvider CreateDefaultLabelFormatProvider();

		protected void DisableAutoGrid()
		{
			gridMode = ChartRangeControlClientGridMode.Manual;
		}

		protected void DisableAutoSnap()
		{
			snapMode = ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Manual;
		}

		protected void UpdateAutoSpacing(double value)
		{
			gridSpacing = value;
			snapSpacing = SnapSpacing;
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateSpacing(double value, string propertyName)
		{
			if (value <= 0.0)
			{
				string format = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectRangeControlClientSpacing);
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(format, propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateOffset(double value, string propertyName)
		{
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions chartRangeControlClientGridOptions)
			{
				gridMode = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.gridMode;
				snapMode = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.snapMode;
				gridSpacing = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.gridSpacing;
				snapSpacing = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.snapSpacing;
				gridOffset = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.gridOffset;
				snapOffset = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.snapOffset;
				labelFormat = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.labelFormat;
				labelFormatProvider = chartRangeControlClientGridOptions.labelFormatProvider;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions")]
	public class ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions : ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions
	{
		private const TimeSpanGridAlignment DefaultGridAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Millisecond;

		private const TimeSpanGridAlignment DefaultSnapAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Millisecond;

		private TimeSpanGridAlignment gridAlignment;

		private TimeSpanGridAlignment snapAlignment;

		private TimeSpanScaleOptions ScaleOptions => base.Axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions;

		protected override double ChartGridSpacing => ScaleOptions.GridSpacing;

		protected override double ChartSnapSpacing => 1.0;

		protected internal override RangeControlGridUnit GridUnit => new AlignedRangeControlGridUnit<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative>((TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)GridAlignment, base.GridSpacing, CalculateGridStep(), base.GridOffset);

		protected internal override RangeControlGridUnit SnapUnit => new AlignedRangeControlGridUnit<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative>((TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)SnapAlignment, base.SnapSpacing, CalculateSnapStep(), base.SnapOffset);

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions.GridAlignment")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions.GridAlignment")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public TimeSpanGridAlignment GridAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return GetActualGridAlignment();
			}
			set
			{
				if (gridAlignment != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					gridAlignment = value;
					DisableAutoGrid();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions.SnapAlignment")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions.SnapAlignment")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public TimeSpanGridAlignment SnapAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return GetActualSnapAlignment();
			}
			set
			{
				if (snapAlignment != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					snapAlignment = value;
					DisableAutoSnap();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGridAlignment()
		{
			if (base.IsManualGrid)
			{
				return gridAlignment != TimeSpanGridAlignment.Millisecond;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSnapAlignment()
		{
			if (base.IsManualSnap)
			{
				return snapAlignment != TimeSpanGridAlignment.Millisecond;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetGridAlignment()
		{
			GridAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Millisecond;
		}

		private void ResetSnapAlignment()
		{
			SnapAlignment = TimeSpanGridAlignment.Millisecond;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeGridAlignment())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSnapAlignment();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "GridAlignment"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SnapAlignment")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeSnapAlignment();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeGridAlignment();
		}

		private TimeSpanGridAlignment GetActualGridAlignment()
		{
			if (base.GridMode == ChartRangeControlClientGridMode.ChartGrid)
			{
				gridAlignment = ScaleOptions.GridAlignment;
			}
			return gridAlignment;
		}

		private TimeSpanGridAlignment GetActualSnapAlignment()
		{
			switch (base.SnapMode)
			{
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Auto:
				snapAlignment = GridAlignment;
				break;
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.ChartMeasureUnit:
				snapAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignment)ScaleOptions.MeasureUnitInternal;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Snap Mode");
				break;
			case ChartRangeControlClientSnapMode.Manual:
				break;
			}
			return snapAlignment;
		}

		private double CalculateGridStep()
		{
			return base.GridSpacing * DateTimeUtilsExt.MillisecondsInMeasureUnit((DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)GridAlignment);
		}

		private double CalculateSnapStep()
		{
			return base.SnapSpacing * DateTimeUtilsExt.MillisecondsInMeasureUnit((DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)SnapAlignment);
		}

		private void ValidateDoubleValueAsInteger(double value, string propertyName)
		{
			if (Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToInt32(value)) != value)
			{
				string format = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTimeSpanRangeControlClientSpacing);
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(format, propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateAutoGridSettings(double refinedWholeRange, double scaleLengthInPixels)
		{
			double num = MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase.CalculateAutoMeasureUnit(refinedWholeRange, refinedWholeRange, scaleLengthInPixels, 200);
			TimeSpanUnitSelector timeSpanUnitSelector = new TimeSpanUnitSelector();
			UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment gridAlignment = timeSpanUnitSelector.SelectAlignment(num, num);
			this.gridAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignment)gridAlignment.Unit;
			snapAlignment = SnapAlignment;
			UpdateAutoSpacing(gridAlignment.Spacing);
		}

		protected override RangeControlClientGridMapping CreateGridMapping()
		{
			return new TimeSpanRangeControlClientGridMapping();
		}

		protected override IFormatProvider CreateDefaultLabelFormatProvider()
		{
			return new TimeSpanLabelFormatter(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions(null);
		}

		protected override void ValidateSpacing(double value, string propertyName)
		{
			base.ValidateSpacing(value, propertyName);
			ValidateDoubleValueAsInteger(value, propertyName);
		}

		protected override void ValidateOffset(double value, string propertyName)
		{
			base.ValidateOffset(value, propertyName);
			ValidateDoubleValueAsInteger(value, propertyName);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions chartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions)
			{
				gridAlignment = chartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions.gridAlignment;
				snapAlignment = chartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions.snapAlignment;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartRangeControlClientNumericGridOptions")]
	public class ChartRangeControlClientNumericGridOptions : ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions
	{
		private const double minMeasureUnitMagnify = 0.001;

		private INumericScaleOptions ScaleOptions => base.Axis.NumericScaleOptions;

		protected override double ChartGridSpacing => ScaleOptions.GridSpacing * ScaleOptions.GridAlignment;

		protected override double ChartSnapSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				double measureUnit = ScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
				if (!double.IsNaN(measureUnit))
				{
					return measureUnit;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
		}

		protected internal override RangeControlGridUnit GridUnit => GetRangeControlUnit(base.GridSpacing, base.GridOffset);

		protected internal override RangeControlGridUnit SnapUnit => GetRangeControlUnit(ValidateSpacing(base.SnapSpacing), base.SnapOffset);

		public ChartRangeControlClientNumericGridOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private double ValidateSpacing(double spacing)
		{
			base.Axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: false);
			NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore = base.Axis.NumericScaleOptions.NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore;
			if (numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore != null && !double.IsNaN(numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore.MinMeasureUnit))
			{
				return Math.Max(spacing, numericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore.MinMeasureUnit * 0.001);
			}
			return spacing;
		}

		private RangeControlGridUnit GetRangeControlUnit(double spacing, double offset)
		{
			return new RangeControlGridUnit(spacing, spacing, offset);
		}

		protected override RangeControlClientGridMapping CreateGridMapping()
		{
			return new NumericRangeControlClientGridMapping();
		}

		protected override IFormatProvider CreateDefaultLabelFormatProvider()
		{
			return new NumericLabelFormatter();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateAutoGridSettings(double refinedWholeRange, double scaleLengthInPixels)
		{
			double value = GridSpacingCalculator.Calculate(refinedWholeRange, scaleLengthInPixels, 100.0);
			UpdateAutoSpacing(value);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ChartRangeControlClientNumericGridOptions(null);
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	[DebuggerDisplay("({left}; {top}; {right}; {bottom})")]
	public class RectangleIndents : ChartElement
	{
		public const int Undefined = -1;

		private readonly int defaultIndent;

		private WeakReference highDpiScaleProvider;

		private int left;

		private int top;

		private int right;

		private int bottom;

		private new DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart Chart
		{
			get
			{
				if (highDpiScaleProvider != null)
				{
					return (DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart)highDpiScaleProvider.Target;
				}
				for (ChartElement chartElement = base.Owner; chartElement != null; chartElement = chartElement.Owner)
				{
					if (chartElement is DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart result)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning("The RectangleIndents can not be scaled because the Chart is not found among the owners.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		private SizeF HighDpiScaleFactor
		{
			get
			{
				if (Chart == null)
				{
					return new SizeF(1f, 1f);
				}
				return Chart.HighDpiScaleFactor;
			}
		}

		internal RectThickness DpiScaledThickness
		{
			get
			{
				SizeF highDpiScaleFactor = HighDpiScaleFactor;
				int num = ((left > 0) ? MathUtils.StrongRound((float)left * highDpiScaleFactor.Width) : left);
				int num2 = ((top > 0) ? MathUtils.StrongRound((float)top * highDpiScaleFactor.Height) : top);
				int num3 = ((right > 0) ? MathUtils.StrongRound((float)right * highDpiScaleFactor.Width) : right);
				int num4 = ((bottom > 0) ? MathUtils.StrongRound((float)bottom * highDpiScaleFactor.Height) : bottom);
				return new RectThickness(num, num2, num3, num4);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsUndefined
		{
			get
			{
				if (left == -1 && Right == -1 && Top == -1)
				{
					return Bottom == -1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHighDpiScaleProviderSet => highDpiScaleProvider != null;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Left")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Left")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Left
		{
			get
			{
				return left;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = defaultIndent;
				}
				if (value != left)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					left = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Top")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Top")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Top
		{
			get
			{
				return top;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = defaultIndent;
				}
				if (value != top)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					top = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Right")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Right")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Right
		{
			get
			{
				return right;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = defaultIndent;
				}
				if (value != right)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					right = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Bottom")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.Bottom")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = defaultIndent;
				}
				if (value != bottom)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bottom = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.All")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RectangleIndents.All")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public int All
		{
			get
			{
				if (left != top || left != right || left != bottom)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return left;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetLeftTopRightBottom(defaultIndent);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
				else if (value != All)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetLeftTopRightBottom(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal RectangleIndents(ChartElement owner, int defaultIndent, DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart highDpiScaleProvider = null)
			: base(owner)
		{
			if (owner != null && highDpiScaleProvider != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Specify the highDpiScaleProvider in case of null owner only.");
			}
			this.defaultIndent = defaultIndent;
			SetLeftTopRightBottom(defaultIndent);
			if (highDpiScaleProvider != null)
			{
				this.highDpiScaleProvider = new WeakReference(highDpiScaleProvider);
			}
		}

		internal RectangleIndents(ChartElement owner, DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart highDpiScaleProvider = null)
			: this(owner, -1, highDpiScaleProvider)
		{
		}

		internal RectangleIndents(ChartElement owner, bool initDefaults, DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart highDpiScaleProvider = null)
			: this(owner, -1, highDpiScaleProvider)
		{
			if (initDefaults)
			{
				left = 4;
				top = 1;
				right = 4;
				bottom = 1;
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Left" => ShouldSerializeLeft(), 
				"Top" => ShouldSerializeTop(), 
				"Right" => ShouldSerializeRight(), 
				"Bottom" => ShouldSerializeBottom(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLeft()
		{
			return left != defaultIndent;
		}

		private void ResetLeft()
		{
			Left = defaultIndent;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTop()
		{
			return top != defaultIndent;
		}

		private void ResetTop()
		{
			Top = defaultIndent;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRight()
		{
			return right != defaultIndent;
		}

		private void ResetRight()
		{
			Right = defaultIndent;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBottom()
		{
			return bottom != defaultIndent;
		}

		private void ResetBottom()
		{
			Bottom = defaultIndent;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAll()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeLeft() && !ShouldSerializeTop() && !ShouldSerializeRight())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBottom();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ResetAll()
		{
			All = defaultIndent;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeLeft() && !ShouldSerializeTop() && !ShouldSerializeRight())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBottom();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetLeftTopRightBottom(int value)
		{
			SetIndents(value, value, value, value);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RectangleIndents(null, defaultIndent);
		}

		internal Rectangle DecreaseRectangle(Rectangle rect)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			int width = Math.Max(rect.Width - dpiScaledThickness.Left - dpiScaledThickness.Right, 0);
			int height = Math.Max(rect.Height - dpiScaledThickness.Top - dpiScaledThickness.Bottom, 0);
			return new Rectangle(rect.X + dpiScaledThickness.Left, rect.Y + dpiScaledThickness.Top, width, height);
		}

		internal RectangleF DecreaseRectangle(RectangleF rect)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			float width = Math.Max(rect.Width - (float)dpiScaledThickness.Left - (float)dpiScaledThickness.Right, 0f);
			float height = Math.Max(rect.Height - (float)dpiScaledThickness.Top - (float)dpiScaledThickness.Bottom, 0f);
			return new RectangleF(rect.X + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Left, rect.Y + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Top, width, height);
		}

		internal ZPlaneRectangle DecreaseRectangle(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			DiagramPoint point = new DiagramPoint(rect.Location.X + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Left, rect.Location.Y + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Top);
			double width = Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width - (double)dpiScaledThickness.Right - (double)dpiScaledThickness.Left);
			double height = Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height - (double)dpiScaledThickness.Bottom - (double)dpiScaledThickness.Top);
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(point, width, height);
		}

		internal Size IncreaseSize(Size size)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			return new Size(size.Width + dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right, size.Height + dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom);
		}

		internal SizeF IncreaseSizeF(SizeF size)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			return new SizeF(size.Width + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Left + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Right, size.Height + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Top + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Bottom);
		}

		internal GRealSize2D IncreaseSizeF(GRealSize2D size)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			return new GRealSize2D(size.Width + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Left + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Right, size.Height + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Top + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Bottom);
		}

		internal Rectangle IncreaseRectangle(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			return new Rectangle(rectangle.X - dpiScaledThickness.Left, rectangle.Y - dpiScaledThickness.Top, rectangle.Width + dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right, rectangle.Height + dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom);
		}

		internal GRealRect2D IncreaseRectangle(GRealRect2D rectangle)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = DpiScaledThickness;
			return new GRealRect2D(rectangle.Left - (double)dpiScaledThickness.Left, rectangle.Top - (double)dpiScaledThickness.Top, rectangle.Width + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Left + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Right, rectangle.Height + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Top + (double)dpiScaledThickness.Bottom);
		}

		internal void SetIndents(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
		{
			this.left = left;
			this.top = top;
			this.right = right;
			this.bottom = bottom;
		}

		internal void SetHighDpiScaleProvider(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
		{
			highDpiScaleProvider = new WeakReference(chart);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RectangleIndents rectangleIndents)
			{
				left = rectangleIndents.left;
				top = rectangleIndents.top;
				right = rectangleIndents.right;
				bottom = rectangleIndents.bottom;
			}
		}
	}

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class RegressionLines : ChartElement, IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem, IEnumerable<RegressionLine>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<RegressionLine> deserializedLines = new List<RegressionLine>();

		private XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase View => base.Owner as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public RegressionLine this[ValueLevel valueLevel]
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = View;
				if (view == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				foreach (Indicator indicator in view.Indicators)
				{
					if (indicator is RegressionLine regressionLine && regressionLine.ValueLevel == valueLevel)
					{
						return regressionLine;
					}
				}
				RegressionLine regressionLine2 = new RegressionLine(valueLevel);
				regressionLine2.Visible = false;
				view.Indicators.Add(regressionLine2);
				return regressionLine2;
			}
			set
			{
				value.ValueLevel = valueLevel;
				XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = View;
				if (view == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				IndicatorCollection indicators = view.Indicators;
				int count = indicators.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (indicators[i] is RegressionLine regressionLine && regressionLine.ValueLevel == valueLevel)
					{
						indicators.RemoveAt(i);
						indicators.Insert(i, value);
						return;
					}
				}
				indicators.Add(value);
			}
		}

		[NonTestableProperty]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public List<RegressionLine> LinesSerializable => deserializedLines;

		public RegressionLines(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<RegressionLine>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<RegressionLine> IEnumerable<RegressionLine>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = View;
			if (view == null)
			{
				yield return null;
			}
			foreach (Indicator indicator in view.Indicators)
			{
				if (indicator is RegressionLine regressionLine)
				{
					yield return regressionLine;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return false;
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "LinesSerializable")
			{
				deserializedLines.Add((RegressionLine)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName != "LinesSerializable")
			{
				return null;
			}
			RegressionLine regressionLine = new RegressionLine();
			regressionLine.Visible = false;
			return regressionLine;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RegressionLines(null);
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view = View;
			if (view == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RegressionLine deserializedLine in deserializedLines)
			{
				view.Indicators.Add(deserializedLine);
			}
			deserializedLines.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public class FinancialIndicatorPoint : ChartElement
	{
		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;

		private object argument;

		private string argumentSerializable;

		private ValueLevel valueLevel;

		internal FinancialIndicator FinancialIndicator => (FinancialIndicator)base.Owner;

		[Description("Gets or sets an argument of a financial indicator’s point.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FinancialIndicatorPoint.Argument")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(FinancialIndicatorPointArgumentTypeConverter))]
		public object Argument
		{
			get
			{
				return argument;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != argument)
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullFinancialIndicatorArgument));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					argument = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new IndicatorUpdateInfo(FinancialIndicator));
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ArgumentSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return SerializingUtils.ConvertToSerializable(argument);
			}
			set
			{
				Argument = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? null : value);
				if (Loading)
				{
					argumentSerializable = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating how to obtain the value of a financial indicator’s point.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FinancialIndicatorPoint.ValueLevel")]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return valueLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != valueLevel)
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						FinancialIndicator.View?.CheckValueLevel(value);
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					valueLevel = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal FinancialIndicatorPoint(FinancialIndicator financialIndicator)
			: base(financialIndicator)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueLevel()
		{
			return valueLevel != ValueLevel.Value;
		}

		private void ResetValueLevel()
		{
			ValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ValueLevel"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeValueLevel();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FinancialIndicatorPoint(null);
		}

		internal void Validate(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool validateAsMaxValue)
		{
			ValidateValueLevel(view);
			Axis2D actualAxisX = view.ActualAxisX;
			if (actualAxisX == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (argument == null)
			{
				Scale scaleType = (Scale)actualAxisX.ScaleType;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = null;
				if (refinedSeries != null)
				{
					if (validateAsMaxValue)
					{
						double num = double.MinValue;
						foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
						{
							if (!point.IsEmpty)
							{
								double num2 = point.Argument;
								if (num2 > num)
								{
									num = num2;
									refinedPoint = point;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						double num3 = double.MaxValue;
						foreach (RefinedPoint point2 in refinedSeries.Points)
						{
							if (!point2.IsEmpty)
							{
								double num4 = point2.Argument;
								if (num4 < num3)
								{
									num3 = num4;
									refinedPoint = point2;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					argument = refinedPoint.GetUserArgument(actualAxisX.ScaleTypeMap);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CultureInfo culture = ((argumentSerializable != null && argumentSerializable.Equals(argument)) ? CultureInfo.InvariantCulture : CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				argument = ((IAxisData)actualAxisX).AxisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(argument, culture);
				argumentSerializable = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateValueLevel(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			valueLevel = view.GetCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FinancialIndicatorPoint financialIndicatorPoint)
			{
				argument = financialIndicatorPoint.argument;
				argumentSerializable = null;
				valueLevel = financialIndicatorPoint.valueLevel;
			}
		}
	}

				return ShouldSerializePoint2();

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)

				if (propertyName == "Point2")

				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializePoint1();
		}

		protected internal override void Validate(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (!Loading)

				point1.Validate(view, refinedSeries, validateAsMaxValue: false);
				point2.Validate(view, refinedSeries, validateAsMaxValue: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ValidateValueLevel(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)

			point2.ValidateValueLevel(view);
		}

		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FinancialIndicator financialIndicator)
			{
				point1.Assign(financialIndicator.point1);
				point2.Assign(financialIndicator.point2);
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum MarkerKind
	{
		Square,
		Diamond,
		Triangle,
		InvertedTriangle,
		Circle,
		Plus,
		Cross,
		Star,
		Pentagon,
		Hexagon,
		ThinCross
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(BaseMarkerTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.MarkerBase")]
	public class MarkerBase : ChartElement
	{
		internal abstract class CalculatorBase
		{
			private MarkerKind kind;

			private int starPointCount;

			private GRealPoint2D center;

			private float size;

			private RectangleF bounds;

			protected int StarPointCount => starPointCount;

			protected float Size => size;

			public IPolygon Polygon => kind switch
			{
				MarkerKind.Circle => new CirclePolygon(center, size / 2f), 
				MarkerKind.Square => new RectanglePolygon(bounds), 
				_ => new VariousPolygon(GetPolygon(), Rectangle.Round(bounds)), 
			};

			private static CalculatorBase CreateInstance(MarkerKind kind, int starPointCount, GRealPoint2D center, float size)
			{
				CalculatorBase calculatorBase = kind switch
				{
					MarkerKind.Circle => new CalculatorCircle(), 
					MarkerKind.Cross => new CalculatorCross(), 
					MarkerKind.Diamond => new CalculatorDiamond(), 
					MarkerKind.Hexagon => new CalculatorHexagon(), 
					MarkerKind.InvertedTriangle => new CalculatorInvertedTriangle(), 
					MarkerKind.Pentagon => new CalculatorPentagon(), 
					MarkerKind.Plus => new CalculatorPlus(), 
					MarkerKind.Square => new CalculatorSquare(), 
					MarkerKind.Star => new CalculatorStar(), 
					MarkerKind.Triangle => new CalculatorTriangle(), 
					MarkerKind.ThinCross => new CalculatorThinCross(), 
					_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
				};
				calculatorBase.Initialize(kind, starPointCount, center, size);
				return calculatorBase;
			}

			private static CalculatorBase CreateInstance(MarkerBase marker, GRealPoint2D point, bool isSelected, int size)
			{
				if (isSelected)
				{
					size += 3;
				}
				return CreateInstance(marker.Kind, marker.StarPointCount, point, size);
			}

			public static IPolygon CreatePolygon(MarkerKind kind, int starPointCount, RectangleF bounds)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left + bounds.Width / 2f, bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 2f);
				float num = Math.Min(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				return CreateInstance(kind, starPointCount, gRealPoint2D, num).Polygon;
			}

			public static IPolygon CreatePolygon(MarkerBase marker, GRealPoint2D point, bool isSelected, int size)
			{
				return CreateInstance(marker, point, isSelected, size).Polygon;
			}

			private void Initialize(MarkerKind kind, int starPointCount, GRealPoint2D center, float size)
			{
				this.kind = kind;
				this.starPointCount = starPointCount;
				this.center = center;
				this.size = size;
				bounds = new RectangleF(new PointF((float)center.X, (float)center.Y), SizeF.Empty);
				bounds.Inflate(size / 2f, size / 2f);
			}

			protected LineStrip OffsetPoints(GRealPoint2D givenPoint, LineStrip points)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
				foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
				{
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(point.X + givenPoint.X, givenPoint.Y - point.Y));
				}
				return lineStrip;
			}

			public LineStrip GetPolygon()
			{
				return OffsetPoints(center, CalcMarkerPolygon());
			}

			protected virtual LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				return new LineStrip();
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorCircle : CalculatorBase
		{
		}

		private class CalculatorPlus : CalculatorBase
		{
			private const float widthRatio = 0.4f;

			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				float num = base.Size / 2f;
				float num2 = num * 0.4f;
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(12);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, 0f - num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, 0f - num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, 0f - num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num, 0f - num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num, 0f - num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, 0f - num2));
				return lineStrip;
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorCross : CalculatorPlus
		{
			private static LineStrip RotateVectors(double rotateAngle, LineStrip points)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(points.Count);
				foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
				{
					double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point.Y, 2.0));
					double num2 = Math.Atan2(point.Y, point.X) + rotateAngle;
					double x = num * Math.Cos(num2);
					double y = num * Math.Sin(num2);
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, y));
				}
				return lineStrip;
			}

			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				LineStrip points = base.CalcMarkerPolygon();
				return RotateVectors(Math.PI / 4.0, points);
			}
		}

		private abstract class CalculatorPolygon : CalculatorBase
		{
			protected LineStrip CalcPolygon(double startAngle, int angleCount)
			{
				return GraphicUtils.CalcPolygon(startAngle, angleCount, default(GRealPoint2D), base.Size / 2f);
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorDiamond : CalculatorPolygon

			}
		}

		private class CalculatorTriangle : CalculatorPolygon
		{
			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				return CalcPolygon(Math.PI / 2.0, 3);
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorInvertedTriangle : CalculatorPolygon
		{
			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				return CalcPolygon(-Math.PI / 2.0, 3);
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorStar : CalculatorPolygon
		{
			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				int num = base.StarPointCount * 2;
				float num2 = base.Size / 2f;
				float radius = num2 * ((base.StarPointCount <= 3) ? 0.25f : 0.43f);
				LineStrip lineStrip = GraphicUtils.CalcPolygon(Math.PI / 2.0, base.StarPointCount, default(GRealPoint2D), num2);
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = GraphicUtils.CalcPolygon(Math.PI / 2.0 + Math.PI / (double)base.StarPointCount, base.StarPointCount, default(GRealPoint2D), radius);
				LineStrip lineStrip3 = new LineStrip(num);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					lineStrip3.Add((i % 2 == 0) ? lineStrip[i / 2] : lineStrip2[i / 2]);
				}
				return lineStrip3;
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorPentagon : CalculatorPolygon
		{
			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				return CalcPolygon(Math.PI / 2.0, 5);
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorHexagon : CalculatorPolygon
		{
			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				return CalcPolygon(Math.PI / 2.0, 6);
			}
		}

		private class CalculatorThinCross : CalculatorPolygon
		{
			private const float widthRatio = 0.15f;

			private static LineStrip RotateVectors(double rotateAngle, LineStrip points)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(points.Count);
				foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
				{
					double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point.Y, 2.0));
					double num2 = Math.Atan2(point.Y, point.X) + rotateAngle;
					double x = num * Math.Cos(num2);
					double y = num * Math.Sin(num2);
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, y));
				}
				return lineStrip;
			}

			private LineStrip CalcThinPlusPolygon()
			{
				float num = base.Size / 2f;
				float num2 = num * 0.15f;
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(12);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, 0f - num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, 0f - num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, 0f - num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num, 0f - num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num2, num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, num));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num, num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num, 0f - num2));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(0f - num2, 0f - num2));
				return lineStrip;
			}

			protected override LineStrip CalcMarkerPolygon()
			{
				LineStrip points = CalcThinPlusPolygon();
				return RotateVectors(Math.PI / 4.0, points);
			}
		}

		internal static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, IPolygon polygon, PolygonFillStyle fillStyle, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			try
			{
				using DXGraphicsPath path = polygon.GetPath();
				if (fillStyle != null)
				{
					polygon.Render(renderer, fillStyle.Options, color, color2, borderColor, borderThickness);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.FillPath(path, color);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		internal static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, MarkerKind kind, int starPointCount, Rectangle bounds, PolygonFillStyle fillStyle, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			IPolygon polygon = CalculatorBase.CreatePolygon(kind, starPointCount, bounds);
			Render(renderer, polygon, fillStyle, color, color2, borderColor, borderThickness);
		}

		protected internal MarkerBase(ChartElement owner)

			kind = defaultKind;
			border = new CustomBorder(this, defaultBorderVisible, Color.Empty);

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"BorderColor" => ShouldSerializeBorderColor(), 
				"Kind" => ShouldSerializeKind(), 
				"StarPointCount" => ShouldSerializeStarPointCount(), 
				"BorderVisible" => ShouldSerializeBorderVisible(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

			Kind = defaultKind;
		}

		{
			return starPointCount != 5;

		private void ResetStarPointCount()
		{
			StarPointCount = 5;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorderVisible()
		{
			return BorderVisible != border.DefaultVisible;
		}

		{
			BorderVisible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFillStyle()
		{

		}

		protected internal virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetBorderColor();
			ResetKind();
			ResetStarPointCount();
			ResetBorderVisible();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeKind() && !ShouldSerializeStarPointCount() && !ShouldSerializeBorderVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFillStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new MarkerBase(null);
		}

		protected internal virtual IPolygon CalculatePolygon(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			IPolygon polygon = CalculatorBase.CreatePolygon(bounds: new RectangleF(bounds.Location, bounds.Size), kind: kind, starPointCount: starPointCount);
			if (!polygon.Rect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return polygon;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			if (fillStyle != null)
			{
				polygon.Render(renderer, fillStyle.Options, color, color2, borderColor, borderThickness);
				return;
			}
			renderer.FillPolygon(polygon.Vertices, color);
			if (borderThickness > 0)
			{
				renderer.DrawPolygon(polygon.Vertices, borderColor, borderThickness);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderWithAntialiasing(ChartRenderer renderer, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(polygon.EnableAntialiasing);
			Render(renderer, polygon, color, color2, borderColor, borderThickness);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		protected internal IPolygon CalculatePolygon(GRealPoint2D origin, bool isSelected, int size)
		{
			return CalculatorBase.CreatePolygon(this, origin, isSelected, size);
		}

		protected internal ZPlaneRectangle GetActualBounds(DiagramPoint point, int size)
		{
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle(point, new SizeF(size, size));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Marker)";
		}

		{

			{
				kind = markerBase.kind;
				starPointCount = markerBase.starPointCount;
				fillStyle.Assign(markerBase.fillStyle);
				border.Assign(markerBase.border);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is MarkerBase markerBase && markerBase.GetType().Equals(GetType()) && kind == markerBase.kind && starPointCount == markerBase.starPointCount && fillStyle.Equals(markerBase.fillStyle))
			{
				return border.Equals(markerBase.border);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(PercentOptionsTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PercentOptions")]
	public class PercentOptions : ChartElement
	{
		private const int DefaultValuePercentageAccuracy = 4;

		private bool defaultValueAsPercent;

		private bool valueAsPercent;

		private int percentageAccuracy = 4;

		internal int PercentPrecision => Math.Max(percentageAccuracy - 2, 0);

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies whether point values are presented as a percentage.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PercentOptions.ValueAsPercent")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ValueAsPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return valueAsPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != valueAsPercent)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					valueAsPercent = value;
					if (valueAsPercent)
					{
						SynchronizeValueNumericOptionsPrecision();
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the percentage accuracy, when the PercentOptions.ValueAsPercent property is enabled.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PercentOptions.PercentageAccuracy")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public int PercentageAccuracy
		{
			get
			{
				return percentageAccuracy;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPercentageAccuracy));
				}
				if (value != percentageAccuracy)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					percentageAccuracy = value;
					SynchronizeValueNumericOptionsPrecision();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal PercentOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: this(owner, defaultValueAsPercent: true)
		{
		}

		internal PercentOptions(ChartElement owner, bool defaultValueAsPercent)
			: base(owner)
		{
			this.defaultValueAsPercent = defaultValueAsPercent;
			valueAsPercent = defaultValueAsPercent;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ValueAsPercent"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "PercentageAccuracy")
				{
					return ShouldSerializePercentageAccuracy();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeValueAsPercent();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueAsPercent()
		{
			return valueAsPercent != defaultValueAsPercent;
		}

		private void ResetValueAsPercent()
		{
			ValueAsPercent = defaultValueAsPercent;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePercentageAccuracy()
		{
			return percentageAccuracy != 4;
		}

		private void ResetPercentageAccuracy()
		{
			PercentageAccuracy = 4;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeValueAsPercent())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePercentageAccuracy();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SynchronizeValueNumericOptionsPrecision()
		{
			if (ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.DesignMode && !Loading && base.Owner is PointOptions pointOptions && pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions.Format == NumericFormat.Percent)
			{
				pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions.SynchronizePrecision(PercentPrecision);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PercentOptions(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PercentOptions percentOptions)
			{
				valueAsPercent = percentOptions.valueAsPercent;
				percentageAccuracy = percentOptions.percentageAccuracy;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is PercentOptions percentOptions && valueAsPercent == percentOptions.valueAsPercent)
			{
				return percentageAccuracy == percentOptions.percentageAccuracy;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(TopNOptionsTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TopNOptions")]
	public class TopNOptions : ChartElement
	{
		private const string SharedOptionsProperty = "PointsFilterOptions";

		private const TopNMode DefaultMode = TopNMode.Count;

		private const int DefaultCount = 5;

		private const double DefaultThresholdValue = 100.0;

						throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUnsupportedTopNOptions));
					}

				}
			}
		}

		}

				"Enabled" => ShouldSerializeEnabled(), 
				"Mode" => ShouldSerializeMode(), 
				"Count" => ShouldSerializeCount(), 
				"ThresholdValue" => ShouldSerializeThresholdValue(), 
				"ThresholdPercent" => ShouldSerializeThresholdPercent(), 
				"ShowOthers" => ShouldSerializeShowOthers(), 
				"OthersArgument" => ShouldSerializeOthersArgument(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is TopNOptions topNOptions)
			{
				enabled = topNOptions.enabled;
				mode = topNOptions.mode;
				count = topNOptions.count;
				thresholdValue = topNOptions.thresholdValue;
				thresholdPercent = topNOptions.thresholdPercent;
				showOthers = topNOptions.showOthers;
				othersArgument = topNOptions.othersArgument;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TopNOptions topNOptions && enabled == topNOptions.enabled && mode == topNOptions.mode && count == topNOptions.count && thresholdValue == topNOptions.thresholdValue && thresholdPercent == topNOptions.thresholdPercent && showOthers == topNOptions.showOthers)
			{
				return othersArgument == topNOptions.othersArgument;
			}
			return false;
		}
