	[TypeConverter(typeof(RadarRangeAreaSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RadarRangeAreaSeriesLabel")]
	public class RadarRangeAreaSeriesLabel : RangeAreaSeriesLabel
	{
		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(double argument, IRangePoint rangePoint, RadarDiagramMapping mapping, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData[] seriesLabelViewData)
		{
			double value = (rangePoint.Value1 + rangePoint.Value2) / 2.0;
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, value, clipValue: true);
			return SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(screenPoint, pointData, seriesLabelViewData, this);
		}

		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(double argument, double value, int angle, RadarDiagramMapping mapping, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData)
		{
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, value, clipValue: true);
			return SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForOutside(screenPoint, pointData, labelViewData, this, angle);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetRangePointMinMaxValues(IRangePoint rangePoint)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(Math.Min(rangePoint.Value1, rangePoint.Value2), Math.Max(rangePoint.Value1, rangePoint.Value2));
		}

		private IEnumerable<XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout> CalculateLayoutList(RadarDiagramMapping mapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			IRangePoint rangePoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			switch (base.Kind)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			{
				MinMaxValues rangePointMinMaxValues = GetRangePointMinMaxValues(rangePoint);
				yield return CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(rangePoint.Argument, rangePointMinMaxValues.Min, base.MinValueAngle, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0]);
				yield return CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(rangePoint.Argument, rangePointMinMaxValues.Max, base.MaxValueAngle, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[1]);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
				yield return CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(rangePoint.Argument, GetRangePointMinMaxValues(rangePoint).Max, base.MaxValueAngle, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0]);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
				yield return CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(rangePoint.Argument, GetRangePointMinMaxValues(rangePoint).Min, base.MinValueAngle, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0]);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel:
				yield return CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(rangePoint.Argument, rangePoint, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
			{
				int angle = ((rangePoint.Value2 >= rangePoint.Value1) ? base.MinValueAngle : base.MaxValueAngle);
				yield return CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(rangePoint.Argument, rangePoint.Value1, angle, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0]);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
			{
				int angle = ((rangePoint.Value2 >= rangePoint.Value1) ? base.MaxValueAngle : base.MinValueAngle);
				yield return CalculateLayoutForRadarPoint(rangePoint.Argument, rangePoint.Value2, angle, mapping, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0]);
				break;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is RadarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList radarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RadarDiagramSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is RadarPointSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RadarPointSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping = radarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.DiagramMapping;
			if (diagramMapping != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout> collection = CalculateLayoutList(diagramMapping, pointData);
				labelLayoutList.AddRange(collection);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RadarRangeAreaSeriesLabel();
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]

		MaxValueLabel,
		MinValueLabel,
		Value1Label,
		Value2Label
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(RangeAreaSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RangeAreaSeriesLabel")]
	public class RangeAreaSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase
	{
		private const RangeAreaLabelKind DefaultLabelKind = RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels;

		private const int DefaultMinValueAngle = 270;

		private const int DefaultMaxValueAngle = 90;

		private RangeAreaLabelKind labelKind = RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels;

		private int minValueAngle = 270;

		private int maxValueAngle = 90;

		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled => Kind != RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel;

		[Description("Gets or sets the kind of labels in 2D Range Area and 3D Range Area series.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RangeAreaSeriesLabel.Kind")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public RangeAreaLabelKind Kind
		{
			get
			{
				return labelKind;
			}
			set
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
				labelKind = value;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the angle between the point line and the label, which shows the minimum value of a series point in a Range Area series view.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RangeAreaSeriesLabel.MinValueAngle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int MinValueAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return minValueAngle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != minValueAngle)
				{
					CheckAngleValue(value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					minValueAngle = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the angle between the point line and the label, which shows the maximum value of a series point in a Range Area series view.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RangeAreaSeriesLabel.MaxValueAngle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int MaxValueAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return maxValueAngle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != maxValueAngle)
				{
					CheckAngleValue(value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					maxValueAngle = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Kind" => ShouldSerializeKind(), 
				"MinValueAngle" => ShouldSerializeMinValueAngle(), 
				"MaxValueAngle" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueAngle(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeKind()
		{
			return labelKind != RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels;
		}

		private void ResetKind()
		{
			Kind = RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinValueAngle()
		{
			return minValueAngle != 270;
		}

		private void ResetMinValueAngle()
		{
			MinValueAngle = 270;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueAngle()
		{
			return maxValueAngle != 90;
		}

		private void ResetMaxValueAngle()
		{
			MaxValueAngle = 90;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMinValueAngle() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValueAngle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeKind();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CheckAngleValue(int value)
		{
			if (value < -360 || value > 360)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLabelAngle));
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RangeAreaSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override bool CheckResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (Kind != RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAllAroundPoint)
			{
				return mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAroundPoint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override string[] ConstructTextCore(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser;
			switch (Kind)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			{
				string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", minValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, base.Series);
				string text = patternParser.GetText();
				string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", maxValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, base.Series);
				string text2 = patternParser.GetText();
				return new string[2] { text, text2 };
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", "V1", "V2"), base.Series.View);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", "V1"), base.Series.View);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", "V2"), base.Series.View);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
			{
				string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", minValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
			{
				string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", maxValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				break;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
				return new string[0];
			}
			patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, base.Series);
			return new string[1] { patternParser.GetText() };
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagramSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is RangeAreaSeriesView rangeAreaSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RangeAreaSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = rangeAreaSeriesView.GetSeriesPointValues(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			bool flag = seriesPointValues.Max >= seriesPointValues.Min;
			double argument = pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument;
			XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetMapping(argument, seriesPointValues.Min);
			if (mapping == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Kind == RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels)
			{
				double pointValue = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Min : seriesPointValues.Max);
				DiagramPoint startPoint = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, pointValue, flag);
				if (mapping.Bounds.Contains((int)startPoint.X, (int)startPoint.Y))
				{
					XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], this, minValueAngle);
					if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
					{
						labelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
					}
				}
				double pointValue2 = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Max : seriesPointValues.Min);
				DiagramPoint startPoint2 = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, pointValue2, !flag);
				if (mapping.Bounds.Contains((int)startPoint2.X, (int)startPoint2.Y))
				{
					XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout2 = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint2, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[1], this, maxValueAngle);
					if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout2 != null)
					{
						labelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout2);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 = null;
			switch (Kind)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel:
				xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData, this, seriesPointValues);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
			{
				double pointValue3 = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Max : seriesPointValues.Min);
				DiagramPoint startPoint3 = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, pointValue3, !flag);
				xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint3, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], this, maxValueAngle);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
			{
				double pointValue3 = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Min : seriesPointValues.Max);
				DiagramPoint startPoint3 = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, pointValue3, flag);
				xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint3, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], this, minValueAngle);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
			{
				int angleDegree = (flag ? minValueAngle : maxValueAngle);
				DiagramPoint startPoint3 = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, seriesPointValues.Min);
				xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint3, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], this, angleDegree);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
			{
				int angleDegree = (flag ? maxValueAngle : minValueAngle);
				DiagramPoint startPoint3 = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, seriesPointValues.Max, isValue1: false);
				xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint3, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], this, angleDegree);
				break;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
				return;
			}
			if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3 != null && IsLabelInViewport(mapping, xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3))
			{
				labelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout3);
			}
		}

		private bool IsLabelInViewport(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout layout)
		{
			if (layout.ConnectorPainter != null)
			{
				DiagramPoint startPoint = layout.ConnectorPainter.StartPoint;
				return mapping.Bounds.Contains((int)startPoint.X, (int)startPoint.Y);
			}
			RectangleF bounds = layout.Bounds;
			Point pt = new Point((int)Math.Round(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2f), (int)Math.Round(bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2f));
			return mapping.Bounds.Contains(pt);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RangeAreaSeriesLabel rangeAreaSeriesLabel)
			{
				labelKind = rangeAreaSeriesLabel.labelKind;
				minValueAngle = rangeAreaSeriesLabel.minValueAngle;
				maxValueAngle = rangeAreaSeriesLabel.maxValueAngle;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(RangeArea3DSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]

	public class RangeArea3DSeriesLabel : RangeAreaSeriesLabel
	{
		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => false;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Kind != RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel)
				{
					return base.Kind == RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new Shadow Shadow => base.Shadow;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new int MinValueAngle => base.MinValueAngle;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new int MaxValueAngle => base.MaxValueAngle;

		protected internal override bool CheckResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAllAroundPoint)
			{
				return mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAroundPoint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RangeArea3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is RangeArea3DSeriesView rangeArea3DSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RangeArea3DSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = rangeArea3DSeriesView.GetSeriesPointValues(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			bool flag = seriesPointValues.Max >= seriesPointValues.Min;
			switch (base.Kind)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			{
				double value = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Min : seriesPointValues.Max);
				double labelPosition2 = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Max : seriesPointValues.Min);
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForStackedArea3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], value);
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForStackedArea3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[1], labelPosition2);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel:
			{
				double labelPosition = MinMaxValues.Intersection(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList.AxisRangeY, seriesPointValues).CalculateCenter();
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForStackedArea3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], labelPosition);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
			{
				double connectorAngle = Math.PI / 2.0;
				DiagramVector connectorDirection = new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
				double labelPosition2 = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Max : seriesPointValues.Min);
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForLine3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, labelPosition2, connectorAngle, connectorDirection);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
			{
				double connectorAngle = 4.71238898038469;
				DiagramVector connectorDirection = new DiagramVector(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
				double value = (flag ? seriesPointValues.Min : seriesPointValues.Max);
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForLine3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, value, connectorAngle, connectorDirection);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForStackedArea3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], seriesPointValues.Min);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
				SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForStackedArea3DLabel(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], seriesPointValues.Max);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class BarSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase
	{
		private const int DefaultLabelIndent = 2;

		private const bool DefaultShowForZeroLabels = false;

		private BarSeriesLabelPosition position;

		private bool showForZeroValues;

		private int indent = 2;

		protected internal virtual BarSeriesLabelPosition DefaultPosition => BarSeriesLabelPosition.Auto;

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating whether to show series labels if a bar’s height is zero.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSeriesLabel.ShowForZeroValues")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowForZeroValues
		{
			get
			{
				return showForZeroValues;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != showForZeroValues)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					showForZeroValues = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the position of series point labels, relative to their corresponding Bars.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSeriesLabel.Position")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public BarSeriesLabelPosition Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != position)
				{
					if (!CheckPosition(value))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBarSeriesLabelPosition));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					position = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the indent between labels and the corresponding Bar side.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSeriesLabel.Indent")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Indent
		{
			get
			{
				return indent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != indent)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBarSeriesLabelIndent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					indent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected BarSeriesLabel()
		{
			position = DefaultPosition;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"ShowForZeroValues" => ShouldSerializeShowForZeroValues(), 
				"Position" => ShouldSerializePosition(), 
				"Indent" => ShouldSerializeIndent(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowForZeroValues()
		{
			return showForZeroValues;
		}

		private void ResetShowForZeroValues()
		{
			ShowForZeroValues = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePosition()
		{
			return position != DefaultPosition;
		}

		private void ResetPosition()
		{
			Position = DefaultPosition;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIndent()
		{
			return indent != 2;
		}

		private void ResetIndent()
		{
			Indent = 2;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeShowForZeroValues() && !ShouldSerializePosition())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIndent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CheckPosition(BarSeriesLabelPosition position)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void AssignBarLabelPosition(BarSeriesLabel label)
		{
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BarSeriesLabel barSeriesLabel)
			{
				showForZeroValues = barSeriesLabel.showForZeroValues;
				AssignBarLabelPosition(barSeriesLabel);
				indent = barSeriesLabel.indent;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BubbleSeriesLabel")]
	public class BubbleSeriesLabel : PointSeriesLabel
	{
		private const double DefaultIndentFromMarker = 0.0;

		private const BubbleLabelValueToDisplay DefaultValueToDisplay = BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight;

		private double indentFromMarker;

		private BubbleLabelValueToDisplay valueToDisplay;

		protected override int DefaultAngleDegree => 90;

		[Description("Gets or sets the indent value (in pixels) between a marker’s edge and its label for a Bubble series view.")]

					RaiseControlChanged();

			}

		[Browsable(false)]

					UpdateTextPattern(base.PointOptions);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "IndentFromMarker")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIndentFromMarker();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIndentFromMarker()
		{
			return indentFromMarker != 0.0;
		}

		private void ResetIndentFromMarker()
		{
			IndentFromMarker = 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIndentFromMarker();
			}
			return true;

		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenter(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, IXYWPoint refinedPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, Color color)
		{
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value);
			double markerSize = refinedPoint.Size * MathUtils.CalcLength2D(diagramMapping.GetInterimPoint(1.0, 0.0, clip: false, round: false), diagramMapping.GetInterimPoint(0.0, 0.0, clip: false, round: false));
			SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = pointData.LabelViewData[0];
			TextPainter textPainter = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(screenPointNoRound);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithValidRectangle(pointData, this, color, textPainter, null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, screenPointNoRound, SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateValidRectangleForCenterPosition(screenPointNoRound, markerSize));
		}

		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForOutside(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, IXYWPoint refinedPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, Color color)
		{
			double angle = XYDiagramMappingHelper.CorrectAngle(diagramMapping, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(base.Angle)));
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value);
			double connectorLength = indentFromMarker + refinedPoint.Size / 2.0 * MathUtils.CalcLength2D(diagramMapping.GetInterimPoint(1.0, 0.0, clip: false, round: false), diagramMapping.GetInterimPoint(0.0, 0.0, clip: false, round: false));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateFinishPoint(angle, screenPointNoRound, connectorLength);
			SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = pointData.LabelViewData[0];
			TextPainter textPainter = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint, angle);
			if (!diagramMapping.Bounds.IntersectsWith(Rectangle.Round(textPainter.BoundsWithBorder)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithExcludedRectangle(pointData, this, color, textPainter, base.ActualLineVisible ? new LineConnectorPainter(screenPointNoRound, diagramPoint, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flat: true) : null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, screenPointNoRound, SeriesLabelHelper.CalcAnchorHoleForPoint(screenPointNoRound, connectorLength));
		}

		internal override void UpdateTextPattern(ChartElement sender)
		{
			base.UpdateTextPattern(sender);
			if (base.PointOptionsInternal != null && (sender == base.PointOptionsInternal || sender.Owner == base.PointOptionsInternal) && base.TextPattern != null)
			{
				switch (valueToDisplay)
				{
				case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight:
					base.TextPattern = PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(base.TextPattern, "V", "W");
					break;
				case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.ValueAndWeight:
					base.TextPattern = PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(base.TextPattern, "V", "V", "W");
					break;
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException();
				case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Value:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList = labelLayoutList as XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList;
			IXYWPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Color color = pointData.DrawOptions.Color;
			XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetMapping(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value);
			if (mapping != null)
			{
				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = ((base.Position == PointLabelPosition.Outside) ? CalculateLayoutForOutside(mapping, refinedPoint, pointData, color) : CalculateLayoutForCenter(mapping, refinedPoint, pointData, color));
				if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
				{
					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool GetDefaultLineVisible(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.SeriesLabelAppearance labelAppearance)
		{
			if (!(labelAppearance is SeriesLabel2DAppearance seriesLabel2DAppearance))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return seriesLabel2DAppearance.ShowBubbleConnector;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BubbleSeriesLabel();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is BubbleSeriesLabel bubbleSeriesLabel)
			{
				indentFromMarker = bubbleSeriesLabel.indentFromMarker;
				valueToDisplay = bubbleSeriesLabel.valueToDisplay;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]

		Right,
		RightColumn
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(FunnelSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSeriesLabel")]
	public class FunnelSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase
	{
		private const FunnelSeriesLabelPosition DefaultPosition = FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Right;

		[Description("Gets or sets the position of labels relative to each other and the funnel diagram.")]

		private Size CalculateMaximumLabelSize(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			if (seriesData.Count == 0)
			{
				return empty;
			}
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				if (seriesDatum.LabelViewData.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = seriesDatum.LabelViewData[0];
				if (seriesLabelViewData != null)
				{
					Size textSize = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize;
					if (textSize.Width > empty.Width)
					{
						empty.Width = textSize.Width;
					}
					if (textSize.Height > empty.Height)
					{
						empty.Height = textSize.Height;
					}
				}
			}
			int num = base.Border.ActualThickness * 2;
			empty.Width += num;
			empty.Height += num;
			return empty;
		}

		private BoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator CreateBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle funnelBounds, Rectangle labelBounds)
		{
			if (!(seriesData.WholeViewData is FunnelWholeSeriesViewData { FilteredPointsData: var filteredPointsData }))
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (position)
			{
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Right:
				return new RightBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(filteredPointsData, funnelBounds, labelBounds, this);
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Left:
				return new LeftBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(filteredPointsData, funnelBounds, labelBounds, this);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected label position");
				return null;
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectFunnelBoundsForColumnPosition(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle funnelBounds, Rectangle labelBounds)
		{
			Size size = CalculateMaximumLabelSize(seriesData);
			int num = labelBounds.Left - funnelBounds.Left + size.Width + base.LineLength;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (!((FunnelSeriesView)View).AlignToCenter)
				{
					int num2 = num;
					int num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(labelBounds.Width - funnelBounds.Width) / 2.0);
					if (num2 > num3)
					{
						int num4 = (num2 - num3) / 2;
						num2 = num3 + num4;
						funnelBounds.Inflate(-num4, 0);
					}
					if (Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.LeftColumn)
					{
						funnelBounds.Offset(num2, 0);
					}
					else
					{
						funnelBounds.Offset(-num2, 0);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					funnelBounds.Inflate(-num, 0);
				}
			}
			return funnelBounds;
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectFunnelBoundsForOutsidePosition(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle funnelBounds, Rectangle labelBounds)
		{
			return CreateBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(seriesData, funnelBounds, labelBounds)?.CalculateBounds() ?? funnelBounds;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FunnelSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected virtual DiagramPoint CalcLabelPositionAndConnectorPoints(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, RectangleF labelsBounds, int labelWidth, double additionalLength, out DiagramPoint startPoint, out DiagramPoint finishPoint)
		{
			switch (position)
			{
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center:
				startPoint = (finishPoint = new DiagramPoint((layout.LeftUpPoint.X + layout.RightUpPoint.X) / 2.0, (layout.RightUpPoint.Y + layout.RightDownPoint.Y) / 2.0));
				return startPoint;
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.RightColumn:
				startPoint = new DiagramPoint(layout.RightUpPoint.X, layout.RightUpPoint.Y);
				finishPoint = new DiagramPoint(labelsBounds.Right - (float)labelWidth, layout.RightUpPoint.Y);
				return finishPoint;
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.LeftColumn:
				startPoint = new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint.X, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y);
				finishPoint = new DiagramPoint(labelsBounds.Left + (float)labelWidth, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y);
				return new DiagramPoint(labelsBounds.Left, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y);
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Left:
				startPoint = new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint.X, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y);
				finishPoint = new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint.X - (double)base.LineLength - additionalLength, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y);
				return new DiagramPoint(finishPoint.X - (double)labelWidth, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y);
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Right:
				startPoint = new DiagramPoint(layout.RightUpPoint.X, layout.RightUpPoint.Y);
				finishPoint = new DiagramPoint(layout.RightUpPoint.X + (double)base.LineLength + additionalLength, layout.RightUpPoint.Y);
				return finishPoint;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown funnel label position");
				startPoint = (finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Zero);
				return finishPoint;
			}
		}

		protected virtual RectangleF CalcCorrectionLabelsBounds(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain)
		{
			return domain.LabelsBounds;
		}

		internal virtual Size CalculateMaximumSizeConsiderIndent(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			if (!base.SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility || position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			Size result = CalculateMaximumLabelSize(seriesData);
			result.Width += base.LineLength;
			return result;
		}

		internal Rectangle CorrectFunnelBounds(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle funnelBounds, Rectangle labelBounds)
		{
			if (!base.SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility || position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center)
			{
				return funnelBounds;
			}
			if (IsColumnPosition)
			{
				return CorrectFunnelBoundsForColumnPosition(seriesData, funnelBounds, labelBounds);
			}
			if (IsOutsidePosition)
			{
				return CorrectFunnelBoundsForOutsidePosition(seriesData, funnelBounds, labelBounds);
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected label position.");
			return funnelBounds;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelsLayout, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (!(pointLayout is FunnelSeriesPointLayout funnelSeriesPointLayout))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("FunnelSeriesPointLayout expected.");
			}
			else if (!(pointLayout.DrawOptions is SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase simpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase expected.");
			}
			else
			{
				if (pointLayout.LabelViewData.Length < 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = pointLayout.LabelViewData[0];
				ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter = null;
				int labelWidth = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize.Width + base.Border.ActualThickness * 2;
				RectangleF labelsBounds = CalcCorrectionLabelsBounds(labelsLayout.Domain);
				DiagramPoint startPoint;
				DiagramPoint finishPoint;
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = CalcLabelPositionAndConnectorPoints(funnelSeriesPointLayout, labelsLayout.Domain, labelsBounds, labelWidth, seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength, out startPoint, out finishPoint);
				TextPainterBase textPainterBase;
				if (position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center)
				{
					textPainterBase = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(diagramPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					textPainterBase = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint, 0.0);
					if (base.ActualLineVisible)
					{
						connectorPainter = new LineConnectorPainter(startPoint, finishPoint, 0.0, (ZPlaneRectangle)((TextPainter)textPainterBase).BoundsWithBorder, IsFlatConnector);
					}
				}
				SeriesLabelLayout item = new SeriesLabelLayout(funnelSeriesPointLayout.PointData, this, simpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase.Color, textPainterBase, connectorPainter, base.ResolveOverlappingMode);
				labelsLayout.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is FunnelSeriesLabel funnelSeriesLabel)
			{
				position = funnelSeriesLabel.position;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(Funnel3DSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Funnel3DSeriesLabel")]
	public class Funnel3DSeriesLabel : FunnelSeriesLabel
	{
		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => false;

		protected override bool IsFlatConnector => false;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new Shadow Shadow => base.Shadow;

		private static DiagramPoint UnProject(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain3D, DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return domain3D.UnProject(new DiagramPoint(point.X, (double)(domain3D.Bounds.Height + 2 * domain3D.Bounds.Top) - point.Y, point.Z));
		}

		private static double CalcCorrectionAngle(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain3D, DiagramPoint point)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = GLHelper.InverseTransform(domain3D.ModelViewMatrix, new DiagramPoint(0.0, point.Y, 0.0));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = GLHelper.InverseTransform(domain3D.ModelViewMatrix, point);
			return Math.Atan2(diagramPoint.X - diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint.Z - diagramPoint2.Z);
		}

		private void CalcConnectorPointsForInsidePosition(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain3D, out DiagramPoint startPoint, out DiagramPoint finishPoint)
		{
			double y = domain3D.Height / 2.0 - (layout.RightUpPoint.Y + layout.RightDownPoint.Y) / 2.0;
			double num = (layout.RightUpPoint.X + layout.RightDownPoint.X - layout.LeftUpPoint.X - layout.LeftDownPoint.X) / 4.0;
			double angle = CalcCorrectionAngle(domain3D, new DiagramPoint(0.0, y, 0.0 - num));
			startPoint = Funnel3DSeriesView.CalcSurfacePoint(y, num, angle);
			double radius = (layout.RightDownPoint.X - layout.LeftDownPoint.X) / 2.0;
			double y2 = domain3D.Height / 2.0 - layout.RightDownPoint.Y;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = Funnel3DSeriesView.CalcSurfacePoint(y2, radius, angle);
			int holeRadiusPercent = ((Funnel3DSeriesView)base.Series.View).HoleRadiusPercent;
			if (holeRadiusPercent >= 50 && holeRadiusPercent != 100)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (domain3D.Project(new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)).Y > domain3D.Project(new DiagramPoint(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)).Y)
				{
					if (startPoint.Y >= diagramPoint.Y)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (startPoint.Y <= diagramPoint.Y)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					startPoint = Funnel3DSeriesView.CalcSurfacePoint(y, (double)holeRadiusPercent * 0.01 * num, angle);
				}
			}
			finishPoint = startPoint;
		}

		private void CalcConnectorPointsForOutsidePosition(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain3D, out DiagramPoint startPoint, out DiagramPoint finishPoint, out DiagramPoint supportingPoint)
		{
			double num = (layout.RightUpPoint.X - layout.LeftUpPoint.X) / 2.0;
			int num2 = domain3D.Bounds.Height / 2;
			double y = (double)num2 - layout.RightUpPoint.Y;
			double angle = ((base.Position != FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Left && base.Position != FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.LeftColumn) ? CalcCorrectionAngle(domain3D, new DiagramPoint(-1.0, y, 0.0)) : CalcCorrectionAngle(domain3D, new DiagramPoint(1.0, y, 0.0)));
			startPoint = Funnel3DSeriesView.CalcSurfacePoint(y, num, angle);
			finishPoint = Funnel3DSeriesView.CalcSurfacePoint(y, num + (double)base.LineLength, angle);
			supportingPoint = ((num + (double)base.LineLength > domain3D.Depth / 2.0) ? Funnel3DSeriesView.CalcSurfacePoint(y, domain3D.Depth / 2.0, angle) : finishPoint);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint CalcLabelPositionAndConnectorPoints(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, RectangleF labelsBounds, int labelWidth, double additionalLength, out DiagramPoint startPoint, out DiagramPoint finishPoint)
		{
			startPoint = (finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Zero);
			if (!(domain is SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain))
			{
				return finishPoint;
			}
			DiagramPoint supportingPoint = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			if (base.Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center)
			{
				CalcConnectorPointsForInsidePosition(layout, simpleDiagram3DDomain, out startPoint, out finishPoint);
			}
			else
			{
				CalcConnectorPointsForOutsidePosition(layout, simpleDiagram3DDomain, out startPoint, out finishPoint, out supportingPoint);
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(startPoint);
			switch (base.Position)
			{
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center:
				return diagramPoint;
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Left:
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(finishPoint);
				finishPoint = UnProject(simpleDiagram3DDomain, new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(supportingPoint).Z));
				return new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint2.X - (double)labelWidth, diagramPoint2.Y);
			}
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.LeftColumn:
				finishPoint = UnProject(simpleDiagram3DDomain, new DiagramPoint(labelsBounds.Left + (float)labelWidth, diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint.Z));
				return new DiagramPoint(labelsBounds.Left, diagramPoint.Y);
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Right:
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(finishPoint);
				finishPoint = UnProject(simpleDiagram3DDomain, new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(supportingPoint).Z));
				return diagramPoint2;
			}
			case FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.RightColumn:
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = diagramPoint;
				diagramPoint2.X = labelsBounds.Right - (float)labelWidth;
				finishPoint = UnProject(simpleDiagram3DDomain, diagramPoint2);
				return diagramPoint2;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown funnel label position");
				return DiagramPoint.Zero;
			}
		}

		protected override RectangleF CalcCorrectionLabelsBounds(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain)
		{
			if (!(domain is SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain))
			{
				return domain.LabelsBounds;
			}
			PointF pointF = (PointF)simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(DiagramPoint.Zero);
			return new RectangleF(pointF.X - (float)domain.LabelsBounds.Width / 2f, pointF.Y - (float)domain.LabelsBounds.Height / 2f, domain.LabelsBounds.Width, domain.LabelsBounds.Height);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Funnel3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		internal override Size CalculateMaximumSizeConsiderIndent(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			Size result = base.CalculateMaximumSizeConsiderIndent(seriesData);
			result.Height = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)result.Height / 2.0);
			if (base.SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility && (base.Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Left || base.Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Right))
			{
				result.Height += base.LineLength;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class StackedBarTotalLabel : TotalLabel, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider, ITextPropertiesProvider, IHitTest, ISupportTextAntialiasing
	{
		private const ResolveOverlappingMode DefaultResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.None;

			set

					Diagram.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent = value;
				}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StackedBarTotalLabel.ShowConnector")]

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StackedBarTotalLabel.Indent")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StackedBarTotalLabel.Indent")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]

		public int Indent
		{

					if (value < 0 || value >= 1000)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTotalLabelIndent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					indent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StackedBarTotalLabel.ConnectorLineStyle")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StackedBarTotalLabel.ConnectorLineStyle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]

		ResolveOverlappingMode ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider.ResolveOverlappingMode => ResolveOverlappingMode;

			: this(null)

		}

		internal StackedBarTotalLabel(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			lineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antiAlias: false);
		}

		Color ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider.GetActualConnectorColor(Color color)
		{
			return ((ITextPropertiesProvider)this).GetBorderColor(color);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingMode()
		{
			return resolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
		}

		private void ResetResolveOverlappingMode()
		{
			ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingMinIndent()
		{
			return ResolveOverlappingMinIndent != -1;
		}

		private void ResetResolveOverlappingMinIndent()
		{
			ResolveOverlappingMinIndent = -1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowConnector()
		{
			return showConnector;
		}

		private void ResetShowConnector()
		{
			ShowConnector = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIndent()
		{
			return indent != 10;
		}

		private void ResetIndent()
		{
			Indent = 10;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingMode() && !ShouldSerializeShowConnector())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIndent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"ResolveOverlappingMode" => ShouldSerializeResolveOverlappingMode(), 
				"ShowConnector" => ShouldSerializeShowConnector(), 
				"Indent" => ShouldSerializeIndent(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new StackedBarTotalLabel();
		}

		internal SeriesLabelViewData CalculateViewData(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Series series)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(base.ActualTextPattern, series.View);
			patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, series);
			return new SeriesLabelViewData(this, patternParser.GetText());
		}

		internal void CalculateLayout(StackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, StackedBarSeriesView view)
		{
			SeriesLabelViewData stackedBarTotalLabelViewData = pointData.StackedBarTotalLabelViewData;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stackedBarTotalLabelViewData.Text))
			{
				return;
			}
			BarData barData = pointData.GetBarData(view);
			Color color = ((stackedBarTotalLabelViewData.TotalLabelCustomizedTextColor == Color.Empty) ? stackedBarTotalLabelViewData.Label.GetTextColor(Color.Empty) : stackedBarTotalLabelViewData.TotalLabelCustomizedTextColor);
			XYDiagramMappingBase xYDiagramMappingBase = (view.IsScrollingEnabled ? labelLayoutList.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling : barData.GetMappingForTopLabelPosition(labelLayoutList.MappingContainer));
			if (xYDiagramMappingBase != null)
			{
				double angle = XYDiagramMappingHelper.CorrectAngle(xYDiagramMappingBase, (barData.ActualValue < 0.0) ? (-Math.PI / 2.0) : (Math.PI / 2.0));
				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForTopBarPosition(xYDiagramMappingBase, new ScreenPointCalculator(), barData, pointData, angle, stackedBarTotalLabelViewData, color, this);
				if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
				{
					labelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel)
			{
				resolveOverlappingMode = stackedBarTotalLabel.resolveOverlappingMode;
				showConnector = stackedBarTotalLabel.showConnector;
				indent = stackedBarTotalLabel.Indent;
				lineStyle.Assign(stackedBarTotalLabel.lineStyle);
			}
		}
	}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)

				"TextColor" => ShouldSerializeTextColor(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"Font" => false, 
				"DXFont" => ShouldSerializeDXFont(), 
				"EnableAntialiasing" => ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"Shadow" => ShouldSerializeShadow(), 
				"Border" => ShouldSerializeBorder(), 
				"MaxWidth" => ShouldSerializeMaxWidth(), 
				"MaxLineCount" => ShouldSerializeMaxLineCount(), 
				"TextAlignment" => ShouldSerializeTextAlignment(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

			{

				maxWidth = totalLabel.maxWidth;
				maxLineCount = totalLabel.maxLineCount;
				textAlignment = totalLabel.TextAlignment;

				shadow.Assign(totalLabel.shadow);
				border.Assign(totalLabel.border);

				visible = totalLabel.visible;
			}
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = GetSeriesPointValues(refinedPoint);
			DiagramPoint zeroPoint = pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Min);
			DiagramPoint actualPoint = pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Max, isValue1: false);
			RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions = (RangeAreaDrawOptions)pointData.DrawOptions;
			IPolygon zeroPolygon = (rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker1Visible ? rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker1.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(zeroPoint.X), Math.Round(zeroPoint.Y)), isSelected: false) : null);
			IPolygon polygon = (rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker2Visible ? rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker2.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(actualPoint.X), Math.Round(actualPoint.Y)), isSelected: false) : null);
			return new RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout(pointData, actualPoint, polygon, zeroPoint, zeroPolygon);
		}

		protected internal override HighlightedPointLayout CalculateHighlightedPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = GetSeriesPointValues(refinedPoint);
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Min);
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound2 = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Max);
			IPolygon polygon = null;
			if (diagramMapping.Bounds.Contains((int)screenPointNoRound.X, (int)screenPointNoRound.Y))
			{
				polygon = Marker1.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(screenPointNoRound.X), Math.Round(screenPointNoRound.Y)), isSelected: true);
			}
			IPolygon polygon2 = null;
			if (diagramMapping.Bounds.Contains((int)screenPointNoRound2.X, (int)screenPointNoRound2.Y))
			{
				polygon2 = Marker2.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(screenPointNoRound2.X), Math.Round(screenPointNoRound2.Y)), isSelected: true);
			}
			if (drawOptions is PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions2)
			{
				Color markerSelfColor = GetMarkerSelfColor(drawOptions2);
				Color borderDrawColor = GetBorderDrawColor(drawOptions2);
				return new HighlightedRangePointLayout(polygon, polygon2, markerSelfColor, borderDrawColor, refinedPoint, screenPointNoRound, screenPointNoRound2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderHighlightedPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (pointLayout is HighlightedRangePointLayout highlightedRangePointLayout)
			{
				if (highlightedRangePointLayout.Polygon != null)
				{
					renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
					highlightedRangePointLayout.Polygon.Render(renderer, new SolidFillOptions(), highlightedRangePointLayout.Color, highlightedRangePointLayout.Color, highlightedRangePointLayout.BorderColor, 1);
					renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				}
				if (highlightedRangePointLayout.Polygon2 != null)
				{
					renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
					highlightedRangePointLayout.Polygon2.Render(renderer, new SolidFillOptions(), highlightedRangePointLayout.Color, highlightedRangePointLayout.Color, highlightedRangePointLayout.BorderColor, 1);
					renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RegisterHighlightedHitRegion(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			base.RegisterHighlightedHitRegion(renderer, pointLayout);
			if (pointLayout is HighlightedRangePointLayout highlightedRangePointLayout)
			{
				ProcessHighlightedPoint(highlightedRangePointLayout.RefinedPoint, highlightedRangePointLayout.Polygon, highlightedRangePointLayout.ToolTipPoint);
				ProcessHighlightedPoint(highlightedRangePointLayout.RefinedPoint, highlightedRangePointLayout.Polygon2, highlightedRangePointLayout.ToolTipPoint2);
			}
		}

		}

		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))

				return false;
			}
			RangeAreaSeriesView rangeAreaSeriesView = (RangeAreaSeriesView)obj;
			if (marker2.Equals(rangeAreaSeriesView.marker2) && marker1.Equals(rangeAreaSeriesView.marker1) && border1.Equals(rangeAreaSeriesView.border1))
			{
				return border2.Equals(rangeAreaSeriesView.border2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IRangeAreaSeriesView rangeAreaSeriesView)
			{
				marker2.Assign(rangeAreaSeriesView.Marker2);
				marker1.Assign(rangeAreaSeriesView.Marker1);
				border1.Assign(rangeAreaSeriesView.Border1);
				border2.Assign(rangeAreaSeriesView.Border2);

					marker1Visibility = rangeAreaSeriesView2.Marker1Visibility;
					marker2Visibility = rangeAreaSeriesView2.Marker2Visibility;
				}
			}
		}

	public class StepAreaSeriesView : AreaSeriesView, IStepSeriesView
	{
		private const bool DefaultInvertedStep = false;

		private bool invertedStep;

		private bool snapCrosshairToActualStep = true;

		protected internal override string StringId => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SvnStepArea);

		protected override bool RoundStrip => true;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StepAreaSeriesView.InvertedStep")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StepAreaSeriesView.InvertedStep")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public bool InvertedStep
		{
			get
			{
				return invertedStep;
			}
			set
			{
				if (invertedStep != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					invertedStep = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StepAreaSeriesView.SnapCrosshairToActualStep")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StepAreaSeriesView.SnapCrosshairToActualStep")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		public bool SnapCrosshairToActualStep
		{
			get
			{
				return snapCrosshairToActualStep;
			}
			set
			{
				if (snapCrosshairToActualStep != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					snapCrosshairToActualStep = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "InvertedStep"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SnapCrosshairToActualStep")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeSnapCrosshairToActualStep();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeInvertedStep();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeInvertedStep()
		{
			return invertedStep;
		}

		private void ResetInvertedStep()
		{
			InvertedStep = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSnapCrosshairToActualStep()
		{
			return !snapCrosshairToActualStep;
		}

		private void ResetSnapCrosshairToActualStep()
		{
			SnapCrosshairToActualStep = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeInvertedStep())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSnapCrosshairToActualStep();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AddStripElementInternal(IGeometryStrip strip, RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = GetSeriesPointValues(pointInfo);
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)strip;
			rangeStrip.TopStrip.AddStepToPoint(new GRealPoint2D(pointInfo.Argument, seriesPointValues.Max), InvertedStep);
			rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(pointInfo.Argument, seriesPointValues.Min));
		}

		protected override PointSeriesViewPainter CreatePainter()
		{
			return new StepAreaSeriesViewPainter(this, this);
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			IStripSplitter stripSplitter = CreateLineColorSplitter();
			if (stripSplitter != null)
			{
				if (!(stripSplitter is StripPointSplitter))
				{
					return new StepAreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator(stripSplitter, InvertedStep);
				}
				return new StepAreaGeometrySplittedPointStripCreator(stripSplitter, InvertedStep);
			}
			return new StepAreaGeometryStripCreator(InvertedStep);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new StepAreaSeriesView();
		}

		protected internal override bool GetActualAntialiasing(int pointsCount)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(base.EnableAntialiasing, defaultValue: false);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IStepSeriesView stepSeriesView)
			{
				invertedStep = stepSeriesView.InvertedStep;
				snapCrosshairToActualStep = stepSeriesView.SnapCrosshairToActualStep;
			}
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new StepLineViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return invertedStep == ((StepAreaSeriesView)obj).invertedStep;
		}
	}

		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.WaterfallValueOptionsPickerEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		public WaterfallValueOptionsBase ValueOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Chart != null)
				{
					return base.Chart.WaterfallValueOptions;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectValueOptionsPropertyUsing));
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Chart != null)
				{
					base.Chart.WaterfallValueOptions = value;
					value.RaiseChanged();
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectValueOptionsPropertyUsing));
			}
		}

		bool ILegendItemProvider.ShowInLegend => ValueOptions.IsSpreadsheetChart;

		public WaterfallSeriesView()
		{
			risingBarColor = DefaultRisingColor;
			fallingBarColor = DefaultFallingColor;
			valueOptionsSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<WaterfallValueOptionsBase>(() => (base.Chart != null) ? ValueOptions : aspxValueOptions, delegate(WaterfallValueOptionsBase value)
			{
				if (base.Chart != null)
				{
					ValueOptions = value;
				}
				else
				{
					aspxValueOptions = value;
				}
			});
			RisingBarFillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this)
			{
				FillMode = FillMode.Solid
			};
			FallingBarFillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this)
			{
				FillMode = FillMode.Solid
			};
			SubtotalBarFillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this)
			{
				FillMode = FillMode.Solid
			};
		}

		bool IWaterfallSeriesView.IsSubtotalPoint(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (!ValueOptions.IsSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return point?.Tag is WaterfallPointType;
			}
			if (point is SeriesPoint point2)
			{
				return base.Series.ActualSeriesPoints.IndexOf(point2) < 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		ISeriesPoint IWaterfallSeriesView.CreateSubtotalPoint(ISeries series, string argument, double value, int? colorCore, object tag)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint((Series)series, argument, new object[1] { value }, ValueOptions.IsSpreadsheetChart ? tag : ((object)(WaterfallPointType)tag));
			if (colorCore.HasValue)
			{
				seriesPoint.Color = Color.FromArgb(colorCore.Value);
			}
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		List<LegendItem> ILegendItemProvider.GetLegendItems(Palette palette, bool legendTextVisible, Color legendTextColor, bool legendMarkerVisible, Size legendMarkerSize)
		{
			List<LegendItem> list = new List<LegendItem>
			{
				new LegendItem("Increase", RisingBarColor, legendTextColor, legendMarkerSize, legendMarkerVisible, legendTextVisible),
				new LegendItem("Decrease", FallingBarColor, legendTextColor, legendMarkerSize, legendMarkerVisible, legendTextVisible),
				new LegendItem("Total", SubtotalBarColor, legendTextColor, legendMarkerSize, legendMarkerVisible, legendTextVisible)
			};
			foreach (LegendItem item in list)
			{
				item.SetLegend(base.Series.ActualLegend);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void DrawLegendMarkerPath(ChartRenderer renderer, Color fill, Color stroke, PointF[] points)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			using DXSolidBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(fill);
			dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(points);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath, brush);
			renderer.DrawPath(dXGraphicsPath, GetBorderColor(fill, stroke), 1);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private Color GetActualColorCore(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex, bool isActualColor2)
		{
			IWaterfallPoint waterfallPoint = points[pointIndex];
			Color result = ((!waterfallPoint.IsSubTotal) ? ((waterfallPoint.RelativeValue > 0.0) ? risingBarColor : fallingBarColor) : (ValueOptions.IsSpreadsheetChart ? SubtotalBarColor : ((pointIndex != 0) ? ((pointIndex == points.Count - 1) ? TotalBarColor : SubtotalBarColor) : StartBarColor)));
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!isActualColor2)
				{
					return ActualColor;
				}
				return ActualColor2;
			}
			if (!isActualColor2)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return Palette.ChangeLuminance(result, 0.4f);
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			if (aspxValueOptions != null)
			{
				ValueOptions = aspxValueOptions;
			}
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new WaterfallSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override SeriesContainer CreateContainer()
		{
			return new WaterfallInteractionContainer(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new WaterfallSeriesView();
		}

		protected internal override Color GetPointActualColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetActualColorCore(points, pointIndex, isActualColor2: false);
		}

		protected internal override Color? GetPointActualColor2(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetActualColorCore(points, pointIndex, isActualColor2: true);
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (fallingBarColor.IsEmpty && risingBarColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				base.RenderLegendMarkerInternal(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, seriesDrawOptions, selectionState);
				return;
			}
			BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions = (BarDrawOptions)seriesPointDrawOptions;
			barDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, bounds, 1);
			Color fill = (fallingBarColor.IsEmpty ? barDrawOptions.Color : fallingBarColor);
			PointF[] points = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.Height),
				new PointF(bounds.X + bounds.Width, bounds.Y),
				new PointF(bounds.X + bounds.Width, bounds.Y + bounds.Height),
				new PointF(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.Height)
			};
			Color stroke = barDrawOptions.Border.Color;
			DrawLegendMarkerPath(renderer, fill, stroke, points);
			fill = (risingBarColor.IsEmpty ? barDrawOptions.Color : risingBarColor);
			points = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(bounds.X, bounds.Y),
				new PointF(bounds.X + bounds.Width, bounds.Y),
				new PointF(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.Height),
				new PointF(bounds.X, bounds.Y)
			};
			DrawLegendMarkerPath(renderer, fill, stroke, points);
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			if (!ValueOptions.IsSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return new WaterfallDrawOptions(this);
			}
			return new SpreadsheetWaterfallDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected override PointPatternDataProvider CreatePointPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, IAxisData axisData)
		{
			return new WaterfallPointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisData?.AxisScaleTypeMap);
		}

		internal RectangleFillStyle GetPointFillStyle(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex)
		{
			IWaterfallPoint waterfallPoint = points[pointIndex];
			RectangleFillStyle rectangleFillStyle = ((!waterfallPoint.IsSubTotal) ? ((waterfallPoint.RelativeValue > 0.0) ? RisingBarFillStyle : FallingBarFillStyle) : SubtotalBarFillStyle);
			return rectangleFillStyle ?? base.ActualFillStyle;
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.WaterfallSeriesPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesContainerLayout CreateSeriesContainerLayout(SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
		{
			return new WaterfallSeriesContainerLayout(seriesContainerData, mapping, singleLayout);
		}

		protected internal override IIndicatorValueProvider CreateIndicatorValueProvider()
		{
			return new IndicatorWaterfallValueProvider();
		}

		protected override void GenerateRandomNumericValues(object[] values, int indexOfRandomPoint)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				values[i] = Math.Round(SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() * 10.0, 1) * Math.Pow(-1.0, indexOfRandomPoint);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement element)
		{
			base.Assign(element);
			if (element is WaterfallSeriesView waterfallSeriesView)
			{
				risingBarColor = waterfallSeriesView.risingBarColor;
				fallingBarColor = waterfallSeriesView.fallingBarColor;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRisingBarColor()
		{
			return risingBarColor != DefaultRisingColor;
		}

		private void ResetRisingBarColor()
		{
			risingBarColor = DefaultRisingColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFallingBarColor()
		{
			return fallingBarColor != DefaultFallingColor;
		}

		private void ResetFallingBarColor()
		{
			fallingBarColor = DefaultFallingColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStartBarColor()
		{
			return StartBarColor != DefaultTotalColor;
		}

		private void ResetStartBarColor()
		{
			StartBarColor = DefaultTotalColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSubtotalBarColor()
		{
			return SubtotalBarColor != DefaultTotalColor;
		}

		private void ResetSubtotalBarColor()
		{
			SubtotalBarColor = DefaultTotalColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTotalBarColor()
		{
			return TotalBarColor != DefaultTotalColor;
		}

		private void ResetTotalBarColor()
		{
			TotalBarColor = DefaultTotalColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeConnectorStyle()
		{
			return ConnectorStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeConnectorColor()
		{
			return ConnectorColor != DefaultConnectorColor;
		}

		private void ResetConnectorColor()
		{
			ConnectorColor = DefaultConnectorColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueOptions()
		{
			return ValueOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetValueOptions()
		{
			ValueOptions = new WaterfallRelativeValueOptions();
		}
	}
	public enum WaterfallPointType

		Start,
		Subtotal,
		Total
