	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Subtotal")]
	public class Subtotal : ChartElement, ISubtotal, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private const int DefaultPointIndex = -1;

		private int pointIndex = -1;

		private string label = string.Empty;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Subtotal.PointIndex")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Subtotal.PointIndex")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int PointIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return pointIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pointIndex != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointIndex = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("PointIndex");
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Subtotal.Label")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Subtotal.Label")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Label
		{
			get
			{
				return label;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(label == value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					label = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Label");
				}
			}
		}

		internal event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		protected Subtotal(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected Subtotal(ChartElement owner, int pointIndex, string label)
			: this(owner)
		{
			this.pointIndex = pointIndex;
			this.label = label;
		}

		public Subtotal()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public Subtotal(int pointIndex, string label)
			: this(null, pointIndex, label)
		{
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Subtotal(null);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Subtotal subtotal)
			{
				pointIndex = subtotal.pointIndex;
				label = subtotal.label;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePointIndex()
		{
			return pointIndex != -1;
		}

		private void ResetPointIndex()
		{
			pointIndex = -1;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLabel()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(label);
		}

		private void ResetLabel()
		{
			label = string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializePointIndex())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLabel();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class WaterfallValueOptionsBase : ChartElement, IWaterfallValueOptions, IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem
	{
		private class SubtotalComparer : IComparer<ISubtotal>
		{
			private static SubtotalComparer instance = new SubtotalComparer();

			public static SubtotalComparer Instance => instance;

			int IComparer<ISubtotal>.Compare(ISubtotal x, ISubtotal y)
			{
				return x.PointIndex.CompareTo(y.PointIndex);
			}
		}

		private const string ValueOptionsName = "ValueOptions";

		private const string DefaultTotalLabel = "Total";

		private readonly SubtotalCollection subtotals;

		private bool showTotal = true;

		private string totalLabel = "Total";

		private List<ISubtotal> sortedPositiveSubtotals;

		private bool isSpreadsheetChart;

		protected virtual string StartLabel => string.Empty;

		protected virtual double StartValue => 0.0;

		internal bool IsSpreadsheetChart => isSpreadsheetChart;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase.Subtotals")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase.Subtotals")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public SubtotalCollection Subtotals => subtotals;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase.ShowTotal")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase.ShowTotal")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowTotal
		{
			get
			{
				return showTotal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (showTotal != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					showTotal = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase.TotalLabel")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallValueOptionsBase.TotalLabel")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TotalLabel
		{
			get
			{
				return totalLabel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(totalLabel == value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					totalLabel = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		string IWaterfallValueOptions.StartLabel => StartLabel;

		double IWaterfallValueOptions.StartValue => StartValue;

		string IWaterfallValueOptions.TotalLabel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowTotal || isSpreadsheetChart)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return TotalLabel;
			}
		}

		bool IWaterfallValueOptions.ShouldUpdateScaleMap => !isSpreadsheetChart;

		IList<ISubtotal> IWaterfallValueOptions.SortedSubtotals
		{
			get
			{
				if (sortedPositiveSubtotals == null)
				{
					sortedPositiveSubtotals = new List<ISubtotal>();
					foreach (ISubtotal subtotal in Subtotals)
					{
						if (subtotal.PointIndex > 0 || isSpreadsheetChart)
						{
							sortedPositiveSubtotals.Add(subtotal);
						}
					}
					sortedPositiveSubtotals.Sort(SubtotalComparer.Instance);
				}
				return sortedPositiveSubtotals;
			}
		}

		protected WaterfallValueOptionsBase(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			subtotals = new SubtotalCollection(this);
		}

		WaterfallPointInteraction IWaterfallValueOptions.CreatePointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (isSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return new WaterfallXCelPointInteraction(series, seriesIndex, point);
			}
			return CreatePointInteraction(series, seriesIndex, point);
		}

		WaterfallFilterBehavior IWaterfallValueOptions.CreateFilterBehavior(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (isSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return new XCelWaterfallFilterBehavior(refinedSeries);
			}
			return new WaterfallFilterBehavior(refinedSeries);
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Subtotals")
			{
				Subtotals.Add((Subtotal)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Subtotals")
			{
				return new Subtotal();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetIsSpreadsheetChart()
		{
			isSpreadsheetChart = true;
		}

		protected internal void RaiseChanged()
		{
			Series series = WaterfallHelper.FindWaterfallSeries(base.Chart);
			if (series != null)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(series, "ValueOptions"));
			}
		}

		protected abstract WaterfallPointInteraction CreatePointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point);

		protected internal override void ChildCollectionChanged(ChartCollectionBase collection, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			base.ChildCollectionChanged(collection, change);
			sortedPositiveSubtotals = null;
			RaiseChanged();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Subtotals" => ShouldSerializeSubtotals(), 
				"ShowTotal" => ShouldSerializeShowTotal(), 
				"TotalLabel" => ShouldSerializeTotalLabel(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeShowTotal() && !ShouldSerializeSubtotals())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTotalLabel();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is WaterfallValueOptionsBase waterfallValueOptionsBase)
			{
				if (waterfallValueOptionsBase.Subtotals.Count > 0)
				{
					subtotals.Assign(waterfallValueOptionsBase.Subtotals);
				}
				showTotal = waterfallValueOptionsBase.showTotal;
				totalLabel = waterfallValueOptionsBase.totalLabel;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSubtotals()
		{
			return Subtotals.Count != 0;
		}

		private void ResetSubtotals()
		{
			Subtotals.Clear();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTotalLabel()
		{
			return TotalLabel != "Total";
		}

		private void ResetTotalLabel()
		{
			TotalLabel = "Total";
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowTotal()
		{
			return !ShowTotal;
		}

		private void ResetShowTotal()
		{
			ShowTotal = true;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallRelativeValueOptions")]

					RaiseControlChanging();
					startBarValue = value;
					RaiseChanged();

			}

		internal WaterfallRelativeValueOptions(ChartElement owner)

			return new WaterfallRelativeValueOptions();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "StartBarLabel"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "StartBarValue")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeStartBarValue();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeStartBarLabel();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeStartBarLabel())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeStartBarValue();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is WaterfallRelativeValueOptions waterfallRelativeValueOptions)
			{
				startBarLabel = waterfallRelativeValueOptions.startBarLabel;
				startBarValue = waterfallRelativeValueOptions.startBarValue;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStartBarValue()
		{
			return StartBarValue != 0.0;
		}

		private void ResetStartBarValue()
		{
			StartBarValue = 0.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeStartBarLabel()
		{
			return StartBarLabel != string.Empty;
		}

		private void ResetStartBarLabel()
		{
			StartBarLabel = string.Empty;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.WaterfallAbsoluteValueOptions")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(WaterfallAbsoluteValueOptionsTypeConverter))]
	public class WaterfallAbsoluteValueOptions : WaterfallValueOptionsBase
	{
		internal WaterfallAbsoluteValueOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)

			: this(null)

		}

		{
			return new WaterfallAbsolutePointInteraction(series, seriesIndex, point);

		}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SubtotalCollection")]
	public class SubtotalCollection : ChartCollectionBase, IEnumerable<ISubtotal>, IEnumerable
	{
		public Subtotal this[int index] => (Subtotal)base.List[index];

		internal SubtotalCollection(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator<ISubtotal> IEnumerable<ISubtotal>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (ISubtotal inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				yield return inner;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public int Add(Subtotal item)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			int result = Add((ChartElement)item);
			item.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
			RaiseControlChanged();
			return result;
		}

		public void AddRange(Subtotal[] coll)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
			foreach (Subtotal subtotal in coll)
			{
				subtotal.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
			}
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void Remove(Subtotal item)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			Remove((ChartElement)item);
			item.PropertyChanged -= OnItemPropertyChanged;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Subtotal item)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)item);
			item.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}
	}

		public BoxPlotSeriesView()
		{
			SetAnimation(GetDefaultAnimation());
			SetSeriesAnimation(GetDefaultSeriesAnimation());
			border = new InsideRectangularBorder(this, visible: true, Color.Empty);
			fillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this);
			lineThickness = 2;
			outlierMarkerSizePixels = 10;
			boxPlotRenderer = new BoxPlotRenderer(this);
			outlierMarkerKind = MarkerKind.Circle;
			meanMarkerKind = MarkerKind.ThinCross;
			meanMarkerSizePixels = 15;
			meanAndMedianColor = DefaultMeanAndMedianColor;
			meanLineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 2, antiAlias: true);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBoxWidth()
		{
			return boxWidth != 0.6;
		}

		private void ResetBoxWidth()
		{
			BoxWidth = 0.6;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorder()
		{
			return border.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFillStyle()
		{
			return fillStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBoxDistance()
		{
			return BoxDistance != 0.0;
		}

		private void ResetBoxDistance()
		{
			BoxDistance = 0.0;
		}

		{
			return BoxDistanceFixed != 1;

		private void ResetBoxDistanceFixed()
		{
			BoxDistanceFixed = 1;
		}

		private object[] GenerateNumericalRandomPoints()
		{
			double num = SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() * 10.0;
			double num2 = num + (SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() + 0.1) * 5.0;
			double num3 = num2 + (SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() + 0.1) * 5.0;
			double num4 = num3 + (SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() + 0.1) * 5.0;
			double num5 = num4 + (SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() + 0.1) * 5.0;
			double num6 = num5 + (SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() + 0.1) * 5.0;
			double num7 = num6 + (SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() + 0.1) * 5.0;
			return new object[7] { num, num2, num3, num5, num6, num4, num7 };
		}

		private object[] GenerateTimeSpanRandomValues()
		{
			int seconds = SeriesViewBase.random.Next(0, 50);
			TimeSpan timeSpan = new TimeSpan(0, 0, seconds);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeSpan.TotalSeconds + (double)SeriesViewBase.random.Next(10, 50));
			TimeSpan timeSpan3 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeSpan2.TotalSeconds + (double)SeriesViewBase.random.Next(10, 50));
			TimeSpan timeSpan4 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeSpan3.TotalSeconds + (double)SeriesViewBase.random.Next(10, 50));
			TimeSpan timeSpan5 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeSpan4.TotalSeconds + (double)SeriesViewBase.random.Next(10, 50));
			TimeSpan timeSpan6 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeSpan5.TotalSeconds + (double)SeriesViewBase.random.Next(10, 50));
			TimeSpan timeSpan7 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeSpan6.TotalSeconds + (double)SeriesViewBase.random.Next(10, 50));
			return new object[7] { timeSpan, timeSpan2, timeSpan3, timeSpan5, timeSpan6, timeSpan4, timeSpan7 };
		}

		private object[] GenerateDateTimeRandomValues()
		{
			DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(DateTime.Now.Year - 1, 1, 1);
			DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			DateTime dateTime3 = dateTime2.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			DateTime dateTime4 = dateTime3.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			DateTime dateTime5 = dateTime4.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			DateTime dateTime6 = dateTime5.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			DateTime dateTime7 = dateTime6.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			DateTime dateTime8 = dateTime7.AddDays(SeriesViewBase.random.Next(1, 30));
			return new object[7] { dateTime2, dateTime3, dateTime4, dateTime6, dateTime7, dateTime5, dateTime8 };
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double val = double.MinValue;
			if (((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers != null)
			{
				val = ((((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Length != 0) ? ((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Max() : double.MinValue);
			}
			return Math.Max(((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Max, val);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double val = double.MaxValue;
			if (((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers != null)
			{
				val = ((((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Length != 0) ? ((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Min() : double.MaxValue);
			}
			return Math.Min(((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Min, val);
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in anchorPointLayoutList.Annotations)
			{
				SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint = (SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint;
				AxisScaleTypeMap scaleTypeMap = anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap;
				SeriesPoint userSeriesPoint = seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint();
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData.GetRefinedPoint(scaleTypeMap, userSeriesPoint);
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					double max = ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Max;
					XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = anchorPointLayoutList.GetMapping(refinedPoint.Argument, max, annotation.ScrollingSupported);
					if (mapping != null)
					{
						DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = mapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, max);
						AnnotationLayout item = new AnnotationLayout(annotation, screenPointNoRound, refinedPoint);
						anchorPointLayoutList.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		{

			double max = refinedPoint.Max;
			double min = refinedPoint.Min;
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, snapMode, min, max);
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, SeriesLayout seriesLayout, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			if (!meanLineVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData = (LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData)seriesLayout.SeriesData.WholeViewData;
			List<IGeometryStrip> strips = StripsUtils.MapBoxPlotMeanLineStrips(diagramMapping, lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData.Strips);
			return new BoxPlotMeanLineWholeSeriesLayout(seriesLayout, strips, lineThickness, diagramMapping.InflatedBounds, ((XYDiagramSeriesLayout)seriesLayout).SingleLayout);
		}

		{
			if (!meanLineVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<IGeometryStrip> strips = geometryCalculator.CreateStrips(seriesData.RefinedSeries);
			return new LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData(strips);
		}

			return "(CandleStickReductionOptions)";
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<int>(base.GetHashCode(), (int)fillMode);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CandleStickReductionOptions candleStickReductionOptions && candleStickReductionOptions.GetType().Equals(GetType()) && base.Equals((object)candleStickReductionOptions))
			{
				return candleStickReductionOptions.fillMode == fillMode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is CandleStickReductionOptions candleStickReductionOptions)
			{
				fillMode = candleStickReductionOptions.fillMode;
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(NestedDoughnutSeriesViewTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "LocalizationRes", "ChartStringId.SvnNestedDoughnut", "NestedDoughnutSeriesView")]
	public class NestedDoughnutSeriesView : DoughnutSeriesView, INestedDoughnutSeriesView, ISupportSeriesGroups
	{
		private const double DefaultWeight = 1.0;

		private const double DefaultInnerIndent = 5.0;

		private const int DefaultHolePercent = 40;

		private double weight = 1.0;

		private double innerIndent = 5.0;

		private bool isOutside = true;

		private object group;

		protected override bool NeedSeriesGroupsInteraction => true;

		protected override int DefaultHoleRadiusPercent => 40;

		protected internal override string StringId => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SvnNestedDoughnut);

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NestedDoughnutSeriesView.Weight")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NestedDoughnutSeriesView.Weight")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public double Weight
		{
			get
			{
				return weight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (weight != value)
				{
					if (value <= 0.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNestedDoughnutWeight));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					weight = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "Weight"));
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NestedDoughnutSeriesView.InnerIndent")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NestedDoughnutSeriesView.InnerIndent")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public double InnerIndent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerIndent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (innerIndent != value)
				{
					if (value < 0.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNestedDoughnutInnerIndent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					innerIndent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "InnerIndent"));
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NestedDoughnutSeriesView.Group")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NestedDoughnutSeriesView.Group")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ObjectTypeConverter))]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.SeriesGroupTypeEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		public object Group
		{
			get
			{
				return group;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(group, value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					group = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "Group"));
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public string GroupSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return ObjectToStringConversion.ObjectToString(Group);
			}
			set
			{
				Group = ObjectToStringConversion.StringToObject(value);
			}
		}

		bool? INestedDoughnutSeriesView.IsOutside
		{
			get
			{
				return isOutside;
			}
			set
			{
				isOutside = value.Value;
			}
		}

		double INestedDoughnutSeriesView.HoleRadiusPercent => HolePercent;

		object ISupportSeriesGroups.SeriesGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return Group;
			}
			set
			{
				Group = value;
			}
		}

		public NestedDoughnutSeriesView()
		{
		}

		public NestedDoughnutSeriesView(int[] explodedPointIds)
			: base(explodedPointIds)
		{
		}

		bool INestedDoughnutSeriesView.HasExplodedPoints(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return HasExplodedPoints(refinedSeries);
		}

		double INestedDoughnutSeriesView.GetExplodedDistancePercentage(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return base.ExplodedDistancePercentage;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Weight" => ShouldSerializeWeight(), 
				"InnerIndent" => ShouldSerializeInnerIndent(), 
				"GroupSerializable" => ShouldSerializeGroupSerializable(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeWeight()
		{
			return weight != 1.0;
		}

		private void ResetWeight()
		{
			Weight = 1.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeInnerIndent()
		{
			return innerIndent != 5.0;
		}

		private void ResetInnerIndent()
		{
			InnerIndent = 5.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGroupSerializable()
		{
			return GroupSerializable != string.Empty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeGroup()
		{
			return Group != null;
		}

		private void ResetGroup()
		{
			Group = null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeWeight())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeInnerIndent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private float CalculatePieSemiaxis(INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries nestedDoughnutSeries, double domainSize)
		{
			double num = domainSize / 2.0;
			double num2 = (1.0 - nestedDoughnutSeries.HoleRadius) * num;
			double num3 = num2 - nestedDoughnutSeries.TotalGroupIndentInPixels;
			double num4 = num3 * nestedDoughnutSeries.StartOffset + nestedDoughnutSeries.StartOffsetInPixels;
			return (float)((num - num4) * 2.0);
		}

		protected internal override SizeF CalculatePieSize(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, SizeF domainSize)
		{
			INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries nestedDoughnutSeries = (INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
			float width = CalculatePieSemiaxis(nestedDoughnutSeries, domainSize.Width);
			float height = CalculatePieSemiaxis(nestedDoughnutSeries, domainSize.Height);
			return new SizeF(width, height);
		}

		protected internal override double CalculateActualHolePercent(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, SizeF domainSize)
		{
			INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries = (INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
			double num = (double)Math.Max(domainSize.Width, domainSize.Height) / 2.0;
			double num2 = (1.0 - nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.HoleRadius) * num;
			double num3 = num2 - nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.TotalGroupIndentInPixels;
			double num4 = num3 * nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.StartOffset + nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.StartOffsetInPixels;
			double val = (1.0 - num3 * nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.NormalizedWeight / (num - num4)) * 100.0;
			return Math.Min(val, 100.0);
		}

		protected internal override double GetExplodedFactor(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries = (INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
			return nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.ExplodedFactor;
		}

		protected override bool CanExplodePoint(IPiePoint pointInfo)
		{
			return isOutside;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsExploded(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries = (INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
			return nestedDoughnutRefinedSeries.IsExploded;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new NestedDoughnutSeriesView();
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.NestedDonutPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new NestedDoughnutSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override SeriesInteractionContainer CreateSeriesGroupsContainer()
		{
			return new NestedDoughnutInteractionContainer(this);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is NestedDoughnutSeriesView nestedDoughnutSeriesView)
			{
				weight = nestedDoughnutSeriesView.weight;
				innerIndent = nestedDoughnutSeriesView.innerIndent;
				group = nestedDoughnutSeriesView.group;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NestedDoughnutSeriesView nestedDoughnutSeriesView = (NestedDoughnutSeriesView)obj;
			if (weight == nestedDoughnutSeriesView.weight && innerIndent == nestedDoughnutSeriesView.innerIndent)
			{
				return object.Equals(group, nestedDoughnutSeriesView.group);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private void AddPoints(SwiftPlotDiagramMapping swiftPlotMapping, List<Point> points, double argument, double minValue, double maxValue, double firstVal, double lastValue)
		{
			points.Add(swiftPlotMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(argument, firstVal));
			if (minValue != maxValue)
			{
				if (minValue != firstVal && minValue != lastValue)
				{
					points.Add(swiftPlotMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(argument, minValue));
				}
				if (maxValue != firstVal && maxValue != lastValue)
				{
					points.Add(swiftPlotMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(argument, maxValue));
				}
				points.Add(swiftPlotMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(argument, lastValue));
			}
		}

		private double CalculateArgumentsPerPixel(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, SwiftPlotDiagramMapping swiftPlotMapping, RefinedPoint minPoint, RefinedPoint maxPoint)
		{
			Point roundedScreenPoint = swiftPlotMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(maxPoint.Argument, maxPoint.Value1);
			Point roundedScreenPoint2 = swiftPlotMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(minPoint.Argument, minPoint.Value1);
			Interval bounds = diagramMapping.LayoutX.Bounds;
			double num = (((double)roundedScreenPoint.X > bounds.End) ? swiftPlotMapping.MappingX.Max : maxPoint.Argument);
			double num2 = (((double)roundedScreenPoint2.X < bounds.Start) ? swiftPlotMapping.MappingX.Min : minPoint.Argument);
			return (num - num2) / bounds.Length;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in anchorPointLayoutList.Annotations)
			{
				SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint = (SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData.GetRefinedPoint(anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap, seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint());
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					IValuePoint valuePoint = refinedPoint;
					XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = anchorPointLayoutList.GetMapping(refinedPoint.Argument, valuePoint.Value, annotation.ScrollingSupported);
					if (mapping != null)
					{
						anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, mapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, valuePoint.Value), refinedPoint));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, SeriesLayout seriesLayout, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			if (!(diagramMapping is SwiftPlotDiagramMapping swiftPlotDiagramMapping))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<List<Point>> list = new List<List<Point>>();
			List<Point> list2 = new List<Point>();
			RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData = seriesLayout.SeriesData;
			IList<RefinedPoint> points = seriesData.Points;
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = seriesData.Points[seriesData.MinVisiblePointIndex];
			double num = refinedPoint.Argument;
			double num2 = ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value;
			double num3 = num2;
			bool flag = refinedPoint.IsEmpty;
			int maxVisiblePointIndex = seriesData.MaxVisiblePointIndex;
			int num4 = ((!ShowIsolatedPoints) ? 1 : 0);
			double firstVal = refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value_1);
			double lastValue = double.NaN;
			Func<double, double> func;
			if (diagramMapping.AxisX.Logarithmic)
			{
				func = swiftPlotDiagramMapping.GetRoundedScreenArgument;
			}
			else
			{
				double argumentsPerPixel = CalculateArgumentsPerPixel(diagramMapping, swiftPlotDiagramMapping, refinedPoint, seriesData.Points[seriesData.MaxVisiblePointIndex]);
				func = (double num8) => Math.Floor(num8 / argumentsPerPixel);
			}
			for (int num5 = seriesData.MinVisiblePointIndex + 1; num5 <= maxVisiblePointIndex; num5++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = points[num5];
				double argument = refinedPoint2.Argument;
				double value = refinedPoint2.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value_1);
				double num6 = func(num);
				double num7 = func(argument);
				bool isEmpty = refinedPoint2.IsEmpty;
				if (num6 != num7 || flag != isEmpty)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						AddPoints(swiftPlotDiagramMapping, list2, num, num2, num3, firstVal, lastValue);
					}
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						if (list2.Count > num4)
						{
							list.Add(list2);
						}
						list2 = new List<Point>();
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						num = argument;
						num2 = value;
						num3 = value;
						flag = false;
					}
					firstVal = value;
				}
				else if (!isEmpty)
				{
					if (num2 > value)
					{
						num2 = value;
					}
					if (num3 < value)
					{
						num3 = value;
					}
					lastValue = value;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				AddPoints(swiftPlotDiagramMapping, list2, num, num2, num3, firstVal, lastValue);
			}
			if (list2.Count > num4)
			{
				list.Add(list2);
			}
			return new SwiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout(seriesLayout, list, GetLineThickness((SwiftPlotDrawOptions)seriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions, seriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState), diagramMapping.InflatedBounds);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			SwiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout swiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout = layout as SwiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout;
			if (!(layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions is SwiftPlotDrawOptions drawOptions) || swiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout == null || swiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Color lineColor = GetLineColor(drawOptions, layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState);
			int lineThickness = GetLineThickness(drawOptions, layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(antialiasing);
			foreach (List<Point> strip in swiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout.Strips)
			{
				renderer.DrawLines(strip.ToArray(), lineColor, lineThickness, lineStyle);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SwiftPlotSeriesView swiftPlotSeriesView = (SwiftPlotSeriesView)obj;
			if (lineStyle.Equals(swiftPlotSeriesView.lineStyle))
			{
				return antialiasing == swiftPlotSeriesView.antialiasing;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, SeriesLayout seriesLayout, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			SwiftPlotDiagramMapping swiftPlotDiagramMapping = diagramMapping as SwiftPlotDiagramMapping;
			SwiftPointDrawOptions swiftPointDrawOptions = seriesLayout.DrawOptions as SwiftPointDrawOptions;
			RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData = seriesLayout.SeriesData;
			int num = seriesData.MaxVisiblePointIndex - seriesData.MinVisiblePointIndex;
			if (num > 0 && swiftPointDrawOptions != null)
			{
				PointsRenderOptimizer pointsRenderOptimizer = null;
				int size = swiftPointDrawOptions.Marker.Size;
				if (PointsRenderOptimizer.ShouldOptimize(num))
				{
					pointsRenderOptimizer = new PointsRenderOptimizer(diagramMapping.InflatedBounds, new SizeF(size, size), swiftPointDrawOptions.Color.A);
				}
				for (int i = seriesData.MinVisiblePointIndex; i <= seriesData.MaxVisiblePointIndex; i++)
				{
					IValuePoint valuePoint = seriesData.Points[i];
					Point roundedScreenPoint = swiftPlotDiagramMapping.GetRoundedScreenPoint(valuePoint.Argument, valuePoint.Value);
					if (pointsRenderOptimizer == null || pointsRenderOptimizer.EmulateRender(roundedScreenPoint))
					{
						GRealPoint2D item = new GRealPoint2D(roundedScreenPoint.X, roundedScreenPoint.Y);
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return new SwiftPointWholeSeriesLayout(seriesLayout, list);
		}

			SwiftPointSeriesViewPainter.RenderMarkers(renderer, layout2, drawOptions, base.ActualAppearance);
		}

			if (obj is SwiftPointSeriesView swiftPointSeriesView)
			{
				return swiftPointSeriesView.PointMarkerOptions.Equals(PointMarkerOptions);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		internal bool IsScrollingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane = ActualPane;
				if (actualPane != null)
				{
					if (!actualPane.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling)
					{
						return actualPane.ActualEnableAxisYScrolling;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.AggregateFunction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.AggregateFunction")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		public SeriesAggregateFunction AggregateFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return aggregateFunction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (aggregateFunction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					bool flag = aggregateFunction == SeriesAggregateFunction.Histogram || value == SeriesAggregateFunction.Histogram;
					aggregateFunction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "AggregateFunction"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
					if (flag && base.SeriesBase != null)
					{
						base.Chart?.DataContainer.InvalidateBackCompatibilityAdapters(needResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType: false);
						base.SeriesBase.BindingChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the custom aggregate function callback that calculates the aggregated values.")]

			indicators = new IndicatorCollection(this);
			financialIndicators = new FinancialIndicators(this);
			regressionLines = new RegressionLines(this);
			rangeControlOptions = new RangeControlOptions(this);
			aggregateFunction = SeriesAggregateFunction.Default;
		}

		List<ISeparatePaneIndicator> IXYSeriesView.GetSeparatePaneIndicators()
		{
			List<ISeparatePaneIndicator> list = new List<ISeparatePaneIndicator>();
			foreach (Indicator indicator in Indicators)
			{
				if (indicator is ISeparatePaneIndicator item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		List<IAffectsAxisRange> IXYSeriesView.GetIndicatorsAffectRange()
		{
			List<IAffectsAxisRange> list = new List<IAffectsAxisRange>();
			foreach (Indicator indicator in Indicators)
			{
				if (indicator is IAffectsAxisRange item && indicator.Visible)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePaneName()
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane = ActualPane;
			if (actualPane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				return actualPane != xYDiagram.DefaultPane;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisXName()
		{
			Axis2D actualAxisX = ActualAxisX;
			if (actualAxisX == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				return actualAxisX != xYDiagram.ActualAxisX;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisYName()
		{
			Axis2D actualAxisY = ActualAxisY;
			if (actualAxisY == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				return actualAxisY != xYDiagram.ActualAxisY;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIndicators()
		{
			return indicators.Count > 0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFinancialIndicators()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRegressionLines()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRangeControlOptions()
		{
			return rangeControlOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction()
		{
			return AggregateFunction != SeriesAggregateFunction.Default;
		}

		private void ResetAggregateFunction()
		{
			AggregateFunction = SeriesAggregateFunction.Default;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializePaneName() && !ShouldSerializeAxisXName() && !ShouldSerializeAxisYName() && !ShouldSerializeIndicators() && !ShouldSerializeFinancialIndicators() && !ShouldSerializeRangeControlOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"PaneName" => ShouldSerializePaneName(), 
				"AxisXName" => ShouldSerializeAxisXName(), 
				"AxisYName" => ShouldSerializeAxisYName(), 
				"Indicators" => ShouldSerializeIndicators(), 
				"FinancialIndicators" => ShouldSerializeFinancialIndicators(), 
				"RegressionLines" => ShouldSerializeRegressionLines(), 
				"RangeControlOptions" => ShouldSerializeRangeControlOptions(), 
				"AggregateFunction" => ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Indicators"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return XtraSerializingUtils.GetKnownContentPropertyInstance(e, SerializationUtils.ChartAssembly, SerializationUtils.PublicNamespace) as Indicator;
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Indicators")
			{
				indicators.Add((Indicator)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override IList<IDataSourceIndicator> GetDataSourceIndicators()
		{
			return Indicators.DataSourceIndicators;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<double> GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			yield return ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value;
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return GetXYDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected override AxisBase GetAxisX()
		{
			if (ActualAxisX != null)
			{
				return ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (base.Chart != null && base.Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(AxisXName))
				{
					AxisBase axisBase = xYDiagram.FindAxisXByName(AxisXName);
					if (axisBase != null)
					{
						return axisBase;
					}
				}
				return xYDiagram.AxisX;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override AxisBase GetAxisY()
		{
			if (ActualAxisY != null)
			{
				return ActualAxisY;
			}
			if (base.Chart != null && base.Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(AxisYName))
				{
					AxisBase axisBase = xYDiagram.FindAxisYByName(AxisYName);
					if (axisBase != null)
					{
						return axisBase;
					}
				}
				return xYDiagram.AxisY;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal string GetPaneName()
		{
			return paneName;
		}

		internal string GetAxisXName()
		{
			return axisXName;
		}

		internal string GetAxisYName()
		{
			return axisYName;
		}

		internal XYDiagram2D GetXYDiagram()
		{
			if (!(base.Owner is SeriesBase { Chart: var chart }))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (xYDiagram2D == null)
			{
				xYDiagram2D = chart.DiagramCache.Load(DiagramType) as XYDiagram2D;
			}
			return xYDiagram2D;
		}

		protected void CheckPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, bool allowNull)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				if (!allowNull)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullSeriesViewPane));
				}
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null && pane != xYDiagram.DefaultPane && !xYDiagram.Panes.Contains(pane))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesViewPane));
			}
		}

		protected void CheckAxisX(Axis2D axisX, bool allowNull)
		{
			if (axisX == null)
			{
				if (!allowNull)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullSeriesViewAxisX));
				}
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null && axisX != xYDiagram.ActualAxisX && !xYDiagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX.ContainsInternal(axisX))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesViewAxisX));
			}
		}

		protected void CheckAxisY(Axis2D axisY, bool allowNull)
		{
			if (axisY == null)
			{
				if (!allowNull)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullSeriesViewAxisY));
				}
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null && axisY != xYDiagram.ActualAxisY && !xYDiagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY.ContainsInternal(axisY))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesViewAxisY));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(point.Argument);
		}

		protected internal virtual ScreenPointCalculator CreateScreenPointCalculator(SidePointDisplayMode displayMode)
		{
			return displayMode switch
			{
				SidePointDisplayMode.SeriesPoint => new EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder, alwaysOnDiagram: false), 
				SidePointDisplayMode.DiagramEdge => new EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder, alwaysOnDiagram: true), 
				_ => new ScreenPointCalculator(), 
			};
		}

		protected internal virtual ScreenPointCalculator CreateScreenPointMarkerCalculator(bool isFirstPoint)
		{
			return CreateScreenPointCalculator(SidePointDisplayMode.Default);
		}

		protected internal virtual ScreenPointCalculator CreateScreenPointLabelCalculator(int pointCount, bool isFirstPoint)
		{
			return CreateScreenPointCalculator(SidePointDisplayMode.Default);
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			BindViewToDiagram();
			regressionLines.OnEndLoading();
		}

		protected internal override bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Indicator indicator)
			{
				return indicators.Contains(indicator);
			}
			return base.Contains(obj);
		}

		protected internal override void CheckOnAddingSeries()
		{
			base.CheckOnAddingSeries();
			BindViewToDiagram();
			CheckPane(ActualPane, allowNull: true);
			CheckAxisX(ActualAxisX, allowNull: true);
			CheckAxisY(ActualAxisY, allowNull: true);
		}

		protected internal override void BindViewToDiagram()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram = GetXYDiagram();
			if (xYDiagram != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(paneName))
				{
					ActualPane = xYDiagram.FindPaneByName(paneName) ?? xYDiagram.DefaultPane;
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Pane"));
				}
				if (!xYDiagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX.Contains(ActualAxisX) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(axisXName))
				{
					Axis2D axis2D = xYDiagram.FindAxisXByName(axisXName) ?? xYDiagram.ActualAxisX;
					PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData> changeInfo = new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(this, "AxisX", ActualAxisX, axis2D);
					ActualAxisX = axis2D;
					RaiseControlChanged(changeInfo);
				}
				if (!xYDiagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY.Contains(ActualAxisY) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(axisYName))
				{
					Axis2D axis2D2 = xYDiagram.FindAxisYByName(axisYName) ?? xYDiagram.ActualAxisY;
					PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData> changeInfo2 = new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(this, "AxisY", ActualAxisY, axis2D2);
					ActualAxisY = axis2D2;
					RaiseControlChanged(changeInfo2);
				}
				indicators.BindToChart();
			}
			else
			{
				ActualPane = null;
				ActualAxisX = null;
				ActualAxisY = null;
			}
		}

		{
			base.CheckLegends(legend);
			foreach (Indicator indicator in Indicators)
			{
				if (indicator.Legend == legend)
				{
					indicator.Legend = base.Chart.Legend;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanLoadOneDimensionData(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			if (AggregateFunction == SeriesAggregateFunction.Histogram)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IAxisData actualAxisX = ActualAxisX;
			if (actualAxisX != null)
			{
				IScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase = null;
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					scaleOptionsBase = actualAxisX.NumericScaleOptions;
					break;
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					scaleOptionsBase = actualAxisX.DateTimeScaleOptions;
					break;
				case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
					scaleOptionsBase = actualAxisX.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
					break;
				case ScaleType.Qualitative:
					scaleOptionsBase = actualAxisX.QualitativeScaleOptions;
					break;
				}
				if (scaleOptionsBase != null)
				{
					return scaleOptionsBase.AggregateFunction == AggregateFunctionNative.Histogram;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

				axisXName = xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.AxisXName;

				indicators.Assign(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.indicators);
				financialIndicators.Assign(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.financialIndicators);
				rangeControlOptions.Assign(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.rangeControlOptions);
			}

	public abstract class ChartColorizerBase : ChartElement, IColorizer, INotifyPropertyChanged, IXtraSupportShouldSerialize
	{
		private PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChangedEventHandler;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChangedEventHandler => propertyChangedEventHandler;

		internal event EventHandler PropertyChanging;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertyChangedEventHandler = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedEventHandler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				propertyChangedEventHandler = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedEventHandler, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEndLoading()
		{
		}

		public abstract Color GetPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object colorKey, Palette palette);

		public virtual Color GetPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object[] colorKeys, Palette palette)
		{
			return GetPointColor(argument, values, colorKeys[0], palette);
		}

		public virtual Color GetAggregatedPointColor(object argument, object[] values, SeriesPoint[] points, Palette palette)
		{
			if (points.Length == 0)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			Dictionary<Color, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<Color, int>();
			int maxColorEntry = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				Color color = points[i].Color;
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(color))
				{
					maxColorEntry = Math.Max(maxColorEntry, ++dictionary[color]);
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[color] = 1;
				}
			}
			if (maxColorEntry <= 1)
			{
				return points[0].Color;
			}
			return dictionary.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<Color, int> x) => x.Value == maxColorEntry).Key;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"({GetType().Name})";
		}

		Color IColorizer.GetPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object colorKey, Palette palette)
		{
			return GetPointColor(argument, values, colorKey, palette);
		}

		Color IColorizer.GetPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object[] colorKeys, Palette palette)
		{
			return GetPointColor(argument, values, colorKeys, palette);
		}

		Color IColorizer.GetAggregatedPointColor(object argument, object[] values, SeriesPoint[] points, Palette palette)
		{
			return GetAggregatedPointColor(argument, values, points, palette);
		}

		internal void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (PropertyChangedEventHandler != null)
			{
				PropertyChangedEventHandler(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		internal void RaisePropertyChanging()
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanging != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanging(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.KeyCollection")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableCollectionTypeConverter))]
	public class KeyCollection : NotificationCollection<object>
	{
		internal List<ObjectSerializable> CreateSerializableKeys()
		{
			List<ObjectSerializable> list = new List<ObjectSerializable>();
			foreach (object item in (DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)this)
			{
				list.Add(new ObjectSerializable(item));
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void LoadSerializableKeys(List<ObjectSerializable> keys)
		{
			((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)this).Clear();
			foreach (ObjectSerializable key in keys)
			{
				((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)this).Add(key.KeyInternal);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ObjectSerializable
	{
		private object value;

		private string valueStr;

		private string typeStr;

		internal object KeyInternal => value;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public string Type
		{
			get
			{
				return typeStr;
			}
			set
			{
				typeStr = value;
				UpdateValue();
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			set
			{
				valueStr = value;
				UpdateValue();
			}
		}

		public ObjectSerializable()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal ObjectSerializable(object value)
		{
			this.value = value;
			valueStr = ((value != null) ? Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : null);
			typeStr = value?.GetType().ToString();
		}

		private void UpdateValue()
		{
			value = TryParseValue();
		}

		private object TryParseValue()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueStr) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeStr))
			{
				try
				{
					Type primitiveOrTrustedType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(typeStr, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)false);
					return Convert.ChangeType(valueStr, primitiveOrTrustedType, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return valueStr;
		}
	}

		{
			return ((DXCollectionBase<double>)(object)RangeStops).Count > 0;
		}

			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeLegendItemPattern() && !ShouldSerializeRangeStops())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"LegendItemPattern" => ShouldSerializeLegendItemPattern(), 
				"RangeStops" => ShouldSerializeRangeStops(), 
				"TypeNameSerializable" => ShouldSerializeTypeNameSerializable(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

				LegendItemPattern = rangeColorizer.LegendItemPattern;
			}
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(DataFilterTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class DataFilter : ChartElement, IDataFilter, IObjectValueTypeProvider
	{
		private static readonly Type defaultType = typeof(string);

		private const string StringTypeName = "System.String";

		private const DataFilterCondition DefaultCondition = DataFilterCondition.Equal;

		private string columnName;

		private Type dataType;

		private DataFilterCondition condition;

		private object val;

		private string valueSerializable;

		private bool required;

		private string ChartDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartContainer == null || ChartContainer.Chart == null || ChartContainer.Chart.DataContainer == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return ChartContainer.Chart.DataContainer.DataMember;
			}
		}

		protected internal string ActualColumnName
		{
			get
			{
				return columnName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value != columnName))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!CheckColumnName(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), value));
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				columnName = value;
				if (Owner != null)
				{
					string dataMember = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(Owner.GetChartDataMember(), columnName);
					Type memberType = BindingHelperCore.GetMemberType(Owner.GetChartDataContext(), Owner.GetDataSource(), dataMember, Owner.GetCalculatedFields());
					if (memberType != null)
					{
						DataType = memberType;
					}
				}
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		internal new SeriesBase Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesBase)base.Owner;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Owner = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the data field which the filter condition is applied to.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataFilter.ColumnName")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.Repaint)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartDataMemberEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ColumnName
		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner != null && ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.DataProvider != null && ChartContainer.DesignMode)
				{
					return BindingHelper.GetDataMemberName(ChartContainer.DataProvider.DataContext, Owner.GetDataSource(), ChartDataMember, columnName, Owner.GetCalculatedFields());
				}
				return columnName;
			}
			set
			{
				ActualColumnName = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ColumnNameSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnName == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return columnName;
			}
			set
			{
				try
				{
					ColumnName = value;
				}
				catch
				{
					ColumnName = string.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the data type of the value associated with the current data filter object.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataFilter.DataType")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.Repaint)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DataTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Type DataType
		{
			get
			{
				return dataType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dataType)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					dataType = value;
					if (!Loading && !CheckCondition(condition))
					{
						condition = DataFilterCondition.Equal;
					}
					try
					{
						SetValue(val);
					}
					catch
					{
						val = null;
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string DataTypeSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataType == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return dataType.AssemblyQualifiedName;
			}
			set
			{
				DataType = ObtainSafeType(value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the comparison operator used to filter the data points within a series.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataFilter.Condition")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DataFilterConditionTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DataFilterCondition Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return condition;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != condition)
				{
					if (!CheckCondition(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidFilterCondition), value.ToString(), dataType.ToString()));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					condition = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the filter value represented by the current data filter item.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataFilter.Value")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ObjectValueTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public virtual object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return val;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != val)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetValue(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string InvariantValueSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				if (val != null)
				{
					return Convert.ToString(val, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
				val = null;
				valueSerializable = value;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the InvariantValueSerializable property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ValueSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val.ToString();
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (val == null || value != val.ToString())
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetValue(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		Condition IDataFilter.Condition => (Condition)condition;

		bool IDataFilter.Required => required;

		string IDataFilter.ColumnName => ActualColumnName;

		private static object ConvertToCompatibleValue(IDataFilter dataFilter, object value)
		{
			if (dataFilter.DataType != null && value != null && value.GetType() != dataFilter.DataType)
			{
				return TypeConversion.ConvertToCompatibleValue(value, dataFilter.DataType);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal DataFilter(string columnName, string dataTypeName, DataFilterCondition condition, object val, bool required)
		{
			this.columnName = columnName;
			dataType = ObtainSafeType(dataTypeName);
			this.condition = condition;
			SetValue(val);
			this.required = required;
		}

		public DataFilter(string columnName, string dataTypeName, DataFilterCondition condition, object val)
			: this(columnName, dataTypeName, condition, val, required: false)
		{
		}

		public DataFilter()
			: this(string.Empty, "System.String", DataFilterCondition.Equal, null, required: false)
		{
		}

		CriteriaOperator IDataFilter.ToCriteriaOperator()
		{
			return ToCriteriaOperator();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColumnName()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName);
		}

		private void ResetColumnName()
		{
			ColumnName = string.Empty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDataType()
		{
			return !dataType.Equals(defaultType);
		}

		private void ResetDataType()
		{
			DataType = defaultType;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCondition()
		{
			return condition != DataFilterCondition.Equal;
		}

		private void ResetCondition()
		{
			Condition = DataFilterCondition.Equal;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValue()
		{
			return val != null;
		}

		private void ResetValue()
		{
			Value = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeInvariantValueSerializable()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(InvariantValueSerializable);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueSerializable()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"ColumnName" => false, 
				"DataTypeSerializable" => ShouldSerializeDataType(), 
				"Condition" => ShouldSerializeCondition(), 
				"InvariantValueSerializable" => ShouldSerializeInvariantValueSerializable(), 
				"ValueSerializable" => ShouldSerializeValueSerializable(), 
				"ColumnNameSerializable" => ShouldSerializeColumnName(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private void SetValue(object value)
		{
			val = ConvertToCompatibleValue(this, value);
			if (dataType == null && val != null)
			{
				dataType = val.GetType();
			}
		}

		private bool CheckCondition(DataFilterCondition condition)
		{
			if (condition != DataFilterCondition.Equal && condition != DataFilterCondition.NotEqual)
			{
				if (dataType != null)
				{
					return typeof(IComparable).IsAssignableFrom(dataType);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Type ObtainSafeType(string strType)
		{
			try
			{
				return SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(strType, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)false);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
				if (!Loading)
				{
					Owner.BindingChanged();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CheckColumnName(string columnName)
		{
			if (Owner == null || Owner.Loading)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DataContext dataContext = Owner.ContainerAdapter?.DataContext;
			return BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, Owner.GetDataSource(), BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(Owner.GetChartDataMember(), columnName), Owner.GetCalculatedFields());
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (val == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueSerializable))
			{
				if (dataType == null)
				{
					val = valueSerializable;
				}
				else
				{
					TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
					if (converter == null)
					{
						val = valueSerializable;
					}
					else
					{
						try
						{
							val = converter.ConvertTo(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, valueSerializable, dataType);
						}
						catch
						{
							try
							{
								val = converter.ConvertFrom(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, valueSerializable);
							}
							catch
							{
								val = valueSerializable;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			valueSerializable = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual CriteriaOperator ToCriteriaOperator()
		{
			OnEndLoading();
			return DataFilterToCriteriaConverter.Convert(this);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ColumnName))
			{
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.DefaultDataFilterName);
			}
			return ColumnName;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DataFilter dataFilter)
			{
				columnName = dataFilter.columnName;
				dataType = dataFilter.dataType;
				condition = dataFilter.condition;
				val = dataFilter.val;
				required = dataFilter.required;
			}
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new DataFilter(columnName, (dataType == null) ? null : dataType.ToString(), condition, val, required);
		}
	}
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartCollectionSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataFilterCollection")]
	public class DataFilterCollection : ChartCollectionBase, IEnumerable<IDataFilter>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class DataFilterEnumerator : IEnumerator<IDataFilter>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly DataFilterCollection collection;

			private int currentIndex;

			public object Current => collection[currentIndex];

			IDataFilter IEnumerator<IDataFilter>.Current => (IDataFilter)Current;

			public DataFilterEnumerator(DataFilterCollection collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return ++currentIndex < collection.List.Count;
			}
		}

		internal const ConjunctionTypes DefaultConjunctionMode = ConjunctionTypes.And;

		private ConjunctionTypes conjunctionMode;

		[Description("Gets or sets the conjunction mode for filter conditions defined by the collection’s items.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DataFilterCollection.ConjunctionMode")]
		public ConjunctionTypes ConjunctionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return conjunctionMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != conjunctionMode)
				{
					SendControlChanging();
					conjunctionMode = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public DataFilter this[int index] => (DataFilter)base.List[index];

		internal DataFilterCollection(SeriesBase series)
		{
			base.Owner = series;
		}

		IEnumerator<IDataFilter> IEnumerable<IDataFilter>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new DataFilterEnumerator(this);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeConjunctionMode()
		{
			return conjunctionMode != ConjunctionTypes.And;
		}

		private void ResetConjunctionMode()
		{
			ConjunctionMode = ConjunctionTypes.And;
		}

		private void AttachFilter(DataFilter filter)
		{
			filter.Owner = (SeriesBase)base.Owner;
			if (!filter.CheckColumnName(filter.ActualColumnName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), filter.ActualColumnName));
			}
		}

		internal void AddRangeWithoutChanged(DataFilter[] coll)
		{
			foreach (DataFilter dataFilter in coll)
			{
				dataFilter.Owner = (SeriesBase)base.Owner;
				if (!dataFilter.CheckColumnName(dataFilter.ActualColumnName))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), dataFilter.ActualColumnName));
				}
			}
			AddRangeWithoutChanged((ICollection)coll);
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			((SeriesBase)base.Owner).SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
		}

		public int Add(DataFilter filter)
		{
			AttachFilter(filter);
			SendControlChanging();
			int result = Add((ChartElement)filter);
			RaiseControlChanged();
			return result;
		}

		public int Add(string columnName, string dataTypeName, DataFilterCondition condition, object val)
		{
			return Add(new DataFilter(columnName, dataTypeName, condition, val));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, DataFilter filter)
		{
			AttachFilter(filter);
			SendControlChanging();
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)filter);
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void ClearAndAddRange(DataFilter[] coll)
		{
			Clear();
			AddRange(coll);
		}

		public void AddRange(DataFilter[] coll)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			AddRangeWithoutChanged(coll);
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void Remove(DataFilter filter)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			Remove((ChartElement)filter);
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}
	}
