	internal class SeriesBindingProcessor : SeriesBindingProcessorBase
	{
		private bool isContinuousData;

		private bool lastUnboundMode = true;

		protected override bool ShouldBreakUpdates => true;

		public SeriesBindingProcessor(Series seriesBindingProvider, BoundPointsList boundPoints)
			: base(seriesBindingProvider, boundPoints)
		{
			base.ElementHelper = seriesBindingProvider;
		}

		private void EnsureDataSourceAdapter(DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapter, Series series)
		{
			if (dataSourceAdapter != null)
			{
				dataSourceAdapter.ChartDataSource = series.DataContainer?.ActualDataSource;
				dataSourceAdapter.ChartDataMember = series.GetChartDataMember();
				dataSourceAdapter.CalculatedFields = series.GetCalculatedFields();
				if (series.DataContext != null)
				{
					dataSourceAdapter.DataContext = (DataContextBase)(object)series.DataContext;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool ResetSeriesBinding()
		{
			Series series = base.Series as Series;
			List<IDataPoint> boundPoints = GetBoundPoints();
			if (lastUnboundMode != series.UnboundMode || boundPoints != null || (!series.UnboundMode && boundPoints == null))
			{
				NotifyPointsClear(base.Series);
				base.BoundPoints.Clear();
				series.ResetBinding();
			}
			if (boundPoints != null)
			{
				base.BoundPoints.SetPoints(boundPoints);
				NotifyPointsInsert(series, boundPoints, 0);
			}
			lastUnboundMode = series.UnboundMode;
			return false;
		}

		protected override IDataPoint GetBoundPoint(int index)
		{
			Series series = (Series)base.Series;
			EnsureDataSourceAdapter(series.ActualDataAdapter as DataSourceAdapterBase, series);
			return new DataAdapterHelper(series).CreatePoint(index);
		}

		internal List<IDataPoint> GetBoundPoints()
		{
			Series series = (Series)base.Series;
			IChartDataAdapter actualDataAdapter = series.ActualDataAdapter;
			SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter = actualDataAdapter as SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter;
			if (seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter != null || series.DataContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataSourceAdapter dataSourceAdapter = actualDataAdapter as DataSourceAdapter;
			EnsureDataSourceAdapter(dataSourceAdapter, series);
			if (!base.SeriesBindingProvider.IsValidMembersForBinding)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series, updateIndicator: true);
			List<IDataPoint> result = dataAdapterHelper.CreateBindingPoints();
			isContinuousData = dataAdapterHelper.IsContinuousData;
			return result;
		}

		internal DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection TrySimplifyUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
			{
				if (update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged || update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset)
				{
					return updates;
				}
				if (update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove)
				{
					num4 += update.Count;
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, update.Index);
				}
				if (update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert)
				{
					num3 += update.Count;
					num = Math.Min(num, update.Index);
				}
			}
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			if (num < num2 + num4 || num4 > base.Series.ActualPoints.Count)
			{
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(base.SeriesBindingProvider);
			}
			else
			{
				if (num4 == 0 || num3 == 0 || updates.Count() < 3)
				{
					return updates;
				}
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(base.SeriesBindingProvider, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove, num2, num4));
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(base.SeriesBindingProvider, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert, num, num3));
			}
			return dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection;
		}

		public override Tuple<bool, bool, bool> ProcessUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update)
		{
			if (base.SeriesBindingProvider.IsUseDataFilters || !isContinuousData)
			{
				return new Tuple<bool, bool, bool>(ResetSeriesBinding(), item2: false, item3: true);
			}
			return ProcessUpdateCore(update);
		}

		public override Tuple<bool, bool> ProcessUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates, bool seriesCountChanged)
		{
			updates = TrySimplifyUpdates(updates);
			if (!isContinuousData || (updates.Count == 1 && updates[0].Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset))
			{
				return new Tuple<bool, bool>(ResetSeriesBinding(), seriesCountChanged);
			}
			Tuple<bool, bool> tuple = ProcessUpdatesCore(updates, seriesCountChanged, isContinuousData);
			if (!tuple.Item1)
			{
				ResetSeriesBinding();
			}
			return tuple;
		}

		public void SetUnboundMode(bool value)
		{
			lastUnboundMode = value;
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesCollection")]
	public class SeriesCollection : DisposableChartCollectionBase, IOwnedElement, ICollection<ISeries>, IEnumerable<ISeries>, IEnumerable
	{
		private string NamePrefix => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SeriesPrefix);

		internal DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart Chart
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((DataContainer)base.Owner).Chart;
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides access to individual series in the collection by their names.")]
		public Series this[int index] => (Series)base.List[index];

		public Series this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (Series item in base.List)
				{
					if (item.Name == name)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		int ICollection<ISeries>.Count => base.Count;

		bool ICollection<ISeries>.IsReadOnly => ((IList)this).IsReadOnly;

		IOwnedElement IOwnedElement.Owner => base.Owner;

		IChartContainer IOwnedElement.ChartContainer => base.Owner.ChartContainer;

		internal SeriesCollection(DataContainer owner)
		{
			base.Owner = owner;
		}

		IEnumerator<ISeries> IEnumerable<ISeries>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new SeriesCollectionEnumerator(base.List);
		}

		void ICollection<ISeries>.Add(ISeries item)
		{
			Add(item as Series);
		}

		void ICollection<ISeries>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<ISeries>.Contains(ISeries item)
		{
			return Contains(item as Series);
		}

		void ICollection<ISeries>.CopyTo(ISeries[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			((ICollection)this).CopyTo((Array)array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<ISeries>.Remove(ISeries item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item as Series);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		private string[] GetNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[base.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = this[i].Name;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected override ICollection GetUpdateInfoSequence(int index)
		{
			return base.UpdateHelper.GetUpdateInfoSequence<ISeries>(index);
		}

		protected override void DisposeItemBeforeRemove(ChartElement item)
		{
			if (!(item is Series series) || (series.Autocreated && !series.Permanent))
			{
				base.DisposeItemBeforeRemove(item);
			}
			item.Owner = null;
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, object oldItem, int oldIndex, object newItem, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo(this, operation, oldItem as ISeries, oldIndex, newItem as ISeries, newIndex));
		}

		protected override ChartUpdate CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, ICollection oldItems, int oldIndex, ICollection newItems, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(new SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, operation, oldItems as ICollection<ISeries>, oldIndex, newItems as ICollection<ISeries>, newIndex));
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			ChartElement chartElement = base.Owner;
			if (chartElement != null && !chartElement.Loading)
			{
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							Series series = (Series)enumerator.Current;
							series.ClearAnnotations();
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			GetOwner<DataContainer>()?.ViewController?.ClearCache();
			base.OnClear();
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value is Series series)
			{
				series.ClearAnnotations();
			}
			base.OnRemove(index, value);
		}

		protected override void ChangeOwnerForItem(ChartElement item)
		{
			base.ChangeOwnerForItem(item);
			if (!(item is Series series))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IDataPoint actualPoint in series.ActualPoints)
			{
				actualPoint.UpdateAnnotationRepository();
			}
		}

		protected override void CheckSwapAbility(ChartElement element1, ChartElement element2)
		{
			Series series = element1 as Series;
			Series series2 = element2 as Series;
			if (series != null && series2 != null && ((series.Autocreated && !series2.Autocreated) || (!series.Autocreated && series2.Autocreated)))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgCantSwapSeries));
			}
		}

		internal bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Series series = (Series)enumerator.Current;
					if (series.Contains(obj))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Series GetSeriesByID(int id)
		{
			return GetElementByID(id) as Series;
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo seriesCollectionUpdateInfo = change.UpdateInfo as SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo;
			DataContainer dataContainer = GetOwner<DataContainer>();
			if (seriesCollectionUpdateInfo != null && seriesCollectionUpdateInfo.NewItem is Series { IsAutoCreated: false } series)
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
				if (!((IChartDataContainer)dataContainer).DesignMode || Chart.ShouldLoadDataInDesignTime)
				{
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(series);
				}
				dataContainer.ViewController.RefreshData(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection, raiseChanged: false);
			}
			base.ProcessChanged(change);
		}

		public int Add(Series series)
		{
			series.Owner = (DataContainer)base.Owner;
			if (!Chart.Loading)
			{
				series.CheckBinding(series.GetDataSource());
			}
			series.View.CheckOnAddingSeries();
			return Add((ChartElement)series);
		}

		public int Add(string name, ViewType viewType)
		{
			return Add(new Series(name, viewType));
		}

		public void AddRange(params Series[] coll)
		{
			foreach (Series series in coll)
			{
				Add(series);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(Series series)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)series);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Series series)
		{
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)series);
		}

		public void Swap(Series series1, Series series2)
		{
			Swap((ChartElement)series1, (ChartElement)series2);
		}

		public bool Contains(Series series)
		{
			return base.Contains((ChartElement)series);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Series series)
		{
			return IndexOf((ChartElement)series);
		}

		public new Series[] ToArray()
		{
			return (Series[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(Series));
		}

		public string GenerateName()
		{
			return NameGenerator.UniqueName(NamePrefix, GetNames());
		}
	}

			}

					dataSourceEventManager.UnsubscribeEvents();

				dataSourceEventManager = value;

					dataSourceEventManager.SubscribeEvents();
				}
			}

					DataSourceEventManager = DataSourceEventManagerBase.CreateDataSourceEventManager(this, value);
					dataSource = value;
					UpdateAndRaiseChanged();
				}
			}

		private bool CheckDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember, bool raiseException)
		{
			if (base.Owner is SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate)
			{
				return seriesTemplate.CheckDataMember(dataSource ?? seriesTemplate.GetDataSource(), dataMember, raiseException);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CheckBinding(object dataSource)
		{
			if (!CheckDataMember(dataSource, seriesColorMember, raiseException: false))
			{
				SeriesColorMember = null;
			}
			if (!CheckDataMember(dataSource, seriesKeyMember, raiseException: false))
			{
				SeriesKeyMember = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesColorMapping()
		{
			ResetMappings();
			RegisterDataSourceUpdate();
		}

		private void RegisterDataSourceUpdate()
		{
			if (base.Chart != null)
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(this);
				base.Chart.ApplyDataUpdates(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
			}
		}

		internal void ResetMappings()
		{
			seriesColorMapping.Clear();
			seriesValueToColorKeyMapping.Clear();
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			CheckBinding(dataSource);
			RegisterDataSourceUpdate();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesDataSourceColorizer();
		}

		protected internal override void Dispose()
		{
			DataSourceEventManager.UnsubscribeEvents();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is SeriesDataSourceColorizer seriesDataSourceColorizer))
			{
				return;
			}
			dataSource = seriesDataSourceColorizer.dataSource;
			seriesColorMember = seriesDataSourceColorizer.seriesColorMember;
			seriesKeyMember = seriesDataSourceColorizer.seriesKeyMember;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item in seriesDataSourceColorizer.seriesValueToColorKeyMapping)
			{
				seriesValueToColorKeyMapping.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, Color> item2 in seriesDataSourceColorizer.seriesColorMapping)
			{
				seriesColorMapping.Add(item2.Key, item2.Value);
			}
		}

		public override Color GetSeriesColor(object seriesKey, Palette palette)
		{
			Color value = Color.Empty;
			object value2 = null;
			seriesValueToColorKeyMapping.TryGetValue(seriesKey, out value2);
			seriesColorMapping.TryGetValue((value2 != null) ? value2 : seriesKey, out value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder))]
	public enum ColorDistributionDirection
	{
		Forward,
		Backward
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PointBasedSegmentColorizerTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointBasedSegmentColorizer")]
	public class PointBasedSegmentColorizer : SegmentColorizerBase, IPointSegmentColorizer
	{
		private ColorDistributionDirection direction;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointBasedSegmentColorizer.Direction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointBasedSegmentColorizer.Direction")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ColorDistributionDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (direction != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					direction = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		public PointBasedSegmentColorizer()
			: base(null)
		{
		}

		int? IPointSegmentColorizer.GetColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex)
		{
			if (base.Owner is LineSeriesView lineSeriesView)
			{
				if (direction == ColorDistributionDirection.Forward)
				{
					pointIndex--;
				}
				if (pointIndex >= 0)
				{
					Color color = lineSeriesView.ColorProvider.GetColor(points[pointIndex].SeriesPoint);
					if (!color.IsEmpty)
					{
						return color.ToArgb();
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PointBasedSegmentColorizer();
		}

		protected internal override IBezierStripSplitter CreateBezierStripSplitter()
		{
			return new BezierPointSplitter(this);
		}

		protected internal override IStripSplitter CreateStripSplitter()
		{
			return new StripPointSplitter(this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Direction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDirection();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PointBasedSegmentColorizer pointBasedSegmentColorizer)
			{
				Direction = pointBasedSegmentColorizer.Direction;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDirection()
		{
			return direction != ColorDistributionDirection.Forward;
		}

		private void ResetDirection()
		{
			direction = ColorDistributionDirection.Forward;
		}
	}

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "LocalizationRes", "ChartStringId.SvnFunnel3D", "Funnel3DSeriesView")]
	public class Funnel3DSeriesView : FunnelSeriesViewBase, ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView
	{
		private const int DefaultHoleRadiusPercent = 90;

		private int holeRadiusPercent = 90;

		protected internal override string StringId => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SvnFunnel3D);

		protected internal override bool HitTestingSupportedForLegendMarker => false;

		protected override bool Is3DView => true;

		protected override Type PointInterfaceType => typeof(IValuePoint);

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public override Type DiagramType => typeof(FunnelDiagram3D);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Funnel3DSeriesView.HoleRadiusPercent")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Funnel3DSeriesView.HoleRadiusPercent")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public int HoleRadiusPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return holeRadiusPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != holeRadiusPercent)
				{
					if (value < 0 || value > 100)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectFunnelHolePercent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					holeRadiusPercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		double ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView.DepthFactor => 1.0;

		double ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView.HeightToWidthRatio => base.HeightToWidthRatio;

		internal static DiagramPoint CalcSurfacePoint(double y, double radius, double angle)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(radius * Math.Sin(angle), y, radius * Math.Cos(angle));
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "HoleRadiusPercent")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHoleRadiusPercent();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeHoleRadiusPercent()
		{
			return holeRadiusPercent != 90;
		}

		private void ResetHoleRadiusPercent()
		{
			HoleRadiusPercent = 90;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHoleRadiusPercent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Rectangle CalcLabelBounds(Rectangle bounds, int maxLabelWidth, int maxLabelHeight)
		{
			if (bounds.Height < bounds.Width)
			{
				int x = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(bounds.Width - bounds.Height) / 2.0);
				bounds.Width = bounds.Height;
				bounds.Offset(x, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				int y = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(bounds.Height - bounds.Width) / 2.0);
				bounds.Height = bounds.Width;
				bounds.Offset(0, y);
			}
			return Rectangle.Inflate(bounds, maxLabelWidth, maxLabelHeight);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			FunnelSeriesPointLayout funnelSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as FunnelSeriesPointLayout;
			SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain = domain as SimpleDiagram3DDomain;
			if (funnelSeriesPointLayout == null || simpleDiagram3DDomain == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Bounds.Height / 2;
			double y = (double)num - (funnelSeriesPointLayout.RightUpPoint.Y + funnelSeriesPointLayout.RightDownPoint.Y) / 2.0;
			double radius = (funnelSeriesPointLayout.RightUpPoint.X + funnelSeriesPointLayout.RightDownPoint.X - funnelSeriesPointLayout.LeftUpPoint.X - funnelSeriesPointLayout.LeftDownPoint.X) / 4.0;
			DiagramPoint point = new DiagramPoint(0.0, y, -1.0);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = GLHelper.InverseTransform(simpleDiagram3DDomain.ModelViewMatrix, new DiagramPoint(0.0, point.Y, 0.0));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = GLHelper.InverseTransform(simpleDiagram3DDomain.ModelViewMatrix, point);
			double angle = Math.Atan2(diagramPoint.X - diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint.Z - diagramPoint2.Z);
			return simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(CalcSurfacePoint(y, radius, angle));
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new Funnel3DDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Funnel3DSeriesView();
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				Funnel3DDrawOptions funnel3DDrawOptions = (Funnel3DDrawOptions)drawOptions;
				Color c = funnel3DDrawOptions.Color;
				if (layout.IsNegativeValuePresents)
				{
					c = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(150, 255, 255, 255), c);
				}
				float num = (float)((layout.RightUpPoint.X - layout.LeftUpPoint.X) / 2.0);
				if (num < 1f)
				{
					num = 1f;
				}
				float num2 = (float)((layout.RightDownPoint.X - layout.LeftDownPoint.X) / 2.0);
				if (num2 < 1f)
				{
					num2 = 1f;
				}
				bool startClosed = layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.First || layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Single || base.PointDistance > 0;
				bool finishClosed = layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Last || layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Single || base.PointDistance > 0;
				return new ConeGraphicsCommand((float)(layout.LeftUpPoint.Y - (double)(mappingBounds.Height / 2)), (float)(layout.LeftDownPoint.Y - (double)(mappingBounds.Height / 2)), num, num2, c, startClosed, finishClosed, holeRadiusPercent);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, VariousPolygon polygon, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (drawOptions is Funnel3DDrawOptions { Color: var color })
			{
				LineStrip vertices = polygon.Vertices;
				vertices[2] = new GRealPoint2D(vertices[2].X, vertices[2].Y - 1.0);
				renderer.FillPolygon(vertices, color);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point((int)polygon.Vertices[1].X - 1, (int)polygon.Vertices[1].Y), new Point((int)polygon.Vertices[2].X - 1, (int)polygon.Vertices[2].Y), color, 1);
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point((int)polygon.Vertices[0].X, (int)polygon.Vertices[0].Y), new Point((int)polygon.Vertices[5].X, (int)polygon.Vertices[5].Y - 1), color, 1);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected override PointF CalculateBasePoint(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, Rectangle correctedBounds)
		{
			return new PointF((float)domain.ElementBounds.X + (float)domain.ElementBounds.Width / 2f, correctedBounds.Y - domain.Bounds.Y);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Abs(((IValuePoint)point).Value);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new Funnel3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool CalculateBounds(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle outerBounds, out Rectangle funnelBounds, out Rectangle labelBounds)
		{
			funnelBounds = outerBounds;
			labelBounds = outerBounds;
			if (!outerBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			Funnel3DSeriesLabel funnel3DSeriesLabel = (Funnel3DSeriesLabel)base.SeriesBase.Label;
			Size size = funnel3DSeriesLabel.CalculateMaximumSizeConsiderIndent(seriesData);
			funnelBounds = Rectangle.Inflate(funnelBounds, -size.Width, -size.Height);
			if (!funnelBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			labelBounds = CalcLabelBounds(funnelBounds, size.Width, size.Height);
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is Funnel3DSeriesView funnel3DSeriesView)
			{
				holeRadiusPercent = funnel3DSeriesView.holeRadiusPercent;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Funnel3DSeriesView funnel3DSeriesView = (Funnel3DSeriesView)obj;
			return holeRadiusPercent == funnel3DSeriesView.holeRadiusPercent;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		}

		private LineStrip CorrectFunnelPolygon(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(layout.LeftUpPoint);
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(layout.RightUpPoint.X + 1.0, layout.RightUpPoint.Y));
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(new GRealPoint2D(layout.RightUpPoint.X + 1.0, layout.RightUpPoint.Y), new GRealPoint2D(layout.RightDownPoint.X + 1.0, layout.RightDownPoint.Y), layout.RightDownPoint.Y + 1.0);
			if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				lineStrip.Add(layout.RightDownPoint);
			}
			gRealPoint2D = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint, layout.LeftDownPoint, layout.LeftDownPoint.Y + 1.0);
			if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				lineStrip.Add(layout.LeftDownPoint);
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		private LineStrip CorrectLegendMarkerPolygon(VariousPolygon polygon)
		{
			if (polygon.Vertices.Count < 6)
			{
				return polygon.Vertices;
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(polygon.Vertices[0]);
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(polygon.Vertices[1].X + 1.0, polygon.Vertices[1].Y));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(polygon.Vertices[2].X + 1.0, polygon.Vertices[2].Y));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(polygon.Vertices[3].X + 1.0, polygon.Vertices[3].Y + 1.0));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(polygon.Vertices[4].X, polygon.Vertices[4].Y + 1.0));
			lineStrip.Add(polygon.Vertices[5]);
			return lineStrip;
		}

		private DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPoint(SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (!(pointLayout is FunnelSeriesPointLayout { LeftUpPoint: { X: var x }, RightUpPoint: var rightUpPoint } funnelSeriesPointLayout))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("FunnelSeriesPointLayout expected.");
				return null;
			}
			return new DiagramPoint((x + rightUpPoint.X) / 2.0, (funnelSeriesPointLayout.RightUpPoint.Y + funnelSeriesPointLayout.RightDownPoint.Y) / 2.0);
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateFunnelGraphicsCommand(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions, Color color)
		{
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SimpleAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			RectangleF rect = layout.Polygon.Rect;
			bool flag = layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Last || layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Single;
			double num = ((base.PointDistance > 0 || flag) ? (rect.Height + 1f) : rect.Height);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new ClippingGraphicsCommand((ZPlaneRectangle)new RectangleF(rect.Location, new SizeF(rect.Width + 1f, (float)num)));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			FillOptionsBase options = funnelDrawOptions.FillStyle.Options;
			LineStrip vertices = CorrectFunnelPolygon(layout);
			if (!layout.CheckWidth())
			{
				graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(new SolidLineGraphicsCommand(new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint.X, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y), new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftDownPoint.X, layout.LeftDownPoint.Y), color, 1));
			}
			if (options != null)
			{
				graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(options.CreateGraphicsCommand(vertices, (ZPlaneRectangle)rect, color, funnelDrawOptions.ActualColor2));
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(new SolidPolygonGraphicsCommand(vertices));
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private void RenderFunnel(ChartRenderer renderer, FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions, Color color)
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality);
				RectangleF rect = layout.Polygon.Rect;
				bool flag = layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Last || layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Single;
				double num = ((base.PointDistance > 0 || flag) ? (rect.Height + 1f) : rect.Height);
				RectangleF clipping = new RectangleF(rect.Location, new SizeF(rect.Width + 1f, (float)num));
				renderer.SetClipping(clipping);
				FillOptionsBase options = funnelDrawOptions.FillStyle.Options;
				LineStrip lineStrip = CorrectFunnelPolygon(layout);
				if (!layout.CheckWidth())
				{
					renderer.DrawLine(new Point((int)layout.LeftUpPoint.X, (int)layout.LeftUpPoint.Y), new Point((int)layout.LeftDownPoint.X, (int)layout.LeftDownPoint.Y), color, 1);
				}
				if (options != null)
				{
					options.Render(renderer, lineStrip, rect, color, funnelDrawOptions.ActualColor2);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, color);
				}
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
				renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateBorderGraphicsCommand(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			Color borderColor = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(funnelDrawOptions.Border, BorderColorFromAppearance);
			int actualThickness = funnelDrawOptions.Border.ActualThickness;
			if (actualThickness == 1)
			{
				return new BoundedPolygonGraphicsCommand(layout.Polygon.Vertices);
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			ClippingGraphicsCommand clippingGraphicsCommand;
			using (DXGraphicsPath path = layout.Polygon.GetPath())
			{
				clippingGraphicsCommand = new ClippingGraphicsCommand(new DXRegion(path));
			}
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(clippingGraphicsCommand);
			ContainerGraphicsCommand containerGraphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			clippingGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(containerGraphicsCommand);
			ContainerGraphicsCommand containerGraphicsCommand2 = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(containerGraphicsCommand2);
			GraphicsCommand command = CreateFlankSidesCommand(layout, mappingBounds, actualThickness, borderColor);
			containerGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
			containerGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateHorizontalSidesCommand(layout, actualThickness, borderColor));
			containerGraphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(new BoundedPolygonGraphicsCommand(layout.Polygon.Vertices));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions)
		{
			Color color = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(funnelDrawOptions.Border, BorderColorFromAppearance);
			int actualThickness = funnelDrawOptions.Border.ActualThickness;
			if (actualThickness != 1 && layout.Polygon.Vertices.Count > 0)
			{
				using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
				PointF[] closedPath = StripsUtils.GetClosedPath(layout.Polygon.Vertices);
				PointF[] points = CalculateBorderInnerPoints(layout, actualThickness);
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(closedPath);
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(points);
				renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath, color);
			}
			renderer.DrawPolygon(layout.Polygon.Vertices, color, 1);
		}

		private PointF[] CalculateBorderInnerPoints(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, int actualBorderThickness)
		{
			float y = (float)layout.LeftUpPoint.Y + CorrectTopBorderThickness(layout.PointOrder, actualBorderThickness);
			float y2 = (float)layout.LeftDownPoint.Y - CorrectBottomBorderThickness(layout.PointOrder, actualBorderThickness);
			Line2D line2D = Line2D.CreateParallelLine(layout.LeftUpPoint.ToPointF(), layout.LeftDownPoint.ToPointF(), (float)actualBorderThickness - 0.5f);
			Line2D line2D2 = Line2D.CreateParallelLine(layout.RightDownPoint.ToPointF(), layout.RightUpPoint.ToPointF(), (float)actualBorderThickness - 0.5f);
			PointF pointByY = line2D.GetPointByY(y);
			return new PointF[5]
			{
				pointByY,
				line2D.GetPointByY(y2),
				line2D2.GetPointByY(y2),
				line2D2.GetPointByY(y),
				pointByY
			};
		}

		private float CorrectTopBorderThickness(PointOrder pointOrder, int thickness)
		{
			if (pointOrder == PointOrder.First || pointOrder == PointOrder.Single || base.PointDistance > 0)
			{
				return (float)thickness - 0.5f;
			}
			if (thickness % 2 == 0)
			{
				return (float)(thickness / 2) - 0.5f;
			}
			return (float)(thickness / 2) + 0.5f;
		}

		private float CorrectBottomBorderThickness(PointOrder pointOrder, int thickness)
		{
			if (pointOrder == PointOrder.Last || pointOrder == PointOrder.Single || base.PointDistance > 0)
			{
				return (float)thickness - 0.5f;
			}
			return (float)(thickness / 2) + 0.5f;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateFlankSidesCommand(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, Rectangle mappingBounds, int actualBorderThickness, Color borderColor)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint, layout.LeftDownPoint, mappingBounds.Bottom);
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D2 = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint, layout.LeftDownPoint, mappingBounds.Top);
			if (!gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				gRealPoint2D = layout.LeftDownPoint;
			}
			if (!gRealPoint2D2.HasValue)
			{
				gRealPoint2D2 = layout.LeftUpPoint;
			}
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new SolidLineGraphicsCommand(new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.Value.X, gRealPoint2D.Value.Y), new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D2.Value.X, gRealPoint2D2.Value.Y), borderColor, actualBorderThickness * 2 - 1));
			gRealPoint2D = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(layout.RightUpPoint, layout.RightDownPoint, mappingBounds.Bottom);
			gRealPoint2D2 = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(layout.RightUpPoint, layout.RightDownPoint, mappingBounds.Top);
			if (!gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				gRealPoint2D = layout.RightDownPoint;
			}
			if (!gRealPoint2D2.HasValue)
			{
				gRealPoint2D2 = layout.RightUpPoint;
			}
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new SolidLineGraphicsCommand(new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.Value.X, gRealPoint2D.Value.Y), new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D2.Value.X, gRealPoint2D2.Value.Y), borderColor, actualBorderThickness * 2 - 1));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateHorizontalSidesCommand(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, int actualBorderThickness, Color borderColor)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			int thickness = actualBorderThickness;
			int thickness2 = actualBorderThickness;
			bool flag = actualBorderThickness % 2 == 0;
			if (layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.First || layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Single || base.PointDistance > 0)
			{
				thickness2 = actualBorderThickness * 2 - 1;
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				thickness2 = actualBorderThickness - 1;
			}
			if (layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Last || layout.PointOrder == PointOrder.Single || base.PointDistance > 0)
			{
				thickness = actualBorderThickness * 2 - 1;
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				thickness = actualBorderThickness + 1;
			}
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new SolidLineGraphicsCommand(new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftUpPoint.X, layout.LeftUpPoint.Y), new DiagramPoint(layout.RightUpPoint.X, layout.RightUpPoint.Y), borderColor, thickness2));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new SolidLineGraphicsCommand(new DiagramPoint(layout.LeftDownPoint.X, layout.LeftDownPoint.Y), new DiagramPoint(layout.RightDownPoint.X, layout.RightDownPoint.Y), borderColor, thickness));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateHatchedGraphicsCommand(SelectionState selectionState, LineStrip vertices)
		{
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				return new HatchedPolygonGraphicsCommand(vertices);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RenderHatched(ChartRenderer renderer, SelectionState selectionState, LineStrip vertices)
		{
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				renderer.FillPolygon(vertices, HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal, base.HitTestState.GetPointHatchColor(base.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode, selectionState));
			}
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			return CalculateAnchorPoint(pointLayout);
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			if (!(drawOptions is FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions) || layout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Color color = funnelDrawOptions.Color;
			if (layout.IsNegativeValuePresents)
			{
				color = Color.FromArgb(40, drawOptions.Color);
				funnelDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Solid;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateFunnelGraphicsCommand(layout, funnelDrawOptions, color));
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new SimpleAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(CreateHatchedGraphicsCommand(layout.PointData.SelectionState, layout.Polygon.Vertices));
			if (funnelDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(CreateBorderGraphicsCommand(layout, funnelDrawOptions, mappingBounds));
			}
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, FunnelSeriesPointLayout layout, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			if (drawOptions is FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions && layout != null)
			{
				Color color = funnelDrawOptions.Color;
				if (layout.IsNegativeValuePresents)
				{
					color = Color.FromArgb(40, drawOptions.Color);
					funnelDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Solid;
				}
				RenderFunnel(renderer, layout, funnelDrawOptions, color);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				RenderHatched(renderer, layout.PointData.SelectionState, layout.Polygon.Vertices);
				if (funnelDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
				{
					RenderBorder(renderer, layout, funnelDrawOptions);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, VariousPolygon polygon, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (drawOptions is FunnelDrawOptions funnelDrawOptions)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				LineStrip lineStrip = CorrectLegendMarkerPolygon(polygon);
				renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality);
				FillOptionsBase options = funnelDrawOptions.FillStyle.Options;
				if (options != null)
				{
					options.Render(renderer, lineStrip, polygon.Rect, funnelDrawOptions.Color, funnelDrawOptions.ActualColor2);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, funnelDrawOptions.Color);
				}
				renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
				RenderHatched(renderer, selectionState, polygon.Vertices);
				if (funnelDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
				{
					renderer.DrawPolygon(polygon.Vertices, funnelDrawOptions.Border.Color, 1);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CalculateBounds(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle outerBounds, out Rectangle innerBounds, out Rectangle labelBounds)
		{
			innerBounds = outerBounds;
			labelBounds = outerBounds;
			if (!outerBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			FunnelSeriesLabel funnelSeriesLabel = (FunnelSeriesLabel)base.SeriesBase.Label;
			Size size = funnelSeriesLabel.CalculateMaximumSizeConsiderIndent(seriesData);
			if (size.Height > 0)
			{
				innerBounds.Offset(0, size.Height / 2);
				innerBounds.Height -= size.Height / 2 + 1;
			}
			innerBounds = CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(innerBounds);
			if (!innerBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			innerBounds = funnelSeriesLabel.CorrectFunnelBounds(seriesData, innerBounds, outerBounds);
			labelBounds = innerBounds;
			labelBounds.Width += size.Width;
			if (funnelSeriesLabel.Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.LeftColumn)
			{
				labelBounds.Offset(-size.Width, 0);
			}
			labelBounds = Rectangle.Intersect(labelBounds, outerBounds);
			return innerBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive();
		}

		protected internal override int CalculateHeightOfPolygon(int height, List<RefinedPointData> filteredPointsData, out int actualPointDistance, out int residueHeightOfPolygon, out int residuePointDistance)
		{
			int num = base.CalculateHeightOfPolygon(height, filteredPointsData, out actualPointDistance, out residueHeightOfPolygon, out residuePointDistance);
			int count = filteredPointsData.Count;
			if (num == 0 || count <= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			if (filteredPointsData[0].LabelViewData.Length != 0)
			{
				num2 = filteredPointsData[0].LabelViewData[0].TextSize.Height / 2 + base.Label.Border.ActualThickness;
			}
			FunnelSeriesLabel funnelSeriesLabel = (FunnelSeriesLabel)base.SeriesBase.Label;
			if (count == 1 || funnelSeriesLabel.Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Center || num >= num2)
			{
				return num;
			}
			residueHeightOfPolygon = 0;
			residuePointDistance = 0;
			int num3 = height - num2;
			if (num3 < count - 1)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num4 = (actualPointDistance = ((base.PointDistance != 0) ? (base.PointDistance + 1) : 0));
			if (base.PointDistance != 0 && num3 - (count - 1) < (count - 1) * num4)
			{
				actualPointDistance = (num3 - (count - 1)) / (count - 1);
				residuePointDistance = (num3 - (count - 1)) % (count - 1);
				num = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				int num5 = num3 - (count - 1) * num4;
				num = num5 / (count - 1);
				residueHeightOfPolygon = num5 % (count - 1);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IColorEachSupportView colorEachSupportView)
			{
				colorEach = colorEachSupportView.ColorEach;
			}
			if (obj is ISimpleDiagram2DSeriesView simpleDiagram2DSeriesView)
			{
				border.Assign(simpleDiagram2DSeriesView.Border);
				fillStyle.Assign(simpleDiagram2DSeriesView.FillStyle);
				if (obj is FunnelSeriesView funnelSeriesView)
				{
					alignToCenter = funnelSeriesView.alignToCenter;
					heightToWidthRatioAuto = funnelSeriesView.heightToWidthRatioAuto;
					pointShape = funnelSeriesView.pointShape;
					animation = ((funnelSeriesView.animation != null) ? ((FunnelAnimationBase)funnelSeriesView.animation.Clone()) : null);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FunnelSeriesView funnelSeriesView = (FunnelSeriesView)obj;
			if (border.Equals(funnelSeriesView.border) && fillStyle.Equals(funnelSeriesView.fillStyle) && alignToCenter == funnelSeriesView.alignToCenter && heightToWidthRatioAuto == funnelSeriesView.heightToWidthRatioAuto && colorEach == funnelSeriesView.colorEach)
			{
				return pointShape == funnelSeriesView.pointShape;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public enum FunnelPointShape
	{
		Rectangle,
		Trapezoid
	}
	public abstract class FunnelSeriesViewBase : SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase
	{
		private const double DefaultHeightToWidthRatio = 1.0;

		private const int DefaultPointDistance = 0;

		private double ratio = 1.0;

		private int pointDistance;

		protected internal virtual bool ActualHeightToWidthRatioAuto => false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldSortPoints => false;

		protected internal override bool NeedFilterVisiblePoints => false;

		protected override CompatibleViewType CompatibleViewType => CompatibleViewType.SimpleView;

		protected virtual bool IsRectanglePointShapeUsed => false;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSeriesViewBase.HeightToWidthRatio")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSeriesViewBase.HeightToWidthRatio")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public double HeightToWidthRatio
		{
			get
			{
				return ratio;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != ratio)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ratio = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSeriesViewBase.PointDistance")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FunnelSeriesViewBase.PointDistance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public int PointDistance
		{
			get
			{
				return pointDistance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pointDistance)
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						ValidatePointDistance(value);
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointDistance = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "HeightToWidthRatio")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHeightToWidthRatio();
			}
			if (propertyName == "PointDistance")
			{
				return ShouldSerializePointDistance();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeHeightToWidthRatio()
		{
			return ratio != 1.0;
		}

		private void ResetHeightToWidthRatio()
		{
			HeightToWidthRatio = 1.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePointDistance()
		{
			return pointDistance != 0;
		}

		private void ResetPointDistance()
		{
			PointDistance = 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeHeightToWidthRatio())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePointDistance();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private PointOrder GetPointOrder(int pointIndex, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (pointsCount == 1)
			{
				return PointOrder.Single;
			}
			if (pointIndex == 0)
			{
				return PointOrder.First;
			}
			if (pointIndex == pointsCount - 1)
			{
				return PointOrder.Last;
			}
			return PointOrder.Middle;
		}

		private void ValidatePointDistance(int val)
		{
			if (val < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPointDistance));
			}
		}

		private VariousPolygon GetPolygonForLegendMarker(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int num = bounds.Height / 2;
			int num2 = bounds.Y + num;
			int num3 = bounds.Width / 3;
			int num4 = bounds.X + num3;
			int num5 = num4 + num3;
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.X, bounds.Y));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right, bounds.Y));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num5, num2));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num5, bounds.Bottom));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num4, bounds.Bottom));
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num4, num2));
			return new VariousPolygon(lineStrip, new RectangleF(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
		}

		protected Rectangle CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (ActualHeightToWidthRatioAuto)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			int num = (int)((double)bounds.Width * HeightToWidthRatio);
			int num2 = bounds.Width;
			if (num > bounds.Height)
			{
				num = bounds.Height;
				num2 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)num / HeightToWidthRatio);
			}
			int num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(bounds.Width - num2) / 2.0);
			int num4 = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(bounds.Height - num) / 2.0);
			return new Rectangle(bounds.X + num3, bounds.Y + num4, num2, num);
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalculateHeightOfPolygon(int height, List<RefinedPointData> filteredPointsData, out int actualPointDistance, out int residueHeightOfPolygon, out int residuePointDistance)
		{
			int count = filteredPointsData.Count;
			int num = (actualPointDistance = ((pointDistance != 0) ? (pointDistance + 1) : 0));
			residueHeightOfPolygon = (residuePointDistance = 0);
			if (count == 0 || height < count)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int result;
			if (pointDistance != 0 && count != 1 && height - count < (count - 1) * num)
			{
				actualPointDistance = (height - count) / (count - 1);
				residuePointDistance = (height - count) % (count - 1);
				result = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = height - (count - 1) * num;
				result = num2 / count;
				residueHeightOfPolygon = num2 % count;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override object[] GenerateRandomValues(int indexOfRandomPoint, int randomPointCount, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			int num = (randomPointCount - 1) * 2;
			double num2 = Math.Round(SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() * 2.0 + (double)num - (double)(indexOfRandomPoint * 2), 1);
			return new object[1] { num2 };
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<SeriesPointLayout> CalculatePointsLayout(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			List<SeriesPointLayout> list = new List<SeriesPointLayout>();
			if (!(seriesData.WholeViewData is FunnelWholeSeriesViewData { FilteredPointsData: var filteredPointsData } funnelWholeSeriesViewData))
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (filteredPointsData.Count == 0 || seriesData.Count == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(domain.ElementBounds);
			if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return list;
			}
			IList<RefinedPoint> list2 = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			foreach (RefinedPointData item in filteredPointsData)
			{
				list2.Add(item.RefinedPoint);
			}
			Funnel2DLayoutCalculator funnel2DLayoutCalculator = new Funnel2DLayoutCalculator(new GRealSize2D(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height), list2, (pointDistance == 0) ? pointDistance : (pointDistance + 1));
			List<FunnelPointInfo> list3 = funnel2DLayoutCalculator.Calculate(IsRectanglePointShapeUsed);
			if (list3 != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list3.Count; i++)
				{
					PointOrder pointOrder = GetPointOrder(i, list3.Count);
					FunnelPointInfo funnelPointInfo = list3[i];
					PointF pointF = CalculateBasePoint(domain, rectangle);
					LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + funnelPointInfo.TopLeftPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)pointF.Y + funnelPointInfo.TopLeftPoint.Y)));
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + funnelPointInfo.TopRightPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)pointF.Y + funnelPointInfo.TopRightPoint.Y)));
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + funnelPointInfo.BottomRightPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)pointF.Y + funnelPointInfo.BottomRightPoint.Y)));
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + funnelPointInfo.BottomLeftPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)pointF.Y + funnelPointInfo.BottomLeftPoint.Y)));
					RectangleF rectangle2 = new RectangleF(rectangle.X, (float)((double)pointF.Y + funnelPointInfo.TopLeftPoint.Y), rectangle.Width, (float)Math.Floor(funnelPointInfo.BottomLeftPoint.Y - funnelPointInfo.TopLeftPoint.Y) + 1f);
					FunnelSeriesPointLayout funnelSeriesPointLayout = new FunnelSeriesPointLayout(filteredPointsData[i], lineStrip, rectangle2, funnelWholeSeriesViewData.NegativeValuePresents, pointOrder);
					filteredPointsData[i].ToolTipRelativePosition = CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(funnelSeriesPointLayout);
					list.Add(funnelSeriesPointLayout);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesViewData CalculateWholeSeriesViewData(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator)
		{
			List<RefinedPointData> list = new List<RefinedPointData>();
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				IFunnelPoint refinedPoint = seriesDatum.RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint != null && !refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					flag |= refinedPoint.Value < 0.0;
					if (!double.IsNaN(refinedPoint.NormalizedValue))
					{
						list.Add(seriesDatum);
					}
				}
			}
			return new FunnelWholeSeriesViewData(list, flag);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is FunnelSeriesViewBase funnelSeriesViewBase)
			{
				ratio = funnelSeriesViewBase.ratio;
				pointDistance = funnelSeriesViewBase.pointDistance;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FunnelSeriesViewBase funnelSeriesViewBase = (FunnelSeriesViewBase)obj;
			if (ratio == funnelSeriesViewBase.ratio)
			{
				return pointDistance == funnelSeriesViewBase.pointDistance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		double IXYWSeriesView.MaxSize => ActualMaxSize;

		double IXYWSeriesView.GetSideMargins(AxisGroup axisGroup, double min, double max)
		{
			if (axisGroup == AxisGroup.Value)
			{
				if (sizeUnit != BubbleSizeUnit.Pixel)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return CalculateSideMarginsPixelUnit(ActualAxisY, min, max);
			}
			return CalculateSideMarginsX(min, max);
		}

			}
			return true;

		private double CalculateSideMarginsPixelUnit(IAxisData axisData, double min, double max)
		{
			double num = GetXYDiagram().GetAxisLength(axisData);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(max - min);
			if (num2 != 0.0)
			{
				return num2 * ActualMaxSize * 1.2 / num;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double CalculateSideMarginsX(double min, double max)
		{
			if (sizeUnit == BubbleSizeUnit.Pixel)
			{
				return CalculateSideMarginsPixelUnit(ActualAxisX, min, max);
			}
			if (!AutoSize)
			{
				return MaxSize;
			}
			return (max - min) * 0.2;
		}

		private int CalculatePointRenderSize(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (sizeUnit == BubbleSizeUnit.Pixel)
			{
				return (int)((IXYWPoint)refinedPoint).Size;
			}
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value);
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound2 = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument + ((IXYWPoint)refinedPoint).Size, ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value);
			return (int)Math.Round(Math.Max(Math.Abs(screenPointNoRound2.X - screenPointNoRound.X), Math.Abs(screenPointNoRound2.Y - screenPointNoRound.Y)));
		}

		}

				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Weight;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator)
		{
			PointDrawOptionsBase pointDrawOptionsBase = pointData.DrawOptions as PointDrawOptionsBase;
			IXYWPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			if (pointDrawOptionsBase == null || refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value);
			int num = CalculatePointRenderSize(diagramMapping, pointData.RefinedPoint);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				bool isSelected = pointData.SelectionState != SelectionState.Normal;
				IPolygon polygon = pointDrawOptionsBase.Marker.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(screenPointNoRound.X), Math.Round(screenPointNoRound.Y)), isSelected, num);
				return new PointSeriesPointLayout(pointData, screenPointNoRound, polygon);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateShadowGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetValueCaption(int index)
		{
			return index switch
			{
				0 => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ValueMember), 
				1 => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WeightMember), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is BubbleSeriesView bubbleSeriesView)
			{
				autoSize = bubbleSeriesView.autoSize;
				maxSize = bubbleSeriesView.maxSize;
				minSize = bubbleSeriesView.minSize;
			}
		}

	public abstract class PointSeriesViewBase : SeriesViewColorEachSupportBase, IPointSeriesView
	{
		protected const int LegendMarkerShadowSize = 1;

		protected const int CrosshairMarkerAdditionalSize = 2;

		private XYMarkerAnimationBase seriesPointAnimation;

		private readonly MarkerBase marker;

		private readonly PointSeriesViewPainter painter;

		private readonly List<HitTestParams> highlightedPointsCache;

		internal List<HitTestParams> HighlightedPointsCache => highlightedPointsCache;

		protected PointSeriesViewPainter Painter => painter;

		protected internal MarkerBase Marker => marker;

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase ActualSeriesPointAnimation => SeriesPointAnimation;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointSeriesViewBase.SeriesPointAnimation")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointSeriesViewBase.SeriesPointAnimation")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.AnimationEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		public XYMarkerAnimationBase SeriesPointAnimation
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesPointAnimation;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgNullProperty), "SeriesPointAnimation"));
				}
				if (seriesPointAnimation != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					SetPointAnimation(value);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		MarkerBase IPointSeriesView.Marker => marker;

		public PointSeriesViewBase()
		{
			SetPointAnimation(GetDefaultAnimation());
			marker = CreateMarker();
			painter = CreatePainter();
			highlightedPointsCache = new List<HitTestParams>();
		}

		private void ResetSeriesPointAnimation()
		{
			SeriesPointAnimation = GetDefaultAnimation();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesPointAnimation()
		{
			if (CheckIsAnimationChanged(seriesPointAnimation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				return base.CanUseAnimation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeSeriesPointAnimation())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private object XtraCreateSeriesPointAnimation(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "SeriesPointAnimation")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesPointAnimation();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private void SetPointAnimation(XYMarkerAnimationBase newAnimation)
		{
			newAnimation.Owner = this;
			if (AnimationHelper.ShouldAssignNewAnimation(ChartContainer, seriesPointAnimation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				newAnimation.Assign(seriesPointAnimation);
			}
			seriesPointAnimation = newAnimation;
		}

		private XYMarkerAnimationBase GetDefaultAnimation()
		{
			return new XYMarkerWidenAnimation();
		}

		private void ProcessHighlightedHitRegion(IPolygon polygon, object additionalObject)
		{
			IHitRegion hitRegion = GraphicUtils.MakeHitRegion(polygon);
			HitTestParams hitTestParams = new HitTestParams(base.Series, additionalObject, useSpecificCursor: false, (IHitRegion)hitRegion.Clone());
			base.HitTestController.Register(hitTestParams);
			highlightedPointsCache.Add(hitTestParams);
		}

		protected void ProcessHighlightedPoint(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, IPolygon polygon, DiagramPoint toolTipPoint)
		{
			if (polygon != null)
			{
				ProcessHighlightedHitRegion(polygon, refinedPoint);
				if (base.Series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled)
				{
					ProcessHighlightedHitRegion(polygon, new ChartFocusedArea(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint, toolTipPoint));
				}
			}
		}

		protected Color GetMarkerSelfColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			return painter.GetMarkerSelfColor(drawOptions);
		}

		protected Color GetBorderDrawColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			return painter.GetBorderDrawColor(drawOptions, marker);
		}

		protected override object CreateContentPropertyValue(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Item.Name == "SeriesPointAnimation" || e.Item.Name == "SeriesAnimation")
			{
				return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
			}
			return base.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		protected virtual int CalculateCrosshairPolygonSize(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (Marker is SimpleMarker simpleMarker)
			{
				return simpleMarker.Size + 2;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateAnnotationAnchorPointLayout(Annotation annotation, XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = anchorPointLayoutList.GetMapping(refinedPoint.Argument, GetHighlightedPointValue(refinedPoint), annotation.ScrollingSupported);
			if (mapping != null)
			{
				anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, mapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, GetHighlightedPointValue(refinedPoint)), refinedPoint));
			}
		}

		protected virtual MarkerBase CreateMarker()
		{
			return new MarkerBase(this);
		}

		protected override Rectangle CorrectLegendMarkerBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int actualSize = base.Shadow.GetActualSize(1);
			return new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width - actualSize, bounds.Height - actualSize);
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new PointDrawOptionsBase(this);
		}

		protected virtual PointSeriesViewPainter CreatePainter()
		{
			return new PointSeriesViewPainter(this);
		}

		protected virtual double GetHighlightedPointValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			painter.RenderLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, seriesDrawOptions, selectionState);
		}

		protected override void RenderCrosshairMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions)
		{
			painter.RenderLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState.Normal);
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value;
		}

		protected internal override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			painter.Render(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			painter.RenderShadow(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			painter.RenderWholeSeries(renderer, mappingBounds, layout);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderWholeSeriesShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			painter.RenderWholeSeriesShadow(renderer, mappingBounds, layout);
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint? CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			return mapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument, GetHighlightedPointValue(pointData.RefinedPoint));
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in anchorPointLayoutList.Annotations)
			{
				SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint = (SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData.GetRefinedPoint(anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap, seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint());
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					CalculateAnnotationAnchorPointLayout(annotation, anchorPointLayoutList, refinedPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override HighlightedPointLayout CalculateHighlightedPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, GetHighlightedPointValue(refinedPoint));
			if (diagramMapping.Bounds.Contains((int)screenPointNoRound.X, (int)screenPointNoRound.Y))
			{
				int size = CalculateCrosshairPolygonSize(diagramMapping, refinedPoint);
				IPolygon polygon = Marker.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(screenPointNoRound.X), Math.Round(screenPointNoRound.Y)), isSelected: true, size);
				if (drawOptions is PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions2)
				{
					Color color2;
					Color borderColor;
					if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint is SeriesPoint { Color: { IsEmpty: false } } seriesPoint)
					{
						color2 = seriesPoint.Color;
						borderColor = seriesPoint.Color;
					}
					else
					{
						Color pointSegmentSeriesColor = GetPointSegmentSeriesColor(refinedPoint);
						if (pointSegmentSeriesColor.IsEmpty)
						{
							color2 = GetMarkerSelfColor(drawOptions2);
							borderColor = GetBorderDrawColor(drawOptions2);
						}
						else
						{
							color2 = (borderColor = pointSegmentSeriesColor);
						}
					}
					return new HighlightedPolygonPointLayout(polygon, color2, borderColor, refinedPoint, screenPointNoRound);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderHighlightedPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			HighlightedPolygonPointLayout highlightedPolygonPointLayout = pointLayout as HighlightedPolygonPointLayout;
			if (highlightedPolygonPointLayout.Polygon != null)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				highlightedPolygonPointLayout.Polygon.Render(renderer, new SolidFillOptions(), highlightedPolygonPointLayout.Color, highlightedPolygonPointLayout.Color, highlightedPolygonPointLayout.BorderColor, 1);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearHighlightingCache()
		{
			base.ClearHighlightingCache();
			foreach (HitTestParams item in highlightedPointsCache)
			{
				base.HitTestController.Unregister(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearCache()
		{
			base.ClearCache();
			ClearHighlightingCache();
			highlightedPointsCache.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override void RegisterHighlightedHitRegion(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			base.RegisterHighlightedHitRegion(renderer, pointLayout);
			if (pointLayout is HighlightedPolygonPointLayout highlightedPolygonPointLayout)
			{
				ProcessHighlightedPoint(highlightedPolygonPointLayout.RefinedPoint, highlightedPolygonPointLayout.Polygon, highlightedPolygonPointLayout.ToolTipPoint);
			}
		}

		protected internal override SeriesContainerLayout CreateSeriesContainerLayout(SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
		{
			return new PointSeriesContainerLayout(seriesContainerData, mapping, singleLayout);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IPointSeriesView pointSeriesView)
			{
				marker.Assign(pointSeriesView.Marker);
			}
			if (obj is PointSeriesViewBase { SeriesPointAnimation: not null } pointSeriesViewBase)
			{
				seriesPointAnimation = (XYMarkerAnimationBase)pointSeriesViewBase.seriesPointAnimation.Clone();
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PointSeriesViewBase pointSeriesViewBase = (PointSeriesViewBase)obj;
			return marker.Equals(pointSeriesViewBase.marker);
		}
	}

				if (diagramPoint.HasValue)

						{
							list.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, diagramPoint.Value, pointLayout.PointData.RefinedPoint));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
