	[TypeConverter(typeof(Spline3DSeriesViewTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "LocalizationRes", "ChartStringId.SvnSpline3D", "Spline3DSeriesView")]
	public class Spline3DSeriesView : Line3DSeriesView, ISplineSeriesView, ISplineView
	{
		private const SplineAlgorithm DefaultSplineAlgorithm = SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax;

		private const int DefaultLineTensionPercent = 80;

		private SplineAlgorithm splineAlgorithm;

		private int lineTensionPercent = 80;

		private double LineTension => (double)lineTensionPercent / 100.0;

		protected internal override string StringId => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SvnSpline3D);

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Spline3DSeriesView.SplineAlgorithm")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Spline3DSeriesView.SplineAlgorithm")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public SplineAlgorithm SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return splineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				if (splineAlgorithm != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					splineAlgorithm = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Spline3DSeriesView.LineTensionPercent")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Spline3DSeriesView.LineTensionPercent")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public int LineTensionPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return lineTensionPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value > 100 || value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLineTensionPercent));
				}
				if (lineTensionPercent != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					lineTensionPercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		bool ISplineSeriesView.ShouldCorrectRanges => true;

		SplineAlgorithmCore ISplineView.SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithmCore)splineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				SplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)value;
			}
		}

		private static void CalcNormals(Line topLine, Line bottomLine, out DiagramVector topNormal, out DiagramVector bottomNormal)
		{
			DiagramVector v = new DiagramVector(topLine.V2.X - topLine.V1.X, topLine.V2.Y - topLine.V1.Y, 0.0);
			topNormal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(v, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, -1.0));
			v = new DiagramVector(bottomLine.V2.X - bottomLine.V1.X, bottomLine.V2.Y - bottomLine.V1.Y, 0.0);
			bottomNormal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(v, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
		}

		private static List<PlanePolygon> GetPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Line topLine, Line bottomLine, DiagramVector topLeftNormal, DiagramVector topRightNormal, DiagramVector bottomLeftNormal, DiagramVector bottomRightNormal, bool leftVisible, bool rightVisible, double lineWidth, int seriesWeight, Color color)
		{
			Prism prism = new Prism(new PlanePolygon(new DiagramPoint[4] { topLine.V2, topLine.V1, bottomLine.V1, bottomLine.V2 }), lineWidth);
			prism.Laterals[0].SameNormals = false;
			prism.Laterals[0].Vertices[0].Normal = topRightNormal;
			prism.Laterals[0].Vertices[1].Normal = topLeftNormal;
			prism.Laterals[0].Vertices[2].Normal = topLeftNormal;
			prism.Laterals[0].Vertices[3].Normal = topRightNormal;
			prism.Laterals[1].Visible = leftVisible;
			prism.Laterals[2].SameNormals = false;
			prism.Laterals[2].Vertices[0].Normal = bottomLeftNormal;
			prism.Laterals[2].Vertices[1].Normal = bottomRightNormal;
			prism.Laterals[2].Vertices[2].Normal = bottomRightNormal;
			prism.Laterals[2].Vertices[3].Normal = bottomLeftNormal;
			prism.Laterals[3].Visible = rightVisible;
			return SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, prism, seriesWeight, color);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SplineAlgorithm"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "LineTensionPercent")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeLineTensionPercent();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeSplineAlgorithm();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSplineAlgorithm()
		{
			return splineAlgorithm != SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax;
		}

		private void ResetSplineAlgorithm()
		{
			SplineAlgorithm = SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLineTensionPercent()
		{
			return lineTensionPercent != 80;
		}

		private void ResetLineTensionPercent()
		{
			LineTensionPercent = 80;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeSplineAlgorithm())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLineTensionPercent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private List<PlanePolygon> CreateSplineSegmentPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, LineStrip strip, LineStrip pointsStrip, double lineWidth, int seriesWeight, int lineThickness, Color color)
		{
			if (strip.Count == 0)
			{
				return new List<PlanePolygon>();
			}
			double z = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesOffset(base.Series);
			if (strip.IsEmpty)
			{
				return CreatePolygonsForSinglePoint(coordsCalculator, strip[0], z, lineWidth, seriesWeight, lineThickness, color);
			}
			float offset = (float)((double)lineThickness / 2.0);
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(strip[0].X, strip[0].Y, z);
			Line line = null;
			Line line2 = null;
			DiagramVector diagramVector = new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramVector diagramVector2 = new DiagramVector(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramVector topNormal = new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramVector bottomNormal = new DiagramVector(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
			bool leftVisible = true;
			int count = pointsStrip.Count;
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(pointsStrip[num].X, pointsStrip[num].Y, z);
			for (int i = 1; i < strip.Count; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = new DiagramPoint(strip[i].X, strip[i].Y, z);
				if (diagramPoint2 == diagramPoint && ++num < count)
				{
					diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(pointsStrip[num].X, pointsStrip[num].Y, z);
				}
				if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(diagramPoint3, diagramPoint, 0.01))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					Line3DSeriesView.CalcLines(diagramPoint, diagramPoint3, offset, out var topLine, out var bottomLine);
					if (line == null || line2 == null)
					{
						CalcNormals(topLine, bottomLine, out topNormal, out bottomNormal);
						diagramVector = topNormal;
						diagramVector2 = bottomNormal;
					}
					else
					{
						CalcNormals(topLine, bottomLine, out var topNormal2, out var bottomNormal2);
						DiagramVector diagramVector3;
						DiagramVector diagramVector4;
						if (flag)
						{
							diagramVector3 = topNormal;
							diagramVector4 = bottomNormal;
						}
						else
						{
							diagramVector3 = topNormal + topNormal2;
							diagramVector3.Normalize();
							diagramVector4 = bottomNormal + bottomNormal2;
							diagramVector4.Normalize();
						}
						Line3DSeriesView.CalcJoints(ref line, ref topLine, out var jointPoint, out var jointLine, revertJointLine: true);
						Line3DSeriesView.CalcJoints(ref line2, ref bottomLine, out var jointPoint2, out var jointLine2, revertJointLine: false);
						bool flag2 = flag;
						if (jointLine != null && jointLine2 != null)
						{
							double value = MathUtils.CalcAngleBetweenLines2D(line.V1, line.V2, topLine.V1, topLine.V2);
							if (Math.Abs(value) > Math.PI / 2.0)
							{
								List<PlanePolygon> polygons = SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, jointLine, jointLine2, leftVisible: false, rightVisible: false, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
								list.AddRange(polygons);
								diagramVector3 = topNormal;
								diagramVector4 = bottomNormal;
								flag2 = true;
							}
						}
						else if (jointLine != null)
						{
							List<PlanePolygon> polygons2 = SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, jointPoint2, jointLine, lineVisible: true, sidesVisible: false, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
							list.AddRange(polygons2);
						}
						else if (jointLine2 != null)
						{
							List<PlanePolygon> polygons3 = SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, jointPoint, jointLine2, lineVisible: true, sidesVisible: false, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
							list.AddRange(polygons3);
						}
						List<PlanePolygon> polygons4 = GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, line, line2, diagramVector, diagramVector3, diagramVector2, diagramVector4, leftVisible, rightVisible: false, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
						list.AddRange(polygons4);
						leftVisible = false;
						topNormal = topNormal2;
						bottomNormal = bottomNormal2;
						diagramVector = diagramVector3;
						diagramVector2 = diagramVector4;
						if (flag2)
						{
							diagramVector = topNormal2;
							diagramVector2 = bottomNormal2;
						}
						flag = false;
					}
					line = topLine;
					line2 = bottomLine;
				}
				diagramPoint = diagramPoint3;
			}
			if (line2 != null && line != null)
			{
				List<PlanePolygon> polygons5 = GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, line, line2, diagramVector, diagramVector, diagramVector2, diagramVector2, leftVisible, rightVisible: true, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
				list.AddRange(polygons5);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Spline3DSeriesView();
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D = (XYDiagram3D)base.Series.Chart.Diagram;
			if (xYDiagram3D != null)
			{
				return new SplineGeometryStripCreator((SplineAlgorithmCore)SplineAlgorithm, LineTension, xYDiagram3D.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation, xYDiagram3D.AxisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			}
			return new SplineGeometryStripCreator((SplineAlgorithmCore)SplineAlgorithm, LineTension, null, null, null);
		}

		protected override List<PlanePolygon> CalculatePolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			double zoomingFactor = (double)coordsCalculator.Diagram.ZoomPercent / 100.0;
			double num = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesWidth(this);
			int seriesWeight = coordsCalculator.GetSeriesWeight(base.Series);
			Color color = seriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions.Color;
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			foreach (LineStrip strip in strips)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = StripsUtils.MapStrip(coordsCalculator, strip);
				List<PlanePolygon> collection = CreateSplineSegmentPolygons(coordsCalculator, BezierUtils.CalcBezier(lineStrip2 as BezierStrip, zoomingFactor), lineStrip2, num, seriesWeight, base.LineThickness, color);
				list.AddRange(collection);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (seriesDrawOptions is Line3DDrawOptions line3DDrawOptions)
			{
				LineStyle lineStyle = base.LegendLineStyle;
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
				renderer.DrawBezier(SplineSeriesViewPainter.CreateStripForLegendMarker(bounds), line3DDrawOptions.Color, 1f, lineStyle);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is ISplineSeriesView splineSeriesView)
			{
				splineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)splineSeriesView.SplineAlgorithm;
				lineTensionPercent = splineSeriesView.LineTensionPercent;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Spline3DSeriesView spline3DSeriesView = (Spline3DSeriesView)obj;
			if (splineAlgorithm == spline3DSeriesView.SplineAlgorithm)
			{
				return lineTensionPercent == spline3DSeriesView.lineTensionPercent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		{
			Transformation transformation = base.AxisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			double minLimit = transformation.TransformForward(0.0);
			double value = (base.Series.IsNegative() ? double.MinValue : double.MaxValue);
			double maxLimit = transformation.TransformForward(value);
			return SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, base.Series, strips, minLimit, maxLimit, seriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions.Color);
		}

		private string endText = string.Empty;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesNameTemplate.BeginText")]

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string BeginText
		{
			get
			{
				return beginText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != beginText)
				{
					ControlChange(delegate
					{
						beginText = value;
					});
					UpdateDataContainer();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesNameTemplate.EndText")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesNameTemplate.EndText")]

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string EndText
		{
			get
			{
				return endText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != endText)
				{
					ControlChange(delegate
					{
						endText = value;
					});
					UpdateDataContainer();
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesNameTemplate()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal SeriesNameTemplate(DataContainer owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "BeginText")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBeginText();
			}
			if (propertyName == "EndText")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEndText();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBeginText()
		{
			return BeginText != string.Empty;
		}

		private void ResetBeginText()
		{
			BeginText = string.Empty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEndText()
		{
			return EndText != string.Empty;
		}

		private void ResetEndText()
		{
			EndText = string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeBeginText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEndText();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesNameTemplate(null);
		}

		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
			change();
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
		}

		private void UpdateDataContainer()
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: true, resetSeriesBinding: false);

	[ListBindable(false)]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ValueDataMemberCollection")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ValueDataMemberCollectionConverter))]
	public class ValueDataMemberCollection : CollectionBase, IOwnedElement
	{
		private const char Separator = ';';

		private readonly SeriesBase owner;

		internal SeriesBase Owner => owner;

		[Description("Provides indexed access to individual items in the collection.")]
		public string this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != this[index])
				{
					CheckDataMember(value);
					Changing();
					base.List[index] = value;
					Changed();
				}
			}
		}

		IOwnedElement IOwnedElement.Owner => Owner;

		IChartContainer IOwnedElement.ChartContainer => Owner.ChartContainer;

		internal event EventHandler CollectionChanged;

		internal ValueDataMemberCollection(string str)
		{
			string[] array = str.Split(';');
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				base.InnerList.Add(array[i].Trim());
			}
		}

		internal ValueDataMemberCollection(SeriesBase owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			base.InnerList.Add("");
		}

		internal void ClearAndFill(params string[] coll)
		{
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			base.InnerList.AddRange(coll);
		}

		internal void SetDimension(int dimension)
		{
			if (dimension > base.Count)
			{
				for (int i = base.Count; i < dimension; i++)
				{
					base.InnerList.Add(string.Empty);
				}
			}
			else if (dimension < base.Count)
			{
				base.InnerList.RemoveRange(dimension, base.Count - dimension);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsEmpty()
		{
			foreach (string inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(inner))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal string[] GetArray()
		{
			string[] array = new string[base.InnerList.Count];
			base.InnerList.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		internal void CheckDataMember(string dataMember)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) && owner != null && !owner.Loading)
			{
				owner.CheckDataMember(owner.GetDataSource(), dataMember, owner.ValueScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember));
			}
		}

		internal void CheckCollectionDataMember(string dataMember)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) && owner != null && !owner.Loading)
			{
				owner.CheckCollectionDataMember(dataMember);
			}
		}

		internal void Changing()
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.RaiseControlChanging();
			}
		}

		internal void Changed()
		{
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.BindingChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClearComplete()
		{
			base.OnClearComplete();
			Changed();
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
			Changed();
		}

		public virtual void Assign(ValueDataMemberCollection collection)
		{
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.InnerList.Count; i++)
			{
				base.InnerList.Add(collection[i]);
			}
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void AddRange(params string[] coll)
		{
			ArrayList c = new ArrayList(base.InnerList);
			try
			{
				base.InnerList.Clear();
				int pointDimension = Owner.View.PointDimension;
				int num = Math.Min(pointDimension, 5);
				if (coll.Length != 0 && coll.Length < num)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectValueDataMemberCount), pointDimension.ToString()));
				}
				int num2 = Math.Min(coll.Length, 6);
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					CheckDataMember(coll[i]);
				}
				if (coll.Length > 6)
				{
					CheckCollectionDataMember(coll[6]);
				}
				Changing();
				base.InnerList.AddRange(coll);
				Changed();
			}
			catch
			{
				base.InnerList.Clear();
				base.InnerList.AddRange(c);
				throw;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ValueDataMemberCollection valueDataMemberCollection && valueDataMemberCollection.InnerList.Count == base.InnerList.Count)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.InnerList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (valueDataMemberCollection.InnerList[i] != base.InnerList[i])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Join(new string(';', 1), GetArray());
		}
	}

	public abstract class SummaryOptionsBase : ChartElement, ISummaryOptionsBase
	{
		private string summaryFunction = string.Empty;

		protected SeriesBase Series => base.Owner as SeriesBase;

		protected ISummaryAdapter Adapter => base.Owner as ISummaryAdapter;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SummaryOptionsBase.SummaryFunction")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SummaryOptionsBase.SummaryFunction")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Data)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.SummaryFunctionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string SummaryFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryFunction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value != summaryFunction))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!Loading)
				{
					Adapter?.CheckSummaryFunction(value);
					SeriesBase series = Series;
					if (series != null)
					{
						series.CheckSummaryFunction(value);
						series.OnDataPropertyChanged();
					}
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				summaryFunction = value;
				Series?.BindingChanged();
				Adapter?.Update();
			}
		}

		internal SummaryOptionsBase(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "SummaryFunction")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSummaryFunction();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSummaryFunction()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryFunction);
		}

		private void ResetSummaryFunction()
		{
			SummaryFunction = string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSummaryFunction();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetSummaryFunctionInternal(string function)
		{
			summaryFunction = function;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SummaryOptionsBase summaryOptionsBase)
			{
				summaryFunction = summaryOptionsBase.summaryFunction;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PaneTitle")]
	public class PaneTitle : Title, IHitTest, ITextPropertiesProvider, ISupportTextAntialiasing, ISupportVisibilityControlElement
	{
		private const System.Drawing.StringAlignment DefaultAlignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near;

		private const DefaultBoolean DefaultVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)1;

		private const int DefaultArrowOffsetX = 5;

		private const double DefaultArrowOpacity = 1.0;

		private const double DefaultArrowDisabledOpacity = 0.25;

		private static readonly DXFont initialFont = DefaultFonts.Tahoma10Bold;

		private readonly RectangleIndents margins;

		private readonly HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private readonly RectangleFillStyle fillStyle;

		private System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment;

		private DefaultBoolean visibility = (DefaultBoolean)1;

		private bool automaticVisibility = true;

		private SvgBitmap arrowImage;

		private SvgBitmap rotatedArrowImage;

		private int id = -1;

		private bool AutomaticVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartContainer == null || ChartContainer.Chart.AutoLayout)
				{
					return automaticVisibility;
				}
				return DefaultVisible;
			}
		}

		private PaneTitleAppearance Appearance => CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this)?.PaneTitleAppearance;

		protected virtual bool Disposed { get; private set; }

		protected override string DefaultText => string.Empty;

		protected override DXFont InitialFont => initialFont;

		protected override bool DefaultVisible => false;

		protected override bool DefaultAntialiasing => true;

		protected internal override bool ActualVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(Visibility, AutomaticVisibility))
				{
					return Pane.Collapsed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal XYDiagramPaneBase Pane => (XYDiagramPaneBase)base.Owner;

		internal string ActualText
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Text))
				{
					return base.Text;
				}
				if (Pane != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Pane.Name))
				{
					return Pane.Name;
				}
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.DefaultPaneTitle);
			}
		}

		internal GRealRect2D Bounds { get; set; }

		internal RectangleIndents ActualMargins
		{
			get
			{
				RectangleIndents rectangleIndents = (RectangleIndents)margins.Clone();
				rectangleIndents.SetHighDpiScaleProvider(base.Owner.Chart);
				RectangleIndents contentMargins = Appearance.ContentMargins;
				if (contentMargins != null)
				{
					if (rectangleIndents.All == -1)
					{
						rectangleIndents.Left = contentMargins.All;
					}
					if (rectangleIndents.Left == -1)
					{
						rectangleIndents.Left = contentMargins.Left;
					}
					if (rectangleIndents.Top == -1)
					{
						rectangleIndents.Top = contentMargins.Top;
					}
					if (rectangleIndents.Right == -1)
					{
						rectangleIndents.Right = contentMargins.Right;
					}
					if (rectangleIndents.Bottom == -1)
					{
						rectangleIndents.Bottom = contentMargins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				return rectangleIndents;
			}
		}

					if (!Pane.ActualRuntimeCollapse)

				return false;

			}
		}

		internal SvgBitmap GetArrowImage(bool rotated)
		{
			if (rotated)
			{
				if (rotatedArrowImage == null)
				{
					rotatedArrowImage = ImageResourcesUtils.GetArrowLeftImageFromResources();
				}
				return rotatedArrowImage;
			}
			if (arrowImage == null)
			{
				arrowImage = ImageResourcesUtils.GetArrowBottomImageFromResources();
			}
			return arrowImage;
		}

		internal Point GetArrowOffset(Size textSize)
		{
			int num = Appearance.ArrowOffsetX;
			int num2 = Appearance.ArrowOffsetY;
			if (num == int.MinValue)
			{
				num = 5;
			}
			if (num2 == int.MinValue)
			{
				num2 = (int)((double)textSize.Height - GetArrowImage(rotated: false).SvgImage.Height) / 2 - 1;
			}
			return new Point(num, num2);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PaneTitle(null);
		}

		protected override Color GetTextColor(IChartAppearance actualAppearance)
		{
			Color result = actualAppearance.PaneTitleAppearance.ForeColor;
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = actualAppearance.WholeChartAppearance.TitleColor;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PaneTitle paneTitle)
			{
				alignment = paneTitle.alignment;
				visibility = paneTitle.visibility;
				margins.Assign(paneTitle.margins);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class Diagram3D : Diagram, IScrollingZoomingOptions
	{
		private const int MaxZoomPercent = 500;

		private const double ZoomPercentStep = 1.5;

		private const double MaxScrollPercent = 100.0;

		private const RotationType DefaultRotationType = RotationType.UseMouseAdvanced;

		private const RotationOrder DefaultRotationOrder = RotationOrder.XYZ;

		private const bool DefaultPerspectiveEnabled = true;

		private const bool DefaultRuntimeRotation = false;

		private const bool DefaultRuntimeZooming = false;

		private const bool DefaultRuntimeScrolling = false;

		internal const double Epsilon = 0.01;

		public const int DefaultZoomPercent = 100;

		public const double DefaultScrollPercent = 0.0;

		private readonly ScrollingOptions scrollingOptions;

		private readonly ZoomingOptions zoomingOptions;

		private readonly RotationOptions rotationOptions;

		private bool perspectiveEnabled = true;

		private bool runtimeRotation;

		private bool runtimeZooming;

		private bool runtimeScrolling;

		private double[] rotationMatrix;

		private double horizontalScrollPercent;

		private double verticalScrollPercent;

		private int rotationAngleX;

		private int rotationAngleY;

		private int rotationAngleZ;

		private int perspectiveAngle;

		private int zoomPercent = 100;

		private RotationType rotationType = RotationType.UseMouseAdvanced;

		private RotationOrder rotationOrder;

		private Rectangle lastDiagramBounds;

		private bool InternalCanRotateWithTouch
		{
			get
			{
				if (RuntimeRotation && RotationOptions.UseTouchDevice)
				{
					return RotationType != RotationType.UseAngles;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool InternalCanRotateWithMouse
		{
			get
			{
				if ((base.Chart.Container.DesignMode || RuntimeRotation) && RotationType != RotationType.UseAngles)
				{
					return RotationOptions.UseMouse;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool InternalCanZoom
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Chart.Container.DesignMode)
				{
					return RuntimeZooming;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool InternalCanScroll
		{
			get
			{
				if ((base.Chart.Container.DesignMode || runtimeScrolling) && lastDiagramBounds.Width != 0)
				{
					return lastDiagramBounds.Height != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int DefaultRotationAngleX => 20;

		protected virtual int DefaultRotationAngleY => -40;

		protected virtual int DefaultRotationAngleZ => 0;

		protected virtual int DefaultPerspectiveAngle => 50;

		protected internal override bool CanZoomIn
		{
			get
			{
				if (InternalCanZoom)
				{
					return zoomPercent < 500;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanZoomInViaRect => false;

		protected internal override bool CanZoomOut
		{
			get
			{
				if (InternalCanZoom)
				{
					return zoomPercent > 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanZoomWithTouch => ZoomingOptions.UseTouchDevice;

		protected internal override bool CanPan => RotationOptions.UseTouchDevice;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Diagram3D.RotationType")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Diagram3D.RotationType")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public RotationType RotationType
		{
			get
			{
				return rotationType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != rotationType)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if (!Loading && value == RotationType.UseMouseStandard)
					{
						rotationAngleZ = 0;
						rotationType = RotationType.UseAngles;
						CalculateRotationMatrix();
					}
					rotationType = value;
					CalculateRotationMatrix();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public double[] RotationMatrix
		{
			get
			{
				if (rotationMatrix == null)
				{
					CalculateRotationMatrix();
				}
				return rotationMatrix;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckRotationMatrix(value);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				rotationMatrix = value;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string RotationMatrixSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				double[] array = RotationMatrix;
				foreach (double num in array)
				{
					text = text + num.ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo) + ";";
				}
				return text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
			}
			set
			{
				string[] array = value.Split(';');
				double[] array2 = new double[array.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = double.Parse(array[i], NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				}
				RotationMatrix = array2;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Diagram3D.ZoomPercent")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Diagram3D.ZoomPercent")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int ZoomPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return zoomPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != zoomPercent)
				{
					if (ClampZoomPercent(value) != value)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectZoomPercent), 500.ToString()));
					}
					int num = zoomPercent;
					RaiseControlChanging();
					zoomPercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
					if (base.Chart != null && !base.Chart.Loading)
					{
						ChartZoomEventType type = ((zoomPercent > num || zoomPercent == 500) ? ChartZoomEventType.ZoomIn : ChartZoomEventType.ZoomOut);
						base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnZoom3D(new ChartZoom3DEventArgs(num, zoomPercent, type));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public Diagram3D()
		{
			rotationAngleX = DefaultRotationAngleX;
			rotationAngleY = DefaultRotationAngleY;
			rotationAngleZ = DefaultRotationAngleZ;
			rotationMatrix = new double[16];
			rotationType = RotationType.UseAngles;
			CalculateRotationMatrix();
			rotationType = RotationType.UseMouseAdvanced;
			perspectiveAngle = DefaultPerspectiveAngle;
			scrollingOptions = new ScrollingOptions(this);
			zoomingOptions = new ZoomingOptions(this);
			rotationOptions = new RotationOptions(this);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotationType()
		{
			return RotationType != RotationType.UseMouseAdvanced;
		}

		private void ResetRotationType()
		{
			RotationType = RotationType.UseMouseAdvanced;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAngleRotation()
		{
			return rotationType == RotationType.UseAngles;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotationOrder()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAngleRotation())
			{
				return rotationOrder != RotationOrder.XYZ;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetRotationOrder()
		{
			RotationOrder = RotationOrder.XYZ;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotationAngleX()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAngleRotation())
			{
				return rotationAngleX != DefaultRotationAngleX;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetRotationAngleX()
		{
			RotationAngleX = DefaultRotationAngleX;
		}

		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAngleRotation())
			{
				return rotationAngleY != DefaultRotationAngleY;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			RotationAngleY = DefaultRotationAngleY;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotationAngleZ()

			{
				return rotationAngleZ != DefaultRotationAngleZ;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetRotationAngleZ()
		{
			RotationAngleZ = DefaultRotationAngleZ;
		}

			return !ShouldSerializeAngleRotation();
		}

			return rotationOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeRotationType() && !ShouldSerializeRotationOrder() && !ShouldSerializeRotationAngleX() && !ShouldSerializeRotationAngleY() && !ShouldSerializeRotationAngleZ() && !ShouldSerializeRotationMatrixSerializable() && !ShouldSerializePerspectiveEnabled() && !ShouldSerializePerspectiveAngle() && !ShouldSerializeZoomPercent() && !ShouldSerializeHorizontalScrollPercent() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalScrollPercent() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeRotation() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeZooming() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeScrolling() && !ShouldSerializeScrollingOptions() && !ShouldSerializeZoomingOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRotationOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"RotationType" => ShouldSerializeRotationType(), 
				"RotationOrder" => ShouldSerializeRotationOrder(), 
				"RotationAngleX" => ShouldSerializeRotationAngleX(), 
				"RotationAngleY" => ShouldSerializeRotationAngleY(), 
				"RotationAngleZ" => ShouldSerializeRotationAngleZ(), 
				"RotationMatrixSerializable" => ShouldSerializeRotationMatrixSerializable(), 
				"PerspectiveEnabled" => ShouldSerializePerspectiveEnabled(), 
				"PerspectiveAngle" => ShouldSerializePerspectiveAngle(), 
				"ZoomPercent" => ShouldSerializeZoomPercent(), 
				"HorizontalScrollPercent" => ShouldSerializeHorizontalScrollPercent(), 
				"VerticalScrollPercent" => ShouldSerializeVerticalScrollPercent(), 
				"RuntimeRotation" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeRotation(), 
				"RuntimeZooming" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeZooming(), 
				"RuntimeScrolling" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeScrolling(), 
				"ScrollingOptions" => ShouldSerializeScrollingOptions(), 
				"ZoomingOptions" => ShouldSerializeZoomingOptions(), 
				"RotationOptions" => ShouldSerializeRotationOptions(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private void CheckRotationMatrix(double[] matrix)
		{
			if (matrix.Length != 16)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTransformationMatrix));
			}
			double num = matrix[0] * (matrix[5] * matrix[10] - matrix[6] * matrix[9]) + matrix[1] * (matrix[6] * matrix[8] - matrix[4] * matrix[10]) + matrix[2] * (matrix[4] * matrix[9] - matrix[5] * matrix[8]);
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 1.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[3], 0.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[7], 0.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[11], 0.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[12], 0.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[13], 0.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[14], 0.0, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(matrix[15], 1.0, 0.01) != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectTransformationMatrix));
			}
		}

		private void CalculateRotationMatrix()
		{
			if (rotationType == RotationType.UseAngles)
			{
				using (GraphicsCommand command = CreateRotationGraphicsCommand())
				{
					GLHelper.CalculateMatrices(command, out rotationMatrix, out var _);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRuntimeProperties(Diagram3D diagram)
		{
			runtimeRotation = diagram.runtimeRotation;
			runtimeZooming = diagram.runtimeZooming;
			runtimeScrolling = diagram.runtimeScrolling;
		}

		private void SetScroll(double newHorizontalScrollPercent, double newVerticalScrollPercent)
		{
			double oldHorizontalScrollPercent = horizontalScrollPercent;
			double oldVerticalScrollPercent = verticalScrollPercent;
			bool flag = horizontalScrollPercent != newHorizontalScrollPercent;
			bool flag2 = verticalScrollPercent != newVerticalScrollPercent;
			if (flag)
			{
				horizontalScrollPercent = newHorizontalScrollPercent;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				verticalScrollPercent = newVerticalScrollPercent;
			}
			if (base.Chart != null && !base.Chart.Loading)
			{
				ChartScrollDirection scrollDirection = ((!flag) ? ChartScrollDirection.Vertical : (flag2 ? ChartScrollDirection.Both : ChartScrollDirection.Horizontal));
				ChartScroll3DEventArgs e = new ChartScroll3DEventArgs(scrollDirection, oldHorizontalScrollPercent, horizontalScrollPercent, oldVerticalScrollPercent, verticalScrollPercent);
				base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnScroll3D(e);
			}
		}

		private int ClampZoomPercent(double value)
		{
			if (value < 1.0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (value > 500.0)
			{
				return 500;
			}
			return Convert.ToInt32(value);
		}

		private double ClampScrollPercent(double value)
		{
			if (value < -100.0)
			{
				return -100.0;
			}
			if (value > 100.0)
			{
				return 100.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool CheckScrollPercent(double value)
		{
			return ClampScrollPercent(value) == value;
		}

		private bool CanRotateAtPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (InternalCanRotateWithMouse)
			{
				return lastDiagramBounds.Contains(point);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanScrollAtPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (InternalCanScroll && lastDiagramBounds.Contains(point))
			{
				return scrollingOptions.UseMouse;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool PerformScrolling(int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (!InternalCanScroll)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = ClampScrollPercent(horizontalScrollPercent + (double)dx / (double)lastDiagramBounds.Width * 10000.0 / (double)zoomPercent);
			double num2 = ClampScrollPercent(verticalScrollPercent - (double)dy / (double)lastDiagramBounds.Height * 10000.0 / (double)zoomPercent);
			if (num == horizontalScrollPercent && num2 == verticalScrollPercent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetScroll(num, num2);
			return true;
		}

		private bool PerformRotation(int dx, int dy)
		{
			double num = Math.PI / 4.0;
			double dx2 = (double)dx * num;
			double dy2 = (double)dy * num;
			if (rotationType == RotationType.UseMouseStandard)
			{
				GLHelper.PerformRotationStandard(RotationMatrix, dx2, dy2);
			}
			else
			{
				GLHelper.PerformRotation(RotationMatrix, dx2, dy2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateRotationGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (rotationType != RotationType.UseAngles)
			{
				return new TransformGraphicsCommand(rotationMatrix);
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			RotateGraphicsCommand command = new RotateGraphicsCommand(rotationAngleX, new DiagramVector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			RotateGraphicsCommand command2 = new RotateGraphicsCommand(rotationAngleY, new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
			RotateGraphicsCommand command3 = new RotateGraphicsCommand(rotationAngleZ, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
			switch (rotationOrder)
			{
			case RotationOrder.XYZ:
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command2);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command3);
				break;
			case RotationOrder.XZY:
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command3);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command2);
				break;
			case RotationOrder.YXZ:
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command2);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command3);
				break;
			case RotationOrder.YZX:
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command2);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command3);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
				break;
			case RotationOrder.ZXY:
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command3);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command2);
				break;
			case RotationOrder.ZYX:
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command3);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command2);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
				break;
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected void UpdateLastDiagramBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			lastDiagramBounds = bounds;
		}

		protected internal override INativeGraphics CreateNativeGraphics(ChartGraphicsBase gr, IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle windowsBounds)
		{
			Rectangle bounds2 = CalculateViewportBounds(bounds, windowsBounds);
			OpenGLGraphics openGLGraphics = new OpenGLGraphics(gr, hdc, bounds2, (base.Chart == null) ? null : base.Chart.TextureCache);
			if (openGLGraphics.Initialized)
			{
				return openGLGraphics;
			}
			openGLGraphics.Dispose();
			return null;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateViewportBounds(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle windowsBounds)
		{
			if (windowsBounds != Rectangle.Empty)
			{
				return new Rectangle(bounds.X, windowsBounds.Height - (bounds.Y + bounds.Height), bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			if (!base.Chart.Container.DesignMode && runtimeRotation && rotationType == RotationType.UseAngles)
			{
				CalculateRotationMatrix();
				rotationType = RotationType.UseMouseAdvanced;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanDrag(Point point, PortableMouseButtons button)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)button != 1048576)
			{
				if ((int)button == 4194304)
				{
					return CanScrollAtPoint(point);
				}
				if (!CanRotateAtPoint(point))
				{
					return CanScrollAtPoint(point);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return CanRotateAtPoint(point);
		}

		protected internal override bool PerformDragging(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, ChartScrollEventType scrollEventType, object focusedElement)
		{
			switch (scrollEventType)
			{
			case ChartScrollEventType.LeftButtonMouseDrag:
				if (!InternalCanRotateWithMouse)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return PerformRotation(dx, dy);
			case ChartScrollEventType.Gesture:
				if (!InternalCanRotateWithTouch)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return PerformRotation(dx, dy);
			default:
				return PerformScrolling(dx, dy);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanZoom(Point point)
		{
			if (InternalCanZoom)
			{
				return lastDiagramBounds.Contains(point);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void Zoom(int delta, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, object focusedElement)
		{
			ZoomPercent = ClampZoomPercent(zoomPercent + delta * 3);
		}

		protected internal override void ZoomIn(Point center)
		{
			if (CanZoomIn)
			{
				ZoomPercent = ClampZoomPercent((double)zoomPercent * 1.5);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ZoomOut(Point center)
		{
			if (CanZoomOut)
			{
				ZoomPercent = ClampZoomPercent((double)zoomPercent / 1.5);
			}
		}

		protected internal override string GetDesignerHint(Point p)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (CanRotateAtPoint(p))
			{
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.Msg3DRotationToolTip);
			}
			if (CanScrollAtPoint(p))
			{
				if (text.Length != 0)
				{
					text += "\n";
				}
				text += ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.Msg3DScrollingToolTip);
			}
			if (text.Length != 0)
			{
				text += "\n";
			}
			return text + ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.Msg3DZoomToolTip);
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateDiagramProperties(Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (diagram is Diagram3D diagram2)
			{
				UpdateRuntimeProperties(diagram2);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void BeginGestureZoom(Point center, double zoomDelta)
		{
			PerformGestureZoom(zoomDelta);
		}

		protected internal override void PerformGestureZoom(double zoomDelta)
		{
			if (RuntimeZooming)
			{
				ZoomPercent = ClampZoomPercent((double)ZoomPercent * zoomDelta);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool PerformGestureRotation(double degreeDelta)
		{
			if (InternalCanRotateWithTouch)
			{
				GLHelper.PerformRotation(RotationMatrix, degreeDelta);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramCoordinates PointToDiagramInternal(Point p)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Diagram3D diagram3D)
			{
				rotationType = diagram3D.rotationType;
				rotationOrder = diagram3D.rotationOrder;
				rotationAngleX = diagram3D.rotationAngleX;
				rotationAngleY = diagram3D.rotationAngleY;
				rotationAngleZ = diagram3D.rotationAngleZ;
				if (diagram3D.rotationMatrix != null)
				{
					rotationMatrix = new double[diagram3D.rotationMatrix.Length];
					Array.Copy(diagram3D.rotationMatrix, rotationMatrix, 16);
				}
				perspectiveEnabled = diagram3D.perspectiveEnabled;
				perspectiveAngle = diagram3D.perspectiveAngle;
				zoomPercent = diagram3D.zoomPercent;
				horizontalScrollPercent = diagram3D.horizontalScrollPercent;
				verticalScrollPercent = diagram3D.verticalScrollPercent;
				scrollingOptions.Assign(diagram3D.scrollingOptions);
				zoomingOptions.Assign(diagram3D.zoomingOptions);
				rotationOptions.Assign(diagram3D.rotationOptions);
				UpdateRuntimeProperties(diagram3D);
			}
		}
	}

	[RuntimeObject]
	public abstract class ChartHitInfoBase
	{
		private readonly Point hitPoint;

		private readonly object hitObject;

		private readonly IList<HitTestParams> hitTestParams;

		public Point HitPoint => hitPoint;

		public virtual object HitObject => hitObject;

		public virtual object[] HitObjects
		{
			get
			{
				object[] array = new object[hitTestParams.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < hitTestParams.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = GetHitObjectByParams(hitTestParams[i]);
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public AxisLabelItemBase AxisLabelItem
		{
			get
			{
				HitTestParams hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(AxisBase));
				if (hitParamsByType != null)
				{
					return hitParamsByType.AdditionalObj as AxisLabelItemBase;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public AxisTitle AxisTitle
		{
			get
			{
				HitTestParams hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(Axis));
				if (hitParamsByType != null)
				{
					return hitParamsByType.AdditionalObj as AxisTitle;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public CustomLegendItem CustomLegendItem => GetLegendItemSource<CustomLegendItem>();

		public bool InAxis => InHitObject(typeof(AxisBase));

		public bool InLegend => InHitObject(typeof(LegendBase));

		public bool InCustomLegendItem => InAdditionalHitObject(typeof(CustomLegendItem));

		internal ChartHitInfoBase(Point hitPoint, IList<HitTestParams> hitTestParams)
		{
			this.hitPoint = hitPoint;
			this.hitTestParams = hitTestParams;
			hitObject = ((hitTestParams.Count > 0) ? GetHitObjectByParams(hitTestParams[0]) : null);
		}

		private object GetHitObjectByParams(HitTestParams hitParams)
		{
			IHitTest hitTest = hitParams.Object;
			object obj = hitTest.Object;
			if (obj is DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
			{
				obj = chart.ChartContainer;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private TSource GetLegendItemSource<TSource>() where TSource : class
		{
			HitTestParams hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(LegendBase));
			if (hitParamsByType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return hitParamsByType.AdditionalObj as TSource;
		}

		protected HitTestParams GetHitParamsByType(Type hitType)
		{
			foreach (HitTestParams hitTestParam in hitTestParams)
			{
				if (hitType.IsAssignableFrom(GetHitObjectByParams(hitTestParam)?.GetType()))
				{
					return hitTestParam;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected object GetHitObjectByType(Type hitType)
		{
			HitTestParams hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(hitType);
			if (hitParamsByType != null)
			{
				return GetHitObjectByParams(hitParamsByType);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected object GetAdditionalHitObjectByType(Type hitType)
		{
			foreach (HitTestParams hitTestParam in hitTestParams)
			{
				object additionalObj = hitTestParam.AdditionalObj;
				if (additionalObj != null && hitType.IsAssignableFrom(additionalObj.GetType()))
				{
					return additionalObj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool InHitObject(Type hitType)
		{
			return GetHitObjectByType(hitType) != null;
		}

		protected bool InAdditionalHitObject(Type hitType)
		{
			return GetAdditionalHitObjectByType(hitType) != null;
		}
	}
	[RuntimeObject]
	public class ChartHitInfo : ChartHitInfoBase
	{
		private readonly ChartHitTest hitTest;

		internal SeriesBase SeriesInsideDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetHitObjectByType(typeof(SeriesBase)) is SeriesBase result)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (GetHitObjectByType(typeof(SeriesLabelBase)) is SeriesLabelBase seriesLabelBase)
				{
					return seriesLabelBase.SeriesBase;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal RefinedPoint RefinedPointInsideDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				HitTestParams hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(SeriesBase));
				if (hitParamsByType == null)
				{
					hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(SeriesLabelBase));
				}
				if (hitParamsByType == null)
				{
					hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(Annotation));
				}
				if (hitParamsByType != null)
				{
					return hitParamsByType.AdditionalObj as RefinedPoint;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ChartHitTest HitTest => hitTest;

		public IChartContainer Chart => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(IChartContainer)) as IChartContainer;

		public ChartTitle ChartTitle => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(ChartTitle)) as ChartTitle;

		public AxisBase Axis => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(AxisBase)) as AxisBase;

		public ConstantLine ConstantLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetHitObjectByType(typeof(ConstantLine)) is ConstantLine result))
				{
					return GetLegendItemSource<ConstantLine>();
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public Diagram Diagram => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(Diagram)) as Diagram;

		public Legend Legend => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(Legend)) as Legend;

		public SeriesBase Series
		{
			get
			{
				SeriesBase seriesInsideDiagram = SeriesInsideDiagram;
				if (seriesInsideDiagram == null)
				{
					return GetLegendItemSource<SeriesBase>();
				}
				return seriesInsideDiagram;
			}
		}

		public SeriesLabelBase SeriesLabel => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(SeriesLabelBase)) as SeriesLabelBase;

		public SeriesTitle SeriesTitle => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(SeriesTitle)) as SeriesTitle;

		public XYDiagramPane NonDefaultPane => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(XYDiagramPane)) as XYDiagramPane;

		public PaneTitle PaneTitle => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(PaneTitle)) as PaneTitle;

		public string Hyperlink
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetAdditionalHitObjectByType(typeof(HyperlinkSource)) is HyperlinkSource hyperlinkSource))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return hyperlinkSource.Hyperlink;
			}
		}

		public Indicator Indicator
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetHitObjectByType(typeof(Indicator)) is Indicator result))
				{
					return GetLegendItemSource<Indicator>();
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public Annotation Annotation => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(Annotation)) as Annotation;

		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = RefinedPointInsideDiagram;
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					refinedPoint = GetLegendItemSource<RefinedPoint>();
				}
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint == null)
				{
					DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper((Series)Series);
					dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
				}
				return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
		}

		public bool InChart => InHitObject(typeof(IChartContainer));

		public bool InChartTitle => InHitObject(typeof(ChartTitle));

		public bool InConstantLine => InHitObject(typeof(ConstantLine));

		public bool InDiagram => InHitObject(typeof(Diagram));

		public bool InSeries => InHitObject(typeof(SeriesBase));

		public bool InSeriesLabel => InHitObject(typeof(SeriesLabelBase));

		public bool InSeriesTitle => InHitObject(typeof(SeriesTitle));

		public bool InNonDefaultPane => InHitObject(typeof(XYDiagramPane));

		public bool InPaneTitle => InHitObject(typeof(PaneTitle));

		public bool InIndicator => InHitObject(typeof(Indicator));

		public bool InAnnotation => InHitObject(typeof(Annotation));

		public bool InHyperlink => InAdditionalHitObject(typeof(HyperlinkSource));

		public bool InSeriesPoint => SeriesPoint != null;

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the Indicator property instead.")]
		public TrendLine TrendLine => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(TrendLine)) as TrendLine;

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the Indicator property instead.")]
		public FibonacciIndicator FibonacciIndicator => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(FibonacciIndicator)) as FibonacciIndicator;

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the Indicator property instead.")]
		public RegressionLine RegressionLine => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(RegressionLine)) as RegressionLine;

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the InIndicator property instead.")]
		public bool InTrendLine => InHitObject(typeof(TrendLine));

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the InIndicator property instead.")]
		public bool InFibonacciIndicator => InHitObject(typeof(FibonacciIndicator));

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the InIndicator property instead.")]
		public bool InRegressionLine => InHitObject(typeof(RegressionLine));

		internal ChartHitInfo(Point hitPoint, IList<HitTestParams> hitTestParams)
			: base(hitPoint, hitTestParams)
		{
			hitTest = GetChartHitTest(HitObject);
		}

		private TSource GetLegendItemSource<TSource>() where TSource : class
		{
			HitTestParams hitParamsByType = GetHitParamsByType(typeof(Legend));
			if (hitParamsByType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return hitParamsByType.AdditionalObj as TSource;
		}

		private ChartHitTest GetChartHitTest(object hitObject)
		{
			if (hitObject == null)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.None;
			}
			if (hitObject is IChartContainer)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Chart;
			}
			if (hitObject is ChartTitle)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.ChartTitle;
			}
			if (hitObject is Axis || hitObject is RadarAxis)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Axis;
			}
			if (hitObject is ConstantLine)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.ConstantLine;
			}
			if (hitObject is Diagram)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Diagram;
			}
			if (hitObject is Legend)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Legend;
			}
			if (hitObject is SeriesBase)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Series;
			}
			if (hitObject is SeriesLabelBase)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.SeriesLabel;
			}
			if (hitObject is SeriesTitle)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.SeriesTitle;
			}
			if (hitObject is XYDiagramPane)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.NonDefaultPane;
			}
			if (hitObject is Annotation)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Annotation;
			}
			if (hitObject is Indicator)
			{
				return ChartHitTest.Indicator;
			}
			return ChartHitTest.None;
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RadarDiagram")]
	public class RadarDiagram : Diagram, IDisposable, IXYDiagram, IDiagram, IAxisProvider, IPane, IBackground, IRadarDiagram, IScrollingZoomingOptions
	{
		private const bool DefaultBorderVisible = true;

		private const int DefaultMargins = 5;

		private const RadarDiagramDrawingStyle DefaultDrawingStyle = RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle;

		private const double DefaultStartAngle = 0.0;

		private const RadarDiagramRotationDirection DefaultRotationDirection = RadarDiagramRotationDirection.Counterclockwise;

		private static readonly Color defaultColor = Color.Empty;

		private readonly RadarAxisX axisX;

		private readonly RadarAxisY axisY;

		private RadarDiagramMapping LastMapping
		{
			get
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart.CacheToMemory && chart.GetCoordinatesConversionCache() is RadarCoordinatesConversionCache radarCoordinatesConversionCache)
				{
					return radarCoordinatesConversionCache.DiagramMapping;
				}
				return lastMapping;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!(backColor == Color.Empty))
				{
					return backColor;
				}
				return Appearance.BackColor;
			}
		}

		internal PolygonFillStyle ActualFillStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (fillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Empty)
				{
					return fillStyle;
				}
				return (PolygonFillStyle)Appearance.FillStyle;
			}
		}

		internal double ActualStartAngle => ((rotationDirection == RadarDiagramRotationDirection.Clockwise) ? startAngleInDegrees : (0.0 - startAngleInDegrees)) * Math.PI / 180.0;

		protected internal override bool CanAnimate
		{
			get
			{
				List<Series> activeSeriesList = base.ViewController.GetActiveSeriesList();
				foreach (Series item in activeSeriesList)
				{
					if (item.View.CanAnimate)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAxisX() && !ShouldSerializeAxisY() && !ShouldSerializeFillStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBackImage() && !ShouldSerializeShadow() && !ShouldSerializeMargins() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderVisible() && !ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeDrawingStyle() && !ShouldSerializeStartAngleInDegrees() && !ShouldSerializeRotationDirection() && !ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSelectionOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"AxisX" => ShouldSerializeAxisX(), 
				"AxisY" => ShouldSerializeAxisY(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"BackImage" => ShouldSerializeBackImage(), 
				"Shadow" => ShouldSerializeShadow(), 
				"Margins" => ShouldSerializeMargins(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"BorderVisible" => ShouldSerializeBorderVisible(), 
				"BorderColor" => ShouldSerializeBorderColor(), 
				"DrawingStyle" => ShouldSerializeDrawingStyle(), 
				"StartAngleInDegrees" => ShouldSerializeStartAngleInDegrees(), 
				"RotationDirection" => ShouldSerializeRotationDirection(), 
				"DrillDownOptions" => ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions(), 
				"SelectionOptions" => ShouldSerializeSelectionOptions(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private ControlCoordinates CalcDiagramToPoint(object argument, object value)
		{
			double num = axisX.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(argument);
			double num2 = axisY.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(value);
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(null, ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Undefined, Point.Empty);
			}
			if (LastMapping == null)
			{
				base.Chart.PerformViewDataCalculation(Rectangle.Empty, correctRanges: false);
			}
			RadarDiagramMapping radarDiagramMapping = LastMapping;
			if (radarDiagramMapping == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates();
			}
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = radarDiagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(num, num2);
			if (screenPoint.IsZero)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates();
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(null, (!(radarDiagramMapping.MinValue <= num2) || !(num2 <= radarDiagramMapping.MaxValue)) ? ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Hidden : ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Visible, (Point)screenPoint);
		}

		private int GetAxisXLength()
		{
			if (base.Chart == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			Rectangle lastBounds = base.Chart.LastBounds;
			return 3 * Math.Min(lastBounds.Width, lastBounds.Height);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				Disposed = true;
				backImage.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				Disposed = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateAutoMeasureUnits()
		{
			if (axisX.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(GetAxisXLength()))
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(AxisX, "AutoMeasureUnit"), ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes);
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal override DiagramViewData CalculateViewData(SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, Rectangle diagramBounds, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			lastMapping = null;
			if (!diagramBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = margins.DecreaseRectangle(diagramBounds);
			if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (shadow.Visible)
			{
				rectangle = new Rectangle(rectangle.Location, shadow.DecreaseSize(rectangle.Size));
				if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (BorderVisible)
			{
				num = 1;
				rectangle.Inflate(-1, -1);
				if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			HitTestState state = ((IHitTest)this).State;
			RectangleCorrection rectangleCorrection = null;
			RectangleF rectangleF;
			RadarDiagramMapping radarDiagramMapping;
			List<LabelLayoutListBase> list;
			List<AnnotationLayout> list2;
			List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;
			RadarAxisXViewData radarAxisXViewData;
			RadarAxisYViewData radarAxisYViewData;
			while (true)
			{
				if (rectangleCorrection == null)
				{
					rectangleF = rectangle;
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = rectangleCorrection.Correct(rectangle);
					if (!rectangle2.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
					{
						return null;
					}
					rectangleF = rectangle2;
				}
				int num2 = rectangle.Width - rectangle.Height;
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					rectangleF.Width -= num2;
					int num3 = num2 / 2;
					rectangleF.Offset(num3, 0f);
				}
				else
				{
					rectangleF.Height += num2;
					int num4 = -num2 / 2;
					rectangleF.Offset(0f, num4);
				}
				double axisLength = (double)Math.Min(rectangleF.Width, rectangleF.Height) * Math.PI;
				GridAndTextData gridAndTextData = new GridAndTextData(axisX.GetSeries(), axisX, scrollingEnabled: false, axisX.VisualRangeData, axisLength, axisX.Label != null && axisX.Label.Staggered);
				radarDiagramMapping = new RadarDiagramMapping(this, rectangleF, gridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleTickMarkValues);
				if (!radarDiagramMapping.IsValid)
				{
					return null;
				}
				GridAndTextData gridAndTextData2 = new GridAndTextData(axisY.GetSeries(), axisY, scrollingEnabled: false, axisY.VisualRangeData, rectangleF.Height, axisY.Label != null && axisY.Label.Staggered);
				list = new List<LabelLayoutListBase>();
				list2 = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
				foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in containerDataList.AllSeriesData)
				{
					list.Add(new RadarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(allSeriesDatum, radarDiagramMapping));
					list2.AddRange(new RadarDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList(allSeriesDatum, radarDiagramMapping));
				}
				annotationsViewData = AnnotationHelper.CreateInnerAnnotationsViewData(list2);
				RectangleCorrection rectangleCorrection2 = new RectangleCorrection(diagramBounds);
				radarAxisXViewData = new RadarAxisXViewData(axisX, radarDiagramMapping, gridAndTextData, num);
				radarAxisXViewData.UpdateCorrection(rectangleCorrection2);
				double num5 = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle((float)startAngleInDegrees);
				radarAxisYViewData = new RadarAxisYViewData(axisY, radarDiagramMapping, gridAndTextData2, num5 == 0.0 || num5 == 90.0 || num5 == 180.0 || num5 == 270.0);
				radarAxisYViewData.UpdateCorrection(rectangleCorrection2);
				foreach (SeriesLabelLayoutList item in list)
				{
					item.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(rectangleCorrection2);
				}
				AnnotationHelper.CalculateAnnotationsCorrection(annotationsViewData, rectangleCorrection2);
				if (!rectangleCorrection2.ShouldCorrect)
				{
					break;
				}
				rectangleCorrection = RectangleCorrection.Combine(rectangleCorrection, rectangleCorrection2);
			}
			if (!state.Normal)
			{
				num++;
			}
			Color color = BorderColor;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				color = GraphicUtils.GetColor(color.IsEmpty ? Appearance.BorderColor : color, state);
			}
			List<SeriesLayout> list3 = new List<SeriesLayout>();
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum2 in containerDataList.AllSeriesData)
			{
				if (allSeriesDatum2.Series.View is RadarRangeAreaSeriesView)
				{
					list3.Add(new RadarRangeAreaSeriesLayout(allSeriesDatum2, radarDiagramMapping));
				}
				else
				{
					list3.Add(new RadarDiagramSeriesLayout(allSeriesDatum2, radarDiagramMapping));
				}
			}
			lastMapping = radarDiagramMapping;
			List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList = Diagram.CreateLegendViewDataList(legendItems, diagramBounds);
			return new RadarDiagramViewData(this, radarDiagramMapping, rectangle, rectangleF, radarAxisXViewData, radarAxisYViewData, num, color, list3, list, list2, annotationsViewData, legendViewDataList, diagramBounds);
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			axisX.OnEndLoading();
			axisY.OnEndLoading();
		}

		protected internal override CoordinatesConversionCache CreateCoordinatesConversionCache()
		{
			return new RadarCoordinatesConversionCache(lastMapping);
		}

		protected internal override DiagramCoordinates PointToDiagramInternal(Point p)
		{
			return PointToDiagram(p);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RadarDiagram radarDiagram)
			{
				axisX.Assign(radarDiagram.axisX);
				axisY.Assign(radarDiagram.axisY);
				fillStyle.Assign(radarDiagram.fillStyle);
				backImage.Assign(radarDiagram.backImage);
				shadow.Assign(radarDiagram.shadow);
				margins.Assign(radarDiagram.margins);
				backColor = radarDiagram.backColor;
				borderVisible = radarDiagram.borderVisible;
				borderColor = radarDiagram.borderColor;
				drawingStyle = radarDiagram.drawingStyle;
				startAngleInDegrees = radarDiagram.startAngleInDegrees;
				rotationDirection = radarDiagram.rotationDirection;
				drillDownOptions.Assign(radarDiagram.drillDownOptions);
				selectionOptions.Assign(radarDiagram.selectionOptions);
			}
		}

		public DiagramCoordinates PointToDiagram(Point p)
		{
			ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
			DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = new DiagramCoordinates();
			if (LastMapping == null)
			{
				base.Chart.PerformViewDataCalculation(Rectangle.Empty, correctRanges: false);
			}
			RadarDiagramMapping radarDiagramMapping = LastMapping;
			if (radarDiagramMapping == null || radarDiagramMapping.MappingBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			diagramCoordinates.SetAxes(axisX, axisY);
			if (radarDiagramMapping.CalcArgumentAndValue(p, out var argumentInternal, out var valueInternal))
			{
				diagramCoordinates.SetArgumentAndValue(argumentInternal, valueInternal);
			}
			return diagramCoordinates;
		}

	public abstract class DrawOptions : ICloneable
	{
		private bool isUserColor;

		private Color color;

		private Color color2 = Color.Empty;

		private Color seriesViewColor;

		protected internal Color SeriesViewColor => seriesViewColor;

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldUpdateColors => false;

		[Description("Gets the actual second color of a series or its point, when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public Color ActualColor2
		{
			get
			{
				return color2;
			}
			internal set
			{
				color2 = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the series view or series view point color when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				color = value;
				isUserColor = true;
			}
		}

		protected DrawOptions()
		{
		}

		protected DrawOptions(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			seriesViewColor = (color = view.ActualColor);
			color2 = view.ActualColor2;
		}

		protected abstract DrawOptions CreateInstance();

		protected virtual void Assign(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DrawOptions drawOptions)
			{
				color = drawOptions.color;
				color2 = drawOptions.color2;
				seriesViewColor = drawOptions.seriesViewColor;
				isUserColor = drawOptions.isUserColor;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void Initialize(SeriesViewBase view, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex, bool forceMarkerVisible = false)
		{
			Color pointColor = view.ColorProvider.GetColor(points[pointIndex].SeriesPoint);
			Color? color = null;
			if (pointColor.IsEmpty && !isUserColor)
			{
				if (view.ActualColorEach)
				{
					pointColor = view.GetPointColor(pointIndex, points.Count);
					color = view.GetPointColor2(pointIndex, points.Count);
				}
				else
				{
					pointColor = view.GetPointActualColor(points, pointIndex);
					color = view.GetPointActualColor2(points, pointIndex);
				}
			}
			Color color2 = ColorProvider.ApplyTransparency(pointColor, view);
			ColorProvider.SetupDrawOptions(color2, this, color);
		}

		internal void SetColor(Color color)
		{
			this.color = color;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			DrawOptions drawOptions = CreateInstance();
			drawOptions.Assign(this);
			return drawOptions;
		}
	}

				{
					synchronizer = value;
					if (synchronizer != null)
					{
						synchronizer.ElementChanged(this);
					}
				}
			}
		}

			{
			}

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointOptions.Pattern")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Editor("System.ComponentModel.Design.MultilineStringEditor, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Pattern
		{
			get
			{
				return pattern;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pattern)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pattern = value;
					pointView = (PointView)PointOptionsHelper.ConvertToPointView(pattern);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pattern))
					{
						pattern = PointOptionsHelper.ConvertToPattern((PointViewKind)pointView);
					}
					OnPropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies which information should be displayed within series labels and legend items.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointOptions.PointView")]

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public PointView PointView
		{
			get
			{
				return pointView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pointView)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointView = value;
					string value2 = PointOptionsHelper.ConvertToPattern((PointViewKind)pointView);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
					{
						pattern = value2;
					}
					OnPropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointOptions.ValueNumericOptions")]

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointOptions.ValueDateTimeOptions")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
