		internal static string ConstructPatternFromPointOptions(PointOptions pointOptions, ScaleType argumentScaleType, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = pointOptions.Pattern;
			if (text.Contains("{A}"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("{A}", ConstructArgumentPattern(pointOptions, argumentScaleType));
			}
			if (text.Contains("{V}"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("{V}", ConstructValuePattern(pointOptions, valueScaleType));
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static string ConstructArgumentPattern(PointOptions pointOptions, ScaleType argumentScaleType)
		{
			string text = "{A";
			switch (argumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				text = text + ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ArgumentNumericOptions);
				break;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				text = text + ":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ArgumentDateTimeOptions);
				break;
			}
			return text + "}";
		}

		internal static string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptions pointOptions, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = "{V";
			if (pointOptions is FullStackedPointOptions fullStackedPointOptions && fullStackedPointOptions.PercentOptions.ValueAsPercent)
			{
				text = "{VP:" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions);
				if (pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions.Format == NumericFormat.General)
				{
					text += fullStackedPointOptions.PercentOptions.PercentageAccuracy;
				}
			}
			else if (pointOptions is SimplePointOptions simplePointOptions && simplePointOptions.PercentOptions.ValueAsPercent)
			{
				text = "{VP:" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions);
				if (pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions.Format == NumericFormat.General)
				{
					text += simplePointOptions.PercentOptions.PercentageAccuracy;
				}
			}
			else if (pointOptions is RangePointOptions rangePointOptions)
			{
				string text2 = string.Empty;
				switch (valueScaleType)
				{
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					text2 = ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions);
					break;
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					text2 = ((rangePointOptions == null || !rangePointOptions.ValueAsDuration) ? (":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ValueDateTimeOptions)) : GetValueDurationFormat(rangePointOptions));
					break;
				}
				text = ((!rangePointOptions.ValueAsDuration) ? ("{V1" + text2 + "}, {V2" + text2) : ("{VD" + text2));
			}
			else
			{
				if (pointOptions is StockPointOptions stockPointOptions)
				{
					switch (stockPointOptions.ValueLevel)
					{
					case StockLevel.Low:
						text = "{LV";
						break;
					case StockLevel.High:
						text = "{HV";
						break;
					case StockLevel.Open:
						text = "{OV";
						break;
					case StockLevel.Close:
						text = "{CV";
						break;
					}
				}
				switch (valueScaleType)
				{
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					text = text + ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ValueNumericOptions);
					break;
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					text = text + ":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(pointOptions.ValueDateTimeOptions);
					break;
				}
			}
			return text + "}";
		}

		internal static string GetValueDurationFormat(RangePointOptions rangePointOptions)
		{
			return rangePointOptions.ValueDurationFormat switch
			{
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalDays => ":TD", 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalHours => ":TH", 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalMinutes => ":TM", 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalSeconds => ":TS", 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalMilliseconds => ":TMS", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		internal static string ChangeArgumentDateTimeFormat(string pattern, DateTimeFormat dateTimeFormat, string formatString)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (pattern.Contains("{A"))
			{
				text = dateTimeFormat switch
				{
					DateTimeFormat.ShortDate => "d", 
					DateTimeFormat.LongDate => "D", 
					DateTimeFormat.ShortTime => "t", 
					DateTimeFormat.LongTime => "T", 
					DateTimeFormat.MonthAndDay => "m", 
					DateTimeFormat.MonthAndYear => "y", 
					DateTimeFormat.Custom => formatString, 
					DateTimeFormat.QuarterAndYear => "q", 
					_ => "g", 
				};
			}
			int num = pattern.IndexOf("{A:");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				string[] array = pattern.Split('{', '}');
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text2 in array2)
				{
					if (pattern.IndexOf(text2, num) == num + 1 && text2.StartsWith("A:"))
					{
						return pattern.Replace(text2, "A:" + text);
					}
				}
				return pattern;
			}
			return pattern.Replace("{A}", "{A:" + text + "}");
		}

		public PointOptions()
		{
			argumentNumericOptions = new NumericOptions(this);
			argumentDateTimeOptions = new DateTimeOptions(this);
			valueNumericOptions = new NumericOptions(this);
			valueDateTimeOptions = new DateTimeOptions(this);
		}

				"ValueNumericOptions" => ShouldSerializeValueNumericOptions(), 
				"ValueDateTimeOptions" => ShouldSerializeValueDateTimeOptions(), 
				"Pattern" => ShouldSerializePattern(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PointOptions pointOptions)
			{
				pointView = pointOptions.pointView;
				pattern = pointOptions.pattern;
				argumentNumericOptions.Assign(pointOptions.argumentNumericOptions);
				argumentDateTimeOptions.Assign(pointOptions.argumentDateTimeOptions);
				valueNumericOptions.Assign(pointOptions.valueNumericOptions);
				valueDateTimeOptions.Assign(pointOptions.valueDateTimeOptions);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is PointOptions pointOptions && pointView == pointOptions.pointView && pattern == pointOptions.pattern && argumentNumericOptions.Equals(pointOptions.argumentNumericOptions) && argumentDateTimeOptions.Equals(pointOptions.argumentDateTimeOptions) && valueNumericOptions.Equals(pointOptions.valueNumericOptions))
			{
				return valueDateTimeOptions.Equals(pointOptions.valueDateTimeOptions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

	public class Area3DSeriesLabel : Line3DSeriesLabel
	{
		protected override double CalcConnectorAngle(MinMaxValues values, out DiagramVector direction)
		{
			double result = Math.PI / 2.0;
			direction = new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			if (values.Max < values.Min)
			{
				result = -Math.PI / 2.0;
				direction = new DiagramVector(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
			}
			return result;
		}

		{

	{
		protected internal override bool DefaultVisible => false;

		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => false;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled => true;

		[Description("Overrides the SeriesLabelBase.Shadow property.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		public new Shadow Shadow => base.Shadow;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new BarSeriesLabelPosition Position => BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]

		{

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is Bar3DSeriesView bar3DSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("Bar3DSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			Bar3DData bar3DData = bar3DSeriesView.CreateBarData(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			if (bar3DData.ActualValue == bar3DData.ZeroValue && !base.ShowForZeroValues)
			{
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList.CoordsCalculator;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, Math.Max(bar3DData.ZeroValue, bar3DData.ActualValue), clipping: false);
			diagramPoint.X += bar3DData.FixedOffset;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = CalculateFinishPoint(-Math.PI / 2.0, diagramPoint);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint2);
			double angle = coordsCalculator.CalcConnectorAngle(new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
			TextPainter textPainter = pointData.LabelViewData[0].CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint3, angle);
			ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter;
			if (base.ActualLineVisible)
			{
				bool flag = base.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
				if (flag)
				{
					diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint);
					diagramPoint2 = diagramPoint3;
				}
				connectorPainter = new LineConnectorPainter(diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flag);
			}
			else
			{
				connectorPainter = null;
			}
			XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout layout = XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, this, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, connectorPainter, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint);
			xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList.AddLabelLayout(layout);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(Doughnut3DSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Doughnut3DSeriesLabel")]
	public class Doughnut3DSeriesLabel : Pie3DSeriesLabel
	{
		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Doughnut3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override GRealPoint2D CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout, ref RectangleF labelsBounds, out double lineAngle, out double crossAngle)
		{
			SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain = domain as SimpleDiagram3DDomain;
			DiagramPoint zero = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			if (simpleDiagram3DDomain == null || !base.IsInside || !DoughnutSeriesLabel.CalculateDoughnutLabelPosition(pieLayout, out zero))
			{
				return base.CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(domain, pieLayout, ref labelsBounds, out lineAngle, out crossAngle);
			}
			zero.X -= pieLayout.BasePoint.X;
			zero.Y = (double)pieLayout.BasePoint.Y - zero.Y;
			return Project(domain, zero, pieLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis, ref labelsBounds, out lineAngle, out crossAngle);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DoughnutSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DoughnutSeriesLabel")]
	public class DoughnutSeriesLabel : PieSeriesLabel
	{
		internal static bool CalculateDoughnutLabelPosition(PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout, out DiagramPoint position)
		{
			position = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			double num = pieLayout.Pie.HoleFraction;
			double num2 = (double)pieLayout.PieBounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num3 = (double)pieLayout.PieBounds.Height / 2.0;
			double num4 = num2 * num;
			double num5 = num3 * num;
			if (num4 <= 0.0 || num5 <= 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double startAngle = pieLayout.Pie.StartAngle;
			double halfAngle = pieLayout.Pie.HalfAngle;
			GRealPoint2D center = pieLayout.Pie.CalculateCenter(pieLayout.BasePoint);
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(center, num2, num3);
			Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse(center, num4, num5);
			Pie pie = new Pie(startAngle, halfAngle, ellipse, 0, 0.0);
			Pie pie2 = new Pie(startAngle, halfAngle, ellipse2, 0, 0.0);
			position = new DiagramPoint((pie.FinishPoint.X + pie2.FinishPoint.X) / 2.0, (pie.FinishPoint.Y + pie2.FinishPoint.Y) / 2.0);
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DoughnutSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override GRealPoint2D CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout, ref RectangleF labelsBounds, out double lineAngle, out double crossAngle)
		{
			lineAngle = pieLayout.Pie.HalfAngle;
			crossAngle = lineAngle + Math.PI / 2.0;
			DiagramPoint zero = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			if (!base.IsInside || !CalculateDoughnutLabelPosition(pieLayout, out zero))
			{
				return base.CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(domain, pieLayout, ref labelsBounds, out lineAngle, out crossAngle);
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(zero.X, zero.Y);
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.FullStackedAreaSeriesLabel")]
	public class FullStackedAreaSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled => false;

		[Browsable(false)]

		[Browsable(false)]

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)

				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData, this, seriesPointValues);
				if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)

					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Line3DSeriesLabel")]
	public class Line3DSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase
	{
		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => false;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled => true;

		protected internal override bool DefaultVisible => false;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]

		protected virtual double CalcConnectorAngle(MinMaxValues values, out DiagramVector direction)
		{
			direction = new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);

		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()

			return new Line3DSeriesLabel();

			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = line3DSeriesView.GetSeriesPointValues(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			DiagramVector direction;

	[TypeConverter(typeof(PieSeriesLabelPositionTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum PieSeriesLabelPosition
	{
		Inside,
		Outside,
		TwoColumns,
		Radial,
		Tangent
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PieSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSeriesLabel")]
	public class PieSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase
	{
		private const int DefaultColumnIndent = 0;

		private PieSeriesLabelPosition position;

		private int columnIndent;

		protected PieSeriesViewBase View
		{
			get
			{
				PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase = base.Series.View as PieSeriesViewBase;
				ChartDebug.Assert(pieSeriesViewBase != null, "view can't be null");
				return pieSeriesViewBase;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsInside => IsInsidePosition(ActualPosition);

		protected virtual PieSeriesLabelPosition DefaultPosition => PieSeriesLabelPosition.Outside;

		protected override bool Rotated
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualPosition != PieSeriesLabelPosition.Radial)
				{
					return ActualPosition == PieSeriesLabelPosition.Tangent;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled => !IsInside;

		protected internal override bool ResolveOverlappingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Position != PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns)
				{
					return Position == PieSeriesLabelPosition.Outside;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool VerticalRotationSupported => false;

		internal PieSeriesLabelPosition ActualPosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsPositionSupported(position))
				{
					return DefaultPosition;
				}
				return position;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the position of labels relative to each other and the pie diagram.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSeriesLabel.Position")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public PieSeriesLabelPosition Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != position)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					position = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets by how much a column of labels is indented from the pie chart.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSeriesLabel.ColumnIndent")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int ColumnIndent
		{
			get
			{
				return columnIndent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != columnIndent)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPieSeriesLabelColumnIndent));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					columnIndent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public override TextOrientation TextOrientation => TextOrientation.Horizontal;

		private static float CalcRadialLabelAngle(double lineAngle)
		{
			return (float)Math.Round((0.0 - lineAngle) * 180.0 / Math.PI + 90.0);
		}

		private static float CalculateCorrection(float size, float maxSize)
		{
			float num = size - maxSize / 2f;
			if (!(num > 0f))
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static float ApplyCorrection(float value, float factor)
		{
			return value * factor + value * (1f - factor) / 2f;
		}

		internal static bool IsTwoColumnsLabelAlignedToRight(double lineAngle)
		{
			return Math.Cos(lineAngle) >= 0.0;
		}

		public PieSeriesLabel()
		{
			position = DefaultPosition;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Position"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ColumnIndent")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeColumnIndent();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializePosition();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePosition()
		{
			return position != DefaultPosition;
		}

		private void ResetPosition()
		{
			Position = DefaultPosition;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColumnIndent()
		{
			return columnIndent != 0;
		}

		private void ResetColumnIndent()
		{
			ColumnIndent = 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializePosition())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeColumnIndent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Size CalculateMaximumSizeForInternalLabels(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Size pieSize)
		{
			float num = (float)(1.0 - View.CalculateActualHolePercent(seriesData.RefinedSeries, new SizeF(pieSize.Width, pieSize.Height)) / 100.0);
			SizeF sizeF = new SizeF((float)pieSize.Width * num, (float)pieSize.Height * num);
			Size size = CalculateMaximumLabelSize(seriesData);
			float value;
			float value2;
			if (ActualPosition == PieSeriesLabelPosition.Inside)
			{
				value = CalculateCorrection(size.Width, sizeF.Width);
				value2 = CalculateCorrection(size.Height, sizeF.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = Math.Max(size.Width, size.Height);
				value = CalculateCorrection(num2, sizeF.Width);
				value2 = CalculateCorrection(num2, sizeF.Height);
			}
			return new Size(MathUtils.StrongRound(ApplyCorrection(value, num)), MathUtils.StrongRound(ApplyCorrection(value2, num)));
		}

		private Size CalculateMaximumLabelSize(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			if (seriesData.Count == 0)
			{
				return empty;
			}
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				if (seriesDatum.LabelViewData.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = seriesDatum.LabelViewData[0];
				if (seriesLabelViewData != null)
				{
					Size textSize = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize;
					if (textSize.Width > empty.Width)
					{
						empty.Width = textSize.Width;
					}
					if (textSize.Height > empty.Height)
					{
						empty.Height = textSize.Height;
					}
				}
			}
			int num = base.Border.ActualThickness * 2;
			empty.Width += num;
			empty.Height += num;
			return empty;
		}

		protected bool IsInsidePosition(PieSeriesLabelPosition labelPosition)
		{
			if (labelPosition != PieSeriesLabelPosition.Inside && labelPosition != PieSeriesLabelPosition.Radial)
			{
				return labelPosition == PieSeriesLabelPosition.Tangent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PieSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected virtual GRealPoint2D CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout, ref RectangleF labelsBounds, out double lineAngle, out double crossAngle)
		{
			lineAngle = pieLayout.Pie.HalfAngle;
			crossAngle = lineAngle + Math.PI / 2.0;
			RectangleF pieBounds = pieLayout.PieBounds;
			if (!pieBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return default(GRealPoint2D);
			}
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(pieLayout.Pie.CalculateCenter(pieLayout.BasePoint), pieBounds.Width / 2f, pieBounds.Height / 2f);
			GRealPoint2D result = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(pieLayout.Pie.HalfAngle);
			if (!IsInside)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (pieLayout.PositiveValuesCount <= 1)
			{
				return ellipse.Center;
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D((ellipse.Center.X + result.X) / 2.0, (ellipse.Center.Y + result.Y) / 2.0);
		}

		protected internal Size CalculateMaximumSize(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Size pieSize)
		{
			if (!base.SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			if (IsInside)
			{
				return CalculateMaximumSizeForInternalLabels(seriesData, pieSize);
			}
			Size result = CalculateMaximumLabelSize(seriesData);
			if (ActualPosition == PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns)
			{
				result.Height = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)result.Height / 2.0);
				result.Width += columnIndent;
			}
			result.Width += base.LineLength;
			result.Height += base.LineLength;
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelsLayout, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (!(pointLayout is PieSeriesPointLayout { PointData: var pointData } pieSeriesPointLayout))
			{
				return;
			}
			SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase simpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase = pointData.DrawOptions as SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase;
			IPiePoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			if (simpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase == null || refinedPoint == null || refinedPoint.NormalizedValue == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = pointData.LabelViewData[0];
			ISimpleDiagramDomain domain = labelsLayout.Domain;
			Size textSize = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize;
			RectangleF labelsBounds = domain.LabelsBounds;
			double lineAngle;
			double crossAngle;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(domain, pieSeriesPointLayout, ref labelsBounds, out lineAngle, out crossAngle);
			if ((gRealPoint2D.X == 0.0 && gRealPoint2D.Y == 0.0) || (!IsInside && double.IsNaN(lineAngle)) || double.IsNaN(gRealPoint2D.X) || double.IsNaN(gRealPoint2D.Y))
			{
				return;
			}
			Point basePoint = new Point((int)Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.X), (int)Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.Y));
			ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter = null;
			bool flag = base.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None && ResolveOverlappingSupported;
			TextPainterBase textPainterBase;
			switch (ActualPosition)
			{
			case PieSeriesLabelPosition.Radial:
				textPainterBase = new RotatedTextPainterOnCircleRadial(CalcRadialLabelAngle(lineAngle), basePoint, seriesLabelViewData.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, shouldCorrectAngle: true);
				break;
			case PieSeriesLabelPosition.Tangent:
				textPainterBase = new RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent(CalcRadialLabelAngle(crossAngle - Math.PI / 2.0), basePoint, seriesLabelViewData.Text, textSize, this, mixColorByHitTestState: false, shouldCorrectAngle: true);
				break;
			case PieSeriesLabelPosition.Inside:
				textPainterBase = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y));
				break;
			default:
			{
				DiagramPoint startPoint = new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X + (double)(float)(Math.Cos(lineAngle) * (double)base.LineLength), gRealPoint2D.Y - (double)(float)(Math.Sin(lineAngle) * (double)base.LineLength));
				if (ActualPosition == PieSeriesLabelPosition.Outside)
				{
					textPainterBase = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForBoundedDrawing(diagramPoint, lineAngle, labelsLayout.Domain.Bounds);
					if (base.ActualLineVisible && textPainterBase != null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							connectorPainter = new OriginBaseLineConnectorPainter(((ZPlaneRectangle)domain.ElementBounds).Center, startPoint, diagramPoint, lineAngle, (ZPlaneRectangle)((TextPainter)textPainterBase).BoundsWithBorder, flat: true);
						}
						else if (textPainterBase != null)
						{
							connectorPainter = new LineConnectorPainter(startPoint, diagramPoint, lineAngle, (ZPlaneRectangle)((TextPainter)textPainterBase).BoundsWithBorder, flat: true);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				DiagramPoint finishPoint = default(DiagramPoint);
				if (IsTwoColumnsLabelAlignedToRight(lineAngle))
				{
					textPainterBase = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForBoundedDrawing(diagramPoint, 0.0, labelsLayout.Domain.Bounds);
					if (textPainterBase != null)
					{
						ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)((TextPainter)textPainterBase).BoundsWithBorder;
						double num = (double)labelsBounds.Right - zPlaneRectangle.Right;
						finishPoint = new DiagramPoint(zPlaneRectangle.Left + num, diagramPoint.Y);
						textPainterBase.Offset(num, 0.0);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					textPainterBase = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForBoundedDrawing(diagramPoint, Math.PI, labelsLayout.Domain.Bounds);
					if (textPainterBase != null)
					{
						ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle2 = (ZPlaneRectangle)((TextPainter)textPainterBase).BoundsWithBorder;
						double num2 = (double)labelsBounds.Left - zPlaneRectangle2.Left;
						finishPoint = new DiagramPoint(zPlaneRectangle2.Right + num2, diagramPoint.Y);
						textPainterBase.Offset(num2, 0.0);
					}
				}
				if (base.ActualLineVisible && textPainterBase != null)
				{
					connectorPainter = new BrokenLineConnectorPainter(startPoint, diagramPoint, finishPoint, lineAngle);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (textPainterBase != null)
			{
				PieSeriesLabelLayout item = new PieSeriesLabelLayout(pointData, this, simpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase.Color, textPainterBase, connectorPainter, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, 0.0 - lineAngle);
				labelsLayout.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsPositionSupported(PieSeriesLabelPosition labelPosition)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool CheckResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None)
			{
				return mode == ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override ResolveOverlappingMode GetResolveOverlappingMode(Rectangle diagramBounds, IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesDataList)
		{
			if (Position != PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns)
			{
				return ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
			}
			return ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PieSeriesLabel pieSeriesLabel)
			{
				position = pieSeriesLabel.position;
				columnIndent = pieSeriesLabel.columnIndent;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(Pie3DSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Pie3DSeriesLabel")]
	public class Pie3DSeriesLabel : PieSeriesLabel
	{
		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => false;

		protected internal override bool ResolveOverlappingEnabled => base.Position == PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns;

		[Description("Overrides the SeriesLabelBase.Shadow property.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new Shadow Shadow => base.Shadow;

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Pie3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override GRealPoint2D CalculateAnchorPointAndAngles(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, PieSeriesPointLayout pieLayout, ref RectangleF labelsBounds, out double lineAngle, out double crossAngle)
		{
			lineAngle = 0.0;
			crossAngle = 0.0;
			float num = (0f - pieLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis) * Math.Min(0.02f, 1f - pieLayout.Pie.HoleFraction);
			RectangleF thisRect = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(pieLayout.PieBounds, num, num);
			if (!thisRect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return default(GRealPoint2D);
			}
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(pieLayout.Pie.CalculateCenter(pieLayout.BasePoint), thisRect.Width / 2f, thisRect.Height / 2f);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(pieLayout.Pie.HalfAngle);
			DiagramPoint labelPoint = new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X - ellipse.Center.X, ellipse.Center.Y - gRealPoint2D.Y);
			if (base.IsInside)
			{
				if (pieLayout.PositiveValuesCount > 1)
				{
					labelPoint.X /= 2.0;
					labelPoint.Y /= 2.0;
				}
				else
				{
					labelPoint.X = 0.0;
					labelPoint.Y = 0.0;
				}
			}
			labelPoint.X += ellipse.Center.X - (double)pieLayout.BasePoint.X;
			labelPoint.Y -= ellipse.Center.Y - (double)pieLayout.BasePoint.Y;
			return Project(domain, labelPoint, pieLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis, ref labelsBounds, out lineAngle, out crossAngle);
		}

		protected GRealPoint2D Project(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, DiagramPoint labelPoint, float majorSemiaxis, ref RectangleF labelsBounds, out double lineAngle, out double crossAngle)
		{
			lineAngle = 0.0;
			crossAngle = 0.0;
			if (!(domain is SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain))
			{
				return default(GRealPoint2D);
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(labelPoint.X, labelPoint.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(labelPoint.X, labelPoint.Y, 1.0));
			double num = (double)(majorSemiaxis * (float)base.View.DepthPercent) * 0.02;
			double z = ((diagramPoint2.Z < diagramPoint.Z) ? (num * 0.5) : ((0.0 - num) * 0.5));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(labelPoint.X, labelPoint.Y, z));
			PointF pointF = (PointF)simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(labelPoint.Y, 0.0 - labelPoint.X, z));
			PointF pointF2 = (PointF)simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0, z));
			lineAngle = Math.Atan2((double)pointF2.Y - diagramPoint3.Y, diagramPoint3.X - (double)pointF2.X);
			crossAngle = Math.Atan2(pointF2.Y - pointF.Y, pointF.X - pointF2.X);
			pointF2 = (PointF)simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(DiagramPoint.Zero);
			labelsBounds = new RectangleF(pointF2.X - labelsBounds.Width / 2f, pointF2.Y - labelsBounds.Height / 2f, labelsBounds.Width, labelsBounds.Height);
			return new GRealPoint2D(diagramPoint3.X, diagramPoint3.Y);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum PointLabelPosition
	{
		Center,
		Outside
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PointSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointSeriesLabel")]
	public class PointSeriesLabel : SeriesLabelBase
	{
		private int angleDegree;

		private PointLabelPosition position;

		protected virtual int DefaultAngleDegree => 45;

		protected virtual PointLabelPosition DefaultPosition => PointLabelPosition.Outside;

		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled => position == PointLabelPosition.Outside;

		[Description("Gets or sets the angle which controls the position of data point labels.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointSeriesLabel.Angle")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return angleDegree;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != angleDegree)
				{
					if (value < -360 || value > 360)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLabelAngle));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					angleDegree = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets where a point’s label is located.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PointSeriesLabel.Position")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public PointLabelPosition Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != position)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					position = value;
					SynchronizeOverlappingMode();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public PointSeriesLabel()
		{
			angleDegree = DefaultAngleDegree;
			position = DefaultPosition;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Angle")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAngle();
			}
			if (propertyName == "Position")
			{
				return ShouldSerializePosition();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAngle()
		{
			return angleDegree != DefaultAngleDegree;
		}

		private void ResetAngle()
		{
			Angle = DefaultAngleDegree;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializePosition()
		{
			return position != DefaultPosition;
		}

		private void ResetPosition()
		{
			Position = DefaultPosition;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAngle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePosition();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenter(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, double pointArgument, double pointValue, int markerSize)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = xyLabelLayoutList.GetMapping(pointArgument, pointValue);
			if (mapping == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = xyLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, pointArgument, pointValue);
			TextPainterBase textPainter = xyLabelLayoutList.CreateTextPainter(pointData, labelViewData, diagramPoint, isCenterPosition: true);
			RectangleF validRectangle = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateValidRectangleForCenterPosition(diagramPoint, markerSize);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithValidRectangle(pointData, this, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint, validRectangle);
		}

		private void SynchronizeOverlappingMode()
		{
			if (Position == PointLabelPosition.Center)
			{
				if (base.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAllAroundPoint || base.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAroundPoint)
				{
					base.ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
				}
			}
			else if (base.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.Default)
			{
				base.ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAroundPoint;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagramSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is PointSeriesView pointSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("PointSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			double argument = pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument;
			double max = pointSeriesView.GetSeriesPointValues(pointData.RefinedPoint).Max;
			XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = ((Position == PointLabelPosition.Outside) ? SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForPoint(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], this, max, angleDegree) : CalculateLayoutForCenter(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], argument, max, pointSeriesView.PointMarkerOptions.Size));
			if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
			{
				xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PointSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override bool CheckResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (Position == PointLabelPosition.Outside)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None && mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.Default)
			{
				return mode == ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is PointSeriesLabel pointSeriesLabel)
			{
				angleDegree = pointSeriesLabel.angleDegree;
				position = pointSeriesLabel.position;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(RadarPointSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RadarPointSeriesLabel")]
	public class RadarPointSeriesLabel : PointSeriesLabel
	{
		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenter(DiagramPoint anchorPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, int markerSize)
		{
			TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(anchorPoint);
			RectangleF validRectangle = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateValidRectangleForCenterPosition(anchorPoint, markerSize);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithValidRectangle(pointData, this, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, anchorPoint, validRectangle);
		}

		private XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForOutside(DiagramPoint startPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData)
		{
			double angle = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(base.Angle));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = CalculateFinishPoint(angle, startPoint);
			TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint, angle);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithExcludedRectangle(pointData, this, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, base.ActualLineVisible ? new LineConnectorPainter(startPoint, diagramPoint, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flat: true) : null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, startPoint, SeriesLabelHelper.CalcAnchorHoleForPoint(startPoint, base.LineLength));
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is RadarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList radarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RadarDiagramSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is RadarPointSeriesView radarPointSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RadarPointSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping = radarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.DiagramMapping;
			if (diagramMapping == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IXYPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value, clipValue: true);
			if (!screenPoint.IsZero)
			{
				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = ((base.Position == PointLabelPosition.Outside) ? CalculateLayoutForOutside(screenPoint, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0]) : CalculateLayoutForCenter(screenPoint, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], radarPointSeriesView.PointMarkerOptions.Size));
				if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
				{
					radarDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RadarPointSeriesLabel();
		}
	}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)

				"Kind" => ShouldSerializeKind(), 
				"Position" => ShouldSerializePosition(), 
				"Indent" => ShouldSerializeIndent(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeKind()
		{
			return labelKind != RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIndent()
		{
			return labelIndent != 0;
		}

		private void ResetIndent()
		{
			Indent = 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeKind() && !ShouldSerializePosition())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIndent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RangeBarSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override string[] ConstructTextCore(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser;
			switch (Kind)
			{
			case RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			{
				string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", minValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, base.Series);
				string text = patternParser.GetText();
				string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", maxValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, base.Series);
				string text2 = patternParser.GetText();
				return new string[2] { text, text2 };
			}
			case RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", "V1", "V2"), base.Series.View);
				break;
			case RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
			{
				string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", minValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				break;
			}
			case RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
			{
				string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(ActualTextPattern, "V", maxValuePlaceholder), base.Series.View);
				break;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
				return new string[0];
			}
			patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, base.Series);
			return new string[1] { patternParser.GetText() };
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList2))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagramSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is RangeBarSeriesView view))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("RangeBarSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			BarData barData = pointData.GetBarData(view);
			Color color = pointData.DrawOptions.Color;
			if (Kind == RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels)
			{
				new MinRangeBarSeriesLabelView(this).CalculateLayout(labelLayoutList2, barData, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], color);
				new MaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView(this).CalculateLayout(labelLayoutList2, barData, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[1], color);
			}
			else
			{
				RangeBarSeriesLabelView.CreateInstance(this).CalculateLayout(labelLayoutList2, barData, pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], color);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is RangeBarSeriesLabel rangeBarSeriesLabel)
			{
				labelKind = rangeBarSeriesLabel.labelKind;
				labelPosition = rangeBarSeriesLabel.labelPosition;
				labelIndent = rangeBarSeriesLabel.labelIndent;
			}
		}
	}

	{

		internal const ResolveOverlappingMode DefaultResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.None;

		internal const TextOrientation DefaultTextOrientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;

		private bool loading;

		private bool isSetResolveOverlappingMode;

		private bool actualVisible;

		private int maxWidth;

		private int maxLineCount;

		private int lineLength = 10;

		private string text = string.Empty;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAntialiasing = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private AspxSerializerWrapper<PointOptions> pointOptionsSerializerWrapper;

		private Color textColor = Color.Empty;

		private Color backColor = Color.Empty;

		private Color lineColor = Color.Empty;

		private BackCompatibilityFontController fontController;

		private Shadow shadow;

		private System.Drawing.StringAlignment textAlignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		private RectangularBorder border;

		private RectangleFillStyle fillStyle;

		private ResolveOverlappingMode resolveOverlappingMode;

		private LineStyle lineStyle;

		private TextOrientation textOrientation;

		private PointView deserializedPointView = PointView.Values;

		private PointOptions pointOptions;

		private DefaultBoolean visibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private DefaultBoolean lineVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.IDataLabelFormatter formatter;

		private string textPattern;

		private string pivotGridTextPattern;

		private bool pointOptionsWasDeserialized;

		private HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private Diagram Diagram => base.Chart?.Diagram;

		private DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.SeriesLabelAppearance LabelAppearance => GetSeriesLabelAppearance();

		private bool ActualAntialiasing => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(enableAntialiasing, defaultValue: false);

		private SeriesLabelBase TemplateLabel => SeriesBase.Owner.SeriesTemplate.Label;

		protected Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				Series series = SeriesBase as Series;
				ChartDebug.Assert(series != null, "series can't be null");
				return series;
			}
		}

		protected virtual Color ActualTextColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TextColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return TextColor;
				}
				return LabelAppearance.TextColor;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool UseTemplateHit
		{
			get
			{
				if (SeriesBase is Series series)
				{
					return series.UseTemplateHit;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool Rotated => false;

		protected virtual ChartElement BackElement
		{
			get
			{
				SeriesViewBase seriesViewBase = ((SeriesBase != null) ? SeriesBase.View : null);
				if (!(seriesViewBase is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase) && !(seriesViewBase is RadarSeriesViewBase))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return this;
			}
		}

		internal virtual string ActualTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textPattern))
				{
					return textPattern;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pivotGridTextPattern))
				{
					return pivotGridTextPattern;
				}
				if (SeriesBase == null || SeriesBase.View == null)
				{
					return "{V}";
				}
				return SeriesBase.View.DefaultLabelTextPattern;
			}
		}

		internal string PivotGridTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return pivotGridTextPattern;
			}
			set
			{
				pivotGridTextPattern = value;
			}
		}

		internal DefaultBoolean InternalVisibility => visibility;

		internal SeriesBase SeriesBase
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Owner as SeriesBase;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Owner = value;
				if (pointOptions == null)
				{
					pointOptions = SeriesBase.View.CreatePointOptions();
				}
				pointOptions.SeriesBase = value;
			}

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the PointOptions.PointView property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SeriesLabelValueType ValueType
		{
			get
			{
				PointView pointView = ((pointOptions == null) ? deserializedPointView : PointOptions.PointView);
				if (pointView != PointView.SeriesName)
				{
					return SeriesLabelValueType.Points;
				}
				return SeriesLabelValueType.SeriesName;
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedPointView = ((value != SeriesLabelValueType.SeriesName) ? PointView.Values : PointView.SeriesName);
				if (PointOptions != null)
				{
					PointOptions.PointView = deserializedPointView;
				}
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now. Use the TextPattern property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public PointOptions PointOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return pointOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Loading)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPointOptionsSettingRuntimeError));
				}
				if (pointOptions != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					pointOptions = value;
					pointOptions.SeriesBase = SeriesBase;
					RaiseControlChanged();
					if (SeriesBase == null)
					{
						pointOptionsWasDeserialized = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected SeriesLabelBase()
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			fillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this, Color.Empty, FillMode.Solid);
			border = new OutsideRectangularBorder(this, visible: true, Color.Empty);
			shadow = new Shadow(this);
			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(DefaultFonts.Tahoma8, this);
			lineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antiAlias: false);
			pointOptionsSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<PointOptions>(() => pointOptions, delegate(PointOptions value)
			{
				PointOptionsInternal = value;
			});
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetTextColor(Color color)
		{
			return CalcActualTextColor(color);
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetBorderColor(Color color)
		{
			Color actualBorderColor = ActualBorderColor;
			if (!(border.Color == Color.Empty) || !(actualBorderColor == Color.Empty))
			{
				return actualBorderColor;
			}
			return BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, CalcLabelAutomaticColor(color), ((IHitTest)this).State);
		}

			{
				return ShouldSerializeTextPattern();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SynchronizePointOptionsWithText(string text)
		{
			SeriesBase seriesBase = SeriesBase;
			if (seriesBase != null)
			{
				seriesBase.BreakPointOptionsRelations();
				PointOptionsInternal.Pattern = CorrectTextForPattern(text);
			}
		}

		private string CorrectTextForPattern(string pattern)
		{
			string text = pattern;
			string text2 = "{A}";
			string text3 = "{V}";
			string text4 = "{S}";
			text = text.Replace(text2, "{" + text2);
			text = text.Replace(text2.ToLower(), "{" + text2.ToLower());
			text = text.Replace(text3, "{" + text3);
			text = text.Replace(text3.ToLower(), "{" + text3.ToLower());
			text = text.Replace(text4, "{" + text4);
			return text.Replace(text4.ToLower(), "{" + text4.ToLower());
		}

		private string ConstructTextFromPattern(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(ActualTextPattern, Series.View);
			patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, Series);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		protected virtual DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.SeriesLabelAppearance GetSeriesLabelAppearance()
		{
			IChartAppearance actualAppearance = CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this);
			if (actualAppearance != null && SeriesBase != null && SeriesBase.View != null)
			{
				if (((ISeriesView)SeriesBase.View).Is3DView)
				{
					return actualAppearance.SeriesLabel3DAppearance;
				}
				return actualAppearance.SeriesLabel2DAppearance;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected string[] ConstructTexts(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (formatter != null)
			{
				if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint == null)
				{
					DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Series);
					dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
				}
				return new string[1] { formatter.GetDataLabelText(refinedPoint) };
			}
			return ConstructTextCore(refinedPoint);
		}

		protected virtual string[] ConstructTextCore(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return new string[1] { ConstructTextFromPattern(refinedPoint) };
		}

		protected virtual bool GetDefaultLineVisible(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.SeriesLabelAppearance labelAppearance)
		{
			return labelAppearance?.ShowConnector ?? true;
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateTextPattern(ChartElement sender)
		{
			if (SeriesBase != null && pointOptions != null && (sender == pointOptions || sender.Owner == pointOptions))
			{
				textPattern = PointOptions.ConstructPatternFromPointOptions(pointOptions, SeriesBase.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal, SeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (deserializedPointView == PointView.SeriesName)
			{
				PointOptionsInternal.PointView = deserializedPointView;
			}
			if (!IsCorrectResolveOverlappingMode(resolveOverlappingMode))
			{
				resolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
			}
			if (pointOptionsWasDeserialized)
			{
				UpdateTextPattern(PointOptionsInternal);
			}
		}

		internal void SetResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode value)
		{
			if (!isSetResolveOverlappingMode)
			{
				if (!loading && !IsCorrectResolveOverlappingMode(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUnsupportedResolveOverlappingMode));
				}
				resolveOverlappingMode = value;
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureResolveOverlappingMode()
		{
			if (!ResolveOverlappingSupported)
			{
				ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
			}
			else if (resolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None)
			{
				if (CheckResolveOverlappingMode(resolveOverlappingMode))
				{
					ResolveOverlappingMode = resolveOverlappingMode;
				}
				else
				{
					ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetNewPointOptions(PointOptions pointOptions)
		{
			this.pointOptions = pointOptions;
			UpdateTextPattern(pointOptions);
		}

		internal bool IsCorrectResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None)
			{
				if (ResolveOverlappingSupported)
				{
					return CheckResolveOverlappingMode(mode);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal Color CalcActualTextColor(Color color)
		{
			if (!TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return TextColor;
			}
			if (!ActualTextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return ActualTextColor;
			}
			return CalcLabelAutomaticColor(color);
		}

		internal Color CalcLabelAutomaticColor(Color baseColor)
		{
			if (!baseColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(40, 0, 0, 0), baseColor);
			}
			return baseColor;
		}

		internal Color GetActualConnectorColor(Color color)
		{
			if (lineColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!LabelAppearance.ConnectorColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return LabelAppearance.ConnectorColor;
				}
				return CalcLabelAutomaticColor(color);
			}
			return lineColor;
		}

		internal SeriesLabelViewData[] CalculateViewData(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, bool edgeLabel)
		{
			if (refinedPoint == null || (!SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility && !edgeLabel))
			{
				return new SeriesLabelViewData[0];
			}
			string[] array = ConstructTexts(refinedPoint);
			SeriesLabelViewData[] array2 = new SeriesLabelViewData[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = new SeriesLabelViewData(this, array[i]);
			}
			return array2;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CheckResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAllAroundPoint)
			{
				return mode != ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAroundPoint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual ResolveOverlappingMode GetResolveOverlappingMode(Rectangle diagramBounds, IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesDataList)
		{
			ResolveOverlappingMode result = ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
			if (SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility)
			{
				double num = diagramBounds.Width * diagramBounds.Height;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData in seriesDataList)
				{
					foreach (RefinedPointData item in seriesData)
					{
						SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData = item.LabelViewData;
						foreach (SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData in labelViewData)
						{
							num2 += (double)(seriesLabelViewData.TextSize.Width * seriesLabelViewData.TextSize.Height);
						}
					}
				}
				if (num2 / num >= 0.1 && IsCorrectResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped))
				{
					result = ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped;
				}
				else if (IsCorrectResolveOverlappingMode(ResolveOverlappingMode.Default))
				{
					result = ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesLabelBase seriesLabelBase)
			{
				maxWidth = seriesLabelBase.maxWidth;
				maxLineCount = seriesLabelBase.maxLineCount;
				textAlignment = seriesLabelBase.TextAlignment;
				fontController.Assign(seriesLabelBase.fontController);
				textColor = seriesLabelBase.textColor;
				backColor = seriesLabelBase.backColor;
				fillStyle.Assign(seriesLabelBase.fillStyle);
				shadow.Assign(seriesLabelBase.shadow);
				border.Assign(seriesLabelBase.border);
				enableAntialiasing = seriesLabelBase.enableAntialiasing;
				lineLength = seriesLabelBase.lineLength;
				lineVisibility = seriesLabelBase.lineVisibility;
				lineColor = seriesLabelBase.lineColor;
				lineStyle.Assign(seriesLabelBase.lineStyle);
				deserializedPointView = seriesLabelBase.deserializedPointView;
				resolveOverlappingMode = seriesLabelBase.resolveOverlappingMode;
				textOrientation = seriesLabelBase.textOrientation;
				if (pointOptions != null && seriesLabelBase.pointOptions != null)
				{
					pointOptions.Assign(seriesLabelBase.pointOptions);
				}
				textPattern = seriesLabelBase.TextPattern;
				pointOptionsWasDeserialized = seriesLabelBase.pointOptionsWasDeserialized;
			}
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(SideBySideBarSeriesLabelTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SideBySideBarSeriesLabel")]
	public class SideBySideBarSeriesLabel : BarSeriesLabel
	{
		protected internal override bool ShadowSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal override bool ConnectorEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Position != BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top)
				{
					return base.Position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.Auto;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SideBySideBarSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected virtual bool CheckViewType(out BarSeriesView view)
		{
			view = base.Series.View as SideBySideBarSeriesView;
			if (view == null)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("SideBySideBarSeriesView expected.");
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual BarSeriesLabelPosition CalculateActualPosition(BarData barData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			if (base.Position != BarSeriesLabelPosition.Auto)
			{
				return base.Position;
			}
			RectangleF totalRect = barData.GetTotalRect(mappingContainer);
			Size size = labelViewData.TextSize;
			if (base.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				int num = 2 * base.Border.ActualThickness;
				size = new Size(size.Width + num, size.Height + num);
			}
			if ((!mappingContainer.Rotated && totalRect.Height > (float)size.Height) || (mappingContainer.Rotated && totalRect.Width > (float)size.Width))
			{
				return BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center;
			}
			return BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsNegativeBar(RefinedPointData pointData, BarData barData)
		{
			return barData.ActualValue < 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagramSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
			}
			else
			{
				if (!CheckViewType(out var view))
				{
					return;
				}
				BarData barData = pointData.GetBarData(view);
				if (barData.ActualValue == 0.0 && !base.ShowForZeroValues)
				{
					return;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData = pointData.LabelViewData[0];
				BarSeriesLabelPosition barSeriesLabelPosition = CalculateActualPosition(barData, labelViewData, xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.MappingContainer);
				Color color = pointData.DrawOptions.Color;
				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout;
				if (barSeriesLabelPosition != BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top)
				{
					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForInsideBarPosition(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList, barData, pointData, labelViewData, barSeriesLabelPosition, base.Indent, color, this);
				}
				else
				{
					XYDiagramMappingBase xYDiagramMappingBase = (view.IsScrollingEnabled ? xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling : barData.GetMappingForTopLabelPosition(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.MappingContainer));
					if (xYDiagramMappingBase == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					double correctAngle = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetCorrectAngle(xYDiagramMappingBase, pointData, IsNegativeBar(pointData, barData));
					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForTopBarPosition(xYDiagramMappingBase, xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData), barData, pointData, correctAngle, labelViewData, color, xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Label);
				}
				if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
				{
					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void AssignBarLabelPosition(BarSeriesLabel label)
		{
			if (label is SideBySideBarSeriesLabel sideBySideBarSeriesLabel)
			{
				base.Position = sideBySideBarSeriesLabel.Position;
			}
		}
	}

			return true;

		protected override BarSeriesLabelPosition CalculateActualPosition(BarData barData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			if (Position == WaterfallSeriesLabelPosition.Auto)
			{
				if (!WaterfallHelper.IsMultipleWaterfallSeries(base.Chart))
				{
					return BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top;
				}
				return BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center;
			}
			return (BarSeriesLabelPosition)position;
		}

		protected override bool IsNegativeBar(RefinedPointData pointData, BarData barData)
		{
			return ((IWaterfallPoint)pointData.RefinedPoint).RelativeValue < 0.0;
		}

		{
			return new WaterfallSeriesLabel();
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new int Indent => 0;

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new StackedBar3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateLayout(SeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!(labelLayoutList is XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelsLayout expected.");
				return;
			}
			if (!(base.Series.View is StackedBar3DSeriesView stackedBar3DSeriesView))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("StackedBar3DSeriesView expected.");
				return;
			}
			Bar3DData bar3DData = stackedBar3DSeriesView.CreateBarData(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			if (bar3DData.ActualValue != bar3DData.ZeroValue || base.ShowForZeroValues)
			{
				XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList.CoordsCalculator;
				stackedBar3DSeriesView.CalcWidthAndDepth(coordsCalculator, bar3DData.Width, out var _, out var depth);
				MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(Math.Min(bar3DData.ZeroValue, bar3DData.ActualValue), Math.Max(bar3DData.ZeroValue, bar3DData.ActualValue));
				minMaxValues.Intersection(xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList.AxisRangeY);
				double num = minMaxValues.CalculateCenter();
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, 0.0, clipping: false);
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, num, clipping: false);
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, bar3DData.MaxValue, clipping: false);
					double num2 = ((!stackedBar3DSeriesView.IsFlatTopModel) ? (depth * (diagramPoint3.Y - diagramPoint2.Y) / (diagramPoint3.Y - diagramPoint.Y)) : depth);
					diagramPoint2.Z += (double)(((coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes() & BoxPlane.Back) > (BoxPlane)0) ? 1 : (-1)) * num2 / 2.0;
					diagramPoint2.X += bar3DData.FixedOffset;
					TextPainter textPainter = pointData.LabelViewData[0].CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint2));
					XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout layout = XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, this, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint2);
					xYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList.AddLabelLayout(layout);
				}
			}
		}
	}

					DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(list[0].X, list[1].Y);
					TextPainterBase textPainter = xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.CreateTextPainter(pointData, pointData.LabelViewData[0], screenPoint, isCenterPosition: false);
					XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout item = XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, this, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, null, base.ResolveOverlappingMode, screenPoint);
					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

			}
			return false;

		{

		private void Initialize(SeriesPointKey key, DataFilterCondition condition, object value)
		{
			this.key = key;
			this.condition = condition;
			this.value = value;
		}

		private void UpdateValue()
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Type dataType = GetDataType();
			if (dataType == null)
			{
				value = null;
				return;
			}
			TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
			if (converter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				value = converter.ConvertTo(value, dataType);
			}
			catch
			{
				value = null;
			}
		}

		private void SeriesPointFiltersChanged()
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateChartBinding));
		}

		private object GetFilterValue(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (key == SeriesPointKey.Argument)
			{
				Series ownedSeries = GetOwnedSeries(this);
				if (ownedSeries == null)
				{
					throw new InternalException("SeriesPointFilter error");
				}
				return ownedSeries.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal switch
				{
					ScaleType.Numerical => point.NumericalArgument, 
					ScaleType.DateTime => point.DateTimeArgument, 
					ScaleType.TimeSpan => point.TimeSpanArgument, 
					_ => point.Argument, 
				};
			}
			int num = (int)(key - 1);
			if (num >= point.Values.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return point.GetValueObject(num);
		}

		private object GetConvertedValue(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ScaleType.Qualitative:
					return value.ToString();
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					return Convert.ToDateTime(value);
				case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
					return (TimeSpan)value;
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					return Convert.ToDouble(value);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal bool CanConvert(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				object convertedValue = GetConvertedValue(scaleType);
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ScaleType.Qualitative:
					return convertedValue is string;
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					return convertedValue is double;
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					return convertedValue is DateTime;
				case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
					return convertedValue is TimeSpan;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ConvertBasedOnScaleType(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			value = GetConvertedValue(scaleType);
		}

		internal Type GetDataType()
		{
			SeriesBase ownedSeriesBase = GetOwnedSeriesBase(this);
			if (ownedSeriesBase != null)
			{
				if (key != SeriesPointKey.Argument)
				{
					return ScaleTypeToType(ownedSeriesBase.ValueScaleType);
				}
				return ScaleTypeToType(ownedSeriesBase.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool CheckSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new InternalException("SeriesPointFilter error");
			}
			object filterValue = GetFilterValue(point);
			if (filterValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (condition)
			{
			case DataFilterCondition.Equal:
				return filterValue.Equals(value);
			case DataFilterCondition.NotEqual:
				return !filterValue.Equals(value);
			default:
				if (filterValue is IComparable comparable)
				{
					int num = comparable.CompareTo(value);
					try
					{
						switch (condition)
						{
						case DataFilterCondition.GreaterThan:
							return num > 0;
						case DataFilterCondition.GreaterThanOrEqual:
							return num >= 0;
						case DataFilterCondition.LessThan:
							return num < 0;
						case DataFilterCondition.LessThanOrEqual:
							return num <= 0;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesPointFilter();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesPointFilter seriesPointFilter)
			{
				key = seriesPointFilter.key;
				condition = seriesPointFilter.condition;
				value = seriesPointFilter.value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is SeriesPointFilter seriesPointFilter) || key != seriesPointFilter.key || condition != seriesPointFilter.condition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return seriesPointFilter.value == null;
			}
			if (!(value is IComparable comparable))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return comparable.CompareTo(seriesPointFilter.value) == 0;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.DefaultSeriesPointFilterName);
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointFilterCollection")]
	public class SeriesPointFilterCollection : ChartCollectionBase
	{
		internal const ConjunctionTypes DefaultConjunctionMode = ConjunctionTypes.And;

		private ConjunctionTypes conjunctionMode;

		[Description("Gets or sets the conjunction mode for filter conditions defined by the collection’s items.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointFilterCollection.ConjunctionMode")]
		public ConjunctionTypes ConjunctionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return conjunctionMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != conjunctionMode)
				{
					SendControlChanging();
					conjunctionMode = value;
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateChartBinding));
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointFilter this[int index] => (SeriesPointFilter)base.List[index];

		private static bool CheckSeriesPointByAnd(SeriesPoint point, List<SeriesPointFilter> filters)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (!filter.CheckSeriesPoint(point))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool CheckSeriesPointByOr(SeriesPoint point, List<SeriesPointFilter> filters)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (filter.CheckSeriesPoint(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal SeriesPointFilterCollection(ChartElement chartElement)
			: base(chartElement)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeConjunctionMode()
		{
			return conjunctionMode != ConjunctionTypes.And;
		}

		private void ResetConjunctionMode()
		{
			ConjunctionMode = ConjunctionTypes.And;
		}

		private List<SeriesPointFilter> GetActualFilters()
		{
			List<SeriesPointFilter> list = new List<SeriesPointFilter>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPointFilter seriesPointFilter = (SeriesPointFilter)enumerator.Current;
					if (seriesPointFilter.Value != null)
					{
						list.Add(seriesPointFilter);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool CheckSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<SeriesPointFilter> actualFilters = GetActualFilters();
			if (actualFilters.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return conjunctionMode switch
			{
				ConjunctionTypes.And => CheckSeriesPointByAnd(point, actualFilters), 
				ConjunctionTypes.Or => CheckSeriesPointByOr(point, actualFilters), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		public int Add(SeriesPointFilter filter)
		{
			return Add((ChartElement)filter);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, SeriesPointFilter filter)
		{
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)filter);
		}

		public void AddRange(SeriesPointFilter[] coll)
		{
			AddRange((ICollection)coll);
		}

		public void Remove(SeriesPointFilter filter)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)filter);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			SeriesPointFilterCollection seriesPointFilterCollection = (SeriesPointFilterCollection)obj;
			if (base.Count != seriesPointFilterCollection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!this[i].Equals(seriesPointFilterCollection[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.Assign(collection);
			if (collection is SeriesPointFilterCollection seriesPointFilterCollection)
			{
				conjunctionMode = seriesPointFilterCollection.conjunctionMode;
			}
		}
	}
