		private static void AddSinglePolygon(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, List<PlanePolygon> polygons, DiagramPoint point1, DiagramPoint point2, double offset, int seriesWeight, Color color)
		{
			if (!MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(point1, point2, 0.01))
			{
				double z = point1.Z - offset;
				double z2 = point1.Z + offset;
				PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlanePolygon(new DiagramPoint[4]
				{
					new DiagramPoint(point1.X, point1.Y, z),
					new DiagramPoint(point2.X, point2.Y, z),
					new DiagramPoint(point2.X, point2.Y, z2),
					new DiagramPoint(point1.X, point1.Y, z2)
				}, sameNormals: true, sameColors: true, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), color);
				planePolygon.Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planePolygon);
				planePolygon.Weight = seriesWeight;
				IList<PlanePolygon> list = coordsCalculator.ClipPolygons(new PlanePolygon[1] { planePolygon });
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					polygons.Add(list[0]);
				}
			}
		}

		public Area3DSeriesView()
		{
			legendFillStyle = new PolygonFillStyle(null);
			legendFillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Solid;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "AreaWidth"))
			{
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeAreaWidth();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAreaWidth()
		{
			return areaWidth != 0.6;
		}

		private void ResetAreaWidth()
		{
			AreaWidth = 0.6;
		}

		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAreaWidth();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return new AreaGeometryStripCreator();
		}

		protected override List<PlanePolygon> CalculatePolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			double epsilon = Math.Min(coordsCalculator.Diagram.AxisX.VisualRangeData.Delta / (double)coordsCalculator.Bounds.Width, coordsCalculator.Diagram.AxisY.VisualRangeData.Delta / (double)coordsCalculator.Bounds.Height) * 0.01;
			double num = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesWidth(this);
			double num2 = num / 2.0;
			int seriesWeight = coordsCalculator.GetSeriesWeight(base.Series);
			Color color = seriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions.Color;
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			foreach (RangeStrip strip in strips)
			{
				RangeStripTriangulationResult rangeStripTriangulationResult = RangeStripTriangulation.Triangulate(strip, epsilon);
				foreach (GPolygon2D polygon in rangeStripTriangulationResult.Polygons)
				{
					List<DiagramPoint> list2 = new List<DiagramPoint>(polygon.Vertices.Length);
					List<DiagramPoint> list3 = new List<DiagramPoint>(polygon.Vertices.Length);
					GRealPoint2D[] vertices = polygon.Vertices;
					for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
					{
						GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = vertices[i];
						DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y, clipping: false);
						list2.Add(DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0, 0.0, num2));
						list3.Add(DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - num2));
					}
					PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlanePolygon(list2.ToArray(), sameNormals: true, sameColors: true, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), color);
					planePolygon.Weight = seriesWeight;
					PlanePolygon planePolygon2 = new PlanePolygon(list3.ToArray(), sameNormals: true, sameColors: true, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), color);
					planePolygon2.Weight = seriesWeight;
					IList<PlanePolygon> list4 = coordsCalculator.ClipPolygons(new PlanePolygon[2] { planePolygon, planePolygon2 });
					if (list4 != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(list4);
					}
				}
				LineStrip borderStrip = rangeStripTriangulationResult.BorderStrip;
				int count = borderStrip.Count;
				if (count > 1)
				{
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, borderStrip[0].X, borderStrip[0].Y, clipping: false);
					DiagramPoint point = diagramPoint2;
					for (int j = 1; j < count; j++)
					{
						DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, borderStrip[j].X, borderStrip[j].Y, clipping: false);
						AddSinglePolygon(coordsCalculator, list, point, diagramPoint3, num2, seriesWeight, color);
						point = diagramPoint3;
					}
					AddSinglePolygon(coordsCalculator, list, point, diagramPoint2, num2, seriesWeight, color);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (seriesPointDrawOptions is Line3DDrawOptions line3DDrawOptions)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				StripsUtils.Render(renderer, StripsUtils.CreateAreaMarkerStrip(this, bounds, pointMarkerVisible: false), legendFillStyle.Options, line3DDrawOptions.Color, line3DDrawOptions.ActualColor2, new SeriesHitTestState(), null, selectionState);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		}

			return null;

			if (obj is Area3DSeriesView area3DSeriesView)
			{
				areaWidth = area3DSeriesView.areaWidth;

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Border" => ShouldSerializeBorder(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"MarkerOptions" => ShouldSerializeMarkerOptions(), 
				"Transparency" => ShouldSerializeTransparency(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeBorder() && !ShouldSerializeFillStyle() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTransparency();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			IXYPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value);
			if (screenPoint.IsZero || screenPoint2.IsZero || double.IsNaN(screenPoint2.X) || double.IsNaN(screenPoint2.Y))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IPolygon polygon = CalculateMarkerPolygon(pointData, screenPoint2);
			return new AreaSeriesPointLayout(pointData, screenPoint2, polygon, screenPoint);
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RadarDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData = (LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData)seriesLayout.WholeViewData;
			List<IGeometryStrip> strips = StripsUtils.MapRangeStrips(diagramMapping, lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData.Strips);
			return new AreaWholeSeriesLayout(seriesLayout, strips);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IAreaSeriesView areaSeriesView)
			{
				if (areaSeriesView.Border != null)
				{
					border.Assign(areaSeriesView.Border);
				}
				fillStyle.Assign(areaSeriesView.FillStyle);
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RadarAreaSeriesView radarAreaSeriesView = (RadarAreaSeriesView)obj;
			if (border.Equals(radarAreaSeriesView.border))
			{
				return fillStyle.Equals(radarAreaSeriesView.fillStyle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "LocalizationRes", "ChartStringId.SvnStackedBar3D", "StackedBar3DSeriesView")]
	public class StackedBar3DSeriesView : Bar3DSeriesView, IStackedView
	{
		protected override bool NeedSeriesInteraction => true;

		protected internal override string StringId => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SvnStackedBar3D);

		protected internal override bool DateTimeValuesSupported => false;

		protected override Type PointInterfaceType => typeof(IStackedPoint);

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Abs(((IValuePoint)point).Value);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, RefinedPointData pointData, IAxisRangeData axisRangeY)
		{
			Bar3DData bar3DData = CreateBarData(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			CalcWidthAndDepth(coordsCalculator, bar3DData.Width, out var _, out var depth);
			double num = MinMaxValues.Intersection(axisRangeY, new MinMaxValues(bar3DData.ZeroValue, bar3DData.ActualValue)).CalculateCenter();
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, 0.0, clipping: false);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, num, clipping: false);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, bar3DData.MaxValue, clipping: false);
			double num2 = ((!base.IsFlatTopModel) ? (depth * (diagramPoint3.Y - diagramPoint2.Y) / (diagramPoint3.Y - diagramPoint.Y)) : depth);
			diagramPoint2.Z += (double)(((coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes() & BoxPlane.Back) > (BoxPlane)0) ? 1 : (-1)) * num2 / 2.0;
			diagramPoint2.X += bar3DData.FixedOffset;
			return coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint2);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new StackedBar3DSeriesView();
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, RefinedPointData pointData, Bar3DData barData)
		{
			if (barData.ActualValue != barData.ZeroValue)
			{
				return base.CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(coordsCalculator, pointData, barData);
			}
			return null;
		}

				"MarkerVisibility" => ShouldSerializeMarkerVisibility(), 
				"SeriesAnimation" => ShouldSerializeSeriesAnimation(), 
				"ShowIsolatedPoints" => ShouldSerializeShowIsolatedPoints(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		}

			List<IGeometryStrip> strips = StripsUtils.MapLineStrips(diagramMapping, lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData.Strips);

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is RadarLineSeriesView radarLineSeriesView)
			{
				closed = radarLineSeriesView.Closed;
				markerVisibility = radarLineSeriesView.markerVisibility;
				seriesAnimation = ((radarLineSeriesView.seriesAnimation != null) ? ((CircularSeriesAnimationBase)radarLineSeriesView.seriesAnimation.Clone()) : null);
				showIsolatedPoints = radarLineSeriesView.showIsolatedPoints;
			}
			if (obj is ILineSeriesView lineSeriesView)
			{
				lineStyle.Assign(lineSeriesView.LineStyle);
				lineStyle.SetAntialiasing(antiAlias: true);
			}
		}

			if (closed == radarLineSeriesView.Closed)
			{

			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override int HolePercent => holeRadiusPercent;

		protected internal override int LegendHolePercent => 60;

		public int HoleRadiusPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return holeRadiusPercent;
			}
			set
			{

					if (value < 0 || value > 100)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDoughnutHolePercent));

					RaiseControlChanging();
					holeRadiusPercent = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}

		{
			if (propertyName == "HoleRadiusPercent")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHoleRadiusPercent();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		{
			return holeRadiusPercent != 60;
		}

		{
			HoleRadiusPercent = 60;
		}

		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHoleRadiusPercent();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			PieSeriesPointLayout pieSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as PieSeriesPointLayout;
			RefinedPointData pointData = pointLayout.PointData;
			IPiePoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain = domain as SimpleDiagram3DDomain;
			if (pieSeriesPointLayout == null || refinedPoint == null || refinedPoint.NormalizedValue == 0.0 || simpleDiagram3DDomain == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float num = (0f - pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis) * Math.Min(0.02f, 1f - pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.HoleFraction);
			RectangleF thisRect = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(pieSeriesPointLayout.PieBounds, num, num);
			if (!thisRect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.CalculateCenter(pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint), thisRect.Width / 2f, thisRect.Height / 2f);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.HalfAngle);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X - ellipse.Center.X, ellipse.Center.Y - gRealPoint2D.Y);
			diagramPoint.X += ellipse.Center.X - (double)pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint.X;
			diagramPoint.Y -= ellipse.Center.Y - (double)pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint.Y;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 1.0));
			double num2 = (double)(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis * (float)DepthPercent) * 0.02;
			double z = ((diagramPoint3.Z < diagramPoint2.Z) ? (num2 * 0.5) : ((0.0 - num2) * 0.5));
			return simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, z));
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Doughnut3DSeriesView();
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new Doughnut3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IDoughnutSeriesView doughnutSeriesView)
			{
				holeRadiusPercent = doughnutSeriesView.HoleRadiusPercent;
			}
		}

		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDoughnutSeriesView doughnutSeriesView = (IDoughnutSeriesView)obj;
			return holeRadiusPercent == doughnutSeriesView.HoleRadiusPercent;
		}
	}

		private abstract class SeriesGroupCalculator<T>
		{
			protected abstract ISupportSeriesGroups GetSeriesGroupInterface(T series);

			public List<List<T>> CalculateSeriesGroups(IEnumerable<T> seriesList)
			{
				object obj = new object();
				Dictionary<object, List<T>> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, List<T>>();
				foreach (T series in seriesList)
				{
					ISupportSeriesGroups seriesGroupInterface = GetSeriesGroupInterface(series);
					if (seriesGroupInterface != null)
					{
						object key = ((seriesGroupInterface.SeriesGroup != null) ? seriesGroupInterface.SeriesGroup : obj);
						if (dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
						{
							value.Add(series);
							continue;
						}
						dictionary.Add(key, new List<T> { series });
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(new object(), new List<T> { series });
					}
				}
				List<List<T>> list = new List<List<T>>();
				foreach (List<T> value2 in dictionary.Values)
				{
					list.Add(value2);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private class RefinedSeriesDataGroupCalculator : SeriesGroupCalculator<RefinedSeriesDataBase>
		{
			protected override ISupportSeriesGroups GetSeriesGroupInterface(RefinedSeriesDataBase series)
			{
				return series.Series.View as ISupportSeriesGroups;
			}
		}

		private class RefinedSeriesGroupCalculator : SeriesGroupCalculator<IRefinedSeries>
		{
			protected override ISupportSeriesGroups GetSeriesGroupInterface(IRefinedSeries series)
			{
				return series.SeriesView as ISupportSeriesGroups;
			}
		}

			public List<DockableTitleViewData> TitleViewDataByDomain => titlesViewDataByDomain;

			public Rectangle ElementBounds => elementBounds;

			public Rectangle ElementWithLabelsBounds => elementWithLabelsBounds;

			public Rectangle DomainBounds => domainBounds;

			public List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> SeriesGroup => seriesGroup;

			public SeriesGroupLayout(List<DockableTitleViewData> titlesViewDataByDomain, Rectangle elementBounds, Rectangle elementWithLabelsBounds, Rectangle domainBounds, List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesGroup)
			{
				this.titlesViewDataByDomain = titlesViewDataByDomain;
				this.elementBounds = elementBounds;
				this.elementWithLabelsBounds = elementWithLabelsBounds;
				this.domainBounds = domainBounds;
				this.seriesGroup = seriesGroup;
			}
		}

			return equalPieSize;
		}

		{
			EqualPieSize = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMargins()
		{
			return margins.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLayoutDirection()
		{
			return layoutDirection != LayoutDirection.Horizontal;
		}

		private void ResetLayoutDirection()
		{
			LayoutDirection = LayoutDirection.Horizontal;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDimension()
		{
			return dimension != 3;

		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeMargins() && !ShouldSerializeLayoutDirection() && !ShouldSerializeDimension() && !ShouldSerializeEqualPieSize() && !ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions() && !ShouldSerializeSelectionOptions())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"LayoutDirection" => ShouldSerializeLayoutDirection(), 
				"Dimension" => ShouldSerializeDimension(), 
				"Margins" => ShouldSerializeMargins(), 
				"EqualPieSize" => ShouldSerializeEqualPieSize(), 
				"DrillDownOptions" => ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions(), 
				"SelectionOptions" => ShouldSerializeSelectionOptions(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool HasAutoLayoutTitles()
		{
			List<IRefinedSeries> firstSeriesOfGroups = GetFirstSeriesOfGroups();
			foreach (IRefinedSeries item in firstSeriesOfGroups)
			{
				if (IsAutoLayoutSeries(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAutoLayoutSeries(IRefinedSeries series)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (series.SeriesView is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase && simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (SeriesTitle title in simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles)
				{
					if ((int)title.Visibility == 2)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CorrectElementAndElementWithLabelsBounds(Size minSize, ref Rectangle correctedElementBounds, ref Rectangle correctedElementWithLabelsBounds)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(minSize.Width <= correctedElementBounds.Width && minSize.Height <= correctedElementBounds.Height, "Min size greater than current size.");
			int num = correctedElementBounds.Width - minSize.Width;
			int num2 = correctedElementBounds.Height - minSize.Height;
			int num3 = num / 2;
			int num4 = num2 / 2;
			correctedElementBounds.Location = new Point(correctedElementBounds.Location.X + num3, correctedElementBounds.Location.Y + num4);
			correctedElementBounds.Width = minSize.Width;
			correctedElementBounds.Height = minSize.Height;
			correctedElementWithLabelsBounds.Location = new Point(correctedElementWithLabelsBounds.Location.X + num3, correctedElementWithLabelsBounds.Location.Y + num4);
			correctedElementWithLabelsBounds.Width -= num;
			correctedElementWithLabelsBounds.Height -= num2;
			if (correctedElementBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private List<IRefinedSeries> GetFirstSeriesOfGroups()
		{
			IList<IRefinedSeries> list = new List<IRefinedSeries>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				if (((IRefinedSeries)item).Series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram && ((IRefinedSeries)item).Points.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			RefinedSeriesGroupCalculator refinedSeriesGroupCalculator = new RefinedSeriesGroupCalculator();
			List<List<IRefinedSeries>> list2 = refinedSeriesGroupCalculator.CalculateSeriesGroups(list);
			List<IRefinedSeries> list3 = new List<IRefinedSeries>();
			foreach (List<IRefinedSeries> item2 in list2)
			{
				if (item2.Count > 0)
				{
					list3.Add(item2[0]);
				}
			}
			return list3;
		}

		private IList<IRefinedSeries> GetFirstSeriesOfGroups(IList<List<RefinedSeriesDataBase>> seriesGroups)
		{
			List<IRefinedSeries> list = new List<IRefinedSeries>();
			foreach (List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesGroup in seriesGroups)
			{
				list.Add(seriesGroup[0].RefinedSeries);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<Series> GetSeriesList(IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
			foreach (IRefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				list.Add((Series)item.Series);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<Rectangle> CalculateSeriesGroupAreaList(IList<IRefinedSeries> firstSeriesOfGroups, Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			if (!(actualPanel is ISimpleDiagramPanelInternal simpleDiagramPanelInternal))
			{
				return actualPanel.Arrange(GetSeriesList(firstSeriesOfGroups), diagramBounds);
			}
			return simpleDiagramPanelInternal.Arrange(firstSeriesOfGroups, diagramBounds);
		}

		private IList<Rectangle> CalculateSeriesGroupAreaList(IList<List<RefinedSeriesDataBase>> seriesGroups, Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			IList<IRefinedSeries> firstSeriesOfGroups = GetFirstSeriesOfGroups(seriesGroups);
			return CalculateSeriesGroupAreaList(firstSeriesOfGroups, diagramBounds);
		}

		private List<SeriesGroupLayout> CalculateSeriesGroupLayouts(IList<List<RefinedSeriesDataBase>> seriesGroups, IList<Rectangle> seriesGroupAreaList)
		{
			IEnumerator<Rectangle> enumerator = seriesGroupAreaList.GetEnumerator();
			List<SeriesGroupLayout> list = new List<SeriesGroupLayout>();
			foreach (List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesGroup in seriesGroups)
			{
				enumerator.MoveNext();
				if (seriesGroup.Count > 0)
				{
					RefinedSeriesDataBase refinedSeriesDataBase = seriesGroup[0];
					SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase = (SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)refinedSeriesDataBase.Series.View;
					Rectangle current2 = enumerator.Current;
					Rectangle bounds = current2;
					List<DockableTitleViewData> titlesViewDataByDomain = simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles.CalculateViewDataAndBoundsWithoutTitle(ref bounds);
					if (!simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.CalculateBounds(refinedSeriesDataBase, bounds, out var innerBounds, out var labelBounds))
					{
						innerBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
						labelBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					list.Add(new SeriesGroupLayout(titlesViewDataByDomain, innerBounds, labelBounds, bounds, seriesGroup));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Size CalculateMinPieOrDoughnutSize(IList<SeriesGroupLayout> seriesGroupLayoutList)
		{
			Size result = new Size(int.MaxValue, int.MaxValue);
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (SeriesGroupLayout seriesGroupLayout in seriesGroupLayoutList)
			{
				Rectangle elementBounds = seriesGroupLayout.ElementBounds;
				if (!elementBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (elementBounds.Width < result.Width)
					{
						result.Width = elementBounds.Width;
					}
					if (elementBounds.Height < result.Height)
					{
						result.Height = elementBounds.Height;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SimpleDiagram();
		}

		protected override void UpdateDiagramAccordingInfo(SeriesBase seriesTemplate, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> activeSeries)
		{
			base.UpdateDiagramAccordingInfo(seriesTemplate, activeSeries);
			foreach (Series item in base.Chart.Series)
			{
				if (item.View is PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase)
				{
					pieSeriesViewBase.ApplyExplodeFiltersToPoints();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateAutomaticLayout(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			List<IRefinedSeries> firstSeriesOfGroups = GetFirstSeriesOfGroups();
			int num = SimpleDiagramAutoLayoutHelper.CalculateDimension(bounds.Width, bounds.Height, firstSeriesOfGroups.Count);
			CustomizeSimpleDiagramLayoutEventArgs e = new CustomizeSimpleDiagramLayoutEventArgs(num, LayoutDirection.Horizontal);
			base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomizeSimpleDiagramLayout(e);
			dimension = e.Dimension;
			layoutDirection = e.LayoutDirection;
		}

		protected internal override void FinishLoading()
		{
			base.FinishLoading();
			foreach (Series item in base.Chart.Series)
			{
				if (item.View is PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase)
				{
					pieSeriesViewBase.FinishUpdateExplodedPoints();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override INativeGraphics CreateNativeGraphics(ChartGraphicsBase gr, IntPtr hDC, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle windowsBounds)
		{
			return new DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.GdiPlusGraphics(gr);
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetAutoLayoutElements(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			List<IRefinedSeries> firstSeriesOfGroups = GetFirstSeriesOfGroups();
			IList<Rectangle> list2 = CalculateSeriesGroupAreaList(firstSeriesOfGroups, bounds);
			for (int i = 0; i < firstSeriesOfGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = firstSeriesOfGroups[i];
				if (!IsAutoLayoutSeries(refinedSeries))
				{
					continue;
				}
				List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list3 = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
				if (refinedSeries.SeriesView is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
				{
					foreach (SeriesTitle title in simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles)
					{
						if ((int)title.Visibility == 2)
						{
							list3.Add(title);
						}
					}
				}
				GRealSize2D size = new GRealSize2D(list2[i].Width, list2[i].Height);
				list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(size, list3));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramViewData CalculateViewData(SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, Rectangle diagramBounds, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			List<SeriesLayout> list = new List<SeriesLayout>();
			List<LabelLayoutListBase> list2 = new List<LabelLayoutListBase>();
			List<AnnotationLayout> list3 = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			diagramBounds = margins.DecreaseRectangle(diagramBounds);
			if (!diagramBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (customPanel != null)
			{
				actualPanel = customPanel;
			}
			RefinedSeriesDataGroupCalculator refinedSeriesDataGroupCalculator = new RefinedSeriesDataGroupCalculator();
			IList<List<RefinedSeriesDataBase>> seriesGroups = refinedSeriesDataGroupCalculator.CalculateSeriesGroups(containerDataList.AllSeriesData);
			IList<Rectangle> list4 = CalculateSeriesGroupAreaList(seriesGroups, diagramBounds);
			bool flag = false;
			if (list4 != null && list4.Count > 0)
			{
				List<SeriesGroupLayout> list5 = CalculateSeriesGroupLayouts(seriesGroups, list4);
				Size minSize = CalculateMinPieOrDoughnutSize(list5);
				foreach (SeriesGroupLayout item in list5)
				{
					List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesGroup = item.SeriesGroup;
					int count = seriesGroup.Count;
					if (count <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Rectangle correctedElementBounds = item.ElementBounds;
					RefinedSeriesDataBase refinedSeriesDataBase = seriesGroup[0];
					Rectangle correctedElementWithLabelsBounds = item.ElementWithLabelsBounds;
					if (correctedElementBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
					{
						if (!equalPieSize || !(refinedSeriesDataBase.Series.View is PieSeriesView) || CorrectElementAndElementWithLabelsBounds(minSize, ref correctedElementBounds, ref correctedElementWithLabelsBounds))
						{
							SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout simpleDiagramSeriesLayout = new SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout(refinedSeriesDataBase, item.TitleViewDataByDomain, diagramBounds, item.DomainBounds, correctedElementWithLabelsBounds, correctedElementBounds);
							list.Add(simpleDiagramSeriesLayout);
							list2.Add(simpleDiagramSeriesLayout.LabelLayoutList);
							list3.AddRange(simpleDiagramSeriesLayout.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout);
							for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
							{
								SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout simpleDiagramSeriesLayout2 = new SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout(seriesGroup[i], null, diagramBounds, item.DomainBounds, correctedElementWithLabelsBounds, simpleDiagramSeriesLayout.Domain.ElementBounds);
								list.Add(simpleDiagramSeriesLayout2);
								list2.Add(simpleDiagramSeriesLayout2.LabelLayoutList);
								list3.AddRange(simpleDiagramSeriesLayout2.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout);
							}
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						isEmptyDiagramViewData = true;
					}
				}
			}
			List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList = Diagram.CreateLegendViewDataList(legendItems, diagramBounds);
			return new SimpleDiagramViewData(this, diagramBounds, list, list2, list3, legendViewDataList, isEmptyDiagramViewData ? (!flag) : isEmptyDiagramViewData);
		}

		protected internal override bool CanDrag(Point point, PortableMouseButtons button)
		{
			ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = base.Chart.CalcHitInfo(point);
			if (!(chartHitInfo.SeriesInsideDiagram is Series series) || chartHitInfo.SeriesPoint == null || series.UseRandomPoints)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (series.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
			{
				return simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.CanDrag(chartHitInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool PerformDragging(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, ChartScrollEventType scrollEventType, object focusedElement)
		{
			ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = base.Chart.CalcHitInfo(x, y);
			Series series = chartHitInfo.SeriesInsideDiagram as Series;
			RefinedPoint refinedPointInsideDiagram = chartHitInfo.RefinedPointInsideDiagram;
			if (series == null || refinedPointInsideDiagram == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (series.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
			{
				return simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.PerformDragging(refinedPointInsideDiagram, dx, dy);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override string GetDesignerHint(Point p)
		{
			ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = base.Chart.CalcHitInfo(p);
			if (chartHitInfo.SeriesInsideDiagram is Series series && CanDrag(p, (PortableMouseButtons)0) && series.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
			{
				return simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.GetDesignerHint();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramCoordinates PointToDiagramInternal(Point p)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SimpleDiagram simpleDiagram)
			{
				layoutDirection = simpleDiagram.layoutDirection;
				dimension = simpleDiagram.dimension;
				margins.Assign(simpleDiagram.margins);
				equalPieSize = simpleDiagram.equalPieSize;
				drillDownOptions.Assign(simpleDiagram.drillDownOptions);
				selectionOptions.Assign(simpleDiagram.selectionOptions);
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(SimpleDiagram3DTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SimpleDiagram3D")]
	public class SimpleDiagram3D : Diagram3D, ISimpleDiagram, IDiagram
	{
		private const LayoutDirection DefaultLayoutDirection = LayoutDirection.Horizontal;

		private const int DefaultDimension = 3;

		private LayoutDirection layoutDirection;

		private int dimension = 3;

		protected override int DefaultRotationAngleX => -60;

		protected override int DefaultRotationAngleY => 0;

		protected override int DefaultRotationAngleZ => 0;

		protected override int DefaultPerspectiveAngle => 20;

		protected internal override bool DependsOnBounds => base.Chart.AutoLayout;

		SimpleDiagramLayoutDirection ISimpleDiagram.LayoutDirection => (SimpleDiagramLayoutDirection)layoutDirection;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SimpleDiagram3D.LayoutDirection")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SimpleDiagram3D.LayoutDirection")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public LayoutDirection LayoutDirection
		{
			get
			{
				return layoutDirection;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != layoutDirection)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					layoutDirection = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SimpleDiagram3D.Dimension")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SimpleDiagram3D.Dimension")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]

		public int Dimension
		{
			get
			{
				return dimension;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dimension)
				{
					if (value < 1 || value > 99)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSimpleDiagramDimension));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					dimension = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLayoutDirection()
		{
			return layoutDirection != LayoutDirection.Horizontal;
		}

		private void ResetLayoutDirection()
		{
			LayoutDirection = LayoutDirection.Horizontal;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDimension()
		{
			return dimension != 3;
		}

		private void ResetDimension()
		{
			Dimension = 3;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeLayoutDirection())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDimension();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "LayoutDirection"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Dimension")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeDimension();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeLayoutDirection();
		}

		private List<IRefinedSeries> GetSeries()
		{
			List<IRefinedSeries> list = new List<IRefinedSeries>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				if (((IRefinedSeries)item).Series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram && ((IRefinedSeries)item).Points.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SimpleDiagram3D();
		}

		protected override void UpdateDiagramAccordingInfo(SeriesBase seriesTemplate, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> activeSeries)
		{
			base.UpdateDiagramAccordingInfo(seriesTemplate, activeSeries);
			foreach (Series item in base.Chart.Series)
			{
				if (item.View is Pie3DSeriesView pie3DSeriesView)
				{
					pie3DSeriesView.ApplyExplodeFiltersToPoints();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateAutomaticLayout(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			List<IRefinedSeries> series = GetSeries();
			int num = SimpleDiagramAutoLayoutHelper.CalculateDimension(bounds.Width, bounds.Height, series.Count);
			CustomizeSimpleDiagramLayoutEventArgs e = new CustomizeSimpleDiagramLayoutEventArgs(num, LayoutDirection.Horizontal);
			base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomizeSimpleDiagramLayout(e);
			dimension = e.Dimension;
			layoutDirection = e.LayoutDirection;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramViewData CalculateViewData(SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, Rectangle diagramBounds, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UpdateLastDiagramBounds(diagramBounds);
			if (!diagramBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<SeriesLayout> list = new List<SeriesLayout>();
			List<LabelLayoutListBase> list2 = new List<LabelLayoutListBase>();
			int num = containerDataList.AllSeriesData.Count();
			IList<DXRectangle> list3;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				list3 = SimpleDiagramLayout.Calculate(this, GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(diagramBounds), num);
			}
			else
			{
				list3 = new List<DXRectangle>();
				list3.Add(GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(diagramBounds));
			}
			bool flag = false;
			List<AnnotationLayout> list4 = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			for (int i = 0; i < containerDataList.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData = containerDataList[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < seriesContainerData.SeriesDataList.Count; j++)
				{
					SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout = new SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout(seriesContainerData.SeriesDataList[j], list3[i]);
					if (simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout.Domain != null && simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout.Domain.Bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
					{
						list.Add(simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout);
						list2.Add(simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout.LabelLayoutList);
						list4.AddRange(simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout);
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						isEmptyDiagramViewData = true;
					}
				}
			}
			List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList = Diagram.CreateLegendViewDataList(legendItems, diagramBounds);
			return new SimpleDiagram3DViewData(this, diagramBounds, list, list2, list4, legendViewDataList, isEmptyDiagramViewData ? (!flag) : isEmptyDiagramViewData);
		}

		protected internal override void FinishLoading()
		{
			base.FinishLoading();
			foreach (Series item in base.Chart.Series)
			{
				if (item.View is Pie3DSeriesView pie3DSeriesView)
				{
					pie3DSeriesView.FinishUpdateExplodedPoints();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SimpleDiagram3D simpleDiagram3D)
			{
				layoutDirection = simpleDiagram3D.layoutDirection;
				dimension = simpleDiagram3D.dimension;
			}
		}
	}

		{

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return GetXYDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IShadowSupportView shadowSupportView)
			{
				shadow.Assign(shadowSupportView.Shadow);
			}
			if (obj is IColorEachSupportView colorEachSupportView)
			{
				colorEach = colorEachSupportView.ColorEach;
			}
			if (obj is RadarSeriesViewBase radarSeriesViewBase)
			{
				seriesPointAnimation = ((radarSeriesViewBase.seriesPointAnimation != null) ? ((CircularMarkerAnimationBase)radarSeriesViewBase.seriesPointAnimation.Clone()) : null);
				aggregateFunction = radarSeriesViewBase.aggregateFunction;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeColorEach() && !ShouldSerializeShadow() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesPointAnimation())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAggregateFunction();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RadarDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal DiagramPoint? CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			IXYPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			return diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new RadarPointSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(RadarDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(seriesDatum.RefinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
				if (seriesPoint == null || seriesPoint.Annotations.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DiagramPoint position = CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(anchorPointLayoutList.DiagramMapping, seriesDatum);
				foreach (Annotation annotation in seriesPoint.Annotations)
				{
					anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, position, seriesDatum.RefinedPoint));
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RadarSeriesViewBase radarSeriesViewBase = (RadarSeriesViewBase)obj;
			if (shadow.Equals(radarSeriesViewBase.shadow))
			{
				return colorEach == radarSeriesViewBase.colorEach;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		internal abstract class DockingBase
		{
			public abstract int TextAngle { get; }

			public abstract NearTextPosition NearPosition { get; }

			public abstract bool IsVertical { get; }

			public static DockingBase CreateInstance(ChartTitleDockStyle dock)
			{
				return dock switch
				{
					ChartTitleDockStyle.Top => new TopDocking(), 
					ChartTitleDockStyle.Bottom => new BottomDocking(), 
					ChartTitleDockStyle.Left => new LeftDocking(), 
					ChartTitleDockStyle.Right => new RightDocking(), 
					_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
				};
			}

			public abstract Rectangle ModifyBounds(Rectangle bounds, int size);

			public abstract int GetSizeFromRect(Rectangle rect);

			public abstract Point CalcOrigin(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment);
		}

		internal abstract class HorizontalDocking : DockingBase
		{
			public override int TextAngle => 0;

			public override bool IsVertical => false;

			protected int GetPointX(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment)
			{
				return alignment switch
				{
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center => bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2, 
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near => bounds.X + rect.Width / 2, 
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far => bounds.Right - rect.Width / 2, 
					_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
				};
			}

			public override int GetSizeFromRect(Rectangle rect)
			{
				return rect.Height;
			}
		}

		internal abstract class VerticalDocking : DockingBase
		{
			public override bool IsVertical => true;

			public override int GetSizeFromRect(Rectangle rect)
			{
				return rect.Width;
			}
		}

		internal class TopDocking : HorizontalDocking
		{
			public override NearTextPosition NearPosition => NearTextPosition.Bottom;

			public override Rectangle ModifyBounds(Rectangle bounds, int size)
			{
				bounds.Y += size;
				bounds.Height -= size;
				return bounds;
			}

			public override Point CalcOrigin(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment)
			{
				int pointX = GetPointX(bounds, rect, alignment);
				int y = bounds.Y;
				return new Point(pointX, y);
			}
		}

		internal class BottomDocking : HorizontalDocking
		{
			public override NearTextPosition NearPosition => NearTextPosition.Top;

			public override Rectangle ModifyBounds(Rectangle bounds, int size)
			{
				bounds.Height -= size;
				return bounds;
			}

			public override Point CalcOrigin(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment)
			{
				int pointX = GetPointX(bounds, rect, alignment);
				int bottom = bounds.Bottom;
				return new Point(pointX, bottom);
			}
		}

		internal class LeftDocking : VerticalDocking
		{
			public override int TextAngle => 270;

			public override NearTextPosition NearPosition => NearTextPosition.Right;

			public override Rectangle ModifyBounds(Rectangle bounds, int size)
			{
				bounds.X += size;
				bounds.Width -= size;
				return bounds;
			}

			public override Point CalcOrigin(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment)
			{
				return alignment switch
				{
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center => new Point(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2), 
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near => new Point(bounds.X, bounds.Bottom - rect.Height / 2), 
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far => new Point(bounds.X, bounds.Y + rect.Height / 2), 
					_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
				};
			}
		}

		internal class RightDocking : VerticalDocking
		{
			public override int TextAngle => 90;

			public override NearTextPosition NearPosition => NearTextPosition.Left;

			public override Rectangle ModifyBounds(Rectangle bounds, int size)
			{
				bounds.Width -= size;
				return bounds;
			}

			public override Point CalcOrigin(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment)
			{
				return alignment switch
				{
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center => new Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2), 
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near => new Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Y + rect.Height / 2), 
					System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far => new Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom - rect.Height / 2), 
					_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
				};
			}
		}

		internal DockableTitleViewData CalculateViewData(ref Rectangle bounds, HitRegionContainer occupiedRegion)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			string text = ConstructActualText();
			if ((int)Visibility == 1 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int maxWidth = (docking.IsVertical ? bounds.Height : bounds.Width);
			SizeF textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, base.DXFont, this);
			RotatedTextPainterNearLine rotatedTextPainterNearLine = new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(Point.Empty, text, textSize, this, docking.NearPosition, docking.TextAngle, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: true, maxWidth, base.MaxLineCount, base.WordWrap);
			Rectangle roundedBounds = rotatedTextPainterNearLine.RoundedBounds;
			Point point = docking.CalcOrigin(bounds, roundedBounds, base.Alignment);
			Bounds = new GRealRect2D(roundedBounds.Left + point.X, roundedBounds.Top + point.Y, roundedBounds.Width, roundedBounds.Height);
			if (!ActualVisibility)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int size = docking.GetSizeFromRect(roundedBounds) + indent + 1;
			roundedBounds.Offset(point);
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = new HitRegionContainer(new HitRegion(roundedBounds));
			hitRegionContainer.Exclude(occupiedRegion);
			IHitRegion excludeRegion = (IHitRegion)occupiedRegion.Underlying.Clone();
			DockableTitleViewData result = new DockableTitleViewData(this, text, excludeRegion, hitRegionContainer, point, maxWidth, size, base.WordWrap);
			bounds = docking.ModifyBounds(bounds, size);
			occupiedRegion.Union(new HitRegion(roundedBounds));
			return result;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DockableTitle dockableTitle)
			{
				SetDock(dockableTitle.dock);
				indent = dockableTitle.indent;
				visibility = dockableTitle.visibility;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return base.Text;
		}

	public abstract class DockableTitleCollectionBase : ChartCollectionBase
	{
		public DockableTitle this[int index] => (DockableTitle)base.List[index];

		protected DockableTitleCollectionBase(ChartElement owner)
		{
			base.Owner = owner;
		}

		internal List<DockableTitleViewData> CalculateViewDataAndBoundsWithoutTitle(ref Rectangle bounds)
		{
			List<DockableTitleViewData> list = new List<DockableTitleViewData>();
			using (HitRegionContainer occupiedRegion = new HitRegionContainer())
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						DockableTitle dockableTitle = (DockableTitle)enumerator.Current;
						DockableTitleViewData dockableTitleViewData = dockableTitle.CalculateViewData(ref bounds, occupiedRegion);
						if (dockableTitleViewData != null)
						{
							list.Add(dockableTitleViewData);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		private SeriesTitle TemplateTitle
		{
			get
			{
				SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase = (SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)base.Owner;
				SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase2 = (SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View;
				int num = simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Titles.IndexOf(this);
				ChartDebug.Assert(num >= 0 && num < simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase2.Titles.Count);
				return simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase2.Titles[num];
			}
		}

		private Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
				{
					if (!(simpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.Owner is Series result))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return result;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override int VisibilityPriority => 5;

		protected override string DefaultText => "{S}";

		protected override DXFont InitialFont => initialFont;

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return base.Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override object HitObject
		{
			get
			{
				if (!UseTemplateHit)
				{
					return base.HitObject;
				}
				return TemplateTitle.HitObject;
			}
		}

		protected internal override HitTestState HitState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!UseTemplateHit)
				{
					return base.HitState;
				}
				return TemplateTitle.HitState;
			}
		}

		int ISupportID.ID
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				ChartDebug.Assert(value >= 0);
				if (value >= 0)
				{
					id = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		public int TitleID
		{

			}
			set

				{

			}

		}

			: base(initialFont)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetSkinFontSize(ChartElement title)
		{
			return CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(title)?.WholeChartAppearance.SeriesTitleFontSize ?? 0;
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructActualText()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Text))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			Series series = Series;
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(base.Text, series.View);
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(series);
			if (refinedSeries.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedSeries.Points[0], Series);
			}
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesTitle();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesTitle seriesTitle)
			{
				id = seriesTitle.id;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ToolTipOptions : ChartElement, IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue
	{
		private const bool DefaultShowForSeries = false;

		private const bool DefaultShowForPoints = true;

		private bool loading;

		private bool showForSeries;

		private bool showForPoints = true;

		private ToolTipPosition toolTipPosition;

		private readonly AspxSerializerWrapper<ToolTipPosition> toolTipPositionSerializerWrapper;

		protected internal override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Loading)
				{
					return loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether to show a tooltip for a particular series.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipOptions.ShowForSeries")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowForSeries
		{
			get
			{
				return showForSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != showForSeries)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					showForSeries = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether to show tooltip for a series point.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipOptions.ShowForPoints")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowForPoints
		{
			get
			{
				return showForPoints;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != showForPoints)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					showForPoints = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Represents how the tooltip position is defined, for example, relative to a mouse pointer or chart element.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ToolTipPositionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public ToolTipPosition ToolTipPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return toolTipPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectToolTipPosition));
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				SetToolTipPosition(value);
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public IList ToolTipPositionSerializable => toolTipPositionSerializerWrapper;

		public ToolTipOptions()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public ToolTipOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			SetToolTipPosition(new ToolTipMousePosition());
			toolTipPositionSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<ToolTipPosition>(() => ToolTipPosition, delegate(ToolTipPosition value)
			{
				ToolTipPosition = value;
			});
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"ShowForSeries" => ShouldSerializeShowForSeries(), 
				"ShowForPoints" => ShouldSerializeShowForPoints(), 
				"ToolTipPosition" => true, 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		object IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue.Create(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.Item.Name == "ToolTipPosition"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return XtraCreateToolTipPosition(e);
		}

		private object XtraCreateToolTipPosition(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			object obj = SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
			return obj ?? toolTipPosition;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowForPoints()
		{
			return !showForPoints;
		}

		private void ResetShowForPoints()
		{
			ShowForPoints = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShowForSeries()
		{
			return showForSeries;
		}

		private void ResetShowForSeries()
		{
			ShowForSeries = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeToolTipPosition()
		{
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = ((base.Owner != null) ? (base.Owner as DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart) : null);
			if (chart != null && chart.Container != null && chart.Container.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl)
			{
				return toolTipPosition.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeToolTipPositionSerializable()
		{
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = ((base.Owner != null) ? (base.Owner as DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart) : null);
			if (chart != null && chart.Container != null && chart.Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl)
			{
				return toolTipPosition.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipPosition() && !ShouldSerializeShowForPoints())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeShowForSeries();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetToolTipPosition(ToolTipPosition position)
		{
			toolTipPosition = position;
			toolTipPosition.Owner = this;
		}

		private void AssignToolTipPosition(ToolTipPosition position)
		{
			if (!toolTipPosition.GetType().Equals(position.GetType()))
			{
				SetToolTipPosition((ToolTipPosition)position.Clone());
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipPosition.Assign(position);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ToolTipOptions();
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading()
		{
			toolTipPosition.OnEndLoading();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ToolTipOptions toolTipOptions)
			{
				showForPoints = toolTipOptions.showForPoints;
				showForSeries = toolTipOptions.showForSeries;
				AssignToolTipPosition(toolTipOptions.toolTipPosition);
				OnEndLoading();
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ToolTipPositionWithOffset : ToolTipPosition
	{
		private const int DefaultOffset = 0;

		private int offsetX;

		private int offsetY;

		[Description("Gets or sets the horizontal offset.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipPositionWithOffset.OffsetX")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int OffsetX
		{
			get
			{
				return offsetX;
			}
			set
			{
				if (offsetX != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					offsetX = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the vertical offset.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipPositionWithOffset.OffsetY")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				if (offsetY != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					offsetY = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "OffsetX")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOffsetX();
			}
			if (propertyName == "OffsetY")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOffsetY();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOffsetX()
		{
			return offsetX != 0;
		}

		private void ResetOffsetX()
		{
			OffsetX = 0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeOffsetY()
		{
			return offsetY != 0;
		}

		private void ResetOffsetY()
		{
			OffsetY = 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeOffsetX())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOffsetY();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected Point PointToScreen(Point chartPoint)
		{
			if (ChartContainer == null)
			{
				return chartPoint;
			}
			return ChartContainer.PointToScreen(chartPoint);
		}

		protected internal abstract Point? CalculateInitialToolTipPosition(ChartFocusedArea focusedArea, Point cursorPosition);

		protected internal abstract ToolTipDockCorner? GetToolTipDockCorner();

		internal Point OffsetPosition(Point point)
		{
			return new Point(point.X + offsetX, point.Y + offsetY);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ToolTipPositionWithOffset toolTipPositionWithOffset)
			{
				offsetX = toolTipPositionWithOffset.offsetX;
				offsetY = toolTipPositionWithOffset.offsetY;
			}
		}
	}
