	[TypeConverter(typeof(ToolTipFreePositionTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipFreePosition")]
	public class ToolTipFreePosition : ToolTipPositionWithOffset
	{
		private const ToolTipDockCorner DefaultDockCorner = ToolTipDockCorner.TopLeft;

		private IDockTarget dockTarget;

		private ToolTipDockCorner dockCorner = ToolTipDockCorner.TopLeft;

		private string deserializedDockTargetName;

		[Description("Specifies the corner of the tooltip’s parent element to which the tooltip is anchored.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipFreePosition.DockCorner")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ToolTipDockCorner DockCorner
		{
			get
			{
				return dockCorner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dockCorner)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					dockCorner = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string DockTargetName
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockTarget != null)
				{
					return dockTarget.Name;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedDockTargetName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the element (chart or pane), to which the tooltip’s shape is docked.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ToolTipFreePosition.DockTarget")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ToolTipFreePositionDockTargetTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public ChartElement DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (ChartElement)dockTarget;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dockTarget)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					if (value != null)
					{
						CommonUtils.CheckDockTarget(value, this);
					}
					dockTarget = value as IDockTarget;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "DockCorner")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDockCorner();
			}
			if (propertyName == "DockTargetName")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDockTargetName();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockCorner()
		{
			return dockCorner != ToolTipDockCorner.TopLeft;
		}

		private void ResetDockCorner()
		{
			DockCorner = ToolTipDockCorner.TopLeft;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockTargetName()
		{
			return dockTarget != null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeDockCorner())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDockTargetName();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ToolTipFreePosition();
		}

		protected internal override Point? CalculateInitialToolTipPosition(ChartFocusedArea focusedArea, Point cursorPosition)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle;
			if (dockTarget == null)
			{
				if (ContainerAdapter.DisplayBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				rectangle = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ContainerAdapter.DisplayBounds.Size);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(dockTarget is XYDiagramPaneBase { LastMappingBounds: not null, LastMappingBounds: var lastMappingBounds }))
				{
					return null;
				}
				rectangle = lastMappingBounds.Value;
			}
			Point chartPoint;
			switch (dockCorner)
			{
			case ToolTipDockCorner.TopLeft:
				chartPoint = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top);
				break;
			case ToolTipDockCorner.TopRight:
				chartPoint = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
				break;
			case ToolTipDockCorner.BottomLeft:
				chartPoint = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
				break;
			case ToolTipDockCorner.BottomRight:
				chartPoint = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected tool tip dock position");
				return null;
			}
			return PointToScreen(chartPoint);
		}

		protected internal override ToolTipDockCorner? GetToolTipDockCorner()
		{
			return DockCorner;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = CommonUtils.GetXYDiagram2D(this);
			if (xYDiagram2D != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializedDockTargetName))
			{
				dockTarget = xYDiagram2D.FindPaneByName(deserializedDockTargetName);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ToolTipFreePosition toolTipFreePosition)
			{
				dockTarget = toolTipFreePosition.dockTarget;
				DockTargetName = toolTipFreePosition.DockTargetName;
				dockCorner = toolTipFreePosition.dockCorner;
			}
		}
	}
	[ListBindable(false)]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableCollectionTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class ChartCollectionBase : CollectionBase, IOwnedElement
	{
		internal class BatchUpdateHelper
		{
			private readonly ChartCollectionBase owner;

			private readonly List<ChartUpdate> lockUpdateInfos = new List<ChartUpdate>();

			public BatchUpdateHelper(ChartCollectionBase owner)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			private bool IsCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
			{
				if (!(updateInfo is SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo))
				{
					return updateInfo is SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool CanCreateBatchUpdate(CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo != null)
				{
					if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation != ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
					{
						return collectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool IsIndexValid(CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo, int lastIndex)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					return lastIndex + 1 == collectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex;
				}
				return lastIndex == collectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex;
			}

			private int GetIndex<T>(CollectionUpdateInfo<T> collectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation != ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					return collectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex;
				}
				return collectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex;
			}

			private T GetItem<T>(CollectionUpdateInfo<T> collectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation != ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					return collectionUpdateInfo.OldItem;
				}
				return collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem;
			}

			public List<ChartUpdate> CreateUpdateInfos()
			{
				List<ChartUpdate> list = new List<ChartUpdate>();
				for (int i = 0; i < lockUpdateInfos.Count; i++)
				{
					ChartUpdate chartUpdate = lockUpdateInfos[i];
					if (IsCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(chartUpdate.UpdateInfo))
					{
						list.Add(chartUpdate);
						continue;
					}
					CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo = lockUpdateInfos[i].UpdateInfo as CollectionUpdateInfo;
					if (!CanCreateBatchUpdate(collectionUpdateInfo))
					{
						list.Add(lockUpdateInfos[i]);
						continue;
					}
					ICollection updateInfoSequence = owner.GetUpdateInfoSequence(i);
					if (updateInfoSequence == null || updateInfoSequence.Count == 1)
					{
						list.Add(lockUpdateInfos[i]);
						continue;
					}
					if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
					{
						list.Add(owner.CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, null, -1, updateInfoSequence, collectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(owner.CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, updateInfoSequence, collectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex, null, -1));
					}
					i += updateInfoSequence.Count - 1;
				}
				return list;
			}

			public ICollection GetUpdateInfoSequence<T>(int index)
			{
				ICollection<T> collection = null;
				CollectionUpdateInfo<T> collectionUpdateInfo = lockUpdateInfos[index++].UpdateInfo as CollectionUpdateInfo<T>;
				ChartCollectionOperation operation = collectionUpdateInfo.Operation;
				if (collectionUpdateInfo != null)
				{
					collection = new Collection<T>();
					int index2 = GetIndex(collectionUpdateInfo);
					collection.Add(GetItem(collectionUpdateInfo));
					while (index < lockUpdateInfos.Count && lockUpdateInfos[index++].UpdateInfo is CollectionUpdateInfo<T> collectionUpdateInfo2 && collectionUpdateInfo2.Operation == operation && IsIndexValid(collectionUpdateInfo2, index2))
					{
						collection.Add(GetItem(collectionUpdateInfo2));
						index2 = GetIndex(collectionUpdateInfo2);
					}
				}
				return collection as ICollection;
			}

			public void Add(ChartUpdate changeInfo)
			{
				if (changeInfo.UpdateInfo is CollectionUpdateInfo { Operation: ChartCollectionOperation.Reset })
				{
					Clear();
				}
				lockUpdateInfos.Add(changeInfo);
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				lockUpdateInfos.Clear();
			}
		}

		private int nextID;

		private ChartElement owner;

		private int updateModeCounter;

		private BatchUpdateHelper batchUpdateHelper;

		internal BatchUpdateHelper UpdateHelper => batchUpdateHelper;

		protected internal ChartElement Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				owner = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool UpdateLocked => updateModeCounter > 0;

		protected virtual int CountCore => base.Count;

		protected virtual bool ShouldUpdateExpressions => true;

		[Description("Gets the number of points stored in the collection.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ChartCollectionBase.Count")]
		public new int Count => CountCore;

		IOwnedElement IOwnedElement.Owner => Owner;

		IChartContainer IOwnedElement.ChartContainer => Owner.ChartContainer;

		protected ChartCollectionBase()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper = new BatchUpdateHelper(this);
		}

		protected ChartCollectionBase(ChartElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			batchUpdateHelper = new BatchUpdateHelper(this);
		}

		private void InitializeID(ISupportID item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (item.ID == -1)
				{
					item.ID = nextID++;
				}
				else
				{
					nextID = Math.Max(nextID, item.ID + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DecreaseUpdateCounter()
		{
			updateModeCounter = Math.Max(0, --updateModeCounter);
		}

		private void ResetOwnerBeforeRemove()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ChartElement item = (ChartElement)enumerator.Current;
					DisposeItemBeforeRemove(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveExpressions(object value)
		{
			if (ShouldUpdateExpressions && value is ISupportID element)
			{
				(Owner?.ChartContainer?.GetExpressionUpdater())?.RemoveExpressions(element);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeItemBeforeRemove(ChartElement item)
		{
			item.Owner = null;
		}

		protected virtual ChartUpdate CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, object oldItem, int oldIndex, object newItem, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnEndUpdate()
		{
		}

		protected virtual ChartUpdate CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation operation, ICollection oldItems, int oldIndex, ICollection newItems, int newIndex)
		{
			return new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		protected virtual ICollection GetUpdateInfoSequence(int index)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected T GetOwner<T>() where T : IOwnedElement
		{
			for (IOwnedElement ownedElement = Owner; ownedElement != null; ownedElement = Owner.Owner)
			{
				if (ownedElement is T)
				{
					return (T)ownedElement;
				}
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeOwnerForItem(ChartElement item)
		{
			item.Owner = owner;
			InitializeID(item as ISupportID);
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					RemoveExpressions(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			ResetOwnerBeforeRemove();
			base.OnClear();
		}

		protected override void OnClearComplete()
		{
			base.OnClearComplete();
			RaiseControlChanged(CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, null, -1, null, -1));
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsertComplete(index, value);
			ChangeOwnerForItem((ChartElement)value);
			RaiseControlChanged(CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, null, -1, value, index));
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			DisposeItemBeforeRemove(value as ChartElement);
			base.OnRemove(index, value);
			RemoveExpressions(value);
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
			RaiseControlChanged(CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, value, index, null, -1));
		}

		protected internal virtual void SendControlChanging()
		{
			if (!UpdateLocked && Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.RaiseControlChanging();
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseControlChanged()
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseControlChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (!UpdateLocked)
			{
				ProcessChanged(change);
			}
			else
			{
				batchUpdateHelper.Add(change);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.ChildCollectionChanged(this, change);
			}
		}

		protected internal int AddWithoutChanged(ChartElement item)
		{
			int result = base.InnerList.Add(item);
			ChangeOwnerForItem(item);
			return result;
		}

		protected int Add(ChartElement item)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			return base.List.Add(item);
		}

		protected void AddRangeWithoutChanged(ICollection coll)
		{
			base.InnerList.AddRange(coll);
			foreach (ChartElement item in coll)
			{
				ChangeOwnerForItem(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRangeAddComplete(int index)
		{
		}

		protected void AddRange(ICollection coll)
		{
			int count = Count;
			SendControlChanging();
			AddRangeWithoutChanged(coll);
			RaiseControlChanged(CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, null, -1, coll, count));
		}

		protected void Insert(int index, ChartElement item)
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			base.List.Insert(index, item);
		}

		public int IndexOf(ChartElement item)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.InnerList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.InnerList[i] == item)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected void RemoveWithoutChanged(ChartElement item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				base.InnerList.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		protected void Swap(ChartElement item1, ChartElement item2)
		{
			if (item1 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item1");
			}
			if (item2 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item2");
			}
			int num = base.InnerList.IndexOf(item1);
			int num2 = base.InnerList.IndexOf(item2);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgItemNotInCollection), "item1");
			}
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgItemNotInCollection), "item2");
			}
			Swap(num, num2);
		}

		protected virtual void CheckSwapAbility(ChartElement element1, ChartElement element2)
		{
		}

		protected ChartElement GetElementByID(int id)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ChartElement chartElement = (ChartElement)enumerator.Current;
					if (chartElement is ISupportID && ((ISupportID)chartElement).ID == id)
					{
						return chartElement;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Remove(ChartElement item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				SendControlChanging();
				base.List.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(ChartElement item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item) >= 0;
		}

		public void Swap(int index1, int index2)
		{
			if (index1 < 0 || index1 >= Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgItemNotInCollection), "index1");
			}
			if (index2 < 0 || index2 >= Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgItemNotInCollection), "index2");
			}
			if (index1 != index2)
			{
				ChartElement chartElement = (ChartElement)base.List[index1];
				ChartElement chartElement2 = (ChartElement)base.List[index2];
				CheckSwapAbility(chartElement, chartElement2);
				SendControlChanging();
				base.InnerList.RemoveAt(index1);
				base.InnerList.Insert(index1, chartElement2);
				base.InnerList.RemoveAt(index2);
				base.InnerList.Insert(index2, chartElement);
				RaiseControlChanged(CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.SwapItem, chartElement, index1, chartElement2, index2));
			}
		}

		internal void BeginUpdate(bool forceChanging, bool bindingProcessing)
		{
			if (forceChanging)
			{
				SendControlChanging();
				if (updateModeCounter == 0 && !bindingProcessing)
				{
					OnBeginUpdate();
				}
			}
			updateModeCounter++;
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndUpdate(bool bindingProcessing)
		{
			DecreaseUpdateCounter();
			if (UpdateLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ChartUpdate> list = batchUpdateHelper.CreateUpdateInfos();
			foreach (ChartUpdate item in list)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(item);
			}
			batchUpdateHelper.Clear();
			if (!bindingProcessing)
			{
				OnEndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			BeginUpdate(forceChanging: true, bindingProcessing: false);
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			EndUpdate(bindingProcessing: false);
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			DecreaseUpdateCounter();
			batchUpdateHelper.Clear();
		}

		public ChartElement GetElementByIndex(int index)
		{
			return (ChartElement)base.List[index];
		}

		public ChartElement[] ToArray()
		{
			return (ChartElement[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(ChartElement));
		}

		public virtual void Assign(ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			RaiseControlChanged(CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, null, -1, null, -1));
			foreach (ChartElement item in collection)
			{
				ChartElement chartElement2 = (ChartElement)item.Clone();
				base.InnerList.Add(chartElement2);
				ChangeOwnerForItem(chartElement2);
			}
			RaiseControlChanged(CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, null, -1, base.List, 0));
		}
	}
	public abstract class DisposableChartCollectionBase : ChartCollectionBase, IDisposable, IOwnedElement
	{
		private bool shouldDisposeItems = true;

		protected internal bool Disposed { get; protected set; }

		protected DisposableChartCollectionBase()
		{
		}

		protected DisposableChartCollectionBase(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		private void DisposeItemsBeforeRemove()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ChartElement item = (ChartElement)enumerator.Current;
					DisposeItemBeforeRemove(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void DisposeItems()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ChartElement item = (ChartElement)enumerator.Current;
					DisposeItem(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeItem(ChartElement item)
		{
			if (shouldDisposeItems && item != null && item is IDisposable disposable)
			{
				disposable.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected override void DisposeItemBeforeRemove(ChartElement item)
		{
			if (shouldDisposeItems)
			{
				if (item is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
				item.Owner = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				Disposed = true;
				DisposeItems();
			}
			else
			{
				Disposed = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			SendControlChanging();
			DisposeItemsBeforeRemove();
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
			DisposeItemBeforeRemove((ChartElement)value);
		}

		protected internal void LockItemsDisposing()
		{
			shouldDisposeItems = false;
		}

		protected internal void UnlockItemsDisposing()
		{
			shouldDisposeItems = true;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			DisposeItems();
			base.Assign(collection);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

				array[i] = ((ChartElementNamed)base.List[i]).Name;
			}
			return array;

					if (chartElementNamed.Name == name)
					{
						return chartElementNamed;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		{
		}
	}
	public static class ChartImageUtils
	{
		private static Image RenderImage(SvgImage svgImage, ISvgPaletteProvider provider, Size size)
		{
			if (svgImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SvgBitmap.Create(svgImage)?.Render(size, provider, (DefaultBoolean)2, (DefaultBoolean)2);
		}

		public static SvgImage GetViewSvgImage(ViewType viewType)
		{
			return ImageResourcesUtils.GetImageFromResources(viewType);
		}

		public static SvgImage GetViewSvgImage(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			return ImageResourcesUtils.GetImageFromResources(view);
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(ViewType viewType, ISvgPaletteProvider provider, Size imageSize)
		{
			SvgImage viewSvgImage = GetViewSvgImage(viewType);
			return RenderImage(viewSvgImage, provider, imageSize);
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(ViewType viewType, ISvgPaletteProvider provider)
		{
			SvgImage viewSvgImage = GetViewSvgImage(viewType);
			if (viewSvgImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return RenderImage(viewSvgImage, provider, new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(viewSvgImage.Width), (int)Math.Ceiling(viewSvgImage.Height)));
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(ViewType viewType)
		{
			return GetViewImage(viewType, null);
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(ViewType viewType, Size imageSize)
		{
			return GetViewImage(viewType, null, imageSize);
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(SeriesViewBase view, ISvgPaletteProvider provider, Size imageSize)
		{
			SvgImage viewSvgImage = GetViewSvgImage(view);
			return RenderImage(viewSvgImage, provider, imageSize);
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(SeriesViewBase view, ISvgPaletteProvider provider)
		{
			SvgImage viewSvgImage = GetViewSvgImage(view);
			if (viewSvgImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return RenderImage(viewSvgImage, provider, new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(viewSvgImage.Width), (int)Math.Ceiling(viewSvgImage.Height)));
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			return GetViewImage(view, null);
		}

		public static Image GetViewImage(SeriesViewBase view, Size imageSize)
		{
			return GetViewImage(view, null, imageSize);
		}
	}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAxisX() && !ShouldSerializeAxisY() && !ShouldSerializeFillStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBackImage() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesDistance() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesDistanceFixed() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesIndentFixed())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePlaneDepthFixed();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"AxisX" => ShouldSerializeAxisX(), 
				"AxisY" => ShouldSerializeAxisY(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"BackImage" => ShouldSerializeBackImage(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"SeriesDistance" => ShouldSerializeSeriesDistance(), 
				"SeriesDistanceFixed" => ShouldSerializeSeriesDistanceFixed(), 
				"SeriesIndentFixed" => ShouldSerializeSeriesIndentFixed(), 
				"PlaneDepthFixed" => ShouldSerializePlaneDepthFixed(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private int GetAxisXLength()
		{
			if (base.Chart != null)
			{
				return base.Chart.LastBounds.Width;
			}
			return 300;
		}

		private List<AxisBase> GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			if (AxisUtils.ShouldUpdateSkippingRangesWithoutPoints(axisX, valueRangeChanged))
			{
				return new List<AxisBase> { axisX };
			}
			return new List<AxisBase>();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new XYDiagram3D();
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				backImage?.Dispose();
			}
			Disposed = true;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramViewData CalculateViewData(SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, Rectangle diagramBounds, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			UpdateLastDiagramBounds(diagramBounds);
			if (!diagramBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator.Create(this, diagramBounds, containerDataList);
			List<SeriesLayout> list = new List<SeriesLayout>();
			List<LabelLayoutListBase> list2 = new List<LabelLayoutListBase>();
			List<AnnotationLayout> list3 = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in containerDataList.AllSeriesData)
			{
				list.Add(new XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout(allSeriesDatum, coordsCalculator));
				list2.Add(new XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList(allSeriesDatum, coordsCalculator, axisY.VisualRangeData));
				list3.AddRange(new XYDiagram3DAnchorPointLayoutList(allSeriesDatum, coordsCalculator, axisY.VisualRangeData));
			}
			List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData = AnnotationHelper.CreateInnerAnnotationsViewData(list3);
			List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList = Diagram.CreateLegendViewDataList(legendItems, diagramBounds);
			return new XYDiagram3DViewData(coordsCalculator, base.Chart.Graphics3DCache, list, list2, list3, annotationsViewData, legendViewDataList);
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			axisX.OnEndLoading();
			axisY.OnEndLoading();
		}

		protected internal override void CheckUpdateMeasureUnits(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			IEnumerable<AxisBase> axesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate = GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(valueRangeChanged);
			List<PropertyUpdateInfo> updateInfos = base.ViewController.GetUpdateInfos(axesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate, "SkipRangesWithoutPoints");
			base.ViewController.SendUpdates(updateInfos);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D)
			{
				axisX.Assign(xYDiagram3D.axisX);
				axisY.Assign(xYDiagram3D.axisY);
				fillStyle.Assign(xYDiagram3D.fillStyle);
				backImage.Assign(xYDiagram3D.backImage);
				backColor = xYDiagram3D.backColor;
				seriesIndentFixed = xYDiagram3D.seriesIndentFixed;
				seriesDistanceFixed = xYDiagram3D.seriesDistanceFixed;
				seriesDistance = xYDiagram3D.seriesDistance;
				planeDepthFixed = xYDiagram3D.planeDepthFixed;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

		{
			return Math.Min(((IRangePoint)point).Value1, ((IRangePoint)point).Value2);
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)point).Value1), Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)point).Value2));
		}

		protected internal override BarData CreateBarData(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return new BarData(pointInfo.Argument, ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Min, ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Max, ((ISideBySidePoint)pointInfo).BarWidth, ((ISideBySidePoint)pointInfo).Offset, ((ISideBySidePoint)pointInfo).FixedOffset, ((ISideBySideBarPoint)pointInfo).Interacted);
		}
	}

		protected internal void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(XYDiagram3DAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(seriesDatum.SeriesPoint);
				if (seriesPoint == null || seriesPoint.Annotations.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DiagramPoint? diagramPoint = CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(anchorPointLayoutList.CoordsCalculator, seriesDatum, anchorPointLayoutList.AxisRangeY);
				if (!diagramPoint.HasValue)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Annotation annotation in seriesPoint.Annotations)
				{
					if (annotation.ScrollingSupported || anchorPointLayoutList.CoordsCalculator.Bounds.Contains((Point)diagramPoint.Value))
					{
						anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, diagramPoint.Value, seriesDatum.RefinedPoint));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is XYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase)
			{
				aggregateFunction = xYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase.aggregateFunction;
			}
		}

		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		protected static Direction GetRectangleDirection(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double zeroValue, double value)
		{
			if (diagramMapping.Rotated)
			{
				if (!(diagramMapping.AxisY.ActualReverse ^ (value < zeroValue)))
				{
					return Direction.LeftToRight;
				}
				return Direction.RightToLeft;
			}
			if (!(diagramMapping.AxisY.ActualReverse ^ (value < zeroValue)))
			{
				return Direction.TopToBottom;
			}
			return Direction.BottomToTop;
		}

		protected XYDiagramSeriesViewBase()
		{
			shadow = new Shadow(this);
			firstPoint = CreateSidePoint(isFirst: true);
			lastPoint = CreateSidePoint(isFirst: false);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeShadow()
		{
			return shadow.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeFirstPoint()
		{
			if (firstPoint != null)
			{
				return firstPoint.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeLastPoint()
		{
			if (lastPoint != null)
			{
				return lastPoint.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeEmptyPointOptions()
		{
			return emptyPointOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeShadow() && !ShouldSerializeFirstPoint() && !ShouldSerializeLastPoint())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEmptyPointOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Shadow"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "EmptyPointOptions")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeEmptyPointOptions();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeShadow();
		}

		private void SetSidePointLabel(SidePoint sidePoint)
		{
			SeriesLabelBase seriesLabelBase = CreateSeriesLabel();
			if (seriesLabelBase != null && sidePoint.Label != null)
			{
				seriesLabelBase.Assign(sidePoint.Label);
			}
			sidePoint.SetLabelInternal(seriesLabelBase);
		}

		protected virtual ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new DiscreteViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected virtual SidePoint CreateSidePoint(bool isFirst)
		{
			return new SidePoint(this, isFirst);
		}

		protected virtual EmptyPointOptions CreateDefaultEmptyPointOptions()
		{
			return new EmptyPointOptions(this);
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			if (FirstPoint != null)
			{
				FirstPoint.Owner = newOwner;
			}
			if (LastPoint != null)
			{
				LastPoint.Owner = newOwner;
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IShadowSupportView shadowSupportView)
			{
				shadow.Assign(shadowSupportView.Shadow);
			}
			if (obj is XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase)
			{
				if (firstPoint != null && xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.firstPoint != null)
				{
					firstPoint.Assign(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.firstPoint);
				}
				if (lastPoint != null && xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.lastPoint != null)
				{
					lastPoint.Assign(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.lastPoint);
				}
				emptyPointOptions.Assign(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.emptyPointOptions);
			}
		}

		protected override object CreateContentPropertyValue(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Item.Name == "FirstPoint" || e.Item.Name == "LastPoint")
			{
				return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
			}
			return base.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		protected internal override bool GetSideLabelVisible(bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				return LastPoint.LabelDisplayMode != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
			}
			return FirstPoint.LabelDisplayMode != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
		}

		protected internal override ScreenPointCalculator CreateScreenPointLabelCalculator(int pointCount, bool isFirstPoint)
		{
			if (pointCount == 1)
			{
				return CreateScreenPointCalculator((FirstPoint.LabelDisplayMode != SidePointDisplayMode.Default) ? FirstPoint.LabelDisplayMode : LastPoint.LabelDisplayMode);
			}
			return CreateScreenPointCalculator(isFirstPoint ? FirstPoint.LabelDisplayMode : LastPoint.LabelDisplayMode);
		}

		protected internal override Color GetPointColor(int pointIndex, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (base.Series.ActualPoints.Count > pointIndex)
			{
				IDataPoint dataPoint = base.Series.ActualPoints[pointIndex];
				Color pointColor = base.Series.GetPointColor(dataPoint);
				if (!pointColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return pointColor;
				}
				if (dataPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					return ActualEmptyPointOptions.Color;
				}
			}
			return base.GetPointColor(pointIndex, pointsCount);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return shadow.Equals(((XYDiagramSeriesViewBase)obj).shadow);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

					else if (colorSource != TaskLinkColorSource.OwnColor)

		private static void RenderLine(ChartRenderer renderer, DiagramPoint dp1, DiagramPoint dp2, Color color)
		{
			Point point = (Point)dp1;
			Point point2 = (Point)dp2;
			if (point == point2)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(new RectangleF(point.X, point.Y, 1f, 1f), color);
			}
			else
			{
				renderer.DrawLine(point, point2, color, 1);
			}
		}

		internal TaskLinkOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"ArrowWidth" => ShouldSerializeArrowWidth(), 
				"ArrowHeight" => ShouldSerializeArrowHeight(), 
				"MinIndent" => ShouldSerializeMinIndent(), 
				"Thickness" => ShouldSerializeThickness(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"ColorSource" => ShouldSerializeColorSource(), 
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"InFront" => ShouldSerializeInFront(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeArrowWidth()
		{
			return arrowWidth != 7;
		}

		private void ResetArrowWidth()
		{
			ArrowWidth = 7;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeArrowHeight()
		{

		{
			return !visible;
		}

		private void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColorSource()
		{
			return colorSource != TaskLinkColorSource.ParentColor;
		}

		private void ResetColorSource()

		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeArrowWidth() && !ShouldSerializeArrowHeight() && !ShouldSerializeMinIndent() && !ShouldSerializeThickness() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeColorSource() && !ShouldSerializeColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeInFront();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Color GetColor(SeriesPointLayout parentLayout, SeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			switch (colorSource)
			{
			case TaskLinkColorSource.ParentColor:
				return parentLayout.PointData.DrawOptions.Color;
			case TaskLinkColorSource.ParentBorderColor:
			{
				BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions = (BarDrawOptions)parentLayout.PointData.DrawOptions;
				return BarSeriesView.CalculateBorderColor(barDrawOptions.Color, barDrawOptions.Border.Color);
			}
			case TaskLinkColorSource.ChildColor:
				return childLayout.PointData.DrawOptions.Color;
			case TaskLinkColorSource.ChildBorderColor:
			{
				BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions = (BarDrawOptions)childLayout.PointData.DrawOptions;
				return BarSeriesView.CalculateBorderColor(barDrawOptions.Color, barDrawOptions.Border.Color);
			}
			case TaskLinkColorSource.OwnColor:
				return color;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		private void RenderArrow(ChartRenderer renderer, LineStrip strip, Color color)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			RenderLine(renderer, new DiagramPoint(strip[0].X, strip[0].Y), new DiagramPoint(strip[1].X, strip[1].Y), color);
			RenderLine(renderer, new DiagramPoint(strip[1].X, strip[1].Y), new DiagramPoint(strip[2].X, strip[2].Y), color);
			RenderLine(renderer, new DiagramPoint(strip[2].X, strip[2].Y), new DiagramPoint(strip[0].X, strip[0].Y), color);
			renderer.FillPolygon(strip, color);
			IHitTest series = View.Series;
			if (series != null && !series.State.Normal)
			{
				renderer.FillPolygon(strip, series.State.HatchStyle, series.State.HatchColorLight, color);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		private void RenderRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, ZPlaneRectangle rect, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle((RectangleF)rect, color);
			IHitTest series = View.Series;
			if (series != null && !series.State.Normal)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle((Rectangle)rect, series.State.HatchStyle, series.State.HatchColorLight, color);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new TaskLinkOptions(null);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, SeriesPointLayout parentLayout, TaskLinkLayout[] linkLayouts)
		{
			foreach (TaskLinkLayout taskLinkLayout in linkLayouts)
			{
				Color color = GetColor(parentLayout, taskLinkLayout.ChildLayout);
				if (taskLinkLayout.LineRects != null)
				{
					foreach (ZPlaneRectangle lineRect in taskLinkLayout.LineRects)
					{
						RenderRectangle(renderer, lineRect, color);
					}
				}
				if (taskLinkLayout.ArrowPoints != null)
				{
					RenderArrow(renderer, taskLinkLayout.ArrowPoints, color);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is TaskLinkOptions taskLinkOptions)
			{
				arrowWidth = taskLinkOptions.arrowWidth;
				arrowHeight = taskLinkOptions.arrowHeight;
				minIndent = taskLinkOptions.minIndent;
				thickness = taskLinkOptions.thickness;
				visible = taskLinkOptions.visible;
				colorSource = taskLinkOptions.colorSource;
				color = taskLinkOptions.color;
				inFront = taskLinkOptions.inFront;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(TaskLinkOptions)";
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TaskLinkOptions taskLinkOptions && arrowWidth == taskLinkOptions.arrowWidth && arrowHeight == taskLinkOptions.arrowHeight && minIndent == taskLinkOptions.minIndent && thickness == taskLinkOptions.thickness && visible == taskLinkOptions.visible && colorSource == taskLinkOptions.colorSource && color == taskLinkOptions.color)
			{
				return inFront == taskLinkOptions.inFront;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	[RuntimeObject]
	public class CrosshairElement : CrosshairElementBase
	{
		private readonly RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

		private readonly IRefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		internal IRefinedSeries RefinedSeries => refinedSeries;

		internal RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => refinedPoint;

		[Description("Gets the series point that a crosshair element hovers over when implementing a custom draw.")]
		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Series);
				return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(refinedPoint));
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets a series that a crosshair element hovers over when implementing a custom draw.")]
		public Series Series => (Series)refinedSeries.Series;

		internal CrosshairElement(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, CrosshairLabelElement labelElement)
			: base(lineElement, axisLabelElement, labelElement)
		{
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle markerBounds)
		{
			ISeries series = refinedSeries.Series;
			((series != null) ? (series.SeriesView as SeriesViewBase) : null)?.RenderCrosshairMarker(renderer, markerBounds, refinedSeries, refinedPoint, base.LabelElement.MarkerColor);
		}

		protected internal override void AddToGroup(CrosshairElementGroup elementGroup)
		{
			elementGroup.CrosshairElements.Add(this);
			elementGroup.Elements.Add(this);
		}
	}

	[RuntimeObject]
	public class IndicatorPoint
	{
		private readonly Indicator indicator;

		private readonly object argument;

		private readonly double[] values;

		private readonly Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> valuesByType;

		public Indicator Indicator => indicator;

		public object Argument => argument;

		public double[] Values => values;

		internal IndicatorPoint(Indicator indicator, object argument, Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> valuesByType)
		{
			this.indicator = indicator;
			this.argument = argument;
			this.valuesByType = valuesByType;
			values = valuesByType.Values.ToArray();
		}

		public double? GetNumericValue(IndicatorValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			valuesByType.TryGetValue((IndicatorValueLevelCore)valueLevel, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}

	}

	[RuntimeObject]
	public abstract class CustomDrawSeriesEventArgsBase : EventArgs, ILegendItemOptions
	{
		private bool disposeLegendFont;

		private bool disposeLegendMarkerImage;

		private bool legendMarkerVisible;

		private bool legendTextVisible;

		private Color legendTextColor;

		private DrawOptions drawOptions;

		private DrawOptions legendDrawOptions;

		private BackCompatibilityFontController fontController;

		private DXImage legendMarkerImage;

		private ChartImageSizeMode legendMarkerImageSizeMode;

		private Series series;

		private Size legendMarkerSize;

		private string legendText;

		public bool DisposeLegendFont
		{
			get
			{
				return disposeLegendFont;
			}
			set
			{
				disposeLegendFont = value;
			}
		}

		public bool DisposeLegendMarkerImage
		{
			get
			{
				return disposeLegendMarkerImage;
			}
			set
			{
				disposeLegendMarkerImage = value;
			}
		}

		public bool LegendMarkerVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return legendMarkerVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				legendMarkerVisible = value;
			}
		}

		public bool LegendTextVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return legendTextVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				legendTextVisible = value;
			}
		}

		public Color LegendTextColor
		{
			get
			{
				return legendTextColor;
			}
			set
			{
				legendTextColor = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawOptions SeriesDrawOptions => drawOptions;

		public DrawOptions LegendDrawOptions => legendDrawOptions;

		public DXFont DXLegendFont
		{
			get
			{
				return fontController.DXFont;
			}
			set
			{
				fontController.DXFont = value;
			}
		}

		public DXImage DXLegendMarkerImage
		{
			get
			{
				return legendMarkerImage;
			}
			set
			{
				legendMarkerImage = value;
			}
		}

		public ChartImageSizeMode LegendMarkerImageSizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return legendMarkerImageSizeMode;
			}
			set
			{
				legendMarkerImageSizeMode = value;
			}
		}

		public Series Series => series;

		public Size LegendMarkerSize
		{
			get
			{
				return legendMarkerSize;
			}
			set
			{
				legendMarkerSize = value;
			}
		}

		public string LegendText
		{
			get
			{
				return legendText;
			}
			set
			{
				legendText = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Font LegendFont
		{
			get
			{
				return fontController.Font;
			}
			set
			{
				fontController.Font = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Image LegendMarkerImage
		{
			get
			{
				return SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(legendMarkerImage);
			}
			set
			{
				legendMarkerImage = SystemDrawingConverter.WrapImage(value);
			}
		}

		DXFont ILegendItemOptions.LegendFont => DXLegendFont;

		internal CustomDrawSeriesEventArgsBase(DrawOptions drawOptions, Series series)
		{
			this.drawOptions = drawOptions;
			this.series = series;
		}

		internal CustomDrawSeriesEventArgsBase(DrawOptions drawOptions, Series series, DrawOptions legendDrawOptions, DXImage legendMarkerImage, Size legendMarkerSize, ChartImageSizeMode legendMarkerImageSizeMode, bool legendTextVisible, Color legendTextColor, DXFont legendFont, string legendText, bool legendMarkerVisible)
		{
			this.drawOptions = drawOptions;
			this.series = series;
			this.legendText = legendText;
			this.legendDrawOptions = legendDrawOptions;
			this.legendMarkerImage = legendMarkerImage;
			this.legendTextVisible = legendTextVisible;
			this.legendTextColor = legendTextColor;
			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(legendFont, null);
			this.legendMarkerVisible = legendMarkerVisible;
			this.legendMarkerSize = legendMarkerSize;
			this.legendMarkerImageSizeMode = legendMarkerImageSizeMode;
			disposeLegendFont = false;
			disposeLegendMarkerImage = false;
		}

		void ILegendItemOptions.DisposeCustomFont(LegendBase legend)
		{
			if (DisposeLegendFont && LegendFont != null && legend != null && LegendFont != legend.Font)
			{
				LegendFont.Dispose();
				LegendFont = null;
			}
		}

		void ILegendItemOptions.DisposeCustomMarkerImage()
		{
			if (DisposeLegendMarkerImage && DXLegendMarkerImage != null)
			{
				DXLegendMarkerImage.Dispose();
				DXLegendMarkerImage = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ValueChangeInfo<T>
	{
		private readonly T oldValue;

		private readonly T newValue;

		public T OldValue => oldValue;

		public T NewValue => newValue;

		internal ValueChangeInfo(T value)
		{
			oldValue = value;
			newValue = value;

	public class CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private readonly List<CrosshairElementGroup> crosshairElementGroups;

		private readonly CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement;

		private readonly List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> crosshairAxisLabelElements;

		private readonly List<CrosshairLegendElement> crosshairLegendElements;

		private readonly List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> indicatorLegendElements;

		[Obsolete("The CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs.CrosshairGroupHeaderElements property is now obsolete. Use the CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs.CrosshairElementGroups.HeaderElement property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public IEnumerable<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement> CrosshairGroupHeaderElements
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairElementGroups)
				{
					yield return crosshairElementGroup.HeaderElement;
				}
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("The CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs.CrosshairElements property is now obsolete. Use the CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs.CrosshairElementGroups.CrosshairElements property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public IEnumerable<CrosshairElement> CrosshairElements
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairElementGroups)
				{
					foreach (CrosshairElement crosshairElement2 in crosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements)
					{
						if (crosshairElement2 is CrosshairElement crosshairElement)
						{
							yield return crosshairElement;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IList<CrosshairElementGroup> CrosshairElementGroups => crosshairElementGroups;

		public CrosshairLineElement CrosshairLineElement => crosshairLineElement;

		public IEnumerable<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> CrosshairAxisLabelElements => crosshairAxisLabelElements;

		public IList<CrosshairLegendElement> CrosshairLegendElements => crosshairLegendElements;

		public IList<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> IndicatorLegendElements => indicatorLegendElements;

		internal CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs(List<CrosshairElementGroup> crosshairElementGroups, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> axisLabelElements, List<CrosshairLegendElement> crosshairLegendElements, List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> legendElementsBase)
		{
			this.crosshairElementGroups = crosshairElementGroups;
			crosshairLineElement = lineElement;
			crosshairAxisLabelElements = axisLabelElements;
			this.crosshairLegendElements = crosshairLegendElements;
			indicatorLegendElements = legendElementsBase;
		}
	}

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LegendTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend")]
	public class Legend : LegendBase
	{
		private const int DefaultCrosshairContentOffset = 4;

		private const LegendMarkerMode DefaultMarkerMode = LegendMarkerMode.Marker;

		private const int DefaultMaxCrosshairContentWidth = 50;

		private const int DefaultMaxCrosshairContentHeight = 0;

		private int crosshairContentOffset = 4;

		private int crosshairContentOffsetScaled = 4;

		private IDockTarget dockTarget;

		private string deserializedDockTargetName;

		private LegendMarkerMode markerMode;

		private int maxCrosshairContentWidth = 50;

		private int maxCrosshairContentHeight;

		private bool? markerVisible;

		protected override bool ActualVisibleCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.ActualVisibleCore)
				{
					return markerMode != LegendMarkerMode.None;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal override bool ShouldBeDrawn
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ShouldBeDrawn)
				{
					XYDiagramPaneBase dockingPane = DockingPane;
					if (dockingPane == null)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return !dockingPane.Collapsed;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal int CrosshairContentOffsetScaled => crosshairContentOffsetScaled;

		internal override bool CheckBoxesVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (markerMode != LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox && markerMode != LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker)
				{
					return MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.MarkerAndCheckBox;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal override bool MarkersVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (markerMode != LegendMarkerMode.Marker && markerMode != LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker)
				{
					return MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.MarkerAndCheckBox;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal XYDiagramPaneBase DockingPane
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.Chart?.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
				if (DockTarget != null || base.IsOutside)
				{
					return DockTarget as XYDiagramPaneBase;
				}
				return xYDiagram2D?.DefaultPane;
			}
		}

		internal IDictionary<ILegendItem, LegendItemInfo> LegendItemsInfo { get; } = new Dictionary<ILegendItem, LegendItemInfo>();

		protected internal override ChartElement ActualDockTarget => DockTarget;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.CrosshairContentOffset")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.CrosshairContentOffset")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int CrosshairContentOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return crosshairContentOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != crosshairContentOffset)
				{
					if (value < 0 || value >= 1000)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLegendCrosshairContentOffset));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					crosshairContentOffset = value;
					if (base.Chart != null)
					{
						crosshairContentOffsetScaled = base.Chart.ScaleX(value);
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string DockTargetName
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockTarget != null)
				{
					return dockTarget.Name;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				deserializedDockTargetName = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.DockTarget")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.DockTarget")]
		[DXDisplayNameIgnore(IgnoreRecursionOnly = true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(LegendDockTargetTypeConverter))]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public ChartElement DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (ChartElement)dockTarget;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					CommonUtils.CheckDockTarget(value, this);
				}
				SetProperty(ref dockTarget, value as IDockTarget);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.MarkerMode")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.MarkerMode")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public LegendMarkerMode MarkerMode
		{
			get
			{
				return markerMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != markerMode)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					markerMode = value;
					if (base.Chart != null)
					{
						base.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateAutoLayoutSettings();
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "UseCheckBoxes"));
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.MaxCrosshairContentWidth")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.MaxCrosshairContentWidth")]

		[OldApi("This is old API. It is recommended to use the MarkerMode property instead.")]
		[Description("Specifies whether the legend markers are visible.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.MarkerVisible")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public bool MarkerVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (markerVisible.HasValue)
				{
					return markerVisible.Value;
				}
				return MarkerMode != LegendMarkerMode.None;
			}
			set
			{
				markerVisible = value;
				if (!value && MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.Marker)
				{
					MarkerMode = LegendMarkerMode.None;
				}
				else if (value && MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.None)
				{
					MarkerMode = LegendMarkerMode.Marker;
				}
			}
		}

		[OldApi("This is old API. It is recommended to use the MarkerMode property instead.")]
		[Description("Specifies a value which determines whether to use checkboxes instead of markers on a chart legend for all legend items.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Legend.UseCheckBoxes")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public bool UseCheckBoxes
		{
			get

				{
					return base.UseCheckBoxesSetByUser.Value;
				}
				return MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox;
			}
			set
			{
				base.UseCheckBoxesSetByUser = value;
				if (value)
				{
					MarkerMode = LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox;
				}
				else if (MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox)
				{
					MarkerMode = LegendMarkerMode.Marker;
				}
			}
		}

		internal Legend(ChartElement owner, string name)
			: base(owner, name)
		{
		}

		public Legend()
		{
		}

		public Legend(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCrosshairContentOffset()
		{
			return crosshairContentOffset != 4;
		}

		private void ResetCrosshairContentOffset()
		{
			CrosshairContentOffset = 4;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockTargetName()
		{
			return dockTarget != null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDockTarget()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetDockTarget()
		{
			DockTarget = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMarkerMode()
		{
			return markerMode != LegendMarkerMode.Marker;
		}

		private void ResetMarkerMode()
		{
			MarkerMode = LegendMarkerMode.Marker;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxCrosshairContentWidth()
		{
			return maxCrosshairContentWidth != 50;
		}

		private void ResetMaxCrosshairContentWidth()
		{
			maxCrosshairContentWidth = 50;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxCrosshairContentHeight()
		{
			return maxCrosshairContentHeight != 0;
		}

		private void ResetMaxCrosshairContentHeight()
		{
			maxCrosshairContentHeight = 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMarkerMode() && !ShouldSerializeDockTargetName() && !ShouldSerializeMaxCrosshairContentWidth())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMaxCrosshairContentHeight();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"MarkerMode" => ShouldSerializeMarkerMode(), 
				"DockTargetName" => ShouldSerializeDockTargetName(), 
				"SpacingHorizontal" => ShouldSerializeSpacingHorizontal(), 
				"SpacingVertical" => ShouldSerializeSpacingVertical(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (base.Chart?.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializedDockTargetName))
			{
				dockTarget = xYDiagram2D.FindPaneByName(deserializedDockTargetName);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Legend();
		}

		protected internal override void AddLegendItemInfo(LegendItemViewData item)
		{
			if (item.LegendItem != null)
			{
				LegendItemsInfo[item.LegendItem] = new LegendItemInfo(item.TextItemInfo, ((ChartLegendItemViewData)item).CrosshairItemBounds);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearLegendItemsInfos()
		{
			LegendItemsInfo.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override LegendItemViewData CreateLegendItemViewData(ILegendItemData item)
		{
			return new ChartLegendItemViewData(this, item);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Legend legend)

				crosshairContentOffset = legend.crosshairContentOffset;
				markerMode = legend.markerMode;
				dockTarget = legend.dockTarget;
				DockTargetName = legend.DockTargetName;
				maxCrosshairContentWidth = legend.MaxCrosshairContentWidth;
				maxCrosshairContentHeight = legend.MaxCrosshairContentHeight;
			}
		}

			return false;

			return false;
		}

		{
			return false;
		}

		{
			return false;

			return false;

	public enum DateTimeFormat

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DateTimeOptionsTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeOptions")]
	public class DateTimeOptions : ChartElement, IDateTimeOptions
	{
		internal const DateTimeFormat DefaultFormat = DateTimeFormat.ShortDate;

		private DateTimeFormat format;

		private DateTimeFormat autoFormat;

		private string formatString = string.Empty;

		private string autoFormatString = string.Empty;

		private bool autoFormatEnabled;

		internal Axis2D Axis
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner is AxisLabel)
				{
					return ((AxisLabel)base.Owner).Axis as Axis2D;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies the form of date-time values’ representation.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeOptions.Format")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public DateTimeFormat Format
		{
			get
			{
				return GetActualFormat();
			}
			set
			{
				if (format != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					format = value;
					autoFormatEnabled = false;
					ResetAxisLabelSizeCache();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the pattern for formatting date-time values.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeOptions.FormatString")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public string FormatString
		{
			get
			{
				return GetActualFormatString();
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.Equals(formatString, value))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					formatString = value;
					autoFormatEnabled = false;
					ResetAxisLabelSizeCache();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies whether to show date-time values in the most appropriate format in X-axis labels, series point labels or in the legend.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.DateTimeOptions.AutoFormat")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public bool AutoFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return autoFormatEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (autoFormatEnabled != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					autoFormatEnabled = value;
					ResetAxisLabelSizeCache();
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		DateTimeOptionsFormat IDateTimeOptions.Format => (DateTimeOptionsFormat)GetActualFormat();

		string IDateTimeOptions.QuarterFormat => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.QuarterFormat);

		string IDateTimeOptions.FormatString => GetActualFormatString();

		internal DateTimeOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			autoFormatEnabled = true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Format" => ShouldSerializeFormat(), 
				"FormatString" => ShouldSerializeFormatString(), 
				"AutoFormat" => ShouldSerializeAutoFormat(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFormat()
		{
			if (format != DateTimeFormat.ShortDate)
			{
				return !autoFormatEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetFormat()
		{
			Format = DateTimeFormat.ShortDate;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFormatString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(formatString) && format == DateTimeFormat.Custom)
			{
				return !autoFormatEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetFormatString()
		{
			FormatString = string.Empty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAutoFormat()
		{
			return !autoFormatEnabled;
		}

		private void ResetAutoFormat()
		{
			AutoFormat = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeFormat() && !ShouldSerializeFormatString())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAutoFormat();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private DateTimeFormat GetActualFormat()
		{
			if (!autoFormatEnabled)
			{
				return format;
			}
			return autoFormat;
		}

		private string GetActualFormatString()
		{
			if (!autoFormatEnabled)
			{
				return formatString;
			}
			return autoFormatString;
		}

		private void ResetAxisLabelSizeCache()
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				Axis.ResetScrollLabelSizeCache();
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new DateTimeOptions(null);
		}

		internal bool AllowDesignTimeEditing()
		{
			if (base.Owner is PointOptions pointOptions)
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = pointOptions.ChartContainer.Chart;
				if (chart != null)
				{
					return !PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions, pointOptions.SeriesBase);
				}
			}
			AxisXBase axisXBase = ((base.Owner is AxisLabel axisLabel) ? (axisLabel.Axis as AxisXBase) : null);
			if (axisXBase != null)
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart2 = ((axisXBase.Diagram != null) ? axisXBase.Diagram.Chart : null);
				if (chart2 != null)
				{
					return !PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(chart2.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions, axisXBase, checkAxisY: false);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetAutoFormat(DateTimeFormat format, string formatString)
		{
			autoFormatString = formatString;
			autoFormat = format;
			ResetAxisLabelSizeCache();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(DateTimeOptions)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is DateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions)
			{
				format = dateTimeOptions.format;
				formatString = dateTimeOptions.formatString;
				autoFormatEnabled = dateTimeOptions.autoFormatEnabled;
				autoFormatString = dateTimeOptions.autoFormatString;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions && format == dateTimeOptions.format && formatString == dateTimeOptions.formatString)
			{
				return autoFormatEnabled == dateTimeOptions.autoFormatEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(NumericOptionsTypeConverter))]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericOptions")]
	public sealed class NumericOptions : ChartElement, INumericOptions
	{
		private const int DefaultPrecision = 2;

		private const NumericFormat DefaultFormat = NumericFormat.General;

		private NumericFormat format;

		private int precision = 2;

		private bool formatPropertyWasSet;

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies the formatting applied to numeric values.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericOptions.Format")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public NumericFormat Format
		{
			get
			{
				return format;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != format)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					formatPropertyWasSet = true;
					format = value;
					if (ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.DesignMode && !Loading && format == NumericFormat.Percent && base.Owner is PointOptions { ShouldSynchronizeValuePercentPrecision: not false } pointOptions)
					{
						SynchronizePrecision(pointOptions.GetValuePercentPrecisionForSynchronization());
					}
				}
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum number of digits displayed to the right of the decimal point.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.NumericOptions.Precision")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Precision
		{
			get
			{
				return precision;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != precision)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectNumericPrecision));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					precision = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		NumericOptionsFormat INumericOptions.Format => (NumericOptionsFormat)format;

		internal NumericOptions(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Format"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Precision")
				{
					return ShouldSerializePrecision();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFormat()
		{
			if (format == NumericFormat.General && !formatPropertyWasSet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ResetFormat()
		{
			Format = NumericFormat.General;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePrecision()
		{
			return precision != 2;
		}

		private void ResetPrecision()
		{
			Precision = 2;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeFormat())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePrecision();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SynchronizePrecision(int precision)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(precision >= 0);
			if (precision >= 0)
			{
				this.precision = precision;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new NumericOptions(null);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(NumericOptions)";
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is NumericOptions numericOptions)
			{
				format = numericOptions.format;
				precision = numericOptions.precision;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is NumericOptions numericOptions && format == numericOptions.format)
			{
				return precision == numericOptions.precision;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public class Series : SeriesBase, IDisposable, ISupportInitialize, ICustomTypeDescriptor, ISeries, ISeriesBase, ISeriesPointFactory, IXtraSerializable, ISupportID, IResamplingSupportSeries, ISeriesBindingProvider, IBindingProvider, IUpdateHelper, IViewportChangedNotifiable
	{
		private class SeriesPropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
		{
			public SeriesPropertyDescriptorCollection(Series series, ICollection descriptors)
				: base(new PropertyDescriptor[0])
			{
				//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0096: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0065: Expected O, but got Unknown
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor descriptor in descriptors)
				{
					if (descriptor.DisplayName == "DataSource")
					{
						Add((PropertyDescriptor)new CustomPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, ((series.ChartContainer != null) ? series.ChartContainer.DataProvider : null)?.SeriesDataSourceVisible ?? true));
					}
					else if (descriptor.DisplayName == "Points" && ShouldProcessPointsProperty(series))
					{
						Add((PropertyDescriptor)new CustomPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, true, series.UnboundMode));
					}
					else
					{
						Add(descriptor);
					}
				}
			}

			private bool ShouldProcessPointsProperty(Series series)
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = series.Chart;
				if (chart != null && !chart.XtraSerializing && chart.Container != null)
				{
					return chart.Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal string ActualLegendText
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowInLegend || (base.View.ShouldAddSeriesPointsInLegend && !base.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(base.LegendTextPattern, base.View);
				patternParser.SetContext(this);
				string text = patternParser.GetText();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
				return Name;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDataAdapterChanged(object sender, ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args is DataSourceChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.Changing)
				{
					if (!Loading && !base.DesignMode)
					{
						CheckBindingRuntime(e.DataSource);
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
				}
				else if (base.Chart != null && base.Chart.Container != null && !base.Chart.Container.Loading)
				{
					CheckBinding(e.DataSource ?? base.Chart.DataContainer.DataSource);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DataWasChanged(new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(this, (ChartDataSourceUpdateType)args.UpdateType, args.ItemIndex, args.Count));
			}
		}

		private void AlignPointsToView()
		{
			if (ActualPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(this);
			IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
			int pointDimension = base.View.PointDimension;
			bool flag = pointDimension < list[0].ValuesCount;
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = list[i];
				if (flag && seriesPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(this, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged, i, 1));
				}
				seriesPoint.IncreaseDimension(pointDimension);
			}
			if (dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				DataWasChanged(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateArguments(ScaleType scaleType, bool throwException = true)
		{
			if (scaleType == ScaleType.Auto || UseRandomPoints || Loading || ActualPoints == null || ActualSeriesPoints.IsBoundPoints)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint actualSeriesPoint in ActualSeriesPoints)
			{
				if (!actualSeriesPoint.IsAuxiliary && !AxisScaleTypeMap.CheckArgumentScaleType(actualSeriesPoint, (Scale)scaleType))
				{
					if (throwException)
					{
						string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatiblePointType), actualSeriesPoint.Argument, SeriesBase.GetScaleTypeName(scaleType));
						throw new ArgumentException(message);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void EnsureSeriesPoints()
		{
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(this);
			dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
		}

		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)

				toolTipImage.Dispose();

			else

			}
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetActualArgumentScaleType()
		{
			ScaleType scaleFromDataSource = GetScaleFromDataSource();
			if (scaleFromDataSource != ScaleType.Auto)

				return scaleFromDataSource;
			}
			return argumentScaleByCore;
		}

		{
			if (DataAdapter == null)

				return base.GetScaleFromDataSourceCore();

			return DataAdapterHelper.GetArgumentScaleType(DataAdapter);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanged(ChartElement sender, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (base.Label != null)
			{
				base.Label.UpdateTextPattern(sender);
			}
			UpdateLegendTextPattern(sender);
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				base.Owner.DataChanged(change);
			}
			return false;
		}

			base.ProcessSetView();
			AlignPointsToView();
