		internal void RecreateBindingProcessor()
		{
			bindingProcessor = CreateBindingProcessor();
			if (!Loading)
			{
				((IResamplingSupportSeries)this).UpdateVisibleFromDataSource(((IResamplingSupportSeries)this).GetRefinedSeries());
			}
		}

		protected override void SetValueScaleType(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			SetValueScaleTypeField(valueScaleType);
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(this);
			IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = list[i];
				if (((ISeriesPoint)seriesPoint).IsEmpty(Scale.Auto))
				{
					seriesPoint.UpdateValueScaleType(valueScaleType);
				}
			}
		}

				return base.XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName, e);
			}
			return new SeriesPoint();
		}

		protected override void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Points")
			{
				Points.Add((SeriesPoint)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
			base.XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(propertyName, e);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Name":
				return ShouldSerializeName();
			case "Points":
				return ShouldSerializePoints();
			case "SeriesID":
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesID();
			case "ToolTipImage":
				return ShouldSerializeToolTipImage();
			case "DataSource":
				if (ChartContainer != null && ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.XRControl)
				{
					return DataSource != null;
				}
				return false;
			case "DataAdapter":
				return ShouldSerializeDataAdapter();
			default:
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsNegative()
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Chart.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(this);
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
				{
					if (((IValuePoint)point).Value < 0.0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (((IValuePoint)point).Value > 0.0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading(bool validatePointsId)
		{
			AlignPointsToView();
			Points.OnEndLoading(validatePointsId);
			base.OnEndLoading(validatePointsId);
		}

		{
			ValidateArguments(argumentScaleType);
			base.SetArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType);
		}

		{
			return true;

		protected internal override bool ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(ScaleType argumentScaleType, bool allowEmptyDataSource, bool throwException)
		{
			bool flag = base.ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType, allowEmptyDataSource, throwException);
			return flag & ValidateArguments(argumentScaleType, throwException);
		}

		protected internal override void ValidatePointsByValueScaleType(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			base.ValidatePointsByValueScaleType(valueScaleType);
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(this);
			IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = list[i];
				if (!seriesPoint.CheckValueScaleType(valueScaleType))
				{
					string message = string.Format(arg0: (seriesPoint.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime) ? seriesPoint.DateTimeValues[0].ToString() : ((seriesPoint.ValueScaleType != ScaleType.TimeSpan) ? seriesPoint.Values[0].ToString() : seriesPoint.TimeSpanValues[0].ToString()), format: ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatiblePointType), arg1: SeriesBase.GetScaleTypeName(valueScaleType));
					throw new ArgumentException(message);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual SeriesPoint GetPointByID(int id)
		{
			return ActualSeriesPoints.GetById(id);
		}

		internal bool ArePointEquals(IList<IDataPoint> points)
		{
			if (points.Count != ActualPoints.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ActualPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!ActualPoints[i].Equals(points[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void BeginPointsUpdate()
		{
			pointsUpdateInProcess = true;
		}

		internal void ClearAnnotations()
		{
			int count = ActualSeriesPoints.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				ActualPoints[i].ClearAnnotations();
			}
		}

		internal SeriesBindingProcessor CreateBindingProcessor()
		{
			return new SeriesBindingProcessor(this, ActualSeriesPoints.BoundPoints);
		}

		internal void DataSnapshot()
		{
			autocreated = false;
			ActualSeriesPoints.ReplaceBoundPointsToInternal();
			bindingProcessor.SetUnboundMode(value: true);
			DataSource = null;
			base.ArgumentDataMember = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ValueDataMembers.Count; i++)
			{
				base.ValueDataMembers[i] = string.Empty;
			}
			base.FilterCriteria = null;
		}

		internal void EndPointsUpdate()
		{
			pointsUpdateInProcess = false;
			RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "Points"));
		}

		internal Color GetPointColor(IDataPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint is SeriesPoint seriesPoint2)
			{
				return seriesPoint2.Color;
			}
			return Color.Empty;
		}

		internal bool IsBoundDataChanged()
		{
			if (CanUseBoundPoints)
			{
				IList<IDataPoint> boundPoints = bindingProcessor.GetBoundPoints();
				if (boundPoints != null)
				{
					return !ArePointEquals(boundPoints);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void NotifyPointInsert(IDataPoint boundPoint, int index)
		{
			ChartUpdate change = new ChartUpdate(new SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, this, null, -1, boundPoint, index));
			base.ViewController.RaiseChanged(change);
		}

		internal void NotifyPointsReset()
		{
			ViewController viewController = base.ViewController;
			if (viewController != null)
			{
				ChartUpdate change = new ChartUpdate(new SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, this, null, -1, null, -1));
				viewController.RaiseChanged(change);
			}
		}

		internal void RenderLegendItem(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = HitTestController;
			if (base.View.HitTestingSupportedForLegendMarker)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, this, pointData?.RefinedPoint, new HitRegion(bounds));
			}
			if (base.ActualPointToolTipEnabled && pointData != null)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, this, new ChartFocusedArea(pointData.SeriesPoint), new HitRegion(bounds), force: true);
			}
			else if (base.ActualSeriesToolTipEnabled)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, this, new ChartFocusedArea(this), new HitRegion(bounds), force: true);
			}
			base.View.RenderLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, seriesDrawOptions, seriesData, pointData);
		}

		internal bool ShouldRefreshData()
		{
			if (ActualDataSource != null)
			{
				return !(ActualDataSource is IBindingList);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetBinding()
		{
			SeriesPointCollection actualSeriesPoints = ActualSeriesPoints;
			actualSeriesPoints.Unlock = true;
			actualSeriesPoints.ClearInternalPoints();
			actualSeriesPoints.Unlock = false;
		}

		internal SeriesPoint GetPointByID(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return ActualSeriesPoints.GetById(point);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Series series)
			{
				name = series.name;
				toolTipImage.Assign(series.toolTipImage);
				base.View.SynchronizePoints();
				autocreated = series.autocreated;
				id = series.id;
			}
		}

		public void BindToData(object dataSource, string argumentDataMember, params string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			if (dataSource != ActualDataSource)
			{
				CheckBindingRuntime(dataSource, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
			}
			object obj = ((dataSource != null) ? dataSource : ((base.Owner != null) ? base.Owner.DataSource : null));
			if (obj != null)
			{
				if (argumentDataMember != base.ActualArgumentDataMember)
				{
					CheckDataMember(obj, argumentDataMember, base.ArgumentScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleArgumentDataMember));
				}
				int num = Math.Min(valueDataMembers.Length, 6);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					CheckDataMember(dataSource, valueDataMembers[i], base.ValueScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember));
				}
				if (valueDataMembers.Length > 6)
				{
					CheckCollectionDataMember(valueDataMembers[6]);
				}
				AdapterController.BindToData(dataSource, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public bool DrillDown()
		{
			if (base.DataContainer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.DataContainer.DrillDownToSeries(this);
		}

		public bool DrillDownToPoint(object seriesPointObject)
		{
			if (base.DataContainer != null)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = seriesPointObject as SeriesPoint;
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					seriesPoint = base.DataContainer.GetSeriesPointByUserObject(this, seriesPointObject);
				}
				if (seriesPoint != null)
				{
					return base.DataContainer.DrillDownToPoint(seriesPoint.Series, seriesPoint);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsCompatible(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("point");
			}
			if (AxisScaleTypeMap.CheckArgumentScaleType(point, (Scale)base.ArgumentScaleType))
			{
				return point.CheckValueScaleType(base.ValueScaleType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!base.Visible)
			{
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.InvisibleSeriesView) + " " + name;
			}
			if (base.Chart == null || !base.Chart.ViewController.SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics.IsSeriesIncompatible(this))
			{
				return name;
			}
			return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.IncompatibleSeriesView) + " " + name;
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner == null)
				{
					return false;

				{

		internal bool CanBoundToData
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetDataSource() == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IList<string> actualValueDataMembers = GetActualValueDataMembers(view.SupportedValueLevels);
				IList<string> list;
				if (!IsSummaryBinding)
				{
					list = actualValueDataMembers;
				}
				else
				{
					IList<string> arguments = new SummaryFunctionParser(ActualSummaryFunction).Arguments;
					list = arguments;
				}
				IList<string> list2 = list;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ActualArgumentDataMember) && (IsSummaryBinding || actualValueDataMembers.Count > 0) && AreNecessaryValueDataMembersSet(list2))
				{
					return true;
				}
				ScaleType scaleFromDataSource = GetScaleFromDataSource();
				if (View != null && View.CanLoadOneDimensionData(scaleFromDataSource))
				{
					bool flag = true;
					foreach (string item in list2)
					{
						flag &= string.IsNullOrEmpty(item);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						return scaleFromDataSource != ScaleType.Auto;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return ValueDataMembers.ToString();

			{
				ValueDataMemberCollection valueDataMemberCollection = new ValueDataMemberCollection(value);
				if (!Loading && valueDataMemberCollection.Count != view.PointDimension)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectValueDataMemberCount), view.PointDimension.ToString()));
				}
				ValueDataMembers.Assign(valueDataMemberCollection);
			}
		}

		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ScaleType ArgumentScaleType
		{
			get
			{
				return argumentScaleType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != argumentScaleType)
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(value, allowEmptyDataSource: false);
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					ScaleType oldValue = argumentScaleType;
					SetArgumentScaleType(value);
					OnDataPropertyChanged();
					RaisePropertyChanged("ArgumentScaleType", oldValue, argumentScaleType);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that determines whether a legend check box is checked for a chart series.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesBase.CheckedInLegend")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayNameIgnore]
		public bool CheckedInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return checkedInLegend;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != checkedInLegend)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					checkedInLegend = value;
					if (ContainerAdapter != null)
					{
						ContainerAdapter.OnLegendItemChecked(new LegendItemCheckedEventArgs(this, value));
					}
					Series series = this as Series;
					if (base.Chart != null && series != null && series.Autocreated)
					{
						base.Chart.OnAutoSeriesCheckedInLegend(series, value);
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, Series.CheckedInLegendProperty));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ThrowIncompatibleScaleTypeException(ChartStringId stringId, ScaleType scaleType, SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(stringId), GetScaleTypeName(scaleType), (view == null) ? string.Empty : view.StringId));
		}

		private static void ThrowInvalidScaleTypeException(ChartStringId stringId, string dataMember, ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(stringId), dataMember, GetScaleTypeName(scaleType)));
		}

		private static void ThrowIncompatibleSummaryFunctionException(ChartStringId stringId, SummaryFunctionDescription description, ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(stringId), description.DisplayName, GetScaleTypeName(scaleType)));
		}

		internal static string CutDataMember(string chartDataMember, string dataMember)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(chartDataMember) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) || !dataMember.StartsWith(chartDataMember + "."))
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			return dataMember.Remove(0, chartDataMember.Length + 1);
		}

		internal static string GetScaleTypeName(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			return ScaleTypeUtils.GetName(scaleType);
		}

		private void UpdateValueDataMembersCollection()
		{
			ValueDataMembers.Clear();
			ValueDataMembers.AddRange(valueDataMemberStorage.Where((string x) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x)).ToArray());
		}

		public SeriesBase()
			: this(SeriesViewFactory.DefaultViewType)
		{
		}

		public SeriesBase(ViewType viewType)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			viewSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<SeriesViewBase>(() => View, delegate(SeriesViewBase value)
			{
				View = value;
			});
			labelSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<SeriesLabelBase>(() => Label, delegate(SeriesLabelBase value)
			{
				Label = value;
			});
			legendPointOptionsSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<PointOptions>(() => legendPointOptions, delegate(PointOptions value)
			{
				SetLegendPointOptions(value);
			});
			pointOptionsSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<PointOptions>(() => (Label == null) ? null : Label.PointOptionsInternal, delegate(PointOptions value)
			{
				if (Label != null)
				{
					Label.PointOptionsInternal = value;
				}
			}, shouldSerialize: false);
			colorizerSerializerWrapper = new AspxSerializerWrapper<ChartColorizerBase>(() => view.Colorizer as ChartColorizerBase, delegate(ChartColorizerBase value)
			{
				view.Colorizer = value;
			});
			dataFilters = new DataFilterCollection(this);
			topNOptions = new TopNOptions(this);
			crosshairTextOptions = new TextOptions(this);
			pointOptionsSynchronizer = new ChartElementSynchronizer();
			SetView(SeriesViewFactory.CreateInstance(viewType), assignParams: true);
			filterHelper = new SeriesFilterHelper(this);
		}

		ISeriesPoint ISeriesPointFactory.CreateSeriesPoint(ISeries owner, object argument)
		{
			return new SeriesPoint((Series)owner, argument, new object[0], null);
		}

		IDataPoint ISeriesPointFactory.CreateSeriesPoint(ISeries owner, object tag, SeriesPointDataContainer templateContainer, IRowData rowData)
		{
			SeriesPointDataContainer seriesPointDataContainer = templateContainer.Create(rowData.DataMemberContainers, rowData.IsEmpty);
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint((Series)owner, seriesPointDataContainer, tag);
			if (rowData.AdditionalContainers != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ToolTipHintDataMember))
				{
					object boxedValue = rowData.AdditionalContainers[ToolTipHintDataMember].BoxedValue;
					seriesPoint.ToolTipHint = ((boxedValue != null) ? boxedValue.ToString() : string.Empty);
				}
				IIndicatorDataPoint indicatorDataPoint = BindingHelperCore.CreateIndicatorPoint(((ISeriesBase)this).Indicators, rowData.AdditionalContainers);
				if (indicatorDataPoint != null)
				{
					seriesPoint.IndicatorPoint = indicatorDataPoint;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ColorDataMember))
				{
					object boxedValue2 = rowData.AdditionalContainers[ColorDataMember].BoxedValue;
					if (boxedValue2 != null)
					{
						object userArgument = ((ISeriesPointArgument)seriesPoint).UserArgument;
						object[] array = new object[seriesPointDataContainer.Dimension];
						for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							switch (seriesPointDataContainer.ValueScaleType)
							{
							case Scale.DateTime:
								array[i] = seriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues[i];
								break;
							case Scale.TimeSpan:
								array[i] = seriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues[i];
								break;
							default:
								array[i] = seriesPointDataContainer.Values[i];
								break;
							}
						}
						seriesPoint.Color = view.ColorProvider.GetColor(userArgument, array, boxedValue2, this);
					}
				}
			}
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		IDataPoint ISeriesPointFactory.CreateSeriesPoint(ISeries owner, object argument, object[] values, object tag, object[] colors)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint((Series)owner, argument, values, tag);
			if (colors != null && colors.Length != 0)
			{
				seriesPoint.Color = view.ColorProvider.GetColor(argument, values, colors, this);
			}
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"ArgumentDataMember" => ShouldSerializeArgumentDataMember(), 
				"ValueDataMembersSerializable" => ShouldSerializeValueDataMembersSerializable(), 
				"ToolTipHintDataMember" => ShouldSerializeToolTipHintDataMember(), 
				"SummaryFunction" => ShouldSerializeSummaryFunction(), 
				"View" => ShouldSerializeViewCore(), 
				"DataFiltersConjunctionMode" => ShouldSerializeDataFiltersConjunctionMode(), 
				"ArgumentScaleType" => ShouldSerializeArgumentScaleType(), 
				"ValueScaleType" => ShouldSerializeValueScaleType(), 
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"ShowInLegend" => ShouldSerializeShowInLegend(), 
				"LegendText" => ShouldSerializeLegendText(), 
				"Label" => ShouldSerializeLabelCore(), 
				"PointOptions" => ShouldSerializePointOptions(), 
				"SeriesPointsSorting" => ShouldSerializeSeriesPointsSorting(), 
				"SeriesPointsSortingKey" => ShouldSerializeSeriesPointsSortingKey(), 
				"ToolTipSeriesPattern" => ShouldSerializeToolTipSeriesPattern(), 
				"ToolTipPointPattern" => ShouldSerializeToolTipPointPattern(), 
				"CrosshairEnabled" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairEnabled(), 
				"CrosshairLabelVisibility" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairLabelVisibility(), 
				"CrosshairLabelPattern" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairLabelPattern(), 
				"CrosshairHighlightPoints" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairHighlightPoints(), 
				"ToolTipEnabled" => ShouldSerializeToolTipEnabled(), 
				"LabelsVisibility" => ShouldSerializeLabelsVisibility(), 
				"CheckedInLegend" => ShouldSerializeCheckedInLegend(), 
				"CheckableInLegend" => ShouldSerializeCheckableInLegend(), 
				"LegendTextPattern" => ShouldSerializeLegendTextPattern(), 
				"LegendPointOptions" => ShouldSerializeLegendPointOptions(), 
				"LegendName" => ShouldSerializeLegendName(), 
				"FilterString" => ShouldSerializeFilterString(), 
				"DataFilters" => ShouldSerializeDataFilters(), 
				"DataSorted" => ShouldSerializeDataSorted(), 
				"CrosshairContentShowMode" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairContentShowMode(), 
				"CrosshairEmptyValueLegendText" => ShouldSerializeCrosshairEmptyValueLegendText(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeArgumentDataMember() && !ShouldSerializeSummaryFunction() && !ShouldSerializeValueDataMembersSerializable() && !ShouldSerializeView() && !ShouldSerializeDataFiltersConjunctionMode() && !ShouldSerializeArgumentScaleType() && !ShouldSerializeValueScaleType() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeShowInLegend() && !ShouldSerializeLabelCore() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesViewTypeName() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesPointsSorting() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesPointsSortingKey() && !ShouldSerializeTopNOptions() && !ShouldSerializeCrosshairTextOptions() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipHintDataMember() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipSeriesPattern() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipPointPattern() && !ShouldSerializeCrosshairEnabled() && !ShouldSerializeCrosshairLabelVisibility() && !ShouldSerializeCrosshairLabelPattern() && !ShouldSerializeCrosshairHighlightPoints() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipEnabled() && !ShouldSerializeLabelsVisibility() && !ShouldSerializeCheckedInLegend() && !ShouldSerializeLegendTextPattern() && !ShouldSerializeLegendName() && !ShouldSerializeFilterString() && !ShouldSerializeDataFilters() && !ShouldSerializeCrosshairContentShowMode() && !ShouldSerializeNumericSummaryOptions() && !ShouldSerializeDateTimeSummaryOptions() && !ShouldSerializeTimeSpanSummaryOptions() && !ShouldSerializeQualitativeSummaryOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDataSorted();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanCheckDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			if (!Loading && dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				if (base.Chart != null)

					return base.Chart.DataContainer.ValidateDataMembers;
				}

			}

		private void CreateNewSeriesLabel(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			SeriesLabelBase seriesLabelBase = view.CreateSeriesLabel();
			if (seriesLabelBase != null)
			{
				seriesLabelBase.SetNewPointOptions(view.CreatePointOptions());
				if (label != null)
				{
					seriesLabelBase.Assign(label);
				}
				seriesLabelBase.EnsureResolveOverlappingMode();
			}
			SetSeriesLabel(seriesLabelBase);
		}

		private void SetSeriesLabel(SeriesLabelBase newLabel)
		{
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PointOptions pointOptions = null;
			if (newLabel != null && newLabel.PointOptionsInternal == null)
			{
				pointOptions = (PointOptions)label.PointOptionsInternal.Clone();
			}
			label = newLabel;
			if (label == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			label.SeriesBase = this;
			if (label.PointOptionsInternal != null)
			{
				if (pointOptions != null)
				{
					label.PointOptionsInternal.Assign(pointOptions);
				}
				pointOptionsSynchronizer.Source = label.PointOptionsInternal;
				label.PointOptionsInternal.Synchronizer = pointOptionsSynchronizer;
			}
			if ((int)label.InternalVisibility != 2)
			{
				LabelsVisibility = label.InternalVisibility;
			}
		}

		private void CreateNewLegendPointOptions(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			PointOptions pointOptions = view.CreatePointOptions();
			if (legendPointOptions != null)
			{
				pointOptions.Assign(legendPointOptions);
			}
			SetLegendPointOptions(pointOptions, updateLegendTextPattern: false);
		}

		private void SetLegendPointOptions(PointOptions pointOptions)
		{
			SetLegendPointOptions(pointOptions, updateLegendTextPattern: true);
		}

		private void SetLegendPointOptions(PointOptions pointOptions, bool updateLegendTextPattern)
		{
			legendPointOptions = pointOptions;
			if (legendPointOptions != null)
			{
				legendPointOptions.SeriesBase = this;
				legendPointOptions.Synchronizer = pointOptionsSynchronizer;
				pointOptionsSynchronizer.Destination = legendPointOptions;
				if (updateLegendTextPattern)
				{
					UpdateLegendTextPattern(legendPointOptions);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateView(SeriesViewBase view, bool assignParams)
		{
			if (this.view != view)
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
				SetView(view, assignParams);
				RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
			}
		}

		private void AssignView(SeriesViewBase templateView)
		{
			if (templateView != null)
			{
				if (view == null || !view.GetType().Equals(templateView.GetType()))
				{
					SetView((SeriesViewBase)templateView.Clone(), assignParams: false);
				}
				else if (view != null)
				{
					view.Assign(templateView);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetView(null, assignParams: false);
			}
		}

		internal void SetView(SeriesViewBase view, bool assignParams)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				this.view = null;
				return;
			}
			hitTestState = view.CreateHitTestState();
			hitTestState.Series = this;
			if (!Loading)
			{
				CheckScaleTypes(view);
			}
			UpdateScaleTypes(view);
			view.Owner = this;
			if (this.view != null && this.view.Colorizer != null)
			{
				view.Colorizer = this.view.Colorizer;
			}
			if (assignParams && this.view != null)
			{
				view.Assign(this.view);
			}
			SeriesViewBase seriesViewBase = this.view;
			this.view = view;
			ProcessSetView();
			ValueDataMembers.SetDimension(this.view.PointDimension);
			if (!CheckSortingKey(pointsSortingKey))
			{
				pointsSortingKey = SeriesPointKey.Argument;
			}
			if (!Loading)
			{
				try
				{
					CheckSummaryFunction(ActualSummaryFunction);
				}
				catch
				{
					SetSummaryFunction(string.Empty);
				}
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("View", seriesViewBase, this.view);
			if (base.Chart != null && seriesViewBase != null && view.DiagramType != seriesViewBase.DiagramType)
			{
				view.BindViewToDiagram();
			}
			CreateNewSeriesLabel(view);
			CreateNewLegendPointOptions(view);
		}

		internal bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != this && obj != label && (view == null || !view.Contains(obj)))
			{
				if (label != null)
				{
					return label.Contains(obj);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool AreNecessaryValueDataMembersSet(IList<string> valueDataMembers)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(5, valueDataMembers.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				string dataMember = valueDataMembers[i];
				if (BoxPlotConventions.IsMissingDataMember(dataMember))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void CheckCollectionDataMember(string dataMember)
		{
			string dataMember2 = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(GetChartDataMember(), dataMember);
			object dataSource = GetDataSource();
			if (!BindingHelper.CheckCollectionDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, dataMember2, GetCalculatedFields()))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), dataMember));
			}
		}

		internal bool CheckDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember, bool raiseException)
		{
			if (CanCheckDataMember(dataSource, dataMember))
			{
				string dataMember2 = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(GetChartDataMember(), dataMember);
				bool flag = BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, dataMember2, GetCalculatedFields());
				if (!flag && raiseException)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), dataMember));
				}
				return flag;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void CheckDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember, ScaleType? scaleType, string incompatibleScaleTypeFormat)
		{
			if (CanCheckDataMember(dataSource, dataMember))
			{
				string dataMember2 = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(GetChartDataMember(), dataMember);
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, dataMember2, GetCalculatedFields()))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), dataMember));
				}
				if (scaleType.HasValue && !BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, dataMember2, scaleType.Value, GetCalculatedFields()))
				{
					string message = string.Format(incompatibleScaleTypeFormat, dataMember, GetScaleTypeName(scaleType.Value));
					throw new ArgumentException(message);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CheckSummaryFunction(object dataSource, string functionString)
		{
			SummaryFunctionParser summaryFunctionParser = new SummaryFunctionParser(functionString);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryFunctionParser.FunctionName))
			{
				return;
			}
			SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = ((base.Chart == null) ? null : base.Chart.SummaryFunctions[summaryFunctionParser.FunctionName]);
			if (summaryFunctionDescription != null)
			{
				if (summaryFunctionDescription.ResultScaleType.HasValue && summaryFunctionDescription.ResultScaleType.Value != valueScaleType)
				{
					ThrowIncompatibleSummaryFunctionException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleSummaryFunction, summaryFunctionDescription, valueScaleType);
				}
				if (summaryFunctionDescription.ResultDimension != view.PointDimension)
				{
					string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleSummaryFunctionDimension), summaryFunctionParser.FunctionName, view.StringId, summaryFunctionDescription.ResultDimension, view.PointDimension);
					throw new ArgumentException(message);
				}
				if (summaryFunctionDescription.ArgumentDescriptions.Length != summaryFunctionParser.Arguments.Length)
				{
					string message2 = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSummaryFunctionParametersCount), summaryFunctionDescription.DisplayName, summaryFunctionDescription.ArgumentDescriptions.Length, summaryFunctionParser.Arguments.Length);
					throw new ArgumentException(message2);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < summaryFunctionParser.Arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				ScaleType? scaleType = null;
				if (summaryFunctionDescription != null)
				{
					scaleType = summaryFunctionDescription.ArgumentDescriptions[i].ScaleType;
					if (!scaleType.HasValue && summaryFunctionDescription.IsStandard)
					{
						scaleType = valueScaleType;
					}
				}
				CheckDataMember(dataSource, summaryFunctionParser.Arguments[i], scaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember));
			}
		}

		internal void CheckBinding(object dataSource)
		{
			if (DataContainer != null && !DataContainer.ValidateDataMembers)
			{
				return;
			}
			string chartDataMember = GetChartDataMember();
			if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, ActualArgumentDataMember), ArgumentScaleType, GetCalculatedFields()))
			{
				SetArgumentDataMember(string.Empty);
			}
			IList<string> actualValueDataMembers = GetActualValueDataMembers(View.SupportedValueLevels);
			int num = Math.Min(actualValueDataMembers.Count, 6);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				string dataMember = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, actualValueDataMembers[i]);
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, dataMember, valueScaleType, GetCalculatedFields()))
				{
					ClearValueDataMember(i);
				}
			}
			if (actualValueDataMembers.Count == 7)
			{
				string dataMember2 = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, actualValueDataMembers[6]);
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckCollectionDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, dataMember2, GetCalculatedFields()))
				{
					ClearValueDataMember(6);
				}
			}
			if (IsSummaryBinding)
			{
				try
				{
					CheckSummaryFunction(dataSource, ActualSummaryFunction);
				}
				catch
				{
					SetSummaryFunction(string.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void BindingChanged()
		{
			BindingChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
		}

		internal void BreakPointOptionsRelations()
		{
			pointOptionsSynchronizer.IsSynchronized = false;
		}

		internal void ValidateIndicators(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (!(view is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Indicator indicator in xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.Indicators)
			{
				indicator.Validate(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase, refinedSeries);
			}
		}

		internal void CheckBindingRuntime(object dataSource, string argumentDataMember, IList<string> valueDataMembers)
		{
			if (base.Chart == null || !Equals(base.Chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate) || !(dataSource is IChartDataSource) || !base.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoBindingSettingsEnabled)
			{
				CheckDataMember(dataSource, argumentDataMember, ArgumentScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleArgumentDataMember));
			}
			int num = Math.Min(valueDataMembers.Count, 6);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				CheckDataMember(dataSource, valueDataMembers[i], ValueScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 6)
			{
				CheckCollectionDataMember(valueDataMembers[6]);
			}
			CheckSummaryFunction(dataSource, ActualSummaryFunction);
		}

		internal void CheckBindingRuntime(object dataSource)
		{
			CheckBindingRuntime(dataSource, ActualArgumentDataMember, GetActualValueDataMembers());
		}

		internal void ValidateArgumentScaleType()
		{
			if (!SeriesScaleTypeUtils.ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(this, ArgumentScaleType, allowEmptyDataSource: true, !DesignMode))
			{
				SetArgumentScaleType(ScaleType.Auto);
			}
		}

		internal void AddValueDataMembersToAdapter(DataSourceAdapterBase adapter, IList<string> valueDataMembers)
		{
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 0)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Value, valueDataMembers[0], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Low, valueDataMembers[0], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Value_1, valueDataMembers[0], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMin, valueDataMembers[0], ValueScaleType));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 1)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.High, valueDataMembers[1], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Weight, valueDataMembers[1], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Value_2, valueDataMembers[1], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_1, valueDataMembers[1], ValueScaleType));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 2)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Open, valueDataMembers[2], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMedian, valueDataMembers[2], ValueScaleType));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 3)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Close, valueDataMembers[3], ValueScaleType));
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_3, valueDataMembers[3], ValueScaleType));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 4)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMax, valueDataMembers[4], ValueScaleType));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 5)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMean, valueDataMembers[5], ValueScaleType));
			}
			if (valueDataMembers.Count > 6)
			{
				adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotOutliers, valueDataMembers[6], ValueScaleType));
			}
		}

		{

			{

			}
			this.argumentScaleType = argumentScaleType;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEndLoading(bool validatePointsId)
		{
			if (base.Chart != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(legendName))
			{
				legend = base.Chart.FindLegendByName(legendName);
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(base.Owner, "Legend"));
			}
			if (view != null)
			{
				view.OnEndLoading();
			}
			if (label != null)
			{
				label.OnEndLoading();
			}
			pointOptionsSynchronizer.EndLoading();
			foreach (DataFilter dataFilter in dataFilters)
			{
				dataFilter.OnEndLoading();
			}
			string chartDataMember = ((DataContainer != null) ? DataContainer.DataMember : null);
			UpdateArgumentAndValueDataMembers(chartDataMember);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(ScaleType argumentScaleType, bool allowEmptyDataSource, bool throwException = true)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (argumentScaleType != ScaleType.Numerical && !view.NonNumericArgumentSupported)
			{
				if (throwException)
				{
					ThrowIncompatibleScaleTypeException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleArgumentScaleType, argumentScaleType, view);
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, GetDataSource(), BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(GetChartDataMember(), ActualArgumentDataMember), argumentScaleType, GetCalculatedFields(), allowEmptyDataSource))
			{
				if (throwException)
				{
					ThrowInvalidScaleTypeException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleArgumentDataMember, ActualArgumentDataMember, argumentScaleType);
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			if (view != null)
			{
				flag &= view.CheckArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType, throwException);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ValidatePointsByValueScaleType(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			if (valueScaleType == ScaleType.Qualitative || valueScaleType == ScaleType.Auto || ((valueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || valueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan) && view != null && !view.DateTimeValuesSupported))
			{
				ThrowIncompatibleScaleTypeException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueScaleType, valueScaleType, view);
			}
			object dataSource = GetDataSource();
			string chartDataMember = GetChartDataMember();
			if (IsSummaryBinding)
			{
				SummaryFunctionParser summaryFunctionParser = new SummaryFunctionParser(ActualSummaryFunction);
				SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = base.Chart.SummaryFunctions[summaryFunctionParser.FunctionName];
				if (summaryFunctionDescription == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ScaleType? resultScaleType = summaryFunctionDescription.ResultScaleType;
				if (!resultScaleType.HasValue)
				{
					if (!summaryFunctionDescription.IsStandard)
					{
						return;
					}
					string[] arguments = summaryFunctionParser.Arguments;
					foreach (string dataMember in arguments)
					{
						if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, dataMember), valueScaleType, GetCalculatedFields()))
						{
							ThrowInvalidScaleTypeException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember, dataMember, valueScaleType);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (resultScaleType != valueScaleType)
				{
					ThrowIncompatibleSummaryFunctionException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleSummaryFunction, summaryFunctionDescription, valueScaleType);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (string actualValueDataMember in GetActualValueDataMembers())
			{
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(DataContext, dataSource, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, actualValueDataMember), valueScaleType, GetCalculatedFields()))
				{
					ThrowInvalidScaleTypeException(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember, actualValueDataMember, valueScaleType);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0119: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0131: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0136: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0149: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0172: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is SeriesBase seriesBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			AssignView(seriesBase.view);
			visible = seriesBase.visible;
			DataSorted = seriesBase.DataSorted;
			showInLegend = seriesBase.showInLegend;
			SetArgumentScaleType(seriesBase.argumentScaleType);
			valueScaleType = seriesBase.valueScaleType;
			pointsSorting = seriesBase.pointsSorting;
			pointsSortingKey = seriesBase.pointsSortingKey;
			if (label != null)
			{
				if (seriesBase.label != null)
				{
					label.Assign(seriesBase.label);
				}
				label.EnsureResolveOverlappingMode();
			}
			pointOptionsSynchronizer.IsSynchronized = seriesBase.pointOptionsSynchronizer.IsSynchronized;
			legendPointOptions.Assign(seriesBase.legendPointOptions);
			AssignDataFilters(seriesBase);
			AdapterController.Assign(seriesBase.AdapterController);
			topNOptions.Assign(seriesBase.topNOptions);
			crosshairTextOptions.Assign(seriesBase.crosshairTextOptions);
			toolTipPointPattern = seriesBase.toolTipPointPattern;
			toolTipSeriesPattern = seriesBase.toolTipSeriesPattern;
			toolTipEnabled = seriesBase.toolTipEnabled;
			crosshairEnabled = seriesBase.crosshairEnabled;
			crosshairLabelVisibility = seriesBase.crosshairLabelVisibility;
			crosshairLabelPattern = seriesBase.crosshairLabelPattern;
			crosshairHighlightPoints = seriesBase.crosshairHighlightPoints;
			crosshairContentShowMode = seriesBase.crosshairContentShowMode;
			crosshairEmptyValueLegendText = seriesBase.crosshairEmptyValueLegendText;
			labelsVisibility = seriesBase.labelsVisibility;
			checkedInLegend = seriesBase.checkedInLegend;
			checkableInLegend = seriesBase.checkableInLegend;
			legendTextPattern = seriesBase.legendTextPattern;
			legendName = seriesBase.LegendName;
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is obsolete now. Set to String.Empty LegendTextPattern property instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLegendPointOptions()
		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
			pointOptionsSynchronizer.IsSynchronized = true;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		ISeries ISeriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(string seriesName, object seriesValue, ISeries existingInstance)
		{
			Series series = ((Series)existingInstance) ?? CreateSeries(seriesName);
			series.Autocreated = true;
			series.Tag = seriesValue;
			series.ChartPaletteProvider = base.Chart;
			return series;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesDataMember()
		{
			return base.DataContainer.ShouldSerializeSeriesDataMember();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesColorizer()
		{
			if (seriesColorizer != null)
			{
				if (ChartContainer != null)
				{
					return ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesDrillTemplate()
		{
			return seriesDrillTemplate != null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesPointDrillTemplate()
		{
			return seriesPointDrillTemplate != null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeArgumentDrillTemplate()
		{
			return argumentDrillTemplate != null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDataAdapter()
		{
			return DataAdapter != null;
		}

		private void ResetSeriesDataMember()
		{
			base.DataContainer.ResetSeriesDataMember();
		}

		private void ResetSeriesColorizer()
		{
			SeriesColorizer = null;
		}

		private void ResetSeriesDrillTemplate()
		{
			seriesDrillTemplate = null;
		}

		private void ResetSeriesPointDrillTemplate()
		{
			seriesPointDrillTemplate = null;
		}

		private void ResetArgumentDrillTemplate()

			argumentDrillTemplate = null;
		}

		private void ResetDataAdapter()
		{
			DataAdapter = null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeArgumentDrillTemplate() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesColorizer() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesDataMember() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesDrillTemplate() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesPointDrillTemplate())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDataAdapter();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"SeriesColorizer" => ShouldSerializeSeriesColorizer(), 
				"SeriesDrillTemplate" => ShouldSerializeSeriesDrillTemplate(), 
				"SeriesPointDrillTemplate" => ShouldSerializeSeriesPointDrillTemplate(), 
				"ArgumentDrillTemplate" => ShouldSerializeArgumentDrillTemplate(), 
				"DataAdapter" => ShouldSerializeDataAdapter(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private void UpdateDrillDownTemplatesOwner(DataContainer owner)
		{
			if (seriesDrillTemplate != null)
			{
				seriesDrillTemplate.Owner = owner;
			}
			if (seriesPointDrillTemplate != null)
			{
				seriesPointDrillTemplate.Owner = owner;
			}
			if (argumentDrillTemplate != null)
			{
				argumentDrillTemplate.Owner = owner;
			}
		}

		internal void SetDrillDownFilter(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			drillDownCriteria = criteria;
			UpdateFilterCriteria();
		}

		internal Series CreateSeries(string name)
		{
			Series series = new Series(name, SeriesViewFactory.GetViewType(base.View));
			series.Assign(this);
			return series;
		}

		internal void ColorizeSeries()
		{
			if (colorizerController == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in AutocreatedSeries)
			{
				if (item.Tag != null)
				{
					colorizerController.ColorizeSeries(item, base.Chart);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SeriesDataMemberChanging(string value)
		{
			if (base.DataContainer != null)
			{
				base.DataContainer.CheckNestedDataMember(base.DataContainer.ActualDataSource, value);
			}
			RaiseControlChanging();
		}

		protected override ISeriesDataAdapter GetDataAdapter()
		{
			ISeriesDataAdapter seriesDataAdapter = DataAdapter as ISeriesDataAdapter;
			return seriesDataAdapter ?? this;
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			UpdateDrillDownTemplatesOwner(newOwner as DataContainer);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SeriesTemplate();
		}

		protected override object CreateContentPropertyValue(XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Item.Name == "SeriesColorizer")
			{
				return XtraSerializingUtils.GetKnownContentPropertyInstance(e, SerializationUtils.ChartAssembly, SerializationUtils.PublicNamespace);
			}
			if (e.Item.Name == "SeriesDrillTemplate" || e.Item.Name == "SeriesPointDrillTemplate" || e.Item.Name == "ArgumentDrillTemplate")
			{
				return new SeriesTemplate();
			}
			if (e.Item.Name == "DataAdapter")
			{
				return SerializationUtils.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
			}
			return base.CreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		protected override DataAdapterControllerBase CreateAdapterController()
		{
			return new TemplateDataAdapterController(this);
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetScaleFromDataSourceCore()
		{
			if (DataAdapter == null)
			{
				return base.GetScaleFromDataSourceCore();
			}
			return DataAdapterHelper.GetArgumentScaleType(DataAdapter);
		}

		protected internal override Series GetSeriesForClone()
		{
			Series series = CreateSeries(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SeriesNamePatternDescription));
			series.Owner = base.Owner;
			series.Points.Unlock = true;
			series.Points.Clear();
			series.Points.Unlock = false;
			return series;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading(bool validatePointsId)
		{
			base.OnEndLoading(validatePointsId);
			seriesColorizer?.OnEndLoading();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate)
			{
				DataAdapter = (ISeriesTemplateAdapter)(seriesTemplate.DataAdapter?.Clone());
				SeriesDataMember = seriesTemplate.SeriesDataMember;
				SeriesColorizer = ((seriesTemplate.seriesColorizer != null) ? ((SeriesColorizerBase)seriesTemplate.seriesColorizer.Clone()) : null);
				seriesDrillTemplate = ((seriesTemplate.seriesDrillTemplate != null) ? ((SeriesTemplate)seriesTemplate.seriesDrillTemplate.Clone()) : null);
				seriesPointDrillTemplate = ((seriesTemplate.seriesPointDrillTemplate != null) ? ((SeriesTemplate)seriesTemplate.seriesPointDrillTemplate.Clone()) : null);
				argumentDrillTemplate = ((seriesTemplate.argumentDrillTemplate != null) ? ((SeriesTemplate)seriesTemplate.argumentDrillTemplate.Clone()) : null);
				UpdateDrillDownTemplatesOwner(base.DataContainer);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(SeriesTemplate)";
		}

		void ISeriesTemplate.ResetDataSourceScale()
		{
			ResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType();
		}

		void ISeriesTemplate.UpdateDataFilters()
		{
			UpdateFilterCriteria();
		}
	}

		internal class ValuesTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private const char separator = ';';

			private string ConvertDoubles2String(double[] values)
			{
				string[] array = new string[values.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = values[i].ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				}
				return string.Join(new string(';', 1), array);
			}

			private double[] ConvertString2Doubles(string value)
			{
				string[] array = value.Split(';');
				double[] array2 = new double[array.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = double.Parse(array[i], NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				}
				return array2;
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				return sourceType == typeof(string);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (!(value is string value2))
				{
					throw GetConvertFromException(value);
				}
				return ConvertString2Doubles(value2);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType != typeof(string))
				{
					throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					return ConvertDoubles2String((double[])value);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		internal class DateTimeValuesTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private const char separator = ';';

			private string ConvertDateTime2String(DateTime[] values)
			{
				string[] array = new string[values.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = values[i].ToString("MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff", DateTimeFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				}
				return string.Join(new string(';', 1), array);
			}

			private DateTime[] ConvertString2DateTime(string value)
			{
				string[] array = value.Split(';');
				DateTime[] array2 = new DateTime[array.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = DateTime.Parse(array[i], DateTimeFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				}
				return array2;
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				return sourceType == typeof(string);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (!(value is string value2))
				{
					throw GetConvertFromException(value);
				}
				return ConvertString2DateTime(value2);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType != typeof(string))
				{
					throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					return ConvertDateTime2String((DateTime[])value);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		internal class TimeSpanValuesTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private const char separator = ';';

			private string ConvertTimeSpan2String(TimeSpan[] values)

					array[i] = values[i].ToString("c");

				TimeSpan[] array2 = new TimeSpan[array.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = TimeSpan.Parse(array[i]);
				}
				return array2;
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				return sourceType == typeof(string);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (!(value is string value2))
				{
					throw GetConvertFromException(value);
				}
				return ConvertString2TimeSpan(value2);

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType != typeof(string))
				{
					throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
				}
				if (value != null)

					return ConvertTimeSpan2String((TimeSpan[])value);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private class SeriesPointPropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
		{
			public SeriesPointPropertyDescriptorCollection(ICollection descriptors, ScaleType scaleType)
				: base(new PropertyDescriptor[0])
			{
				//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor descriptor in descriptors)
				{
					if ((descriptor.DisplayName == "DateTimeValues" && scaleType != ScaleType.DateTime) || (descriptor.DisplayName == "TimeSpanValues" && scaleType != ScaleType.TimeSpan) || (descriptor.DisplayName == "Values" && (scaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || scaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)))
					{
						Add((PropertyDescriptor)new CustomPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, false));
					}
					else
					{
						Add(descriptor);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ValuesSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				string[] array = new string[Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						array[i] = dataContainer.DateTimeValues[i].ToString("MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
					else if (ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						array[i] = dataContainer.TimeSpanValues[i].ToString("c");
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = dataContainer.Values[i].ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
				return SerializingUtils.StringArrayToString(array);
			}
			set
			{
				string[] array = SerializingUtils.StringToStringArray(value);
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArrayOfValues));
				}
				SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer serializableSeriesPointDataContainer = dataContainer as SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer;
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer == null)
				{
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer = (SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer)(dataContainer = new SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer));
				}
				DateTime result2;
				if (double.TryParse(array[0], NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var _))
				{
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values = Array.ConvertAll(array, (string item) => double.Parse(item, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (DateTime.TryParse(array[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out result2))
				{
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues = Array.ConvertAll(array, (string item) => DateTime.Parse(item, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else
				{
					if (!TimeSpan.TryParse(array[0], out var _))
					{
						throw new InternalException("Illegal valueScaleType when XtraDeserializing");
					}
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues = Array.ConvertAll(array, (string item) => TimeSpan.Parse(item, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				if (!Loading)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Values");
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ArgumentSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return ((Series != null) ? Series.ActualArgumentScaleType : ScaleType.Auto) switch
				{
					ScaleType.Numerical => NumericalArgument.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), 
					ScaleType.DateTime => DateTimeArgument.ToString("MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), 
					ScaleType.TimeSpan => TimeSpanArgument.ToString("c"), 
					_ => Argument, 
				};
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Owner != null && !Loading)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInternalPropertyChangeError));
				}
				SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer serializableSeriesPointDataContainer = dataContainer as SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer;
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer == null)
				{
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer = (SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer)(dataContainer = new SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer));
				}
				ScaleType scaleType = ((Series != null) ? Series.ArgumentScaleType : ScaleType.Auto);
				if (scaleType != ScaleType.Auto)
				{
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument = GetQualitativeArgByScaleType(value, scaleType);
				}
				else
				{
					serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPoint.IsEmpty")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPoint.IsEmpty")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				return dataContainer.IsEmpty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataContainer.IsEmpty == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				if (value)
				{
					switch (ArgumentScaleType)
					{
					case ScaleType.Numerical:
						dataContainer = new NumericSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						break;
					case ScaleType.DateTime:
						dataContainer = new DateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						break;
					case ScaleType.Qualitative:
						dataContainer = new QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						break;
					case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
						dataContainer = new TimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						break;
					default:
						dataContainer = new EmptySeriesPointDataContainer();
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.InitializeValues(dataContainer, dataContainer.Values, shouldBeNonEmpty: true);
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("Values");
			}
		}

		internal static SeriesPoint GetSeriesPoint(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point is SeriesPoint)
			{
				return (SeriesPoint)point;
			}
			if (point is AggregatedSeriesPoint)
			{
				AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint = (AggregatedSeriesPoint)point;
				if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePointsCount == 1 && !aggregatedSeriesPoint.IsAuxiliary)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = aggregatedSeriesPoint.GetRefinedPoint(0);
					if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint is SeriesPoint result)
					{
						return result;
					}
					if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.Series is Series series)
					{
						DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series);
						return dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
					}
				}
				return new SeriesPoint((AggregatedSeriesPoint)point);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool EqualsBySourcePoints(SeriesPoint pointA, SeriesPoint pointB)
		{
			if (pointA == pointB)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (pointB.SourcePoints != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint in pointB.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (pointA == sourcePoint)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (pointA.SourcePoints == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint2 in pointA.SourcePoints)
					{
						if (sourcePoint2 == sourcePoint)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (pointA.SourcePoints != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint3 in pointA.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (sourcePoint3 == pointB)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static string GetValueString(SeriesPoint point, int index)
		{
			ScaleType valueScaleType = point.ValueScaleType;
			if (valueScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical)
			{
				return ((ISeriesPoint)point).Values.NumericalValues[index].ToString();
			}
			if (point.Series != null && point.Series.Chart != null && point.Series.Chart.Diagram != null && point.Series.View is IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView)
			{
				PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(iXYSeriesView.AxisYData.Label.TextPattern, (IPatternHolder)iXYSeriesView.AxisYData.Label);
				patternParser.SetContext((valueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime) ? ((object)point.DateTimeValues[index]) : ((object)point.TimeSpanValues[index]));
				return patternParser.GetText();
			}
			if (valueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return point.TimeSpanValues[index].ToString();
			}
			return point.DateTimeValues[index].ToShortDateString();
		}

		public static SeriesPoint CreateSeriesPointWithId(object argument, int id)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint(argument);
			seriesPoint.id = id;
			return seriesPoint;
		}

			dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(Convert.ToDouble(argument), values);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SeriesPoint(object argument, object[] values, int id)
		{
			if (argument == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArgument));
			}
			if (values == null)
			{
				dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.CreateFromObject(argument, parse: true, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				if (values.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArrayOfValues));
				}
				CheckValuesArray(values);
				dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.CreateFromObject(argument, values, parse: true, 1);
			}
			this.id = id;
		}

		}

		}

		private SeriesPoint(AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
		{
			dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.CreateFromObject(aggregatedPoint.ArgumentX.Argument, aggregatedPoint.Values, parse: true);
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			FullSettingsContainer.SourcePoints = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedPoint.SourcePoints)
			{
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper((Series)aggregatedPoint.Series);
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(sourcePoint);
				if (seriesPoint != null)
				{
					list.Add(seriesPoint.Tag);
					FullSettingsContainer.SourcePoints.Add(GetSeriesPoint(sourcePoint.SeriesPoint));
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				InitTag(list[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				InitTag(list);
			}
			FullSettingsContainer.IsAuxiliary = aggregatedPoint.IsAuxiliary;
			base.Owner = aggregatedPoint.Series as ChartElement;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"IsEmpty" => ShouldSerializeIsEmpty(), 
				"SeriesPointID" => ShouldSerializeSeriesPointID(), 
				"Relations" => ShouldSerializeRelations(), 
				"ArgumentSerializable" => ShouldSerializeArgumentSerializable(), 
				"ValuesSerializable" => !IsEmpty, 
				"ColorSerializable" => ShouldSerializeColorSerializable(), 
				"ToolTipHint" => ShouldSerializeToolTipHint(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Relations")
			{
				Relations.Add((Relation)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Relations")
			{
				return new TaskLink();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIsEmpty()
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!IsWebChartControl)
				{
					return XtraSerializing;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValuesInternal()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty && !ShouldSerializeDateTimeValuesInternal())
			{
				return !ShouldSerializeTimeSpanValuesInternal();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValues()
		{
			if (IsWebChartControl)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeValuesInternal();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColorSerializable()
		{
			return !Color.IsEmpty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDateTimeValues()
		{
			if (IsWebChartControl)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDateTimeValuesInternal();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTimeSpanValues()
		{
			if (IsWebChartControl)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTimeSpanValuesInternal();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesPointID()
		{
			if (IsWebChartControl || XtraSerializing)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesPointIDInternal();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeDateTimeValuesInternal()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty && base.Owner != null)
			{
				return Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeTimeSpanValuesInternal()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty && base.Owner != null)
			{
				return Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeSeriesPointIDInternal()
		{
			if (id >= 0 && Series != null)
			{
				if (!Series.View.IsSupportedRelations && !Series.View.SerializeSeriesPointID)
				{
					return Annotations.Count > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}

		private string GetQualitativeArgByScaleType(string argSerializable, ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			switch (scaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				return double.Parse(argSerializable, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString();
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.Parse(argSerializable, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				string fullDateTimePattern = DateTimeFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.FullDateTimePattern;
				fullDateTimePattern = Regex.Replace(fullDateTimePattern, "(:ss|:s)", "$1.fff");
				return dateTime.ToString(fullDateTimePattern);
			}
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				return TimeSpan.Parse(argSerializable, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString();
			default:
				return argSerializable;
			}
		}

		private void CheckValuesArray(object[] values)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!(values[i] is IConvertible) && !(values[i] is TimeSpan))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectArrayOfValues));
				}
			}
		}

		private AnnotationCollection CreateAnnotationCollection()
		{
			return new AnnotationCollection(new AnnotationCollectionSeriesPointBehavior(this));
		}
