		internal void OnEndLoading(bool force = false)
		{
			if ((!force && !ShouldSerializeArgumentSerializable()) || !(dataContainer is SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer serializableSeriesPointDataContainer))
			{
				return;
			}
			int dimension = ((Series == null || Series.View == null) ? 1 : Series.View.PointDimension);
			switch (SeriesArgumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
			{
				double argument2 = double.Parse(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values != null)
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(argument2, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = NumericDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument2, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = NumericTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument2, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
				else
				{
					dataContainer = new NumericSeriesPointDataContainer(argument2, dimension);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime argument = DateTime.Parse(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values != null)
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(argument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = DateTimeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = DateTimeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
				else
				{
					dataContainer = new DateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dimension);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.Qualitative:
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values != null)
				{
					dataContainer = QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = QualitativeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
				else
				{
					dataContainer = new QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dimension);
				}
				break;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
			{
				TimeSpan argument3 = TimeSpan.Parse(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values != null)
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(argument3, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = TimeSpanDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument3, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = TimeSpanTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument3, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
				else
				{
					dataContainer = new TimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(argument3, dimension);
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				bool useInvariant = true;
				if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values != null)
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.Values, useInvariant);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues, useInvariant);
				}
				else if (serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues != null)
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues, useInvariant);
				}
				else
				{
					dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(serializableSeriesPointDataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dimension, useInvariant);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (Series != null && !Series.PointsUpdateInProcess)
			{
				if (Series.DataAdapter is SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter)
				{
					seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter.OnDataChanged(this, new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(ChartDataUpdateType.ItemChanged, Series.ActualSeriesPoints.IndexOf(this), 1));
				}
				GetOwner<DataContainer>()?.DataChanged(new ChartUpdate(new PropertyUpdateInfo<ISeries, IDataPoint>(this, propertyName, null, null, Series)));
			}
		}

		internal void SetArgument(object argument, bool parse, bool needRaiseChangedProperty)
		{
			if (argument == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArgument));
			}
			dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.InitializeArgument(dataContainer, argument, (Scale)SeriesArgumentScaleType, parse);
			if (needRaiseChangedProperty && !Loading)
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("Argument");
			}
		}

		internal void SetArgument(string argument)
		{
			dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.InitializeArgument(dataContainer, argument, (Scale)SeriesArgumentScaleType);
			RaisePropertyChanged("Argument");
		}

		internal object GetValueObject(int index)
		{
			if (ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
			{
				return DateTimeValues[index];
			}
			if (ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return TimeSpanValues[index];
			}
			return Values[index];
		}

		internal bool CheckValueScaleType(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			if (!((ISeriesPoint)this).IsEmpty(Scale.Auto))
			{
				return scaleType == ValueScaleType;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void IncreaseDimension(int pointDimension)
		{
			dataContainer = dataContainer.SetDimension(pointDimension);
		}

		internal void UpdateValueScaleType(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			if (!(dataContainer is SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer))
			{
				dataContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.InitializeValues(dataContainer, (Scale)valueScaleType);
			}
		}

		public string GetValueString(int index)
		{
			return GetValueString(this, index);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ISeriesPoint seriesPoint) || ArgumentScaleType != ((SeriesPoint)seriesPoint).ArgumentScaleType || ValueScaleType != ((SeriesPoint)seriesPoint).ValueScaleType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (ArgumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Qualitative:
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument != seriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).ArgumentX.NumericalArgument != seriesPoint.ArgumentX.NumericalArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).ArgumentX.DateTimeArgument != seriesPoint.ArgumentX.DateTimeArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).ArgumentX.TimeSpanArgument != seriesPoint.ArgumentX.TimeSpanArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			switch (ValueScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
			{
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.NumericalValues.Length != seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < ((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.NumericalValues.Length; j++)
				{
					double num = ((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.NumericalValues[j];
					double num2 = seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[j];
					if (num != num2 && (!double.IsNaN(num) || !double.IsNaN(num2)))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
			{
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.DateTimeValues.Length != seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < ((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.DateTimeValues.Length; k++)
				{
					if (((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.DateTimeValues[k] != seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues[k])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
			{
				if (((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.TimeSpanValues.Length != seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.TimeSpanValues.Length; i++)
				{
					if (((ISeriesPoint)this).Values.TimeSpanValues[i] != seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues[i])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
			{
				dataContainer = seriesPoint.dataContainer.Clone();
				lightSettingsContainer = ((seriesPoint.lightSettingsContainer != null) ? seriesPoint.lightSettingsContainer.Clone(this) : null);
				if (lightSettingsContainer != null)
				{
					lightSettingsContainer.IndicatorPoint = null;
				}
				id = seriesPoint.id;
			}
		}

		public double? GetNumericValue(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (ValueScaleType != ScaleType.Numerical)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(valueLevel, dataContainer.Values);
		}

		public DateTime? GetDateTimeValue(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (ValueScaleType != ScaleType.DateTime)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(valueLevel, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
		}

		public TimeSpan? GetTimeSpanValue(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (ValueScaleType != ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValueFromArray(valueLevel, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
		}
	}

		private void TestPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (!point.IsValidArgument)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArgument));
			}
			Series series = Owner;
			if (series == null)
			{
				if (point.Values.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyArrayOfValues));
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!AxisScaleTypeMap.CheckArgumentScaleType(point, (Scale)series.ArgumentScaleType))
			{
				string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleArgument), point.Argument);
				throw new ArgumentException(message);
			}
			if (!point.CheckValueScaleType(series.ValueScaleType))
			{
				string message2 = string.Format(arg0: (point.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime) ? point.DateTimeValues[0].ToString() : ((point.ValueScaleType != ScaleType.TimeSpan) ? point.Values[0].ToString() : point.TimeSpanValues[0].ToString()), format: ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValue));
				throw new ArgumentException(message2);
			}
			int pointDimension = series.View.PointDimension;
			if (pointDimension > point.ValuesCount)
			{
				if (point.IsEmpty)
				{
					point.IncreaseDimension(pointDimension);
				}
				else if (point.ValuesCount < 5)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectValueDataMemberCount), pointDimension.ToString()));
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetID(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point.HasRelations)
			{
				point.Relations.ClearInternal();
			}
			point.SetID(GetNextId());
		}

		private int AddNoTesting(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return Add((ChartElement)point);
		}

		private int GetNextId()
		{
			if (currentMaxId == -1)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint item in base.List)
				{
					if (item.SeriesPointID > currentMaxId)
					{
						currentMaxId = item.SeriesPointID;
					}
				}
			}
			return ++currentMaxId;
		}

		private void CheckIDs()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
			IList<SeriesPoint> list2 = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = list2[i];
				int num = list.BinarySearch(seriesPoint.SeriesPointID);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSeriesPointIDNotUnique));
				}
				list.Insert(~num, seriesPoint.SeriesPointID);
				if (seriesPoint.HasRelations)
				{
					seriesPoint.Relations.ValidateIDs();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateIDs()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0 || IsBoundPoints)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				if (inner.SeriesPointID == -1)
				{
					inner.SetID(GetNextId());
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint inner2 in base.InnerList)
			{
				if (!inner2.HasRelations)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Relation relation in inner2.Relations)
				{
					relation.InitializeChildPointId();
				}
			}
			CheckIDs();
		}

		private void TestUnboundMode()
		{
			if (!Unlock && Owner != null && !Owner.UnboundMode)
			{
				throw new SeriesPointCollectionChangingException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgDenyChangeSeriesPointCollection));
			}
		}

		private void ThrowOutOfRangeException()
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgOutOfRangeIndexInSeriesPointCollection));
		}

		private void NativeInsert(int index, SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			if (index < 0 || index > base.Count)
			{
				ThrowOutOfRangeException();
			}
			OnValidate(seriesPoint);
			OnInsert(index, seriesPoint);
			base.InnerList.Insert(index, seriesPoint);
			try
			{
				OnInsertComplete(index, seriesPoint);
			}
			catch
			{
				base.InnerList.RemoveAt(index);
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void NativeSet(int index, SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			if (index < 0 || index >= base.Count)
			{
				ThrowOutOfRangeException();
			}
			OnValidate(seriesPoint);
			object obj = base.InnerList[index];
			OnSet(index, obj, seriesPoint);
			base.InnerList[index] = seriesPoint;
			try
			{
				OnSetComplete(index, obj, seriesPoint);
			}
			catch
			{
				base.InnerList[index] = obj;
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void SetBoxPlotValues(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, double min, double quartile1, double median, double quartile3, double max, double mean, params double[] outliers)
		{
			double[] array = new double[6 + outliers.Length];
			array[0] = min;
			array[1] = quartile1;
			array[2] = median;
			array[3] = quartile3;
			array[4] = max;
			array[5] = mean;
			if (outliers != null)
			{
				int num = 6;
				int num2 = 0;
				while (num < 6 + outliers.Length)
				{
					array[num] = outliers[num2];
					num++;
					num2++;
				}
			}
			seriesPoint.Values = array;
		}

		private SeriesPoint CreateNewSeriesPoint()
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint(Owner.View.PointDimension, Owner.ArgumentScaleType, Owner.ValueScaleType);
			IChartContainer chartContainer = ((Owner != null) ? Owner.ChartContainer : null);
			if (chartContainer != null && chartContainer.DesignMode)
			{
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint2 = ((base.Count > 0) ? dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(ActualPoints[base.Count - 1]) : null);
				if (Owner.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal == ScaleType.DateTime)
				{
					seriesPoint.DateTimeArgument = seriesPoint2?.ArgumentX.DateTimeArgument ?? DateTime.Now;
				}
				else if (Owner.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
				{
					seriesPoint.TimeSpanArgument = seriesPoint2?.ArgumentX.TimeSpanArgument ?? TimeSpan.Zero;
				}
				else
				{
					seriesPoint.Argument = ((seriesPoint2 != null) ? seriesPoint2.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument : "0");
				}
				emptyDesignPoint = (SeriesPoint)seriesPoint.Clone();
			}
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		private bool IsEmptyDesignPoint(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			IChartContainer chartContainer = Owner.ChartContainer;
			if (chartContainer != null && chartContainer.DesignMode)
			{
				return seriesPoint.Equals(emptyDesignPoint);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ValidateLastPoint(Predicate<ISeriesPoint> shouldRemovePoint)
		{
			if (base.Count > 0)
			{
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
				ISeriesPoint obj = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(ActualPoints[base.Count - 1]);
				if (shouldRemovePoint(obj))
				{
					RemoveAt(base.Count - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateEmptyArgument()
		{
			ValidateLastPoint((ISeriesPoint point) => point.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument == string.Empty);
		}

		private SeriesPoint[] CreateBoundPointsArray()
		{
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
			return dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(boundPoints);
		}

		private ChartDataUpdateEventArgs CalculateChartDataUpdateArgs(ChartUpdate chartUpdate)
		{
			if (!(chartUpdate.UpdateInfo is SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo seriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo))
			{
				return new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs();
			}
			return seriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo.Operation switch
			{
				ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem => new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(ChartDataUpdateType.Insert, seriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex, 1), 
				ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem => new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(ChartDataUpdateType.Remove, seriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex, 1), 
				ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem => new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(ChartDataUpdateType.ItemChanged, seriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex, 1), 
				_ => new ChartDataUpdateEventArgs(), 
			};
		}

		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IDataPoint dataPoint = (IDataPoint)enumerator.Current;
					dataPoint.ClearAnnotations();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			TestUnboundMode();
			base.OnClear();
		}

		protected override void OnClearComplete()
		{
			base.OnClearComplete();
			OnListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, -1, -1);
		}

		protected override void OnInsert(int index, object value)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			base.OnInsert(index, value);
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsertComplete(index, value);
			if (value is SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
			{
				seriesPoint.UpdateAnnotationRepository();
			}
			OnListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, index, -1);
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = value as SeriesPoint;
			seriesPoint?.ClearAnnotations();
			TestUnboundMode();
			if (seriesPoint.HasRelations || Series.View is GanttSeriesView)
			{
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
				IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (i == index)
					{
						continue;
					}
					seriesPoint = list[i];
					if (seriesPoint != null && seriesPoint.HasRelations)
					{
						Relation byChildSeriesPoint = seriesPoint.Relations.GetByChildSeriesPoint(value as SeriesPoint);
						if (byChildSeriesPoint != null)
						{
							seriesPoint.Relations.Remove(byChildSeriesPoint);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnRemove(index, value);
		}

		protected override void OnSet(int index, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			if (newValue is SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
			{
				seriesPoint.UpdateAnnotationRepository();
			}
			base.OnSet(index, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
			OnListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, index, -1);
		}

			base.OnEndUpdate();
			Series.EndPointsUpdate();
		}

		internal SeriesPoint GetById(int id)
		{
			if (id < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsBoundPoints)
			{
				if (id >= base.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
				return dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(boundPoints[id]);
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				if (inner.SeriesPointID == id)
				{
					return inner;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal SeriesPoint GetById(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point.SeriesPointID < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
			IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(ActualPoints);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = list[i];
				if (seriesPoint.SeriesPointID == point.SeriesPointID)
				{
					return seriesPoint;
				}
				if (point.SourcePoints == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint in point.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (seriesPoint.SeriesPointID == sourcePoint.SeriesPointID)
					{
						return seriesPoint;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void OnEndLoading(bool validatePointsId)
		{
			if (IsBoundPoints)
			{
				return;
			}
			EndUpdate(bindingProcessing: false);
			foreach (SeriesPoint inner in base.InnerList)
			{
				inner.OnEndLoading();
			}
			if (validatePointsId)
			{
				ValidateIDs();
			}
		}

		internal void AddBoundPoint(IDataPoint point)
		{
			boundPoints.Add(point);
		}

		internal void InsertBoundPoint(int index, IDataPoint point)
		{
			boundPoints.Insert(index, point);
		}

		internal void ClearBoundPoints()
		{
			boundPoints.Clear();
		}

		internal void SetBoundPoints(List<IDataPoint> points)
		{
			boundPoints.SetPoints(points);
		}

		internal void RemoveBoundPointAt(int startIndex)
		{
			boundPoints.RemoveAt(startIndex);
		}

		internal void SetBoundPoint(int index, IDataPoint point)
		{
			boundPoints[index] = point;
		}

		internal void ReplaceBoundPointsToInternal()
		{
			if (!IsBoundPoints)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>(boundPoints.Count);
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
			foreach (IDataPoint item in (IEnumerable<IDataPoint>)boundPoints)
			{
				list.Add(dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(item));
			}
			boundPoints.Clear();
			AddRangeWithoutChanged(list);
		}

		protected internal override void EndUpdate(bool bindingProcessing)
		{
			if (!Loading)
			{
				base.EndUpdate(bindingProcessing);
			}
		}

		public void Validate()
		{
			ValidateLastPoint((ISeriesPoint point) => point.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument == string.Empty || IsEmptyDesignPoint(point));
			emptyDesignPoint = null;
		}

		public void Move(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			if (newIndex != oldIndex)
			{
				object obj = ActualPoints[oldIndex];
				base.InnerList.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
				base.InnerList.Insert(newIndex, obj);
				RaiseControlChanged(CreateUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.MoveItem, null, oldIndex, obj, newIndex));
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(params SeriesPoint[] points)
		{
			if (Owner != null && !Owner.Loading)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint seriesPoint in points)
				{
					TestPoint(seriesPoint);
					SetID(seriesPoint);
				}
			}
			AddRange((ICollection)points);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (Owner != null && !Owner.Loading)
			{
				TestPoint(point);
				SetID(point);
			}
			TestUnboundMode();
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)point);
		}

		public void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			IDataPoint[] array = null;
			if (index >= 0 && count > 0 && index + count <= base.InnerList.Count)
			{
				array = new IDataPoint[count];
				base.InnerList.CopyTo(index, array, 0, count);
			}
			if (array != null)
			{
				IDataPoint[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					ChartElement item = (ChartElement)array2[i];
					DisposeItemBeforeRemove(item);
				}
				SendControlChanging();
			}
			base.InnerList.RemoveRange(index, count);
			if (array != null)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(CreateBatchUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, array, index, null, -1));
			}
		}

		public void Remove(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			Remove((ChartElement)point);
		}

		public new void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			base.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Swap(SeriesPoint point1, SeriesPoint point2)
		{
			TestUnboundMode();
			Swap((ChartElement)point1, (ChartElement)point2);
		}

		public new int IndexOf(ChartElement point)
		{
			if (IsBoundPoints)
			{
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(Owner);
				IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(boundPoints);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (list[i] == point)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return base.IndexOf(point);
		}

		public new SeriesPoint[] ToArray()
		{
			if (IsBoundPoints)
			{
				return CreateBoundPointsArray();
			}
			return (SeriesPoint[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(SeriesPoint));
		}

		public new bool Contains(ChartElement item)
		{
			if (IndexOf(item) >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (item is SeriesPoint { SourcePoints: not null } seriesPoint)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint in seriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (IndexOf(sourcePoint) >= 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public new IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new SeriesPointEnumerator(this);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.Assign(collection);
			if (collection is SeriesPointCollection seriesPointCollection)
			{
				emptyDesignPoint = seriesPointCollection.emptyDesignPoint;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class Relation : ChartElement
	{
		private SeriesPoint childPoint;

		private int childPointID = -1;

		private SeriesPointRelationCollection Relations => ParentPoint?.Relations;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int ChildPointID
		{
			get
			{
				return childPointID;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Owner != null && !Loading)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInternalPropertyChangeError));
				}
				childPointID = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Relation.ChildPoint")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Relation.ChildPoint")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SeriesPoint ChildPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (Relations == null)
				{
					return childPoint;
				}
				return Relations.Series.GetPointByID(childPointID);
			}
			set
			{
				if (Relations == null)
				{
					childPoint = value;
					return;
				}
				Relations.TestPoint(value);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				childPoint = value;
				childPointID = value.SeriesPointID;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Relation.ParentPoint")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Relation.ParentPoint")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SeriesPoint ParentPoint => base.Owner as SeriesPoint;

		protected Relation()
		{
		}

		protected Relation(SeriesPoint childPoint)
			: this(childPoint.SeriesPointID)
		{
			this.childPoint = childPoint;
		}

		protected Relation(int childPointID)
			: this()
		{
			this.childPointID = childPointID;
		}

		internal void InitializeChildPointId()
		{
			if (childPoint != null)
			{
				childPointID = childPoint.SeriesPointID;
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is Relation relation)
			{
				childPointID = relation.childPointID;
				childPoint = relation.childPoint;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	public enum TaskLinkType
	{
		FinishToStart,
		StartToStart,
		FinishToFinish,
		StartToFinish
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(TaskLinkTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class TaskLink : Relation
	{
		private const TaskLinkType DefaultLinkType = TaskLinkType.FinishToStart;

		private TaskLinkType linkType;

		[Description("Gets or sets the value specifying the connection order of child and parent bars.")]

		public TaskLink()

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartCollectionSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SeriesPointRelationCollection")]
	public class SeriesPointRelationCollection : ChartCollectionBase, ICloneable
	{
		internal SeriesPoint ParentPoint => base.Owner as SeriesPoint;

		internal Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (ParentPoint == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ParentPoint.Series;
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides indexed access to individual items in the collection.")]
		public Relation this[int index] => (Relation)base.List[index];

		internal SeriesPointRelationCollection(SeriesPoint parentPoint)
		{
			base.Owner = parentPoint;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			SeriesPointRelationCollection seriesPointRelationCollection = new SeriesPointRelationCollection(null);
			seriesPointRelationCollection.InnerList.AddRange(base.InnerList);
			seriesPointRelationCollection.SetOwner(ParentPoint);
			return seriesPointRelationCollection;
		}

		private void SetOwner(SeriesPoint owner)
		{
			base.Owner = owner;
		}

		internal void TestPoint(SeriesPoint childPoint)
		{
			if (!(ParentPoint.Owner is Series))
			{
				throw new InvalidOwnerException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectParentSeriesPointOwner));
			}
			if (!((Series)ParentPoint.Owner).View.IsSupportedRelations)
			{
				throw new InvalidOwnerException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSeriesViewNotSupportRelations));
			}
			if (childPoint == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("childPoint");
			}
			if (!(childPoint.Owner is Series))
			{
				throw new InvalidOwnerException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectChildSeriesPointOwner));
			}
			if (childPoint.SeriesPointID < 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectChildSeriesPointID));
			}
			if (ParentPoint.Owner != childPoint.Owner)
			{
				throw new InvalidOwnerException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesOfParentAndChildPoints));
			}
			if (childPoint.SeriesPointID == ParentPoint.SeriesPointID || childPoint.GetHashCode() == ParentPoint.GetHashCode())
			{
				throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSelfRelatedSeriesPoint));
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Relation relation = (Relation)enumerator.Current;
					if (relation.ChildPoint.SeriesPointID == childPoint.SeriesPointID)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSeriesPointRelationAlreadyExists));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateIDs()
		{
			List<Relation> list = new List<Relation>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Relation relation = (Relation)enumerator.Current;
					if (relation.ChildPointID < 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectChildSeriesPointID));
					}
					if (relation.ChildPointID == ParentPoint.SeriesPointID)
					{
						throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSelfRelatedSeriesPoint));
					}
					if (Series.GetPointByID(relation.ChildPointID) == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgChildSeriesPointNotExist), relation.ChildPointID.ToString()));
					}
					if (list.Contains(relation))
					{
						throw new InvalidSeriesPointIDException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgRelationChildPointIDNotUnique));
					}
					list.Add(relation);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearInternal()
		{
			base.InnerList.Clear();
		}

		public int Add(Relation relation)
		{
			if (ParentPoint.Owner != null && !ParentPoint.Owner.Loading)
			{
				TestPoint(relation.ChildPoint);
			}
			return Add((ChartElement)relation);
		}

		public int Add(TaskLink relation)
		{
			if (ParentPoint.Owner != null && !ParentPoint.Owner.Loading)
			{
				TestPoint(relation.ChildPoint);
			}
			return Add((ChartElement)relation);
		}

		public int Add(SeriesPoint childPoint, TaskLinkType linkType)
		{
			return Add(new TaskLink(childPoint, linkType));
		}

		public int Add(SeriesPoint childPoint)
		{
			return Add(new TaskLink(childPoint));
		}

		public void AddRange(Relation[] relations)
		{
			if (ParentPoint.Owner != null && !ParentPoint.Owner.Loading)
			{
				foreach (Relation relation in relations)
				{
					TestPoint(relation.ChildPoint);
				}
			}
			AddRange((ICollection)relations);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Relation relation)
		{
			if (ParentPoint.Owner != null && !ParentPoint.Owner.Loading)
			{
				TestPoint(relation.ChildPoint);
			}
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)relation);
		}

		public void Remove(Relation relation)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)relation);
		}

		public Relation GetByChildSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Relation relation = (Relation)enumerator.Current;
					if (relation.ChildPoint.SeriesPointID == point.SeriesPointID)
					{
						return relation;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Remove(SeriesPoint childPoint)
		{
			Relation byChildSeriesPoint = GetByChildSeriesPoint(childPoint);
			if (byChildSeriesPoint != null)
			{
				Remove(byChildSeriesPoint);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(SeriesPoint childPoint)
		{
			return base.List.Contains(childPoint.SeriesPointID);
		}
	}

		protected override void AddStripElementInternal(IGeometryStrip strip, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = GetSeriesPointValues(refinedPoint);
			GRealPoint2D top = new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Max);
			GRealPoint2D bottom = new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Min);
			((RangeStrip)strip).Add(new StripRange(top, bottom));
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			IStripSplitter stripSplitter = CreateLineColorSplitter();
			if (stripSplitter != null)
			{
				return new AreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator(stripSplitter);
			}
			return new AreaGeometryStripCreator();
		}

		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IAreaSeriesView areaSeriesView)
			{
				if (areaSeriesView.Border != null)
				{
					border.Assign(areaSeriesView.Border);
				}
				fillStyle.Assign(areaSeriesView.FillStyle);
			}
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = GetSeriesPointValues(refinedPoint);
			DiagramPoint zeroPoint = pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Min);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Argument, seriesPointValues.Max);
			IPolygon polygon = null;
			if (!double.IsNaN(diagramPoint.X) && !double.IsNaN(diagramPoint.Y))
			{
				polygon = CalculateMarkerPolygon(pointData, diagramPoint);
			}
			return new AreaSeriesPointLayout(pointData, diagramPoint, polygon, zeroPoint);
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, SeriesLayout seriesLayout, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData = (LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData)seriesLayout.SeriesData.WholeViewData;
			List<IGeometryStrip> strips = ((allowOptimization && ShouldSortPoints && !diagramMapping.AxisX.Logarithmic && !RoundStrip) ? StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeRangeStrips(diagramMapping, lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData.Strips, RoundStrip) : StripsUtils.MapRangeStrips(diagramMapping, lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData.Strips, RoundStrip));
			return new AreaWholeSeriesLayout(seriesLayout, strips);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AreaSeriesView areaSeriesView = (AreaSeriesView)obj;
			if (border.Equals(areaSeriesView.border))
			{
				return fillStyle.Equals(areaSeriesView.fillStyle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private PlaneEquation CalcSeparatingPlane(Box boundingBox)
		{
			if (FillStyle.FillMode != FillMode3D.Gradient)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(FillStyle.Options is RectangleGradientFillOptions rectangleGradientFillOptions))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical || rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical)
			{
				return new PlaneEquation(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0 - (boundingBox.Location.Y + boundingBox.Height / 2.0));
			}
			if (rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal || rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal)
			{
				return new PlaneEquation(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - (boundingBox.Location.X + boundingBox.Width / 2.0));
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, RefinedPointData pointData, IAxisRangeData axisRangeY)
		{
			Bar3DData bar3DData = CreateBarData(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			CalcWidthAndDepth(coordsCalculator, bar3DData.Width, out var _, out var _);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, bar3DData.DisplayArgument, bar3DData.MaxValue, clipping: false);
			diagramPoint.X += bar3DData.FixedOffset;
			return coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint);
		}

		protected override Rectangle CorrectLegendMarkerBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bounds.X++;
			bounds.Y++;
			bounds.Width -= 2;
			bounds.Height -= 2;
			return bounds;
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (seriesPointDrawOptions is Bar3DDrawOptions { FillStyle: var rectangleFillStyle3D } bar3DDrawOptions)
			{
				rectangleFillStyle3D.Options.RenderRectangle(renderer, bounds, bounds, bar3DDrawOptions.Color, bar3DDrawOptions.ActualColor2);
			}
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new Bar3DDrawOptions(this);
		}

			return refinedPoint.Value;
		}

		}

			return BarWidth;
		}

		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, RefinedPointData pointData, Bar3DData barData)
		{
			Bar3DDrawOptions bar3DDrawOptions = (Bar3DDrawOptions)pointData.DrawOptions;
			Bar3DRepresentationCalculator bar3DRepresentationCalculator = new Bar3DRepresentationCalculator(this);
			Box boundingBox;
			PlanePolygon[] polyhedron = bar3DRepresentationCalculator.CalcRepresentation(coordsCalculator, barData, out boundingBox);
			PlaneEquation separatingPlane = CalcSeparatingPlane(boundingBox);
			PlanePolygon[] array = coordsCalculator.ClipPolyhedron(polyhedron, boundingBox, separatingPlane);
			if (array == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(boundingBox.Location, boundingBox.Width, boundingBox.Height);
			PlanePolygon[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PlanePolygon polygon in array2)
			{
				list.AddRange(bar3DDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillPlanePolygon(polygon, gradientRect, bar3DDrawOptions.Color, bar3DDrawOptions.ActualColor2));
			}
			return new View3DSeriesPointLayout(pointData, list.ToArray());
		}

		internal void CalcWidthAndDepth(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, double initialWidth, out double width, out double depth)
		{
			AxisBase axisX = coordsCalculator.Diagram.AxisX;
			int width2 = coordsCalculator.Bounds.Width;
			double coord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(axisX.VisualRangeData, 0.0, width2);
			double coord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(axisX.VisualRangeData, initialWidth, width2);
			width = Math.Abs(coord - coord2);
			if (barDepthAuto)
			{
				depth = width;
				return;
			}
			coord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(axisX.VisualRangeData, barDepth, width2);
			depth = Math.Abs(coord - coord2);
		}

		protected internal Bar3DData CreateBarData(IXYPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			double maxValue = GetMaxValue(refinedPoint);
			double totalMaxValue = GetTotalMaxValue(refinedPoint);
			return new Bar3DData(refinedPoint.Argument, GetMinValue(refinedPoint), maxValue, totalMaxValue, GetBarWidth(refinedPoint), GetDisplayOffset(refinedPoint), GetFixedOffset(refinedPoint), ShowFacet && maxValue == totalMaxValue);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new Bar3DSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override double GetSeriesDepth()
		{
			if (!barDepthAuto)
			{
				return barDepth;
			}
			return barWidth;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			return CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(coordsCalculator, pointData, CreateBarData(pointData.RefinedPoint));
		}

		protected internal override XYDiagram3DWholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, SeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			int num = coordsCalculator.GetSeriesWeight(base.Series);
			foreach (SeriesPointLayout item in seriesLayout)
			{
				if (!(item is View3DSeriesPointLayout { Polygons: not null } view3DSeriesPointLayout))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (PlanePolygon polygon in view3DSeriesPointLayout.Polygons)
				{
					polygon.Weight = num;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return new XYDiagram3DWholeSeriesLayout();
		}

		public override string GetValueCaption(int index)
		{
			if (index > 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ValueMember);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IBarSeriesView barSeriesView)
			{
				barWidth = barSeriesView.BarWidth;
				if (obj is Bar3DSeriesView bar3DSeriesView)
				{
					barDepth = bar3DSeriesView.barDepth;
					barDepthAuto = bar3DSeriesView.barDepthAuto;
					model = bar3DSeriesView.model;
					showFacet = bar3DSeriesView.showFacet;
					fillStyle.Assign(bar3DSeriesView.fillStyle);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Bar3DSeriesView bar3DSeriesView = (Bar3DSeriesView)obj;
			if (barWidth == bar3DSeriesView.barWidth && barDepth == bar3DSeriesView.barDepth && barDepthAuto == bar3DSeriesView.barDepthAuto && fillStyle.Equals(bar3DSeriesView.FillStyle) && model == bar3DSeriesView.model)
			{
				return showFacet == bar3DSeriesView.showFacet;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.BarSeriesView.BarWidth")]

		{
			Color baseColor = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(100, 0, 0, 0), barColor);
			baseColor = Color.FromArgb(90, baseColor);

		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"BarWidth" => ShouldSerializeBarWidth(), 
				"Transparency" => ShouldSerializeTransparency(), 
				"Border" => ShouldSerializeBorder(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"Animation" => ShouldSerializeAnimation(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAnimation()
		{
			if (CheckIsAnimationChanged(animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				return base.CanUseAnimation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAnimation()
		{
			Animation = GetDefaultAnimation();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeBarWidth() && !ShouldSerializeTransparency() && !ShouldSerializeBorder() && !ShouldSerializeFillStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAnimation();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetAnimation(BarAnimationBase newAnimation)
		{
			newAnimation.Owner = this;
			if (AnimationHelper.ShouldAssignNewAnimation(ChartContainer, animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				newAnimation.Assign(animation);
			}
			animation = newAnimation;
		}

		private void RenderBar(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions, int borderThickness, bool rotateGradient, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			RenderBarCore(renderer, rect, barDrawOptions, barDrawOptions.Color, borderThickness, rotateGradient, selectionState);
		}

		private Color GetSmallBarColor(BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions, Color color)
		{
			Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(barDrawOptions.Color, barDrawOptions.Border.Color);
			color = HitTestColors.MixColors(borderColor, barDrawOptions.Color);
			if (barDrawOptions.Color.A != byte.MaxValue)
			{
				byte alpha = (byte)((barDrawOptions.Color.A + borderColor.A) / 2);
				color = Color.FromArgb(alpha, color);
			}
			return color;
		}

		private void RenderBarSelection(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				IHitTest series = base.Series;
				if (series != null)
				{
					renderer.FillRectangle(rect, base.HitTestState.HatchStyle, base.HitTestState.GetPointHatchColor(base.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode, selectionState));
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void CalculateAnnotationAnchorPointLayout(Annotation annotation, XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList, RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		protected Color GetBorderColor(Color barColor, Color borderColor)
		{
			if (borderColor == Color.Empty && Appearance.BorderColor != Color.Empty)
			{
				return Appearance.BorderColor;
			}
			return CalculateBorderColor(barColor, borderColor);
		}

		protected void RenderBarCore(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions, Color color, int borderThickness, bool rotateGradient, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			bool flag = rect.Width < 3f || rect.Height < 3f;
			if (flag && barDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Solid)
			{
				if (barDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
				{
					color = GetSmallBarColor(barDrawOptions, color);
				}
				renderer.FillRectangle(rect, color);
				if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
				{
					RenderBarSelection(renderer, rect, selectionState);
				}
				return;
			}
			RectangleFillStyle rectangleFillStyle = barDrawOptions.FillStyle;
			bool flag2 = rectangleFillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient && rotateGradient;
			RectangleGradientMode gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom;
			if (flag2)
			{
				gradientMode = ((RectangleGradientFillOptions)rectangleFillStyle.Options).GradientMode;
				((RectangleGradientFillOptions)rectangleFillStyle.Options).RotateGradientMode();
			}
			rectangleFillStyle.Render(renderer, rect, rect, color, barDrawOptions.ActualColor2);
			if (flag2)
			{
				((RectangleGradientFillOptions)rectangleFillStyle.Options).RestoreGradientOrientation(gradientMode);
			}
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				RenderBarSelection(renderer, rect, selectionState);
			}
			if (borderThickness <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(barDrawOptions.Color, barDrawOptions.Border.Color);
			bool actualVisibility = barDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility;
			if (actualVisibility)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					barDrawOptions.Border.Render(renderer, rect, actualVisibility, borderThickness, borderColor);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.FillRectangle(rect, borderColor);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldInflateBar(BarData barData)
		{
			if (!base.TransparencyContainer.IsDefaultValue && !border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				return barData.SideBySideInteracted;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, BarData barData)

			return new BarSeriesPointLayout(pointData, rectangleDirection, screenRect);
		}

		protected override Rectangle CorrectLegendMarkerBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bounds.X++;
			bounds.Y++;
			bounds.Width -= 2;
			bounds.Height -= 2;
			return new Rectangle(bounds.Location, base.Shadow.DecreaseSize(bounds.Size, 1));
		}

			barDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, bounds, 1);

		protected internal override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions = drawOptions as BarDrawOptions;
			BarSeriesPointLayout barSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as BarSeriesPointLayout;
			if (barDrawOptions != null && barSeriesPointLayout != null)
			{
				int actualThicknessBasedOnAppearance = barDrawOptions.Border.GetActualThicknessBasedOnAppearance(this);
				RenderBar(renderer, barSeriesPointLayout.ScreenRect, barDrawOptions, actualThicknessBasedOnAppearance, ((XYDiagram)base.Series.Chart.Diagram).Rotated, pointLayout.PointData.SelectionState);
			}
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateShadowGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions = drawOptions as BarDrawOptions;
			BarSeriesPointLayout barSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as BarSeriesPointLayout;
			if (barDrawOptions == null || barSeriesPointLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle a = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(mappingBounds, EdgeGeometry.MaxCrosswiseStep, EdgeGeometry.MaxCrosswiseStep);
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Intersect(a, (Rectangle)(ZPlaneRectangle)barSeriesPointLayout.ScreenRect);
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return barDrawOptions.Shadow.CreateGraphicsCommand((ZPlaneRectangle)rectangle);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			BarDrawOptions barDrawOptions = drawOptions as BarDrawOptions;
			BarSeriesPointLayout barSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as BarSeriesPointLayout;
			if (barDrawOptions != null && barSeriesPointLayout != null)
			{
				Rectangle a = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(mappingBounds, EdgeGeometry.MaxCrosswiseStep, EdgeGeometry.MaxCrosswiseStep);
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Intersect(a, MathUtils.StrongRound(barSeriesPointLayout.ScreenRect));
				if (!rectangle.IsEmpty)
				{
					barDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, rectangle);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderHighlightedPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			HighlightedBarPointLayout highlightedBarPointLayout = pointLayout as HighlightedBarPointLayout;
			Color selectHatch = HitTestColors.SelectHatch;
			if (highlightedBarPointLayout != null)
			{
				int actualThickness = Border.ActualThickness;
				RectangleF bounds = new RectangleF(highlightedBarPointLayout.Rectangle.X + (float)actualThickness, highlightedBarPointLayout.Rectangle.Y + (float)actualThickness, highlightedBarPointLayout.Rectangle.Width - (float)(actualThickness * 2), highlightedBarPointLayout.Rectangle.Height - (float)(actualThickness * 2));
				renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, HatchStyle.LightUpwardDiagonal, selectHatch);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in anchorPointLayoutList.Annotations)
			{
				SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint = (SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData.GetRefinedPoint(anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap, seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint());
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					CalculateAnnotationAnchorPointLayout(annotation, anchorPointLayoutList, refinedPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override ScreenErrorBarData ConvertErrorBarDataToScreenCoords(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, ErrorBarData errBarData)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = errBarData.RefinedPoint;
			double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
			BarData barData = CreateBarData(refinedPoint);
			double num = BarWidth;
			ISideBySideBarPoint sideBySideBarPoint = refinedPoint;
			if (sideBySideBarPoint != null)
			{
				num = sideBySideBarPoint.BarWidth;
			}
			PointF center = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument, errBarData.Center, diagramMapping);
			PointF top = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument, errBarData.Top, diagramMapping);
			PointF bottom = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument, errBarData.Bottom, diagramMapping);
			PointF topLeft = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument - num / 2.0, errBarData.Top, diagramMapping);
			PointF topRight = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument + num / 2.0, errBarData.Top, diagramMapping);
			PointF bottomLeft = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument - num / 2.0, errBarData.Bottom, diagramMapping);
			PointF bottomRight = (PointF)barData.GetScreenPoint(argument + num / 2.0, errBarData.Bottom, diagramMapping);
			return new ScreenErrorBarData(center, top, bottom, topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight);
		}

		protected MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRangeSideBySide(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double num = ((ISideBySidePoint)point).BarWidth / 2.0;
			return new MinMaxValues(((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument - num + ((ISideBySidePoint)point).Offset, ((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument + num + ((ISideBySidePoint)point).Offset);
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double num = barWidth / 2.0;
			return new MinMaxValues(point.Argument - num, point.Argument + num);
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new BarViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IBarSeriesView barSeriesView)
			{
				barWidth = barSeriesView.BarWidth;
				if (obj is BarSeriesView barSeriesView2)
				{
					border.Assign(barSeriesView2.border);
					fillStyle.Assign(barSeriesView2.fillStyle);
					animation = ((barSeriesView2.animation != null) ? ((BarAnimationBase)barSeriesView2.animation.Clone()) : null);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BarSeriesView barSeriesView = (BarSeriesView)obj;
			if (barWidth == barSeriesView.barWidth && border.Equals(barSeriesView.border))
			{
				return fillStyle.Equals(barSeriesView.FillStyle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(CandleStickSeriesViewTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "LocalizationRes", "ChartStringId.SvnCandleStick", "CandleStickSeriesView")]
	public class CandleStickSeriesView : FinancialSeriesViewBase
	{
		protected internal override string StringId => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SvnCandleStick);

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CandleStickSeriesView.ReductionOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.CandleStickSeriesView.ReductionOptions")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		public new CandleStickReductionOptions ReductionOptions => (CandleStickReductionOptions)base.ReductionOptions;

		private void RenderPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color, RectangleF stockHighLowRect, RectangleF bodyRect)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(stockHighLowRect, color);
			if (bodyRect.Width > 1f)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(bodyRect, color);
			}
		}

		private void RenderPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color, RectangleF stockLowRect, RectangleF stockHighRect, RectangleF[] bodyRects)
		{
			if (bodyRects.Length != 0 && bodyRects[0].Width <= 1f)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(RectangleF.Union(stockHighRect, stockLowRect), color);
				return;
			}
			renderer.FillRectangle(stockLowRect, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(stockHighRect, color);
			foreach (RectangleF bounds in bodyRects)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, color);
			}
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new CandleStickDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected override ReductionStockOptions CreateReductionOptions()
		{
			return new CandleStickReductionOptions(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CandleStickSeriesView();
		}

		protected override FinancialSeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, int lineThickness, Direction direction)
		{
			return new CandleStickSeriesPointLayout(pointData, lineThickness, direction);
		}

		protected override void RenderFinancial(ChartRenderer renderer, FinancialSeriesPointLayout financialPointLayout, Color color, ReductionStockOptions reductionOptions)
		{
			CandleStickSeriesPointLayout candleStickSeriesPointLayout = (CandleStickSeriesPointLayout)financialPointLayout;
			CandleStickFillMode fillMode = ((CandleStickReductionOptions)reductionOptions).FillMode;
			if (fillMode == CandleStickFillMode.AlwaysFilled)
			{
				RenderPoint(renderer, color, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockHighLowRect, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.BodyRect);
			}
			else
			{
				RenderPoint(renderer, color, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockLowRect, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockHighRect, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.SplitBodyRect(fillMode));
			}
			if (financialPointLayout.PointData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectionState selectionState = financialPointLayout.PointData.SelectionState;
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				SeriesHitTestState hitState = base.Series.HitState;
				renderer.FillRectangle(candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockLowRect, hitState.HatchStyle, hitState.GetHatchColorLight(selectionState));
				renderer.FillRectangle(candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockHighRect, hitState.HatchStyle, hitState.GetHatchColorLight(selectionState));
				RectangleF[] array = candleStickSeriesPointLayout.SplitBodyRect(fillMode);
				RectangleF[] array2 = array;
				foreach (RectangleF bounds in array2)
				{
					renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, hitState.HatchStyle, hitState.GetHatchColorLight(selectionState));
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override PointOptions CreatePointOptions()
		{
			return new StockPointOptions();
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateShadowGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			if (pointLayout != null)
			{
				CandleStickSeriesPointLayout candleStickSeriesPointLayout = (CandleStickSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout;
				CandleStickDrawOptions candleStickDrawOptions = (CandleStickDrawOptions)drawOptions;
				int actualSize = candleStickDrawOptions.Shadow.GetActualSize(-1);
				candleStickDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockLowRect, actualSize);
				candleStickDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockHighRect, actualSize);
				RectangleF[] array = candleStickSeriesPointLayout.SplitBodyRect(candleStickDrawOptions.ReductionOptions.FillMode);
				RectangleF[] array2 = array;
				foreach (RectangleF rect in array2)
				{
					candleStickDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, rect, actualSize);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override HighlightedPointLayout CalculateHighlightedPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			CandleStickDrawOptions candleStickDrawOptions = drawOptions as CandleStickDrawOptions;
			if (refinedPoint == null || candleStickDrawOptions == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Direction rectangleDirection = XYDiagramSeriesViewBase.GetRectangleDirection(diagramMapping, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Low, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).High);
			CandleStickSeriesPointLayout candleStickSeriesPointLayout = new CandleStickSeriesPointLayout(null, candleStickDrawOptions.LineThickness, rectangleDirection);
			candleStickSeriesPointLayout.Calculate(diagramMapping, ((IArgumentPoint)refinedPoint).Argument, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Low, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).High, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Open, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Close, base.LevelLineLengthTransformed);
			return new HighlightedCandleStickPointLayout(drawOptions.Color, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockLowRect, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.StockHighRect, candleStickSeriesPointLayout.SplitBodyRect(candleStickDrawOptions.ReductionOptions.FillMode));
		}

		protected internal override void RenderHighlightedPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (pointLayout is HighlightedCandleStickPointLayout highlightedCandleStickPointLayout)
			{
				RectangleF stockLowRect = new RectangleF(highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockLowRect.X - 1f, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockLowRect.Y - 1f, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockLowRect.Width + 2f, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockLowRect.Height + 2f);
				RectangleF stockHighRect = new RectangleF(highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockHighRect.X - 1f, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockHighRect.Y - 1f, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockHighRect.Width + 2f, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.StockHighRect.Height + 2f);
				RectangleF[] bodyRects = highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.BodyRects;
				RectangleF[] array = new RectangleF[bodyRects.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < bodyRects.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = new RectangleF(bodyRects[i].X - 1f, bodyRects[i].Y - 1f, bodyRects[i].Width + 2f, bodyRects[i].Height + 2f);
				}
				RenderPoint(renderer, highlightedCandleStickPointLayout.Color, stockLowRect, stockHighRect, array);
			}
		}
	}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"LevelLineLength" => ShouldSerializeLevelLineLength(), 
				"LineThickness" => ShouldSerializeLineThickness(), 
				"ReductionOptions" => ShouldSerializeReductionOptions(), 
				"Animation" => ShouldSerializeAnimation(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLevelLineLength()
		{
			return LevelLineLength != 0.25;
		}

			LevelLineLength = 0.25;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLineThickness()

			return LineThickness != 2;

		{
			LineThickness = 2;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeReductionOptions()
		{
			return ReductionOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAnimation()
		{
			if (CheckIsAnimationChanged(animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				return base.CanUseAnimation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAnimation()
		{
			Animation = GetDefaultAnimation();
		}

		private void SetAnimation(FinancialAnimationBase newAnimation)
		{
			newAnimation.Owner = this;
			if (AnimationHelper.ShouldAssignNewAnimation(ChartContainer, animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				newAnimation.Assign(animation);
			}
			animation = newAnimation;
		}

		}

		private ProjectTransform CreateLegendTransform(Rectangle rect)

			return new ProjectTransform(rect);
		}

		protected abstract void RenderFinancial(ChartRenderer renderer, FinancialSeriesPointLayout financialPointLayout, Color color, ReductionStockOptions reductionOptions);

		protected abstract FinancialSeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, int lineThickness, Direction direction);

		protected override IEnumerable<double> GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			yield return ((IFinancialPoint)pointInfo).Low;
			yield return ((IFinancialPoint)pointInfo).High;
			yield return ((IFinancialPoint)pointInfo).Open;
			yield return ((IFinancialPoint)pointInfo).Close;
		}

		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Min(Math.Abs(((IFinancialPoint)point).Low), Math.Abs(((IFinancialPoint)point).High)), Math.Min(Math.Abs(((IFinancialPoint)point).Open), Math.Abs(((IFinancialPoint)point).Close)));
		}

		protected override Rectangle CorrectLegendMarkerBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(bounds, -1, -1);
			return GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(CorrectRectangleByShadowSize(rectangle, 1));
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(bounds.Size))
			{
				int num = (int)Math.Round((double)bounds.Width / 3.5);
				int num2 = (int)Math.Round((double)bounds.Height / 4.0);
				int num3 = (int)Math.Round((double)bounds.Width / 7.5);
				int num4 = (int)Math.Round((double)bounds.Height / 4.5);
				int lineThickness = 2;
				MatrixTransform matrixTransform = CreateLegendTransform(bounds);
				Point low = new Point(num, num2);
				Point high = new Point(low.X, bounds.Height + 1);
				Point open = new Point(low.X, low.Y + num4);
				Point close = new Point(low.X, bounds.Height + 1 - num4);
				FinancialSeriesPointLayout financialSeriesPointLayout = CreateSeriesPointLayout(null, lineThickness, Direction.BottomToTop);
				financialSeriesPointLayout.CalculateForLegend(matrixTransform, low, high, open, close, num3);
				Point low2 = new Point(bounds.Width + 1 - num, 0);
				Point high2 = new Point(low2.X, bounds.Height + 1 - num2);
				Point open2 = new Point(low2.X, low2.Y + num4);
				Point close2 = new Point(low2.X, high2.Y - num4);
				FinancialSeriesPointLayout financialSeriesPointLayout2 = CreateSeriesPointLayout(null, lineThickness, Direction.BottomToTop);
				financialSeriesPointLayout2.CalculateForLegend(matrixTransform, low2, high2, open2, close2, num3);
				FinancialDrawOptions financialDrawOptions = (FinancialDrawOptions)seriesPointDrawOptions;
				RenderShadow(renderer, bounds, financialSeriesPointLayout, financialDrawOptions);
				RenderShadow(renderer, bounds, financialSeriesPointLayout2, financialDrawOptions);
				RenderFinancial(renderer, financialSeriesPointLayout, financialDrawOptions.Color, financialDrawOptions.ReductionOptions);
				Color color = (financialDrawOptions.ReductionOptions.Visible ? financialDrawOptions.ReductionOptions.Color : financialDrawOptions.Color);
				RenderFinancial(renderer, financialSeriesPointLayout2, color, financialDrawOptions.ReductionOptions);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.High && valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.Low && valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.Open)
			{
				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Close;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ICustomBindingProperty> GetValueBindingProperties()
		{
			return ValueDataMemberBindingPropertyHelper.FinancialValueBindingProperties;
		}

		protected RectangleF CorrectRectangleByShadowSize(RectangleF rect, int shadowSize)
		{
			rect = new RectangleF(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width - (float)base.Shadow.GetActualSize(shadowSize), rect.Height - (float)base.Shadow.GetActualSize(shadowSize));
			return rect;
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(point.Argument - levelLineLength, point.Argument + levelLineLength);
		}

			return new FinancialViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeLevelLineLength() && !ShouldSerializeLineThickness() && !ShouldSerializeReductionOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAnimation();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in anchorPointLayoutList.Annotations)
			{
				SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint = (SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = anchorPointLayoutList.SeriesData.GetRefinedPoint(anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap, seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint());
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = anchorPointLayoutList.GetMapping(refinedPoint.Argument, GetRefinedPointMax(refinedPoint), annotation.ScrollingSupported);
					if (mapping != null)
					{
						anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, mapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(refinedPoint.Argument, GetRefinedPointMax(refinedPoint)), refinedPoint));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint? CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			return mapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument, GetRefinedPointMax(pointData.RefinedPoint));
		}

		protected internal override object[] GenerateRandomValues(int indexOfRandomPoint, int randomPointCount, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			double num = SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble();
			if (num < 0.5)
			{
				num += 0.5;
			}
			num = Math.Round(num * 10.0, 1);
			double num2 = SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble();
			if (num2 > 0.5)
			{
				num2 -= 0.5;
			}
			num2 = Math.Round(num2 * num, 1);
			double num3 = Math.Round(SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() * (num - num2) + num2, 1);
			double num4 = Math.Round(SeriesViewBase.random.NextDouble() * (num - num2) + num2, 1);
			return new object[4] { num2, num, num3, num4 };
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator)
		{
			IFinancialPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = LineThickness;
			if (pointData.SelectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				num += 2;
			}
			Direction rectangleDirection = XYDiagramSeriesViewBase.GetRectangleDirection(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Low, refinedPoint.High);
			FinancialSeriesPointLayout financialSeriesPointLayout = CreateSeriesPointLayout(pointData, num, rectangleDirection);
			financialSeriesPointLayout.Calculate(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Low, refinedPoint.High, refinedPoint.Open, refinedPoint.Close, LevelLineLengthTransformed);
			return financialSeriesPointLayout;
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeCalculate(XYDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			double coordCoreRound = seriesLayout.DiagramMapping.MappingX.GetCoordCoreRound(seriesLayout.DiagramMapping.MappingX.Min);
			double coordCoreRound2 = seriesLayout.DiagramMapping.MappingX.GetCoordCoreRound(seriesLayout.DiagramMapping.MappingX.Min + LevelLineLength);
			LevelLineLengthTransformed = coordCoreRound2 - coordCoreRound;
		}

		{
			return new ToolTipFinancialValueToStringConverter(base.Series);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()

		}

		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			return null;
		}

			{

			}
		}

		protected internal override Color GetPointColor(int pointIndex, int pointsCount)
		{
			Color pointColor = base.Series.GetPointColor(base.Series.ActualPoints[pointIndex]);

			{

			}
			return ActualColor;
		}

		{

		}

		{

			{
				return new EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder, alwaysOnDiagram: true);
			}
			return new ScreenPointCalculator();
		}

		public override string GetValueCaption(int index)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(index <= valueCaptions.Length - 1, "Invalid value caption index");
			return valueCaptions[index];
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FinancialSeriesViewBase financialSeriesViewBase = (FinancialSeriesViewBase)obj;
			if (financialSeriesViewBase.levelLineLength == levelLineLength && financialSeriesViewBase.lineStyle.Equals(lineStyle))
			{
				return financialSeriesViewBase.reductionOptions.Equals(reductionOptions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is FinancialSeriesViewBase financialSeriesViewBase)
			{
				levelLineLength = financialSeriesViewBase.levelLineLength;
				lineStyle.Assign(financialSeriesViewBase.lineStyle);
				reductionOptions.Assign(financialSeriesViewBase.reductionOptions);
				animation = ((financialSeriesViewBase.animation != null) ? ((FinancialAnimationBase)financialSeriesViewBase.animation.Clone()) : null);
			}
		}
	}
