	public abstract class GanttSeriesView : RangeBarSeriesView
	{
		private readonly TaskLinkOptions linkOptions;

		protected internal override bool IsSupportedRelations => true;

		protected override int PixelsPerArgument => 40;

		protected override CompatibleViewType CompatibleViewType => CompatibleViewType.GanttView;

		protected internal override string DefaultLabelTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesBase != null)
				{
					if (base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						return "{V:d}";
					}
					if (base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						return "{V:g}";
					}
					return "{V}";
				}
				return "{V}";
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool NeedFilterVisiblePoints => false;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public override Type DiagramType => typeof(GanttDiagram);

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GanttSeriesView.LinkOptions")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.GanttSeriesView.LinkOptions")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public TaskLinkOptions LinkOptions => linkOptions;

		private static SeriesPointLayout FindSeriesPointLayout(SeriesPoint point, SeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointLayout item in seriesLayout)
			{
				if (item.PointData.SeriesPoint == point)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public GanttSeriesView()
		{
			linkOptions = new TaskLinkOptions(this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == "LinkOptions")
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLinkOptions();
			}
			return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLinkOptions()
		{
			return LinkOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLinkOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RenderTaskLinkShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, TaskLinkLayout layout, Shadow shadow)
		{
			if (layout.LineRects != null)
			{
				foreach (ZPlaneRectangle lineRect in layout.LineRects)
				{
					shadow.Render(renderer, (Rectangle)lineRect);
				}
			}
			if (layout.ArrowPoints != null)
			{
				VariousPolygon variousPolygon = new VariousPolygon(layout.ArrowPoints, RectangleF.Empty);
				variousPolygon.RenderShadow(renderer, shadow, -1);
			}
		}

		private void RenderTaskLinks(ChartRenderer renderer, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			GanttWholeSeriesLayout ganttWholeSeriesLayout = (GanttWholeSeriesLayout)layout;
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = ganttWholeSeriesLayout.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout parentLayout = (SeriesPointLayout)enumerator.Key;
				TaskLinkLayout[] linkLayouts = (TaskLinkLayout[])enumerator.Value;
				linkOptions.Render(renderer, parentLayout, linkLayouts);
			}
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new GanttDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, BarData barData)
		{
			barData.CalculateBarRects(diagramMapping, out var diagramRect, out var screenRect);
			CalculateMarkerPoints(diagramMapping, barData, out var maxMarkerPoint, out var minMarkerPoint);
			RangeBarDrawOptions rangeBarDrawOptions = (RangeBarDrawOptions)pointData.DrawOptions;
			IPolygon minMarkerPolygon = (rangeBarDrawOptions.MinValueMarkerVisible ? rangeBarDrawOptions.MinValueMarker.CalculatePolygon(minMarkerPoint, isSelected: false) : null);
			IPolygon maxMarkerPolygon = (rangeBarDrawOptions.MaxValueMarkerVisible ? rangeBarDrawOptions.MaxValueMarker.CalculatePolygon(maxMarkerPoint, isSelected: false) : null);
			Direction rectangleDirection = XYDiagramSeriesViewBase.GetRectangleDirection(diagramMapping, barData.ZeroValue, barData.ActualValue);
			return new GanttSeriesPointLayout(pointData, rectangleDirection, screenRect, diagramRect, minMarkerPolygon, maxMarkerPolygon);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is GanttSeriesView ganttSeriesView)
			{
				linkOptions.Assign(ganttSeriesView.linkOptions);
			}
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, SeriesLayout seriesLayout, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			if (!linkOptions.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GanttWholeSeriesLayout ganttWholeSeriesLayout = new GanttWholeSeriesLayout(seriesLayout);
			foreach (SeriesPointLayout item in seriesLayout)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(base.Series);
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(item.PointData.RefinedPoint));
				foreach (TaskLink relation in seriesPoint.Relations)
				{
					SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = FindSeriesPointLayout(relation.ChildPoint, seriesLayout);
					if (seriesPointLayout != null)
					{
						TaskLinkLayout value = TaskLinkLayout.CreateLayout(diagramMapping, ((GanttDrawOptions)item.PointData.DrawOptions).LinkOptions, relation, (GanttSeriesPointLayout)item, (GanttSeriesPointLayout)seriesPointLayout);
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
				}
				ganttWholeSeriesLayout.Add(item, (TaskLinkLayout[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(TaskLinkLayout)));
			}
			return ganttWholeSeriesLayout;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			RenderTaskLinks(renderer, layout);
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateWholeSeriesShadowGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderWholeSeriesShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			GanttWholeSeriesLayout ganttWholeSeriesLayout = (GanttWholeSeriesLayout)layout;
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = ganttWholeSeriesLayout.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				TaskLinkLayout[] array = (TaskLinkLayout[])enumerator.Value;
				TaskLinkLayout[] array2 = array;
				foreach (TaskLinkLayout layout2 in array2)
				{
					RenderTaskLinkShadow(renderer, layout2, ((GanttDrawOptions)layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions).Shadow);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			GanttSeriesView ganttSeriesView = (GanttSeriesView)obj;
			return linkOptions.Equals(ganttSeriesView.linkOptions);
		}
	}

		private static bool CalcJointPoint(Line line1, Line line2, out DiagramPoint point)
		{
			switch (IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(line1.V1, line1.V2, line2.V1, line2.V2, intervalMode: true, 0.01, out point))
			{
			case Intersection.Yes:
				point.Z = line1.V2.Z;
				return true;
			case Intersection.No:
			{
				double num = Math.Abs(MathUtils.CalcAngleBetweenLines2D(line1.V1, line1.V2, line2.V1, line2.V2));
				bool result = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, Math.PI / 2.0, 0.01) <= 0 && IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(line1.V1, line1.V2, line2.V1, line2.V2, intervalMode: false, 0.01, out point) == Intersection.Yes;
				point.Z = line1.V2.Z;
				return result;
			}
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected static List<SeriesPointLayout> ExtractSeriesPointViewInfo(List<SeriesPointLayout> pointsLayout, ref int index)
		{
			List<SeriesPointLayout> list = new List<SeriesPointLayout>();
			while (index < pointsLayout.Count)
			{
				if (pointsLayout[index] is View3DSeriesPointLayout item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					return list;
				}
				index++;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected static void CalcLines(DiagramPoint point1, DiagramPoint point2, float offset, out Line topLine, out Line bottomLine)
		{
			double z = point1.Z;
			float x = (float)MathUtils.CalcLength2D(point1, point2);
			PointF[] array = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(0f, 0f - offset),
				new PointF(x, 0f - offset),
				new PointF(0f, offset),
				new PointF(x, offset)
			};
			MathUtils.CalcTranslateMatrix(point1, point2).TransformPoints(array);
			bottomLine = new Line(new DiagramPoint(array[0].X, array[0].Y, z), new DiagramPoint(array[1].X, array[1].Y, z));
			topLine = new Line(new DiagramPoint(array[2].X, array[2].Y, z), new DiagramPoint(array[3].X, array[3].Y, z));
		}

		protected static void CalcJoints(ref Line line1, ref Line line2, out DiagramPoint jointPoint, out Line jointLine, bool revertJointLine)
		{
			if (CalcJointPoint(line1, line2, out jointPoint))
			{
				double value = MathUtils.CalcAngleBetweenLines2D(line1.V1, jointPoint, line1.V1, line1.V2);
				line1 = ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(value), Math.PI, 0.01) == 0) ? new Line(jointPoint, line1.V1) : new Line(line1.V1, jointPoint));
				value = MathUtils.CalcAngleBetweenLines2D(jointPoint, line2.V2, line2.V1, line2.V2);
				line2 = ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(value), Math.PI, 0.01) == 0) ? new Line(line2.V2, jointPoint) : new Line(jointPoint, line2.V2));
				jointLine = null;
			}
			else
			{
				jointLine = (revertJointLine ? new Line(line2.V1, line1.V2) : new Line(line1.V2, line2.V1));
				jointPoint = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter2D(line1.V2, line2.V1, 0.01);
			}
		}

		public Line3DSeriesView()
		{
			markerLineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antiAlias: false);
			legendLineStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antiAlias: true);
		}

				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private List<PlanePolygon> CreateLineSegmentPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, LineStrip strip, double lineWidth, int seriesWeight, int lineThickness, Color color)
		{
			if (strip.Count == 0)
			{
				return new List<PlanePolygon>();
			}
			double z = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesOffset(base.Series);
			if (strip.IsEmpty)
			{
				return CreatePolygonsForSinglePoint(coordsCalculator, strip[0], z, lineWidth, seriesWeight, lineThickness, color);
			}
			float offset = (float)((double)lineThickness / 2.0);
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(strip[0].X, strip[0].Y, z);
			Line line = null;
			Line line2 = null;
			bool leftVisible = true;
			for (int i = 1; i < strip.Count; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(strip[i].X, strip[i].Y, z);
				if (!MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(diagramPoint2, diagramPoint, 0.01))
				{
					CalcLines(diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, offset, out var topLine, out var bottomLine);
					if (line != null && line2 != null)
					{
						CalcJoints(ref line, ref topLine, out var jointPoint, out var jointLine, revertJointLine: true);
						CalcJoints(ref line2, ref bottomLine, out var jointPoint2, out var jointLine2, revertJointLine: false);
						bool rightVisible = false;
						if (jointLine != null && jointLine2 != null)
						{
							double value = MathUtils.CalcAngleBetweenLines2D(line.V1, line.V2, topLine.V1, topLine.V2);
							if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(value), Math.PI, 0.01) == 0)
							{
								rightVisible = true;
							}
						}
						else if (jointLine != null)
						{
							List<PlanePolygon> polygons = SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, jointPoint2, jointLine, lineVisible: true, sidesVisible: false, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
							list.AddRange(polygons);
						}
						else if (jointLine2 != null)
						{
							List<PlanePolygon> polygons2 = SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, jointPoint, jointLine2, lineVisible: true, sidesVisible: false, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
							list.AddRange(polygons2);
						}
						List<PlanePolygon> polygons3 = SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, line, line2, leftVisible, rightVisible, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
						list.AddRange(polygons3);
						leftVisible = false;
					}
					line = topLine;
					line2 = bottomLine;
				}
				diagramPoint = diagramPoint2;
			}
			if (line2 != null && line != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, line, line2, leftVisible, rightVisible: true, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected List<PlanePolygon> CreatePolygonsForSinglePoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, GRealPoint2D point, double z, double lineWidth, int seriesWeight, int lineThickness, Color color)
		{
			double num = (double)lineThickness / 2.0;
			double x = point.X - num;
			double x2 = point.X + num;
			double y = point.Y - num;
			double y2 = point.Y + num;
			return SeriesView3DHelper.GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, new Line(new DiagramPoint(x, y2, z), new DiagramPoint(x2, y2, z)), new Line(new DiagramPoint(x, y, z), new DiagramPoint(x2, y, z)), leftVisible: true, rightVisible: true, lineWidth, seriesWeight, color);
		}

		protected virtual GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return new LineGeometryStripCreator(closed: false);
		}

		protected virtual List<PlanePolygon> CalculatePolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			double num = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesWidth(this);
			int seriesWeight = coordsCalculator.GetSeriesWeight(base.Series);
			Color color = seriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions.Color;
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			foreach (LineStrip item in StripsUtils.MapLineStrips(coordsCalculator, strips))
			{
				List<PlanePolygon> collection = CreateLineSegmentPolygons(coordsCalculator, item, num, seriesWeight, lineThickness, color);
				list.AddRange(collection);
			}
			return list;
		}

		{
			return new LineStrip();
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, RefinedPointData pointData, IAxisRangeData axisRangeY)
		{
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = GetSeriesPointValues(pointData.RefinedPoint);
			return coordsCalculator.Project(coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, ((IArgumentPoint)pointData.RefinedPoint).Argument, seriesPointValues.Max, clipping: false));
		}

		protected override void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (seriesPointDrawOptions is Line3DDrawOptions line3DDrawOptions)
			{
				int y = bounds.Top + (bounds.Height - 1) / 2;
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(legendLineStyle.AntiAlias);
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point(bounds.Left, y), new Point(bounds.Right, y), line3DDrawOptions.Color, 1, legendLineStyle, LineCap.Round);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected internal override XYDiagram3DWholeSeriesLayout CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, SeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout xYDiagram3DSeriesLayout = seriesLayout as XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout;
			LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData = ((xYDiagram3DSeriesLayout != null) ? (xYDiagram3DSeriesLayout.SeriesData.WholeViewData as LineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData) : null);
			if (lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData != null)
			{
				return new Line3DWholeSeriesLayout(CalculatePolygons(coordsCalculator, xYDiagram3DSeriesLayout, lineAndAreaWholeSeriesViewData.Strips));
			}
			return null;
		}

				return false;
			}
			Line3DSeriesView line3DSeriesView = (Line3DSeriesView)obj;
			if (lineThickness == line3DSeriesView.lineThickness)

			return false;
		}

				"MarkerVisibility" => ShouldSerializeMarkerVisibility(), 
				"EnableAntialiasing" => ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing(), 
				"SeriesAnimation" => ShouldSerializeSeriesAnimation(), 
				"ShowIsolatedPoints" => ShouldSerializeShowIsolatedPoints(), 
				"SegmentColorizer" => ShouldSerializeSegmentColorizer(),

			};
		}

			}
			if (bezierStripSplitter2 != null)
			{
				return bezierStripSplitter2;
			}
			if (bezierStripSplitter != null)
			{
				return bezierStripSplitter;
			}
			return DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance;

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (!(obj is ILineSeriesView lineSeriesView))
			{
				return;
			}
			lineStyle.Assign(lineSeriesView.LineStyle);
			lineStyle.SetAntialiasing(DefaultLineAntialiasing);
			if (lineSeriesView is LineSeriesView lineSeriesView2)
			{
				markerVisibility = lineSeriesView2.markerVisibility;
				enableAntialiasing = lineSeriesView2.enableAntialiasing;
				seriesAnimation = ((lineSeriesView2.seriesAnimation != null) ? ((XYSeriesAnimationBase)lineSeriesView2.seriesAnimation.Clone()) : null);
				showIsolatedPoints = lineSeriesView2.showIsolatedPoints;
				if (lineSeriesView2.segmentColorizer != null)
				{
					SegmentColorizer = (SegmentColorizerBase)lineSeriesView2.segmentColorizer.Clone();
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LineSeriesView lineSeriesView = (LineSeriesView)obj;
			if (lineStyle.Equals(lineSeriesView.lineStyle))
			{
				return LineMarkerOptions.Equals(lineSeriesView.LineMarkerOptions);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (!(pointLayout is PieSeriesPointLayout { PointData: var pointData } pieSeriesPointLayout))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IPiePoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain = domain as SimpleDiagram3DDomain;
			if (refinedPoint == null || refinedPoint.NormalizedValue == 0.0 || simpleDiagram3DDomain == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float num = (0f - pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis) * Math.Min(0.02f, 1f - pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.HoleFraction);
			RectangleF thisRect = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(pieSeriesPointLayout.PieBounds, num, num);
			if (!thisRect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.CalculateCenter(pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint), thisRect.Width / 2f, thisRect.Height / 2f);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.HalfAngle);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X - ellipse.Center.X, ellipse.Center.Y - gRealPoint2D.Y);
			diagramPoint.X += ellipse.Center.X - (double)pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint.X;
			diagramPoint.Y -= ellipse.Center.Y - (double)pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint.Y;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 1.0));
			double num2 = (double)(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.MajorSemiaxis * (float)DepthPercent) * 0.02;
			double z = ((diagramPoint3.Z < diagramPoint2.Z) ? (num2 * 0.5) : ((0.0 - num2) * 0.5));
			return simpleDiagram3DDomain.Project(new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, z));
		}

		protected override SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase CreateSimpleDiagramSeriesLayout()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData = new RefinedSeriesData(base.Chart.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(base.Series), null, null);
			DXRectangle bounds = GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DisplayBounds);
			return new SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout(seriesData, bounds);
		}

		{
			if (!(drawOptions is Pie3DDrawOptions pie3DDrawOptions) || !pie.ShouldCreateGraphicsCommand())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Color color = pie3DDrawOptions.Color;
			if (negativeValuesPresents)
			{
				color = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(150, 255, 255, 255), pie3DDrawOptions.Color);
				pie3DDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode = FillMode3D.Solid;
			}
			return pie.CreateGraphicsCommand(color, pie3DDrawOptions.ActualColor2, pie3DDrawOptions.FillStyle, PointF.Empty);
		}

				{
					return fillStyle;
				}
				return Appearance?.FillStyle;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSeriesView.MinAllowedSizePercentage")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.PieSeriesView.MinAllowedSizePercentage")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double MinAllowedSizePercentage
		{
			get
			{
				return minAllowedSizeFraction * 100.0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(0.0 <= value) || !(value <= 100.0))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPercentValue));
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				minAllowedSizeFraction = value / 100.0;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"MinAllowedSizePercentage" => ShouldSerializeMinAllowedSizePercentage(), 
				"Rotation" => ShouldSerializeRotation(), 
				"HeightToWidthRatio" => ShouldSerializeHeightToWidthRatio(), 
				"Border" => ShouldSerializeBorder(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"RuntimeExploding" => ShouldSerializeRuntimeExploding(), 
				"Animation" => ShouldSerializeAnimation(), 
				"TotalLabel" => ShouldSerializeTotalLabel(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinAllowedSizePercentage()
		{
			return minAllowedSizeFraction != 0.5;
		}

		private void ResetMinAllowedSizePercentage()
		{
			MinAllowedSizePercentage = 50.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotation()
		{
			return Rotation != 0;
		}

		private void ResetRotation()
		{
			Rotation = 0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeHeightToWidthRatio()
		{
			return HeightToWidthRatio != 1.0;
		}

		private void ResetHeightToWidthRatio()
		{
			HeightToWidthRatio = 1.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorder()
		{
			return Border.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFillStyle()
		{
			return FillStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRuntimeExploding()
		{
			return runtimeExploding;
		}

		private void ResetRuntimeExploding()
		{
			RuntimeExploding = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAnimation()
		{
			if (CheckIsAnimationChanged(animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				return base.CanUseAnimation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAnimation()
		{
			Animation = GetDefaultAnimation();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTotalLabel()
		{
			return totalLabel.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeRotation() && !ShouldSerializeHeightToWidthRatio() && !ShouldSerializeBorder() && !ShouldSerializeFillStyle() && !ShouldSerializeRuntimeExploding() && !ShouldSerializeAnimation())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTotalLabel();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			SetAnimation(GetDefaultAnimation());
			border = new CustomBorder(this, visible: true, Color.Empty);
			fillStyle = new PolygonFillStyle(this);
			totalLabel = new PieTotalLabel(this);
		}

		private void SetAnimation(PieAnimationBase newAnimation)
		{
			newAnimation.Owner = this;
			if (AnimationHelper.ShouldAssignNewAnimation(ChartContainer, animation, GetDefaultAnimation()))
			{
				newAnimation.Assign(animation);
			}
			animation = newAnimation;
		}

		private PieAnimationBase GetDefaultAnimation()
		{
			return new PieGrowUpAnimation();
		}

		private DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPoint(SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (!(pointLayout is PieSeriesPointLayout { PointData: var pointData } pieSeriesPointLayout))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IPiePoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint == null || refinedPoint.NormalizedValue == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RectangleF pieBounds = pieSeriesPointLayout.PieBounds;
			if (!pieBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.CalculateCenter(pieSeriesPointLayout.BasePoint), pieBounds.Width / 2f, pieBounds.Height / 2f);
			return (DiagramPoint)ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.HalfAngle);
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateMaxPossiblePieBounds(Rectangle seriesAreaExcludingTitles, out DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds direction)
		{
			Rectangle thisRectangle = default(Rectangle);
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width * heightToWidthRatio);
			if (num < seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height)
			{
				thisRectangle.Width = seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width;
				thisRectangle.Height = num;
				direction = DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds.Horizontal;
			}
			else
			{
				int width = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height / heightToWidthRatio);
				thisRectangle.Width = width;
				thisRectangle.Height = seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height;
				direction = DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds.Vertical;
			}
			return thisRectangle.GetTheSameRectPlacedInCenterOf(seriesAreaExcludingTitles);
		}

		private Size CalculateMaxLabelOrAnnotationInLabelModeSize(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle pieBounds)
		{
			PieSeriesLabel pieSeriesLabel = (PieSeriesLabel)base.SeriesBase.Label;
			Size size = pieSeriesLabel.CalculateMaximumSize(seriesData, pieBounds.Size);
			Size size2 = AnnotationHelper.CalculateAnnotationSize(seriesData);
			return new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height));
		}

		private Rectangle GetCorrectedByLabelsInHorizontalDirectionPieBounds(Rectangle maxPossiblePieBounds, Rectangle seriesAreaExcludingTitles, Size maxLabelOrAnnotationSize)
		{
			Rectangle thisRectangle = maxPossiblePieBounds;
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width * minAllowedSizeFraction);
			num = ((num < 2) ? 2 : num);
			int heightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio = GetHeightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio(num);
			int num2 = seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width - MathUtils.StrongRound(num);
			int num3 = 2 * maxLabelOrAnnotationSize.Width;
			if (num3 > num2)
			{
				int num4 = num2;
				thisRectangle.Width -= num4;
				thisRectangle.Height = GetHeightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio(thisRectangle.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				int num5 = num3;
				thisRectangle.Width -= num5;
				thisRectangle.Height = GetHeightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio(thisRectangle.Width);
				int num6 = thisRectangle.Height - MathUtils.StrongRound(heightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio);
				int num7 = 2 * maxLabelOrAnnotationSize.Height - (seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height - thisRectangle.Height);
				int num8 = ((num7 > num6) ? num6 : ((num7 > 0) ? num7 : 0));
				thisRectangle.Height -= num8;
				thisRectangle.Width = GetWidthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio(thisRectangle.Height);
				if (thisRectangle.Width > seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width)
				{
					thisRectangle.Width = seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width;
				}
			}
			return thisRectangle.GetTheSameRectPlacedInCenterOf(seriesAreaExcludingTitles);
		}

		private Rectangle GetCorrectedByLabelsInVerticalDirectionPieBounds(Rectangle maxPossiblePieBounds, Rectangle seriesAreaExcludingTitles, Size maxLabelOrAnnotationSize)
		{
			Rectangle thisRectangle = maxPossiblePieBounds;
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height * minAllowedSizeFraction);
			num = ((num < 2) ? 2 : num);
			int widthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio = GetWidthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio(num);
			int num2 = seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height - num;
			int num3 = 2 * maxLabelOrAnnotationSize.Height;
			if (num3 > num2)
			{
				int num4 = num2;
				thisRectangle.Height -= num4;
				thisRectangle.Width = GetWidthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio(thisRectangle.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				int num5 = num3;
				thisRectangle.Height -= num5;
				thisRectangle.Width = GetWidthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio(thisRectangle.Height);
				int num6 = thisRectangle.Width - widthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio;
				int num7 = 2 * maxLabelOrAnnotationSize.Width - (seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width - thisRectangle.Width);
				int num8 = ((num7 > num6) ? num6 : ((num7 > 0) ? num7 : 0));
				thisRectangle.Width -= num8;
				thisRectangle.Height = GetHeightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio(thisRectangle.Width);
				if (thisRectangle.Height > seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height)
				{
					thisRectangle.Height = seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height;
				}
			}
			return thisRectangle.GetTheSameRectPlacedInCenterOf(seriesAreaExcludingTitles);
		}

		private int GetWidthByHeightUsingHeightToWidthRatio(int height)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)height / heightToWidthRatio);
			if (num < 2)
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetHeightByWidthUsingHeightToWidthRatio(int width)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)width * heightToWidthRatio);
			if (num < 2)
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint? CalculateAnnotationAnchorPoint(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			return CalculateAnchorPoint(pointLayout);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PieSeriesView();
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(Pie pie, PointF basePoint, bool negativeValuesPresents, SelectionState selectionState, int borderThickness, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			if (!(drawOptions is PieDrawOptions pieDrawOptions) || !pie.ShouldCreateGraphicsCommand())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Color color = drawOptions.Color;
			if (negativeValuesPresents)
			{
				color = Color.FromArgb(40, drawOptions.Color);
				pieDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Solid;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SimpleAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			GraphicsCommand command = ((pie.HolePercent == 100.0) ? pie.CreateBorderGraphicsCommand(1, basePoint) : pie.CreateGraphicsCommand(color, drawOptions.ActualColor2, pieDrawOptions.FillStyle, basePoint));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(command);
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(pie.CreateHatchGraphicsCommand(basePoint));
			}
			if (pieDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				int thickness = ((borderThickness > 0) ? borderThickness : pieDrawOptions.Border.ActualThickness);
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(pie.CreateBorderGraphicsCommand(thickness, basePoint));
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Pie pie, PointF basePoint, bool negativeValuesPresents, SelectionState selectionState, int borderThickness, SimpleDiagramDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			if (drawOptions is PieDrawOptions pieDrawOptions && pie.ShouldCreateGraphicsCommand())
			{
				Color borderColor = drawOptions.Color;
				if (negativeValuesPresents)
				{
					borderColor = Color.FromArgb(40, drawOptions.Color);
					pieDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Solid;
				}
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				if (pie.HolePercent == 100.0)
				{
					pie.RenderBorder(renderer, borderColor, 1, basePoint);
				}
				else
				{
					pie.Render(renderer, borderColor, drawOptions.ActualColor2, pieDrawOptions.FillStyle, basePoint);
				}
				if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
				{
					pie.RenderHatch(renderer, base.HitTestState.GetPointHatchColor(base.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode, selectionState), basePoint);
				}
				if (pieDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
				{
					Color borderColor2 = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(pieDrawOptions.Border, BorderColorFromAppearance);
					int thickness = ((borderThickness > 0) ? borderThickness : pieDrawOptions.Border.ActualThickness);
					pie.RenderBorder(renderer, borderColor2, thickness, basePoint);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Abs(((IValuePoint)point).Value);
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new PieDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected internal override bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != totalLabel)
			{
				return base.Contains(obj);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint? CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(SeriesPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			return CalculateAnchorPoint(pointLayout);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new PieSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override bool CalculateBounds(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle seriesAreaExcludingTitles, out Rectangle pieBounds, out Rectangle pieWithLabelsBounds)
		{
			pieBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			pieWithLabelsBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Width < 2 || seriesAreaExcludingTitles.Height < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds direction;
			Rectangle rectangle = CalculateMaxPossiblePieBounds(seriesAreaExcludingTitles, out direction);
			Size maxLabelOrAnnotationSize = CalculateMaxLabelOrAnnotationInLabelModeSize(seriesData, rectangle);
			switch (direction)
			{
			case DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds.Horizontal:
				pieBounds = GetCorrectedByLabelsInHorizontalDirectionPieBounds(rectangle, seriesAreaExcludingTitles, maxLabelOrAnnotationSize);
				break;
			case DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds.Vertical:
				pieBounds = GetCorrectedByLabelsInVerticalDirectionPieBounds(rectangle, seriesAreaExcludingTitles, maxLabelOrAnnotationSize);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds");
				break;
			}
			pieWithLabelsBounds = pieBounds;
			pieWithLabelsBounds.Inflate(maxLabelOrAnnotationSize.Width, maxLabelOrAnnotationSize.Height);
			pieWithLabelsBounds = Rectangle.Intersect(pieWithLabelsBounds, seriesAreaExcludingTitles);
			ChartDebug.Assert(pieBounds.IsInto(pieWithLabelsBounds));
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is ISimpleDiagram2DSeriesView simpleDiagram2DSeriesView)
			{
				border.Assign(simpleDiagram2DSeriesView.Border);
				fillStyle.Assign(simpleDiagram2DSeriesView.FillStyle);
			}
			if (obj is PieSeriesView pieSeriesView)
			{
				angleDegree = pieSeriesView.angleDegree;
				heightToWidthRatio = pieSeriesView.heightToWidthRatio;
				runtimeExploding = pieSeriesView.runtimeExploding;
				minAllowedSizeFraction = pieSeriesView.minAllowedSizeFraction;
				animation = ((pieSeriesView.animation != null) ? ((PieAnimationBase)pieSeriesView.animation.Clone()) : null);
				totalLabel.Assign(pieSeriesView.totalLabel);
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PieSeriesView pieSeriesView = (PieSeriesView)obj;
			if (minAllowedSizeFraction == pieSeriesView.minAllowedSizeFraction && angleDegree == pieSeriesView.angleDegree && heightToWidthRatio == pieSeriesView.heightToWidthRatio && border.Equals(pieSeriesView.border))
			{
				return fillStyle.Equals(pieSeriesView.fillStyle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PieSeriesViewBase : SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase
	{
		private const PieSweepDirection DefaultSweepDirection = PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise;

		private const double DoublePi = Math.PI * 2.0;

		private const double DefaultSize = 100.0;

		private const double DefaultExplodedDistancePercentage = 10.0;

		private const PieExplodeMode DefaultExplodeMode = PieExplodeMode.None;

		private double sizeAsPercentage = 100.0;

		private double explodedDistancePercentage = 10.0;

		private PieExplodeMode explodeMode;

		private readonly ExplodedSeriesPointCollection explodedPoints;

		private ExplodeFilter explodeFilter;

		private int[] explodedPointIds = new int[0];

		private readonly SeriesPointFilterCollection explodedPointsFilters;

		private PieSweepDirection sweepDirection;

		private List<int> explodedPointsIndices;

		private new PieSeriesLabel Label => (PieSeriesLabel)base.Label;

		private ExplodeFilter ExplodeFilter => explodeFilter;

		internal bool ShouldSerializeExplodedPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (explodeMode != PieExplodeMode.UsePoints)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Owner is Series { UnboundMode: not false } series)
				{
					return !series.UseRandomPoints;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal List<int> ExplodedPointsIndices
		{
			get
			{
				return explodedPointsIndices;
			}
			set
			{
				explodedPointsIndices = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool NeedFilterVisiblePoints => false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldSortPoints => false;

		protected internal override bool SerializeSeriesPointID => true;

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"SizeAsPercentage" => ShouldSerializeSizeAsPercentage(), 
				"ExplodedDistancePercentage" => ShouldSerializeExplodedDistancePercentage(), 
				"ExplodeMode" => ShouldSerializeExplodeMode(), 
				"ExplodedPointIdsSerializable" => ShouldSerializeExplodedPointIdsSerializable(), 
				"ExplodedPointsFiltersConjuctionMode" => ShouldSerializeExplodedPointsFiltersConjunctionMode(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		protected override void SetIndexCollectionItemOnXtraDeserializing(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "ExplodedPointsFilters")
			{
				ExplodedPointsFilters.Add((SeriesPointFilter)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				base.SetIndexCollectionItemOnXtraDeserializing(propertyName, e);
			}
		}

		protected override object CreateCollectionItemOnXtraDeserializing(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ExplodedPointsFilters"))
			{
				return base.CreateCollectionItemOnXtraDeserializing(propertyName, e);
			}
			return new SeriesPointFilter();
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSizeAsPercentage()
		{
			return sizeAsPercentage != 100.0;
		}

		protected void ResetSizeAsPercentage()
		{
			SizeAsPercentage = 100.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeExplodedDistancePercentage()
		{
			return explodedDistancePercentage != 10.0;
		}

		private void ResetExplodedDistancePercentage()
		{
			ExplodedDistancePercentage = 10.0;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeExplodeMode()
		{
			return explodeMode != PieExplodeMode.None;
		}

		private void ResetExplodeMode()
		{
			ExplodeMode = PieExplodeMode.None;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeExplodedPointIdsSerializable()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeExplodedPoints)
			{
				if (!XtraSerializing)
				{
					if (ChartContainer != null)
					{
						return ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeExplodedPointsFiltersConjunctionMode()
		{
			return ExplodedPointsFiltersConjunctionMode != ConjunctionTypes.And;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSweepDirection()
		{
			return sweepDirection != PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
		}

		private void ResetSweepDirection()
		{
			SweepDirection = PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeSizeAsPercentage() && !ShouldSerializeExplodedDistancePercentage() && !ShouldSerializeExplodeMode() && !ShouldSerializeExplodedPointIdsSerializable() && !ShouldSerializeSweepDirection() && ExplodedPointsFilters.Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeExplodedPointsFiltersConjunctionMode();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private RectangleF CorrectBoundsByExploding(RectangleF bounds, RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, float explodedFactor, bool canExplode)
		{
			bool flag = IsExploded(seriesData.RefinedSeries);
			if (flag || canExplode)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (seriesData.WholeViewData is PieWholeSeriesViewData { PositiveValuesCount: >1 })
					{
						flag2 = HasExplodedPoints(seriesData.RefinedSeries);
					}
					bool flag3 = base.Series.Chart.Container.DesignMode && flag2;
					bool flag4 = !base.Series.Chart.Container.DesignMode && (ActualRuntimeExploding || flag2);
					if (!flag3 && !flag4)
					{
						return bounds;
					}
				}
				float num = bounds.Width / (1f + explodedFactor);
				float num2 = bounds.Height / (1f + explodedFactor);
				float x = bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2f - num / 2f;
				float y = bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2f - num2 / 2f;
				return new RectangleF(x, y, num, num2);
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private void UpdateExplodeFilter()
		{
			explodeFilter = ExplodeFilter.CreateInstance(this);
		}

		private Pie CreatePieForLegendItem(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			GRealPoint2D center = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom);
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(center, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			return new Pie(0.0, Math.PI / 2.0, ellipse, 0, LegendHolePercent);
		}

		private SeriesPointLayout FindSeriesPointLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointLayout item in seriesLayout)
			{
				if (item.PointData.RefinedPoint == refinedPoint)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SeriesPointLayout CalculatePointLayout(ref double startAngle, ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			IPiePoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = seriesData.RefinedSeries;
			PieWholeSeriesViewData pieWholeSeriesViewData = seriesData.WholeViewData as PieWholeSeriesViewData;
			bool flag = CanExplodePoint(refinedPoint);
			double explodedFactor = GetExplodedFactor(refinedSeries);
			RectangleF rectangleF = CorrectBoundsByExploding(domain.ElementBounds, seriesData, (float)explodedFactor, flag);
			if (!rectangleF.AreWidthAndHeightPositive() || domain == null || refinedPoint == null || refinedPoint.IsEmpty || pieWholeSeriesViewData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SizeF size = rectangleF.Size;
			PointF basePoint = SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase.CalculateBasePoint(rectangleF);
			SizeF sizeF = CalculatePieSize(refinedSeries, size);
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(default(GRealPoint2D), sizeF.Width / 2f, sizeF.Height / 2f);
			double areaSector = ellipse.Area * refinedPoint.NormalizedValue;
			double num = ellipse.CalcEllipseSectorFinishAngle(areaSector, startAngle);
			double holePercent = CalculateActualHolePercent(refinedSeries, size);
			Pie pie;
			if (SweepDirection == PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise)
			{
				pie = new Pie(startAngle, num, ellipse, DepthPercent, holePercent);
			}
			else
			{
				double num2 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num;
				double num3;
				for (num3 = Math.PI * 2.0 - startAngle; num2 < 0.0 || num3 < 0.0; num3 += Math.PI * 2.0)
				{
					num2 += Math.PI * 2.0;
				}
				pie = new Pie(num2, num3, ellipse, DepthPercent, holePercent);
			}
			if (pieWholeSeriesViewData.PositiveValuesCount > 0 && !pieWholeSeriesViewData.NegativeValuePresents && flag && IsExploded(pointData.RefinedPoint))
			{
				pie = pie.Explode(explodedFactor);
			}
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = pie.CalculateCenter(basePoint);
			RectangleF pieBounds = new RectangleF((float)(gRealPoint2D.X - ellipse.MajorSemiaxis), (float)(gRealPoint2D.Y - ellipse.MinorSemiaxis), (float)(ellipse.MajorSemiaxis * 2.0), (float)(ellipse.MinorSemiaxis * 2.0));
			startAngle = num;
			return new PieSeriesPointLayout(pointData, domain.Bounds, pie, basePoint, pieBounds, pieWholeSeriesViewData.NegativeValuePresents, pieWholeSeriesViewData.PositiveValuesCount);
		}

		}

		protected void ValidatePercentValue(double val)
		{
			if (val < 0.0 || val > 100.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPercentValue));
			}
		}

		protected Rectangle CorrectBoundsBySizeAsPercentageAndHeightToWidthRatio(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int num;
			int num2;
			if ((double)bounds.Height / (double)bounds.Width >= ActualHeightToWidthRatio)
			{
				num = MathUtils.StrongRound(sizeAsPercentage * (double)bounds.Width / 100.0);
				num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(ActualHeightToWidthRatio * (double)num);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(sizeAsPercentage * (double)bounds.Height / 100.0);
				num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)num2 / ActualHeightToWidthRatio);
			}
			int num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(bounds.Width - num) / 2.0);
			int num4 = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)(bounds.Height - num2) / 2.0);
			return new Rectangle(bounds.X + num3, bounds.Y + num4, num, num2);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanExplodePoint(IPiePoint pointInfo)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal bool HasExplodedPoints(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty && IsExploded(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool IsExploded(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (ExplodeFilter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ExplodeFilter.CheckPoint(point);
		}

		}

		{
			return HolePercent;
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetExplodedFactor(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return explodedDistancePercentage / 100.0;
		}

		protected internal override bool CalculateBounds(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle domainBounds, out Rectangle pieBounds, out Rectangle pieWithLabelsBounds)
		{
			pieBounds = domainBounds;
			pieWithLabelsBounds = domainBounds;
			if (!domainBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			Size size = Label.CalculateMaximumSize(seriesData, pieBounds.Size);
			Size size2 = AnnotationHelper.CalculateAnnotationSize(seriesData);
			Size size3 = new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height));
			pieBounds.Inflate(-size3.Width, -size3.Height);
			if (!pieBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			pieBounds = CorrectBoundsBySizeAsPercentageAndHeightToWidthRatio(pieBounds);
			pieWithLabelsBounds = Rectangle.Inflate(pieBounds, size3.Width, size3.Height);
			return pieBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive();
		}

		protected internal override bool CheckArgumentScaleType(ScaleType argumentScaleType, bool throwException)
		{
			bool result = base.CheckArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType, throwException);
			if (argumentScaleType != ((SeriesBase)base.Owner).ArgumentScaleType)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointFilter explodedPointsFilter in explodedPointsFilters)
				{
					if (explodedPointsFilter.Key == SeriesPointKey.Argument && !explodedPointsFilter.CanConvert(argumentScaleType))
					{
						if (throwException)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPieArgumentScaleType), argumentScaleType.ToString()));
						}
						result = false;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void SetArgumentScaleType(ScaleType argumentScaleType)
		{
			base.SetArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType);
			if (argumentScaleType == ((SeriesBase)base.Owner).ArgumentScaleType)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointFilter explodedPointsFilter in explodedPointsFilters)
			{
				if (explodedPointsFilter.Key == SeriesPointKey.Argument)
				{
					explodedPointsFilter.ConvertBasedOnScaleType(argumentScaleType);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanDrag(ChartHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!base.Chart.Container.DesignMode)
			{
				return ActualRuntimeExploding;
			}
			if (base.Series.UnboundMode)
			{
				return !hitInfo.SeriesPoint.IsAuxiliary;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool PerformDragging(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int dx, int dy)
		{
			SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase seriesLayout = CreateSimpleDiagramSeriesLayout();
			SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = FindSeriesPointLayout(seriesLayout, refinedPoint);
			if (seriesPointLayout == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PieSeriesPointLayout pieSeriesPointLayout = (PieSeriesPointLayout)seriesPointLayout;
			Point point = new Point((int)Math.Round(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.CenterPoint.X), (int)Math.Round(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.CenterPoint.Y));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.Ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(pieSeriesPointLayout.Pie.HalfAngle);
			base.Chart.LockChanges();
			try
			{
				if ((Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.X) - (double)point.X) * (double)dx + (Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.Y) - (double)point.Y) * (double)dy > 0.0)
				{
					if (!ExplodedPoints.Contains(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint)))
					{
						ExplodedPoints.AddWithEvent(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint), dragged: true);
					}
				}
				else if (ExplodedPoints.Contains(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint)))
				{
					ExplodedPoints.RemoveWithEvent(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint), dragged: true);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Chart.UnlockChanges();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<SeriesPointLayout> CalculatePointsLayout(ISimpleDiagramDomain domain, RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			double angle = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(ActualRotation));
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(default(GRealPoint2D), (double)domain.ElementBounds.Width / 2.0, (double)domain.ElementBounds.Height / 2.0);
			double startAngle = ellipse.CalcEllipseAngleFromCircleAngle(angle);
			List<SeriesPointLayout> list = new List<SeriesPointLayout>();
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = CalculatePointLayout(ref startAngle, domain, seriesData, seriesDatum);
				if (seriesPointLayout != null)
				{
					seriesDatum.ToolTipRelativePosition = CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(seriesPointLayout);
					list.Add(seriesPointLayout);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override WholeSeriesViewData CalculateWholeSeriesViewData(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = seriesDatum.RefinedPoint;
				if (!refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value < 0.0)
					{
						num++;
					}
					else if (((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value > 0.0)
					{
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				num2 = num;
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num2 == 0 && num == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new PieWholeSeriesViewData(num2, num > 0);
		}

		protected internal override void ChildCollectionChanged(ChartCollectionBase collection, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (collection == explodedPoints)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "ExplodedPoints"));
			}
			base.ChildCollectionChanged(collection, change);
		}

		internal List<ISeriesPoint> CollectActualPoints()
		{
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			ViewController viewController = GetOwner<ViewController>();
			if (viewController != null)
			{
				IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = viewController.FindRefinedSeries(base.Series);
				if (refinedSeries != null)
				{
					IList<RefinedPoint> points = refinedSeries.Points;
					DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(base.Series);
					IList<SeriesPoint> list2 = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(points.Cast<IDataPoint>().ToArray());
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						list.Add(list2[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void ApplyExplodeFiltersToPoints()
		{
			if (Loading)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (explodeMode == PieExplodeMode.UsePoints && explodedPoints != null && explodedPointsIndices == null)
			{
				explodedPoints.Synchronize();
				return;
			}
			explodedPoints.BeginUpdate(forceChanging: false, bindingProcessing: false);
			try
			{
				explodedPoints.Clear();
				if (!(base.Owner is Series) || base.Series.ActualSeriesPoints.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				ExplodeFilter explodeFilter = ExplodeFilter.CreateInstance(this);
				if (explodeFilter == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<ISeriesPoint> list = explodeFilter.FilterPoints(CollectActualPoints());
				foreach (SeriesPoint item in list)
				{
					explodedPoints.Add(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				explodedPoints.CancelUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void FinishUpdateExplodedPoints()
		{
			if (explodeMode == PieExplodeMode.UsePoints)
			{
				if (explodedPoints.Fill(explodedPointIds))
				{
					explodedPointIds = new int[0];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyExplodeFiltersToPoints();
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase)
			{
				sizeAsPercentage = pieSeriesViewBase.sizeAsPercentage;
				explodedDistancePercentage = pieSeriesViewBase.explodedDistancePercentage;
				explodeMode = pieSeriesViewBase.explodeMode;
				UpdateExplodeFilter();
				explodedPointIds = pieSeriesViewBase.ExplodedPoints.GetPointIds();
				explodedPointsFilters.Assign(pieSeriesViewBase.explodedPointsFilters);
				sweepDirection = pieSeriesViewBase.sweepDirection;
				if (base.Owner is Series series && series.ActualSeriesPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					FinishUpdateExplodedPoints();
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase = (PieSeriesViewBase)obj;
			if (sizeAsPercentage == pieSeriesViewBase.sizeAsPercentage && explodedDistancePercentage == pieSeriesViewBase.explodedDistancePercentage && explodeMode == pieSeriesViewBase.explodeMode && explodedPoints.Equals(pieSeriesViewBase.explodedPoints))
			{
				return explodedPointsFilters.Equals(pieSeriesViewBase.explodedPointsFilters);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public enum PieExplodeMode
	{
		None,
		All,
		MinValue,
		MaxValue,
		UsePoints,
		UseFilters,
		Others
	}
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	public enum PieSweepDirection
	{
		Clockwise = 1,
		Counterclockwise = 0
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ExplodedSeriesPointCollection")]
	public class ExplodedSeriesPointCollection : ChartCollectionBase
	{
		private List<SeriesPoint> pointsToClear;

		private PieSeriesViewBase View => (PieSeriesViewBase)base.Owner;

		internal Series Series => View.Owner as Series;

		internal SeriesBase SeriesBase => (SeriesBase)View.Owner;

		public SeriesPoint this[int index] => (SeriesPoint)base.List[index];

		public ExplodedSeriesPointCollection(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private void RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(List<SeriesPoint> points, bool exploded)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(point, exploded, dragged: false);
			}
		}

		private void RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(SeriesPoint point, bool exploded, bool dragged)
		{
			if (Series != null && Series.Chart != null && Series.Chart.Container != null)
			{
				PieSeriesPointExplodedEventArgs e = new PieSeriesPointExplodedEventArgs(Series, point, exploded, dragged);
				Series.Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnPieSeriesPointExploded(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			if (pointsToClear == null)
			{
				pointsToClear = new List<SeriesPoint>();
				if (Series == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							SeriesPoint item = (SeriesPoint)enumerator.Current;
							pointsToClear.Add(item);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The pointsToClear should be null.");
			}
			base.OnClear();
		}

		protected override void OnClearComplete()
		{
			base.OnClearComplete();
			if (pointsToClear == null)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The pointsToClear can't be null.");
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(pointsToClear, exploded: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				pointsToClear = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void DisposeItemBeforeRemove(ChartElement item)
		{
		}

		protected override void ChangeOwnerForItem(ChartElement item)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			View.LockChanges();
			try
			{
				View.ExplodeMode = PieExplodeMode.UsePoints;
			}
			finally
			{
				View.UnlockChanges();
			}
			base.ProcessChanged(change);
		}

		internal bool Contains(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return IndexOf(point) >= 0;
		}

		internal int IndexOf(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point.IsAuxiliary)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					SeriesPoint seriesPoint = this[i];
					if (seriesPoint.IsAuxiliary && point.Argument == seriesPoint.Argument)
					{
						return i;
					}
					if (point.SourcePoints == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint in point.SourcePoints)
					{
						if (seriesPoint == sourcePoint)
						{
							return i;
						}
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < base.Count; j++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint2 = this[j];
				if (seriesPoint2.SourcePoints == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint2 in seriesPoint2.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (point == sourcePoint2)
					{
						return j;
					}
				}
			}
			return IndexOf((ChartElement)point);
		}

		internal bool Fill(int[] seriesPointIds)
		{
			if (seriesPointIds.Length != 0)
			{
				base.InnerList.Clear();
			}
			foreach (int num in seriesPointIds)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = null;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					foreach (SeriesPoint item in View.CollectActualPoints())
					{
						if (item.IsAuxiliary)
						{
							seriesPoint = item;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					seriesPoint = Series.GetPointByID(num);
				}
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected series point id.");
					return false;
				}
				base.InnerList.Add(seriesPoint);
				RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(seriesPoint, exploded: true, dragged: false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void Synchronize()
		{
			SeriesPointCollection actualSeriesPoints = Series.ActualSeriesPoints;
			int num = 0;
			while (num < base.Count)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = this[num];
				if (actualSeriesPoints.Contains(seriesPoint))
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				base.InnerList.Remove(seriesPoint);
				RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(seriesPoint, exploded: false, dragged: false);
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeById()
		{
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPoint point = (SeriesPoint)enumerator.Current;
					SeriesPoint pointByID = Series.GetPointByID(point);
					if (pointByID != null)
					{
						list.Add(pointByID);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			BeginUpdate(forceChanging: false, bindingProcessing: false);
			try
			{
				Clear();
				AddRange(list);
			}
			finally
			{
				CancelUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal int[] GetPointIds()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)enumerator.Current;
					if (!seriesPoint.IsEmpty)
					{
						list.Add(seriesPoint.SeriesPointID);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void AddRange(List<SeriesPoint> points)
		{
			AddRange((ICollection)points);
			RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(points, exploded: true);
		}

		internal void CopyPoints(ExplodedSeriesPointCollection explodedPoints)
		{
			base.InnerList.AddRange(explodedPoints);
		}

		internal int AddWithEvent(SeriesPoint point, bool dragged)
		{
			if (Series == null)
			{
				throw new ExplodedSeriesPointCollectionException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidExplodedModeAdd));
			}
			if (point.IsAuxiliary)
			{
				if (SeriesBase.ChartContainer != null && SeriesBase.ChartContainer.DesignMode)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			else if (!Series.ActualSeriesPoints.Contains(point))
			{
				throw new ExplodedSeriesPointCollectionException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidExplodedSeriesPoint));
			}
			if (Contains(point))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int result = Add((ChartElement)point);
			RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(point, exploded: true, dragged);
			return result;
		}

		internal void RemoveWithEvent(SeriesPoint point, bool dragged)
		{
			if (Series == null)
			{
				throw new ExplodedSeriesPointCollectionException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidExplodedModeRemove));
			}
			int num = IndexOf(point);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RaisePieSeriesPointExplodedEvent(this[num], exploded: false, dragged);
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public int Add(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return AddWithEvent(point, dragged: false);
		}

		public void Remove(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			RemoveWithEvent(point, dragged: false);
		}

		public void ToggleExplodedState(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (Contains(point))
			{
				Remove(point);
			}
			else
			{
				Add(point);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			base.InnerList.Clear();
			foreach (SeriesPoint item in collection)
			{
				SeriesPoint pointByID = Series.GetPointByID(item.SeriesPointID);
				if (pointByID != null)
				{
					base.InnerList.Add(pointByID);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ExplodedSeriesPointCollection explodedSeriesPointCollection = (ExplodedSeriesPointCollection)obj;
			if (base.Count != explodedSeriesPointCollection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!this[i].Equals(explodedSeriesPointCollection[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

			DiagramPoint point = pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(diagramMapping, refinedPoint.Argument, GetSeriesPointValues(refinedPoint).Max);
			IPolygon polygon = null;
			if (!double.IsNaN(point.X) && !double.IsNaN(point.Y))

		protected internal override ScreenErrorBarData ConvertErrorBarDataToScreenCoords(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, ErrorBarData errBarData)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = errBarData.RefinedPoint;
			double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
			PointF center = (PointF)diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, errBarData.Center);
			PointF top = (PointF)diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, errBarData.Top);
			PointF bottom = (PointF)diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, errBarData.Bottom);
			float num = (float)PointMarkerOptions.Size / 2f;
			PointF pointF = default(PointF);
			if (diagramMapping.Rotated)
			{
				pointF.Y += num;
			}
			else
			{
				pointF.X += num;
			}
			return new ScreenErrorBarData(topLeft: new PointF(top.X - pointF.X, top.Y - pointF.Y), topRight: new PointF(top.X + pointF.X, top.Y + pointF.Y), bottomLeft: new PointF((float)Math.Floor(bottom.X - pointF.X), (float)Math.Floor(bottom.Y - pointF.Y)), bottomRight: new PointF((float)Math.Ceiling(bottom.X + pointF.X), (float)Math.Floor(bottom.Y + pointF.Y)), center: center, top: top, bottom: bottom);
		}

				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ValueMember);
		}

		{
			if (GetType() == typeof(PointSeriesView))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.Require2dResampling();
		}

				if (value != minValueMarkerVisibility)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					minValueMarkerVisibility = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RangeBarSeriesView.MaxValueMarkerVisibility")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.RangeBarSeriesView.MaxValueMarkerVisibility")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DefaultBoolean MaxValueMarkerVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return maxValueMarkerVisibility;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (value != maxValueMarkerVisibility)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					maxValueMarkerVisibility = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public RangeBarSeriesView()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			minValueMarker = new Marker(this, 10);
			maxValueMarker = new Marker(this, 10);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"MinValueMarker" => ShouldSerializeMinValueMarker(), 
				"MaxValueMarker" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueMarker(), 
				"MinValueMarkerVisibility" => ShouldSerializeMinValueMarkerVisibility(), 
				"MaxValueMarkerVisibility" => ShouldSerializeMaxValueMarkerVisibility(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinValueMarker()
		{
			return MinValueMarker.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueMarker()
		{
			return MaxValueMarker.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMinValueMarkerVisibility()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)minValueMarkerVisibility != 2;
		}

		private void ResetMinValueMarkerVisibility()
		{
			MinValueMarkerVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueMarkerVisibility()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)maxValueMarkerVisibility != 2;
		}

		private void ResetMaxValueMarkerVisibility()
		{
			MaxValueMarkerVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)2;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeMinValueMarker() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValueMarker() && !ShouldSerializeMinValueMarkerVisibility())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMaxValueMarkerVisibility();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Marker marker, Color color, Color color2, IPolygon polygon)
		{
			if (polygon != null)
			{
				CustomBorder customBorder = marker.Border;
				Color automaticBorderColor = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(20, 0, 0, 0), color);
				Color borderColor = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(customBorder, automaticBorderColor);
				int borderThickness = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderThickness(customBorder, 1);
				Color color3 = (marker.Color.IsEmpty ? color : marker.Color);
				marker.RenderWithAntialiasing(renderer, polygon, color3, color2, borderColor, borderThickness);
			}
		}

		private void RenderMarkerShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, IPolygon markerPolygon, Shadow shadow)
		{
			markerPolygon?.RenderShadow(renderer, shadow, -1);
		}

		private void CalculateRageBarValues(double value1, double value2, out double zeroValue, out double actualValue)
		{
			if (value1 >= value2)
			{
				actualValue = value1;
				zeroValue = value2;
			}
			else
			{
				actualValue = value2;
				zeroValue = value1;
			}
		}

		protected void CalculateMarkerPoints(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, BarData barData, out GRealPoint2D maxMarkerPoint, out GRealPoint2D minMarkerPoint)
		{
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = barData.GetScreenPoint(barData.Argument, barData.ActualValue, diagramMapping);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = barData.GetScreenPoint(barData.Argument, barData.ZeroValue, diagramMapping);
			maxMarkerPoint = new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y);
			minMarkerPoint = new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint2.X, screenPoint2.Y);
		}

		protected BarData CreateRangeBarData(double argument, double value1, double value2, double width, double displayOffset, int fixedOffset)
		{
			CalculateRageBarValues(value1, value2, out var zeroValue, out var actualValue);
			return new BarData(argument, zeroValue, actualValue, width, displayOffset, fixedOffset, sideBySideInteracted: false);
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new RangeBarDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<double> GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			yield return ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Min;
			yield return ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Max;
		}

		protected override void CalculateAnnotationAnchorPointLayout(Annotation annotation, XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			AnnotationHelper.CalculateAnchorPointLayoutForCenterBarPoint(annotation, this, anchorPointLayoutList, refinedPoint);
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CalculateSeriesPointLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, BarData barData)
		{
			RectangleF screenRect = barData.CalculateBarRect(diagramMapping);
			CalculateMarkerPoints(diagramMapping, barData, out var maxMarkerPoint, out var minMarkerPoint);
			RangeBarDrawOptions rangeBarDrawOptions = (RangeBarDrawOptions)pointData.DrawOptions;
			IPolygon minMarkerPolygon = (rangeBarDrawOptions.MinValueMarkerVisible ? rangeBarDrawOptions.MinValueMarker.CalculatePolygon(minMarkerPoint, isSelected: false) : null);
			IPolygon maxMarkerPolygon = (rangeBarDrawOptions.MaxValueMarkerVisible ? rangeBarDrawOptions.MaxValueMarker.CalculatePolygon(maxMarkerPoint, isSelected: false) : null);
			Direction rectangleDirection = XYDiagramSeriesViewBase.GetRectangleDirection(diagramMapping, barData.ZeroValue, barData.ActualValue);
			return new RangeBarSeriesPointLayout(pointData, rectangleDirection, screenRect, minMarkerPolygon, maxMarkerPolygon);
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.Value_1)
			{
				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value_2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ICustomBindingProperty> GetValueBindingProperties()
		{
			return ValueDataMemberBindingPropertyHelper.RangeValueBindingProperties;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is RangeBarSeriesView rangeBarSeriesView)
			{
				maxValueMarker.Assign(rangeBarSeriesView.maxValueMarker);
				minValueMarker.Assign(rangeBarSeriesView.minValueMarker);
				minValueMarkerVisibility = rangeBarSeriesView.minValueMarkerVisibility;
				maxValueMarkerVisibility = rangeBarSeriesView.maxValueMarkerVisibility;
			}
		}

		internal override string LabelPatternToLegendPattern()
		{
			if (base.SeriesBase != null && base.Label != null)
			{
				return PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(base.Label.ActualTextPattern, "V", "V2", "V1");
			}
			return base.LabelPatternToLegendPattern();
		}

		protected internal override PointOptions CreatePointOptions()
		{
			return new RangeBarPointOptions();
		}

		protected internal override BarData CreateBarData(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return CreateRangeBarData(pointInfo.Argument, ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Min, ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Max, base.BarWidth, 0.0, 0);
		}

		protected internal override ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter CreateToolTipValueToStringConverter()
		{
			return new ToolTipRangeValueToStringConverter(base.Series);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || base.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return ToolTipPatternUtils.DateTimeRangeViewPointPatterns;
			}
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.RangeViewPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			base.Render(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
			RangeBarDrawOptions rangeBarDrawOptions = (RangeBarDrawOptions)drawOptions;
			RangeBarSeriesPointLayout rangeBarSeriesPointLayout = (RangeBarSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout;
			RenderMarker(renderer, rangeBarDrawOptions.MinValueMarker, rangeBarDrawOptions.Color, rangeBarDrawOptions.ActualColor2, rangeBarSeriesPointLayout.MinMarkerPolygon);
			RenderMarker(renderer, rangeBarDrawOptions.MaxValueMarker, rangeBarDrawOptions.Color, rangeBarDrawOptions.ActualColor2, rangeBarSeriesPointLayout.MaxMarkerPolygon);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			base.RenderShadow(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
			RangeBarDrawOptions rangeBarDrawOptions = (RangeBarDrawOptions)drawOptions;
			RangeBarSeriesPointLayout rangeBarSeriesPointLayout = (RangeBarSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout;
			RenderMarkerShadow(renderer, rangeBarSeriesPointLayout.MinMarkerPolygon, rangeBarDrawOptions.Shadow);
			RenderMarkerShadow(renderer, rangeBarSeriesPointLayout.MaxMarkerPolygon, rangeBarDrawOptions.Shadow);
		}

		protected internal override DiagramPoint? CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			BarData barData = pointData.GetBarData(this);
			return barData.CalculateAnchorPointForCenterLabelPosition(mapping.Container, new ScreenPointCalculator());
		}

		protected internal override SeriesLabelBase CreateSeriesLabel()
		{
			return new RangeBarSeriesLabel();
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxPointRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram diagram, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = point.RefinedPoint;
			double max = refinedPoint.Max;
			double min = refinedPoint.Min;
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, snapMode, min, max);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RangeBarSeriesView rangeBarSeriesView = (RangeBarSeriesView)obj;
			if (maxValueMarker.Equals(rangeBarSeriesView.maxValueMarker))
			{
				return minValueMarker.Equals(rangeBarSeriesView.minValueMarker);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
