		protected PaletteEntry PaletteEntry
		{
			get
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart == null || chart.ViewController == null || chart.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend == null)
				{
					return new PaletteEntry(Color.Black);
				}
				int count = chart.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend.Count;
				IList<RefinedSeries> list = ((Series.ActualLegend != null && Series.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible) ? chart.ViewController.RefinedSeries : chart.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend);
				if (list == null)
				{
					return new PaletteEntry(Color.Black);
				}
				int index = IListExtensions.FindIndex<RefinedSeries>(list, (Predicate<RefinedSeries>)((RefinedSeries s) => s.Series == Series));
				return chart.Palette.GetEntry(index, count, chart.PaletteBaseColorNumber);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ColorizerPickerEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public IColorizer Colorizer
		{
			get
			{
				return colorizer;
			}
			set
			{
				if (colorizer == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (colorizer != null)
				{
					if (colorizer is ChartColorizerBase chartColorizerBase)
					{
						chartColorizerBase.PropertyChanging -= ColorizerPropertyChanging;
					}
					colorizer.PropertyChanged -= ColorizerPropertyChanged;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					colorizer = value;
					if (colorizer is ChartColorizerBase chartColorizerBase2)
					{
						chartColorizerBase2.Owner = this;
						chartColorizerBase2.PropertyChanging += ColorizerPropertyChanging;
					}
					colorizer.PropertyChanged += ColorizerPropertyChanged;
					colorProvider = new ColorProvider(colorizer, EmptyPointColorizer);
					if (SeriesBase != null)
					{
						SeriesBase.BindingChanged();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					colorProvider = new ColorProvider(defaultColorizer, EmptyPointColorizer);
					colorizer = null;
					if (SeriesBase != null)
					{
						SeriesBase.BindingChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Color GetPointColorCore(int pointIndex, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (Series.ActualPoints.Count > pointIndex)
			{
				Color pointColor = Series.GetPointColor(Series.ActualPoints[pointIndex]);
				if (!pointColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return pointColor;
				}
			}
			if (!ActualColorEach || pointIndex < 0)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			return base.Chart.Palette.GetEntry(pointIndex, pointsCount, base.Chart.PaletteBaseColorNumber).Color;
		}

		protected PatternDataProvider GetXYDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (Series != null)
			{
				IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView = (IXYSeriesView)this;
				IAxisData axisXData = iXYSeriesView.AxisXData;
				IAxisData axisYData = iXYSeriesView.AxisYData;
				switch (patternConstant)
				{
				case "A":
					return CreatePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisXData);
				case "V":
				case "VP":
				case "V1":
				case "V2":
				case "OV":
				case "CV":
				case "HV":
				case "LV":
				case "W":
				case "HINT":
				case "VD":
				case "TV":
				case "BP_MIN":
				case "BP_Q1":
				case "BP_MDN":
				case "BP_Q3":
				case "BP_MAX":
				case "BP_AVG":
				case "VABS":
					return CreatePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisYData);
				case "VDTD":
				case "VDTH":
				case "VDTM":
				case "VDTS":
				case "VDTMS":
					break;
				case "S":
				case "G":
					return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
				default:
					return new DataSourcePatternDataProvider(patternConstant, new SeriesPointEnsurer(Series));
				}
				if (Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
				{
					return CreatePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisYData);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected IPolygon CalculateMarkerPolygon(RefinedPointData pointData, DiagramPoint point)
		{
			bool isSelected = pointData != null && pointData.RefinedPoint != null && pointData.SelectionState != SelectionState.Normal;
			PointDrawOptions pointDrawOptions = pointData.DrawOptions as PointDrawOptions;
			if (!pointDrawOptions.ActualMarkerVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return pointDrawOptions.Marker.CalculatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(point.X), Math.Round(point.Y)), isSelected);
		}

		protected string GetDefaultFormat(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.DateTime => ":d", 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => ":g", 
				_ => "", 
			};
		}

		protected string GetDefaultArgumentFormat()

			if (Series.View is IXYSeriesView { AxisXData: not null } iXYSeriesView && Series.ArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime && iXYSeriesView.AxisXData.Label != null)
			{
				return ":" + PatternUtils.GetArgumentFormat(iXYSeriesView.AxisXData.Label.TextPattern);
			}
			return GetDefaultFormat(Series.ArgumentScaleType);
		}

		internal DrawOptions CreatePointDrawOptions(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			DrawOptions crosshairHighlightingDrawOptions = CrosshairHighlightingDrawOptions;
			DrawOptions drawOptions;
			if (NeedInitializeDrawOptions)
			{
				drawOptions = (DrawOptions)crosshairHighlightingDrawOptions.Clone();
				int pointIndex = Math.Max(refinedPoints.IndexOf(point), 0);
				drawOptions.Initialize(this, refinedPoints, pointIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				drawOptions = crosshairHighlightingDrawOptions;
			}
			return drawOptions;
		}

		internal IList<IDataPoint> GenerateRandomPoints(ScaleType argumentScaleType, ScaleType valueScaleType, int pointsCount)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<IDataPoint> list = new List<IDataPoint>();
			switch (argumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
				DateTimeMeasureUnitNative val = (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)GetArgumentDateTimeMeasureUnit();
				for (int l = 0; l < pointsCount; l++)
				{
					object[] values4 = GenerateRandomValues(l, pointsCount, valueScaleType);
					list.Add(new SeriesPoint(DateTimeUtils.AddRange(val, val, now, l, null).ToString(), values4));
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
			{
				TimeSpan zero = TimeSpan.Zero;
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative argumentTimeSpanMeasureUnit = (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)GetArgumentTimeSpanMeasureUnit();
				for (int j = 0; j < pointsCount; j++)
				{
					object[] values2 = GenerateRandomValues(j, pointsCount, valueScaleType);
					list.Add(new SeriesPoint(DateTimeUtilsExt.AddRange(argumentTimeSpanMeasureUnit, argumentTimeSpanMeasureUnit, zero, j), values2));
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < pointsCount; k++)
				{
					object[] values3 = GenerateRandomValues(k, pointsCount, valueScaleType);
					list.Add(new SeriesPoint(((int)Math.Round(GetRandomNumericalArgument(k, pointsCount))).ToString(), values3));
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.Qualitative:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < pointsCount; i++)
				{
					object[] values = GenerateRandomValues(i, pointsCount, valueScaleType);
					list.Add(new SeriesPoint(((char)(65 + i)).ToString(), values));
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void RenderCrosshairMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point, Color markerColor)
		{
			DrawOptions drawOptions = CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal();
			Color pointSegmentSeriesColor = GetPointSegmentSeriesColor(point);
			Color actualColor = (drawOptions.ActualColor2 = (drawOptions.Color = (pointSegmentSeriesColor.IsEmpty ? markerColor : pointSegmentSeriesColor)));
			DrawOptions drawOptions2 = CreatePointDrawOptions(refinedSeries.Points, point);
			if (point.SeriesPoint is SeriesPoint { Color: { IsEmpty: false } } seriesPoint)
			{
				drawOptions2.Color = seriesPoint.Color;
				drawOptions2.ActualColor2 = seriesPoint.Color;
			}
			else
			{
				drawOptions2.Color = actualColor;
				drawOptions2.ActualColor2 = actualColor;
			}
			RenderCrosshairMarkerInternal(renderer, bounds, drawOptions2, drawOptions);
		}

		internal void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, RefinedPointData pointData)
		{
			if (!GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(bounds.Size))
			{
				return;
			}
			DXImage dXImage = null;
			ChartImageSizeMode sizeMode = ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize;
			if (pointData != null)
			{
				dXImage = pointData.MarkerImage;
				sizeMode = pointData.MarkerImageSizeMode;
			}
			else if (seriesData != null)
			{
				dXImage = seriesData.MarkerImage;
				sizeMode = seriesData.MarkerImageSizeMode;
			}
			if (dXImage != null)
			{
				renderer.DrawImage(dXImage, bounds, (DXImageSizeMode)sizeMode);
				return;
			}
			bounds = CorrectLegendMarkerBounds(bounds);
			if (GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(bounds.Size))
			{
				RenderLegendMarkerInternal(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, seriesDrawOptions, pointData?.SelectionState ?? Series.HitState.LegendSelectionState);
			}
		}

		internal void CheckValueLevel(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (Loading)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueLevel[] supportedValueLevels = SupportedValueLevels;
			foreach (ValueLevel valueLevel2 in supportedValueLevels)
			{
				if (valueLevel == valueLevel2)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUnsupportedValueLevel), new ValueLevelItem(valueLevel).ToString(), StringId);
			throw new ArgumentException(message);
		}

		internal ValueLevel GetCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			ValueLevel[] supportedValueLevels = SupportedValueLevels;
			foreach (ValueLevel valueLevel2 in supportedValueLevels)
			{
				if (valueLevel == valueLevel2)
				{
					return valueLevel;
				}
			}
			return DefaultValueLevel;
		}

		protected internal virtual object[] GenerateRandomValues(int indexOfRandomPoint, int randomPointCount, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object[] array = new object[PointDimension];
			switch (valueScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
				DateTimeMeasureUnitNative val = (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)GetValueDateTimeMeasureUnit();
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = DateTimeUtils.AddRange(val, val, now, random.NextDouble() * 10.0, null);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
			{
				TimeSpan zero = TimeSpan.Zero;
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative valueTimeSpanMeasureUnit = (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)GetValueTimeSpanMeasureUnit();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = DateTimeUtilsExt.AddRange(valueTimeSpanMeasureUnit, valueTimeSpanMeasureUnit, zero, random.Next(0, 10));
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				GenerateRandomNumericValues(array, indexOfRandomPoint);
				break;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateRandomNumericValues(object[] values, int indexOfRandomPoint)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				values[i] = Math.Round(random.NextDouble() * 10.0, 1);
			}
		}

	{

		internal const bool DefaultSnapCrosshairToActualStep = true;

		private bool invertedStep;

		private bool snapCrosshairToActualStep = true;

		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		public bool InvertedStep
		{
			get
			{
				return invertedStep;
			}
			set
			{
				if (invertedStep != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					invertedStep = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StepLineSeriesView.SnapCrosshairToActualStep")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.StepLineSeriesView.SnapCrosshairToActualStep")]

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		public bool SnapCrosshairToActualStep
		{
			get
			{
				return snapCrosshairToActualStep;
			}
			set
			{
				if (snapCrosshairToActualStep != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					snapCrosshairToActualStep = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		LineStyle ILineSeriesView.LineStyle => base.LineStyle;

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "InvertedStep"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SnapCrosshairToActualStep")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeSnapCrosshairToActualStep();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializeInvertedStep();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeInvertedStep()
		{
			return invertedStep;
		}

		private void ResetInvertedStep()
		{
			InvertedStep = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSnapCrosshairToActualStep()
		{
			return !snapCrosshairToActualStep;
		}

		private void ResetSnapCrosshairToActualStep()
		{
			SnapCrosshairToActualStep = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeInvertedStep())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSnapCrosshairToActualStep();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AddStripElementInternal(IGeometryStrip strip, RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			((LineStrip)strip).AddStepToPoint(new GRealPoint2D(pointInfo.Argument, ((IValuePoint)pointInfo).Value), InvertedStep);
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			IStripSplitter stripSplitter = CreateLineColorSplitter();
			if (stripSplitter != null)
			{
				if (!(stripSplitter is StripPointSplitter))
				{
					return new StepLineGeometrySplittedStripCreator(stripSplitter, InvertedStep, base.ShowIsolatedPoints);
				}
				return new StepLineGeometrySplittedPointStripCreator(stripSplitter, InvertedStep, base.ShowIsolatedPoints);
			}
			return new StepLineGeometryStripCreator(InvertedStep, base.ShowIsolatedPoints);
		}

		protected override PointSeriesViewPainter CreatePainter()
		{
			return new StepLineSeriesViewPainter(this);
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new StepLineViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new StepLineSeriesView();
		}

		protected internal override bool GetActualAntialiasing(int pointsCount)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(base.EnableAntialiasing, defaultValue: false);
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is IStepSeriesView stepSeriesView)
			{
				invertedStep = stepSeriesView.InvertedStep;
				snapCrosshairToActualStep = stepSeriesView.SnapCrosshairToActualStep;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (invertedStep == ((StepLineSeriesView)obj).invertedStep)
			{
				return snapCrosshairToActualStep == ((StepLineSeriesView)obj).snapCrosshairToActualStep;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = ShowOpenClose == StockType.Both || ShowOpenClose == StockType.Open;
				bool flag2 = ShowOpenClose == StockType.Both || ShowOpenClose == StockType.Close;
				string text = "{A" + GetDefaultArgumentFormat() + "}";
				string text2 = "\nHigh: {HV" + GetDefaultFormat(base.Series.ValueScaleType) + "}\nLow: {LV" + GetDefaultFormat(base.Series.ValueScaleType) + "}" + (flag ? ("\nOpen: {OV" + GetDefaultFormat(base.Series.ValueScaleType) + "}") : "") + (flag2 ? ("\nClose: {CV" + GetDefaultFormat(base.Series.ValueScaleType) + "}") : "");

			}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeShowOpenClose();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RenderPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color, RectangleF stockRect, RectangleF openRect, RectangleF closeRect)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(stockRect, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(openRect, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(closeRect, color);
		}

		protected override DrawOptions CreateSeriesDrawOptionsInternal()
		{
			return new StockDrawOptions(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new StockSeriesView();
		}

		protected override FinancialSeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, int lineThickness, Direction direction)
		{
			return new StockSeriesPointLayout(pointData, stockType, lineThickness, direction);
		}

		protected override void RenderFinancial(ChartRenderer renderer, FinancialSeriesPointLayout financialPointLayout, Color color, ReductionStockOptions reductionOptions)
		{
			StockSeriesPointLayout stockSeriesPointLayout = (StockSeriesPointLayout)financialPointLayout;
			RenderPoint(renderer, color, stockSeriesPointLayout.StockRect, stockSeriesPointLayout.OpenRect, stockSeriesPointLayout.CloseRect);
			if (financialPointLayout.PointData != null)
			{
				SelectionState selectionState = financialPointLayout.PointData.SelectionState;
				if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
				{
					SeriesHitTestState hitState = base.Series.HitState;
					renderer.FillRectangle(stockSeriesPointLayout.StockRect, hitState.HatchStyle, hitState.GetHatchColorLight(selectionState), color);
					renderer.FillRectangle(stockSeriesPointLayout.OpenRect, hitState.HatchStyle, hitState.GetHatchColorLight(selectionState), color);
					renderer.FillRectangle(stockSeriesPointLayout.CloseRect, hitState.HatchStyle, hitState.GetHatchColorLight(selectionState), color);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateShadowGraphicsCommand(Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			if (pointLayout != null)
			{
				StockSeriesPointLayout stockSeriesPointLayout = (StockSeriesPointLayout)pointLayout;
				FinancialDrawOptions financialDrawOptions = (FinancialDrawOptions)drawOptions;
				int actualSize = financialDrawOptions.Shadow.GetActualSize(-1);
				financialDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, stockSeriesPointLayout.StockRect, actualSize);
				financialDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, stockSeriesPointLayout.OpenRect, actualSize);
				financialDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, stockSeriesPointLayout.CloseRect, actualSize);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderHighlightedPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, HighlightedPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			if (pointLayout is HighlightedStockPointLayout highlightedStockPointLayout)
			{
				RectangleF stockRect = new RectangleF(highlightedStockPointLayout.StockRect.X - 1f, highlightedStockPointLayout.StockRect.Y - 1f, highlightedStockPointLayout.StockRect.Width + 2f, highlightedStockPointLayout.StockRect.Height + 2f);
				RectangleF openRect = new RectangleF(highlightedStockPointLayout.OpenRect.X - 1f, highlightedStockPointLayout.OpenRect.Y - 1f, highlightedStockPointLayout.OpenRect.Width + 2f, highlightedStockPointLayout.OpenRect.Height + 2f);
				RectangleF closeRect = new RectangleF(highlightedStockPointLayout.CloseRect.X - 1f, highlightedStockPointLayout.CloseRect.Y - 1f, highlightedStockPointLayout.CloseRect.Width + 2f, highlightedStockPointLayout.CloseRect.Height + 2f);
				RenderPoint(renderer, highlightedStockPointLayout.Color, stockRect, openRect, closeRect);
			}
		}

		protected internal override PointOptions CreatePointOptions()
		{
			return new StockPointOptions();
		}

		protected internal override HighlightedPointLayout CalculateHighlightedPointLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Direction rectangleDirection = XYDiagramSeriesViewBase.GetRectangleDirection(diagramMapping, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Low, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).High);
			StockSeriesPointLayout stockSeriesPointLayout = new StockSeriesPointLayout(null, stockType, base.LineThickness, rectangleDirection);
			stockSeriesPointLayout.Calculate(diagramMapping, ((IArgumentPoint)refinedPoint).Argument, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Low, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).High, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Open, ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Close, base.LevelLineLengthTransformed);
			return new HighlightedStockPointLayout(drawOptions.Color, stockSeriesPointLayout.StockRect, stockSeriesPointLayout.OpenRect, stockSeriesPointLayout.CloseRect);
		}

		protected internal override ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter CreateToolTipValueToStringConverter()
		{
			bool showOpen = ShowOpenClose == StockType.Both || ShowOpenClose == StockType.Open;
			bool showClose = ShowOpenClose == StockType.Both || ShowOpenClose == StockType.Close;
			return new ToolTipFinancialValueToStringConverter(base.Series, showOpen, showClose);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			StockSeriesView stockSeriesView = (StockSeriesView)obj;
			return stockSeriesView.stockType == stockType;
		}

		protected override void AssignInternal(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.AssignInternal(obj);
			if (obj is StockSeriesView stockSeriesView)
			{
				stockType = stockSeriesView.stockType;
			}
		}
	}

		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class TitleBase : ChartElement, ITextAppearance, ISupportTextAntialiasing, IDisposable, IXtraPartlyDeserializable
	{
		private static readonly Color DefaultTextColor = Color.Empty;

		private BackCompatibilityFontController fontController;

		private Color textColor = DefaultTextColor;

		private bool visible;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAntialiasing = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private bool ActualAntialiasing => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(enableAntialiasing, DefaultAntialiasing);

		protected abstract bool DefaultVisible { get; }

		protected abstract DXFont InitialFont { get; }

		protected abstract bool DefaultAntialiasing { get; }

		protected virtual bool Rotated => false;

		protected virtual Color TextBackColor => Color.Empty;

		protected virtual RectangleFillStyle TextBackFillStyle => RectangleFillStyle.Empty;

		protected virtual bool CanBeDrawnOn3D => true;

		protected internal bool IsDefaultFont { get; protected set; } = true;

		protected internal virtual Color ActualTextColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!textColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return textColor;
				}
				IChartAppearance actualAppearance = CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(this);
				if (actualAppearance != null)
				{
					return GetTextColor(actualAppearance);
				}
				return Color.Empty;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ActualVisibility => Visible;

		protected internal virtual ChartElement BackElement => this;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.Visible")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.Visible")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != visible)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					visible = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the font used to display the title’s text.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return fontController.Font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectFont));
				}
				fontController.Font = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.DXFont")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.DXFont")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DXFont DXFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (!fontController.IsDefaultFont)
				{
					return fontController.DXFont;
				}
				float num = GetSkinFontSize(this);
				if (num <= 0f)
				{
					num = InitialFont.SizeInPoints;
				}
				DXFont defaultDXFont = fontController.DefaultDXFont;
				bool isFontBoldFromSkin = GetIsFontBoldFromSkin();
				if (defaultDXFont.SizeInPoints != num || defaultDXFont.Bold != isFontBoldFromSkin)
				{
					DXFontStyle style = defaultDXFont.Style;
					style = ((!isFontBoldFromSkin) ? (style & ~DXFontStyle.Bold) : (style | DXFontStyle.Bold));
					return new DXFont(defaultDXFont.Name, num, style);
				}
				return fontController.DXFont;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectFont));
				}
				fontController.DXFont = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.TextColor")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.TextColor")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color TextColor
		{
			get
			{
				return textColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == textColor))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					textColor = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the EnableAntialiasing property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Antialiasing
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualAntialiasing;
			}
			set
			{
				EnableAntialiasing = (DefaultBoolean)(!value);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.EnableAntialiasing")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.TitleBase.EnableAntialiasing")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DefaultBoolean EnableAntialiasing
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return enableAntialiasing;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (enableAntialiasing != value)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					enableAntialiasing = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		DXFont ITextAppearance.Font
		{
			get
			{
				return DXFont;
			}
			set
			{
				DXFont = value;
			}
		}

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.DefaultAntialiasing => DefaultAntialiasing;

		Color ISupportTextAntialiasing.TextBackColor => TextBackColor;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.Rotated => Rotated;

		RectangleFillStyle ISupportTextAntialiasing.TextBackFillStyle => TextBackFillStyle;

		ChartElement ISupportTextAntialiasing.BackElement => BackElement;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.CanBeDrawnOn3D => CanBeDrawnOn3D;

		protected TitleBase(ChartElement obj, DXFont initialFont)
			: base(obj)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			visible = DefaultVisible;
			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(initialFont, this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Visible" => ShouldSerializeVisible(), 
				"DXFont" => ShouldSerializeDXFont(), 
				"Font" => false, 
				"TextColor" => ShouldSerializeTextColor(), 
				"Antialiasing" => false, 
				"EnableAntialiasing" => ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return visible != DefaultVisible;
		}

		internal void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = DefaultVisible;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeDXFont()
		{
			return fontController.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		internal void ResetDXFont()
		{
			fontController.Reset();
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeTextColor()
		{
			return textColor != DefaultTextColor;
		}

		internal void ResetTextColor()
		{
			TextColor = DefaultTextColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAntialiasing()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)enableAntialiasing != 2;
		}

		internal void ResetEnableAntialiasing()
		{
			EnableAntialiasing = (DefaultBoolean)2;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFont()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeDXFont() && !ShouldSerializeTextColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEnableAntialiasing();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual int GetSkinFontSize(ChartElement title)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetIsFontBoldFromSkin()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual Color GetTextColor(IChartAppearance actualAppearance)
		{
			return Color.Empty;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is TitleBase titleBase)
			{
				visible = titleBase.visible;
				fontController.Assign(titleBase.fontController);
				IsDefaultFont = titleBase.IsDefaultFont;
				textColor = titleBase.textColor;
				enableAntialiasing = titleBase.enableAntialiasing;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		void IXtraPartlyDeserializable.Deserialize(object rootObject, IXtraPropertyCollection properties)
		{
			SerializationUtils.ConvertFontToDXFont(properties);
		}
	}

			set
			{
				base.Text = StringUtils.StringArrayToString(value);
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeLines()
		{
			return ShouldSerializeText();
		}

		internal void ResetLines()
		{
			ResetText();
		}

		protected MultilineTitle(ChartElement obj, DXFont intialFont)
			: base(obj, intialFont)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class AlignedTitle : MultilineTitle
	{
		private const int DefaultMaxLineCount = 0;

		private const bool DefaultWordWrap = false;

		private const System.Drawing.StringAlignment DefaultAlignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		private bool wordWrap;

		private int maxLineCount;

		private System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AlignedTitle.WordWrap")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AlignedTitle.WordWrap")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public bool WordWrap
		{
			get
			{
				return wordWrap;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != wordWrap)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					wordWrap = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AlignedTitle.MaxLineCount")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AlignedTitle.MaxLineCount")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int MaxLineCount
		{
			get
			{
				return maxLineCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != maxLineCount)
				{
					if (value < 0 || value > 20)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectMaxLineCount));
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					maxLineCount = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AlignedTitle.Alignment")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.AlignedTitle.Alignment")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(StringAlignmentTypeConvertor))]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public System.Drawing.StringAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != alignment)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					alignment = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected AlignedTitle(ChartElement obj, DXFont initialFont)
			: base(obj, initialFont)
		{
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeWordWrap()
		{
			return wordWrap;
		}

		internal void ResetWordWrap()
		{
			WordWrap = false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeMaxLineCount()
		{
			return maxLineCount != 0;
		}

		internal void ResetMaxLineCount()
		{
			MaxLineCount = 0;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeAlignment()
		{
			return alignment != System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		internal void ResetAlignment()
		{
			Alignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeMaxLineCount())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeWordWrap();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Alignment" => ShouldSerializeAlignment(), 
				"MaxLineCount" => ShouldSerializeMaxLineCount(), 
				"WordWrap" => ShouldSerializeWordWrap(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AlignedTitle alignedTitle)
			{
				wordWrap = alignedTitle.wordWrap;
				alignment = alignedTitle.alignment;
				maxLineCount = alignedTitle.maxLineCount;
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(XYDiagramTypeConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram")]
	public class XYDiagram : XYDiagram2D
	{
		private readonly AxisX axisX;

		private readonly AxisY axisY;

		private readonly SecondaryAxisXCollection secondaryAxesX;

		private readonly SecondaryAxisYCollection secondaryAxesY;

		private readonly XYSelectionOptions selectionOptions;

		private readonly DrillDownOptions drillDownOptions;

		private bool rotated;

		protected virtual bool DefaultRotatedValue => false;

		protected override ISelectionBindings SelectionBindings => SelectionOptions;

		protected override IDrillDownBindings DrillDownBindings => DrillDownOptions;

		protected internal override bool ActualRotated => rotated;

		protected internal override bool CanAnimate
		{
			get
			{
				List<Series> activeSeriesList = base.ViewController.GetActiveSeriesList();
				foreach (Series item in activeSeriesList)
				{
					if (item.View.CanAnimate)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!(item.View is XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (Indicator indicator in xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.Indicators)
					{
						if (indicator.CanAnimate)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Axis2D ActualAxisX => axisX;

		protected internal override Axis2D ActualAxisY => axisY;

		protected internal override SecondaryAxisCollection ActualSecondaryAxesX => secondaryAxesX;

		protected internal override SecondaryAxisCollection ActualSecondaryAxesY => secondaryAxesY;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.AxisX")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.AxisX")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Elements)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public AxisX AxisX => axisX;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.AxisY")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.AxisY")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Elements)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public AxisY AxisY => axisY;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.SecondaryAxesX")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.SecondaryAxesX")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Elements)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.SecondaryAxisXCollectionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SecondaryAxisXCollection SecondaryAxesX => secondaryAxesX;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.SecondaryAxesY")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.SecondaryAxesY")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Elements)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.SecondaryAxisYCollectionEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SecondaryAxisYCollection SecondaryAxesY => secondaryAxesY;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.Rotated")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.Rotated")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public virtual bool Rotated
		{
			get
			{
				return rotated;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != rotated)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					rotated = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns mouse actions and hotkey settings for the Selection feature.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.SelectionOptions")]
		[DXDisplayNameIgnore]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public XYSelectionOptions SelectionOptions => selectionOptions;

		[Description("Returns mouse actions and hotkey settings for the Drill Down feature.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.XYDiagram.DrillDownOptions")]
		[DXDisplayNameIgnore]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public DrillDownOptions DrillDownOptions => drillDownOptions;

		public XYDiagram()
		{
			axisX = CreateAxisX();
			axisY = new AxisY(this);
			secondaryAxesX = new SecondaryAxisXCollection(this);
			secondaryAxesY = new SecondaryAxisYCollection(this);
			rotated = DefaultRotatedValue;
			selectionOptions = new XYSelectionOptions(this);
			drillDownOptions = new DrillDownOptions(this);
		}

		protected override void XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, object item)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SecondaryAxesX"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SecondaryAxesY")
				{
					SecondaryAxesY.Add((SecondaryAxisY)item);
				}
				else
				{
					base.XtraSetIndexCollectionItem(propertyName, item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SecondaryAxesX.Add((SecondaryAxisX)item);
			}
		}

		protected override object XtraCreateCollectionItem(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SecondaryAxesX"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SecondaryAxesY")
				{
					return new SecondaryAxisY();
				}
				return base.XtraCreateCollectionItem(propertyName);
			}
			return new SecondaryAxisX();
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"AxisX" => ShouldSerializeAxisX(), 
				"AxisY" => ShouldSerializeAxisY(), 
				"Rotated" => ShouldSerializeRotated(), 
				"DrillDownOptions" => ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisX()
		{
			return axisX.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAxisY()
		{
			return axisY.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRotated()
		{
			return rotated != DefaultRotatedValue;
		}

		private void ResetRotated()
		{
			Rotated = DefaultRotatedValue;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSelectionOptions()
		{
			return selectionOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetSelectionOptions()
		{
			selectionOptions.Reset();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions()
		{
			return drillDownOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetDrillDownOptions()
		{
			drillDownOptions.Reset();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeRotated() && !ShouldSerializeAxisX() && !ShouldSerializeAxisY() && secondaryAxesX.Count <= 0 && secondaryAxesY.Count <= 0 && !ShouldSerializeSelectionOptions())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeDrillDownOptions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual AxisX CreateAxisX()
		{
			return new AxisX(this);
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new XYDiagram();
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ChartElement oldOwner, ChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldOwner, newOwner);
			List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
			list.Add(AxisX);
			list.Add(AxisY);
			RaiseControlChanged(new AxisCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, null, 0, list, 0));
		}

		protected internal override void BeginZooming()
		{
			base.BeginZooming();
			RaiseControlChanging();
		}

		protected internal override XYDiagramMappingBase CreateDiagramMapping(XYDiagramMappingContainer container, AxisIntervalLayout layoutX, AxisIntervalLayout layoutY)
		{
			return new XYDiagramMapping(container, layoutX, layoutY);
		}

		protected internal override bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Contains(obj) && obj != axisX && obj != axisY && !axisX.Contains(obj) && !axisY.Contains(obj) && !secondaryAxesX.ContainsWithChildren(obj) && !secondaryAxesY.ContainsWithChildren(obj))
			{
				return base.Contains(obj);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEndLoading()
		{
			base.OnEndLoading();
			axisX.OnEndLoading();
			axisY.OnEndLoading();
			foreach (SecondaryAxisX item in secondaryAxesX)
			{
				item.OnEndLoading();
			}
			foreach (SecondaryAxisY item2 in secondaryAxesY)
			{
				item2.OnEndLoading();
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				axisX.Assign(xYDiagram.axisX);
				axisY.Assign(xYDiagram.axisY);
				secondaryAxesX.Assign(xYDiagram.secondaryAxesX);
				secondaryAxesY.Assign(xYDiagram.secondaryAxesY);
				rotated = xYDiagram.rotated;
				selectionOptions.Assign(xYDiagram.selectionOptions);
				drillDownOptions.Assign(xYDiagram.drillDownOptions);
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(PaneTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class XYDiagramPaneBase : ChartElementNamed, IDisposable, IZoomablePane, IPane, IBackground, IDockTarget, ISupportTextAntialiasing, IXYDiagramPane, ILinearLayoutItem, IGridLayoutItem
	{
		private const ChartElementVisibility DefaultVisibility = ChartElementVisibility.Visible;

		private readonly Shadow shadow;

		private readonly ScrollBarOptions scrollBarOptions;

		private readonly StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel;

		private readonly LayoutDefinition linearLayoutOptions;

		private readonly GridLayoutOptions layoutOptions;

		private readonly ZoomRectangle zoomRectangle;

		private readonly ZoomRectangle selectionRectangle;

		private readonly PaneTitle title;

		private ChartElementVisibility visibility;

		private Color backColor = Color.Empty;

		private bool borderVisible = true;

		private Color borderColor = Color.Empty;

		private Rectangle? lastMappingBounds;

		private Rectangle? publicPaneBounds;

		private XYDiagramMappingList mappingList;

		private ResolveOverlappingCache resolveOverlappingCache;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAxisXScrolling = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAxisYScrolling = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAxisXZooming = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private DefaultBoolean enableAxisYZooming = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, DXGraphicsPath> seriesClipRegions;

		private DefaultBoolean runtimeCollapse = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private Color ActualBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return borderColor;
				}
				return Diagram.Appearance.BorderColor;
			}
		}

		private Color ActualBackColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!backColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return backColor;
				}
				return Diagram.Appearance.BackColor;
			}
		}

		private RectangleFillStyle ActualFillStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (fillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Empty)
				{
					return fillStyle;
				}
				return (RectangleFillStyle)Diagram.Appearance.FillStyle;
			}
		}

		protected abstract int PaneIndex { get; }

		protected virtual HitTestState HitTestState => ((IHitTest)Diagram).State;

		internal DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.ChartDataTable ChartDataTable { get; }

		internal XYDiagram2D Diagram => (XYDiagram2D)base.Owner;

		internal XYDiagramMappingList MappingList
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Chart.CacheToMemory)
				{
					XYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache xYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache = (XYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache)base.Chart.GetCoordinatesConversionCache();
					if (xYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache != null)
					{
						PaneCoordinatesConversionCache paneCoordinatesConversionCache = xYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache.GetPaneCoordinatesConversionCache(this);
						if (paneCoordinatesConversionCache != null)
						{
							return paneCoordinatesConversionCache.MappingList;
						}
					}
				}
				return mappingList;
			}
			set
			{
				mappingList = value;
			}
		}

		internal List<Tuple<Axis2D, Rectangle>> AxesBounds => axesBounds;

		internal Rectangle? PublicPaneBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return LastMappingBounds ?? publicPaneBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				publicPaneBounds = value;
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle? LastMappingBounds
		{
			get
			{
				DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart != null && chart.CacheToMemory && chart.GetCoordinatesConversionCache() is XYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache xYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache)
				{
					PaneCoordinatesConversionCache paneCoordinatesConversionCache = xYDiagramCoordinatesConversionCache.GetPaneCoordinatesConversionCache(this);
					if (paneCoordinatesConversionCache != null)
					{
						return paneCoordinatesConversionCache.MappingBounds;
					}
				}
				return lastMappingBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				lastMappingBounds = value;
			}
		}

		internal ResolveOverlappingCache ResolveOverlappingCache
		{
			get
			{
				return resolveOverlappingCache;
			}
			set
			{
				resolveOverlappingCache = value;
			}
		}

		internal Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, DXGraphicsPath> SeriesClipRegions
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesClipRegions;
			}
			set
			{
				seriesClipRegions = value;
			}
		}

		internal LayoutDefinition LinearLayoutOptions => linearLayoutOptions;

		internal bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (visibility != ChartElementVisibility.Visible)
				{
					return Collapsed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool ActualRuntimeCollapse => DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(RuntimeCollapse, Diagram == null || Diagram.RuntimePaneCollapse);

		internal bool Collapsed => Visibility == ChartElementVisibility.Collapsed;

		{

				if (Diagram == null)

					return false;
				}
				return Diagram.CheckIsLastNotCollapsedPane(this);
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		bool ILinearLayoutItem.Fixed => linearLayoutOptions.Fixed;

		double ILinearLayoutItem.Weight
		{
			get
			{
				PaneLayoutDirection direction = Diagram.PaneLayout.Direction;
				if (direction == PaneLayoutDirection.Vertical && !layoutOptions.IsDefaultRowSpan)
				{
					return layoutOptions.RowSpan;
				}
				if (direction == PaneLayoutDirection.Horizontal && !layoutOptions.IsDefaultColumnSpan)
				{
					return layoutOptions.ColumnSpan;
				}
				return linearLayoutOptions.Weight;
			}
		}

		int ILinearLayoutItem.SizeInPixels => linearLayoutOptions.SizeInPixelsScaled;

		int IGridLayoutItem.Row => layoutOptions.Row;

		int IGridLayoutItem.Column => layoutOptions.Column;

		int IGridLayoutItem.RowSpan => layoutOptions.RowSpan;

		int IGridLayoutItem.ColumnSpan => layoutOptions.ColumnSpan;

		bool IGridLayoutItem.VisibleInLayout => Visibility != ChartElementVisibility.Hidden;

		protected XYDiagramPaneBase(string name, XYDiagram2D diagram)
			: base(name, diagram)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			annotations = new AnnotationCollection(new AnnotationCollectionPaneBehavior(this));
			fillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this);
			backImage = new BackgroundImage(this);
			shadow = new Shadow(this);
			scrollBarOptions = new ScrollBarOptions(this);
			zoomRectangle = new ZoomRectangle(this);
			selectionRectangle = new ZoomRectangle(this);
			stackedBarTotalLabel = new StackedBarTotalLabel(this);
			linearLayoutOptions = new LayoutDefinition(this);
			layoutOptions = new GridLayoutOptions(this);
			title = new PaneTitle(this);
			ChartDataTable = new DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.ChartDataTable(this);
		}

		{
		}

		void IZoomablePane.BeginZooming()
		{
			Diagram.BeginZooming();
		}

		void IZoomablePane.EndZooming(NavigationType navigationType, RangesSnapshot oldRange, RangesSnapshot newRange, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			Diagram.EndZooming((ChartZoomEventType)navigationType, oldRange, newRange, axisX as AxisBase, axisY as AxisBase);
		}

		void IZoomablePane.EndScrolling(ScrollingOrientation orientation, NavigationType navigationType, RangesSnapshot oldRange, RangesSnapshot newRange, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			Diagram.EndScrolling((ChartScrollOrientation)orientation, (ChartScrollEventType)navigationType, oldRange, newRange, axisX as AxisBase, axisY as AxisBase);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Weight" => ShouldSerializeWeight(), 
				"SizeMode" => ShouldSerializeSizeMode(), 
				"SizeInPixels" => ShouldSerializeSizeInPixels(), 
				"BorderColor" => ShouldSerializeBorderColor(), 
				"BorderVisible" => ShouldSerializeBorderVisible(), 
				"BackColor" => ShouldSerializeBackColor(), 
				"BackImage" => ShouldSerializeBackImage(), 
				"FillStyle" => ShouldSerializeFillStyle(), 
				"Shadow" => ShouldSerializeShadow(),

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{

			{
				return ShouldSerializeTitle();

		}

		private IEnumerable<IAxisData> GetAxes()
		{
			yield return Diagram.ActualAxisX;
			yield return Diagram.ActualAxisY;
			foreach (IAxisData item in Diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
			foreach (IAxisData item2 in Diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY)
			{
				yield return item2;
			}
		}

		private void RenderInnerBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea)
		{
			PaneAreaRenderer.RenderBorder(renderer, paneArea, 1, ActualBorderColor, isInner: true);
		}

		private void RenderOuterBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea)
		{
			if (borderVisible)
			{
				PaneAreaRenderer.RenderBorder(renderer, paneArea, 1, ActualBorderColor, isInner: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				backImage.Dispose();
				title.Dispose();
			}
			Disposed = true;
		}

		internal void UnregisterVisibilities()
		{
			if (Diagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IAxisData axis in GetAxes())
			{
				axis.AxisVisibilityInPanes.PanesForHide.Remove(this);
			}
		}

		internal bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			return obj == StackedBarTotalLabel;
		}

		internal bool ContainsPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (!lastMappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle value = lastMappingBounds.Value;
			value.Width++;
			value.Height++;
			return value.Contains(point);
		}

		internal void RenderBeforeContent(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, Rectangle maxBounds, DXGraphicsPath clipRegion)
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = base.Chart.HitTestController;
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, Diagram, null, new HitRegion(mappingBounds));
			if (this is IHitTest hitTestObject)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, hitTestObject, null, new HitRegion(mappingBounds));
			}
			if (maxBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, base.Chart, new ChartFocusedArea(this), new HitRegion(maxBounds), force: true);
			}
			shadow.Render(renderer, mappingBounds);
			if (clipRegion != null)
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(clipRegion);
			}
			ActualFillStyle.RenderRectangle(renderer, mappingBounds, ActualBackColor);
			if (backImage != null)
			{
				backImage.Render(renderer, mappingBounds);
			}
			if (clipRegion != null)
			{
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
			}
		}

		internal void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			RenderBorder(renderer, new XYDiagramPaneArea(new RaggedEdgeGeometry(shouldCutEdge: true), new WavedEdgeGeometry(shouldCutEdge: true), bounds.ToGRealRect2D()));
		}

		internal void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea)
		{
			RenderInnerBorder(renderer, paneArea);
			RenderOuterBorder(renderer, paneArea);
		}

		internal void RenderHitBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea)
		{
			HitTestState hitTestState = HitTestState;
			if (!hitTestState.Normal)
			{
				int thickness = ThicknessUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitState(borderVisible ? 1 : 0, hitTestState);
				PaneAreaRenderer.RenderBorder(renderer, paneArea, thickness, hitTestState.ActualColor, isInner: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAnnotationRepository()
		{
			annotations.UpdateAnnotationRepository();
		}

		internal void ClearAnnotations()
		{
			Annotations.ClearAnnotations();
		}

		internal void UpdateAxisIntervalBoundsCache(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (LastMappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository axisIntervalsLayoutRepository = new AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository(this, LastMappingBounds.Value);
				axisIntervalsLayoutRepository.GetIntervalsLayout(axis);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawZoomRectangleHorizontal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			Rectangle a = lastMappingBounds ?? rect;
			rect = Rectangle.Intersect(a, rect);
			rect.Location = new Point(a.Left, rect.Location.Y);
			rect.Width = a.Width;
			zoomRectangle.FillZoomRectangle(renderer, rect);
			if (zoomRectangle.BorderVisible)
			{
				rect = zoomRectangle.DecreaseBorderRect(rect);
				using DXPen pen = zoomRectangle.CreateBorderPen();
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top), new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top), pen);
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), pen);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawZoomRectangleVertical(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			Rectangle a = lastMappingBounds ?? rect;
			rect = Rectangle.Intersect(a, rect);
			rect.Location = new Point(rect.Location.X, a.Top);
			rect.Height = a.Height;
			zoomRectangle.FillZoomRectangle(renderer, rect);
			if (zoomRectangle.BorderVisible)
			{
				rect = zoomRectangle.DecreaseBorderRect(rect);
				using DXPen pen = zoomRectangle.CreateBorderPen();
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top), new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), pen);
				renderer.DrawLine(new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top), new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), pen);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawZoomRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			Rectangle a = lastMappingBounds ?? rect;
			rect = Rectangle.Intersect(a, rect);
			zoomRectangle.FillZoomRectangle(renderer, rect);
			if (zoomRectangle.BorderVisible)
			{
				rect = zoomRectangle.DecreaseBorderRect(rect);
				using DXPen pen = zoomRectangle.CreateBorderPen();
				renderer.DrawRectangle(rect, pen);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawSelectionRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			Rectangle a = lastMappingBounds ?? rect;
			rect = Rectangle.Intersect(a, rect);
			selectionRectangle.FillZoomRectangle(renderer, rect);
			if (selectionRectangle.BorderVisible)
			{
				rect = selectionRectangle.DecreaseBorderRect(rect);
				using DXPen pen = selectionRectangle.CreateBorderPen();
				renderer.DrawRectangle(rect, pen);
			}
		}

		public void ResetZoom()
		{
			PaneAxesManager axesManager = Diagram.GetAxesManager(this);
			if (axesManager != null && axesManager.ResetZoom())
			{
				Diagram.UpdateAutomaticMeasurement(this);
			}
		}

		public Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			Rectangle result = PublicPaneBounds ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			if (base.Chart != null && result.IsEmpty)
			{
				base.Chart.ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
				base.Chart.PerformViewDataCalculationWithoutEvents(base.Chart.LastBounds, correctRanges: true);
				result = PublicPaneBounds ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			if (Collapsed)
			{
				return new Rectangle(result.Location, Size.Empty);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool ContainsElement(object element)
		{
			if (element is XYDiagramPane)
			{
				return Contains((XYDiagramPane)element);
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					XYDiagramPane xYDiagramPane = (XYDiagramPane)enumerator.Current;
					if (xYDiagramPane.Contains(element))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

					xYDiagramPane.ClearAnnotations();
				}
			}
			finally

				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;

					disposable.Dispose();

			base.OnClear();
		}

				xYDiagramPane.UpdateAnnotationRepository();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = GetOwner<XYDiagram2D>();
			if (change.UpdateInfo is CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo && xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				switch (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation)
				{
				case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
					xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.OnPaneCollectionClear();
					break;
				case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
					if (collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem is XYDiagramPane)
					{
						xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.AddPane(collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem as XYDiagramPane);
					}
					else if (collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem is XYDiagramPane[])
					{
						xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.AddPanes(collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem as XYDiagramPane[]);
					}
					break;
				case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
					if (collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem is XYDiagramPane)
					{
						xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.RemovePane(collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem as XYDiagramPane);
					}
					else if (collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem is XYDiagramPane[])
					{
						xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.RemovePanes(collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem as XYDiagramPane[]);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			GetOwner<DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart>()?.CheckXYDiagramBindings();
			base.ProcessChanged(change);
		}

		public int Add(XYDiagramPane pane)
		{
			CheckPane(pane);
			return Add((ChartElement)pane);
		}

		public void AddRange(XYDiagramPane[] coll)
		{
			if (coll != null)
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in coll)
				{
					CheckPane(pane);
				}
				AddRange((ICollection)coll);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, XYDiagramPane pane)
		{
			CheckPane(pane);
			Insert(index, (ChartElement)pane);
		}

		public void Remove(XYDiagramPane pane)
		{
			Remove((ChartElement)pane);
		}

		public bool Contains(XYDiagramPane pane)
		{
			return Contains((ChartElement)pane);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public XYDiagramPane GetPaneByName(string name)
		{
			return (XYDiagramPane)GetElementByName(name);
		}

		public new XYDiagramPane[] ToArray()
		{
			return (XYDiagramPane[])base.InnerList.ToArray(typeof(XYDiagramPane));
		}
	}

		[Description("Gets or sets a color that fills a zoom rectangle.")]

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ColorConverter))]

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;

			set

				if (color != value)

					RaiseControlChanged();

			}

		[Description("Gets or sets the color of zoom rectangle borders.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.ZoomRectangle.BorderColor")]

					RaiseControlChanging();

			}

		[Description("Provides access to the line style of zoom rectangle borders.")]

					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public Color ActualColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					return Color;
				}
				return Pane.Diagram.Appearance.ZoomRectangleColor;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public Color ActualBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!BorderColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return BorderColor;
				}
				return Pane.Diagram.Appearance.ZoomRectangleBorderColor;
			}
		}

		internal ZoomRectangle(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			borderLineStyle = new LineStyle(this);
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Color" => ShouldSerializeColor(), 
				"BorderColor" => ShouldSerializeBorderColor(), 
				"BorderLineStyle" => ShouldSerializeBorderLineStyle(), 
				"BorderVisible" => ShouldSerializeBorderVisible(), 
				_ => base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return !color.IsEmpty;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = Color.Empty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorderColor()
		{
			return !borderColor.IsEmpty;
		}

		private void ResetBorderColor()
		{
			BorderColor = Color.Empty;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorderLineStyle()
		{
			return borderLineStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBorderVisible()
		{
			return !borderVisible;
		}

		private void ResetBorderVisible()
		{
			BorderVisible = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderLineStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBorderVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new ZoomRectangle(null);
		}

		internal DXPen CreateBorderPen()
		{
			return DXPenHelper.Create(ActualBorderColor, BorderLineStyle.Thickness, BorderLineStyle);
		}

		internal Rectangle DecreaseBorderRect(Rectangle rect)
		{
			int num = BorderLineStyle.Thickness / 2;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				rect.Inflate(-num, -num);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		internal void FillZoomRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(rect, ActualColor);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is ZoomRectangle zoomRectangle)
			{
				color = zoomRectangle.color;
				borderColor = zoomRectangle.borderColor;
				borderLineStyle.Assign(zoomRectangle.borderLineStyle);
				borderVisible = zoomRectangle.borderVisible;
			}
		}
	}

	{

		[Description("Gets or sets a value which specifies the size mode used to print the chart.")]

		[Description("Gets or sets the value specifying whether to draw the crosshair when printing/exporting the chart.")]

				}
			}
		}

		internal ChartOptionsPrint(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"SizeMode" => ShouldSerializeSizeMode(), 
				"ImageFormat" => ShouldSerializeImageFormat(), 
				"PrintCrosshair" => ShouldSerializePrintCrosshair(), 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeSizeMode()
		{
			return sizeMode != PrintSizeMode.None;
		}

		internal void ResetSizeMode()
		{
			SizeMode = PrintSizeMode.None;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeImageFormat()
		{
			return imageFormat != PrintImageFormat.Bitmap;
		}

		internal void ResetImageFormat()
		{
			ImageFormat = PrintImageFormat.Bitmap;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePrintCrosshair()
		{
			return printCrosshair;
		}

		private void ResetPrintCrosshair()
		{
			PrintCrosshair = false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeSizeMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeImageFormat();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Assign(BaseOptions options)
		{
			((BaseOptions)this).Assign(options);
			if (options is ChartOptionsPrint chartOptionsPrint)
			{
				SizeMode = chartOptionsPrint.SizeMode;
				ImageFormat = chartOptionsPrint.ImageFormat;
				PrintCrosshair = chartOptionsPrint.PrintCrosshair;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(OptionsPrint)";
		}

				chart.Printer.SizeMode = sizeMode;
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePrinterImageFormat()
		{
			if (chart != null && chart.Printer != null)
			{
				chart.Printer.ImageFormat = imageFormat;
			}
		}

	[RuntimeObject]
	public class ChartPrinter : IChartPrinter, IDisposable, ICloneable
	{
		private readonly IChartContainer control;

		private readonly PrinterNative printerNative;

		private IDisposable componentPrinter;

		[Description("Specifies the printing size mode for the chart control.")]
		public PrintSizeMode SizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return printerNative.SizeMode;
			}
			set
			{
				printerNative.SizeMode = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the chart’s print image format.")]
		public PrintImageFormat ImageFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return printerNative.ImageFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				printerNative.ImageFormat = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides access to the component printer to print a chart.")]
		public ComponentExporter ComponentPrinter
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (componentPrinter == null)
				{
					componentPrinter = (IDisposable)CreateComponentPrinter();
				}
				return (ComponentExporter)componentPrinter;
			}
		}

		[Description("Indicates whether or not the chart can be printed and exported.")]
		public bool IsPrintingAvailable => printerNative.IsPrintingAvailable;

		Size IChartPrinter.ImageSize => printerNative.ImageSize;

		public ChartPrinter(IChartContainer control)
		{
			this.control = control;
			printerNative = new PrinterNative(control.RenderProvider);
		}

		void IChartPrinter.SetPageSettings(ChartPageSettings settings)
		{
			printerNative.PageSettings = settings;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Release();
			printerNative.Dispose();
		}

		public void Assign(ChartPrinter printer)
		{
			printerNative.Assign(printer.printerNative);
		}

		public void PerformPrintingAction(Action0 action, PrintSizeMode sizeMode)
		{
			printerNative.PerformPrintingAction(sizeMode);
			PerformPrintingAction(action);
		}

		public virtual ComponentExporter CreateComponentPrinter()
		{
			return printerNative.CreateComponentPrinter();
		}

		public virtual void Initialize(PrintingSystemBase ps, LinkBase link)
		{
			printerNative.Initialize(ps, link);
		}

		public virtual void Release()
		{
			printerNative.Release();
		}

		public virtual void PerformPrintingAction(Action0 action)
		{
			ComponentPrinter.ClearDocument();
			action.Invoke();
		}

		public virtual void CreateArea(string areaName, BrickGraphics graph)
		{
			if (printerNative.PrintingSystem != null && areaName == "Detail" && printerNative.RenderProvider != null)
			{
				CreateDetail(graph);
			}
		}

		public virtual void CreateDetail(BrickGraphics brickGraph)
		{
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = control.Chart;
			Rectangle printBounds = printerNative.GetPrintBounds();
			if (printBounds.Width <= 0 || printBounds.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit = brickGraph.PageUnit;
			DXImage dXImage = null;
			try
			{
				brickGraph.PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
				chart.ResetGraphicsCache();
				chart.BeginExport();
				dXImage = ((printerNative.ImageFormat == PrintImageFormat.Metafile) ? ((DXImage)chart.CreateMetafile(printBounds.Size)) : ((DXImage)chart.CreateBitmap(printBounds.Size)));
				ImageBrick val = new ImageBrick();
				chart.FinishExport();
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ImageSource = new ImageSource(dXImage);
					((VisualBrick)val).Sides = (BorderSide)0;
					val.DisposeImage = true;
					brickGraph.DrawBrick<ImageBrick>(val, (RectangleF)printBounds);
					dXImage = null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				chart.ResetGraphicsCache();
				chart.ClearCache();
				brickGraph.PageUnit = pageUnit;
				dXImage?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public virtual object Clone()
		{
			ChartPrinter chartPrinter = new ChartPrinter(control);
			chartPrinter.Assign(this);
			return chartPrinter;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return obj.GetType().Equals(GetType());
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
}

	public class ChartResLocalizer : XtraResXLocalizer<ChartStringId>
	{
		internal ChartResLocalizer(ChartLocalizer localizer)
			: base((XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>)localizer)
		{
		}

		public ChartResLocalizer()
			: this(ChartLocalizer.GetDefaultLocalizer())
		{
		}

		protected override ResourceManager CreateResourceManagerCore()
		{
			return XtraLocalizer.CreateResourceManager<ChartStringId>((XtraResXLocalizer<ChartStringId>)this, "DevExpress.XtraCharts.LocalizationRes", typeof(ChartResLocalizer));
		}
	}
	public class ChartLocalizer : XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ChartLocalizer defaultLocalizer;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ChartResLocalizer defaultResLocalizer;

		[Description("Gets or sets a localizer object providing localization of the user interface at runtime.")]
		public static XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId> Active
		{
			get
			{
				return XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>.Active;
			}
			set
			{
				XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>.Active = value;
			}
		}

		static ChartLocalizer()
		{
			XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>.SetActiveLocalizerProvider((ActiveLocalizerProvider<ChartStringId>)(object)new DefaultActiveLocalizerProvider<ChartStringId>(CreateDefaultLocalizer()));
		}

		internal static ChartLocalizer GetDefaultLocalizer()
		{
			if (defaultLocalizer == null)
			{
				defaultLocalizer = new ChartLocalizer();
				((XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>)defaultLocalizer).PopulateStringTable();
			}
			return defaultLocalizer;
		}

		public static XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId> CreateDefaultLocalizer()
		{
			if (defaultResLocalizer == null)
			{
				defaultResLocalizer = new ChartResLocalizer(GetDefaultLocalizer());
			}
			return (XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>)(object)defaultResLocalizer;
		}

		public static string GetString(ChartStringId id)
		{
			return Active.GetLocalizedString(id);
		}

		public static string GetDefaultString(ChartStringId id)
		{
			if (Active is XtraResXLocalizer<ChartStringId> val)
			{
				return val.GetInvariantString(id);
			}
			return ((XtraResXLocalizer<ChartStringId>)(ChartResLocalizer)(object)CreateDefaultLocalizer()).GetInvariantString(id);
		}
