	public class SankeyBorderOptions : IXtraSupportShouldSerialize
	{
		private const int DefaultThickness = 1;

		private readonly Color defaultColor = Color.Empty;

		private readonly IUpdateListener updateListener;

		private Color color;

		private int thickness = 1;

		[Description("Gets or sets the diagram border’s color.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyBorderOptions.Color")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				if (color != value)
				{
					color = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the diagram border’s thickness in pixels.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyBorderOptions.Thickness")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Thickness
		{
			get
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectBorderThickness));
				}
				if (thickness != value)
				{
					thickness = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal SankeyBorderOptions(IUpdateListener updateListener)
		{
			this.updateListener = updateListener;
			color = defaultColor;
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "Color"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Thickness")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeThickness();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return ShouldSerializeColor();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return !color.IsEmpty;
		}

		private void ResetColor()
		{
			color = defaultColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeThickness()
		{
			return thickness != 1;
		}

		private void ResetThickness()
		{
			Thickness = 1;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeThickness();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RaiseChanged()
		{
			updateListener.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.View);
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyBorderOptions border)
		{
			color = border.color;
			thickness = border.thickness;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(BorderOptions)";
		}
	}

		public virtual void CalculateNodeBounds(IEnumerable<ISankeyNodeLayoutItem> nodes, DXRectangle bounds)

		}

	public class SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm : SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase, ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm, ISankeyLayoutAlgorithm
	{
		private const bool DefaultResolveOverlapping = true;

		private const SankeyNodeAlignment DefaultNodeAlignment = SankeyNodeAlignment.Center;

		private DefaultBoolean resolveOverlapping = (DefaultBoolean)2;

		private SankeyNodeAlignment nodeAlignment = SankeyNodeAlignment.Center;

		private SankeyLayoutAlgorithmCore linearLayoutAlgorithmCore;

		[Description("Indicates whether nodes are automatically repositioned to avoid link overlap.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.ResolveOverlapping")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DefaultBoolean ResolveOverlapping
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return resolveOverlapping;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (resolveOverlapping != value)
				{
					resolveOverlapping = value;
					linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToBoolean(value, defaultValue: true);
					RaiseLayoutAlgorithmChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the node alignment within the Sankey diagram control.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.NodeAlignment")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Layout)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SankeyNodeAlignment NodeAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return nodeAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (nodeAlignment != value)
				{
					nodeAlignment = value;
					linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment = (SankeyNodeAlignmentCore)nodeAlignment;
					RaiseLayoutAlgorithmChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		bool ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.ResolveOverlapping
		{
			get
			{
				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping;
			}
			set
			{
				linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping = value;
			}
		}

		Comparison<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.NodeComparison
		{
			get
			{
				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeComparison;
			}
			set
			{
				linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeComparison = value;
			}
		}

		DevExpress.Charts.Sankey.Native.ISankeyViewOptionsProvider ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.ViewOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ViewOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ViewOptions = value;
			}
		}

		List<SankeyLayoutLevel> ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.Levels => linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.Levels;

		SankeyNodeAlignmentCore ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.NodeAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment = value;
			}
		}

		internal event EventHandler LayoutAlgorithmChanged;

		public SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			linearLayoutAlgorithmCore = new SankeyLayoutAlgorithmCore();
			linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping = true;
			linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment = (SankeyNodeAlignmentCore)nodeAlignment;
		}

		protected void RaiseLayoutAlgorithmChanged()
		{
			if (this.LayoutAlgorithmChanged != null)
			{
				this.LayoutAlgorithmChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(LayoutAlgorithm)";
		}

		bool ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.CalculateNodeBoundsInternal(IEnumerable<ISankeyNodeLayoutItem> nodes, DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.CalculateNodeBoundsInternal(nodes, bounds);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeResolveOverlapping()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)ResolveOverlapping != 2;
		}

		private void ResetResolveOverlapping()
		{
			ResolveOverlapping = (DefaultBoolean)2;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeNodeAlignment()
		{
			return NodeAlignment != SankeyNodeAlignment.Center;
		}

		private void ResetNodeAlignment()
		{
			NodeAlignment = SankeyNodeAlignment.Center;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeResolveOverlapping())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeNodeAlignment();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			ResetResolveOverlapping();
			ResetNodeAlignment();
		}
	}
	public class SankeyPadding : IXtraSupportShouldSerialize
	{
		private const int Undefined = -1;

		private const int DefaultPadding = 20;

		private readonly IUpdateListener updateListener;

		private readonly IScalingHelper scalingHelper;

		private RectThickness padding;

		internal int ActualLeft => scalingHelper.ScaleX(Left);

		internal int ActualRight => scalingHelper.ScaleX(Right);

		internal int ActualTop => scalingHelper.ScaleY(Top);

		internal int ActualBottom => scalingHelper.ScaleY(Bottom);

		[Description("Gets or sets a padding value for a diagram’s left edge.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPadding.Left")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Left
		{
			get
			{
				return padding.Left;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 20;
				}
				if (padding.Left != value)
				{
					padding.Left = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a padding value for a diagram’s top edge.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPadding.Top")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Top
		{
			get
			{
				return padding.Top;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 20;
				}
				if (padding.Top != value)
				{
					padding.Top = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a padding value for a diagram’s right edge.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPadding.Right")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Right
		{
			get
			{
				return padding.Right;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 20;
				}
				if (padding.Right != value)
				{
					padding.Right = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a padding value for a diagram’s bottom edge.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPadding.Bottom")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return padding.Bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 20;
				}
				if (padding.Bottom != value)
				{
					padding.Bottom = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies padding for all diagram sides.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPadding.All")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int All
		{
			get
			{
				if (Left != Top || Left != Right || Left != Bottom)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return Left;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 20;
				}
				Left = value;
				Top = value;
				Right = value;
				Bottom = value;
			}
		}

		internal SankeyPadding(IUpdateListener updateListener, IScalingHelper scalingHelper)
		{
			this.updateListener = updateListener;
			this.scalingHelper = scalingHelper;
			padding = new RectThickness(20, 20, 20, 20);
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Left" => ShouldSerializeLeft(), 
				"Top" => ShouldSerializeTop(), 
				"Right" => ShouldSerializeRight(), 
				"Bottom" => ShouldSerializeBottom(), 
				"All" => ShouldSerializeAll(), 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLeft()
		{
			if (All == -1)
			{
				return padding.Left != 20;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetLeft()
		{
			padding.Left = 20;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTop()
		{
			if (All == -1)
			{
				return padding.Top != 20;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetTop()
		{
			padding.Top = 20;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeRight()
		{
			if (All == -1)
			{
				return padding.Right != 20;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetRight()
		{
			padding.Right = 20;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeBottom()
		{
			if (All == -1)
			{
				return padding.Bottom != 20;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetBottom()
		{
			padding.Bottom = 20;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAll()
		{
			if (All != -1)
			{
				return All != 20;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetAll()
		{
			All = 20;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeLeft() && !ShouldSerializeTop() && !ShouldSerializeRight() && !ShouldSerializeBottom())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAll();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RaiseChanged()
		{
			updateListener.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.View);
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyPadding obj)
		{
			padding = obj.padding;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Padding)";
		}
	}
	public abstract class SankeyTextElement : IXtraSupportShouldSerialize, IXtraPartlyDeserializable
	{
		private BackCompatibilityFontController fontController;

		private System.Drawing.StringAlignment textAlignment;

		private string text;

		private Color textColor;

		private SankeyUpdateType updateType;

		protected abstract Color DefaultTextColor { get; }

		protected abstract DXFont DefaultFont { get; }

		protected abstract System.Drawing.StringAlignment DefaultTextAlignment { get; }

		protected abstract string DefaultText { get; }

		internal IUpdateListener UpdateListener { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets element text.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyTextElement.Text")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != text)
				{
					text = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the text color for the element.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyTextElement.TextColor")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color TextColor
		{
			get
			{
				return textColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != TextColor)
				{
					textColor = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the font that is used to display text.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return fontController.Font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != fontController.Font)
				{
					fontController.Font = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the font that is used to display text.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyTextElement.DXFont")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DXFont DXFont
		{
			get
			{
				return fontController.DXFont;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != fontController.DXFont)
				{
					fontController.DXFont = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies text alignment.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyTextElement.TextAlignment")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Behavior)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(StringAlignmentTypeConvertor))]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public System.Drawing.StringAlignment TextAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return textAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != textAlignment)
				{
					textAlignment = value;
					RaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public SankeyTextElement(IUpdateListener updateListener, SankeyUpdateType updateType)
		{
			UpdateListener = updateListener;
			this.updateType = updateType;
			text = DefaultText;
			textColor = DefaultTextColor;
			fontController = new BackCompatibilityFontController(DefaultFont, null);
			textAlignment = DefaultTextAlignment;
		}

		protected void RaiseChanged()
		{
			UpdateListener?.ProcessChanged(updateType);
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyTextElement textElement)
		{
			text = textElement.Text;
			fontController.Assign(textElement.fontController);
			textAlignment = textElement.TextAlignment;
			textColor = textElement.TextColor;
		}

		internal virtual Color GetActualTextColor(ISankeyStyle style)
		{
			if (TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (style == null)
				{
					return Color.Black;
				}
				return GraphicUtils.XorColor(style.BackColor);
			}
			return TextColor;
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected virtual bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"Text" => ShouldSerializeText(), 
				"Font" => false, 
				"DXFont" => ShouldSerializeDXFont(), 
				"TextAlignment" => ShouldSerializeTextAlignment(), 
				"TextColor" => ShouldSerializeTextColor(), 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeFont()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetText()
		{
			text = DefaultText;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeText()
		{
			return text != DefaultText;
		}

		private void ResetDXFont()
		{
			fontController.Reset();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDXFont()
		{
			return fontController.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private void ResetTextAlignment()
		{
			textAlignment = DefaultTextAlignment;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTextAlignment()
		{
			return textAlignment != DefaultTextAlignment;
		}

		private void ResetTextColor()
		{
			textColor = DefaultTextColor;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeTextColor()
		{
			return textColor != DefaultTextColor;
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeDXFont() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeTextAlignment())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTextColor();
			}
			return true;
		}

				return true;
			}

			}
			return true;
		}

	public class SankeyTitleCollection : NotificationCollection<SankeyTitle>
	{
		private readonly IUpdateListener updateListener;

		internal SankeyTitleCollection(IUpdateListener updateListener)
		{
			this.updateListener = updateListener;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(CollectionChangedEventArgs<SankeyTitle> e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)e.Action == 0)
			{
				e.Element.UpdateListener = updateListener;
			}
			updateListener.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.Title);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return ((DXCollectionBase<SankeyTitle>)(object)this).Count > 0;
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyTitleCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			((DXCollectionBase<SankeyTitle>)(object)this).InnerList.Clear();
			foreach (SankeyTitle item in (DXCollectionBase<SankeyTitle>)(object)collection)
			{
				SankeyTitle sankeyTitle = new SankeyTitle();
				sankeyTitle.Assign(item);
				sankeyTitle.UpdateListener = updateListener;
				((DXCollectionBase<SankeyTitle>)(object)this).InnerList.Add(sankeyTitle);
			}
		}
	}

			updateListener.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.View);
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyViewOptions viewOptions)
		{
			verticalNodeIndent = viewOptions.verticalNodeIndent;
			nodeWidth = viewOptions.nodeWidth;
			linkTransparency = viewOptions.linkTransparency;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(ViewOptions)";
		}
	}

	public abstract class SankeyColorizerBase : ISankeyColorizer, IXtraSupportShouldSerialize
	{
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		internal SankeyAppearanceController Owner { get; set; }

		internal event EventHandler ColorizerChanged;

		Color ISankeyColorizer.GetNodeColor(SankeyNode node)
		{
			return GetNodeColor(node);
		}

		Color ISankeyColorizer.GetLinkSourceColor(SankeyLink link)
		{
			return GetLinkColor(link);
		}

		Color ISankeyColorizer.GetLinkTargetColor(SankeyLink link)
		{
			return GetLinkColor2(link);
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
		}

		protected void RaiseColorizerChanged()
		{
			if (this.ColorizerChanged != null)
			{
				this.ColorizerChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		protected abstract Color GetNodeColor(SankeyNode info);

		protected abstract Color GetLinkColor(SankeyLink link);

		protected abstract Color GetLinkColor2(SankeyLink link);

		protected virtual bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void Assign(SankeyColorizerBase colorizer)
		{
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SankeyPaletteColorizer : SankeyColorizerBase, IPaletteProvider, ISankeyPaletteRepositoryProvider
	{
		private DefaultPalette defaultPalette;

		private Palette palette;

		private string paletteName;

		private Color linkColor = Color.Empty;

		internal DefaultPalette DefaultPalette => defaultPalette;

		internal Palette ActualPalette
		{
			get
			{
				if (palette == null)
				{
					EnsurePalette();
				}
				return palette ?? defaultPalette;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a palette that should be applied to a Sankey diagram.")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableCollectionTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public Palette Palette
		{
			get
			{
				return palette;
			}
			set
			{
				if (palette != value)
				{
					palette = value;
					paletteName = ((palette != null) ? palette.Name : string.Empty);
					RaiseColorizerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of a palette that is applied to a diagram.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPaletteColorizer.PaletteName")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.SankeyColorizerPaletteTypeEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(SankeyPaletteTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string PaletteName
		{
			get
			{
				return paletteName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (paletteName != value)
				{
					paletteName = value;
					EnsurePalette();
					RaiseColorizerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a color that is used to paint all links in the diagram.")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.SankeyPaletteColorizer.LinkColor")]
		[XtraChartsLocalizableCategory(XtraChartsCategory.Appearance)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Color LinkColor
		{
			get
			{
				return linkColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != linkColor)
				{
					linkColor = value;
					RaiseColorizerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		PaletteRepository ISankeyPaletteRepositoryProvider.PaletteRepository => base.Owner?.PaletteRepository;

		public SankeyPaletteColorizer()
		{
			defaultPalette = new DefaultPalette();
			paletteName = ActualPalette.Name;
		}

		Palette IPaletteProvider.GetPalette()
		{
			return Palette;
		}

		string IPaletteProvider.GetPaletteName()
		{
			return PaletteName;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePaletteName()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PaletteName);
		}

		private void ResetPaletteName()
		{
			PaletteName = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeLinkColor()
		{
			return !LinkColor.IsEmpty;
		}

		private void ResetLinkColor()
		{
			LinkColor = Color.Empty;
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "PaletteName"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "LinkColor")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeLinkColor();
				}
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
			return ShouldSerializePaletteName();
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializePaletteName())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLinkColor();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void Assign(SankeyColorizerBase colorizer)
		{
			base.Assign(colorizer);
			if (colorizer is SankeyPaletteColorizer sankeyPaletteColorizer)
			{
				linkColor = sankeyPaletteColorizer.linkColor;
				PaletteName = sankeyPaletteColorizer.paletteName;
			}
		}

		private void EnsurePalette()
		{
			palette = ((paletteName != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName && base.Owner != null) ? base.Owner.PaletteRepository.GetPaletteByName(paletteName) : null);
		}

		protected override Color GetNodeColor(SankeyNode node)
		{
			int index = node.Index;
			return ActualPalette.GetEntry(index, 1, 0).Color;
		}

		protected override Color GetLinkColor(SankeyLink link)
		{
			if (!LinkColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return LinkColor;
			}
			int index = link.SourceNode.Index;
			return ActualPalette.GetEntry(index, 1, 0).Color;
		}

		protected override Color GetLinkColor2(SankeyLink link)
		{
			if (!LinkColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return LinkColor;
			}
			int index = link.TargetNode.Index;
			return ActualPalette.GetEntry(index, 1, 0).Color;
		}

		internal void UpdateDefaultPalette(string paletteName)
		{
			defaultPalette.LoadColorsFromActualPalette(paletteName);
			RaiseColorizerChanged();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(PaletteColorizer)";
		}
	}

	public class SankeyLink

namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.Native
{
	public class SankeyDataController : ISankeyDataSourceProvider, IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider, IDesignTimeDataProvider
	{
		private readonly IUpdateListener updateListener;

		private readonly ISankeyContainer container;

		private readonly SankeyDataAggregator aggregator;

		private readonly IEnumerable<ISankeyLink> designTimeFakeData;

		private ICollection<ISankeyLink> initialLinks;

		private object dataSource;

		private object dataAdapter;

		private string sourceDataMember;

		private string targetDataMember;

		private string weightDataMember;

		private DataSourceEventManagerBase dataSourceEventManager;

		private bool isDataUpdatesLocked;

		private DataSourceEventManagerBase DataSourceEventManager
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSourceEventManager;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSourceEventManager != null)
				{
					dataSourceEventManager.UnsubscribeEvents();
				}
				dataSourceEventManager = value;
				if (dataSourceEventManager != null)
				{
					dataSourceEventManager.SubscribeEvents();
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<ISankeyLink> InitialLinks
		{
			get
			{
				if (initialLinks != null && initialLinks.Count > 0)
				{
					return initialLinks;
				}
				if (DataSource == null && container != null && container.DesignMode)
				{
					return designTimeFakeData;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal ICollection<ISankeyLink> ProcessedLinks => aggregator.GetLinks(InitialLinks);

		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSource != value)
				{
					DataSourceEventManager = DataSourceEventManagerBase.CreateDataSourceEventManager(this, value);
					dataSource = value;
					if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(null, dataSource, SourceDataMember))
					{
						sourceDataMember = "";
					}
					if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(null, dataSource, TargetDataMember))
					{
						targetDataMember = "";
					}
					if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(null, dataSource, WeightDataMember))
					{
						weightDataMember = "";
					}
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		public string SourceDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return sourceDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (sourceDataMember != value)
				{
					CheckMember(value, string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), value));
					CheckDifferentMembers(value, TargetDataMember);
					sourceDataMember = value;
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		public string TargetDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return targetDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (targetDataMember != value)
				{
					CheckMember(value, string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), value));
					CheckDifferentMembers(SourceDataMember, value);
					targetDataMember = value;
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		public string WeightDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return weightDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (weightDataMember != value)
				{
					CheckMember(value, string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), value), ScaleType.Numerical, string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleDataMember), value, ScaleType.Numerical.ToString()));
					weightDataMember = value;
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		object IDesignTimeDataProvider.DataAdapter => dataAdapter;

		public SankeyDataController(IUpdateListener updateListener, ISankeyContainer container)
		{
			this.updateListener = updateListener;
			this.container = container;
			aggregator = new SankeyDataAggregator();
			dataSourceEventManager = new EmptySourceEventManager(this, null);
			designTimeFakeData = SankeyFakeDataGenerator.GenerateFakeData();
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, DataChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		bool IDesignTimeDataProvider.CanFillDataSource()
		{
			dataAdapter = BindingHelper.UpdateDataAdapter(dataSource, container.Site, container.DesignMode);
			if (BindingHelper.ConvertToIDataAdapter(dataAdapter) != null)
			{
				return BindingHelper.ConvertToDataSet(DataSource) != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IDesignTimeDataProvider.FillDataSource()
		{
			if (!((IDesignTimeDataProvider)this).CanFillDataSource())
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isDataUpdatesLocked = true;
				BindingHelper.ConvertToIDataAdapter(dataAdapter).Fill(BindingHelper.ConvertToDataSet(DataSource));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				container.ShowErrorMessage(ex.Message, string.Empty);
			}
			finally
			{
				isDataUpdatesLocked = false;
				UpdateData();
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeDataSource()
		{
			return dataSource != null;
		}

		internal void ResetDataSource()
		{
			DataSource = null;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeSourceDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SourceDataMember);
		}

		internal void ResetSourceDataMember()
		{
			SourceDataMember = null;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeTargetDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TargetDataMember);
		}

		internal void ResetTargetDataMember()
		{
			TargetDataMember = null;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeWeightDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(WeightDataMember);
		}

		internal void ResetWeightDataMember()
		{
			WeightDataMember = null;
		}

		private void OnDataAdapterChanged()
		{
			aggregator.Reset();
			updateListener.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.Data);
		}

		private void CheckMember(string member, string error)
		{
			if (dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(member) && !BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(null, dataSource, member))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(error);
			}
		}

		private void CheckDifferentMembers(string source, string target)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(source) && source.Equals(target))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSankeyEqualDataMembers));
			}
		}

		private void CheckMember(string member, string error, ScaleType type, string typeError)
		{
			if (dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(member))
			{
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(null, dataSource, member))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(error);
				}
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(null, dataSource, member, type))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(typeError);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool MembersAreValid()
		{
			if (dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SourceDataMember))
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TargetDataMember);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateData()
		{
			if (isDataUpdatesLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			initialLinks = null;
			if (MembersAreValid())
			{
				using SankeyBindingProcedure sankeyBindingProcedure = new SankeyBindingProcedure(this);
				initialLinks = sankeyBindingProcedure.Process();
			}
			OnDataAdapterChanged();
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyDataController controller)
		{
			sourceDataMember = controller.sourceDataMember;
			targetDataMember = controller.targetDataMember;
			weightDataMember = controller.weightDataMember;
			dataAdapter = controller.dataAdapter;
		}

		internal void Dispose()
		{
			DataSourceEventManager.UnsubscribeEvents();
		}
	}
	public class SankeyAppearanceController
	{
		private readonly IUpdateListener updateListener;

		private readonly ISankeyContainer container;

		private readonly SankeyPaletteColorizer defaultColorizer;

		private readonly PaletteRepository paletteRepository;

		private readonly SankeyViewOptions viewOptions;

		private readonly SankeyBorderOptions borderOptions;

		private readonly SankeyPadding padding;

		private ISankeyColorizer colorizer;

		private Color backColor = Color.Empty;

		internal Color ActualBackColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (BackColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (Style == null)
					{
						return Color.White;
					}
					return Style.BackColor;
				}
				return BackColor;
			}
		}

		public Color ActualBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (BorderOptions.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (Style == null)
					{
						return Color.Gray;
					}
					return Style.BorderColor;
				}
				return BorderOptions.Color;
			}
		}

		internal PaletteRepository PaletteRepository => paletteRepository;

		public SankeyViewOptions ViewOptions => viewOptions;

		public SankeyPadding Padding => padding;

		public SankeyBorderOptions BorderOptions => borderOptions;

		public ISankeyStyle Style => container.RenderProvider?.Style;

		public ISankeyColorizer Colorizer
		{
			get
			{
				return colorizer;
			}
			set
			{
				if (colorizer != value)
				{
					if (colorizer != null)
					{
						UnsubscribeColorizer(colorizer);
					}
					colorizer = value;
					SubscribeColorizer(colorizer);
					OnAppearanceChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public Color BackColor
		{
			get
			{
				return backColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != backColor)
				{
					backColor = value;
					OnAppearanceChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public SankeyAppearanceController(IUpdateListener updateListener, ISankeyContainer container, IScalingHelper scalingHelper)
		{
			this.updateListener = updateListener;
			this.container = container;
			defaultColorizer = new SankeyPaletteColorizer();
			paletteRepository = new PaletteRepository(new PredefinedPaletteList(), defaultColorizer.DefaultPalette);
			viewOptions = new SankeyViewOptions(updateListener, scalingHelper);
			borderOptions = new SankeyBorderOptions(updateListener);
			padding = new SankeyPadding(updateListener, scalingHelper);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeColorizer()
		{
			if (Colorizer != null)
			{
				if (Colorizer is SankeyColorizerBase)
				{
					return (Colorizer as SankeyColorizerBase).ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetColorizer()
		{
			Colorizer = defaultColorizer;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeBackColor()
		{
			return !backColor.IsEmpty;
		}

		internal void ResetBackColor()
		{
			BackColor = Color.Empty;
		}

		private void SubscribeColorizer(ISankeyColorizer colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer is SankeyColorizerBase)
			{
				SankeyColorizerBase sankeyColorizerBase = (SankeyColorizerBase)colorizer;
				sankeyColorizerBase.ColorizerChanged += OnColorizerChanged;
				sankeyColorizerBase.Owner = this;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeColorizer(ISankeyColorizer colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer is SankeyColorizerBase)
			{
				SankeyColorizerBase sankeyColorizerBase = (SankeyColorizerBase)colorizer;
				sankeyColorizerBase.ColorizerChanged -= OnColorizerChanged;
				sankeyColorizerBase.Owner = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnColorizerChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnAppearanceChanged();
		}

		private Color GetColorOrDefault(Func<ISankeyColorizer, Color> getColor, Func<ISankeyColorizer, Color> getColorAdditional = null)
		{
			Color result = Color.Empty;
			if (colorizer != null)
			{
				result = getColor(colorizer);
				if (getColorAdditional != null && result.IsEmpty)
				{
					result = getColorAdditional(colorizer);
				}
			}
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = getColor(defaultColorizer);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyAppearanceController controller)
		{
			paletteRepository.Assign(controller.paletteRepository);
			ISankeyColorizer sankeyColorizer = controller.colorizer;
			if (sankeyColorizer != null && sankeyColorizer is SankeyColorizerBase)
			{
				if (colorizer?.GetType() != sankeyColorizer.GetType())
				{
					Colorizer = (SankeyColorizerBase)Activator.CreateInstance(sankeyColorizer.GetType());
				}
				((SankeyColorizerBase)colorizer).Assign((SankeyColorizerBase)sankeyColorizer);
			}
			else
			{
				colorizer = null;
			}
			backColor = controller.backColor;
			viewOptions.Assign(controller.viewOptions);
			borderOptions.Assign(controller.borderOptions);
			padding.Assign(controller.padding);
		}

		public void OnAppearanceChanged()
		{
			updateListener.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.Appearance);
		}

		public void UpdatePalette(string paletteName)
		{
			if (Colorizer is SankeyPaletteColorizer)
			{
				((SankeyPaletteColorizer)Colorizer).UpdateDefaultPalette(paletteName);
			}
			defaultColorizer.UpdateDefaultPalette(paletteName);
		}

		public Color GetNodeColor(SankeyNode node)
		{
			return GetColorOrDefault((ISankeyColorizer c) => c.GetNodeColor(node));
		}

		public Color GetLinkColor(SankeyLink link)
		{
			return GetColorOrDefault((ISankeyColorizer c) => c.GetLinkSourceColor(link), (ISankeyColorizer c) => c.GetNodeColor(link.SourceNode));
		}

		public Color GetLinkColor2(SankeyLink link)
		{
			return GetColorOrDefault((ISankeyColorizer c) => c.GetLinkTargetColor(link), (ISankeyColorizer c) => c.GetNodeColor(link.TargetNode));
		}
	}
	public abstract class SankeyInteractionController
	{
		public class ActiveItemsCollection : NotificationCollection<object>
		{
			private readonly SankeyInteractionController controller;

			private int changesLockedCount;

			internal ActiveItemsCollection(SankeyInteractionController controller)
			{
				this.controller = controller;
			}

			protected override void OnCollectionChanged(CollectionChangedEventArgs<object> e)
			{
				if (changesLockedCount == 0)
				{
					controller.ActiveItemsChanged();
				}
			}

			public void LockChanges()
			{
				changesLockedCount++;
			}

			public void UnlockChanges(bool raiseChanged = false)
			{
				changesLockedCount--;
				if (raiseChanged)
				{
					((NotificationCollection<object>)this).OnCollectionChanged(new CollectionChangedEventArgs<object>((CollectionChangedAction)4, (object)null));
				}
			}

			public override void AddRange(ICollection collection)
			{
				base.AddRange(collection);
			}
		}

		private readonly SankeyDiagram diagram;

		private readonly List<SankeyNode> activeNodes = new List<SankeyNode>();

		private readonly List<SankeyLink> activeLinks = new List<SankeyLink>();

		private ActiveItemsCollection activeTags;

		protected SankeyDiagram Diagram => diagram;

		protected ActiveItemsCollection ActiveTags => activeTags;

		protected List<SankeyNode> ActiveNodes => activeNodes;

		protected List<SankeyLink> ActiveLinks => activeLinks;

		protected bool ShouldUpdateCollection { get; set; } = true;

		protected virtual bool SetAdjacentLinksActive { get; set; } = true;

		protected virtual bool SetAdjacentNodesActive { get; set; }

		public SankeyInteractionController(SankeyDiagram diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			activeTags = new ActiveItemsCollection(this);
		}

		private void AddLinksToActive(IList<SankeyLink> links)
		{
			foreach (SankeyLink link in links)
			{
				SankeyLinkViewData viewData = link.ViewData;
				foreach (object tag in link.Tags)
				{
					((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)ActiveTags).Add(tag);
				}
				SetIsActive(viewData, value: true);
				activeLinks.Add(link);
			}
		}

		private void AddNodesToActive(IList<SankeyNode> nodes)
		{
			foreach (SankeyNode node in nodes)
			{
				SankeyNodeViewData viewData = node.ViewData;
				((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)ActiveTags).Add(node.Tag);
				SetIsActive(viewData, value: true);
				activeNodes.Add(node);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLinksFromActive(IList<SankeyLink> links)
		{
			foreach (SankeyLink link in links)
			{
				SankeyLinkViewData viewData = link.ViewData;
				foreach (object tag in link.Tags)
				{
					((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)ActiveTags).Remove(tag);
				}
				SetIsActive(viewData, value: false);
				activeLinks.Remove(link);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveNodesFromActive(IList<SankeyNode> nodes)
		{
			foreach (SankeyNode node in nodes)
			{
				SankeyNodeViewData viewData = node.ViewData;
				((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)ActiveTags).Remove(node.Tag);
				SetIsActive(viewData, value: false);
				activeNodes.Remove(node);
			}
		}

		private void AddLinksToCollection(IList<SankeyLink> linkCollection, IList<SankeyLink> links, bool addActive, bool addInactive)
		{
			foreach (SankeyLink link in links)
			{
				bool isActive = GetIsActive(link.ViewData);
				if ((addInactive && !isActive) || (addActive && isActive))
				{
					linkCollection.Add(link);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddLinkToCollection(IList<SankeyLink> linkCollection, SankeyLink link, bool addActive, bool addInactive)
		{
			bool isActive = GetIsActive(link.ViewData);
			if ((addInactive && !isActive) || (addActive && isActive))
			{
				linkCollection.Add(link);
			}
		}

		private void AddNodeToCollection(IList<SankeyNode> nodeCollection, SankeyNode node, bool addActive, bool addInactive)
		{
			bool isActive = GetIsActive(node.ViewData);
			if ((addInactive && !isActive) || (addActive && isActive))
			{
				nodeCollection.Add(node);
			}
		}

		private void FillAdjacentItems(SankeyNodeViewData nodeViewData, IList<SankeyNode> adjacentNodes, IList<SankeyLink> adjacentLinks, bool addActive, bool addInactive)
		{
			SankeyNode node = nodeViewData.Node;
			AddNodeToCollection(adjacentNodes, node, addActive, addInactive);
			if (SetAdjacentLinksActive)
			{
				AddLinksToCollection(adjacentLinks, node.InputLinks, addActive, addInactive);
				AddLinksToCollection(adjacentLinks, node.OutputLinks, addActive, addInactive);
			}
			Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData>.ValueCollection valueCollection = diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Nodes?.Values;
			if (valueCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SankeyNode sankeyNode = valueCollection.LastOrDefault((SankeyNodeViewData x) => x.Node.Tag.Equals(node.Tag) && x.Node != node)?.Node;
			if (sankeyNode != null)
			{
				AddNodeToCollection(adjacentNodes, sankeyNode, addActive, addInactive);
				if (SetAdjacentLinksActive)
				{
					AddLinksToCollection(adjacentLinks, sankeyNode.InputLinks, addActive, addInactive);
					AddLinksToCollection(adjacentLinks, sankeyNode.OutputLinks, addActive, addInactive);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillAdjacentItems(SankeyLinkViewData linkViewData, IList<SankeyNode> adjacentNodes, IList<SankeyLink> adjacentLinks, bool addActive, bool addInactive)
		{
			AddLinkToCollection(adjacentLinks, linkViewData.Link, addActive, addInactive);
			if (SetAdjacentNodesActive)
			{
				AddNodeToCollection(adjacentNodes, linkViewData.SourceViewData.Node, addActive, addInactive);
				AddNodeToCollection(adjacentNodes, linkViewData.TargetViewData.Node, addActive, addInactive);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ActiveItemsChanged();

		protected abstract void SetIsActive(ISankeyInteractiveElement interactiveElement, bool value);

		protected abstract bool GetIsActive(ISankeyInteractiveElement interactiveElement);

		protected void FillAdjacentItems(ISankeyInteractiveElement sankeyInteractiveElement, IList<SankeyNode> adjacentNodes, IList<SankeyLink> adjacentLinks, bool addActive, bool addInactive)
		{
			if (sankeyInteractiveElement is SankeyNodeViewData)
			{
				FillAdjacentItems((SankeyNodeViewData)sankeyInteractiveElement, adjacentNodes, adjacentLinks, addActive, addInactive);
			}
			else
			{
				FillAdjacentItems((SankeyLinkViewData)sankeyInteractiveElement, adjacentNodes, adjacentLinks, addActive, addInactive);
			}
		}

		protected void AddItems(IList<SankeyNode> nodes, IList<SankeyLink> links, bool shouldReset = true)
		{
			ActiveTags.LockChanges();
			if (shouldReset)
			{
				Reset();
			}
			AddNodesToActive(nodes);
			AddLinksToActive(links);
			ActiveTags.UnlockChanges();
		}

		protected void RemoveItems(IList<SankeyNode> nodes, IList<SankeyLink> links)
		{
			ActiveTags.LockChanges();
			RemoveNodesFromActive(nodes);
			RemoveLinksFromActive(links);
			ActiveTags.UnlockChanges();
		}

		protected virtual void Reset()
		{
			Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData>.ValueCollection valueCollection = diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Nodes?.Values;
			if (valueCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (SankeyNodeViewData item in valueCollection)
				{
					SetIsActive(item, value: false);
				}
			}
			ICollection<SankeyLinkViewData> collection = diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Links;
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (SankeyLinkViewData item2 in collection)
				{
					SetIsActive(item2, value: false);
				}
			}
			ActiveTags.LockChanges();
			((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)ActiveTags).Clear();
			ActiveTags.UnlockChanges();
			activeLinks.Clear();
			activeNodes.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class SankeyHighlightingController : SankeyInteractionController
	{
		public bool HighlightingEnabled { get; set; } = true;

		public object HighlightedItem { get; private set; }

		public IList HighlightedItems => (IList)base.ActiveTags;

		public SankeyHighlightingController(SankeyDiagram diagram)
			: base(diagram)
		{
		}

		private void Highlight(SankeyNodeViewData nodeViewData)
		{
			List<SankeyNode> list = new List<SankeyNode>();
			List<SankeyLink> list2 = new List<SankeyLink>();
			FillAdjacentItems(nodeViewData, list, list2, addActive: false, addInactive: true);
			AddItems(list, list2);
			HighlightedItem = nodeViewData;
		}

		private void Highlight(SankeyLinkViewData linkViewData)
		{
			List<SankeyNode> list = new List<SankeyNode>();
			List<SankeyLink> list2 = new List<SankeyLink>();
			FillAdjacentItems(linkViewData, list, list2, addActive: false, addInactive: true);
			AddItems(list, list2);
			HighlightedItem = linkViewData;
		}

		private void Unhighlight()
		{
			Reset();
			HighlightedItem = null;
		}

		protected override void ActiveItemsChanged()
		{
			Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData>.ValueCollection valueCollection = base.Diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Nodes?.Values;
			ICollection<SankeyLinkViewData> collection = base.Diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Links;
			if (valueCollection == null || collection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ActiveNodes.Clear();
			base.ActiveLinks.Clear();
			foreach (SankeyNodeViewData item in valueCollection)
			{
				if (((ISankeyInteractiveElement)item).IsHighlighted = ((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)base.ActiveTags).Contains(item.Node.Tag))
				{
					base.ActiveNodes.Add(item.Node);
				}
			}
			foreach (SankeyLinkViewData item2 in collection)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				foreach (object tag in item2.Link.Tags)
				{
					if (((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)base.ActiveTags).Contains(tag))
					{
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				((ISankeyInteractiveElement)item2).IsHighlighted = flag2;
				if (flag2)
				{
					base.ActiveLinks.Add(item2.Link);
				}
			}
			base.Diagram.ViewController.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific);
		}

		protected override void SetIsActive(ISankeyInteractiveElement interactiveElement, bool value)
		{
			interactiveElement.IsHighlighted = value;
		}

		protected override bool GetIsActive(ISankeyInteractiveElement interactiveElement)
		{
			return interactiveElement.IsHighlighted;
		}

		protected override void Reset()
		{
			HighlightedItem = null;
			base.Reset();
		}

		internal void HighlightElement(Point p)
		{
			if (!HighlightingEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			object highlightedItem = HighlightedItem;
			IHitTest hitTest = base.Diagram.HitTestController.Find(p).FirstOrDefault()?.Object;
			if (highlightedItem == hitTest)
			{
				return;
			}
			Unhighlight();
			if (hitTest == null)
			{
				base.Diagram.ViewController.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific);
				base.Diagram.RaiseHighlightedItemsChangedEvent(new SankeyHighlightedItemsChangedEventArgs(base.ActiveNodes, base.ActiveLinks));
				return;
			}
			if (hitTest is SankeyNodeViewData)
			{
				Highlight((SankeyNodeViewData)hitTest);
			}
			else if (hitTest is SankeyNodeLabelViewData)
			{
				Highlight(((SankeyNodeLabelViewData)hitTest).NodeViewData);
			}
			else if (hitTest is SankeyLinkViewData)
			{
				Highlight((SankeyLinkViewData)hitTest);
			}
			else if (hitTest != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Diagram.ViewController.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific);
			base.Diagram.RaiseHighlightedItemsChangedEvent(new SankeyHighlightedItemsChangedEventArgs(base.ActiveNodes, base.ActiveLinks));
		}

		internal void ResetHighlighting()
		{
			Unhighlight();
			base.Diagram.ViewController.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific);
		}
	}
	public class SankeySelectionController : SankeyInteractionController
	{
		internal const int TouchDelta = 5;

		public SankeySelectionMode SelectionMode { get; set; }

		public IList SelectedItems => (IList)base.ActiveTags;

		public SankeySelectionController(SankeyDiagram diagram)
			: base(diagram)
		{
		}

		private SelectionAction CalculateSelectionAction(bool currentSelection, SankeySelectionMode selectionMode, PortableKeys keyModifiers)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (selectionMode)
			{
			case SankeySelectionMode.Single:
				return SelectionAction.Replace;
			case SankeySelectionMode.Multiple:
				if (!currentSelection)
				{
					return SelectionAction.Add;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Remove;
			case SankeySelectionMode.Extended:
				if ((keyModifiers & 0x10000) != 0)
				{
					if (!currentSelection)
					{
						return SelectionAction.Add;
					}
					return SelectionAction.None;
				}
				if ((keyModifiers & 0x20000) != 0)
				{
					if (!currentSelection)
					{
						return SelectionAction.Add;
					}
					return SelectionAction.Remove;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Replace;
			default:
				return SelectionAction.None;
			}
		}

		private void ChangeSelection(ISankeyInteractiveElement sankeyInteractiveElement, PortableKeys keyModifiers)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SelectionAction selectionAction = CalculateSelectionAction(sankeyInteractiveElement.IsSelected, SelectionMode, keyModifiers);
			if (selectionAction == SelectionAction.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<SankeyNode> list = new List<SankeyNode>();
			IList<SankeyLink> list2 = new List<SankeyLink>();
			switch (selectionAction)
			{
			case SelectionAction.Replace:
			{
				IList<SankeyNode> list3 = new List<SankeyNode>(base.ActiveNodes);
				IList<SankeyLink> list4 = new List<SankeyLink>(base.ActiveLinks);
				FillAdjacentItems(sankeyInteractiveElement, list, list2, addActive: true, addInactive: true);
				SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs(list3, list4, list, list2, (SelectedItemsChangedAction)selectionAction);
				base.Diagram.RaiseSelectedItemsChangingEvent(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					AddItems(list, list2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case SelectionAction.Add:
			{
				IList<SankeyNode> list3 = new List<SankeyNode>();
				IList<SankeyLink> list4 = new List<SankeyLink>();
				FillAdjacentItems(sankeyInteractiveElement, list, list2, addActive: false, addInactive: true);
				SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs(list3, list4, list, list2, (SelectedItemsChangedAction)selectionAction);
				base.Diagram.RaiseSelectedItemsChangingEvent(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					AddItems(list, list2, shouldReset: false);
				}
				break;
			}
			case SelectionAction.Remove:
			{
				IList<SankeyNode> list3 = new List<SankeyNode>();
				IList<SankeyLink> list4 = new List<SankeyLink>();
				FillAdjacentItems(sankeyInteractiveElement, list3, list4, addActive: true, addInactive: false);
				SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs(list3, list4, list, list2, (SelectedItemsChangedAction)selectionAction);
				base.Diagram.RaiseSelectedItemsChangingEvent(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					RemoveItems(list3, list4);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void ResetSelection(PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (SelectionMode != SankeySelectionMode.Extended || (modifierKeys & 0x10000) == 0)
			{
				SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SankeySelectedItemsChangingEventArgs(new List<SankeyNode>(base.ActiveNodes), new List<SankeyLink>(base.ActiveLinks), new List<SankeyNode>(), new List<SankeyLink>(), SelectedItemsChangedAction.Reset);
				base.Diagram.RaiseSelectedItemsChangingEvent(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					base.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void SetIsActive(ISankeyInteractiveElement interactiveElement, bool value)
		{
			interactiveElement.IsSelected = value;
		}

		protected override bool GetIsActive(ISankeyInteractiveElement interactiveElement)
		{
			return interactiveElement.IsSelected;
		}

		protected override void ActiveItemsChanged()
		{
			Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData>.ValueCollection valueCollection = base.Diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Nodes?.Values;
			ICollection<SankeyLinkViewData> collection = base.Diagram.ViewController.ViewData?.Links;
			if (valueCollection == null || collection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ActiveNodes.Clear();
			base.ActiveLinks.Clear();
			foreach (SankeyNodeViewData item in valueCollection)
			{
				if (((ISankeyInteractiveElement)item).IsSelected = ((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)base.ActiveTags).Contains(item.Node.Tag))
				{
					base.ActiveNodes.Add(item.Node);
				}
			}
			foreach (SankeyLinkViewData item2 in collection)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				foreach (object tag in item2.Link.Tags)
				{
					if (((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)base.ActiveTags).Contains(tag))
					{
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				((ISankeyInteractiveElement)item2).IsSelected = flag2;
				if (flag2)
				{
					base.ActiveLinks.Add(item2.Link);
				}
			}
			base.Diagram.ViewController.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific);
		}

		internal void ChangeElementSelection(Point p, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (SelectionMode == SankeySelectionMode.None)
			{
				Reset();
				return;
			}
			IHitTest hitTest = base.Diagram.HitTestController.Find(p).FirstOrDefault()?.Object;
			if (hitTest == null)
			{
				ResetSelection(modifierKeys);
			}
			if (hitTest is ISankeyInteractiveElement)
			{
				ChangeSelection((ISankeyInteractiveElement)hitTest, modifierKeys);
			}
			else if (hitTest is SankeyNodeLabelViewData)
			{
				ChangeSelection(((SankeyNodeLabelViewData)hitTest).NodeViewData, modifierKeys);
			}
			else if (hitTest != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Diagram.ViewController.ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific);
			base.Diagram.RaiseSelectedItemsChangedEvent(new SankeySelectedItemsChangedEventArgs(base.ActiveNodes, base.ActiveLinks));
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			ActiveItemsChanged();
		}
	}
	public class SankeyLinkViewData : IHitTest, ISankeyInteractiveElement
	{
		private readonly SankeyLinkLayoutInfo linkLayout;

		private readonly SankeyLink link;

		private readonly SankeyNodeViewData sourceNodeViewData;

		private readonly SankeyNodeViewData targetNodeViewData;

		private readonly ISankeyViewOptionsProvider viewOptions;

		private readonly BezierRangeStrip strip;

		private HitTestState state = new HitTestState();

		public SankeyLink Link => link;

		public Color Color { get; set; }

		public Color Color2 { get; set; }

		public SankeyNodeViewData SourceViewData => sourceNodeViewData;

		public SankeyNodeViewData TargetViewData => targetNodeViewData;

		bool IHitTest.CanBeHot => true;

		object IHitTest.Object => link;

		HitTestState IHitTest.State => state;

		bool ISankeyInteractiveElement.IsHighlighted { get; set; }

		bool ISankeyInteractiveElement.IsSelected { get; set; }

		public SankeyLinkViewData(SankeyLink link, SankeyNodeViewData sourceViewData, SankeyNodeViewData targetViewData, ISankeyViewOptionsProvider viewOptions)
		{
			this.link = link;
			linkLayout = link.Info;
			sourceNodeViewData = sourceViewData;
			targetNodeViewData = targetViewData;
			this.viewOptions = viewOptions;
			strip = CreateStrip();
		}

		private BezierRangeStrip CreateStrip()
		{
			LinkPointsCalculator linkPointsCalculator = new LinkPointsCalculator(linkLayout);
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = new BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, viewOptions.LinkTension);
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = new BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			bezierStrip.SetPointsForDrawing(new List<GRealPoint2D> { linkPointsCalculator.FirstTop, linkPointsCalculator.SecondTop, linkPointsCalculator.ThirdTop, linkPointsCalculator.FourthTop });
			bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip = bezierStrip;
			BezierStrip bezierStrip2 = new BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			bezierStrip2.SetPointsForDrawing(new List<GRealPoint2D> { linkPointsCalculator.FirstBottom, linkPointsCalculator.SecondBottom, linkPointsCalculator.ThirdBottom, linkPointsCalculator.FourthBottom });
			bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip = bezierStrip2;
			return bezierRangeStrip;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle bounds = link.SourceNode.Bounds;
			DXRectangle bounds2 = link.TargetNode.Bounds;
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(viewOptions.LinkAlpha, Color);
			Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(viewOptions.LinkAlpha, Color2);
			RectangleF gradient = RectangleF.FromLTRB(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Right, Math.Min(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds2)).Top), ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds2)).Right, Math.Max(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds2)).Bottom, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Bottom));
			renderer.FillBezier(strip, gradient, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.Horizontal);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, this, null, new HitRegion(new PolygonPath(StripsUtils.GetPathPoints(strip))));
		}

		public void RenderOver(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (((ISankeyInteractiveElement)this).IsSelected)
			{
				renderer.FillBezier(strip, HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal, SankeyHitTestColors.SelectHatch);
			}
			else if (((ISankeyInteractiveElement)this).IsHighlighted)
			{
				renderer.FillBezier(strip, HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal, SankeyHitTestColors.HighlightHatch);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SankeyNodeViewData : IHitTest, ISankeyInteractiveElement
	{
		private readonly SankeyNode node;

		private TextPainter CreateTextPainter(Point location, Size textSize)
		{
			string text = labelItem.Text;
			if (Label.TextOrientation == TextOrientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new TextPainter(text, textSize, this, location, Label.MaxWidth, Label.MaxLineCount, wordWrap: false);
			}
			bool topToBottom = Label.TextOrientation == TextOrientation.TopToBottom;
			return new VerticalRotatedTextPainter(text, textSize, this, location, topToBottom, Label.MaxWidth, Label.MaxLineCount, wordWrap: false);
		}

		private SizeF MeasureText()
		{
			return TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(labelItem.Text, labelItem.DXFont, this) + Label.ActualLabelPadding;
		}

		private Color GetActualLabelColor()
		{
			if (!labelItem.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				return labelItem.Color;
			}
			return nodeViewData.ViewController.AppearanceController.Style?.NodeLabelTextColor ?? Color.Black;
		}

		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			SizeF sizeF = MeasureText();
			Rectangle rectangle = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(LabelLayoutCalculator.CalculateBounds(Label.LabelAlignment, new GRealSize2D(sizeF.Width, sizeF.Height), nodeViewData.Bounds, Label.ActualPaddingFromNode, nodeViewData.IsLast, Label.TextOrientation != TextOrientation.Horizontal));
			TextPainter textPainter = CreateTextPainter(rectangle.LeftTop(), rectangle.Size);
			textPainter.RenderWithClipping(renderer, null, null, GetActualLabelColor(), rectangle, 1.0);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, nodeViewData, null, new HitRegion(rectangle));
		}

		private TextPainterBase CreateTextPainter(DXRectangle diagramBounds, float fontSize = -1f)
		{
			dxFont = textElement.DXFont;
			if (fontSize != -1f)
			{
				dxFont = new DXFont(textElement.DXFont.Name, fontSize);
			}
			string text = textElement.Text;
			SizeF textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, dxFont, textElement.TextAlignment, textElement.TextAlignment);
			PointF location = new PointF(Math.Max((float)((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Left + ((float)((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Width - textSize.Width) / 2f, 0f), Math.Max((float)((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Top + ((float)((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Height - textSize.Height) / 2f, 0f));
			if (location.X <= 0f || location.Y <= 0f)
			{
				location.X = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Left;
				location.Y = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Top;
			}
			return new TextPainter(text, textSize, this, location, ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Width - ((int)location.X - ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Left), 0, wordWrap: true);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, DXRectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			float sizeInPoints = textElement.DXFont.SizeInPoints;
			painter = CreateTextPainter(diagramBounds);
			for (int i = 1; (float)i < sizeInPoints; i++)
			{
				if (painter.Width <= ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Width && painter.Height <= ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Height)
				{
					break;
				}
				painter = CreateTextPainter(diagramBounds, sizeInPoints - (float)i);
			}
			painter.RenderWithClipping(renderer, null, null, textElement.GetActualTextColor(viewController.AppearanceController.Style), GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(diagramBounds), 1.0);
		}

			this.title = title;
			this.clippingBounds = clippingBounds;
			this.controller = controller;
			textSize = new Size(clippingBounds.Width, clippingBounds.Height);
			painter = CreateTextPainter(clippingBounds.LeftTop());
		}

		{
			return true;
		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetTextColor(Color color)
		{

		}

		Color ITextPropertiesProvider.GetBorderColor(Color color)
		{
			return color;

		private TextPainterBase CreateTextPainter(Point location)
		{
			string text = title.Text;
			if (!title.Rotated)
			{
				return new TextPainter(text, textSize, this, location, clippingBounds.Width, 0, wordWrap: false);
			}
			float angleDegree = 90f;
			NearTextPosition nearPosition = NearTextPosition.Bottom;
			if (title.Dock == SankeyTitleDockStyle.Left)
			{
				angleDegree = 270f;
			}
			return new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(location, text, textSize, this, nearPosition, angleDegree, mixColorByHitTestState: false);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			painter.RenderWithClipping(renderer, null, null, title.GetActualTextColor(controller.AppearanceController.Style), clippingBounds, 1.0);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, this, null, new HitRegion(clippingBounds));
		}

	public class SankeyToolTipController
	{
		public class ToolTipInfo
		{
			public object Object { get; }

			public string Text { get; }

			public string Title { get; }

			public ToolTipInfo(object currentObject, string text, string title)
			{
				Object = currentObject;
				Text = text;
				Title = title;
			}
		}

		private readonly SankeyDiagram diagram;

		private readonly SankeyToolTipOptions toolTipOptions;

		public SankeyToolTipOptions ToolTipOptions => toolTipOptions;

		public SankeyToolTipController(SankeyDiagram diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			toolTipOptions = new SankeyToolTipOptions();
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyToolTipController controller)
		{
			toolTipOptions.Assign(controller.toolTipOptions);
		}

		public ToolTipInfo GetToolTipInfo(Point p)
		{
			object obj = diagram.HitTestController.Find(p).FirstOrDefault()?.Object?.Object;
			if (obj != null)
			{
				string text = null;
				string text2 = null;
				if (obj is SankeyNode && ToolTipOptions.ActualNodeToolTipEnabled)
				{
					SankeyNode sankeyNode = (SankeyNode)obj;
					Tuple<string, string> toolTipText = SankeyDefaultTextConstructor.GetToolTipText(sankeyNode.Info);
					CustomizeSankeyNodeToolTipEventArgs e = new CustomizeSankeyNodeToolTipEventArgs(sankeyNode, toolTipText.Item2, toolTipText.Item1);
					diagram.RaiseCustomizeNodeToolTipEvent(e);
					text2 = e.Content;
					text = e.Title;
				}
				else if (obj is SankeyLink && ToolTipOptions.ActualLinkToolTipEnabled)
				{
					SankeyLink sankeyLink = (SankeyLink)obj;
					Tuple<string, string> toolTipText2 = SankeyDefaultTextConstructor.GetToolTipText(sankeyLink.Info);
					CustomizeSankeyLinkToolTipEventArgs e2 = new CustomizeSankeyLinkToolTipEventArgs(sankeyLink, toolTipText2.Item2, toolTipText2.Item1);
					diagram.RaiseCustomizeLinkToolTipEvent(e2);
					text2 = e2.Content;
					text = e2.Title;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return new ToolTipInfo(obj, text2, text);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class SankeyViewController : IUpdateListener, IScalingHelper, ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<SankeyNode>
	{
		private readonly SankeyDiagram diagram;

		private SankeyViewData viewData;

		private SankeyUpdateType updates;

		private IComparer<SankeyNode> nodeComparer;

		private SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase layoutAlgorithm;

		private SizeF HighDpiScaleFactor => diagram.DpiScaleFactor;

		public SankeyViewData ViewData => viewData;

		public IList<SankeyTitle> Titles => (IList<SankeyTitle>)diagram.Titles;

		public IComparer<SankeyNode> NodeComparer
		{
			get
			{
				return nodeComparer;
			}
			set
			{
				if (nodeComparer != value)
				{
					nodeComparer = value;
					ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.Data);
				}
			}
		}

		public SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase LayoutAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return layoutAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				if (layoutAlgorithm != value)
				{
					if (layoutAlgorithm != null)
					{
						UnsubscribeLayoutAlgorithm(layoutAlgorithm);
					}
					layoutAlgorithm = value;
					SubscribeLayoutAlgorithm(layoutAlgorithm);
					ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.Appearance);
				}
			}
		}

		public SankeyAppearanceController AppearanceController => diagram.AppearanceController;

		public SankeyTextElement EmptySankeyText => diagram.EmptySankeyText;

		public SankeyTextElement SmallSankeyText => diagram.SmallSankeyText;

		public SankeyNodeLabel NodeLabel => diagram.NodeLabel;

		public SankeyHighlightingController HighlightingController => diagram.HighlightingController;

		DevExpress.Charts.Sankey.Native.ISankeyViewOptionsProvider ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<SankeyNode>.ViewOptions => AppearanceController.ViewOptions;

		IComparer<SankeyNode> ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<SankeyNode>.NodeComparer => NodeComparer;

		ISankeyLayoutAlgorithm ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<SankeyNode>.LayoutAlgorithm => LayoutAlgorithm;

		public SankeyViewController(SankeyDiagram diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			layoutAlgorithm = new SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm();
		}

		private void CalculateLayout(DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (viewData == null || viewData.NeedRecalculate(bounds))
			{
				viewData = SankeyViewDataCalculator.CreateViewData(bounds, diagram.DataController.ProcessedLinks, this);
				diagram.SelectionController.Update();
				viewData?.UpdateAppearance(diagram.AppearanceController);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyChanges()
		{
			if ((updates & SankeyUpdateType.NonSpecific) != SankeyUpdateType.None)
			{
				diagram.Invalidate();
			}
			if ((updates & SankeyUpdateType.Data) != SankeyUpdateType.None)
			{
				diagram.InvalidateWithClearCache();
				diagram.Container.RenderProvider.Changed();
				viewData = null;
			}
			if ((updates & SankeyUpdateType.Appearance) != SankeyUpdateType.None)
			{
				viewData?.UpdateAppearance(diagram.AppearanceController);
				diagram.InvalidateWithClearCache();
			}
			if ((updates & SankeyUpdateType.NodeLabel) != SankeyUpdateType.None)
			{
				diagram.InvalidateWithClearCache();
			}
			if ((updates & SankeyUpdateType.View) != SankeyUpdateType.None || (updates & SankeyUpdateType.Title) != SankeyUpdateType.None)
			{
				diagram.InvalidateWithClearCache();
				viewData = null;
			}
			updates = SankeyUpdateType.None;
		}

		private void SubscribeLayoutAlgorithm(SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase layoutAlgorithm)
		{
			if (layoutAlgorithm is SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)
			{
				SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm = (SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)layoutAlgorithm;
				sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.LayoutAlgorithmChanged += OnLayouthAlgorithmChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeLayoutAlgorithm(SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase layoutAlgorithm)
		{
			if (layoutAlgorithm is SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)
			{
				SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm = (SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)layoutAlgorithm;
				sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.LayoutAlgorithmChanged -= OnLayouthAlgorithmChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnLayouthAlgorithmChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType.View);
		}

		private DXRectangle GetBoundsWithoutBorder(DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int thickness = AppearanceController.BorderOptions.Thickness;
			return DXRectangle.FromLTRB(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left + ScaleX(thickness), ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top + ScaleY(thickness), ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Right - ScaleX(thickness), ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Bottom - ScaleY(thickness));
		}

		private DXRectangle GetInnerBounds(DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SankeyPadding padding = AppearanceController.Padding;
			DXRectangle bounds2 = DXRectangle.FromLTRB(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left + padding.ActualLeft, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top + padding.ActualTop, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Right - padding.ActualRight, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Bottom - padding.ActualBottom);
			return GetBoundsWithoutBorder(bounds2);
		}

		internal void Assign(SankeyViewController controller)
		{
			nodeComparer = controller.nodeComparer;
		}

		internal void RaiseCustomizeNodeEvent(CustomizeSankeyNodeEventArgs args)
		{
			diagram.RaiseCustomizeNodeEvent(args);
		}

		public Size ScaleSize(Size size)
		{
			int width = MathUtils.StrongRound((float)size.Width * HighDpiScaleFactor.Width);
			int height = MathUtils.StrongRound((float)size.Height * HighDpiScaleFactor.Height);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public int ScaleX(int width)
		{
			return MathUtils.StrongRound((float)width * HighDpiScaleFactor.Width);
		}

		public int ScaleY(int height)
		{
			return MathUtils.StrongRound((float)height * HighDpiScaleFactor.Height);
		}

		public void ProcessChanged(SankeyUpdateType type)
		{
			updates |= type;
			ApplyChanges();
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, DXRectangle bounds, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			renderer.FillRectangle(GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(bounds), AppearanceController.ActualBorderColor);
			DXRectangle boundsWithoutBorder = GetBoundsWithoutBorder(bounds);
			renderer.FillRectangle(GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(boundsWithoutBorder), AppearanceController.ActualBackColor);
			DXRectangle innerBounds = GetInnerBounds(bounds);
			CalculateLayout(innerBounds);
			viewData?.Render(renderer, hitTestController);
