	public class SankeyViewData : INodesCreator<SankeyNode>
	{
		private readonly DXRectangle bounds;

		private readonly SankeyViewController viewController;

		private readonly IEnumerable<SankeyTitleViewData> titles;

		private readonly Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData> nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs;

		private readonly Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNode> nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs;

		private ICollection<SankeyLinkViewData> links;

		private SankeyNotificationTextViewData emptySankeyTextViewData;

		private SankeyNotificationTextViewData smallSankeyTextViewData;

		private bool ShouldDisplayEmptySankeyText
		{
			get
			{
				if (links != null)
				{
					return links.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private SankeyNotificationTextViewData EmptySankeyTextViewData
		{
			get
			{
				if (emptySankeyTextViewData == null)
				{
					emptySankeyTextViewData = new SankeyNotificationTextViewData(viewController.EmptySankeyText, viewController);
				}
				return emptySankeyTextViewData;
			}
		}

		private SankeyNotificationTextViewData SmallSankeyTextViewData
		{
			get
			{
				if (smallSankeyTextViewData == null)
				{
					smallSankeyTextViewData = new SankeyNotificationTextViewData(viewController.SmallSankeyText, viewController);
				}
				return smallSankeyTextViewData;
			}
		}

		internal ICollection<SankeyLinkViewData> Links
		{
			get
			{
				return links;
			}
			set
			{
				links = value;
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<SankeyTitleViewData> TitlesForTests => titles;

		internal Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData> Nodes => nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs;

		internal Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNode> PlatformNodes => nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs;

		internal bool ShouldDisplaySmallSankeyText { get; set; }

		public SankeyViewData(IEnumerable<SankeyTitleViewData> titles, DXRectangle bounds, SankeyViewController viewController)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.titles = titles;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.viewController = viewController;
			nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs = new Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData>();
			nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs = new Dictionary<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNode>();
		}

		internal void CreatePlatformNodes(List<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodeLayoutInfos)
		{
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo nodeLayoutInfo in nodeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (!nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs.TryGetValue(nodeLayoutInfo, out var value))
				{
					value = new SankeyNode(nodeLayoutInfo);
					nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs.Add(nodeLayoutInfo, value);
				}
				if (nodeLayoutInfo.TargetLinks == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (SankeyLinkLayoutInfo targetLink in nodeLayoutInfo.TargetLinks)
				{
					if (!nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs.TryGetValue(targetLink.Target, out var value2))
					{
						value2 = new SankeyNode(targetLink.Target);
						nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs.Add(targetLink.Target, value2);
					}
					SankeyLink sankeyLink = null;
					foreach (SankeyLink inputLink in value2.InputLinks)
					{
						if (inputLink.SourceNode.Equals(value))
						{
							sankeyLink = inputLink;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (sankeyLink == null)
					{
						sankeyLink = new SankeyLink(targetLink, value, value2);
						value2.AddInputLinks(sankeyLink);
					}
					value.AddOutputLinks(sankeyLink);
				}
			}
		}

		public SankeyNode GetNode(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo info)
		{
			return nodeLayoutInfoPlatformNodePairs[info];
		}

		public SankeyNodeViewData GetViewData(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo info, SankeyNodeLabel label)
		{
			if (!nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs.TryGetValue(info, out var value))
			{
				SankeyNode node = GetNode(info);
				value = new SankeyNodeViewData(node, label, viewController);
				nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs.Add(info, value);
				node.ViewData = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public bool NeedRecalculate(DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return this.bounds != bounds;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ShouldDisplaySmallSankeyText)
			{
				SmallSankeyTextViewData.Render(renderer, bounds);
				return;
			}
			if (ShouldDisplayEmptySankeyText)
			{
				EmptySankeyTextViewData.Render(renderer, bounds);
				return;
			}
			foreach (SankeyTitleViewData title in titles)
			{
				title.Render(renderer, hitTestController);
			}
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			foreach (SankeyLinkViewData link in links)
			{
				link.Render(renderer, hitTestController);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			foreach (SankeyLinkViewData link2 in links)
			{
				link2.RenderOver(renderer);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData> nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPair in nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs)
			{
				nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPair.Value.Render(renderer, hitTestController);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData> nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPair2 in nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs)
			{
				nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPair2.Value.RenderOver(renderer, hitTestController);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateAppearance(SankeyAppearanceController appearanceController)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo, SankeyNodeViewData> nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPair in nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPairs)
			{
				SankeyNode node = nodeLayoutInfoViewDataPair.Value.Node;
				node.Color = appearanceController.GetNodeColor(node);
			}
			foreach (SankeyLinkViewData link in links)
			{
				link.Color = appearanceController.GetLinkColor(link.Link);
				link.Color2 = appearanceController.GetLinkColor2(link.Link);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class SankeyViewDataCalculator
	{
		public static SankeyViewData CreateViewData(DXRectangle bounds, ICollection<ISankeyLink> links, SankeyViewController controller)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width <= 0 || ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXRectangle diagramBounds = ReserveSpaceForTitles(bounds, controller);
			List<SankeyTitleViewData> list = new List<SankeyTitleViewData>();
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Width > 0 && ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Height > 0)
			{
				IList<SankeyTitle> titles = controller.Titles;
				if (titles != null && titles.Count > 0)
				{
					list = CalcTitleViewDatas(controller, bounds, diagramBounds);
					goto IL_005c;
				}
			}
			diagramBounds = bounds;
			goto IL_005c;
			IL_005c:
			SankeyViewData sankeyViewData = new SankeyViewData(list, bounds, controller);
			List<SankeyLinkViewData> links2 = CalculateLinksViewDatas(links, controller, diagramBounds, sankeyViewData);
			if (sankeyViewData.ShouldDisplaySmallSankeyText && list.Count != 0)
			{
				sankeyViewData.ShouldDisplaySmallSankeyText = false;
				list.Clear();
				links2 = CalculateLinksViewDatas(links, controller, bounds, sankeyViewData);
			}
			sankeyViewData.Links = links2;
			return sankeyViewData;
		}

		private static List<SankeyLinkViewData> CalculateLinksViewDatas(ICollection<ISankeyLink> links, SankeyViewController controller, DXRectangle diagramBounds, SankeyViewData viewData)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<SankeyLinkViewData> list = new List<SankeyLinkViewData>();
			List<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodes = SankeyNodeCreator.GetNodes(links);
			viewData.CreatePlatformNodes(nodes);
			if (SankeyLayoutCalculatorChooser<SankeyNode>.CalculateNodes(diagramBounds, nodes, viewData, controller))
			{
				SankeyNodeLabel nodeLabel = controller.NodeLabel;
				foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo item2 in nodes)
				{
					SankeyNodeViewData viewData2 = viewData.GetViewData(item2, nodeLabel);
					ReadOnlyCollection<SankeyLink> outputLinks = viewData2.Node.OutputLinks;
					if (outputLinks == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (SankeyLink item3 in outputLinks)
					{
						SankeyNodeViewData viewData3 = viewData.GetViewData(item3.TargetNode.Info, nodeLabel);
						SankeyLinkViewData item = (item3.ViewData = new SankeyLinkViewData(item3, viewData2, viewData3, controller.AppearanceController.ViewOptions));
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (nodes == null || nodes.Count != 0)
			{
				viewData.ShouldDisplaySmallSankeyText = true;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static DXRectangle ReserveSpaceForTitles(DXRectangle bounds, SankeyViewController controller)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle result = bounds;
			IList<SankeyTitle> titles = controller.Titles;
			if (titles != null && titles.Count > 0)
			{
				RectThickness titleIndents = GetTitleIndents(controller.Titles);
				int num = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width - titleIndents.Left - titleIndents.Right;
				int num2 = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height - titleIndents.Top - titleIndents.Bottom;
				if (num <= 0 || num2 <= 0)
				{
					return DXRectangle.Empty;
				}
				((DXRectangle)(ref result))..ctor(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left + titleIndents.Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top + titleIndents.Top, num, num2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static RectThickness GetTitleIndents(IEnumerable<SankeyTitle> titles)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			RectThickness result = default(RectThickness);
			foreach (SankeyTitle title in titles)
			{
				if ((int)title.Visibility != 1)
				{
					SizeF sizeF = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(title.Text, title.DXFont);
					title.BoundsHeight = (int)sizeF.Height;
					switch (title.Dock)
					{
					case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Top:
						result.Top += (int)sizeF.Height + title.Indent;
						break;
					case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Bottom:
						result.Bottom += (int)sizeF.Height + title.Indent;
						break;
					case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Left:
						result.Left += (int)sizeF.Height + title.Indent;
						break;
					case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Right:
						result.Right += (int)sizeF.Height + title.Indent;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static List<SankeyTitleViewData> CalcTitleViewDatas(SankeyViewController controller, DXRectangle bounds, DXRectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<SankeyTitleViewData> list = new List<SankeyTitleViewData>();
			Dictionary<SankeyTitleDockStyle, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<SankeyTitleDockStyle, int>();
			foreach (SankeyTitle title in controller.Titles)
			{
				if ((int)title.Visibility != 1)
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(title.Dock, out var value))
					{
						dictionary.Add(title.Dock, (title.Dock != SankeyTitleDockStyle.Bottom) ? title.Indent : 0);
					}
					int boundsHeight = title.BoundsHeight;
					int width = (title.Rotated ? ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Height : ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Width);
					dictionary[title.Dock] += boundsHeight;
					Point titlePosition = GetTitlePosition(title, bounds, diagramBounds, boundsHeight, value);
					list.Add(new SankeyTitleViewData(title, new Rectangle(titlePosition.X, titlePosition.Y, width, boundsHeight), controller));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static Point GetTitlePosition(SankeyTitle title, DXRectangle bounds, DXRectangle diagramBounds, int titleHeight, int indentFromBorder)
		{
			int x = 0;
			int y = 0;
			switch (title.Dock)
			{
			case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Top:
				x = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Left;
				y = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top + indentFromBorder;
				break;
			case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Bottom:
				x = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Left;
				y = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Bottom + indentFromBorder + title.Indent;
				break;
			case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Left:
				x = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left + indentFromBorder + titleHeight / 2;
				y = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Top;
				break;
			case SankeyTitleDockStyle.Right:
				x = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Right - indentFromBorder - titleHeight / 2;
				y = ((DXRectangle)(ref diagramBounds)).Top;
				break;
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}
	}

		internal void UpdateTextMeasurer()
		{
			TextMeasurer.RecreateDefault(dpiProvider, null, isRightToLeft, isDirectXRendering);
		}

		public void DrawContent(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Disposed || ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width == 0 || ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (useBitmapCache)
			{
				if (CheckAndUpdateCache(bounds))
				{
					renderer.SetNativeRenderer(CreateRenderer(cacheBitmap.Graphics));
					DrawDiagram(bounds);
					cacheBitmap.DisposeGraphics();
				}
				renderer.SetNativeRenderer(CreateRenderer(graphics));
				cacheBitmap.Render(renderer);
			}
			else
			{
				renderer.SetNativeRenderer(CreateRenderer(graphics));
				DrawDiagram(bounds);
			}
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			container?.RenderProvider?.Invalidate();
		}

		public void InvalidateWithClearCache()
		{
			ResetCache();
			Invalidate();
		}

		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		}

		private void DrawMetafile(DXMetafile metafile, DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			using ChartGraphicsBase chartGraphicsBase = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(metafile);
			renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing = chartGraphicsBase.IsGdiPlusGraphics;
			UpdateTextMeasurer();
			renderer.SetNativeRenderer(CreateRenderer(chartGraphicsBase));
			DrawDiagram(bounds);
			renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing = false;
		}

		public DXImage CreateMetafile(Size size)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XtraChartsPrintingHelper.CheckSize(size);
			UpdateTextMeasurer();
			DXRectangle val = default(DXRectangle);
			((DXRectangle)(ref val))..ctor(0, 0, size.Width, size.Height);
			DXMetafile dXMetafile = XtraChartsPrintingHelper.CreateMetafileInstance(null, GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(val), DXEmfType.EmfPlusOnly);
			try
			{
				DrawMetafile(dXMetafile, val);
				return dXMetafile;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXMetafile.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
		}

		{

			return SankeyBitmapContainer.Draw(this, size, null, GraphicsQuality.Highest);
		}

		public void ExportToImage(Stream stream, DXImageFormat format)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ISankeyRenderProvider sankeyRenderProvider = container?.RenderProvider;
			if (sankeyRenderProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (format == DXImageFormat.Emf || format == DXImageFormat.Wmf)
			{
				DXMetafile dXMetafile = XtraChartsPrintingHelper.CreateMetafileInstance(stream, sankeyRenderProvider.DisplayBounds, DXEmfType.EmfPlusDual);
				try
				{
					DrawMetafile(dXMetafile, GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(container.RenderProvider.DisplayBounds));
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					dXMetafile.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (format != DXImageFormat.Unknown)
			{
				using (DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreateBitmap(sankeyRenderProvider.DisplayBounds.Size))
				{
					dXBitmap.Save(stream, format);
					return;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectImageFormat));
		}

		public void ExportToImage(string filePath, DXImageFormat format)
		{
			using FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite);
			ExportToImage(fileStream, format);
			fileStream.Close();
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.Printing.SankeyOptionsPrint")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public class SankeyOptionsPrint : BaseOptions, IXtraSupportShouldSerialize
	{
		private const PrintSizeMode defaultSizeMode = PrintSizeMode.None;

		private const PrintImageFormat defaultImageFormat = PrintImageFormat.Bitmap;

		private readonly SankeyPrinter printer;

		private PrintSizeMode sizeMode;

		private PrintImageFormat imageFormat;

		[Description("Specifies the size mode used to print the SankeyDiagramControl.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.Printing.SankeyOptionsPrint.SizeMode")]
		public PrintSizeMode SizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return sizeMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (sizeMode != value)
				{
					sizeMode = value;
					UpdatePrinterSizeMode();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the Sankey image format in the Print Preview form.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.Printing.SankeyOptionsPrint.ImageFormat")]
		public PrintImageFormat ImageFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return imageFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				if (imageFormat != value)
				{
					imageFormat = value;
					UpdatePrinterImageFormat();
				}
			}
		}

		internal SankeyOptionsPrint(SankeyPrinter printer)
		{
			this.printer = printer;
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SizeMode"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ImageFormat")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeImageFormat();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return ShouldSerializeSizeMode();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSizeMode()
		{
			return sizeMode != PrintSizeMode.None;
		}

		private void ResetSizeMode()
		{
			SizeMode = PrintSizeMode.None;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeImageFormat()
		{
			return imageFormat != PrintImageFormat.Bitmap;
		}

		private void ResetImageFormat()
		{
			ImageFormat = PrintImageFormat.Bitmap;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeSizeMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeImageFormat();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdatePrinterSizeMode()
		{
			if (printer != null)
			{
				printer.SizeMode = SizeMode;
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePrinterImageFormat()
		{
			if (printer != null)
			{
				printer.ImageFormat = ImageFormat;
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(BaseOptions options)
		{
			((BaseOptions)this).Assign(options);
			if (options is SankeyOptionsPrint sankeyOptionsPrint)
			{
				SizeMode = sankeyOptionsPrint.SizeMode;
				ImageFormat = sankeyOptionsPrint.ImageFormat;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(OptionsPrint)";
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.Sankey.Printing.Native

	public class SankeyPrinter : IDisposable, ICloneable
	{
		private readonly SankeyDiagram diagram;

		private readonly PrinterNative printerNative;

		private IDisposable componentPrinter;

		private ISankeyContainer Control => diagram.Container;

		public PrintSizeMode SizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return printerNative.SizeMode;
			}
			set
			{
				printerNative.SizeMode = value;
			}
		}

		public PrintImageFormat ImageFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return printerNative.ImageFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				printerNative.ImageFormat = value;
			}
		}

		public ComponentExporter ComponentPrinter
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (componentPrinter == null)
				{
					componentPrinter = (IDisposable)CreateComponentPrinter();
				}
				return (ComponentExporter)componentPrinter;
			}
		}

		public bool IsPrintingAvailable => printerNative.IsPrintingAvailable;

		public SankeyPrinter(SankeyDiagram diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			printerNative = new PrinterNative(Control?.RenderProvider);
		}

		private void CreateDetail(BrickGraphics brickGraph)
		{
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Rectangle printBounds = printerNative.GetPrintBounds();
			if (diagram == null || printBounds.Width <= 0 || printBounds.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit = brickGraph.PageUnit;
			DXImage dXImage = null;
			try
			{
				brickGraph.PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
				dXImage = ((ImageFormat == PrintImageFormat.Metafile) ? diagram.CreateMetafile(printBounds.Size) : diagram.CreateBitmap(printBounds.Size));
				ImageBrick val = new ImageBrick();
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ImageSource = new ImageSource(dXImage);
					((VisualBrick)val).Sides = (BorderSide)0;
					val.DisposeImage = true;
					brickGraph.DrawBrick<ImageBrick>(val, (RectangleF)printBounds);
					dXImage = null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				brickGraph.PageUnit = pageUnit;
				dXImage?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private ComponentExporter CreateComponentPrinter()
		{
			return printerNative.CreateComponentPrinter();
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			SankeyPrinter sankeyPrinter = new SankeyPrinter(diagram);
			sankeyPrinter.Assign(this);
			return sankeyPrinter;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Release();
			printerNative.Dispose();
		}

		public void Assign(SankeyPrinter printer)
		{
			printerNative.Assign(printer.printerNative);
		}

		public void PerformPrintingAction(Action0 action, PrintSizeMode sizeMode)
		{
			printerNative.PerformPrintingAction(sizeMode);
			PerformPrintingAction(action);
		}

		public void Initialize(PrintingSystemBase ps, LinkBase link)
		{
			printerNative.Initialize(ps, link);
		}

		public void Release()
		{
			printerNative.Release();
		}

		public void PerformPrintingAction(Action0 action)
		{
			ComponentPrinter.ClearDocument();
			action.Invoke();
		}

		public void CreateArea(string areaName, BrickGraphics graph)
		{
			if (printerNative.PrintingSystem != null && areaName == "Detail" && printerNative.RenderProvider != null)
			{
				CreateDetail(graph);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return obj.GetType().Equals(GetType());
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
}

	public class XtraChartsModelControllerFactory : ModelControllerFactoryBase
	{
		public override IController CreateController()
		{
			return new ModelController();
		}

		public override IChartRenderContext CreateRenderContext(ModelRect bounds, params object[] renderParams)
		{
			try
			{
				ModelRect windowBounds = ((renderParams.Length > 1) ? ((ModelRect)renderParams[1]) : bounds);
				IChartDpiProvider dpiProvider = ((renderParams.Length > 2) ? (renderParams[2] as IChartDpiProvider) : null);
				object obj = renderParams[0];
				if (obj is IDXGraphics gr)
				{
					return new ChartRenderContext(gr, bounds, windowBounds, dpiProvider);
				}
				return new ChartRenderContext((Graphics)obj, bounds, windowBounds, dpiProvider);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartRenderContext : IChartRenderContext
	{
		private Graphics graphics;

		private ModelRect bounds;

		private ModelRect windowBounds;

		public Graphics Graphics => graphics;

		public IDXGraphics DXGraphics { get; }

		public ModelRect Bounds => bounds;

		public ModelRect WindowBounds => windowBounds;

		public IChartDpiProvider DpiProvider { get; private set; }

		public ChartRenderContext(Graphics gr, ModelRect bounds, ModelRect windowBounds, IChartDpiProvider dpiProvider = null)
		{
			graphics = gr;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.windowBounds = windowBounds;
			DpiProvider = dpiProvider;
		}

		public ChartRenderContext(IDXGraphics gr, ModelRect bounds, ModelRect windowBounds, IChartDpiProvider dpiProvider = null)
		{
			DXGraphics = gr;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.windowBounds = windowBounds;
			DpiProvider = dpiProvider;
		}
	}
	public class ModelController : Controller, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart;

		private readonly ChartConfigurator configurator;

		private bool isDisposed;

		protected ChartConfigurator Configurator => configurator;

		protected DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart Chart => chart;

		public ModelController()
		{
			ModelChartContainer modelChartContainer = new ModelChartContainer();
			chart = new DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart(modelChartContainer);
			modelChartContainer.SetChart(chart);
			configurator = new ChartConfigurator(chart);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !isDisposed)
			{
				base.ChartModel = null;
				chart?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		~ModelController()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			isDisposed = true;
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected override void OnModelChanged()
		{
			ApplyModel();
		}

		public override void ClearSelection()
		{
			chart.ClearSelection();
		}

		public override void Deselect(ModelElement element)
		{
			UpdateSelection(element, selected: false);
		}

		public override void Select(ModelElement element)
		{
			UpdateSelection(element, selected: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateSelection(ModelElement element, bool selected)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				object obj = base.ElementContainer.FindViewObject(element);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					chart.SetObjectSelection(obj, selected);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ApplyModel()
		{
			Configurator.Configure((DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart)base.ChartModel, base.ElementContainer);
		}

		public override HitInfo CalcHitInfo(double x, double y)
		{
			if (base.ChartModel is IChart3D)
			{
				return HitInfo.Empty;
			}
			ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = Chart.CalcHitInfo(Convert.ToInt32(x), Convert.ToInt32(y));
			if (chartHitInfo.HitTest == ChartHitTest.None)
			{
				return HitInfo.Empty;
			}
			object hitObject = chartHitInfo.HitObject;
			if (chartHitInfo.HitTest == ChartHitTest.Chart || chartHitInfo.HitTest == ChartHitTest.Diagram)
			{
				hitObject = chartHitInfo.Chart.Chart;
			}
			return CreateHitInfo(hitObject);
		}

		public override void RenderChart(IChartRenderContext renderContext)
		{
			if (renderContext is ChartRenderContext { Bounds: var bounds } chartRenderContext)
			{
				Rectangle bounds2 = new Rectangle((int)bounds.Left, (int)bounds.Top, (int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height);
				ModelRect windowBounds = chartRenderContext.WindowBounds;
				Rectangle windowsBounds = new Rectangle((int)windowBounds.Left, (int)windowBounds.Top, (int)windowBounds.Width, (int)windowBounds.Height);
				bool enableAntialiasing = false;
				if (base.ChartModel is IChart3D)
				{
					enableAntialiasing = ((IChart3D)base.ChartModel).Options3D.EnableAntialiasing;
				}
				float num = chartRenderContext.DXGraphics?.DpiX ?? chartRenderContext.Graphics.DpiX;
				if (Chart.DPI != num)
				{
					Chart.UpdateTextMeasurer(num);
				}
				Chart.UpdateDpiProvider(chartRenderContext.DpiProvider);
				IDisposable graphics = chartRenderContext.Graphics;
				ChartGraphicsBase graphics2 = new ChartGraphicsBase(graphics ?? chartRenderContext.DXGraphics, null);
				Chart.DrawContent(graphics2, bounds2, windowsBounds, enableAntialiasing);
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.ModelSupport.Implementation
{
	public class ModelDataLabelFormatter : DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.IDataLabelFormatter
	{
		private readonly DevExpress.Charts.Model.IDataLabelFormatter formatter;

		private readonly SeriesViewBase seriesView;

		public ModelDataLabelFormatter(DevExpress.Charts.Model.IDataLabelFormatter formatter, SeriesViewBase seriesView)
		{
			this.formatter = formatter;
			this.seriesView = seriesView;
		}

		private double GetNormalizedValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (seriesView is PieSeriesViewBase)
			{
				return ((IPiePoint)point).NormalizedValue;
			}
			if (seriesView is FunnelSeriesView)
			{
				return ((IFunnelPoint)point).NormalizedValue;
			}
			if (seriesView is FullStackedBarSeriesView || seriesView is SideBySideFullStackedBarSeriesView || seriesView is FullStackedArea3DSeriesView || seriesView is FullStackedAreaSeriesView || seriesView is FullStackedBar3DSeriesView || seriesView is FullStackedLine3DSeriesView || seriesView is FullStackedLineSeriesView || seriesView is FullStackedSplineArea3DSeriesView || seriesView is SideBySideFullStackedBar3DSeriesView)
			{
				return ((IFullStackedPoint)point).NormalizedValue;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public string GetDataLabelText(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(point.SeriesPoint);
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint2 = seriesPoint;
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (seriesPoint != null)
			{
				LabelPointData pointData = new LabelPointData(seriesPoint2.Tag, seriesPoint2.ArgumentX.UserArgument, GetNormalizedValue(point));
				result = formatter.GetDataLabelText(pointData);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesConfigurator
	{
		public Diagram Diagram { get; set; }

		private void ConfigureScaleTypes(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			series.ArgumentScaleType = (ScaleType)model.ArgumentScaleType;
			series.ValueScaleType = (ScaleType)model.ValueScaleType;
		}

		private void ConfigureLegendProperties(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			series.ShowInLegend = model.ShowInLegend;
			string text = (model.ActualColorEach ? "{V}" : string.Empty);
			series.LegendTextPattern = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.LegendPointPattern)) ? model.LegendPointPattern : text);
		}

		private void ConfigureColorEach(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			if (model is ISupportColorEachSeries supportColorEachSeries && series.View is IColorEachSupportView colorEachSupportView)
			{
				colorEachSupportView.ColorEach = supportColorEachSeries.ColorEach;
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureMarker(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			if (!(model is ISupportMarkerSeries { Marker: var marker } supportMarkerSeries))
			{
				return;
			}
			IPointSeriesView pointSeriesView = series.View as IPointSeriesView;
			if (marker == null || pointSeriesView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (series.View is ILineSeriesView lineSeriesView)
			{
				lineSeriesView.MarkerVisible = supportMarkerSeries.Marker.Visible;
			}
			MarkerBase marker2 = pointSeriesView.Marker;
			marker2.Kind = (MarkerKind)marker.MarkerType;
			if (marker2 is SimpleMarker simpleMarker)
			{
				simpleMarker.Size = marker.Size;
				simpleMarker.BorderVisible = marker.BorderVisible;
				if (marker.BorderColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
				{
					simpleMarker.BorderColor = marker.BorderColor.ToColor();
				}
				simpleMarker.Border.Thickness = marker.BorderThickness;
			}
			if (marker2 is Marker marker3)
			{
				if (marker.Color != ColorARGB.Empty)
				{
					marker3.Color = marker.Color.ToColor();
					return;
				}
				marker3.FillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Empty;
				marker3.Color = Color.Transparent;
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureTransparency(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			ISupportTransparencySeries supportTransparencySeries = model as ISupportTransparencySeries;
			ISupportTransparency supportTransparency = series.View as ISupportTransparency;
			if (supportTransparencySeries != null && supportTransparency != null)
			{
				supportTransparency.Transparency = supportTransparencySeries.Transparency;
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureDataProperties(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			series.DataSource = model.DataSource;
			series.ArgumentDataMember = GetDataMemberValue(model.DataMembers, DataMemberType.Argument);
			string[] valueDataMembers = GetValueDataMembers(model.DataMembers);
			series.ValueDataMembers.AddRange(valueDataMembers);
			series.ColorDataMember = GetDataMemberValue(model.DataMembers, DataMemberType.Color);
		}

		private void ConfigureScatterLine(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			if (model is ScatterLineSeries scatterLineSeries && series.View is ScatterLineSeriesView scatterLineSeriesView)
			{
				scatterLineSeriesView.ProcessMissingPointsMode = (ProcessMissingPointsMode)scatterLineSeries.ProcessMissingPointsMode;
			}
		}

		private string GetDataMemberValue(Dictionary<DataMemberType, string> dataMembers, DataMemberType key)
		{
			if (dataMembers.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string[] GetValueDataMembers(Dictionary<DataMemberType, string> dataMembers)
		{
			string[] array = new string[0];
			string[] array2 = new string[7];
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataMemberType, string> dataMember in dataMembers)
			{
				switch (dataMember.Key)
				{
				case DataMemberType.Value:
				case DataMemberType.Low:
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotMin:
					array2[0] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				case DataMemberType.High:
				case DataMemberType.Weight:
				case DataMemberType.Value2:
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile1:
					array2[1] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				case DataMemberType.Open:
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotMedian:
					array2[2] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				case DataMemberType.Close:
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile3:
					array2[3] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotMax:
					array2[4] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotMean:
					array2[5] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				case DataMemberType.BoxPlotOutliers:
					array2[6] = dataMember.Value;
					break;
				}
				int num = FindLastNotNullIndex(array2);
				array = new string[num + 1];
				Array.Copy(array2, array, num + 1);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private int FindLastNotNullIndex(string[] arr)
		{
			for (int num = arr.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (arr[num] != null)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected virtual void ConfigureSeriesLabel(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			series.LabelsVisibility = (DefaultBoolean)(!model.LabelsVisibility);
			if (model.Label != null)
			{
				series.Label.EnableAntialiasing = model.Label.EnableAntialiasing;
				if (model.Label.Formatter != null)
				{
					series.Label.Formatter = new ModelDataLabelFormatter(model.Label.Formatter, series.View);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			series.Name = model.DisplayName;
			ConfigureScaleTypes(series, model);
			ConfigureDataProperties(series, model);
			ConfigureLegendProperties(series, model);
			ConfigureSeriesLabel(series, model);
			ConfigureTransparency(series, model);
			ConfigureMarker(series, model);
			ConfigureColorEach(series, model);
			ConfigureScatterLine(series, model);
		}
	}
	internal class BoxPlotSeriesConfigurator : SeriesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
			BoxPlotSeriesView boxPlotSeriesView = (BoxPlotSeriesView)series.View;
			BoxPlotSeries boxPlotSeries = (BoxPlotSeries)model;
			boxPlotSeriesView.MeanLineVisible = boxPlotSeries.ShowMeanLine;
		}
	}
	internal class CartesianSeriesConfigurator : SeriesConfigurator
	{
		private void ConfigureBarWidth(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			IBarSeriesView barSeriesView = series.View as IBarSeriesView;
			BarSeries barSeries = model as BarSeries;
			if (barSeriesView != null && barSeries != null)
			{
				barSeriesView.BarWidth = barSeries.BarWidth;
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureSecondaryAxes(XYDiagramSeriesViewBase view, CartesianSeriesBase modelSeries)
		{
			if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				int secondaryArgumentAxisIndex = modelSeries.SecondaryArgumentAxisIndex;
				if (GetSecondaryAxisByIndex(xYDiagram.SecondaryAxesX, secondaryArgumentAxisIndex) is AxisXBase axisX)
				{
					view.AxisX = axisX;
				}
				else
				{
					view.AxisX = xYDiagram.AxisX;
				}
				int secondaryValueAxisIndex = modelSeries.SecondaryValueAxisIndex;
				if (GetSecondaryAxisByIndex(xYDiagram.SecondaryAxesY, secondaryValueAxisIndex) is AxisYBase axisY)
				{
					view.AxisY = axisY;
				}
				else
				{
					view.AxisY = xYDiagram.AxisY;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureIndicators(XYDiagramSeriesViewBase view, CartesianSeriesBase modelSeries)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Indicator indicator2 in modelSeries.Indicators)
			{
				Indicator indicator = null;
				switch (indicator2.GetType().Name)
				{
				case "RegressionLine":
					indicator = new RegressionLine
					{
						ForecastBackwardPeriods = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression)indicator2).ForecastBackwardPeriods,
						ForecastForwardPeriods = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression)indicator2).ForecastForwardPeriods
					};
					break;
				case "SimpleMovingAverage":
					indicator = new SimpleMovingAverage
					{
						PointsCount = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.SimpleMovingAverage)indicator2).PointsCount,
						IgnoreEmptyValues = true,
						StartFromFirstPoint = false
					};
					break;
				case "ExponentialRegression":
					indicator = new ExponentialRegression();
					break;
				case "LogarithmicRegression":
					indicator = new LogarithmicRegression();
					break;
				case "PowerRegression":
					indicator = new PowerRegression();
					break;
				case "PolynomialRegression":
					indicator = new PolynomialRegression
					{
						Degree = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.PolynomialRegression)indicator2).Degree
					};
					break;
				case "DataSourceBasedErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.DataSourceBasedErrorBars dataSourceBasedErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.DataSourceBasedErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new DataSourceBasedErrorBars
					{
						PositiveErrorDataMember = dataSourceBasedErrorBars.PositiveErrorDataMember,
						NegativeErrorDataMember = dataSourceBasedErrorBars.NegativeErrorDataMember
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "FixedValueErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.FixedValueErrorBars fixedValueErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.FixedValueErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new FixedValueErrorBars
					{
						NegativeError = fixedValueErrorBars.NegativeError,
						PositiveError = fixedValueErrorBars.PositiveError
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "PercentageErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.PercentageErrorBars percentageErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.PercentageErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new PercentageErrorBars
					{
						Percent = percentageErrorBars.Percent
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "StandardDeviationErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.StandardDeviationErrorBars standardDeviationErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.StandardDeviationErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new StandardDeviationErrorBars
					{
						Multiplier = standardDeviationErrorBars.Multiplier
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "StandardErrorBars":
					indicator = new StandardErrorBars();
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("The " + indicator2.GetType().Name + " indicator model type is unknown.");
				}
				if (indicator != null)
				{
					ParametricRegression parametricRegression = indicator as ParametricRegression;
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression parametricRegression2 = indicator2 as DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression;
					if (parametricRegression != null && parametricRegression2 != null)
					{
						parametricRegression.ForecastBackwardPeriods = parametricRegression2.ForecastBackwardPeriods;
						parametricRegression.ForecastForwardPeriods = parametricRegression2.ForecastForwardPeriods;
					}
					indicator.Color = indicator2.Color.ToColor();
					indicator.LineStyle.Thickness = indicator2.LineStyle.Thickness;
					indicator.LineStyle.DashStyle = (DashStyle)indicator2.LineStyle.DashStyle;
					indicator.Name = indicator2.Name;
					indicator.ShowInLegend = indicator2.ShowInLegend;
					indicator.Visible = indicator2.Visible;
					view.Indicators.Add(indicator);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetCommonErrorBarProperties(Indicator indicator, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Indicator indicatorModel)
		{
			ErrorBars errorBars = (ErrorBars)indicator;
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.ErrorBars errorBars2 = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.ErrorBars)indicatorModel;
			errorBars.Direction = errorBars2.Direction switch
			{
				ErrorBarsDirection.Both => ErrorBarDirection.Both, 
				ErrorBarsDirection.Minus => ErrorBarDirection.Minus, 
				ErrorBarsDirection.Plus => ErrorBarDirection.Plus, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException($"The {errorBars2.Direction} error bar direction is unknown."), 
			};
			errorBars.EndStyle = errorBars2.EndStyle switch
			{
				ErrorBarsEndStyle.Cap => ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap, 
				ErrorBarsEndStyle.NoCap => ErrorBarEndStyle.NoCap, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("The {errorBarsModel.EndStyle} error bar end style is unknown"), 
			};
		}

		private AxisBase GetSecondaryAxisByIndex(SecondaryAxisCollection collection, int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= collection.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return collection[index];
		}

		private ProcessEmptyPointsMode ConvertEmptyPointsMode(DevExpress.Charts.Model.ProcessEmptyPointsMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				DevExpress.Charts.Model.ProcessEmptyPointsMode.InsertZero => ProcessEmptyPointsMode.InsertZero, 
				DevExpress.Charts.Model.ProcessEmptyPointsMode.Ignore => ProcessEmptyPointsMode.Ignore, 
				_ => ProcessEmptyPointsMode.InsertZero, 
			};
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
			XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase = (XYDiagramSeriesViewBase)series.View;
			CartesianSeriesBase cartesianSeriesBase = (CartesianSeriesBase)model;
			ConfigureSecondaryAxes(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase, cartesianSeriesBase);
			ConfigureBarWidth(series, model);
			ConfigureIndicators(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase, cartesianSeriesBase);
			xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.EmptyPointOptions.ProcessPoints = ConvertEmptyPointsMode(cartesianSeriesBase.ProcessEmptyPoints);
			if (xYDiagramSeriesViewBase is LineSeriesView lineSeriesView && !(lineSeriesView is AreaSeriesView))
			{
				lineSeriesView.SegmentColorizer = new PointBasedSegmentColorizer
				{
					Direction = ColorDistributionDirection.Backward
				};
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PointDescendantSeriesConfigurator : CartesianSeriesConfigurator
	{
		protected override void ConfigureSeriesLabel(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			base.ConfigureSeriesLabel(series, seriesModel);
			SeriesLabel label = seriesModel.Label;
			PointSeriesLabel pointSeriesLabel = (PointSeriesLabel)series.Label;
			if (label != null)
			{
				pointSeriesLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)label.TextOrientation;
				SeriesLabelPosition position = label.Position;
				pointSeriesLabel.Position = ((position != SeriesLabelPosition.Center) ? PointLabelPosition.Outside : PointLabelPosition.Center);
				switch (position)
				{
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Left:
					pointSeriesLabel.Angle = 180;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Top:
					pointSeriesLabel.Angle = 90;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Right:
					pointSeriesLabel.Angle = 0;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Bottom:
					pointSeriesLabel.Angle = 270;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
		}
	}
	internal class BubbleSeriesConfigurator : PointDescendantSeriesConfigurator
	{
		private void ConfigureSize(BubbleSeriesView view, BubbleSeries bubbleModel)
		{
			if (bubbleModel != null)
			{
				view.AutoSize = false;
			}
			if (bubbleModel.MinSize < view.MaxSize)
			{
				view.MinSize = bubbleModel.MinSize;
				view.MaxSize = bubbleModel.MaxSize;
			}
			else
			{
				view.MaxSize = bubbleModel.MaxSize;
				view.MinSize = bubbleModel.MinSize;
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
			ConfigureSize((BubbleSeriesView)series.View, (BubbleSeries)model);
		}
	}
	internal class BarSeriesConfigurator : CartesianSeriesConfigurator
	{
		private BarSeriesLabelPosition CalcLabelPosition(SeriesLabelPosition position)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				SeriesLabelPosition.Center => BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center, 
				SeriesLabelPosition.InsideBase => BarSeriesLabelPosition.BottomInside, 
				SeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd => BarSeriesLabelPosition.TopInside, 
				_ => BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top, 
			};
		}

		protected override void ConfigureSeriesLabel(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{

			if (model.Label != null)

				BarSeriesLabel barSeriesLabel = (BarSeriesLabel)series.View.Label;
				barSeriesLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)model.Label.TextOrientation;
				barSeriesLabel.Position = CalcLabelPosition(model.Label.Position);
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)

			base.Configure(series, model);
		}
	}
	internal class WaterfallSeriesConfigurator : CartesianSeriesConfigurator
	{
		private WaterfallSeriesLabelPosition CalcLabelPosition(SeriesLabelPosition position)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				SeriesLabelPosition.Center => WaterfallSeriesLabelPosition.Center, 
				SeriesLabelPosition.InsideBase => WaterfallSeriesLabelPosition.InsideStart, 
				SeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd => WaterfallSeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd, 
				_ => WaterfallSeriesLabelPosition.Auto, 
			};
		}

		protected override void ConfigureSeriesLabel(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.ConfigureSeriesLabel(series, model);
			if (model.Label != null)
			{
				WaterfallSeriesLabel waterfallSeriesLabel = (WaterfallSeriesLabel)series.View.Label;
				waterfallSeriesLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)model.Label.TextOrientation;
				waterfallSeriesLabel.Position = CalcLabelPosition(model.Label.Position);
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
			WaterfallSeriesView waterfallSeriesView = (WaterfallSeriesView)series.View;
			if (!(model is WaterfallSeries waterfallSeries))
			{
				return;
			}
			waterfallSeriesView.ValueOptions.SetIsSpreadsheetChart();
			if (waterfallSeries.RisingBarColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				waterfallSeriesView.RisingBarColor = waterfallSeries.RisingBarColor.ToColor();
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.FallingBarColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				waterfallSeriesView.FallingBarColor = waterfallSeries.FallingBarColor.ToColor();
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				waterfallSeriesView.SubtotalBarColor = waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarColor.ToColor();
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.ShowConnectors)
			{
				if (waterfallSeries.ConnectorColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
				{
					waterfallSeriesView.ConnectorColor = waterfallSeries.ConnectorColor.ToColor();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				waterfallSeriesView.ConnectorColor = ColorARGB.Transparent.ToColor();
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.FallingBarFillStyle != null && waterfallSeries.FallingBarFillStyle.FillMode != DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Empty)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(waterfallSeriesView.FallingBarFillStyle, waterfallSeries.FallingBarFillStyle);
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.RisingBarFillStyle != null && waterfallSeries.RisingBarFillStyle.FillMode != DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Empty)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(waterfallSeriesView.RisingBarFillStyle, waterfallSeries.RisingBarFillStyle);
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarFillStyle != null && waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarFillStyle.FillMode != DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Empty)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(waterfallSeriesView.SubtotalBarFillStyle, waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarFillStyle);
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.Subtotals == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (int subtotal in waterfallSeries.Subtotals)
			{
				waterfallSeriesView.ValueOptions.Subtotals.Add(new Subtotal(subtotal, ""));
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PieSeriesBaseConfigurator : SeriesConfigurator
	{
		private void ConfigureExploding(PieSeriesViewBase view, PieSeriesBase modelSeries)
		{
			switch (modelSeries.ExplodeMode)
			{
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.PieExplodeMode.All:
				view.ExplodeMode = PieExplodeMode.All;
				view.ExplodedDistancePercentage = modelSeries.ExplodedDistancePercentage;
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.PieExplodeMode.UsePoints:
				view.ExplodeMode = PieExplodeMode.UsePoints;
				view.ExplodedDistancePercentage = modelSeries.ExplodedDistancePercentage;
				view.ExplodedPointsIndices = modelSeries.ExplodedPointsIndexes;
				break;
			default:
				view.ExplodeMode = PieExplodeMode.None;
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
			PieSeriesBase pieSeriesBase = (PieSeriesBase)model;
			PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase = (PieSeriesViewBase)series.View;
			pieSeriesViewBase.SweepDirection = ((pieSeriesBase.SweepDirection == DevExpress.Charts.Model.PieSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? PieSweepDirection.Clockwise : PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
			ConfigureExploding(pieSeriesViewBase, pieSeriesBase);
		}

		protected override void ConfigureSeriesLabel(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.ConfigureSeriesLabel(series, model);
		}
	}
	internal class PieSeriesConfigurator : PieSeriesBaseConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.Configure(series, model);
			PieSeries pieSeries = (PieSeries)model;
			PieSeriesView pieSeriesView = (PieSeriesView)series.View;
			pieSeriesView.SweepDirection = ((pieSeries.SweepDirection == DevExpress.Charts.Model.PieSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? PieSweepDirection.Clockwise : PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
			pieSeriesView.Rotation = pieSeries.RotationAngle;
		}

		protected override void ConfigureSeriesLabel(Series series, SeriesModel model)
		{
			base.ConfigureSeriesLabel(series, model);
			if (model.Label != null)
			{
				PieSeriesLabel pieSeriesLabel = (PieSeriesLabel)series.View.Label;
				switch (model.Label.Position)
				{
				case SeriesLabelPosition.OutsideEnd:
					pieSeriesLabel.Position = PieSeriesLabelPosition.Outside;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Center:
					pieSeriesLabel.Position = PieSeriesLabelPosition.Inside;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.BestFit:
					pieSeriesLabel.Position = PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns;
					pieSeriesLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideBase:
				case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd:
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class HtmlTextHelper
	{
		private static string CreateRunHtml(RunModel run, FontModel defaultFontModel, ColorARGB defaultFontColor)
		{
			string text = run.Text;
			FontModel font = run.Font;
			if (font.Name != defaultFontModel.Name)
			{
				text = "<font=" + font.Name + ">" + text + "</font>";
			}
			if (font.Size != defaultFontModel.Size || font.Subscript || font.Superscript)
			{
				float num = font.Size;
				if (font.Subscript || font.Superscript)
				{
					num *= 0.6f;
				}
				text = $"<size={num}>{text}</size>";
			}
			if (run.Color != defaultFontColor)
			{
				Color color = run.Color.ToColor();
				text = $"<color={color.A},{color.R},{color.G},{color.B}>{text}</color>";
			}
			if (font.Bold)
			{
				text = "<b>" + text + "</b>";
			}
			if (font.Italic)
			{
				text = "<i>" + text + "</i>";
			}
			if (font.Strikeout)
			{
				text = "<s>" + text + "</s>";
			}
			if (font.Underline)
			{
				text = "<u>" + text + "</u>";
			}
			if (font.Subscript)
			{
				text = "<sub>" + text + "</sub>";
			}
			if (font.Superscript)
			{
				text = "<sup>" + text + "</sup>";
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string CreateHtml(IList<ParagraphModel> paragraphs, FontModel defaultFontModel, ColorARGB defaultFontColor)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < paragraphs.Count; i++)
			{
				foreach (RunModel run in paragraphs[i].Runs)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(CreateRunHtml(run, defaultFontModel, defaultFontColor));
				}
				if (i != paragraphs.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine();
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static bool IsRichTextHasOneStyle(IList<ParagraphModel> paragraphs, ColorARGB defaultFontColor, out FontModel font)
		{
			font = null;
			if (paragraphs == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IList<RunModel> list = paragraphs.SelectMany((ParagraphModel paragraph) => paragraph.Runs).ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FontModel font2 = list[0].Font;
			if (defaultFontColor != list[0].Color)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = 1; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				if (!font2.Equals(list[num].Font) || defaultFontColor != list[num].Color)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			font = font2;
			return true;
		}
	}
