	public abstract class AxisBaseConfigurator
	{
		private readonly DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator;

		public AxisBaseConfigurator(DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
		{
			this.appearanceConfigurator = appearanceConfigurator;
		}

		protected void ConfigureAxisBase(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxis, AxisBase axis, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (modelAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			container.Register(axis, modelAxis);
			axis.GridLines.Visible = modelAxis.GridLinesVisible;
			axis.GridLines.MinorVisible = modelAxis.GridLinesMinorVisible;
			if (modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor.HasValue)
			{
				axis.NumericScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor.Value;
				axis.QualitativeScaleOptionsInternal.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor.Value;
				axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor.Value;
			}
			if (modelAxis.Label != null)
			{
				axis.Label.Visible = modelAxis.Label.Visible;
				axis.Label.EnableAntialiasing = modelAxis.Label.EnableAntialiasing;
				axis.Label.Angle = modelAxis.Label.RotationAngleDegree;
				ModelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions = modelAxis.Label.ResolveOverlappingOptions;
				if (modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions == null)
				{
					modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions = new ModelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions(modelAxis.Label);
				}
				AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions resolveOverlappingOptions = axis.Label.ResolveOverlappingOptions;
				resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide = modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide;
				resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowRotate = modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowRotate;
				resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowStagger = modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowStagger;
				resolveOverlappingOptions.MinIndent = modelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.MinIndent;
				if (modelAxis.Label.Formatter != null)
				{
					axis.Label.Formatter = new ModelAxisLabelFormatter(modelAxis.Label.Formatter);
				}
			}
			axis.WholeRange.Auto = true;
			axis.VisualRange.Auto = true;
			if (modelAxis.Range != null)
			{
				if (modelAxis.Range.MinValue != null && modelAxis.Range.MaxValue != null)
				{
					axis.WholeRange.SetMinMaxValues(modelAxis.Range.MinValue, modelAxis.Range.MaxValue);
					axis.VisualRange.SetMinMaxValues(modelAxis.Range.MinValue, modelAxis.Range.MaxValue);
				}
				else
				{
					if (modelAxis.Range.MinValue != null)
					{
						axis.WholeRange.MinValue = modelAxis.Range.MinValue;
					}
					if (modelAxis.Range.MaxValue != null)
					{
						axis.WholeRange.MaxValue = modelAxis.Range.MaxValue;
					}
					if (modelAxis.Range.MinValue != null)
					{
						axis.VisualRange.MinValue = modelAxis.Range.MinValue;
					}
					if (modelAxis.Range.MaxValue != null)
					{
						axis.VisualRange.MaxValue = modelAxis.Range.MaxValue;
					}
				}
				axis.WholeRange.SideMarginsValue = 0.0;
				axis.VisualRange.SideMarginsValue = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				axis.WholeRange.AutoSideMargins = true;
				axis.VisualRange.AutoSideMargins = true;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ConfigureAxisCore(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase, AxisBase axisBase, IModelElementContainer container);

		protected void ConfigureAxis(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxis, AxisBase axis, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			ConfigureAxisCore(modelAxis, axis, container);
			if (modelAxis != null && modelAxis.Appearance != null)
			{
				appearanceConfigurator.ConfigureAxis(axis, modelAxis.Appearance);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ModelDateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculator : IDateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculator
	{
		public DateTimeMeasureUnit CalculateMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<Series> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			foreach (Series item in series)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < item.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan2 = item.Points[i].DateTimeArgument - item.Points[i - 1].DateTimeArgument;
					if (timeSpan > timeSpan2)
					{
						timeSpan = timeSpan2;
					}
				}
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0))
			{
				return DateTimeMeasureUnit.Millisecond;
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0))
			{
				return DateTimeMeasureUnit.Second;
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromHours(1.0))
			{
				return DateTimeMeasureUnit.Minute;
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0))
			{
				return DateTimeMeasureUnit.Hour;
			}
			return DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day;
		}
	}
	internal class ModelTimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculator : ITimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculator
	{
		public TimeSpanMeasureUnit CalculateMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<Series> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			foreach (Series item in series)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < item.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan2 = item.Points[i].DateTimeArgument - item.Points[i - 1].DateTimeArgument;
					if (timeSpan > timeSpan2)
					{
						timeSpan = timeSpan2;
					}
				}
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0))
			{
				return TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Millisecond;
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0))
			{
				return TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Second;
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromHours(1.0))
			{
				return TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Minute;
			}
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0))
			{
				return TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Hour;
			}
			return TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Day;
		}
	}
	public class AxesConfigurator : AxisBaseConfigurator
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<AxisPosition, AxisAlignment> alignmentDict;

		static AxesConfigurator()
		{
			alignmentDict = new Dictionary<AxisPosition, AxisAlignment>();
			alignmentDict[AxisPosition.Left] = AxisAlignment.Near;
			alignmentDict[AxisPosition.Top] = AxisAlignment.Far;
			alignmentDict[AxisPosition.Right] = AxisAlignment.Far;
			alignmentDict[AxisPosition.Bottom] = AxisAlignment.Near;
		}

		public AxesConfigurator(DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
			: base(appearanceConfigurator)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigurateSecondaryArgumentAxes(SecondaryAxisXCollection targetAxes, IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis> modelAxes, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis modelAxis in modelAxes)
			{
				SecondaryAxisX axis = new SecondaryAxisX();
				ConfigureAxis(modelAxis, axis, container);
				targetAxes.Add(axis);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigurateSecondaryValueAxes(SecondaryAxisYCollection targetAxes, IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis> modelAxes, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis modelAxis in modelAxes)
			{
				SecondaryAxisY axis = new SecondaryAxisY();
				ConfigureAxis(modelAxis, axis, container);
				targetAxes.Add(axis);
			}
		}

		internal AxisAlignment CalculateAxisAlignment(AxisPosition pos)
		{
			AxisAlignment value = AxisAlignment.Near;
			if (alignmentDict.TryGetValue(pos, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return AxisAlignment.Near;
		}

		protected override void ConfigureAxisCore(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase, AxisBase axisBase, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ConfigureAxisBase(modelAxisBase, axisBase, container);
			Axis axis = axisBase as Axis;
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis axis2 = modelAxisBase as DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis;
			NumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions = axis.NumericScaleOptions;
			DateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions = axis.DateTimeScaleOptions;
			TimeSpanScaleOptions timeSpanScaleOptions = axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
			if (axis2 == null || axis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			axis.Visibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(axis2.Visible);
			axis.Alignment = CalculateAxisAlignment(axis2.Position);
			axis.Tickmarks.Visible = axis2.TickmarksVisible;
			axis.Tickmarks.MinorVisible = axis2.TickmarksMinorVisible;
			axis.Tickmarks.CrossAxis = axis2.TickmarksCrossAxis;
			bool isValuesAxis = axis.IsValuesAxis;
			AggregateFunction aggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.None;
			if (axis2.AutoGrid)
			{
				if (!isValuesAxis && axis2.Range == null)
				{
					dateTimeScaleOptions.AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator = new ModelDateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculator();
					timeSpanScaleOptions.AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator = new ModelTimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculator();
					dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Automatic;
					timeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Automatic;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				numericScaleOptions.GridSpacing = 1.0;
				numericScaleOptions.GridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Custom;
				numericScaleOptions.CustomGridAlignment = axis2.GridSpacing;
				numericScaleOptions.AutoGrid = axis2.AutoGrid;
				numericScaleOptions.GridAlignmentStartPoint = ((axis2.Range != null) ? NumericStartPoint.MinRangeValue : NumericStartPoint.Zero);
				if (!isValuesAxis)
				{
					dateTimeScaleOptions.AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator = null;
					timeSpanScaleOptions.AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator = null;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Manual;
					timeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Manual;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.GridSpacing = axis2.GridSpacing;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit = DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)axis2.GridAlignment;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.AutoGrid = axis2.AutoGrid;
					QualitativeScaleOptions qualitativeScaleOptionsInternal = axis.QualitativeScaleOptionsInternal;
					qualitativeScaleOptionsInternal.GridSpacing = axis2.GridSpacing;
					qualitativeScaleOptionsInternal.AutoGrid = axis2.AutoGrid;
				}
			}
			ModelIntervalOptions intervalOptions = axis2.IntervalOptions;
			if (intervalOptions != null)
			{
				aggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Histogram;
				object underflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
				object overflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
				numericScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Interval;
				NumericIntervalOptions intervalOptions2 = axis.NumericScaleOptions.IntervalOptions;
				intervalOptions2.DivisionMode = (IntervalDivisionMode)intervalOptions.DivisionMode;
				intervalOptions2.Count = intervalOptions.Count;
				intervalOptions2.Width = intervalOptions.Width;
				if (underflowValue != null && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(underflowValue.GetType()))
				{
					intervalOptions2.UnderflowValue = Convert.ToDouble(underflowValue);
				}
				if (overflowValue != null && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(overflowValue.GetType()))
				{
					intervalOptions2.OverflowValue = Convert.ToDouble(overflowValue);
				}
				if (!isValuesAxis)
				{
					dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode = ScaleMode.Interval;
					DateTimeIntervalOptions intervalOptions3 = axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.IntervalOptions;
					intervalOptions3.DivisionMode = (IntervalDivisionModeNative)intervalOptions.DivisionMode;
					intervalOptions3.Count = intervalOptions.Count;
					intervalOptions3.Width = intervalOptions.Width;
					intervalOptions3.UnderflowValue = DataItemsHelper.ParseDateTime(underflowValue);
					intervalOptions3.OverflowValue = DataItemsHelper.ParseDateTime(overflowValue);
					axis.QualitativeScaleOptionsInternal.AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Sum;
				}
			}
			numericScaleOptions.AggregateFunction = aggregateFunction;
			if (!isValuesAxis)
			{
				dateTimeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction = aggregateFunction;
			}
			if (axis2.Title != null)
			{
				axis.Title.EnableAntialiasing = axis2.Title.EnableAntialiasing;
				axis.Title.Visibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(axis2.Title.Visible);
				ColorARGB defaultFontColor = axis2.Appearance?.TitleAppearance.TextColor ?? ColorARGB.Empty;
				IList<ParagraphModel> richFormattedText = axis2.Title.RichFormattedText;
				bool flag = richFormattedText != null;
				FontModel font = null;
				bool flag2 = HtmlTextHelper.IsRichTextHasOneStyle(richFormattedText, defaultFontColor, out font);
				axis.Title.Text = ((flag && !flag2) ? HtmlTextHelper.CreateHtml(richFormattedText, axis2.Title.Font, defaultFontColor) : axis2.Title.Text);
				FontModel fontModel = ((flag && flag2) ? font : axis2.Title.Font);
				DXFont dXFont = FontConfiguratorHelper.ConfigureDXFont(fontModel, axis.Title.DXFont.Name);
				if (dXFont != null)
				{
					axis.Title.DXFont = dXFont;
				}
			}
			axis.Reverse = axis2.Reverse;
			axis.Logarithmic = axis2.Logarithmic;
			if (axis2.Logarithmic)
			{
				axis.LogarithmicBase = axis2.LogarithmicBase;
			}
		}

		public void Configure(XYDiagram diagram, CartesianChart chart, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (chart != null && diagram != null)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(chart.ArgumentAxis, diagram.AxisX, container);
				ConfigureAxis(chart.ValueAxis, diagram.AxisY, container);
				diagram.SecondaryAxesX.Clear();
				diagram.SecondaryAxesY.Clear();
				ConfigurateSecondaryArgumentAxes(diagram.SecondaryAxesX, (IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis>)chart.SecondaryArgumentAxes, container);
				ConfigurateSecondaryValueAxes(diagram.SecondaryAxesY, (IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis>)chart.SecondaryValueAxes, container);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RadarAxesConfigurator : AxisBaseConfigurator
	{
		public RadarAxesConfigurator(DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
			: base(appearanceConfigurator)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxisX(DevExpress.Charts.Model.RadarAxisX modelAxis, RadarAxisX axis, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (modelAxis != null)
			{
				ConfigureAxisBase(modelAxis, axis, container);
				if (!modelAxis.AutoGrid && axis.ActualScaleOptions is NumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions)
				{
					axis.ActualScaleOptions.GridSpacing = 1.0;
					numericScaleOptions.GridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Custom;
					numericScaleOptions.CustomGridAlignment = modelAxis.GridSpacing;
				}
				axis.Logarithmic = modelAxis.Logarithmic;
				if (modelAxis.Logarithmic)
				{
					axis.LogarithmicBase = modelAxis.LogarithmicBase;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureAxisY(CircularAxisY modelAxis, RadarAxisY axis, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (modelAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ConfigureAxisBase(modelAxis, axis, container);
			axis.Visible = modelAxis.Visible;
			axis.Tickmarks.Visible = modelAxis.TickmarksVisible;
			axis.Tickmarks.MinorVisible = modelAxis.TickmarksMinorVisible;
			axis.Tickmarks.CrossAxis = modelAxis.TickmarksCrossAxis;
			if (!modelAxis.AutoGrid)
			{
				if (axis.ActualScaleOptions is NumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions)
				{
					axis.ActualScaleOptions.GridSpacing = 1.0;
					numericScaleOptions.GridAlignment = NumericGridAlignment.Custom;
					numericScaleOptions.CustomGridAlignment = modelAxis.GridSpacing;
				}
				if (axis.ActualScaleOptions is DateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions)
				{
					axis.ActualScaleOptions.GridSpacing = modelAxis.GridSpacing;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit = (DateTimeMeasureUnit)modelAxis.GridAlignment;
					dateTimeScaleOptions.GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)modelAxis.GridAlignment;
				}
			}
			axis.Logarithmic = modelAxis.Logarithmic;
			if (modelAxis.Logarithmic)
			{
				axis.LogarithmicBase = modelAxis.LogarithmicBase;
			}
		}

		protected override void ConfigureAxisCore(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase, AxisBase axisBase, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (axisBase is RadarAxisX)
			{
				ConfigureAxisX((DevExpress.Charts.Model.RadarAxisX)modelAxisBase, (RadarAxisX)axisBase, container);
			}
			if (axisBase is RadarAxisY)
			{
				ConfigureAxisY((CircularAxisY)modelAxisBase, (RadarAxisY)axisBase, container);
			}
		}

		public void Configure(RadarDiagram diagram, RadarChart chart, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (chart != null && diagram != null)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(chart.ArgumentAxis, diagram.AxisX, container);
				ConfigureAxis(chart.ValueAxis, diagram.AxisY, container);
			}
		}
	}
	public class PolarAxesConfigurator : RadarAxesConfigurator
	{
		public PolarAxesConfigurator(DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
			: base(appearanceConfigurator)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxisX(DevExpress.Charts.Model.PolarAxisX modelAxis, PolarAxisX axis, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			ConfigureAxisBase(modelAxis, axis, container);
		}

		protected override void ConfigureAxisCore(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase, AxisBase axisBase, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (axisBase is RadarAxisX)
			{
				ConfigureAxisX((DevExpress.Charts.Model.PolarAxisX)modelAxisBase, (PolarAxisX)axisBase, container);
			}
			if (axisBase is RadarAxisY)
			{
				ConfigureAxisY((CircularAxisY)modelAxisBase, (RadarAxisY)axisBase, container);
			}
		}

		public void Configure(PolarDiagram diagram, PolarChart chart, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (chart != null && diagram != null)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(chart.ArgumentAxis, (PolarAxisX)diagram.AxisX, container);
				ConfigureAxis(chart.ValueAxis, diagram.AxisY, container);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartConfigurator
	{
		private readonly DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart;

		private ChartAppearanceConfigurator appearanceConfigurator;

		private IModelElementContainer container;

		private DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model;

		public DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart Chart => chart;

		public DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart Model => model;

		public ChartConfigurator(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)chart, "chart");
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		private void ConfigureChart(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model)
		{
			ConfigureTitles(chart.Titles, model.Titles, model.Appearance?.ChartAppearance?.TitleAppearance);
			if (model.Palette != null)
			{
				ConfigureChartPalette(chart, model.Palette);
			}
			DiagramConfigurator diagramConfigurator = DiagramConfigurator.CreateInstance(model);
			diagramConfigurator.Configure(Chart.Diagram, model);
			if (model is CartesianChart cartesianChart)
			{
				ConfigureCartesianChart(chart, cartesianChart);
			}
			diagramConfigurator.ConfigureAxes(Chart.Diagram, model, container, appearanceConfigurator.DiagramConfigurator);
			Chart.AutoLayout = model.AutoLayout;
		}

		private void ConfigureTitles(ChartTitleCollection titles, DevExpress.Charts.Model.ChartTitleCollection model, ChartTitleAppearance appearance)
		{
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			titles.Clear();
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.ChartTitle item in (DXCollectionBase<DevExpress.Charts.Model.ChartTitle>)(object)model)
			{
				ChartTitle chartTitle = new ChartTitle();
				bool flag = item.RichFormattedText != null;
				FontModel font = null;
				ColorARGB defaultFontColor = appearance?.TextColor ?? ColorARGB.Empty;
				bool flag2 = HtmlTextHelper.IsRichTextHasOneStyle(item.RichFormattedText, defaultFontColor, out font);
				chartTitle.Text = ((flag && !flag2) ? HtmlTextHelper.CreateHtml(item.RichFormattedText, item.Font, defaultFontColor) : string.Join(Environment.NewLine, item.Lines));
				FontModel fontModel = ((flag && flag2) ? font : item.Font);
				DXFont dXFont = FontConfiguratorHelper.ConfigureDXFont(fontModel, chartTitle.DXFont.Name);
				if (dXFont != null)
				{
					chartTitle.DXFont = dXFont;
				}
				chartTitle.EnableAntialiasing = item.EnableAntialiasing;
				titles.Add(chartTitle);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureCartesianChart(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, CartesianChart cartesianChart)
		{
			chart.SideBySideBarDistance = cartesianChart.BarDistance;
			chart.SideBySideBarDistanceFixed = cartesianChart.BarDistanceFixed;
		}

		private void ConfigureDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			Chart.DataContainer.DataSource = dataSource;
		}

		private ChartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator CreateSeriesCollectionConfigurator(DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model)
		{
			if (model is IChart3D)
			{
				return new Chart3DSeriesCollectionConfigurator();
			}
			return new ChartSeriesCollectionConfigurator();
		}

		private void ConfigureLegend(DevExpress.Charts.Model.Legend legend)
		{
			LegendConfigurator legendConfigurator = new LegendConfigurator();
			legendConfigurator.Configure(chart.Legend, legend);
			if (legend != null)
			{
				container.Register(chart.Legend, legend);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureChartPalette(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Palette palette)
		{
			Palette palette2 = new Palette("palette", PaletteScaleMode.Extrapolate);
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.PaletteEntry entry in palette.Entries)
			{
				PaletteEntry paletteEntry = new PaletteEntry(entry.Color.ToColor());
				if (!entry.Color2.IsEmpty)
				{
					paletteEntry.Color2 = entry.Color2.ToColor();
				}
				palette2.Add(paletteEntry);
			}
			chart.PaletteRepository.RegisterPalette(palette2);
			chart.PaletteName = "palette";
		}

		private void ConfigureChartAppearance(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, ChartAppearanceOptions appearance)
		{
			appearanceConfigurator.Configure(chart, appearance);
		}

		private void UpdateChart(UpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			string propertyName = updateInfo.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "Palette"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Appearance")
				{
					ConfigureChartAppearance(chart, (ChartAppearanceOptions)updateInfo.Value);
					updateInfo.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ConfigureChartPalette(chart, (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Palette)updateInfo.Value);
				updateInfo.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private Diagram CreateDiagram(DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model)
		{
			if (model is Cartesian3DChart)
			{
				return new XYDiagram3D();
			}
			if (model is CartesianChart)
			{
				return new XYDiagram();
			}
			if (model is Pie3DChart)
			{
				return new SimpleDiagram3D();
			}
			if (model is PieChart || model is FunnelChart)
			{
				return new SimpleDiagram();
			}
			if (model is RadarChart)
			{
				return new RadarDiagram();
			}
			if (model is PolarChart)
			{
				return new PolarDiagram();
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private void ConfigureChartDataTable(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart chartModel)
		{
			CartesianChart cartesianChart = chartModel as CartesianChart;
			XYDiagram xYDiagram = chart.Diagram as XYDiagram;
			if (cartesianChart == null || xYDiagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.ChartDataTable chartDataTable = xYDiagram.DefaultPane.ChartDataTable;
			if (cartesianChart.ChartDataTable == null)
			{
				chartDataTable.Visible = false;
				return;
			}
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.ChartDataTable chartDataTable2 = cartesianChart.ChartDataTable;
			chartDataTable.Visible = chartDataTable2.Visible;
			chartDataTable.VerticalIndent = chartDataTable2.VerticalIndent;
			chartDataTable.ShowBorder = chartDataTable2.ShowBorder;
			chartDataTable.ShowHorizontalLines = chartDataTable2.ShowHorizontalLines;
			chartDataTable.ShowLegendMarker = chartDataTable2.ShowLegendMarker;
			chartDataTable.ShowVerticalLines = chartDataTable2.ShowVerticalLines;
			chartDataTable.LineColor = chartDataTable2.LineColor.ToColor();
			if (chartDataTable2.LineStyle != null)
			{
				chartDataTable.LineStyle.DashStyle = (DashStyle)chartDataTable2.LineStyle.DashStyle;
				chartDataTable.LineStyle.Thickness = chartDataTable2.LineStyle.Thickness;
			}
			chartDataTable.TextColor = chartDataTable2.TextColor.ToColor();
			if (cartesianChart.ArgumentAxis != null && cartesianChart.ArgumentAxis.Label != null && cartesianChart.ArgumentAxis.Label.Formatter != null)
			{
				chartDataTable.ArgumentFormatter = new ModelAxisLabelFormatter(cartesianChart.ArgumentAxis.Label.Formatter);
			}
			DXFont dXFont = FontConfiguratorHelper.ConfigureDXFont(chartDataTable2.Font, chartDataTable.DXFont.Name);
			if (dXFont != null)
			{
				chartDataTable.DXFont = dXFont;
			}
		}

		public void Configure(DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			this.model = model;
			this.container = container;
			if (model != null)
			{
				container.Clear();
				container.Register(chart, model);
				chart.DoNotChangeDiagram = true;
				Diagram diagram = CreateDiagram(model);
				if ((chart.Diagram == null || chart.Diagram.GetType() != diagram.GetType()) && ((DXCollectionBase<SeriesModel>)(object)model.Series).Count > 0)
				{
					chart.EnableLoadingMode();
					chart.Diagram = diagram;
					chart.DisableLoadingMode();
				}
				appearanceConfigurator = new ChartAppearanceConfigurator(chart.Diagram, container);
				ConfigureChart(chart, model);
				ChartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator chartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator = CreateSeriesCollectionConfigurator(model);
				chartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator.CreateSeries(Chart, model, container);
				chartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator.Configurate(Chart, model, container);
				ConfigureDataSource(model.DataSource);
				ConfigureLegend(model.Legend);
				ConfigureChartDataTable(chart, model);
				ConfigureChartAppearance(chart, model.Appearance);
				chart.DoNotChangeDiagram = false;
			}
		}

		public void Update(UpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo.Element is DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart)
			{
				UpdateChart(updateInfo);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartConfiguratorException : Exception
	{
		public ChartConfiguratorException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class AppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		private static void ConfigureGradientFillOptions(FillOptionsBase fillOptions, FillOptions fillOptionsModel)
		{
			if (fillOptions is RectangleGradientFillOptions)
			{
				RectangleGradientFillOptions rectangleGradientFillOptions = (RectangleGradientFillOptions)fillOptions;
				rectangleGradientFillOptions.Color2 = fillOptionsModel.Color2.ToColor();
				rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = (RectangleGradientMode)fillOptionsModel.GradientMode;
			}
			else if (fillOptions is PolygonGradientFillOptions)
			{
				PolygonGradientFillOptions polygonGradientFillOptions = (PolygonGradientFillOptions)fillOptions;
				polygonGradientFillOptions.Color2 = fillOptionsModel.Color2.ToColor();
				switch (fillOptionsModel.GradientMode)
				{
				case GradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight;
					break;
				case GradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft;
					break;
				case GradientMode.BottomToTop:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.BottomToTop;
					break;
				case GradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.FromCenter;
					break;
				case GradientMode.FromCenterVertical:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.FromCenter;
					break;
				case GradientMode.LeftToRight:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.LeftToRight;
					break;
				case GradientMode.RightToLeft:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.RightToLeft;
					break;
				case GradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.ToCenter;
					break;
				case GradientMode.ToCenterVertical:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.ToCenter;
					break;
				case GradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight;
					break;
				case GradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft;
					break;
				case GradientMode.TopToBottom:
					polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode = PolygonGradientMode.TopToBottom;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ConfigureFillStyle2D(FillStyle2D fillStyle, FillStyle fillStyleModel)
		{
			switch (fillStyleModel.FillMode)
			{
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Empty:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Empty;
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Solid:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Solid;
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Gradient:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Gradient;
				if (fillStyleModel.Options != null)
				{
					ConfigureGradientFillOptions(fillStyle.Options, fillStyleModel.Options);
				}
				break;
			default:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode.Empty;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureFillStyle3D(FillStyle3D fillStyle, FillStyle fillStyleModel)
		{
			switch (fillStyleModel.FillMode)
			{
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Empty:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode3D.Empty;
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Solid:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode3D.Solid;
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Gradient:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode3D.Gradient;
				ConfigureGradientFillOptions(fillStyle.Options, fillStyleModel.Options);
				break;
			default:
				fillStyle.FillMode = FillMode3D.Empty;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureShadow(Shadow shadow, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Shadow shadowModel)
		{
			if (shadowModel != null)
			{
				if (!shadowModel.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					shadow.Color = shadowModel.Color.ToColor();
				}
				shadow.Size = shadowModel.Size;
				shadow.Visible = true;
			}
			else
			{
				shadow.Visible = false;
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureLineStyle(LineStyle lineStyle, DevExpress.Charts.Model.LineStyle lineStyleModel)
		{
			lineStyle.DashStyle = (DashStyle)lineStyleModel.DashStyle;
			lineStyle.Thickness = lineStyleModel.Thickness;
		}

		protected void ConfigureBorder(BorderBase border, Border borderModel)
		{
			if (!borderModel.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				border.Color = borderModel.Color.ToColor();
			}
			if (borderModel.Thickness > 0)
			{
				border.Visibility = (DefaultBoolean)0;
				border.Thickness = borderModel.Thickness;
			}
			else
			{
				border.Visibility = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureDefaultBorder(BorderBase border)
		{
			border.Color = Color.Empty;
			border.Visibility = (DefaultBoolean)0;
			border.Thickness = 1;
		}

		protected void ConfigureIndents(RectangleIndents indents, DevExpress.Charts.Model.RectangleIndents indentsModel)
		{
			if (indentsModel.All != -1)
			{
				indents.All = indentsModel.All;
				return;
			}
			indents.Left = indentsModel.Left;
			indents.Top = indentsModel.Top;
			indents.Right = indentsModel.Right;
			indents.Bottom = indentsModel.Bottom;
		}
	}
	public class ChartAppearanceConfigurator : AppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		private readonly DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase diagramConfigurator;

		public DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase DiagramConfigurator => diagramConfigurator;

		public ChartAppearanceConfigurator(Diagram diagram, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			diagramConfigurator = DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase.CreateConfigurator(diagram, container);
		}

		private void ConfigureLegend(Legend legend, DevExpress.Charts.Model.LegendAppearance appearance)
		{
			legend.BackColor = appearance.BackColor.ToColor();
			legend.TextColor = appearance.TextColor.ToColor();
			if (appearance.Border != null)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(legend.Border, appearance.Border);
			}
			else
			{
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(legend.Border);
			}
			if (appearance.FillStyle != null)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(legend.FillStyle, appearance.FillStyle);
			}
			ConfigureShadow(legend.Shadow, appearance.Shadow);
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureIndents(legend.Margins, appearance.Margins);
			}
			if (appearance.Padding != null)
			{
				ConfigureIndents(legend.Padding, appearance.Padding);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureChart(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, DevExpress.Charts.Model.ChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			chart.Padding.All = 5;
			chart.BackColor = appearance.BackColor.ToColor();
			if (appearance.Border != null)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(chart.Border, appearance.Border);
			}
			else
			{
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(chart.Border);
			}
			if (appearance.FillStyle != null)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(chart.FillStyle, appearance.FillStyle);
			}
			if (appearance.Padding != null)
			{
				ConfigureIndents(chart.Padding, appearance.Padding);
			}
			if (appearance.TitleAppearance != null)
			{
				ConfigureChartTitles(chart.Titles, appearance.TitleAppearance);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureChartTitles(ChartTitleCollection titles, ChartTitleAppearance appearance)
		{
			foreach (ChartTitle title in titles)
			{
				title.TextColor = appearance.TextColor.ToColor();
				title.Indent = appearance.Indent;
			}
		}

		public void Configure(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, ChartAppearanceOptions appearance)
		{
			if (appearance == null)
			{
				appearance = new ChartAppearanceOptions();
			}
			if (appearance.ChartAppearance != null)
			{
				ConfigureChart(chart, appearance.ChartAppearance);
			}
			if (appearance.LegendAppearance != null)
			{
				ConfigureLegend(chart.Legend, appearance.LegendAppearance);
			}
			if (diagramConfigurator != null)
			{
				if (appearance.DiagramAppearance != null)
				{
					diagramConfigurator.Configure(chart.Diagram, appearance.DiagramAppearance);
				}
				diagramConfigurator.ConfigureSeries(chart.Series, appearance.SeriesAppearance);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase : AppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		private readonly IModelElementContainer container;

		protected IModelElementContainer Container => container;

		public static DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase CreateConfigurator(Diagram diagram, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				return new CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				return new XYDiagram3DAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is RadarDiagram)
			{
				return new RadarDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is SimpleDiagram)
			{
				return new SimpleDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is SimpleDiagram3D)
			{
				return new SimpleDiagram3DAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase(IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			this.container = container;
		}

		protected void ConfigureSeriesLabel(SeriesLabelBase label, DevExpress.Charts.Model.SeriesLabelAppearance appearance)
		{
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			label.BackColor = appearance.BackColor.ToColor();
			if (appearance.Border != null)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(label.Border, appearance.Border);
			}
			else
			{
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(label.Border);
			}
			if (appearance.FillStyle != null)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(label.FillStyle, appearance.FillStyle);
			}
			label.LineColor = appearance.LineColor.ToColor();
			label.LineLength = appearance.LineLength;
			if (appearance.LineStyle != null)
			{
				ConfigureLineStyle(label.LineStyle, appearance.LineStyle);
			}
			label.LineVisibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(appearance.LineVisible);
			ConfigureShadow(label.Shadow, appearance.Shadow);
			label.TextColor = appearance.TextColor.ToColor();
		}

		protected AxisAppearance GetAxisActualAppearance(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance allAxesAppearance)
		{
			if (Container.FindModelElement(axis) is DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase { Appearance: not null } axisBase)
			{
				return axisBase.Appearance;
			}
			return allAxesAppearance;
		}

		protected abstract void ConfigureView(SeriesViewBase view, SeriesAppearance appearance);

		public abstract void Configure(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.DiagramAppearance appearance);

		public void ConfigureSeries(SeriesCollection seriesCollection, SeriesAppearance appearance)
		{
			foreach (Series item in seriesCollection)
			{
				if (Container.FindModelElement(item) is SeriesModel { Appearance: not null } seriesModel)
				{
					appearance = seriesModel.Appearance;
				}
				if (appearance != null && appearance.LabelAppearance != null)
				{
					ConfigureSeriesLabel(item.Label, appearance.LabelAppearance);
				}
				if (appearance != null && appearance.MarkerAppearance != null)
				{
					MarkerAppearanceConfigurator.CreateMarkerConfigurator(item.View)?.Configure(item.View, appearance.MarkerAppearance);
				}
				ConfigureView(item.View, appearance);
			}
		}

		public virtual void ConfigureAxis(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				axis.GridLines.Color = appearance.GridLinesColor.ToColor();
				axis.GridLines.MinorColor = appearance.GridLinesMinorColor.ToColor();
				if (appearance.GridLinesLineStyle != null)
				{
					ConfigureLineStyle(axis.GridLines.LineStyle, appearance.GridLinesLineStyle);
				}
				if (appearance.GridLinesMinorLineStyle != null)
				{
					ConfigureLineStyle(axis.GridLines.MinorLineStyle, appearance.GridLinesMinorLineStyle);
				}
				axis.Interlaced = appearance.Interlaced;
				axis.InterlacedColor = appearance.InterlacedColor.ToColor();
				axis.Label.TextColor = appearance.LabelTextColor.ToColor();
			}
		}
	}
	public class CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator : DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		public CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxes(XYDiagram2D diagram, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.ActualAxisX, GetAxisActualAppearance(diagram.ActualAxisX, appearance));
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.ActualAxisY, GetAxisActualAppearance(diagram.ActualAxisY, appearance));
			foreach (Axis2D item in diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(item, GetAxisActualAppearance(item, appearance));
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(item2, GetAxisActualAppearance(item2, appearance));
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureViewBorder(XYDiagramSeriesViewBase view, Border borderModel)
		{
			if (view is BarSeriesView)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(((BarSeriesView)view).Border, borderModel);
			}
			if (view is AreaSeriesViewBase)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(((AreaSeriesViewBase)view).Border, borderModel);
			}
			if (view is RangeAreaSeriesView)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(((RangeAreaSeriesView)view).Border1, borderModel);
				ConfigureBorder(((RangeAreaSeriesView)view).Border2, borderModel);
			}
			if (view is BubbleSeriesView)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(((BubbleSeriesView)view).BubbleMarkerOptions.Border, borderModel);
			}
			if (view is BoxPlotSeriesView)
			{
				BoxPlotSeriesView boxPlotSeriesView = (BoxPlotSeriesView)view;
				ConfigureBorder(boxPlotSeriesView.Border, borderModel);
				boxPlotSeriesView.LineThickness = boxPlotSeriesView.Border.Thickness;
				boxPlotSeriesView.MeanLineStyle.Thickness = boxPlotSeriesView.Border.Thickness;
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureViewDefaultBorder(XYDiagramSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (view is BarSeriesView)
			{
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(((BarSeriesView)view).Border);
			}
			if (view is AreaSeriesViewBase)
			{
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(((AreaSeriesViewBase)view).Border);
			}
			if (view is RangeAreaSeriesView)
			{
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(((RangeAreaSeriesView)view).Border1);
				ConfigureDefaultBorder(((RangeAreaSeriesView)view).Border2);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureViewFillStyle(XYDiagramSeriesViewBase view, FillStyle fillStyle)
		{
			if (view is BarSeriesView)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(((BarSeriesView)view).FillStyle, fillStyle);
			}
			if (view is AreaSeriesViewBase)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(((AreaSeriesViewBase)view).FillStyle, fillStyle);
			}
		}

		protected override void ConfigureView(SeriesViewBase view, SeriesAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!(view is XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				if (xYDiagramSeriesViewBase is LineSeriesView && appearance.LineStyle != null)
				{
					ConfigureLineStyle(((LineSeriesView)xYDiagramSeriesViewBase).LineStyle, appearance.LineStyle);
				}
				if (!appearance.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.Color = appearance.Color.ToColor();
				}
				ConfigureShadow(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.Shadow, appearance.Shadow);
				if (appearance.Border != null)
				{
					ConfigureViewBorder(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase, appearance.Border);
				}
				else
				{
					ConfigureViewDefaultBorder(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase);
				}
				if (appearance.FillStyle != null && appearance.FillStyle.FillMode != DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Empty)
				{
					ConfigureViewFillStyle(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase, appearance.FillStyle);
					return;
				}
				ConfigureViewFillStyle(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase, new FillStyle
				{
					FillMode = DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Solid
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ConfigureViewFillStyle(xYDiagramSeriesViewBase, new FillStyle
				{
					FillMode = DevExpress.Charts.Model.FillMode.Solid
				});
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)diagram;
			xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane.BackColor = appearance.BackColor.ToColor();
			xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane.BorderColor = appearance.BorderColor.ToColor();
			xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane.BorderVisible = appearance.BorderVisible;
			if (appearance.FillStyle != null)
			{
				AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane.FillStyle, appearance.FillStyle);
			}
			ConfigureShadow(xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane.Shadow, appearance.Shadow);
			ConfigureAxes(xYDiagram2D, appearance.AxesAppearance);
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureIndents(xYDiagram2D.Margins, appearance.Margins);
			}
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxis(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			base.ConfigureAxis(axis, appearance);
			Axis2D axis2D = axis as Axis2D;
			if (appearance != null && axis2D != null)
			{
				axis2D.Color = appearance.Color.ToColor();
				axis2D.Thickness = appearance.Thickness;
				if (appearance.InterlacedFillStyle != null)
				{
					AppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureFillStyle2D(axis2D.InterlacedFillStyle, appearance.InterlacedFillStyle);
				}
				if (appearance.TitleAppearance != null)
				{
					axis2D.Title.TextColor = appearance.TitleAppearance.TextColor.ToColor();
				}
			}
		}
	}

				});
			}

	public abstract class DiagramConfigurator
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, Type> supportedTypes;

		static DiagramConfigurator()
		{
			supportedTypes = new Dictionary<Type, Type>
			{
				[typeof(CartesianChart)] = typeof(XYDiagramConfigurator),
				[typeof(PolarChart)] = typeof(PolarDiagramConfigurator),
				[typeof(RadarChart)] = typeof(RadarDiagramConfigurator),
				[typeof(PieChart)] = typeof(PieDiagramConfigurator),
				[typeof(Cartesian3DChart)] = typeof(XYDiagram3DConfigurator),
				[typeof(Pie3DChart)] = typeof(Pie3DDiagramConfigurator)
			};
		}

		public static DiagramConfigurator CreateInstance(DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model)
		{
			if (((DXCollectionBase<SeriesModel>)(object)model.Series).Count > 0 && supportedTypes.TryGetValue(model.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return (DiagramConfigurator)Activator.CreateInstance(value);
			}
			return EmptyDiagramConfigurator.Instance;
		}

		public abstract void Configure(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model);

		public abstract void ConfigureAxes(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container, DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator);
	}
	public abstract class GenericDiagramConfigurator<T> : DiagramConfigurator where T : DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart
	{
		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model)
		{
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				ConfigureCore(diagram, (T)model);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ConfigureCore(Diagram diagram, T model)
		{
			IChart3D chart3D = model as IChart3D;
			Diagram3D diagram3D = diagram as Diagram3D;
			if (chart3D != null && diagram3D != null)
			{
				Configurate3DOptions(diagram3D, chart3D.Options3D);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Configurate3DOptions(Diagram3D diagram, IOptions3D options3D)
		{
			diagram.RotationType = RotationType.UseAngles;
			diagram.PerspectiveEnabled = true;
			diagram.RotationOrder = RotationOrder.XYZ;
			diagram.RotationAngleX = options3D.RotationAngleX;
			diagram.RotationAngleY = options3D.RotationAngleY;
			diagram.RotationAngleZ = options3D.RotationAngleZ;
			diagram.PerspectiveAngle = options3D.PerspectiveAngle;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyDiagramConfigurator : DiagramConfigurator
	{
		public static readonly EmptyDiagramConfigurator Instance = new EmptyDiagramConfigurator();

		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model)
		{
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxes(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container, DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
		{
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramConfigurator : GenericDiagramConfigurator<CartesianChart>
	{
		protected override void ConfigureCore(Diagram diagram, CartesianChart model)
		{
			base.ConfigureCore(diagram, model);
			XYDiagram xYDiagram = (XYDiagram)diagram;
			xYDiagram.Rotated = model.Rotated;
			((IXYDiagram)diagram).UseRangeDependentEnqueuer = model.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer;
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxes(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container, DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
		{
			if (model is CartesianChart chart)
			{
				AxesConfigurator axesConfigurator = new AxesConfigurator(appearanceConfigurator);
				axesConfigurator.Configure(diagram as XYDiagram, chart, container);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram3DConfigurator : GenericDiagramConfigurator<Cartesian3DChart>
	{
		protected override void ConfigureCore(Diagram diagram, Cartesian3DChart model)
		{
			base.ConfigureCore(diagram, model);
			((IXYDiagram)diagram).UseRangeDependentEnqueuer = model.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer;
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxes(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container, DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
		{
			XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D = (XYDiagram3D)diagram;
			Cartesian3DChart cartesian3DChart = (Cartesian3DChart)model;
			if (cartesian3DChart.ArgumentAxis != null)
			{
				xYDiagram3D.AxisX.Label.Angle = cartesian3DChart.ArgumentAxis.Label.RotationAngleDegree;
			}
			if (cartesian3DChart.ValueAxis != null)
			{
				xYDiagram3D.AxisY.Label.Angle = cartesian3DChart.ValueAxis.Label.RotationAngleDegree;
			}
		}
	}

	public class PolarDiagramConfigurator : GenericDiagramConfigurator<PolarChart>
	{
		protected override void ConfigureCore(Diagram diagram, PolarChart model)
		{
			base.ConfigureCore(diagram, model);
			PolarDiagram polarDiagram = (PolarDiagram)diagram;
			polarDiagram.RotationDirection = (RadarDiagramRotationDirection)model.Direction;
			polarDiagram.DrawingStyle = ((model.Style != CircularDiagramStyle.Circle) ? RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Polygon : RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle);
			((IXYDiagram)polarDiagram).UseRangeDependentEnqueuer = model.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer;
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxes(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container, DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
		{
			if (model is PolarChart chart)
			{
				PolarAxesConfigurator polarAxesConfigurator = new PolarAxesConfigurator(appearanceConfigurator);
				polarAxesConfigurator.Configure(diagram as PolarDiagram, chart, container);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RadarDiagramConfigurator : GenericDiagramConfigurator<RadarChart>
	{
		protected override void ConfigureCore(Diagram diagram, RadarChart model)
		{
			base.ConfigureCore(diagram, model);
			RadarDiagram radarDiagram = (RadarDiagram)diagram;
			radarDiagram.RotationDirection = (RadarDiagramRotationDirection)model.Direction;
			radarDiagram.DrawingStyle = ((model.Style != CircularDiagramStyle.Circle) ? RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Polygon : RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle);
			((IXYDiagram)radarDiagram).UseRangeDependentEnqueuer = model.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer;
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxes(Diagram diagram, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container, DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase appearanceConfigurator)
		{
			if (model is RadarChart chart)
			{
				RadarAxesConfigurator radarAxesConfigurator = new RadarAxesConfigurator(appearanceConfigurator);
				radarAxesConfigurator.Configure(diagram as RadarDiagram, chart, container);
			}
		}
	}
	public class LegendConfigurator
	{
		internal LegendAlignmentHorizontal CalculateHorizontalAlignment(LegendPosition pos, bool overlay)
		{
			return (LegendAlignmentHorizontal)LegendPositionConverter.ConverterToHorizontalAlignment(pos, overlay);
		}

		internal LegendAlignmentVertical CalculateVerticalAlignment(LegendPosition pos, bool overlay)
		{
			return (LegendAlignmentVertical)LegendPositionConverter.ConverterToVerticalAlignment(pos, overlay);
		}

		public void Configure(Legend legend, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Legend modelLegend)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (legend == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			legend.Visibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(modelLegend != null);
			if (modelLegend == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			legend.EnableAntialiasing = modelLegend.EnableAntialiasing;
			legend.AlignmentHorizontal = CalculateHorizontalAlignment(modelLegend.LegendPosition, modelLegend.Overlay);
			legend.AlignmentVertical = CalculateVerticalAlignment(modelLegend.LegendPosition, modelLegend.Overlay);
			legend.Direction = ((modelLegend.Orientation != LegendOrientation.Vertical) ? LegendDirection.LeftToRight : LegendDirection.TopToBottom);
			Border border = modelLegend.Border;
			legend.Border.Visibility = DefaultBooleanUtils.ToDefaultBoolean(border != null);
			if (border != null)
			{
				if (border.Color != ColorARGB.Empty)
				{
					legend.Border.Color = border.Color.ToColor();
				}
				legend.Border.Thickness = border.Thickness;
			}
			DXFont dXFont = FontConfiguratorHelper.ConfigureDXFont(modelLegend.Font, legend.DXFont.Name);
			if (dXFont != null)
			{
				legend.DXFont = dXFont;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator
	{
		private readonly SeriesConfiguratorFactoryBase factory;

		protected internal SeriesConfiguratorFactoryBase Factory => factory;

		public virtual Diagram Diagram { get; set; }

		protected ChartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator()
		{
			factory = CreateFactory();
		}

		protected abstract SeriesConfiguratorFactoryBase CreateFactory();

		internal void ConfigurateSeries(Series series, SeriesModel item)
		{
			SeriesConfigurator seriesConfigurator = Factory.CreateSeriesConfigurator(series.View);
			if (seriesConfigurator != null)
			{
				seriesConfigurator.Diagram = Diagram;
				seriesConfigurator.Configure(series, item);
			}
		}

		public void CreateSeries(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			chart.Series.Clear();
			foreach (SeriesModel item in (DXCollectionBase<SeriesModel>)(object)model.Series)
			{
				SeriesViewBase seriesViewBase = Factory.CreateSeriesView(item);
				if (seriesViewBase != null)
				{
					Series series = new Series();
					series.View = seriesViewBase;
					container.Register(series, item);
					chart.Series.Add(series);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Configurate(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Chart model, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			Diagram = chart.Diagram;
			IList<SeriesModel> series = (IList<SeriesModel>)model.Series;
			foreach (SeriesModel item in series)
			{
				Series series2 = (Series)container.FindViewObject(item);
				ConfigurateSeries(series2, item);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartSeriesCollectionConfigurator : ChartBaseSeriesCollectionConfigurator
	{
		protected override SeriesConfiguratorFactoryBase CreateFactory()
		{
			return new SeriesConfiguratorFactory();
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesConfiguratorFactoryBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<Type, Type> viewTypes;

		private readonly Dictionary<Type, Type> configuratorTypes;

		protected Dictionary<Type, Type> SupportedViewTypes => viewTypes;

		protected Dictionary<Type, Type> SupportedConfiguratorTypes => configuratorTypes;

		public SeriesConfiguratorFactoryBase()
		{
			viewTypes = new Dictionary<Type, Type>();
			configuratorTypes = new Dictionary<Type, Type>();
			FillSupportedViewTypes();
			FillSupportedConfiguratorTypes();
		}

		protected abstract void FillSupportedViewTypes();

		protected abstract void FillSupportedConfiguratorTypes();

		internal SeriesConfigurator CreateSeriesConfigurator(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (configuratorTypes.TryGetValue(view.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return (SeriesConfigurator)Activator.CreateInstance(value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal SeriesViewBase CreateSeriesView(SeriesModel series)
		{
			if (viewTypes.TryGetValue(series.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return (SeriesViewBase)Activator.CreateInstance(value);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(HeatmapKeyColorProvider)";
		}

	public abstract class HeatmapDataAdapterBase : NotificationElement, IHeatmapAdapter
	{
		private HeatmapColorProviderBase colorProvider;

		private HeatmapData heatmapData = HeatmapData.Empty;

		protected HeatmapData HeatmapData
		{
			get
			{
				return heatmapData;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref heatmapData, value, "HeatmapData");
			}
		}

		internal HeatmapColorProviderBase ColorProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return colorProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				if (SetProperty(ref colorProvider, value, "ColorProvider", OnColorProviderChanged, OnPropertyChanging))
				{
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		HeatmapData IHeatmapAdapter.HeatmapData => HeatmapData;

		IHeatmapColorProvider IHeatmapAdapter.ColorProvider => ColorProvider;

		object IHeatmapAdapter.GetColorValue(int x, int y)
		{
			return GetColorValue(x, y);
		}

		bool IHeatmapAdapter.IsCellEmpty(int x, int y)
		{
			return IsCellEmpty(x, y);
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanging(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanging();
		}

		private void OnColorProviderChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateData()
		{
			ColorProvider?.Invalidate();
		}

		protected abstract object GetColorValue(int x, int y);

		protected abstract bool IsCellEmpty(int x, int y);
	}

			}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]

	[RuntimeObject]
	public class HeatmapHitInfo : ChartHitInfoBase
	{
		private HeatmapChart HeatmapChart => Heatmap.Chart as HeatmapChart;

		public IChartContainer Heatmap => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(IChartContainer)) as IChartContainer;

		public HeatmapTitle Title
		{
			get
			{
				if (HeatmapChart != null)
				{
					ChartTitle chartTitle = GetHitObjectByType(typeof(ChartTitle)) as ChartTitle;
					foreach (HeatmapTitle title in HeatmapChart.Titles)
					{
						if (title.ChartTitle == chartTitle)
						{
							return title;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public HeatmapAxis Axis
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetHitObjectByType(typeof(Axis)) is Axis axis)
				{
					if (!axis.IsValuesAxis)
					{
						return HeatmapChart.AxisX;
					}
					return HeatmapChart.AxisY;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public HeatmapCell Cell { get; }

		public HeatmapLegend Legend => GetHitObjectByType(typeof(HeatmapLegend)) as HeatmapLegend;

		public bool InHeatmap => HeatmapChart != null;

		public bool InTitle => Title != null;

		public bool InCell => Cell != null;

		public override object HitObject
		{
			get
			{
				object[] hitObjects = HitObjects;
				if (hitObjects.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return hitObjects[0];
			}
		}

		public override object[] HitObjects
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				if (InHeatmap)
				{
					if (InTitle)
					{
						list.Add(Title);
					}
					if (base.InAxis)
					{
						if (base.AxisLabelItem != null)
						{
							list.Add(base.AxisLabelItem);
						}
						if (base.AxisTitle != null)
						{
							list.Add(base.AxisTitle);
						}
						list.Add(Axis);
					}
					if (base.InLegend)
					{
						if (base.CustomLegendItem != null)
						{
							list.Add(base.CustomLegendItem);
						}
						list.Add(Legend);
					}
					if (InCell)
					{
						list.Add(Cell);
					}
					list.Add(Heatmap);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		internal HeatmapHitInfo(Point hitPoint, IList<HitTestParams> hitTestParams, HeatmapCell cell)
			: base(hitPoint, hitTestParams)
		{
			Cell = cell;
		}
	}

		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{

		private bool ShouldSerializeBackColor()
		{
			return color != Color.Empty;

		{
			return pattern != "{V}";
		}

		}

		{

		}

		{

		}

		private void ResetBackColor()
		{
			color = Color.Empty;
		}

		private void ResetPattern()
		{
			pattern = "{V}";
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeTextOrientation() && !ShouldSerializeDXFont() && !ShouldSerializeColor() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePattern();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(HeatmapLabel)";
		}

namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.Heatmap.Printing

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Heatmap.Printing.HeatmapOptionsPrint")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public class HeatmapOptionsPrint : BaseOptions, IXtraSupportShouldSerialize
	{
		private readonly ChartOptionsPrint innerOptions;

		[Description("")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Heatmap.Printing.HeatmapOptionsPrint.SizeMode")]
		public PrintSizeMode SizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return innerOptions.SizeMode;
			}
			set
			{
				innerOptions.SizeMode = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Heatmap.Printing.HeatmapOptionsPrint.ImageFormat")]
		public PrintImageFormat ImageFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return innerOptions.ImageFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				innerOptions.ImageFormat = value;
			}
		}

		internal HeatmapOptionsPrint(ChartOptionsPrint innerOptions)
		{
			this.innerOptions = innerOptions;
		}

		bool IXtraSupportShouldSerialize.ShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "SizeMode"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ImageFormat")
				{
					return ShouldSerializeImageFormat();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return ShouldSerializeSizeMode();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSizeMode()
		{
			return innerOptions.ShouldSerializeSizeMode();
		}

		private void ResetSizeMode()
		{
			innerOptions.ResetSizeMode();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeImageFormat()
		{
			return innerOptions.ShouldSerializeImageFormat();
		}

		private void ResetImageFormat()
		{
			innerOptions.ResetImageFormat();
		}

		public override void Assign(BaseOptions options)
		{
			((BaseOptions)this).Assign(options);
			if (options is HeatmapOptionsPrint heatmapOptionsPrint)
			{
				SizeMode = heatmapOptionsPrint.SizeMode;
				ImageFormat = heatmapOptionsPrint.ImageFormat;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(OptionsPrint)";
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.Heatmap.Native
{
	public class HeatmapChart : DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart, IHeatmapDataProvider, IHeatmapLegendItemProvider
	{
		private readonly HeatmapObjectColorProvider DefaultColorProvider = new HeatmapObjectColorProvider();

		private HeatmapColorProviderBase colorProvider;

		private SmallHeatmapText smallHeatmapText;

		private IHeatmapInteractionContainer HeatmapContainer { get; }

		public new HeatmapHitTestController HitTestController { get; }

		public HighlightingController HighlightingController { get; }

		public HeatmapDataController DataController { get; }

		public HeatmapToolTipController ToolTipController { get; }

		public HeatmapLabel Label { get; }

		public new HeatmapLegend Legend => (HeatmapLegend)base.ActualLegend;

		public new HeatmapTitleCollection Titles { get; }

		public HeatmapAxis AxisX { get; }

		public HeatmapAxis AxisY { get; }

		public new XYDiagram Diagram => (XYDiagram)base.Diagram;

		public HeatmapDiagram HeatmapDiagram { get; }

		public override SmallChartText SmallChartText => smallHeatmapText;

		public override bool HitTestingEnabled => true;

		public HeatmapColorProviderBase ActualColorProvider => ColorProvider ?? DefaultColorProvider;

		public HeatmapColorProviderBase ColorProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return colorProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				if (colorProvider is HeatmapPaletteColorProvider heatmapPaletteColorProvider)
				{
					heatmapPaletteColorProvider.PaletteRepository = null;
				}
				if (SetProperty(ref colorProvider, value))
				{
					if (colorProvider is HeatmapPaletteColorProvider heatmapPaletteColorProvider2)
					{
						heatmapPaletteColorProvider2.PaletteRepository = base.PaletteRepository;
					}
					if (DataController?.DataAdapter != null)
					{
						DataController.DataAdapter.ColorProvider = ActualColorProvider;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public new HeatmapOptionsPrint OptionsPrint { get; }

		HeatmapData IHeatmapDataProvider.HeatmapData => DataController.HeatmapData;

		public HeatmapChart(IChartContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
			EnableLoadingMode();
			base.ViewController.ApplyChangesBeforeRender();
			XYDiagram xYDiagram = (XYDiagram)(base.Diagram = new XYDiagram());
			HeatmapDiagram = new HeatmapDiagram(Diagram.DefaultPane);
			DisableLoadingMode();
			DataController = new HeatmapDataController(this);
			HitTestController = new HeatmapHitTestController(base.HitTestController, this);
			HighlightingController = new HighlightingController(this);
			ToolTipController = new HeatmapToolTipController(this);
			AxisX = new HeatmapAxis(xYDiagram.AxisX);
			AxisY = new HeatmapAxis(xYDiagram.AxisY);
			Label = new HeatmapLabel();
			Label.PropertyChanged += OnElementChanged;
			Label.PropertyChanging += OnElementChanging;
			Legend.Visibility = (DefaultBoolean)0;
			Titles = new HeatmapTitleCollection(base.Titles);
			smallHeatmapText = new SmallHeatmapText(this);
			base.Border.Visibility = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			OptionsPrint = new HeatmapOptionsPrint(base.OptionsPrint);
			HeatmapContainer = (IHeatmapInteractionContainer)container;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeColorProvider()
		{
			return colorProvider != null;
		}

		private void ResetColorProvider()
		{
			colorProvider = null;
		}

		List<LegendItem> IHeatmapLegendItemProvider.GetLegendItems(Palette palette, bool legendTextVisible, Color legendTextColor, bool legendMarkerVisible, Size legendMarkerSize, MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			List<LegendItem> list = DataController?.GetLegendItems(palette, legendTextVisible, legendTextColor, legendMarkerVisible, legendMarkerSize, valueRange);
			return list ?? new List<LegendItem>();
		}

		private void OnElementChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		private void OnElementChanging(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseControlChanging();
		}

		protected override void DrawContent(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, INativeGraphics nativeGraphics, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle windowsBounds, bool lockDrawingHelper, bool useImageCache, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			base.ViewController.ApplyChangesBeforeRender();
			nativeGraphics = CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, IntPtr.Zero, bounds, windowsBounds, graphicsQuality);
			INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = CreateRenderer(graphics, nativeGraphics);
			DrawNonCachedContent2D(new SingleLayerRendererContext(nativeRenderer), bounds, shouldUpdateBounds: true, null);
			HeatmapContainer.RaiseCustomPaint(new HeatmapCustomPaintEventArgs(graphics.DXGraphics, bounds));
		}

		protected internal override ChartUpdateInfoBase EnsureDiagramType(Type diagramType)
		{
			return base.EnsureDiagramType(typeof(XYDiagram));
		}

		protected override RefinedSeries CreateRefinedSeries(ISeries series, IRefinedSeriesContainer seriesContainer)
		{
			return DataController.CreateRefinedSeries(series, seriesContainer);
		}

		protected override LegendBase CreateLegend()
		{
			return new HeatmapLegend(this);
		}

		protected override SelectionController CreateSelectionController()
		{
			return new HeatmapSelectionController(this);
		}

		internal override HitTestParams PerformHitTesting(Point point, IList<HitTestParams> paramsArray, RaiseHitTestingDelegate raiseHitTesting)
		{
			HeatmapHitInfo heatmapHitInfo = CalcHitInfo(point);
			return new HitTestParams(heatmapHitInfo.Heatmap?.Chart, heatmapHitInfo.Cell, null);
		}

		public HeatmapHitInfo CalcHitInfo(Point point)
		{
			return HitTestController.CalcHitInfo(point);
		}

		public new HeatmapHitInfo CalcHitInfo(int x, int y)
		{
			return CalcHitInfo(new Point(x, y));
		}

		public override void HighlightObjectsAt(Point p)
		{
		}
	}

	public class HeatmapDataController
	{
		private readonly HeatmapChart heatmap;

		private readonly Series fakeHeatmapSeries;

		private HeatmapDataAdapterBase adapter;

		private HeatmapRefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		private HeatmapMatrixAdapter designTimeFakeAdapter;

		private Dictionary<object, CellIndex> tags;

		public HeatmapDataAdapterBase DataAdapter
		{
			get
			{
				return adapter;
			}
			set
			{
				if (adapter != value)
				{
					if (adapter != null)
					{
						UnsubscribeDataAdapter();
					}
					adapter = value;
					if (adapter != null)
					{
						adapter.ColorProvider = heatmap.ActualColorProvider;
						SubscribeDataAdapter();
					}
					OnDataChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public HeatmapData HeatmapData => GetHeatmapData();

		public HeatmapDataController(HeatmapChart heatmap)
		{
			this.heatmap = heatmap;
			fakeHeatmapSeries = new Series
			{
				View = new HeatmapSeriesView(),
				CrosshairEnabled = (DefaultBoolean)1
			};
			this.heatmap.Series.Add(fakeHeatmapSeries);
			designTimeFakeAdapter = FakeDataGenerator.CreateDesignTimeFakeAdapter();
			OnDataChanged();
		}

		private HeatmapData GetHeatmapData()
		{
			HeatmapData heatmapData = ((IHeatmapAdapter)DataAdapter)?.HeatmapData;
			if (heatmap.Container.DesignMode)
			{
				return heatmapData ?? ((IHeatmapAdapter)designTimeFakeAdapter).HeatmapData;
			}
			return heatmapData ?? HeatmapData.Empty;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataAdapter()
		{
			DataAdapter.PropertyChanged -= OnDataChanged;
			DataAdapter.PropertyChanging -= OnPropertyChanging;
			if (DataAdapter is IServiceProviderHolder serviceProviderHolder)
			{
				serviceProviderHolder.ServiceProvider = null;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeDataAdapter()
		{
			DataAdapter.PropertyChanged += OnDataChanged;
			DataAdapter.PropertyChanging += OnPropertyChanging;
			if (DataAdapter is IServiceProviderHolder serviceProviderHolder)
			{
				serviceProviderHolder.ServiceProvider = heatmap.Container.ServiceProvider;
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanging(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			heatmap.RaiseControlChanging();
		}

		private void OnDataChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			OnDataChanged();
		}

		private void OnDataChanged()
		{
			UpdateData();
			heatmap.RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateData()
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				refinedSeries.HeatmapData = GetHeatmapData();
			}
			if (HeatmapData != null)
			{
				tags = new Dictionary<object, CellIndex>();
				for (int i = 0; i < HeatmapData.XCoords.Count; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < HeatmapData.YCoords.Count; j++)
					{
						if (HeatmapData.GetTag(i, j) != null)
						{
							tags.Add(HeatmapData.GetTag(i, j), new CellIndex(i, j));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			heatmap.ViewController.RaiseChanged(new ChartUpdate(new SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, fakeHeatmapSeries, null, -1, null, -1)));
		}

		internal CellIndex GetCellIndexByTag(object tag)
		{
			if (!(tag is HeatmapCell))
			{
				if (!tags.ContainsKey(tag))
				{
					return CellIndex.Invalid;
				}
				return tags[tag];
			}
			return ((HeatmapCell)tag).Index;
		}

		internal HeatmapRefinedSeries CreateRefinedSeries(ISeries series, IRefinedSeriesContainer seriesContainer)
		{
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				refinedSeries = new HeatmapRefinedSeries(HeatmapData, series, seriesContainer);
			}
			return refinedSeries;
		}

		protected internal List<LegendItem> GetLegendItems(Palette palette, bool legendTextVisible, Color legendTextColor, bool legendMarkerVisible, Size legendMarkerSize, MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			return heatmap.ColorProvider?.GetLegendItems(palette, legendTextVisible, legendTextColor, legendMarkerVisible, legendMarkerSize, valueRange);
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapRefinedSeriesData : RefinedSeriesDataBase
	{
		private readonly IHeatmapLegendItemProvider legendItemProvider;

		public List<SeriesLabelViewData> LabelViewDataList { get; }

		public HeatmapRefinedSeriesData(IHeatmapLegendItemProvider legendItemProvider, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, SeriesContainerData containerData, int seriesIndexInContainer = 0)
			: base(refinedSeries, geometryCalculator, containerData, seriesIndexInContainer)
		{
			this.legendItemProvider = legendItemProvider;
			LabelViewDataList = new List<SeriesLabelViewData>();
			CollectLabels(refinedSeries);
		}

		private void CollectLabels(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			HeatmapRefinedSeries heatmapRefinedSeries = (HeatmapRefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
			HeatmapSeriesView heatmapSeriesView = (HeatmapSeriesView)heatmapRefinedSeries.Series.SeriesView;
			HeatmapLabel label = heatmapSeriesView.Label;
			if (!label.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeatmapData heatmapData = heatmapRefinedSeries.HeatmapData;
			HeatmapPatternHelper heatmapPatternHelper = new HeatmapPatternHelper(label.Pattern, heatmapData);
			for (int i = 0; i < heatmapData.XCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < heatmapData.YCoords.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!heatmapData.IsCellEmpty(i, j))
					{
						CellIndex cellIndex = new CellIndex(i, j);
						string text = heatmapPatternHelper.GetText(cellIndex);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							HeatmapSeriesLabelViewData heatmapSeriesLabelViewData = new HeatmapSeriesLabelViewData(label, text, cellIndex, label.ActualTextColor);
							heatmapSeriesLabelViewData.CalculateTextSize();
							LabelViewDataList.Add(heatmapSeriesLabelViewData);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal override SeriesLayout CreateSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
		{
			return new HeatmapSeriesLayout(seriesData, mapping, singleLayout);
		}

		public override List<ILegendItemData> GetLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			if (base.Legend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
			{
				foreach (LegendItem item in legendItemProvider?.GetLegendItems(null, base.TextVisible, base.TextColor, base.MarkerVisible, base.MarkerSize, ((HeatmapRefinedSeries)base.RefinedSeries).HeatmapData.ValueRange))
				{
					item.SetLegend(base.Series.ActualLegend);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

			: base(label, text)

			Color = color;
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapSeriesLayout : XYDiagramSeriesLayout
	{
		private readonly XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayouts;

		protected internal XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList LabelLayoutsForTest => labelLayouts;

		public HeatmapSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, bool singleLayout)
			: base(seriesData, diagramMapping, singleLayout)
		{
			labelLayouts = new XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(seriesData, diagramMapping.Container, isFirstSeriesInInteraction: false);
		}

		private void CalculateLayoutBasedLabels()
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			labelLayouts.Clear();
			HeatmapRefinedSeriesData heatmapRefinedSeriesData = (HeatmapRefinedSeriesData)base.SeriesData;
			HeatmapGeometry geometry = ((HeatmapWholeSeriesLayout)WholeLayout).Geometry;
			foreach (HeatmapSeriesLabelViewData labelViewData in heatmapRefinedSeriesData.LabelViewDataList)
			{
				Rectangle cellRect = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(geometry.GetCellBounds(labelViewData.CellIndex));
				if (labelViewData.TextSize.Width < cellRect.Size.Width && labelViewData.TextSize.Height < cellRect.Size.Height)
				{
					labelLayouts.Add(SeriesLabelHelper.CalculateLayoutForCenterHeatmapCellPosition(cellRect, labelViewData));
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Calculate(bool allowOptimization)
		{
			base.Calculate(allowOptimization);
			CalculateLayoutBasedLabels();
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeriesAbove(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			labelLayouts.RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapHitTestController : IHeatmapHitTestController
	{
		private readonly HitTestController chartHitTestController;

		private readonly IHeatmapDataProvider dataProvider;

		internal HeatmapGeometry HeatmapGeometry { get; private set; }

		public HeatmapHitTestController(HitTestController chartHitTestController, IHeatmapDataProvider dataProvider)
		{
			this.chartHitTestController = chartHitTestController;
			this.dataProvider = dataProvider;
		}

		void IHeatmapHitTestController.Update(HeatmapGeometry geometry)
		{
			HeatmapGeometry = geometry;
		}

		internal HeatmapCell HitTest(Point point)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (HeatmapGeometry != null && !dataProvider.HeatmapData.IsEmpty)
			{
				CellIndex cellIndex = HeatmapGeometry.CalculateCellIndex(new DXPoint(point.X, point.Y));
				if (cellIndex.IsValid && !dataProvider.HeatmapData.IsCellEmpty(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y))
				{
					return new HeatmapCell(dataProvider.HeatmapData.XCoords[cellIndex.X], dataProvider.HeatmapData.YCoords[cellIndex.Y], dataProvider.HeatmapData.GetColorValue(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y), dataProvider.HeatmapData.GetTag(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y), cellIndex);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public HeatmapHitInfo CalcHitInfo(Point point)
		{
			return new HeatmapHitInfo(point, chartHitTestController.Find(point), HitTest(point));
		}
	}
