	public class HeatmapWholeSeriesLayout : WholeSeriesLayout
	{
		private DXRectangle Bounds => Geometry.Bounds;

		public DXBitmap Heatmap { get; private set; }

		public HeatmapGeometry Geometry { get; private set; }

		public PointF Location
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				DXRectangle bounds = Bounds;
				float x = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left;
				bounds = Bounds;
				return new PointF(x, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top);
			}
		}

		public HeatmapWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, HeatmapData heatmapData, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, IHeatmapHitTestController hitTestController)
			: base(seriesLayout)
		{
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Geometry = HeatmapGeometry.Calculate((HeatmapRefinedSeries)seriesLayout.SeriesData.RefinedSeries, axisX, axisY, delegate(double x, double y)
			{
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				DiagramPoint screenPoint = diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(x, y);
				return new DXPoint((int)screenPoint.X, (int)screenPoint.Y);
			});
			int[] heatmap = Geometry.CreateHeatmap(heatmapData);
			DXRectangle bounds = Bounds;
			int width = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width;
			bounds = Bounds;
			Heatmap = CreateBitmap(heatmap, new Size(width, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height));
			hitTestController.Update(Geometry);
		}

		private DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int[] heatmap, Size heatmapSize)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(heatmapSize.Width, heatmapSize.Height);
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), heatmapSize);
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = dXBitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			Marshal.Copy(heatmap, 0, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, heatmap.Length);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion(DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PointF location = Location;
			DXRectangle bounds = Bounds;
			int width = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width;
			bounds = Bounds;
			return new HitRegionContainer(new HitRegion(new RectangleF(location, new Size(width, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height))));
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapToolTipController
	{
		private static readonly string DefaultHeatmapCellToolTipTitle = string.Empty;

		public const string DefaultTextPattern = "X-Argument: {X}\nY-Argument: {Y}\nValue: {V}";

		private readonly HeatmapHitTestController hitTestController;

		private readonly IHeatmapInteractionContainer interactionContainer;

		private readonly IHeatmapDataProvider heatmapDataProvider;

		private string toolTipPattern = "X-Argument: {X}\nY-Argument: {Y}\nValue: {V}";

		public bool ToolTipEnabled { get; set; }

		public string TextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return toolTipPattern;
			}
			set
			{
				toolTipPattern = value;
			}
		}

		public HeatmapToolTipController(HeatmapChart heatmap)
		{
			hitTestController = heatmap.HitTestController;
			interactionContainer = (IHeatmapInteractionContainer)heatmap.Container;
			heatmapDataProvider = heatmap;
		}

		private string CreateToolTipText(CellIndex index)
		{
			HeatmapPatternHelper heatmapPatternHelper = new HeatmapPatternHelper(TextPattern, heatmapDataProvider.HeatmapData);
			return heatmapPatternHelper.GetText(index);
		}

		public ToolTipInfo CalculateToolTipInfo(Point point)
		{
			if (!ToolTipEnabled)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HeatmapCell heatmapCell = hitTestController.HitTest(point);
			if (heatmapCell == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CustomizeHeatmapToolTipEventArgs e = new CustomizeHeatmapToolTipEventArgs(DefaultHeatmapCellToolTipTitle, CreateToolTipText(heatmapCell.Index), heatmapCell);
			interactionContainer.RaiseCustomizeHeatmapCellToolTip(e);
			return new ToolTipInfo(heatmapCell, e.Text, e.Title);
		}
	}
	public class ToolTipInfo
	{
		public object Object { get; }

		public string Text { get; }

		public string Title { get; }

		public ToolTipInfo(object currentObject, string text, string title)
		{
			Object = currentObject;
			Text = text;
			Title = title;
		}
	}
	public class HighlightingController : IHighlightingStyleProvider
	{
		private const int CellBorderThickness = 2;

		private const HatchStyle UpwardDiagonalHatch = HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal;

		private readonly HeatmapHitTestController hitTestController;

		private readonly IHeatmapInteractionContainer interactionContainer;

		private readonly IChartRenderProvider renderProvider;

		private HeatmapHighlightMode highlightMode;

		private Color hatchColor;

		private Color cellBorderColor;

		internal HeatmapCell HighlightCell { get; set; }

		public HeatmapHighlightMode HighlightMode
		{
			get
			{
				return highlightMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (highlightMode != value)
				{
					highlightMode = value;
					if (highlightMode == HeatmapHighlightMode.None)
					{
						HighlightCell = null;
					}
					renderProvider.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		Color IHighlightingStyleProvider.HatchColor => hatchColor;

		Color IHighlightingStyleProvider.CellBorderColor => cellBorderColor;

		int IHighlightingStyleProvider.CellBorderThickness => 2;

		HatchStyle IHighlightingStyleProvider.HatchStyle => HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal;

		public HighlightingController(HeatmapChart heatmap)
		{
			hitTestController = heatmap.HitTestController;
			interactionContainer = (IHeatmapInteractionContainer)heatmap.Container;
			renderProvider = heatmap.ContainerAdapter.RenderProvider;
		}

		internal CellBorderHighlightingGeometry CreateHighlightingGeometry()
		{
			return HighlightMode switch
			{
				HeatmapHighlightMode.Cell => new CellHighlightingGeometry(hitTestController.HeatmapGeometry, HighlightCell), 
				HeatmapHighlightMode.Row => new RowHighlightingGeometry(hitTestController.HeatmapGeometry, HighlightCell), 
				HeatmapHighlightMode.Column => new ColumnHighlightingGeometry(hitTestController.HeatmapGeometry, HighlightCell), 
				HeatmapHighlightMode.RowAndColumn => new RowAndColumnHighlightingGeometry(hitTestController.HeatmapGeometry, HighlightCell), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public void UpdateHighlightingColor(Color color)
		{
			cellBorderColor = color;
			hatchColor = Color.FromArgb(100, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}

		public void Update(Point point)
		{
			if (highlightMode != HeatmapHighlightMode.None)
			{
				HeatmapCell heatmapCell = hitTestController.HitTest(point);
				if (HighlightCell != heatmapCell)
				{
					interactionContainer.RaiseHeatmapHighlightedItemChanged(new HeatmapHighlightedItemChangedEventArgs(heatmapCell));
					HighlightCell = heatmapCell;
					renderProvider.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (!(HighlightCell == null))
			{
				CreateHighlightingGeometry().Render(renderer, this);
			}
		}
	}

			: base(heatmapGeometry, highlightedCell)

			RowBounds = ToRectangle(heatmapGeometry.GetRowBounds(highlightedCell.Index.Y));

			Rectangle[] columnBounds = ColumnBounds;

			Rectangle[] rowBounds = RowBounds;
			foreach (Rectangle rectangle2 in rowBounds)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(rectangle2, styleProvider.HatchStyle, styleProvider.HatchColor);
			}
			base.Render(renderer, styleProvider);
		}

	public class FakeDataGenerator
	{
		private static double[,] CreateRandomMatrix(int n, int m)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			NonCryptographicRandom val = new NonCryptographicRandom(0);
			double[,] array = new double[n, m];
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
				{
					array[i, j] = val.Next(20);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static HeatmapMatrixAdapter CreateDesignTimeFakeAdapter()
		{
			HeatmapRangeColorProvider heatmapRangeColorProvider = new HeatmapRangeColorProvider();
			((DXCollectionBase<HeatmapRangeStop>)(object)heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeStops).Add(new HeatmapRangeStop(0.0, HeatmapRangeStopType.Percentage));
			((DXCollectionBase<HeatmapRangeStop>)(object)heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeStops).Add(new HeatmapRangeStop(0.5, HeatmapRangeStopType.Percentage));
			((DXCollectionBase<HeatmapRangeStop>)(object)heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeStops).Add(new HeatmapRangeStop(1.0, HeatmapRangeStopType.Percentage));
			heatmapRangeColorProvider.Palette = new Palette("Design Time Default Palette", new PaletteEntry[3]
			{
				new PaletteEntry(Color.Green),
				new PaletteEntry(Color.White),
				new PaletteEntry(Color.Red)
			});
			heatmapRangeColorProvider.ApproximateColors = true;
			return new HeatmapMatrixAdapter
			{
				XArguments = new List<object> { "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G" },
				YArguments = new List<object> { "1", "2", "3", "4", "5" },
				Values = CreateRandomMatrix(5, 7),
				ColorProvider = heatmapRangeColorProvider
			};
		}

		public static void PopulateHeatmap(HeatmapChart heatmap, int n, int m)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
			{
				list.Add(i);
			}
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
			{
				list2.Add(j);
			}
			PopulateHeatmap(heatmap, list, list2);
		}

		public static void PopulateHeatmap(HeatmapChart heatmap, IList<object> xArguments, IList<object> yArguments)
		{
			HeatmapRangeColorProvider heatmapRangeColorProvider = new HeatmapRangeColorProvider();
			((DXCollectionBase<HeatmapRangeStop>)(object)heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeStops).Add(new HeatmapRangeStop(0.0, HeatmapRangeStopType.Percentage));
			((DXCollectionBase<HeatmapRangeStop>)(object)heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeStops).Add(new HeatmapRangeStop(1.0, HeatmapRangeStopType.Percentage));
			heatmapRangeColorProvider.Palette = new Palette("Palette", new PaletteEntry[2]
			{
				new PaletteEntry(Color.Yellow),
				new PaletteEntry(Color.Red)
			});
			heatmapRangeColorProvider.ApproximateColors = true;
			heatmap.DataController.DataAdapter = new HeatmapMatrixAdapter
			{
				XArguments = xArguments,
				YArguments = yArguments,
				Values = CreateRandomMatrix(yArguments.Count, xArguments.Count)
			};
			heatmap.ColorProvider = heatmapRangeColorProvider;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.GLGraphics

	public class EGLContext : IPlatformContext, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private IntPtr display;

		private IntPtr pBuffer;

		private IntPtr context;

		public static bool Available => EGL.Available;

		private bool HasPBuffer => pBuffer != IntPtr.Zero;

		public bool Initialized
		{
			get
			{
				if (display != IntPtr.Zero && HasPBuffer)
				{
					return context != IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public EGLContext(IDXGraphics graphics, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			display = EGL.GetDisplay();
			if (!EGL.Initialize(display, out var major, out var minor) || major < 1 || minor < 4)
			{
				return;
			}
			int[] attributes = new int[17]
			{
				12339, 1, 12324, 8, 12323, 8, 12322, 8, 12321, 8,
				12325, 16, 12326, 8, 12352, 8, 12344
			};
			if (EGL.ChooseConfig(display, attributes, out var config, 1, out var _))
			{
				int[] obj = new int[5] { 12375, 0, 12374, 0, 12344 };
				obj[1] = bounds.Width;
				obj[3] = bounds.Height;
				int[] attributes2 = obj;
				pBuffer = EGL.CreatePbufferSurface(display, config, attributes2);
				if (HasPBuffer && EGL.BindAPI(12450))
				{
					context = EGL.CreateContext(display, config, IntPtr.Zero, null);
				}
			}
		}

		public void FinishDrawing()
		{
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			using (IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = dXBitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.WriteOnly))
			{
				GL.ReadBuffer(1029);
				GL.ReadPixels(0, 0, dXBitmap.Width, dXBitmap.Height, 32993, 5121, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer);
			}
			graphics.DrawImage(dXBitmap, 0, 0);
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
		}

		public void ReleaseCurrent()
		{
			EGL.MakeCurrent(IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
		}

		public bool MakeCurrent()
		{
			return EGL.MakeCurrent(display, pBuffer, pBuffer, context);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (pBuffer != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				EGL.DestroySurface(display, pBuffer);
				pBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (context != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				EGL.DestroyContext(display, context);
				context = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (display != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				EGL.Terminate(display);
				display = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}
	}
	public class GLXContext : IPlatformContext, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private readonly bool isMultiThread;

		private IntPtr display;

		private IntPtr pBuffer;

		private IntPtr xWindow;

		private IntPtr context;

		private IntPtr Drawable
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(pBuffer != IntPtr.Zero))
				{
					return xWindow;
				}
				return pBuffer;
			}
		}

		public bool Initialized
		{
			get
			{
				if (display != IntPtr.Zero && Drawable != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return context != IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public GLXContext(IDXGraphics graphics, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			isMultiThread = GLX.XInitThreads() > 0;
			display = GLX.XOpenDisplay();
			if (display != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				int screen = GLX.XDefaultScreen(display);
				Lock();
				if (!CreateGLXOffscreenContext(screen))
				{
					CreateGLXWindowContext(screen, showWindow: false);
				}
				Unlock();
			}
		}

		private void CreateGLXWindowContext(int screen, bool showWindow)
		{
			int[] attributes = new int[14]
			{
				4, 8, 8, 9, 8, 10, 8, 12, 16, 13,
				8, 5, 0, 0
			};
			IntPtr parent = GLX.XRootWindow(display, screen);
			IntPtr visualInfo = GLX.ChooseVisual(display, screen, attributes);
			context = GLX.CreateContext(display, visualInfo, IntPtr.Zero, direct: true);
			if (context == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				context = GLX.CreateContext(display, visualInfo, IntPtr.Zero, direct: false);
			}
			xWindow = GLX.XCreateSimpleWindow(display, parent, 0, 0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height, 0, 0L, Color.White.ToArgb());
			if (showWindow)
			{
				GLX.XMapWindow(display, xWindow);
			}
		}

		private bool CreateGLXOffscreenContext(int screen)
		{
			int[] attribList = new int[17]
			{
				32784, 4, 32785, 1, 8, 8, 9, 8, 10, 8,
				11, 8, 12, 16, 13, 8, 0
			};
			int[] obj = new int[10] { 32833, 0, 32832, 0, 32795, 1, 32796, 0, 0, 0 };
			obj[1] = bounds.Width;
			obj[3] = bounds.Width;
			int[] attribList2 = obj;
			IntPtr intPtr = GLX.ChooseFBConfig(display, screen, attribList);
			if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				try
				{
					pBuffer = GLX.CreatePbuffer(display, intPtr, attribList2);
					context = GLX.CreateNewContext(display, intPtr, 32788, IntPtr.Zero, direct: true);
					if (context == IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						context = GLX.CreateNewContext(display, intPtr, 32788, IntPtr.Zero, direct: false);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					if (pBuffer != IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						GLX.DestroyPbuffer(display, pBuffer);
					}
				}
			}
			return context != IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		private void CopyPixels(int format, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height, pixelFormat);
			using (IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = dXBitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.WriteOnly))
			{
				GL.ReadBuffer(1029);
				GL.ReadPixels(0, 0, dXBitmap.Width, dXBitmap.Height, format, 5121, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer);
			}
			graphics.DrawImage(dXBitmap, 0, 0);
		}

		public void FinishDrawing()
		{
			if (xWindow != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				CopyPixels(32993, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			}
			else
			{
				CopyPixels(32992, DXPixelFormat.RGB24bpp);
			}
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
			if (isMultiThread)
			{
				GLX.XLockDisplay(display);
			}
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			if (isMultiThread)
			{
				GLX.XUnlockDisplay(display);
			}
		}

		public void ReleaseCurrent()
		{
			GLX.MakeCurrent(IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (xWindow != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				GLX.XDestroyWindow(display, xWindow);
				xWindow = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (pBuffer != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				GLX.DestroyPbuffer(display, pBuffer);
				pBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (context != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				GLX.DestroyContext(display, context);
				context = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (display != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				GLX.XCloseDisplay(display);
				display = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		public bool MakeCurrent()
		{
			return GLX.MakeCurrent(display, Drawable, context);
		}
	}
	public class OSMesaContext : IPlatformContext, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private IntPtr bufferPtr;

		private IntPtr context;

		private int BufferSize => bounds.Width * bounds.Height * 4;

		public bool Initialized => context != IntPtr.Zero;

		public OSMesaContext(IDXGraphics graphics, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			bufferPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(BufferSize);
			context = OSMesa.OSMesaCreateContext(6408, IntPtr.Zero);
		}

		public void FinishDrawing()
		{
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			using (IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = dXBitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite))
			{
				GL.ReadPixels(0, 0, dXBitmap.Width, dXBitmap.Height, 32993, 5121, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer);
			}
			graphics.DrawImage(dXBitmap, 0, 0);
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
		}

		public void ReleaseCurrent()
		{
		}

		public bool MakeCurrent()
		{
			return OSMesa.OSMesaMakeCurrent(context, bufferPtr, 5121, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (context != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				OSMesa.OSMesaDestroyContext(context);
				context = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (bufferPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(bufferPtr);
				bufferPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IPlatformContext : IDisposable
	{
		bool Initialized { get; }

		void FinishDrawing();

		void Lock();

		void Unlock();

		void ReleaseCurrent();

		bool MakeCurrent();
	}
	public static class PlatformContextUtils
	{
		public static IPlatformContext CreatePlatformContext(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, Rectangle bounds, IntPtr windowDC)
		{
			if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				GL.Library = GL.GLLibrary.Win;
				return new WGLContext(graphics, windowDC);
			}
			if (PlatformHelpers.IsLinux)
			{
				IPlatformContext platformContext = null;
				if (EGLContext.Available)
				{
					EGLContext eGLContext = new EGLContext(graphics.DXGraphics, bounds);
					if (eGLContext.Initialized)
					{
						platformContext = eGLContext;
						GL.Library = GL.GLLibrary.LibGL;
					}
					else
					{
						eGLContext.Dispose();
					}
				}
				if (platformContext == null || !platformContext.Initialized)
				{
					try
					{
						platformContext = new GLXContext(graphics.DXGraphics, bounds);
						GL.Library = GL.GLLibrary.LibGL;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				if (platformContext == null || !platformContext.Initialized)
				{
					try
					{
						platformContext = new OSMesaContext(graphics.DXGraphics, bounds);
						GL.Library = GL.GLLibrary.OSMesa;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return platformContext;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class WGLContext : IPlatformContext, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly ChartGraphicsBase graphics;

		private bool isWindowDC;

		private bool isDoubleBuffered;

		private IntPtr hdc;

		private IntPtr hglrc;

		public bool Initialized
		{
			get
			{
				if (hdc != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return hglrc != IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public WGLContext(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, IntPtr windowDC)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			if (windowDC == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				isWindowDC = false;
				hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			}
			else
			{
				isWindowDC = true;
				hdc = windowDC;
			}
			CreateWGLContext();
		}

		private void CreateWGLContext()
		{
			WGL.PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR = new WGL.PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR();
			pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.dwFlags = 2147487776u;
			if (isWindowDC)
			{
				pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.dwFlags |= 4101u;
			}
			else
			{
				pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.dwFlags |= 8u;
			}
			pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.cAccumBits = 64;
			pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.cStencilBits = 32;
			int num = WGL.ChoosePixelFormat(hdc, pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR);
			int num2 = WGL.DescribePixelFormat(hdc, num, Marshal.SizeOf(pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR), pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR);
			if (num2 == 0 || (num != 0 && CreateWGLContext(hdc, num, pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR)))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (WGL.DescribePixelFormat(hdc, i, Marshal.SizeOf(pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR), pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR) == 0 || pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.iPixelType != 0 || pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.cStencilBits < 8 || pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.cAccumBits < 32 || (pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.dwFlags & 0x20) != 32)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (isWindowDC)
				{
					if ((pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.dwFlags & 5) != 5)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if ((pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR.dwFlags & 8) != 8)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (CreateWGLContext(hdc, i, pIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CreateWGLContext(IntPtr drawable, int pixelFormat, WGL.PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR pfd)
		{
			if (!WGL.SetPixelFormat(drawable, pixelFormat, pfd))
			{
				return false;
			}
			hglrc = WGL.CreateContext(drawable);
			if (hglrc == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return false;
			}
			isDoubleBuffered = (pfd.dwFlags & 1) == 1;
			return true;
		}

		public void FinishDrawing()
		{
			if (isDoubleBuffered)
			{
				WGL.SwapBuffers(hdc);
			}
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
		}

		public void ReleaseCurrent()
		{
			WGL.MakeCurrent(IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isWindowDC && hdc != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				graphics.ReleaseHdcInternal(hdc);
				hdc = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (hglrc != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				WGL.DeleteContext(hglrc);
				hglrc = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		public bool MakeCurrent()
		{
			return WGL.MakeCurrent(hdc, hglrc);
		}
	}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void Finish()
		{
			switch (Library)
			{
			case GLLibrary.LibGL:
				GLImport_Linux.Finish();
				break;
			case GLLibrary.OSMesa:
				GLImport_OSMesa.Finish();
				break;
			case GLLibrary.Win:
				GLImport_Win.Finish();
				break;
			}
		}

	[CLSCompliant(false)]
	[SuppressUnmanagedCodeSecurity]
	public class GLUImport_Win
	{
		private const string Glu32 = "glu32.dll";

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluLookAt")]
		public static extern void LookAt(double eyex, double eyey, double eyez, double centerx, double centery, double centerz, double upx, double upy, double upz);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluPerspective")]
		public static extern void Perspective(double fovy, double aspect, double zNear, double zFar);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluNewQuadric")]
		public static extern IntPtr NewQuadric();

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluDeleteQuadric")]
		public static extern IntPtr DeleteQuadric(IntPtr state);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluQuadricNormals")]
		public static extern IntPtr QuadricNormals(IntPtr qobj, int normals);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluPartialDisk")]
		public static extern IntPtr PartialDisk(IntPtr qobj, double innerRadius, double outerRadius, int slices, int loops, double startAngle, double sweepAngle);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluScaleImage")]
		public static extern int ScaleImage(int format, int widthin, int heightin, int typein, byte[] datain, int widthout, int heightout, int typeout, byte[] dataout);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluScaleImage")]
		public static extern int ScaleImage(int format, int widthin, int heightin, int typein, IntPtr datain, int widthout, int heightout, int typeout, byte[] dataout);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluErrorString")]
		public static extern string ErrorString(int errCode);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluProject")]
		public static extern int Project(double objx, double objy, double objz, [In] double[] modelMatrix, [In] double[] projMatrix, [In] int[] viewport, out double winx, out double winy, out double winz);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluUnProject")]
		public static extern int UnProject(double winx, double winy, double winz, [In] double[] modelMatrix, [In] double[] projMatrix, [In] int[] viewport, out double objx, out double objy, out double objz);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluNewTess")]
		public static extern IntPtr NewTess();

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessCallback")]
		public static extern void TessCallback(IntPtr tess, int which, IntPtr fn);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessProperty")]
		public static extern void TessProperty(IntPtr tess, int which, double value);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessNormal")]
		public static extern void TessNormal(IntPtr tess, double x, double y, double z);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessBeginPolygon")]
		public static extern void TessBeginPolygon(IntPtr tess, IntPtr polygon_data);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessEndPolygon")]
		public static extern void TessEndPolygon(IntPtr tess);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessBeginContour")]
		public static extern void TessBeginContour(IntPtr tess);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessEndContour")]
		public static extern void TessEndContour(IntPtr tess);

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluTessVertex")]

		[DllImport("glu32.dll", EntryPoint = "gluDeleteTess")]

	public class GLHelper
	{
		private class GLMatrix
		{
			private TransformMatrix matrixKind;

			private double[] array = new double[16];

			public double[] Array => array;

			private static double CalcDeterminant(double[] matrix, int i, int j)
			{
				double[,] array = new double[3, 3];
				int num = 0;
				for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
				{
					if (k == i)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num2 = 0;
					for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++)
					{
						if (l != j)
						{
							array[num, num2] = matrix[k * 4 + l];
							num2++;
						}
					}
					num++;
				}
				double num3 = array[0, 0] * (array[1, 1] * array[2, 2] - array[2, 1] * array[1, 2]);
				num3 -= array[0, 1] * (array[1, 0] * array[2, 2] - array[2, 0] * array[1, 2]);
				return num3 + array[0, 2] * (array[1, 0] * array[2, 1] - array[2, 0] * array[1, 1]);
			}

			private static GLMatrix CalculateVMultVt(DiagramVector v)
			{
				GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView);
				gLMatrix.array[0] = v.DX * v.DX;
				gLMatrix.array[1] = v.DX * v.DY;
				gLMatrix.array[2] = v.DX * v.DZ;
				gLMatrix.array[3] = 0.0;
				gLMatrix.array[4] = v.DY * v.DX;
				gLMatrix.array[5] = v.DY * v.DY;
				gLMatrix.array[6] = v.DY * v.DZ;
				gLMatrix.array[7] = 0.0;
				gLMatrix.array[8] = v.DZ * v.DX;
				gLMatrix.array[9] = v.DZ * v.DY;
				gLMatrix.array[10] = v.DZ * v.DZ;
				gLMatrix.array[11] = 0.0;
				gLMatrix.array[12] = 0.0;
				gLMatrix.array[13] = 0.0;
				gLMatrix.array[14] = 0.0;
				gLMatrix.array[15] = 0.0;
				return gLMatrix;
			}

			public static GLMatrix operator +(GLMatrix m1, GLMatrix m2)
			{
				GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(m1.matrixKind);
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
				{
					gLMatrix.array[i] = m1.array[i] + m2.array[i];
				}
				return gLMatrix;
			}

			public static GLMatrix operator -(GLMatrix m1, GLMatrix m2)
			{
				GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(m1.matrixKind);
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
				{
					gLMatrix.array[i] = m1.array[i] - m2.array[i];
				}
				return gLMatrix;
			}

			public static GLMatrix operator *(double factor, GLMatrix m)
			{
				GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(m.matrixKind);
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
				{
					gLMatrix.array[i] = factor * m.array[i];
				}
				return gLMatrix;
			}

			public static DiagramPoint operator *(DiagramPoint point, GLMatrix m)
			{
				return new DiagramPoint
				{
					X = m.array[0] * point.X + m.array[4] * point.Y + m.array[8] * point.Z + m.array[12] * 1.0,
					Y = m.array[1] * point.X + m.array[5] * point.Y + m.array[9] * point.Z + m.array[13] * 1.0,
					Z = m.array[2] * point.X + m.array[6] * point.Y + m.array[10] * point.Z + m.array[14] * 1.0
				};
			}

			public static GLMatrix operator *(GLMatrix m1, GLMatrix m2)
			{
				GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(m1.matrixKind);
				gLMatrix.array[0] = m1.array[0] * m2.array[0] + m1.array[4] * m2.array[1] + m1.array[8] * m2.array[2] + m1.array[12] * m2.array[3];
				gLMatrix.array[1] = m1.array[1] * m2.array[0] + m1.array[5] * m2.array[1] + m1.array[9] * m2.array[2] + m1.array[13] * m2.array[3];
				gLMatrix.array[2] = m1.array[2] * m2.array[0] + m1.array[6] * m2.array[1] + m1.array[10] * m2.array[2] + m1.array[14] * m2.array[3];
				gLMatrix.array[3] = m1.array[3] * m2.array[0] + m1.array[7] * m2.array[1] + m1.array[11] * m2.array[2] + m1.array[15] * m2.array[3];
				gLMatrix.array[4] = m1.array[0] * m2.array[4] + m1.array[4] * m2.array[5] + m1.array[8] * m2.array[6] + m1.array[12] * m2.array[7];
				gLMatrix.array[5] = m1.array[1] * m2.array[4] + m1.array[5] * m2.array[5] + m1.array[9] * m2.array[6] + m1.array[13] * m2.array[7];
				gLMatrix.array[6] = m1.array[2] * m2.array[4] + m1.array[6] * m2.array[5] + m1.array[10] * m2.array[6] + m1.array[14] * m2.array[7];
				gLMatrix.array[7] = m1.array[3] * m2.array[4] + m1.array[7] * m2.array[5] + m1.array[11] * m2.array[6] + m1.array[15] * m2.array[7];
				gLMatrix.array[8] = m1.array[0] * m2.array[8] + m1.array[4] * m2.array[9] + m1.array[8] * m2.array[10] + m1.array[12] * m2.array[11];
				gLMatrix.array[9] = m1.array[1] * m2.array[8] + m1.array[5] * m2.array[9] + m1.array[9] * m2.array[10] + m1.array[13] * m2.array[11];
				gLMatrix.array[10] = m1.array[2] * m2.array[8] + m1.array[6] * m2.array[9] + m1.array[10] * m2.array[10] + m1.array[14] * m2.array[11];
				gLMatrix.array[11] = m1.array[3] * m2.array[8] + m1.array[7] * m2.array[9] + m1.array[11] * m2.array[10] + m1.array[15] * m2.array[11];
				gLMatrix.array[12] = m1.array[0] * m2.array[12] + m1.array[4] * m2.array[13] + m1.array[8] * m2.array[14] + m1.array[12] * m2.array[15];
				gLMatrix.array[13] = m1.array[1] * m2.array[12] + m1.array[5] * m2.array[13] + m1.array[9] * m2.array[14] + m1.array[13] * m2.array[15];
				gLMatrix.array[14] = m1.array[2] * m2.array[12] + m1.array[6] * m2.array[13] + m1.array[10] * m2.array[14] + m1.array[14] * m2.array[15];
				gLMatrix.array[15] = m1.array[3] * m2.array[12] + m1.array[7] * m2.array[13] + m1.array[11] * m2.array[14] + m1.array[15] * m2.array[15];
				return gLMatrix;
			}

			public GLMatrix(TransformMatrix matrixKind)
			{
				this.matrixKind = matrixKind;
				array[0] = 1.0;
				array[4] = 0.0;
				array[8] = 0.0;
				array[12] = 0.0;
				array[1] = 0.0;
				array[5] = 1.0;
				array[9] = 0.0;
				array[13] = 0.0;
				array[2] = 0.0;
				array[6] = 0.0;
				array[10] = 1.0;
				array[14] = 0.0;
				array[3] = 0.0;
				array[7] = 0.0;
				array[11] = 0.0;
				array[15] = 1.0;
			}

			public GLMatrix(TransformMatrix matrixKind, double[] matrix)
			{
				this.matrixKind = matrixKind;
				array = matrix;
			}

			public void PerformTranslateCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
			{
				if (matrixKind == TransformMatrix.ModelView && command is TranslateGraphicsCommand translateGraphicsCommand)
				{
					GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(matrixKind);
					gLMatrix.array[12] = translateGraphicsCommand.XTranslate;
					gLMatrix.array[13] = translateGraphicsCommand.YTranslate;
					gLMatrix.array[14] = translateGraphicsCommand.ZTranslate;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = this * gLMatrix;
					array = gLMatrix2.array;
				}
			}

			public void PerformRotateCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
			{
				if (matrixKind == TransformMatrix.ModelView && command is RotateGraphicsCommand { RotateVector: var rotateVector } rotateGraphicsCommand)
				{
					rotateVector.Normalize();
					double num = (double)rotateGraphicsCommand.Angle * Math.PI / 180.0;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix = CalculateVMultVt(rotateVector);
					GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = new GLMatrix(matrixKind);
					int num2 = 0;
					gLMatrix2.array[0] = num2;
					gLMatrix2.array[1] = rotateVector.DZ;
					gLMatrix2.array[2] = 0.0 - rotateVector.DY;
					gLMatrix2.array[3] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[4] = 0.0 - rotateVector.DZ;
					gLMatrix2.array[5] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[6] = rotateVector.DX;
					gLMatrix2.array[7] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[8] = rotateVector.DY;
					gLMatrix2.array[9] = 0.0 - rotateVector.DX;
					gLMatrix2.array[10] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[11] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[12] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[13] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[14] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix2.array[15] = 0.0;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix3 = gLMatrix + Math.Cos(num) * (new GLMatrix(matrixKind) - gLMatrix) + Math.Sin(num) * gLMatrix2;
					gLMatrix3.array[3] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix3.array[7] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix3.array[11] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix3.array[12] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix3.array[13] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix3.array[14] = 0.0;
					gLMatrix3.array[15] = 1.0;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix4 = this * gLMatrix3;
					array = gLMatrix4.array;
				}
			}

			public void PerformTransformCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
			{
				if (matrixKind == TransformMatrix.ModelView && command is TransformGraphicsCommand { TransformMatrix: var transformMatrix })
				{
					GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(matrixKind);
					for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
					{
						gLMatrix.array[i] = transformMatrix[i];
					}
					GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = this * gLMatrix;
					array = gLMatrix2.array;
				}
			}

			public void PerformOrthoCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
			{
				if (matrixKind == TransformMatrix.Projection && command is OrthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand { P2: { X: var x }, P1: var p2 } orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand)
				{
					double num = x - p2.X;
					double num2 = orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Y - orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Y;
					double num3 = orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Z - orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Z;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(matrixKind);
					gLMatrix.array[0] = 2.0 / num;
					gLMatrix.array[5] = 2.0 / num2;
					gLMatrix.array[10] = -2.0 / num3;
					gLMatrix.array[12] = (0.0 - (orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.X + orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.X)) / num;
					gLMatrix.array[13] = (0.0 - (orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Y + orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Y)) / num2;
					gLMatrix.array[14] = (0.0 - (orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Z + orthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Z)) / num3;
					gLMatrix.array[15] = 1.0;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = this * gLMatrix;
					array = gLMatrix2.array;
				}
			}

			public void PerformPerspectiveCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
			{
				if (matrixKind == TransformMatrix.Projection && command is FrustumProjectionGraphicsCommand { P2: { X: var x }, P1: var p2 } frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand)
				{
					double num = x - p2.X;
					double num2 = frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Y - frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Y;
					double num3 = frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Z - frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Z;
					double num4 = 2.0 * frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Z;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(matrixKind);
					gLMatrix.array[0] = num4 / num;
					gLMatrix.array[5] = num4 / num2;
					gLMatrix.array[8] = (frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.X + frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.X) / num;
					gLMatrix.array[9] = (frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Y + frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Y) / num2;
					gLMatrix.array[10] = (0.0 - (frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Z + frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Z)) / num3;
					gLMatrix.array[11] = -1.0;
					gLMatrix.array[14] = -2.0 * frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P1.Z * frustumProjectionGraphicsCommand.P2.Z / num3;
					gLMatrix.array[15] = 0.0;
					GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = this * gLMatrix;
					array = gLMatrix2.array;
				}
			}

			public void PerformCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
			{
				PerformTranslateCommand(command);
				PerformRotateCommand(command);
				PerformTransformCommand(command);
				PerformOrthoCommand(command);
				PerformPerspectiveCommand(command);
				if (command.Children == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (GraphicsCommand child in command.Children)
				{
					PerformCommand(child);
				}
			}

			public GLMatrix CalcInverseMatrix()
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					num += ((i % 2 == 1) ? ((0.0 - this.array[i]) * CalcDeterminant(this.array, 0, i)) : (this.array[i] * CalcDeterminant(this.array, 0, i)));
				}
				num = 1.0 / num;
				double[] array = new double[16];
				for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
					{
						double num2 = CalcDeterminant(this.array, k, j);
						array[j * 4 + k] = (((j + k) % 2 == 1) ? ((0.0 - num2) * num) : (num2 * num));
					}
				}
				return new GLMatrix(matrixKind, array);
			}
		}

		public delegate void DrawingFunction();

		public delegate int Gen1DTextureCoord(double x, double y, double z);

		public const int MinTexCoord = 0;

		public const int MidTexCoord = 127;

		public const int MaxTexCoord = 255;

		public static int ConvertTexCoord(float texCoord)
		{
			if (texCoord < 0f)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (texCoord > 1f)
			{
				return 255;
			}
			return Convert.ToInt32(texCoord * 255f);
		}

		public static float[] Create1DTexture(Color color, Color color2)
		{
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(color, out var red, out var green, out var blue, out var alpha);
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(color2, out var red2, out var green2, out var blue2, out var alpha2);
			int num = 255;
			float num2 = (red2 - red) / (float)num;
			float num3 = (green2 - green) / (float)num;
			float num4 = (blue2 - blue) / (float)num;
			float num5 = (alpha2 - alpha) / (float)num;
			float[] array = new float[(num + 1) * 4];
			int i = 0;
			int num6 = 0;
			for (; i <= num; i++)
			{
				array[num6++] = red + num2 * (float)i;
				array[num6++] = green + num3 * (float)i;
				array[num6++] = blue + num4 * (float)i;
				array[num6++] = alpha + num5 * (float)i;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static int GetSlicesCount(double sweepAngle)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round(sweepAngle);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return -num;
		}

		public static void Arc(float position, float radius, float sweepAngle)
		{
			float num = (0f - (float)((double)sweepAngle * Math.PI)) / 3600f;
			GL.Begin(3);
			for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
			{
				double num2 = (float)i * num;
				float num3 = (float)Math.Sin(num2);
				float num4 = (float)Math.Cos(num2);
				GL.Normal3d(0.0, num4, num3);
				GL.Vertex3d(position, num4 * radius, num3 * radius);
			}
			GL.End();
		}

		public static void PartialDisk(float radius, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			PartialDisk(radius, startAngle, sweepAngle, null, null);
		}

		public static void PartialDisk(float radius, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float[] texture, Gen1DTextureCoord textureGenerator)
		{
			float num = (float)((double)startAngle * Math.PI) / 180f;
			int slicesCount = GetSlicesCount(sweepAngle);
			float num2 = (float)((double)sweepAngle * Math.PI) / 180f / (float)slicesCount;
			GL.Normal3d(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			GL.Begin(4);
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 1;
			while (num3 < slicesCount)
			{
				double num5 = (float)num3 * num2 + num;
				double x = Math.Cos(num5) * (double)radius;
				double y = Math.Sin(num5) * (double)radius;
				num5 = (float)num4 * num2 + num;
				double x2 = Math.Cos(num5) * (double)radius;
				double y2 = Math.Sin(num5) * (double)radius;
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x, y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x, y, 0.0);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x2, y2, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x2, y2, 0.0);
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
			GL.End();
		}

		public static void PartialDisk(float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			PartialDisk(innerRadius, outerRadius, startAngle, sweepAngle, null, null);
		}

		public static void PartialDisk(float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float[] texture, Gen1DTextureCoord textureGenerator)
		{
			float num = (float)((double)startAngle * Math.PI) / 180f;
			int slicesCount = GetSlicesCount(sweepAngle);
			float num2 = (float)((double)sweepAngle * Math.PI) / 180f / (float)slicesCount;
			GL.Normal3d(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			GL.Begin(7);
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 1;
			while (num3 < slicesCount)
			{
				double num5 = (float)num3 * num2 + num;
				double num6 = Math.Cos(num5);
				double num7 = Math.Sin(num5);
				double x = num6 * (double)outerRadius;
				double y = num7 * (double)outerRadius;
				double x2 = num6 * (double)innerRadius;
				double y2 = num7 * (double)innerRadius;
				num5 = (float)num4 * num2 + num;
				num6 = Math.Cos(num5);
				num7 = Math.Sin(num5);
				double x3 = num6 * (double)outerRadius;
				double y3 = num7 * (double)outerRadius;
				double x4 = num6 * (double)innerRadius;
				double y4 = num7 * (double)innerRadius;
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x4, y4, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x4, y4, 0.0);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x2, y2, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x2, y2, 0.0);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x, y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x, y, 0.0);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x3, y3, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x3, y3, 0.0);
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
			GL.End();
		}

		public static void PartialCylinder(float height, float radius, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)

		public static void PartialCylinder(float height, float radius, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float[] texture, Gen1DTextureCoord textureGenerator)
		{
			float num = (float)((double)startAngle * Math.PI) / 180f;
			int slicesCount = GetSlicesCount(sweepAngle);
			float num2 = (float)((double)sweepAngle * Math.PI) / 180f / (float)slicesCount;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 1;
			while (num3 < slicesCount)
			{
				double num5 = (float)num3 * num2 + num;
				float num6 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				num5 = (float)num4 * num2 + num;
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(num6, num7, 0.0);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(num8, num9, 0.0);
				num6 *= radius;
				num7 *= radius;
				num8 *= radius;
				num9 *= radius;
				GL.Begin(7);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(num6, num7, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Normal3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint.Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(num6, num7, height);
				GL.Vertex3d(num6, num7, 0.0);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(num8, num9, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Normal3d(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, diagramPoint2.Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(num8, num9, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(num8, num9, height);
				GL.End();
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
		}

		public static void PartialCone(float height, float radius1, float radius2, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)

		public static void PartialCone(float height, float radius1, float radius2, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float[] texture, Gen1DTextureCoord textureGenerator)
		{
			float num = (float)((double)startAngle * Math.PI) / 180f;
			int slicesCount = GetSlicesCount(sweepAngle);
			float num2 = (float)((double)sweepAngle * Math.PI) / 180f / (float)slicesCount;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 1;
			while (num3 < slicesCount)
			{
				double num5 = (float)num3 * num2 + num;
				float num6 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				num5 = (float)num4 * num2 + num;
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				double num10 = ((height != 0f) ? Math.Atan2(radius1 - radius2, height) : 0.0);
				double dz = Math.Sin(num10);
				double num11 = Math.Cos(num10);
				DiagramVector diagramVector = new DiagramVector((double)num6 * num11, (double)num7 * num11, dz);
				DiagramVector diagramVector2 = new DiagramVector((double)num8 * num11, (double)num9 * num11, dz);
				diagramVector.Normalize();
				diagramVector2.Normalize();
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(num6 * radius2, num7 * radius2, height);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(num6 * radius1, num7 * radius1, 0.0);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = new DiagramPoint(num8 * radius1, num9 * radius1, 0.0);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint4 = new DiagramPoint(num8 * radius2, num9 * radius2, height);
				GL.Begin(7);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Normal3d(diagramVector.DX, diagramVector.DY, diagramVector.DZ);
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint.Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, diagramPoint2.Z);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(diagramPoint3.X, diagramPoint3.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Normal3d(diagramVector2.DX, diagramVector2.DY, diagramVector2.DZ);
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint3.X, diagramPoint3.Y, diagramPoint3.Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint4.X, diagramPoint4.Y, diagramPoint4.Z);
				GL.End();
				num3++;
				num4++;
			}
		}

		public static void PieSections(float height, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float facetSize, float startAngle, float endAngle)
		{
			PieSections(height, innerRadius, outerRadius, facetSize, startAngle, endAngle, null, null);
		}

		public static void PieSections(float height, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float facetSize, float startAngle, float endAngle, float[] texture, Gen1DTextureCoord textureGenerator)
		{
			double num = (double)startAngle * Math.PI / 180.0;
			double num2 = (double)endAngle * Math.PI / 180.0;
			double num3 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num4 = Math.Sin(num);
			double num5 = Math.Cos(num2);
			double num6 = Math.Sin(num2);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(num3 * (double)innerRadius, num4 * (double)innerRadius);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(num5 * (double)innerRadius, num6 * (double)innerRadius);
			DiagramPoint p = new DiagramPoint(num3 * (double)outerRadius, num4 * (double)outerRadius);
			DiagramPoint p2 = new DiagramPoint(num5 * (double)outerRadius, num6 * (double)outerRadius);
			DiagramPoint zero = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			DiagramPoint p3 = new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0, height);
			DiagramVector diagramVector = MathUtils.CalcNormal(zero, p3, p);
			DiagramVector diagramVector2 = MathUtils.CalcNormal(zero, p3, p2);
			if (facetSize > 0f)
			{
				double num7 = ((innerRadius == 0f) ? 0f : (innerRadius + facetSize));
				double num8 = outerRadius - facetSize;
				if (num7 > num8)
				{
					num7 = num8;
				}
				double z = facetSize;
				double z2 = height - facetSize;
				double x = num3 * num7;
				double y = num4 * num7;
				double x2 = num5 * num7;
				double y2 = num6 * num7;
				double x3 = num3 * num8;
				double y3 = num4 * num8;
				double x4 = num5 * num8;
				double y4 = num6 * num8;
				GL.Normal3d(diagramVector.DX, diagramVector.DY, diagramVector.DZ);
				GL.Begin(8);
				if (innerRadius > 0f)
				{
					if (textureGenerator != null)
					{
						SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0));
					}
					GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, z);
					GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, z2);
				}
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x, y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x, y, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x, y, height);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x3, y3, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x3, y3, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x3, y3, height);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(p.X, p.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(p.X, p.Y, z);
				GL.Vertex3d(p.X, p.Y, z2);
				GL.End();
				GL.Normal3d(diagramVector2.DX, diagramVector2.DY, diagramVector2.DZ);
				GL.Begin(8);
				if (innerRadius > 0f)
				{
					if (textureGenerator != null)
					{
						SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, 0.0));
					}
					GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, z);
					GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, z2);
				}
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x2, y2, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x2, y2, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x2, y2, height);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(x4, y4, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(x4, y4, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x4, y4, height);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(p2.X, p2.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(p2.X, p2.Y, z);
				GL.Vertex3d(p2.X, p2.Y, z2);
				GL.End();
			}
			else
			{
				GL.Begin(7);
				GL.Normal3d(diagramVector.DX, diagramVector.DY, diagramVector.DZ);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, height);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(p.X, p.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(p.X, p.Y, height);
				GL.Vertex3d(p.X, p.Y, 0.0);
				GL.Normal3d(diagramVector2.DX, diagramVector2.DY, diagramVector2.DZ);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y, height);
				if (textureGenerator != null)
				{
					SetColor(texture, textureGenerator(p2.X, p2.Y, 0.0));
				}
				GL.Vertex3d(p2.X, p2.Y, height);
				GL.Vertex3d(p2.X, p2.Y, 0.0);
				GL.End();
			}
		}

		public static void SetColor(float[] texture, int index)
		{
			GL.Color4f(texture[index * 4], texture[index * 4 + 1], texture[index * 4 + 2], texture[index * 4 + 3]);
		}

		public static void CalculateMatrices(GraphicsCommand command, out double[] modelView, out double[] projection)
		{
			GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.Projection);
			gLMatrix.PerformCommand(command);
			gLMatrix2.PerformCommand(command);
			modelView = gLMatrix.Array;
			projection = gLMatrix2.Array;
		}

		public static void PerformRotationStandard(double[] matrix, double dx, double dy)
		{
			GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView);
			RotateGraphicsCommand command = new RotateGraphicsCommand((float)dy, new DiagramVector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			gLMatrix.PerformRotateCommand(command);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView, matrix);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix3 = gLMatrix * gLMatrix2;
			RotateGraphicsCommand command2 = new RotateGraphicsCommand((float)dx, new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
			gLMatrix3.PerformRotateCommand(command2);
			gLMatrix3.Array.CopyTo(matrix, 0);
		}

		public static void PerformRotation(double[] matrix, double dx, double dy)
		{
			GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView);
			RotateGraphicsCommand command = new RotateGraphicsCommand((float)dx, new DiagramVector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
			RotateGraphicsCommand command2 = new RotateGraphicsCommand((float)dy, new DiagramVector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			gLMatrix.PerformRotateCommand(command);
			gLMatrix.PerformRotateCommand(command2);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView, matrix);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix3 = gLMatrix * gLMatrix2;
			gLMatrix3.Array.CopyTo(matrix, 0);
		}

		public static void PerformRotation(double[] matrix, double dz)
		{
			GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView);
			RotateGraphicsCommand command = new RotateGraphicsCommand((float)dz, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
			gLMatrix.PerformRotateCommand(command);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix2 = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView, matrix);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix3 = gLMatrix * gLMatrix2;
			gLMatrix3.Array.CopyTo(matrix, 0);
		}

		public static DiagramPoint InverseTransform(double[] matrix, DiagramPoint point)
		{
			double[] array = new double[16];
			matrix.CopyTo(array, 0);
			GLMatrix gLMatrix = new GLMatrix(TransformMatrix.ModelView, array);
			gLMatrix.Array[12] = (gLMatrix.Array[13] = (gLMatrix.Array[14] = 0.0));
			return point * gLMatrix.CalcInverseMatrix();
		}
	}

		{
			int fbCount;
			IntPtr source = GLXImport.ChooseFBConfig(display, screen, attribList, out fbCount);
			if (fbCount > 0)
			{
				IntPtr[] array = new IntPtr[fbCount];
				Marshal.Copy(source, array, 0, fbCount);
				return array[0];
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		}

		{
			GLXImport.DestroyPbuffer(display, pbuffer);
		}

	[CLSCompliant(false)]
	public class WGL
	{
		[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
		public class PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR
		{
			public short nSize;

			public short nVersion;

			public uint dwFlags;

			public byte iPixelType;

			public byte cColorBits;

			public byte cRedBits;

			public byte cRedShift;

			public byte cGreenBits;

			public byte cGreenShift;

			public byte cBlueBits;

			public byte cBlueShift;

			public byte cAlphaBits;

			public byte cAlphaShift;

			public byte cAccumBits;

			public byte cAccumRedBits;

			public byte cAccumGreenBits;

			public byte cAccumBlueBits;

			public byte cAccumAlphaBits;

			public byte cDepthBits;

			public byte cStencilBits;

			public byte cAuxBuffers;

			public byte iLayerType;

			public byte bReserved;

			public int dwLayerMask;

			public int dwVisibleMask;

			public int dwDamageMask;

			public PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR()
			{
				nSize = (short)Marshal.SizeOf(this);
				nVersion = 1;
				iPixelType = 0;
				cColorBits = 24;
				cDepthBits = 32;
				iLayerType = 0;
			}
		}

		public const uint PFD_DOUBLEBUFFER = 1u;

		public const uint PFD_STEREO = 2u;

		public const uint PFD_DRAW_TO_WINDOW = 4u;

		public const uint PFD_DRAW_TO_BITMAP = 8u;

		public const uint PFD_SUPPORT_GDI = 16u;

		public const uint PFD_SUPPORT_OPENGL = 32u;

		public const uint PFD_GENERIC_FORMAT = 64u;

		public const uint PFD_NEED_PALETTE = 128u;

		public const uint PFD_NEED_SYSTEM_PALETTE = 256u;

		public const uint PFD_SWAP_EXCHANGE = 512u;

		public const uint PFD_SWAP_COPY = 1024u;

		public const uint PFD_SWAP_LAYER_BUFFERS = 2048u;

		public const uint PFD_GENERIC_ACCELERATED = 4096u;

		public const uint PFD_SUPPORT_DIRECTDRAW = 8192u;

		public const uint PFD_DIRECT3D_ACCELERATED = 16384u;

		public const uint PFD_SUPPORT_COMPOSITION = 32768u;

		public const uint PFD_DEPTH_DONTCARE = 536870912u;

		public const uint PFD_DOUBLEBUFFER_DONTCARE = 1073741824u;

		public const uint PFD_STEREO_DONTCARE = 2147483648u;

		public const byte PFD_TYPE_RGBA = 0;

		public const byte PFD_TYPE_COLORINDEX = 1;

		public const byte PFD_MAIN_PLANE = 0;

		public const byte PFD_OVERLAY_PLANE = 1;

		public const byte PFD_UNDERLAY_PLANE = byte.MaxValue;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static int DescribePixelFormat(IntPtr hdc, int iPixelFormat, int nBytes, PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR ppfd)
		{
			return WGLImport.DescribePixelFormat(hdc, iPixelFormat, nBytes, ppfd);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static int ChoosePixelFormat(IntPtr hdc, PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR ppfd)
		{
			return WGLImport.ChoosePixelFormat(hdc, ppfd);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static bool SetPixelFormat(IntPtr hdc, int iPixelFormat, PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR ppfd)
		{
			return WGLImport.SetPixelFormat(hdc, iPixelFormat, ppfd);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static bool SwapBuffers(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			return WGLImport.SwapBuffers(hdc);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static IntPtr CreateContext(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			return WGLImport.CreateContext(hdc);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static bool DeleteContext(IntPtr hglrc)
		{
			try
			{
				return WGLImport.DeleteContext(hglrc);
			}
			catch (AccessViolationException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		{

		}

namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design

	public class ChartItemSerializer : CodeDomSerializer
	{
		private CodeExpressionStatement SerializeSupportInitialize(string name, bool beginInit)
		{
			CodeVariableReferenceExpression expression = new CodeVariableReferenceExpression(name);
			CodeTypeReference targetType = new CodeTypeReference(typeof(ISupportInitialize));
			CodeCastExpression targetObject = new CodeCastExpression(targetType, expression);
			CodeMethodReferenceExpression method = new CodeMethodReferenceExpression(targetObject, beginInit ? "BeginInit" : "EndInit");
			CodeMethodInvokeExpression codeMethodInvokeExpression = new CodeMethodInvokeExpression();
			codeMethodInvokeExpression.Method = method;
			CodeExpressionStatement codeExpressionStatement = new CodeExpressionStatement(codeMethodInvokeExpression);
			codeExpressionStatement.UserData["statement-ordering"] = (beginInit ? "begin" : "end");
			return codeExpressionStatement;
		}

		private void SerializeMembers(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, CodeStatementCollection statements, object value)
		{
			SerializeProperties(manager, statements, value, null);
			SerializeEvents(manager, statements, value, (Attribute[])null);
		}

		public override object Serialize(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, object value)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("manager");
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			bool isComplete;
			CodeExpression codeExpression = SerializeCreationExpression(manager, value, out isComplete);
			if (codeExpression == null || isComplete)
			{
				return codeExpression;
			}
			bool flag = manager.Context[typeof(ExpressionContext)] is ExpressionContext expressionContext && expressionContext.PresetValue == value;
			CodeStatementCollection codeStatementCollection = new CodeStatementCollection();
			if (flag)
			{
				SetExpression(manager, value, codeExpression, isPreset: true);
				SerializeMembers(manager, codeStatementCollection, value);
			}
			else
			{
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(value);
				if (converter == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				InstanceDescriptor instanceDescriptor = (InstanceDescriptor)converter.ConvertTo(value, typeof(InstanceDescriptor));
				if (instanceDescriptor == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string uniqueName = GetUniqueName(manager, value);
				CodeVariableDeclarationStatement codeVariableDeclarationStatement = new CodeVariableDeclarationStatement(instanceDescriptor.MemberInfo.DeclaringType, uniqueName);
				codeVariableDeclarationStatement.InitExpression = codeExpression;
				codeStatementCollection.Add(codeVariableDeclarationStatement);
				SetExpression(manager, value, new CodeVariableReferenceExpression(uniqueName));
				ISupportInitialize supportInitialize = value as ISupportInitialize;
				if (supportInitialize != null)
				{
					codeStatementCollection.Add(SerializeSupportInitialize(uniqueName, beginInit: true));
				}
				SerializeMembers(manager, codeStatementCollection, value);
				if (supportInitialize != null)
				{
					codeStatementCollection.Add(SerializeSupportInitialize(uniqueName, beginInit: false));
				}
			}
			return codeStatementCollection;
		}
	}
	public class ChartCollectionSerializer : CollectionCodeDomSerializer
	{
		protected override object SerializeCollection(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, CodeExpression targetExpression, Type targetType, ICollection originalCollection, ICollection valuesToSerialize)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("manager");
			}
			if (targetType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("targetType");
			}
			if (originalCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("originalCollection");
			}
			if (valuesToSerialize == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("valuesToSerialize");
			}
			if (valuesToSerialize.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (originalCollection is SeriesPointCollection { Owner: not null } seriesPointCollection && !CommonUtils.IsUnboundMode(seriesPointCollection.Owner))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(originalCollection.Count);
			foreach (object item in originalCollection)
			{
				CodeExpression codeExpression = SerializeToExpression(manager, item);
				if (codeExpression != null)
				{
					arrayList.Add(codeExpression);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type reflectionType = TypeDescriptor.GetReflectionType(originalCollection);
			string text = ((reflectionType.GetMethod("ClearAndAddRange") == null) ? "AddRange" : "ClearAndAddRange");
			MethodInfo method = reflectionType.GetMethod(text, BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			if (method == null)
			{
				method = reflectionType.GetMethod(text, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			}
			if (method == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ParameterInfo[] parameters = method.GetParameters();
			if (parameters.Length != 1 || !parameters[0].ParameterType.IsArray)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CodeArrayCreateExpression codeArrayCreateExpression = new CodeArrayCreateExpression();
			codeArrayCreateExpression.CreateType = new CodeTypeReference(parameters[0].ParameterType.GetElementType());
			foreach (CodeExpression item2 in arrayList)
			{
				codeArrayCreateExpression.Initializers.Add(item2);
			}
			CodeMethodInvokeExpression codeMethodInvokeExpression = new CodeMethodInvokeExpression();
			codeMethodInvokeExpression.Method = new CodeMethodReferenceExpression(targetExpression, text);
			codeMethodInvokeExpression.Parameters.Add(codeArrayCreateExpression);
			return new CodeStatementCollection { codeMethodInvokeExpression };
		}
	}
	public class ChartDictionarySerializer : CodeDomSerializer
	{
		public override object Serialize(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is IDictionary { Count: not 0 } dictionary))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(manager.Context.Current is ExpressionContext expressionContext))
			{
				return null;
			}
			CodePropertyReferenceExpression codePropertyReferenceExpression = expressionContext.Expression as CodePropertyReferenceExpression;
			if (codePropertyReferenceExpression == null)
			{
				Type type = expressionContext.GetType();
				if (type.Name == "CodeValueExpression")
				{
					codePropertyReferenceExpression = type.InvokeMember("Expression", BindingFlags.GetProperty, null, expressionContext, null) as CodePropertyReferenceExpression;
					if (codePropertyReferenceExpression == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			CodeMethodReferenceExpression method = new CodeMethodReferenceExpression(codePropertyReferenceExpression, "Add");
			CodeStatementCollection codeStatementCollection = new CodeStatementCollection();
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in dictionary)
			{
				CodeMethodInvokeExpression codeMethodInvokeExpression = new CodeMethodInvokeExpression();
				codeMethodInvokeExpression.Method = method;
				codeMethodInvokeExpression.Parameters.Add(SerializeToExpression(manager, item.Key));
				codeMethodInvokeExpression.Parameters.Add(SerializeToExpression(manager, item.Value));
				codeStatementCollection.Add(codeMethodInvokeExpression);
			}
			return codeStatementCollection;
		}

		public override object Deserialize(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, object codeObject)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ChartElementPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		private readonly PropertyDescriptor defaultDescriptor;

		private readonly string typeConverterName;

		private TypeConverter typeConverter;

		private Attribute[] additionalAttributes;

		public override TypeConverter Converter
		{
			get
			{
				if (typeConverter == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeConverterName))
				{
					Type typeFromName = GetTypeFromName(typeConverterName);
					if (typeFromName != null)
					{
						typeConverter = CreateInstance(typeFromName) as TypeConverter;
					}
				}
				return typeConverter ?? defaultDescriptor.Converter;
			}
		}

		public override System.ComponentModel.AttributeCollection Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				System.ComponentModel.AttributeCollection attributeCollection = defaultDescriptor.Attributes;
				if (additionalAttributes == null)
				{
					return attributeCollection;
				}
				List<Attribute> list = new List<Attribute>(attributeCollection.Count + additionalAttributes.Length);
				foreach (Attribute item in attributeCollection)
				{
					Type type = item.GetType();
					bool flag = false;
					Attribute[] array = additionalAttributes;
					foreach (Attribute attribute2 in array)
					{
						if (attribute2.GetType() == type)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				list.AddRange(additionalAttributes);
				return new System.ComponentModel.AttributeCollection(list.ToArray());
			}
		}

		public override string Category => defaultDescriptor.Category;

		public override Type ComponentType => defaultDescriptor.ComponentType;

		public override string Description => defaultDescriptor.Description;

		public override bool DesignTimeOnly => defaultDescriptor.DesignTimeOnly;

		public override string DisplayName => defaultDescriptor.DisplayName;

		public override bool IsBrowsable => defaultDescriptor.IsBrowsable;

		public override bool IsLocalizable => defaultDescriptor.IsLocalizable;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => defaultDescriptor.IsReadOnly;

		public override string Name => defaultDescriptor.Name;

		public override Type PropertyType => defaultDescriptor.PropertyType;

		public static PropertyDescriptor GetValidPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor descriptor, object value)
		{
			if (value == null || descriptor is ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor)
			{
				return descriptor;
			}
			object[] customAttributes = value.GetType().GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TypeConverterAttribute), inherit: false);
			if (customAttributes.Length == 0)
			{
				return descriptor;
			}
			if (!(customAttributes[0] is TypeConverterAttribute typeConverterAttribute))
			{
				return descriptor;
			}
			return new ChartElementPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, typeConverterAttribute.ConverterTypeName);
		}

		public static PropertyDescriptor GetPropertyDescriptorWithAttributes(PropertyDescriptor descriptor, params Attribute[] additionalAttributes)
		{
			ChartElementPropertyDescriptor chartElementPropertyDescriptor = new ChartElementPropertyDescriptor(descriptor, string.Empty);
			chartElementPropertyDescriptor.additionalAttributes = additionalAttributes;
			return chartElementPropertyDescriptor;
		}

		private ChartElementPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor descriptor, string typeConverterName)
			: base(descriptor)
		{
			defaultDescriptor = descriptor;
			this.typeConverterName = typeConverterName;
		}

		public override void AddValueChanged(object component, EventHandler handler)
		{
			defaultDescriptor.AddValueChanged(component, handler);
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			return defaultDescriptor.CanResetValue(component);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return defaultDescriptor.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetChildProperties(object instance, Attribute[] filter)
		{
			return defaultDescriptor.GetChildProperties(instance, filter);
		}

		public override object GetEditor(Type editorBaseType)
		{
			if (additionalAttributes != null)
			{
				Attribute[] array = additionalAttributes;
				foreach (Attribute attribute in array)
				{
					if (!(attribute is EditorAttribute editorAttribute))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (editorBaseType != null)
					{
						string editorBaseTypeName = editorAttribute.EditorBaseTypeName;
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(editorBaseTypeName))
						{
							Type knownUserType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownUserType(editorBaseTypeName, false);
							if (knownUserType != editorBaseType)
							{
								continue;
							}
						}
					}
					string editorTypeName = editorAttribute.EditorTypeName;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(editorTypeName))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Type knownUserType2 = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownUserType(editorTypeName, false);
					if (knownUserType2 != null)
					{
						object obj = Activator.CreateInstance(knownUserType2);
						if (obj != null)
						{
							return obj;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return defaultDescriptor.GetEditor(editorBaseType);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return defaultDescriptor.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			return defaultDescriptor.GetValue(component);
		}

		public override void RemoveValueChanged(object component, EventHandler handler)
		{
			defaultDescriptor.RemoveValueChanged(component, handler);
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
			defaultDescriptor.ResetValue(component);
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			defaultDescriptor.SetValue(component, value);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			return defaultDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(component);
		}
	}

		object ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetEditor(Type editorBaseType)
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetEditor(obj, editorBaseType);
		}

		System.ComponentModel.AttributeCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetAttributes()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetAttributes(obj);
		}

		TypeConverter ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetConverter()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(obj);
		}

		EventDescriptor ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetDefaultEvent()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetDefaultEvent(obj);
		}

		PropertyDescriptor ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetDefaultProperty()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetDefaultProperty(obj);
		}

		EventDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetEvents()
		{
			return EventDescriptorCollection.Empty;
		}

		EventDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetEvents(Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return EventDescriptorCollection.Empty;
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetProperties()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj);
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetProperties(Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj, attributes);
		}

		object ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetPropertyOwner(PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			return obj;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
	public static class FilterPropertiesUtils
	{
		public static readonly string[] ConnectorProperties = new string[4] { "LineLength", "LineVisibility", "LineColor", "LineStyle" };

		public static PropertyDescriptorCollection FilterProperties(PropertyDescriptorCollection properties, IList<string> names)
		{
			if (names.Count == 0)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in properties)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (string name in names)
				{
					if (property.Name == name)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					list.Add(property);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		public static PropertyDescriptorCollection FilterSeriesLabelConnectorProperties(PropertyDescriptorCollection properties)
		{
			return FilterProperties(properties, ConnectorProperties);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesLabelBaseTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		protected const string anglePropertyName = "Angle";

		protected abstract Type LabelType { get; }

		protected virtual List<string> GetFilteredProperties(SeriesLabelBase label)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (label != null && label.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.JustifyAllAroundPoint)
			{
				list.AddRange(new string[1] { "Angle" });
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			SeriesLabelBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesLabelBase>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[properties.Count];
			properties.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array), GetFilteredProperties(element));
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
			return new InstanceDescriptor(LabelType.GetConstructor(new Type[0]), null, isComplete: false);
		}
	}

	public class PieSeriesLabelTypeConverter : SeriesLabelBaseTypeConverter
	{
		protected override Type LabelType => typeof(PieSeriesLabel);

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			PieSeriesLabel element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<PieSeriesLabel>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return propertyDescriptorCollection;
			}
			if (element.Position == PieSeriesLabelPosition.Inside)
			{
				propertyDescriptorCollection = FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterSeriesLabelConnectorProperties(propertyDescriptorCollection);
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (element.Position != PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns)
			{
				list.Add("ColumnIndent");
			}
			if (!element.ResolveOverlappingSupported)
			{
				list.Add("ResolveOverlappingMode");
				list.Add("ResolveOverlappingMinIndent");
			}
			propertyDescriptorCollection = FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(propertyDescriptorCollection, list);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in propertyDescriptorCollection)
			{
				if (item.Name == "Position" && PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(element.SeriesBase.View.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions, element.SeriesBase))
				{
					list2.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list2.ToArray());
		}
	}

					filteredProperties.Add("MinValueAngle");
					filteredProperties.Add("MaxValueAngle");
				}
			}
