	public class ScaleOptionBaseConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		private PropertyDescriptorCollection ApplyReadOnlyFilter(PropertyDescriptorCollection sourceCollection, ScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions)
		{
			string[] readOnlyProperties = GetReadOnlyProperties(scaleOptions);
			if (readOnlyProperties.Length == 0)
			{
				return sourceCollection;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in sourceCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				string[] array = readOnlyProperties;
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					if (item.Name == text)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		protected bool CheckIsAxisX(AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				return !axis.IsValuesAxis;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual string[] GetAutomaticModeFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected virtual string[] GetManualModeFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected virtual string[] GetContinuousModeFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected virtual string[] GetAdditionalFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected virtual string[] GetPolarFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected virtual string[] GetReadOnlyProperties(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			ScaleOptionsBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<ScaleOptionsBase>(value);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (!CheckIsAxisX(element.Axis))
				{
					list.Add("ScaleMode");
					list.Add("ProcessMissingPoints");
					list.Add("SkipRangesWithoutPoints");
				}
				if (element.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.Continuous)
				{
					list.Add("ProcessMissingPoints");
					list.Add("AggregateFunction");
					list.Add("SkipRangesWithoutPoints");
				}
				switch (element.ScaleMode)
				{
				case ScaleMode.Automatic:
					list.AddRange(GetAutomaticModeFilter(element));
					break;
				case ScaleMode.Manual:
					list.AddRange(GetManualModeFilter(element));
					break;
				case ScaleMode.Continuous:
					list.AddRange(GetContinuousModeFilter(element));
					break;
				}
				list.AddRange(GetAdditionalFilter(element));
				if (element.Axis is PolarAxisX)
				{
					list.AddRange(GetPolarFilter(element));
				}
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection sourceCollection = FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, list);
			return ApplyReadOnlyFilter(sourceCollection, element);
		}
	}
	public class NumericScaleOptionsTypeConverter : ScaleOptionBaseConverter
	{
		protected override string[] GetAutomaticModeFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[4] { "GridAlignment", "MeasureUnit", "CustomGridAlignment", "CustomMeasureUnit" };
		}

		protected override string[] GetManualModeFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			if (!CheckIsAxisX(options.Axis))
			{
				return new string[2] { "MeasureUnit", "CustomMeasureUnit" };
			}
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected override string[] GetContinuousModeFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[2] { "MeasureUnit", "CustomMeasureUnit" };
		}

		protected override string[] GetPolarFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			return new string[5] { "AutoGrid", "GridSpacing", "GridOffset", "GridAlignment", "CustomGridAlignment" };
		}

		protected override string[] GetAdditionalFilter(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			NumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions = (NumericScaleOptions)options;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (numericScaleOptions.GridAlignment != NumericGridAlignment.Custom)
			{
				list.Add("CustomGridAlignment");
			}
			if (numericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit != NumericMeasureUnit.Custom)
			{
				list.Add("CustomMeasureUnit");
			}
			if (numericScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleMode.Interval)
			{
				list.Add("IntervalOptions");
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			NumericIntervalOptions element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<NumericIntervalOptions>(value);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (element != null)

				switch (element.DivisionMode)
				{
				case IntervalDivisionMode.Width:

				case IntervalDivisionMode.Auto:
					list.AddRange(new string[2] { "Width", "Count" });
					break;
				}
			}
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, list);
		}

	public class BarSeriesLabelPositionTypeConverter : EnumTypeConverter
	{
		public BarSeriesLabelPositionTypeConverter(Type type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		public override TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection standardValues = ((EnumConverter)this).GetStandardValues(context);
			BarSeriesLabel element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<BarSeriesLabel>(context.Instance);
			if (element == null || element.SeriesBase == null || !(element.SeriesBase.View is StackedBarSeriesView))
			{
				return standardValues;
			}
			List<BarSeriesLabelPosition> list = new List<BarSeriesLabelPosition>();
			foreach (BarSeriesLabelPosition value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(BarSeriesLabelPosition)))
			{
				if (value != BarSeriesLabelPosition.Top && value != BarSeriesLabelPosition.Auto)
				{
					list.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return new TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}
	}
	public class ChartDesignHelper
	{
		public const string ChartItemSerializerTypeName = "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartItemSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2";

		public const string ChartCollectionSerializerTypeName = "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartCollectionSerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2";

		public const string ChartDictionarySerializerTypeName = "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartDictionarySerializer,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2";

		private static void SelectHitTestable(IChartContainer container, ChartElement element)
		{
			for (ChartElement chartElement = element; chartElement != null; chartElement = chartElement.Owner)
			{
				if (chartElement is IHitTest)
				{
					SelectObject(container.Chart, chartElement);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SelectHitTestable(IChartContainer container, ChartCollectionBase collection)
		{
			SelectHitTestable(container, collection.Owner);
		}

		public static void SelectOwnerHitTestable(IChartContainer container, ChartElement element)
		{
			SelectHitTestable(container, element.Owner);
		}

		public static T GetOwner<T>(ChartElement element) where T : ChartElement
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ChartElement chartElement = element;
			do
			{
				chartElement = chartElement.Owner;
				if (chartElement is T)
				{
					return (T)chartElement;
				}
			}
			while (chartElement != null);
			return null;
		}

		public static object GetField(Type type, object obj, string name)
		{
			FieldInfo fieldInfo = NativeField.Ensure(type, name);
			if (fieldInfo == null)
			{
				throw new MemberAccessException(name);
			}
			return fieldInfo.GetValue(obj);
		}

		public static object InvokeMethod(object obj, string name, object[] parameters)
		{
			MethodInfo method = obj.GetType().GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.InvokeMethod);
			if (method == null)
			{
				throw new MemberAccessException(name);
			}
			return method.Invoke(obj, parameters);
		}

		public static void SelectObject(DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart, object obj)
		{
			if (chart != null)
			{
				if (obj == null || obj == chart || !chart.Contains(obj))
				{
					chart.SelectHitElement(chart);
					obj = chart.Container;
				}
				else
				{
					chart.SelectHitElement((IHitTest)obj);
				}
				chart.ContainerAdapter.OnObjectSelected(new HotTrackEventArgs(obj, null, null));
			}
		}

		public static void PopulateDataSource(IDesignTimeDataProvider provider)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VS2005ConnectionStringHelper val = new VS2005ConnectionStringHelper();
			try
			{
				val.PatchConnectionString(provider.DataAdapter);
				provider.FillDataSource();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static void InitializeDefaultGanttScaleType(SeriesBase series)
		{
			if (series.View is GanttSeriesView)
			{
				series.ValueScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesViewTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		protected abstract Type ViewType { get; }

		protected virtual bool IsComplete => false;

		protected virtual Type[] GetConstructorParamsType(object value)
		{
			return new Type[0];
		}

		protected virtual object[] GetConstructorParams(object value)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is SeriesViewBase)
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = ViewType.GetConstructor(GetConstructorParamsType(value));
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, GetConstructorParams(value), IsComplete);
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			SeriesViewBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesViewBase>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties2 = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties2.Count);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties2)
			{
				if (item.Name == "Colorizer")
				{
					if (element.IsSupportColorizer)
					{
						list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetValidPropertyDescriptor(item, element.Colorizer as ChartColorizerBase));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (element.ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WinControl)
			{
				return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray()), new List<string> { "RangeControlOptions", "Animation", "SeriesPointAnimation", "SeriesAnimation" });
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}
	}

	public abstract class PieSeriesViewBaseTypeConverter : SeriesViewTypeConverter
	{
		protected override Type[] GetConstructorParamsType(object value)
		{
			if (((PieSeriesViewBase)value).ShouldSerializeExplodedPoints)
			{
				return new Type[1] { typeof(int[]) };
			}
			return base.GetConstructorParamsType(value);
		}

		protected override object[] GetConstructorParams(object value)
		{
			PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase = (PieSeriesViewBase)value;
			if (pieSeriesViewBase.ShouldSerializeExplodedPoints)
			{
				return new object[1] { pieSeriesViewBase.ExplodedPoints.GetPointIds() };
			}
			return base.GetConstructorParams(value);
		}

		protected virtual PropertyDescriptorCollection FilterProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] propertyDescriptors, PieSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(propertyDescriptors);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			PieSeriesViewBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<PieSeriesViewBase>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				if (item.Name == "Titles" && PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(element.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions, element.Owner as SeriesBase))
				{
					list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
				}
				else if (item.Name == "ExplodedPointsFilters")
				{
					if (element.ExplodeMode == PieExplodeMode.UseFilters)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return FilterProperties(list.ToArray(), element);
		}
	}

		{
			return view.BarDepthAuto;

		{
			return !view.IsFlatTopModel;
		}

		private static List<string> GetFilteredProperties(object value)
		{
			Bar3DSeriesView element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<Bar3DSeriesView>(value);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (element == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (ShouldHideBarDepthProperty(element))
			{
				list.Add("BarDepth");
			}
			if (ShouldHideShowFacetProperty(element))
			{
				list.Add("ShowFacet");
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, GetFilteredProperties(value));
		}
	}

	public class ChartTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			object element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement(value);
			DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart chart = element as DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart;
			if (chart == null && element is IChartContainer chartContainer)
			{
				chart = chartContainer.Chart;
			}
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				switch (item.Name)
				{
				case "SeriesSelectionMode":
					if (chart.SelectionMode != ElementSelectionMode.None)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "SeriesDataMember":
				{
					PivotGridDataSourceOptions pivotGridDataSourceOptions = chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions;
					if (pivotGridDataSourceOptions.HasDataSource && pivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoBindingSettingsEnabled)
					{
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				}
				case "Diagram":
					list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetValidPropertyDescriptor(item, chart.Diagram));
					break;
				case "AnimationStartMode":
					if (chart.Container != null && chart.Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WinControl && !chart.Is3DDiagram)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "CalculatedFields":
					if (chart.Container != null && chart.Container.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				default:
					list.Add(item);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}
	}
	public class PivotGridDataSourceOptionsTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			if (!(value is PivotGridDataSourceOptions pivotGridDataSourceOptions))
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (pivotGridDataSourceOptions.HasPivotGrid)
			{
				if (!pivotGridDataSourceOptions.PivotGrid.SelectionSupported)
				{
					list.Add("SelectionOnly");
					list.Add("UpdateDelay");
				}
				else if (!pivotGridDataSourceOptions.PivotGrid.SelectionOnly)
				{
					list.Add("UpdateDelay");
				}
				if (!pivotGridDataSourceOptions.PivotGrid.SinglePageSupported)
				{
					list.Add("SinglePageOnly");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add("RetrieveDataByColumns");
				list.Add("RetrieveEmptyCells");
				list.Add("SelectionOnly");
				list.Add("SinglePageOnly");
				list.Add("RetrieveColumnTotals");
				list.Add("RetrieveColumnGrandTotals");
				list.Add("RetrieveColumnCustomTotals");
				list.Add("RetrieveRowTotals");
				list.Add("RetrieveRowGrandTotals");
				list.Add("RetrieveRowCustomTotals");
				list.Add("MaxAllowedSeriesCount");
				list.Add("MaxAllowedPointCountInSeries");
				list.Add("UpdateDelay");
			}
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, list.ToArray());
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseFilterConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private bool isLocalDataContext;

		private XRDataContextBase dataContext;

		private static ISeriesProvider GetSeriesProvider(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			ISeriesProvider result = null;
			if (context.Instance is ISeriesProvider)
			{
				result = (ISeriesProvider)context.Instance;
			}
			else if (context.Instance is FakeComponent)
			{
				result = ((FakeComponent)context.Instance).Object as ISeriesProvider;
			}
			else if (context.Instance is IChartElementDesignerModel)
			{
				result = ((IChartElementDesignerModel)context.Instance).SourceElement as ISeriesProvider;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected static SeriesBase GetSeries(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return GetSeriesProvider(context)?.Series;
		}

		private void EnsureDataContext(SeriesBase series)
		{
			ref XRDataContextBase reference = ref dataContext;
			DataContextBase chartDataContext = series.GetChartDataContext();
			reference = (XRDataContextBase)(object)((chartDataContext is XRDataContextBase) ? chartDataContext : null);
			if (dataContext == null)
			{
				dataContext = (XRDataContextBase)(object)new ChartDataContext(null);
				isLocalDataContext = true;
			}
		}

		private void ClearDataContext()
		{
			if (isLocalDataContext)
			{
				((DataContextBase)dataContext).Dispose();
				dataContext = null;
			}
		}

		protected string ConvertToDisplayNames(SeriesBase series, string value)
		{
			EnsureDataContext(series);
			string result = CriteriaFieldNameConverterCore.Convert(value, (Func<string, string>)((string name) => FieldNameTransformer.GetLongFieldDisplayName(dataContext, series.GetDataSource(), series.GetChartDataMember(), name)));
			ClearDataContext();
			return result;
		}

		protected string ConvertFromDisplayNames(SeriesBase series, string value)
		{
			EnsureDataContext(series);
			string result = CriteriaFieldNameConverterCore.Convert(value, (Func<string, string>)((string name) => FieldNameTransformer.GetLongFieldRealName(dataContext, series.GetDataSource(), series.GetChartDataMember(), name)));
			ClearDataContext();
			return result;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return destinationType == typeof(string);
		}
	}
	public class FilterStringTypeConverter : BaseFilterConverter
	{
		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			SeriesBase series = BaseFilterConverter.GetSeries(context);
			if (value != null && series != null)
			{
				return ConvertFromDisplayNames(series, (string)value);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			SeriesBase series = BaseFilterConverter.GetSeries(context);
			if (value != null && series != null)
			{
				string text = ConvertToDisplayNames(series, (string)value);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class FilterCriteriaTypeConverter : BaseFilterConverter
	{
		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			SeriesBase series = BaseFilterConverter.GetSeries(context);
			if (value != null && series != null)
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.Parse(ConvertFromDisplayNames(series, (string)value), (object[])null);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SeriesBase series = BaseFilterConverter.GetSeries(context);
			if (value != null && series != null)
			{
				string text = ConvertToDisplayNames(series, ((object)(CriteriaOperator)value).ToString());
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class AxisBaseTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		private static List<string> GetFilteredProperties(object value)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			AxisBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<AxisBase>(value);
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
				{
					list.Add("QualitativeScaleOptions");
				}
				if (element.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
				{
					list.AddRange(new string[3] { "NumericOptions", "Logarithmic", "NumericScaleOptions" });
				}
				if (element.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical || !element.Logarithmic)
				{
					list.Add("LogarithmicBase");
				}
				if (element.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
				{
					list.AddRange(new string[1] { "TimeSpanScaleOptions" });
				}
				if (element.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					if (element is AxisXBase axisXBase && (axisXBase.ScrollingZoomingEnabled || (axisXBase.Diagram != null && axisXBase.Diagram is GanttDiagram)))
					{
						list.Add("DateTimeScaleMode");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(new string[2] { "DateTimeScaleMode", "DateTimeScaleOptions" });
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, GetFilteredProperties(value));
		}
	}

	public class DateTimeOptionsTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			DateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions = null;
			if (value is DateTimeOptions)
			{
				dateTimeOptions = (DateTimeOptions)value;
			}
			else if (value is FakeComponent)
			{
				dateTimeOptions = ((FakeComponent)value).Object as DateTimeOptions;
			}
			if (dateTimeOptions == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				if (item.Name == "FormatString")
				{
					if (dateTimeOptions.Format == DateTimeFormat.Custom)
					{
						if (dateTimeOptions.AllowDesignTimeEditing())
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
						}
					}
				}
				else if (item.Name == "Format" && !dateTimeOptions.AllowDesignTimeEditing())
				{
					list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}
	}

	public class TopNOptionsTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		private const string ModePropertyName = "Mode";

		private const string CountPropertyName = "Count";

		private const string ThresholdValuePropertyName = "ThresholdValue";

		private const string ThresholdPercentPropertyName = "ThresholdPercent";

		private const string ShowOthersPropertyName = "ShowOthers";

		private const string OthersArgumentPropertyName = "OthersArgument";

		private List<string> GetFilteredProperties(object value)
		{
			TopNOptions element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<TopNOptions>(value);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element.Enabled)
				{
					switch (element.Mode)
					{
					case TopNMode.Count:
						list.AddRange(new string[2] { "ThresholdValue", "ThresholdPercent" });
						break;
					case TopNMode.ThresholdValue:
						list.AddRange(new string[2] { "Count", "ThresholdPercent" });
						break;
					case TopNMode.ThresholdPercent:
						list.AddRange(new string[2] { "Count", "ThresholdValue" });
						break;
					}
					if (element.Owner is SeriesBase { ShouldUseTopNOthers: false })
					{
						list.AddRange(new string[2] { "ShowOthers", "OthersArgument" });
					}
					else if (!element.ShowOthers)
					{
						list.Add("OthersArgument");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(new string[6] { "Mode", "Count", "ThresholdValue", "ThresholdPercent", "ShowOthers", "OthersArgument" });
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes), GetFilteredProperties(value));
		}
	}

	public class LegendTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			LegendBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<LegendBase>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				switch (item.Name)
				{
				case "EquallySpacedItems":
					if (element.Direction != LegendDirection.TopToBottom && element.Direction != LegendDirection.BottomToTop)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "MaxVerticalPercentage":
				case "MaxHorizontalPercentage":
					if (element.Chart != null && element.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.HasDataSource && element.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled)
					{
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "Visible":
					if (element.Chart != null && PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabledForSimpleView(element.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions))
					{
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "UseCheckBoxes":
					if (element.Chart != null && element.Chart.Container.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "MaxCrosshairContentWidth":
				case "MaxCrosshairContentHeight":
				case "CrosshairContentOffset":
					if (element.Chart != null && element.Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				default:
					list.Add(item);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(Legend).GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, null, isComplete: false);
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class PointOptionsTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			PointOptions pointOptions = null;
			if (value is PointOptions)
			{
				pointOptions = (PointOptions)value;
			}
			else if (value is FakeComponent)
			{
				pointOptions = ((FakeComponent)value).Object as PointOptions;
			}
			if (pointOptions == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				switch (item.Name)
				{
				case "ArgumentNumericOptions":
					if (pointOptions.SeriesBase.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ArgumentDateTimeOptions":
					if (pointOptions.SeriesBase.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ArgumentTimeSpanOptions":
					if (pointOptions.SeriesBase.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ValueNumericOptions":
					if (pointOptions.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ValueDateTimeOptions":
					if (pointOptions.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ValueTimeSpanOptions":
					if (pointOptions.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "PointView":
				{
					SeriesBase seriesBase = pointOptions.SeriesBase;
					if (seriesBase != null && PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabledForSimpleView(seriesBase.View.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions, seriesBase))
					{
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					list.Add(item);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PointOptions).GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, null, isComplete: false);
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			RangePointOptions rangePointOptions = null;
			if (value is RangePointOptions)
			{
				rangePointOptions = (RangePointOptions)value;
			}
			else if (value is FakeComponent)
			{
				rangePointOptions = ((FakeComponent)value).Object as RangePointOptions;
			}
			if (rangePointOptions == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (rangePointOptions.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType != ScaleType.DateTime && rangePointOptions.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType != ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				list.Add("ValueDurationFormat");
			}
			else if (rangePointOptions.ValueAsDuration)
			{
				list.Add((rangePointOptions.SeriesBase.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime) ? "ValueDateTimeOptions" : "ValueTimeSpanOptions");
				if (rangePointOptions.ValueDurationFormat != TimeSpanFormat.Standard)
				{
					list.Remove("ValueNumericOptions");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add("ValueDurationFormat");
			}
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, list);
		}
	}

	public class ValueScaleTypeTypeConverter : EnumTypeConverter
	{
		public ValueScaleTypeTypeConverter()
			: base(typeof(ScaleType))
		{
		}

		public override TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection standardValues = ((EnumConverter)this).GetStandardValues(context);
			if (context == null)
			{
				return standardValues;
			}
			SeriesBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesBase>(context.Instance);
			bool flag = element == null || element.View == null || element.View.DateTimeValuesSupported;
			List<ScaleType> list = new List<ScaleType>();
			foreach (ScaleType item in standardValues)
			{
				if (item == ScaleType.Numerical || ((item == ScaleType.DateTime || item == ScaleType.TimeSpan) && flag))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return new TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}
	}

	public class SeriesPointKeyConverter : EnumTypeConverter
	{
		private string[] GetNames(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			if (context == null || context.Instance == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement(context.Instance);
			SeriesBase seriesBase = element as SeriesBase;
			if (seriesBase == null && element is SeriesPointFilter seriesPointFilter)
			{
				seriesBase = seriesPointFilter.Series;
			}
			if (seriesBase == null || seriesBase.View == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = new string[seriesBase.View.PointDimension + 1];
			array[0] = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ArgumentMember);
			for (int i = 1; i <= seriesBase.View.PointDimension; i++)
			{
				array[i] = seriesBase.View.GetValueCaption(i - 1);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public SeriesPointKeyConverter()
			: base(typeof(SeriesPointKey))
		{
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return context != null;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			List<SeriesPointKey> list = new List<SeriesPointKey>();
			for (int i = 0; i < GetNames(context).Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add((SeriesPointKey)i);
			}
			return new TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is SeriesPointKey && destinationType == typeof(string) && context != null)
			{
				string[] names = GetNames(context);
				if (names != null)
				{
					return names[(int)value];
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return ((EnumTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return ((EnumConverter)this).CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string[] names = GetNames(context);
				SeriesPointKey result;
				if (names != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
					{
						if (names[i] == text)
						{
							return (SeriesPointKey)i;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (Enum.TryParse<SeriesPointKey>(text, out result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return ((EnumTypeConverter)this).ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}
	}
	public abstract class PaletteTypeConverterBase : TypeConverter
	{
		private string[] GetStandardValues(PaletteRepository paletteRepository)
		{
			return paletteRepository.PaletteNames;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			PaletteRepository paletteRepository = GetPaletteRepository(context.Instance, null);
			if (paletteRepository != null)
			{
				return new StandardValuesCollection(GetStandardValues(paletteRepository));
			}
			return base.GetStandardValues(context);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is string name && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = context.PropertyDescriptor;
				PaletteRepository paletteRepository = GetPaletteRepository(context.Instance, propertyDescriptor);
				if (paletteRepository != null && propertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					return GetDisplayName(name, paletteRepository);
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		private static string GetDisplayName(string name, PaletteRepository repository)
		{
			if (DXDisplayNameAttribute.UseResourceManager)
			{
				return repository[name].DisplayName;
			}
			return repository[name].Name;
		}

		protected abstract PaletteRepository GetPaletteRepository(object instance, PropertyDescriptor pd);
	}
	public class PaletteTypeConverter : PaletteTypeConverterBase
	{
		protected override PaletteRepository GetPaletteRepository(object instance, PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			if (instance is IChartContainer chartContainer && pd != null)
			{
				if (pd == null || !(pd.Name == "IndicatorsPaletteName"))
				{
					return chartContainer.Chart.PaletteRepository;
				}
				return chartContainer.Chart.IndicatorsPaletteRepository;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		}

	public abstract class Diagram3DTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			Diagram3D element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<Diagram3D>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (element.RotationType != RotationType.UseAngles)
			{
				list.AddRange(new string[4] { "RotationAngleX", "RotationAngleY", "RotationAngleZ", "RotationOrder" });
			}
			if (element.ChartContainer == null || element.ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WinControl)
			{
				list.AddRange(new string[6] { "RuntimeRotation", "RuntimeZooming", "RuntimeScrolling", "ScrollingOptions", "ZoomingOptions", "RotationOptions" });
			}
			else
			{
				if (!element.RuntimeScrolling)
				{
					list.Add("ScrollingOptions");
				}
				if (!element.RuntimeZooming)
				{
					list.Add("ZoomingOptions");
				}
				if (!element.RuntimeRotation)
				{
					list.Add("RotationOptions");
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, list.ToArray());
			}
			return properties;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisValueTypeConverterBase : StringConverter
	{
		protected abstract AxisBase GetAxis(ITypeDescriptorContext context);

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			return GetAxis(context).ConvertBasedOnScaleType(value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string) && value is DateTime)
			{
				AxisBase axis = GetAxis(context);
				if (axis != null)
				{
					PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(axis.ActualLabel.ActualTextPattern, axis.ActualLabel);
					patternParser.SetContext(value);
					return patternParser.GetText();
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class AxisValueTypeConverter : AxisValueTypeConverterBase
	{
		protected override AxisBase GetAxis(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			object element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement(context.Instance);
			if (!(element is IAxisValueContainer axisValueContainer))
			{
				if (element is AxisRange axisRange)
				{
					return (AxisBase)axisRange.Owner;
				}
				if (element is AxisCoordinate axisCoordinate)
				{
					return axisCoordinate.ActualAxis;
				}
			}
			else if (axisValueContainer.Axis != null)
			{
				return (AxisBase)axisValueContainer.Axis;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

			{
				FinancialIndicatorPoint element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<FinancialIndicatorPoint>(context.Instance);
				if (element != null)
				{
					SeriesBase seriesBase = (SeriesBase)element.Owner.Owner.Owner;
					string format = "G";
					if (seriesBase.Label != null)
					{
						format = PatternUtils.GetArgumentFormat(seriesBase.Label.ActualTextPattern);
					}
					return PatternUtils.Format(value, format);
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class ScaleBreakEdgeTypeConverter : AxisValueTypeConverterBase
	{
		protected override AxisBase GetAxis(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<ScaleBreak>(context.Instance)?.Axis;
		}
	}
	public class RangeValueTypeConverter : StringConverter
	{
		private RangeDataBase GetRangeData(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<Range>(context.Instance)?.RangeData;
		}

		private void ThrowIncorrectPropertyValueException(object propertyValue, string propertyName)
		{
			string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPropertyValue), (propertyValue == null) ? string.Empty : propertyValue.ToString(), propertyName);
			throw new ArgumentException(message);
		}

		private object ConvertToNativeValue(IAxisData axis, object value, string propertyName)
		{
			CultureInfo currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			if (value == null)
			{
				ThrowIncorrectPropertyValueException(value, propertyName);
			}
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			object obj = axisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, currentCulture);
			if (!axisScaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(obj))
			{
				ThrowIncorrectPropertyValueException(value, propertyName);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			RangeDataBase rangeData = GetRangeData(context);
			IAxisData axis = rangeData.Axis;
			if (axis != null)
			{
				return ConvertToNativeValue(axis, value, context.PropertyDescriptor.Name);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				RangeDataBase rangeData = GetRangeData(context);
				IAxisData axis = rangeData.Axis;
				if (axis != null && value is DateTime)
				{
					PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(axis.Label.TextPattern, (IPatternHolder)axis.Label);
					patternParser.SetContext(value);
					return patternParser.GetText();
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisRangeValueTypeConverter : StringConverter
	{
		private IAxisData GetAxis(ITypeDescriptorContext context, out AxisRangeData data)
		{
			if (context.Instance is AxisRange axisRange)
			{
				data = axisRange.Data;
				return axisRange.Axis;
			}
			if (context.Instance is ScrollingRange scrollingRange)
			{
				data = scrollingRange.Data;
				return scrollingRange.Range.Axis;
			}
			data = null;
			return null;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			AxisRangeData data;
			IAxisData axis = GetAxis(context, out data);
			if (axis != null)
			{
				return data.ConvertToNativeValue(value, context.PropertyDescriptor.Name);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				AxisRangeData data;
				IAxisData axis = GetAxis(context, out data);
				if (axis != null)
				{
					if (!CanConvertFromNativeValue(data))
					{
						return "";
					}
					if (value is DateTime)
					{
						PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(axis.Label.TextPattern, (IPatternHolder)axis.Label);
						patternParser.SetContext(value);
						return patternParser.GetText();
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		protected abstract bool CanConvertFromNativeValue(AxisRangeData data);
	}
	public class AxisRangeMinValueTypeConverter : AxisRangeValueTypeConverter

	{
		public AxisAlignmentTypeConverter(Type type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		public override TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection standardValues = ((EnumConverter)this).GetStandardValues(context);
			Axis2D element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<Axis2D>(context.Instance);
			if (element == null || !element.ShouldFilterInnerAlignment)
			{
				return standardValues;
			}
			List<AxisAlignment> list = new List<AxisAlignment>(standardValues.Count);
			foreach (AxisAlignment item in standardValues)
			{
				if (item != AxisAlignment.Zero && item != AxisAlignment.Center)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return new TypeConverter.StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}

	public abstract class XYDiagram2DTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		protected abstract Type DiagramType { get; }

		private static IList<string> GetFilteredProperties(object value)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			XYDiagram2D element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<XYDiagram2D>(value);
			if (element != null && element.Chart != null && element.Chart.Container != null)
			{
				if (!element.Chart.SupportScrollingAndZooming)
				{
					list.AddRange(new string[7] { "EnableAxisXZooming", "EnableAxisYZooming", "EnableAxisXScrolling", "EnableAxisYScrolling", "ScrollingOptions", "ZoomingOptions", "SelectionOptions" });
				}
				else
				{
					if (!element.IsScrollingEnabled)
					{
						list.Add("ScrollingOptions");
					}
					if (!element.IsZoomingEnabled)
					{
						list.Add("ZoomingOptions");
					}
				}
				if (!element.ShowRangeControlDateTimeGridOptions)
				{
					list.Add("RangeControlDateTimeGridOptions");
				}
				if (!element.ShowRangeControlNumericGridOptions)
				{
					list.Add("RangeControlNumericGridOptions");
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(properties, GetFilteredProperties(value));
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
			return new InstanceDescriptor(DiagramType.GetConstructor(new Type[0]), null, isComplete: false);
		}
	}

	public class ValueDataMemberCollectionConverter : CollectionTypeConverter
	{
		protected class ValueDataMemberPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private readonly int index;

			public override Type ComponentType => typeof(ValueDataMemberCollection);

			public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

			public override Type PropertyType => typeof(string);

			public ValueDataMemberPropertyDescriptor(string name, int index)
				: base(name, new Attribute[1]
				{
					new EditorAttribute("DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.ChartDataMemberEditor,DevExpress.XtraCharts.v23.2.Wizard, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")
				})
			{
				this.index = index;
			}

			protected virtual void SetValueDataMember(object component, string dataMember, int valueIndex)
			{
				if (component is ValueDataMemberCollection valueDataMemberCollection)
				{
					valueDataMemberCollection[valueIndex] = dataMember;
				}
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				if (component is ValueDataMemberCollection valueDataMemberCollection)
				{
					return valueDataMemberCollection[index];
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				if (value is string dataMember)
				{
					SetValueDataMember(component, dataMember, index);
				}
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				if (component is ValueDataMemberCollection valueDataMemberCollection)
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueDataMemberCollection[index]);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				SetValueDataMember(component, string.Empty, index);
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual PropertyDescriptor CreateValuePropertyDescriptor(ITypeDescriptorContext context, string caption, int valueIndex)
		{
			return new ValueDataMemberPropertyDescriptor(caption, valueIndex);
		}

		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			if (context != null)
			{
				SeriesBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesBase>(context.Instance);
				if (element != null)
				{
					SeriesViewBase view = element.View;
					int pointDimension = view.PointDimension;
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[pointDimension];
					for (int i = 0; i < pointDimension; i++)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = CreateValuePropertyDescriptor(context, view.GetValueCaption(i), i);
						if (element.View.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.HasDataSource && element.View.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoBindingSettingsEnabled)
						{
							propertyDescriptor = new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(propertyDescriptor);
						}
						array[i] = propertyDescriptor;
					}
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
		}
	}
	public class ChartShortcutKeyCollectionConverter : LocalizableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		private readonly PortableKeysConverter converter = new PortableKeysConverter();

		public unsafe override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (value is IList<PortableKeys> list && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				{
					foreach (PortableKeys item in list)
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							text += ", ";
						}
						text += ((TypeConverter)(object)converter).ConvertTo(context, culture, (object)((object)(*(PortableKeys*)(&item))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString(), destinationType).ToString();
					}
					return text;
				}
			}
			return ((LocalizableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AnnotationTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		protected abstract Type AnnotationType { get; }

		private bool ShouldShowRuntimeProperties(Annotation annotation)
		{
			IChartContainer chartContainer = CommonUtils.FindChartContainer(annotation);
			if (!annotation.ActualLabelMode && chartContainer != null && chartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WinControl)
			{
				return !chartContainer.Chart.Is3DDiagram;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private List<string> GetFilteredProperties(Annotation annotation)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (annotation != null && annotation.ShapeKind != ShapeKind.RoundedRectangle)
			{
				list.Add("ShapeFillet");
			}
			if (!annotation.LabelModeSupported)
			{
				list.Add("LabelMode");
			}
			if (!ShouldShowRuntimeProperties(annotation))
			{
				list.AddRange(new string[4] { "RuntimeAnchoring", "RuntimeRotation", "RuntimeResizing", "RuntimeMoving" });
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			if (properties == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			Annotation element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<Annotation>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[properties.Count];
			properties.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return FilterPropertiesUtils.FilterProperties(new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array), GetFilteredProperties(element));
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
			return new InstanceDescriptor(AnnotationType.GetConstructor(new Type[0]), null, isComplete: false);
		}
	}

	public class AnnotationAnchorPointTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		private const string seriesPointPropertyName = "SeriesPoint";

		private Attribute[] GetAttributes(PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor)
		{
			Attribute[] array = new Attribute[propertyDescriptor.Attributes.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < propertyDescriptor.Attributes.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = propertyDescriptor.Attributes[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetSeriesPointAnchorPointProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[properties.Count];
			properties.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i].Name == "SeriesPoint")
				{
					array[i] = new SeriesPointPropertyDescriptor(array[i].Name, GetAttributes(array[i]));
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			if (value is SeriesPointAnchorPoint)
			{
				return GetSeriesPointAnchorPointProperties(context, value, attributes);
			}
			return ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
		}
	}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)(object)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			SeriesDataSourceColorizer element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesDataSourceColorizer>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			IChartContainer chartContainer = element.ChartContainer;
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				string name = item.Name;
				if (name == "DataSource")
				{
					if (chartContainer == null || chartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
					string typeName = "DevExpress.XtraReports.Design.DataSourceEditor,DevExpress.XtraReports.v23.2.Extensions";
					EditorAttribute editorAttribute = new EditorAttribute(typeName, "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a");
					list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetPropertyDescriptorWithAttributes(item, editorAttribute));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}
	}

	public interface IObjectValueTypeProvider
	{
		Type DataType { get; }
	}
	public class ObjectValueTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string)
			{
				if (context == null)
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (context.Instance != null && context.Instance is IObjectValueTypeProvider)
				{
					Type dataType = ((IObjectValueTypeProvider)context.Instance).DataType;
					if (dataType != null)
					{
						TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
						if (converter != null)
						{
							return converter.ConvertFrom(value);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}
	}
	public class DataTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private static readonly Type[] types = new Type[17]
		{
			typeof(bool),
			typeof(byte),
			typeof(char),
			typeof(DateTime),
			typeof(decimal),
			typeof(double),
			typeof(Guid),
			typeof(short),
			typeof(int),
			typeof(long),
			typeof(sbyte),
			typeof(float),
			typeof(string),
			typeof(TimeSpan),
			typeof(ushort),
			typeof(uint),
			typeof(ulong)
		};

		private readonly StandardValuesCollection values;

		public DataTypeConverter()
		{
			object[] destinationArray = new object[types.Length];
			Array.Copy(types, destinationArray, types.Length);
			values = new StandardValuesCollection(destinationArray);
		}

		private Type FindTypeByName(string name)
		{
			Type[] array = types;
			foreach (Type type in array)
			{
				if (type.ToString().Equals(name))
				{
					return type;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Type GetTypeFromValue(object value)
		{
			if (value is Type)
			{
				return (Type)value;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				return FindTypeByName((string)value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.GetType() != typeof(string))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			return FindTypeByName((string)value) ?? typeof(string);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return value.ToString();
			}
			if (value != null && destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				Type typeFromValue = GetTypeFromValue(value);
				if (typeFromValue != null)
				{
					MethodInfo method = typeof(Type).GetMethod("GetType", new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					return new InstanceDescriptor(method, new object[1] { typeFromValue.AssemblyQualifiedName });
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return values;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesBaseTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			SeriesBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesBase>(value);
			if (element == null || element.Owner == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				switch (item.Name)
				{
				case "Label":
					if (element.IsSupportedLabel)
					{
						list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetValidPropertyDescriptor(item, element.Label));
					}
					break;
				case "LabelsVisibility":
					if (element.IsSupportedLabel)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "View":
					list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetValidPropertyDescriptor(item, element.View));
					break;
				case "TopNOptions":
					if (element.ShouldApplyTopNOptions)
					{
						list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetValidPropertyDescriptor(item, element.TopNOptions));
					}
					break;
				case "ArgumentScaleType":
				case "ValueScaleType":
				case "ArgumentDataMember":
					if (PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoBindingSettingsUsed(element.ChartContainer.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions, element))
					{
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ShowInLegend":
					if (PivotGridDataSourceUtils.IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabledForSimpleView(element.View.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions))
					{
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "ValueDataMembers":
					if (!element.IsSummaryBinding)
					{
						if (value is SeriesBase)
						{
							list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetValidPropertyDescriptor(item, element.ValueDataMembers));
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					break;
				case "ToolTipHintDataMember":
				case "ToolTipSeriesPattern":
				case "ToolTipPointPattern":
				case "ToolTipEnabled":
					if (element.Owner != null && element.IsToolTipsSupported)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "CrosshairEnabled":
				case "CrosshairLabelPattern":
				case "CrosshairTextOptions":
					if (element.Owner != null && element.Chart.SupportCrosshair && element.View.IsSupportedCrosshair)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "CrosshairHighlightPoints":
					if (element.ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "FilterCriteria":
					if (element.ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "FilterString":
					if (element.ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "NumericSummaryOptions":
					if (element.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "DateTimeSummaryOptions":
					if (element.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "TimeSpanSummaryOptions":
					if (element.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "QualitativeSummaryOptions":
					if (element.ActualArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.Qualitative)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				default:
					list.Add(item);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}
	}

	public abstract class BaseSeriesTypeDescriptorProvider<TSeries> : TypeDescriptionProvider
	{
		private static readonly TypeDescriptionProvider defaultTypeProvider = TypeDescriptor.GetProvider(typeof(TSeries));

		protected BaseSeriesTypeDescriptorProvider()
			: base(defaultTypeProvider)
		{
		}

		public override ICustomTypeDescriptor GetTypeDescriptor(Type objectType, object instance)
		{
			ICustomTypeDescriptor typeDescriptor = base.GetTypeDescriptor(objectType, instance);
			SeriesBase element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<SeriesBase>(instance);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return typeDescriptor;
			}
			return new SeriesTypeDescriptor(typeDescriptor, instance, element);
		}
	}

	public class SeriesTypeDescriptor : CustomTypeDescriptor
	{
		private readonly SeriesBase series;

		private readonly object instance;

		public SeriesTypeDescriptor(ICustomTypeDescriptor defaultDescriptor, object instance, SeriesBase series)
			: base(defaultDescriptor)
		{
			this.instance = instance;
			this.series = series;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetPropertiesCore(PropertyDescriptorCollection properties)
		{
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in properties)
			{
				if (property.Name == "FilterString")
				{
					if (series != null && series.ChartContainer != null && series.ChartContainer.ControlType == ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						List<Attribute> list2 = new List<Attribute>();
						foreach (Attribute attribute in property.Attributes)
						{
							if (!(attribute is EditorBrowsableAttribute))
							{
								list2.Add(attribute);
							}
						}
						list2.Add(new EditorAttribute("DevExpress.XtraReports.Design.ChartSeriesFilterStringEditor,DevExpress.XtraReports.v23.2.Extensions", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a"));
						list.Add(TypeDescriptor.CreateProperty(instance.GetType(), property, list2.ToArray()));
						continue;
					}
					List<Attribute> list3 = new List<Attribute>();
					foreach (Attribute attribute2 in property.Attributes)
					{
						list3.Add(attribute2);
					}
					list3.Add(new BrowsableAttribute(browsable: false));
					list.Add(TypeDescriptor.CreateProperty(instance.GetType(), property, list3.ToArray()));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(property);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties()
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties();
			try
			{
				return GetPropertiesCore(properties);
			}
			catch
			{
				return properties;
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(attributes);
			try
			{
				return GetPropertiesCore(properties);
			}
			catch
			{
				return properties;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SeriesTypeConverter : SeriesBaseTypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
			return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(Series).GetConstructor(new Type[0]), null, isComplete: false);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			Series element = TypeConverterHelper.GetElement<Series>(value);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				switch (item.Name)
				{
				case "Points":
					if (context.Container != null)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				case "DataSource":
				{
					if (element.ChartContainer == null || element.ChartContainer.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl)
					{
						list.Add(item);
						break;
					}
					string typeName = "DevExpress.XtraReports.Design.DataSourceEditor,DevExpress.XtraReports.v23.2.Extensions";
					EditorAttribute editorAttribute = new EditorAttribute(typeName, "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a");
					list.Add(ChartElementPropertyDescriptor.GetPropertyDescriptorWithAttributes(item, editorAttribute));
					break;
				}
				case "ToolTipImage":
					if (element.Owner != null && element.IsToolTipsSupported)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				default:
					list.Add(item);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}
	}

	public static class TypeConverterHelper
	{
		public static TElement GetElement<TElement>(object value) where TElement : class
		{
			if (value is TElement)
			{
				return (TElement)value;
			}
			if (value is FakeComponent)
			{
				return ((FakeComponent)value).Object as TElement;
			}
			if (value is IChartElementDesignerModel)
			{
				return ((IChartElementDesignerModel)value).SourceElement as TElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object GetElement(object value)
		{
			if (value is FakeComponent)
			{
				return ((FakeComponent)value).Object;
			}
			if (value is IChartElementDesignerModel)
			{
				return ((IChartElementDesignerModel)value).SourceElement;
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class TaskLinkTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = GetConstructorInfo(value);
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructorInfo, GetConstructorParams(value), isComplete: true);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		private ConstructorInfo GetConstructorInfo(object value)
		{
			TaskLink taskLink = (TaskLink)value;
			if (!taskLink.ShouldSerializeLinkType())
			{
				return typeof(TaskLink).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(int) });
			}
			return typeof(TaskLink).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(int),
				typeof(TaskLinkType)
			});
		}

		private object[] GetConstructorParams(object value)
		{
			TaskLink taskLink = (TaskLink)value;
			List<object> list = new List<object> { taskLink.ChildPointID };
			if (taskLink.ShouldSerializeLinkType())
			{
				list.Add(taskLink.LinkType);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

	public class DataFilterTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{

		protected Type[] ConstructorParameterTypes => new Type[4]

			typeof(string),
			typeof(string),
			typeof(DataFilterCondition),
			typeof(object)
		};

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)

				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);

		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{

				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, GetConstructorParams((DataFilter)value), isComplete: true);
			}

		}

		protected object[] GetConstructorParams(DataFilter value)

			return new object[4] { value.ActualColumnName, text, value.Condition, value.Value };
