	public class SeriesPointTypeConverter : LocalizableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		private object GetArgument(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return ((point.Series != null) ? point.Series.ActualArgumentScaleType : point.ArgumentScaleType) switch
			{
				ScaleType.Numerical => point.NumericalArgument, 
				ScaleType.DateTime => point.DateTimeArgument, 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => point.TimeSpanArgument, 
				_ => point.Argument, 
			};
		}

		private MethodBase GetCreatorInfo(object value)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)value;
			if (seriesPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!seriesPoint.ShouldSerializeSeriesPointIDInternal())
				{
					return typeof(SeriesPoint).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(object) });
				}
				return typeof(SeriesPoint).GetConstructor(new Type[3]
				{
					typeof(object),
					typeof(object[]),
					typeof(int)
				});
			}
			if (!seriesPoint.ShouldSerializeSeriesPointIDInternal())
			{
				return typeof(SeriesPoint).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(object),
					typeof(object[])
				});
			}
			return typeof(SeriesPoint).GetConstructor(new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(object),
				typeof(object[]),
				typeof(int)
			});
		}

		private object GetPointValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			object[] array;
			if (point.ShouldSerializeDateTimeValuesInternal())
			{
				array = new object[point.DateTimeValues.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = point.DateTimeValues[i];
				}
			}
			else if (point.ShouldSerializeTimeSpanValuesInternal())
			{
				array = new object[point.TimeSpanValues.Length];
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = point.TimeSpanValues[j];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				array = new object[point.Values.Length];
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					array[k] = point.Values[k];
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private object[] GetCreatorParams(object value)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)value;
			List<object> list = new List<object> { GetArgument(seriesPoint) };
			bool flag = seriesPoint.ShouldSerializeSeriesPointIDInternal();
			if (seriesPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(null);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(GetPointValues(seriesPoint));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				list.Add(seriesPoint.SeriesPointID);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return ((LocalizableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return new InstanceDescriptor(GetCreatorInfo(value), GetCreatorParams(value), isComplete: false);
			}
			return ((LocalizableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class StringArrayTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return $"({ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.StringArray)})";
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native
{
	public abstract class AnimatedPointReorderBase
	{
		private int pointsCount;

		public int PointsCount => pointsCount;

		public abstract PointAnimationOrder Order { get; }

		public static AnimatedPointReorderBase CreatePointAnimationVisitor(PointAnimationOrder order)
		{
			return order switch
			{
				PointAnimationOrder.Straight => new StraitAnimatedPointReorder(), 
				PointAnimationOrder.Inverted => new BackwardAnimatedPointReorder(), 
				PointAnimationOrder.Random => new RandomAnimatedPointReorder(), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		public virtual void Initialize(int pointsCount)
		{
			this.pointsCount = pointsCount;
		}

		public abstract int GetIndex(int initialIndex);
	}
	public class StraitAnimatedPointReorder : AnimatedPointReorderBase
	{
		public override PointAnimationOrder Order => PointAnimationOrder.Straight;

		public override int GetIndex(int initialIndex)
		{
			return initialIndex;
		}
	}
	public class BackwardAnimatedPointReorder : AnimatedPointReorderBase
	{
		public override PointAnimationOrder Order => PointAnimationOrder.Inverted;

		public override int GetIndex(int pointIndex)
		{
			return base.PointsCount - pointIndex - 1;
		}
	}
	public class RandomAnimatedPointReorder : AnimatedPointReorderBase
	{
		private List<int> randomizedIndexes;

		public override PointAnimationOrder Order => PointAnimationOrder.Random;

		public override void Initialize(int initialIndex)
		{
			base.Initialize(initialIndex);
			randomizedIndexes = new List<int>(initialIndex);
			NonCryptographicRandom val = NonCryptographicRandom.Default;
			for (int i = 0; i < initialIndex; i++)
			{
				int index = ((randomizedIndexes.Count != 0) ? val.Next(randomizedIndexes.Count) : 0);
				randomizedIndexes.Insert(index, i);
			}
		}

		public override int GetIndex(int pointIndex)
		{
			return randomizedIndexes[pointIndex];
		}
	}
	internal static class AnimationHelper
	{
		internal static bool CheckIsAnimationChanged(AnimationBase animation, AnimationBase defaultAnimation)
		{
			Type type = animation.GetType();
			Type type2 = defaultAnimation.GetType();
			if (type2.Equals(type))
			{
				return animation.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ShouldAssignNewAnimation(IChartContainer chartContainer, AnimationBase oldAnimation, AnimationBase defaultAnimation)
		{
			if (chartContainer != null && chartContainer.DesignMode && oldAnimation != null)
			{
				return CheckIsAnimationChanged(oldAnimation, defaultAnimation);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal static class UnwindAnimationHelper
	{
		private static RectangleF GetUnwindFormTopClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float height = (float)diagramBounds.Height * progress;
			return new RectangleF(diagramBounds.X, diagramBounds.Y, diagramBounds.Width, height);
		}

		private static RectangleF GetUnwindFormRightClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = (float)diagramBounds.Width * progress;
			float x = (float)(diagramBounds.X + diagramBounds.Width) - num;
			return new RectangleF(x, diagramBounds.Y, num, diagramBounds.Height);
		}

		private static RectangleF GetUnwindFormBottomClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float num = (float)diagramBounds.Height * progress;
			float y = (float)(diagramBounds.Height + diagramBounds.Y) - num;
			return new RectangleF(diagramBounds.X, y, diagramBounds.Width, num);
		}

		private static RectangleF GetUnwindFormLeftClippingRect(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			float width = (float)diagramBounds.Width * progress;
			return new RectangleF(diagramBounds.X, diagramBounds.Y, width, diagramBounds.Height);
		}

		public static void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress, AnimationDirection direction)
		{
			modifier.Clip(direction switch
			{
				AnimationDirection.FromLeft => GetUnwindFormLeftClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromBottom => GetUnwindFormBottomClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromRight => GetUnwindFormRightClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				AnimationDirection.FromTop => GetUnwindFormTopClippingRect(diagramBounds, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			});
		}
	}
	internal static class StretchAnimationHelper
	{
		private static void ApplyStretchFormBottomAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Scale(1f, progress);
			float num = (1f - progress) * (float)(diagramBounds.Top + diagramBounds.Height) / progress;
			if (!float.IsInfinity(num) && !float.IsNaN(num))
			{
				modifier.Translate(0f, num);
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyStretchFormRightAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Translate((1f - progress) * (float)(diagramBounds.Width + diagramBounds.Left), 0f);
			modifier.Scale(progress, 1f);
		}

		private static void ApplyStretchFormTopAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Translate(0f, diagramBounds.Y);
			modifier.Scale(1f, progress);
			modifier.Translate(0f, -diagramBounds.Y);
		}

		private static void ApplyStretchFromLeftAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Translate((1f - progress) * (float)diagramBounds.Left, 0f);
			modifier.Scale(progress, 1f);
		}

		public static void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress, AnimationDirection direction)
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case AnimationDirection.FromLeft:
				ApplyStretchFromLeftAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			case AnimationDirection.FromTop:
				ApplyStretchFormTopAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			case AnimationDirection.FromRight:
				ApplyStretchFormRightAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			case AnimationDirection.FromBottom:
				ApplyStretchFormBottomAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class SlideAnimationHelper
	{
		private static void ApplySlideFromLeftAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(diagramBounds);
			modifier.Translate((1f - progress) * (float)(-diagramBounds.Width), 0f);
		}

		private static void ApplySlideFormTopAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(diagramBounds);
			modifier.Translate(0f, (1f - progress) * (float)(-diagramBounds.Height));
		}

		private static void ApplySlideFormRightAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(diagramBounds);
			modifier.Translate((1f - progress) * (float)diagramBounds.Width, 0f);
		}

		private static void ApplySlideFormBottomAnimation(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			modifier.Clip(diagramBounds);
			modifier.Translate(0f, (1f - progress) * (float)diagramBounds.Height);
		}

		public static void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress, AnimationDirection direction)
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case AnimationDirection.FromLeft:
				ApplySlideFromLeftAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			case AnimationDirection.FromTop:
				ApplySlideFormTopAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			case AnimationDirection.FromRight:
				ApplySlideFormRightAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			case AnimationDirection.FromBottom:
				ApplySlideFormBottomAnimation(modifier, diagramBounds, progress);
				break;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class BlowUpAnimationHelper
	{
		public static void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			PointF pointF = diagramBounds.CalculateCenter();
			modifier.Translate(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
			modifier.Scale(progress, progress);
			modifier.Translate(0f - pointF.X, 0f - pointF.Y);
		}
	}
	internal static class UnwrapAnimationHelper
	{
		private static PointF GetUnwrapHorizontallyScale(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			if ((double)progress <= 0.5)
			{
				float y = 2f / (float)diagramBounds.Height;
				return new PointF(2f * progress, y);
			}
			return new PointF(1f, (progress - 0.5f) * 2f);
		}

		private static PointF GetUnwrapVerticallyScale(Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			if ((double)progress <= 0.5)
			{
				float x = 2f / (float)diagramBounds.Width;
				return new PointF(x, 2f * progress);
			}
			return new PointF((progress - 0.5f) * 2f, 1f);
		}

		public static void ApplyState(SceneModifier modifier, Rectangle diagramBounds, float progress, XYSeriesAnimationUnwrapDirection direction)
		{
			PointF pointF = direction switch
			{
				XYSeriesAnimationUnwrapDirection.Horizontal => GetUnwrapHorizontallyScale(diagramBounds, progress), 
				XYSeriesAnimationUnwrapDirection.Vertical => GetUnwrapVerticallyScale(diagramBounds, progress), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
			PointF offset = diagramBounds.CalculateCenter();
			modifier.Translate(offset);
			modifier.Scale(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
			modifier.Translate(0f - offset.X, 0f - offset.Y);
		}
	}
	public static class PieAnimationHelper
	{
		public static PointF CalculateGrowUpOffset(RectangleF pointBounds, float progress)
		{
			float x = (pointBounds.Width / 2f + pointBounds.X) * (1f - progress);
			float y = (pointBounds.Height / 2f + pointBounds.Y) * (1f - progress);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		public static float CalculateWidenStartAngle(float initialStartAngle, float initialSweepAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			return initialStartAngle + 0.5f * initialSweepAngle - 0.5f * sweepAngle;
		}

		public static PointF CalculateDropInOffset(double pieAngle, RectangleF diagramBounds, float progress)
		{
			double num = 0.5 * Math.Sqrt(diagramBounds.Height * diagramBounds.Height + diagramBounds.Width * diagramBounds.Width);
			double num2 = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(pieAngle);
			double num3 = (1.0 - (double)progress) * num * Math.Cos(num2);
			double num4 = ((double)progress - 1.0) * num * Math.Sin(num2);
			return new PointF((float)num3, (float)num4);
		}
	}
	public abstract class PieAnglesTransform
	{
		private readonly float pieStartAngle;

		protected float PieStartAngle => pieStartAngle;

		public static PieAnglesTransform Create(PieSeriesViewBase pieView)
		{
			float num = pieView?.ActualRotation ?? 0;
			if (pieView == null || pieView.SweepDirection == PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise)
			{
				return new CounterclockwiseAnglesTransform(num);
			}
			return new ClockwiseAnglesTransform(num);
		}

		protected PieAnglesTransform(float pieStartAngle)
		{
			this.pieStartAngle = pieStartAngle;
		}

		public abstract float TransformStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle);

		public abstract float TransformStartAngleBack(float startAngle, float sweepAngle);
	}
	public class ClockwiseAnglesTransform : PieAnglesTransform
	{
		internal ClockwiseAnglesTransform(float pieStartAngle)
			: base(pieStartAngle)
		{
		}

		private float TransformStartAngleInternal(float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			return 360f - (startAngle + sweepAngle + base.PieStartAngle);
		}

		public override float TransformStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			return (float)MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(TransformStartAngleInternal(startAngle, sweepAngle));
		}

		public override float TransformStartAngleBack(float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			return TransformStartAngleInternal(startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}
	}
	public class CounterclockwiseAnglesTransform : PieAnglesTransform
	{
		internal CounterclockwiseAnglesTransform(float pieStartAngle)
			: base(pieStartAngle)
		{
		}

		public override float TransformStartAngle(float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			return (float)MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(startAngle - base.PieStartAngle);
		}

		public override float TransformStartAngleBack(float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			return startAngle + base.PieStartAngle;
		}
	}
	public static class AnnotationHelper
	{
		private class PaneDistanceDescription
		{
			private readonly AxisXBase axisX;

			private readonly AxisYBase axisY;

			private readonly AxisAlignment horizontalAlignment;

			private readonly AxisAlignment verticalAlignment;

			private readonly int distance;

			public AxisXBase AxisX => axisX;

			public AxisYBase AxisY => axisY;

			public AxisAlignment HorizontalAlignment => horizontalAlignment;

			public AxisAlignment VerticalAlignment => verticalAlignment;

			public int Distance => distance;

			public PaneDistanceDescription(AxisXBase axisX, AxisYBase axisY, AxisAlignment horizontalAlignment, AxisAlignment verticalAlignment, int distance)
			{
				this.axisX = axisX;
				this.axisY = axisY;
				this.horizontalAlignment = horizontalAlignment;
				this.verticalAlignment = verticalAlignment;
				this.distance = distance;
			}
		}

		private static PaneDistanceDescription CalculatePaneDistanceDescription(XYDiagram2D diagram, XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Point point)
		{
			Rectangle? lastMappingBounds = pane.LastMappingBounds;
			if (lastMappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = diagram.GetPaneAxesData(pane);
				if (paneAxesData != null)
				{
					AxisXBase axisXBase = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX as AxisXBase;
					AxisYBase axisYBase = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY as AxisYBase;
					if (axisXBase != null && axisYBase != null)
					{
						Rectangle value = lastMappingBounds.Value;
						int x = point.X;
						int num = Math.Abs(x - value.Left);
						int num2 = Math.Abs(x - value.Right);
						AxisAlignment horizontalAlignment;
						int val;
						if (num <= num2)
						{
							horizontalAlignment = AxisAlignment.Near;
							val = num;
						}
						else
						{
							horizontalAlignment = AxisAlignment.Far;
							val = num2;
						}
						int y = point.Y;
						int num3 = Math.Abs(y - value.Top);
						int num4 = Math.Abs(y - value.Bottom);
						AxisAlignment verticalAlignment;
						int val2;
						if (num4 <= num3)
						{
							verticalAlignment = AxisAlignment.Near;
							val2 = num4;
						}
						else
						{
							verticalAlignment = AxisAlignment.Far;
							val2 = num3;
						}
						return new PaneDistanceDescription(axisXBase, axisYBase, horizontalAlignment, verticalAlignment, Math.Min(val, val2));
					}
				}
			}
			return new PaneDistanceDescription(null, null, AxisAlignment.Near, AxisAlignment.Near, int.MaxValue);
		}

		public static Size CalculateAnnotationSize(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			Size result = new Size(0, 0);
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				if (!(seriesDatum.SeriesPoint is SeriesPoint seriesPoint) || seriesPoint.Annotations.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Annotation annotation in seriesPoint.Annotations)
				{
					RelativePosition relativePosition = annotation.ShapePosition as RelativePosition;
					if (annotation.ActualLabelMode && relativePosition != null)
					{
						DiagramPoint shapeLocation = relativePosition.GetShapeLocation(new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0));
						ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = MathUtils.CalcBounds(new ZPlaneRectangle(shapeLocation, annotation.Width, annotation.Height), annotation.Angle);
						double num = Math.Min(0.0, zPlaneRectangle.Left);
						double num2 = Math.Max(0.0, zPlaneRectangle.Right);
						double num3 = Math.Max(0.0, zPlaneRectangle.Top);
						double num4 = Math.Min(0.0, zPlaneRectangle.Bottom);
						result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, MathUtils.StrongRound(num2 - num));
						result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, MathUtils.StrongRound(num3 - num4));
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static void CalculateAnnotationsCorrection(List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData, RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction);
			}
		}

		public static int CompareByAnnotationZOrder(AnnotationViewData x, AnnotationViewData y)
		{
			if (x == null)
			{
				if (y == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x.Annotation.ZOrder > y.Annotation.ZOrder)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x.Annotation.ZOrder < y.Annotation.ZOrder)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return x.IndexInRepository.CompareTo(y.IndexInRepository);
		}

		public static ChartAnchorPoint CreateChartAnchorPoint(Annotation annotation, Chart chart)
		{
			ChartAnchorPoint chartAnchorPoint = new ChartAnchorPoint();
			if (annotation != null && chart != null)
			{
				chartAnchorPoint.SetPosition((int)annotation.LastAnchorPosition.X - chart.Border.ActualThickness, (int)annotation.LastAnchorPosition.Y - chart.Border.ActualThickness);
			}
			return chartAnchorPoint;
		}

		public static PaneAnchorPoint CreatePaneAnchorPoint(Annotation annotation, Chart chart)
		{
			PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint = new PaneAnchorPoint();
			if (annotation != null && chart != null && chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
			{
				Point point = (Point)annotation.LastAnchorPosition;
				DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(point);
				if (diagramCoordinates.IsEmpty)
				{
					XYDiagramPaneBase pane = xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane;
					PaneDistanceDescription paneDistanceDescription = CalculatePaneDistanceDescription(xYDiagram2D, pane, point);
					foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes)
					{
						PaneDistanceDescription paneDistanceDescription2 = CalculatePaneDistanceDescription(xYDiagram2D, actualPane, point);
						if (paneDistanceDescription2.Distance < paneDistanceDescription.Distance)
						{
							pane = actualPane;
							paneDistanceDescription = paneDistanceDescription2;
						}
					}
					paneAnchorPoint.Pane = pane;
					AxisAlignment axisAlignment;
					AxisAlignment axisAlignment2;
					if (xYDiagram2D.ActualRotated)
					{
						axisAlignment = paneDistanceDescription.VerticalAlignment;
						axisAlignment2 = paneDistanceDescription.HorizontalAlignment;
					}
					else
					{
						axisAlignment = paneDistanceDescription.HorizontalAlignment;
						axisAlignment2 = paneDistanceDescription.VerticalAlignment;
					}
					Axis2D axis2D = paneDistanceDescription.AxisX ?? xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisX;
					paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis = axis2D;
					IVisualAxisRangeData visualRangeData = axis2D.VisualRangeData;
					object obj;
					if ((axisAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far) ^ ((IAxisData)axis2D).Reverse)
					{
						obj = visualRangeData.MaxValue;
						if (obj == null)
						{
							obj = ((IAxisData)axis2D).AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRangeData.Max);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = visualRangeData.MinValue;
						if (obj == null)
						{
							obj = ((IAxisData)axis2D).AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRangeData.Min);
						}
					}
					paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = obj;
					Axis2D axis2D2 = paneDistanceDescription.AxisY ?? xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisY;
					paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis = axis2D2;
					IVisualAxisRangeData visualRangeData2 = axis2D2.VisualRangeData;
					object obj2;
					if ((axisAlignment2 == AxisAlignment.Far) ^ ((IAxisData)axis2D2).Reverse)
					{
						obj2 = visualRangeData2.MaxValue;
						if (obj2 == null)
						{
							obj2 = ((IAxisData)axis2D2).AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRangeData2.Max);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj2 = visualRangeData2.MinValue;
						if (obj2 == null)
						{
							obj2 = ((IAxisData)axis2D2).AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRangeData2.Min);
						}
					}
					paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = obj2;
				}
				else
				{
					paneAnchorPoint.Pane = diagramCoordinates.Pane;
					paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis = (Axis2D)diagramCoordinates.AxisX;
					switch (diagramCoordinates.ArgumentScaleType)
					{
					case ScaleType.Numerical:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.NumericalArgument;
						break;
					case ScaleType.Qualitative:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.QualitativeArgument;
						break;
					case ScaleType.DateTime:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.DateTimeArgument;
						break;
					case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.TimeSpanArgument;
						break;
					}
					paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis = (Axis2D)diagramCoordinates.AxisY;
					switch (diagramCoordinates.ValueScaleType)
					{
					case ScaleType.Numerical:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.NumericalValue;
						break;
					case ScaleType.DateTime:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.DateTimeValue;
						break;
					case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = diagramCoordinates.TimeSpanValue;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return paneAnchorPoint;
		}

		public static FreePosition CreateFreePosition(Annotation annotation, Chart chart)
		{
			FreePosition freePosition = new FreePosition();
			if (annotation != null && chart != null)
			{
				freePosition.DockCorner = DockCorner.LeftTop;
				freePosition.DockTarget = null;
				if (annotation.LastLocation.X > (double)chart.Border.ActualThickness)
				{
					freePosition.OuterIndents.Left = 0;
					freePosition.InnerIndents.Left = (int)annotation.LastLocation.X - chart.Border.ActualThickness;
				}
				else
				{
					freePosition.OuterIndents.Left = ((annotation.LastLocation.X > 0.0) ? ((int)annotation.LastLocation.X + chart.Border.ActualThickness) : (chart.Border.ActualThickness - (int)annotation.LastLocation.X));
					freePosition.InnerIndents.Left = 0;
				}
				if (annotation.LastLocation.Y > (double)chart.Border.ActualThickness)
				{
					freePosition.OuterIndents.Top = 0;
					freePosition.InnerIndents.Top = (int)annotation.LastLocation.Y - chart.Border.ActualThickness;
				}
				else
				{
					freePosition.OuterIndents.Top = ((annotation.LastLocation.Y > 0.0) ? ((int)annotation.LastLocation.Y + chart.Border.ActualThickness) : (chart.Border.ActualThickness - (int)annotation.LastLocation.Y));
					freePosition.InnerIndents.Top = 0;
				}
			}
			return freePosition;
		}

		public static RelativePosition CreateRelativePosition(Annotation annotation)
		{
			RelativePosition relativePosition = new RelativePosition();
			if (annotation != null)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(annotation.LastLocation.X + 0.5 * (double)annotation.Width, annotation.LastLocation.Y + 0.5 * (double)annotation.Height);
				double connectorLength = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(annotation.LastAnchorPosition, diagramPoint);
				double num = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)annotation.LastAnchorPosition, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint);
				relativePosition.SetConnectorLength(connectorLength);
				relativePosition.SetAngle(MathUtils.Radian2Degree(0.0 - num));
			}
			return relativePosition;
		}

		public static List<AnnotationViewData> CreateInnerAnnotationsViewData(List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout)
		{
			return CreateInnerAnnotationsViewData(annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		public static List<AnnotationViewData> CreateInnerAnnotationsViewData(List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, Rectangle visibleBounds)
		{
			List<AnnotationViewData> list = new List<AnnotationViewData>();
			AnnotationLayout[] array = annotationsAnchorPointsLayout.ToArray();
			foreach (AnnotationLayout annotationLayout in array)
			{
				if (annotationLayout.Annotation.ShapePosition is RelativePosition relativePosition)
				{
					annotationsAnchorPointsLayout.Remove(annotationLayout);
					AnnotationLayout shapeLayout = new AnnotationLayout(annotationLayout.Annotation, relativePosition.GetShapeLocation(annotationLayout.Position));
					AnnotationViewData annotationViewData = annotationLayout.Annotation.CalculateViewData(shapeLayout, annotationLayout);
					if (annotationViewData != null && annotationViewData.InBounds(visibleBounds))
					{
						list.Add(annotationViewData);
					}
				}
			}
			list.Sort(CompareByAnnotationZOrder);
			return list;
		}

		public static List<AnnotationViewData> CreateInnerAnnotationsViewDataClipped(List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, Rectangle allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing)
		{
			List<AnnotationViewData> list = new List<AnnotationViewData>();
			AnnotationLayout[] array = annotationsAnchorPointsLayout.ToArray();
			foreach (AnnotationLayout annotationLayout in array)
			{
				if (annotationLayout.Annotation.ShapePosition is RelativePosition relativePosition)
				{
					annotationsAnchorPointsLayout.Remove(annotationLayout);
					AnnotationLayout shapeLayout = new AnnotationLayout(annotationLayout.Annotation, relativePosition.GetShapeLocation(annotationLayout.Position));
					AnnotationViewData annotationViewData = annotationLayout.Annotation.CalculateViewData(shapeLayout, annotationLayout, allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing);
					if (annotationViewData != null)
					{
						list.Add(annotationViewData);
					}
				}
			}
			list.Sort(CompareByAnnotationZOrder);
			return list;
		}

		public static List<AnnotationLayout> CreateFreeAnnotationsShapesLayout(AnnotationRepository annotations, ChartElement dockTarget, ZPlaneRectangle viewport)
		{
			List<AnnotationLayout> list = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			foreach (Annotation annotation in annotations)
			{
				if (annotation.ShapePosition is FreePosition freePosition && freePosition.DockTarget == dockTarget)
				{
					annotation.UpdateSize();
					list.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, freePosition.GetShapeLocation(viewport)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static IDockTarget[] GetDockTargets(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				return new IDockTarget[1];
			}
			IDockTarget[] array = new XYDiagramPaneBase[diagram.Panes.Count + 2];
			IDockTarget[] array2 = array;
			array2[0] = null;
			array2[1] = diagram.DefaultPane;
			for (int i = 2; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = diagram.Panes[i - 2];
			}
			return array2;
		}

		public static string GetDockTargetName(IDockTarget dockTarget)
		{
			if (dockTarget == null)
			{
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ChartControlDockTarget);
			}
			return dockTarget.Name;
		}

		public static ChartElement GetDockTarget(string name, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (name != null && diagram != null)
			{
				return diagram.FindPaneByName(name);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool IsPaneAnchorPointSupported(Annotation annotation)
		{
			Chart chart = annotation.Chart;
			if (chart != null)
			{
				return chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsSeriesPointAnchorPointSupported(Annotation annotation)
		{
			Chart chart = annotation.Chart;
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (Series item in chart.Series)
			{
				if (!item.Autocreated && item.ActualSeriesPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPointForCenterAreaPointWithoutScrolling(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, double argument, MinMaxValues values)
		{
			Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> intervalLayoutX = mappingContainer.GetIntervalLayoutX(argument);
			if (intervalLayoutX == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double interimCoord = intervalLayoutX.Item2.GetInterimCoord(argument, clip: false, round: true);
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = mappingContainer.CalculateMinMaxInterimY(null, clipBySideLimits: true, values.Min, values.Max);
			if (minMaxValues.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double y = (minMaxValues.Min + minMaxValues.Max) / 2.0;
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = new DiagramPoint(interimCoord, y);
			return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, mappingContainer);
		}

		public static void CalculateAnchorPointLayoutForCenterAreaPoint(Annotation annotation, AreaSeriesView areaView, XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer;
			MinMaxValues seriesPointValues = areaView.GetSeriesPointValues(refinedPoint);
			double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
			if (areaView.IsScrollingEnabled && annotation.ScrollingSupported)
			{
				double num = MinMaxValues.Intersection(mappingContainer.MappingForScrolling.AxisY.WholeRangeData, seriesPointValues).CalculateCenter();
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, mappingContainer.MappingForScrolling.GetScreenPoint(argument, num), refinedPoint));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DiagramPoint? diagramPoint = CalculateAnchorPointForCenterAreaPointWithoutScrolling(mappingContainer, argument, seriesPointValues);
				if (diagramPoint.HasValue)
				{
					anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, diagramPoint.Value, refinedPoint));
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateAnchorPointLayoutForCenterBarPoint(Annotation annotation, BarSeriesView barView, XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList anchorPointLayoutList, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			BarData barData = barView.CreateBarData(refinedPoint);
			if (barView.IsScrollingEnabled && annotation.ScrollingSupported)
			{
				XYDiagramMappingBase mappingForScrolling = anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling;
				double num = MinMaxValues.Intersection(mappingForScrolling.AxisY.WholeRangeData, new MinMaxValues(barData.ZeroValue, barData.ActualValue)).CalculateCenter();
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, barData.GetScreenPoint(barData.Argument, num, mappingForScrolling), refinedPoint));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DiagramPoint? diagramPoint = barData.CalculateAnchorPointForCenterLabelPosition(anchorPointLayoutList.MappingContainer, new ScreenPointCalculator());
				if (diagramPoint.HasValue)
				{
					anchorPointLayoutList.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, diagramPoint.Value, refinedPoint));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties()
		{
			if (point == null || point.Series == null || point.Series.View == null)
			{
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
			}
			SeriesViewBase view = point.Series.View;
			int pointDimension = view.PointDimension;
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[pointDimension + 1];
			array[0] = new ArgumentPropertyDescriptor();
			for (int i = 0; i < pointDimension; i++)
			{
				array[i + 1] = new ValuePropertyDescriptor(view.GetValueCaption(i), i);
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
		}

		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

				return anchorPointSeriesPointItem.point == point;
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		{

		private SeriesPoint GetSeriesPointFromValue(object value)
		{
			if (value is SeriesPoint)
			{
				return (SeriesPoint)value;
			}
			if (value is AnchorPointSeriesPointItem)
			{
				return ((AnchorPointSeriesPointItem)value).Point;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			if (!(component is SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new AnchorPointSeriesPointItem(seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint());
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			if (component is SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPointFromValue = GetSeriesPointFromValue(value);
				if (seriesPointAnchorPoint.SeriesPoint != seriesPointFromValue)
				{
					seriesPointAnchorPoint.SeriesPoint = seriesPointFromValue;
				}
			}
		}

			return false;

	public class AnnotationCollectionPaneBehavior : AnnotationCollectionBehavior
	{
		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		public AnnotationCollectionPaneBehavior(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
			: base(pane)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
		}

		public override void ArrangeAnnotation(Annotation annotation)
		{
			annotation.ShapePosition = new RelativePosition();
			PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint = new PaneAnchorPoint();
			paneAnchorPoint.Pane = pane;
			if (pane.Diagram != null)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = pane.Diagram.GetPaneAxesData(pane);
				if (paneAxesData != null)
				{
					Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
					Axis2D axis2D2 = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
					if (axis2D != null)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis = axis2D;
					}
					if (axis2D2 != null)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis = axis2D2;
					}
				}
			}
			annotation.AnchorPoint = paneAnchorPoint;
		}

		public override bool CheckAnnotation(Annotation annotation)
		{
			if (annotation.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint && paneAnchorPoint.Pane == pane)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class AnnotationCollectionSeriesPointBehavior : AnnotationCollectionBehavior
	{
		private readonly SeriesPoint point;

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> Points
		{
			get
			{
				yield return point;
				if (point.SourcePoints == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint in point.SourcePoints)
				{
					yield return sourcePoint;
				}
			}
		}

		public AnnotationCollectionSeriesPointBehavior(SeriesPoint point)
			: base(point)
		{
			this.point = point;
		}

		public override void ArrangeAnnotation(Annotation annotation)
		{
			annotation.ShapePosition = new RelativePosition();
			SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint = new SeriesPointAnchorPoint();
			seriesPointAnchorPoint.SetSeriesPoint(point);
			annotation.AnchorPoint = seriesPointAnchorPoint;
		}

		public override bool CheckAnnotation(Annotation annotation)
		{
			if (annotation.AnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint point in Points)
				{
					if (seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint() == point)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AnnotationViewData : IBoundsProvider
	{
		private readonly Annotation annotation;

		private readonly AnnotationShape shape;

		private readonly DiagramPoint anchorPoint;

		private readonly int indexInRepository;

		private readonly RefinedPoint connectedPoint;

		private ZPlaneRectangle bounds;

		private ZPlaneRectangle innerBounds;

		protected AnnotationShape Shape => shape;

		protected DiagramPoint AnchorPoint => anchorPoint;

		protected ZPlaneRectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			set
			{
				bounds = value;
			}
		}

		protected ZPlaneRectangle InnerBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return innerBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				innerBounds = value;
			}
		}

		protected ZPlaneRectangle HitTestBounds
		{
			get
			{
				float width = (float)Math.Max(5.0, bounds.Width);
				float height = (float)Math.Max(5.0, bounds.Height);
				return MathUtils.MakeRectangle(bounds.Center, new SizeF(width, height));
			}
		}

		protected HitTestController HitTestController => annotation.Chart.HitTestController;

		public int IndexInRepository => indexInRepository;

		public RefinedPoint ConnectedPoint => connectedPoint;

		public Annotation Annotation => annotation;

		public AnnotationViewData(Annotation annotation, AnnotationShape shape, RefinedPoint connectedPoint, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, DiagramPoint location)
		{
			this.annotation = annotation;
			this.shape = shape;
			this.anchorPoint = anchorPoint;
			indexInRepository = annotation.IndexInRepository;
			this.annotation.UpdateSize();
			bounds = new ZPlaneRectangle(location, annotation.Width, annotation.Height);
			innerBounds = CalculateInnerBounds();
			this.connectedPoint = connectedPoint;
		}

		bool IBoundsProvider.IsEnableInBounds(DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			return annotation.ActualLabelMode;
		}

		GRealRect2D IBoundsProvider.GetBounds()
		{
			return GetBounds();
		}

		private void RenderNavigation(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (!bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = annotation.CanDrag();
			if (Annotation.RuntimeEditing || flag)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, annotation, new ChartFocusedArea(annotation), useSpecificCursor: true, shape.CreateHitRegion(HitTestBounds, AnchorPoint), null, force: true);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AnnotationDragPoint item in AnnotationDragPointsHelper.CalcPoints(annotation, shape, bounds, HitTestBounds, anchorPoint))
			{
				item.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private GRealRect2D GetBounds()
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = MathUtils.CalcBounds(bounds, annotation.Angle);
			return new GRealRect2D(zPlaneRectangle.Left, zPlaneRectangle.Top, zPlaneRectangle.Width, zPlaneRectangle.Height);
		}

		protected abstract void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer);

		protected ZPlaneRectangle CalculateInnerBounds()
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle rect = ((annotation.Border.ActualThickness > 0) ? ZPlaneRectangle.Inflate(bounds, -annotation.Border.ActualThickness, -annotation.Border.ActualThickness) : bounds);
			rect = annotation.Padding.DecreaseRectangle(rect);
			Size size = shape.CalcInnerSize(rect.Size.ToSize());
			DiagramPoint point = new DiagramPoint(rect.Location.X + (rect.Width - (double)size.Width) / 2.0, rect.Location.Y + (rect.Height - (double)size.Height) / 2.0);
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(point, size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		public void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (annotation.ActualLabelMode)
			{
				correction.Update((Rectangle)MathUtils.CalcBounds(bounds, annotation.Angle));
			}
		}

		public bool InBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			GRealRect2D rect = GetBounds();
			if (!bounds.IsEmpty && !bounds.IntersectsWith(rect.ToRectangle()))
			{
				return bounds.Contains((int)anchorPoint.X, (int)anchorPoint.Y);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			shape.RenderShadow(renderer, bounds, anchorPoint);
			shape.Render(renderer, bounds, anchorPoint);
			RenderContent(renderer);
			RenderNavigation(renderer);
		}
	}

	public class ImageAnnotationViewData : AnnotationViewData
	{
		private ImageAnnotation ImageAnnotation => (ImageAnnotation)base.Annotation;

		public ImageAnnotationViewData(ImageAnnotation annotation, AnnotationShape shape, RefinedPoint connectedPoint, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, DiagramPoint location)
			: base(annotation, shape, connectedPoint, anchorPoint, location)
		{
		}

		public ImageAnnotationViewData(ImageAnnotation annotation, AnnotationShape shape, RefinedPoint connectedPoint, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, DiagramPoint location, Rectangle allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing)
			: base(annotation, shape, connectedPoint, anchorPoint, location)
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle rect = (ZPlaneRectangle)allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing;
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.Intersect(rect, base.Bounds);
			if (zPlaneRectangle != null)
			{
				base.Bounds = zPlaneRectangle;
				base.InnerBounds = CalculateInnerBounds();
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(base.HitTestController, base.Annotation, base.ConnectedPoint, base.Shape.CreateHitRegion(base.HitTestBounds, base.AnchorPoint));
			DXImage actualImage = ImageAnnotation.ActualImage;
			if (actualImage != null)
			{
				renderer.SaveState();
				Point point = new Point((int)base.Bounds.Center.X, (int)base.Bounds.Center.Y);
				renderer.TranslateModel(point.X, point.Y);
				Rectangle rectangle = (Rectangle)base.InnerBounds;
				rectangle.Offset(-point.X, -point.Y);
				renderer.RotateModel(base.Annotation.Angle);
				renderer.DrawImage(actualImage, rectangle, (DXImageSizeMode)ImageAnnotation.SizeMode);
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}
	}

	public interface IAnnotationDragElement

		Annotation Annotation { get; }

	public class AnnotationNavigation
	{
		private readonly AnnotationRepository annotationRepository;

		private WeakReference selectedAnnotationReference;

		public AnnotationNavigation(AnnotationRepository annotationRepository)
		{
			this.annotationRepository = annotationRepository;
		}

		private AnnotationOperation CreateOperation(IAnnotationDragPoint dragPoint)
		{
			return dragPoint?.CreateOperation();
		}

		private void ResetSelect()
		{
			foreach (Annotation item in annotationRepository)
			{
				item.RuntimeOperationSelect = false;
			}
		}

		public bool CanDrag()
		{
			foreach (Annotation item in annotationRepository)
			{
				if (item.CanDrag())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void DoSelect(IAnnotationDragElement element, IChartContainer container)
		{
			ResetSelect();
			if (element != null)
			{
				element.DoSelect();
				selectedAnnotationReference = new WeakReference(element.Annotation);
			}
			if (container.RenderProvider != null)
			{
				container.RenderProvider.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public bool PerformDragging(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, IAnnotationDragPoint dragPoint)
		{
			AnnotationOperation annotationOperation = CreateOperation(dragPoint);
			if (annotationOperation == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			annotationOperation.Run(x, y, dx, dy);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveSelectedAnnotation()
		{
			if (selectedAnnotationReference == null || !selectedAnnotationReference.IsAlive)
			{
				return;
			}
			Annotation annotation = (Annotation)selectedAnnotationReference.Target;
			Chart chart = annotation.Chart;
			if (chart != null && annotation.RuntimeEditing)
			{
				AnnotationRepositoryChangingEventArgs e = new AnnotationRepositoryChangingEventArgs(annotation, AnnotationRepositoryChange.Deletion);
				chart.ContainerAdapter.OnAnnotationRepositoryChanging(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					chart.AnnotationRepository.Remove(annotation);
					AnnotationRepositoryChangedEventArgs e2 = new AnnotationRepositoryChangedEventArgs(annotation, AnnotationRepositoryChange.Deletion);
					chart.ContainerAdapter.OnAnnotationRepositoryChanged(e2);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public static class AnnotationDragPointsHelper
	{
		private const double minSide = 8.0;

		private static List<AnnotationDragPoint> CalcResizingPoints(Annotation annotation, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			List<AnnotationDragPoint> list = new List<AnnotationDragPoint>();
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(bounds.Location, bounds.Width - 1.0, bounds.Height - 1.0);
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.RotateAt(annotation.Angle, (PointF)bounds.Center);
			list.Add(new LeftTopDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.LeftBottom)));
			list.Add(new RightTopDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.RightBottom)));
			list.Add(new RightBottomDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.RightTop)));
			list.Add(new LeftBottomDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.LeftTop)));
			if (MathUtils.CalcLength2D(zPlaneRectangle.LeftBottom, zPlaneRectangle.RightBottom) > 8.0)
			{
				list.Add(new TopDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.LeftBottom), TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.RightBottom)));
				list.Add(new BottomDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.RightTop), TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.LeftTop)));
			}
			if (MathUtils.CalcLength2D(zPlaneRectangle.LeftBottom, zPlaneRectangle.LeftTop) > 8.0)
			{
				list.Add(new LeftDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.LeftTop), TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.LeftBottom)));
				list.Add(new RightDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.RightBottom), TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, zPlaneRectangle.RightTop)));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static AnnotationDragPoint CalcRotationPoint(Annotation annotation, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint((bounds.Left + bounds.Right) / 2.0, bounds.Bottom);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint((bounds.Left + bounds.Right) / 2.0, bounds.Bottom - 15.0);
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.RotateAt(annotation.Angle, (PointF)bounds.Center);
			return new RotationDragPoint(annotation, TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, diagramPoint), TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, diagramPoint2));
		}

		public static List<AnnotationDragPoint> CalcPoints(Annotation annotation, AnnotationShape shape, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, ZPlaneRectangle hitTestBounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			List<AnnotationDragPoint> list = new List<AnnotationDragPoint>();
			if (annotation.CanPerformMoving)
			{
				list.Add(new ShapeMovingDragPoint(annotation, shape.CreateHitRegion(hitTestBounds, anchorPoint)));
			}
			if (annotation.RuntimeOperationSelect)
			{
				if (annotation.CanPerformRotation)
				{
					list.Add(CalcRotationPoint(annotation, bounds));
				}
				if (annotation.CanPerformResizing)
				{
					list.AddRange(CalcResizingPoints(annotation, bounds));
				}
				if (annotation.CanPerformAnchoring)
				{
					list.Add(new AnchoringDragPoint(annotation, anchorPoint));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class AnchoringDragPoint : AnnotationDragPoint
	{
		protected override Color BackColor => Color.Yellow;

		protected override CursorType CanDragCursorType => CursorType.Move;

		protected override string DesignerHint => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgAnchorPointMovingToolTip);

		public AnchoringDragPoint(Annotation annotation, DiagramPoint point)
			: base(annotation, point)
		{
		}

		public override AnnotationOperation CreateOperation()
		{
			if (base.Annotation.AnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint)
			{
				return new ChartAnchorPointMoving(base.Annotation);
			}
			if (base.Annotation.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint)
			{
				return new PaneAnchorPointMoving(base.Annotation);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AnnotationDragPoint : IAnnotationDragPoint, IDragPoint, IAnnotationDragElement
	{
		private readonly CursorType cursorType;

		protected const int PointRadius = 4;

		private readonly Annotation annotation;

		private readonly DiagramPoint point;

		protected virtual CursorType CanDragCursorType => cursorType;

		protected virtual CursorType DragCursorType => CanDragCursorType;

		protected virtual Color BorderColor => Color.Black;

		protected virtual Color BackColor => Color.White;

		protected abstract string DesignerHint { get; }

		protected DiagramPoint Point => point;

		public Annotation Annotation => annotation;

		CursorType IDragPoint.CanDragCursorType => CanDragCursorType;

		CursorType IDragPoint.DragCursorType => DragCursorType;

		string IAnnotationDragPoint.DesignerHint => DesignerHint;

		public AnnotationDragPoint(Annotation annotation, DiagramPoint point)
		{
			this.annotation = annotation;
			this.point = point;
		}

		bool IDragPoint.CanDrag()
		{
			return Annotation.CanDrag();
		}

		void IAnnotationDragElement.DoSelect()
		{
			if (annotation.CanDrag() || annotation.RuntimeEditing)
			{
				annotation.RuntimeOperationSelect = true;
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessHitTesting(ChartRenderer renderer, DiagramPoint point)
		{
			Annotation hitTestObject = Annotation;
			HitTestController hitTestController = Annotation.Chart.HitTestController;
			int num = 8;
			RectangleF rect = new RectangleF((float)point.X - 4f, (float)point.Y - 4f, num, num);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, hitTestObject, null, new HitRegion(rect), force: true);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, hitTestObject, new ChartFocusedArea(this), useSpecificCursor: true, new HitRegion(rect), null, force: true);
		}

		public virtual void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (Annotation != null)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.FillCircle((Point)point, 4f, BorderColor);
				renderer.FillCircle((Point)point, 3f, BackColor);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				ProcessHitTesting(renderer, point);
			}
		}

		public abstract AnnotationOperation CreateOperation();
	}

		protected override string DesignerHint => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgAnnotationResizingToolTip);

		public ResizingDragPoint(Annotation annotation, DiagramPoint point)
			: base(annotation, point)
		{
		}

		protected double GetCorrectedAngle()
		{
			if (base.Annotation.Angle > 0)
			{
				return base.Annotation.Angle;
			}
			return 360 + base.Annotation.Angle;

				return new RelativePositionAllResizing(base.Annotation, ResizeDirection);

			return new FreePositionAllResizing(base.Annotation, ResizeDirection);
		}
	}

	public class RotationDragPoint : AnnotationDragPoint
	{
		public const int Indent = 15;

		private readonly DiagramPoint point2;

		protected override Color BackColor => Color.GreenYellow;

		protected override CursorType CanDragCursorType => CursorType.Rotate;

		protected override CursorType DragCursorType => CursorType.RotateDrag;

		protected override string DesignerHint => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgAnnotationRotationToolTip);

		public RotationDragPoint(Annotation annotation, DiagramPoint point1, DiagramPoint point2)
			: base(annotation, point1)
		{
			this.point2 = point2;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)base.Point, (Point)point2, base.Annotation.ActualBorderColor, 1);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.FillCircle((Point)point2, 4f, BorderColor);
			renderer.FillCircle((Point)point2, 3f, BackColor);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			ProcessHitTesting(renderer, point2);
		}

		public override AnnotationOperation CreateOperation()
		{
			return new RotationOperation(base.Annotation);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AnnotationOperation
	{
		private readonly Annotation annotation;

		protected Annotation Annotation => annotation;

		public AnnotationOperation(Annotation annotation)
		{
			this.annotation = annotation;
		}

		protected void CorrectParamsByAngle(ref int dx, ref int dy)
		{
			if (Annotation != null)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(dx, dy);
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
				dXMatrix.Rotate(-Annotation.Angle);
				diagramPoint = TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, diagramPoint);
				dx = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.X);
				dy = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.Y);
			}
		}

		public abstract void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy);
	}
	public class RotationOperation : AnnotationOperation
	{
		public RotationOperation(Annotation annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation != null && x >= 0 && y >= 0)
			{
				GRealPoint2D p = new GRealPoint2D(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + 0.5 * (double)base.Annotation.Width, base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + 0.5 * (double)base.Annotation.Height);
				double num = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle(p2: new GRealPoint2D(x + dx, y + dy), p1: p));
				base.Annotation.SetAngle(MathUtils.StrongRound(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(num + 90.0)));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ResizingOperation : AnnotationOperation
	{
		private readonly ResizeDirection resizeDirection;

		protected ResizeDirection ResizeDirection => resizeDirection;

		public ResizingOperation(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation)
		{
			this.resizeDirection = resizeDirection;
		}

		protected DiagramPoint CalcCursorPoint(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(x + dx, y + dy);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = DiagramPoint.Offset(base.Annotation.LastLocation, 0.5 * (double)base.Annotation.Width, 0.5 * (double)base.Annotation.Height, 0.0);
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.RotateAt(-base.Annotation.Angle, (PointF)diagramPoint2);
			return TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, diagramPoint);
		}

		protected void CorrectSize(ref int width, ref int height)
		{
			if (width < 1)
			{
				width = 1;
			}
			if (height < 1)
			{
				height = 1;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartAnchorPointMoving : AnnotationOperation
	{
		private ChartAnchorPoint AnchorPoint => base.Annotation.AnchorPoint as ChartAnchorPoint;

		public ChartAnchorPointMoving(Annotation annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation != null && x >= 0 && y >= 0)
			{
				AnchorPoint.SetPosition(AnchorPoint.X + dx, AnchorPoint.Y + dy);
			}
		}
	}
	public class PaneAnchorPointMoving : AnnotationOperation
	{
		private class AnchorPointParams
		{
			private XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

			private Axis2D axisX;

			private object axisXValue;

			private Axis2D axisY;

			private object axisYValue;

			public bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (Pane != null && AxisX != null && AxisY != null && AxisXValue != null)
					{
						return AxisYValue == null;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public XYDiagramPaneBase Pane
			{
				get
				{
					return pane;
				}
				set
				{
					pane = value;
				}
			}

			public Axis2D AxisX
			{
				get
				{
					return axisX;
				}
				set
				{
					axisX = value;
				}
			}

			public object AxisXValue
			{
				get
				{
					return axisXValue;
				}
				set
				{
					axisXValue = value;
				}
			}

			public Axis2D AxisY
			{
				get
				{
					return axisY;
				}
				set
				{
					axisY = value;
				}
			}

			public object AxisYValue
			{
				get
				{
					return axisYValue;
				}
				set
				{
					axisYValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private PaneAnchorPoint AnchorPoint => base.Annotation.AnchorPoint as PaneAnchorPoint;

		public PaneAnchorPointMoving(Annotation annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		private AnchorPointParams GetAnchorPointParamsByCoordinates(DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
		{
			AnchorPointParams anchorPointParams = new AnchorPointParams();
			if (!coordinates.IsEmpty)
			{
				AxisValue axisValue;
				AxisValue axisValue2;
				if (AnchorPoint.Pane == coordinates.Pane)
				{
					anchorPointParams.Pane = AnchorPoint.Pane;
					axisValue = coordinates.GetAxisValue(AnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis);
					if (axisValue == null)
					{
						anchorPointParams.AxisX = coordinates.AxisX as Axis2D;
						axisValue = coordinates.GetAxisValue(anchorPointParams.AxisX);
					}
					else
					{
						anchorPointParams.AxisX = AnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis;
					}
					axisValue2 = coordinates.GetAxisValue(AnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis);
					if (axisValue2 == null)
					{
						anchorPointParams.AxisY = coordinates.AxisY as Axis2D;
						axisValue2 = coordinates.GetAxisValue(anchorPointParams.AxisY);
					}
					else
					{
						anchorPointParams.AxisY = AnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					anchorPointParams.Pane = coordinates.Pane;
					anchorPointParams.AxisX = coordinates.AxisX as Axis2D;
					anchorPointParams.AxisY = coordinates.AxisY as Axis2D;
					axisValue = coordinates.GetAxisValue(anchorPointParams.AxisX);
					axisValue2 = coordinates.GetAxisValue(anchorPointParams.AxisY);
				}
				if (axisValue != null)
				{
					anchorPointParams.AxisXValue = axisValue.ActualValue;
				}
				if (axisValue2 != null)
				{
					anchorPointParams.AxisYValue = axisValue2.ActualValue;
				}
			}
			return anchorPointParams;
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation == null || x < 0 || y < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = ((base.Annotation.ChartContainer.Chart == null) ? null : (base.Annotation.ChartContainer.Chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D));
			if (xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				AnchorPointParams anchorPointParamsByCoordinates = GetAnchorPointParamsByCoordinates(xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(new Point(x + dx, y + dy)));
				if (!anchorPointParamsByCoordinates.IsEmpty)
				{
					AnchorPoint.SetPosition(anchorPointParamsByCoordinates.Pane, anchorPointParamsByCoordinates.AxisX, anchorPointParamsByCoordinates.AxisY, anchorPointParamsByCoordinates.AxisXValue, anchorPointParamsByCoordinates.AxisYValue);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class FreePositionResizing : ResizingOperation
	{
		protected FreePosition ShapePosition => base.Annotation.ShapePosition as FreePosition;

		public FreePositionResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void CalcNewSize(DiagramPoint cursorPoint, out int width, out int height);

		protected abstract void CorrectShapePosition(int dx, int dy);

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation != null && x >= 0 && y >= 0)
			{
				CalcNewSize(CalcCursorPoint(x, y, dx, dy), out var width, out var height);
				dx = width - base.Annotation.Width;
				dy = height - base.Annotation.Height;
				base.Annotation.SetWidth(width);
				base.Annotation.SetHeight(height);
				CorrectShapePosition(dx, dy);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FreePositionHorizontalResizing : FreePositionResizing
	{
		public FreePositionHorizontalResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcNewSize(DiagramPoint cursorPoint, out int width, out int height)
		{
			height = base.Annotation.Height;
			width = base.Annotation.Width;
			switch (base.ResizeDirection)
			{
			case ResizeDirection.Left:
				width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + (double)base.Annotation.Width - cursorPoint.X);
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.Right:
				width = MathUtils.StrongRound(cursorPoint.X - base.Annotation.LastLocation.X);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
				return;
			}
			CorrectSize(ref width, ref height);
		}

		protected override void CorrectShapePosition(int dx, int dy)
		{
			base.ShapePosition.GetIndents(out var left, out var _, out var right, out var _);
			switch (base.ResizeDirection)
			{
			case ResizeDirection.Left:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftTop)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetLeftIndent(left - dx);
				}
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.Right:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightTop)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetRightIndent(right - dx);
				}
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class FreePositionVerticalResizing : FreePositionResizing
	{
		public FreePositionVerticalResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcNewSize(DiagramPoint cursorPoint, out int width, out int height)
		{
			height = base.Annotation.Height;
			width = base.Annotation.Width;
			switch (base.ResizeDirection)
			{
			case ResizeDirection.Top:
				height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + (double)base.Annotation.Height - cursorPoint.Y);
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.Bottom:
				height = MathUtils.StrongRound(cursorPoint.Y - base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
				return;
			}
			CorrectSize(ref width, ref height);
		}

		protected override void CorrectShapePosition(int dx, int dy)
		{
			base.ShapePosition.GetIndents(out var _, out var top, out var _, out var bottom);
			switch (base.ResizeDirection)
			{
			case ResizeDirection.Top:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightTop)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetTopIndent(top - dy);
				}
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.Bottom:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftBottom || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetBottomIndent(bottom - dy);
				}
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class FreePositionAllResizing : FreePositionResizing
	{
		public FreePositionAllResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcNewSize(DiagramPoint cursorPoint, out int width, out int height)
		{
			height = base.Annotation.Height;
			width = base.Annotation.Width;
			switch (base.ResizeDirection)
			{
			case ResizeDirection.LeftTop:
				width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + (double)base.Annotation.Width - cursorPoint.X);
				height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + (double)base.Annotation.Height - cursorPoint.Y);
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.RightTop:
				width = MathUtils.StrongRound(cursorPoint.X - base.Annotation.LastLocation.X);
				height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + (double)base.Annotation.Height - cursorPoint.Y);
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.RightBottom:
				width = MathUtils.StrongRound(cursorPoint.X - base.Annotation.LastLocation.X);
				height = MathUtils.StrongRound(cursorPoint.Y - base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y);
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.LeftBottom:
				width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + (double)base.Annotation.Width - cursorPoint.X);
				height = MathUtils.StrongRound(cursorPoint.Y - base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
				return;
			}
			CorrectSize(ref width, ref height);
		}

		protected override void CorrectShapePosition(int dx, int dy)
		{
			base.ShapePosition.GetIndents(out var left, out var top, out var right, out var bottom);
			switch (base.ResizeDirection)
			{
			case ResizeDirection.LeftTop:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetLeftIndent(left - dx);
				}
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightTop)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetTopIndent(top - dy);
				}
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.RightTop:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetRightIndent(right - dx);
				}
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightTop)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetTopIndent(top - dy);
				}
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.RightBottom:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetRightIndent(right - dx);
				}
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftBottom || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetBottomIndent(bottom - dy);
				}
				break;
			case ResizeDirection.LeftBottom:
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftTop || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetLeftIndent(left - dx);
				}
				if (base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.LeftBottom || base.ShapePosition.DockCorner == DockCorner.RightBottom)
				{
					base.ShapePosition.SetBottomIndent(bottom - dy);
				}
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class RelativePositionResizing : ResizingOperation
	{
		public RelativePositionResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}
	}
	public class RelativePositionHorizontalResizing : RelativePositionResizing
	{
		public RelativePositionHorizontalResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation != null && x >= 0 && y >= 0)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = CalcCursorPoint(x, y, dx, dy);
				int width = base.Annotation.Width;
				int height = base.Annotation.Height;
				switch (base.ResizeDirection)
				{
				case ResizeDirection.Left:
					width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + (double)base.Annotation.Width - diagramPoint.X);
					break;
				case ResizeDirection.Right:
					width = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.X - base.Annotation.LastLocation.X);
					break;
				default:
					ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
					return;
				}
				width = 2 * width - base.Annotation.Width;
				CorrectSize(ref width, ref height);
				base.Annotation.SetWidth(width);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RelativePositionVerticalResizing : RelativePositionResizing
	{
		public RelativePositionVerticalResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation != null && x >= 0 && y >= 0)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = CalcCursorPoint(x, y, dx, dy);
				int width = base.Annotation.Width;
				int height = base.Annotation.Height;
				switch (base.ResizeDirection)
				{
				case ResizeDirection.Top:
					height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + (double)base.Annotation.Height - diagramPoint.Y);
					break;
				case ResizeDirection.Bottom:
					height = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.Y - base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y);
					break;
				default:
					ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
					return;
				}
				height = 2 * height - base.Annotation.Height;
				CorrectSize(ref width, ref height);
				base.Annotation.SetHeight(height);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RelativePositionAllResizing : RelativePositionResizing
	{
		public RelativePositionAllResizing(Annotation annotation, ResizeDirection resizeDirection)
			: base(annotation, resizeDirection)
		{
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (base.Annotation != null && x >= 0 && y >= 0)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = CalcCursorPoint(x, y, dx, dy);
				int width = base.Annotation.Width;
				int height = base.Annotation.Height;
				switch (base.ResizeDirection)
				{
				case ResizeDirection.LeftTop:
					width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + (double)base.Annotation.Width - diagramPoint.X);
					height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + (double)base.Annotation.Height - diagramPoint.Y);
					break;
				case ResizeDirection.RightTop:
					width = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.X - base.Annotation.LastLocation.X);
					height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y + (double)base.Annotation.Height - diagramPoint.Y);
					break;
				case ResizeDirection.RightBottom:
					width = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.X - base.Annotation.LastLocation.X);
					height = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.Y - base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y);
					break;
				case ResizeDirection.LeftBottom:
					width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Annotation.LastLocation.X + (double)base.Annotation.Width - diagramPoint.X);
					height = MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.Y - base.Annotation.LastLocation.Y);
					break;
				default:
					ChartDebug.Fail("The resize direction is incorrect for this operation.");
					return;
				}
				width = 2 * width - base.Annotation.Width;
				height = 2 * height - base.Annotation.Height;
				CorrectSize(ref width, ref height);
				base.Annotation.SetWidth(width);
				base.Annotation.SetHeight(height);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FreePositionShapeMoving : AnnotationOperation
	{
		private FreePosition ShapePosition => base.Annotation.ShapePosition as FreePosition;

		public FreePositionShapeMoving(Annotation annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		private void SetIndents(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
		{
			switch (ShapePosition.DockCorner)
			{
			case DockCorner.LeftTop:
			case DockCorner.LeftBottom:
				ShapePosition.SetLeftIndent(left);
				break;
			case DockCorner.RightTop:
			case DockCorner.RightBottom:
				ShapePosition.SetRightIndent(right);
				break;
			}
			switch (ShapePosition.DockCorner)
			{
			case DockCorner.RightTop:
			case DockCorner.LeftTop:
				ShapePosition.SetTopIndent(top);
				break;
			case DockCorner.RightBottom:
			case DockCorner.LeftBottom:
				ShapePosition.SetBottomIndent(bottom);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CalcNewIndents(int dx, int dy, out int left, out int top, out int right, out int bottom)
		{
			ShapePosition.GetIndents(out left, out top, out right, out bottom);
			switch (ShapePosition.DockCorner)
			{
			case DockCorner.LeftTop:
				left += dx;
				top += dy;
				break;
			case DockCorner.RightTop:
				right -= dx;
				top += dy;
				break;
			case DockCorner.RightBottom:
				right -= dx;
				bottom -= dy;
				break;
			case DockCorner.LeftBottom:
				left += dx;
				bottom -= dy;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Doc Corner.");
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (ShapePosition != null)
			{
				CalcNewIndents(dx, dy, out var left, out var top, out var right, out var bottom);
				SetIndents(left, top, right, bottom);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RelativePositionShapeMoving : AnnotationOperation
	{
		private RelativePosition ShapePosition => base.Annotation.ShapePosition as RelativePosition;

		public RelativePositionShapeMoving(Annotation annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		public override void Run(int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
		{
			if (ShapePosition != null)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset(ShapePosition.GetShapeLocation(base.Annotation.LastAnchorPosition), dx, dy, 0.0);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X + 0.5 * (double)base.Annotation.Width, diagramPoint.Y + 0.5 * (double)base.Annotation.Height);
				double num = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)base.Annotation.LastAnchorPosition, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint2);
				ShapePosition.SetConnectorLength(MathUtils.CalcLength2D(base.Annotation.LastAnchorPosition, diagramPoint2));
				ShapePosition.SetAngle(MathUtils.Radian2Degree(0.0 - num));
			}
		}
	}

	public class AdjectiveConnectorInfo

		public double Angle => angle;
