		public IntersectionInfo PositiveIntersection => positiveIntersection;

		public IntersectionInfo NegativeIntersection => negativeIntersection;

		public AdjectiveConnectorInfo(double angle, double sweepAngle, DiagramPoint centerPoint, IntersectionInfo positiveIntersection, IntersectionInfo negativeIntersection)
		{
			this.angle = angle;
			this.sweepAngle = sweepAngle;
			this.centerPoint = centerPoint;
			this.positiveIntersection = positiveIntersection;
			this.negativeIntersection = negativeIntersection;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AnnotationShape
	{
		private class ArrowInfo
		{
			private DiagramPoint arrowPoint;

			private DiagramPoint arrowConnectionPoint;

			public DiagramPoint ArrowPoint => arrowPoint;

			public DiagramPoint ArrowConnectionPoint => arrowConnectionPoint;

			public ArrowInfo(DiagramPoint arrowPoint, DiagramPoint arrowConnectionPoint)
			{
				this.arrowPoint = arrowPoint;
				this.arrowConnectionPoint = arrowConnectionPoint;
			}
		}

		private const int DefaultArrowLength = 13;

		private const double AdditionalArrowAngle = 0.262;

		private readonly IAnnotationShapeOwner annotation;

		private int ActualBorderThickness
		{
			get
			{
				if (annotation.State.Normal)
				{
					return annotation.BorderThickness;
				}
				return annotation.BorderThickness + 1;
			}
		}

		private bool BorderVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!annotation.BorderVisible)
				{
					return !annotation.State.Normal;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private FillOptionsBase FillOptions => annotation.FillStyle.Options;

		protected IAnnotationShapeOwner Annotation => annotation;

		private static DiagramPoint Rotate(DiagramPoint point, float angle)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Rotate(angle);
			PointF[] array = new PointF[1] { (PointF)point };
			dXMatrix.TransformPoints(array);
			return (DiagramPoint)array[0];
		}

		public static AnnotationShape CreateInstance(Annotation annotation)
		{
			switch (annotation.ShapeKind)
			{
			case ShapeKind.Rectangle:
				return new RectangleAnnotationShape(annotation);
			case ShapeKind.RoundedRectangle:
				return new RoundedRectangleAnnotationShape(annotation);
			case ShapeKind.Ellipse:
				return new EllipseAnnotationShape(annotation);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown annotation shape kind");
				return new RectangleAnnotationShape(annotation);
			}
		}

		public AnnotationShape(IAnnotationShapeOwner annotation)
		{
			this.annotation = annotation;
		}

		private void RenderLineConnector(ChartRenderer renderer, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, int thickness, Color color)
		{
			DiagramPoint? lineConnectorFinishPoint = GetLineConnectorFinishPoint(bounds, anchorPoint);
			if (lineConnectorFinishPoint.HasValue)
			{
				Point point = new Point((int)Math.Floor(anchorPoint.X), (int)Math.Floor(anchorPoint.Y));
				if ((double)point.X == lineConnectorFinishPoint.Value.X || (double)point.Y == lineConnectorFinishPoint.Value.Y)
				{
					renderer.DrawLine(point, (Point)lineConnectorFinishPoint.Value, color, thickness);
					return;
				}
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawLine(point, (Point)lineConnectorFinishPoint.Value, color, thickness);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private static void ReduceSweepAngle(double delta, ref double angle1, ref double angle2)
		{
			double num = CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(angle2, angle1);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				angle2 -= delta;
				angle1 += delta;
			}
			else
			{
				angle2 += delta;
				angle1 -= delta;
			}
		}

		private double CorrectAngle(ZPlaneRectangle rect, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, double angle)
		{
			CalcTangentLines(rect, anchorPoint, out var angle2, out var angle3);
			ReduceSweepAngle(0.001, ref angle2, ref angle3);
			double num = CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(angle3, angle2);
			double num2 = CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(angle, angle2);
			double value = CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(angle, angle3);
			bool flag = false;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				if (num2 < 0.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (num2 > num)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (num2 < num)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (Math.Abs(num2) < Math.Abs(value))
				{
					return angle2;
				}
				return angle3;
			}
			return angle;
		}

		private ArrowInfo CalcArrowInfo(DiagramPoint anchorPoint, DiagramPoint connectionPoint, AdjectiveConnectorInfo connectorInfo, bool isNegative)
		{
			double num = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(connectorInfo.SweepAngle / 2.0 + 0.262);
			double num2 = Math.Cos(0.262);
			double d = Math.Min(MathUtils.CalcLength2D((DiagramPoint)connectorInfo.PositiveIntersection.IntersectionPoint, anchorPoint), MathUtils.CalcLength2D((DiagramPoint)connectorInfo.NegativeIntersection.IntersectionPoint, anchorPoint)) * num2;
			double num3 = Math.Min(13 + Annotation.BorderThickness, Math.Floor(d));
			double num4 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num5 = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(anchorPoint, connectorInfo.CenterPoint);
			if (num3 - num5 == num3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num6 = num3 / num5;
			if (num3 - num4 == num3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num7 = num3 / num4;
			double num8 = (isNegative ? (0.0 - num) : num);
			num8 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(connectorInfo.Angle + num8);
			if (Annotation.ConnectorStyle == AnnotationConnectorStyle.NotchedArrow)
			{
				num6 /= 2.0;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X + (connectorInfo.CenterPoint.X - anchorPoint.X) * num6, anchorPoint.Y + (connectorInfo.CenterPoint.Y - anchorPoint.Y) * num6);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X + num7 * Math.Cos(num8), anchorPoint.Y + num7 * Math.Sin(num8));
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = GeometricUtils.CalcLinesIntersection((GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint2, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint, (GRealPoint2D)anchorPoint, (GRealPoint2D)connectionPoint, intervalMode: false);
			if (!gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ArrowInfo(diagramPoint2, (DiagramPoint)gRealPoint2D.Value);
		}

		private DiagramPoint? GetLineConnectorFinishPoint(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			if (annotation.Angle % 360 != 0)
			{
				anchorPoint = Rotate(anchorPoint, -annotation.Angle);
			}
			if (Annotation.ConnectorStyle == AnnotationConnectorStyle.Line && !IsPointInsideShape(anchorPoint, bounds))
			{
				IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(anchorPoint, bounds.Center, bounds);
				if (intersectionInfo.HasIntersection)
				{
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint = Rotate((DiagramPoint)intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint, annotation.Angle);
					return new DiagramPoint(Math.Floor(diagramPoint.X), Math.Floor(diagramPoint.Y));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPathWithConnector(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			AdjectiveConnectorInfo adjectiveConnectorInfo = CalcAdjectiveConnectorPoints(bounds, anchorPoint);
			if (adjectiveConnectorInfo == null)
			{
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = (DiagramPoint)adjectiveConnectorInfo.PositiveIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = (DiagramPoint)adjectiveConnectorInfo.NegativeIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			if (Annotation.ConnectorStyle == AnnotationConnectorStyle.Tail)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)anchorPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrowInfo arrowInfo = CalcArrowInfo(anchorPoint, diagramPoint2, adjectiveConnectorInfo, isNegative: true);
				if (arrowInfo != null)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)anchorPoint, (PointF)arrowInfo.ArrowPoint);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)arrowInfo.ArrowPoint, (PointF)arrowInfo.ArrowConnectionPoint);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)arrowInfo.ArrowConnectionPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2);
				}
			}
			CreateShape(dXGraphicsPath, adjectiveConnectorInfo.PositiveIntersection, adjectiveConnectorInfo.NegativeIntersection, bounds);
			if (Annotation.ConnectorStyle == AnnotationConnectorStyle.Tail)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)anchorPoint);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrowInfo arrowInfo2 = CalcArrowInfo(anchorPoint, diagramPoint, adjectiveConnectorInfo, isNegative: false);
				if (arrowInfo2 != null)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)arrowInfo2.ArrowConnectionPoint);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)arrowInfo2.ArrowConnectionPoint, (PointF)arrowInfo2.ArrowPoint);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)arrowInfo2.ArrowPoint, (PointF)anchorPoint);
				}
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private void RenderFill(ChartRenderer renderer, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (BorderVisible ? CorrectRectangle(bounds) : bounds);
			if (zPlaneRectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality);
				Color backColor = Annotation.BackColor;
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateGraphicsPath(zPlaneRectangle, anchorPoint);
				if (FillOptions == null)
				{
					renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath, backColor);
				}
				else
				{
					RectangleF bounds2 = dXGraphicsPath.GetBounds();
					RectangleF gradientRect = new Rectangle((int)bounds2.X, (int)bounds2.Y, (int)bounds2.Width, (int)bounds2.Height);
					FillOptions.RenderAnnotationShape(renderer, dXGraphicsPath, gradientRect, backColor);
				}
				renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
				if (!BorderVisible)
				{
					RenderLineConnector(renderer, bounds, anchorPoint, 1, backColor);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private PixelOffsetMode GetPixelOffsetMode(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			int num = (int)MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(Annotation.Angle);
			if (((num >= 45 && num < 135) || (num > 225 && num <= 315)) && (int)(rect.Height + rect.Width) % 2 != 0)
			{
				if (ActualBorderThickness % 2 == 0)
				{
					return PixelOffsetMode.Default;
				}
				return PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
			}
			if (ActualBorderThickness % 2 != 0)
			{
				return PixelOffsetMode.Default;
			}
			return PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
		}

		private ZPlaneRectangle CorrectRectangle(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			int num = (int)MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(Annotation.Angle);
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if ((num >= 0 && num < 45) || (num > 315 && num <= 360))
			{
				num2 = (num3 = ActualBorderThickness / 2);
			}
			else if (num >= 45 && num < 135)
			{
				if ((int)(rect.Height + rect.Width) % 2 == 0)
				{
					num2 = ActualBorderThickness / 2;
					num3 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)ActualBorderThickness / 2.0);
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)ActualBorderThickness / 2.0);
					num3 = ActualBorderThickness / 2;
				}
			}
			else if (num > 225 && num <= 315)
			{
				if ((int)(rect.Height + rect.Width) % 2 == 0)
				{
					num2 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)ActualBorderThickness / 2.0);
					num3 = ActualBorderThickness / 2;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = ActualBorderThickness / 2;
					num3 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)ActualBorderThickness / 2.0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = (num3 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)ActualBorderThickness / 2.0));
			}
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(rect, num2, num3, 0.0);
			zPlaneRectangle.Width = ((zPlaneRectangle.Width - (double)ActualBorderThickness < 0.0) ? 0.0 : (zPlaneRectangle.Width - (double)ActualBorderThickness));
			zPlaneRectangle.Height = ((zPlaneRectangle.Height - (double)ActualBorderThickness < 0.0) ? 0.0 : (zPlaneRectangle.Height - (double)ActualBorderThickness));
			return zPlaneRectangle;
		}

		protected static void ProcessAngle(double angle, ref double minAngle, ref double maxAngle)
		{
			double num = CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(angle, minAngle);
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				minAngle = angle;
			}
			num = CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(angle, maxAngle);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				maxAngle = angle;
			}
		}

		protected static double CalcBetweenAnglesMinDifference(double minuend, double deducts)
		{
			minuend = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(minuend);
			deducts = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(deducts);
			double num = minuend - deducts;
			if (num > Math.PI)
			{
				return num - Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			if (num < -Math.PI)
			{
				return num + Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected abstract void CalcTangentLines(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, out double angle1, out double angle2);

		protected abstract void CreateShape(DXGraphicsPath path, IntersectionInfo positiveIntersection, IntersectionInfo negativeIntersection, ZPlaneRectangle bounds);

		protected abstract IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(DiagramPoint segmentPoint1, DiagramPoint segmentPoint2, ZPlaneRectangle bounds);

		protected abstract DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(ZPlaneRectangle bounds);

		protected internal abstract bool IsPointInsideShape(DiagramPoint point, ZPlaneRectangle bounds);

		internal AdjectiveConnectorInfo CalcAdjectiveConnectorPoints(ZPlaneRectangle rect, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(anchorPoint, rect.Center, rect);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = (intersectionInfo.HasIntersection ? ((DiagramPoint)intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint) : rect.Center);
			double num = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(anchorPoint, diagramPoint);
			double y = 0.15 * Math.Min(rect.Width, rect.Height);
			double num2 = Math.Atan2(y, num);
			double num3 = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)anchorPoint, (GRealPoint2D)rect.Center);
			double angle = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(num3 + num2 / 2.0);
			double angle2 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(num3 - num2 / 2.0);
			angle = CorrectAngle(rect, anchorPoint, angle);
			angle2 = CorrectAngle(rect, anchorPoint, angle2);
			num += 2.0 * Math.Max(rect.Width, rect.Height);
			DiagramPoint segmentPoint = new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X + num * Math.Cos(angle), anchorPoint.Y + num * Math.Sin(angle));
			DiagramPoint segmentPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X + num * Math.Cos(angle2), anchorPoint.Y + num * Math.Sin(angle2));
			IntersectionInfo positiveIntersection = CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(anchorPoint, segmentPoint, rect);
			IntersectionInfo negativeIntersection = CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(anchorPoint, segmentPoint2, rect);
			if (positiveIntersection.HasIntersection && negativeIntersection.HasIntersection)
			{
				return new AdjectiveConnectorInfo(num3, num2, diagramPoint, positiveIntersection, negativeIntersection);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			if (annotation.Angle % 360 != 0)
			{
				anchorPoint = Rotate(anchorPoint, -annotation.Angle);
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = ((Annotation.ConnectorStyle != AnnotationConnectorStyle.None && Annotation.ConnectorStyle != AnnotationConnectorStyle.Line && !IsPointInsideShape(anchorPoint, bounds)) ? CreateGraphicsPathWithConnector(bounds, anchorPoint) : CreateGraphicsPath(bounds));
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Rotate(annotation.Angle);
			dXGraphicsPath.Transform(dXMatrix);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public abstract Size CalcInnerSize(Size outerSize);

		public abstract Size CalcOuterSize(Size innerSize);

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			if (Annotation.Shadow.Visible && bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				Annotation.Shadow.BeforeShadowRender(renderer);
				Point point = new Point((int)(0.0 - bounds.Center.X), (int)(0.0 - bounds.Center.Y));
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.TranslateModel(-point.X, -point.Y);
				using (DXGraphicsPath path = CreateGraphicsPath((ZPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(bounds, point.X, point.Y, 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(anchorPoint, point.X, point.Y, 0.0)))
				{
					renderer.FillPath(path, Annotation.Shadow.Color);
				}
				renderer.RestoreState();
				Annotation.Shadow.AfterShadowRender(renderer);
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			if (!bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return;
			}
			renderer.SaveState();
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(0.0 - bounds.Center.X, 0.0 - bounds.Center.Y);
			renderer.TranslateModel((float)(0.0 - diagramPoint.X), (float)(0.0 - diagramPoint.Y));
			anchorPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset(anchorPoint, diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0);
			bounds = (ZPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(bounds, diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0);
			RenderFill(renderer, bounds, anchorPoint);
			if (BorderVisible || annotation.CanDrag())
			{
				Color color = annotation.BorderColor;
				int num = ActualBorderThickness;
				if (annotation.RuntimeOperationSelect)
				{
					color = Color.Red;
					num++;
				}
				RenderBorder(renderer, bounds, anchorPoint, num, color);
			}
			renderer.RestoreState();
		}

		public HitRegion CreateHitRegion(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(0.0 - bounds.Center.X, 0.0 - bounds.Center.Y);
			anchorPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset(anchorPoint, diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0);
			ZPlaneRectangle bounds2 = (ZPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(bounds, diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, 0.0);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateGraphicsPath(bounds2, anchorPoint);
			DiagramPoint? lineConnectorFinishPoint = GetLineConnectorFinishPoint(bounds2, anchorPoint);
			if (lineConnectorFinishPoint.HasValue && lineConnectorFinishPoint.Value != new DiagramPoint(Math.Floor(anchorPoint.X), Math.Floor(anchorPoint.Y)))
			{
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath2 = new DXGraphicsPath();
				dXGraphicsPath2.AddLine(new Point((int)Math.Floor(anchorPoint.X), (int)Math.Floor(anchorPoint.Y)), (Point)lineConnectorFinishPoint.Value);
				using (DXPen pen = new DXPen(Annotation.BorderColor, ActualBorderThickness))
				{
					dXGraphicsPath2.Widen(pen);
				}
				dXGraphicsPath.CloseFigure();
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath2, connect: false);
			}
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Translate((float)(0.0 - diagramPoint.X), (float)(0.0 - diagramPoint.Y));
			dXGraphicsPath.Transform(dXMatrix);
			return new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath);
		}

		public void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, int thickness, Color color)
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = CorrectRectangle(bounds);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(GetPixelOffsetMode(bounds));
			if (!zPlaneRectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				using (DXGraphicsPath path = CreateGraphicsPath(bounds, anchorPoint))
				{
					renderer.FillPath(path, color);
				}
				renderer.DrawLine((Point)anchorPoint, (Point)bounds.Center, color, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				using DXGraphicsPath path2 = CreateGraphicsPath(zPlaneRectangle, anchorPoint);
				renderer.DrawPath(path2, color, thickness);
			}
			RenderLineConnector(renderer, bounds, anchorPoint, thickness, color);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}
	}
	public class EllipseAnnotationShape : AnnotationShape
	{
		public EllipseAnnotationShape(Annotation annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcTangentLines(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, out double angle1, out double angle2)
		{
			MathUtils.CalcEllipseTangentLines(bounds, anchorPoint, out angle1, out angle2);
		}

		protected override void CreateShape(DXGraphicsPath path, IntersectionInfo positiveIntersection, IntersectionInfo negativeIntersection, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = (DiagramPoint)positiveIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = (DiagramPoint)negativeIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			double num = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)bounds.Center, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint2);
			double num2 = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)bounds.Center, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint);
			double angleRadian = ((num > num2) ? (Math.PI * 2.0 - (num - num2)) : (0.0 - (num - num2)));
			path.AddArc((RectangleF)bounds, (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(num), (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(angleRadian));
		}

		protected override IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(DiagramPoint segmentPoint1, DiagramPoint segmentPoint2, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			return GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithEllipseIntersection((GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint1, (GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint2, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.LeftBottom.Point, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.RightTop.Point);
		}

		protected override DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddEllipse((RectangleF)bounds);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointInsideShape(DiagramPoint point, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			return MathUtils.IsPointInsideEllipse(point, bounds);
		}

		public override Size CalcInnerSize(Size outerSize)
		{
			bool flag = outerSize.Width > outerSize.Height;
			double num = (flag ? ((double)outerSize.Width / 2.0) : ((double)outerSize.Height / 2.0));
			double num2 = (flag ? ((double)outerSize.Height / 2.0) : ((double)outerSize.Width / 2.0));
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num2 * num2 / 2.0);
			double num4 = num * num3 / num2;
			double value = (flag ? (num4 * 2.0) : (num3 * 2.0));
			double value2 = (flag ? (num3 * 2.0) : (num4 * 2.0));
			return new Size((int)Math.Abs(value), (int)Math.Abs(value2));
		}

		public override Size CalcOuterSize(Size innerSize)
		{
			bool flag = innerSize.Width > innerSize.Height;
			double num = (flag ? ((double)innerSize.Width / 2.0) : ((double)innerSize.Height / 2.0));
			double num2 = (flag ? ((double)innerSize.Height / 2.0) : ((double)innerSize.Width / 2.0));
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(2.0 * num2 * num2);
			double num4 = num * num3 / num2;
			double doubleNumber = (flag ? (num4 * 2.0) : (num3 * 2.0));
			double doubleNumber2 = (flag ? (num3 * 2.0) : (num4 * 2.0));
			return new Size(MathUtils.Ceiling(doubleNumber), MathUtils.Ceiling(doubleNumber2));
		}
	}
	public class RectangleAnnotationShape : AnnotationShape
	{
		public RectangleAnnotationShape(IAnnotationShapeOwner annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		private static int GetIndexBySegmentKind(SegmentKind segmentKind)
		{
			switch (segmentKind)
			{
			case SegmentKind.Left:
				return 3;
			case SegmentKind.Bottom:
				return 2;
			case SegmentKind.Right:
				return 1;
			case SegmentKind.Top:
				return 0;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect segment kind.");
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected override void CalcTangentLines(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			minAngle = double.MaxValue;
			maxAngle = double.MinValue;
			Vertex[] vertices = bounds.Vertices;
			foreach (Vertex vertex in vertices)
			{
				AnnotationShape.ProcessAngle(GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)anchorPoint, (GRealPoint2D)vertex.Point), ref minAngle, ref maxAngle);
			}
		}

		protected override IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(DiagramPoint segmentPoint1, DiagramPoint segmentPoint2, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			return GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection((GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint1, (GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint2, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.LeftBottom.Point, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.RightTop.Point);
		}

		protected override DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle((RectangleF)bounds);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		protected override void CreateShape(DXGraphicsPath path, IntersectionInfo positiveIntersection, IntersectionInfo negativeIntersection, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = (DiagramPoint)positiveIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = (DiagramPoint)negativeIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[5] { bounds.LeftBottom, bounds.RightBottom, bounds.RightTop, bounds.LeftTop, bounds.LeftBottom };
			int indexBySegmentKind = GetIndexBySegmentKind(negativeIntersection.SegmentKind);
			int indexBySegmentKind2 = GetIndexBySegmentKind(positiveIntersection.SegmentKind);
			int num = array.Length - 1;
			path.AddLine((PointF)diagramPoint2, (PointF)array[indexBySegmentKind + 1]);
			for (int num2 = (indexBySegmentKind + 1) % num; num2 != indexBySegmentKind2; num2 = (num2 + 1) % num)
			{
				path.AddLine((PointF)array[num2], (PointF)array[num2 + 1]);
			}
			path.AddLine((PointF)array[indexBySegmentKind2], (PointF)diagramPoint);
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointInsideShape(DiagramPoint point, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			return bounds.Contains(point);
		}

		public override Size CalcInnerSize(Size outerSize)
		{
			return outerSize;
		}

		public override Size CalcOuterSize(Size innerSize)
		{
			return innerSize;
		}
	}
	public class RoundedRectangleAnnotationShape : RectangleAnnotationShape
	{
		public RoundedRectangleAnnotationShape(IAnnotationShapeOwner annotation)
			: base(annotation)
		{
		}

		private int GetIndexBySegmentKind(SegmentKind segmentKind)
		{
			switch (segmentKind)
			{
			case SegmentKind.Left:
			case SegmentKind.LeftTop:
				return 0;
			case SegmentKind.LeftBottom:
			case SegmentKind.Bottom:
				return 6;
			case SegmentKind.RightBottom:
			case SegmentKind.Right:
				return 4;
			case SegmentKind.RightTop:
			case SegmentKind.Top:
				return 2;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown segment kind.");
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private bool IsLineSegment(SegmentKind segmentKind)
		{
			switch (segmentKind)
			{
			case SegmentKind.LeftBottom:
			case SegmentKind.RightBottom:
			case SegmentKind.RightTop:
			case SegmentKind.LeftTop:
				return false;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void CalcArcParams(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, int fillet, int segmentIndex, out ZPlaneRectangle arcRect, out int startAngle)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] arcsPoints = GetArcsPoints(bounds, fillet);
			int num = segmentIndex / 2;
			startAngle = 180 + num * 90;
			arcRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(arcsPoints[num], fillet * 2, fillet * 2);
		}

		private DiagramPoint[] GetLinesPoints(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, int fillet)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint[8]
			{
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, bounds.Top - (double)fillet),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom + (double)fillet),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left + (double)fillet, bounds.Bottom),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right - (double)fillet, bounds.Bottom),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom + (double)fillet),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right, bounds.Top - (double)fillet),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right - (double)fillet, bounds.Top),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left + (double)fillet, bounds.Top)
			};
		}

		private DiagramPoint[] GetArcsPoints(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, int fillet)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint[4]
			{
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right - (double)(fillet * 2), bounds.Bottom),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right - (double)(fillet * 2), bounds.Top - (double)(fillet * 2)),
				new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, bounds.Top - (double)(fillet * 2))
			};
		}

		protected override void CalcTangentLines(ZPlaneRectangle bounds, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			int correctedFillet = GetCorrectedFillet(new Size((int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height));
			if (correctedFillet < 1)
			{
				base.CalcTangentLines(bounds, anchorPoint, out minAngle, out maxAngle);
				return;
			}
			DiagramPoint[] linesPoints = GetLinesPoints(bounds, correctedFillet);
			minAngle = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)anchorPoint, (GRealPoint2D)linesPoints[0]);
			maxAngle = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 1; i < linesPoints.Length; i++)
			{
				AnnotationShape.ProcessAngle(GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)anchorPoint, (GRealPoint2D)linesPoints[i]), ref minAngle, ref maxAngle);
			}
			linesPoints = GetArcsPoints(bounds, correctedFillet);
			DiagramPoint[] array = linesPoints;
			foreach (DiagramPoint point in array)
			{
				if (MathUtils.CalcEllipseTangentLines(new ZPlaneRectangle(point, correctedFillet * 2, correctedFillet * 2), anchorPoint, out var angle, out var angle2))
				{
					AnnotationShape.ProcessAngle(angle, ref minAngle, ref maxAngle);
					AnnotationShape.ProcessAngle(angle2, ref minAngle, ref maxAngle);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithShapeIntersection(DiagramPoint segmentPoint1, DiagramPoint segmentPoint2, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			int correctedFillet = GetCorrectedFillet(new Size((int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height));
			if (correctedFillet < 1)
			{
				return GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection((GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint1, (GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint2, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.LeftBottom.Point, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.RightTop.Point);
			}
			return GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRoundedRectIntersection((GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint1, (GRealPoint2D)segmentPoint2, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.LeftBottom.Point, (GRealPoint2D)bounds.RightTop.Point, correctedFillet);
		}

		protected override DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			int correctedFillet = GetCorrectedFillet(new Size((int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height));
			if (correctedFillet < 1)
			{
				return base.CreateGraphicsPath(bounds);
			}
			DiagramPoint[] linesPoints = GetLinesPoints(bounds, correctedFillet);
			DiagramPoint[] arcsPoints = GetArcsPoints(bounds, correctedFillet);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			for (int i = 0; i < linesPoints.Length - 1; i += 2)
			{
				int num = i / 2;
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(arcsPoints[num], correctedFillet * 2, correctedFillet * 2);
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)linesPoints[i], (PointF)linesPoints[i + 1]);
				dXGraphicsPath.AddArc((RectangleF)zPlaneRectangle, 180 + num * 90, 90f);
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		protected override void CreateShape(DXGraphicsPath path, IntersectionInfo positiveIntersection, IntersectionInfo negativeIntersection, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			int correctedFillet = GetCorrectedFillet(new Size((int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height));
			if (correctedFillet < 1)
			{
				base.CreateShape(path, positiveIntersection, negativeIntersection, bounds);
				return;
			}
			DiagramPoint[] linesPoints = GetLinesPoints(bounds, correctedFillet);
			int indexBySegmentKind = GetIndexBySegmentKind(negativeIntersection.SegmentKind);
			int indexBySegmentKind2 = GetIndexBySegmentKind(positiveIntersection.SegmentKind);
			CalcArcParams(bounds, correctedFillet, indexBySegmentKind, out var arcRect, out var startAngle);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = (DiagramPoint)positiveIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = (DiagramPoint)negativeIntersection.IntersectionPoint;
			if (IsLineSegment(negativeIntersection.SegmentKind))
			{
				path.AddLine((PointF)diagramPoint2, (PointF)linesPoints[indexBySegmentKind + 1]);
				path.AddArc((RectangleF)arcRect, startAngle, 90f);
			}
			else
			{
				double num = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)arcRect.Center, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint2);
				double num2 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(startAngle + 90));
				double angleRadian = ((num > num2) ? (Math.PI * 2.0 - (num - num2)) : (0.0 - (num - num2)));
				path.AddArc((RectangleF)arcRect, (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(num), (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(angleRadian));
			}
			for (int num3 = (indexBySegmentKind + 2) % linesPoints.Length; num3 != indexBySegmentKind2; num3 = (num3 + 2) % linesPoints.Length)
			{
				CalcArcParams(bounds, correctedFillet, num3, out arcRect, out startAngle);
				path.AddLine((PointF)linesPoints[num3], (PointF)linesPoints[num3 + 1]);
				path.AddArc((RectangleF)arcRect, startAngle, 90f);
			}
			if (IsLineSegment(positiveIntersection.SegmentKind))
			{
				path.AddLine((PointF)linesPoints[indexBySegmentKind2], (PointF)diagramPoint);
				return;
			}
			CalcArcParams(bounds, correctedFillet, indexBySegmentKind2, out arcRect, out startAngle);
			path.AddLine((PointF)linesPoints[indexBySegmentKind2], (PointF)linesPoints[indexBySegmentKind2 + 1]);
			double num4 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(startAngle));
			double num5 = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle((GRealPoint2D)arcRect.Center, (GRealPoint2D)diagramPoint);
			double angleRadian2 = ((num4 > num5) ? (Math.PI * 2.0 - (num4 - num5)) : (0.0 - (num4 - num5)));
			path.AddArc((RectangleF)arcRect, (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(num4), (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(angleRadian2));
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointInsideShape(DiagramPoint point, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			int correctedFillet = GetCorrectedFillet(new Size((int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height));
			if (correctedFillet < 1)
			{
				return base.IsPointInsideShape(point, bounds);
			}
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left + (double)correctedFillet, bounds.Bottom), bounds.Width - (double)(correctedFillet * 2), bounds.Height);
			if (zPlaneRectangle.Contains(point))
			{
				return true;
			}
			zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom + (double)correctedFillet), bounds.Width, bounds.Height - (double)(correctedFillet * 2));
			if (zPlaneRectangle.Contains(point))
			{
				return true;
			}
			DiagramPoint[] arcsPoints = GetArcsPoints(bounds, correctedFillet);
			DiagramPoint[] array = arcsPoints;
			foreach (DiagramPoint point2 in array)
			{
				if (MathUtils.IsPointInsideEllipse(point, new ZPlaneRectangle(point2, correctedFillet * 2, correctedFillet * 2)))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetCorrectedFillet(Size size)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(size.Width / 2, size.Height / 2);
			if (num >= base.Annotation.ShapeFillet)
			{
				return base.Annotation.ShapeFillet;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override Size CalcInnerSize(Size outerSize)
		{
			int correctedFillet = GetCorrectedFillet(outerSize);
			if (outerSize.Width < outerSize.Height)
			{
				return new Size(outerSize.Width, outerSize.Height - correctedFillet * 2);
			}
			return new Size(outerSize.Width - correctedFillet * 2, outerSize.Height);
		}

		public override Size CalcOuterSize(Size innerSize)
		{
			if (innerSize.Width < innerSize.Height)
			{
				return new Size(innerSize.Width, innerSize.Height + base.Annotation.ShapeFillet * 2);
			}
			return new Size(innerSize.Width + base.Annotation.ShapeFillet * 2, innerSize.Height);
		}
	}

		}

	public class TextAnnotationViewData : AnnotationViewData
	{
		private readonly RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent painter;

		private new TextAnnotation Annotation => (TextAnnotation)base.Annotation;

		internal RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent TextPainter => painter;

		public TextAnnotationViewData(TextAnnotation annotation, AnnotationShape shape, RefinedPoint connectedPoint, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, DiagramPoint location)
			: base(annotation, shape, connectedPoint, anchorPoint, location)
		{
			painter = CreateTextPainter();
		}

		public TextAnnotationViewData(TextAnnotation annotation, AnnotationShape shape, RefinedPoint connectedPoint, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, DiagramPoint location, Rectangle allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing)
			: base(annotation, shape, connectedPoint, anchorPoint, location)
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle rect = (ZPlaneRectangle)allowedBoundsForAnnotationPlacing;
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.Intersect(rect, base.Bounds);
			if (zPlaneRectangle != null)
			{
				base.Bounds = zPlaneRectangle;
				base.InnerBounds = CalculateInnerBounds();
				painter = CreateTextPainter();
			}
		}

		private RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent CreateTextPainter()
		{
			Size size = base.InnerBounds.Size.ToSize();
			if (size.Width > 0 && size.Height > 0)
			{
				TextAnnotation textAnnotation = Annotation;
				Point basePoint = new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(base.InnerBounds.Center.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(base.InnerBounds.Center.Y));
				if (base.InnerBounds.Width != (double)Annotation.Width || base.InnerBounds.Height != (double)Annotation.Height)
				{
					return new RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent(textAnnotation.Angle, basePoint, textAnnotation.ActualText, size, textAnnotation, mixColorByHitTestState: false, shouldCorrectAngle: false, size.Width, size.Height);
				}
				return new RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent(textAnnotation.Angle, basePoint, textAnnotation.ActualText, size, textAnnotation, mixColorByHitTestState: false, shouldCorrectAngle: false, parseText: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetAnnotationContentRenderBounds()
		{
			Rectangle contentRenderBounds = base.InnerBounds.RoundToRectangle();
			contentRenderBounds.Inflate(0, 1);
			Annotation.ContentRenderBounds = contentRenderBounds;
		}

		protected override void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (painter != null)
			{
				HitRegion hitRegion = base.Shape.CreateHitRegion(base.HitTestBounds, base.AnchorPoint);
				painter.Render(renderer, base.HitTestController, hitRegion, base.ConnectedPoint, Color.Black, 1.0);
			}
			SetAnnotationContentRenderBounds();
		}
	}

	public abstract class AppearanceBase
	{
		public abstract void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader);

		public virtual void Assign(AppearanceBase obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("obj");
			}
		}
	}
	public class WholeChartAppearance : AppearanceBase
	{
		public Color BorderColor { get; set; }

		public Color BackColor { get; set; }

		public Color TitleColor { get; set; }

		public int ChartTitleFontSize { get; set; }

		public int SeriesTitleFontSize { get; set; }

		public BackgroundImage BackImage { get; set; }

		public override void ReadFromXml(XmlReader xmlReader)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Chart");
			BorderColor = XmlUtils.ReadColor(xmlReader, "BorderColor");
			BackColor = XmlUtils.ReadColor(xmlReader, "BackColor");
			TitleColor = XmlUtils.ReadColor(xmlReader, "TitleColor");
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
			BackImage = null;
		}

		public override void Assign(AppearanceBase obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is WholeChartAppearance wholeChartAppearance))
			{
				return;
			}
			BorderColor = wholeChartAppearance.BorderColor;
			BackColor = wholeChartAppearance.BackColor;
			TitleColor = wholeChartAppearance.TitleColor;
			ChartTitleFontSize = wholeChartAppearance.ChartTitleFontSize;
			SeriesTitleFontSize = wholeChartAppearance.SeriesTitleFontSize;
			if (wholeChartAppearance.BackColor != Color.Empty)
			{
				if (wholeChartAppearance.BackImage != null)
				{
					if (BackImage == null)
					{
						BackImage = (BackgroundImage)wholeChartAppearance.BackImage.Clone();
					}
					BackImage.Assign(wholeChartAppearance.BackImage);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BackImage = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class RectangularBorderLayout
	{
		private readonly RectangularBorder border;

		private RectangleF topRect;

		private RectangleF bottomRect;

		private RectangleF leftRect;

		private RectangleF rightRect;

		public RectangleF TopRect => topRect;

		public RectangleF BottomRect => bottomRect;

		public RectangleF LeftRect => leftRect;

		public RectangleF RightRect => rightRect;

		public RectangularBorderLayout(RectangularBorder border, RectangleF rect, int actualThickness)
		{
			this.border = border;
			CalculateLayout(rect, actualThickness);
		}

		private void CalculateLayout(RectangleF rect, int actualThickness)
		{
			topRect = border.CalcBorderItem(rect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.TopItem, actualThickness);
			bottomRect = border.CalcBorderItem(rect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.BottomItem, actualThickness);
			leftRect = border.CalcBorderItem(rect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.LeftItem, actualThickness);
			rightRect = border.CalcBorderItem(rect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.RightItem, actualThickness);
		}

		public void Enlarge()
		{
			topRect = border.Enlarge(topRect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.TopItem);
			bottomRect = border.Enlarge(bottomRect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.BottomItem);
			leftRect = border.Enlarge(leftRect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.LeftItem);
			rightRect = border.Enlarge(rightRect, RectangularBorder.RectangularBorderItem.RightItem);
		}
	}
	public sealed class BorderHelper
	{
		public static void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangularBorder border, RectangleF rect, HitTestState hitTestState, int actualThickness, Color actualColor)
		{
			if (border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				RectangularBorderLayout rectangularBorderLayout = new RectangularBorderLayout(border, rect, actualThickness);
				if (!hitTestState.Normal)
				{
					rectangularBorderLayout.Enlarge();
				}
				RectangularBorder.Render(renderer, rectangularBorderLayout, actualColor);
			}
			else if (!hitTestState.Normal)
			{
				RectangleF bounds = new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width - 1f, rect.Height - 1f);
				renderer.DrawRectangle(bounds, actualColor, 1f);
			}
		}

		public static Color CalculateBorderColor(Color borderColor, Color automaticBorderColor)
		{
			if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return borderColor;
			}
			return automaticBorderColor;
		}

		public static Color CalculateBorderColor(BorderBase border, Color automaticBorderColor)
		{
			return CalculateBorderColor(border.Color, automaticBorderColor);
		}

		public static Color CalculateBorderColor(BorderBase border, Color automaticBorderColor, HitTestState hitState)
		{
			if (hitState.Normal)
			{
				return CalculateBorderColor(border, automaticBorderColor);
			}
			return hitState.ActualColor;
		}

		public static int CalculateBorderThickness(BorderBase border, int thickness)
		{
			if (!border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		private BorderHelper()
		{
		}
	}
	public class ChartSvgPalette : ISvgPaletteProvider
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, Color> colors = new Dictionary<string, Color>();

		public double Opacity { get; set; }

		Color ISvgPaletteProvider.GetColor(Color defaultColor)
		{
			return defaultColor;
		}

		Color ISvgPaletteProvider.GetColor(string defaultColor)
		{
			return colors[defaultColor];
		}

		Color ISvgPaletteProvider.GetColorByStyleName(string styleName, string defaultColor, object tag)
		{
			return colors[tag.ToString()];
		}

		bool ISvgPaletteProvider.Equals(ISvgPaletteProvider provider)
		{
			return Equals(provider);
		}

		ISvgPaletteProvider ISvgPaletteProvider.Clone()
		{
			return (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)Clone();
		}

		public void AddColor(string key, Color color)
		{
			colors.Add(key, color);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			colors.Clear();
		}

		public void Assign(ChartSvgPalette palette)
		{
			Clear();
			Opacity = palette.Opacity;
			foreach (string key in palette.colors.Keys)
			{
				AddColor(key, palette.colors[key]);
			}
		}

		public ChartSvgPalette Clone()
		{
			ChartSvgPalette chartSvgPalette = new ChartSvgPalette();
			chartSvgPalette.Assign(this);
			return chartSvgPalette;
		}
	}
	public class SimpleColorSvgPaletteProvider : ISvgPaletteProvider
	{
		private readonly double opacity;

		private readonly Color actualColor;

		double ISvgPaletteProvider.Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return opacity;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public SimpleColorSvgPaletteProvider(double opacity, Color actualColor)
		{
			this.opacity = opacity;
			this.actualColor = actualColor;
		}

		Color ISvgPaletteProvider.GetColor(Color defaultColor)
		{
			return actualColor;
		}

		Color ISvgPaletteProvider.GetColor(string defaultColor)
		{
			return actualColor;
		}

		Color ISvgPaletteProvider.GetColorByStyleName(string styleName, string defaultColor, object tag)
		{
			return actualColor;
		}

		ISvgPaletteProvider ISvgPaletteProvider.Clone()
		{
			return (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)new SimpleColorSvgPaletteProvider(opacity, actualColor);
		}

		public bool Equals(ISvgPaletteProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider is SimpleColorSvgPaletteProvider simpleColorSvgPaletteProvider)
			{
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(opacity, simpleColorSvgPaletteProvider.opacity, 1E-07) == 0)
				{
					return actualColor == simpleColorSvgPaletteProvider.actualColor;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public static class DashStyleHelper
	{
		public static System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle ConvertDashStyle(DashStyle dashStyle)
		{
			return dashStyle switch
			{
				DashStyle.Solid => System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Solid, 
				DashStyle.Dash => System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dash, 
				DashStyle.Dot => System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dot, 
				DashStyle.DashDot => System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.DashDot, 
				DashStyle.DashDotDot => System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.DashDotDot, 
				DashStyle.Empty => System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Custom, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		public static void ApplyDashStyle(DXPen pen, DashStyle dashStyle)
		{
			pen.DashStyle = (DXDashStyle)ConvertDashStyle(dashStyle);
		}
	}
	public abstract class GradientPainterBase : IGradientPainter
	{
		protected ChartRenderer renderer;

		private PlanePolygon[] FillPlanePolygon(PlanePolygon polygon, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				polygon.Vertices[i].Color = CalcVertexColor(polygon.Vertices[i], gradientRect, color, color2);
			}
			return new PlanePolygon[1] { polygon };
		}

		protected GradientPainterBase(ChartRenderer assignRenderer)
		{
			renderer = assignRenderer;
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RenderRectangle(rect, gradientRect, color, color2);
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			RenderRectangle(rect, color, color2);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderStrip(LineStrip vertices, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			boundRectangle.Inflate(1f, 1f);
			renderer.SetClipping(boundRectangle);
			RenderStrip(vertices, boundRectangle, color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			GRealRect2D boundingRectangle = strip.GetBoundingRectangle();
			boundingRectangle.Inflate(1.0, 1.0);
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)boundingRectangle.Left, (float)boundingRectangle.Top, (float)boundingRectangle.Width, (float)boundingRectangle.Height);
			renderer.SetClipping(rectangleF);
			RenderBezier(strip, rectangleF, color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderCircle(PointF center, float radius, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF clipping = new RectangleF(center.X, center.Y, 0f, 0f);
			clipping.Inflate(radius + 1f, radius + 1f);
			renderer.SetClipping(clipping);
			RenderCircle(center, radius, color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderRing(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2, float thickness)
		{
			RenderRing(bounds, gradientRect, color, color2, thickness);
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderEllipse(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF clipping = new RectangleF(center.X, center.Y, 0f, 0f);
			clipping.Inflate(semiAxisX + 1f, semiAxisY + 1f);
			renderer.SetClipping(clipping);
			RenderEllipse(center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY, color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderPie(PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF clipping = new RectangleF(center.X, center.Y, 0f, 0f);
			clipping.Inflate(majorSemiAxis + 1f, minorSemiAxis + 1f);
			renderer.SetClipping(clipping);
			RenderPie(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent, gradientBounds, color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RenderPath(path, gradientRect, color, color2);
		}

		void IGradientPainter.RenderAnnotationPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			RenderAnnotationPath(path, gradientRect, color, color2);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}

		GraphicsCommand IGradientPainter.CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(rect, gradientRect, color, color2);
		}

		GraphicsCommand IGradientPainter.CreateGraphicsCommand(LineStrip vertices, ZPlaneRectangle boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			boundRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.Inflate(boundRectangle, 1.0, 1.0);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new IntersectClippingGraphicsCommand(boundRectangle);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateGraphicsCommand(vertices, boundRectangle, color, color2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		GraphicsCommand IGradientPainter.CreatePieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle clipRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.Inflate(new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(center.X, center.Y), 0.0, 0.0), majorSemiAxis + 1f, minorSemiAxis + 1f);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new IntersectClippingGraphicsCommand(clipRectangle);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreatePieGraphicsCommand(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent, gradientBounds, color, color2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		void IGradientPainter.FillPolygon(Graphics gr, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			if (!polygon.Rect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = MathUtils.StrongRound(polygon.Rect);
			RectangleF clipBounds = gr.ClipBounds;
			if (!(polygon is RectanglePolygon))
			{
				rectangle = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(rectangle, 1, 1);
				polygon.Rect = rectangle;
			}
			gr.SetClip(Rectangle.Intersect(Rectangle.Round(clipBounds), rectangle));
			try
			{
				if (polygon is RectanglePolygon)
				{
					rectangle = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(rectangle, 1, 1);
					polygon.Rect = rectangle;
				}
				FillPolygon(gr, polygon, color, color2);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.SetClip(clipBounds);
			}
		}

		PlanePolygon[] IGradientPainter.FillPlanePolygon(PlanePolygon polygon, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			if (color == color2)
			{
				polygon.SameColors = true;
				polygon.Color = color;
				return new PlanePolygon[1] { polygon };
			}
			polygon.SameColors = false;
			return FillPlanePolygon(polygon, gradientRect, color, color2);
		}

		protected abstract void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderStrip(LineStrip vertices, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderCircle(PointF center, float radius, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderRing(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2, float thickness);

		protected abstract void RenderEllipse(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderPie(PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderAnnotationPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(LineStrip vertices, ZPlaneRectangle boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreatePieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void FillPolygon(Graphics gr, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract Color CalcVertexColor(Vertex vertex, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);
	}
	public abstract class GradientPainter : GradientPainterBase
	{
		protected GradientPainter(ChartRenderer renderer)
			: base(renderer)
		{
		}

		protected abstract DXBrush CreateBrush(IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2);

		protected override void FillPolygon(Graphics gr, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			using DXBrush dxBrush = CreateBrush(polygon, color, color2);
			using DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = polygon.GetPath();
			GraphicsPath path = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(graphicsPath);
			using Brush brush = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateBrush(dxBrush);
			gr.FillPath(brush, path);
		}

		protected override void RenderAnnotationPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RenderPath(path, gradientRect, color, color2);
		}

		protected override void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RenderRectangle(rect, rect, color, color2);
		}

		protected RectangleF CorrectPieGradientRectangle(RectangleF rect)
		{
			if (!rect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			rect.Y--;
			rect.Height += 2f;
			rect.X--;
			rect.Width += 2f;
			return rect;
		}
	}

		{
			return new DXLinearGradientBrush(polygon.Rect, color, color2, DXLinearGradientMode.BackwardDiagonal);
		}

		protected override Color CalcVertexColor(Vertex vertex, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			Color color3 = GraphicUtils.CalcGradientColor(color, color2, 0.5);
			double ratio = (gradientRect.Top - vertex.Y) / gradientRect.Height;
			Color color4 = GraphicUtils.CalcGradientColor(color, color3, ratio);
			Color color5 = GraphicUtils.CalcGradientColor(color3, color2, ratio);

			return GraphicUtils.CalcGradientColor(color4, color5, ratio);
		}

	public abstract class CenterHorizontalGradientPainter : GradientPainterBase
	{
		public CenterHorizontalGradientPainter(ChartRenderer renderer)
			: base(renderer)
		{
		}

		private void CalcHalfRectangles(ZPlaneRectangle rect, out ZPlaneRectangle leftRect, out ZPlaneRectangle rightRect)
		{
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(rect.Width);
			int num2 = num / 2 + 1;
			int num3 = num - num2;
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			leftRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(rect.Location, num2, rect.Height);
			rightRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(rect.Location.X + (double)num2, rect.Location.Y), num3, rect.Height);
		}

		private void FillLeftRectangle(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			using DXBrush dxBrush = CreateLeftBrush(rect, color, color2);
			using Brush brush = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateBrush(dxBrush);
			gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
		}

		private void FillRightRectangle(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF clipBounds = gr.ClipBounds;
			gr.SetClip(Rectangle.Intersect(GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(clipBounds), rect));
			try
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(rect.X - 1, rect.Y, rect.Width + 1, rect.Height);
				using DXBrush dxBrush = CreateRightBrush(rect2, color, color2);
				using Brush brush = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateBrush(dxBrush);
				gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect2);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.SetClip(clipBounds);
			}
		}

		protected override void FillPolygon(Graphics gr, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			CalcHalfRectangles((ZPlaneRectangle)polygon.Rect, out var leftRect, out var rightRect);
			FillRightRectangle(gr, (Rectangle)rightRect, color, color2);
			FillLeftRectangle(gr, (Rectangle)leftRect, color, color2);
		}

		protected override Color CalcVertexColor(Vertex vertex, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			GetColors(color, color2, out var c, out var c2);
			double ratio = 2.0 * Math.Abs(gradientRect.Center.X - vertex.X) / gradientRect.Width;
			return GraphicUtils.CalcGradientColor(c2, c, ratio);
		}

		protected abstract void GetColors(Color color, Color color2, out Color c, out Color c2);

		protected abstract DXBrush CreateLeftBrush(Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract DXBrush CreateRightBrush(Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderLeftRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderRightRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderLeftEllipse(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderRightEllipse(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderLeftPath(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderRightPath(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected override void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(gradientRect, SplitRectangleMode.Horizontal, weld: true);
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				array[1].X--;
				array[1].Width++;
				renderer.SetClipping(array[1]);
				RenderRightRectangle(renderer, RectangleF.Intersect(rect, array[1]), array[1], color, color2);
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
				RenderLeftRectangle(renderer, RectangleF.Intersect(rect, array[0]), array[0], color, color2);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderStrip(LineStrip vertices, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderCircle(PointF center, float radius, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderRing(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2, float thickness)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderEllipse(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(GraphicUtils.CalcBoundRectangle(new GRealPoint2D(center.X, center.Y), semiAxisX, semiAxisY), SplitRectangleMode.Horizontal, weld: true);
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[1].Left, array[1].Bottom - 1f, array[1].Width + 1f, array[1].Height + 2f));
			RenderRightEllipse(renderer, center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[0].Left - 1f, array[0].Bottom - 1f, array[0].Width + 2f, array[0].Height + 2f));
			RenderLeftEllipse(renderer, center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override void RenderPie(PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(gradientRect, SplitRectangleMode.Horizontal, weld: true);
			array[0].Width++;
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[1].Left, array[1].Bottom - 1f, array[1].Width + 1f, array[1].Height + 2f));
			array[1].Offset(-1f, 0f);
			array[1].Width++;
			RenderRightPath(renderer, path, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[0].Left - 1f, array[0].Bottom - 1f, array[0].Width + 1f, array[0].Height + 2f));
			RenderLeftPath(renderer, path, array[0], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override void RenderAnnotationPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(gradientRect, SplitRectangleMode.Horizontal, weld: true);
			renderer.SetClipping(GraphicUtils.CorrectRectangle(array[0], new Point(-1, -1), new Size(1, 2)));
			RenderLeftPath(renderer, path, array[0], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			renderer.SetClipping(GraphicUtils.CorrectRectangle(array[1], new Point(0, -1), new Size(1, 2)));
			RenderRightPath(renderer, path, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = rect;
			rectangleF.Width = MathUtils.StrongRound(rectangleF.Width / 2f);
			RenderLeftRectangle(renderer, rectangleF, rectangleF, color, color2);
			rectangleF.X += rectangleF.Width;
			rectangleF.Width = rect.Width - rectangleF.Width;
			RenderRightRectangle(renderer, rectangleF, rectangleF, color, color2);
		}

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreateLeftRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreateRightRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			CalcHalfRectangles(gradientRect, out var leftRect, out var rightRect);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			IntersectClippingGraphicsCommand intersectClippingGraphicsCommand = new IntersectClippingGraphicsCommand(rightRect);
			rightRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(rightRect.Location.X - 1.0, rightRect.Location.Y), rightRect.Width + 1.0, rightRect.Height);
			intersectClippingGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateRightRectangleGraphicsCommand((ZPlaneRectangle)Rectangle.Intersect((Rectangle)rect, (Rectangle)rightRect), rightRect, color, color2));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(intersectClippingGraphicsCommand);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateLeftRectangleGraphicsCommand((ZPlaneRectangle)Rectangle.Intersect((Rectangle)rect, (Rectangle)leftRect), leftRect, color, color2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(LineStrip vertices, ZPlaneRectangle boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreatePieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class CenterVerticalGradientPainter : GradientPainterBase
	{
		public CenterVerticalGradientPainter(ChartRenderer renderer)
			: base(renderer)
		{
		}

		private void CalcHalfRectangles(ZPlaneRectangle rect, out ZPlaneRectangle topRect, out ZPlaneRectangle bottomRect)
		{
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(rect.Height);
			int num2 = num / 2 + 1;
			int num3 = num - num2;
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			topRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(rect.Location, rect.Width, num2);
			bottomRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y + (double)num2), rect.Width, num3);
		}

		private void FillTopRectangle(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			using DXBrush dxBrush = CreateTopBrush(rect, color, color2);
			using Brush brush = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateBrush(dxBrush);
			gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
		}

		private void FillBottomRectangle(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF clipBounds = gr.ClipBounds;
			gr.SetClip(Rectangle.Intersect(GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(clipBounds), rect));
			try
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y - 1, rect.Width, rect.Height + 1);
				using DXBrush dxBrush = CreateBottomBrush(rect2, color, color2);
				using Brush brush = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateBrush(dxBrush);
				gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect2);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.SetClip(clipBounds);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void GetColors(Color color, Color color2, out Color c, out Color c2);

		protected abstract DXBrush CreateTopBrush(Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract DXBrush CreateBottomBrush(Rectangle rect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected override void FillPolygon(Graphics gr, IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			CalcHalfRectangles((ZPlaneRectangle)polygon.Rect, out var topRect, out var bottomRect);
			FillBottomRectangle(gr, (Rectangle)bottomRect, color, color2);
			FillTopRectangle(gr, (Rectangle)topRect, color, color2);
		}

		protected override Color CalcVertexColor(Vertex vertex, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			GetColors(color, color2, out var c, out var c2);
			double ratio = 2.0 * Math.Abs(gradientRect.Center.Y - vertex.Y) / gradientRect.Height;
			return GraphicUtils.CalcGradientColor(c2, c, ratio);
		}

		protected abstract void RenderTopRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderBottomRectangle(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderTopEllipse(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderBottomEllipse(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderTopPath(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract void RenderBottomPath(ChartRenderer renderer, DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected override void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(gradientRect, SplitRectangleMode.Vertical, weld: false);
			renderer.SetClipping(array[1]);
			RenderBottomRectangle(renderer, RectangleF.Intersect(rect, array[1]), array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			RenderTopRectangle(renderer, RectangleF.Intersect(rect, array[0]), array[0], color, color2);
		}

		protected override void RenderStrip(LineStrip vertices, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderCircle(PointF center, float radius, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderRing(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2, float thickness)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderEllipse(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(GraphicUtils.CalcBoundRectangle(new GRealPoint2D(center.X, center.Y), semiAxisX, semiAxisY), SplitRectangleMode.Vertical, weld: true);
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[0].Left - 1f, array[0].Bottom - 1f, array[0].Width + 2f, array[0].Height + 2f));
			RenderTopEllipse(renderer, center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY, array[0], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[1].Left - 1f, array[1].Bottom, array[1].Width + 2f, array[1].Height + 1f));
			RenderBottomEllipse(renderer, center, semiAxisX, semiAxisX, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override void RenderPie(PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(gradientRect, SplitRectangleMode.Vertical, weld: true);
			array[0].Height++;
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[0].Left - 1f, array[0].Bottom - 1f, array[0].Width + 2f, array[0].Height + 1f));
			RenderTopPath(renderer, path, array[0], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			renderer.SetClipping(new RectangleF(array[1].Left - 1f, array[1].Bottom, array[1].Width + 2f, array[1].Height + 1f));
			array[1].Offset(0f, -1f);
			array[1].Height++;
			RenderBottomPath(renderer, path, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override void RenderAnnotationPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = GraphicUtils.SplitRectangle(gradientRect, SplitRectangleMode.Vertical, weld: true);
			renderer.SetClipping(array[0]);
			RenderTopPath(renderer, path, array[0], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			renderer.SetClipping(array[1]);
			RenderBottomPath(renderer, path, array[1], color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		protected override void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = rect;
			rectangleF.Height = MathUtils.StrongRound(rectangleF.Height / 2f);
			RenderTopRectangle(renderer, rectangleF, rectangleF, color, color2);
			rectangleF.Y += rectangleF.Height;
			rectangleF.Height = rect.Height - rectangleF.Height;
			RenderBottomRectangle(renderer, rectangleF, rectangleF, color, color2);
		}

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreateTopRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract GraphicsCommand CreateBottomRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2);

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			CalcHalfRectangles(gradientRect, out var topRect, out var bottomRect);
			IntersectClippingGraphicsCommand intersectClippingGraphicsCommand = new IntersectClippingGraphicsCommand(bottomRect);
			bottomRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(bottomRect.Location.X, bottomRect.Location.Y - 1.0), bottomRect.Width, bottomRect.Height + 1.0);
			intersectClippingGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateBottomRectangleGraphicsCommand((ZPlaneRectangle)Rectangle.Intersect((Rectangle)rect, (Rectangle)bottomRect), bottomRect, color, color2));
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(intersectClippingGraphicsCommand);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateTopRectangleGraphicsCommand((ZPlaneRectangle)Rectangle.Intersect((Rectangle)rect, (Rectangle)topRect), topRect, color, color2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(LineStrip vertices, ZPlaneRectangle boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreatePieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class RadialGradientPainter : GradientPainter
	{
		public RadialGradientPainter(ChartRenderer renderer)
			: base(renderer)
		{
		}

		protected abstract Color GetCenterColor(Color color, Color color2);

		protected abstract Color GetSurroundColor(Color color, Color color2);

		protected override DXBrush CreateBrush(IPolygon polygon, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = polygon.GetPath();
			DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush = new DXPathGradientBrush(dXGraphicsPath.GetPathData());
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterColor = GetCenterColor(color, color2);
			dXPathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { GetSurroundColor(color, color2) };
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = new Point(Convert.ToInt32(polygon.Rect.Location.X + polygon.Rect.Width / 2f), Convert.ToInt32(polygon.Rect.Location.Y + polygon.Rect.Height / 2f));
			return dXPathGradientBrush;
		}

		protected override Color CalcVertexColor(Vertex vertex, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return color;
		}

		protected override void RenderRectangle(RectangleF rect, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderStrip(LineStrip vertices, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillPolygonGradient(vertices, boundRectangle, GetCenterColor(color, color2), GetSurroundColor(color, color2));
		}

		protected override void RenderBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, RectangleF boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderCircle(PointF center, float radius, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillCircle(center, radius, GetCenterColor(color, color2), GetSurroundColor(color, color2));
		}

		protected override void RenderRing(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2, float thickness)
		{
			renderer.DrawRing(bounds, gradientRect, GetCenterColor(color, color2), GetSurroundColor(color, color2), thickness);
		}

		protected override void RenderEllipse(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillEllipse(center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY, GetCenterColor(color, color2), GetSurroundColor(color, color2));
		}

		protected override void RenderPie(PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			renderer.FillPie(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent, GetCenterColor(color, color2), GetSurroundColor(color, color2));
		}

		protected override void RenderPath(DXGraphicsPath path, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			path?.Dispose();
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(LineStrip vertices, ZPlaneRectangle boundRectangle, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return new CenterGradientPolygonGraphicsCommand(vertices);
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreatePieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			return new CenterGradientPieGraphicsCommand(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent, GetCenterColor(color, color2), GetSurroundColor(color, color2));
		}
	}
