	public static class PaletteSerializer
	{
		private const string PaletteNodeName = "Palette";

		private const string PaletteNameAttributeName = "Name";

		private const string ScaleModeAttributeName = "ScaleMode";

		private const string PaletteEntryNodeName = "PaletteEntry";

		private const string ColorAttributeName = "Color";

		private const string Color2AttributeName = "Color2";

		private static XmlNode AddNode(XmlDocument document, XmlNode parent, string name)
		{
			XmlNode xmlNode = document.CreateElement(name);
			parent.AppendChild(xmlNode);
			return xmlNode;
		}

		private static void AddAttribute(XmlDocument document, XmlNode parent, string name, string value)
		{
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = document.CreateAttribute(name);
			xmlAttribute.Value = value;
			parent.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
		}

		public static void SaveToStream(Palette palette, Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream != null && palette != null)
			{
				XmlDocument xmlDocument = SafeXml.CreateDocument();
				XmlNode parent = AddNode(xmlDocument, xmlDocument, "Palette");
				AddAttribute(xmlDocument, parent, "Name", palette.Name);
				AddAttribute(xmlDocument, parent, "ScaleMode", palette.ScaleMode.ToString());
				for (int i = 0; i < palette.Count; i++)
				{
					XmlNode parent2 = AddNode(xmlDocument, parent, "PaletteEntry");
					AddAttribute(xmlDocument, parent2, "Color", ColorTranslator.ToHtml(palette[i].Color));
					AddAttribute(xmlDocument, parent2, "Color2", ColorTranslator.ToHtml(palette[i].Color2));
				}
				xmlDocument.Save(stream);
			}
		}

		public static void SetPaletteName(Palette palette, string name)
		{
			palette.SetName(name);
		}

		public static Palette LoadFromStream(IChartContainer chart, Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (TryLoadPalettes(stream, out var document) && document.ChildNodes.Count == 1)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode = document.ChildNodes[0];
				if (xmlNode.Name == "Palette" && (xmlNode.Attributes.Count == 1 || xmlNode.Attributes.Count == 2) && xmlNode.Attributes[0].Name == "Name")
				{
					string value = xmlNode.Attributes[0].Value;
					PaletteScaleMode? paletteScaleMode = null;
					if (xmlNode.Attributes.Count == 2)
					{
						paletteScaleMode = (PaletteScaleMode)Enum.Parse(typeof(PaletteScaleMode), xmlNode.Attributes[1].Value);
					}
					Palette palette = (paletteScaleMode.HasValue ? new Palette(value, paletteScaleMode.Value) : new Palette(value));
					for (int i = 0; i < xmlNode.ChildNodes.Count; i++)
					{
						XmlNode xmlNode2 = xmlNode.ChildNodes[i];
						if (xmlNode2.Name == "PaletteEntry" && xmlNode2.Attributes.Count == 2 && xmlNode2.Attributes[0].Name == "Color" && xmlNode2.Attributes[1].Name == "Color2")
						{
							Color color = ColorTranslator.FromHtml(xmlNode2.Attributes[0].Value);
							Color color2 = ColorTranslator.FromHtml(xmlNode2.Attributes[1].Value);
							palette.Add(new PaletteEntry(color, color2));
						}
					}
					return palette;
				}
			}
			chart?.ShowErrorMessage(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPaletteEditorInvalidFile), ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPaletteEditorTitle));
			return null;
		}

		private static bool TryLoadPalettes(Stream stream, out XmlDocument document)
		{
			document = null;
			try
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				document = SafeXml.CreateDocument(stream, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
	}

	public class RectanglePolygon : IPolygon
	{
		private RectangleF rect;

		public bool EnableAntialiasing => false;

		public RectangleF Rect
		{
			get
			{
				return rect;
			}
			set
			{
				rect = value;
			}
		}

		public LineStrip Vertices => null;

		public RectanglePolygon(RectangleF rect)
		{
			this.rect = rect;
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath GetPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle(rect);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Shadow shadow, int shadowSize)
		{
			shadow.Render(renderer, rect, shadowSize);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, FillOptionsBase fillOptions, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			fillOptions?.RenderRectangle(renderer, rect, rect, color, color2);
			if (borderThickness > 0)
			{
				renderer.DrawRectangle(rect, borderColor, borderThickness);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CirclePolygon : IPolygon
	{
		private RectangleF rect;

		private GRealPoint2D center;

		private float radius;

		public bool EnableAntialiasing => true;

		public GRealPoint2D Center => center;

		public float Radius => radius;

		public RectangleF Rect
		{
			get
			{
				return rect;
			}
			set
			{
				rect = value;
			}
		}

		public LineStrip Vertices => null;

		public CirclePolygon(GRealPoint2D center, float radius)
		{
			this.center = center;
			this.radius = radius;
			rect = new RectangleF((float)center.X, (float)center.Y, 0f, 0f);
			rect.Inflate(radius, radius);
			MathUtils.StrongRound(rect);
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath GetPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			if (radius > 0f)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddEllipse((float)center.X - radius, (float)center.Y - radius, radius * 2f, radius * 2f);
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Shadow shadow, int shadowSize)
		{
			shadow.Render(renderer, center, radius, shadowSize);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, FillOptionsBase fillOptions, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			if (fillOptions != null)
			{
				fillOptions.FillCircle(renderer, new PointF((float)center.X, (float)center.Y), radius, color, color2);
				if (borderThickness > 0)
				{
					fillOptions.DrawCircle(renderer, center.ToPointF(), radius, borderColor, borderThickness);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class VariousPolygon : IPolygon
	{
		private RectangleF rect;

		private LineStrip vertices;

		public bool EnableAntialiasing => true;

		public RectangleF Rect
		{
			get
			{
				return rect;
			}
			set
			{
				rect = value;
			}
		}

		public LineStrip Vertices => vertices;

		public VariousPolygon(LineStrip vertices, RectangleF rect)
		{
			this.vertices = vertices;
			this.rect = rect;
		}

		public virtual DXGraphicsPath GetPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			if (vertices.Count > 1)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(StripsUtils.Convert(vertices));
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Shadow shadow, int shadowSize)
		{
			shadow.Render(renderer, this, shadowSize);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillPolygon(vertices, color);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, FillOptionsBase fillOptions, Color color, Color color2, Color borderColor, int borderThickness)
		{
			fillOptions?.Render(renderer, vertices, rect, color, color2);
			if (borderThickness > 0)
			{
				renderer.DrawPolygon(vertices, borderColor, borderThickness);
			}
		}

		internal static VariousPolygon Intersect(VariousPolygon polygon, Rectangle clipBounds)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = RectangleF.Intersect(polygon.rect, clipBounds);
			return new VariousPolygon(new LineStrip(new List<GRealPoint2D>
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Left, rectangleF.Top),
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Left, rectangleF.Bottom),
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Right, rectangleF.Top),
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Right, rectangleF.Bottom)
			}), rectangleF);
		}
	}
	public class PredefinedPaletteList : PaletteListBase
	{
		public override Palette this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				Palette palette = base[name];
				if (palette == null)
				{
					palette = Palettes.GetPalette(name);
					if (palette != null)
					{
						Add(name, palette);
						if (palette.Name != palette.DisplayName && !base.Contains(palette.DisplayName))
						{
							Add(palette.DisplayName, palette);
						}
					}
				}
				return palette;
			}
		}

		public override string[] GetPaletteNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(Palettes.GetNames());
			list.Sort();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override string[] GetLocalizedPaletteNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(Palettes.GetLocalizedNames());
			list.Sort();
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorsPredefinedPaletteList : PredefinedPaletteList
	{
		public override Palette this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				Palette palette = base[name];
				if (palette == null)
				{
					palette = IndicatorsPalettes.GetPalette(name);
					if (palette != null)
					{
						Add(palette.Name, palette);
					}
				}
				return palette;
			}
		}

		public override string[] GetPaletteNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(IndicatorsPalettes.GetNames());
			list.Sort();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override string[] GetLocalizedPaletteNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(IndicatorsPalettes.GetLocalizedNames());
			list.Sort();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

	public static class ChartDataMemberTypeHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<ChartDataMemberType, bool> isValueDataMember = new Dictionary<ChartDataMemberType, bool>
		{

			},

				false

			},

				ChartDataMemberType.SeriesColor,
				false
			}
		};

		public static bool IsValueDataMember(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return isValueDataMember[dataMember];
		}

		public static ValueLevel DataMemberToValueLevel(ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return dataMember switch
			{
				ChartDataMemberType.Value => ValueLevel.Value, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Value_1 => ValueLevel.Value_1, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Value_2 => ValueLevel.Value_2, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Low => ValueLevel.Low, 
				ChartDataMemberType.High => ValueLevel.High, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Open => ValueLevel.Open, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Close => ValueLevel.Close, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Weight => ValueLevel.Weight, 
				ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMax => ValueLevel.BoxPlotMax, 
				ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMin => ValueLevel.BoxPlotMin, 
				ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMean => ValueLevel.BoxPlotMean, 
				ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMedian => ValueLevel.BoxPlotMedian, 
				ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_1 => ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_1, 
				ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_3 => ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_3, 
				_ => ValueLevel.Value, 
			};
		}

		public static ChartDataMemberType ValueLevelToChartDataMemberType(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return valueLevel switch
			{
				ValueLevel.Value => ChartDataMemberType.Value, 
				ValueLevel.Value_1 => ChartDataMemberType.Value_1, 
				ValueLevel.Value_2 => ChartDataMemberType.Value_2, 
				ValueLevel.Low => ChartDataMemberType.Low, 
				ValueLevel.High => ChartDataMemberType.High, 
				ValueLevel.Open => ChartDataMemberType.Open, 
				ValueLevel.Close => ChartDataMemberType.Close, 
				ValueLevel.Weight => ChartDataMemberType.Weight, 
				ValueLevel.BoxPlotMax => ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMax, 
				ValueLevel.BoxPlotMin => ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMin, 
				ValueLevel.BoxPlotMean => ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMean, 
				ValueLevel.BoxPlotMedian => ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotMedian, 
				ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_1 => ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_1, 
				ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_3 => ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotQuartile_3, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown ValueLevel"), 
			};
		}

		public static T? GetValueFromArray<T>(ValueLevel valueLevel, T[] values) where T : struct
		{
			switch (valueLevel)
			{
			case ValueLevel.Value:
				if (values.Length == 1 || values.Length == 2)
				{
					return values[0];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.Value_1:
				if (values.Length == 2)
				{
					return values[0];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.Value_2:
				if (values.Length == 2)
				{
					return values[1];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.Low:
				if (values.Length == 4)
				{
					return values[0];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.High:
				if (values.Length == 4)
				{
					return values[1];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.Open:
				if (values.Length == 4)
				{
					return values[2];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.Close:
				if (values.Length == 4)
				{
					return values[3];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.Weight:
				if (values.Length == 2)
				{
					return values[1];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMin:
				if (values.Length > 4)
				{
					return values[0];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_1:
				if (values.Length > 4)
				{
					return values[1];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMedian:
				if (values.Length > 4)
				{
					return values[2];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_3:
				if (values.Length > 4)
				{
					return values[3];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMax:
				if (values.Length > 4)
				{
					return values[4];
				}
				return null;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMean:
				if (values.Length > 5)
				{
					return values[5];
				}
				return null;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException("The " + valueLevel.ToString() + " value level is unknown.");
			}
		}

		public static T? GetValueFromArray<T>(ChartDataMemberType dataMember, T[] values) where T : struct
		{
			return GetValueFromArray(DataMemberToValueLevel(dataMember), values);
		}

		public static object GetValue(ISeriesPoint point, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			if (IsValueDataMember(dataMember))
			{
				return GetValue(point.Values, dataMember);
			}
			return dataMember switch
			{
				ChartDataMemberType.Argument => point.ArgumentX.UserArgument, 
				ChartDataMemberType.Color => ColorProvider.ParseColor(point.ColorCore), 
				_ => point.ToolTipHint.ToString(), 
			};
		}

		private static object GetValue(ISeriesPointValues values, ChartDataMemberType dataMember)
		{
			return values.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => GetValueFromArray(dataMember, values.DateTimeValues), 
				Scale.TimeSpan => GetValueFromArray(dataMember, values.TimeSpanValues), 
				_ => GetValueFromArray(dataMember, values.NumericalValues), 
			};
		}

		public static object[] GetValues(ISeriesPointValues values)
		{
			return values.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => ToObjectArray(values.DateTimeValues), 
				Scale.TimeSpan => ToObjectArray(values.TimeSpanValues), 
				_ => ToObjectArray(values.NumericalValues), 
			};
		}

		private static object[] ToObjectArray<T>(T[] array)
		{
			int num = array.Length;
			object[] array2 = new object[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i];
			}
			return array2;
		}
	}

	internal interface IPropertySetter
	{
		bool SetProperty(IDataPoint dataPoint, int index);

		IDataPointFactory GetDataPointFactory(SeriesBase series);
	}
	internal abstract class PointPropertySetter : IPropertySetter
	{
		protected IChartDataAdapter Adapter { get; }

		protected PointPropertySetter(IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			Adapter = adapter;
		}

		private List<T> GetOutliers<T>(int index)
		{
			if (!(Adapter.GetObjectValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.BoxPlotOutliers) is IEnumerable<T> source))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return source.ToList();
		}

		private T[] MergeValues<T>(T[] values, List<T> outliers)
		{
			int num = values.Length;
			int count = outliers.Count;
			T[] array = new T[num + count];
			Array.Copy(values, array, num);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[num + i] = outliers[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private bool CheckValues<T>(T[] values, Func<T, bool> checker)
		{
			int num = CropForBoxPlot(values);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!checker(values[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int CropForBoxPlot<T>(T[] values)
		{
			return Math.Min(5, values.Length);
		}

		protected T[] GetValues<T>(int index, ChartDataMemberType[] dataMembers, Func<int, ChartDataMemberType, T> valueGetter)
		{
			T[] array = new T[dataMembers.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < dataMembers.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = valueGetter(index, dataMembers[i]);
			}
			if (dataMembers.Length < 6)
			{
				return array;
			}
			List<T> outliers = GetOutliers<T>(index);
			if (outliers != null)
			{
				return MergeValues(array, outliers);
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected bool SetValue<T>(IDataPoint point, T[] values, Func<T, bool> valueChecker, Action<IDataPoint, T[]> setter)
		{
			bool flag = CheckValues(values, valueChecker);
			if (flag)
			{
				setter(point, values);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public abstract bool SetProperty(IDataPoint dataPoint, int index);

		public virtual IDataPointFactory GetDataPointFactory(SeriesBase series)
		{
			return new RefinedPointFactory();
		}
	}

	internal interface IMissingPointProcessor
	{
		bool IsPointMissing(IDataPoint point, bool argumentSet, bool valuesSet);
	}
	internal class DefaultMissingPointProcessor : IMissingPointProcessor
	{
		private readonly ISeriesBase series;

		public DefaultMissingPointProcessor(ISeriesBase series)
		{
			this.series = series;
		}

		bool IMissingPointProcessor.IsPointMissing(IDataPoint point, bool argumentSet, bool valuesSet)
		{
			if (!IsPointEmpty(argumentSet, valuesSet))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsArgumentMissing(argumentSet) || IsValuesMissing(valuesSet))
			{
				return true;
			}
			point.MakeEmpty();
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsPointEmpty(bool argumentSet, bool valuesSet)
		{
			if (argumentSet)
			{
				return !valuesSet;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsArgumentMissing(bool argumentSet)
		{
			if (!argumentSet)
			{
				return !series.ProcessMissingArguments;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsValuesMissing(bool valuesSet)
		{
			if (!valuesSet)
			{
				return !series.ProcessMissingValues;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class HistogramMissingPointProcessor : DefaultMissingPointProcessor
	{
		public HistogramMissingPointProcessor(ISeriesBase series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsPointEmpty(bool argumentSet, bool valuesSet)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool IsValuesMissing(bool valuesSet)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class DataBindPointBuilder : IDataPointBuilder
	{
		private readonly IPropertySetter argumentSetter;

		private readonly IPropertySetter valuesSetter;

		private readonly IPropertySetter tagSetter;

		private readonly IMissingPointProcessor missingPointProcessor;

		private IDataPointFactory pointFactory;

		IDataPointFactory IDataPointBuilder.PointFactory
		{
			get
			{
				return pointFactory;
			}
			set
			{
				pointFactory = value;
			}
		}

		public DataBindPointBuilder(IPropertySetter argumentSetter, IPropertySetter valuesSetter, IPropertySetter tagSetter, IMissingPointProcessor missingPointProcessor)
		{
			this.argumentSetter = argumentSetter;
			this.valuesSetter = valuesSetter;
			this.tagSetter = tagSetter;
			this.missingPointProcessor = missingPointProcessor;
			pointFactory = new RefinedPointFactory();
		}

		IDataPoint IDataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(int index)
		{
			return BuildPointCore(index);
		}

		void IDataPointBuilder.SetPointOwner(IDataPoint point, SeriesBase series)
		{
		}

		protected virtual IDataPoint BuildPointCore(int index)
		{
			IDataPoint dataPoint = pointFactory.Create();
			bool argumentSet = argumentSetter.SetProperty(dataPoint, index);
			bool valuesSet = valuesSetter.SetProperty(dataPoint, index);
			tagSetter.SetProperty(dataPoint, index);
			if (missingPointProcessor.IsPointMissing(dataPoint, argumentSet, valuesSet))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dataPoint;
		}
	}
	internal class FilteringPointBuilder : DataBindPointBuilder
	{
		private readonly IComplexDataAdapter adapter;

		public FilteringPointBuilder(IPropertySetter argumentSetter, IPropertySetter valuesSetter, IPropertySetter tagSetter, IMissingPointProcessor missingPointProcessor, IComplexDataAdapter adapter)
			: base(argumentSetter, valuesSetter, tagSetter, missingPointProcessor)
		{
			this.adapter = adapter;
		}

		protected override IDataPoint BuildPointCore(int index)
		{
			if (!adapter.IsItemFit(index))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.BuildPointCore(index);
		}
	}
	internal class IndicatorPointBuilder : IDataPointBuilder
	{
		private readonly IDataPointBuilder innerBuilder;

		private readonly IChartDataAdapter adapter;

		private readonly IDataSourceIndicator indicator;

		IDataPointFactory IDataPointBuilder.PointFactory
		{
			get
			{
				return innerBuilder.PointFactory;
			}
			set
			{
				innerBuilder.PointFactory = value;
			}
		}

		public IndicatorPointBuilder(IDataPointBuilder builder, IChartDataAdapter adapter, IDataSourceIndicator indicator)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)indicator, "Indicator");
			innerBuilder = builder;
			this.adapter = adapter;
			this.indicator = indicator;
		}

		IDataPoint IDataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(int index)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)innerBuilder.BuildPoint(index);
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double numericalValue = adapter.GetNumericalValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.ErrorBarsNegativeError);
			double numericalValue2 = adapter.GetNumericalValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.ErrorBarsPositiveError);
			double[] values = new double[2]
			{
				CorrectValue(numericalValue),
				CorrectValue(numericalValue2)
			};
			seriesPoint.IndicatorPoint = indicator.CreatePoint(values);
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		void IDataPointBuilder.SetPointOwner(IDataPoint point, SeriesBase series)
		{
		}

		private double CorrectValue(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	internal class AdditionalPointBuilder : IDataPointBuilder
	{
		private readonly IDataPointBuilder innerBuilder;

		private readonly IChartDataAdapter adapter;

		private readonly SeriesBase series;

		IDataPointFactory IDataPointBuilder.PointFactory
		{
			get
			{
				return innerBuilder.PointFactory;
			}
			set
			{
				innerBuilder.PointFactory = value;
			}
		}

		public AdditionalPointBuilder(IDataPointBuilder builder, IChartDataAdapter adapter, SeriesBase series)
		{
			innerBuilder = builder;
			this.adapter = adapter;
			this.series = series;
		}

		IDataPoint IDataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(int index)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)innerBuilder.BuildPoint(index);
			SetAdditionalValues(seriesPoint, index);
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		void IDataPointBuilder.SetPointOwner(IDataPoint point, SeriesBase series)
		{
		}

		private void SetAdditionalValues(SeriesPoint point, int index)
		{
			if (point != null)
			{
				object objectValue = adapter.GetObjectValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.Color);
				if (objectValue != null)
				{
					object userArgument = ((ISeriesPointArgument)point).UserArgument;
					object[] values = ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.GetValues(point);
					point.Color = series.View.ColorProvider.GetColor(userArgument, values, objectValue, series);
				}
				string qualitativeValue = adapter.GetQualitativeValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.ToolTipHint);
				if (qualitativeValue != null)
				{
					point.ToolTipHint = qualitativeValue;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}

		}

		}

	internal interface IRefinedPropertyConverter
	{
		object Convert(double value);
	}
	internal class NumericRefinedConverter : IRefinedPropertyConverter
	{
		object IRefinedPropertyConverter.Convert(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	internal class DateTimeRefinedConverter : IRefinedPropertyConverter
	{
		object IRefinedPropertyConverter.Convert(double value)
		{
			return DateTimeUtilsExt.DoubleToDateTime(value);
		}
	}
	internal class TimeSpanRefinedConverter : IRefinedPropertyConverter
	{
		object IRefinedPropertyConverter.Convert(double value)
		{
			return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Math.Round(value));
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesPointCreator : ISeriesPointCreator
	{
		private readonly SeriesBase series;

		private readonly IRefinedPropertyConverter argumentConverter;

		private readonly IRefinedPropertyConverter valueConverter;

		public SeriesPointCreator(SeriesBase series, IRefinedPropertyConverter argumentConverter, IRefinedPropertyConverter valueConverter)
		{
			this.series = series;
			this.argumentConverter = argumentConverter;
			this.valueConverter = valueConverter;
		}

		ISeriesPoint ISeriesPointCreator.CreateSeriesPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			object argument = argumentConverter.Convert(point.Argument);
			object[] array = new object[point.ValuesDimension];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = valueConverter.Convert(point.GetNumericalValue(i));
			}
			return new SeriesPoint((Series)series, argument, array, point.Tag);
		}
	}
	public class DataAdapterHelper
	{
		private readonly SeriesBase series;

		private IChartDataAdapter dataAdapter;

		private DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapter;

		private IDataSourceIndicator indicator;

		private IDataSourceColorizer colorizer;

		public bool IsContinuousData { get; private set; }

		public static Scale GetValueScaleType(SeriesBase series, IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			return (Scale)adapter.GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.ValueLevelToChartDataMemberType(series.View.SupportedValueLevels[0]));
		}

		public static ScaleType GetArgumentScaleType(IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (adapter is SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter)
			{
				return ScaleType.Auto;
			}
			if (!(adapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase))
			{
				return (ScaleType)adapter.GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberType.Argument);
			}
			return (ScaleType)dataSourceAdapterBase.GetScaleTypeCore(ChartDataMemberType.Argument);
		}

		public static bool CheckBinding(IChartDataAdapter adapter, params ChartDataMemberType[] dataMembers)
		{
			if (adapter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(adapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (dataSourceAdapterBase.ActualDataSource == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ChartDataMemberType key in dataMembers)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers[key]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public DataAdapterHelper(Series series, bool updateIndicator = false)
		{
			UpdateAdapter(series.ActualDataAdapter);
			this.series = series;
			if (updateIndicator)
			{
				IDataSourceIndicator dataSourceIndicator = EnsureDataSourceIndicator(dataSourceAdapter, series);
				UpdateIndicator(dataSourceIndicator);
			}
		}

		public DataAdapterHelper(SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate, IDataSourceColorizer colorizer)
		{
			UpdateAdapter(seriesTemplate.ActualAdapter);
			series = seriesTemplate;
			UpdateIndicator(EnsureDataSourceIndicator(dataSourceAdapter, seriesTemplate));
			this.colorizer = colorizer;
		}

		public DataAdapterHelper(SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate)
			: this(seriesTemplate, null)
		{
		}

		private IDataSourceIndicator EnsureDataSourceIndicator(DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapter, ISeriesBase series)
		{
			if (series.Indicators == null || series.Indicators.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			dataSourceAdapter?.EnsureIndicator(series.Indicators[0]);
			return series.Indicators[0];
		}

		private void EnsureDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			if (dataSourceAdapter != null && series.DataContainer != null)
			{
				dataSourceAdapter.ChartDataSource = series.DataContainer.ActualDataSource;
			}
		}

		private bool IsHistogramMode()
		{
			return series.View.CanLoadOneDimensionData((ScaleType)dataAdapter.GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberType.Argument));
		}

		private static ChartDataMemberType[] ValueLevelsToDataMembers(ValueLevel[] valueLevels)
		{
			ChartDataMemberType[] array = new ChartDataMemberType[valueLevels.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < valueLevels.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.ValueLevelToChartDataMemberType(valueLevels[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private IPropertySetter CreateArgumentSetter()
		{
			return dataAdapter.GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberType.Argument) switch
			{
				ActualScaleType.Numerical => new NumericArgumentSetter(dataAdapter), 
				ActualScaleType.DateTime => new DateTimeArgumentSetter(dataAdapter), 
				ActualScaleType.TimeSpan => new TimeSpanArgumentSetter(dataAdapter), 
				_ => new QualitativeArgumentSetter(dataAdapter, series.ChartContainer is ModelChartContainer), 
			};
		}

		private IPropertySetter CreateValuesSetter(ChartDataMemberType[] dataMembers)
		{
			if (dataMembers.Length == 0)
			{
				return new EmptyValuesSetter();
			}
			return dataAdapter.GetScaleType(dataMembers[0]) switch
			{
				ActualScaleType.Numerical => new NumericValuesSetter(dataAdapter, dataMembers), 
				ActualScaleType.DateTime => new DateTimeValuesSetter(dataAdapter, dataMembers), 
				_ => new TimeSpanValuesSetter(dataAdapter, dataMembers), 
			};
		}

		private IRefinedPropertyConverter CreateArgumentConverter()
		{
			return dataAdapter.GetScaleType(ChartDataMemberType.Argument) switch
			{
				ActualScaleType.DateTime => new DateTimeRefinedConverter(), 
				ActualScaleType.TimeSpan => new TimeSpanRefinedConverter(), 
				_ => new NumericRefinedConverter(), 
			};
		}

		private IRefinedPropertyConverter CreateValueConverter()
		{
			return dataAdapter.GetScaleType(ValueLevelsToDataMembers(series.View.SupportedValueLevels)[0]) switch
			{
				ActualScaleType.DateTime => new DateTimeRefinedConverter(), 
				ActualScaleType.TimeSpan => new TimeSpanRefinedConverter(), 
				_ => new NumericRefinedConverter(), 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldCreateSeriesPoint(IComplexDataAdapter complexAdapter)
		{
			if (colorizer != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (complexAdapter != null)
			{
				if (!complexAdapter.ColorEnabled)
				{
					return complexAdapter.ToolTipHintEnabled;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IDataPointBuilder CreateDataBindPointBuilder()
		{
			IPropertySetter propertySetter = CreateArgumentSetter();
			IPropertySetter valuesSetter = CreateValuesSetter(ValueLevelsToDataMembers(series.View.SupportedValueLevels));
			IPropertySetter tagSetter = new TagSetter(dataAdapter);
			IMissingPointProcessor missingPointProcessor = (IsHistogramMode() ? new HistogramMissingPointProcessor(series) : new DefaultMissingPointProcessor(series));
			IComplexDataAdapter complexDataAdapter = dataAdapter as IComplexDataAdapter;
			IDataPointBuilder dataPointBuilder = ((complexDataAdapter != null && complexDataAdapter.FilteringEnabled) ? new FilteringPointBuilder(propertySetter, valuesSetter, tagSetter, missingPointProcessor, complexDataAdapter) : new DataBindPointBuilder(propertySetter, valuesSetter, tagSetter, missingPointProcessor));
			dataPointBuilder.PointFactory = propertySetter.GetDataPointFactory(series);
			if (indicator != null)
			{
				dataPointBuilder.PointFactory = new SeriesPointFactory(series);
				dataPointBuilder = new IndicatorPointBuilder(dataPointBuilder, dataAdapter, indicator);
			}
			if (ShouldCreateSeriesPoint(complexDataAdapter))
			{
				dataPointBuilder.PointFactory = new SeriesPointFactory(series);
				dataPointBuilder = new AdditionalPointBuilder(dataPointBuilder, dataAdapter, series);
			}
			if (colorizer != null)
			{
				dataPointBuilder.PointFactory = new SeriesPointFactory(series);
				dataPointBuilder = new AdditionalPointBuilder(dataPointBuilder, dataAdapter, series);
			}
			return dataPointBuilder.PointFactory.CreateAdvancedPropertiesBuilder(dataPointBuilder);
		}

		internal void UpdateAdapter(IChartDataAdapter actualDataAdapter)
		{
			dataAdapter = actualDataAdapter;
			dataSourceAdapter = dataAdapter as DataSourceAdapterBase;
		}

		internal void UpdateIndicator(IDataSourceIndicator indicator)
		{
			this.indicator = indicator;
		}

		internal IDataPointBuilder CreatePointBuilder()
		{
			if (dataAdapter is ISupportIndexAdapter<IDataPoint> { CanUseIndexation: not false } supportIndexAdapter)
			{
				return new IndexDataPointBuilder(supportIndexAdapter);
			}
			return CreateDataBindPointBuilder();
		}

		private ISeries GetSeries(IList<ISeries> autocreatedSeries, object tag)
		{
			foreach (ISeries item in autocreatedSeries)
			{
				if (tag.Equals(item.Tag))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IList<ISeries> CreateSortedSeriesList(Dictionary<object, ISeries> seriesList, SortMode sorting)
		{
			List<ISeries> list = new List<ISeries>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			list2.AddRange(seriesList.Keys);
			list2.Sort(BindingHelperCore.CompareValues);
			if (sorting == SortMode.Descending)
			{
				list2.Reverse();
			}
			foreach (object item2 in list2)
			{
				ISeries item = seriesList[item2];
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void UpdateColorizer(int index, Color pointColor, object seriesValue)
		{
			object color = dataAdapter.GetObjectValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.SeriesColor) ?? ((object)pointColor);
			object obj = dataAdapter.GetObjectValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.SeriesKey) ?? seriesValue;
			if (!colorizer.IsColorMappingContainsKey(obj))
			{
				colorizer.AddColorMappingElement(obj, color);
			}
			colorizer.SeriesValueToColorKeyMapping[seriesValue] = obj;
		}

		private IList<ISeries> GetSeries(ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries> adapter)
		{
			List<ISeries> list = new List<ISeries>();
			int count = adapter.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(adapter[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IDataPoint CreatePoint(int index)
		{
			IDataPointBuilder dataPointBuilder = CreatePointBuilder();
			return dataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(index);
		}

		public List<IDataPoint> CreateBindingPoints()
		{
			dataSourceAdapter?.Initialize();
			int itemsCount = dataAdapter.ItemsCount;
			List<IDataPoint> list = new List<IDataPoint>(itemsCount);
			IDataPointBuilder dataPointBuilder = CreatePointBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < itemsCount; i++)
			{
				IDataPoint dataPoint = dataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(i);
				if (dataPoint != null)
				{
					list.Add(dataPoint);
				}
			}
			IsContinuousData = list.Count == itemsCount;
			dataSourceAdapter?.Restore();
			return list;
		}

		public SeriesPoint CreateSeriesPoint(IDataPoint actualPoint)
		{
			EnsureDataSourceAdapter();
			SeriesPointCreator pointCreator = new SeriesPointCreator(series, CreateArgumentConverter(), CreateValueConverter());
			return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(actualPoint.GetSeriesPoint(pointCreator));
		}

		public SeriesPoint[] CreateSeriesPoints(IList<IDataPoint> actualPoints)
		{
			EnsureDataSourceAdapter();
			int count = actualPoints.Count;
			SeriesPoint[] array = new SeriesPoint[count];
			SeriesPointCreator pointCreator = new SeriesPointCreator(series, CreateArgumentConverter(), CreateValueConverter());
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(actualPoints[i].GetSeriesPoint(pointCreator));
			}
			return array;
		}

		public IList<ISeries> CreateSeries(SortMode sorting, IList<ISeries> autoCreatedSeries)
		{
			if (dataAdapter is ISupportIndexAdapter<ISeries> supportIndexAdapter)
			{
				supportIndexAdapter.UpdateItems();
				return GetSeries(supportIndexAdapter);
			}
			return CreateSeriesCore(sorting, autoCreatedSeries);
		}

		public IList<ISeries> CreateSeriesCore(SortMode sorting, IList<ISeries> autoCreatedSeries)
		{
			ISeriesFactory seriesFactory = (ISeriesFactory)series;
			Dictionary<object, ISeries> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, ISeries>();
			Dictionary<object, ISeries> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<object, ISeries>();
			if (autoCreatedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in autoCreatedSeries)
				{
					if (item.Tag != null && !dictionary2.ContainsKey(item.Tag) && item?.SeriesView?.GetType() == seriesFactory?.SeriesTemplate?.GetType())
					{
						dictionary2.Add(item.Tag, item);
					}
				}
			}
			dataSourceAdapter?.Initialize();
			IDataPointBuilder dataPointBuilder = CreateDataBindPointBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < dataAdapter.ItemsCount; i++)
			{
				object objectValue = dataAdapter.GetObjectValue(i, ChartDataMemberType.Series);
				if (objectValue == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IDataPoint dataPoint = dataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(i);
				if (dataPoint == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				dictionary.TryGetValue(objectValue, out var value);
				if (value == null || dictionary2.ContainsKey(objectValue))
				{
					string seriesName = $"{seriesFactory.SeriesNameBeginText}{objectValue.ToString()}{seriesFactory.SeriesNameEndText}";
					dictionary2.TryGetValue(objectValue, out value);
					if (value != null)
					{
						dictionary.Add(value.Tag, value);
						if (value is ISeriesBindingProvider seriesBindingProvider)
						{
							seriesBindingProvider.BindingClear(clearBoundPoints: true);
						}
						value = seriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(seriesName, objectValue, value);
						dictionary2.Remove(value.Tag);
					}
					else
					{
						value = seriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(seriesName, objectValue);
						dictionary.Add(objectValue, value);
					}
					if (colorizer != null)
					{
						UpdateColorizer(i, ((SeriesPoint)dataPoint).Color, objectValue);
					}
				}
				dataPointBuilder.SetPointOwner(dataPoint, (SeriesBase)value);
				value.AddSeriesPoint(dataPoint);
			}
			dataSourceAdapter?.Restore();
			if (sorting == SortMode.None)
			{
				return dictionary.Values.ToList();
			}
			return CreateSortedSeriesList(dictionary, sorting);
		}

		public ISeries AddBoundPoint(IList<ISeries> autocreatedSeries, int index, bool allowCachedUpdates)
		{
			ISeries series = null;
			dataSourceAdapter?.Initialize();
			bool num;
			if (!allowCachedUpdates)
			{
				num = index == dataAdapter.ItemsCount - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				if (index <= 0)
				{
					goto IL_0077;
				}
				num = index <= dataAdapter.ItemsCount - 1;
			}
			if (num)
			{
				series = GetSeries(autocreatedSeries, dataAdapter.GetObjectValue(index, ChartDataMemberType.Series));
				if (series != null)
				{
					IDataPointBuilder dataPointBuilder = CreateDataBindPointBuilder();
					IDataPoint dataPoint = dataPointBuilder.BuildPoint(index);
					if (dataPoint != null)
					{
						series.AddSeriesPoint(dataPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			goto IL_0077;
			IL_0077:
			dataSourceAdapter?.Restore();
			return series;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesPointEnsurer : ISeriesPointEnsurer

		}
	}

	public class DataAdapterControllerBase : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly ValueDataMemberCollection valueDataMembers;

		private readonly NumericSummaryOptions numericSummaryOptions;

		private readonly DateTimeSummaryOptions dateTimeSummaryOptions;

		private readonly TimeSpanSummaryOptions timeSpanSummaryOptions;

		private readonly QualitativeSummaryOptions qualitativeSummaryOptions;

		private IChartDataAdapter actualAdapter;

		private string argumentDataMember;

		private string colorDataMember;

		private string toolTipHintDataMember;

		private CriteriaOperator criteria;

		private bool dataSorted;

		private IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget bindingTarget;

		internal bool IsAdapterValid => actualAdapter != null;

		protected SeriesBase Series { get; }

		protected virtual IChartDataAdapter PublicDataAdapter => null;

		public IChartDataAdapter ActualAdapter => actualAdapter ?? (actualAdapter = CalculateActualAdapter());

		public string ArgumentDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return argumentDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(argumentDataMember == value))
				{
					Invalidate();
					Series.ArgumentDataMemberChanging(value);
					argumentDataMember = value;
					Series.ArgumentDataMemberChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public ValueDataMemberCollection ValueDataMembers => valueDataMembers;

		public string ColorDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return colorDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == colorDataMember))
				{
					Invalidate();
					Series.DataMemberChanging(value);
					colorDataMember = value;
					Series.BindingChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public string ToolTipHintDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return toolTipHintDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == toolTipHintDataMember))
				{
					Invalidate();
					Series.DataMemberChanging(value);
					toolTipHintDataMember = value;
					Series.BindingChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public string FilterString
		{
			get
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.ToString(FilterCriteria);
			}
			set
			{
				FilterCriteria = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(value, new object[0]);
			}
		}

		public CriteriaOperator FilterCriteria
		{
			get
			{
				return criteria;
			}
			set
			{
				if (criteria != value)
				{
					Invalidate();
					Series.RaiseControlChanging();
					criteria = value;
					BindingTargetChanged();
					Series.FilterCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool DataSorted
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSorted;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSorted != value)
				{
					Invalidate();
					dataSorted = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public NumericSummaryOptions NumericSummaryOptions => numericSummaryOptions;

		public DateTimeSummaryOptions DateTimeSummaryOptions => dateTimeSummaryOptions;

		public TimeSpanSummaryOptions TimeSpanSummaryOptions => timeSpanSummaryOptions;

		public QualitativeSummaryOptions QualitativeSummaryOptions => qualitativeSummaryOptions;

		public string ActualArgumentDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase))
				{
					return ArgumentDataMember;
				}
				return dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Argument];
			}
		}

		public string ActualSummaryFunction
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(PublicDataAdapter is ISummaryAdapter summaryAdapter))
				{
					return ActualSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction;
				}
				return summaryAdapter.ActualSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction;
			}
		}

		public SummaryOptionsBase ActualSummaryOptions => Series.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal switch
		{
			ScaleType.DateTime => dateTimeSummaryOptions, 
			ScaleType.Numerical => numericSummaryOptions, 
			ScaleType.Qualitative => qualitativeSummaryOptions, 
			ScaleType.TimeSpan => timeSpanSummaryOptions, 
			_ => null, 
		};

		public bool ActualDataSorted
		{
			get
			{
				if (PublicDataAdapter == null)
				{
					return DataSorted;
				}
				return PublicDataAdapter.DataSorted;
			}
		}

		public IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget BindingTarget
		{
			get
			{
				if (bindingTarget == null)
				{
					IChartDataAdapter publicDataAdapter = PublicDataAdapter;
					IFilterCriteriaBindingAware val = (IFilterCriteriaBindingAware)((publicDataAdapter is IFilterCriteriaBindingAware) ? publicDataAdapter : null);
					bindingTarget = (IFilterCriteriaBindingTarget)(((object)((val != null) ? val.BindingTarget : null)) ?? ((object)new ChartFilterCriteriaBindingTarget(Series)));
				}
				return bindingTarget;
			}
		}

		public DataAdapterControllerBase(SeriesBase series)
		{
			Series = series;
			valueDataMembers = new ValueDataMemberCollection(series);
			valueDataMembers.CollectionChanged += delegate
			{
				Invalidate();
			};
			numericSummaryOptions = new NumericSummaryOptions(series);
			dateTimeSummaryOptions = new DateTimeSummaryOptions(series);
			timeSpanSummaryOptions = new TimeSpanSummaryOptions(series);
			qualitativeSummaryOptions = new QualitativeSummaryOptions(series);
		}

		private IChartDataAdapter CalculateActualAdapter()
		{
			return PublicDataAdapter ?? CalculateActualAdapterCore();
		}

		private void BindingTargetChanged()
		{
			if (!Series.Loading && bindingTarget != null)
			{
				bindingTarget.RaiseFilterCriteriaChanged();
			}
		}

		protected ISummaryAdapter MakeSummaryDataAdapter()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(NumericSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(DateTimeSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(TimeSpanSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(QualitativeSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISummaryAdapter summaryAdapter = CreateSummaryAdapter();
			summaryAdapter.NumericSummaryOptions.Assign(NumericSummaryOptions);
			summaryAdapter.DateTimeSummaryOptions.Assign(DateTimeSummaryOptions);
			summaryAdapter.TimeSpanSummaryOptions.Assign(TimeSpanSummaryOptions);
			summaryAdapter.QualitativeSummaryOptions.Assign(QualitativeSummaryOptions);
			PrepareDataAdapter((DataSourceAdapterBase)summaryAdapter);
			return summaryAdapter;
		}

		protected DataSourceAdapterBase MakeDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase = CreateDataSourceAdapter();
			PrepareDataAdapter(dataSourceAdapterBase);
			return dataSourceAdapterBase;
		}

		protected void PrepareDataAdapter(DataSourceAdapterBase adapter)
		{
			PopulateDataAdapter(adapter);
			adapter.Owner = Series;
			((IChartDataAdapter)adapter).DataChanged += OnDataChanged;
		}

		private void PopulateDataAdapter(DataSourceAdapterBase adapter)
		{
			adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Argument, ArgumentDataMember, Series.ArgumentScaleType));
			adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Color, ColorDataMember));
			adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.ToolTipHint, ToolTipHintDataMember));
			Series.AddValueDataMembersToAdapter(adapter, ValueDataMembers.GetArray());
			adapter.FilterCriteria = FilterCriteria;
			adapter.DataSorted = DataSorted;
			PopulateAdapterCore(adapter);
		}

		public IList<string> GetActualValueDataMembers(ValueLevel[] supportedValueLevels)
		{
			if (!(PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase))
			{
				return ValueDataMembers.GetArray();
			}
			return dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers.GetValueDataMembers(supportedValueLevels);
		}

		public IList<string> GetActualValueDataMembers()
		{
			if (!(PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase))
			{
				return ValueDataMembers.GetArray();
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>(dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers.Count);
			foreach (DataMember item in (IEnumerable<DataMember>)dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers)
			{
				if (ChartDataMemberTypeHelper.IsValueDataMember(item.DataMemberType))
				{
					list.Add(item.ColumnName);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void ClearValueDataMember(int index)
		{
			if (PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase)
			{
				dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers.RemoveValueDataMember(index);
			}
			ValueDataMembers[index] = string.Empty;
		}

		public void SetSummaryFunction(string value)
		{
			if (PublicDataAdapter is ISummaryAdapter summaryAdapter)
			{
				summaryAdapter.NumericSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
				summaryAdapter.DateTimeSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
				summaryAdapter.TimeSpanSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
				summaryAdapter.QualitativeSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
			}
			NumericSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
			DateTimeSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
			TimeSpanSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
			QualitativeSummaryOptions.SetSummaryFunctionInternal(value);
		}

		public void SynchronizeFilterCriteria(DataFilterCollection dataFilters, Conjunction conjunction)
		{
			CriteriaOperator filterCriteria = DataFilterToCriteriaConverter.Convert(dataFilters, conjunction);
			if (PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase)
			{
				dataSourceAdapterBase.FilterCriteria = filterCriteria;
			}
			FilterCriteria = filterCriteria;
		}

		public void UpdateArgumentAndValueDataMembers(string chartDataMember)
		{
			if (PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase)
			{
				dataSourceAdapterBase.UpdateArgumentAndValueDataMembers(chartDataMember);
			}
			argumentDataMember = SeriesBase.CutDataMember(chartDataMember, argumentDataMember);
			for (int i = 0; i < ValueDataMembers.Count; i++)
			{
				ValueDataMembers[i] = SeriesBase.CutDataMember(chartDataMember, ValueDataMembers[i]);
			}
		}

		public void SetArgumentDataMember(string value)
		{
			if (PublicDataAdapter is DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapterBase)
			{
				dataSourceAdapterBase.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Argument, value));
			}
			argumentDataMember = value;
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			if (actualAdapter != PublicDataAdapter)
			{
				UnsubscribeAdapter(actualAdapter);
				if (actualAdapter is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			actualAdapter = null;
		}

		public virtual void Assign(DataAdapterControllerBase adapterController)
		{
			Series.ResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType();
			IAssignableAdapter assignableAdapter = adapterController.PublicDataAdapter as IAssignableAdapter;
			SetActualAdapter((assignableAdapter != null) ? assignableAdapter.Assign(Series) : ((IChartDataAdapter)(adapterController.PublicDataAdapter?.Clone())));
			argumentDataMember = adapterController.ArgumentDataMember;
			valueDataMembers.Clear();
			if (adapterController.valueDataMembers.Count != 0)
			{
				valueDataMembers.AddRange(adapterController.valueDataMembers.GetArray());
			}
			else
			{
				valueDataMembers.AddRange("");
			}
			colorDataMember = adapterController.colorDataMember;
			toolTipHintDataMember = adapterController.toolTipHintDataMember;
			numericSummaryOptions.Assign(adapterController.numericSummaryOptions);
			dateTimeSummaryOptions.Assign(adapterController.dateTimeSummaryOptions);
			timeSpanSummaryOptions.Assign(adapterController.timeSpanSummaryOptions);
			qualitativeSummaryOptions.Assign(adapterController.qualitativeSummaryOptions);
			FilterString = adapterController.FilterString;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			UnsubscribeAdapter(ActualAdapter);
			if (ActualAdapter != PublicDataAdapter && ActualAdapter is IDisposable disposable)
			{
				disposable.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class SeriesDataAdapterController : DataAdapterControllerBase
	{
		private readonly SeriesPointCollection points;

		private IChartDataAdapter dataAdapter;

		private bool allowResample;

		private object dataSource;

		protected new Series Series => (Series)base.Series;

		protected override IChartDataAdapter PublicDataAdapter => DataAdapter;

		public IChartDataAdapter DataAdapter
		{
			get
			{
				return dataAdapter;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataAdapter != value)
				{
					Invalidate();
					UnsubscribeDataAdapter(dataAdapter);
					dataAdapter = value;
					PrepareAssignedDataAdapter(dataAdapter);
					Series.OnDataAdapterChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AllowResample
		{
			get
			{
				return allowResample;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowResample != value)
				{
					Invalidate();
					allowResample = value;
					Series.RecreateBindingProcessor();
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointCollection Points => points;

		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSource != value)
				{
					Invalidate();
					if (!Series.Loading && !Series.DesignMode)
					{
						Series.CheckBindingRuntime(value);
					}
					Series.OnDataSourceChanging();
					dataSource = value;
					Series.OnDataSourceChanged(dataSource);
				}
			}
		}

		public object ActualDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(dataAdapter is DataSourceAdapter dataSourceAdapter))
				{
					return DataSource;
				}
				return dataSourceAdapter.DataSource;
			}
		}

		public bool UnboundMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ActualArgumentDataMember))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ActualDataSource != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Series.Chart?.DataContainer.ActualDataSource == null;
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointCollection ActualSeriesPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(dataAdapter is SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter))
				{
					return Points;
				}
				return seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter.Points;
			}
		}

		public SeriesDataAdapterController(Series series)
			: base(series)
		{
			points = new SeriesPointCollection(series);
		}

		private ResamplingDataAdapter MakeResamplingDataAdapter()
		{
			IScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase = ((!(Series.View is XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase)) ? null : xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX?.ActualScaleOptions);
			if (!AllowResample || (scaleOptionsBase != null && scaleOptionsBase.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ResamplingDataAdapter resamplingDataAdapter = new ResamplingDataAdapter();
			PrepareDataAdapter(resamplingDataAdapter);
			return resamplingDataAdapter;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataAdapter(IChartDataAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			if (dataAdapter != null)
			{
				dataAdapter.DataChanged -= Series.OnDataAdapterChanged;
				if (dataAdapter is SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter)
				{
					seriesPointCollectionDataAdapter.Owner = null;
				}
				else if (dataAdapter is BaseDataAdapter baseDataAdapter)
				{
					baseDataAdapter.Owner = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrepareAssignedDataAdapter(IChartDataAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			if (dataAdapter != null)
			{
				dataAdapter.DataChanged += Series.OnDataAdapterChanged;
				PrepareSeriesPointCollection(dataAdapter as SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter);
				PrepareDataSourceAdapter(dataAdapter as DataSourceAdapter);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareDataSourceAdapter(DataSourceAdapter dataSourceAdapter)
		{
			if (dataSourceAdapter != null)
			{
				dataSourceAdapter.Owner = Series;
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSeriesPointCollection(SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter collection)
		{
			if (collection != null)
			{
				collection.Owner = Series;
			}
		}

		protected override void UnsubscribeAdapter(IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (adapter != null)
			{
				adapter.DataChanged -= Series.OnDataAdapterChanged;
			}
		}

		protected override IChartDataAdapter CalculateActualAdapterCore()
		{
			if (!Series.CanBoundToData)
			{
				return new SeriesPointCollectionDataAdapter(points);
			}
			SummaryDataAdapter summaryDataAdapter = (SummaryDataAdapter)MakeSummaryDataAdapter();
			if (summaryDataAdapter != null)
			{
				return summaryDataAdapter;
			}
			ResamplingDataAdapter resamplingDataAdapter = MakeResamplingDataAdapter();
			if (resamplingDataAdapter != null)
			{
				return resamplingDataAdapter;
			}
			return MakeDataSourceAdapter();
		}

		protected override void SetActualAdapter(IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			DataAdapter = adapter;
		}

		protected override ISummaryAdapter CreateSummaryAdapter()
		{
			return new SummaryDataAdapter();
		}

		protected override DataSourceAdapterBase CreateDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			return new DataSourceAdapter();
		}

		protected override void OnDataChanged(object sender, ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			Series.OnDataAdapterChanged(sender, args);
		}

		protected override void PopulateAdapterCore(DataSourceAdapterBase adapter)
		{
			DataSourceAdapter dataSourceAdapter = (DataSourceAdapter)adapter;
			dataSourceAdapter.DataSource = DataSource;
		}

		public override void Assign(DataAdapterControllerBase adapterController)
		{
			base.Assign(adapterController);
			if (adapterController is SeriesDataAdapterController seriesDataAdapterController)
			{
				points.Assign(seriesDataAdapterController.Points);
				points.ClearBoundPoints();
				dataSource = seriesDataAdapterController.DataSource;
				base.DataSorted = seriesDataAdapterController.DataSorted;
			}
		}

		public void BindToData(object dataSource, string argumentDataMember, string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			Invalidate();
			Series.OnDataSourceChanging();
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			base.ArgumentDataMember = argumentDataMember;
			base.ValueDataMembers.ClearAndFill(valueDataMembers);
			Series.BindingChanged();
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			UnsubscribeDataAdapter(dataAdapter);
			base.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public class TemplateDataAdapterController : DataAdapterControllerBase
	{
		private ISeriesTemplateAdapter dataAdapter;

		private string seriesDataMember;

		protected new SeriesTemplate Series => (SeriesTemplate)base.Series;

		protected override IChartDataAdapter PublicDataAdapter => DataAdapter;

		public ISeriesTemplateAdapter DataAdapter
		{
			get
			{
				return dataAdapter;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataAdapter != value)
				{
					Invalidate();
					UnsubscribeDataAdapter(dataAdapter);
					dataAdapter = value;
					SubscribeDataAdapter(dataAdapter);
					Series.BindingChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public string SeriesDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(seriesDataMember == value))
				{
					Invalidate();
					Series.SeriesDataMemberChanging(value);
					seriesDataMember = value;
					Series.RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: true, resetSeriesBinding: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public TemplateDataAdapterController(SeriesTemplate series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataAdapter(ISeriesTemplateAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			if (dataAdapter != null)
			{
				dataAdapter.DataChanged -= OnDataAdapterChanged;
				if (dataAdapter is BaseDataAdapter baseDataAdapter)
				{
					baseDataAdapter.Owner = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeDataAdapter(ISeriesTemplateAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			if (dataAdapter != null)
			{
				dataAdapter.DataChanged += OnDataAdapterChanged;
				if (dataAdapter is SeriesTemplateAdapter seriesTemplateAdapter)
				{
					seriesTemplateAdapter.Owner = Series;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDataAdapterChanged(object sender, ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			Series.BindingChanged();
		}

		protected override void UnsubscribeAdapter(IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (adapter != null)
			{
				adapter.DataChanged -= OnDataAdapterChanged;
			}
		}

		protected override IChartDataAdapter CalculateActualAdapterCore()
		{
			SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter = (SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter)MakeSummaryDataAdapter();
			if (seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter != null)
			{
				return seriesTemplateSummaryAdapter;
			}
			return MakeDataSourceAdapter();
		}

		protected override void SetActualAdapter(IChartDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			DataAdapter = (ISeriesTemplateAdapter)adapter;
		}

		protected override ISummaryAdapter CreateSummaryAdapter()
		{
			return new SeriesTemplateSummaryAdapter();
		}

		protected override DataSourceAdapterBase CreateDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			return new SeriesTemplateAdapter();
		}

		protected override void OnDataChanged(object sender, ChartDataUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			OnDataAdapterChanged(sender, args);
		}

		protected override void PopulateAdapterCore(DataSourceAdapterBase adapter)
		{
			adapter.DataMembers.Add(new DataMember(ChartDataMemberType.Series, SeriesDataMember));
		}

		public override void Assign(DataAdapterControllerBase adapterController)
		{
			base.Assign(adapterController);
			TemplateDataAdapterController templateDataAdapterController = adapterController as TemplateDataAdapterController;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			UnsubscribeDataAdapter(dataAdapter);
			base.Dispose();
		}
	}

	public class DataTableViewData
	{
		private int horizontalPadding = 3;

		private int verticalPadding = 3;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		private List<int> ColCoords { get; set; }

		private List<int> RowCoords { get; set; }

		private int RowHeight { get; }

		private int RowCount { get; }

		private ChartDataTable ChartDataTable { get; }

		private List<List<string>> TableTextData { get; }

		private List<LegendItemViewData> LegendItemViewDataList { get; }

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public int FirstColWidth { get; set; }

		public int OccupiedVerticalSpace => Bounds.Height + ChartDataTable.VerticalIndent;

		public DataTableViewData(ChartDataTable dataTable, DXRectangle mappingBounds, IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesDataBase> allSeriesData)
		{
			ChartDataTable = dataTable;
			TableTextData = GetTableData(allSeriesData);
			int num = allSeriesData.Count();
			LegendItemViewDataList = new List<LegendItemViewData>(num);
			int num2 = 0;
			int val = 0;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in allSeriesData)
			{
				LegendItemViewData legendItemViewData = new ChartDataTableLegendItemViewData(dataTable, allSeriesDatum, ChartDataTable.DXFont, ChartDataTable.ActualTextColor);
				LegendItemViewDataList.Add(legendItemViewData);
				legendItemViewData.CalculateSize();
				num2 = Math.Max(legendItemViewData.Size.Width, num2);
				val = Math.Max(legendItemViewData.Size.Height, val);
			}
			val = Math.Max(dataTable.DXFont.DpiScale().Height, val);
			FirstColWidth = num2 + 2 * horizontalPadding;
			RowHeight = val + 2 * verticalPadding;
			RowCount = num + 1;
			int num3 = RowCount * RowHeight + 1;
			Point location = new Point(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Bottom - num3 - 1);
			bounds = new Rectangle(location, new Size(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Width, num3));
		}

		private string FormatValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		private object GetValue(ISeriesPointValues values)
		{
			return values.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => values.DateTimeValues[0], 
				Scale.Numerical => values.NumericalValues[0], 
				Scale.TimeSpan => values.TimeSpanValues[0], 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Impossible to get value for DataTable"), 
			};
		}

		private List<List<string>> GetTableData(IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesDataBase> allSeriesData)
		{
			Dictionary<string, List<object>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<object>>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in allSeriesData)
			{
				IList<RefinedPoint> points = allSeriesDatum.RefinedSeries.Points;
				foreach (RefinedPoint item2 in points)
				{
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = item2.SeriesPoint;
					string axisLabelText = ChartDataTable.ArgumentFormatter.GetAxisLabelText(seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument);
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(axisLabelText, out var value))
					{
						List<object> list = (dictionary[axisLabelText] = new object[allSeriesData.Count()].ToList());
						value = list;
					}
					value[num] = GetValue(seriesPoint.Values);
				}
				num++;
			}
			List<List<string>> list3 = new List<List<string>>(dictionary.Keys.Count);
			foreach (string key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				List<object> list4 = dictionary[key];
				List<string> list5 = new List<string>(list4.Count) { key };
				foreach (object item3 in list4)
				{
					string item = FormatValue(item3);
					list5.Add(item);
				}
				list3.Add(list5);
			}
			return list3;
		}

		private Tuple<List<int>, List<int>> CalculateRowColCoords(Rectangle bounds, int rowHeight, int firstColWidth, int dataColCount)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int> { bounds.X };
			int num = bounds.X + firstColWidth;
			double num2 = (double)(bounds.Width - firstColWidth) / (double)dataColCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataColCount; i++)
			{
				int item = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)num + (double)i * num2);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			int num3 = bounds.Height / RowHeight;
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				int item2 = bounds.Y + j * rowHeight;
				list2.Add(item2);
			}
			return new Tuple<List<int>, List<int>>(list, list2);
		}

		private DXPen CreateDxPen()
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(ChartDataTable.ActualLineColor, ChartDataTable.LineStyle.Thickness);
			dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)ChartDataTable.LineStyle.LineJoin;
			dXPen.DashStyle = (DXDashStyle)DashStyleHelper.ConvertDashStyle(ChartDataTable.LineStyle.DashStyle);
			return dXPen;
		}

		private void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			using DXPen pen = CreateDxPen();
			List<int> colCoords = ColCoords;
			List<int> rowCoords = RowCoords;
			int y = Bounds.Bottom - 1;
			int right = Bounds.Right;
			Point p = new Point(colCoords[1], Bounds.Top);
			Point p2 = new Point(right, Bounds.Top);
			renderer.DrawLine(p, p2, pen);
			p = new Point(Bounds.Left, rowCoords[1]);
			renderer.DrawLine(p2: new Point(right, rowCoords[1]), p1: p, pen: pen);
			p = new Point(Bounds.Left, y);
			p2 = new Point(right, y);
			renderer.DrawLine(p, p2, pen);
			p = new Point(Bounds.Left, rowCoords[1]);
			p2 = new Point(Bounds.Left, y);
			renderer.DrawLine(p, p2, pen);
			p = new Point(colCoords[1], Bounds.Top);
			renderer.DrawLine(p2: new Point(colCoords[1], y), p1: p, pen: pen);
			p = new Point(right, Bounds.Top);
			renderer.DrawLine(p2: new Point(right, y), p1: p, pen: pen);
		}

		private void RenderHorizontalLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			using DXPen pen = CreateDxPen();
			for (int i = 2; i < RowCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				Point p = new Point(Bounds.Left, RowCoords[i]);
				Point p2 = new Point(Bounds.Right, RowCoords[i]);
				renderer.DrawLine(p, p2, pen);
			}
		}

		private void RenderVerticalLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			int y = Bounds.Bottom - 1;
			using DXPen pen = CreateDxPen();
			for (int i = 2; i < ColCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				Point p = new Point(ColCoords[i], Bounds.Top);
				renderer.DrawLine(p2: new Point(ColCoords[i], y), p1: p, pen: pen);
			}
		}

		private void RenderLegendItems(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			for (int i = 1; i < RowCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				int x = Bounds.Left + horizontalPadding;
				int y = RowCoords[i] + verticalPadding;
				LegendItemViewDataList[i - 1].Render(renderer, new Point(x, y));
			}
		}

		private int CalculateCellWidth(int colIndex)
		{
			if (colIndex < ColCoords.Count - 1)
			{
				return ColCoords[colIndex + 1] - ColCoords[colIndex] - 2 * horizontalPadding;
			}
			return Bounds.Right - ColCoords[colIndex] - 2 * horizontalPadding;
		}

		private int CalculateCellHeight(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (rowIndex < RowCoords.Count - 1)
			{
				return RowCoords[rowIndex + 1] - RowCoords[rowIndex] - 2 * verticalPadding;
			}
			return Bounds.Bottom - RowCoords[rowIndex] - 2 * verticalPadding;
		}

		private void RenderTableText(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			for (int i = 1; i < ColCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < RowCoords.Count; j++)
				{
					string text = TableTextData[i - 1][j];
					renderer.DrawBoundedText(bounds: new RectangleF(ColCoords[i] + horizontalPadding, RowCoords[j] + verticalPadding, CalculateCellWidth(i), CalculateCellHeight(j)), text: text, font: ChartDataTable.DXFont.DpiScale(), color: ChartDataTable.ActualTextColor, antialiasingSupport: ChartDataTable, alignment: System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, lineAlignment: System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCorrectionAndFirstColWidth(RectangleCorrection correction, Rectangle paneBounds, Rectangle mappingBounds, DataTableViewData dataTableViewData)
		{
			int num = mappingBounds.Left - paneBounds.Left;
			if (num < FirstColWidth)
			{
				int additionalLeftCorrection = FirstColWidth - num;
				correction.AddLeftCorrection(additionalLeftCorrection);
			}
			else
			{
				dataTableViewData.FirstColWidth = num;
			}
			int num2 = mappingBounds.Right - Bounds.Right;
			bounds.Width += num2;
		}

		public void CalculateAfterAxesCorrection()
		{
			Tuple<List<int>, List<int>> tuple = CalculateRowColCoords(Bounds, RowHeight, FirstColWidth, TableTextData.Count);
			ColCoords = tuple.Item1;
			RowCoords = tuple.Item2;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (RowCoords != null && ColCoords != null)
			{
				if (ChartDataTable.ShowBorder)
				{
					RenderBorder(renderer);
				}
				if (ChartDataTable.ShowHorizontalLines)
				{
					RenderHorizontalLines(renderer);
				}
				if (ChartDataTable.ShowVerticalLines)
				{
					RenderVerticalLines(renderer);
				}
				RenderLegendItems(renderer);
				RenderTableText(renderer);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CommonChartRenderer : INativeRenderer
	{
		private readonly Stack<DXRegion> clippingCache = new Stack<DXRegion>();

		private readonly Stack<object> stateCache = new Stack<object>();

		private readonly Stack<DXPixelOffsetMode> pixelOffsetCache = new Stack<DXPixelOffsetMode>();

		private readonly Stack<DXSmoothingMode> smoothingCache = new Stack<DXSmoothingMode>();

		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private bool IsGdiPlusGraphics => graphics.GraphicsKind == DXGraphicsKind.GdiPlus;

		bool INativeRenderer.CanDrawSegmentedLines => IsGdiPlusGraphics;

		public DXMatrix Transform => graphics.Transform;

		internal Stack<DXRegion> ClippingCache => clippingCache;

		public SmoothingMode SmoothingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (SmoothingMode)graphics.SmoothingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = (DXSmoothingMode)value;
			}
		}

		public CommonChartRenderer(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
		}

		public void SaveState()
		{
			stateCache.Push(graphics.Save());
		}

		public void RestoreState()
		{
			if (stateCache.Count > 0)
			{
				graphics.Restore(stateCache.Pop());
			}
		}

		public void SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode mode)
		{
			pixelOffsetCache.Push(graphics.PixelOffsetMode);
			graphics.PixelOffsetMode = (DXPixelOffsetMode)mode;
		}

		public void RestorePixelOffsetMode()
		{
			if (pixelOffsetCache.Count > 0)
			{
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = pixelOffsetCache.Pop();
			}
		}

		public void SetSmoothingMode(SmoothingMode smoothingMode)
		{
			smoothingCache.Push(graphics.SmoothingMode);
			graphics.SmoothingMode = (DXSmoothingMode)smoothingMode;
		}

		public void RestoreSmoothingMode()
		{
			if (smoothingCache.Count > 0)
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingCache.Pop();
			}
		}

		public void Present()
		{
			if (stateCache.Count > 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("Renderer state cache not empty on finishing drawing");
			}
			if (clippingCache.Count > 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("Renderer clipping cache not empty on finishing drawing");
			}
			if (pixelOffsetCache.Count > 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("Renderer pixel offset cache not empty on finishing drawing");
			}
			if (smoothingCache.Count > 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("Antialiasing cache not empty on finishing drawing");
			}
			if (!IsGdiPlusGraphics)
			{
				graphics.Present();
			}
		}

		public void TranslateModel(float x, float y)
		{
			graphics.TranslateTransform(x, y);
		}

		public virtual void ScaleModel(float x, float y)
		{
			float sx = Math.Max(x, 1E-10f);
			float sy = Math.Max(y, 1E-10f);
			graphics.ScaleTransform(sx, sy);
		}

		public void RotateModel(float angle)
		{
			graphics.RotateTransform(angle);
		}

		public void SetClip(Rectangle rect)
		{
			clippingCache.Push(graphics.GetClip());
			graphics.SetClip(rect, DXClipCombineMode.Intersect);
		}

		public void SetClip(DXGraphicsPath dxPath)
		{
			clippingCache.Push(graphics.GetClip());
			graphics.SetClip(dxPath, DXClipCombineMode.Intersect);
		}

		public void RestoreClip()
		{
			if (clippingCache.Count > 0)
			{
				DXRegion dXRegion = clippingCache.Pop();
				graphics.SetClip(dXRegion);
				dXRegion.Dispose();
			}
		}
