	public struct DXImageTileBounds
	{
		private readonly RectangleF tileBounds;

		private readonly RectangleF sourceBounds;

		public RectangleF TileBounds => tileBounds;

		public RectangleF SourceBounds => sourceBounds;

		public DXImageTileBounds(RectangleF tileBounds, RectangleF sourceBounds)
		{
			this.tileBounds = tileBounds;
			this.sourceBounds = sourceBounds;
		}
	}
	public class ChartRenderer
	{
		private const double ArcMinSweepAngle = 2.0;

		private const double MinArcSquaredLength = 4.0;

		internal const int PointsCountForOptimizing = 500;

		internal const int MaxChunkSize = 1000;

		public const float MinScaleAbsValue = 1E-10f;

		private readonly Stack<bool> optimizationCache = new Stack<bool>();

		private INativeRenderer nativeRenderer;

		public INativeRenderer NativeRenderer => nativeRenderer;

		public bool AllowLineOptimization { get; set; }

		public bool CanOptimizePolygons
		{
			get
			{
				if (optimizationCache.Count <= 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return optimizationCache.Peek();
			}
		}

		public bool IsGdiMetafileDrawing { get; set; }

		public bool IsRightToLeft { get; set; }

		public ChartRenderer()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public ChartRenderer(INativeRenderer nativeRenderer)
		{
			SetNativeRenderer(nativeRenderer);
			AllowLineOptimization = true;
		}

		private void RoundPoint(ref PointF point)
		{
			point.X = MathUtils.StrongRound(point.X);
			point.Y = MathUtils.StrongRound(point.Y);
		}

		private void RoundRectangle(ref RectangleF rect)
		{
			rect.X = MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.X);
			rect.Y = MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Y);
			rect.Width = MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Width);
			rect.Height = MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Height);
		}

		private RectangleF GetEllipseBounds(PointF center, float radius)
		{
			RectangleF result = new RectangleF(center, new Size(0, 0));
			result.Inflate(radius, radius);
			return result;
		}

		private RectangleF GetEllipseBounds(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY)
		{
			return RectangleF.Inflate(new RectangleF(center.X, center.Y, 0f, 0f), semiAxisX, semiAxisY);
		}

		private void AddPointsFromStrip(LineStrip strip, List<PointF> points, int x, int startIndex, int endIndex, int minYIndex, int maxYIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex == endIndex)
			{
				points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[startIndex].Y)));
				return;
			}
			if (endIndex - startIndex == 1)
			{
				points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[startIndex].Y)));
				points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[endIndex].Y)));
				return;
			}
			points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[startIndex].Y)));
			if (minYIndex < maxYIndex)
			{
				if (minYIndex != startIndex)
				{
					points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[minYIndex].Y)));
				}
				if (maxYIndex != endIndex)
				{
					points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[maxYIndex].Y)));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (maxYIndex != startIndex)
				{
					points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[maxYIndex].Y)));
				}
				if (minYIndex != endIndex)
				{
					points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[minYIndex].Y)));
				}
			}
			points.Add(new PointF(x, MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[endIndex].Y)));
		}

		private RectangleF GetBoundsForCircle(PointF[] polygon, PointF centerPoint)
		{
			PointF p = centerPoint;
			float num = float.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Length; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = polygon[i];
				PointF p2 = new PointF(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
				float num2 = (float)Math.Ceiling(MathUtils.CalcLength2D(p2, p));
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			int num3 = MathUtils.Ceiling(centerPoint.X - num);
			int num4 = MathUtils.Ceiling(centerPoint.Y - num);
			return new RectangleF(num3, num4, num * 2f, num * 2f);
		}

		private void DrawImage(DXImage image, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				RoundRectangle(ref bounds);
				nativeRenderer.DrawImage(image, bounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawImage(DXImage image, DXImageTileBounds[] tileBounds)
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				nativeRenderer.DrawImage(image, tileBounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawTiledImage(DXImage source, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int width = source.Width;
			int height = source.Height;
			int num = bounds.Width / width + 1;
			int num2 = bounds.Height / height + 1;
			DXImageTileBounds[] array = new DXImageTileBounds[num * num2];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(i * width + bounds.X, j * height + bounds.Y, width, height);
					int num3 = rectangle.Right - bounds.Right;
					if (num3 > 0)
					{
						rectangle.Width -= num3;
					}
					num3 = rectangle.Bottom - bounds.Bottom;
					if (num3 > 0)
					{
						rectangle.Height -= num3;
					}
					array[j + i * num2] = new DXImageTileBounds(rectangle, new Rectangle(0, 0, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height));
				}
			}
			DrawImage(source, array);
		}

		private void DrawZoomedImage(DXImage source, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			double num = Math.Min((double)bounds.Width / (double)source.Width, (double)bounds.Height / (double)source.Height);
			Size size = new Size((int)((double)source.Width * num), (int)((double)source.Height * num));
			Point location = new Point(bounds.Location.X + (bounds.Width - size.Width) / 2, bounds.Location.Y + (bounds.Height - size.Height) / 2);
			DrawImage(source, new Rectangle(location, size));
		}

		private void FillCircle(PointF center, float radius, DXBrush brush)
		{
			nativeRenderer.FillEllipse(brush, GetEllipseBounds(center, radius));
		}

		private void FillEllipse(PointF center, float semiAxisX, float semiAxisY, DXBrush brush)
		{
			FillEllipse(GetEllipseBounds(center, semiAxisX, semiAxisY), brush);
		}

		private void DrawLinesOneByOne(DXPen pen, Point[] points)
		{
			if (points.Length != 0)
			{
				points[0] = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(points[0]);
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Length - 1; i++)
				{
					points[i + 1] = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(points[i + 1]);
					nativeRenderer.DrawLine(pen, points[i], points[i + 1]);
				}
			}
		}

		private float StrongInflateCoord(float coord, DXPen pen, bool reduce)
		{
			if (reduce)
			{
				return MathUtils.StrongRound(coord - 0.5f * pen.Width);
			}
			return MathUtils.StrongRound(coord + 0.5f * pen.Width);
		}

		private void DrawLinesOneByOne(DXPen pen, PointF[] points)
		{
			if (points.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			points[0] = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(points[0]);
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				points[i + 1] = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(points[i + 1]);
				float num = points[i].X;
				float num2 = points[i].Y;
				float num3 = points[i + 1].X;
				float num4 = points[i + 1].Y;
				if (num2 == num4)
				{
					num2 = (num4 = MathUtils.StrongRound(num2));
					if (pen.Width % 2f == 0f)
					{
						if (num3 > num)
						{
							num = StrongInflateCoord(num, pen, reduce: true);
							num3 = StrongInflateCoord(num3, pen, reduce: false);
						}
						else
						{
							num = StrongInflateCoord(num, pen, reduce: false);
							num3 = StrongInflateCoord(num3, pen, reduce: true);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (num == num3)
				{
					num = (num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound(num));
					if (pen.Width % 2f == 0f)
					{
						if (num4 > num2)
						{
							num2 = StrongInflateCoord(num2, pen, reduce: true);
							num4 = StrongInflateCoord(num4, pen, reduce: false);
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = StrongInflateCoord(num2, pen, reduce: false);
							num4 = StrongInflateCoord(num4, pen, reduce: true);
						}
					}
				}
				nativeRenderer.DrawLine(pen, num, num2, num3, num4);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLinesCore(DXPen pen, PointF[] points)
		{
			int num = 8125;
			if (IsGdiMetafileDrawing && points.Length > num)
			{
				ProcessMetafileLinesDrawing(pen, points, 0, num);
			}
			else
			{
				nativeRenderer.DrawLines(pen, points);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMetafileLinesDrawing(DXPen pen, PointF[] points, int offset, int count)
		{
			count = Math.Min(count, points.Length - offset);
			PointF[] array = new PointF[count];
			Array.Copy(points, offset, array, 0, count);
			nativeRenderer.DrawLines(pen, array);
			offset += count;
			if (offset < points.Length)
			{
				ProcessMetafileLinesDrawing(pen, points, offset, count);
			}
		}

		private void AdjustClipping(DXFont font, ref RectangleF bounds)
		{
			float num = (int)((float)font.GetGdiHeight() * 0.25f);
			bounds.X -= num;
			bounds.Width += num * 2f;
		}

		private void FillSplittedPolygon(LineStrip strip, DXBrush brush)
		{
			nativeRenderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			nativeRenderer.FillPolygon(brush, StripsUtils.Convert(strip, skipEqualPoints: true));
			nativeRenderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}

		private void OptimizeAndFillPolygon(LineStrip strip, DXBrush brush)
		{
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>(strip.Count);
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			int num4 = -1;
			int minYIndex = -1;
			int maxYIndex = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < strip.Count; i++)
			{
				int num5 = MathUtils.StrongRound(strip[i].X);
				double y = strip[i].Y;
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num4 = (minYIndex = (maxYIndex = i));
					num = num5;
					num2 = (num3 = y);
				}
				else if (num == num5)
				{
					if (y < num2)
					{
						num2 = y;
						minYIndex = i;
					}
					if (y > num3)
					{
						num3 = y;
						maxYIndex = i;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AddPointsFromStrip(strip, list, num, num4, Math.Max(0, i - 1), minYIndex, maxYIndex);
					num4 = (minYIndex = (maxYIndex = i));
					num = num5;
					num2 = (num3 = y);
				}
			}
			if (num4 >= 0)
			{
				AddPointsFromStrip(strip, list, num, num4, strip.Count - 1, minYIndex, maxYIndex);
			}
			nativeRenderer.FillPolygon(brush, list.ToArray());
		}

		private void FillBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, DXBrush brush, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			if (strip.Count == 1)
			{
				GRealRect2D boundingRectangle = strip.GetBoundingRectangle();
				nativeRenderer.FillRectangle(brush, (float)boundingRectangle.Left, (float)boundingRectangle.Top, (float)boundingRectangle.Width, (float)boundingRectangle.Height);
				return;
			}
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			strip.GetPointsForDrawing(out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints);
			dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(StripsUtils.Convert(topPoints));
			dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(StripsUtils.Convert(bottomPoints));
			if (isSplittedStrip)
			{
				nativeRenderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
				nativeRenderer.FillPath(brush, dXGraphicsPath);
				nativeRenderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
			}
			else
			{
				nativeRenderer.FillPath(brush, dXGraphicsPath);
			}
		}

		public void DrawImage(DXImage image, RectangleF bounds, DXImageSizeMode sizeMode)
		{
			if (image != null && bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				switch (sizeMode)
				{
				case DXImageSizeMode.AutoSize:
				case DXImageSizeMode.Stretch:
					DrawImage(image, bounds);
					break;
				case DXImageSizeMode.Tile:
					DrawTiledImage(image, MathUtils.StrongRound(bounds));
					break;
				case DXImageSizeMode.Zoom:
					DrawZoomedImage(image, MathUtils.StrongRound(bounds));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void DrawStretchedImage(DXImage image, Rectangle bounds, RectThickness dpiScaledThickness)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, dpiScaledThickness.Left);
			int num2 = Math.Max(1, dpiScaledThickness.Right);
			int num3 = Math.Max(1, dpiScaledThickness.Top);
			int num4 = Math.Max(1, dpiScaledThickness.Bottom);
			int num5 = image.Width - num2;
			int num6 = image.Height - num4;
			int width = num5 - num;
			int height = num6 - num3;
			int x = bounds.X;
			int num7 = x + num;
			int num8 = x + bounds.Width - num2;
			int y = bounds.Y;
			int num9 = y + num3;
			int num10 = y + bounds.Height - num4;
			int width2 = num8 - num7;
			int height2 = num10 - num9;
			DrawImage(image, new DXImageTileBounds[9]
			{
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(num7, num9, width2, height2), new Rectangle(num, num3, width, height)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(num7, y, width2, num3), new Rectangle(num, 0, width, num3)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(num8, num9, num2, height2), new Rectangle(num5, num3, num2, height)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(num7, num10, width2, num4), new Rectangle(num, num6, width, num4)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(x, num9, num, height2), new Rectangle(0, num3, num, height)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(x, y, num, num3), new Rectangle(0, 0, num, num3)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(num8, y, num2, num3), new Rectangle(num5, 0, num2, num3)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(num8, num10, num2, num4), new Rectangle(num5, num6, num2, num4)),
				new DXImageTileBounds(new Rectangle(x, num10, num, num4), new Rectangle(0, num6, num, num4))
			});
		}

				WrapMode = DXWrapMode.TileFlipXY

		public void FillMetafileRectangle(Rectangle rect, Color color, int thickness)
		{
			if (rect.Height == thickness)
			{
				DrawLine(new Point(rect.X, (rect.Top + rect.Bottom) / 2), new Point(rect.Right, (rect.Top + rect.Bottom) / 2), color, thickness);
			}
			else
			{
				FillRectangle(rect, color);
			}
		}

		public void DrawLines(Point[] points, Color color, int thickness, ILineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (points.Length > 1)
			{
				using (DXPen pen = DXPenHelper.Create(color, thickness, lineStyle))
				{
					try
					{
						nativeRenderer.DrawLines(pen, points);
						return;
					}
					catch (OverflowException)
					{
						DrawLinesOneByOne(pen, points);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (points.Length == 1)
			{
				float num = 0.5f * (float)thickness;
				using DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
				nativeRenderer.FillRectangle(brush, (float)points[0].X - num, (float)points[0].Y - num, thickness, thickness);
			}
		}

		public void DrawLines(PointF[] points, Color color, int thickness, ILineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (points.Length <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			using DXPen dXPen = DXPenHelper.Create(color, thickness, lineStyle);
			if (dXPen.IsLineJoinInvisible)
			{
				DrawLinesOneByOne(dXPen, points);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				DrawLinesCore(dXPen, points);
			}
			catch (OverflowException)
			{
				DrawLinesOneByOne(dXPen, points);
			}
		}

		public void DrawRing(RectangleF bounds, RectangleF gradientRect, Color color, Color color2, float thickness)
		{
			float gradientStartPercent = (gradientRect.Width - thickness * 2f) / gradientRect.Width;
			DXGraphicsPathBuilder dXGraphicsPathBuilder = new DXGraphicsPathBuilder();
			dXGraphicsPathBuilder.AddEllipse(gradientRect);
			PointF centerPoint = bounds.CalculateCenter();
			using DXRadialGradientBrush brush = new DXRadialGradientBrush(dXGraphicsPathBuilder.GetPathData(), color, color2, centerPoint, gradientStartPercent);
			using DXPen pen = new DXPen(brush, thickness);
			nativeRenderer.DrawEllipse(pen, bounds);
		}

		public void DrawText(string text, DXFont font, Color color, ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingSupport, PointF position)
		{
			TextRenderingHint renderHint = AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(antialiasingSupport);
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat();
			if (IsRightToLeft)
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft;
				dXStringFormat.Alignment = DXStringAlignment.Far;
			}
			nativeRenderer.DrawText(text, font, color, renderHint, position, dXStringFormat);
		}

		public void DrawBoundedText(string text, DXFont font, Color color, ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingSupport, RectangleF bounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment)
		{
			DrawBoundedText(text, font, color, antialiasingSupport, bounds, alignment, lineAlignment, 0f, allowWrap: true);
		}

		public void DrawBoundedText(string text, DXFont font, Color color, ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingSupport, RectangleF bounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment, float textHeight, bool allowWrap)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = TextMeasurer.CreateFormatWithTabs();
			if (bounds.Height > textHeight)
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.LineLimit;
			}
			if (allowWrap)
			{
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter;
			}
			else
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.None;
			}
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)alignment;
			dXStringFormat.LineAlignment = (DXStringAlignment)lineAlignment;
			if (IsRightToLeft)
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft;
			}
			if (alignment == System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center && !allowWrap)
			{
				AdjustClipping(font, ref bounds);
			}
			TextRenderingHint renderHint = AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(antialiasingSupport);
			nativeRenderer.DrawText(text, font, color, renderHint, bounds.ToRectangle(), dXStringFormat);
		}

		public void DrawLines(LineStrip strip, Color color, int thickness, ILineStyle lineStyle, LineCap lineCap)
		{
			List<List<PointF>> list = StripsUtils.OptimizeAndConvert(strip, 1000);
			if (list.Count > 0 && list[0].Count > 1)
			{
				using (DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color, thickness))
				{
					if (lineStyle != null)
					{
						dXPen.DashStyle = (DXDashStyle)lineStyle.DashStyle;
						dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)lineStyle.LineJoin;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						nativeRenderer.DrawLines(dXPen, list[i].ToArray());
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				float num = 0.5f * (float)thickness;
				using DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
				nativeRenderer.FillRectangle(brush, list[0][0].X - num, list[0][0].Y - num, thickness, thickness);
			}
		}

			nativeRenderer.DrawPolygon(pen, StripsUtils.Convert(strip, skipEqualPoints: true));
		}

		public void FillPolygon(LineStrip strip, DXBrush brush, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			if (isSplittedStrip)
			{
				FillSplittedPolygon(strip, brush);
			}
			else if (CanOptimizePolygons && strip.Count > 1000)
			{
				OptimizeAndFillPolygon(strip, brush);
			}
			else
			{
				nativeRenderer.FillPolygon(brush, StripsUtils.Convert(strip, skipEqualPoints: true));
			}
		}

		{
			using DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
			FillPolygon(strip, brush, isSplittedStrip);
		}

			nativeRenderer.FillPolygon(brush, StripsUtils.Convert(strip, skipEqualPoints: true));
		}

		public void FillPolygonGradient(LineStrip strip, RectangleF gradient, Color color, Color color2, LinearGradientMode mode)
		{
			SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			using (DXBrush brush = new DXLinearGradientBrush(gradient, color, color2, (DXLinearGradientMode)mode))
			{
				FillPolygon(strip, brush);
			}
			RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}

		public void FillPolygonGradient(LineStrip strip, RectangleF bounds, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			PointF centerPoint = bounds.CalculateCenter();
			PointF[] array = StripsUtils.Convert(strip, skipEqualPoints: true);
			DXGraphicsPathBuilder dXGraphicsPathBuilder = new DXGraphicsPathBuilder();
			dXGraphicsPathBuilder.AddEllipse(GetBoundsForCircle(array, centerPoint));
			using (DXBrush brush = new DXRadialGradientBrush(dXGraphicsPathBuilder.GetPathData(), color, color2, centerPoint))
			{
				nativeRenderer.FillPolygon(brush, array);
			}
			RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}

		public void DrawBezier(BezierStrip strip, Color color, float thickness)

		}

		public void DrawBezier(BezierStrip strip, Color color, float thickness, ILineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (!strip.IsEmpty)
			{
				using (DXPen pen = DXPenHelper.Create(color, thickness, lineStyle))
				{
					nativeRenderer.DrawBezier(pen, StripsUtils.Convert(strip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true)));
					return;
				}
			}
			if (strip.Count == 1)
			{
				float num = 0.5f * thickness;
				List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = strip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true);
				using DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
				nativeRenderer.FillRectangle(brush, (float)pointsForDrawing[0].X - num, (float)pointsForDrawing[0].Y - num, thickness, thickness);
			}
		}

		public void FillBezier(BezierRangeStrip strip, Color color, bool isSplittedStrip = false)

		public void DrawPie(Pie pie, PointF basePoint, Color color, int thickness)
		{
			float startAngleInDegrees = pie.StartAngleInDegrees;
			float sweepAngleInDegrees = pie.SweepAngleInDegrees;
			GRealPoint2D center = pie.CalculateCenter(basePoint);
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle((int)Math.Round(center.X), (int)Math.Round(center.Y), 0, 0);
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(pie.MinorSemiaxis);
			int num2 = Convert.ToInt32(pie.MajorSemiaxis);
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Inflate(rect, num2, num);
			int num3 = (int)Math.Floor((float)Math.Min(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height) / 2f);
			if (thickness <= num3)
			{
				bool flag = (double)sweepAngleInDegrees != -360.0;
				using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color, thickness);
				int num4 = Convert.ToInt32(pie.MajorSemiaxis * pie.HoleFraction);
				int num5 = Convert.ToInt32(pie.MinorSemiaxis * pie.HoleFraction);
				if ((float)num4 >= 1f && (float)num5 >= 1f)
				{
					Rectangle bounds = Rectangle.Inflate(rect, num4, num5);
					GRealPoint2D startPoint = default(GRealPoint2D);
					GRealPoint2D finishPoint = default(GRealPoint2D);
					GRealPoint2D startPoint2 = default(GRealPoint2D);
					GRealPoint2D finishPoint2 = default(GRealPoint2D);
					bool flag2 = (double)sweepAngleInDegrees < 2.0;
					bool flag3 = true;
					bool flag4 = true;
					if (flag2)
					{
						GraphicUtils.CalculateStartFinishPoints(center, num2, num, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees, out startPoint, out finishPoint);
						GraphicUtils.CalculateStartFinishPoints(center, num4, num5, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees, out startPoint2, out finishPoint2);
						flag3 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredLength(startPoint, finishPoint) > 4.0;
						if (!flag3)
						{
							nativeRenderer.DrawLine(dXPen, (float)startPoint.X, (float)startPoint.Y, (float)finishPoint.X, (float)finishPoint.Y);
						}
						flag4 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredLength(startPoint2, finishPoint2) > 4.0;
						if (!flag4)
						{
							nativeRenderer.DrawLine(dXPen, (float)startPoint2.X, (float)startPoint2.Y, (float)finishPoint2.X, (float)finishPoint2.Y);
						}
					}
					if (flag3)
					{
						nativeRenderer.DrawArc(dXPen, rectangle, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees);
					}
					if (flag4)
					{
						nativeRenderer.DrawArc(dXPen, bounds, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (!flag2)
						{
							GraphicUtils.CalculateStartFinishPoints(center, num2, num, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees, out startPoint, out finishPoint);
							GraphicUtils.CalculateStartFinishPoints(center, num4, num5, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees, out startPoint2, out finishPoint2);
						}
						using DXPen pen = new DXPen(color, thickness, DXLineCap.AnchorMask);
						nativeRenderer.DrawLine(pen, (float)startPoint.X, (float)startPoint.Y, (float)startPoint2.X, (float)startPoint2.Y);
						nativeRenderer.DrawLine(pen, (float)finishPoint.X, (float)finishPoint.Y, (float)finishPoint2.X, (float)finishPoint2.Y);
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					dXPen.MiterLimit = Math.Min(thickness, dXPen.MiterLimit);
					nativeRenderer.DrawPie(dXPen, rectangle, startAngleInDegrees, sweepAngleInDegrees);
				}
				else
				{
					nativeRenderer.DrawEllipse(dXPen, rectangle);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num6 = thickness / 2;
			rectangle.Inflate(num6, num6);
			using DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
			nativeRenderer.FillEllipse(brush, rectangle);
		}

		public void FillPie(Pie pie, PointF basePoint, HatchStyle hatchStyle, Color color, Color backColor)
		{
			using DXBrush brush = new DXHatchBrush((DXHatchStyle)hatchStyle, color, backColor);
			DXGraphicsPath path = GraphicUtils.CreatePieGraphicsPath(pie.CalculateCenter(basePoint), pie.MajorSemiaxis, pie.MinorSemiaxis, pie.HoleFraction, pie.StartAngleInDegrees, pie.SweepAngleInDegrees);
			nativeRenderer.FillPath(brush, path);
		}

		public void FillPie(Rectangle rect, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, DXBrush brush)
		{
			nativeRenderer.FillPie(brush, rect, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void FillPie(PointF center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, Color color, Color color2)
		{
			SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			DXGraphicsPathBuilder dXGraphicsPathBuilder = new DXGraphicsPathBuilder();
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Inflate(new Rectangle((int)Math.Round(center.X), (int)Math.Round(center.Y), 0, 0), Convert.ToInt32(majorSemiAxis), Convert.ToInt32(minorSemiAxis));
			dXGraphicsPathBuilder.AddEllipse(rectangle);
			using (DXBrush brush = new DXRadialGradientBrush(dXGraphicsPathBuilder.GetPathData(), color, color2, center, holePercent))
			{
				DXGraphicsPath path = GraphicUtils.CreatePieGraphicsPath(new GRealPoint2D(center.X, center.Y), majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, holePercent, startAngle, sweepAngle);
				FillPath(path, brush);
			}
			RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}
	}
	public class DXRadialGradientBrush : DXPathGradientBrush
	{
		public DXRadialGradientBrush(DXGraphicsPathData path, Color centerColor, Color endColor, PointF centerPoint)
			: this(path, centerColor, endColor, centerPoint, 0f)
		{
		}

		public DXRadialGradientBrush(DXGraphicsPathData path, Color centerColor, Color endColor, PointF centerPoint, float gradientStartPercent)
			: base(path)
		{
			base.CenterColor = centerColor;
			base.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { endColor };
			base.CenterPoint = centerPoint;
			if (gradientStartPercent > 0f)
			{
				base.Blend = new DXBlend
				{
					Positions = new float[3]
					{
						0f,
						1f - gradientStartPercent,
						1f
					},
					Factors = new float[3] { 0f, 1f, 0f }
				};
			}
		}
	}
	public class BitmapUtils
	{
		private struct BITMAPINFOHEADER
		{
			public int bihSize;

			public int bihWidth;

			public int bihHeight;

			public short bihPlanes;

			public short bihBitCount;

			public int bihCompression;

			public int bihSizeImage;

			public double bihXPelsPerMeter;

			public double bihClrUsed;
		}

		private struct BITMAPINFO
		{
			public BITMAPINFOHEADER biHeader;

			public int biColors;
		}

		private static int _width;

		private static int _height;

		private static int[] _pArray;

		private static GCHandle _gcHandle;

		private static BITMAPINFO _BI;

		private static object locker = new object();

		public static void DrawBitmap(Graphics target, Bitmap sourceImage)
		{
			FastPaint(target, sourceImage);
		}

		private static void FastPaint(Graphics target, Bitmap sourceImage)
		{
			HandleRef hRef = new HandleRef(target, target.GetHdc());
			try
			{
				FastPaint(hRef, sourceImage);
			}
			finally
			{
				target.ReleaseHdc(hRef.Handle);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void FastPaint(HandleRef hRef, Bitmap bitmap)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				if (bitmap.Width != _width || bitmap.Height != _height)
				{
					Realloc(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
				}
				BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height), ImageLockMode.ReadOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
				Marshal.Copy(bitmapData.Scan0, _pArray, 0, _width * _height);
				SetDIBitsToDevice(hRef, 0, 0, _width, _height, 0, 0, 0, _height, ref _pArray[0], ref _BI, 0u);
				bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
				if (_gcHandle.IsAllocated)
				{
					_gcHandle.Free();
				}
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void Realloc(int width, int height)
		{
			if (_gcHandle.IsAllocated)
			{
				_gcHandle.Free();
			}
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
			_pArray = new int[_width * _height];
			_gcHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(_pArray, GCHandleType.Pinned);
			_BI = new BITMAPINFO
			{
				biHeader = 
				{
					bihBitCount = 32,
					bihPlanes = 1,
					bihSize = 40,
					bihWidth = _width,
					bihHeight = -_height,
					bihSizeImage = _width * _height << 2
				}
			};
		}

		[DllImport("gdi32")]
		private static extern int SetDIBitsToDevice(HandleRef hDC, int xDest, int yDest, int dwWidth, int dwHeight, int XSrc, int YSrc, int uStartScan, int cScanLines, ref int lpvBits, ref BITMAPINFO lpbmi, uint fuColorUse);
	}
	public class GdiPlusModifierNativeRenderer : GdiPlusNativeRenderer
	{
		private readonly GraphicsModifier modifier;

		public GdiPlusModifierNativeRenderer(IDXGraphics dxGraphics, Graphics graphics, GraphicsModifier modifier)
			: base(dxGraphics, graphics)
		{
			this.modifier = modifier;
		}

		public override void ScaleModel(float x, float y)
		{
			float num = Math.Max(x, 1E-10f);
			float num2 = Math.Max(y, 1E-10f);
			modifier.ScaleTransform(base.Graphics, num, num2, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public override void DrawImage(DXImage image, PointF position)
		{
			modifier.DrawImage(base.Graphics, SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(image), new RectangleF(position, image.Size));
		}

		public override void DrawImage(DXImage image, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			modifier.DrawImage(base.Graphics, SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(image), bounds);
		}

		public override void DrawRectangle(DXPen dxPen, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			modifier.DrawRectangle(base.Graphics, pen, (RectangleF)bounds);
		}

		public override void DrawLine(DXPen dxPen, PointF point1, PointF point2)
		{
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			modifier.DrawLine(base.Graphics, pen, point1.X, point1.Y, point2.X, point2.Y);
		}

		public override void DrawLine(DXPen dxPen, Point point1, Point point2)
		{
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			modifier.DrawLine(base.Graphics, pen, (float)point1.X, (float)point1.Y, (float)point2.X, (float)point2.Y);
		}

		public override void DrawLine(DXPen dxPen, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			modifier.DrawLine(base.Graphics, pen, x1, y1, x2, y2);
		}

		public override void DrawLines(DXPen dxPen, Point[] points)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[points.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new PointF(points[i].X, points[i].Y);
			}
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			modifier.DrawLines(base.Graphics, pen, array);
		}

		public override void DrawPath(DXPen dxPen, DXGraphicsPath dxPath)
		{
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(dxPath);
			modifier.DrawPath(base.Graphics, pen, graphicsPath);
		}

		public override void DrawEllipse(DXPen dxPen, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			using Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dxPen);
			modifier.DrawEllipse(base.Graphics, pen, bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}

		public override void DrawText(string text, DXFont font, Color color, TextRenderingHint textRenderingHint, PointF position, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			DrawTextWithTextRenderingHint(textRenderingHint, delegate
			{
				using Brush brush = new SolidBrush(color);
				using StringFormat stringFormat = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(dxStringFormat);
				using Font font2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font);
				SizeF size = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, font);
				modifier.DrawString(base.Graphics, text, font2, brush, new RectangleF(position, size), stringFormat);
			});
		}

		public override void DrawText(string text, DXFont font, Color color, TextRenderingHint textRenderingHint, Rectangle bounds, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			DrawTextWithTextRenderingHint(textRenderingHint, delegate
			{
				using Brush brush = new SolidBrush(color);
				using StringFormat stringFormat = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(dxStringFormat);
				using Font font2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font);
				modifier.DrawString(base.Graphics, text, font2, brush, (RectangleF)bounds, stringFormat);
			});
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisRangeData : ChartElement, IAxisRange, ICloneable
	{
		public abstract bool Auto { get; set; }

		public abstract object MinValue { get; set; }

		public abstract object MaxValue { get; set; }

		public abstract object MinValueSerializable { set; }

		public abstract object MaxValueSerializable { set; }

		public abstract double MinValueInternal { get; set; }

		public abstract double MaxValueInternal { get; set; }

		public abstract bool AlwaysShowZeroLevel { get; set; }

		public abstract bool SideMarginsEnabled { get; set; }

		public abstract double SideMargins { get; }

		protected abstract IAxisRange AxisRangeImplementation { get; }

		object IAxisRange.MinValue => AxisRangeImplementation.MinValue;

		object IAxisRange.MaxValue => AxisRangeImplementation.MaxValue;

		double IAxisRange.MinValueInternal => AxisRangeImplementation.MinValueInternal;

		double IAxisRange.MaxValueInternal => AxisRangeImplementation.MaxValueInternal;

		void IAxisRange.Assign(IAxisRange source)
		{
			AxisRangeImplementation.Assign(source);
		}

		void IAxisRange.Assign(IAxisRangeData source)
		{
			AxisRangeImplementation.Assign(source);
		}

		void IAxisRange.UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			AxisRangeImplementation.UpdateRange(min, max, internalMin, internalMax);
		}

		public AxisRangeData(ChartElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeAuto();

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeMinValue();

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeMaxValue();

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal();

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal();

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeAlwaysShowZeroLevel();

		public abstract bool ShouldSerializeSideMarginsEnabled();

		public abstract void ShiftInternalMinMaxValues(double shift);

		public abstract void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue);

		public abstract void SetInternalMinMaxValues(double min, double max);

		public abstract void OnScaleTypeUpdated();

		public abstract object ConvertToNativeValue(object value, string propertyName);

		public abstract void CheckRange(object minValue, object maxValue, double minValueInternal, double maxValueInternal);

		protected void CheckMinValueInternal(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMinValueInternal));
			}
		}

		protected void CheckMaxValueInternal(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMaxValueInternal));
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisRangeDataEx : AxisRangeData
	{
		public class AxisRangeImp : IAxisRange, ICloneable
		{
			private AxisRangeDataEx owner;

			object IAxisRange.MinValue => owner.minValue;

			object IAxisRange.MaxValue => owner.maxValue;

			double IAxisRange.MinValueInternal => owner.minValueInternal;

			double IAxisRange.MaxValueInternal => owner.maxValueInternal;

			public AxisRangeImp(AxisRangeDataEx owner)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			void IAxisRange.Assign(IAxisRange source)
			{
				if (source is AxisRangeData obj)
				{
					owner.Assign(obj);
				}
			}

			void IAxisRange.Assign(IAxisRangeData source)
			{
				if (source != null)
				{
					owner.minValue = source.MinValue;
					owner.maxValue = source.MaxValue;
					owner.minValueInternal = source.Min;
					owner.maxValueInternal = source.Max;
					owner.auto = source.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
					owner.sideMarginsEnabled = source.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.Enable || source.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.UserEnable;
				}
			}

			void IAxisRange.UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
			{
				owner.minValue = min;
				owner.maxValue = max;
				owner.minValueInternal = internalMin;
				owner.maxValueInternal = internalMax;
			}

			public object Clone()
			{
				return owner.Clone();
			}
		}

		public const string minValuePropertyName = "MinValue";

		public const string maxValuePropertyName = "MaxValue";

		private readonly AxisBase axis;

		private bool auto = true;

		private object minValue;

		private object maxValue;

		private object minValueSerializable;

		private object maxValueSerializable;

		private double minValueInternal = double.NaN;

		private double maxValueInternal = double.NaN;

		private bool alwaysShowZeroLevel = true;

		private bool sideMarginsEnabled = true;

		private AxisRangeImp axisRangeImp;

		protected override IAxisRange AxisRangeImplementation => axisRangeImp;

		public override bool Auto
		{
			get
			{
				return auto;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != auto)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						RaiseControlChanging();
						auto = true;
						minValue = null;
						maxValue = null;
						minValueInternal = double.NaN;
						maxValueInternal = double.NaN;
					}
					else
					{
						RaiseControlChanging();
						ClearAuto();
					}
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public override object MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				return minValue;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMinValue(value);
				if (!Loading)
				{
					value = ConvertToNativeValue(value, "MinValue");
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				ClearAuto();
				minValue = value;
				minValueInternal = double.NaN;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public override object MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				return maxValue;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMaxValue(value);
				if (!Loading)
				{
					value = ConvertToNativeValue(value, "MaxValue");
				}
				RaiseControlChanging();
				ClearAuto();
				maxValue = value;
				maxValueInternal = double.NaN;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public override object MinValueSerializable
		{
			set
			{
				if (Loading)
				{
					minValueSerializable = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override object MaxValueSerializable
		{
			set
			{
				if (Loading)
				{
					maxValueSerializable = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override double MinValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return minValueInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMinValueInternal(value);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				ClearAuto();
				minValueInternal = value;
				minValue = null;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public override double MaxValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return maxValueInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMaxValueInternal(value);
				RaiseControlChanging();
				ClearAuto();
				maxValueInternal = value;
				maxValue = null;
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public override bool AlwaysShowZeroLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return alwaysShowZeroLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != alwaysShowZeroLevel)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					alwaysShowZeroLevel = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool SideMarginsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return sideMarginsEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != sideMarginsEnabled)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					sideMarginsEnabled = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public override double SideMargins => 0.0;

		private static void ThrowIncorrectPropertyValueException(object propertyValue, string propertyName)
		{
			string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPropertyValue), (propertyValue == null) ? string.Empty : propertyValue.ToString(), propertyName);
			throw new ArgumentException(message);
		}

		private static void GenerateAxisRangeException()
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRange));
		}

		public static void CheckNumericalMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue, double minValueInternal, double maxValueInternal)
		{
			double num = ((minValue == null) ? minValueInternal : Convert.ToDouble(minValue));
			double num2 = ((maxValue == null) ? maxValueInternal : Convert.ToDouble(maxValue));
			if (num >= num2)
			{
				GenerateAxisRangeException();
			}
		}

		public static void CheckAbstractMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue, double minValueInternal, double maxValueInternal)
		{
			if (minValue == null || maxValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (minValue is string)
			{
				if (!(maxValue is string))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgMinMaxDifferentTypes));
				}
			}
			else if (minValue is DateTime)
			{
				if (!(maxValue is DateTime))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgMinMaxDifferentTypes));
				}
				if (DateTime.Compare((DateTime)minValue, (DateTime)maxValue) >= 0)
				{
					GenerateAxisRangeException();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CheckNumericalMinMaxValues(minValue, maxValue, minValueInternal, maxValueInternal);
			}
		}

		private AxisRangeDataEx(ChartElement owner, AxisBase axis)
			: base(owner)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			axisRangeImp = new AxisRangeImp(this);
		}

		public AxisRangeDataEx(AxisRange range)
			: this(range, range.Axis)
		{
		}

		public AxisRangeDataEx(ScrollingRange range)
			: this(range, range.Range.Axis)
		{
		}

		private void CheckMinValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMinValue));
			}
		}

		private void CheckMaxValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMaxValue));
			}
		}

		private void ClearAuto()
		{
			if (auto)
			{
				auto = false;
			}
		}

		private void CheckValueType<T>(object value, string propertyName)
		{
			if (!(value is T))
			{
				string message = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPropertyValue), value, propertyName);
				throw new ArgumentException(message);
			}
		}

		private object ConvertToNativeValue(object value, string propertyName, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				ThrowIncorrectPropertyValueException(value, propertyName);
			}
			ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
			AxisScaleTypeMap scaleTypeMap = axis.ScaleTypeMap;
			object obj = scaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, culture);
			if (!scaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(obj))
			{
				ThrowIncorrectPropertyValueException(value, propertyName);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object ConvertToNativeValue(object value, string propertyName)
		{
			return ConvertToNativeValue(value, propertyName, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		public override void CheckRange(object minValue, object maxValue, double minValueInternal, double maxValueInternal)
		{
			switch (axis.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (minValue != null)
				{
					CheckValueType<string>(minValue, "MinValue");
					minValueInternal = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(minValue);
					flag = minValueInternal >= 0.0;
				}
				if (maxValue != null)
				{
					CheckValueType<string>(maxValue, "MaxValue");
					maxValueInternal = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(maxValue);
					flag = maxValueInternal >= 0.0;
				}
				if (flag && maxValueInternal <= minValueInternal)
				{
					GenerateAxisRangeException();
				}
				break;
			}
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				if (minValue != null)
				{
					CheckValueType<DateTime>(minValue, "MinValue");
					minValueInternal = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(minValue);
				}
				if (maxValue != null)
				{
					CheckValueType<DateTime>(maxValue, "MaxValue");
					maxValueInternal = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(maxValue);
				}
				if (maxValueInternal <= minValueInternal)
				{
					GenerateAxisRangeException();
				}
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				if (minValue != null)
				{
					CheckValueType<TimeSpan>(minValue, "MinValue");
					minValueInternal = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(minValue);
				}
				if (maxValue != null)
				{
					CheckValueType<TimeSpan>(maxValue, "MaxValue");
					maxValueInternal = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(maxValue);
				}
				if (maxValueInternal <= minValueInternal)
				{
					GenerateAxisRangeException();
				}
				break;
			default:
				CheckNumericalMinMaxValues(minValue, maxValue, minValueInternal, maxValueInternal);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			if (Loading)
			{
				auto = false;
				this.minValue = minValue;
				this.maxValue = maxValue;
				return;
			}
			CheckMinValue(minValue);
			CheckMaxValue(maxValue);
			minValue = ConvertToNativeValue(minValue, "MinValue");
			maxValue = ConvertToNativeValue(maxValue, "MaxValue");
			CheckRange(minValue, maxValue, minValueInternal, maxValueInternal);
			RaiseControlChanging();
			auto = false;
			this.minValue = minValue;
			this.maxValue = maxValue;
			minValueInternal = double.NaN;
			maxValueInternal = double.NaN;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public override void SetInternalMinMaxValues(double min, double max)
		{
			CheckMinValueInternal(min);
			CheckMaxValueInternal(max);
			CheckAbstractMinMaxValues(min, max, minValueInternal, maxValueInternal);
			RaiseControlChanging();
			auto = false;
			minValueInternal = min;
			maxValueInternal = max;
			minValue = null;
			maxValue = null;
			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public override void ShiftInternalMinMaxValues(double shift)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(minValueInternal))
			{
				minValueInternal += shift;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(maxValueInternal))
			{
				maxValueInternal += shift;
			}
		}

		public override void OnScaleTypeUpdated()
		{
			if (auto)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (minValue != null)
				{
					if (minValueSerializable == minValue)
					{
						minValue = ConvertToNativeValue(minValue, "MinValue", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						if (base.Owner != null && base.Owner is ScrollingRange)
						{
							axis.WholeRangeData.MinValue = minValue;
						}
						else
						{
							double internalMin = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(minValue);
							XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = ((axis is Axis2D axis2D) ? (axis2D.Diagram as XYDiagram) : null);
							if (xYDiagram2D == null)
							{
								axis.WholeRangeData.MinValue = minValue;
							}
							else if ((!xYDiagram2D.EnableAxisXScrolling && !axis.IsValuesAxis) || (!xYDiagram2D.EnableAxisYScrolling && axis.IsValuesAxis))
							{
								((VisualRangeData)axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(minValue, axis.WholeRangeData.MaxValue, internalMin, axis.WholeRangeData.Max, needUpdate: false);
							}
							((VisualRangeData)axis.VisualRangeData).SetRange(minValue, axis.VisualRangeData.MaxValue, internalMin, axis.VisualRangeData.Max, needUpdate: false);
						}
						minValueSerializable = null;
					}
					else
					{
						minValue = ConvertToNativeValue(minValue, "MinValue");
					}
				}
				if (maxValue == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (maxValueSerializable == maxValue)
				{
					maxValue = ConvertToNativeValue(maxValue, "MaxValue", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					if (base.Owner != null && base.Owner is ScrollingRange)
					{
						axis.WholeRangeData.MaxValue = maxValue;
					}
					else
					{
						double internalMax = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(maxValue);
						XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D2 = ((axis is Axis2D axis2D2) ? (axis2D2.Diagram as XYDiagram) : null);
						if (xYDiagram2D2 == null)
						{
							axis.WholeRangeData.MaxValue = maxValue;
						}
						else if ((!xYDiagram2D2.EnableAxisXScrolling && !axis.IsValuesAxis) || (!xYDiagram2D2.EnableAxisYScrolling && axis.IsValuesAxis))
						{
							((VisualRangeData)axis.WholeRangeData).SetRange(axis.WholeRangeData.MinValue, maxValue, axis.WholeRangeData.Min, internalMax, needUpdate: false);
						}
						((VisualRangeData)axis.VisualRangeData).SetRange(axis.VisualRangeData.MinValue, maxValue, axis.VisualRangeData.Min, internalMax, needUpdate: false);
					}
					maxValueSerializable = null;
				}
				else
				{
					maxValue = ConvertToNativeValue(maxValue, "MaxValue");
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				LockChanges();
				try
				{
					Auto = true;
				}
				finally
				{
					UnlockChanges();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAuto() && !ShouldSerializeMinValue() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValue() && !ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal() && !ShouldSerializeAlwaysShowZeroLevel())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSideMarginsEnabled();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeAuto()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeMinValue()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeMaxValue()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeMinValueInternal()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeMaxValueInternal()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeAlwaysShowZeroLevel()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeSideMarginsEnabled()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (obj is AxisRangeDataEx axisRangeDataEx)
			{
				auto = axisRangeDataEx.Auto;
				minValue = axisRangeDataEx.minValue;
				maxValue = axisRangeDataEx.maxValue;
				minValueInternal = axisRangeDataEx.minValueInternal;
				maxValueInternal = axisRangeDataEx.maxValueInternal;
				alwaysShowZeroLevel = axisRangeDataEx.AlwaysShowZeroLevel;
				sideMarginsEnabled = axisRangeDataEx.SideMarginsEnabled;
			}
			else if (obj is AxisRangeData axisRangeData)
			{
				auto = axisRangeData.Auto;
				minValue = axisRangeData.MinValue;
				maxValue = axisRangeData.MaxValue;
				minValueInternal = axisRangeData.MinValueInternal;
				maxValueInternal = axisRangeData.MaxValueInternal;
				alwaysShowZeroLevel = axisRangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel;
				sideMarginsEnabled = axisRangeData.SideMarginsEnabled;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AxisRangeDataEx(null, null);
		}
	}
	public abstract class RangeDataBase : ChartElement, IAxisRangeData, IMinMaxValues
	{
		public class Deserializer
		{
			protected readonly AxisBase axis;

			private object minSerializable;

			private object maxSerializable;

			private double minInternal = double.NaN;

			private double maxInternal = double.NaN;

			private double actualStartSideMargin;

			private double actualEndSideMargin;

			private SideMarginMode autoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.Enable;

			private SideMarginSizeUnitNative sideMarginSizeUnit;

			private MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue = new MinMaxValues(0.0);

			public bool HasValue
			{
				get
				{
					if (autoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.Enable && double.IsNaN(minInternal) && double.IsNaN(maxInternal) && minSerializable == null)
					{
						return maxSerializable != null;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public bool AutoSideMargins
			{
				set
				{
					autoSideMargins = (value ? SideMarginMode.UserEnable : SideMarginMode.UserDisable);
				}
			}

			public SideMarginSizeUnitNative SideMarginSizeUnit
			{
				set
				{
					sideMarginSizeUnit = value;
				}
			}

			public MinMaxValues SideMarginsValue
			{
				set
				{
					sideMarginsValue = value;
				}
			}

			public double ActualStartSideMargin
			{
				set
				{
					actualStartSideMargin = value;
				}
			}

			public double ActualEndSideMargin
			{
				set
				{
					actualEndSideMargin = value;
				}
			}

			public double MinInternal
			{
				set
				{
					minInternal = value;
				}
			}

			public double MaxInternal
			{
				set
				{
					maxInternal = value;
				}
			}

			public object MinValueSerializable
			{
				get
				{
					return minSerializable;
				}
				set
				{
					if (IsValidSerializableValue(value))
					{
						minSerializable = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public object MaxValueSerializable
			{
				get
				{
					return maxSerializable;
				}
				set
				{
					if (IsValidSerializableValue(value))
					{
						maxSerializable = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public Deserializer(AxisBase axis)
			{
				this.axis = axis;
			}

			private bool TryConvertToNativeValue(object value, CultureInfo culture, double defaultInternal, out object nativeValue)
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap scaleTypeMap = axis.ScaleTypeMap;
				if (value == null)
				{
					double num = defaultInternal;
					if (axis.ScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
					{
						num += ((AxisDateTimeMap)axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
					}
					nativeValue = scaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(num);
				}
				else
				{
					nativeValue = scaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, culture);
				}
				if (!scaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(nativeValue))
				{
					nativeValue = null;
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool IsValidSerializableValue(object value)
			{
				if ((value is string && (string)value == "") || (value is DateTime && (DateTime)value == DateTime.MinValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected virtual void Deserialize(RangeDataBase range)
			{
				if (minSerializable != null || maxSerializable != null || !double.IsNaN(minInternal) || !double.IsNaN(maxInternal))
				{
					if (!TryGetNativeValue(minSerializable, minInternal, 0.0, out var nativeValue) || !TryGetNativeValue(maxSerializable, maxInternal, 1.0, out var nativeValue2))
					{
						return;
					}
					double num = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(nativeValue);
					double num2 = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(nativeValue2);
					if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (num > num2)
					{
						object obj = nativeValue;
						nativeValue = nativeValue2;
						nativeValue2 = obj;
					}
					range.min = nativeValue;
					range.max = nativeValue2;
					range.minInternal = num;
					range.maxInternal = num2;
					range.minRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(nativeValue);
					range.maxRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(nativeValue2);
					range.correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
					range.autoMin = false;
					range.autoMax = false;
				}
				else
				{
					if (range.min == null)
					{
						range.AutoMin = true;
					}
					if (range.max == null)
					{
						range.AutoMax = true;
					}
				}
				range.sideMarginSizeUnit = sideMarginSizeUnit;
				range.autoSideMarginsValue = autoSideMargins;
				if (autoSideMargins != SideMarginMode.UserDisable && autoSideMargins != SideMarginMode.Disable)
				{
					range.sideMargins = sideMarginsValue;
					range.actualStartSideMargin = actualStartSideMargin;
					range.actualEndSideMargin = actualEndSideMargin;
				}
			}

			private bool TryGetNativeValue(object value, double internalValue, double defaultInternal, out object nativeValue)
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (!TryConvertToNativeValue(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, defaultInternal, out var nativeValue2))
					{
						nativeValue = null;
						return false;
					}
					nativeValue = nativeValue2;
					return true;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(internalValue))
				{
					if (axis.ScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
					{
						internalValue = minInternal + ((AxisDateTimeMap)axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
					}
					nativeValue = axis.ScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(internalValue);
					return true;
				}
				if (axis.ScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					defaultInternal += ((AxisDateTimeMap)axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
				}
				nativeValue = axis.ScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(defaultInternal);
				return true;
			}

			internal void Assign(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is Deserializer deserializer)
				{
					minSerializable = deserializer.minSerializable;
					maxSerializable = deserializer.maxSerializable;
					autoSideMargins = deserializer.autoSideMargins;
					sideMarginSizeUnit = deserializer.sideMarginSizeUnit;
					sideMarginsValue = deserializer.sideMarginsValue;
					actualStartSideMargin = deserializer.actualStartSideMargin;
					actualEndSideMargin = deserializer.actualEndSideMargin;
				}
			}

			public void TryDeserialize(params RangeDataBase[] ranges)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ranges.Length; i++)
				{
					Deserialize(ranges[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private class EventFiring
		{
			private readonly RangeDataBase range;

			private RangeSnapshot oldRange;

			private RangeSnapshot newRange;

			public bool Changed
			{
				get
				{
					if (newRange != null && oldRange != null)
					{
						return !newRange.IsSame(oldRange);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public EventFiring(RangeDataBase range)
			{
				this.range = range;
			}

			private void Clear()
			{
				oldRange = null;
				newRange = null;
			}

			public void RunEvent()
			{
				if (Changed)
				{
					if (!range.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
					{
						range.Axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: true);
					}
					range.RaiseRangeChanged(oldRange, newRange);
					oldRange = newRange;
				}
			}

			public void CacheOldValues()
			{
				if (oldRange == null)
				{
					Clear();
					oldRange = new RangeSnapshot(range);
				}
			}

			public void CacheNewValues()
			{
				if (oldRange != null)
				{
					newRange = new RangeSnapshot(range);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly AxisBase axis;

		private readonly EventFiring eventFiring;

		private SideMarginSizeUnitNative sideMarginSizeUnit;

		private SideMarginMode autoSideMarginsValue = SideMarginMode.Enable;

		private bool alwaysShowZeroLevel = true;

		private object min;

		private object max;

		private double minInternal = double.NaN;

		private double maxInternal = double.NaN;

		private double minRefined = double.NaN;

		private double maxRefined = double.NaN;

		private MinMaxValues sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(0.0);

		private double actualStartSideMargin;

		private double actualEndSideMargin;

		private bool autoMin = true;

		private bool autoMax = true;

		private RangeCorrectionMode correctionModeValue;

		protected RangeCorrectionMode CorrectionModeValue
		{
			set
			{
				correctionModeValue = value;
			}
		}

		internal double StartSideMarginInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return actualStartSideMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				actualStartSideMargin = value;
			}
		}

		internal double EndSideMarginInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return actualEndSideMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				actualEndSideMargin = value;
			}
		}

		public AxisBase Axis => axis;

		public MinMaxValues SideMargins
		{
			get
			{
				return sideMargins;
			}
			set
			{
				sideMargins = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual double ActualStartSideMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return actualStartSideMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualStartSideMargin != value || SideMarginSizeUnit == SideMarginSizeUnitNative.AxisRangePercentage)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					actualStartSideMargin = value;
					autoSideMarginsValue = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
				else if (value == 0.0)
				{
					AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double ActualEndSideMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return actualEndSideMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualEndSideMargin != value || SideMarginSizeUnit == SideMarginSizeUnitNative.AxisRangePercentage)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					actualEndSideMargin = value;
					autoSideMarginsValue = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
				else if (value == 0.0)
				{
					AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual SideMarginMode AutoSideMargins
		{
			get
			{
				return autoSideMarginsValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != autoSideMarginsValue)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					autoSideMarginsValue = value;
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual object MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				return min;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMinValue(value);
				if (CheckNewValue(value, min))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Min = 0.0;
					autoMin = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
					min = value;
					minInternal = double.NaN;
					minRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(min);
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual object MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				return max;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMaxValue(value);
				if (CheckNewValue(value, max))
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Max = 0.0;
					autoMax = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
					max = value;
					maxInternal = double.NaN;
					maxRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(max);
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double MinValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return minInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (maxInternal != value && (!double.IsNaN(value) || !double.IsNaN(maxInternal)))
				{
					CheckMinValueInternal(value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Min = 0.0;
					autoMin = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
					min = null;
					minInternal = value;
					minRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(minInternal);
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double MaxValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return maxInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (maxInternal != value && (!double.IsNaN(value) || !double.IsNaN(maxInternal)))
				{
					CheckMaxValueInternal(value);
					RaiseControlChanging();
					eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Max = 0.0;
					autoMax = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
					max = null;
					maxInternal = value;
					maxRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(maxInternal);
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AutoMin

			set

					RaiseControlChanging();

					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AutoMax
		{
			get

				}
			}
		}

		public RangeCorrectionMode CorrectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return correctionModeValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (correctionModeValue != value)

					if (value == RangeCorrectionMode.Values)
					{
						ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
					}
					RaiseControlChanging();
					eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
					correctionModeValue = value;
					autoMin = value == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
					autoMax = value == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
					RaiseControlChanged();
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AlwaysShowZeroLevel

		public RangeDataBase(AxisBase axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			eventFiring = new EventFiring(this);
		}

		void IAxisRangeData.Reset(bool needUpdate, bool resetMin, bool resetMax)
		{
			Reset(needUpdate, resetMin, resetMax);
		}

		bool IAxisRangeData.Contains(double value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}

		void IAxisRangeData.UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			UpdateRange(min, max, internalMin, internalMax);
		}

		void IAxisRangeData.ApplyState(RangeSnapshot rangeSnapshot)
		{
			minInternal = rangeSnapshot.Min;
			maxInternal = rangeSnapshot.Max;
			min = rangeSnapshot.MinValue;
			max = rangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
		}

		double IMinMaxValues.CalculateCenter()
		{
			return MinMaxValues.CalculateCenter(this);
		}

		void IMinMaxValues.Intersection(IMinMaxValues minMaxValues)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = MinMaxValues.Intersection(this, minMaxValues);
			maxInternal = minMaxValues2.Max;
			minInternal = minMaxValues2.Min;
		}

		private bool Contains(double value)
		{
			if (MinValueInternal <= value)
			{
				return value <= MaxValueInternal;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckNewValue(object nValue, object oValue)
		{
			if (nValue == null && oValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((nValue == null) ^ (oValue == null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			Type type = nValue.GetType();
			Type type2 = oValue.GetType();
			if (type != type2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (oValue is double)
			{
				return (double)oValue != (double)nValue;
			}
			if (oValue is float)
			{
				return (float)oValue != (float)nValue;
			}
			if (oValue is int)
			{
				return (int)oValue != (int)nValue;
			}
			if (oValue is string)
			{
				return (string)oValue != (string)nValue;
			}
			if (oValue is decimal)
			{
				return (decimal)oValue != (decimal)nValue;
			}
			return oValue != nValue;
		}

		private void CheckMinValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMinValue));
			}
		}

		private void CheckMaxValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMaxValue));
			}
		}

		private void CheckMinValueInternal(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMinValueInternal));
			}
		}

		private void CheckMaxValueInternal(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRangeMaxValueInternal));
			}
		}

		private void CheckRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)axis).AxisScaleTypeMap;
			if (min != null && max != null && (!(axisScaleTypeMap is IIntervalScaleMap) || (!min.Equals(string.Empty) && !max.Equals(string.Empty))) && axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(min) > axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(max))
			{
				GenerateAxisRangeException();
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(internalMin) && !double.IsNaN(internalMax) && internalMin > internalMax)
			{
				GenerateAxisRangeException();
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAxisRangeException()
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAxisRange));
		}

		private void UpdateMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (!axis.IsValuesAxis)
			{
				axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: true);
				axis.UpdateIntervalsWithPropertyChange();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			minInternal = internalMin;
			maxInternal = internalMax;
			eventFiring.CacheNewValues();
		}

		private void Assign(AxisRangeData axisRange)
		{
			if (axisRange == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!axisRange.Auto)
			{
				min = axisRange.MinValue;
				max = axisRange.MaxValue;
				if (axis.ScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					minInternal = axisRange.MinValueInternal + ((AxisDateTimeMap)axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
					maxInternal = axisRange.MaxValueInternal + ((AxisDateTimeMap)axis.ScaleTypeMap).Min;
				}
				else
				{
					minInternal = axisRange.MinValueInternal;
					maxInternal = axisRange.MaxValueInternal;
				}
			}
			autoSideMarginsValue = ((!axisRange.SideMarginsEnabled) ? SideMarginMode.Disable : SideMarginMode.Enable);
		}

		private void Assign(RangeDataBase axisRange)
		{
			if (axisRange != null)
			{
				correctionModeValue = axisRange.correctionModeValue;
				min = axisRange.min;
				max = axisRange.max;
				minInternal = axisRange.minInternal;
				maxInternal = axisRange.maxInternal;
				minRefined = axisRange.minRefined;
				maxRefined = axisRange.maxRefined;
				autoSideMarginsValue = axisRange.autoSideMarginsValue;
				alwaysShowZeroLevel = axisRange.alwaysShowZeroLevel;
				autoMax = axisRange.autoMax;
				autoMin = axisRange.autoMin;
				sideMargins = axisRange.sideMargins;
				actualEndSideMargin = axisRange.actualEndSideMargin;
				actualStartSideMargin = axisRange.actualStartSideMargin;
				sideMarginSizeUnit = axisRange.sideMarginSizeUnit;
			}
		}

		internal abstract void RaiseRangeChanged(RangeSnapshot oldRange, RangeSnapshot newRange);

		internal abstract Deserializer GetDeserializer();

		public void RaiseChangedEventIfNecessary()
		{
			eventFiring.RunEvent();
		}

		public virtual void Reset(bool needUpdate, bool resetMin, bool resetMax)
		{
			if (needUpdate)
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
			}
			if (resetMax)
			{
				autoMax = true;
			}
			if (resetMin)
			{
				autoMin = true;
			}
			if (resetMin && resetMax)
			{
				correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			}
			if (needUpdate)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "AutoRange"));
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax, bool needUpdate, bool isRangeControl = false)
		{
			autoMin = false;
			autoMax = false;
			if (min != null || max != null)
			{
				CheckMinValue(min);
				CheckMaxValue(max);
				correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(internalMin) || !double.IsNaN(internalMax))
			{
				CheckMinValueInternal(internalMin);
				CheckMaxValueInternal(internalMax);
				correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
			}
			CheckRange(min, max, internalMin, internalMax);
			if (needUpdate)
			{
				RaiseControlChanging();
			}
			eventFiring.CacheOldValues();
			sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(0.0);
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			minInternal = internalMin;
			maxInternal = internalMax;
			minRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(min);
			maxRefined = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(max);
			if (needUpdate)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged();
			}
			eventFiring.CacheNewValues();
			axis.IsUpdating = true;
			RangeChangedUpdateInfo changeInfo = new RangeChangedUpdateInfo(this, !axis.IsValuesAxis);
			RaiseControlChanged(changeInfo, ChartElementChange.UpdateIndicators);
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			if (obj is RangeDataBase axisRange)
			{
				Assign(axisRange);
			}
			else if (obj is AxisRangeData axisRange2)
			{
				Assign(axisRange2);
			}
		}
	}
