	public class XYDiagram2DScrollParameters
	{
		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		private readonly NavigationType navigationType;

		private readonly ScrollingOrientation orientation;

		private readonly double relativePosition;

		private readonly int range;

		public XYDiagramPaneBase Pane => pane;

		public NavigationType NavigationType => navigationType;

		public ScrollingOrientation Orientation => orientation;

		public double RelativePosition => relativePosition;

		public int Range => range;

		public XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, NavigationType navigationType, ScrollingOrientation orientation, double relativePosition, int range)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.navigationType = navigationType;
			this.orientation = orientation;
			this.relativePosition = relativePosition;
			this.range = range;
		}

		public XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, NavigationType navigationType, ScrollingOrientation orientation)
			: this(pane, navigationType, orientation, 0.0, 0)
		{
		}

		public bool AreSame(XYDiagram2DScrollParameters parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (navigationType == parameters.navigationType && orientation == parameters.orientation)
			{
				return pane == parameters.pane;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarInteriorViewData
	{
		private Color color;

		private DiagramPoint centerPoint1;

		private DiagramPoint centerPoint2;

		private DiagramPoint nearPoint1;

		private DiagramPoint nearPoint2;

		private DiagramPoint farPoint1;

		private DiagramPoint farPoint2;

		public static ScrollBarInteriorViewData CreateInstance(AxisMapping axisMapping, Color color, int centerX, int centerY)
		{
			ScrollBarInteriorViewData scrollBarInteriorViewData = new ScrollBarInteriorViewData();
			int normalOffset = centerY - 1;
			int normalOffset2 = centerY + 1;
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.color = color;
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.centerPoint1 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, centerX, normalOffset);
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.centerPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, centerX, normalOffset2);
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.nearPoint1 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, centerX - 2, normalOffset);
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.nearPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, centerX - 2, normalOffset2);
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.farPoint1 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, centerX + 2, normalOffset);
			scrollBarInteriorViewData.farPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, centerX + 2, normalOffset2);
			return scrollBarInteriorViewData;
		}

		private ScrollBarInteriorViewData()
		{
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)centerPoint1, (Point)centerPoint2, color, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)nearPoint1, (Point)nearPoint2, color, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)farPoint1, (Point)farPoint2, color, 1);
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarArrowViewData
	{
		private Color color;

		private DiagramPoint centerPoint;

		private DiagramPoint centerPoint1;

		private DiagramPoint nearPoint;

		private DiagramPoint nearPoint1;

		private DiagramPoint farPoint;

		private DiagramPoint farPoint1;

		public static ScrollBarArrowViewData CreateInstance(AxisMapping axisMapping, Color color, int x, int y, bool rightArrow)
		{
			ScrollBarArrowViewData scrollBarArrowViewData = new ScrollBarArrowViewData();
			int num;
			int num2;
			if (rightArrow)
			{
				num = x - 2;
				num2 = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				num = x + 2;
				num2 = 1;
			}
			scrollBarArrowViewData.color = color;
			scrollBarArrowViewData.centerPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, x, y);
			scrollBarArrowViewData.nearPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num, y - 2);
			scrollBarArrowViewData.farPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num, y + 2);
			scrollBarArrowViewData.centerPoint1 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, x + num2, y);
			scrollBarArrowViewData.nearPoint1 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num + num2, y - 2);
			scrollBarArrowViewData.farPoint1 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num + num2, y + 2);
			return scrollBarArrowViewData;
		}

		private ScrollBarArrowViewData()
		{
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)nearPoint, (Point)centerPoint, color, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)centerPoint, (Point)farPoint, color, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)nearPoint1, (Point)centerPoint1, color, 1);
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)centerPoint1, (Point)farPoint1, color, 1);
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarAnnotationViewData
	{
		private readonly Color color;

		private readonly RectangleF bounds;

		public Color Color => color;

		public RectangleF Bounds => bounds;

		public ScrollBarAnnotationViewData(RectangleF bounds, Color color)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.color = color;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, color);
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarViewData
	{
		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		private readonly ScrollBarAlignment alignment;

		private readonly ScrollBarOptions scrollBarOptions;

		private readonly ScrollBarAnnotationOptions annotationOptions;

		private readonly List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData> frontAnnotationViewDataList = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData>();

		private readonly List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData> backAnnotationViewDataList = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData>();

		private int scrollRange;

		private int annotationsOffset;

		private double relativeScrollPosition;

		private AxisMapping annotationsMapping;

		private Color backColor;

		private Color barColor;

		private Color borderColor;

		private RectangleF rect;

		private RectangleF nearAxisRect;

		private RectangleF farAxisRect;

		private RectangleF minValueAxisRect;

		private RectangleF maxValueAxisRect;

		private RectangleF barRect;

		private RectangleF minDecrementRect;

		private RectangleF maxDecrementRect;

		private RectangleF minIncrementRect;

		private RectangleF maxIncrementRect;

		private ScrollBarArrowViewData leftArrowViewData;

		private ScrollBarArrowViewData rightArrowViewData;

		private ScrollBarInteriorViewData barInteriorViewData;

		private bool Calculated
		{
			get
			{
				if (!farAxisRect.IsEmpty && !minValueAxisRect.IsEmpty && !maxValueAxisRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return !barRect.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public RectangleF Bounds => rect;

		public List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData> FrontAnnotationViewDataList => frontAnnotationViewDataList;

		public List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData> BackAnnotationViewDataList => backAnnotationViewDataList;

		private static void AddVisibleScrollBarAnnotations(List<IScrollBarAnnotation> list, ChartElementNamedCollection annotations)
		{
			foreach (IScrollBarAnnotation annotation in annotations)
			{
				if (annotation.Visible)
				{
					list.Add(annotation);
				}
			}
		}

		private static double MapToVisualRange(Axis2D axis, double value)
		{
			double num = (value - axis.WholeRange.MinValueInternal) / (axis.WholeRange.MaxValueInternal - axis.WholeRange.MinValueInternal);
			return axis.VisualRange.MinValueInternal + num * (axis.VisualRange.MaxValueInternal - axis.VisualRange.MinValueInternal);
		}

		private static int ApplyOffsetAlignment(ScrollBarAlignment alignment, int offset)
		{
			if (alignment != ScrollBarAlignment.Near)
			{
				return offset;
			}
			return -offset;
		}

		public ScrollBarViewData(Axis2D axis, XYDiagramPaneBase pane, Rectangle bounds, ScrollBarOptions scrollBarOptions)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.pane = pane;
			this.scrollBarOptions = scrollBarOptions;
			alignment = (axis.IsValuesAxis ? scrollBarOptions.YAxisScrollBarAlignment : scrollBarOptions.XAxisScrollBarAlignment);
			annotationOptions = (axis.IsValuesAxis ? scrollBarOptions.YAxisAnnotationOptions : scrollBarOptions.XAxisAnnotationOptions);
			Calculate(bounds);
		}

		private void Calculate(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			AxisAlignment axisAlignment = ((alignment != ScrollBarAlignment.Near) ? AxisAlignment.Far : AxisAlignment.Near);
			AxisMapping axisMapping = new AxisMapping(bounds, axis, axisAlignment);
			backColor = scrollBarOptions.ActualBackColor;
			barColor = scrollBarOptions.ActualBarColor;
			borderColor = scrollBarOptions.ActualBorderColor;
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, 0);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, 0);
			nearAxisRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)screenPoint, (PointF)screenPoint2, 1f);
			int num = scrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness + 3;
			int normalOffset = ApplyOffsetAlignment(alignment, num);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint3 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, normalOffset);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint4 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, normalOffset);
			farAxisRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)screenPoint3, (PointF)screenPoint4, 1f);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint5 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, normalOffset);
			minValueAxisRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)screenPoint, (PointF)screenPoint5, 1f);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint6 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, 0);
			maxValueAxisRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)screenPoint6, (PointF)screenPoint4, 1f);
			rect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)screenPoint, (PointF)screenPoint4, 1f);
			CalculateBar(axisMapping);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint7 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num, 0);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint8 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, -num, normalOffset);
			Rectangle mappingBounds = MathUtils.MakeRoundedRectangle(screenPoint7, screenPoint8);
			annotationsMapping = new AxisMapping(mappingBounds, axis, axisAlignment);
			annotationsOffset = normalOffset;
			IList<IScrollBarAnnotation> annotations = GetAnnotations();
			AddAnnotations(annotations);
		}

		private void CalculateBar(AxisMapping axisMapping)
		{
			int num = scrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness + 2;
			int num2 = axisMapping.Length - num * 2;
			if (num2 >= scrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness)
			{
				relativeScrollPosition = PaneAxesManager.GetScrollBarPosition(axis);
				int num3 = ApplyOffsetAlignment(alignment, 2);
				int num4 = num3 + ApplyOffsetAlignment(alignment, scrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness - 1);
				DiagramPoint screenPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, num3);
				DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num, num4);
				minDecrementRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2, 1.0);
				int num5 = axisMapping.Length - num - 1;
				screenPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num5, num3);
				screenPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num5 + num, num4);
				minIncrementRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2, 1.0);
				int num6 = (int)Math.Floor(PaneAxesManager.GetScrollBarRelativeSize(axis) * (double)num2);
				if (num6 < scrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness)
				{
					num6 = scrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness;
				}
				if (num6 % 2 == 0)
				{
					num6++;
				}
				scrollRange = num2 - num6;
				int num7 = num6 / 2;
				int num8 = num + num7;
				int num9 = Convert.ToInt32(relativeScrollPosition * (double)scrollRange);
				int num10 = num9 - num7;
				int num11 = num9 + num7;
				num10 += num8;
				num11 += num8;
				if (num10 > num)
				{
					screenPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num, num3);
					screenPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num10, num4);
					maxDecrementRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2, 1.0);
				}
				else
				{
					maxDecrementRect = RectangleF.Empty;
				}
				if (num11 < num5)
				{
					screenPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num11, num3);
					screenPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num5, num4);
					maxIncrementRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2, 1.0);
				}
				else
				{
					maxIncrementRect = RectangleF.Empty;
				}
				screenPoint = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num10, num3);
				screenPoint2 = axisMapping.GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, num11, num4);
				barRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2, 1.0);
				int num12 = (num3 + num4) / 2;
				leftArrowViewData = ScrollBarArrowViewData.CreateInstance(axisMapping, borderColor, num / 2 - 1, num12, rightArrow: false);
				rightArrowViewData = ScrollBarArrowViewData.CreateInstance(axisMapping, borderColor, axisMapping.Length - num / 2 + 1, num12, rightArrow: true);
				if (num6 >= 9)
				{
					barInteriorViewData = ScrollBarInteriorViewData.CreateInstance(axisMapping, backColor, (num10 + num11) / 2, num12);
				}
				if (axis.ActualReverse)
				{
					relativeScrollPosition = 1.0 - relativeScrollPosition;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderAnnotations(ChartRenderer renderer, List<ScrollBarAnnotationViewData> annotationViewDataList)
		{
			if (annotationViewDataList.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ScrollBarAnnotationViewData annotationViewData in annotationViewDataList)
			{
				annotationViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private IList<IScrollBarAnnotation> GetAnnotations()
		{
			List<IScrollBarAnnotation> list = new List<IScrollBarAnnotation>();
			if (annotationOptions.ShowStrips)
			{
				AddVisibleScrollBarAnnotations(list, axis.Strips);
			}
			if (annotationOptions.ShowCustomLabels)
			{
				AddVisibleScrollBarAnnotations(list, axis.CustomLabels);
			}
			if (annotationOptions.ShowConstantLines)
			{
				AddVisibleScrollBarAnnotations(list, axis.ConstantLines);
			}
			AnnotationCollection annotations = pane.Annotations;
			foreach (Annotation item in annotations)
			{
				if (annotationOptions.ShowPaneAnnotations && item.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint)
				{
					PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint = (PaneAnchorPoint)item.AnchorPoint;
					IScrollBarAnnotation scrollBarAnnotation = paneAnchorPoint.GetScrollBarAnnotation(pane, axis);
					if (scrollBarAnnotation != null)
					{
						list.Add(scrollBarAnnotation);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void AddAnnotations(IList<IScrollBarAnnotation> annotations)
		{
			foreach (IScrollBarAnnotation annotation in annotations)
			{
				int normalOffset = -MathUtils.StrongRound((1.0 - annotation.WidthStart) * (double)annotationsOffset);
				int normalOffset2 = -MathUtils.StrongRound((1.0 - annotation.WidthEnd) * (double)annotationsOffset);
				double num = MapToVisualRange(axis, annotation.AxisValueStart);
				double num2;
				double value;
				if (annotation.AxisValueEnd != annotation.AxisValueStart)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					value = MapToVisualRange(axis, annotation.AxisValueEnd);
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = Math.Max(0.5, 0.5 * (double)annotation.FixedSize);
					value = num;
				}
				DiagramPoint screenPoint = annotationsMapping.GetScreenPoint(num, ApplyOffsetAlignment(alignment, (int)Math.Ceiling(num2)), normalOffset);
				DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = annotationsMapping.GetScreenPoint(value, ApplyOffsetAlignment(alignment, -(int)Math.Floor(num2)), normalOffset2);
				ScrollBarAnnotationViewData item = new ScrollBarAnnotationViewData(MathUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2), annotation.Color);
				if (annotation.InFrontOfScrollbar)
				{
					frontAnnotationViewDataList.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					backAnnotationViewDataList.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (Calculated)
			{
				correction.Update(MathUtils.StrongRound(rect));
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (Calculated)
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = axis.XYDiagram2D;
				Chart chart = xYDiagram2D.Chart;
				HitTestController hitTestController = chart.HitTestController;
				ScrollingOrientation orientation = ((!axis.IsValuesAxis) ? ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll : ScrollingOrientation.AxisYScroll);
				if (maxDecrementRect != RectangleF.Empty)
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, chart, new XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(pane, NavigationType.LargeDecrement, orientation), new HitRegion(maxDecrementRect), force: true);
				}
				if (maxIncrementRect != RectangleF.Empty)
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, chart, new XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(pane, NavigationType.LargeIncrement, orientation), new HitRegion(maxIncrementRect), force: true);
				}
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, chart, new XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(pane, NavigationType.SmallDecrement, orientation), new HitRegion(minDecrementRect), force: true);
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, chart, new XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(pane, NavigationType.SmallIncrement, orientation), new HitRegion(minIncrementRect), force: true);
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, chart, new XYDiagram2DScrollParameters(pane, NavigationType.ThumbPosition, orientation, relativeScrollPosition, scrollRange), new HitRegion(barRect), force: true);
				renderer.FillRectangle(rect, backColor);
				RenderAnnotations(renderer, backAnnotationViewDataList);
				renderer.FillRectangle(barRect, barColor);
				RenderAnnotations(renderer, frontAnnotationViewDataList);
				renderer.FillRectangle(nearAxisRect, borderColor);
				renderer.FillRectangle(farAxisRect, borderColor);
				renderer.FillRectangle(minValueAxisRect, borderColor);
				renderer.FillRectangle(maxValueAxisRect, borderColor);
				leftArrowViewData.Render(renderer);
				rightArrowViewData.Render(renderer);
				if (barInteriorViewData != null)
				{
					barInteriorViewData.Render(renderer);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class VisibleInPanesBehavior : AxisVisibilityInPanes
	{
		private readonly HashSet<int> visibleIds = new HashSet<int>();

		private IList<int> deserializedPaneIds;

		private IList<int> assignedPaneIdsForHide;

		private Axis2D Axis2D => (Axis2D)base.Axis;

		private IList<int> VisibleInPanesIds
		{
			get
			{
				if (deserializedPaneIds != null)
				{
					return deserializedPaneIds;
				}
				return visibleIds.ToList();
			}
		}

		public string VisibleInPanesSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				IList<int> visibleInPanesIds = VisibleInPanesIds;
				int count = visibleInPanesIds.Count;
				string[] array = new string[count];
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = visibleInPanesIds[i].ToString();
				}
				return SerializingUtils.StringArrayToString(array);
			}
			set
			{
				string[] array = SerializingUtils.StringToStringArray(value, "-1");
				List<int> list = new List<int>(array.Length);
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string value2 in array2)
				{
					list.Add(Convert.ToInt32(value2));
				}
				deserializedPaneIds = list;
			}
		}

		public VisibleInPanesBehavior(Axis2D axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		public void Assign(VisibleInPanesBehavior behavior)
		{
			deserializedPaneIds = behavior.deserializedPaneIds;
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = Axis2D.XYDiagram2D;
			if (xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				base.Visibility.Clear();
				base.PanesForHide.Clear();
				visibleIds.Clear();
				{
					foreach (IPane item in behavior.PanesForHide)
					{
						int actualPaneID = ((XYDiagramPaneBase)item).ActualPaneID;
						base.PanesForHide.Add(xYDiagram2D.GetPaneByID(actualPaneID));
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			assignedPaneIdsForHide = new List<int>();
			foreach (IPane item2 in behavior.PanesForHide)
			{
				assignedPaneIdsForHide.Add(((XYDiagramPaneBase)item2).ActualPaneID);
			}
		}

		public void ApplyAssignedPaneIds()
		{
			if (assignedPaneIdsForHide == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = Axis2D.XYDiagram2D;
			if (xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				foreach (int item in assignedPaneIdsForHide)
				{
					base.PanesForHide.Add(xYDiagram2D.GetPaneByID(item));
				}
			}
			assignedPaneIdsForHide = null;
		}

		public void SetVisibilityInPane(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, bool visible)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pane");
			}
			if (Axis2D.XYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				Axis2D.RaiseControlChanging();
				SetVisibilityInPaneCore(pane, visible);
				if (visible)
				{
					visibleIds.Add(pane.ActualPaneID);
				}
				else
				{
					visibleIds.Remove(pane.ActualPaneID);
				}
				Axis2D.RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public override bool GetVisibilityInPane(IPane pane)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pane");
			}
			return base.GetVisibilityInPane(pane);
		}

		public override void UpdateVisibilityInPanes(IList<IPane> newPanes)
		{
			base.UpdateVisibilityInPanes(newPanes);
			if (deserializedPaneIds != null)
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = Axis2D.XYDiagram2D;
				if (xYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					Reset(visible: false);
					foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase newPane in newPanes)
					{
						SetVisibilityInPaneCore(newPane, deserializedPaneIds.Contains(newPane.ActualPaneID));
					}
					deserializedPaneIds = null;
				}
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase newPane2 in newPanes)
			{
				if (!base.PanesForHide.Contains(newPane2))
				{
					visibleIds.Add(newPane2.ActualPaneID);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelsResolveOverlappingHelper
	{
		public static void Process(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, AxisBase axis)
		{
			AxisLabelOverlappingResolver axisLabelOverlappingResolver = CreateOverlappingResolver(labels, axis, outsideLabels: true, AxisAlignment.Near);
			axisLabelOverlappingResolver.Process();
		}

		public static AxisLabelOverlappingResolver CreateOverlappingResolver(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, AxisBase axis, bool outsideLabels, AxisAlignment alignment, GRealRect2D paneBounds = default(GRealRect2D))
		{
			bool isRadar = axis is RadarAxis;
			bool mirrored = (alignment == AxisAlignment.Far && outsideLabels) || (alignment != AxisAlignment.Far && !outsideLabels);
			return new AxisLabelOverlappingResolver(labels, axis, isRadar, mirrored, useBoundsRound: true, paneBounds);
		}
	}
	public class AxisValueContainer
	{
		private object value;

		private object userValue;

		private string valueSerializable;

		private double valueInternal;

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (value == null || !(value is string) || !(userValue is string))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return userValue;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
				userValue = value;
			}
		}

		public string ValueSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return valueSerializable;
			}
			set
			{
				valueSerializable = value;
			}
		}

		public double ValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return valueInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				valueInternal = value;
			}
		}

		public CultureInfo Culture
		{
			get
			{
				if (valueSerializable == null || !valueSerializable.Equals(value))
				{
					return CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				return CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			}
		}

		public object UserValue => userValue;

		public AxisValueContainer(object defaultValue, double defaultValueInternal)
			: this(defaultValueInternal)
		{
			Value = defaultValue;
		}

		public AxisValueContainer(double defaultValueInternal)
		{
			valueInternal = defaultValueInternal;
		}

		public void SetValue(object value)
		{
			if (value != this.value)
			{
				this.value = value;
				valueSerializable = null;
			}
		}

		public void Assign(AxisValueContainer valueContainer)
		{
			value = valueContainer.value;
			userValue = valueContainer.userValue;
			valueInternal = valueContainer.valueInternal;
			valueSerializable = null;
		}
	}
	public class ConstantLineNavigation
	{
		private Chart chart;

		private ConstantLine selectedConstantLine;

		private bool dragging;

		public ConstantLineNavigation(Chart chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		internal bool MoveConstantLine(ConstantLine constantLine, AxisValue newAxisValue)
		{
			if (newAxisValue == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			object axisValue = constantLine.AxisValue;
			constantLine.AxisValue = newAxisValue.ActualValue;
			ConstantLineMovedEventArgs e = new ConstantLineMovedEventArgs(constantLine, axisValue);
			chart.ContainerAdapter.InteractionProvider?.OnConstantLineMoved(e);
			return true;
		}

		public bool PerformDragging(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			if (constantLine == null || !constantLine.RuntimeMoving)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x < 0 || y < 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			dragging = true;
			Point p = new Point(x + dx, y + dy);
			DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates;
			if (chart.Diagram is XYDiagram xYDiagram)
			{
				diagramCoordinates = xYDiagram.PointToDiagram(p);
			}
			else
			{
				SwiftPlotDiagram swiftPlotDiagram = chart.Diagram as SwiftPlotDiagram;
				diagramCoordinates = swiftPlotDiagram.PointToDiagram(p);
			}
			AxisValue axisValue = diagramCoordinates.GetAxisValue(constantLine.Axis);
			return MoveConstantLine(constantLine, axisValue);
		}

		public void ResetSelection(IChartContainer container)
		{
			if (selectedConstantLine != null)
			{
				selectedConstantLine.RuntimeOperationSelect = false;
			}
			selectedConstantLine = null;
			if (container.RenderProvider != null)
			{
				container.RenderProvider.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public void Select(object focusedElement, IChartContainer container)
		{
			ResetSelection(container);
			if (dragging)
			{
				dragging = false;
				return;
			}
			if (focusedElement is ConstantLine constantLine)
			{
				selectedConstantLine = constantLine;
				constantLine.RuntimeOperationSelect = true;
			}
			if (container.RenderProvider != null)
			{
				container.RenderProvider.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveSelectedConstantLine()
		{
			if (selectedConstantLine != null && selectedConstantLine.RuntimeDeletion)
			{
				selectedConstantLine.Axis.ConstantLines.Remove(selectedConstantLine);
				selectedConstantLine = null;
			}
		}
	}
