	public class AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository
	{
		private readonly IXYDiagramPane pane;

		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		private readonly Dictionary<IAxisData, List<AxisIntervalLayout>> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, List<AxisIntervalLayout>>();

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => mappingBounds;

		public AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository(IXYDiagramPane pane, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
		}

		public List<AxisIntervalLayout> GetIntervalsLayout(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (dictionary.ContainsKey(axis))
			{
				return dictionary[axis];
			}
			List<AxisIntervalLayout> list = AxisIntervalLayout.CreateIntervalsLayout(axis, axis.IsVertical ? mappingBounds.Height : mappingBounds.Width);
			axis.IntervalBoundsCache.SetAxisIntervalLayout(pane, list);
			dictionary.Add(axis, list);
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class Axis3DViewData
	{
		private readonly IList<PlanePolygon> interlacedPolygons;

		private readonly IList<Line> gridLines;

		private readonly AxisLabel3DViewData labelViewData;

		internal AxisLabel3DViewData LabelViewData => labelViewData;

		public IList<PlanePolygon> InterlacedPolygons => interlacedPolygons;

		public IList<Line> GridLines => gridLines;

		private static List<PlanePolygon> CreateAndFillInterlacedPolygons(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData, Box filterBox, Box foreOrBackBox, ZPlaneRectangle area, double depth, double planeDepth)
		{
			Box left = diagramViewData.Left;
			Box right = diagramViewData.Right;
			Box bottom = diagramViewData.Bottom;
			RectangleFillStyle3D actualInterlacedFillStyle = axis.ActualInterlacedFillStyle;
			Color actualInterlacedColor = axis.ActualInterlacedColor;
			int weight = (axis.IsVertical ? 5 : 6);
			ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(foreOrBackBox.Location, foreOrBackBox.Fore.Width, foreOrBackBox.Fore.Height);
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			List<PlaneQuadrangle> list2 = filterBox.FilterPlanes(foreOrBackBox);
			PlanePolygon[] rects = list2.ToArray();
			list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(rects, gradientRect, actualInterlacedFillStyle, actualInterlacedColor, weight));
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				if (right == null)
				{
					Box box = new Box(area.Location, 0.0 - planeDepth, area.Height, depth);
					list2 = left.FilterPlanes(box);
					rects = list2.ToArray();
					list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(rects, gradientRect, actualInterlacedFillStyle, actualInterlacedColor, weight));
				}
				else
				{
					Box box2 = new Box(DiagramPoint.Offset(area.Location, area.Width, 0.0, 0.0), planeDepth, area.Height, depth);
					list2 = right.FilterPlanes(box2);
					rects = list2.ToArray();
					list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(rects, gradientRect, actualInterlacedFillStyle, actualInterlacedColor, weight));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Box box3 = new Box(area.Location, area.Width, 0.0 - planeDepth, depth);
				list2 = bottom.FilterPlanes(box3);
				rects = list2.ToArray();
				list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(rects, gradientRect, actualInterlacedFillStyle, actualInterlacedColor, weight));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IList<PlanePolygon> CreateInterlacedPolygons(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData, IList<InterlacedData> interlacedData)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			if (!axis.Interlaced)
			{
				return list;
			}
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = diagramViewData.CoordsCalculator;
			double min = axis.VisualRangeData.Min;
			double max = axis.VisualRangeData.Max;
			Axis3DMapping axis3DMapping = new Axis3DMapping(coordsCalculator, axis);
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list2 = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>(interlacedData.Count);
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in interlacedData)
			{
				ZPlaneRectangle item = new ZPlaneRectangle(axis3DMapping.GetNearDiagramPoint((interlacedDatum.Near < min) ? double.NegativeInfinity : interlacedDatum.Near, 0, 0), axis3DMapping.GetFarDiagramPoint((interlacedDatum.Far > max) ? double.PositiveInfinity : interlacedDatum.Far, 0, 0));
				list2.Add(item);
			}
			double depth = coordsCalculator.Depth;
			double planeDepth = coordsCalculator.PlaneDepth;
			Box back = diagramViewData.Back;
			Box fore = diagramViewData.Fore;
			if (back == null)
			{
				foreach (ZPlaneRectangle item2 in list2)
				{
					Box foreOrBackBox = new Box((ZPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(item2, 0.0, 0.0, depth), planeDepth);
					list.AddRange(CreateAndFillInterlacedPolygons(axis, diagramViewData, fore, foreOrBackBox, item2, depth, planeDepth));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ZPlaneRectangle item3 in list2)
				{
					Box foreOrBackBox2 = new Box(item3, 0.0 - planeDepth);
					list.AddRange(CreateAndFillInterlacedPolygons(axis, diagramViewData, back, foreOrBackBox2, item3, depth, planeDepth));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IList<Line> CreateHorizontalGridLines(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData, List<double> values)
		{
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = diagramViewData.CoordsCalculator;
			double depth = coordsCalculator.Depth;
			double planeDepth = coordsCalculator.PlaneDepth;
			double dz = depth + planeDepth;
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = axis.GetDiagramPoint(coordsCalculator, value, double.NegativeInfinity);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = axis.GetDiagramPoint(coordsCalculator, value, double.PositiveInfinity);
				if (diagramViewData.Back == null)
				{
					list.AddRange(new XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0, 0.0, depth), DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint2, 0.0, 0.0, dz)).GetPerimeter());
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(new XPlaneRectangle(diagramPoint, DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint2, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - planeDepth)).GetPerimeter());
				}
				list.AddRange(new XPlaneRectangle(diagramPoint, DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0, 0.0 - planeDepth, depth)).GetPerimeter());
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IList<Line> CreateVerticalGridLines(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData, List<double> values)
		{
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = diagramViewData.CoordsCalculator;
			double depth = coordsCalculator.Depth;
			double planeDepth = coordsCalculator.PlaneDepth;
			double dz = depth + planeDepth;
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = axis.GetDiagramPoint(coordsCalculator, value, double.NegativeInfinity);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = axis.GetDiagramPoint(coordsCalculator, value, double.PositiveInfinity);
				if (diagramViewData.Back == null)
				{
					list.AddRange(new YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0, 0.0, depth), DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint2, 0.0, 0.0, dz)).GetPerimeter());
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(new YPlaneRectangle(diagramPoint, DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint2, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - planeDepth)).GetPerimeter());
				}
				if (diagramViewData.Right == null)
				{
					list.AddRange(new YPlaneRectangle(diagramPoint, DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0 - planeDepth, 0.0, depth)).GetPerimeter());
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(new YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint2, planeDepth, 0.0, depth), diagramPoint2).GetPerimeter());
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IList<Line> CreateGridLines(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData, List<double> values, Color color, LineStyle lineStyle, int weight)
		{
			IList<Line> list = (axis.IsVertical ? CreateVerticalGridLines(axis, diagramViewData, values) : CreateHorizontalGridLines(axis, diagramViewData, values));
			foreach (Line item in list)
			{
				lineStyle.SetLineStyle(item);
				item.Color = color;
				item.Weight = weight;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IList<Line> CreateGridLines(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData, AxisGridData gridData)
		{
			GridLines gridLines = axis.GridLines;
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			XYDiagram3DAppearance xYDiagram3DAppearance = CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(axis).XYDiagram3DAppearance;
			if (gridLines.Visible)
			{
				IList<Line> collection = CreateGridLines(axis, diagramViewData, gridData.Items.VisibleGridLineValues, gridLines.GetActualColor(xYDiagram3DAppearance), gridLines.LineStyle, axis.IsVertical ? 1 : 2);
				list.AddRange(collection);
			}
			if (gridLines.MinorVisible)
			{
				IList<Line> collection2 = CreateGridLines(axis, diagramViewData, gridData.MinorItems.VisibleGridLineValues, gridLines.GetActualMinorColor(xYDiagram3DAppearance), gridLines.MinorLineStyle, axis.IsVertical ? 3 : 4);
				list.AddRange(collection2);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public Axis3DViewData(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DViewData diagramViewData)
		{
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = diagramViewData.CoordsCalculator;
			IMinMaxValues visualRangeData = axis.VisualRangeData;
			double axisLength = (axis.IsVertical ? coordsCalculator.Bounds.Height : coordsCalculator.Bounds.Width);
			GridAndTextData gridAndTextData = new GridAndTextData(axis.GetSeries(), axis, scrollingEnabled: false, visualRangeData, axisLength, axis.Label != null && axis.Label.Staggered);
			AxisGridData gridData = gridAndTextData.GridData;
			interlacedPolygons = CreateInterlacedPolygons(axis, diagramViewData, gridData.InterlacedData);
			gridLines = CreateGridLines(axis, diagramViewData, gridData);
			if (axis.Label.ActualVisibility)
			{
				labelViewData = new AxisLabel3DViewData(axis, coordsCalculator, gridAndTextData.GetTextData());
			}
		}

		public void RenderLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (labelViewData != null)
			{
				labelViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum AxisElementLocation
	{
		Outside,
		Inside
	}
	public abstract class AxisElementViewDataBase
	{
		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly AxisMappingBase mapping;

		private int sign = 1;

		private int fullElementOffset;

		protected Axis2D Axis => axis;

		protected HitTestController HitTestController => axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController;

		protected HitTestState HitState => ((IHitTest)axis).State;

		protected AxisMappingBase Mapping => mapping;

		public static AxisElementLocation Opposite(AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			if (location == AxisElementLocation.Inside)
			{
				return AxisElementLocation.Outside;
			}
			return AxisElementLocation.Inside;
		}

		public static bool GetActualElementPositionRelativeToAxis(AxisMappingBase mapping, bool actual)
		{
			if (mapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram)
			{
				double actualNormalCoord = mapping.ActualNormalCoord;
				if (actualNormalCoord > Math.Ceiling((double)mapping.NormalLength / 2.0))
				{
					actual = !actual;
				}
			}
			return actual;
		}

		public AxisElementViewDataBase(Axis2D axis, AxisMappingBase mapping)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.mapping = mapping;
		}

		protected Point GetScreenPoint(double axisValue, int selfOffset, int offset)
		{
			return (Point)mapping.GetScreenPoint(axisValue, selfOffset, fullElementOffset + offset * sign);
		}

		protected Point GetNotClampedScreenPoint(double axisValue, int selfOffset, int offset)
		{
			return (Point)((AxisIntervalMapping)mapping).GetNotClampedScreenPoint(axisValue, selfOffset, fullElementOffset + offset * sign);
		}

		private int GetSign(AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			if ((location != AxisElementLocation.Outside || Mapping.ActualAlignment != AxisAlignment.Far) && (location != AxisElementLocation.Inside || Mapping.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		internal virtual void CalculateBounds(int axisOffset, int elementOffset, AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			sign = GetSign(location);
			fullElementOffset = elementOffset * sign + axisOffset * GetSign(AxisElementLocation.Outside);
		}

		public abstract void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottom);

		public abstract void Render(ChartRenderer renderer);
	}
	public class AxisIntervalViewData
	{
		public const int AxisLabelIndent = 3;

		private readonly bool visible = true;

		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly AxisIntervalMapping intervalMapping;

		private readonly GridAndTextData gridAndTextData;

		private readonly AxisLineViewData lineViewData;

		private readonly AxisTickmarksViewData tickmarksViewData;

		private readonly AxisTickmarksViewData crossTickmarksViewData;

		private readonly AxisLabelViewData labelViewData;

		private readonly List<GridLineViewData> majorGridLinesViewData;

		private readonly List<GridLineViewData> minorGridLinesViewData;

		private readonly List<ZPlaneRectangle> interlacedAreas;

		private readonly List<ConstantLineViewData> backConstantLinesViewData = new List<ConstantLineViewData>();

		private readonly List<ConstantLineViewData> frontConstantLinesViewData = new List<ConstantLineViewData>();

		private readonly List<StripViewData> stripsViewData = new List<StripViewData>();

		private Rectangle axisIntervalBounds;

		public Rectangle AxisIntervalBounds => axisIntervalBounds;

		public AxisIntervalMapping IntervalMapping => intervalMapping;

		public GridAndTextData GridAndTextData => gridAndTextData;

		public List<ConstantLineViewData> BackConstantLinesViewData => backConstantLinesViewData;

		public List<ConstantLineViewData> FrontConstantLinesViewData => frontConstantLinesViewData;

		public List<StripViewData> StripsViewData => stripsViewData;

		public AxisLabelViewData LabelViewData => labelViewData;

		public AxisLineViewData LineViewData => lineViewData;

		public AxisIntervalViewData(Axis2D axis, AxisIntervalMapping intervalMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, bool visible, AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			this.axis = axis;
			this.intervalMapping = intervalMapping;
			this.gridAndTextData = gridAndTextData;
			this.visible = visible;
			AxisGridData gridData = gridAndTextData.GridData;
			if (visible || (int)axis.Visibility != 1)
			{
				lineViewData = new AxisLineViewData(axis, intervalMapping);
				Tickmarks tickmarks = axis.Tickmarks;
				if (tickmarks.Visible || tickmarks.MinorVisible)
				{
					tickmarksViewData = AxisTickmarksViewData.Create(axis, intervalMapping, gridData);
					if (tickmarks.CrossAxis)
					{
						crossTickmarksViewData = AxisTickmarksViewData.CreateCrossAxis(axis, intervalMapping, gridData);
					}
				}
				if (axis.Label.ActualVisibility)
				{
					labelViewData = new AxisLabelViewData(axis, intervalMapping, gridAndTextData.GetTextData(axesInteraction?.GetIntersectionInternalValue(axis)));
				}
			}
			GridLines gridLines = axis.GridLines;
			if (gridLines.Visible)
			{
				majorGridLinesViewData = CalculateGridLinesViewData(gridData.Items.VisibleGridLineValues);
			}
			if (gridLines.MinorVisible)
			{
				minorGridLinesViewData = CalculateGridLinesViewData(gridData.MinorItems.VisibleGridLineValues);
			}
			if (axis.Interlaced)
			{
				interlacedAreas = CalculateInterlacedAreas();
			}
		}

		private List<GridLineViewData> CalculateGridLinesViewData(IList<double> values)
		{
			List<GridLineViewData> list = new List<GridLineViewData>(values.Count);
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				GridLineViewData item = new GridLineViewData(intervalMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(value, 0, 0), intervalMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(value, 0, 0));
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<ZPlaneRectangle> CalculateInterlacedAreas()
		{
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>();
			IMinMaxValues limits = intervalMapping.Limits;
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in gridAndTextData.GridData.InterlacedData)
			{
				double num = interlacedDatum.Near;
				double num2 = interlacedDatum.Far;
				if (num < num2)
				{
					if (num < limits.Min)
					{
						num = double.NegativeInfinity;
					}
					if (num2 > limits.Max)
					{
						num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
					}
					ZPlaneRectangle item = new ZPlaneRectangle(intervalMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(num, 0, 0), intervalMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(num2, 0, 0));
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateAxisIntervalBounds()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Rectangle rectangle = default(Rectangle);
			if ((int)axis.Visibility != 1)
			{
				rectangle = lineViewData.Bounds;
				if (tickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					Rectangle bounds = tickmarksViewData.GetBounds();
					if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						rectangle = GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, bounds);
					}
				}
				if (labelViewData != null)
				{
					Rectangle rect = labelViewData.CalculateBounds();
					if (!rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						rectangle = GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, rect);
					}
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		public int CalculateNextElementOffset(int elementsOffset)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (lineViewData != null)
			{
				num = elementsOffset + axis.Thickness;
				if (tickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					num += axis.Tickmarks.MaxLength;
				}
				if (labelViewData != null)
				{
					num += 3 + labelViewData.Size;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void CalculateBounds(int axisOffset, int elementsOffset, AxisElementLocation axisLabelLocation)
		{
			if (lineViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = elementsOffset;
			lineViewData.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, num, AxisElementLocation.Outside);
			num += axis.Thickness;
			if (tickmarksViewData != null)
			{
				tickmarksViewData.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, num, axisLabelLocation);
				num += axis.Tickmarks.MaxLength;
				if (crossTickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					crossTickmarksViewData.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, 1, AxisElementViewDataBase.Opposite(axisLabelLocation));
				}
			}
			if (labelViewData != null)
			{
				num += 3;
				labelViewData.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, num, axisLabelLocation);
			}
			axisIntervalBounds = CalculateAxisIntervalBounds();
		}

		public void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottomByLabel = false)
		{
			if (visible && lineViewData != null)
			{
				lineViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottom: false);
				if (tickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					tickmarksViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottom: false);
				}
				if (crossTickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					crossTickmarksViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottom: false);
				}
				if (labelViewData != null)
				{
					labelViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottomByLabel);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, AxisIntervalViewData previousIntervalViewData)
		{
			if (visible && lineViewData != null && labelViewData != null)
			{
				Rectangle previousPrimaryLabelItemBounds = previousIntervalViewData?.labelViewData.LastPrimaryLabelItemBounds ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				Rectangle previousStaggeredLabelItemBounds = previousIntervalViewData?.labelViewData.LastStaggeredLabelItemBounds ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				labelViewData.Render(renderer, previousPrimaryLabelItemBounds, previousStaggeredLabelItemBounds);
			}
		}

		public void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (visible && lineViewData != null)
			{
				lineViewData.Render(renderer);
				if (tickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					tickmarksViewData.Render(renderer);
				}
				if (crossTickmarksViewData != null)
				{
					crossTickmarksViewData.Render(renderer);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderInterlacedGraphics(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (interlacedAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ZPlaneRectangle interlacedArea in interlacedAreas)
			{
				axis.ActualInterlacedFillStyle.RenderRectangle(renderer, (RectangleF)interlacedArea, axis.ActualInterlacedColor);
			}
		}

		public void RenderStrips(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (StripViewData stripsViewDatum in stripsViewData)
			{
				stripsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		public void RenderBackConstantLines(ChartRenderer renderer, HitRegionContainer paneHitContainer)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLineViewData backConstantLinesViewDatum in backConstantLinesViewData)
			{
				backConstantLinesViewDatum.Render(renderer, paneHitContainer);
			}
		}

		public void RenderBackConstantLinesTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLineViewData backConstantLinesViewDatum in backConstantLinesViewData)
			{
				backConstantLinesViewDatum.RenderTitle(renderer);
			}
		}

		public void RenderFrontConstantLines(ChartRenderer renderer, HitRegionContainer paneHitContainer)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLineViewData frontConstantLinesViewDatum in frontConstantLinesViewData)
			{
				frontConstantLinesViewDatum.Render(renderer, paneHitContainer);
			}
		}

		public void RenderFrontConstantLinesTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLineViewData frontConstantLinesViewDatum in frontConstantLinesViewData)
			{
				frontConstantLinesViewDatum.RenderTitle(renderer);
			}
		}

		public void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			GridLines gridLines = axis.GridLines;
			if (majorGridLinesViewData != null)
			{
				GridLineViewData.RenderGridLines(renderer, majorGridLinesViewData, gridLines.GetActualColor(appearance), gridLines.LineStyle);
			}
			if (minorGridLinesViewData != null)
			{
				GridLineViewData.RenderGridLines(renderer, minorGridLinesViewData, gridLines.GetActualMinorColor(appearance), gridLines.MinorLineStyle);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabel3DViewData
	{
		private readonly Axis3D axis;

		private readonly AxisLabelItemList items;

		internal AxisLabelItemList Items => items;

		public AxisLabel3DViewData(Axis3D axis, XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, AxisTextData textData)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			items = CalculateItems(coordsCalculator, textData.PrimaryItems, 0);
			IList<AxisTextItem> staggeredItems = textData.StaggeredItems;
			if (staggeredItems.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (AxisLabel3DItem item in items)
			{
				int textSize = axis.GetTextSize(item.RoundedBounds);
				if (textSize > num)
				{
					num = textSize;
				}
			}
			num += 2;
			items.AddRange(CalculateItems(coordsCalculator, staggeredItems, num));
		}

		private AxisLabelItemList CalculateItems(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, IList<AxisTextItem> textItems, int extent)
		{
			AxisLabel label = axis.Label;
			AxisLabelItemList axisLabelItemList = new AxisLabelItemList(textItems.Count);
			foreach (AxisTextItem textItem in textItems)
			{
				Point basePoint = (Point)coordsCalculator.Project(axis.GetLabelPoint(coordsCalculator, textItem.Value, -extent));
				axisLabelItemList.Add(new AxisLabel3DItem(coordsCalculator, label, basePoint, textItem));
			}
			axisLabelItemList.AdjustPropertiesAndCreatePainters(axis);
			return axisLabelItemList;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			items.Render(renderer, axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController);
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelItemList : List<AxisLabelItemBase>
	{
		public AxisLabelItemList(int count)
			: base(count)
		{
		}

		public void AdjustPropertiesAndCreatePainters(AxisBase axis)
		{
			axis.ChartContainer.Chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateAxisLabelItems(axis, this);
			if (axis.ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawAxisLabels)
			{
				RaiseCustomDrawEvents(axis);
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
				current.CreatePainter();
			}
		}

		public Rectangle GetLabelsOffsetRect()
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
				RectangleF bounds = current.Bounds;
				bounds.Offset(-current.BasePoint.X, -current.BasePoint.Y);
				rectangle = GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(bounds));
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		public void UpdateCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottomByLabel = false)
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Visible)
				{
					if (doNotCorrectBottomByLabel)
					{
						correction.UpdateWithoutBottom(current.RoundedBounds);
					}
					else
					{
						correction.Update(current.RoundedBounds);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateHeight(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Visible)
				{
					correction.UpdateHeight(current.RoundedBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsRotated()
		{
			bool result = false;
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.Rotated)
					{
						result = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public Rectangle GetMaxLabelRect(bool isVertical, AxisAlignment alignment)
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = int.MinValue;
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
					Point basePoint = current.BasePoint;
					int val = (isVertical ? basePoint.X : basePoint.Y);
					num = Math.Min(num, val);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, val);
				}
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			using Enumerator enumerator2 = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current2 = enumerator2.Current;
				Point basePoint2 = current2.BasePoint;
				int num3 = -basePoint2.X;
				int num4 = -basePoint2.Y;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					num3 -= basePoint2.X;
					num3 += ((alignment == AxisAlignment.Far) ? num2 : num);
				}
				else
				{
					num4 -= basePoint2.Y;
					num4 += ((alignment == AxisAlignment.Far) ? num : num2);
				}
				Rectangle rectangle2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(current2.Bounds);
				rectangle2.Offset(num3, num4);
				rectangle = ((!rectangle.IsEmpty) ? GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, rectangle2) : rectangle2);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, Rectangle previousPrimaryItemBounds, Rectangle previousStaggeredItemBounds)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
				if (!current.Visible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!previousPrimaryItemBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = previousPrimaryItemBounds;
					previousPrimaryItemBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					if (rectangle.IntersectsWith(current.RoundedBounds))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (!previousStaggeredItemBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = previousStaggeredItemBounds;
					previousStaggeredItemBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					if (rectangle2.IntersectsWith(current.RoundedBounds))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				current.Render(renderer, hitTestController);
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, Rectangle.Empty, Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		private void RaiseCustomDrawEvents(AxisBase axis)
		{
			ChartContainerAdapter containerAdapter = axis.ContainerAdapter;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				AxisLabelItemBase current = enumerator.Current;
				containerAdapter.OnCustomDrawAxisLabel(new CustomDrawAxisLabelEventArgs(current));
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelViewData : AxisElementViewDataBase
	{
		private const int staggeredIndent = 2;

		private readonly AxisLabelItemList items;

		private readonly IList<AxisLabelItemBase> primaryItems;

		private readonly IList<AxisLabelItemBase> staggeredItems;

		private Rectangle lastPrimaryLabelItemBounds;

		private Rectangle lastStaggeredLabelItemBounds;

		private Rectangle bounds = Rectangle.Empty;

		public AxisLabelItemList Items => items;

		public Rectangle LastPrimaryLabelItemBounds => lastPrimaryLabelItemBounds;

		public Rectangle LastStaggeredLabelItemBounds => lastStaggeredLabelItemBounds;

		public int Size => CalculateSize(items);

		public AxisLabelViewData(Axis2D axis, AxisIntervalMapping mapping, AxisTextData textData)
			: base(axis, mapping)
		{
			primaryItems = CalculateItems(textData.PrimaryItems, 0);
			int num = CalculateSize(primaryItems);
			staggeredItems = CalculateItems(textData.StaggeredItems, num + 2);
			items = new AxisLabelItemList(primaryItems.Count + staggeredItems.Count);
			items.AddRange(primaryItems);
			items.AddRange(staggeredItems);
		}

		private AxisLabelItemList CalculateItems(IList<AxisTextItem> textItems, int offset)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = base.Axis;
			AxisLabel2D label = axis2D.Label;
			AxisLabelItemList axisLabelItemList = new AxisLabelItemList(textItems.Count);
			foreach (AxisTextItem textItem in textItems)
			{
				axisLabelItemList.Add(new AxisLabelItem(label, GetNotClampedScreenPoint(textItem.Value, 0, offset), textItem, base.Mapping));
			}
			axisLabelItemList.AdjustPropertiesAndCreatePainters(axis2D);
			return axisLabelItemList;
		}

		private int CalculateSize(IList<AxisLabelItemBase> items)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (AxisLabelItemBase item in items)
			{
				int num2 = base.Axis.GetTextSize(item.RoundedBounds);
				if (item is IAxisLabelLayout axisLabelLayout)
				{
					num2 = ((!base.Axis.IsVertical) ? (num2 + (int)Math.Abs(axisLabelLayout.Offset.Y)) : (num2 + (int)Math.Abs(axisLabelLayout.Offset.X)));
				}
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void UpdateCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (ShouldLimitLabels())
			{
				correction.UpdateHeight(rect);
			}
			else
			{
				correction.Update(rect);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCorrectionWithScrolling(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			Rectangle maxLabelRect = items.GetMaxLabelRect(base.Axis.IsVertical, base.Mapping.ActualAlignment);
			Rectangle maxLabelRectCache = base.Axis.MaxLabelRectCache;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Math.Min(maxLabelRect.Left, maxLabelRectCache.Left), Math.Min(maxLabelRect.Top, maxLabelRectCache.Top), Math.Max(maxLabelRect.Width, maxLabelRectCache.Width), Math.Max(maxLabelRect.Height, maxLabelRectCache.Height));
			Rectangle rect = rectangle;
			rect.Offset(GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, 0));
			UpdateCorrection(correction, rect);
			rect = rectangle;
			rect.Offset(GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, 0));
			UpdateCorrection(correction, rect);
			base.Axis.MaxLabelRectCache = rectangle;
		}

		internal override void CalculateBounds(int axisOffset, int elementOffset, AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (items.Count > 0)
			{
				Point notClampedScreenPoint = GetNotClampedScreenPoint(items[0].AxisValueInternal, 0, 0);
				num = notClampedScreenPoint.X;
				num2 = notClampedScreenPoint.Y;
			}
			base.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, elementOffset, location);
			foreach (AxisLabelItem item in items)
			{
				item.SetAxisElementLocation(location);
			}
			if (items.Count > 0)
			{
				Point notClampedScreenPoint2 = GetNotClampedScreenPoint(items[0].AxisValueInternal, 0, 0);
				num = notClampedScreenPoint2.X - num;
				num2 = notClampedScreenPoint2.Y - num2;
			}
			foreach (AxisLabelItem item2 in items)
			{
				item2.ApplyOffset(default(GRealPoint2D), new GRealPoint2D(num, num2));
			}
			lastPrimaryLabelItemBounds = ((primaryItems.Count > 0) ? primaryItems[primaryItems.Count - 1].RoundedBounds : Rectangle.Empty);
			lastStaggeredLabelItemBounds = ((staggeredItems.Count > 0) ? staggeredItems[staggeredItems.Count - 1].RoundedBounds : Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		public bool ShouldLimitLabels(bool labelPositionInsideDiagram = false)
		{
			if (!base.Axis.IsVertical || labelPositionInsideDiagram)
			{
				if (!PaneAxesManager.CanZoomOutAxis(base.Axis))
				{
					return !items.IsRotated();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Rectangle CalculateBounds()
		{
			if (bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF = bounds;
				foreach (AxisLabelItemBase item in items)
				{
					RectangleF rectangleF2 = item.Bounds;
					rectangleF = (rectangleF.IsEmpty ? rectangleF2 : GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangleF, rectangleF2));
				}
				bounds = GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(rectangleF);
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		public override void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottom)
		{
			if (PaneAxesManager.CanScrollAxis(base.Axis) && base.Axis.XYDiagram2D.IsScrollingEnabled)
			{
				UpdateCorrectionWithScrolling(correction);
			}
			else if (ShouldLimitLabels())
			{
				items.UpdateHeight(correction);
			}
			else
			{
				items.UpdateCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottom);
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Render(renderer, Rectangle.Empty, Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle previousPrimaryLabelItemBounds, Rectangle previousStaggeredLabelItemBounds)
		{
			items.Render(renderer, base.HitTestController, previousPrimaryLabelItemBounds, previousStaggeredLabelItemBounds);
		}
	}
	public class AxisLineViewData : AxisElementViewDataBase
	{
		private Rectangle bounds;

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public AxisLineViewData(Axis2D axis, AxisIntervalMapping mapping)
			: base(axis, mapping)
		{
		}

		internal override void CalculateBounds(int axisOffset, int elementOffset, AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			base.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, elementOffset, location);
			Point screenPoint = GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, 0);
			Point screenPoint2 = GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, base.HitState.Normal ? (base.Axis.Thickness - 1) : base.Axis.Thickness);
			bounds = GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(screenPoint, screenPoint2);
		}

		public override void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottom = false)
		{
			correction.Update(bounds);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				Axis2D axis2D = base.Axis;
				renderer.FillRectangle(bounds, axis2D.GetActualColor(base.Mapping));
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(base.HitTestController, axis2D, null, new HitRegion(bounds));
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisTickmarksViewData : AxisElementViewDataBase
	{
		private readonly bool isCrossAxis;

		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly AxisGridData gridData;

		private List<Rectangle> majorRects;

		private List<Rectangle> minorRects;

		private Rectangle? scrollingCorrectionRect;

		public static AxisTickmarksViewData Create(Axis2D axis, AxisIntervalMapping mapping, AxisGridData gridData)
		{
			return new AxisTickmarksViewData(axis, mapping, isCrossAxis: false, gridData);
		}

		public static AxisTickmarksViewData CreateCrossAxis(Axis2D axis, AxisIntervalMapping mapping, AxisGridData gridData)
		{
			return new AxisTickmarksViewData(axis, mapping, isCrossAxis: true, gridData);
		}

		private AxisTickmarksViewData(Axis2D axis, AxisIntervalMapping mapping, bool isCrossAxis, AxisGridData gridData)
			: base(axis, mapping)
		{
			this.isCrossAxis = isCrossAxis;
			this.axis = axis;
			this.gridData = gridData;
		}

		private Rectangle GetBoundsInternal()
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			foreach (Rectangle majorRect in majorRects)
			{
				rectangle = ((!rectangle.IsEmpty) ? GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, majorRect) : majorRect);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		private List<Rectangle> CalculateRects(List<double> values, int length, int thickness)
		{
			ThicknessUtils.SplitToHalves(thickness, base.HitState, out var firstHalf, out var secondHalf);
			base.Axis.Tickmarks.ApplySignToHalves(ref firstHalf, ref secondHalf);
			int num = length;
			if (isCrossAxis || base.HitState.Normal)
			{
				num--;
			}
			List<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>();
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				list.Add(GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(GetScreenPoint(value, firstHalf, 0), GetScreenPoint(value, secondHalf, num)));
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal override void CalculateBounds(int axisOffset, int elementOffset, AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			base.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, elementOffset, location);
			Tickmarks tickmarks = axis.Tickmarks;
			majorRects = (tickmarks.Visible ? CalculateRects(gridData.Items.VisibleTickMarkValues, tickmarks.Length, tickmarks.Thickness) : new List<Rectangle>());
			minorRects = (tickmarks.MinorVisible ? CalculateRects(gridData.MinorItems.VisibleTickMarkValues, tickmarks.MinorLength, tickmarks.MinorThickness) : new List<Rectangle>());
			if (PaneAxesManager.CanScrollAxis(axis) && axis.XYDiagram2D.IsScrollingEnabled)
			{
				scrollingCorrectionRect = GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(GetScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, 0), GetScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, tickmarks.MaxLength));
			}
		}

		private void RenderMetafile(ChartRenderer renderer, IEnumerable<Rectangle> rects, int thickness)
		{
			foreach (Rectangle rect in rects)
			{
				renderer.FillMetafileRectangle(rect, base.Axis.GetActualColor(base.Mapping), thickness);
			}
		}

		private void RenderCore(ChartRenderer renderer, IEnumerable<Rectangle> rects)
		{
			foreach (Rectangle rect in rects)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(rect, base.Axis.GetActualColor(base.Mapping));
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, IEnumerable<Rectangle> rects, int thickness)
		{
			if (renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing)
			{
				RenderMetafile(renderer, rects, thickness);
			}
			else
			{
				RenderCore(renderer, rects);
			}
			HitTestController hitTestController = base.HitTestController;
			if (!hitTestController.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Rectangle rect in rects)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, base.Axis, null, new HitRegion(rect));
			}
		}

		public override void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottom = false)
		{
			if (!scrollingCorrectionRect.HasValue)
			{
				correction.Update(majorRects);
				correction.Update(minorRects);
			}
			else
			{
				correction.Update(scrollingCorrectionRect.Value);
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Render(renderer, majorRects, axis.Tickmarks.Thickness);
			Render(renderer, minorRects, axis.Tickmarks.MinorThickness);
		}

		public Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			if (majorRects.Count == 0 && minorRects.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = GetBoundsInternal();
			Rectangle boundsInternal = GetBoundsInternal();
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangle = boundsInternal;
			}
			else if (!boundsInternal.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangle = GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, boundsInternal);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}
	}
	public class AxisTitleViewData : AxisElementViewDataBase
	{
		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly RotatedTextPainterNearLine painter;

		private readonly int size;

		private readonly bool showAboveAxis;

		private readonly AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction;

		private Rectangle boundsForCorrection;

		internal RotatedTextPainterNearLine TextPainter => painter;

		public Rectangle Bounds => painter.RoundedBounds;

		public int Size => size;

		public bool ShowAboveAxis => showAboveAxis;

		public AxisTitleViewData(Axis2D axis, AxisMapping mapping, int maxWidth, AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction)
			: base(axis, mapping)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.axesInteraction = axesInteraction;
			AxisTitle title = axis.Title;
			string text = title.Text;
			SizeF textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, title.DXFont, title);
			Point basePoint = CalculateScreenPoint(textSize);
			showAboveAxis = AxisElementViewDataBase.GetActualElementPositionRelativeToAxis(mapping, axis.Title.ShowAboveAxis);
			NearTextPosition titleNearTextPosition = GetTitleNearTextPosition();
			painter = new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(basePoint, text, textSize, title, titleNearTextPosition, axis.GetAxisTitleActualAngle(), mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: true, maxWidth, title.MaxLineCount, title.WordWrap);
			size = axis.GetTextSize(painter.RoundedBounds);
		}

		private Point CalculateScreenPoint(SizeF textSize)
		{
			double axisValue;
			int selfOffset;
			switch (axis.Title.Alignment)
			{
			case System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near:
				axisValue = double.NegativeInfinity;
				selfOffset = (int)Math.Floor((double)textSize.Width / 2.0);
				break;
			case System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far:
				axisValue = double.PositiveInfinity;
				selfOffset = -(int)Math.Floor((double)textSize.Width / 2.0);
				break;
			default:
			{
				selfOffset = 0;
				IMinMaxValues visualRangeData = axis.VisualRangeData;
				if (axesInteraction != null && axesInteraction.GetIntersectionInternalValue(axis).HasValue)
				{
					double val = Math.Min(axesInteraction.GetIntersectionInternalValue(axis).Value, visualRangeData.Max);
					val = Math.Max(val, visualRangeData.Min);
					axisValue = ((!(val - visualRangeData.Min <= visualRangeData.Max - val) && base.Mapping.ActualAlignment != AxisAlignment.Center) ? ((visualRangeData.Min + val) / 2.0) : ((val + visualRangeData.Max) / 2.0));
				}
				else
				{
					axisValue = (visualRangeData.Min + visualRangeData.Max) / 2.0;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return GetScreenPoint(axisValue, selfOffset, 0);
		}

		private NearTextPosition GetTitleNearTextPosition()
		{
			NearTextPosition nearTextPosition = (axis.IsVertical ? NearTextPosition.Left : NearTextPosition.Bottom);
			if ((base.Mapping.ActualAlignment != AxisAlignment.Far || ShowAboveAxis) && (base.Mapping.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far || !ShowAboveAxis))
			{
				return AxisLabelPositionHelper.Opposite(nearTextPosition);
			}
			return nearTextPosition;
		}

		internal override void CalculateBounds(int axisOffset, int elementOffset, AxisElementLocation location)
		{
			base.CalculateBounds(axisOffset, elementOffset, location);
			Size size = painter.RoundedBounds.Size;
			Point point = CalculateScreenPoint(axis.IsVertical ? new Size(size.Height, size.Width) : size);
			painter.Offset(point.X - painter.BasePoint.X, point.Y - painter.BasePoint.Y);
			boundsForCorrection = painter.RoundedBounds;
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				boundsForCorrection.Height = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				boundsForCorrection.Width = 0;
			}
		}

		public override void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottom = false)
		{
			correction.Update(boundsForCorrection);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			painter.Render(renderer, base.HitTestController, base.Axis.Title);
		}
	}
	public class AxisViewData
	{
		private const int axisTitleIndent = 3;

		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly List<AxisIntervalViewData> intervalsViewData = new List<AxisIntervalViewData>();

		private readonly IList<GRealRect2D> intervalsBounds = new List<GRealRect2D>();

		private readonly AxisTitleViewData titleViewData;

		private readonly int nextAxisOffset;

		private readonly GRealRect2D paneBounds;

		private readonly bool visible;

		private readonly AxisMapping axisMapping;

		private int axisMappingLengthCached = -1;

		private AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache axisLabelResolveOverlappingCache;

		public int NextAxisOffset => nextAxisOffset;

		public Axis2D Axis => axis;

		public List<AxisIntervalViewData> IntervalsViewData => intervalsViewData;

		public IList<GRealRect2D> IntervalsBounds => intervalsBounds;

		public AxisTitleViewData TitleViewData => titleViewData;

		public Rectangle Bounds { get; private set; }

		public bool Visible => visible;

		public AxisMapping Mapping => axisMapping;

		public AxisViewData(Axis2D axis, AxisGridAndTextData gridAndTextData, AxisMapping axisMapping, List<AxisIntervalMapping> intervalMappings, bool visible, int axisOffset, int elementsOffset, AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction, IBackground backgroundElement)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.visible = visible;
			this.axisMapping = axisMapping;
			bool flag = axisOffset == 0;
			bool flag2 = axisMapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram || (flag && !Axis.LabelInOutsidePosition);
			paneBounds = (flag2 ? axisMapping.MappingBounds : gridAndTextData.MaxBounds).ToGRealRect2D();
			List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels = CalculateLabelsLayout(intervalMappings, gridAndTextData, axesInteraction);
			bool actualElementPositionRelativeToAxis = AxisElementViewDataBase.GetActualElementPositionRelativeToAxis(axisMapping, axis.LabelInOutsidePosition);
			ProcessOverlappingAxisLabels(labels, actualElementPositionRelativeToAxis, flag2, axesInteraction);
			int num = elementsOffset;
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum in intervalsViewData)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, intervalsViewDatum.CalculateNextElementOffset(elementsOffset));
			}
			int num2 = axisOffset;
			int num3 = 0;
			if (actualElementPositionRelativeToAxis)
			{
				num3 += num;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 += ((!flag) ? num : 0);
			}
			titleViewData = CalculateTitleViewData(axisMapping, axesInteraction, out var titleSize);
			if (titleViewData != null)
			{
				bool showAboveAxis = titleViewData.ShowAboveAxis;
				int axisOffset2;
				if (showAboveAxis)
				{
					axisOffset2 = num2 + num3;
					num3 += titleSize;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += ((!flag) ? titleSize : 0);
					axisOffset2 = num2 - ((!actualElementPositionRelativeToAxis) ? num : 0);
				}
				titleViewData.CalculateBounds(axisOffset2, elementsOffset + 3, (!showAboveAxis) ? AxisElementLocation.Inside : AxisElementLocation.Outside);
				axis.Title.Bounds = titleViewData.Bounds.ToGRealRect2D();
			}
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum2 in intervalsViewData)
			{
				intervalsViewDatum2.CalculateBounds(num2, elementsOffset, (!actualElementPositionRelativeToAxis) ? AxisElementLocation.Inside : AxisElementLocation.Outside);
				intervalsBounds.Add(CalculateIntervalBounds(intervalsViewDatum2.IntervalMapping));
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum3 in intervalsViewData)
			{
				rectangle = (rectangle.IsEmpty ? intervalsViewDatum3.AxisIntervalBounds : GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, intervalsViewDatum3.AxisIntervalBounds));
			}
			if (axesInteraction != null && flag2)
			{
				axesInteraction.CacheAxisLabelBounds(axisMapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram ? rectangle : CalculateLabelBounds());
				if ((axis.IsVertical && paneBounds.Left - 1.0 <= (double)rectangle.Left && paneBounds.Right + 1.0 >= (double)rectangle.Right) || (!axis.IsVertical && paneBounds.Top - 1.0 <= (double)rectangle.Top && paneBounds.Bottom + 1.0 >= (double)rectangle.Bottom))
				{
					foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum4 in intervalsViewData)
					{
						AxisLabelViewData labelViewData = intervalsViewDatum4.LabelViewData;
						if (labelViewData == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (AxisLabelItemBase item in labelViewData.Items)
						{
							item.SetBackgroundElement(backgroundElement);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			Bounds = rectangle;
			axis.Bounds = rectangle.ToGRealRect2D();
			nextAxisOffset = num2 + num3;
			CalculateStripsViewData();
			CalculateConstantLinesViewData(showBehind: true);
			CalculateConstantLinesViewData(showBehind: false);
		}

		private List<IAxisLabelLayout> CalculateLabelsLayout(List<AxisIntervalMapping> intervalMappings, AxisGridAndTextData gridAndTextData, AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction)
		{
			List<IAxisLabelLayout> list = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();
			foreach (AxisIntervalMapping intervalMapping in intervalMappings)
			{
				AxisInterval interval = intervalMapping.IntervalLayout.Interval;
				AxisIntervalViewData axisIntervalViewData = new AxisIntervalViewData(axis, intervalMapping, gridAndTextData[interval], visible, axesInteraction);
				intervalsViewData.Add(axisIntervalViewData);
				AxisLabelViewData labelViewData = axisIntervalViewData.LabelViewData;
				if (labelViewData == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (AxisLabelItemBase item2 in labelViewData.Items)
				{
					if (item2 is IAxisLabelLayout item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			AxisLabelOffsetCalculator.CorrectLabelWithAlignment(list, axis, axis.ActualLabelAlignment);
			return list;
		}

		private GRealRect2D CalculateIntervalBounds(AxisIntervalMapping intervalMapping)
		{
			Point corner = (Point)intervalMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0, 0);
			Point corner2 = (Point)intervalMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(double.PositiveInfinity, 0, 0);
			return GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(corner, corner2).ToGRealRect2D();
		}

		private AxisTitleViewData CalculateTitleViewData(AxisMapping axisMapping, AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction, out int titleSize)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			titleSize = 0;
			AxisTitleViewData axisTitleViewData = null;
			if (visible && (int)axis.Title.Visibility != 1)
			{
				Rectangle mappingBounds = axisMapping.MappingBounds;
				axisTitleViewData = new AxisTitleViewData(axis, axisMapping, axis.IsVertical ? mappingBounds.Height : mappingBounds.Width, axesInteraction);
				if (axis.Title.ActualVisibility)
				{
					titleSize += 3 + axisTitleViewData.Size;
				}
			}
			return axisTitleViewData;
		}

		private void CalculateStripsViewData()
		{
			foreach (Strip strip in axis.Strips)
			{
				if (strip.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
				{
					CalculateStripViewData(strip);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateStripViewData(Strip strip)
		{
			double actualValue = strip.MinLimit.ActualValue;
			double actualValue2 = strip.MaxLimit.ActualValue;
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum in intervalsViewData)
			{
				AxisIntervalMapping intervalMapping = intervalsViewDatum.IntervalMapping;
				if (!(actualValue >= intervalMapping.Limits.Max) && !(actualValue2 <= intervalMapping.Limits.Min))
				{
					RectangleF thisRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)intervalMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(actualValue, 0, 0), (PointF)intervalMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(actualValue2, 0, 0));
					thisRect = thisRect.InflateIfZero();
					if (thisRect.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
					{
						intervalsViewDatum.StripsViewData.Add(new StripViewData(strip, thisRect));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateConstantLinesViewData(bool showBehind)
		{
			IList<ConstantLine> subsetByShowBehindProperty = axis.ConstantLines.GetSubsetByShowBehindProperty(showBehind);
			foreach (ConstantLine item in subsetByShowBehindProperty)
			{
				if (item.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
				{
					CalculateConstantLineViewData(item, showBehind);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateConstantLineViewData(ConstantLine constantLine, bool showBehind)
		{
			double value = ((IAxisValueContainer)constantLine).Value;
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum in intervalsViewData)
			{
				if (intervalsViewDatum.IntervalMapping.IntervalLayout.ValueWithinRange(value))
				{
					ConstantLineViewData item = new ConstantLineViewData(constantLine, intervalsViewDatum.IntervalMapping, value);
					if (showBehind)
					{
						intervalsViewDatum.BackConstantLinesViewData.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						intervalsViewDatum.FrontConstantLinesViewData.Add(item);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanApplyOverlappingCache(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (diagram != null && diagram.IsScrollingEnabled && Axis.OverlappingCache != null && Axis.OverlappingCache.Count == labels.Count)
			{
				return Mapping.Length == axisMappingLengthCached;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldLimitLabels(bool labelPositionInsideDiagram)
		{
			bool result = false;
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum in intervalsViewData)
			{
				AxisLabelViewData labelViewData = intervalsViewDatum.LabelViewData;
				if (labelViewData != null && labelViewData.ShouldLimitLabels(labelPositionInsideDiagram))
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ProcessOverlappingAxisLabels(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, bool outsideLabels, bool labelPositionInsideDiagram, AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction)
		{
			AxisLabelOverlappingResolver axisLabelOverlappingResolver = AxisLabelsResolveOverlappingHelper.CreateOverlappingResolver(labels, Axis, outsideLabels, axisMapping.ActualAlignment, paneBounds);
			if (axesInteraction != null && labelPositionInsideDiagram)
			{
				axesInteraction.ProcessLabelLayout(axis, labels, axisLabelOverlappingResolver, outsideLabels);
			}
			AxisLabel2D label = Axis.Label;
			if (label.ResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowResolveOverlapping || label.Staggered)
			{
				if (CanApplyOverlappingCache(labels, Axis.Diagram as XYDiagram2D))
				{
					Axis.OverlappingCache.Apply(labels);
				}
				else
				{
					axisLabelOverlappingResolver.Process();
					CreateOverlappingCache(labels);
				}
			}
			if (ShouldLimitLabels(labelPositionInsideDiagram))
			{
				axisLabelOverlappingResolver.ProcessLabelsLimits(paneBounds);
			}
			axisLabelOverlappingResolver.ProcessCustomLabels();
		}

		private void CreateOverlappingCache(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			axisMappingLengthCached = Mapping.Length;
			axisLabelResolveOverlappingCache = new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache(Axis, labels);
		}

		public void UpdateCache()
		{
			axisLabelResolveOverlappingCache?.Store();
		}

		public Rectangle CalculateLabelBounds()
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum in intervalsViewData)
			{
				AxisLabelViewData labelViewData = intervalsViewDatum.LabelViewData;
				if (labelViewData != null)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = labelViewData.CalculateBounds();
					if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty)
					{
						rectangle = (rectangle.IsEmpty ? rectangle2 : GraphicUtils.UnionRectangle(rectangle, rectangle2));
					}
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		public void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, bool doNotCorrectBottomByLabel)
		{
			foreach (AxisIntervalViewData intervalsViewDatum in intervalsViewData)
			{
				intervalsViewDatum.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottomByLabel);
			}
			if (titleViewData != null && axis.Title.ActualVisibility)
			{
				titleViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction, doNotCorrectBottom: false);
			}
		}

				previousIntervalViewData = intervalsViewDatum;

				titleViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

	public static class AxisNavigationUtils
	{
		public static bool IsScrollingZoomingEnabled(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (diagram.DefaultPane.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling || diagram.DefaultPane.ActualEnableAxisXZooming)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in diagram.Panes)
			{
				if (pane.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling || pane.ActualEnableAxisXZooming)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsScrollingZoomingEnabled(AxisXBase axis)
		{
			XYDiagram xYDiagram = axis.XYDiagram;
			if (xYDiagram == null || xYDiagram.AxisPaneRepository == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return xYDiagram.AxisPaneRepository.IsScrollingZoomingEnabledForAxis(axis);
		}
	}
	public class ConstantLineViewData
	{
		private readonly ConstantLine constantLine;

		private readonly DiagramPoint point1;

		private readonly DiagramPoint point2;

		private readonly RotatedTextPainterNearLine titlePainter;

		private HitTestController HitTestController => constantLine.Axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController;

		public ConstantLine ConstantLine => constantLine;

		public DiagramPoint Point1 => point1;

		public DiagramPoint Point2 => point2;

		public RotatedTextPainterNearLine TitlePainter => titlePainter;

		public ConstantLineViewData(ConstantLine constantLine, AxisIntervalMapping intervalMapping, double value)
		{
			this.constantLine = constantLine;
			point1 = intervalMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(value, 0, 0);
			point2 = intervalMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(value, 0, 0);
			ConstantLineTitle title = constantLine.Title;
			string actualText = title.ActualText;
			if (title.ActualVisibility && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualText))
			{
				Axis2D axis = constantLine.Axis;
				SizeF textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(actualText, title.DXFont, title);
				int num = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)constantLine.LineStyle.Thickness / 2.0);
				if (title.ShowBelowLine ^ (axis.ActualReverse && ((XYDiagram2D)axis.Diagram).ActualRotated))
				{
					num = -num;
				}
				int num2 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)textSize.Width / 2.0) + 1;
				titlePainter = new RotatedTextPainterNearLine((title.Alignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Far) ? ((Point)intervalMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(value, num, -num2)) : ((Point)intervalMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(value, num, num2)), actualText, textSize, title, GetNearTextPosition(), axis.GetConstantLineTitleActualAngle(), mixColorByHitTestState: true);
			}
		}

		private NearTextPosition GetNearTextPosition()
		{
			NearTextPosition nearTextPosition = ((!constantLine.Axis.IsVertical) ? (constantLine.Axis.ActualReverse ? NearTextPosition.Left : NearTextPosition.Right) : NearTextPosition.Top);
			if (!constantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine)
			{
				return nearTextPosition;
			}
			return AxisLabelPositionHelper.Opposite(nearTextPosition);
		}

		private IHitRegion CalcHitRegion(HitRegionContainer paneHitContainer, int additionalWiden = 2)
		{
			using DXPen pen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, constantLine.LineStyle.Thickness + additionalWiden);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((Point)point1, (Point)point2);
			if (dXGraphicsPath.PointCount != 0 && point1 != point2)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Widen(pen);
			}
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = new HitRegionContainer(new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath));
			hitRegionContainer.Intersect(paneHitContainer);
			return hitRegionContainer.Underlying;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitRegionContainer paneHitContainer)
		{
			HitTestState state = ((IHitTest)constantLine).State;
			LineStyle lineStyle = constantLine.LineStyle;
			int num = (state.Normal ? lineStyle.Thickness : GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(lineStyle.Thickness, state, 1));
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
			Color color = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(constantLine.ActualColor, state);
			if (constantLine.RuntimeOperationSelect && constantLine.RuntimeDeletion)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num + 2, MathUtils.StrongRound(1.3 * (double)num));
			}
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)point1, (Point)point2, color, num, lineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			bool flag = constantLine.RuntimeMoving || constantLine.RuntimeDeletion;
			IHitRegion region = CalcHitRegion(paneHitContainer);
			if (flag)
			{
				IHitRegion specificCursorRegion = CalcHitRegion(paneHitContainer);
				object additionalObject = new ChartFocusedArea(constantLine);
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, constantLine, additionalObject, flag, region, specificCursorRegion, flag);
			}
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, constantLine, null, flag, region, null, flag);
		}

		public void RenderTitle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (titlePainter != null)
			{
				titlePainter.UseSpecificCursor = constantLine.RuntimeTitleEditing;
				titlePainter.Render(renderer, HitTestController);
				ConstantLine.Title.RenderBounds = titlePainter.Bounds.ToRectangle();
			}
		}
	}
	public class GridLineViewData
	{
		private DiagramPoint point1;

		private DiagramPoint point2;

		public DiagramPoint Point1 => point1;

		public DiagramPoint Point2 => point2;

		public static void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, IEnumerable<GridLineViewData> gridLinesViewData, Color color, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			foreach (GridLineViewData gridLinesViewDatum in gridLinesViewData)
			{
				gridLinesViewDatum.Render(renderer, color, lineStyle);
			}
		}

		public GridLineViewData(DiagramPoint point1, DiagramPoint point2)
		{
			this.point1 = point1;
			this.point2 = point2;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (!point1.IsZero && !point2.IsZero)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
				renderer.DrawLine((Point)point1, (Point)point2, color, lineStyle);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}
	}

	public class RadarAxisYLabelViewData
	{
		private readonly RadarAxisYViewData axisViewData;

		private readonly AxisLabelItemList items;

		private RadarAxisY Axis => axisViewData.Axis;

		public AxisLabelItemList Items => items;

		public RadarAxisYLabelViewData(RadarAxisYViewData axisViewData, RadarAxisYMapping mapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData)
		{
			this.axisViewData = axisViewData;
			double diagramStartAngle = (mapping.DiagramMapping.RevertAngle ? (0.0 - Axis.Diagram.StartAngleInDegrees) : Axis.Diagram.StartAngleInDegrees);
			NearTextPosition textPosition = (mapping.DiagramMapping.RevertAngle ? NearTextPosition.Left : NearTextPosition.Right);
			IList<AxisTextItem> primaryItems = gridAndTextData.GetTextData().PrimaryItems;
			int count = primaryItems.Count;
			items = new AxisLabelItemList(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				AxisTextItem axisTextItem = primaryItems[i];
				Point basePoint = (Point)mapping.GetDiagramPoint(axisTextItem.Value, 0, (int)axisViewData.LabelOffset);
				RadarAxisYLabelItem radarAxisYLabelItem = new RadarAxisYLabelItem(Axis.Label, basePoint, axisTextItem, diagramStartAngle, textPosition);
				radarAxisYLabelItem.SetBackgroundElement(Axis.Diagram);
				items.Add(radarAxisYLabelItem);
			}
			items.AdjustPropertiesAndCreatePainters(Axis);
		}

		{
			items.UpdateCorrection(correction);
		}
