		{
			items.Render(renderer, Axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController);
		}
	}
	public class RadarAxisXViewData
	{
		private readonly RadarAxisX axis;

		private readonly GridAndTextData gridAndTextData;

		private readonly AxisLabelItemList labelItems;

		public GridAndTextData GridAndTextData => gridAndTextData;

		public RadarAxisX Axis => axis;

		public AxisLabelItemList LabelItems => labelItems;

		private static float CalcAngle(RadarDiagramMapping mapping, double argument)
		{
			return (float)(mapping.CalcAngle(argument) / Math.PI * 180.0);
		}

		public RadarAxisXViewData(RadarAxisX axis, RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, int indent)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.gridAndTextData = gridAndTextData;
			if (axis.Label.ActualVisibility)
			{
				int indent2 = indent + 3;
				int num = gridAndTextData.GetTextData().PrimaryItems.Count - 1;
				labelItems = new AxisLabelItemList(num);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					AxisTextItem axisTextItem = gridAndTextData.GetTextData().PrimaryItems[i];
					double value = axisTextItem.Value;
					Point basePoint = (Point)diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(value, double.MaxValue, clipValue: false, indent2);
					float angleOnCircleDegree = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle((float)(diagramMapping.CalcAngle(value) * 180.0 / Math.PI) + 90f);
					labelItems.Add(new RadarAxisXLabelItem(axis.Label, basePoint, axisTextItem, angleOnCircleDegree));
				}
				labelItems.AdjustPropertiesAndCreatePainters(axis);
			}
		}

		public void RenderLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (labelItems != null)
			{
				labelItems.Render(renderer, axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (labelItems != null)
			{
				labelItems.UpdateCorrection(correction);
			}
		}

		private static GridLineViewData[] CalculateViewData(RadarAxisXMapping axisMapping, List<double> values)
		{
			if (values.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridLineViewData[] array = new GridLineViewData[values.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Count; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint nearScreenPoint = axisMapping.GetNearScreenPoint(values[i]);
				DiagramPoint farScreenPoint = axisMapping.GetFarScreenPoint(values[i]);
				array[i] = new GridLineViewData(nearScreenPoint, farScreenPoint);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, GridLineViewData[] viewData, Color color, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (viewData != null)
			{
				GridLineViewData.RenderGridLines(renderer, viewData, color, lineStyle);
			}
		}

		public void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarAxisXMapping axisMapping, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (axis.GridLines.Visible)
			{
				RenderGridLines(renderer, CalculateViewData(axisMapping, gridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleGridLineValues), axis.GridLines.GetActualColor(appearance), axis.GridLines.LineStyle);
			}
		}

		public void RenderMinorGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarAxisXMapping axisMapping, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (axis.GridLines.MinorVisible)
			{
				RenderGridLines(renderer, CalculateViewData(axisMapping, gridAndTextData.GridData.MinorItems.VisibleGridLineValues), axis.GridLines.GetActualMinorColor(appearance), axis.GridLines.MinorLineStyle);
			}
		}

		private void RenderCircleInterlacedAreas(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramMapping mapping)
		{
			PolygonFillStyle actualInterlacedFillStyle = axis.ActualInterlacedFillStyle;
			Color actualInterlacedColor = axis.ActualInterlacedColor;
			AxisGridData gridData = gridAndTextData.GridData;
			float num = (float)mapping.Radius;
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in gridData.InterlacedData)
			{
				float num2 = CalcAngle(mapping, interlacedDatum.Near);
				float num3 = CalcAngle(mapping, interlacedDatum.Far);
				float num4 = num3 - num2;
				RectangleF gradientBounds = GraphicUtils.BoundsFromPointsArray(GraphicUtils.FillAnchorPoints(mapping, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num2), MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num4), addCenter: true));
				actualInterlacedFillStyle.Options.RenderPie(renderer, new PointF((float)mapping.Center.X, (float)mapping.Center.Y), num, num, num2, num4, 0f, 0f, gradientBounds, actualInterlacedColor, Color.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void RenderPolygonInterlacedAreas(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramMapping mapping)
		{
			PolygonFillStyle actualInterlacedFillStyle = axis.ActualInterlacedFillStyle;
			Color actualInterlacedColor = axis.ActualInterlacedColor;
			AxisGridData gridData = gridAndTextData.GridData;
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in gridData.InterlacedData)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(3);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(mapping.Center.X, mapping.Center.Y));
				DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(interlacedDatum.Near, double.MaxValue);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y));
				screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(interlacedDatum.Far, double.MaxValue);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y));
				RectangleF boundedRectangle = GraphicUtils.BoundsFromPointsArray(lineStrip);
				if (actualInterlacedFillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient)
				{
					PolygonGradientFillOptions polygonGradientFillOptions = (PolygonGradientFillOptions)actualInterlacedFillStyle.Options;
					if (polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == PolygonGradientMode.ToCenter || polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == PolygonGradientMode.FromCenter)
					{
						boundedRectangle = mapping.MappingBounds;
					}
				}
				actualInterlacedFillStyle.Options.Render(renderer, lineStrip, boundedRectangle, actualInterlacedColor, Color.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void RenderInterlacedAreas(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramMapping mapping)
		{
			if (axis.Interlaced)
			{
				if (axis.Diagram.DrawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
				{
					RenderCircleInterlacedAreas(renderer, mapping);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderPolygonInterlacedAreas(renderer, mapping);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class TickmarkLineBase
	{
		private readonly DiagramPoint left;

		private readonly DiagramPoint right;

		protected DiagramPoint Left => left;

		protected DiagramPoint Right => right;

		protected TickmarkLineBase(DiagramPoint left, DiagramPoint right)
		{
			this.left = left;
			this.right = right;
		}

		public abstract DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath();

		public abstract void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color);
	}
	public class TickmarkLineAsRectangle : TickmarkLineBase
	{
		public TickmarkLineAsRectangle(DiagramPoint left, DiagramPoint right)
			: base(left, right)
		{
		}

		private ZPlaneRectangle CreateRectangle()
		{
			return ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(base.Left, base.Right);
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle((Rectangle)CreateRectangle());
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color)
		{
			renderer.FillRectangle((RectangleF)CreateRectangle(), color);
		}
	}
	public class TickmarkLineAsLine : TickmarkLineBase
	{
		private readonly int thickness;

		public TickmarkLineAsLine(DiagramPoint left, DiagramPoint right, int thickness)
			: base(left, right)
		{
			this.thickness = thickness;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)base.Left, (PointF)base.Right);
				using (DXPen pen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, thickness))
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.Widen(pen);
				}
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color)
		{
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)base.Left, (Point)base.Right, color, thickness);
		}
	}
	public class RadarAxisYTickmarksViewData
	{
		private readonly RadarAxisYMapping mapping;

		private readonly RadarAxisYViewData viewData;

		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private readonly double extent;

		private readonly bool isVerticalOrHorizontal;

		private TickmarkLineBase[] tickmarksLines = new TickmarkLineBase[0];

		private TickmarkLineBase[] minorTickmarksLines = new TickmarkLineBase[0];

		public RadarAxisY Axis => viewData.Axis;

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public TickmarkLineBase[] TickmarkLines => tickmarksLines;

		public TickmarkLineBase[] MinorTickmarkLines => minorTickmarksLines;

		public double Extent => extent;

		private RadarTickmarksY Tickmarks => Axis.Tickmarks;

		private int DrawingLength => viewData.DrawingHalf + Tickmarks.Length;

		private int DrawingCrossLength => viewData.DrawingCrossHalf + Tickmarks.Length;

		private int DrawingMinorLength => viewData.DrawingHalf + Tickmarks.MinorLength;

		private int DrawingMinorCrossLength => viewData.DrawingCrossHalf + Tickmarks.MinorLength;

		private static DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(TickmarkLineBase[] lines)
		{
			if (lines.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				foreach (TickmarkLineBase tickmarkLineBase in lines)
				{
					DXGraphicsPath path = tickmarkLineBase.CreateGraphicsPath();
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
				}
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RadarAxisYTickmarksViewData(RadarAxisYMapping mapping, RadarAxisYViewData viewData, AxisGridData gridData, bool isVerticalOrHorizontal)
		{
			this.mapping = mapping;
			this.viewData = viewData;
			this.isVerticalOrHorizontal = isVerticalOrHorizontal;
			extent = CalculateExtent();
			if (Tickmarks.Visible)
			{
				tickmarksLines = CreateTickmarkMajorLines(gridData);
			}
			if (Tickmarks.MinorVisible)
			{
				minorTickmarksLines = CreateTickmarkMinorLines(gridData);
			}
			bounds = CalculateBounds();
		}

		private double CalculateExtent()
		{
			double val = viewData.Half + Tickmarks.Length;
			double val2 = (Tickmarks.MinorVisible ? (viewData.Half + Tickmarks.MinorLength) : 0);
			return Math.Max(val, val2);
		}

		private TickmarkLineBase[] CreateTickmarkMajorLines(AxisGridData gridData)
		{
			return CreateTickmarkLines(gridData.Items.VisibleTickMarkValues, DrawingLength, Tickmarks.CrossAxis ? DrawingCrossLength : 0, Tickmarks.Thickness);
		}

		private TickmarkLineBase[] CreateTickmarkMinorLines(AxisGridData gridData)
		{
			return CreateTickmarkLines(gridData.MinorItems.VisibleTickMarkValues, DrawingMinorLength, Tickmarks.CrossAxis ? DrawingMinorCrossLength : 0, Tickmarks.MinorThickness);
		}

		private TickmarkLineBase[] CreateTickmarkLines(List<double> values, int length, int crossLength, int thickness)
		{
			TickmarkLineBase[] array = new TickmarkLineBase[values.Count];
			if (isVerticalOrHorizontal)
			{
				ThicknessUtils.SplitToHalves(thickness, out var firstHalf, out var secondHalf);
				for (int i = 0; i < values.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = CreateTickmarkLineAsRectangle(values[i], length, crossLength, firstHalf, secondHalf);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < values.Count; j++)
				{
					array[j] = CreateTickmarkLineAsLine(values[j], length, crossLength, thickness);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private TickmarkLineBase CreateTickmarkLineAsRectangle(double value, int length, int crossLength, int halfFirst, int halfSecond)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(value, halfSecond, length);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(value, -halfFirst, -crossLength);
			return new TickmarkLineAsRectangle(MathUtils.StrongRoundXY(diagramPoint), MathUtils.StrongRoundXY(diagramPoint2));
		}

		private TickmarkLineBase CreateTickmarkLineAsLine(double value, int length, int crossLength, int thickness)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(value, 0, length);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(value, 0, -crossLength);
			return new TickmarkLineAsLine(diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, thickness);
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateBounds()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateGraphicsPath();
			if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
			{
				return GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(dXGraphicsPath.GetBounds());
			}
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath()
		{
			if (tickmarksLines.Length == 0 && minorTickmarksLines.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath2 = CreateGraphicsPath(tickmarksLines);
				if (dXGraphicsPath2 != null)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath2, connect: false);
				}
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath3 = CreateGraphicsPath(minorTickmarksLines);
				if (dXGraphicsPath3 != null)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath3, connect: false);
				}
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class RadarAxisYViewData
	{
		private readonly RadarAxisY axis;

		private readonly GridAndTextData gridAndTextData;

		private readonly RadarAxisYTickmarksViewData tickmarksViewData;

		private readonly RadarAxisYLabelViewData labelViewData;

		private readonly bool isVerticalOrHorizontal;

		private readonly int half;

		private readonly int drawingHalf;

		private readonly int drawingCrossHalf;

		private HitTestController HitTestController => axis.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController;

		public RadarAxisY Axis => axis;

		public RadarAxisYLabelViewData LabelData => labelViewData;

		public int Half => half;

		public int DrawingHalf => drawingHalf;

		public int DrawingCrossHalf => drawingCrossHalf;

		public double LabelOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (tickmarksViewData == null)
				{
					return Half;
				}
				return tickmarksViewData.Extent;
			}
		}

		public bool IsVerticalOrHorizontal => isVerticalOrHorizontal;

		public AxisLabelItemList LabelItems => labelViewData?.Items;

		public RadarAxisYViewData(RadarAxisY axis, RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, bool isVerticalOrHorizontal)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.gridAndTextData = gridAndTextData;
			if (axis.Visible)
			{
				this.isVerticalOrHorizontal = isVerticalOrHorizontal;
				ThicknessUtils.SplitToHalves(axis.Thickness, out half, out var _);
				ThicknessUtils.SplitToHalves(axis.Thickness, ((IHitTest)axis).State, out drawingHalf, out drawingCrossHalf);
				RadarAxisYMapping mapping = new RadarAxisYMapping(diagramMapping);
				if (axis.Tickmarks.Visible || axis.Tickmarks.MinorVisible)
				{
					tickmarksViewData = new RadarAxisYTickmarksViewData(mapping, this, gridAndTextData.GridData, isVerticalOrHorizontal);
				}
				if (axis.Label.ActualVisibility)
				{
					labelViewData = new RadarAxisYLabelViewData(this, mapping, gridAndTextData);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (tickmarksViewData != null)
			{
				correction.Update(tickmarksViewData.Bounds);
			}
			if (labelViewData != null)
			{
				labelViewData.UpdateCorrection(correction);
			}
		}

		private void RenderTickmarks(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (tickmarksViewData != null)
			{
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = tickmarksViewData.CreateGraphicsPath();
				if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, axis, null, new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath));
				}
				TickmarkLineBase[] tickmarkLines = tickmarksViewData.TickmarkLines;
				foreach (TickmarkLineBase tickmarkLineBase in tickmarkLines)
				{
					tickmarkLineBase.Render(renderer, axis.DrawingColor);
				}
				TickmarkLineBase[] minorTickmarkLines = tickmarksViewData.MinorTickmarkLines;
				foreach (TickmarkLineBase tickmarkLineBase2 in minorTickmarkLines)
				{
					tickmarkLineBase2.Render(renderer, axis.DrawingColor);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderInterlacedAreas(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramMapping mapping, RadarDiagramViewData diagramViewData)
		{
			if (!axis.Interlaced)
			{
				return;
			}
			PolygonFillStyle actualInterlacedFillStyle = axis.ActualInterlacedFillStyle;
			Color actualInterlacedColor = axis.ActualInterlacedColor;
			RectangleF rectangleF = mapping.MappingBounds;
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in gridAndTextData.GridData.InterlacedData)
			{
				float num = (float)mapping.GetDistance(interlacedDatum.Near);
				float num2 = (float)mapping.GetDistance(interlacedDatum.Far);
				if ((double)num2 > mapping.Radius)
				{
					num2 = (float)mapping.Radius;
				}
				if (num2 <= num)
				{
					break;
				}
				IPolygon polygon = ((num <= 0f) ? null : diagramViewData.CreatePolygon(mapping.Center, num, mapping.VerticesCount, rectangleF));
				IPolygon polygon2 = diagramViewData.CreatePolygon(mapping.Center, num2, mapping.VerticesCount, rectangleF);
				if (axis.Diagram.DrawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
				{
					if (polygon == null)
					{
						actualInterlacedFillStyle.Options.FillCircle(renderer, new PointF((float)mapping.Center.X, (float)mapping.Center.Y), num2, actualInterlacedColor, Color.Empty);
					}
					else if (num2 > 0f)
					{
						PointF location = new PointF((float)mapping.Center.X, (float)mapping.Center.Y);
						RectangleF gradientRect = new RectangleF(location, default(SizeF));
						gradientRect.Inflate(num2, num2);
						int num3 = (int)Math.Floor(num);
						float num4 = num2 - (float)num3;
						float num5 = (float)num3 + num4 / 2f;
						RectangleF bounds = new RectangleF(location, default(SizeF));
						bounds.Inflate(num5, num5);
						actualInterlacedFillStyle.Options.RenderRing(renderer, bounds, gradientRect, actualInterlacedColor, num4);
					}
					continue;
				}
				LineStrip vertices;
				if (polygon == null)
				{
					vertices = polygon2.Vertices;
				}
				else
				{
					LineStrip vertices2 = polygon.Vertices;
					LineStrip vertices3 = polygon2.Vertices;
					LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip((mapping.VerticesCount + 1) * 2);
					lineStrip.AddRange(vertices2);
					lineStrip.Add(vertices2[0]);
					lineStrip.Add(vertices3[0]);
					for (int num6 = vertices3.Count - 1; num6 >= 0; num6--)
					{
						lineStrip.Add(vertices3[num6]);
					}
					vertices = lineStrip;
				}
				actualInterlacedFillStyle.Options.Render(renderer, vertices, rectangleF, actualInterlacedColor, Color.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void RenderMinorGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RadarDiagramViewData diagramViewData, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (axis.GridLines.MinorVisible)
			{
				RenderGridLines(renderer, CalculateGridLinesViewData(diagramMapping, diagramViewData, gridAndTextData.GridData.MinorItems.VisibleGridLineValues), axis.GridLines.GetActualMinorColor(appearance), axis.GridLines.MinorLineStyle);
			}
		}

		public void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RadarDiagramViewData diagramViewData, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (axis.GridLines.Visible)
			{
				RenderGridLines(renderer, CalculateGridLinesViewData(diagramMapping, diagramViewData, gridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleGridLineValues), axis.GridLines.GetActualColor(appearance), axis.GridLines.LineStyle);
			}
		}

		private List<RadarAxisYGridLineViewData> CalculateGridLinesViewData(RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, RadarDiagramViewData diagramViewData, List<double> values)
		{
			if (values.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RadarDiagram diagram = Axis.Diagram;
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<RadarAxisYGridLineViewData> list = new List<RadarAxisYGridLineViewData>();
			int verticesCount = diagramMapping.VerticesCount;
			RectangleF bounds = diagramMapping.MappingBounds;
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Count; i++)
			{
				float num = (float)diagramMapping.GetDistance(values[i]);
				if (num > 0f)
				{
					list.Add(new RadarAxisYGridLineViewData(diagramViewData.CreatePolygon(diagramMapping.Center, num, verticesCount, bounds)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, List<RadarAxisYGridLineViewData> viewData, Color color, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (viewData == null || viewData.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RadarAxisYGridLineViewData viewDatum in viewData)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
				IPolygon polygon = viewDatum.Polygon;
				if (polygon is CirclePolygon circlePolygon)
				{
					renderer.DrawCircle(new Point((int)circlePolygon.Center.X, (int)circlePolygon.Center.Y), (int)circlePolygon.Radius, color, lineStyle.Thickness, lineStyle);
				}
				else
				{
					LineStrip vertices = polygon.Vertices;
					LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(vertices.Count + 1);
					lineStrip.AddRange(vertices);
					lineStrip.Add(lineStrip[0]);
					renderer.DrawLines(lineStrip, color, lineStyle.Thickness, lineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreateAxisGraphicsPath(Point zeroPoint, Point maxPoint)
		{
			if (zeroPoint.X == maxPoint.X && zeroPoint.Y == maxPoint.Y)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLine(zeroPoint, maxPoint);
				using (DXPen pen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, axis.Thickness))
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.Widen(pen);
				}
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void RenderVerticalOrHorizontalAxis(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarAxisYMapping mapping)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(axis.VisualRangeData.Min, 0, DrawingHalf);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(axis.VisualRangeData.Max, 0, -DrawingCrossHalf);
			if (!(Math.Abs(diagramPoint2.X - diagramPoint.X) < 1.0) || !(Math.Abs(diagramPoint2.Y - diagramPoint.Y) < 1.0))
			{
				RenderTickmarks(renderer);
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(diagramPoint, diagramPoint2);
				renderer.FillRectangle((RectangleF)zPlaneRectangle, axis.DrawingColor);
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, axis, null, new HitRegion((Rectangle)zPlaneRectangle));
			}
		}

		private void RenderObliqueAxis(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarAxisYMapping mapping)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(axis.VisualRangeData.Min, 0, 0);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(axis.VisualRangeData.Max, 0, 0);
			if (!(Math.Abs(diagramPoint2.X - diagramPoint.X) < 1.0) || !(Math.Abs(diagramPoint2.Y - diagramPoint.Y) < 1.0))
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				RenderTickmarks(renderer);
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateAxisGraphicsPath((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2);
				if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, axis, null, new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath));
					int thickness = ThicknessUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitState(axis.Thickness, ((IHitTest)axis).State);
					renderer.DrawLine((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2, axis.DrawingColor, thickness);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RadarDiagramViewData diagramViewData)
		{
			if (axis.Visible)
			{
				RadarAxisYMapping mapping = new RadarAxisYMapping(diagramViewData.DiagramMapping);
				if (IsVerticalOrHorizontal)
				{
					RenderVerticalOrHorizontalAxis(renderer, mapping);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderObliqueAxis(renderer, mapping);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class BindingHelper
	{
		public static readonly Type[] ListTypes = new Type[3]
		{
			typeof(IList),
			typeof(IListSource),
			typeof(IBindingList)
		};

		private static Type[] ConvertToTypeArray(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.Numerical => PredefinedTypesHelper.NumericTypes, 
				ScaleType.DateTime => new Type[1] { typeof(DateTime) }, 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => new Type[1] { typeof(TimeSpan) }, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static string ExtractDataMember(string dataMember, string chartDataMember)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(chartDataMember) && dataMember.StartsWith(chartDataMember + "."))
			{
				return dataMember.Substring(chartDataMember.Length + 1);
			}
			return dataMember;
		}

		public static bool CheckDataType(ScaleType scaleType, Type type)
		{
			if (scaleType != ScaleType.Auto && !PredefinedTypesHelper.IsAssignableFrom(type, ConvertToTypeArray(scaleType)))
			{
				return PredefinedTypesHelper.IsAssignableFrom(type, ListTypes);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool AreAvailableFieldsPresent(object dataSource, ScaleType scaleType, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			if (dataSource != null)
			{
				return AvailableFieldsFinder.Find(dataSource, ConvertToTypeArray(scaleType), calculatedFields);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckDataMember(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, Type[] types, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, bool allowEmptyDataSource = false)
		{
			if (!BindingHelperCore.IsValidDataParams(dataSource, dataMember) || dataSource is IControlRowSourceComponent)
			{
				return true;
			}
			using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment((DataContextBase)(object)dataContext, dataSource, calculatedFields);
			DataBrowser dataBrowser = bindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true);
			if (dataBrowser == null)
			{
				RealTimeSource val = (RealTimeSource)((dataSource is RealTimeSource) ? dataSource : null);
				if (val != null && val.DisplayableProperties.Contains(dataMember))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return allowEmptyDataSource;
			}
			return PredefinedTypesHelper.IsAssignableFrom(dataBrowser.DataSourceType, types);
		}

		public static bool CheckDataMember(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			return CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember, null, calculatedFields);
		}

		public static bool CheckDataMember(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, ScaleType scaleType, bool allowEmptyDataSource = false)
		{
			return CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember, ConvertToTypeArray(scaleType), null, allowEmptyDataSource);
		}

		public static bool CheckDataMember(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, ScaleType scaleType, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, bool allowEmptyDataSource = false)
		{
			return CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember, ConvertToTypeArray(scaleType), calculatedFields, allowEmptyDataSource);
		}

		public static string GetDataMemberName(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string controlDataMember, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment((DataContextBase)(object)dataContext, dataSource, calculatedFields, createDataContextBase: false);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string dataMemberPrefix = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(controlDataMember) ? string.Empty : bindingEnvironment.GetDataMemberDisplayName(controlDataMember));
			return bindingEnvironment.GetDataMemberDisplayName(dataMemberPrefix, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(controlDataMember, dataMember));
		}

		public static bool CheckCollectionDataMember(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			if (!BindingHelperCore.IsValidDataParams(dataSource, dataMember) || dataSource is IControlRowSourceComponent)
			{
				return true;
			}
			using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment((DataContextBase)(object)dataContext, dataSource, calculatedFields);
			return bindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true) is ListBrowser;
		}

		public static DataContext GetDataContext(Chart chart)
		{
			if (chart != null && chart.ContainerAdapter != null)
			{
				return chart.ContainerAdapter.DataContext;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool HasBoundSeries(Chart chart)
		{
			if (chart.DataContainer.ActualDataSource != null)
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(chart.DataContainer.SeriesDataMember);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static object WrapTypeDataSourceIfNeeded(object dataSource)
		{
			Type type = dataSource as Type;
			if (type == null)
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(type));
		}

		public static bool CheckDataMember(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			return CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember, null, null);
		}

		public static string GetDataMemberName(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string chartDataMember, string dataMember)
		{
			return GetDataMemberName(dataContext, dataSource, chartDataMember, dataMember, null);
		}

		public static object UpdateDataAdapter(object dataSource, ISite site, bool designMode)
		{
			if (dataSource != null && designMode && dataSource is DataTable dataTable && site != null && site.Container != null)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				foreach (object component in site.Container.Components)
				{
					arrayList.Add(component);
				}
				return BindingHelper.DetermineDataAdapter((IList)arrayList, dataTable);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class AvailableFieldsFinder : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Type[] types;

		private readonly BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment;

		public static bool Find(object dataSource, Type[] types, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			using AvailableFieldsFinder availableFieldsFinder = new AvailableFieldsFinder(dataSource, calculatedFields, types);
			return availableFieldsFinder.Find(string.Empty, null, new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
		}

		private AvailableFieldsFinder(object dataSource, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, Type[] types)
		{
			this.types = types;
			bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataSource, calculatedFields);
		}

		private bool Find(string name, PropertyDescriptor descriptor, IList<PropertyDescriptor> parentDescriptors)
		{
			if (descriptor != null)
			{
				Type propertyType = descriptor.PropertyType;
				if (propertyType.IsPrimitive || propertyType.Equals(typeof(string)) || propertyType.Equals(typeof(DateTime)) || propertyType.Equals(typeof(decimal)) || propertyType.Equals(typeof(TimeSpan)))
				{
					return PredefinedTypesHelper.IsAssignableFrom(descriptor.PropertyType, types);
				}
			}
			DataBrowser dataBrowser = bindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(name, suppressException: true);
			if (dataBrowser == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				name += ".";
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = dataBrowser.GetItemProperties();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
			{
				if (!parentDescriptors.Contains(item))
				{
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[parentDescriptors.Count + 1];
					parentDescriptors.CopyTo(array, 0);
					array[parentDescriptors.Count] = item;
					if (Find(name + item.Name, item, array))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			IDisposable disposable = bindingEnvironment;
			disposable.Dispose();
		}
	}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart.PaletteName")]
		public string PaletteName
		{
			get
			{
				return palette.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Loading)
				{
					paletteName = value;
				}
				else if (value != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName)
				{
					Palette palette = paletteRepository[value];
					if (palette == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgPaletteNotFound), value));
					}
					Palette = palette;
				}
				else
				{
					Palette = defaultPalette;
				}
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart.AppearanceName")]
		public string AppearanceName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userAppearanceName))
				{
					return userAppearanceName;
				}
				return appearance.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				ChartAppearance chartAppearance = appearanceRepository[value];
				if (chartAppearance == null)
				{
					if (!Loading)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectAppearanceName), value));
					}
					return;
				}
				if (Appearance != chartAppearance)
				{
					userAppearanceName = value;
				}
				Appearance = chartAppearance;
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string AppearanceNameSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return appearance.SerializableName;
			}
			set
			{
				ChartAppearance chartAppearance = appearanceRepository.GetAppearance(value, useDefault: true);
				if (chartAppearance != null)
				{
					Appearance = chartAppearance;
					userAppearanceName = string.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		[NonTestableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(XtraChartsResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Native.Chart.Appearance")]
		public ChartAppearance Appearance
		{
			get
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				if (value != appearance)
				{
					RaiseControlChanging();
					appearance = value;
					string text = value.PaletteName;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName)
					{
						LoadColorsForDefaultPalette(text);
					}
					else
					{
						LoadColorsForDefaultPalette("Module");
					}
					RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly));
				}
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public List<AutoSeriesCheckedStateItem> AutoSeriesCheckedInLegendStates
		{
			get
			{
				List<AutoSeriesCheckedStateItem> list = new List<AutoSeriesCheckedStateItem>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, bool> item in autoSeriesCheckedInLegendStateDictionary)
				{
					list.Add(new AutoSeriesCheckedStateItem
					{
						AutoSeriesName = item.Key,
						CheckState = item.Value
					});
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private static int ZoomValue(int value, double zoomDelta)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)value * zoomDelta) - value;
			if ((num & 1) == 1)
			{
				num += ((num > 0) ? 1 : (-1));
			}
			return value + num;
		}

		public Chart(IChartContainer container)
		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			diagramCache = new DiagramCache();
			drawing2DCache = new Drawing2DCache();
			graphicsCache = new Graphics3DCache();
			textureCache = new OpenGLGraphicsTextureCache();
			dummyDiagramRange = new DummyRangeControlClient();
			sideBySideBarDistance = 0.0;
			sideBySideBarDistanceFixed = 1;
			sideBySideEqualBarWidth = true;
			stackedStepAreaInvertedStep = false;
			bindingProcessor = new ChartBindingProcessor(this);
			isFirstAnimation = true;
			needLayoutUpdate = false;
			loading = false;
			cacheToMemory = false;
			lastBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			crosshairEnabled = (DefaultBoolean)0;
			toolTipEnabled = (DefaultBoolean)2;
			cacheHashCode = 0;
			rightToLeft = (DefaultBoolean)2;
			animationStartMode = ChartAnimationMode.None;
			diagramCompatibility = new DiagramCompatibility();
			hitTestState = new HitTestState();
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			this.container = container;
			containerAdapter = new ChartContainerAdapter(container);
			container.EndLoading += OnEndLoading;
			dataContainer = new DataContainer(this);
			viewController = new ViewController(this);
			base.Owner = viewController;
			legends = new LegendCollection(this);
			titles = new ChartTitleCollection(this);
			fillStyle = new RectangleFillStyle(this, Color.Empty, FillMode.Solid);
			border = new InsideRectangularBorder(this, visible: true, Color.Empty);
			backImage = new BackgroundImage(this);
			padding = new RectangleIndents(this, 5);
			optionsPrint = new ChartOptionsPrint(this);
			emptyChartText = new EmptyChartText(this);
			smallChartText = new SmallChartText(this);
			annotationRepository = new AnnotationRepository(this);
			annotations = new AnnotationCollection(new AnnotationCollectionChartBehavior(this));
			AnnotationNavigation = new AnnotationNavigation(annotationRepository);
			ConstantLineNavigation = new ConstantLineNavigation(this);
			hitTestController = new HitTestController(this);
			appearanceRepository = new AppearanceRepository();
			appearance = appearanceRepository["Default"];
			defaultPalette = new DefaultPalette();
			paletteRepository = new PaletteRepository(new PredefinedPaletteList(), defaultPalette);
			paletteRepository.OnPaletteRemoved = EnsurePalettes;
			palette = defaultPalette;
			paletteBaseColorNumber = 0;
			indicatorsPaletteRepository = new PaletteRepository(new IndicatorsPredefinedPaletteList());
			indicatorsPaletteRepository.OnPaletteRemoved = EnsureIndicatorPalettes;
			indicatorsPalette = indicatorsPaletteRepository.GetAppearancePalette(appearance.IndicatorsPaletteName);
			ResetSummaryFunctions();
			toolTipOptions = new ToolTipOptions(this);
			renderer = new ChartRenderer();
			crosshairOptions = new CrosshairOptions(this);
			SelectionController = CreateSelectionController();
			ActualLegend = CreateLegend();
			autoLayout = DefaultAutoLayout;
			breadcrumbs = new Breadcrumbs(this);
			CreateCustomDrawEventArgs = (ChartGraphicsBase g, Rectangle b) => new CustomPaintEventArgs(g, b);
			waterfallStartBarColor = DefaultTotalColor;
			waterfallSubtotalBarColor = DefaultTotalColor;
			waterfallTotalBarColor = DefaultTotalColor;
			waterfallConnectorColor = DefaultWaterfallConnectorColor;
			waterfallConnectorStyle = new LineStyle(this, 1, antialiasing: false, DashStyle.Solid);
			waterfallValueOptions = new WaterfallRelativeValueOptions(this);
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"SeriesSerializable" => ((IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem)DataContainer).CreateCollectionItem(propertyName, e), 
				"Titles" => new ChartTitle(), 
				"Legends" => new Legend(), 
				"XtraPaletteRepository" => new XtraPaletteWrapper(), 
				"XtraIndicatorsPaletteRepository" => new XtraPaletteWrapper(), 
				"AnnotationRepository" => XtraSerializingUtils.GetKnownContentPropertyInstance(e, SerializationUtils.ChartAssembly, SerializationUtils.PublicNamespace) as Annotation, 
				"SelectedItemsInfos" => new SelectedItemInfo(), 
				"AutoSeriesCheckedInLegendStates" => new AutoSeriesCheckedStateItem(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesSerializable":
				((IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem)DataContainer).SetIndexCollectionItem(propertyName, e);
				break;
			case "Titles":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is ChartTitle title)
				{
					titles.Add(title);
				}
				break;
			case "Legends":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is Legend legend)
				{
					Legends.Add(legend);
				}
				break;
			case "XtraPaletteRepository":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is XtraPaletteWrapper paletteWrapper)
				{
					xtraPaletteRepository.Add(paletteWrapper);
				}
				break;
			case "XtraIndicatorsPaletteRepository":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is XtraPaletteWrapper paletteWrapper2)
				{
					xtraIndicatorsPaletteRepository.Add(paletteWrapper2);
				}
				break;
			case "AnnotationRepository":
			{
				Annotation annotation = ((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value as Annotation;
				if (annotationRepository != null)
				{
					annotationRepository.Add(annotation);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "SelectedItemsInfos":
			{
				SelectedItemInfo value = ((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value as SelectedItemInfo;
				if (SelectedItemsInfos != null)
				{
					((IList)SelectedItemsInfos).Add((object)value);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "AutoSeriesCheckedInLegendStates":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is AutoSeriesCheckedStateItem autoSeriesCheckedStateItem)
				{
					autoSeriesCheckedInLegendStateDictionary[autoSeriesCheckedStateItem.AutoSeriesName] = autoSeriesCheckedStateItem.CheckState;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyPaletteUpdates()
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate = DataContainer.SeriesTemplate;
			if (NeedUpdateColorizer(seriesTemplate.View.Colorizer as IPaletteProvider))
			{
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(DataContainer);
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (!item.IsAutoCreated && (!((IChartDataContainer)DataContainer).DesignMode || ShouldLoadDataInDesignTime) && NeedUpdateColorizer(item.View.Colorizer as IPaletteProvider))
				{
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(item);
				}
			}
			ApplyDataUpdates(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
			ChartElementChange chartElementChange = ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly;
			if (NeedUpdateColorizer(seriesTemplate.SeriesColorizer as IPaletteProvider))
			{
				chartElementChange |= ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems;
			}
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, chartElementChange));
		}

		private void AssignWaterfall(Chart chart)
		{
			waterfallStartBarColor = chart.waterfallStartBarColor;
			waterfallSubtotalBarColor = chart.waterfallSubtotalBarColor;
			waterfallTotalBarColor = chart.waterfallTotalBarColor;
			waterfallConnectorStyle.Assign(chart.waterfallConnectorStyle);
			waterfallConnectorColor = chart.waterfallConnectorColor;
			waterfallValueOptions.Assign(chart.WaterfallValueOptions);
		}

		private void CheckChartAnnotationsBindedToDiagram(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			foreach (Annotation item in AnnotationRepository)
			{
				if (item.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint)
				{
					Axis2D axis = paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis;
					Axis2D axis2 = paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis;
					XYDiagramPaneBase pane = paneAnchorPoint.Pane;
					if (axis == null || (axis != diagram.ActualAxisX && !diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX.ContainsInternal(axis)))
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.ActualAxis = diagram.ActualAxisX;
					}
					if (axis2 == null || (axis2 != diagram.ActualAxisY && !diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY.ContainsInternal(axis2)))
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.ActualAxis = diagram.ActualAxisY;
					}
					if (pane == null || (pane != diagram.DefaultPane && !diagram.Panes.Contains(pane)))
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.SetPane(diagram.DefaultPane);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckChartSeriesViewsBindedToDiagram(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			foreach (SeriesBase item in DataContainer.Series)
			{
				CheckSeriesViewBindedToDiagram(item.View, diagram);
			}
		}

		private void CheckSeriesViewBindedToDiagram(SeriesViewBase seriesView, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (!(seriesView is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase { ActualAxisX: var actualAxisX, ActualAxisY: var actualAxisY, ActualPane: var actualPane } xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			Axis2D actualAxisX2 = diagram.ActualAxisX;
			Axis2D actualAxisY2 = diagram.ActualAxisY;
			if (actualAxisX == null || (actualAxisX != actualAxisX2 && !diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX.ContainsInternal(actualAxisX)))
			{
				xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX = actualAxisX2;
			}
			if (actualAxisY == null || (actualAxisY != actualAxisY2 && !diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY.ContainsInternal(actualAxisY)))
			{
				xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY = actualAxisY2;
			}
			if (actualPane == null || (actualPane != diagram.DefaultPane && !diagram.Panes.Contains(actualPane)))
			{
				xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualPane = diagram.DefaultPane;
			}
			if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Indicator indicator in xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.Indicators)
			{
				if (indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
				{
					bool flag = separatePaneIndicator.AxisY != actualAxisY2 && !diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY.ContainsInternal(separatePaneIndicator.AxisY);
					if (separatePaneIndicator.AxisY == null || flag)
					{
						separatePaneIndicator.ActualAxisY = actualAxisY2;
					}
					bool flag2 = separatePaneIndicator.Pane != diagram.DefaultPane && !diagram.Panes.Contains(separatePaneIndicator.Pane);
					if (separatePaneIndicator.Pane == null || flag2)
					{
						separatePaneIndicator.ActualPane = diagram.DefaultPane;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawContent(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, INativeGraphics nativeGraphics, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle windowsBounds, bool lockDrawingHelper, bool useImageCache, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			if (Disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SafeAllowDirectXRendering && !Is3DDiagram)
			{
				throw new Exception("internal error.");
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				renderer.IsRightToLeft = container.GetActualRightToLeft();
				bool is3DDiagram = Is3DDiagram;
				ViewController.ApplyChangesBeforeRender();
				bool flag = is3DDiagram != Is3DDiagram;
				bool flag2 = nativeGraphics == null || flag;
				if (Is3DDiagram)
				{
					ViewController.BeginDrawing();
					try
					{
						PrepareRenderInternal(bounds);
						using ChartViewData chartViewData = ChartViewData.Create(this, (ZPlaneRectangle)new Rectangle(default(Point), bounds.Size), performRangeCorrection: false);
						if (chartViewData == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						chartViewData.CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper);
						if (flag2)
						{
							INativeGraphics nativeGraphics2;
							if (!chartViewData.IsEmpty)
							{
								nativeGraphics2 = CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, IntPtr.Zero, bounds, windowsBounds, graphicsQuality);
							}
							else
							{
								INativeGraphics nativeGraphics3 = new GdiPlusGraphics(graphics);
								nativeGraphics2 = nativeGraphics3;
							}
							nativeGraphics = nativeGraphics2;
						}
						DrawContent3D(new ChartDrawingContext
						{
							Viewport = bounds,
							Window = bounds,
							NativeGraphics = nativeGraphics,
							NativeRenderer = graphics.CreateNativeRenderer()
						}, lockDrawingHelper, chartViewData);
					}
					finally
					{
						ViewController.EndDrawing();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					LastRenderUsedGL = false;
					if (flag2)
					{
						nativeGraphics = CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, IntPtr.Zero, bounds, windowsBounds, graphicsQuality);
					}
					INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = null;
					if (nativeGraphics is GdiPlusGraphics)
					{
						nativeRenderer = CreateRenderer(graphics, nativeGraphics);
					}
					DrawContent2D(new SingleLayerRendererContext(nativeRenderer), bounds, useImageCache);
					containerAdapter.OnCustomPaint(CreateCustomDrawEventArgs(graphics, bounds));
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					nativeGraphics?.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawContent2D(IRenderContext renderContext, Rectangle bounds, bool useImageCache)
		{
			//IL_0123: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (CanAnimate && AnimationStartMode == ChartAnimationMode.OnLoad && isFirstAnimation && !AnimationInProgress)
			{
				Animate();
				isFirstAnimation = false;
			}
			if (renderContext == null || bounds.Width <= 0 || bounds.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (AnimationInProgress)
			{
				if (animationViewData == null || bounds != lastBounds)
				{
					hitTestController.Clear();
					PrepareRenderInternal(bounds);
					if (animationViewData != null)
					{
						animationViewData.Dispose();
						animationViewData = null;
					}
					animationViewData = viewController.CreateAnimationViewDataAndCalcLayout((ZPlaneRectangle)bounds);
				}
				if (animationViewData != null)
				{
					renderer.IsRightToLeft = container.GetActualRightToLeft();
					renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.Renderer);
					viewController.RenderAnimatedChart(animationViewData, renderer, bounds);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (bounds.Width > 10000 || bounds.Height > 10000 || (LockForExport && EnumExtensions.ToBoolean(AllowDirectXRendering, IsDesignMode)))
				{
					useImageCache = false;
				}
				if (!useImageCache || (!cacheToMemory && !ActualCrosshairEnabled) || !DrawCachedContent2D(renderContext, bounds))
				{
					DrawNonCachedContent2D(renderContext, bounds, shouldUpdateBounds: true, null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawContent3D(ChartDrawingContext context, bool lockDrawingHelper, ChartViewData chartViewData)
		{
			if (!lockDrawingHelper && DrawHighQualityImage(context.NativeRenderer, context.Viewport))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!lockDrawingHelper && drawingHelper != null)
			{
				graphicsCache.GraphicsTree = drawingHelper.GetGraphicsTree(graphicsCache.Container);
			}
			LastRenderUsedGL = !chartViewData.IsEmpty;
			if (LastRenderUsedGL)
			{
				GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = CreateGraphicsCommand(context, lockDrawingHelper, chartViewData);
				renderer.Present();
				if (graphicsCommand != null)
				{
					context.NativeGraphics.Execute(graphicsCommand);
					if (!lockDrawingHelper && context.NativeGraphics.GraphicsQuality == GraphicsQuality.Lowest)
					{
						DrawingHelper.Process(context.Viewport.Size, graphicsCommand);
					}
					else
					{
						graphicsCommand.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (context.Viewport.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				DrawNonCachedContent2D(new SingleLayerRendererContext(context.NativeRenderer), context.Viewport, shouldUpdateBounds: false, chartViewData);
			}
		}

		private void DrawMetafile(DXMetafile metafile, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (Is3DDiagram)
			{
				using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = metafile.CreateGraphics())
				{
					using DXBitmap image = CreateBitmap(bounds.Size);
					iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, 0, 0);
					return;
				}
			}
			using ChartGraphicsBase chartGraphicsBase = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(metafile);
			renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing = chartGraphicsBase.IsGdiPlusGraphics;
			DrawContent(chartGraphicsBase, bounds, useImageCache: false);
			renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing = false;
		}

		protected void DrawNonCachedContent2D(IRenderContext renderContext, Rectangle bounds, bool shouldUpdateBounds, ChartViewData viewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated = false)
		{
			hitTestController.Clear();
			if (shouldUpdateBounds)
			{
				PrepareRenderInternal(bounds);
			}
			RenderContext = renderContext;
			Render(bounds, lockDrawingHelper: true, viewData, autoLayoutUpdated);
		}

		private void EnsureChartAnnotationsBindedToDiagram(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			foreach (Annotation item in AnnotationRepository)
			{
				if (item.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint)
				{
					if (paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.Axis == null)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate.ActualAxis = diagram.ActualAxisX;
					}
					if (paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.Axis == null)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate.ActualAxis = diagram.ActualAxisY;
					}
					if (paneAnchorPoint.Pane == null)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.SetPane(diagram.DefaultPane);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureChartSeriesViewsBindedToDiagram(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			foreach (SeriesBase item in DataContainer.Series)
			{
				EnsureSeriesViewBindedToDiagram(item.View, diagram);
			}
		}

		{

		}

		private void EnsureSeriesViewBindedToDiagram(SeriesViewBase seriesView, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (!(seriesView is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX == null)
			{
				xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX = diagram.ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY == null)
			{
				xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY = diagram.ActualAxisY;
			}
			if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualPane == null)
			{
				xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualPane = diagram.DefaultPane;
			}
			if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.Indicators.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Indicator indicator in xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.Indicators)
			{
				if (indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
				{
					if (separatePaneIndicator.ActualAxisY == null)
					{
						separatePaneIndicator.ActualAxisY = diagram.ActualAxisY;
					}
					if (separatePaneIndicator.ActualPane == null)
					{
						separatePaneIndicator.ActualPane = diagram.DefaultPane;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureXYDiagramBindings(XYDiagram2D xyDiagram)
		{
			if (xyDiagram != null)
			{
				EnsureChartAnnotationsBindedToDiagram(xyDiagram);
				EnsureChartSeriesViewsBindedToDiagram(xyDiagram);
				if (dataContainer.SeriesTemplate != null)
				{
					EnsureSeriesViewBindedToDiagram(dataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View, xyDiagram);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ExportToImageInternal(Stream stream, DXImageFormat format)
		{
			if (containerAdapter.RenderProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (format != DXImageFormat.Unknown)
			{
				using (DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreateBitmap(containerAdapter.RenderProvider.DisplayBounds.Size))
				{
					dXBitmap.Save(stream, format);
					return;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectImageFormat));
		}

		private void ExportToMetafile(Stream stream)
		{
			if (containerAdapter.RenderProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXMetafile dXMetafile = XtraChartsPrintingHelper.CreateMetafileInstance(stream, containerAdapter.RenderProvider.DisplayBounds, DXEmfType.EmfPlusDual);
			try
			{
				isMetafile = true;
				DrawMetafile(dXMetafile, containerAdapter.RenderProvider.DisplayBounds);
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dXMetafile.Dispose();
				isMetafile = false;
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCustomPaintOnSeparateBitmap(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (!containerAdapter.HasCustomPaintEventsListeners)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			try
			{
				using ChartGraphicsBase graphics = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(dXBitmap);
				containerAdapter.OnCustomPaint(CreateCustomDrawEventArgs(graphics, bounds));
			}
			catch
			{
				dXBitmap.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
			renderer.DrawImage(dXBitmap, bounds.Location);
		}

		private void SetObjectSelectionInternal(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalObject, bool forceSelect)
		{

		private bool CorrectOnBoundsChanging(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!Disposed && !Loading)
			{
				diagram.OnUpdateBounds();
				if ((AutoLayout && HasAutoLayoutElements) || diagram.DependsOnBounds)
				{
					PerformViewDataCalculationWithoutEvents(bounds, correctRanges: true);
					diagram.OnUpdateAutomaticLayout();
					result = UpdateAutomaticLayout(bounds);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool DrawCachedContent2D(IRenderContext renderContext, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int num = CalculateDrawingHashCode(bounds.Size);
			if (ShouldUpdateCache(num) && !UpdateCache(bounds, num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			CrosshairViewData crosshairViewData = (ViewController.IsChartEmpty ? null : CalculateCrosshairViewData());
			renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.Renderer);
			bool isWebControl = (Container != null && Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl) || AzureCompatibility.Enable;
			cacheBitmap.Render(renderer, ActualBackColor.A != byte.MaxValue, IsMetafile, isWebControl);
			crosshairViewData?.RenderHighlighting(renderer);
			cacheBitmap.RenderMiddle(renderer);
			crosshairViewData?.Render(renderer);
			cacheBitmap.RenderAbove(renderer);
			cacheBitmap.RenderOverlays(renderer);
			crosshairViewData?.RenderAbove(renderer);
			renderer.Present();
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsContainsChartAnnotations()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < AnnotationRepository.Count; i++)
			{
				if (AnnotationRepository[i].AnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint || AnnotationRepository[i].ShapePosition is FreePosition)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool NeedUpdateColorizer(IPaletteProvider colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer != null && colorizer.GetPalette() == null)
			{
				return string.IsNullOrEmpty(colorizer.GetPaletteName());
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool PrepareRenderInternal(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (diagram != null && (bounds != lastBounds || needLayoutUpdate))
			{
				diagram.ClearResolveOverlappingCache();
				lastBounds = bounds;
				result = CorrectOnBoundsChanging(bounds);
				needLayoutUpdate = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool ShouldUpdateCache(int hashCode)
		{
			if (hashCode == cacheHashCode && cacheBitmap != null && (cacheToMemory || !containerAdapter.HasCustomDrawEventsListeners))
			{
				return dataContainer.IsDrillDownAvailable;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool UpdateAutomaticLayout(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00e8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ee: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0143: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!container.DesignMode && AutoLayout && diagram != null)
			{
				if (!diagram.LastBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					diagram.UpdateAutomaticLayout(diagram.LastBounds);
				}
				List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
				if ((int)breadcrumbs.Visibility == 2)
				{
					list.Add(breadcrumbs);
				}
				List<LegendBase> actualLegends = ActualLegends;
				foreach (LegendBase item in actualLegends)
				{
					if ((int)item.Visibility == 2 && item.ActualDockTarget == null && item.IsOutside)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				foreach (ChartTitle title in Titles)
				{
					if ((int)title.Visibility == 2)
					{
						list.Add(title);
					}
				}
				List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list2 = diagram.GetAutoLayoutElements(bounds);
				if (list2 == null)
				{
					list2 = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
				}
				foreach (LegendBase item2 in actualLegends)
				{
					if ((int)item2.Visibility != 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (VisibilityLayoutRegion item3 in list2)
					{
						item3.ElementsToRemove.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				if (list2.Count == 0)
				{
					list2.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(new GRealSize2D(bounds.Width, bounds.Height), new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>()));
				}
				VisibilityCalculator visibilityCalculator = new VisibilityCalculator(diagram.MinimumLayoutSize);
				return visibilityCalculator.CalculateLayout(list, list2).Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool UpdateCache(Rectangle bounds, int cacheCode)
		{
			bool autoLayoutUpdated = PrepareRenderInternal(bounds);
			if (cacheBitmap != null)
			{
				cacheBitmap.Dispose();
			}
			cacheBitmap = new ChartBitmapCache(bounds, ActualCrosshairHighlightPoints, IsContainsChartAnnotations());
			if (cacheBitmap.IsDisposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DrawNonCachedContent2D(cacheBitmap, bounds, shouldUpdateBounds: false, null, autoLayoutUpdated);
			cacheBitmap.DisposeGraphics();
			cacheHashCode = cacheCode;
			return true;
		}

		private bool UpdateCacheEx(Rectangle bounds, int cacheCode)
		{
			if (cacheBitmap != null && cacheBitmap.Bounds != bounds)
			{
				cacheBitmap.Dispose();
				cacheBitmap = null;
			}
			if (cacheBitmap == null)
			{
				cacheBitmap = new ChartBitmapCache(bounds, ActualCrosshairHighlightPoints, IsContainsChartAnnotations());
			}
			if (cacheBitmap.IsDisposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DrawNonCachedContent2DEx(bounds, RenderContext.Renderer, cacheBitmap);
			cacheBitmap.DisposeGraphics();
			cacheHashCode = cacheCode;
			return true;
		}

		private INativeGraphics CreateNativeGraphicsCore(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle windowsBounds, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			try
			{
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					INativeGraphics nativeGraphics = diagram.CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, hdc, bounds, windowsBounds);
					if (nativeGraphics != null)
					{
						nativeGraphics.GraphicsQuality = graphicsQuality;
						return nativeGraphics;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return new GdiPlusGraphics(graphics);
		}

		internal virtual HitTestParams PerformHitTesting(Point point, IList<HitTestParams> paramsArray, RaiseHitTestingDelegate raiseHitTesting)
		{
			ChartHitInfo hitInfo = new ChartHitInfo(point, paramsArray);
			foreach (HitTestParams item in paramsArray)
			{
				HotTrackEventArgs e = new HotTrackEventArgs(item.Object.Object, GetCorrectAdditionalObject(item.AdditionalObj), hitInfo);
				raiseHitTesting(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected List<object> HitTest(IList<HitTestParams> hitTestParams)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (HitTestParams hitTestParam in hitTestParams)
			{
				IHitTest hitTest = hitTestParam.Object;
				object item = hitTest.Object;
				if (list.IndexOf(item) == -1)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				Disposed = true;
				DataContainer.Dispose();
				ClearCache(shouldDispose: true);
				DisposeDrawingHelper();
				if (container != null)
				{
					container.EndLoading -= OnEndLoading;
				}
				hitTestController.Clear();
				legends.Dispose();
				dataContainer.Dispose();
				foreach (Diagram item in diagramCache)
				{
					if (item is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				diagramCache.Clear();
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					if (diagram is IDisposable disposable2)
					{
						disposable2.Dispose();
					}
					diagram = null;
				}
				Series.Dispose();
				Series.Clear();
				annotationRepository.Clear();
				backImage.Dispose();
				annotationRepository.Dispose();
				if (printer != null)
				{
					printer.Dispose();
				}
				TextMeasurer.Default.Dispose();
				ObjectsFactory.Default.Dispose();
				ActualLegend.Dispose();
				cachedSelectedHitParams?.Dispose();
				animationViewData?.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				Disposed = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAllowDirectXRenderChanged()
		{
			UpdateTextMeasurer();
			if (CreateDirectXRenderer != null)
			{
				ClearCache(shouldDispose: true);
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesSerializable":
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesSerializable();
			case "DataContainer":
				return ShouldSerializeDataContainer();
			case "SeriesTemplate":
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesTemplate();
			case "SeriesNameTemplate":
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesNameTemplate();
			case "Diagram":
				return ShouldSerializeDiagram();
			case "ActualLegend":
				return ActualLegend.ShouldSerialize();
			case "FillStyle":
				return fillStyle.ShouldSerialize();
			case "BackColor":
				return ShouldSerializeBackColor();
			case "SeriesDataMember":
				return ShouldSerializeSeriesDataMember();
			case "BoundSeriesSorting":
				return ShouldSerializeBoundSeriesSorting();
			case "Border":
				if (SupportBorder)
				{
					return border.ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			case "AppearanceName":
				return ShouldSerializeAppearanceName();
			case "PaletteName":
				return ShouldSerializePaletteName();
			case "IndicatorsPaletteName":
				return ShouldSerializeIndicatorsPaletteName();
			case "PaletteBaseColorNumber":
				return ShouldSerializePaletteBaseColorNumber();
			case "BackImage":
				return backImage.ShouldSerialize();
			case "CacheToMemory":
				return ShouldSerializeCacheToMemory();
			case "RefreshDataOnRepaint":
				return ShouldSerializeRefreshDataOnRepaint();
			case "SideBySideBarDistance":
				return ShouldSerializeSideBySideBarDistance();
			case "SideBySideBarDistanceFixed":
				return ShouldSerializeSideBySideBarDistanceFixed();
			case "SideBySideEqualBarWidth":
				return ShouldSerializeSideBySideEqualBarWidth();
			case "StackedStepAreaInvertedStep":
				return ShouldSerializeStackedStepAreaInvertedStep();
			case "OptionsPrint":
				return optionsPrint.ShouldSerialize();
			case "DataMember":
				if (SupportDataMember)
				{
					return ShouldSerializeDataMember();
				}
				return false;
			case "Padding":
				return ShouldSerializePadding();
			case "EmptyChartText":
				return ShouldSerializeEmptyChartText();
			case "SmallChartText":
				return ShouldSerializeSmallChartText();
			case "AutoBindingSettingsEnabled":
				return ShouldSerializeAutoBindingSettingsEnabled();
			case "AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled":
				return ShouldSerializeAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled();
			case "PivotGridDataSourceOptions":
				return ShouldSerializePivotGridDataSourceOptions();
			case "ToolTipOptions":
				return ShouldSerializeToolTipOptions();
			case "CrosshairEnabled":
				return ShouldSerializeCrosshairEnabled();
			case "CrosshairOptions":
				return ShouldSerializeCrosshairOptions();
			case "ToolTipEnabled":
				return ShouldSerializeToolTipEnabled();
			case "RuntimeSelection":
				return ShouldSerializeRuntimeSelection();
			case "SelectedItemsInfos":
				return ShouldSerializeSelectedItemsInfos();
			case "AutoLayout":
				return ShouldSerializeAutoLayout();
			case "RightToLeft":
				return ShouldSerializeRightToLeft();
			case "AnimationStartMode":
				return ShouldSerializeAnimationStartMode();
			case "Breadcrumbs":
				return ShouldSerializeBreadcrumbs();
			case "AutoSeriesCheckedInLegendStates":
				if (DataContainer.SeriesDataMember == null || DataContainer.DataSource == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (Series item in Series)
				{
					if (item.IsAutoCreated)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			case "WaterfallStartBarColor":
				return ShouldSerializeWaterfallStartBarColor();
			case "WaterfallSubtotalBarColor":
				return ShouldSerializeWaterfallSubtotalBarColor();
			case "WaterfallTotalBarColor":
				return ShouldSerializeWaterfallTotalBarColor();
			case "WaterfallConnectorColor":
				return ShouldSerializeWaterfallConnectorColor();
			case "WaterfallConnectorStyle":
				return ShouldSerializeWaterfallConnectorStyle();
			case "WaterfallValueOptions":
				return ShouldSerializeWaterfallValueOptions();
			default:
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
		}

		internal void SelectObjectsAt(ElementsSelectionState state, Point p, bool isMouseDown)
		{
			if (!Is3DDiagram)
			{
				HitTestParams hitTestParams = null;
				if (isMouseDown)
				{
					hitTestParams = (cachedSelectedHitParams = PerformHitTesting(p, hitTestController.Find(p), containerAdapter.OnObjectSelected));
				}
				else
				{
					hitTestParams = ((hitTestController.Items.Count <= 0) ? cachedSelectedHitParams : PerformHitTesting(p, hitTestController.Find(p), containerAdapter.OnObjectSelected));
					cachedSelectedHitParams = null;
				}
				if (hitTestParams != null)
				{
					SelectionController.SelectHitElementInternal(hitTestParams.Object, hitTestParams.AdditionalObj, forceSelect: false, state, hitTestController.FindFocusedArea(p));
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool GetActualCrosshairEnabledForElement(DefaultBoolean elementCrosshairEnabled)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (Container == null || Container.DesignMode || !SupportCrosshair)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)elementCrosshairEnabled != 2)
			{
				if ((int)elementCrosshairEnabled != 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (CrosshairForced)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((int)CrosshairEnabled != 2)
			{
				if ((int)CrosshairEnabled != 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CanDrillDown(Point location)
		{
			if (DataContainer.IsDrillDownAvailable)
			{
				ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = CalcHitInfo(location, forceUpdate: false);
				if (chartHitInfo.InSeriesPoint)
				{
					if (!DataContainer.CanDrillDownToPoint)
					{
						return DataContainer.CanDrillDownToSeries;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (chartHitInfo.InSeries)
				{
					return DataContainer.CanDrillDownToSeries;
				}
				if (chartHitInfo.InAxis && chartHitInfo.AxisLabelItem != null && !chartHitInfo.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return DataContainer.CanDrillDownToArgument;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsPointInLegend(Point location)
		{
			GRealPoint2D point = new GRealPoint2D(location.X, location.Y);
			if (base.Chart.ActualLegend.ActualVisible && base.Chart.ActualLegend.Bounds.Contains(point))
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (Legend legend in base.Chart.Legends)
			{
				if (legend.ActualVisible && legend.Bounds.Contains(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int CalculateDrawingHashCode(Size size)
		{
			IHitTest selected = hitTestController.Selected;
			int num = selected?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
			foreach (object selectedItem in SelectionController.SelectedItems)
			{
				num ^= ((selectedItem != null && !object.Equals(selectedItem, selected)) ? selectedItem.GetHashCode() : 0);
			}
			int num2 = hitTestController.Hot?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
			return ((size.Width << 16) + size.Height) ^ ((num2 << 16) + num);
		}

		protected internal virtual ChartUpdateInfoBase EnsureDiagramType(Type diagramType)
		{
			if (DoNotChangeDiagram)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ChartUpdateInfoBase result = null;
			Type type = ((diagram == null) ? null : diagram.GetType());
			if (type != diagramType)
			{
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					diagramCache.Save(diagram);
					diagram.ClearAnnotations();
					diagram.ClearCrosshairManager();
				}
				if (diagramType != null)
				{
					Diagram oldValue = diagram;
					diagram = diagramCache.Load(diagramType);
					if (diagram == null)
					{
						diagram = (Diagram)Activator.CreateInstance(diagramType);
						diagram.Owner = this;
					}
					if (type != null && ChartContainer is IMvcChartContainer)
					{
						((IMvcChartContainer)Container).OnDiagramChanged();
					}
					diagram.UpdateDiagramProperties(oldValue);
					result = new PropertyUpdateInfo<IDiagram>(this, "Diagram", oldValue, diagram);
				}
				else if (!(Container is IMvcChartContainer))
				{
					diagram = null;
				}
				CheckXYDiagramBindings();
			}
			else
			{
				EnsureXYDiagramBindings(diagram as XYDiagram2D);
			}
			diagramCompatibility.EnsureCompatibility(diagram);
			return result;
		}

		}

		internal Size ScaleSize(Size size)
		{
			int width = MathUtils.StrongRound((float)size.Width * HighDpiScaleFactor.Width);
			int height = MathUtils.StrongRound((float)size.Height * HighDpiScaleFactor.Height);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public void ArrangeAnnotation(Annotation annotation)
		{
			if (!(annotation.ShapePosition is FreePosition freePosition))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			annotation.UpdateSize();
			Rectangle displayBounds = containerAdapter.DisplayBounds;
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)border.CalcBorderedRect(new RectangleF(0f, 0f, displayBounds.Width, displayBounds.Height));
			if (zPlaneRectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				for (int num3 = annotationRepository.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					if (annotationRepository[num3].ShapePosition is FreePosition freePosition2)
					{
						Point point = (Point)freePosition2.GetShapeLocation(zPlaneRectangle);
						num = point.X + Annotation.StartOffset.X;
						num2 = point.Y + Annotation.StartOffset.Y;
						if ((double)(num + annotation.Width) >= zPlaneRectangle.Width)
						{
							num = point.X;
						}
						if ((double)(num2 + annotation.Height) >= zPlaneRectangle.Height)
						{
							num2 = point.Y;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			freePosition.DockTarget = null;
			freePosition.SetLeftIndent(num);
			freePosition.SetTopIndent(num2);
			if (annotation.AnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint chartAnchorPoint)
			{
				chartAnchorPoint.SetPosition(num, num2 + annotation.Height + 20);
			}
		}

		public void DrawWholeContent(INativeRenderer nativeRenderer, Rectangle bounds, float dpi)
		{
			if (Is3DDiagram)
			{
				using (DXBitmap image = CreateBitmap(bounds.Size))
				{
					nativeRenderer.DrawImage(image, bounds);
					return;
				}
			}
			renderer.IsRightToLeft = container.GetActualRightToLeft();
			renderer.SetNativeRenderer(nativeRenderer);
			renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing = !nativeRenderer.CanDrawSegmentedLines;
			UpdateTextMeasurer(dpi);
			viewController.ApplyChangesBeforeRender();
			viewController.RenderWholeChart(renderer, bounds);
			RaiseCustomPaintOnSeparateBitmap(renderer, bounds);
			renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing = false;
		}

		public virtual void HighlightObjectsAt(Point p)
		{
			if (!Is3DDiagram && !AnimationInProgress)
			{
				IHitTest hitElement = null;
				object obj = null;
				HitTestParams hitTestParams = PerformHitTesting(p, hitTestController.Find(p), containerAdapter.OnObjectHotTracked);
				if (hitTestParams != null)
				{
					hitElement = hitTestParams.Object;
					obj = hitTestParams.AdditionalObj;
				}
				if (obj is RefinedPoint)
				{
					HotHitElementInternal(hitElement, ((RefinedPoint)obj).SeriesPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					HotHitElementInternal(hitElement, obj);
				}
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateDrawingHelper()
		{

		public void LoadLayout(Stream stream)
		{
			Chart chart = new Chart(new EmptyChartContainer(container.ControlType));
			try
			{
				XtraSerializingHelper.LoadLayoutFromStream(chart, stream);
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
				throw new ChartLoadingException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgChartLoadingException));
			}
			RaiseControlChanging();
			Assign(chart);
			RaiseControlChanged();
			container.AfterLoadLayout();
		}

		}

		public void OnEndLoading()
		{
			viewController.StartOnEndLoading();
			DataContainer.EndLoadSeries(validatePointsId: true);
			EndLoadAnnotations();
			EndLoadLegends();
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.OnEndLoading();
			}
			if (xtraPaletteRepository != null)
			{
				xtraPaletteRepository.OnEndLoading();
				xtraPaletteRepository = null;
			}
			if (xtraIndicatorsPaletteRepository != null)
			{
				xtraIndicatorsPaletteRepository.OnEndLoading();
				xtraIndicatorsPaletteRepository = null;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(paletteName))
			{
				if (paletteName != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName)
				{
					Palette palette = paletteRepository[paletteName];
					if (palette != null)
					{
						this.palette = palette;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Palette = defaultPalette;
				}
				paletteName = null;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(indicatorsPaletteName))
			{
				Palette palette2 = indicatorsPaletteRepository[indicatorsPaletteName];
				if (palette2 != null)
				{
					indicatorsPalette = palette2;
				}
				indicatorsPaletteName = null;
			}
			if (toolTipOptions != null)
			{
				toolTipOptions.OnEndLoading();
			}
			if (crosshairOptions != null)
			{
				crosshairOptions.OnEndLoading();
			}
			CheckXYDiagramBindings();
			viewController.ResetLoadingFlag();
			if (!viewController.InBoundDataChanged)
			{
				RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: true, resetSeriesBinding: true, raiseChanged: false);
			}
			RaiseControlChanged(new OnLoadEndUpdateInfo(this));
			RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.FinishLoading();
			}
			DataContainer.CheckScaleTypes();
		}

			RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void PerformChanging()
