			RaiseControlChanging();
		}

		public void PerformGestureRotation(double degreeDelta, IAnnotationDragPoint annotationDragPoint)
		{
			if (annotationDragPoint != null && annotationDragPoint.Annotation.RuntimeRotation)
			{
				annotationDragPoint.Annotation.SetAngle(MathUtils.StrongRound(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree((double)annotationDragPoint.Annotation.Angle + degreeDelta)));
			}
			else if (diagram == null || !diagram.PerformGestureRotation(0.0 - degreeDelta))
			{
				return;
			}
			RedrawChart();
		}

		public void PerformGestureZoom(double zoomDelta, IAnnotationDragPoint annotationDragPoint)
		{
			if (annotationDragPoint != null && annotationDragPoint.Annotation.RuntimeResizing)
			{
				annotationDragPoint.Annotation.SetWidth(ZoomValue(annotationDragPoint.Annotation.Width, zoomDelta));
				annotationDragPoint.Annotation.SetHeight(ZoomValue(annotationDragPoint.Annotation.Height, zoomDelta));
				RedrawChart();
			}
			else if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.PerformGestureZoom(zoomDelta);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessMouseDownAt(Point p, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (CanDrillDown(p))
			{
				ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = CalcHitInfo(p);
				if (chartHitInfo.InSeriesPoint)
				{
					DrillDownToSeriesPoint(GetDrillDownSeriesPointObject(chartHitInfo.SeriesPoint.Tag));
				}
				else if (chartHitInfo.InSeries)
				{
					DrillDownToSeries(chartHitInfo.Series);
				}
				else if (chartHitInfo.InAxis && chartHitInfo.AxisLabelItem != null)
				{
					DrillDownToArgument(chartHitInfo.AxisLabelItem.AxisValue);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SelectObjectsAt(p, isMouseDown: true, modifierKeys);
			}
		}

		public void RefreshData(bool forceRefresh)
		{
			bindingProcessor.RefreshData(new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(), this);
			foreach (Series item in DataContainer.Series)
			{
				item.OnDataPropertyChanged();
				item.UpdateFilterCriteria();
			}
			DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.OnDataPropertyChanged();
			DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.UpdateFilterCriteria();
			if (forceRefresh || !DataContainer.RefreshDataOnRepaint)
			{
				ViewController.OnEndLoading();
				RaiseControlChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
			}
			if (Is3DDiagram)
			{
				ResetGraphicsCache();
				InvalidateDrawingHelper();
			}
			containerAdapter.Invalidate();
		}

		public void SelectObjectsAt(Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (Is3DDiagram)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<HitTestParams> list = hitTestController.Find(rect);
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>(list.Count);
			if (SeriesSelectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series)
			{
				foreach (HitTestParams item2 in list)
				{
					if (item2.Object is Series item)
					{
						list2.Add(item);
					}
				}
				SelectionController.SelectSeries(list2);
				return;
			}
			foreach (HitTestParams item3 in list)
			{
				if (item3.AdditionalObj != null)
				{
					list2.Add(item3.AdditionalObj);
				}
			}
			SelectionController.SelectPoints(list2);
		}

		public void DrillDownHighlightObjectAt(Point location)
		{
			if (!Is3DDiagram && !AnimationInProgress)
			{
				IHitTest hitElement = null;
				object obj = null;
				HitTestParams hitTestParams = PerformHitTesting(location, hitTestController.Find(location), containerAdapter.OnObjectHotTracked);
				if (hitTestParams != null)
				{
					hitElement = hitTestParams.Object;
					obj = hitTestParams.AdditionalObj;
				}
				if (obj is RefinedPoint)
				{
					SelectionController.DrillDownHotElement(hitElement, ((RefinedPoint)obj).SeriesPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectionController.DrillDownHotElement(hitElement, obj);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool DrawHighQualityImage(INativeRenderer nativeRenderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (drawingHelper == null || !drawingHelper.IsImageReady)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DXImage image = drawingHelper.GetImage();
			if (image != null)
			{
				if (image.Size == bounds.Size)
				{
					nativeRenderer.DrawImage(image, bounds);
					return true;
				}
				image.Dispose();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != diagram && !legends.Contains(obj) && !Series.Contains(obj) && !titles.Contains(obj) && !annotationRepository.Contains(obj) && !DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.Contains(obj))
			{
				if (diagram == null || !diagram.Contains(obj))
				{
					return obj == ActualLegend;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public double GetTotalAnimationDuration()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			IList<RefinedSeries> activeRefinedSeries = ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in activeRefinedSeries)
			{
				SeriesViewBase seriesViewBase = (SeriesViewBase)item.SeriesView;
				if (seriesViewBase.ActualSeriesAnimation != null && seriesViewBase.ActualSeriesAnimation.CanAnimate)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, seriesViewBase.ActualSeriesAnimation.TotalDuration);
				}
				if (seriesViewBase.ActualSeriesPointAnimation != null)
				{
					int pointsCount = item.MaxVisiblePointIndex - item.MinVisiblePointIndex;
					num = Math.Max(num, seriesViewBase.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.GetTotalDuration(pointsCount));
				}
				if (!(seriesViewBase is XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Indicator indicator in xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.Indicators)
				{
					if (indicator.Animation != null && indicator.Animation.CanAnimate)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, indicator.Animation.TotalDuration);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public DXMetafile CreateMetafile(Size size, float? dpi)
		{
			XtraChartsPrintingHelper.CheckSize(size);
			float? dPI = DPI;
			UpdateTextMeasurer(dpi);
			Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, size);
			DXMetafile dXMetafile = XtraChartsPrintingHelper.CreateMetafileInstance(null, bounds, DXEmfType.EmfPlusOnly);
			try
			{
				isMetafile = true;
				DrawMetafile(dXMetafile, bounds);
				return dXMetafile;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXMetafile.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				isMetafile = false;
				UpdateTextMeasurer(dPI, forceUpdateDPI: true);
			}
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_031a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_031f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0326: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_032b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			loading = true;
			base.Assign(obj);
			if (!(obj is Chart chart))
			{
				return;
			}
			ShouldLoadDataInDesignTime = chart.ShouldLoadDataInDesignTime;
			rightToLeft = chart.rightToLeft;
			fillStyle.Assign(chart.fillStyle);
			backColor = chart.backColor;
			if (SupportDataMember)
			{
				DataContainer.DataMember = chart.DataContainer.DataMember;
			}
			if (SupportBorder)
			{
				border.Assign(chart.border);
			}
			backImage.Assign(chart.backImage);
			titles.Assign(chart.titles);
			DataContainer.Assign(chart.DataContainer);
			legends.Assign(chart.legends);
			ActualLegend.Assign(chart.ActualLegend);
			ChartUpdateInfoBase changeInfo;
			if (chart.diagram == null)
			{
				changeInfo = EnsureDiagramType(null);
			}
			else
			{
				changeInfo = EnsureDiagramType(chart.diagram.GetType());
				diagram.Assign(chart.diagram);
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					diagram.OnEndLoading();
				}
			}
			autoLayout = chart.autoLayout;
			annotationRepository.Assign(chart.annotationRepository);
			sideBySideBarDistance = chart.sideBySideBarDistance;
			sideBySideBarDistanceFixed = chart.sideBySideBarDistanceFixed;
			sideBySideEqualBarWidth = chart.sideBySideEqualBarWidth;
			stackedStepAreaInvertedStep = chart.stackedStepAreaInvertedStep;
			paletteRepository.Assign(chart.paletteRepository);
			palette = ((chart.Palette.Name != DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName) ? paletteRepository.GetPaletteByName(chart.palette.Name) : defaultPalette);
			indicatorsPaletteRepository.Assign(chart.indicatorsPaletteRepository);
			indicatorsPalette = indicatorsPaletteRepository.GetPaletteByName(chart.indicatorsPalette.Name);
			appearance = appearanceRepository[chart.appearance.SerializableName];
			if (container != null && container.ControlType != ChartContainerType.XRControl)
			{
				appearance.Assign(chart.Appearance);
			}
			LoadColorsForDefaultPalette(chart.defaultPalette.ActualPaletteName);
			paletteBaseColorNumber = chart.paletteBaseColorNumber;
			CacheToMemory = chart.cacheToMemory;
			((BaseOptions)optionsPrint).Assign((BaseOptions)(object)chart.optionsPrint);
			if (printer != null && chart.printer != null)
			{
				printer.Assign(chart.printer);
			}
			DataContainer.EndLoadSeries(validatePointsId: false);
			EndLoadAnnotations();
			EndLoadLegends();
			summaryFunctions.Assign(chart.summaryFunctions);
			padding.Assign(chart.padding);
			emptyChartText.Assign(chart.emptyChartText);
			smallChartText.Assign(chart.smallChartText);
			SelectionMode = (SupportRuntimeSelection ? chart.SelectionMode : ElementSelectionMode.None);
			SeriesSelectionMode = chart.SeriesSelectionMode;
			toolTipOptions.Assign(chart.toolTipOptions);
			crosshairEnabled = chart.crosshairEnabled;
			toolTipEnabled = chart.toolTipEnabled;
			crosshairOptions.Assign(chart.crosshairOptions);
			animationStartMode = chart.animationStartMode;
			breadcrumbs.Assign(chart.breadcrumbs);
			AssignWaterfall(chart);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, bool> item in chart.autoSeriesCheckedInLegendStateDictionary)
			{
				autoSeriesCheckedInLegendStateDictionary[item.Key] = item.Value;
			}
			RaiseControlChanged(changeInfo);
			loading = false;
			SelectionController.Assign(chart.SelectionController);
			if (containerAdapter.ShouldRaiseOnDeserializeEventsListeners)
			{
				containerAdapter.OnDeserialized(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			ViewController.OnEndLoading();
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.FinishLoading();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateDpiProvider(IChartDpiProvider dpiProvider)
		{
			this.dpiProvider = dpiProvider ?? EmptyChartDpiProvider.Instance;
			UpdateTextMeasurer();
		}

		public void Draw2DContentEx(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, INativeGraphics nativeGraphics, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (graphics == null || nativeGraphics == null || bounds == Rectangle.Empty || containerAdapter == null || viewController == null || renderer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				ViewController.ApplyChangesBeforeRender();
				INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = CreateDirectXRenderer(nativeGraphics, (renderContext is SingleLayerRendererContext) ? renderContext.Renderer : null);
				renderContext = new SingleLayerRendererContext(nativeRenderer);
				renderer.IsRightToLeft = container.GetActualRightToLeft();
				renderer.AllowLineOptimization = false;
				RenderAnimationRelatedStuff(bounds);
				if (!AnimationInProgress)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					PrepareRenderInternal(bounds);
					if (!flag || (!cacheToMemory && !ActualCrosshairEnabled) || !DrawCachedContent2DEx(renderContext, bounds))
					{
						DrawNonCachedContent2DEx(bounds, nativeRenderer, null);
					}
				}
				containerAdapter.OnCustomPaint(CreateCustomDrawEventArgs(graphics, bounds));
			}
		}

		private ChartViewData CalculateViewData(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			ChartViewData chartViewData = ChartViewData.ReCreate(this, (ZPlaneRectangle)bounds, performRangeCorrection: false, null);
			chartViewData?.CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper: false, !renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing);
			return chartViewData;
		}

		private void DrawNonCachedContent2DEx(Rectangle bounds, INativeRenderer nativeRenderer, ChartBitmapCache bitmapCache)
		{
			hitTestController.Clear();
			ChartViewData chartViewData = CalculateViewData(bounds);
			if (chartViewData != null)
			{
				viewController.RenderChartEx(renderer, nativeRenderer, chartViewData, bitmapCache);
			}
		}

		private bool DrawCachedContent2DEx(IRenderContext renderContext, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			CrosshairViewData crosshairViewData = CalculateCrosshairViewData();
			if (crosshairViewData == null || crosshairViewData.CrosshairPaneViewDataList.Count <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = CalculateDrawingHashCode(bounds.Size);
			if (ShouldUpdateCache(num) && !UpdateCacheEx(bounds, num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.Renderer);
			bool isWebControl = Container != null && Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl;
			cacheBitmap.Render(renderer, ActualBackColor.A != byte.MaxValue, IsMetafile, isWebControl);
			crosshairViewData = CalculateCrosshairViewData();
			crosshairViewData.RenderHighlighting(renderer);
			cacheBitmap.RenderMiddle(renderer);
			crosshairViewData.Render(renderer);
			cacheBitmap.RenderAbove(renderer);
			cacheBitmap.RenderOverlays(renderer);
			crosshairViewData.RenderAbove(renderer);
			renderer.Present();
			return true;
		}

		private void RenderAnimationRelatedStuff(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (CanAnimate && AnimationStartMode == ChartAnimationMode.OnLoad && isFirstAnimation && !AnimationInProgress)
			{
				Animate();
				isFirstAnimation = false;
			}
			if (bounds.Width > 0 && bounds.Height > 0 && AnimationInProgress)
			{
				if (animationViewData == null || bounds != lastBounds)
				{
					hitTestController.Clear();
					PrepareRenderInternal(bounds);
					animationViewData = viewController.CreateAnimationViewDataAndCalcLayout((ZPlaneRectangle)bounds);
				}
				if (animationViewData != null)
				{
					renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.Renderer);
					viewController.RenderAnimatedChart(animationViewData, renderer, bounds);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ChartBindingProcessor : BindingProcessorBase
	{
		private readonly IChartBindingProvider chartBindingProvider;

		private IList<ISeries> autoCreatedSeries;

		protected override bool ShouldBreakUpdates => true;

		public ChartBindingProcessor(IChartBindingProvider chartBindingProvider)
		{
			this.chartBindingProvider = chartBindingProvider;
			base.ElementHelper = chartBindingProvider as IUpdateHelper;
		}

		private ISeries AddBoundPoint(IList<ISeries> autocreatedSeries, int index)
		{
			SimpleChartBindingProcedure simpleChartBindingProcedure = new SimpleChartBindingProcedure(chartBindingProvider.SeriesDataMember, chartBindingProvider.SeriesFactory, allowCachedUpdates: false);
			return simpleChartBindingProcedure.AddBoundPoint(autocreatedSeries, index);
		}

		private bool ApplyInsertUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < update.Count; i++)
			{
				ISeries series = AddBoundPoint(autoCreatedSeries, update.Index + i);
				if (series != null)
				{
					int index = series.ActualPoints.Count - 1;
					NotifyPointInsert(series, series.ActualPoints[index], index);
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override Tuple<bool, bool, bool> ProcessUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool item = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (chartBindingProvider.IsValidMembersForBinding)
			{
				if (update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert)
				{
					flag = ApplyInsertUpdate(update);
					item = !flag;
				}
				flag2 = false;
			}
			else
			{
				autoCreatedSeries = new List<ISeries>();
				item = true;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, bool, bool>(flag, flag2, item);
		}
	}
	public class BitmapCache : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private IDisposable image;

		private ChartGraphicsBase graphics;

		private bool isDisposed;

		public bool IsDisposed => isDisposed;

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public virtual bool IsEmpty => graphics == null;

		public ChartGraphicsBase Graphics
		{
			get
			{
				if (graphics == null)
				{
					graphics = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics((DXBitmap)image);
				}
				return graphics;
			}
		}

		public IDisposable Image
		{
			get
			{
				return image;
			}
			set
			{
				image = value;
			}
		}

		public BitmapCache(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			try
			{
				image = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
			catch
			{
				Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected void DisposeGraphics(ChartGraphicsBase gr)
		{
			gr?.Dispose();
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeImages()
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				image.Dispose();
				image = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual void DisposeGraphics()
		{
			DisposeGraphics(graphics);
			graphics = null;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeGraphics();
			DisposeImages();
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (image is DXImage)
			{
				renderer.DrawImage((DXImage)image, Bounds.Location);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartBitmapCache : BitmapCache, IRenderContext
	{
		private readonly List<DXBitmap> imageOverlays = new List<DXBitmap>();

		private readonly List<ChartGraphicsBase> graphicsOverlays = new List<ChartGraphicsBase>();

		private readonly List<Point> locationOverlays = new List<Point>();

		private IDisposable imageMiddle;

		private IDisposable imageAbove;

		private ChartGraphicsBase graphicsMiddle;

		private ChartGraphicsBase graphicsAbove;

		public override bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsEmpty && graphicsAbove == null)
				{
					return graphicsMiddle == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IDisposable ImageMiddle
		{
			get
			{
				return imageMiddle;
			}
			set
			{
				imageMiddle = value;
			}
		}

		public IDisposable ImageAbove
		{
			get
			{
				return imageAbove;
			}
			set
			{
				imageAbove = value;
			}
		}

		bool IRenderContext.SupportOverlays => true;

		INativeRenderer IRenderContext.Renderer => base.Graphics.CreateNativeRenderer();

		INativeRenderer IRenderContext.RendererMiddle
		{
			get
			{
				if (imageMiddle == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (graphicsMiddle == null)
				{
					graphicsMiddle = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics((DXBitmap)imageMiddle);
				}
				return graphicsMiddle.CreateNativeRenderer();
			}
		}

		INativeRenderer IRenderContext.RendererAbove
		{
			get
			{
				if (imageAbove == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (graphicsAbove == null)
				{
					graphicsAbove = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics((DXBitmap)imageAbove);
				}
				return graphicsAbove.CreateNativeRenderer();
			}
		}

		public ChartBitmapCache(Rectangle bounds, bool useMiddleLayer, bool useAboveLayer)
			: base(bounds)
		{
			try
			{
				if (useMiddleLayer)
				{
					imageMiddle = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				}
				if (useAboveLayer)
				{
					imageAbove = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				Dispose();
			}
		}

		INativeRenderer IRenderContext.CreateOverlayRenderer(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			locationOverlays.Add(bounds.Location);
			DXBitmap item = new DXBitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			imageOverlays.Add(item);
			ChartGraphicsBase chartGraphicsBase = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(item);
			graphicsOverlays.Add(chartGraphicsBase);
			INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = chartGraphicsBase.CreateNativeRenderer();
			nativeRenderer.TranslateModel(-bounds.X, -bounds.Y);
			return nativeRenderer;
		}

		private void DisposeOverlays()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < graphicsOverlays.Count; i++)
			{
				DisposeGraphics(graphicsOverlays[i]);
			}
			graphicsOverlays.Clear();
			for (int j = 0; j < imageOverlays.Count; j++)
			{
				imageOverlays[j].Dispose();
			}
			imageOverlays.Clear();
			locationOverlays.Clear();
		}

		protected override void DisposeImages()
		{
			base.DisposeImages();
			if (imageMiddle != null)
			{
				imageMiddle.Dispose();
				imageMiddle = null;
			}
			if (imageAbove != null)
			{
				imageAbove.Dispose();
				imageAbove = null;
			}
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			base.Dispose();
			DisposeOverlays();
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, bool isTransparentBackground, bool isMetaFile, bool isWebControl)
		{
			if (base.Image != null)
			{
				if (!(base.Image is DXImage dXImage) || (base.Bounds.Location.IsEmpty && !isTransparentBackground && !isMetaFile && !isWebControl))
				{
					renderer.DrawImageFast(base.Image);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.DrawImage(dXImage, base.Bounds.Location);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (imageMiddle != null)
			{
				if (imageMiddle is DXImage dXImage)
				{
					renderer.DrawImage(dXImage, base.Bounds.Location);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.DrawImageFast(imageMiddle);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (imageAbove != null)
			{
				if (imageAbove is DXImage dXImage)
				{
					renderer.DrawImage(dXImage, base.Bounds.Location);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.DrawImageFast(imageAbove);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderOverlays(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < imageOverlays.Count; i++)
			{
				renderer.DrawImage(imageOverlays[i], locationOverlays[i]);
			}
		}

		public override void DisposeGraphics()
		{
			base.DisposeGraphics();
			DisposeGraphics(graphicsMiddle);
			graphicsMiddle = null;
			DisposeGraphics(graphicsAbove);
			graphicsAbove = null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BitmapContainerBase : IDisposable
	{
		private Size size;

		private GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality;

		private DXBitmap bitmap;

		private ChartGraphicsBase graphics;

		private INativeGraphics nativeGraphics;

		protected DXBitmap Bitmap => bitmap;

		public Size Size => size;

		internal INativeGraphics NativeGraphics => nativeGraphics;

		public BitmapContainerBase(Size size, float? dpi, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			this.size = size;
			this.graphicsQuality = graphicsQuality;
			bitmap = SafeBitmapCreator.CreateBitmap(size, dpi);
		}

		private void DisposeNativeGraphics()
		{
			if (nativeGraphics != null)
			{
				nativeGraphics.Dispose();
				nativeGraphics = null;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeGraphics()
		{
			if (graphics != null)
			{
				graphics.Dispose();
				graphics = null;
			}
		}

		private void Finish()
		{
			DisposeNativeGraphics();
			DisposeGraphics();
		}

		protected ChartGraphicsBase GetBitmapGraphics()
		{
			return DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(bitmap);
		}

		protected void DisposeBitmap()
		{
			if (bitmap != null)
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
				bitmap = null;
			}
		}

		protected void Start()
		{
			if (bitmap != null)
			{
				Finish();
				graphics = GetBitmapGraphics();
				nativeGraphics = CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, IntPtr.Zero, size, graphicsQuality);
			}
		}

		protected DXBitmap PrepareBitmap()
		{
			if (bitmap != null)
			{
				Finish();
			}
			return bitmap;
		}

		protected abstract INativeGraphics CreateNativeGraphics(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, IntPtr intPtr, Size size, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality);

		protected abstract DXBitmap GetBitmap();

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			Finish();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartBitmapContainer : BitmapContainerBase
	{
		protected Chart Chart { get; }

		private static ChartBitmapContainer CreateInstance(Chart chart, Size size, float? dpi, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality, bool isChart3D)
		{
			if (isChart3D)
			{
				return new ChartBitmapContainer3D(chart, size, dpi, graphicsQuality);
			}
			return new ChartBitmapContainer2D(chart, size, dpi, graphicsQuality);
		}

		public static ChartBitmapContainer CreateInstance(Chart chart, Size size, float? dpi, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			return CreateInstance(chart, size, dpi, graphicsQuality, chart.Is3DDiagram);
		}

		public static DXBitmap Draw(Chart chart, Size size, float? dpi, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			using ChartBitmapContainer chartBitmapContainer = CreateInstance(chart, size, dpi, graphicsQuality);
			try
			{
				chartBitmapContainer.DrawChart(lockDrawingHelper: true);
				return chartBitmapContainer.GetBitmap();
			}
			catch
			{
				chartBitmapContainer.DisposeBitmap();
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ChartBitmapContainer(Chart chart, Size size, float? dpi, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
			: base(size, dpi, graphicsQuality)
		{
			Chart = chart;
		}

		protected override INativeGraphics CreateNativeGraphics(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, IntPtr intPtr, Size size, GraphicsQuality graphicsQuality)
		{
			return Chart.CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, IntPtr.Zero, size, graphicsQuality);
		}

		public void DrawChart(bool lockDrawingHelper)
		{
			using ChartGraphicsBase chartGraphicsBase = GetBitmapGraphics();
			Chart.DrawContent(chartGraphicsBase, base.NativeGraphics, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, base.Size), lockDrawingHelper, useImageCache: true);
		}
	}

			using ChartBitmapContainer3D chartBitmapContainer3D = new ChartBitmapContainer3D(chart, size, null, GraphicsQuality.Highest);

					return chartBitmapContainer3D.GetBitmap();
				}
			}
			catch

			}
			chartBitmapContainer3D.DisposeBitmap();
			return null;
		}

			: base(chart, size, dpi, graphicsQuality)
		{
			Start();
		}

		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = PrepareBitmap();
			if (base.Chart.LastRenderUsedGL)
			{
				dXBitmap.FlipVertical();
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public DXBitmap GetBitmapCopy()
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = PrepareBitmap();
			if (dXBitmap == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXBitmap dXBitmap2 = dXBitmap.CloneBitmap();
			if (base.Chart.LastRenderUsedGL)
			{
				dXBitmap2.FlipVertical();
			}
			Start();
			return dXBitmap2;
		}
	}

	public class ChartDrawingContext
	{

	public delegate void DrawCompleteDelegate();
	public class ChartDrawingHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Chart chart;

		private readonly ManualResetEvent exitEvent;

		private readonly AutoResetEvent startDrawImageEvent;

		private readonly AutoResetEvent startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent;

		private Thread buildGraphicsTreeThread;

		private Thread drawImageThread;

		private DXBitmap image;

		private Node graphicsTree;

		private Size imageSize;

		private GraphicsCommand command;

		private bool imageReady;

		private bool graphicsTreeReady;

		private bool disposed;

		private PrimitivesContainer primitivesContainer;

		public bool IsImageReady => imageReady;

		public ChartDrawingHelper(Chart chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			exitEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
			startDrawImageEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
			startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
			image = null;
		}

		~ChartDrawingHelper()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !disposed)
			{
				disposed = true;
				exitEvent.Set();
				if (buildGraphicsTreeThread != null)
				{
					buildGraphicsTreeThread.Join();
				}
				if (drawImageThread != null)
				{
					drawImageThread.Join();
				}
				DisposeGraphicsCommand();
				DisposeImage();
				startDrawImageEvent.Close();
				startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.Close();
				exitEvent.Close();
			}
		}

		private void DisposeImage()
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				image.Dispose();
				image = null;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (command != null)
			{
				command.Dispose();
				command = null;
			}
		}

		private void DrawImageLoop()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					WaitHandle.WaitAny(new WaitHandle[2] { exitEvent, startDrawImageEvent });
					if (exitEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
					{
						startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.Set();
						continue;
					}
					GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand;
					lock (this)
					{
						graphicsCommand = command;
						if (graphicsCommand == null)
						{
							chart.ContainerAdapter.InvokeInvalidate();
							continue;
						}
						command = null;
						imageReady = false;
						DisposeImage();
					}
					try
					{
						image = ChartBitmapContainer3D.Draw(chart, imageSize, graphicsCommand);
					}
					finally
					{
						graphicsCommand.Dispose();
					}
					if (image == null)
					{
						startDrawImageEvent.Reset();
					}
					lock (chart)
					{
						if (startDrawImageEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
						{
							startDrawImageEvent.Set();
						}
						else if (startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
						{
							startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.Set();
						}
						else if (image != null)
						{
							imageReady = true;
							if (!disposed)
							{
								chart.ContainerAdapter.InvokeInvalidate();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void BuildGraphicsTreeLoop()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					WaitHandle.WaitAny(new WaitHandle[2] { exitEvent, startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent });
					if (exitEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
					{
						break;
					}
					PrimitivesContainer container;
					lock (this)
					{
						graphicsTreeReady = false;
						container = primitivesContainer;
					}
					if (startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
					{
						startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.Set();
						continue;
					}
					graphicsTree = GraphicsHelper.BuildGraphicsTree(container);
					if (startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.WaitOne(0, exitContext: false))
					{
						startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.Set();
						continue;
					}
					lock (chart)
					{
						imageReady = false;
						startDrawImageEvent.Set();
						graphicsTreeReady = true;
						if (!disposed)
						{
							chart.ContainerAdapter.InvokeInvalidate();
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void Process(PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			if (buildGraphicsTreeThread == null)
			{
				buildGraphicsTreeThread = new Thread(BuildGraphicsTreeLoop);
				buildGraphicsTreeThread.Name = "BuildGraphicsTree";
				buildGraphicsTreeThread.Priority = ThreadPriority.BelowNormal;
				buildGraphicsTreeThread.IsBackground = true;
				buildGraphicsTreeThread.Start();
			}
			imageReady = false;
			graphicsTreeReady = false;
			primitivesContainer = container;
			startBuildGraphicsTreeEvent.Set();
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				imageReady = false;
			}
		}

		public void Process(Size imageSize, GraphicsCommand command)
		{
			if (drawImageThread == null)
			{
				drawImageThread = new Thread(DrawImageLoop);
				drawImageThread.Name = "DrawImage";
				drawImageThread.Priority = ThreadPriority.BelowNormal;
				drawImageThread.IsBackground = true;
				drawImageThread.Start();
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				imageReady = false;
				this.imageSize = imageSize;
				DisposeGraphicsCommand();
				this.command = command;
				startDrawImageEvent.Set();
			}
		}

		public Node GetGraphicsTree(PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				if (container == primitivesContainer)
				{
					if (graphicsTreeReady)
					{
						return graphicsTree;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Process(container);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DXImage GetImage()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				return image?.Clone();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartViewData : IDisposable
	{
		private const int maxFontSize = 11;

		private const int minFontSize = 2;

		private const System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		private const System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		private readonly string fontFamilyName = "Microsoft Sans Serif";

		private readonly Chart chart;

		private readonly Diagram diagram;

		private readonly List<LegendBase> legends;

		private readonly ZPlaneRectangle bounds;

		private readonly ZPlaneRectangle innerBounds;

		private readonly ZPlaneRectangle excludeTitlesBounds;

		private readonly DiagramViewData diagramViewData;

		private readonly IList<DockableTitleViewData> titlesViewData;

		private readonly BreadcrumbsViewData breadcrumbsViewData;

		private readonly List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList = new List<LegendViewData>();

		private readonly IList<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;

		private bool seriesLayoutIsCalculated;

		private bool isDisposed;

		private bool DesignMode => chart.Container.DesignMode;

		private bool HasData
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					if (!(diagram is ISimpleDiagram))
					{
						return ViewController.HasDataToPresent;
					}
					return ViewController.HasProcessedNotEmptyPoints;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldShowEmptyChartText => !HasData;

		private bool ShouldShowSmallChartText
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					if (ShouldShowEmptyChartText)
					{
						if (DesignMode)
						{
							return string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetTextForDesignModeNoDataPresentation());
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagramViewData == null || diagramViewData.IsEmpty)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!(diagramViewData is XYDiagramViewData xYDiagramViewData))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (diagram is XYDiagram && !xYDiagramViewData.IsCorrectPaneViewDataCount)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (diagram is SwiftPlotDiagram && !xYDiagramViewData.IsCorrectPaneViewDataCount)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DiagramViewData DiagramViewData => diagramViewData;

		public LegendViewData LegendViewData
		{
			get
			{
				if (legendViewDataList.Count > 0)
				{
					return legendViewDataList[0];
				}
				if (diagramViewData != null && diagramViewData.LegendViewDataList != null && diagramViewData.LegendViewDataList.Count > 0)
				{
					return diagramViewData.LegendViewDataList[0];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public List<LegendViewData> LegendViewDataList => legendViewDataList;

		public ViewController ViewController => chart.ViewController;

		public SeriesContainerDataList ContainerDataList { get; } = new SeriesContainerDataList();

		internal IList<DockableTitleViewData> TitleViewDatas => titlesViewData;

		public static ChartViewData ReCreate(Chart chart, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, bool performRangeCorrection, ChartViewData pViewData)
		{
			if (pViewData != null && pViewData.chart == chart && pViewData.bounds.Equals(bounds))
			{
				return pViewData;
			}
			return Create(chart, bounds, performRangeCorrection);
		}

		public static ChartViewData Create(Chart chart, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, bool performRangeCorrection, bool autoLayoutUpdated = false)
		{
			if (!bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)chart.Border.CalcBorderedRect((RectangleF)bounds);
			if (!zPlaneRectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ChartViewData(chart, bounds, zPlaneRectangle, performRangeCorrection, autoLayoutUpdated);
		}

		private ChartViewData(Chart chart, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, ZPlaneRectangle innerBounds, bool performRangeCorrection, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.innerBounds = innerBounds;
			Rectangle rectangle = chart.Padding.DecreaseRectangle((Rectangle)innerBounds);
			breadcrumbsViewData = CalculateBreadcrumbsViewData(ref rectangle);
			titlesViewData = chart.Titles.CalculateViewDataAndBoundsWithoutTitle(ref rectangle);
			excludeTitlesBounds = (ZPlaneRectangle)rectangle;
			legends = chart.ActualLegends;
			diagram = chart.Diagram;
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator = new GeometryCalculator();
				Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> dictionary = new Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>>(legends.Count);
				foreach (LegendBase legend in legends)
				{
					dictionary.Add(legend, new List<ILegendItemData>());
				}
				bool flag = true;
				bool isCrosshairContentExistInLegends = false;
				SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate = chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate;
				bool showColorizerInLegend = seriesTemplate.View.ShowColorizerInLegend;
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
				{
					SeriesContainerData containerData;
					bool flag2 = FindSeriesContainerData(item, out containerData);
					Series series = (Series)item.Series;
					RefinedSeriesDataBase refinedSeriesDataBase = series.View.CreateSeriesData(item, geometryCalculator, containerData, containerData.SeriesDataList.Count);
					if (!series.IsAutoCreated || !showColorizerInLegend)
					{
						FillLegendItems(dictionary, refinedSeriesDataBase.GetLegendItems(), ref isCrosshairContentExistInLegends);
					}
					if (!item.IsEmpty && series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
					{
						containerData.SeriesDataList.Add(refinedSeriesDataBase);
						if (!flag2)
						{
							ContainerDataList.Add(containerData);
						}
					}
					flag &= item.IsEmpty || !series.Visible;
				}
				if (showColorizerInLegend && seriesTemplate.ActualLegend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
				{
					FillLegendItems(dictionary, ColorizerLegendItemsCreator.CreateItems(seriesTemplate), ref isCrosshairContentExistInLegends);
				}
				chart.SetCrosshairContentExistInLegends(isCrosshairContentExistInLegends);
				IList<ILegendItemData> legendItems = diagram.GetLegendItems();
				foreach (ILegendItemData item2 in legendItems)
				{
					dictionary[item2.Legend].Add(item2);
				}
				foreach (LegendBase legend2 in legends)
				{
					dictionary[legend2].AddRange(legend2.CustomItems);
				}
				Rectangle rectangle2 = OutLegendsViewDataCalculator.CalculateLegendsViewData(legends, legendViewDataList, dictionary, rectangle);
				chart.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateByDiagramBounds(rectangle2, ContainerDataList.AllSeriesData);
				diagramViewData = CreateDiagramViewData(rectangle2, ContainerDataList, performRangeCorrection, dictionary, flag, autoLayoutUpdated);
				diagram.LastBounds = rectangle2;
			}
			annotationsViewData = chart.AnnotationRepository.CreateViewData(diagramViewData, innerBounds);
		}

		private void FillLegendItems(Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendsItems, List<ILegendItemData> legendItems, ref bool isCrosshairContentExistInLegends)
		{
			foreach (ILegendItemData legendItem in legendItems)
			{
				legendsItems[legendItem.Legend].Add(legendItem);
				isCrosshairContentExistInLegends |= legendItem.RepresentedObject != null && legendItem.RepresentedObject.CrosshairLegendTextVisible;
			}
		}

		private BreadcrumbsViewData CalculateBreadcrumbsViewData(ref Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (chart.Breadcrumbs.ActualVisible && chart.DataContainer.IsDrillDownAvailable)
			{
				DrillDownState state = (DesignMode ? chart.DataContainer.GetDesignModeDrillDownState() : chart.DataContainer.DrillDownState);
				return chart.Breadcrumbs.CreateViewData(state, ref bounds);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DiagramViewData CreateDiagramViewData(Rectangle diagramBounds, SeriesContainerDataList seriesContainerDataList, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			return diagram.CalculateViewData(seriesContainerDataList, diagramBounds, performRangeCorrection, legendItems, isEmptyDiagramViewData, autoLayoutUpdated);
		}

		private RectangleFillStyle GetActualFillStyle()
		{
			RectangleFillStyle rectangleFillStyle = (RectangleFillStyle)chart.FillStyle.Clone();
			if (diagram is Diagram3D && rectangleFillStyle.Options is RectangleGradientFillOptions rectangleGradientFillOptions)
			{
				rectangleGradientFillOptions.InvertGradientMode();
			}
			return rectangleFillStyle;
		}

		private void RenderSmallChartText(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (!ShouldShowSmallChartText)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (chart.ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider != null)
			{
				chart.ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider.OnSmallChartTextShowing(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(chart.SmallChartText.Text) || !ShouldShowSmallChartText)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = (float)(innerBounds.Width * 0.05);
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)innerBounds.Left + num, (float)innerBounds.Bottom, (float)innerBounds.Width - num * 2f, (float)innerBounds.Height);
			float num2 = GraphicUtils.CalcFontEmSize(rectangleF, chart.SmallChartText.Text, chart.SmallChartText.DXFont.Name, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			if (num2 != 0f)
			{
				DXFont dXFont = chart.SmallChartText.DXFont;
				if (num2 > dXFont.SizeInPoints)
				{
					num2 = dXFont.SizeInPoints;
				}
				renderer.DrawBoundedText(chart.SmallChartText.Text, dXFont.DpiScale(num2), chart.SmallChartText.ActualTextColor, chart.SmallChartText, rectangleF, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
		}

		private string GetTextForDesignModeNoDataPresentation()
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (ViewController.ActiveSeriesCount == 0 && !chart.ShouldUseSeriesTemplate)
			{
				result = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyChart);
			}
			else if (diagramViewData == null && diagram != null)
			{
				result = diagram.GetInvisibleDiagramMessage();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void RenderDesignModeNoDataPresentation(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			string textForDesignModeNoDataPresentation = GetTextForDesignModeNoDataPresentation();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(textForDesignModeNoDataPresentation))
			{
				return;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = (RectangleF)excludeTitlesBounds;
			float num = GraphicUtils.CalcFontEmSize(rectangleF, textForDesignModeNoDataPresentation, fontFamilyName, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			if (!(num < 2f))
			{
				if (num > 11f)
				{
					num = 11f;
				}
				DXFont font = new DXFont(fontFamilyName, num);
				renderer.DrawBoundedText(textForDesignModeNoDataPresentation, font.DpiScale(), GraphicUtils.XorColor(chart.ActualBackColor), new AntialiasingSupport(chart.EmptyChartText, defaultAntialiasing: true), rectangleF, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
		}

		private void RenderNoDataPresentation(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			EmptyChartText emptyChartText = chart.EmptyChartText;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(emptyChartText.Text))
			{
				renderer.DrawBoundedText(emptyChartText.Text, emptyChartText.DXFont.DpiScale(), emptyChartText.ActualTextColor, emptyChartText, (RectangleF)excludeTitlesBounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
		}

		private void RenderTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if ((diagramViewData == null && !DesignMode && HasData) || titlesViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockableTitleViewData titlesViewDatum in titlesViewData)
			{
				titlesViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderBreadcrumbs(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (diagramViewData != null && breadcrumbsViewData != null)
			{
				breadcrumbsViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderEmptyChartText(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (!ShouldShowEmptyChartText)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in chart.Series)
			{
				if (item.Visible && item.CheckableInLegend && !item.CheckedInLegend && item.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (DesignMode)
			{
				RenderDesignModeNoDataPresentation(renderer);
			}
			else
			{
				RenderNoDataPresentation(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RectangularBorder border = chart.Border;
			HitTestState hitTestState = (chart.ContainerAdapter.EnableChartHitTesting ? ((IHitTest)chart).State : new HitTestState());
			Color actualColor = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(chart).WholeChartAppearance.BorderColor, hitTestState);
			BorderHelper.RenderBorder(renderer, border, (Rectangle)bounds, hitTestState, border.ActualThickness, actualColor);
		}

		private bool FindSeriesContainerData(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, out SeriesContainerData containerData)
		{
			SeriesContainer container = ViewController.GetSeriesContainer(refinedSeries);
			containerData = ContainerDataList.Find((SeriesContainerData data) => data.Container == container);
			if (containerData == null)
			{
				containerData = new SeriesContainerData(container);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (titlesViewData != null)
			{
				foreach (DockableTitleViewData titlesViewDatum in titlesViewData)
				{
					titlesViewDatum.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (ContainerDataList != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesContainerData containerData in ContainerDataList)
				{
					foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData in containerData.SeriesDataList)
					{
						seriesData.DisposeCustomImageAndFont();
					}
				}
			}
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public void CalculateLayout(bool lockDrawingHelper)
		{
			CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper, allowOptimization: true);
		}

		public void CalculateLayout(bool lockDrawingHelper, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			if (!seriesLayoutIsCalculated)
			{
				if (diagramViewData != null)
				{
					diagramViewData.CalculateSeriesAndLabelLayout(lockDrawingHelper ? null : chart.DrawingHelper, allowOptimization);
				}
				seriesLayoutIsCalculated = true;
			}
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			HitTestController hitTestController = chart.HitTestController;
			if (hitTestController.Enabled)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new HitTestingGraphicsCommand(hitTestController, chart, new HitRegion((Rectangle)innerBounds)));
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = chart.BackImage.CreateGraphicsCommand(innerBounds);
			if (graphicsCommand2 == null)
			{
				WholeChartAppearance wholeChartAppearance = ((IChartAppearance)chart.Appearance).WholeChartAppearance;
				BackgroundImage backImage = wholeChartAppearance.BackImage;
				if (backImage != null)
				{
					graphicsCommand2 = backImage.CreateGraphicsCommand(innerBounds);
				}
				if (graphicsCommand2 == null)
				{
					RectangleFillStyle actualFillStyle = GetActualFillStyle();
					Color actualBackColor = chart.ActualBackColor;
					graphicsCommand2 = ((actualBackColor.A == byte.MaxValue && actualFillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Solid) ? new BackgroundSolidRectangleGraphicsCommand(innerBounds, actualBackColor) : actualFillStyle.CreateGraphicsCommand(innerBounds, actualBackColor, Color.Empty));
				}
			}
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			if (diagramViewData != null)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(diagramViewData.CreateGraphicsCommand());
			}
			DXBitmap image = SafeBitmapCreator.CreateBitmap(bounds.Size, chart.DPI);
			using (ChartGraphicsBase graphics = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(image))
			{
				ChartRenderer chartRenderer = DrawingUtils.CreateChartRenderer(graphics);
				RenderSmallChartText(chartRenderer);
				RenderEmptyChartText(chartRenderer);
				RenderBreadcrumbs(chartRenderer);
				RenderTitles(chartRenderer);
				RenderMiddle(chartRenderer);
				RenderAbove(chartRenderer, null);
				chartRenderer.Present();
			}
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(default(Point), bounds.Size);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new GdiImageGraphicsCommand(rect, image));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(chart.HitTestController, chart, null, new HitRegion((Rectangle)innerBounds));
			BackgroundImage backImage = chart.BackImage;
			if (backImage == null || backImage.DXImage == null)
			{
				backImage = ((IChartAppearance)chart.Appearance).WholeChartAppearance.BackImage;
			}
			if (backImage != null && backImage.DXImage != null)
			{
				backImage.Render(renderer, (Rectangle)innerBounds);
			}
			else
			{
				RectangleFillStyle actualFillStyle = GetActualFillStyle();
				actualFillStyle.RenderBackground(renderer, (RectangleF)innerBounds, chart.ActualBackColor);
			}
			if (diagramViewData != null)
			{
				diagramViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
			RenderSmallChartText(renderer);
			RenderEmptyChartText(renderer);
			RenderTitles(renderer);
			RenderBreadcrumbs(renderer);
		}

		public void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (diagramViewData != null)
			{
				diagramViewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
			}
			RenderLegends(renderer);
			RenderBorder(renderer);
		}

		private void RenderLegends(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LegendViewData legendViewData in legendViewDataList)
			{
				legendViewData.Render(renderer, diagramViewData.GetLegendMappingBounds(legendViewData.Legend));
			}
		}

		public void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext)
		{
			bool flag = ((annotationsViewData != null && diagramViewData != null) || DesignMode || !HasData) && annotationsViewData.Count > 0;
			if (renderContext != null && flag)
			{
				renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.RendererAbove);
			}
			if (diagramViewData != null)
			{
				diagramViewData.RenderAbove(renderer, renderContext, !flag);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}
	}

				{
					SeriesContainerData current = enumerator.Current;
					foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData in current.SeriesDataList)
					{

					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

			get
			{

				{

						DrillDownState parent = drillDownState;
						while (!parent.IsRoot)
						{
							drillDownStateItems.Insert(0, parent.GetCurrentStateItem());

					}
				}
				return drillDownStateItems;

		private static bool IsAdapterAvailable(ISeriesTemplateAdapter adapter)
		{
			SeriesTemplateAdapter seriesTemplateAdapter = adapter as SeriesTemplateAdapter;
			if (adapter != null)
			{
				if (seriesTemplateAdapter != null)
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesTemplateAdapter.DataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Series]);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsSeriesTemplateAvailable(SeriesTemplate template)
		{
			if (template != null && template.Visible)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(template.SeriesDataMember))
				{
					return IsAdapterAvailable(template.DataAdapter);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DataContainer(Chart chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			series = new SeriesCollection(this);
			seriesTemplate = new SeriesTemplate();
			seriesTemplate.Owner = this;
			seriesNameTemplate = new SeriesNameTemplate(this);
			autocreatedSeries = new ISeries[0];
			refreshDataOnRepaint = false;
			bindingLocked = false;
			lockDataSourceEventsSubscription = false;
			dataMember = string.Empty;
			boundSeriesSorting = SortingMode.None;
			pivotGridDataSourceOptions = new PivotGridDataSourceOptions(this);
			dataSourceEventManager = new EmptySourceEventManager(this, null);
			calculatedFieldCollection = new ChartCalculatedFieldCollection(this);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(this, args);
			dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddRange(CloneDataSourceUpdates(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection));
			DataWasChanged(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(this, args);
			dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddRange(CloneDataSourceUpdates(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection));
			DataWasChanged(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(object sender, DataChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)args.DataChangedType == 1)
			{
				PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateAutoBindingSettings();
			}
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(this);
			dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddRange(CloneDataSourceUpdates(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection));
			DataWasChanged(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return propertyName switch
			{
				"SeriesSerializable" => new Series(), 
				"DrillDownStates" => SerializationUtils.CreateContentNativePropertyValue(e), 
				"CalculatedFields" => new ChartCalculatedField(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesSerializable":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is Series series)
				{
					Series.Add(series);
				}
				break;
			case "DrillDownStates":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is DrillDownStateItemBase item)
				{
					drillDownStateItems.Add(item);
				}
				break;
			case "CalculatedFields":
				if (((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value is ChartCalculatedField calculatedField)
				{
					CalculatedFields.Add(calculatedField);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private Series[] CreateSeriesSerializableArray()
		{
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>(Series.Count);
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (!item.Autocreated)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private bool ApplyDrillDownStateItem(DrillDownStateItemBase item)
		{
			if (item is SeriesPointDrillDownStateItem)
			{
				SeriesPointDrillDownStateItem seriesPointDrillDownStateItem = (SeriesPointDrillDownStateItem)item;
				if (seriesPointDrillDownStateItem.SeriesIndex < Series.Count)
				{
					Series series = Series[seriesPointDrillDownStateItem.SeriesIndex];
					if (seriesPointDrillDownStateItem.PointIndex < series.ActualSeriesPoints.Count)
					{
						DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series);
						return DrillDownToPoint(series, dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(series.ActualPoints[seriesPointDrillDownStateItem.PointIndex]));
					}
				}
			}
			if (item is SeriesDrillDownStateItem)
			{
				SeriesDrillDownStateItem seriesDrillDownStateItem = (SeriesDrillDownStateItem)item;
				if (seriesDrillDownStateItem.SeriesIndex < Series.Count)
				{
					return DrillDownToSeries(Series[seriesDrillDownStateItem.SeriesIndex]);
				}
			}
			if (item is ArgumentDrillDownStateItem)
			{
				ArgumentDrillDownStateItem argumentDrillDownStateItem = (ArgumentDrillDownStateItem)item;
				return DrillDownToArgument(argumentDrillDownStateItem.Argument);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ApplyInsertUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<IBindingProvider> updates)
		{
			foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < update.Count; i++)
				{
					if (AddBoundPoint(autocreatedSeries, update.Index + i) is Series series)
					{
						int index = series.ActualPoints.Count - 1;
						series.NotifyPointInsert(series.ActualPoints[index], index);
						continue;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanCheckDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			if (!base.Chart.Loading && dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return ValidateDataMembers;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnDrillDownStateChanging(DrillDownState state)
		{
			if (ContainerAdapter != null && ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider != null && !lockDrillDownEvents)
			{
				DrillDownStateChangingEventArgs e = new DrillDownStateChangingEventArgs(DrillDownItem.CollectItems(state, shouldClearBreadcrumbItemText: true));
				return ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider.OnDrillDownStateChanging(e);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldRefreshData()
		{
			if (!refreshDataOnRepaint)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataSource != null && !(DataSource is IBindingList))
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.ShouldRefreshData())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			return PivotGridDataSourceOptions.ShouldSerialize();
		}
