		{
			return SeriesNameTemplate.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSeriesTemplate()
		{
			return SeriesTemplate.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		private DataContext GetDataContext()
		{
			return base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider?.DataContext;
		}

		private DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection CloneDataSourceUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.IsAutoCreated || item.ActualDataSource != null || item.GetDataSource() != ActualDataSource || string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ActualArgumentDataMember))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
				{
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(item, update.Type, update.Index, update.Count));
				}
			}
			return dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesBase> GetSeriesWithoutDataSource()
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.ActualDataSource == null && !item.IsAutoCreated)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureDataSourceAdapter(DataSourceAdapterBase dataSourceAdapter)
		{
			if (dataSourceAdapter != null)
			{
				dataSourceAdapter.ChartDataSource = ActualDataSource;
				dataSourceAdapter.ChartDataMember = DataMember;
				dataSourceAdapter.CalculatedFields = CalculatedFields;
				if (SeriesTemplate.DataContext != null)
				{
					dataSourceAdapter.DataContext = (DataContextBase)(object)SeriesTemplate.DataContext;
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<ISeries> GetActualAutocreatedSeries(SeriesTemplate template)
		{
			ISeriesTemplateAdapter actualAdapter = template.ActualAdapter;
			SeriesTemplateAdapter seriesTemplateAdapter = actualAdapter as SeriesTemplateAdapter;
			EnsureDataSourceAdapter(seriesTemplateAdapter);
			IDataSourceColorizer dataSourceColorizer = template.SeriesColorizer as IDataSourceColorizer;
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper;
			if (!IsDesignMode && dataSourceColorizer != null && dataSourceColorizer.DataSource == null)
			{
				seriesTemplateAdapter?.EnsureColorizer(dataSourceColorizer);
				dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(template, dataSourceColorizer);
			}
			else
			{
				dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(template);
			}
			return dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeries((SortMode)BoundSeriesSorting, null);
		}

		private bool IsCustomAdapter(ISeriesTemplateAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (adapter != null)
			{
				return !(adapter is SeriesTemplateAdapter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IList<ISeries> GetAutocreatedSeries()
		{
			if (ShouldUseSeriesTemplate)
			{
				if ((ActualDataSource != null || IsCustomAdapter(SeriesTemplate.DataAdapter)) && base.Chart.CanUseBoundPoints && CanGetAutocreatedSeries)
				{
					IList<ISeries> actualAutocreatedSeries = GetActualAutocreatedSeries(SeriesTemplate);
					if (actualAutocreatedSeries.Count > 0)
					{
						return actualAutocreatedSeries;
					}
				}
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					return GetTempAutocreatedSeries();
				}
			}
			return new ISeries[0];
		}

		private IList<ISeries> GetTempAutocreatedSeries()
		{
			if (tempAutocreatedSeries == null)
			{
				CreateTempAutocreatedSeries();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateTempAutocreatedSeries();
			}
			return tempAutocreatedSeries;
		}

		private ISeries AddBoundPoint(IList<ISeries> autocreatedSeries, int index)
		{
			IChartDataAdapter actualAdapter = SeriesTemplate.ActualAdapter;
			EnsureDataSourceAdapter(actualAdapter as DataSourceAdapterBase);
			return new DataAdapterHelper(SeriesTemplate).AddBoundPoint(autocreatedSeries, index, allowCachedUpdates: true);
		}

		private SeriesPoint FindPointByUserObject(Series series, object userObject)
		{
			DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series);
			IList<SeriesPoint> list = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoints(series.ActualSeriesPoints);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = list[i];
				if (TagList.ContainsTag(seriesPoint.Tag, userObject) || seriesPoint.Tag == userObject)
				{
					return seriesPoint;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void AddAutocreatedSeriesToSeriesCollection(IList<ISeries> realAutocreatedSeries)
		{
			for (int num = realAutocreatedSeries.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Series series = (Series)realAutocreatedSeries[num];
				Series.Insert(0, series);
				chart.AddAutoSeriesToCheckStateDictionary(series);
			}
		}

		private void AssignTempAutocreatedSeries(IList<ISeries> sourceSeries)
		{
			if (sourceSeries != null)
			{
				tempAutocreatedSeries = new List<ISeries>(3);
				for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
				{
					Series series = new Series
					{
						Autocreated = true,
						Permanent = true
					};
					series.Assign((Series)sourceSeries[i]);
					tempAutocreatedSeries.Add(series);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AttachToDataSource(object source, bool isDataSourceDeleted)
		{
			InvalidateBackCompatibilityAdapters(needResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType: true);
			seriesTemplate.ResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType();
			if (source == Convert.DBNull)
			{
				source = null;
			}
			if ((dataSource != null || source == null) && (dataSource == null || dataSource.Equals(source)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.Chart.Loading && !IsDesignMode && !(source is IControlRowSourceComponent))
			{
				CheckBindingRuntime(source);
			}
			RaiseControlChanging();
			SetDataSource(source, isDataSourceDeleted);
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.UpdateFilterCriteria();
			}
			seriesTemplate.UpdateFilterCriteria();
			ProcessChangeBinding();
			RaiseControlChanged(new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "DataSource"));
		}

		private void CheckBindingRuntime(object source, string dataMember, string seriesDataMember, string argumentDataMember, string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			CheckDataMember(source, dataMember);
			CheckNestedDataMember(source, seriesDataMember);
			SeriesTemplate.CheckBindingRuntime(source, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
			foreach (SeriesBase item in GetSeriesWithoutDataSource())
			{
				item.CheckBindingRuntime(source);
			}
		}

		private void CheckColorizer(ChartPaletteColorizerBase colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(colorizer.PaletteName))
			{
				Palette paletteByName = base.Chart.PaletteRepository.GetPaletteByName(colorizer.PaletteName);
				if (paletteByName == null)
				{
					colorizer.PaletteName = base.Chart.DefaultPalette.Name;
					colorizer.Palette = base.Chart.DefaultPalette;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckColorizerDataMembersAndResetMappings(SeriesDataSourceColorizer colorizer)
		{
			object source = colorizer.DataSource ?? ActualDataSource;
			CheckDataMember(source, colorizer.SeriesColorMember);
			CheckDataMember(source, colorizer.SeriesKeyMember);
			colorizer.ResetMappings();
		}

		private void CheckDataMember(object source, string member)
		{
			if (CanCheckDataMember(source, member) && !BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataContext, source, member, CalculatedFields))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDataMember), member));
			}
		}

		private void CheckDataSourcesDeleting(object source)
		{
			if (source == DataSource)
			{
				AttachToDataSource(null, isDataSourceDeleted: true);
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (source == item.DataSource)
				{
					item.DataSource = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Clear(bool isSourceDeleted)
		{
			object obj = dataSource;
			IChartDataSource val = (IChartDataSource)((obj is IChartDataSource) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Chart.EnableLoadingMode();
			try
			{
				ClearDrillDownState();
				if (isSourceDeleted || SeriesDataMember == val.SeriesDataMember)
				{
					SeriesDataMember = null;
				}
				if (isSourceDeleted || SeriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember == val.ArgumentDataMember)
				{
					SeriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember = null;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers.Count; i++)
				{
					if (isSourceDeleted || SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers[i] == val.ValueDataMember)
					{
						SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers[i] = string.Empty;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Chart.DisableLoadingMode();
			}
		}

		private void ClearDrillDownState()
		{
			base.Chart.Breadcrumbs.ClearItemsCache();
			drillDownState = null;
		}

		private void CreateTempAutocreatedSeries()
		{
			tempAutocreatedSeries = new List<ISeries>();
			string text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SeriesPrefix);
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				Series series = CreateSeries(text + (i + 1));
				series.Autocreated = true;
				series.Permanent = true;
				tempAutocreatedSeries.Add(series);
			}
		}

		private void DataWasChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (!item.IsAutoCreated)
				{
					item.UpdateFilterCriteria();
				}
			}
			SeriesTemplate.UpdateFilterCriteria();
			IChartDataProvider dataProvider = base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider;
			if (dataProvider != null && dataProvider.DataContext != null)
			{
				DataBrowser obj = ((DataContextBase)dataProvider.DataContext)[DataSource];
				ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((obj is ListBrowser) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ResetList();
				}
			}
			BindingProcessor.QueryUpdate(updates, base.Chart);
		}

		private void EnsureDrillDownState()
		{
			if (drillDownState == null && ShouldUseSeriesTemplate && IsDrillDownAvailable)
			{
				drillDownState = DrillDownState.CreateRootDrillDownState(SeriesTemplate);
				drillDownState.Series = new List<ISeries>(autocreatedSeries);
			}
		}

		private void OnDrillDownStateChanged(DrillDownState state)
		{
			if (ContainerAdapter != null && ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider != null && !lockDrillDownEvents)
			{
				DrillDownItem[] states = DrillDownItem.CollectItems(state, shouldClearBreadcrumbItemText: false);
				Series[] array = new Series[state.Series.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < state.Series.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = (Series)state.Series[i];
				}
				ContainerAdapter.EventsProvider.OnDrillDownStateChanged(new DrillDownStateChangedEventArgs(states, array));
			}
		}

		private void PopulateColorizerData(SeriesTemplate template, SeriesDataSourceColorizer colorizer)
		{
			CheckColorizerDataMembersAndResetMappings(colorizer);
			ColorizerBindingProcedure colorizerBindingProcedure = ((colorizer.DataSource != null) ? new ColorizerBindingProcedure(colorizer, (DataContextBase)(object)GetDataContext(), colorizer.DataSource, string.Empty, ((ISeriesDataAdapter)template).CalculatedFields) : new ColorizerBindingProcedure(colorizer, (DataContextBase)(object)GetDataContext(), ActualDataSource, template.SeriesDataMember, ((ISeriesDataAdapter)template).CalculatedFields));
			colorizerBindingProcedure.PopulateColorizer();
		}

		private void ReadSeriesSerializableArray(Series[] data)
		{
			Series.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Series.Clear();
				Series.AddRange(data);
			}
			finally
			{
				Series.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveAutocreatedSeriesFromSeriesCollection()
		{
			try
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (num < Series.Count)
				{
					if (Series[num].Autocreated)
					{
						Series.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceAutocreatedSeries(DrillDownState state)
		{
			Series.LockItemsDisposing();
			RemoveAutocreatedSeriesFromSeriesCollection();
			Series.UnlockItemsDisposing();
			if (state.Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AddAutocreatedSeriesToSeriesCollection(state.Series);
			AutocreatedSeries.Clear();
			foreach (Series item in state.Series)
			{
				AutocreatedSeries.Add(item);
			}
			chart.RestoreAutoSeriesUncheckedState();
		}

		private void SetDataSource(object source, bool isSourceDeleted)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				Clear(isSourceDeleted);
			}
			DataSourceEventManager = DataSourceEventManagerBase.CreateDataSourceEventManager(this, source);
			dataSource = source;
			PivotGridDataSourceOptions.Initialize(source, isSourceDeleted);
		}

		private void UpdateAutocreatedSeries(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<IBindingProvider> updates)
		{
			bool flag = !SeriesTemplate.IsSummaryBinding && ShouldUseSeriesTemplate && !IsDesignMode && ActualDataSource != null && base.Chart.CanUseBoundPoints && CanGetAutocreatedSeries;
			flag &= updates.IsUpdatesTypeOf(ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert);
			ClearDrillDownState();
			if (flag)
			{
				flag = ApplyInsertUpdates(updates);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				RemoveAutocreatedSeriesFromSeriesCollection();
				PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateDataMembers(canUpdateArgumentScaleType: true);
				autocreatedSeries = GetAutocreatedSeries();
				AddAutocreatedSeriesToSeriesCollection(autocreatedSeries);
				foreach (Series item in autocreatedSeries)
				{
					item.View.BindViewToDiagram();
				}
			}
			PivotGridDataSourceOptions.CheckData();
			PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateAutoLayoutSettings();
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesBinding(Series series, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			bool seriesCountChanged = false;
			if (!series.Autocreated)
			{
				if (!IsDesignMode || base.Chart.ShouldLoadDataInDesignTime)
				{
					((IBindingProvider)series).BindingProcessor.ProcessUpdates(updates, seriesCountChanged);
				}
				else if (!series.UnboundMode)
				{
					series.NotifyPointsReset();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTempAutocreatedSeries()
		{
			foreach (Series item in tempAutocreatedSeries)
			{
				item.Owner = null;
				item.Assign(SeriesTemplate);
				item.Owner = SeriesTemplate.Owner;
			}
		}

		protected override bool XtraShouldSerialize(string propertyName)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "DataMember":
				return ShouldSerializeDataMember();
			case "RefreshDataOnRepaint":
				return ShouldSerializeRefreshDataOnRepaint();
			case "DrillDownStates":
				if (DrillDownState != null)
				{
					return !DrillDownState.IsRoot;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return base.XtraShouldSerialize(propertyName);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				DataSourceEventManager.UnsubscribeEvents();
				DisposeTempAutocreatedSeries();
				series?.Dispose();
				seriesTemplate?.SeriesColorizer?.Dispose();
			}
			Disposed = true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeSeriesTemplate() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesNameTemplate() && !ShouldSerializePivotGridDataSourceOptions() && !ShouldSerializeRefreshDataOnRepaint() && !ShouldSerializeDataMember() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesDataMember() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesSerializable())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeBoundSeriesSorting();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void ChildCollectionChanged(ChartCollectionBase collection, ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (!Disposed && collection == series)
			{
				DataChanged(change);
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateBackCompatibilityAdapters(bool needResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType)
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (needResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType)
				{
					item.ResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType();
				}
				item.OnDataPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		internal bool DrillDownToArgument(object argument)
		{
			if (DrillDownState != null)
			{
				DrillDownState newStateByArgument = DrillDownState.GetNewStateByArgument(argument);
				return SetDrillDownState(newStateByArgument);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DrillDownToPoint(Series series, SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (DrillDownState != null)
			{
				DrillDownState drillDownState = DrillDownState.GetNewStateByPoint(series, point);
				if (drillDownState == null)
				{
					drillDownState = DrillDownState.GetNewStateBySeries(series);
				}
				return SetDrillDownState(drillDownState);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DrillDownToSeries(Series series)
		{
			if (DrillDownState != null)
			{
				DrillDownState newStateBySeries = DrillDownState.GetNewStateBySeries(series);
				return SetDrillDownState(newStateBySeries);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DrillUp()
		{
			if (drillDownState != null && drillDownState.Parent != null)
			{
				DrillDownState parent = drillDownState.Parent;
				if (OnDrillDownStateChanging(parent))
				{
					drillDownState = parent;
					ReplaceAutocreatedSeries(drillDownState);
					OnDrillDownStateChanged(drillDownState);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsAutocreatedSeriesChanged()
		{
			IList<ISeries> list = GetAutocreatedSeries();
			if (list == autocreatedSeries)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (list.Count != autocreatedSeries.Count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < autocreatedSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = (Series)autocreatedSeries[i];
				Series series2 = (Series)list[i];
				if (series.Name != series2.Name || !series.ArePointEquals(series2.ActualPoints))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool SetDrillDownState(DrillDownState state)
		{
			if (state != null && OnDrillDownStateChanging(state))
			{
				drillDownState = state;
				if (drillDownState.Series == null && ActualDataSource != null)
				{
					drillDownState.SeriesTemplate.SetDrillDownFilter(drillDownState.Filter);
					drillDownState.Series = GetActualAutocreatedSeries(drillDownState.SeriesTemplate);
				}
				ReplaceAutocreatedSeries(drillDownState);
				OnDrillDownStateChanged(drillDownState);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection GetDataSourceUpdates()
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			if (ShouldRefreshData())
			{
				if (IsAutocreatedSeriesChanged())
				{
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(this);
				}
				foreach (Series item in Series)
				{
					if (!item.Autocreated && item.IsBoundDataChanged() && (!IsDesignMode || base.Chart.ShouldLoadDataInDesignTime))
					{
						dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection;
		}

		internal DrillDownState GetDesignModeDrillDownState()
		{
			if (this.drillDownState != null && !this.drillDownState.IsRoot)
			{
				return this.drillDownState;
			}
			if (designModeDrillDownState == null && IsDrillDownAvailable)
			{
				DrillDownState drillDownState = DrillDownState.CreateRootDrillDownState(seriesTemplate);
				drillDownState = drillDownState.CreateDesignModeState(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.DesignTimeDrillDownLevel1));
				drillDownState = drillDownState.CreateDesignModeState(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.DesignTimeDrillDownLevel2));
				designModeDrillDownState = drillDownState;
			}
			return designModeDrillDownState;
		}

		internal Series GetSeriesByUserObject(object seriesObject)
		{
			foreach (Series item in this.series)
			{
				if (object.Equals(item.Tag, seriesObject))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal SeriesPoint GetSeriesPointByUserObject(Series series, object userObject)
		{
			if (series != null)
			{
				return FindPointByUserObject(series, userObject);
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = FindPointByUserObject(item, userObject);
				if (seriesPoint != null)
				{
					return seriesPoint;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void CheckNestedDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			CheckDataMember(dataSource, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(DataMember, dataMember));
		}

		internal void CheckScaleTypes()
		{
			if (ShouldUseSeriesTemplate)
			{
				SeriesTemplate.ValidateArgumentScaleType();
			}
			if (Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.Visible)
				{
					item.ValidateArgumentScaleType();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DisposeTempAutocreatedSeries()
		{
			if (tempAutocreatedSeries != null)
			{
				RemoveAutocreatedSeriesFromSeriesCollection();
				foreach (Series item in tempAutocreatedSeries)
				{
					item.Dispose();
				}
			}
			tempAutocreatedSeries = null;
		}

		internal void EndLoadSeries(bool validatePointsId)
		{
			SeriesTemplate.OnEndLoading(validatePointsId);
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (!item.Autocreated)
				{
					item.OnEndLoading(validatePointsId);
				}
			}
			if (tempAutocreatedSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item2 in tempAutocreatedSeries)
			{
				item2.OnEndLoading(validatePointsId);
			}
		}

		internal void EnsurePalettes()
		{
			CheckColorizer(SeriesTemplate.View.Colorizer as ChartPaletteColorizerBase);
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				CheckColorizer(item.View.Colorizer as ChartPaletteColorizerBase);
			}
		}

		internal void LoadDrillDownStates()
		{
			lockDrillDownEvents = true;
			try
			{
				if (drillDownStateItems == null || drillDownStateItems.Count <= 0 || Series.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (DrillDownStateItemBase drillDownStateItem in drillDownStateItems)
				{
					if (!ApplyDrillDownStateItem(drillDownStateItem))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lockDrillDownEvents = false;
			}
		}

		public bool CanClearDataSource()
		{
			if (base.Chart.Container.ControlType != ChartContainerType.WebControl)
			{
				return BindingHelper.ConvertToDataSet(DataSource) != null;
			}
			if (DataSource == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataSource is ICollection collection)
			{
				return collection.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool CanFillDataSource()
		{
			if (base.Chart.Container.ControlType == ChartContainerType.WebControl)
			{
				return DataSource != null;
			}
			dataAdapter = BindingHelper.UpdateDataAdapter(DataSource, base.Chart.Container.Site, IsDesignMode);
			if (!base.Chart.Container.Loading && ActualDataAdapter != null)
			{
				return BindingHelper.ConvertToDataSet(ActualDataSource) != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool CanPerformDataSnapshot()
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.Autocreated || item.CanDataSnapshot)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeBoundSeriesSorting()
		{
			return boundSeriesSorting != SortingMode.None;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataMember);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeRefreshDataOnRepaint()
		{
			return refreshDataOnRepaint;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeSeriesDataMember()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesDataMember);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeSeriesSerializable()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public bool UpdateBinding(Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> updates)
		{
			if (bindingLocked || Loading || updates == null || updates.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			LockBinding();
			base.ViewController.BeginUpdateData();
			chart.Container.LockChangeService();
			try
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (IBindingProvider key in updates.Keys)
				{
					DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates2 = BindingProcessorBase.SimplifyUpdates(updates[key], key.ExistItemsCount);
					if (key is DataContainer)
					{
						UpdateAutocreatedSeries(updates2);
						flag = true;
						continue;
					}
					if (key is Series)
					{
						UpdateSeriesBinding((Series)key, updates2);
						continue;
					}
					SeriesDataSourceColorizer seriesDataSourceColorizer = key as SeriesDataSourceColorizer;
					if (seriesDataSourceColorizer?.Chart != null && (!flag || seriesDataSourceColorizer.DataSource != null))
					{
						PopulateColorizerData(SeriesTemplate, seriesDataSourceColorizer);
					}
				}
				updates.Clear();
				PivotGridDataSourceOptions.UpdateXAxisLabels();
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				UnlockBinding();
				base.ViewController.EndUpdateData();
				chart.Container.UnlockChangeService();
				chart.SelectionController.RestoreSelectedItems();
			}
		}

		public Series CreateSeries(string name)
		{
			return SeriesTemplate.CreateSeries(name);
		}

		public Series GetSeriesByName(string seriesName)
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.Name == seriesName)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void BindToData(ViewType viewType, object dataSource, string seriesDataMember, string argumentDataMember, params string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			BindToData(viewType, dataSource, string.Empty, seriesDataMember, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
		}

		public void BindToData(SeriesViewBase view, object dataSource, string seriesDataMember, string argumentDataMember, params string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			BindToData(view, dataSource, string.Empty, seriesDataMember, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
		}

		public void BindToData(SeriesViewBase view, object dataSource, string dataMember, string seriesDataMember, string argumentDataMember, params string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			if (!(dataSource is IControlRowSourceComponent))
			{
				CheckBindingRuntime(dataSource, dataMember, seriesDataMember, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
			}
			IChartDataProvider dataProvider = base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider;
			object source = ((dataSource != null) ? dataSource : dataProvider?.ParentDataSource);
			if (SeriesDataMember != seriesDataMember)
			{
				CheckNestedDataMember(source, seriesDataMember);
			}
			if (DataMember != dataMember)
			{
				CheckDataMember(source, dataMember);
			}
			if (argumentDataMember != SeriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember)
			{
				SeriesTemplate.CheckDataMember(source, argumentDataMember, SeriesTemplate.ArgumentScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleArgumentDataMember));
			}
			foreach (string text in valueDataMembers)
			{
				SeriesTemplate.CheckDataMember(source, text, SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleValueDataMember));
			}
			RaiseControlChanging();
			SeriesTemplate.SetView(view, assignParams: false);
			SetDataSource(dataSource, isSourceDeleted: false);
			DataMember = dataMember;
			SeriesDataMember = seriesDataMember;
			SeriesTemplate.SetArgumentDataMember(argumentDataMember);
			SeriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers.ClearAndFill(valueDataMembers);
			ProcessChangeBinding();
		}

		public void BindToData(ViewType viewType, object dataSource, string dataMember, string seriesDataMember, string argumentDataMember, params string[] valueDataMembers)
		{
			SeriesViewBase view = SeriesViewFactory.CreateInstance(viewType);
			BindToData(view, dataSource, dataMember, seriesDataMember, argumentDataMember, valueDataMembers);
		}

		public void CheckBindingRuntime(object source)
		{
			SeriesTemplate seriesTemplate = SeriesTemplate;
			CheckBindingRuntime(source, DataMember, SeriesDataMember, seriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember, seriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers.GetArray());
		}

		public void DataChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			RaiseControlChanged(change);
		}

		public void DataSnapshot()
		{
			if (!CanPerformDataSnapshot())
			{
				return;
			}
			RaiseControlChanging();
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.DataSnapshot();
			}
			dataAdapter = null;
			SetDataSource(null, isSourceDeleted: false);
			SeriesDataMember = null;
			RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: true, resetSeriesBinding: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public void FillDataSource()
		{
			ActualDataAdapter.Fill(BindingHelper.ConvertToDataSet(ActualDataSource));
		}

		public void LockBinding()
		{
			bindingLocked = true;
		}

		public void LockDataSourceEventsSubscription()
		{
			lockDataSourceEventsSubscription = true;
		}

		public void OnObjectDeleted(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == dataAdapter)
			{
				dataAdapter = null;
				return;
			}
			CheckDataSourcesDeleting(obj);
			if (!(obj is DataSet dataSet))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DataTable table in dataSet.Tables)
			{
				CheckDataSourcesDeleting(table);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessChangeBinding()
		{
			object actualDataSource = ActualDataSource;
			if (actualDataSource != null && !base.Chart.Container.Loading)
			{
				DataContext dataContext = base.Chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider?.DataContext;
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, actualDataSource, DataMember, CalculatedFields) && ValidateDataMembers)
				{
					DataMember = null;
				}
				if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, actualDataSource, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(dataMember, SeriesDataMember), CalculatedFields) && ValidateDataMembers)
				{
					SeriesDataMember = null;
				}
				SeriesTemplate.CheckBinding(actualDataSource);
				foreach (Series item in Series)
				{
					if (item.ActualDataSource == null)
					{
						item.CheckBinding(actualDataSource);
					}
				}
			}
			RaiseControlChanged(resetSmartBinding: true, resetSeriesBinding: true);
		}

		public void ResetBoundSeriesSorting()
		{
			BoundSeriesSorting = SortingMode.None;
		}

		public void ResetDataMember()
		{
			DataMember = null;
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is obsolete now. Use the ResetLegendTextPattern method instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLegendPointOptions()
		{
			if (SeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				SeriesTemplate.ResetLegendPointOptions();
			}
			if (Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.ResetLegendPointOptions();
			}
		}

		public void ResetLegendTextPattern()
		{
			if (SeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				SeriesTemplate.LegendTextPattern = string.Empty;
			}
			if (Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.LegendTextPattern = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public void ResetRefreshDataOnRepaint()
		{
			RefreshDataOnRepaint = false;
		}

		public void ResetSeriesDataMember()
		{
			SeriesDataMember = null;
		}

		public void UnlockBinding()
		{
			bindingLocked = false;
		}

		public override void Assign(ChartElement obj)
		{
			if (obj is DataContainer dataContainer)
			{
				drillDownState = null;
				boundSeriesSorting = dataContainer.boundSeriesSorting;
				dataAdapter = dataContainer.dataAdapter;
				DataSource = dataContainer.DataSource;
				DataMember = dataContainer.DataMember;
				seriesTemplate.Assign(dataContainer.seriesTemplate);
				SeriesNameTemplate.Assign(dataContainer.SeriesNameTemplate);
				Series.Assign(dataContainer.Series);
				AssignTempAutocreatedSeries(dataContainer.tempAutocreatedSeries);
				RemoveAutocreatedSeriesFromSeriesCollection();
				PivotGridDataSourceOptions.Assign(dataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions);
				RefreshDataOnRepaint = dataContainer.RefreshDataOnRepaint;
				drillDownStateItems = dataContainer.DrillDownStates;
				validateDataMembers = dataContainer.ValidateDataMembers;
				calculatedFieldCollection.Assign(dataContainer.calculatedFieldCollection);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider
	{
		void DataWasChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs args);

		void DataWasChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args);

		void DataWasChanged(object sender, DataChangedEventArgs args);
	}
	public abstract class DataSourceEventManagerBase
	{
		private readonly IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider;

		private readonly object initialSource;

		protected IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider HandlerProvider => handlerProvider;

		protected object InitialSource => initialSource;

		protected DataSourceEventManagerBase(IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider, object source)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)handlerProvider, "handlerProvider");
			this.handlerProvider = handlerProvider;
			initialSource = source;
		}

		public abstract void UnsubscribeEvents();

		public abstract void SubscribeEvents();

		public static DataSourceEventManagerBase CreateDataSourceEventManager(IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider, object source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return new EmptySourceEventManager(handlerProvider, null);
			}
			IChartDataSource val = (IChartDataSource)((source is IChartDataSource) ? source : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return new ChartDataSourceEventManager(handlerProvider, val);
			}
			IControlRowSourceComponent val2 = (IControlRowSourceComponent)((source is IControlRowSourceComponent) ? source : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				return new ControlRowSourceEventManager(handlerProvider, val2);
			}
			return new ListSourceEventManager(handlerProvider, source);
		}
	}
	public class EmptySourceEventManager : DataSourceEventManagerBase
	{
		public EmptySourceEventManager(IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider, object source)
			: base(handlerProvider, source)
		{
		}

		public override void SubscribeEvents()
		{
		}

		public override void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
		}
	}
	public class ListSourceEventManager : DataSourceEventManagerBase
	{
		public ListSourceEventManager(IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider, object source)
			: base(handlerProvider, source)
		{
		}

		private IBindingList GetBindingListSource()
		{
			IBindingList bindingList = base.InitialSource as IBindingList;
			if (bindingList == null && base.InitialSource is IListSource)
			{
				bindingList = ((IListSource)base.InitialSource).GetList() as IBindingList;
			}
			return bindingList;
		}

		public override void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			IBindingList bindingListSource = GetBindingListSource();
			if (bindingListSource != null)
			{
				bindingListSource.ListChanged += base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged;
			}
			else if (base.InitialSource is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged;
			}
		}

		public override void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			IBindingList bindingListSource = GetBindingListSource();
			if (bindingListSource != null)
			{
				bindingListSource.ListChanged -= base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged;
			}
			else if (base.InitialSource is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartDataSourceEventManager : DataSourceEventManagerBase
	{
		private readonly IChartDataSource chartDataSource;

		public ChartDataSourceEventManager(IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider, IChartDataSource source)
			: base(handlerProvider, source)
		{
			chartDataSource = source;
		}

		public override void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IChartDataSource obj = chartDataSource;
			IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider dataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider = base.HandlerProvider;
			obj.DataChanged += new DataChangedEventHandler(dataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged);
		}

		public override void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IChartDataSource obj = chartDataSource;
			IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider dataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider = base.HandlerProvider;
			obj.DataChanged -= new DataChangedEventHandler(dataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider.DataWasChanged);
		}
	}
	public class ControlRowSourceEventManager : ListSourceEventManager
	{
		private readonly IControlRowSourceComponent rowSource;

		private IList list;

		private IList List
		{
			get
			{
				return list;
			}
			set
			{
				if (list != value)
				{
					UnsubscribeListEvent();
					list = value;
					SubscribeListEvent();
				}
			}
		}

		public ControlRowSourceEventManager(IDataSourceChangedEventHandlerProvider handlerProvider, IControlRowSourceComponent source)
			: base(handlerProvider, source)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			rowSource = source;
		}

		private void SubscribeListEvent()
		{
			if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeListEvent()
		{
			if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateList()
		{
			List = ((IListSource)rowSource).GetList();
		}

		private void ResetList()
		{
			List = null;
		}

		private void RowSource_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName.Equals("List"))
			{
				UpdateList();
			}
			base.HandlerProvider.DataWasChanged(sender, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		public override void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			UpdateList();
			base.SubscribeEvents();
			((INotifyPropertyChanged)rowSource).PropertyChanged += RowSource_PropertyChanged;
		}

		public override void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			ResetList();
			((INotifyPropertyChanged)rowSource).PropertyChanged -= RowSource_PropertyChanged;
			base.UnsubscribeEvents();
		}
	}
	public abstract class CrosshairElementFactory
	{
		private static Color GetLineColor(CrosshairLine crosshairLine, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			if (!crosshairLine.IsValueLine)
			{
				return crosshairOptions.ArgumentLineColor;
			}
			return crosshairOptions.ValueLineColor;
		}

		private static LineStyle GetLineStyle(CrosshairLine crosshairLine, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle = (crosshairLine.IsValueLine ? crosshairOptions.ValueLineStyle : crosshairOptions.ArgumentLineStyle);
			if (!shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
			{
				return lineStyle;
			}
			return (LineStyle)lineStyle.Clone();
		}

		private static List<SeriesPoint> CollectPoints(CrosshairPointsGroup group)
		{
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPoint seriesPoint2 in group.SeriesPoints)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = seriesPoint2.RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = refinedPoint.SeriesPoint;
					if (seriesPoint == null)
					{
						seriesPoint = new DataAdapterHelper((Series)seriesPoint2.RefinedSeries.Series).CreateSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
					}
					list.Add(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(seriesPoint));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected static Color GetActualTextColor(TextOptions textOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!textOptions.TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return textOptions.TextColor;
			}
			return appearance.TextColor;
		}

		protected static DXFont GetActualFont(TextOptions textOptions)
		{
			return textOptions.DXFont ?? DefaultFonts.Tahoma8;
		}

		public static CrosshairGroupHeaderElement CreateCrosshairGroupHeaderElement(CrosshairPointsGroup pointsGroup, TextOptions textOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new CrosshairGroupHeaderElement(CollectPoints(pointsGroup), pointsGroup.HeaderText, GetActualTextColor(textOptions, appearance), GetActualFont(textOptions), textOptions.EnableAntialiasing);
		}

		public static CrosshairAxisLabelElement CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo)
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (crosshairAxisInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CrosshairAxisLabelOptions crosshairAxisLabelOptions = ((Axis2D)crosshairAxisInfo.Axis).CrosshairAxisLabelOptions;
			return new CrosshairAxisLabelElement(crosshairAxisInfo.Value, crosshairAxisInfo.Text, crosshairAxisLabelOptions.ActualBackColor, crosshairAxisLabelOptions.ActualTextColor, crosshairAxisLabelOptions.ActualDXFont, crosshairAxisLabelOptions.ActualVisibility, crosshairAxisLabelOptions.EnableAntialiasing);
		}

		public static CrosshairLineElement CreateCrosshairLineElement(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, CrosshairLine crosshairLine, bool visible, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			return new CrosshairLineElement(GetLineColor(crosshairLine, crosshairOptions), GetLineStyle(crosshairLine, crosshairOptions, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair), visible);
		}
	}
	public abstract class CrosshairPointElementFactory : CrosshairElementFactory
	{
		private static CrosshairSeriesPointElementFactory crosshairSeriesPointElementFactory;

		private static CrosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory crosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory;

		private static CrosshairSeriesPointElementFactory CrosshairSeriesPointElementFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (crosshairSeriesPointElementFactory == null)
				{
					crosshairSeriesPointElementFactory = new CrosshairSeriesPointElementFactory();
				}
				return crosshairSeriesPointElementFactory;
			}
		}

		private static CrosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory CrosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (crosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory == null)
				{
					crosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory = new CrosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory();
				}
				return crosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory;
			}
		}

		public static CrosshairElementBase CreateCrosshairElement(CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			CrosshairLineElement lineElement = null;
			CrosshairLine crosshairLine = crosshairPoint.CrosshairLine;
			if (crosshairLine != null)
			{
				lineElement = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions, crosshairLine, crosshairLine.IsValueLine ? crosshairOptions.ShowValueLine : crosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLine, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			}
			CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(crosshairPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo);
			if (crosshairPoint is CrosshairSeriesPoint)
			{
				return CrosshairSeriesPointElementFactory.CreateCrosshairElementCore(crosshairPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, crosshairPoint.CrosshairSeriesText, crosshairOptions, appearance);
			}
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointElementFactory.CreateCrosshairElementCore(crosshairPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, crosshairPoint.CrosshairSeriesText, crosshairOptions, appearance);
		}

		private Color GetActualTextColor(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextOptions textOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (textOptions.TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return CrosshairElementFactory.GetActualTextColor(crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelTextOptions, appearance);
			}
			return textOptions.TextColor;
		}

		private DXFont GetActualFont(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextOptions textOptions)
		{
			if (textOptions.DXFont == null)
			{
				return CrosshairElementFactory.GetActualFont(crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelTextOptions);
			}
			return textOptions.DXFont;
		}

		private DefaultBoolean GetActualAntialiasing(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextOptions textOptions)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)textOptions.EnableAntialiasing != 2)
			{
				return textOptions.EnableAntialiasing;
			}
			return crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelTextOptions.EnableAntialiasing;
		}

		protected abstract CrosshairElementBase CreateCrosshairElementCore(CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, string text, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance);

		protected CrosshairLabelElement CreateCrosshairLabelElement(string crosshairText, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextOptions textOptions, Color markerColor, bool crosshairLabelVisibleParam)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool visible = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(crosshairText) && crosshairLabelVisibleParam;
			Size markerSize = new Size(15, 15);
			Color actualTextColor = GetActualTextColor(crosshairOptions, textOptions, appearance);
			DXFont actualFont = GetActualFont(crosshairOptions, textOptions);
			DefaultBoolean actualAntialiasing = GetActualAntialiasing(crosshairOptions, textOptions);
			return new CrosshairLabelElement(crosshairText, actualTextColor, actualFont, null, ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize, markerSize, markerColor, markerVisible: true, textVisible: true, visible, actualAntialiasing);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairSeriesPointElementFactory : CrosshairPointElementFactory
	{
		protected override CrosshairElementBase CreateCrosshairElementCore(CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, string text, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance)
		{
			CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint = (CrosshairSeriesPoint)crosshairPoint;

		}
	}

	public class CrosshairIndicatorLegendEmptyElementFactory : CrosshairLegendElementFactory

		protected override CrosshairLegendElementBase CreateCrosshairLegendElementCore(CrosshairLegendPoint point, CrosshairLegendViewData crosshairLegendViewData, Series series, string text, Color actualTextColor, DXFont font, bool crosshairLegendTextVisible, DefaultBoolean enableAntialiasing, CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement crosshairAxisLabelElement)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement crosshairIndicatorLegendElement = new CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement(series, CreateIndicatorPoint(point), text, actualTextColor, font, crosshairLegendTextVisible, enableAntialiasing, crosshairLineElement, crosshairAxisLabelElement);
			crosshairLegendViewData.IndicatorLegendElements.Add(crosshairIndicatorLegendElement);
			return crosshairIndicatorLegendElement;
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairIndicatorLegendElementFactory : CrosshairIndicatorLegendEmptyElementFactory
	{
		protected override IndicatorPoint CreateIndicatorPoint(CrosshairLegendPoint point)
		{
			CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint = (CrosshairIndicatorPoint)point;
			return new IndicatorPoint((Indicator)crosshairIndicatorPoint.Indicator, crosshairIndicatorPoint.AxisXProjection.CalculateNativeValue(), crosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairLegendViewData : CrosshairViewDataBase
	{
		private readonly List<CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo> pointDrawInfos;

		private readonly CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions;

		private readonly Color backColor;

		private readonly RectangleFillStyle fillStyle;

		private readonly List<CrosshairLegendElement> legendElements = new List<CrosshairLegendElement>();

		private readonly List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> indicatorLegendElements = new List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement>();

		protected override Chart Chart => crosshairOptions.Chart;

		public List<CrosshairLegendElement> LegendElements => legendElements;

		public List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> IndicatorLegendElements => indicatorLegendElements;

		public CrosshairLegendViewData(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfos, TextAnnotationAppearance textAppearance, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			pointDrawInfos = new List<CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo>();
			this.crosshairOptions = crosshairOptions;
			backColor = (crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelBackColor.IsEmpty ? textAppearance.BackColor : crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelBackColor);
			fillStyle = textAppearance.FillStyle;
			FillPointDrawInfos(crosshairInfos, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
		}

		private void FillPointDrawInfos(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfos, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			CrosshairLegendSeriesPointDrawInfoProvider provider = new CrosshairLegendSeriesPointDrawInfoProvider(new CrosshairSeriesLegendElementFactory());
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPoint seriesLegendPoint in crosshairInfos.SeriesLegendPoints)
			{
				pointDrawInfos.Add(new CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo(this, crosshairInfos, crosshairOptions, seriesLegendPoint, provider, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair));
			}
			CrosshairLegendIndicatorPointDrawInfoProvider provider2 = new CrosshairLegendIndicatorPointDrawInfoProvider(new CrosshairIndicatorLegendElementFactory());
			foreach (CrosshairIndicatorPoint indicatorLegendPoint in crosshairInfos.IndicatorLegendPoints)
			{
				pointDrawInfos.Add(new CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo(this, crosshairInfos, crosshairOptions, indicatorLegendPoint, provider2, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair));
			}
			foreach (CrosshairLegendPoint emptyLegendPoint in crosshairInfos.EmptyLegendPoints)
			{
				pointDrawInfos.Add(new CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo(this, crosshairInfos, crosshairOptions, emptyLegendPoint, null, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair));
			}
		}

		public void RenderLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo pointDrawInfo in pointDrawInfos)
			{
				CrosshairLegendElementBase crosshairLegendElement = pointDrawInfo.CrosshairLegendElement;
				if (crosshairLegendElement != null && pointDrawInfo.Legend.RenderTextByRenderer && crosshairLegendElement.ActualVisible)
				{
					if (pointDrawInfo.Point.CrosshairLine != null)
					{
						RenderCrosshairLine(renderer, pointDrawInfo.Point.CrosshairLine, crosshairLegendElement.LineElement);
					}
					if (pointDrawInfo.Point.CrosshairAxisInfo != null)
					{
						RenderCrosshairAxisLabel(renderer, pointDrawInfo.Point.CrosshairAxisInfo, crosshairLegendElement.AxisLabelElement);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderLegendElements(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo pointDrawInfo in pointDrawInfos)
			{
				CrosshairLegendElementBase crosshairLegendElement = pointDrawInfo.CrosshairLegendElement;
				if (crosshairLegendElement != null && pointDrawInfo.Legend.RenderTextByRenderer && crosshairLegendElement.ActualVisible)
				{
					RectangleF bounds = pointDrawInfo.Bounds;
					crosshairLegendElement.InitializeTextElement(Chart, backColor, fillStyle, bounds.Size);
					crosshairLegendElement.TextElement.RenderText(renderer, bounds);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo
	{
		private readonly CrosshairLegendPoint point;

		private readonly CrosshairOptions options;

		private RectangleF bounds;

		private Legend legend;

		private CrosshairLegendElementBase crosshairLegendElement;

		public RectangleF Bounds => bounds;

		public Legend Legend => legend;

		public CrosshairLegendPoint Point => point;

		public CrosshairLegendElementBase CrosshairLegendElement => crosshairLegendElement;

		public CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfo(CrosshairLegendViewData crosshairLegendViewData, CrosshairInfo crosshairInfos, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, CrosshairLegendPoint point, CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfoProvider provider, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			this.point = point;
			options = crosshairOptions;
			if (provider == null)
			{
				provider = CreateCrosshairLegendPointDrawInfoProvider(point.LegendItem, null);
			}
			provider.InitializeProvider(point);
			legend = provider.Legend;
			bounds = provider.CrosshairItemBounds;
			if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				crosshairLegendElement = provider.CreateCrosshairLegendElement(crosshairLegendViewData, point, crosshairOptions, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			}
		}

		private CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfoProvider CreateCrosshairLegendPointDrawInfoProvider(ILegendItem legendItem, CrosshairLegendElementFactory crosshairLegendElementFactory)
		{
			if (legendItem is Series)
			{
				return new CrosshairLegendSeriesPointDrawInfoProvider(crosshairLegendElementFactory);
			}
			return new CrosshairLegendIndicatorPointDrawInfoProvider(crosshairLegendElementFactory);
		}
	}
	public abstract class CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfoProvider
	{
		private CrosshairLegendElementFactory crosshairLegendElementFactory;

		protected abstract ILegendItem LegendItem { get; }

		protected abstract Series Series { get; }

		protected abstract string CrosshairEmptyValueLegendText { get; }

		public abstract Legend Legend { get; }

		public RectangleF CrosshairItemBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (Legend.LegendItemsInfo.TryGetValue(LegendItem, out var value))
				{
					return value.CrosshairItemBounds;
				}
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
		}

		public CrosshairLegendPointDrawInfoProvider(CrosshairLegendElementFactory crosshairLegendElementFactory)
		{
			this.crosshairLegendElementFactory = crosshairLegendElementFactory;
		}

		protected abstract CrosshairLegendElementFactory CreateCrosshairLegendElementFactory();

		public CrosshairLegendElementBase CreateCrosshairLegendElement(CrosshairLegendViewData crosshairLegendViewData, CrosshairLegendPoint point, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			if (crosshairLegendElementFactory == null)
			{
				crosshairLegendElementFactory = CreateCrosshairLegendElementFactory();
			}
			return crosshairLegendElementFactory.CreateCrosshairLegendElement(crosshairLegendViewData, point, crosshairOptions, Series, Legend, CrosshairEmptyValueLegendText, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
		}

		public abstract void InitializeProvider(CrosshairLegendPoint point);
	}

	public class BreadcrumbsViewData
	{
		private class BreadcrumbsLine
		{
			private readonly List<BreadcrumbItemViewData> viewDataList = new List<BreadcrumbItemViewData>();

			private int width;

			private int height;

			public bool IsEmpty => viewDataList.Count == 0;

			public int Width => width;

			public int Height => height;

			public void Add(BreadcrumbItemViewData viewData)
			{
				viewDataList.Add(viewData);
				width += viewData.Size.Width;
				height = Math.Max(height, viewData.Size.Height);
			}

			public void Arrange(int x, int y)
			{
				foreach (BreadcrumbItemViewData viewData in viewDataList)
				{
					viewData.Arrange(x, y, height);
					x += viewData.Size.Width;
				}
			}

			public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
			{
				foreach (BreadcrumbItemViewData viewData in viewDataList)
				{
					viewData.Render(renderer);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly List<BreadcrumbsLine> lines = new List<BreadcrumbsLine>();

		private readonly Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs;

		private readonly Point location;

		private readonly Size contentSize = Size.Empty;

		private readonly Size size;

		public Point Location => location;

		public Size Size => size;

		public BreadcrumbsViewData(Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs, List<BreadcrumbItem> items, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.breadcrumbs = breadcrumbs;
			bounds = breadcrumbs.Padding.DecreaseRectangle(bounds);
			if (breadcrumbs.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				bounds = DecreaseRectangle(bounds, breadcrumbs.Border.Thickness);
			}
			int num = bounds.Top;
			BreadcrumbsLine breadcrumbsLine = new BreadcrumbsLine();
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				BreadcrumbItemViewData breadcrumbItemViewData = new BreadcrumbItemViewData(breadcrumbs, items[i]);
				if (breadcrumbsLine.Width + breadcrumbItemViewData.Size.Width >= bounds.Width)
				{
					contentSize = AddLine(breadcrumbsLine, contentSize, bounds.Left, num);
					num += breadcrumbsLine.Height;
					breadcrumbsLine = new BreadcrumbsLine();
				}
				breadcrumbsLine.Add(breadcrumbItemViewData);
			}
			if (!breadcrumbsLine.IsEmpty)
			{
				contentSize = AddLine(breadcrumbsLine, contentSize, bounds.Left, num);
			}
			location = bounds.Location;
			size = breadcrumbs.Padding.IncreaseSize(contentSize);
			if (breadcrumbs.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				size = IncreaseSize(size, breadcrumbs.Border.Thickness);
			}
		}

		private Rectangle DecreaseRectangle(Rectangle rect, int thickness)
		{
			int width = Math.Max(rect.Width - thickness - thickness, 0);
			int height = Math.Max(rect.Height - thickness - thickness, 0);
			return new Rectangle(rect.X + thickness, rect.Y + thickness, width, height);
		}

		private Rectangle IncreaseRectangle(Rectangle rectangle, int thickness)
		{
			return new Rectangle(rectangle.X - thickness, rectangle.Y - thickness, rectangle.Width + thickness + thickness, rectangle.Height + thickness + thickness);
		}

		private Size IncreaseSize(Size size, int thickness)
		{
			return new Size(size.Width + thickness + thickness, size.Height + thickness + thickness);
		}

		private Size AddLine(BreadcrumbsLine line, Size totalSize, int x, int y)
		{
			line.Arrange(x, y);
			lines.Add(line);
			return new Size(Math.Max(line.Width, totalSize.Width), totalSize.Height + line.Height);
		}

		private void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			RectangularBorder border = breadcrumbs.Border;
			HitTestState state = ((IHitTest)breadcrumbs).State;
			Color actualColor = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, breadcrumbs.ActualBorderColor, state);
			BorderHelper.RenderBorder(renderer, border, bounds, state, border.ActualThickness, actualColor);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(location.X, location.Y, contentSize.Width, contentSize.Height);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(breadcrumbs.Chart.HitTestController, breadcrumbs, null, new HitRegion(rectangle));
			rectangle = breadcrumbs.Padding.IncreaseRectangle(rectangle);
			if (breadcrumbs.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				rectangle = IncreaseRectangle(rectangle, breadcrumbs.Border.Thickness);
			}
			if (!breadcrumbs.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(rectangle, breadcrumbs.BackColor);
			}
			foreach (BreadcrumbsLine line in lines)
			{
				line.Render(renderer);
			}
			RenderBorder(renderer, rectangle);
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbItemViewData
	{
		private readonly BreadcrumbItem item;

		private readonly Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs;

		private readonly BreadcrumbsHomeItemViewData homeItem;

		private readonly BreadcrumbsLinkItemViewData linkItem;

		private Size size = Size.Empty;

		private Size arrowSize = Size.Empty;

		private Rectangle arrowBounds;

		private BreadcrumbsArrowAppearance ArrowAppearance => breadcrumbs.Appearance.ArrowAppearance;

		public Size Size => size;

		public BreadcrumbItem Item => item;

		internal static void RenderImage(ChartRenderer renderer, SvgBitmap svg, Size imageSize, ISvgPaletteProvider palette, Rectangle bounds, RectangleIndents sizingMargins)
		{
			if (svg != null)
			{
				DXImage image = svg.RenderDXImage(imageSize, palette);
				if (sizingMargins.IsUndefined)
				{
					renderer.DrawImage(image, bounds, DXImageSizeMode.Stretch);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.DrawStretchedImage(image, bounds, sizingMargins.DpiScaledThickness);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void RenderGlyph(ChartRenderer renderer, SvgBitmap svg, Size imageSize, ISvgPaletteProvider palette, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (svg != null)
			{
				int x = (bounds.Width - imageSize.Width) / 2 + bounds.X;
				int y = (bounds.Height - imageSize.Height) / 2 + bounds.Y;
				renderer.DrawSvgImage(svg, new Point(x, y), imageSize, palette);
			}
		}

		public BreadcrumbItemViewData(Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs, BreadcrumbItem item)
		{
			this.breadcrumbs = breadcrumbs;
			this.item = item;
			if (item.IsHomeItem && string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Text))
			{
				homeItem = new BreadcrumbsHomeItemViewData(breadcrumbs, item);
				UpdateSize(homeItem.Bounds.Size);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Text))
			{
				linkItem = new BreadcrumbsLinkItemViewData(breadcrumbs, item);
				UpdateSize(linkItem.Bounds.Size);
			}
			if (!item.IsLast)
			{
				BreadcrumbsArrowAppearance arrowAppearance = ArrowAppearance;
				if (!arrowAppearance.Padding.IsHighDpiScaleProviderSet)
				{
					arrowAppearance.Padding.SetHighDpiScaleProvider(breadcrumbs.Chart);
				}
				arrowSize = arrowAppearance.Padding.IncreaseSize(arrowAppearance.GlyphSize);
				UpdateSize(arrowSize);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessHitRegion()
		{
			if (breadcrumbs.ChartContainer.DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (homeItem != null)
			{
				rectangle = homeItem.Bounds;
			}
			if (linkItem != null)
			{
				if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
				{
					rectangle = linkItem.Bounds;
				}
				else
				{
					int x = Math.Min(rectangle.X, linkItem.Bounds.X);
					int y = Math.Min(rectangle.Y, linkItem.Bounds.Y);
					int height = Math.Max(rectangle.Height, linkItem.Bounds.Height);
					rectangle = new Rectangle(x, y, rectangle.Width + linkItem.Bounds.Width, height);
				}
			}
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(breadcrumbs.Chart.HitTestController, Item, false, new HitRegion(rectangle), force: true);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(breadcrumbs.Chart.HitTestController, Item, new ChartFocusedArea(Item), useSpecificCursor: true, new HitRegion(rectangle), null, force: true);
		}

		private void UpdateSize(Size itemSize)
		{
			size = new Size(size.Width + itemSize.Width, Math.Max(size.Height, itemSize.Height));
		}

		public void Arrange(int x, int y, int height)
		{
			int val = 0;
			int num = 0;
			if (homeItem != null)
			{
				homeItem.Arrange(x, y, height);
				x += homeItem.Bounds.Width;
				val = Math.Max(val, homeItem.Bounds.Height);
				num += homeItem.Bounds.Width;
			}
			if (linkItem != null)
			{
				linkItem.Arrange(x, y, height);
				x += linkItem.Bounds.Width;
				val = Math.Max(val, linkItem.Bounds.Height);
				num += linkItem.Bounds.Width;
			}
			if (!arrowSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				y = (height - arrowSize.Height) / 2 + y;
				arrowBounds = new Rectangle(x, y, arrowSize.Width, arrowSize.Height);
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			ProcessHitRegion();
			if (homeItem != null)
			{
				homeItem.RenderContent(renderer);
			}
			if (linkItem != null)
			{
				linkItem.RenderContent(renderer);
			}
			if (arrowSize.Width > 0 && arrowSize.Height > 0)
			{
				BreadcrumbsArrowAppearance arrowAppearance = ArrowAppearance;
				RenderImage(renderer, arrowAppearance.SvgImage, arrowAppearance.ImageSize, (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)arrowAppearance.ImageSvgPalette, arrowBounds, arrowAppearance.SizingMargins);
				RenderGlyph(renderer, arrowAppearance.SvgGlyph, breadcrumbs.Chart.ScaleSize(arrowAppearance.GlyphSize), (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)arrowAppearance.GlyphSvgPalette, arrowBounds);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class BreadcrumbItemElementViewData
	{
		private readonly Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs;

		private readonly BreadcrumbItem item;

		protected BreadcrumbsAppearance Appearance => breadcrumbs.Appearance;

		protected Breadcrumbs Breadcrumbs => breadcrumbs;

		protected BreadcrumbItem Item => item;

		public Rectangle Bounds { get; set; }

		protected BreadcrumbItemElementViewData(Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs, BreadcrumbItem item)
		{
			this.breadcrumbs = breadcrumbs;
			this.item = item;
		}

		public void Arrange(int x, int y, int height)
		{
			int y2 = (height - Bounds.Height) / 2 + y;
			Bounds = new Rectangle(x, y2, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height);
		}

		public abstract void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer);
	}
	public class BreadcrumbsHomeItemViewData : BreadcrumbItemElementViewData
	{
		private readonly ISvgPaletteProvider imagePalette;

		private readonly ISvgPaletteProvider glyphPalette;

		private readonly BreadcrumbsHomeAppearance appearance;

		public BreadcrumbsHomeItemViewData(Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs, BreadcrumbItem item)
			: base(breadcrumbs, item)
		{
			appearance = breadcrumbs.Appearance.HomeAppearance;
			if (!appearance.Padding.IsHighDpiScaleProviderSet)
			{
				appearance.Padding.SetHighDpiScaleProvider(breadcrumbs.Chart);
			}
			if (item != null && item.IsHot)
			{
				imagePalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.ImageHotSvgPalette;
				glyphPalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.GlyphHotSvgPalette;
			}
			else if (item != null && item.IsActive)
			{
				imagePalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.ImageSvgPalette;
				glyphPalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.GlyphSvgPalette;
			}
			else
			{
				imagePalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.ImageInactiveSvgPalette;
				glyphPalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.GlyphInactiveSvgPalette;
			}
			Size size = appearance.Padding.IncreaseSize(appearance.GlyphSize);
			base.Bounds = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, size);
		}

		public override void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			BreadcrumbItemViewData.RenderImage(renderer, appearance.SvgImage, appearance.ImageSize, imagePalette, base.Bounds, appearance.SizingMargins);
			BreadcrumbItemViewData.RenderGlyph(renderer, appearance.SvgGlyph, base.Breadcrumbs.Chart.ScaleSize(appearance.GlyphSize), glyphPalette, base.Bounds);
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbsLinkItemViewData : BreadcrumbItemElementViewData
	{
		private readonly ISvgPaletteProvider imagePalette;

		private readonly Size textSize;

		private readonly BreadcrumbsLinkAppearance appearance;

		public BreadcrumbsLinkItemViewData(Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs, BreadcrumbItem item)
			: base(breadcrumbs, item)
		{
			appearance = breadcrumbs.Appearance.LinkAppearance;
			if (item != null && item.IsHot)
			{
				imagePalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.ImageHotSvgPalette;
			}
			else if (item != null && item.IsActive)
			{
				imagePalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.ImageSvgPalette;
			}
			else
			{
				imagePalette = (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)appearance.ImageInactiveSvgPalette;
			}
			textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureStringRounded(base.Item.Text, breadcrumbs.ActualFont, base.Item);
			if (!appearance.Padding.IsHighDpiScaleProviderSet)
			{
				appearance.Padding.SetHighDpiScaleProvider(breadcrumbs.Chart);
			}
			base.Bounds = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, appearance.Padding.IncreaseSize(textSize));
		}

		public override void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			BreadcrumbItemViewData.RenderImage(renderer, appearance.SvgImage, appearance.ImageSize, imagePalette, base.Bounds, appearance.SizingMargins);
			int num = base.Bounds.X + (base.Bounds.Width - textSize.Width) / 2;
			int num2 = base.Bounds.Y + (base.Bounds.Height - textSize.Height) / 2;
			TextPainter textPainter = new TextPainter(base.Item.Text, textSize, base.Item, new PointF(num, num2), 0, 0, wordWrap: false);
			textPainter.Render(renderer);
		}
	}
	public class DrillDownState
	{
		private readonly string name;

		private readonly CriteriaOperator filter;

		private readonly DrillDownState parent;

		private readonly SeriesTemplate template;

		private readonly SeriesTemplateAdapter adapter;

		private readonly Dictionary<object, DrillDownState> children = new Dictionary<object, DrillDownState>();

		private Dictionary<string, object> parameters = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		private string ArgumentDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				if (adapter == null)
				{
					return template.ArgumentDataMember;
				}
				return adapter.DataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Argument];
			}
		}

		private string SeriesDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				if (adapter == null)
				{
					return template.SeriesDataMember;
				}
				return adapter.DataMembers[ChartDataMemberType.Series];
			}
		}

		public bool IsRoot => parent == null;

		public string Name => name;

		public DrillDownStateItemBase GetCurrentStateItem()
		{

			{

					{
						if (child.Key is SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
						{
							int seriesIndex = Parent.Series.IndexOf(seriesPoint.Series);
							int pointIndex = seriesPoint.Series.ActualSeriesPoints.IndexOf(seriesPoint);
							return new SeriesPointDrillDownStateItem(seriesIndex, pointIndex);
						}
						if (child.Key is Series item)
						{
							int seriesIndex2 = Parent.Series.IndexOf(item);
							return new SeriesDrillDownStateItem(seriesIndex2);
						}
						return new ArgumentDrillDownStateItem(child.Key);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static PointF GetMeasuredStringLocation(string text, DXFont font, ITextMeasurer measurer, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return default(PointF);
			}
			if (text.Length > 32000)
			{
				return GetMeasuredStringLocation(text.Substring(0, 16000), font, measurer, stringFormat);
			}
			return measurer.MeasureString(text, font, stringFormat).Location;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> SplitTextOnLines(string text, Rectangle bounds, DXFont font, ITextMeasurer measurer, DXStringFormat stringFormat, out bool allowClipping)
		{
			string[] array = text.Split(new string[1] { Environment.NewLine }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			bool flag = bounds.Height >= font.GetGdiHeight() * 2;
			bool flag2 = (stringFormat.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap) == 0 && flag;
			bool flag3 = stringFormat.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.None;
			allowClipping = (stringFormat.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.NoClip) == 0 || (!flag2 && !flag3);
			if (!bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive() || (!flag2 && !flag3))
			{
				return array;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			SimpleTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider = new SimpleTextPropertiesProvider(font, stringFormat);
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				TextLineInfo textLineInfo = new TextLineInfo();
				TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(text2, font, Color.Empty, Color.Empty, isFirstBlockInLine: true, isLastBlockInLine: true);
				textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				textLineInfo.TextBlocks.Add(textBlockInfo);
				List<TextLineInfo> list2 = new List<TextLineInfo>();
				if (flag2)
				{
					list2.AddRange(textLineInfo.Wrap(bounds.Width, propertiesProvider, measurer));
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(textLineInfo);
				}
				foreach (TextLineInfo item in list2)
				{
					if (flag3 && item.Width > (float)bounds.Width)
					{
						item.Trim(bounds.Width, propertiesProvider, measurer);
					}
					list.Add(item.Text);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		{

		public void CreateGroup(SvgClippingDefinition clipping)
		{

				((SvgElement)currentGroup).ClippingDefinition = clipping;

		private static SvgTransformCollection CalculateRelativeTransform(DXHatchBrush hatchBrush)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_00fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0104: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SvgTransformCollection val = new SvgTransformCollection();

			{

			case DXHatchStyle.DarkHorizontal:

		private static SvgBrush CreateRadialGradientBrush(DXRadialGradientBrush radialBrush)

		public static SvgBrush CreateBrush(DXBrush dxBrush)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (dxBrush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
			{
				return (SvgBrush)new SvgSolidBrush(dXSolidBrush.Color);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXHatchBrush dXHatchBrush)
			{
				return (SvgBrush)new SvgHatchBrush(dXHatchBrush.ForegroundColor, dXHatchBrush.BackgroundColor, (SvgGradientUnits)2)
				{
					TransformCollection = CalculateRelativeTransform(dXHatchBrush)
				};
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXRadialGradientBrush radialBrush)
			{
				return CreateRadialGradientBrush(radialBrush);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush)
			{
				return (SvgBrush)new SvgLinearGradientBrush(CorrectEmptyColor(dXLinearGradientBrush.LinearColors[0]), CorrectEmptyColor(dXLinearGradientBrush.LinearColors[1]))
				{
					TransformCollection = CalculateRelativeTransform(dXLinearGradientBrush.Mode)
				};
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Unexpected brush type");
		}

		public static double? GetSvgOpacity(DXBrush dxBrush)
		{
			if (dxBrush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXSolidBrush { Color: var color })
			{
				return (double)(int)color.A / 255.0;
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		public static Tuple<string, SvgElement> GetSvgFill(DXBrush dxBrush)
		{
			if (dxBrush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
			{
				return new Tuple<string, SvgElement>(ColorTranslator.ToHtml(dXSolidBrush.Color), null);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXLinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush)
			{
				return GetSvgFill(linearGradientBrush);
			}
			return null;
		}

	public class SvgGeometricUtils
	{
		private static SvgPoint Polar2Cartesian(double angle, double radius)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SvgPoint(radius * Math.Cos(angle), (0.0 - radius) * Math.Sin(angle));
		}

		private static double CalcEllipseRadius(double rx, double ry, double angle)
		{
			return rx * ry / Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(rx * Math.Sin(angle), 2.0) + Math.Pow(ry * Math.Cos(angle), 2.0));
		}

		public static SvgPoint CalcEllipsePoint(SvgPoint center, double rx, double ry, double angle)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SvgPoint val = Polar2Cartesian(angle, CalcEllipseRadius(rx, ry, angle));
			return new SvgPoint(((SvgPoint)(ref center)).X + ((SvgPoint)(ref val)).X, ((SvgPoint)(ref center)).Y - ((SvgPoint)(ref val)).Y);
		}
	}

	public class NotificationElement : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		[Browsable(false)]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public event EventHandler PropertyChanging;

		protected virtual void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyPropertyChanging()
		{
			this.PropertyChanging?.Invoke(this, new EventArgs());
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessOldValue<T>(T storage)
		{
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null, PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChangedHandler = null, EventHandler propertyChangingHandler = null)
		{
			if (object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanging();
			if (storage is NotificationElement notificationElement)
			{
				notificationElement.PropertyChanged -= propertyChangedHandler;
				notificationElement.PropertyChanging -= propertyChangingHandler;
			}
			storage = value;
			if (storage is NotificationElement notificationElement2)
			{
				notificationElement2.PropertyChanged += propertyChangedHandler;
				notificationElement2.PropertyChanging += propertyChangingHandler;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(T storage, T value, Action setter, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanging();
			setter();
			NotifyPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}
	}
