	internal abstract class ParametricRegressionBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private const double deltaX = 3.0;

		public ParametricRegressionBehavior(Indicator indicator)
			: base(indicator)
		{
		}

		protected abstract double F(double x);

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CalculateRangeLimits(diagramMapping, out var rangeMin, out var rangeMax);
			double num = 3.0 * diagramMapping.LayoutX.Interval.Delta / (double)diagramMapping.Bounds.Width;
			int num2 = MathUtils.Ceiling((rangeMax - rangeMin) / num) + 1;
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(num2);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				double num3 = rangeMin + (double)i * num;
				double value = F(num3 + 1.0);
				GRealPoint2D item = (GRealPoint2D)diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(num3, value);
				lineStrip.Add(item);
			}
			List<LineStrip> source = StripsUtils.OptimizeScreenStrip(diagramMapping, lineStrip);
			List<LineStripItem> items = source.Select((LineStrip strip) => new LineStripItem(strip, base.Indicator.Color, base.Indicator.LineStyle, base.Indicator.LineStyle.Thickness)).ToList();
			return new LineStripsIndicatorLayout(base.Indicator, items);
		}

		private void CalculateRangeLimits(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, out double rangeMin, out double rangeMax)
		{
			rangeMin = diagramMapping.LayoutX.Range.Min;
			rangeMax = diagramMapping.LayoutX.Range.Max;
			ParametricRegression parametricRegression = (ParametricRegression)base.Indicator;
			if (parametricRegression.ForecastBackwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double refinedMin = diagramMapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.RefinedMin;
				double num = diagramMapping.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMin);
				num -= parametricRegression.ForecastBackwardPeriods;
				if (num > rangeMin)
				{
					rangeMin = num;
				}
			}
			double value = F(rangeMin);
			if (MathUtils.IsNanOrInfinity(value))
			{
				rangeMin = double.Epsilon;
			}
			if (parametricRegression.ForecastForwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double refinedMax = diagramMapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.RefinedMax;
				double num2 = diagramMapping.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMax);
				num2 += parametricRegression.ForecastForwardPeriods;
				if (num2 < rangeMax)
				{
					rangeMax = num2;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ExponentialRegressionBehavior : ParametricRegressionBehavior
	{
		private readonly ExponentialRegressionCalculator calculator = new ExponentialRegressionCalculator();

		public double A { get; private set; }

		public double B { get; private set; }

		public double SqrR { get; private set; }

		public override bool HasPoints => true;

		public ExponentialRegressionBehavior(ExponentialRegression exponentialRegression)
			: base(exponentialRegression)
		{
		}

		protected override double F(double x)
		{
			return A * Math.Exp(x * B);
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			if (base.Indicator.Visible)
			{
				ValueLevelInternal valueLevel = (ValueLevelInternal)((SingleLevelIndicator)base.Indicator).ValueLevel;
				Tuple<double, double> tuple = calculator.Calculate(points, valueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
				base.Visible = tuple != null;
				if (base.Visible)
				{
					A = tuple.Item1;
					B = tuple.Item2;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class PolynomialRegressionBehavior : ParametricRegressionBehavior
	{
		private readonly PolynomialRegressionCalculator calculator = new PolynomialRegressionCalculator();

		public double[] Parameters { get; private set; }

		public double SqrR { get; private set; }

		public override bool HasPoints => true;

		public PolynomialRegressionBehavior(PolynomialRegression polynomialRegression)
			: base(polynomialRegression)
		{
		}

		protected override double F(double x)
		{
			double num = Parameters[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < Parameters.Length; i++)
			{
				num += Parameters[i] * Math.Pow(x, i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			if (base.Indicator.Visible)
			{
				PolynomialRegression polynomialRegression = (PolynomialRegression)base.Indicator;
				ValueLevelInternal valueLevel = (ValueLevelInternal)polynomialRegression.ValueLevel;
				Parameters = calculator.Calculate(polynomialRegression.Degree, points, valueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
				base.Visible = Parameters != null;
			}
		}
	}
	public struct ChartLegendPosition : IEquatable<ChartLegendPosition>
	{
		public LegendAlignmentHorizontal Horizontal { get; }

		public LegendAlignmentVertical Vertical { get; }

		public ChartLegendPosition(LegendAlignmentHorizontal horizontal, LegendAlignmentVertical vertical)
		{
			Horizontal = horizontal;
			Vertical = vertical;
		}

		public bool Equals(ChartLegendPosition legendPosition)
		{
			if (Horizontal == legendPosition.Horizontal)
			{
				return Vertical == legendPosition.Vertical;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)((int)Horizontal * 10 + Vertical);
		}
	}
	internal static class OutLegendsViewDataCalculator
	{
		private static Rectangle ObtainAvailableBounds(Dictionary<ChartLegendPosition, Size> sizeByPosition, ChartLegendPosition position, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (!sizeByPosition.TryGetValue(position, out var value))
			{
				sizeByPosition.Add(position, Size.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				bounds.Height -= value.Height;
				if (position.Horizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside)
				{
					bounds.Width -= value.Width;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private static Rectangle UpdateBoundsCorrection(Dictionary<ChartLegendPosition, Size> sizeByPosition, ChartLegendPosition position, Size size, Rectangle boundsCorrection)
		{
			Size size2 = sizeByPosition[position];
			Size size3 = (sizeByPosition[position] = new Size(Math.Max(size2.Width, size.Width), size2.Height + size.Height));
			if (position.Vertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside)
			{
				boundsCorrection.Y = Math.Max(boundsCorrection.Y, size3.Height);
			}
			else if (position.Vertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside)
			{
				boundsCorrection.Height = Math.Max(boundsCorrection.Height, size3.Height);
			}
			if (position.Horizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside)
			{
				boundsCorrection.X = Math.Max(boundsCorrection.X, size3.Width);
			}
			else if (position.Horizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside)
			{
				boundsCorrection.Width = Math.Max(boundsCorrection.Width, size3.Width);
			}
			return boundsCorrection;
		}

		public static Rectangle CalculateLegendsViewData(List<LegendBase> legends, List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendsItems, Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			Rectangle boundsCorrection = default(Rectangle);
			Dictionary<ChartLegendPosition, Size> sizeByPosition = new Dictionary<ChartLegendPosition, Size>();
			foreach (LegendBase legend in legends)
			{
				if (legend.ActualDockTarget == null && legend.IsOutside)
				{
					ChartLegendPosition position = new ChartLegendPosition(legend.AlignmentHorizontal, legend.AlignmentVertical);
					Rectangle arrangeBounds = ObtainAvailableBounds(sizeByPosition, position, diagramBounds);
					LegendViewData legendViewData = LegendViewData.Create(legend, legendsItems[legend], arrangeBounds);
					if (legendViewData != null)
					{
						boundsCorrection = UpdateBoundsCorrection(sizeByPosition, position, legendViewData.OuterBounds.Size, boundsCorrection);
						legendViewDataList.Add(legendViewData);
					}
					legendsItems.Remove(legend);
				}
			}
			diagramBounds = new Rectangle(diagramBounds.X + boundsCorrection.X, diagramBounds.Y + boundsCorrection.Y, diagramBounds.Width - boundsCorrection.X - boundsCorrection.Width, diagramBounds.Height - boundsCorrection.Y - boundsCorrection.Height);
			Dictionary<ChartLegendPosition, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<ChartLegendPosition, int>();
			foreach (LegendViewData legendViewData2 in legendViewDataList)
			{
				ChartLegendPosition key = new ChartLegendPosition(legendViewData2.Legend.AlignmentHorizontal, legendViewData2.Legend.AlignmentVertical);
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = (dictionary[key] = 0);
				}
				legendViewData2.UpdateLocationAfterDiagramCorrection(diagramBounds, value, boundsCorrection.Height);
				dictionary[key] += legendViewData2.OuterBounds.Height;
			}
			return diagramBounds;
		}
	}
	public abstract class Diagram3DDomain
	{
		private readonly Diagram3D diagram;

		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private double width;

		private double height;

		private double depth;

		private double viewRadius;

		private double viewOffsetX;

		private double viewOffsetY;

		private double zoomFactor;

		private int[] viewport;

		private double[] modelView;

		private double[] projection;

		protected Diagram3D Diagram => diagram;

		protected double ViewRadius => viewRadius;

		protected double ZoomFactor => zoomFactor;

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public double Width => width;

		public double Height => height;

		public double Depth => depth;

		public double[] ModelViewMatrix => modelView;

		public abstract Rectangle ElementBounds { get; }

		protected Diagram3DDomain(Diagram3D diagram, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		private void CalcBoundsAccordingZoomingAndScrolling(double distance, out DiagramPoint p1, out DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			p1 = new DiagramPoint(viewOffsetX, viewOffsetY, distance);
			p2 = new DiagramPoint(0.0 - viewOffsetX, 0.0 - viewOffsetY, distance);
			double num = (double)(bounds.Width - ElementBounds.Width) * zoomFactor * 0.5;
			double num2 = (double)(bounds.Height - ElementBounds.Height) * zoomFactor * 0.5;
			p1 = DiagramPoint.Offset(p1, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num2, 0.0);
			p2 = DiagramPoint.Offset(p2, num, num2, 2.0 * viewRadius);
			if (Diagram.ZoomPercent != 100 || Diagram.HorizontalScrollPercent != 0.0 || Diagram.VerticalScrollPercent != 0.0)
			{
				double num3 = p2.X - p1.X;
				double num4 = p2.Y - p1.Y;
				double num5 = (p1.X + p2.X) / 2.0 - num3 * Diagram.HorizontalScrollPercent / 100.0;
				double num6 = (p1.Y + p2.Y) / 2.0 - num4 * Diagram.VerticalScrollPercent / 100.0;
				num = num3 / (double)Diagram.ZoomPercent * 50.0;
				num2 = num4 / (double)Diagram.ZoomPercent * 50.0;
				p1.X = num5 - num;
				p1.Y = num6 - num2;
				p2.X = num5 + num;
				p2.Y = num6 + num2;
			}
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateOrthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new TranslateGraphicsCommand(0.0, 0.0, (0.0 - viewRadius) * 2.0));
			CalcBoundsAccordingZoomingAndScrolling(viewRadius, out var p, out var p2);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new OrthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand(p, p2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreatePerspectiveGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (diagram.PerspectiveAngle == 0)
			{
				return CreateOrthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand();
			}
			double num = Math.Min(ElementBounds.Width, ElementBounds.Height);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			double num2 = 0.5 * num * zoomFactor / Math.Tan((double)diagram.PerspectiveAngle / 360.0 * Math.PI);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new TranslateGraphicsCommand(0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - num2 - viewRadius));
			CalcBoundsAccordingZoomingAndScrolling(num2, out var p, out var p2);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new FrustumProjectionGraphicsCommand(p, p2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected void SetWidth(double width)
		{
			this.width = width;
		}

		protected void SetHeight(double height)
		{
			this.height = height;
		}

		protected void SetDepth(double depth)
		{
			this.depth = depth;
		}

		protected void CalculateParameters()
		{
			SetDimensions();
			viewRadius = CalcViewRadius();
			if (!diagram.PerspectiveEnabled || diagram.PerspectiveAngle == 0)
			{
				zoomFactor = viewRadius * 2.0;
				viewOffsetX = 0.0 - viewRadius;
				viewOffsetY = 0.0 - viewRadius;
			}
			else
			{
				double num = (double)diagram.PerspectiveAngle / 360.0 * Math.PI;
				zoomFactor = 2.0 * viewRadius * (1.0 - Math.Sin(num)) / Math.Cos(num);
				viewOffsetX = (0.0 - zoomFactor) / 2.0;
				viewOffsetY = (0.0 - zoomFactor) / 2.0;
			}
			if (ElementBounds.Width > ElementBounds.Height)
			{
				zoomFactor /= ElementBounds.Height;
				viewOffsetX -= (double)(ElementBounds.Width - ElementBounds.Height) * zoomFactor * 0.5;
			}
			else
			{
				zoomFactor /= ElementBounds.Width;
				viewOffsetY -= (double)(ElementBounds.Height - ElementBounds.Width) * zoomFactor * 0.5;
			}
			viewport = new int[4] { bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height };
			using GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateProjectionGraphicsCommand());
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateModelViewGraphicsCommand());
			GLHelper.CalculateMatrices(graphicsCommand, out modelView, out projection);
		}

		protected abstract void SetDimensions();

		protected virtual double CalcViewRadius()
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(width * width + height * height + depth * depth) * 0.5;
		}

		protected virtual GraphicsCommand CreateAdditionalModelViewCommand()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateModelViewGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(diagram.CreateRotationGraphicsCommand());
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateAdditionalModelViewCommand());
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateProjectionGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (!diagram.PerspectiveEnabled)
			{
				return CreateOrthographicProjectionGraphicsCommand();
			}
			return CreatePerspectiveGraphicsCommand();
		}

		public DiagramPoint Project(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			GLU.Project(point.X, point.Y, point.Z, modelView, projection, viewport, out var winx, out var winy, out var winz);
			return new DiagramPoint(winx, (double)bounds.Height - winy + (double)bounds.Top + (double)bounds.Top, winz);
		}

		public DiagramPoint UnProject(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			GLU.UnProject(point.X, point.Y, point.Z, modelView, projection, viewport, out var objx, out var objy, out var objz);
			return new DiagramPoint(objx, objy, objz);
		}
	}

	public class DiagramCompatibility
	{
		private Diagram previousDiagram;

		private XYDiagram2D previousXYDiagram2D;

		private XYDiagram previousXYDiagram;

		internal XYDiagram2D PreviousXYDiagram2D => previousXYDiagram2D;

		private static void AssignPrimaryAxis(AxisBase currentAxis, AxisBase previousAxis)
		{
			if (currentAxis != null && previousAxis != null)
			{
				currentAxis.Assign(previousAxis);
			}
		}

		private static void AssignSecondaryAxis(SecondaryAxisCollection currentAxes, SecondaryAxisCollection previousAxes)
		{
			if (currentAxes != null && previousAxes != null)
			{
				for (int i = previousAxes.Count; i < currentAxes.Count; i++)
				{
					currentAxes.RemoveAt(i);
				}
				int num = previousAxes.Count - currentAxes.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					Axis2D item = ChartElementFactory.CreateNewAxis(currentAxes);
					CommonUtils.AddWithoutChanged(currentAxes, item);
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < currentAxes.Count; k++)
				{
					currentAxes[k].Assign(previousAxes[k]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AssignPrimaryAxes(Diagram currentDiagram, Diagram previousDiagram)
		{
			AssignPrimaryAxis(DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramAxisX(currentDiagram), DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramAxisX(previousDiagram));
			AssignPrimaryAxis(DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramAxisY(currentDiagram), DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramAxisY(previousDiagram));
		}

		private static void AssignSecondaryAxes(Diagram currentDiagram, XYDiagram2D previousXYDiagram)
		{
			AssignSecondaryAxis(DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramSecondaryAxesX(currentDiagram), DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramSecondaryAxesX(previousXYDiagram));
			AssignSecondaryAxis(DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramSecondaryAxesY(currentDiagram), DiagramAxisHelper.GetDiagramSecondaryAxesY(previousXYDiagram));
		}

		private void SetPreviousDiagram(Diagram diagram)
		{
			previousDiagram = diagram;
			if (previousDiagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				previousXYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)previousDiagram;
			}
			if (previousDiagram is XYDiagram)
			{
				previousXYDiagram = (XYDiagram)previousDiagram;
			}
		}

		public void EnsureCompatibility(Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (previousDiagram != null && diagram != null && previousDiagram.GetType() != diagram.GetType())
			{
				bool flag = diagram is XYDiagram2D;
				if (previousXYDiagram2D != null && flag && diagram != previousXYDiagram2D)
				{
					diagram.Assign(previousXYDiagram2D);
					AssignPrimaryAxes(diagram, previousXYDiagram2D);
					AssignSecondaryAxes(diagram, previousXYDiagram2D);
					if (diagram.GetType() == typeof(GanttDiagram) && previousXYDiagram2D.GetType() == typeof(XYDiagram))
					{
						((GanttDiagram)diagram).AxisX.Reverse = true;
					}
				}
				else if (previousXYDiagram != null && flag && diagram != previousXYDiagram)
				{
					diagram.Assign(previousXYDiagram);
					AssignPrimaryAxes(diagram, previousDiagram);
				}
				else if (diagram != previousDiagram)
				{
					diagram.Assign(previousDiagram);
					AssignPrimaryAxes(diagram, previousDiagram);
				}
			}
			SetPreviousDiagram(diagram);
		}
	}

	public abstract class PaneViewData : DiagramViewData
	{
		private readonly IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists;

		public override IList<LabelLayoutListBase> LabelLayoutLists => labelLayoutLists;

		protected bool IsLabelsResolveOverlapping { get; set; }

		public PaneViewData(Diagram diagram, Rectangle bounds, IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists)
			: base(diagram, bounds)
		{
			this.labelLayoutLists = labelLayoutLists;
		}

		protected bool IsResolveOverlappingEnabled(SeriesLabelBase label)
		{
			if (label != null && label.SeriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility)
			{
				return label.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists)
		{
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				if (labelLayoutList is SeriesLabelLayoutList seriesLabelLayoutList)
				{
					if (IsResolveOverlappingEnabled(seriesLabelLayoutList.Label))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (labelLayoutList is StackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList stackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList && stackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList.StackedBarTotalLabel.Visible && stackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList.StackedBarTotalLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual IList<LabelLayoutListBase> GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping()
		{
			List<LabelLayoutListBase> list = new List<LabelLayoutListBase>();
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				if (labelLayoutList is SeriesLabelLayoutList { Label: { SeriesBase: var seriesBase } } && seriesBase.ActualLabelsVisibility)
				{
					list.Add(labelLayoutList);
				}
				if (labelLayoutList is StackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList { StackedBarTotalLabel: var stackedBarTotalLabel } && stackedBarTotalLabel.Visible)
				{
					list.Add(labelLayoutList);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected void RenderSeriesLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (labelLayoutLists.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				labelLayoutList.RenderSeriesLabelConnectors(renderer);
			}
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList2 in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				labelLayoutList2.RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagram3DDomain : Diagram3DDomain, ISimpleDiagramDomain
	{
		private readonly Rectangle labelsBounds;

		private readonly Rectangle diagramBounds;

		private readonly double depthFactor;

		private readonly double heightToWidthRatio;

		public Rectangle LabelsBounds => CorrectLabelsBoundsAccordingZoomingAndScrolling(labelsBounds);

		public override Rectangle ElementBounds => diagramBounds;

		public static SimpleDiagram3DDomain Create(SimpleDiagram3D diagram, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle labelsBounds, Rectangle diagramBounds, ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView view)
		{
			SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain = new SimpleDiagram3DDomain(diagram, bounds, labelsBounds, diagramBounds, view);
			simpleDiagram3DDomain.CalculateParameters();
			return simpleDiagram3DDomain;
		}

		private SimpleDiagram3DDomain(SimpleDiagram3D diagram, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle labelsBounds, Rectangle diagramBounds, ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView view)
			: base(diagram, bounds)
		{
			this.labelsBounds = labelsBounds;
			this.diagramBounds = diagramBounds;
			depthFactor = view.DepthFactor;
			heightToWidthRatio = view.HeightToWidthRatio;
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectLabelsBoundsAccordingZoomingAndScrolling(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (base.Diagram.ZoomPercent == 100 && base.Diagram.HorizontalScrollPercent == 0.0 && base.Diagram.VerticalScrollPercent == 0.0)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double num = (double)bounds.Width * base.ZoomFactor;
			double num2 = (double)bounds.Height * base.ZoomFactor;
			double num3 = (double)bounds.Left + (double)bounds.Width / 2.0 + num * base.Diagram.HorizontalScrollPercent / 100.0;
			double num4 = (double)bounds.Top + (double)bounds.Height / 2.0 + num2 * base.Diagram.VerticalScrollPercent / 100.0;
			double num5 = (double)(bounds.Width * base.Diagram.ZoomPercent) / 200.0;
			double num6 = (double)(bounds.Height * base.Diagram.ZoomPercent) / 200.0;
			int left = (int)Math.Round(num3 - num5);
			int top = (int)Math.Round(num4 - num6);
			int right = (int)Math.Round(num3 + num5);
			int bottom = (int)Math.Round(num4 + num6);
			return Rectangle.FromLTRB(left, top, right, bottom);
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateLightingCommand(out GraphicsCommand innerLightingCommand)
		{
			double num = base.ViewRadius * 0.7;
			DiagramPoint position = new DiagramPoint(0.0 - num, 1.5 * num, num * 2.0);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new LightGraphicsCommand(0, Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), Color.FromArgb(255, 130, 130, 130), Color.FromArgb(255, 50, 50, 50), position, DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(0.0 - position.X, 0.0 - position.Y, 0.0 - position.Z), 0f, 180f, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			position = new DiagramPoint((0.0 - num) * 2.0, (0.0 - num) * 2.0, num * 4.0);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new LightGraphicsCommand(1, Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), Color.FromArgb(255, 80, 80, 80), Color.FromArgb(255, 100, 100, 100), position, DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(0.0 - position.X, 0.0 - position.Y, 0.0 - position.Z), 0f, 180f, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			innerLightingCommand = graphicsCommand2;
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected override void SetDimensions()
		{
			SetWidth(diagramBounds.Width);
			SetHeight(diagramBounds.Height);
			SetDepth(Math.Min(diagramBounds.Width, (double)diagramBounds.Height / heightToWidthRatio) * depthFactor);
		}

		protected override double CalcViewRadius()
		{
			double num = Math.Min(base.Height, base.Width * heightToWidthRatio);
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + base.Depth * base.Depth) * 0.5 * 1.001;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(out GraphicsCommand innerCommand, out GraphicsCommand innerCommandForLabelConnector)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new DepthTestGraphicsCommand();
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand3 = new LightingGraphicsCommand(Color.FromArgb(255, 130, 130, 130), Color.White, Color.Black, 10f);
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand3);
			graphicsCommand3.AddChildCommand(new IdentityTransformGraphicsCommand(TransformMatrix.ModelView));
			graphicsCommand3.AddChildCommand(new IdentityTransformGraphicsCommand(TransformMatrix.Projection));
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand4 = CreateProjectionGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand3.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand4);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand5 = new PolygonAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand4.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand5);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand6 = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand5.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand6);
			graphicsCommand6.AddChildCommand(CreateLightingCommand(out innerCommand));
			innerCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateModelViewGraphicsCommand());
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand7 = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand5.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand7);
			innerCommandForLabelConnector = new LightGraphicsCommand(0, Color.FromArgb(255, 130, 130, 130), Color.Black, Color.Black, DiagramPoint.Zero, DiagramVector.Zero, 0f, 180f, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			innerCommandForLabelConnector.AddChildCommand(CreateModelViewGraphicsCommand());
			graphicsCommand7.AddChildCommand(innerCommandForLabelConnector);
			return graphicsCommand;
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagram3DViewData : SimpleDiagramViewData
	{
		public SimpleDiagram3DViewData(Diagram diagram, Rectangle bounds, List<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList, List<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList, bool isEmptyDiagramViewData)
			: base(diagram, bounds, seriesLayoutList, labelLayoutLists, annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, legendViewDataList, isEmptyDiagramViewData)
		{
			base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping = CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(labelLayoutLists);
		}

		public override void CalculateSeriesAndLabelLayout(ChartDrawingHelper drawingHelper, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			ResolveOverlappingHelper.ProcessForSimpleDiagram(GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping(), base.Diagram.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
		}

		public override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			foreach (SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase seriesLayout in base.SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				if (seriesLayout is SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout)
				{
					graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(simpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout.CreateGraphicsCommand());
				}
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public override void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext, bool renderInOverlays)
		{
			foreach (SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout in base.SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				seriesLayout.RenderTitles(renderer);
			}
			foreach (SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout2 in base.SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				if (seriesLayout2.Domain != null)
				{
					renderer.SetClipping(seriesLayout2.Domain.Bounds);
					seriesLayout2.RenderExclamation(renderer);
					seriesLayout2.LabelLayoutList.RenderSeriesLabelConnectors(renderer);
					seriesLayout2.LabelLayoutList.RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
					renderer.RestoreClipping();
					seriesLayout2.RenderAnnotations(renderer);
				}
			}
			base.RenderAbove(renderer, renderContext, renderInOverlays);
		}
	}

	public class SimpleDiagramViewData : PaneViewData
	{
		private readonly List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		private readonly List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList;

		private readonly IList<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList;

		private readonly bool isEmpty;

		public IList<SeriesLayout> SeriesLayoutList => seriesLayoutList;

		public override List<AnnotationLayout> AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout => annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		public override bool IsEmpty => isEmpty;

		public override List<LegendViewData> LegendViewDataList => legendViewDataList;

		public SimpleDiagramViewData(Diagram diagram, Rectangle bounds, List<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList, List<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList, bool isEmpty)
			: base(diagram, bounds, labelLayoutLists)
		{
			this.annotationsAnchorPointsLayout = annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;
			this.legendViewDataList = legendViewDataList;
			this.seriesLayoutList = seriesLayoutList;
			this.isEmpty = isEmpty;
			base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping = CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(labelLayoutLists);
		}

		private bool IsAnimationDisabledOrFinished(SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout)
		{
			SeriesViewBase view = seriesLayout.View;
			double num = view.ActualSeriesAnimation?.CalculateAnimationProgress(view.Chart.AnimationTimeMs) ?? 1.0;
			return num == 1.0;
		}

		public override void CalculateSeriesAndLabelLayout(ChartDrawingHelper drawingHelper, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			ResolveOverlappingHelper.ProcessForSimpleDiagram(GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping(), base.Diagram.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
		}

		public override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.SetClipping(base.Bounds);
			foreach (SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout in SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				seriesLayout.RenderContent(renderer);
				seriesLayout.RenderExclamation(renderer);
			}
			foreach (SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout2 in SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				if (IsAnimationDisabledOrFinished(seriesLayout2))
				{
					seriesLayout2.LabelLayoutList.RenderSeriesLabelConnectors(renderer);
					seriesLayout2.LabelLayoutList.RenderSeriesLabels(renderer, base.Bounds);
					seriesLayout2.RenderAnnotations(renderer);
				}
			}
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		public override void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public override void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext, bool renderInOverlays)
		{
			foreach (LegendViewData legendViewData in legendViewDataList)
			{
				legendViewData.Render(renderer, base.Bounds);
			}
		}
	}
	public class Axis3DMapping
	{
		private readonly XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator;

		private readonly bool vertical;

		public Axis3DMapping(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Axis3D axis)
		{
			this.coordsCalculator = coordsCalculator;
			vertical = axis.IsVertical;
		}

		private DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(double argument, double value, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			double argument2;
			double value2;
			if (vertical)
			{
				argument2 = value;
				value2 = argument;
			}
			else
			{
				argument2 = argument;
				value2 = value;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPointForDiagram = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPointForDiagram(argument2, value2);
			diagramPointForDiagram.X += selfOffset;
			diagramPointForDiagram.Y += normalOffset;
			return diagramPointForDiagram;
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetNearDiagramPoint(double axisValue, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			return GetDiagramPoint(axisValue, double.NegativeInfinity, selfOffset, normalOffset);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetFarDiagramPoint(double axisValue, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			return GetDiagramPoint(axisValue, double.PositiveInfinity, selfOffset, normalOffset);
		}
	}

	public class CrosshairPaneViewDataFactory
	{
		private readonly CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions;

		private readonly CrosshairViewData crosshairViewData;

		private readonly CrosshairSeriesLabel crosshairSeriesLabel;

		private readonly TextAnnotationAppearance textAppearance;

		private CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs customDrawCrosshairEventArgs;

		public CrosshairViewData CrosshairViewData => crosshairViewData;

		public CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs => customDrawCrosshairEventArgs;

		public CrosshairPaneViewDataFactory(TextAnnotationAppearance textAppearance, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			this.crosshairOptions = crosshairOptions;
			crosshairSeriesLabel = new CrosshairSeriesLabel(textAppearance, crosshairOptions);
			this.textAppearance = textAppearance;
			crosshairViewData = new CrosshairViewData(textAppearance, crosshairOptions);
		}

		public void ProcessCrosshairInfo(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfos, List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> highlightedPointsInfo, bool useCommonSeriesLabel, IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			List<CrosshairPaneViewData> list = new List<CrosshairPaneViewData>();
			List<CrosshairElementGroup> list2 = new List<CrosshairElementGroup>();
			CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement = null;
			List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> list3 = new List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement>();
			foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo in crosshairInfos.CrosshairPaneInfos)
			{
				CrosshairPaneViewData crosshairPaneViewData = new CrosshairPaneViewData(crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairSeriesLabel, crosshairOptions, highlightedPointsInfo, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
				if (crosshairPaneViewData == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(crosshairPaneViewData);
				if (crosshairLineElement == null)
				{
					crosshairLineElement = crosshairPaneViewData.CrosshairLineElement;
				}
				else
				{
					crosshairPaneViewData.CrosshairLineElement = crosshairLineElement;
				}
				if (useCommonSeriesLabel)
				{
					if (crosshairPaneViewData.CrosshairElementGroups.Count > 0)
					{
						list2 = crosshairPaneViewData.CrosshairElementGroups;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list2.AddRange(crosshairPaneViewData.CrosshairElementGroups);
				}
				list3.AddRange(crosshairPaneViewData.CrosshairAxisLabelElements);
			}
			crosshairViewData.SetCrosshairPaneViewDataList(list);
			CrosshairLegendViewData crosshairLegendViewData = new CrosshairLegendViewData(crosshairInfos, textAppearance, crosshairOptions, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			crosshairViewData.SetCrosshairLegendViewData(crosshairLegendViewData);
			if (crosshairInfos.CrosshairPaneInfos.Count > 0)
			{
				customDrawCrosshairEventArgs = new CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs(list2, crosshairLineElement, list3, crosshairLegendViewData.LegendElements, crosshairLegendViewData.IndicatorLegendElements);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessAfterCustomDraw()
		{
			foreach (CrosshairPaneViewData crosshairPaneViewData in crosshairViewData.CrosshairPaneViewDataList)
			{
				crosshairPaneViewData.CalculatePointsHighlightingVisibility();
			}
		}
	}

	{

				this.crosshairSeriesPoint = crosshairSeriesPoint;
				this.crosshairElement = crosshairElement;
			}
		}

		internal struct CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo
		{
			private CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo;

			private CrosshairAxisLabelElement crosshairAxisLabelElement;

			public CrosshairAxisInfo CrosshairAxisInfo => crosshairAxisInfo;

			public CrosshairAxisLabelElement CrosshairAxisLabelElement => crosshairAxisLabelElement;

			public CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo(CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo, CrosshairAxisLabelElement crosshairAxisLabelElement)
			{
				this.crosshairAxisInfo = crosshairAxisInfo;
				this.crosshairAxisLabelElement = crosshairAxisLabelElement;
			}
		}

		internal struct CrosshairLineDrawInfo
		{
			private CrosshairLine crosshairLine;

			private CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement;

			public CrosshairLine CrosshairLine => crosshairLine;

			public CrosshairLineElement CrosshairLineElement
			{
				get
				{
					return crosshairLineElement;
				}
				set
				{
					crosshairLineElement = value;
				}
			}

			public CrosshairLineDrawInfo(CrosshairLine crosshairLine, CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement)
			{
				this.crosshairLine = crosshairLine;
				this.crosshairLineElement = crosshairLineElement;
			}
		}

		private List<CrosshairPointDrawInfo> pointDrawInfos;

		private CrosshairLineDrawInfo cursorArgumentLineDrawInfo;

		private CrosshairLineDrawInfo cursorValueLineDrawInfo;

		private CrosshairLineElement actualCursorLineElement;

		private List<CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo> cursorAxisLabelDrawInfos;

		private List<CrosshairElementGroup> elementGroups;

		internal List<CrosshairPointDrawInfo> PointDrawInfos => pointDrawInfos;

		internal List<CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo> CursorAxisLabelDrawInfos => cursorAxisLabelDrawInfos;

		internal CrosshairLineDrawInfo CursorArgumentLineDrawInfo => cursorArgumentLineDrawInfo;

		internal CrosshairLineDrawInfo CursorValueLineDrawInfo => cursorValueLineDrawInfo;

		internal CrosshairLineElement CrosshairLineElement
		{
			get
			{
				return actualCursorLineElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (cursorArgumentLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement != null)
				{
					cursorArgumentLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement = value;
				}
				if (cursorValueLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement != null)
				{
					cursorValueLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public List<CrosshairElementGroup> CrosshairElementGroups => elementGroups;

		public CrosshairDrawInfo(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairInfo, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			pointDrawInfos = new List<CrosshairPointDrawInfo>();
			elementGroups = new List<CrosshairElementGroup>();
			cursorAxisLabelDrawInfos = new List<CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo>();
			FillPointDrawInfos(crosshairInfo, crosshairOptions, appearance, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			if (crosshairInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine != null || crosshairInfo.CursorValueCrossLine != null)
			{
				CrosshairLine crosshairLine = ((crosshairInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine != null) ? crosshairInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine : crosshairInfo.CursorValueCrossLine);
				bool flag = false;
				actualCursorLineElement = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions, crosshairLine, (crosshairOptions.LinesMode != CrosshairLinesMode.Auto) ? (crosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLine || crosshairOptions.ShowValueLine) : (crosshairLine.IsValueLine ? crosshairOptions.ShowValueLine : crosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLine), shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			}
			if (crosshairInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine != null)
			{
				cursorArgumentLineDrawInfo = new CrosshairLineDrawInfo(crosshairInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine, actualCursorLineElement);
			}
			if (crosshairInfo.CursorValueCrossLine != null)
			{
				cursorValueLineDrawInfo = new CrosshairLineDrawInfo(crosshairInfo.CursorValueCrossLine, actualCursorLineElement);
			}
			FillCursorAxisLabelDrawInfos(crosshairInfo);
		}

		private void FillPointDrawInfos(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairInfo, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, TextAnnotationAppearance appearance, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairLabelInfo item in crosshairInfo.LabelsInfo)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairPointsGroup pointGroup in item.PointGroups)
				{
					CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup = new CrosshairElementGroup(CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairGroupHeaderElement(pointGroup, crosshairOptions.GroupHeaderTextOptions, appearance), item);
					foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase point in pointGroup.Points)
					{
						CrosshairElementBase crosshairElementBase = CrosshairPointElementFactory.CreateCrosshairElement(point, crosshairOptions, appearance, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
						pointDrawInfos.Add(new CrosshairPointDrawInfo(point, crosshairElementBase));
						crosshairElementBase.AddToGroup(crosshairElementGroup);
					}
					elementGroups.Add(crosshairElementGroup);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillCursorAxisLabelDrawInfos(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairInfo)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairAxisInfo item in crosshairInfo.CursorAxesInfo)
			{
				cursorAxisLabelDrawInfos.Add(new CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo(item, CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(item)));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class CrosshairViewDataBase : IDisposable
	{
		private RectangleIndents labelIndents;

		protected abstract Chart Chart { get; }

		protected bool Disposed { get; private set; }

		~CrosshairViewDataBase()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private void InitializeIndents()
		{
			labelIndents = new RectangleIndents(Chart, initDefaults: true);
		}

		private RectangleF GetRectangle(CrosshairAxisInfo axisLabelInfo, CrosshairTextElement textElement)
		{
			if (labelIndents == null)
			{
				InitializeIndents();
			}
			axisLabelInfo.Size = new GRealSize2D(textElement.Painter.Width, textElement.Painter.Height);
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = labelIndents.IncreaseRectangle(axisLabelInfo.Bounds);
			return new RectangleF((float)Math.Floor(gRealRect2D.Left), (float)Math.Floor(gRealRect2D.Top), (float)gRealRect2D.Width, (float)gRealRect2D.Height);
		}

		private PointF CreatePointF(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			return new PointF((float)point.X, (float)point.Y);
		}

		protected void RenderCrosshairAxisLabel(ChartRenderer renderer, CrosshairAxisInfo axisLabelInfo, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement)
		{
			if (axisLabelElement != null && axisLabelElement.Visible)
			{
				if (labelIndents == null)
				{
					InitializeIndents();
				}
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = labelIndents.DpiScaledThickness;
				int maxWidth = (dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right) / 2 + (int)axisLabelInfo.MaxSize.Width;
				CrosshairTextElement crosshairTextElement = new CrosshairAxisLabelTextElement(Chart, axisLabelElement, axisLabelElement.BackColor, null, maxWidth);
				RectangleF rectangle = GetRectangle(axisLabelInfo, crosshairTextElement);
				renderer.FillRectangle(rectangle, axisLabelElement.BackColor);
				crosshairTextElement.RenderText(renderer, rectangle);
			}
		}

		protected void RenderCrosshairLine(ChartRenderer renderer, CrosshairLine crosshairLine, CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement)
		{
			if (crosshairLineElement != null && crosshairLineElement.Visible)
			{
				Color color = crosshairLineElement.Color;
				LineStyle lineStyle = crosshairLineElement.LineStyle;
				renderer.DrawLine(CreatePointF(crosshairLine.Line.Start), CreatePointF(crosshairLine.Line.End), color, lineStyle);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			Disposed = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairPaneViewData : CrosshairViewDataBase
	{
		private readonly CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo;

		private readonly CrosshairSeriesLabel crosshairSeriesLabel;

		private readonly CrosshairDrawInfo drawInfo;

		private readonly List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> highlightedPointsInfo;

		private readonly bool showArgumentLine;

		private readonly bool showValueLine;

		private List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> crosshairAxisLabelElements;

		protected override Chart Chart => crosshairSeriesLabel.Chart;

		public CrosshairLineElement CrosshairLineElement
		{
			get
			{
				return drawInfo.CrosshairLineElement;
			}
			set
			{
				drawInfo.CrosshairLineElement = value;
			}
		}

		public List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> CrosshairAxisLabelElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (crosshairAxisLabelElements == null)
				{
					crosshairAxisLabelElements = GetCrosshairAxisLabelElements(drawInfo.CursorAxisLabelDrawInfos);
				}
				return crosshairAxisLabelElements;
			}
		}

		public List<CrosshairElementGroup> CrosshairElementGroups => drawInfo.CrosshairElementGroups;

		public CrosshairPaneViewData(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSeriesLabel crosshairSeriesLabel, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, List<CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo> highlightedPointsInfo, bool shouldCustomDrawCrosshair)
		{
			this.crosshairPaneInfo = crosshairPaneInfo;
			this.crosshairSeriesLabel = crosshairSeriesLabel;
			this.highlightedPointsInfo = highlightedPointsInfo;
			drawInfo = new CrosshairDrawInfo(crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairOptions, crosshairSeriesLabel.TextAppearance, shouldCustomDrawCrosshair);
			showArgumentLine = crosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLine;
			showValueLine = crosshairOptions.ShowValueLine;
		}

		private List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> GetCrosshairAxisLabelElements(List<CrosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo> cursorAxisLabelDrawInfos)
		{
			List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> list = new List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement>();
			foreach (CrosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo cursorAxisLabelDrawInfo in cursorAxisLabelDrawInfos)
			{
				list.Add(cursorAxisLabelDrawInfo.CrosshairAxisLabelElement);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void CalculatePointsHighlightingVisibility()
		{
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in CrosshairElementGroups)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairElement crosshairElement in crosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements)
				{
					if (crosshairElement.Visible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo item in highlightedPointsInfo)
					{
						if (item.Series == crosshairElement.Series)
						{
							item.Hide();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderAxisLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairPointDrawInfo pointDrawInfo in drawInfo.PointDrawInfos)
			{
				if (pointDrawInfo.CrosshairElement.Visible)
				{
					RenderCrosshairAxisLabel(renderer, pointDrawInfo.CrosshairSeriesPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo, pointDrawInfo.CrosshairElement.AxisLabelElement);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderCursorAxisLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairAxisLabelDrawInfo cursorAxisLabelDrawInfo in drawInfo.CursorAxisLabelDrawInfos)
			{
				RenderCrosshairAxisLabel(renderer, cursorAxisLabelDrawInfo.CrosshairAxisInfo, cursorAxisLabelDrawInfo.CrosshairAxisLabelElement);
			}
		}

		public void RenderLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairPointDrawInfo pointDrawInfo in drawInfo.PointDrawInfos)
			{
				if (pointDrawInfo.CrosshairElement.Visible)
				{
					RenderCrosshairLine(renderer, pointDrawInfo.CrosshairSeriesPoint.CrosshairLine, pointDrawInfo.CrosshairElement.LineElement);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderCursorLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (drawInfo.CursorArgumentLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLine != null && drawInfo.CursorArgumentLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement != null && showArgumentLine)
			{
				RenderCrosshairLine(renderer, drawInfo.CursorArgumentLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLine, drawInfo.CursorArgumentLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement);
			}
			if (drawInfo.CursorValueLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLine != null && drawInfo.CursorValueLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement != null && showValueLine)
			{
				RenderCrosshairLine(renderer, drawInfo.CursorValueLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLine, drawInfo.CursorValueLineDrawInfo.CrosshairLineElement);
			}
		}

		public void RenderLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			crosshairSeriesLabel.Render(renderer, crosshairPaneInfo, drawInfo.CrosshairElementGroups);
		}

		public void RenderHighlighting(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo item in highlightedPointsInfo)
			{
				Series series = item.Series;
				if (series != null && series.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)
				{
					xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ClearHighlightingCache();
				}
			}
			foreach (CrosshairHighlightedPointInfo item2 in highlightedPointsInfo)
			{
				Series series2 = item2.Series;
				if (item2.Visible && series2 != null && series2.ActualCrosshairHighlightPoints)
				{
					XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2 = series2.View as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
					DXGraphicsPath clipRegion = item2.ClipRegion;
					if (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2 != null && clipRegion != null)
					{
						renderer.SetClipping(clipRegion);
						xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2.RenderHighlightedPoint(renderer, item2.Layout);
						xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2.RegisterHighlightedHitRegion(renderer, item2.Layout);
						renderer.RestoreClipping();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RenderLines(renderer);
			RenderCursorLines(renderer);
		}

		public void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RenderAxisLabels(renderer);
			RenderCursorAxisLabels(renderer);
			RenderLabels(renderer);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairSeriesLabel : IAnnotationShapeOwner, IHitTest
	{
		private struct LabelElementSizes
		{
			private readonly double lineHeight;

			private readonly SizeF elementSize;

			private readonly SizeF headerSize;

			private readonly SizeF footerSize;

			public double LineHeight => lineHeight;

			public SizeF ElementSize => elementSize;

			public SizeF HeaderSize => headerSize;

			public SizeF FooterSize => footerSize;

			public LabelElementSizes(double lineHeight, SizeF textSize, SizeF headerSize, SizeF footerSize)
			{
				this.lineHeight = lineHeight;
				elementSize = textSize;
				this.headerSize = headerSize;
				this.footerSize = footerSize;
			}
		}

		private const int DefaultTailHeight = 20;

		private readonly RectangleIndents labelIndents;

		private readonly RectangleIndents markerIndents;

		private readonly RectangleIndents itemIndents;

		private readonly Color borderColor;

		private readonly Color backColor;

		private readonly RectangleFillStyle fillStyle;

		private readonly RoundedRectangleAnnotationShape shape;

		private readonly TextAnnotationAppearance textAppearance;

		private readonly bool showTail;

		private readonly CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions;

		private int TailHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (!showTail)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 20;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

		internal TextAnnotationAppearance TextAppearance => textAppearance;

		internal Chart Chart => crosshairOptions.Chart;

		public bool BorderVisible => true;

		public int BorderThickness => 1;

		public Color BorderColor => borderColor;

		public RectangleFillStyle FillStyle => fillStyle;

		public Color BackColor => backColor;

		public int ShapeFillet => 3;

		public Shadow Shadow => null;

		public AnnotationConnectorStyle ConnectorStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (!showTail)
				{
					return AnnotationConnectorStyle.None;
				}
				return AnnotationConnectorStyle.Tail;
			}
		}

		public int Angle => 0;

		object IHitTest.Object => null;

		HitTestState IHitTest.State => new HitTestState();

		bool IHitTest.CanBeHot => false;

		bool IAnnotationShapeOwner.RuntimeOperationSelect => false;

		public CrosshairSeriesLabel(TextAnnotationAppearance textAppearance, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			this.crosshairOptions = crosshairOptions;
			this.textAppearance = textAppearance;
			borderColor = textAppearance.BorderColor;
			backColor = (crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelBackColor.IsEmpty ? textAppearance.BackColor : crosshairOptions.CrosshairLabelBackColor);
			fillStyle = textAppearance.FillStyle;
			showTail = ((ICrosshairOptions)crosshairOptions).ShowTail;
			shape = new RoundedRectangleAnnotationShape(this);
			Chart chart = crosshairOptions.Chart;
			labelIndents = new RectangleIndents(null, chart)
			{
				Left = 12,
				Top = 8,
				Right = 12,
				Bottom = 8
			};
			markerIndents = new RectangleIndents(null, chart)
			{
				Left = 0,
				Top = 1,
				Right = 2,
				Bottom = 1
			};
			itemIndents = new RectangleIndents(null, chart)
			{
				Left = 0,
				Top = 3,
				Right = 0,
				Bottom = 3
			};
		}

		bool IAnnotationShapeOwner.CanDrag()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private GRealSize2D CalcWholeLabelSizes(List<CrosshairElementGroup> elementGroups, CrosshairLabelInfo seriesLabelInfo, Dictionary<CrosshairLabelElement, LabelElementSizes> labelElementSizesCache, Dictionary<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement, SizeF> headerSizeCache)
		{
			GRealSize2D size = new GRealSize2D(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup elementGroup in elementGroups)
			{
				if (elementGroup.Label != seriesLabelInfo)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool actualVisibility = elementGroup.HeaderElement.ActualVisibility;
				foreach (CrosshairElementBase element in elementGroup.Elements)
				{
					CrosshairLabelElement labelElement = element.LabelElement;
					if (element.Visible && labelElement.Visible)
					{
						labelElement.InitializeTextElement(Chart, backColor, fillStyle);
						LabelElementSizes value = CalcLabelElementSizes(labelElement, labelElement.TextElement);
						labelElementSizesCache.Add(labelElement, value);
						SizeF elementSize = value.ElementSize;
						size.Height += elementSize.Height;
						size.Height += value.HeaderSize.Height;
						size.Height += value.FooterSize.Height;
						size.Width = Math.Max(elementSize.Width, size.Width);
					}
				}
				if (actualVisibility)
				{
					CrosshairGroupHeaderElement headerElement = elementGroup.HeaderElement;
					headerElement.InitializeTextElement(Chart, backColor, fillStyle);
					SizeF size2 = headerElement.TextElement.Size;
					size2 = itemIndents.IncreaseSizeF(size2);
					size.Height += size2.Height;
					size.Width = Math.Max(size2.Width, size.Width);
					headerSizeCache.Add(headerElement, size2);
				}
			}
			size = labelIndents.IncreaseSizeF(size);
			size.Height += TailHeight;
			return size;
		}

		private bool IsVisible(CrosshairLabelInfo label, List<CrosshairElementGroup> elementGroups)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup elementGroup in elementGroups)
			{
				if (elementGroup.Label != label)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CrosshairElementBase element in elementGroup.Elements)
				{
					if (element.Visible && !element.LabelElement.Empty)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateMarkerBounds(LabelElementSizes labelElementSizes, RectangleF bounds, Size markerSize, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = markerIndents.DpiScaledThickness;
			int x = (isRightToLeft ? (MathUtils.StrongRound(bounds.X + bounds.Width - (float)markerSize.Width) - dpiScaledThickness.Left) : (MathUtils.StrongRound(bounds.X) + dpiScaledThickness.Left));
			int y = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)bounds.Y + labelElementSizes.LineHeight * 0.5 - (double)markerSize.Height * 0.5 + (double)itemIndents.DpiScaledThickness.Top);
			return new Rectangle(x, y, markerSize.Width, markerSize.Height);
		}

		private RectangleF CalcWholeLabelBounds(AnnotationLocation location, GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			RectangleF result = new RectangleF((float)bounds.Left, (float)bounds.Top, (float)bounds.Width, (float)bounds.Height);
			if (location == AnnotationLocation.TopLeft || location == AnnotationLocation.TopRight)
			{
				result = new RectangleF((float)bounds.Left, (float)bounds.Top, (float)bounds.Width, (float)Math.Max(bounds.Height - (double)TailHeight, 0.0));
			}
			if (location == AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft || location == AnnotationLocation.BottomRight)
			{
				result = new RectangleF((float)bounds.Left, (float)(bounds.Top + (double)TailHeight), (float)bounds.Width, (float)Math.Max(bounds.Height - (double)TailHeight, 0.0));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private LabelElementSizes CalcLabelElementSizes(CrosshairLabelElement labelElement, CrosshairLabelTextElement element)
		{
			double val;
			SizeF size;
			if (labelElement.TextVisible)
			{
				size = element.Size;
				val = element.GetFirstLineHeight();
			}
			else
			{
				size = new SizeF(0f, 0f);
				val = 0.0;
			}
			SizeF sizeF = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelElement.HeaderText) ? new SizeF(0f, 0f) : element.HeaderSize);
			SizeF sizeF2 = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelElement.FooterText) ? new SizeF(0f, 0f) : element.FooterSize);
			Size size2 = markerIndents.IncreaseSize(labelElement.MarkerSize);
			val = Math.Max(val, size2.Height);
			size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height);
			size.Width += size2.Width;
			float val2 = Math.Max(size.Width, sizeF.Width);
			val2 = Math.Max(val2, sizeF2.Width);
			float num = (sizeF2.Width = val2);
			float width = (sizeF.Width = num);
			size.Width = width;
			size = itemIndents.IncreaseSizeF(size);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelElement.HeaderText))
			{
				sizeF = itemIndents.IncreaseSizeF(sizeF);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelElement.FooterText))
			{
				sizeF2 = itemIndents.IncreaseSizeF(sizeF2);
			}
			return new LabelElementSizes(val, size, sizeF, sizeF2);
		}

		private void RenderMarkerAndText(ChartRenderer renderer, CrosshairElementBase element, LabelElementSizes labelElementSizes, RectangleF elementBounds)
		{
			CrosshairLabelElement labelElement = element.LabelElement;
			Rectangle rectangle = CalculateMarkerBounds(labelElementSizes, elementBounds, labelElement.MarkerSize, renderer.IsRightToLeft);
			if (labelElement.MarkerVisible)
			{
				if (labelElement.DXMarkerImage != null)
				{
					renderer.DrawImage(labelElement.DXMarkerImage, rectangle, (DXImageSizeMode)labelElement.MarkerImageSizeMode);
				}
				else
				{
					element.RenderMarker(renderer, rectangle);
				}
			}
			rectangle = markerIndents.IncreaseRectangle(rectangle);
			float x = (renderer.IsRightToLeft ? elementBounds.Left : (elementBounds.Left + (float)rectangle.Width));
			RectangleF expectedBounds = new RectangleF(x, elementBounds.Y, Math.Max(elementBounds.Width - (float)rectangle.Width, 0f), elementBounds.Height);
			if (labelElement.TextVisible)
			{
				labelElement.TextElement.RenderText(renderer, expectedBounds);
			}
		}

		private void RenderCrosshairLabelElement(CrosshairElementBase element, ChartRenderer renderer, LabelElementSizes labelElementSizes, RectangleF wholeLabelBounds, float offsetY)
		{
			float height = labelElementSizes.HeaderSize.Height;
			RectangleF expectedBounds = new RectangleF(wholeLabelBounds.X, wholeLabelBounds.Y + offsetY, wholeLabelBounds.Width, height);
			CrosshairLabelTextElement textElement = element.LabelElement.TextElement;
			textElement.RenderHeader(renderer, expectedBounds);
			offsetY += height;
			SizeF elementSize = labelElementSizes.ElementSize;
			float x = ((!renderer.IsRightToLeft) ? wholeLabelBounds.Left : (wholeLabelBounds.Right - elementSize.Width));
			RenderMarkerAndText(elementBounds: new RectangleF(x, wholeLabelBounds.Y + offsetY, elementSize.Width, elementSize.Height), renderer: renderer, element: element, labelElementSizes: labelElementSizes);
			offsetY += elementSize.Height;
			float height2 = labelElementSizes.FooterSize.Height;
			RectangleF expectedBounds2 = new RectangleF(wholeLabelBounds.X, wholeLabelBounds.Y + offsetY, wholeLabelBounds.Width, height2);
			textElement.RenderFooter(renderer, expectedBounds2);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, List<CrosshairElementGroup> elementGroups)
		{
			Dictionary<CrosshairLabelElement, LabelElementSizes> dictionary = new Dictionary<CrosshairLabelElement, LabelElementSizes>();
			Dictionary<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement, SizeF> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement, SizeF>();
			foreach (CrosshairLabelInfo item in crosshairPaneInfo.LabelsInfo)
			{
				item.Size = CalcWholeLabelSizes(elementGroups, item, dictionary, dictionary2);
			}
			crosshairPaneInfo.CompleteLabelsLayout();
			foreach (CrosshairLabelInfo item2 in crosshairPaneInfo.LabelsInfo)
			{
				if (!IsVisible(item2, elementGroups))
				{
					continue;
				}
				RectangleF rectangleF = CalcWholeLabelBounds(item2.Location, item2.Bounds);
				shape.Render(renderer, (ZPlaneRectangle)rectangleF, new DiagramPoint(item2.AnchorPoint.X, item2.AnchorPoint.Y));
				rectangleF = labelIndents.DecreaseRectangle(rectangleF);
				float num = 0f;
				foreach (CrosshairElementGroup elementGroup in elementGroups)
				{
					if (elementGroup.Label != item2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					CrosshairGroupHeaderElement headerElement = elementGroup.HeaderElement;
					if (headerElement.ActualVisibility)
					{
						float height = dictionary2[headerElement].Height;
						RectangleF expectedBounds = new RectangleF(rectangleF.X, rectangleF.Y + num, rectangleF.Width, height);
						headerElement.TextElement.RenderText(renderer, expectedBounds);
						num += height;
					}
					foreach (CrosshairElementBase element in elementGroup.Elements)
					{
						if (element.Visible && element.LabelElement.Visible)
						{
							LabelElementSizes labelElementSizes = dictionary[element.LabelElement];
							RenderCrosshairLabelElement(element, renderer, labelElementSizes, rectangleF, num);
							num += labelElementSizes.HeaderSize.Height + labelElementSizes.ElementSize.Height + labelElementSizes.FooterSize.Height;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class CrosshairTextElement : CrosshairTextElementBase
	{
		private readonly TextPainter painter;

		public SizeF Size => painter.Bounds.Size;

		public TextPainter Painter => painter;

		internal CrosshairTextElement(Chart chart, BaseCrosshairLabelElement crosshairLabelElement, Color backColor, RectangleFillStyle fillStyle, int maxWidth = int.MaxValue)
			: base(chart, crosshairLabelElement, backColor, fillStyle)
		{
			painter = CreateTextPainter(base.Text, maxWidth);
		}

		protected TextPainter CreateTextPainter(string text, int maxWidth = int.MaxValue)
		{
			TextMeasurer textMeasurer = TextMeasurer.Default;
			textMeasurer.Mode = TextMeasurer.TextMeasuringMode.Fast;
			TextPainter result = new TextPainter(text, new Size(1, 1), this, parseText: true, new Point(0, 0), maxWidth, 0, wordWrap: false);
			textMeasurer.Mode = TextMeasurer.TextMeasuringMode.Strict;
			return result;
		}

		protected void RenderTextCore(ChartRenderer renderer, TextPainterBase textPainter, RectangleF expectedBounds)
		{
			float num = expectedBounds.X + expectedBounds.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = expectedBounds.Y + expectedBounds.Height / 2f;
			renderer.SaveState();
			renderer.TranslateModel(MathUtils.StrongRound(num), MathUtils.StrongRound(num2));
			textPainter.Render(renderer);
			renderer.RestoreState();
		}

		public double GetFirstLineHeight()
		{
			StringInfo parsedText = painter.ParsedText;
			if (parsedText != null && parsedText.Lines.Count > 0)
			{
				return parsedText.Lines[0].Height;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override void RenderText(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF expectedBounds)
		{
			RenderTextCore(renderer, painter, expectedBounds);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairLegendTextElement : CrosshairTextElementBase
	{
		private readonly Legend legend;

		protected override System.Drawing.StringAlignment Alignment => System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far;

		internal CrosshairLegendTextElement(Chart chart, Legend legend, BaseCrosshairLabelElement crosshairLabelElement, Color backColor, RectangleFillStyle fillStyle, SizeF fixedSize)
			: base(chart, crosshairLabelElement, backColor, fillStyle)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
		}

		public override void RenderText(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF expectedBounds)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat();
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)((ITextPropertiesProvider)this).Alignment;
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			SimpleTextPropertiesProvider simpleTextPropertiesProvider = new SimpleTextPropertiesProvider(((ITextPropertiesProvider)this).Font, dXStringFormat);
			simpleTextPropertiesProvider.ReserveLineBreak = true;
			simpleTextPropertiesProvider.AvailableBounds = new AvailableTextBounds(legend.MaxCrosshairContentWidth);
			simpleTextPropertiesProvider.TextColor = ((ITextPropertiesProvider)this).GetTextColor(Color.Empty);
			TextMeasurer textMeasurer = TextMeasurer.Default;
			textMeasurer.Mode = TextMeasurer.TextMeasuringMode.Fast;
			textMeasurer.SetTextRenderingHint(AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(this));
			StringInfo stringInfo = new StringInfo(base.Text, simpleTextPropertiesProvider, textMeasurer);
			textMeasurer.RestoreTextRenderingHint();
			textMeasurer.Mode = TextMeasurer.TextMeasuringMode.Strict;
			System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment = ((stringInfo.Lines.Count == 1 && stringInfo.Size.Height >= expectedBounds.Height) ? System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center : System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near);
			foreach (TextLineInfo line in stringInfo.Lines)
			{
				foreach (TextBlockInfo textBlock in line.TextBlocks)
				{
					RectangleF bounds = textBlock.Bounds;
					bounds.Offset(expectedBounds.CalculateCenter());
					if (!textBlock.BackColor.IsEmpty)
					{
						renderer.FillRectangle(textBlock.FillBounds, textBlock.BackColor);
					}
					renderer.DrawBoundedText(textBlock.Text, textBlock.Font.DpiScale(), textBlock.FontColor, legend, bounds, ((ITextPropertiesProvider)this).Alignment, lineAlignment, bounds.Height, allowWrap: false);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class DiagramToPointUtils
	{
		private static object CheckValue(object value, ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType, ActualScaleTypeCore incorrectScaleType)
		{
			if (scaleType == incorrectScaleType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgDiagramToPointIncorrectValue), value.GetType().ToString(), scaleType.ToString()));
			}
			if (scaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static object CheckValue(string value, AxisScaleTypeMap map)
		{
			if (map is IIntervalScaleMap)
			{
				return value;
			}
			ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType = map.ScaleType;
			object result = value;
			try
			{
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					result = Convert.ToDateTime(value);
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				{
					if (TimeSpan.TryParse(value, out var result2))
					{
						result = result2;
					}
					break;
				}
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
					result = Convert.ToDouble(value);
					break;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgDiagramToPointIncorrectValue), value.GetType().ToString(), scaleType.ToString()), innerException);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static object CheckValue(double value, ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType)
		{
			return CheckValue(value, scaleType, ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime);
		}

		public static object CheckValue(TimeSpan value, ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType)
		{
			return CheckValue(value, scaleType, ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical);
		}

		public static object CheckValue(DateTime value, ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType)
		{
			return CheckValue(value, scaleType, ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical);
		}

		public static object CheckValue(object value, AxisScaleTypeMap map)
		{
			ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType = map.ScaleType;
			if (value is string)
			{
				return CheckValue((string)value, map);
			}
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				return CheckValue((DateTime)value, scaleType);
			}
			if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				return CheckValue((TimeSpan)value, scaleType);
			}
			return CheckValue(Convert.ToDouble(value), scaleType);
		}
	}
	public class DiagramToPointCalculator
	{
		private static bool ValueInScaleBreak(List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalLayouts)
		{
			return intervalLayouts.Count == 2;
		}

		private static bool CheckLayouts(List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalLayouts)
		{
			if (intervalLayouts.Count != 1)
			{
				return intervalLayouts.Count == 2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static Point GetCoordInScaleBreak(double value, List<AxisIntervalLayout> layout, Axis2D axis, XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			AxisMapping axisMapping = new AxisMapping(mappingContainer.IntervalsLayoutRepository, axis);
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout;
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout2;
			if (layout[0].Range.Max > layout[1].Range.Max)
			{
				axisIntervalLayout = layout[1];
				axisIntervalLayout2 = layout[0];
			}
			else
			{
				axisIntervalLayout = layout[0];
				axisIntervalLayout2 = layout[1];
			}
			double max = axisIntervalLayout.Range.Max;
			double min = axisIntervalLayout2.Range.Min;
			double num = ((min - max != 0.0) ? ((value - max) / (min - max)) : 0.0);
			double x = axisIntervalLayout.End + (axisIntervalLayout2.Start - axisIntervalLayout.End) * num;
			return (Point)axisMapping.InterimPointToScreenPoint(new DiagramPoint(x, 0.0));
		}

		private static List<AxisIntervalLayout> CalcIntervals(double value, IList<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout, out bool inRange)
		{
			inRange = false;
			List<AxisIntervalLayout> list = new List<AxisIntervalLayout>();
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = null;
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout2 = null;
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in intervalsLayout)
			{
				if (item.ValueWithinRange(value))
				{
					list.Add(item);
					inRange = true;
					return list;
				}
				if (value > item.Range.Max)
				{
					if (axisIntervalLayout2 == null)
					{
						axisIntervalLayout2 = item;
					}
					else if (axisIntervalLayout2.Range.Max < item.Range.Max)
					{
						axisIntervalLayout2 = item;
					}
				}
				if (value < item.Range.Min)
				{
					if (axisIntervalLayout == null)
					{
						axisIntervalLayout = item;
					}
					else if (axisIntervalLayout.Range.Min > item.Range.Min)
					{
						axisIntervalLayout = item;
					}
				}
			}
			if (axisIntervalLayout2 != null)
			{
				list.Add(axisIntervalLayout2);
			}
			if (axisIntervalLayout != null)
			{
				list.Add(axisIntervalLayout);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static ControlCoordinates CalculateCoords(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, double argument, double value)
		{
			bool inRange = false;
			bool inRange2 = false;
			List<AxisIntervalLayout> list = CalcIntervals(argument, mappingContainer.IntervalsLayoutX, out inRange);
			List<AxisIntervalLayout> list2 = CalcIntervals(value, mappingContainer.IntervalsLayoutY, out inRange2);
			if (!CheckLayouts(list) || !CheckLayouts(list2))
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
			}
			ControlCoordinatesVisibility visibility = ((!(inRange && inRange2)) ? ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Hidden : ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Visible);
			XYDiagramMappingBase xYDiagramMappingBase = mappingContainer.CreateDiagramMapping(list[0], list2[0]);
			Point point = (Point)xYDiagramMappingBase.GetScreenPoint(argument, value);
			if (!ValueInScaleBreak(list) && !ValueInScaleBreak(list2))
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(pane, visibility, point);
			}
			Axis2D axisX = mappingContainer.AxisX;
			Axis2D axisY = mappingContainer.AxisY;
			int x;
			int y;
			if (!mappingContainer.Rotated)
			{
				x = (ValueInScaleBreak(list) ? GetCoordInScaleBreak(argument, list, axisX, mappingContainer).X : point.X);
				y = (ValueInScaleBreak(list2) ? GetCoordInScaleBreak(value, list2, axisY, mappingContainer).Y : point.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				x = (ValueInScaleBreak(list2) ? GetCoordInScaleBreak(value, list2, axisY, mappingContainer).X : point.X);
				y = (ValueInScaleBreak(list) ? GetCoordInScaleBreak(argument, list, axisX, mappingContainer).Y : point.Y);
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(pane, visibility, new Point(x, y));
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramMappingList
	{
		private readonly List<XYDiagramMappingContainer> mappingContainers = new List<XYDiagramMappingContainer>();

		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private readonly AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository;

		private readonly Rectangle maximumMappingBounds;

		public IEnumerable<XYDiagramMappingContainer> MappingContainers => mappingContainers;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => intervalsLayoutRepository.MappingBounds;

		public Rectangle MaximumMappingBounds => maximumMappingBounds;

		public XYDiagramMappingList(XYDiagram2D diagram, AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, Rectangle maximumMappingBounds)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.intervalsLayoutRepository = intervalsLayoutRepository;
			this.maximumMappingBounds = maximumMappingBounds;
		}

		private XYDiagramMappingContainer FindMappingContainer(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer in mappingContainers)
			{
				if (mappingContainer.AxisX == axisX && mappingContainer.AxisY == axisY)
				{
					return mappingContainer;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingContainer GetMappingContainer(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingContainer xYDiagramMappingContainer = FindMappingContainer(axisX, axisY);
			if (xYDiagramMappingContainer == null)
			{
				xYDiagramMappingContainer = new XYDiagramMappingContainer(intervalsLayoutRepository, diagram, (Axis2D)axisX, (Axis2D)axisY);
				mappingContainers.Add(xYDiagramMappingContainer);
			}
			return xYDiagramMappingContainer;
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingContainer GetMappingContainer(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			if (!(seriesData.Series.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase expected.");
				return null;
			}
			return GetMappingContainer(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX, xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY);
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorsRepository
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, List<Indicator>> indicatorsByPanes;

		private readonly List<Indicator> indicators;

		public IndicatorsRepository()
		{
			indicatorsByPanes = new Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, List<Indicator>>();
			indicators = new List<Indicator>();
		}

		public void Add(Indicator indicator)
		{
			Series owningSeries = indicator.OwningSeries;
			if (owningSeries.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase key = ((!(indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)) ? ((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)owningSeries.View).ActualPane : separatePaneIndicator.Pane);
				if (indicatorsByPanes.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					indicatorsByPanes[key].Add(indicator);
				}
				else
				{
					indicatorsByPanes.Add(key, new List<Indicator> { indicator });
				}
			}
			indicators.Add(indicator);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			indicatorsByPanes.Clear();
			indicators.Clear();
		}

		public List<Indicator> GetIndicators(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			if (indicatorsByPanes.ContainsKey(pane))
			{
				return indicatorsByPanes[pane];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public int IndexOf(Indicator indicator)
		{
			return indicators.IndexOf(indicator);
		}
	}
	public static class SmartAxesUtils
	{
		public static bool HasSmartAxis(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase actualPane in diagram.ActualPanes)
			{
				if (!HasSmartAxis(actualPane))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool HasSmartAxis(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = pane.Diagram.GetPaneAxesData(pane);
			if (paneAxesData != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis2D axis in paneAxesData.Axes)
				{
					if (axis.IsSmartAxis)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class PanesCollapsingOrderManager
	{
		private readonly List<int> ids = new List<int>();

		public int Count => ids.Count;

		public int IndexOf(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			return ids.IndexOf(pane.ActualPaneID);
		}

		public void OnPaneVisibilityChanged(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			ids.Remove(pane.ActualPaneID);
			if (pane.Collapsed)
			{
				ids.Add(pane.ActualPaneID);
			}
		}

		public void OnPaneCollectionClear()
		{
			ids.Clear();
		}

		public void AddPane(XYDiagramPane pane)
		{
			if (pane.Collapsed)
			{
				ids.Add(pane.ActualPaneID);
			}
		}

		public void AddPanes(XYDiagramPane[] panes)
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in panes)
			{
				AddPane(pane);
			}
		}

		public void RemovePane(XYDiagramPane pane)
		{
			ids.Remove(pane.ActualPaneID);
		}

		public void RemovePanes(XYDiagramPane[] panes)
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in panes)
			{
				RemovePane(pane);
			}
		}
	}
