	public static class GraphicsPathCreator
	{
		public static DXGraphicsPath Create(IList<GRealPoint2D> points, bool close)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new PointF((float)points[i].X, (float)points[i].Y);
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(array);
			if (close)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.CloseFigure();
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}
	}
	public static class PaneAreaRenderer
	{
		public static bool AlignBorderWithTickmarksWhenExported { get; set; }

		public static void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea, int thickness, Color defaultColor, bool isInner)
		{
			if ((paneArea.TopSide.IsInner != isInner && paneArea.BottomSide.IsInner != isInner && paneArea.LeftSide.IsInner != isInner && paneArea.RightSide.IsInner != isInner) || thickness <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ThicknessUtils.SplitToHalves(thickness, out var firstHalf, out var secondHalf);
			Rectangle bounds = paneArea.Bounds.ToRectangle();
			int left = bounds.Left - secondHalf;
			int top = bounds.Top - secondHalf;
			int right = bounds.Right - firstHalf - 1;
			int bottom = bounds.Bottom - firstHalf - 1;
			Size horizontalBorderSize = new Size(bounds.Width + secondHalf * 2, thickness);
			Size verticalBorderSize = new Size(thickness, bounds.Height);
			if (paneArea.TopSide.IsInner == isInner)
			{
				RenderSide(renderer, paneArea.TopSide.Options, paneArea.TopPath, thickness, defaultColor, () => new Rectangle(left, top, horizontalBorderSize.Width, horizontalBorderSize.Height));
			}
			if (paneArea.BottomSide.IsInner == isInner)
			{
				RenderSide(renderer, paneArea.BottomSide.Options, paneArea.BottomPath, thickness, defaultColor, () => new Rectangle(left, bottom, horizontalBorderSize.Width, horizontalBorderSize.Height));
			}
			if (paneArea.LeftSide.IsInner == isInner)
			{
				RenderSide(renderer, paneArea.LeftSide.Options, paneArea.LeftPath, thickness, defaultColor, () => new Rectangle(left, bounds.Top, verticalBorderSize.Width, verticalBorderSize.Height));
			}
			if (paneArea.RightSide.IsInner == isInner)
			{
				RenderSide(renderer, paneArea.RightSide.Options, paneArea.RightPath, thickness, defaultColor, () => new Rectangle(right, bounds.Top, verticalBorderSize.Width, verticalBorderSize.Height));
			}
		}

		private static void RenderSide(ChartRenderer renderer, IScaleBreakOptions options, IList<GRealPoint2D> path, int thickness, Color defaultColor, Func<Rectangle> createRectangle)
		{
			Color color = ((options != null) ? ((ScaleBreakOptions)options).Color : Color.Empty);
			Color color2 = (color.IsEmpty ? defaultColor : color);
			if (path != null)
			{
				renderer.DrawPath(GraphicsPathCreator.Create(path, close: false), color2, 1);
			}
			else if (renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing && AlignBorderWithTickmarksWhenExported)
			{
				renderer.FillMetafileRectangle(createRectangle(), color2, thickness);
			}
			else
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(createRectangle(), color2);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramPaneAreas : List<XYDiagramPaneArea>, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly bool shouldCalculateHitRegions;

		private readonly Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, DXGraphicsPath> seriesClipRegions = new Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, DXGraphicsPath>();

		private readonly Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, HitRegionContainer> seriesHitRegions = new Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, HitRegionContainer>();

		private readonly RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry = new RaggedEdgeGeometry(shouldCutEdge: true);

		private readonly WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry = new WavedEdgeGeometry(shouldCutEdge: true);

		private DXGraphicsPath clipRegion;

		private HitRegionContainer hitRegion;

		protected internal bool Disposed { get; private set; }

		public DXGraphicsPath ClipRegion => clipRegion;

		public HitRegionContainer HitRegion => hitRegion;

		public Dictionary<XYDiagramMappingBase, DXGraphicsPath> SeriesClipRegions => seriesClipRegions;

		public XYDiagramPaneAreas(List<AxisViewData> axisViewDataList, List<SeriesContainerLayout> seriesContainerLayouts, bool shouldCalculateHitRegions)
		{
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.shouldCalculateHitRegions = shouldCalculateHitRegions;
			if (axisViewDataList.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Axis2D axis = axisViewDataList[0].Axis;
			RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedEdgeGeometry = raggedGeometry;
			WavedEdgeGeometry wavedEdgeGeometry = wavedGeometry;
			if ((int)axis.Chart.AllowDirectXRendering == 0)
			{
				raggedEdgeGeometry = null;
				wavedEdgeGeometry = null;
			}
			List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list = XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator.GenerateAreas(raggedEdgeGeometry, wavedEdgeGeometry, axis, axis.ActualScaleBreakOptions, axisViewDataList[0].IntervalsBounds);
			for (int i = 1; i < axisViewDataList.Count; i++)
			{
				axis = axisViewDataList[i].Axis;
				List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list2 = XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator.GenerateAreas(raggedEdgeGeometry, wavedEdgeGeometry, axis, axis.ActualScaleBreakOptions, axisViewDataList[i].IntervalsBounds);
				List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list3 = new List<XYDiagramPaneArea>();
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item in list2)
				{
					foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item2 in list)
					{
						XYDiagramPaneArea xYDiagramPaneArea = XYDiagramPaneArea.Intersect(item, item2);
						if (xYDiagramPaneArea != null)
						{
							list3.Add(xYDiagramPaneArea);
						}
					}
				}
				list = list3;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item3 in list)
			{
				item3.Complete();
				Add(item3);
			}
			CalculateClipRegion();
			if (shouldCalculateHitRegions)
			{
				CalculateHitRegion();
			}
			foreach (SeriesContainerLayout seriesContainerLayout in seriesContainerLayouts)
			{
				CalculateSeriesRegions(seriesContainerLayout.Mapping, shouldCalculateHitRegions);
			}
		}

		private List<XYDiagramPaneArea> GetActualPaneAreas(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping)
		{
			Rectangle rect = GraphicUtils.InflateRect(mapping.Bounds, -1, -1);
			List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list = new List<XYDiagramPaneArea>();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				XYDiagramPaneArea current = enumerator.Current;
				if (GRealRect2D.IsIntersected(current.Bounds, rect.ToGRealRect2D()))
				{
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CalculateClipRegion()
		{
			clipRegion = new DXGraphicsPath();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				XYDiagramPaneArea current = enumerator.Current;
				clipRegion.AddPath(GraphicsPathCreator.Create(current.Border, close: true), connect: false);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			hitRegion = new HitRegionContainer();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				XYDiagramPaneArea current = enumerator.Current;
				hitRegion.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicsPathCreator.Create(current.Border, close: true)));
			}
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesRegions(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool shouldCalculateHitRegions)
		{
			List<XYDiagramPaneArea> actualPaneAreas = GetActualPaneAreas(mapping);
			CalculateSeriesClipRegions(mapping, actualPaneAreas);
			if (shouldCalculateHitRegions)
			{
				CalculateSeriesHitRegions(mapping, actualPaneAreas);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesClipRegions(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, List<XYDiagramPaneArea> actualAreas)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = null;
			if (actualAreas.Count > 0)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea actualArea in actualAreas)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(GraphicsPathCreator.Create(actualArea.Border, close: true), connect: false);
				}
			}
			if (!seriesClipRegions.ContainsKey(mapping))
			{
				seriesClipRegions.Add(mapping, dXGraphicsPath);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesHitRegions(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, List<XYDiagramPaneArea> actualAreas)
		{
			List<HitRegionContainer> list = new List<HitRegionContainer>();
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea actualArea in actualAreas)
			{
				HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = new HitRegionContainer(new HitRegion(mapping.InflatedBounds));
				hitRegionContainer.Intersect(new HitRegion(GraphicsPathCreator.Create(actualArea.Border, close: true)));
				list.Add(hitRegionContainer);
			}
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer2 = null;
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				hitRegionContainer2 = new HitRegionContainer();
				foreach (HitRegionContainer item in list)
				{
					hitRegionContainer2.Union(item);
				}
			}
			if (!seriesHitRegions.ContainsKey(mapping))
			{
				seriesHitRegions.Add(mapping, hitRegionContainer2);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				Disposed = true;
				clipRegion?.Dispose();
				hitRegion?.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				Disposed = true;
			}
		}

		public HitRegionContainer GetSeriesHitRegion(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping)
		{
			if (!seriesHitRegions.ContainsKey(mapping))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return seriesHitRegions[mapping];
		}

		public void UpdateClipRegions(IndicatorLayoutList indicatorsLayout)
		{
			foreach (XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer in indicatorsLayout.MappingList.MappingContainers)
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramMappingBase item in mappingContainer)
				{
					CalculateSeriesRegions(item, shouldCalculateHitRegions);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

	public class AntialiasingSupport : ISupportTextAntialiasing
	{
		private readonly bool defaultAntialiasing;

		private readonly ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingSource;

		DefaultBoolean ISupportTextAntialiasing.EnableAntialiasing => (DefaultBoolean)2;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.DefaultAntialiasing => defaultAntialiasing;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.Rotated => antialiasingSource.Rotated;

		Color ISupportTextAntialiasing.TextBackColor => antialiasingSource.TextBackColor;

		RectangleFillStyle ISupportTextAntialiasing.TextBackFillStyle => antialiasingSource.TextBackFillStyle;

		ChartElement ISupportTextAntialiasing.BackElement => antialiasingSource.BackElement;

		bool ISupportTextAntialiasing.CanBeDrawnOn3D => true;

		private static TextRenderingHint GetAntialiasingRenderHint(bool transparentBackground, bool rotated)
		{
			if (!(transparentBackground || rotated))
			{
				return TextRenderingHint.ClearTypeGridFit;
			}
			return TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
		}

		private static TextRenderingHint GetRenderHint(bool antialias, bool transparentBackground, bool rotated)
		{
			if (!antialias)
			{
				return TextRenderingHint.SingleBitPerPixelGridFit;
			}
			return GetAntialiasingRenderHint(transparentBackground, rotated);
		}

		private static bool GetActualAntialiasing(DefaultBoolean enableAntialiasing, bool defaultAntialiasing, bool transparentBackground, bool rotated)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)enableAntialiasing == 2)
			{
				return !transparentBackground || defaultAntialiasing || rotated;
			}
			return (int)enableAntialiasing == 0;
		}

		private static bool IsTransparentColor(Color color)
		{
			return color.A < byte.MaxValue;
		}

		private static bool IsTransparentFill(RectangleFillStyle fillStyle)
		{
			if (fillStyle == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (fillStyle != null && fillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Empty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (fillStyle.Options is FillOptionsColor2Base fillOptionsColor2Base)
			{
				return IsTransparentColor(fillOptionsColor2Base.Color2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsTransparentBackground(ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingProvider)
		{
			bool flag = IsTransparentColor(antialiasingProvider.TextBackColor) || IsTransparentFill(antialiasingProvider.TextBackFillStyle);
			ChartElement backElement = antialiasingProvider.BackElement;
			if (flag && backElement != null)
			{
				Chart chart = backElement.Chart;
				if (chart == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((!chart.Is3DDiagram || !antialiasingProvider.CanBeDrawnOn3D) && !IsTransparentColor(chart.ActualBackColor))
				{
					return IsTransparentFill(chart.FillStyle);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal static TextRenderingHint GetRenderHint(ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingProvider)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool transparentBackground = IsTransparentBackground(antialiasingProvider);
			bool rotated = antialiasingProvider.Rotated;
			bool actualAntialiasing = GetActualAntialiasing(antialiasingProvider.EnableAntialiasing, antialiasingProvider.DefaultAntialiasing, transparentBackground, rotated);
			return GetRenderHint(actualAntialiasing, transparentBackground, rotated);
		}

		internal static bool GetAntialiasingEnabled(ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingProvider)
		{
			TextRenderingHint renderHint = GetRenderHint(antialiasingProvider);
			return renderHint == TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
		}

		public AntialiasingSupport(ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingSource, bool defaultAntialiasing)
		{
			this.defaultAntialiasing = defaultAntialiasing;
			this.antialiasingSource = antialiasingSource;
		}
	}

	public abstract class ErrorBarsBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private ErrorBars ErrorBars => (ErrorBars)base.Indicator;

		protected abstract ErrorBarsCalculator Calculator { get; }

		protected override bool StoreRefinedPoints => true;

		public override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				ErrorBarsCalculator calculator = Calculator;
				if (calculator != null && calculator.ErrorBarDataList != null)
				{
					return calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				ErrorBarsCalculator calculator = Calculator;
				if (calculator == null || calculator.ErrorBarDataList == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count;
			}
		}

		public ErrorBarsBehavior(ErrorBars indicator)
			: base(indicator)
		{
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase = base.Indicator.Owner as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
			if (base.Visible && base.Indicator != null && Calculator.Calculated.Value && xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase != null)
			{
				List<ScreenErrorBarData> list = new List<ScreenErrorBarData>();
				foreach (ErrorBarData errorBarData in Calculator.ErrorBarDataList)
				{
					if (!errorBarData.ShouldBeSkipped)
					{
						ScreenErrorBarData screenErrorBarData = xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ConvertErrorBarDataToScreenCoords(diagramMapping, errorBarData);
						if (screenErrorBarData != null)
						{
							list.Add(screenErrorBarData);
						}
					}
				}
				return new ErrorBarsLayout(ErrorBars, list);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateErrorBarValuesByType(index, Calculator.ErrorBarDataList, (ErrorBarDirectionCore)ErrorBars.Direction);
		}

		public override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return Calculator.ErrorBarDataList[index].RefinedPoint.Argument;
		}

		public MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (Calculator == null || Calculator.ErrorBarDataList == null || Calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count == 0)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Delta))
			{
				return Calculator.YRange;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			List<ErrorBarData> errorBarDataList = Calculator.ErrorBarDataList;
			for (int i = 0; i < Calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (errorBarDataList[i].RefinedPoint.Argument >= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Min)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int num3 = Calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				if (errorBarDataList[num3].RefinedPoint.Argument <= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Max)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1 || num2 == -1)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double bottom = errorBarDataList[num].Bottom;
			double top = errorBarDataList[num].Top;
			for (int j = num + 1; j <= num2; j++)
			{
				if (errorBarDataList[j].Bottom < bottom)
				{
					bottom = errorBarDataList[j].Bottom;
				}
				if (errorBarDataList[j].Top > top)
				{
					top = errorBarDataList[j].Top;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(bottom, top);
		}
	}
	public class ScreenErrorBarData
	{
		public PointF Bottom { get; private set; }

		public PointF Center { get; private set; }

		public PointF Top { get; private set; }

		public PointF TopLeft { get; private set; }

		public PointF TopRight { get; private set; }

		public PointF BottomLeft { get; private set; }

		public PointF BottomRight { get; private set; }

		public ScreenErrorBarData(PointF center, PointF top, PointF bottom, PointF topLeft, PointF topRight, PointF bottomLeft, PointF bottomRight)
		{
			Center = center;
			Top = top;
			Bottom = bottom;
			TopLeft = topLeft;
			TopRight = topRight;
			BottomLeft = bottomLeft;
			BottomRight = bottomRight;
		}
	}
	public class ErrorBarsLayout : IndicatorLayout
	{
		private readonly IList<ScreenErrorBarData> screenDataList;

		private ErrorBars ErrorBars => (ErrorBars)base.Indicator;

		public ErrorBarsLayout(ErrorBars indicator, IList<ScreenErrorBarData> screenDataList)
			: base(indicator)
		{
			this.screenDataList = screenDataList;
		}

		internal DXGraphicsPath CreatePath()
		{
			if (screenDataList == null || screenDataList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			foreach (ScreenErrorBarData screenData in screenDataList)
			{
				PointF startPoint = new PointF(screenData.Center.X, screenData.Center.Y);
				PointF endPoint = new PointF(screenData.Top.X, screenData.Top.Y);
				PointF endPoint2 = new PointF(screenData.Bottom.X, screenData.Bottom.Y);
				if (ErrorBars.Direction != ErrorBarDirection.Plus)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.StartFigure();
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine(startPoint, endPoint2);
					if (ErrorBars.EndStyle == ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap)
					{
						dXGraphicsPath.StartFigure();
						dXGraphicsPath.AddLine(screenData.BottomLeft, screenData.BottomRight);
					}
				}
				if (ErrorBars.Direction != ErrorBarDirection.Minus)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.StartFigure();
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine(startPoint, endPoint);
					if (ErrorBars.EndStyle == ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap)
					{
						dXGraphicsPath.StartFigure();
						dXGraphicsPath.AddLine(screenData.TopLeft, screenData.TopRight);
					}
				}
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreatePath();
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(base.Color, base.Thickness);
			if (base.Indicator.LineStyle != null)
			{
				dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)base.Indicator.LineStyle.LineJoin;
			}
			dXGraphicsPath.Widen(dXPen);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreatePath();
			if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
			{
				using (DXPen pen = DXPenHelper.Create(base.Color, base.Thickness, ErrorBars.LineStyle))
				{
					renderer.DrawPath(dXGraphicsPath, pen);
					return;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class IndicatorBehavior : ICheckableLegendItemData, ILegendItemData
	{
		private class ArgumentsComparer : IComparer<GRealPoint2D>
		{
			int IComparer<GRealPoint2D>.Compare(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
			{
				if (p1.X < p2.X)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (p1.X > p2.X)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private readonly Indicator indicator;

		private readonly ArgumentsComparer pointsComparer = new ArgumentsComparer();

		private bool visible;

		private Color color;

		private double visualRangeMin = double.NaN;

		private double visualRangeMax = double.NaN;

		private Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> linePointsByType;

		private Legend ActualLegend => indicator.ActualLegend;

		protected IIndicatorValueProvider ValueProvider => indicator.View.IndicatorValueProvider;

		internal Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> LinePointsByType
		{
			get
			{
				if (linePointsByType == null)
				{
					linePointsByType = CreateLinePointsByType();
				}
				return linePointsByType;
			}
		}

		protected virtual LineStrip IndicatorLineStrip => null;

		protected virtual bool StoreRefinedPoints => false;

		public Indicator Indicator => indicator;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			protected set
			{
				visible = value;
			}
		}

		public Color Color => color;

		public virtual Color LegendColor => color;

		public virtual LineStyle LegendLineStyle => indicator.LineStyle;

		public virtual bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (IndicatorLineStrip != null)
				{
					return IndicatorLineStrip.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (IndicatorLineStrip == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return IndicatorLineStrip.Count;
			}
		}

		bool ILegendItemData.DisposeFont => false;

		bool ILegendItemData.MarkerVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ActualLegend.MarkersVisible)
				{
					if (ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible)
					{
						return !Indicator.CheckableInLegend;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		bool ILegendItemData.TextVisible => ActualLegend.TextVisible;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenText => false;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarker => false;

		string ILegendItemData.Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(indicator.LegendText))
				{
					return indicator.LegendText;
				}
				return indicator.Name;
			}
		}

		Color ILegendItemData.TextColor => ActualLegend.ActualTextColor;

		Color ICheckableLegendItemData.MainColor => color;

		DXImage ILegendItemData.MarkerImage => null;

		ChartImageSizeMode ILegendItemData.MarkerImageSizeMode => ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize;

		Size ILegendItemData.MarkerSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (Indicator.Chart == null)
				{
					return ActualLegend.MarkerSize;
				}
				return Indicator.Chart.ScaleSize(ActualLegend.MarkerSize);
			}
		}

		DXFont ILegendItemData.Font => ActualLegend.DXFont;

		ILegendItem ILegendItemData.RepresentedObject => indicator;

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible)
				{
					return Indicator.CheckableInLegend;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckedInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return indicator.CheckedInLegend;
			}
			set
			{
				indicator.CheckedInLegend = value;
			}
		}

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxEnabled => indicator.View.Series.CheckedInLegend;

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenCheckBox => false;

		DXImage ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxImage => null;

		Size ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (Indicator.Chart == null)
				{
					return ActualLegend.MarkerSize;
				}
				return Indicator.Chart.ScaleSize(ActualLegend.MarkerSize);
			}
		}

		ChartImageSizeMode ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxImageSizeMode => ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize;

		LegendBase ILegendItemData.Legend => ActualLegend;

		protected IndicatorBehavior(Indicator indicator)
		{
			this.indicator = indicator;
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			RenderMarkerInternal(renderer, bounds, LegendColor);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualRange(Axis2D axisX)
		{
			visualRangeMin = axisX.VisualRangeData.Min;
			visualRangeMax = axisX.VisualRangeData.Max;
		}

		private int GetValueIndex(LineStrip strip, double value)
		{
			int num = strip.BinarySearch(new GRealPoint2D(value, 0.0), pointsComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int FindMinUpdatedArgument(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection seriesPoints, RefinedPoint[] sourcePoints, IXYSeriesView seriesView)
		{
			if (sourcePoints.Length == 0)
			{
				return int.MaxValue;
			}
			double argument = seriesView.AxisXData.AxisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(sourcePoints[0].Argument);
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			int num = seriesPoints.BinarySearch(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalculateUpdateIndex(RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo pointsUpdateInfo, object lockObject)
		{
			IXYSeriesView seriesView = (IXYSeriesView)pointsUpdateInfo.RefinedSeries.SeriesView;
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection seriesPoints = null;
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				seriesPoints = pointsUpdateInfo.RefinedSeries.FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
			}
			return FindMinUpdatedArgument(seriesPoints, pointsUpdateInfo.AffectedPoints, seriesView);
		}

		private int CalculateStartUpdateIndex(ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> pointsUpdateInfo, object lockObject)
		{
			if (pointsUpdateInfo == null || pointsUpdateInfo.Count == 0 || !Visible)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item in pointsUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					ChartCollectionOperation operation = item.Operation;
					if ((uint)(operation - 1) > 2u)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					num = Math.Min(num, CalculateUpdateIndex(item, lockObject));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void RenderMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, Color markerColor)
		{
			int y = bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 2;
			Point point = new Point(bounds.Left + 1, y);
			Point point2 = new Point(bounds.Right - 1, y);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(LegendLineStyle.AntiAlias);
			renderer.DrawLine(point, point2, GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(markerColor, ((IHitTest)indicator).State), 2, LegendLineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(indicator.ChartContainer.Chart.HitTestController, indicator, null, new HitRegion(bounds));
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex);

		protected abstract IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping);

		protected virtual Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> CreateLinePointsByType()
		{
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> { 
			{
				IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value,
				IndicatorLineStrip
			} };
		}

		public virtual Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateIndicatorValuesByType(LinePointsByType, index);
		}

		protected LineStrip GetVisibleSubStrip(LineStrip strip)
		{
			if (strip.Count > 0 && !double.IsNaN(visualRangeMin) && !double.IsNaN(visualRangeMax))
			{
				int startIndex = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(GetValueIndex(strip, visualRangeMin) - 1, strip.Count - 1));
				int endIndex = Math.Min(GetValueIndex(strip, visualRangeMax) + 1, strip.Count - 1);
				return strip.ExtractSubStrip(startIndex, endIndex);
			}
			return strip;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateColorInternal(Color color)
		{
			this.color = indicator.Color;
			if (this.color.IsEmpty)
			{
				this.color = color;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> pointsUpdateInfo, object lockObject)
		{
			ResetLinePointsByType();
			UpdateIndicatorData(refinedSeries, points, CalculateStartUpdateIndex(pointsUpdateInfo, lockObject));
		}

		public void NotifyRefinedPointsChanging()
		{
			if (StoreRefinedPoints)
			{
				Visible = false;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateColor(Color newColor)
		{
			UpdateColorInternal(newColor);
		}

		public IndicatorLayout CreateLayout(Axis2D axisX, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			UpdateVisualRange(axisX);
			return CreateLayoutInternal(diagramMapping);
		}

		public virtual double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return IndicatorLineStrip[index].X;
		}

		public void ResetLinePointsByType()
		{
			linePointsByType = null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class IndicatorLayout
	{
		private readonly Indicator indicator;

		protected Color Color => GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(Indicator.IndicatorBehavior.Color, ((IHitTest)Indicator).State);

		protected int Thickness => GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(Indicator.LineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)Indicator).State, 1);

		public Indicator Indicator => indicator;

		public XYDiagramMappingBase DiagramMapping { get; set; }

		protected IndicatorLayout(Indicator indicator)
		{
			this.indicator = indicator;
		}

		public abstract void Render(ChartRenderer renderer);

		public abstract DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath();
	}
	public class IndicatorLayoutList : List<IndicatorLayout>
	{
		private readonly XYDiagramMappingList mappingList;

		public XYDiagramMappingList MappingList => mappingList;

		public IndicatorLayoutList(XYDiagramMappingList mappingList)
		{
			this.mappingList = mappingList;
		}

		public void Initialize(Indicator indicator)
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase = (XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)indicator.OwningSeries.View;
			Axis2D actualAxisX = xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisX;
			Axis2D axisY = ((!(indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)) ? xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualAxisY : separatePaneIndicator.ActualAxisY);
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = mappingList.GetMappingContainer(actualAxisX, axisY);
			if (mappingContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramMappingBase item in mappingContainer)
			{
				IndicatorLayout indicatorLayout = indicator.IndicatorBehavior.CreateLayout(actualAxisX, item);
				if (indicatorLayout != null)
				{
					indicatorLayout.DiagramMapping = item;
					Add(indicatorLayout);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class LineIndicatorLayout : IndicatorLayout
	{
		private readonly DiagramPoint startPoint;

		private readonly DiagramPoint endPoint;

		public LineIndicatorLayout(Indicator indicator, GRealLine2D line)
			: base(indicator)
		{
			startPoint = DiagramPoint.Round((DiagramPoint)line.Start);
			endPoint = DiagramPoint.Round((DiagramPoint)line.End);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(startPoint.X != endPoint.X && startPoint.Y != endPoint.Y);
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)startPoint, (Point)endPoint, base.Color, base.Indicator.LineStyle);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath()
		{
			if (startPoint == endPoint)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddLine((PointF)startPoint, (PointF)endPoint);
			using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, base.Thickness);
			if (base.Indicator.LineStyle != null)
			{
				dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)base.Indicator.LineStyle.LineJoin;
			}
			dXGraphicsPath.Widen(dXPen);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}
	}
	public class BollingerBandsBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private readonly BollingerBandsCalculator calculator;

		private LineStrip movingAverageStrip;

		private LineStrip upperBandStrip;

		private LineStrip lowerBandStrip;

		private MinMaxValues yRange;

		private BollingerBands BollingerBands => (BollingerBands)base.Indicator;

		private Color BandsColor
		{
			get
			{
				Color bandsColor = BollingerBands.BandsColor;
				if (!bandsColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return bandsColor;
				}
				return base.Color;
			}
		}

		public override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (movingAverageStrip != null)
				{
					return movingAverageStrip.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (movingAverageStrip == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return movingAverageStrip.Count;
			}
		}

		public BollingerBandsBehavior(BollingerBands indicator)
			: base(indicator)
		{
			calculator = new BollingerBandsCalculator();
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			calculator.UpdateIndicatorData(startUpdateIndex, refinedSeries, points, BollingerBands.PointsCount, BollingerBands.StandardDeviationMultiplier, (ValueLevelInternal)BollingerBands.ValueLevel);
			movingAverageStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			movingAverageStrip.AddRange(calculator.MovingAveragePoints);
			upperBandStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			upperBandStrip.AddRange(calculator.UpperBandPoints);
			lowerBandStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			lowerBandStrip.AddRange(calculator.LowerBandPoints);
			yRange = calculator.YRange;
			base.Visible = calculator.Calculated;
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible || movingAverageStrip == null || upperBandStrip == null || lowerBandStrip == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LineStripItem> list = new List<LineStripItem>();
			LineStrip lineStrip = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(movingAverageStrip));
			Color color = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(base.Color, ((IHitTest)BollingerBands).State);
			LineStyle lineStyle = BollingerBands.LineStyle;
			int thickness = GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(lineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)BollingerBands).State, 1);
			list.Add(new LineStripItem(lineStrip, color, lineStyle, thickness));
			LineStrip lineStrip2 = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(upperBandStrip));
			Color color2 = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(BandsColor, ((IHitTest)BollingerBands).State);
			LineStyle bandsLineStyle = BollingerBands.BandsLineStyle;
			int thickness2 = GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(bandsLineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)BollingerBands).State, 1);
			list.Add(new LineStripItem(lineStrip2, color2, bandsLineStyle, thickness2));
			LineStrip lineStrip3 = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(lowerBandStrip));
			list.Add(new LineStripItem(lineStrip3, color2, bandsLineStyle, thickness2));
			return new LineStripsIndicatorLayout(BollingerBands, list);
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> CreateLinePointsByType()
		{
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>>
			{
				{
					IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average,
					movingAverageStrip
				},
				{
					IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower,
					lowerBandStrip
				},
				{
					IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper,
					upperBandStrip
				}
			};
		}

		public MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Delta))
			{
				return yRange;
			}
			if (upperBandStrip == null || lowerBandStrip == null)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			int num = -1;
			ChartDebug.Assert(upperBandStrip.Count == lowerBandStrip.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < upperBandStrip.Count; i++)
			{
				if (upperBandStrip[i].X >= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Min)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int num3 = upperBandStrip.Count - 1; num3 > -1; num3--)
			{
				if (upperBandStrip[num3].X <= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Max)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1 || num2 == -1)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double y = lowerBandStrip[num].Y;
			double y2 = upperBandStrip[num].Y;
			for (int j = num + 1; j <= num2; j++)
			{
				if (lowerBandStrip[j].Y < y)
				{
					y = lowerBandStrip[j].Y;
				}
				if (upperBandStrip[j].Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = upperBandStrip[j].Y;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(y, y2);
		}

		public override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return movingAverageStrip[index].X;
		}
	}
	public class MedianPriceBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private LineStrip medLineStrip;

		private MedianPrice MedianPrice => (MedianPrice)base.Indicator;

		protected override LineStrip IndicatorLineStrip => medLineStrip;

		public MedianPriceBehavior(MedianPrice indicator)
			: base(indicator)
		{
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible || medLineStrip == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LineStrip multiline = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(medLineStrip));
			return new MultilineIndicatorLayout(MedianPrice, multiline);
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			MedianPriceCalculator medianPriceCalculator = new MedianPriceCalculator();
			medLineStrip = medianPriceCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, points);
			base.Visible = medianPriceCalculator.Calculated;
		}
	}
	public abstract class MovingAverageIndicatorBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private readonly MovingAverageCalculator calculator;

		private MovingAverage MovingAverage => (MovingAverage)base.Indicator;

		private Color EnvelopeColor
		{
			get
			{
				Color envelopeColor = MovingAverage.EnvelopeColor;
				if (!envelopeColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return envelopeColor;
				}
				return base.Color;
			}
		}

		protected MovingAverageCalculator Calculator => calculator;

		public override Color LegendColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (MovingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
				{
					return base.LegendColor;
				}
				return EnvelopeColor;
			}
		}

		public override LineStyle LegendLineStyle
		{
			get
			{
				MovingAverage movingAverage = MovingAverage;
				if (movingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
				{
					return base.LegendLineStyle;
				}
				return movingAverage.EnvelopeLineStyle;
			}
		}

		public override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (MovingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
				{
					return calculator.MovingAverageData.Count > 0;
				}
				return calculator.UpperEnvelopeData.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		public override int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (MovingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
				{
					return calculator.MovingAverageData.Count;
				}
				return calculator.UpperEnvelopeData.Count;
			}
		}

		protected MovingAverageIndicatorBehavior(MovingAverage movingAverage)
			: base(movingAverage)
		{
			calculator = CreateCalculator();
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			SubsetBasedIndicator subsetBasedIndicator = (SubsetBasedIndicator)base.Indicator;
			if (subsetBasedIndicator.Visible)
			{
				Calculator.UpdateMovingAverageData(points, startUpdateIndex, subsetBasedIndicator.PointsCount, (ValueLevelInternal)subsetBasedIndicator.ValueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
				Calculator.CalculateEnvelopeData(((MovingAverage)subsetBasedIndicator).EnvelopePercent, startUpdateIndex);
			}
			base.Visible = Calculator.MovingAverageData.Count > 0;
		}

		protected abstract MovingAverageCalculator CreateCalculator();

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			MovingAverage movingAverage = base.Indicator as MovingAverage;
			if (!base.Visible || movingAverage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LineStripItem> list = new List<LineStripItem>();
			if (movingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
			{
				LineStyle lineStyle = movingAverage.LineStyle;
				LineStrip lineStrip = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(Calculator.MovingAverageData));
				Color color = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(base.Color, ((IHitTest)movingAverage).State);
				int thickness = GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(lineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)movingAverage).State, 1);
				LineStripItem item = new LineStripItem(lineStrip, color, lineStyle, thickness);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (movingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage)
			{
				Color color2 = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(EnvelopeColor, ((IHitTest)movingAverage).State);
				LineStyle envelopeLineStyle = movingAverage.EnvelopeLineStyle;
				int thickness2 = GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(envelopeLineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)movingAverage).State, 1);
				if (Calculator.UpperEnvelopeData != null)
				{
					list.Add(new LineStripItem(StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(Calculator.UpperEnvelopeData)), color2, envelopeLineStyle, thickness2));
				}
				if (Calculator.LowerEnvelopeData != null)
				{
					list.Add(new LineStripItem(StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(Calculator.LowerEnvelopeData)), color2, envelopeLineStyle, thickness2));
				}
			}
			return new LineStripsIndicatorLayout(movingAverage, list);
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> CreateLinePointsByType()
		{
			Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> dictionary = new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>>();
			switch (MovingAverage.Kind)
			{
			case MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage:
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average, calculator.MovingAverageData);
				break;
			case MovingAverageKind.Envelope:
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper, calculator.UpperEnvelopeData);
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower, calculator.LowerEnvelopeData);
				break;
			case MovingAverageKind.MovingAverageAndEnvelope:
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average, calculator.MovingAverageData);
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper, calculator.UpperEnvelopeData);
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower, calculator.LowerEnvelopeData);
				break;
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			if (MovingAverage.Kind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
			{
				return calculator.MovingAverageData[index].X;
			}
			return calculator.UpperEnvelopeData[index].X;
		}
	}
	public class LineStripItem
	{
		private readonly LineStrip lineStrip;

		private readonly Color color;

		private readonly LineStyle lineStyle;

		private readonly int thickness;

		public LineStrip LineStrip => lineStrip;

		public Color Color => color;

		public LineStyle LineStyle => lineStyle;

		public int Thickness => thickness;

		public LineStripItem(LineStrip lineStrip, Color color, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
		{
			this.lineStrip = lineStrip;
			this.color = color;
			this.lineStyle = lineStyle;
			this.thickness = thickness;
		}
	}
	public class LineStripsIndicatorLayout : IndicatorLayout
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<LineStripItem> items;

		public LineStripsIndicatorLayout(Indicator indicator, IEnumerable<LineStripItem> items)
			: base(indicator)
		{
			this.items = items;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (LineStripItem item in items)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(item.LineStyle.AntiAlias);
				renderer.DrawLines(item.LineStrip, item.Color, item.Thickness, item.LineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				foreach (LineStripItem item in items)
				{
					DXGraphicsPath path = StripsUtils.GetPath(item.LineStrip, item.Thickness, base.Indicator.LineStyle);
					if (path.PointCount == 0)
					{
						path.Dispose();
					}
					else
					{
						dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
					}
				}
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
		}
	}
	public class MultilineIndicatorLayout : IndicatorLayout
	{
		private LineStrip lineStrip;

		public MultilineIndicatorLayout(Indicator indicator, LineStrip multiline)
			: base(indicator)
		{
			lineStrip = multiline;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			if (lineStrip == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				DXGraphicsPath path = StripsUtils.GetPath(lineStrip, base.Thickness, base.Indicator.LineStyle);
				if (path.PointCount == 0)
				{
					path.Dispose();
				}
				else
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(base.Indicator.LineStyle.AntiAlias);
			renderer.DrawLines(lineStrip, base.Color, base.Thickness, base.Indicator.LineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}
	}

	public class MovingAverageConvergenceDivergenceBehavior : SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior
	{
		private MinMaxValues minMaxYByWholeXRange;

		private LineStrip macdLineStrip;

		private LineStrip signalLineStrip;

		private MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence Macd => (MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)base.Indicator;

		private Color SignalLineColor
		{
			get
			{
				Color signalLineColor = Macd.SignalLineColor;
				if (!signalLineColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return signalLineColor;
				}
				return base.Color;
			}
		}

		public override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (macdLineStrip != null)
				{
					return macdLineStrip.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (macdLineStrip == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return macdLineStrip.Count;
			}
		}

		public MovingAverageConvergenceDivergenceBehavior(MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence indicator)
			: base(indicator)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			MovingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator movingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator = new MovingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator();
			movingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, points, Macd.ShortPeriod, Macd.LongPeriod, Macd.SignalSmoothingPeriod, (ValueLevelInternal)Macd.ValueLevel);
			macdLineStrip = movingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator.MacdPoints;
			signalLineStrip = movingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator.SignalPoints;
			minMaxYByWholeXRange = movingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator.YRange;
			base.Visible = movingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator.Calculated;
		}

		public override MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			return GetFilteredMinMaxY(macdLineStrip, minMaxYByWholeXRange, visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
		}

		public override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return macdLineStrip[index].X;
		}

		public override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double>();
			dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value, macdLineStrip[index].Y);
			int num = index - Macd.SignalSmoothingPeriod;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Signal, signalLineStrip[num].Y);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible || macdLineStrip == null || signalLineStrip == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LineStripItem> list = new List<LineStripItem>();
			LineStrip lineStrip = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(macdLineStrip));
			Color color = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(base.Color, ((IHitTest)Macd).State);
			LineStyle lineStyle = Macd.LineStyle;
			int thickness = GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(lineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)Macd).State, 1);
			list.Add(new LineStripItem(lineStrip, color, lineStyle, thickness));
			LineStrip lineStrip2 = StripsUtils.MapAndOptimizeStrip(diagramMapping, GetVisibleSubStrip(signalLineStrip));
			Color color2 = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(SignalLineColor, ((IHitTest)Macd).State);
			LineStyle signalLineStyle = Macd.SignalLineStyle;
			int thickness2 = GraphicUtils.CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(signalLineStyle.Thickness, ((IHitTest)Macd).State, 1);
			list.Add(new LineStripItem(lineStrip2, color2, signalLineStyle, thickness2));
			return new LineStripsIndicatorLayout(Macd, list);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		public SeparatePaneIndicatorBehavior(SeparatePaneIndicator indicator)
			: base(indicator)
		{
		}

		protected MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(LineStrip indicatorPoints, MinMaxValues minMaxYByWholeXRange, IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Delta))
			{
				return minMaxYByWholeXRange;
			}
			if (indicatorPoints == null || indicatorPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < indicatorPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (indicatorPoints[i].X >= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Min)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int num3 = indicatorPoints.Count - 1; num3 > -1; num3--)
			{
				if (indicatorPoints[num3].X <= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Max)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1 || num2 == -1)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double y = indicatorPoints[num].Y;
			double y2 = indicatorPoints[num].Y;
			for (int j = num + 1; j < num2; j++)
			{
				if (indicatorPoints[j].Y < y)
				{
					y = indicatorPoints[j].Y;
				}
				if (indicatorPoints[j].Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = indicatorPoints[j].Y;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(y, y2);
		}

		public abstract MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
	}
