	public struct FibonacciArc
	{
		private readonly float startAngle;

		private readonly float sweepAngle;

		public float StartAngle => startAngle;

		public float SweepAngle => sweepAngle;

		public FibonacciArc(double startAngle, double endAngle)
		{
			this.startAngle = (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(startAngle);
			sweepAngle = (float)(MathUtils.Radian2Degree(endAngle - startAngle) * 2.0);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciCircle : List<FibonacciArc>
	{
		private readonly RectangleF bounds;

		private readonly float radius;

		public RectangleF Bounds => bounds;

		public float Radius => radius;

		public FibonacciCircle(RectangleF bounds, float radius)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.radius = radius;
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciArcsBehavior : FibonacciIndicatorBehavior
	{
		public override bool DefaultShowLevel0 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel100 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel23_6 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel76_4 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowAdditionalLevels => false;

		public override bool ShowLevel0PropertyEnabled => false;

		public override bool ShowLevel100PropertyEnabled => true;

		public override bool ShowAdditionalLevelsPropertyEnabled => false;

		private static IList<DiagramPoint> CalculateLevelsPoints(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, DiagramPoint centralPoint, DiagramPoint level100Point, IList<double> levels)
		{
			List<DiagramPoint> list = new List<DiagramPoint>(levels.Count);
			foreach (double level in levels)
			{
				double argument = centralPoint.X + (level100Point.X - centralPoint.X) * level;
				double value = centralPoint.Y + (level100Point.Y - centralPoint.Y) * level;
				list.Add(diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(argument, value));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public FibonacciArcsBehavior(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator)
		{
		}

		private IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> CalculateLabels(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, DiagramPoint centerPoint, IList<double> levels, IList<DiagramPoint> levelsPoints, int thickness)
		{
			FibonacciIndicatorLabel label = base.FibonacciIndicator.Label;
			DXFont dXFont = label.DXFont;
			double num = Math.Ceiling((double)thickness / 2.0);
			List<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> list = new List<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent>(levels.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < levels.Count; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint p = levelsPoints[i];
				string text = FibonacciIndicatorBehavior.ConstructLevelText(levels[i]);
				double num2 = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(centerPoint, p);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint;
				int num3;
				if (diagramMapping.Rotated)
				{
					diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(centerPoint.X + ((centerPoint.X > p.X) ? (0.0 - num2) : num2) - num, centerPoint.Y);
					num3 = 270;
				}
				else
				{
					diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(centerPoint.X, centerPoint.Y + ((centerPoint.Y > p.Y) ? (0.0 - num2) : num2) - num);
					num3 = 0;
				}
				RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent item = new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent(num3, (Point)diagramPoint, text, TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, dXFont, label), label, mixColorByHitTestState: true);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator = base.FibonacciIndicator;
			DiagramPoint centralPoint = base.MaxPoint;
			DiagramPoint level100Point = base.MinPoint;
			IList<double> levels = GetLevels();
			IList<double> baseLevels = GetBaseLevels();
			IList<DiagramPoint> levelsPoints = CalculateLevelsPoints(diagramMapping, centralPoint, level100Point, levels);
			IList<DiagramPoint> list = CalculateLevelsPoints(diagramMapping, centralPoint, level100Point, baseLevels);
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(centralPoint.X, centralPoint.Y);
			FibonacciIndicatorLabel label = fibonacciIndicator.Label;
			FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout labelsLayout;
			if (label.ActualVisibility)
			{
				IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> painters = CalculateLabels(diagramMapping, screenPointNoRound, levels, levelsPoints, fibonacciIndicator.LineStyle.Thickness);
				IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> baseLevelPainters = CalculateLabels(diagramMapping, screenPointNoRound, baseLevels, list, fibonacciIndicator.BaseLevelLineStyle.Thickness);
				labelsLayout = new FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout(label, painters, baseLevelPainters);
			}
			else
			{
				labelsLayout = null;
			}
			return new FibonacciArcsLayout(fibonacciIndicator, labelsLayout, screenPointNoRound, diagramMapping.Bounds, levelsPoints, list);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciArcsLayout : FibonacciIndicatorLayout
	{
		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		internal DiagramPoint CenterPoint { get; }

		internal IList<FibonacciCircle> LevelsCircles { get; }

		internal IList<FibonacciCircle> BaseLevelsCircles { get; }

		private static DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPathBase(IList<FibonacciCircle> circles, int thickness)
		{
			if (circles.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			foreach (FibonacciCircle circle in circles)
			{
				foreach (FibonacciArc item in circle)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(circle.Bounds, item.StartAngle, item.SweepAngle);
				}
			}
			using DXPen pen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, thickness);
			dXGraphicsPath.Widen(pen);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public FibonacciArcsLayout(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator, FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout labelsLayout, DiagramPoint centerPoint, Rectangle mappingBounds, IList<DiagramPoint> levelsPoints, IList<DiagramPoint> baseLevelsPoints)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator, labelsLayout)
		{
			CenterPoint = centerPoint;
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
			LevelsCircles = CalculateCircles(levelsPoints);
			BaseLevelsCircles = CalculateCircles(baseLevelsPoints);
		}

		private double CalcAngle(double radius, double x, double y)
		{
			double num = x - CenterPoint.X;
			double num2 = y - CenterPoint.Y;
			double num3 = Math.Acos(Math.Abs(num) / radius);
			if (num >= 0.0)
			{
				if (!(num2 >= 0.0))
				{
					return Math.PI * 2.0 - num3;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			if (!(num2 >= 0.0))
			{
				return Math.PI + num3;
			}
			return Math.PI - num3;
		}

		private void AddIntersectionAngles(List<double> angles, double radius, Point point1, Point point2)
		{
			double num = (double)point1.X - CenterPoint.X;
			double num2 = point2.X - point1.X;
			double num3 = (double)point1.Y - CenterPoint.Y;
			double num4 = point2.Y - point1.Y;
			double num5 = num2 * num2 + num4 * num4;
			double num6 = num2 * num + num4 * num3;
			double num7 = num6 * num6 - num5 * (num * num + num3 * num3 - radius * radius);
			if (num7 > 0.0)
			{
				num7 = Math.Sqrt(num7);
				double num8 = (0.0 - num6 + num7) / num5;
				angles.Add(CalcAngle(radius, num2 * num8 + (double)point1.X, num4 * num8 + (double)point1.Y));
				num8 = (0.0 - num6 - num7) / num5;
				angles.Add(CalcAngle(radius, num2 * num8 + (double)point1.X, num4 * num8 + (double)point1.Y));
			}
			else if (num7 == 0.0)
			{
				double num9 = (0.0 - num6) / num5;
				if (num9 >= 0.0 && num9 <= 1.0)
				{
					angles.Add(CalcAngle(radius, num2 * num9 + (double)point1.X, num4 * num9 + (double)point1.Y));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool PointInMappingBounds(double radius, double angle)
		{
			int x = MathUtils.StrongRound(CenterPoint.X + radius * Math.Cos(angle));
			int y = MathUtils.StrongRound(CenterPoint.Y + radius * Math.Sin(angle));
			return mappingBounds.Contains(new Point(x, y));
		}

		private bool ShouldAddArc(double radius, double startAngle, double endAngle)
		{
			if (startAngle < endAngle)
			{
				return PointInMappingBounds(radius, (startAngle + endAngle) / 2.0);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private FibonacciCircle CreateFibonacciCircle(double radius)
		{
			float num = (float)(radius * 2.0);
			if (num < 0.5f)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RectangleF bounds = new RectangleF((float)(CenterPoint.X - radius), (float)(CenterPoint.Y - radius), num, num);
			FibonacciCircle fibonacciCircle = new FibonacciCircle(bounds, (float)radius);
			Point point = new Point(mappingBounds.Left, mappingBounds.Top);
			Point point2 = new Point(mappingBounds.Left, mappingBounds.Bottom);
			Point point3 = new Point(mappingBounds.Right, mappingBounds.Top);
			Point point4 = new Point(mappingBounds.Right, mappingBounds.Bottom);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			AddIntersectionAngles(list, radius, point, point3);
			AddIntersectionAngles(list, radius, point3, point4);
			AddIntersectionAngles(list, radius, point4, point2);
			AddIntersectionAngles(list, radius, point2, point);
			int count = list.Count;
			if (count > 1)
			{
				list.Sort();
				double num2 = list[0];
				double startAngle;
				for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
				{
					startAngle = num2;
					num2 = list[i];
					if (ShouldAddArc(radius, startAngle, num2))
					{
						fibonacciCircle.Add(new FibonacciArc(startAngle, num2));
					}
				}
				startAngle = list[0] + Math.PI * 2.0;
				if (ShouldAddArc(radius, num2, startAngle))
				{
					fibonacciCircle.Add(new FibonacciArc(num2, startAngle));
				}
			}
			else if (mappingBounds.Contains((Point)CenterPoint) && PointInMappingBounds(radius, Math.PI / 4.0))
			{
				fibonacciCircle.Add(new FibonacciArc(0.0, Math.PI * 2.0));
			}
			if (fibonacciCircle.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return fibonacciCircle;
		}

		private IList<FibonacciCircle> CalculateCircles(IList<DiagramPoint> levelsPoints)
		{
			List<FibonacciCircle> list = new List<FibonacciCircle>(levelsPoints.Count);
			foreach (DiagramPoint levelsPoint in levelsPoints)
			{
				FibonacciCircle fibonacciCircle = CreateFibonacciCircle(MathUtils.CalcLength2D(CenterPoint, levelsPoint));
				if (fibonacciCircle != null)
				{
					list.Add(fibonacciCircle);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void RenderBase(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			Color color = base.Color;
			int thickness = base.Thickness;
			foreach (FibonacciCircle levelsCircle in LevelsCircles)
			{
				renderer.DrawCircle(new PointF(levelsCircle.Bounds.Left + levelsCircle.Radius, levelsCircle.Bounds.Top + levelsCircle.Radius), levelsCircle.Radius, color, thickness);
			}
			color = base.BaseLevelColor;
			thickness = base.BaseLevelThickness;
			foreach (FibonacciCircle baseLevelsCircle in BaseLevelsCircles)
			{
				renderer.DrawCircle(new PointF(baseLevelsCircle.Bounds.Left + baseLevelsCircle.Radius, baseLevelsCircle.Bounds.Top + baseLevelsCircle.Radius), baseLevelsCircle.Radius, color, thickness);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateGraphicsPathBase(LevelsCircles, base.Thickness);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath2 = CreateGraphicsPathBase(BaseLevelsCircles, base.BaseLevelThickness);
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return dXGraphicsPath2;
			}
			if (dXGraphicsPath2 == null)
			{
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath2, connect: false);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciFansBehavior : FibonacciLinesBehavior
	{
		public override bool DefaultShowLevel0 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel100 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel23_6 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel76_4 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowAdditionalLevels => false;

		public override bool ShowLevel0PropertyEnabled => true;

		public override bool ShowLevel100PropertyEnabled => false;

		public override bool ShowAdditionalLevelsPropertyEnabled => false;

		protected override bool Antialiasing => true;

		public FibonacciFansBehavior(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<FibonacciLine> CalculateLines(IList<double> levels)
		{
			GRealPoint2D startPoint = (GRealPoint2D)base.MinPoint;
			GRealPoint2D endPoint = (GRealPoint2D)base.MaxPoint;
			FibonacciFansCalculator fibonacciFansCalculator = new FibonacciFansCalculator();
			return fibonacciFansCalculator.CalculateLines(startPoint, endPoint, levels);
		}

		protected override RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent CreateLabelPainter(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, FibonacciLine line, string text, SizeF size, int thickness)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = line.Start.ToDiagramPoint();
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = line.End.ToDiagramPoint();
			double x = diagramPoint2.X;
			double y = diagramPoint2.Y;
			double num = Math.Atan2(y - diagramPoint.Y, x - diagramPoint.X) / Math.PI * 180.0;
			double num2 = (double)thickness / 2.0;
			return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent((float)num, new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(x + num2 * (double)Math.Sign(num)), MathUtils.StrongRound(y - num2)), text, size, base.FibonacciIndicator.Label, mixColorByHitTestState: true);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout
	{
		private readonly FibonacciIndicatorLabel label;

		private readonly IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> painters;

		private readonly IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> baseLevelPainters;

		public FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout(FibonacciIndicatorLabel label, IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> painters, IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> baseLevelPainters)
		{
			this.label = label;
			this.painters = painters;
			this.baseLevelPainters = baseLevelPainters;
		}

		private void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> painters, Color color)
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = label.FibonacciIndicator.HitTestController;
			foreach (RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent painter in painters)
			{
				painter.Render(renderer, hitTestController, null, color);
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Color actualTextColor = label.ActualTextColor;
			Color actualBaseLevelTextColor = label.ActualBaseLevelTextColor;
			Render(renderer, painters, actualTextColor);
			Render(renderer, baseLevelPainters, actualBaseLevelTextColor);
		}
	}
	public abstract class FibonacciLinesBehavior : FibonacciIndicatorBehavior
	{
		protected abstract bool Antialiasing { get; }

		public FibonacciLinesBehavior(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator)
		{
		}

		private IList<FibonacciLine> CalculateScreenLines(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, IList<FibonacciLine> lines)
		{
			List<FibonacciLine> list = new List<FibonacciLine>(lines.Count);
			foreach (FibonacciLine line in lines)
			{
				DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(line.Start.X, line.Start.Y);
				DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound2 = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(line.End.X, line.End.Y);
				list.Add(new FibonacciLine(line.Level, (GRealPoint2D)screenPointNoRound, (GRealPoint2D)screenPointNoRound2));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> TruncateScreenLines(IList<FibonacciLine> lines, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			List<FibonacciLine> list = new List<FibonacciLine>(lines.Count);
			foreach (FibonacciLine line in lines)
			{
				GRealLine2D? gRealLine2D = TruncatedLineCalculator.Truncate(line.Start, line.End, bounds, LineKind.Ray);
				if (gRealLine2D.HasValue)
				{
					GRealLine2D value = gRealLine2D.Value;
					list.Add(new FibonacciLine(line.Level, value.Start, value.End));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> CalculateLabels(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, IList<FibonacciLine> lines, int thickness)
		{
			DXFont dXFont = base.FibonacciIndicator.Label.DXFont;
			List<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> list = new List<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent>(lines.Count);
			TextMeasurer textMeasurer = TextMeasurer.Default;
			foreach (FibonacciLine line in lines)
			{
				string text = FibonacciIndicatorBehavior.ConstructLevelText(line.Level);
				list.Add(CreateLabelPainter(diagramMapping, line, text, textMeasurer.MeasureString(text, dXFont, base.FibonacciIndicator.Label), thickness));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected abstract IList<FibonacciLine> CalculateLines(IList<double> levels);

		protected abstract RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent CreateLabelPainter(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, FibonacciLine line, string text, SizeF size, int thickness);

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator = base.FibonacciIndicator;
			IList<FibonacciLine> lines = CalculateScreenLines(diagramMapping, CalculateLines(GetLevels()));
			IList<FibonacciLine> lines2 = CalculateScreenLines(diagramMapping, CalculateLines(GetBaseLevels()));
			Rectangle bounds = diagramMapping.Bounds;
			IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> lines3 = TruncateScreenLines(lines, bounds);
			IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> baseLevelsLines = TruncateScreenLines(lines2, bounds);
			FibonacciIndicatorLabel label = fibonacciIndicator.Label;
			FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout labelsLayout;
			if (label.ActualVisibility)
			{
				IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> painters = CalculateLabels(diagramMapping, lines, fibonacciIndicator.LineStyle.Thickness);
				IEnumerable<RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent> baseLevelPainters = CalculateLabels(diagramMapping, lines2, fibonacciIndicator.BaseLevelLineStyle.Thickness);
				labelsLayout = new FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout(label, painters, baseLevelPainters);
			}
			else
			{
				labelsLayout = null;
			}
			return new FibonacciLinesLayout(fibonacciIndicator, labelsLayout, lines3, baseLevelsLines, Antialiasing);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciLinesLayout : FibonacciIndicatorLayout
	{
		private readonly bool antialiasing;

		internal IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> Lines { get; }

		internal IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> BaseLevelsLines { get; }

		private static DXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPathBase(IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> lines, int thickness, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			foreach (FibonacciLine line in lines)
			{
				Point point = line.Start.ToPoint();
				Point point2 = line.End.ToPoint();
				if (point2 != point)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLine(point, point2);
					dXGraphicsPath.CloseFigure();
				}
			}
			RectangleF bounds = dXGraphicsPath.GetBounds();
			if ((double)bounds.Width < 0.5 && (double)bounds.Height < 0.5)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, thickness);
			if (lineStyle != null)
			{
				dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)lineStyle.LineJoin;
			}
			dXGraphicsPath.Widen(dXPen);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		protected override void RenderBase(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator = base.FibonacciIndicator;
			LineStyle lineStyle = fibonacciIndicator.LineStyle;
			Color color = base.Color;
			int thickness = base.Thickness;
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(antialiasing);
			foreach (FibonacciLine line in Lines)
			{
				renderer.DrawLine(line.Start.ToPoint(), line.End.ToPoint(), color, thickness, lineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			lineStyle = fibonacciIndicator.BaseLevelLineStyle;
			color = base.BaseLevelColor;
			thickness = base.BaseLevelThickness;
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(antialiasing);
			foreach (FibonacciLine baseLevelsLine in BaseLevelsLines)
			{
				renderer.DrawLine(baseLevelsLine.Start.ToPoint(), baseLevelsLine.End.ToPoint(), color, thickness, lineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public FibonacciLinesLayout(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator, FibonacciIndicatorLabelsLayout labelsLayout, IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> lines, IEnumerable<FibonacciLine> baseLevelsLines, bool antialiasing)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator, labelsLayout)
		{
			Lines = lines;
			BaseLevelsLines = baseLevelsLines;
			this.antialiasing = antialiasing;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateGraphicsPathBase(Lines, base.Thickness, base.Indicator.LineStyle);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath2 = CreateGraphicsPathBase(BaseLevelsLines, base.BaseLevelThickness, base.Indicator.LineStyle);
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return dXGraphicsPath2;
			}
			if (dXGraphicsPath2 != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath2, connect: false);
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciRetracementBehavior : FibonacciLinesBehavior
	{
		protected override bool Antialiasing => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel0 => true;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel100 => true;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel23_6 => true;

		public override bool DefaultShowLevel76_4 => false;

		public override bool DefaultShowAdditionalLevels => false;

		public override bool ShowLevel0PropertyEnabled => false;

		public override bool ShowLevel100PropertyEnabled => false;

		public override bool ShowAdditionalLevelsPropertyEnabled => true;

		public FibonacciRetracementBehavior(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<FibonacciLine> CalculateLines(IList<double> levels)
		{
			GRealPoint2D startPoint = (GRealPoint2D)base.MinPoint;
			GRealPoint2D endPoint = (GRealPoint2D)base.MaxPoint;
			endPoint.X = Math.Max(startPoint.X, base.FibonacciIndicator.View.ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData.Max);
			FibonacciRetracementCalculator fibonacciRetracementCalculator = new FibonacciRetracementCalculator();
			return fibonacciRetracementCalculator.CalculateLines(startPoint, endPoint, levels);
		}

		protected override RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent CreateLabelPainter(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, FibonacciLine line, string text, SizeF size, int thickness)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)size.Width / 2.0);
			int num2 = MathUtils.Ceiling((double)thickness / 2.0);
			int num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound(line.End.X);
			int num4 = MathUtils.StrongRound(line.End.Y);
			int num5;
			if (diagramMapping.Rotated)
			{
				num5 = 90;
				int num6 = MathUtils.StrongRound(line.Start.Y);
				num3 += num2;
				if (diagramMapping.XReverse)
				{
					num4 -= num + 2;
					int num7 = num6 + num;
					if (num4 < num7)
					{
						num4 = num7;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num4 += num + 1;
					int num8 = num6 - num;
					if (num4 > num8)
					{
						num4 = num8;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num5 = 0;
				int num9 = MathUtils.StrongRound(line.Start.X);
				num4 -= num2;
				if (diagramMapping.XReverse)
				{
					num3 += num + 1;
					int num10 = num9 - num;
					if (num3 > num10)
					{
						num3 = num10;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 -= num + 2;
					int num11 = num9 + num;
					if (num3 < num11)
					{
						num3 = num11;
					}
				}
			}
			return new RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent(num5, new Point(num3, num4), text, size, base.FibonacciIndicator.Label, mixColorByHitTestState: true);
		}
	}
	public class ConeGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private readonly float offset;

		private readonly float height;

		private readonly float startRadius;

		private readonly float finishRadius;

		private readonly bool startClosed;

		private readonly bool finishClosed;

		private readonly Color color;

		private readonly float holeRadiusFactor;

		public ConeGraphicsCommand(float startHeight, float finishHeight, float startRadius, float finishRadius, Color color, bool startClosed, bool finishClosed, int holeRadiusPercent)
		{
			offset = startHeight;
			height = finishHeight - startHeight;
			this.startRadius = startRadius;
			this.finishRadius = finishRadius;
			this.color = color;
			this.startClosed = startClosed;
			this.finishClosed = finishClosed;
			holeRadiusFactor = (float)holeRadiusPercent / 100f;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.PushMatrix();
			try
			{
				GL.Rotated(90.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				GL.PushMatrix();
				try
				{
					GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, offset);
					GLHelper.PartialCone(height, startRadius, finishRadius, 0f, 360f);
					if (holeRadiusFactor != 0f && holeRadiusFactor != 1f)
					{
						GLHelper.PartialCone(height, startRadius * holeRadiusFactor, finishRadius * holeRadiusFactor, 0f, 360f);
					}
					if (startClosed && holeRadiusFactor != 1f)
					{
						GLHelper.PartialDisk(startRadius * holeRadiusFactor, startRadius, 0f, 360f);
					}
					if (finishClosed && holeRadiusFactor != 1f)
					{
						GL.PushMatrix();
						try
						{
							GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, height);
							GLHelper.PartialDisk(finishRadius * holeRadiusFactor, finishRadius, 0f, 360f);
							return;
						}
						finally
						{
							GL.PopMatrix();
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					GL.PopMatrix();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				GL.PopMatrix();
			}
		}
	}
	public class Cone
	{
		private const double startAngle = Math.PI / 2.0;

		private readonly List<PlanePolygon> laterals = new List<PlanePolygon>();

		private PlanePolygon topBase;

		private PlanePolygon bottomBase;

		private DiagramPoint location;

		private double width;

		private double height;

		private double depth;

		protected virtual bool IsSmoothing => true;

		public double Width => width;

		public double Height => height;

		public double Depth => depth;

		public DiagramPoint Location => location;

		public List<PlanePolygon> Laterals => laterals;

		public PlanePolygon TopBase => topBase;

		public PlanePolygon BottomBase => bottomBase;

		public Cone(YPlaneRectangle bottomBase, YPlaneRectangle topBase, int segmentsCount)
		{
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(bottomBase.Center.X, topBase.Center.X, 0.01) != 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(bottomBase.Center.Z, topBase.Center.Z, 0.01) != 0)
			{
				double dx = topBase.Center.X - bottomBase.Center.X;
				double dz = topBase.Center.Z - bottomBase.Center.Z;
				topBase.Offset(dx, 0.0, dz);
			}
			CreateTruncatedCone(bottomBase, topBase, segmentsCount);
		}

		public Cone(YPlaneRectangle coneBase, double coneHeight, double beginHeight, double endHeight, int segmentsCount)
		{
			double num = coneBase.Height * (coneHeight - beginHeight) / coneHeight;
			double num2 = coneBase.Width * (coneHeight - beginHeight) / coneHeight;
			DiagramPoint point = DiagramPoint.Offset(coneBase.Location, (coneBase.Height - num) / 2.0, beginHeight, (coneBase.Width - num2) / 2.0);
			YPlaneRectangle bottomRectBase = new YPlaneRectangle(point, num2, num);
			if ((coneHeight >= 0.0) ? (endHeight < coneHeight) : (endHeight > coneHeight))
			{
				num = coneBase.Height * (coneHeight - endHeight) / coneHeight;
				num2 = coneBase.Width * (coneHeight - endHeight) / coneHeight;
				point = DiagramPoint.Offset(coneBase.Location, (coneBase.Height - num) / 2.0, endHeight, (coneBase.Width - num2) / 2.0);
				YPlaneRectangle topRectBase = new YPlaneRectangle(point, num2, num);
				CreateTruncatedCone(bottomRectBase, topRectBase, segmentsCount);
			}
			else
			{
				CreateSimpleCone(bottomRectBase, endHeight - beginHeight, segmentsCount);
			}
		}

		protected virtual PlanePolygon CalcBase(YPlaneRectangle rectBase, int segmentsCount)
		{
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlanePolygon(MathUtils.CalcInscribedEllipsePoints(rectBase, Math.PI / 2.0, segmentsCount));
			planePolygon.SameNormals = true;
			planePolygon.Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planePolygon);
			return planePolygon;
		}

		private DiagramVector[] CalcNormalsForTruncatedCone(DiagramPoint centerBase)
		{
			if (topBase == null || bottomBase == null || bottomBase.Vertices.Length < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramVector[] array = new DiagramVector[bottomBase.Vertices.Length];
			double num = topBase.Vertices[0].Y - bottomBase.Vertices[0].Y;
			for (int i = 0; i < bottomBase.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				double num2 = bottomBase.Vertices[i].X - topBase.Vertices[i].X;
				double num3 = bottomBase.Vertices[i].Z - topBase.Vertices[i].Z;
				double y = Math.Sqrt(num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
				double num4 = ((num != 0.0) ? Math.Atan2(y, num) : (Math.PI / 2.0));
				double dy = Math.Sin(num4);
				double num5 = Math.Cos(num4);
				double num6 = bottomBase.Vertices[i].X - centerBase.X;
				double num7 = bottomBase.Vertices[i].Z - centerBase.Z;
				array[i] = new DiagramVector(2.0 * num6 * num5 / width, dy, 2.0 * num7 * num5 / depth);
				array[i].Normalize();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private DiagramVector[] CalcNormalsForSimpleCone(DiagramPoint coneVertex)
		{
			if (bottomBase == null || bottomBase.Vertices.Length < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramVector[] array = new DiagramVector[bottomBase.Vertices.Length];
			double num = coneVertex.Y - bottomBase.Vertices[0].Y;
			for (int i = 0; i < bottomBase.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				double num2 = bottomBase.Vertices[i].X - coneVertex.X;
				double num3 = bottomBase.Vertices[i].Z - coneVertex.Z;
				double y = Math.Sqrt(num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
				double num4 = ((num != 0.0) ? Math.Atan2(y, num) : (Math.PI / 2.0));
				double dy = Math.Sin(num4);
				double num5 = Math.Cos(num4);
				array[i] = new DiagramVector(2.0 * num2 * num5 / width, dy, 2.0 * num3 * num5 / depth);
				array[i].Normalize();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void CreateTruncatedCone(YPlaneRectangle bottomRectBase, YPlaneRectangle topRectBase, int segmentsCount)
		{
			height = topRectBase.Center.Y - bottomRectBase.Center.Y;
			width = bottomRectBase.Height;
			depth = bottomRectBase.Width;
			location = bottomRectBase.Location;
			bottomBase = CalcBase(bottomRectBase, segmentsCount);
			topBase = CalcBase(topRectBase, segmentsCount);
			DiagramVector[] array = CalcNormalsForTruncatedCone(bottomRectBase.Center);
			for (int i = 0; i < bottomBase.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = ((i <= bottomBase.Vertices.Length - 2) ? (i + 1) : 0);
				Vertex v = new Vertex(bottomBase.Vertices[num].Point, array[num]);
				Vertex v2 = new Vertex(bottomBase.Vertices[i].Point, array[i]);
				Vertex v3 = new Vertex(topBase.Vertices[i].Point, array[i]);
				Vertex v4 = new Vertex(topBase.Vertices[num].Point, array[num]);
				PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlaneQuadrangle(v, v2, v3, v4);
				planePolygon.Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planePolygon);
				planePolygon.SameNormals = !IsSmoothing;
				laterals.Add(planePolygon);
			}
		}

		private void CreateSimpleCone(YPlaneRectangle bottomRectBase, double height, int segmentsCount)
		{
			this.height = height;
			width = bottomRectBase.Height;
			depth = bottomRectBase.Width;
			location = bottomRectBase.Location;
			bottomBase = CalcBase(bottomRectBase, segmentsCount);
			topBase = null;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset(bottomRectBase.Center, 0.0, height, 0.0);
			DiagramVector[] array = CalcNormalsForSimpleCone(diagramPoint);
			for (int i = 0; i < bottomBase.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = ((i <= bottomBase.Vertices.Length - 2) ? (i + 1) : 0);
				Vertex v = new Vertex(bottomBase.Vertices[num], array[num]);
				Vertex v2 = new Vertex(bottomBase.Vertices[i], array[i]);
				DiagramVector normal = array[num] + array[i];
				normal.Normalize();
				Vertex v3 = new Vertex(diagramPoint, normal);
				PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlaneTriangle(v, v2, v3);
				planePolygon.Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planePolygon);
				planePolygon.SameNormals = !IsSmoothing;
				laterals.Add(planePolygon);
			}
		}
	}

	public class Pyramid : Cone
	{
		private const int pyramidSegmentsCount = 4;

		protected override bool IsSmoothing => false;

		public Pyramid(YPlaneRectangle bottomPyramidBase, YPlaneRectangle topPyramidBase)
			: base(bottomPyramidBase, topPyramidBase, 4)
		{
		}

		public Pyramid(YPlaneRectangle pyramidBase, double pyramidHeight, double beginHeight, double endHeight)
			: base(pyramidBase, pyramidHeight, beginHeight, endHeight, 4)
		{
		}

		protected override PlanePolygon CalcBase(YPlaneRectangle rectBase, int segmentsCount)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[6];
			array[5] = rectBase.LeftBottom;
			array[4] = rectBase.RightBottom;
			array[3] = new DiagramPoint(rectBase.RightCenter.X, rectBase.RightBottom.Y, rectBase.RightBottom.Z);
			array[2] = rectBase.RightTop;
			array[1] = rectBase.LeftTop;
			array[0] = new DiagramPoint(rectBase.LeftCenter.X, rectBase.LeftTop.Y, rectBase.LeftTop.Z);
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlanePolygon(array);
			planePolygon.SameNormals = true;
			planePolygon.Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planePolygon);
			return planePolygon;
		}
	}

	public abstract class LegendItemGroupingAlgorithm
	{
		private readonly LegendBase legend;

		private readonly IList<LegendItemViewData> items;

		private readonly Size maxSize;

		private readonly RectangleIndents padding;

		protected LegendBase Legend => legend;

		protected IList<LegendItemViewData> Items => items;

		protected Size MaxSize => maxSize;

		protected RectangleIndents Padding => padding;

		protected abstract int Indent { get; }

		private static LegendItemGroupingAlgorithm CreateInstance(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> items, Size maxSize)
		{
			switch (legend.Direction)
			{
			case LegendDirection.TopToBottom:
			case LegendDirection.BottomToTop:
				return new VerticalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm(legend, items, maxSize);
			case LegendDirection.LeftToRight:
			case LegendDirection.RightToLeft:
				if (legend.EquallySpacedItems)
				{
					return new HorizontalGroupingAlgorithmWithVerticalAlignment(legend, items, maxSize);
				}
				return new HorizontalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm(legend, items, maxSize);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public static LegendItemGroup[] Calculate(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> items, Size maxSize)
		{
			return CreateInstance(legend, items, maxSize).CalculateGroups();
		}

		public LegendItemGroupingAlgorithm(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> items, Size maxSize)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
			if (legend.Direction == LegendDirection.BottomToTop || legend.Direction == LegendDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				items.Reverse();
			}
			this.items = items;
			this.maxSize = maxSize;
			padding = legend.ActualPadding;
		}

		protected internal virtual LegendItemGroup[] CalculateGroups()
		{
			List<LegendItemGroup> list = new List<LegendItemGroup>();
			LegendItemGroup nextGroup;
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i += nextGroup.Count)
			{
				nextGroup = GetNextGroup(i);
				list.Add(nextGroup);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual LegendItemGroup GetNextGroup(int index)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = GetCharacteristicLength(maxSize) - GetPadding();
			List<LegendItemViewData> list = new List<LegendItemViewData>();
			for (int i = index; i < Items.Count; i++)
			{
				num += GetCharacteristicLength(Items[i].Size);
				if (i > index && num > num2)
				{
					break;
				}
				num += Indent;
				list.Add(Items[i]);
			}
			return new LegendItemGroup(list.ToArray());
		}

		protected abstract int GetPadding();

		protected abstract int GetCharacteristicLength(Size size);
	}
	public class VerticalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm : LegendItemGroupingAlgorithm
	{
		protected override int Indent => base.Legend.VerticalIndent;

		public VerticalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> itemData, Size maxSize)
			: base(legend, itemData, maxSize)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetPadding()
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
			return dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom;
		}

		protected override int GetCharacteristicLength(Size size)
		{
			return size.Height;
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm : LegendItemGroupingAlgorithm
	{
		protected override int Indent => base.Legend.HorizontalIndent;

		public HorizontalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> itemData, Size maxSize)
			: base(legend, itemData, maxSize)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetPadding()
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
			return dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right;
		}

		protected override int GetCharacteristicLength(Size size)
		{
			return size.Width;
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalGroupingAlgorithmWithVerticalAlignment : HorizontalLegendItemGroupingAlgorithm
	{
		private int actualDimension;

		public HorizontalGroupingAlgorithmWithVerticalAlignment(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> itemData, Size maxSize)
			: base(legend, itemData, maxSize)
		{
		}

		private bool IsLegendFitInLimits(LegendItemGroup[] groups)
		{
			if (groups.Length == 0 || groups[0].Count < 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int[] array = new int[groups[0].Count];
			foreach (LegendItemGroup legendItemGroup in groups)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < legendItemGroup.Count; j++)
				{
					array[j] = Math.Max(array[j], GetCharacteristicLength(legendItemGroup[j].Size));
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			int[] array2 = array;
			foreach (int num2 in array2)
			{
				num += num2;
			}
			if (array.Length > 1)
			{
				num += (array.Length - 1) * base.Legend.HorizontalIndent;
			}
			return num <= GetCharacteristicLength(base.MaxSize) - GetPadding();
		}

		private int CalcInitialDimension()
		{
			if (base.Items.Count <= 1)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int num = GetCharacteristicLength(base.MaxSize) - GetPadding();
			int num2 = GetCharacteristicLength(base.Items[0].Size) + Indent;
			for (int i = 1; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				num2 += GetCharacteristicLength(base.Items[i].Size);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					return i;
				}
				num2 += Indent;
			}
			return base.Items.Count;
		}

		protected internal override LegendItemGroup[] CalculateGroups()
		{
			actualDimension = CalcInitialDimension();
			LegendItemGroup[] array = base.CalculateGroups();
			while (!IsLegendFitInLimits(array))
			{
				actualDimension--;
				array = base.CalculateGroups();
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected override LegendItemGroup GetNextGroup(int index)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(actualDimension, base.Items.Count - index);
			LegendItemViewData[] array = new LegendItemViewData[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < num)
			{
				array[num2] = base.Items[index];
				num2++;
				index++;
			}
			return new LegendItemGroup(array);
		}
	}
	public abstract class LegendItemsOffsetCalculator
	{
		private LegendBase legend;

		private IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups;

		protected LegendBase Legend => legend;

		protected IList<LegendItemGroup> ItemGroups => itemGroups;

		private static LegendItemsOffsetCalculator CreateInstance(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups)
		{
			switch (legend.Direction)
			{
			case LegendDirection.TopToBottom:
			case LegendDirection.BottomToTop:
				return new VerticalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator(legend, itemGroups);
			case LegendDirection.LeftToRight:
			case LegendDirection.RightToLeft:
				if (!legend.EquallySpacedItems)
				{
					return new HorizontalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator(legend, itemGroups);
				}
				return new HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAligningOffsetCalculator(legend, itemGroups);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public static void Calculate(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups)
		{
			if (itemGroups.Count != 0)
			{
				LegendItemsOffsetCalculator legendItemsOffsetCalculator = CreateInstance(legend, itemGroups);
				legendItemsOffsetCalculator.CalculateRightIndents();
				legendItemsOffsetCalculator.CalculateOffsets();
			}
		}

		public LegendItemsOffsetCalculator(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
			this.itemGroups = itemGroups;
		}

		private int GetMaxCharacteristicLength(LegendItemGroup group)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)group)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, GetCharacteristicLength(item.Size));
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected abstract int GetCharacteristicLength(Size size);

		protected abstract void CalculateOffsets();

		protected virtual void CalculateRightIndents()
		{
			foreach (LegendItemGroup itemGroup in ItemGroups)
			{
				int maxCharacteristicLength = GetMaxCharacteristicLength(itemGroup);
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)itemGroup)
				{
					item.RightIndent = maxCharacteristicLength - GetCharacteristicLength(item.Size);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class VerticalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator : LegendItemsOffsetCalculator
	{
		public VerticalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups)
			: base(legend, itemGroups)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetCharacteristicLength(Size size)
		{
			return size.Width;
		}

		protected override void CalculateOffsets()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ItemGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < base.ItemGroups[i].Count; j++)
				{
					base.ItemGroups[i][j].Offset = new Point(num, num2);
					num2 += base.ItemGroups[i][j].Size.Height + base.Legend.VerticalIndent;
				}
				num += base.ItemGroups[i][0].Size.Width + base.ItemGroups[i][0].RightIndent + base.Legend.HorizontalIndent;
			}
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator : LegendItemsOffsetCalculator
	{
		public HorizontalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups)
			: base(legend, itemGroups)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetCharacteristicLength(Size size)
		{
			return size.Height;
		}

		protected override void CalculateOffsets()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ItemGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < base.ItemGroups[i].Count; j++)
				{
					base.ItemGroups[i][j].Offset = new Point(num2, num);
					num2 += base.ItemGroups[i][j].Size.Width + base.ItemGroups[i][j].RightIndent + base.Legend.HorizontalIndent;
				}
				num += base.ItemGroups[i][0].Size.Height + base.Legend.VerticalIndent;
			}
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAligningOffsetCalculator : HorizontalLayoutLegendItemsOffsetCalculator
	{
		public HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAligningOffsetCalculator(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups)
			: base(legend, itemGroups)
		{
		}

		private int[] CalculateWidths()
		{
			int[] array = new int[base.ItemGroups[0].Count];
			foreach (LegendItemGroup itemGroup in base.ItemGroups)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < itemGroup.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = Math.Max(array[i], itemGroup[i].Size.Width);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected override void CalculateRightIndents()
		{
			int[] array = CalculateWidths();
			foreach (LegendItemGroup itemGroup in base.ItemGroups)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < itemGroup.Count; i++)
				{
					itemGroup[i].RightIndent = array[i] - itemGroup[i].Size.Width;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class LegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator
	{
		private IList<LegendItemGroup> itemGroups;

		protected IList<LegendItemGroup> ItemGroups => itemGroups;

		private static LegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator CreateInstance(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> items)
		{
			switch (legend.Direction)
			{
			case LegendDirection.TopToBottom:
			case LegendDirection.BottomToTop:
				return new VerticalLayoutLegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator(items);
			case LegendDirection.LeftToRight:
			case LegendDirection.RightToLeft:
				if (!legend.EquallySpacedItems)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAligningCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator(items);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public static void Calculate(LegendBase legend, IList<LegendItemGroup> items)
		{
			if (items.Count != 0)
			{
				CreateInstance(legend, items)?.CalculateOffsets();
			}
		}

		public LegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator(IList<LegendItemGroup> items)
		{
			itemGroups = items;
		}

		protected abstract void CalculateOffsets();
	}
	public class VerticalLayoutLegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator : LegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator
	{
		public VerticalLayoutLegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator(IList<LegendItemGroup> items)
			: base(items)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalculateOffsets()
		{
			foreach (LegendItemGroup itemGroup in base.ItemGroups)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)itemGroup)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, item.Size.Width);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, item.SizeWithoutCrosshairContent.Width);
				}
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item2 in (IEnumerable)itemGroup)
				{
					item2.UpdateLegendItemCrosshairContentWidth(num2, num);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAligningCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator : LegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator
	{
		public HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAligningCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator(IList<LegendItemGroup> items)
			: base(items)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalculateOffsets()
		{
			int[] array = new int[base.ItemGroups[0].Count];
			int[] array2 = new int[base.ItemGroups[0].Count];
			foreach (LegendItemGroup itemGroup in base.ItemGroups)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < itemGroup.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = Math.Max(array[i], itemGroup[i].Size.Width);
					array2[i] = Math.Max(array2[i], itemGroup[i].SizeWithoutCrosshairContent.Width);
				}
			}
			foreach (LegendItemGroup itemGroup2 in base.ItemGroups)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < itemGroup2.Count; j++)
				{
					itemGroup2[j].UpdateLegendItemCrosshairContentWidth(array2[j], array[j]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class LegendItemViewData : IHitTest, IClickableElement
	{
		private HitTestState hitTestState = new HitTestState();

		private DXFont CustomFont { get; }

		protected HitTestController HitTestController => LegendItemContainer.GetHitTestController();

		protected internal ILegendItemContainer LegendItemContainer { get; }

		protected Size TextSize { get; }

		protected Size MarkerSize { get; }

		protected bool UseTextSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Item.TextVisible)
				{
					return Item.ReserveSpaceForHiddenText;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool UseMarkerSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (LegendItemContainer.ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarker == ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarkerMode.Never && !LegendItemContainer.MarkersVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Item.MarkerVisible && !Item.ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarker)
				{
					if (Item is CustomLegendItem)
					{
						if (!LegendItemContainer.MarkersVisible)
						{
							return LegendItemContainer.CheckboxesVisible;
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected DXFont ActualFont => CustomFont ?? Item.Font;

		internal LegendItemTextInfo TextItemInfo { get; private set; }

		internal ILegendItem LegendItem => Item.RepresentedObject;

		public int RightIndent { get; set; }

		public ILegendItemData Item { get; }

		public Point Offset { get; set; }

		public Size Size { get; set; }

		public Size SizeWithoutCrosshairContent { get; protected set; }

		object IHitTest.Object => this;

		HitTestState IHitTest.State => hitTestState;

		bool IHitTest.CanBeHot
		{
			get
			{
				if (LegendItemContainer.Owner is Chart { ContainerAdapter: not null } chart)
				{
					return chart.ContainerAdapter.SelectionEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public LegendItemViewData(ILegendItemContainer legend, ILegendItemData item, DXFont customFont = null)
		{
			CustomFont = customFont;
			LegendItemContainer = legend;
			Item = item;
			TextSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureStringRounded(item.Text, ActualFont, legend);
			MarkerSize = ((item.MarkerImage != null && item.MarkerImageSizeMode == ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize) ? item.MarkerImage.Size : item.MarkerSize);
		}

		bool IClickableElement.ProcessLeftButtonClick()
		{
			ICheckableLegendItemData checkableLegendItemData = Item as ICheckableLegendItemData;
			if (Item.Legend.CheckBoxesVisible && checkableLegendItemData != null && checkableLegendItemData.CheckBoxEnabled)
			{
				checkableLegendItemData.CheckedInLegend = !checkableLegendItemData.CheckedInLegend;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Color GetActualBackColor()
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (LegendItemContainer == null || LegendItemContainer.Owner == null)
			{
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
			if (!(LegendItemContainer.Owner is Chart chart) || !EnumExtensions.ToBoolean(chart.AllowDirectXRendering, false))
			{
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
			if (LegendItemContainer.ActualBackColor != Color.Transparent)
			{
				return LegendItemContainer.ActualBackColor;
			}
			return chart.ActualBackColor;
		}

		protected Size CalculateSizeCore()
		{
			Size result = (UseTextSize ? TextSize : default(Size));
			if (UseMarkerSize)
			{
				result.Width += MarkerSize.Width;
				if (MarkerSize.Height > result.Height)
				{
					result.Height = MarkerSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void RenderLegendItemText(ChartRenderer renderer, Point textLocation)
		{
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, LegendItemContainer.HitTestableObject, Item.RepresentedObject, new HitRegion(new RectangleF(textLocation.X, textLocation.Y, TextSize.Width, TextSize.Height)));
			Color actualLegendItemTextColor = GetActualLegendItemTextColor();
			if (LegendItemContainer.RenderTextByRenderer)
			{
				bool flag = Item.DisposeFont && ActualFont != LegendItemContainer.DXFont;
				Color actualBackColor = GetActualBackColor();
				if (actualBackColor != Color.Transparent)
				{
					renderer.FillRectangle(new RectangleF(textLocation, TextSize), new DXSolidBrush(actualBackColor));
				}
				renderer.DrawText(Item.Text, ActualFont.DpiScale(), actualLegendItemTextColor, LegendItemContainer, textLocation);
			}
			else
			{
				TextItemInfo = new LegendItemTextInfo(Item.Text, new GRealPoint2D(textLocation.X, textLocation.Y), ActualFont, actualLegendItemTextColor);
			}
		}

		protected Rectangle CalcMarkerOrCheckBoxBounds(Point firstItemLocation, Size markerOrCheckBoxSize, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = (TextSize.Height - markerOrCheckBoxSize.Height) / 2;
			int num2 = ((num >= 0) ? num : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + Offset.Y + num2;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + Offset.X;
			}
			else
			{
				int num3 = firstItemLocation.X + Size.Width + RightIndent + Offset.X;
				x = num3 - markerOrCheckBoxSize.Width;
			}
			Point location = new Point(x, y);
			return new Rectangle(location, markerOrCheckBoxSize);
		}

		protected Point CalcTextLocationForMarkerOrCheckBoxMode(Size markerOrCheckSize, Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = (markerOrCheckSize.Height - ((TextSize.Height != 0) ? TextSize.Height : (ActualFont.GetGdiHeight() + 1))) / 2;
			int num2 = ((num >= 0) ? num : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + Offset.Y + num2;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + Offset.X + markerOrCheckSize.Width + LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled;
			}
			else
			{
				int num3 = firstItemLocation.X + Size.Width + RightIndent + Offset.X;
				x = num3 - (markerOrCheckSize.Width + LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled + TextSize.Width);
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		protected Point CalcTextLocationForNoneMode(Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + Offset.Y;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + Offset.X;
			}
			else
			{
				int num = firstItemLocation.X + Size.Width + RightIndent + Offset.X;
				x = num - TextSize.Width;
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		protected virtual Color GetActualLegendItemTextColor()
		{
			return Item.TextColor;
		}

		protected virtual Point RenderLegendItems(ChartRenderer renderer, Point firstItemLocation, Point textLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			return RenderMarkerItem(renderer, firstItemLocation, textLocation, isRightToLeft);
		}

		protected Point RenderMarkerItem(ChartRenderer renderer, Point firstItemLocation, Point textLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			Rectangle bounds = CalcMarkerOrCheckBoxBounds(firstItemLocation, MarkerSize, isRightToLeft);
			if (Item.MarkerVisible && LegendItemContainer.MarkersVisible)
			{
				Item.RenderMarker(renderer, bounds);
			}
			if (Item.TextVisible)
			{
				textLocation = ((!LegendItemContainer.MarkersVisible) ? CalcTextLocationForNoneMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft) : CalcTextLocationForMarkerOrCheckBoxMode(bounds.Size, firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft));
				RenderLegendItemText(renderer, textLocation);
			}
			return textLocation;
		}

		public virtual void UpdateLegendItemCrosshairContentWidth(int maxWidthWithoutCrosshairContent, int maxWidth)
		{
		}

		public virtual Point Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Point firstItemLocation)
		{
			return RenderLegendItems(renderer, firstItemLocation, default(Point), renderer.IsRightToLeft);
		}

		public virtual void CalculateSize()
		{
			Size sizeWithoutCrosshairContent = (Size = CalculateSizeCore());
			SizeWithoutCrosshairContent = sizeWithoutCrosshairContent;
		}
	}
	public class ChartLegendItemViewData : LegendItemViewData
	{
		private readonly Color colorForDisabledItem = Color.LightGray;

		private Size crosshairContentSize;

		private int crosshairItemOffset;

		private Size checkBoxSize;

		private ICheckableLegendItemData CheckableItem => base.Item as ICheckableLegendItemData;

		private Legend ChartLegend => (Legend)base.LegendItemContainer;

		internal RectangleF CrosshairItemBounds { get; set; } = RectangleF.Empty;

		private bool UseLegacyCustomCheckBox()
		{
			if (base.LegendItemContainer.UseCheckBoxesSetByUser.HasValue && base.LegendItemContainer.UseCheckBoxesSetByUser.Value && CheckableItem != null)
			{
				return CheckableItem.MarkerImage != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ChartLegendItemViewData(LegendBase legend, ILegendItemData item)
			: base(legend, item)
		{
			if (CheckableItem != null)
			{
				checkBoxSize = ((CheckableItem.CheckBoxImage != null && CheckableItem.CheckBoxImageSizeMode == ChartImageSizeMode.AutoSize) ? CheckableItem.CheckBoxImage.Size : CheckableItem.CheckBoxSize);
			}
			crosshairContentSize = CalculateCrosshairContentSize();
			crosshairItemOffset = ChartLegend.CrosshairContentOffsetScaled;
		}

		private Size CalculateLegendItemSizeWithCrosshairContent(Size oldSize, int crosshairItemOffset, Size crosshairContentSize)
		{
			if (!crosshairContentSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				int width = oldSize.Width + crosshairContentSize.Width + crosshairItemOffset;
				int height = ((crosshairContentSize.Height > oldSize.Height) ? crosshairContentSize.Height : oldSize.Height);
				return new Size(width, height);
			}
			return oldSize;
		}

		private Size CalculateCrosshairContentSize()
		{
			if (base.LegendItem == null || !base.LegendItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible)
			{
				return default(Size);
			}
			string text = Regex.Replace(((ICheckableLegendItem)base.LegendItem).CrosshairLegendPattern, "(<br */>)", "\n");
			int height = ((ChartLegend.MaxCrosshairContentHeight > 0) ? ChartLegend.MaxCrosshairContentHeight : TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureStringRounded(text, base.LegendItemContainer.DXFont, base.LegendItemContainer).Height);
			return new Size(ChartLegend.MaxCrosshairContentWidth, height);
		}

		private Rectangle CalcCheckBoxBoundsForMarkerAndCheckBoxMode(Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.TextSize.Height, base.MarkerSize.Height);
			int num2 = (num - base.MarkerSize.Height) / 2;
			int num3 = ((num2 >= 0) ? num2 : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + base.Offset.Y + num3;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + base.Offset.X + base.MarkerSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled;
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = firstItemLocation.X + base.Size.Width + base.RightIndent + base.Offset.X;
				x = num4 - (checkBoxSize.Width + base.MarkerSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled);
			}
			Point location = new Point(x, y);
			return new Rectangle(location, base.MarkerSize);
		}

		private Point CalcTextLocationForCheckBoxWithMarkerMode(Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.MarkerSize.Height, checkBoxSize.Height);
			int num2 = (num - ((base.TextSize.Height != 0) ? base.TextSize.Height : (base.ActualFont.GetGdiHeight() + 1))) / 2;
			int num3 = ((num2 >= 0) ? num2 : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + base.Offset.Y + num3;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + base.Offset.X + base.MarkerSize.Width + checkBoxSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled;
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = firstItemLocation.X + base.Size.Width + base.RightIndent + base.Offset.X;
				x = num4 - (base.MarkerSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled + base.TextSize.Width + checkBoxSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled);
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		private void RenderCheckBox(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle checkBoxAreaBounds)
		{
			if (CheckableItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(base.HitTestController, base.LegendItemContainer.HitTestableObject, new ChartFocusedArea(this), new HitRegion(checkBoxAreaBounds), force: true);
			if (CheckableItem.CheckBoxImage == null)
			{
				Color color = ((!CheckableItem.CheckBoxEnabled) ? colorForDisabledItem : CheckableItem.MainColor);
				int num = (checkBoxAreaBounds.Width - checkBoxAreaBounds.Height) / 2;
				int num2 = 0;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
					num2 = (checkBoxAreaBounds.Height - checkBoxAreaBounds.Width) / 2;
				}
				int num3 = Math.Min(checkBoxAreaBounds.Height, checkBoxAreaBounds.Width);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(checkBoxAreaBounds.X + num, checkBoxAreaBounds.Y + num2, num3, num3);
				int num4 = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.Width / 16.0);
				if (num4 < 1)
				{
					num4 = 1;
				}
				int thickness = 2 * num4;
				rectangle.Inflate(-MathUtils.StrongRound((double)num4 / 2.0), -MathUtils.StrongRound((double)num4 / 2.0));
				renderer.DrawRectangle(rectangle, color, num4);
				if (CheckableItem.CheckedInLegend)
				{
					Point[] points = new Point[3]
					{
						new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + 0.25 * (double)rectangle.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.Y + 0.45 * (double)rectangle.Height)),
						new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + 0.45 * (double)rectangle.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.Y + 0.7 * (double)rectangle.Height)),
						new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.X + 0.8 * (double)rectangle.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound((double)rectangle.Y + 0.25 * (double)rectangle.Height))
					};
					renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
					renderer.DrawLines(points, color, thickness, new LineStyle(null));
					renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				renderer.DrawImage(CheckableItem.CheckBoxImage, checkBoxAreaBounds, (DXImageSizeMode)CheckableItem.CheckBoxImageSizeMode);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateCrosshairItemBounds(Point textLocation, Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			if (!crosshairContentSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				float x = (isRightToLeft ? (firstItemLocation.X + base.Offset.X + base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled) : (textLocation.X + base.TextSize.Width + crosshairItemOffset));
				CrosshairItemBounds = new RectangleF(x, textLocation.Y, crosshairContentSize.Width, crosshairContentSize.Height);
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateSizeForLegacyCustomCheckBoxCase()
		{
			Size size = default(Size);
			size = ((base.Item.TextVisible || base.Item.ReserveSpaceForHiddenText) ? base.TextSize : default(Size));
			size.Width += base.MarkerSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled;
			return size;
		}

		private Rectangle CalcMarkerBoundsForMarkerAndCheckBoxMode(Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.TextSize.Height, checkBoxSize.Height);
			int num2 = (num - base.MarkerSize.Height) / 2;
			int num3 = ((num2 >= 0) ? num2 : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + base.Offset.Y + num3;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + base.Offset.X;
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = firstItemLocation.X + base.Size.Width + base.RightIndent + base.Offset.X;
				x = num4 - base.MarkerSize.Width;
			}
			Point location = new Point(x, y);
			return new Rectangle(location, base.MarkerSize);
		}

		private Rectangle CalcMarkerBoundsForCheckBoxAndMarkerMode(Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.TextSize.Height, checkBoxSize.Height);
			int num2 = (num - base.MarkerSize.Height) / 2;
			int num3 = ((num2 >= 0) ? num2 : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + base.Offset.Y + num3;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + base.Offset.X + checkBoxSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled;
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = firstItemLocation.X + base.Size.Width + base.RightIndent + base.Offset.X;
				x = num4 - (base.MarkerSize.Width + checkBoxSize.Width + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled);
			}
			Point location = new Point(x, y);
			return new Rectangle(location, base.MarkerSize);
		}

		private Rectangle CalcCheckBoxBoundsForCheckBoxAndMarkerMode(Point firstItemLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.TextSize.Height, base.MarkerSize.Height);
			int num2 = (num - base.MarkerSize.Height) / 2;
			int num3 = ((num2 >= 0) ? num2 : 0);
			int y = firstItemLocation.Y + base.Offset.Y + num3;
			int x;
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				x = firstItemLocation.X + base.Offset.X;
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = firstItemLocation.X + base.Size.Width + base.RightIndent + base.Offset.X;
				x = num4 - checkBoxSize.Width;
			}
			Point location = new Point(x, y);
			return new Rectangle(location, base.MarkerSize);
		}

		protected override Color GetActualLegendItemTextColor()
		{
			if (CheckableItem == null)
			{
				return base.GetActualLegendItemTextColor();
			}
			if (CheckableItem.CheckBoxEnabled || !CheckableItem.CheckBoxVisible)
			{
				return base.Item.TextColor;
			}
			return colorForDisabledItem;
		}

		protected override Point RenderLegendItems(ChartRenderer renderer, Point firstItemLocation, Point textLocation, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			if (UseLegacyCustomCheckBox())
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = CalcMarkerOrCheckBoxBounds(firstItemLocation, base.MarkerSize, isRightToLeft);
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(base.HitTestController, base.LegendItemContainer.HitTestableObject, new ChartFocusedArea(this), new HitRegion(rectangle), force: true);
				base.Item.RenderMarker(renderer, rectangle);
				if (base.Item.TextVisible)
				{
					textLocation = CalcTextLocationForMarkerOrCheckBoxMode(rectangle.Size, firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
					RenderLegendItemText(renderer, textLocation);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (ChartLegend.MarkerMode)
				{
				case LegendMarkerMode.Marker:
					textLocation = RenderMarkerItem(renderer, firstItemLocation, textLocation, isRightToLeft);
					break;
				case LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox:
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = CalcMarkerOrCheckBoxBounds(firstItemLocation, checkBoxSize, isRightToLeft);
					if (base.Item is ICheckableLegendItemData && ((ICheckableLegendItemData)base.Item).CheckBoxVisible)
					{
						RenderCheckBox(renderer, rectangle2);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Item.RenderMarker(renderer, rectangle2);
					}
					if (base.Item.TextVisible)
					{
						textLocation = CalcTextLocationForMarkerOrCheckBoxMode(rectangle2.Size, firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
						RenderLegendItemText(renderer, textLocation);
					}
					break;
				}
				case LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker:
				{
					Rectangle bounds = CalcMarkerBoundsForCheckBoxAndMarkerMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
					Rectangle checkBoxAreaBounds = CalcCheckBoxBoundsForCheckBoxAndMarkerMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
					if (base.Item is ICheckableLegendItemData && ((ICheckableLegendItemData)base.Item).CheckBoxVisible)
					{
						RenderCheckBox(renderer, checkBoxAreaBounds);
					}
					if (base.Item.MarkerVisible)
					{
						base.Item.RenderMarker(renderer, bounds);
					}
					if (base.Item.TextVisible)
					{
						textLocation = CalcTextLocationForCheckBoxWithMarkerMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
						RenderLegendItemText(renderer, textLocation);
					}
					break;
				}
				case LegendMarkerMode.MarkerAndCheckBox:
				{
					Rectangle bounds = CalcMarkerBoundsForMarkerAndCheckBoxMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
					Rectangle checkBoxAreaBounds = CalcCheckBoxBoundsForMarkerAndCheckBoxMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
					if (base.Item.MarkerVisible)
					{
						base.Item.RenderMarker(renderer, bounds);
					}
					if (base.Item is ICheckableLegendItemData && ((ICheckableLegendItemData)base.Item).CheckBoxVisible)
					{
						RenderCheckBox(renderer, checkBoxAreaBounds);
					}
					if (base.Item.TextVisible)
					{
						textLocation = CalcTextLocationForCheckBoxWithMarkerMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
						RenderLegendItemText(renderer, textLocation);
					}
					break;
				}
				case LegendMarkerMode.None:
					if (base.Item.TextVisible)
					{
						textLocation = CalcTextLocationForNoneMode(firstItemLocation, isRightToLeft);
						RenderLegendItemText(renderer, textLocation);
					}
					break;
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException($"Unknown LegendMarkerMode: {ChartLegend.MarkerMode}");
				}
			}
			return textLocation;
		}

		public override void UpdateLegendItemCrosshairContentWidth(int maxWidthWithoutCrosshairContent, int maxWidth)
		{
			if (!crosshairContentSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				crosshairItemOffset = maxWidthWithoutCrosshairContent - base.SizeWithoutCrosshairContent.Width + ChartLegend.CrosshairContentOffsetScaled;
				int width = maxWidth - base.SizeWithoutCrosshairContent.Width - crosshairItemOffset;
				crosshairContentSize = new Size(width, crosshairContentSize.Height);
				base.Size = CalculateLegendItemSizeWithCrosshairContent(base.SizeWithoutCrosshairContent, crosshairItemOffset, crosshairContentSize);
			}
		}

		public override Point Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Point firstItemLocation)
		{
			Point point = base.Render(renderer, firstItemLocation);
			CalculateCrosshairItemBounds(point, firstItemLocation, renderer.IsRightToLeft);
			return point;
		}

		public override void CalculateSize()
		{
			Size size = CalculateSizeCore();
			bool flag = CheckableItem != null && (CheckableItem.CheckBoxVisible || CheckableItem.ReserveSpaceForHiddenCheckBox || (base.LegendItemContainer.MarkersVisible && base.LegendItemContainer.CheckboxesVisible));
			if (flag)
			{
				size.Width += checkBoxSize.Width;
				if (checkBoxSize.Height > size.Height)
				{
					size.Height = checkBoxSize.Height;
				}
			}
			if (base.UseTextSize && ((base.UseMarkerSize && !flag) || (flag && !base.UseMarkerSize)))
			{
				size.Width += base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled;
			}
			else if (base.UseTextSize && base.UseMarkerSize && flag)
			{
				size.Width += base.LegendItemContainer.TextOffsetScaled + base.LegendItemContainer.MarkerOffsetScaled;
			}
			base.SizeWithoutCrosshairContent = (UseLegacyCustomCheckBox() ? CalculateSizeForLegacyCustomCheckBoxCase() : size);
			base.Size = CalculateLegendItemSizeWithCrosshairContent(size, crosshairItemOffset, crosshairContentSize);
		}
	}
