	public abstract class LegendSizeCalculator
	{
		private readonly LegendBase legend;

		private readonly LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups;

		private readonly RectangleIndents padding;

		protected LegendBase Legend => legend;

		protected LegendItemGroup[] ItemGroups => itemGroups;

		protected RectangleIndents Padding => padding;

		private static LegendSizeCalculator CreateInstance(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups)
		{
			switch (legend.Direction)
			{
			case LegendDirection.TopToBottom:
			case LegendDirection.BottomToTop:
				return new VerticalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator(legend, itemGroups);
			case LegendDirection.LeftToRight:
			case LegendDirection.RightToLeft:
				if (!legend.EquallySpacedItems)
				{
					return new HorizontalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator(legend, itemGroups);
				}
				return new HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAlignmentLegendSizeCalculator(legend, itemGroups);
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public static Size Calculate(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups)
		{
			LegendSizeCalculator legendSizeCalculator = CreateInstance(legend, itemGroups);
			return new Size(legendSizeCalculator.CalcWidth(), legendSizeCalculator.CalcHeight());
		}

		protected LegendSizeCalculator(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
			this.itemGroups = itemGroups;
			padding = legend.ActualPadding;
		}

		protected abstract int CalcWidth();

		protected abstract int CalcHeight();
	}
	public class VerticalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator : LegendSizeCalculator
	{
		internal VerticalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups)
			: base(legend, itemGroups)
		{
		}

		protected override int CalcWidth()
		{
			int num = 0;
			LegendItemGroup[] array = base.ItemGroups;
			foreach (LegendItemGroup legendItemGroup in array)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)legendItemGroup)
				{
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, item.Size.Width);
				}
				num += num2;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
				num += dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right;
				if (base.ItemGroups.Length > 1)
				{
					num += base.Legend.HorizontalIndent * (base.ItemGroups.Length - 1);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override int CalcHeight()
		{
			int num = 0;
			LegendItemGroup[] array = base.ItemGroups;
			foreach (LegendItemGroup legendItemGroup in array)
			{
				int num2 = ((legendItemGroup.Count > 1) ? (base.Legend.VerticalIndent * (legendItemGroup.Count - 1)) : 0);
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)legendItemGroup)
				{
					num2 += item.Size.Height;
				}
				num = Math.Max(num2, num);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
				num += dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator : LegendSizeCalculator
	{
		internal HorizontalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups)
			: base(legend, itemGroups)
		{
		}

		protected override int CalcWidth()
		{
			int num = 0;
			LegendItemGroup[] array = base.ItemGroups;
			foreach (LegendItemGroup legendItemGroup in array)
			{
				int num2 = ((legendItemGroup.Count > 1) ? (base.Legend.HorizontalIndent * (legendItemGroup.Count - 1)) : 0);
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)legendItemGroup)
				{
					num2 += item.Size.Width;
				}
				num = Math.Max(num, num2);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
				num += dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override int CalcHeight()
		{
			int num = 0;
			LegendItemGroup[] array = base.ItemGroups;
			foreach (LegendItemGroup legendItemGroup in array)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)legendItemGroup)
				{
					num2 = Math.Max(item.Size.Height, num2);
				}
				num += num2;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
				num += dpiScaledThickness.Top + dpiScaledThickness.Bottom;
				if (base.ItemGroups.Length > 1)
				{
					num += base.Legend.VerticalIndent * (base.ItemGroups.Length - 1);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAlignmentLegendSizeCalculator : HorizontalLayoutLegendSizeCalculator
	{
		internal HorizontalLayoutWithVerticalAlignmentLegendSizeCalculator(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups)
			: base(legend, itemGroups)
		{
		}

		protected override int CalcWidth()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (base.ItemGroups.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.ItemGroups[0].Count; i++)
				{
					num += base.ItemGroups[0][i].Size.Width + base.ItemGroups[0][i].RightIndent;
					if (i < base.ItemGroups[0].Count - 1)
					{
						num += base.Legend.HorizontalIndent;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = base.Padding.DpiScaledThickness;
				num += dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyLegendTextViewData
	{
		private readonly LegendBase legend;

		private readonly string text;

		private readonly Size textSize;

		private HitTestController HitTestController => legend.Chart.HitTestController;

		public Size Size => textSize;

		public EmptyLegendTextViewData(LegendBase legend)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
			text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.LegendEmptyText);
			textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureStringRounded(text, legend.DXFont, legend);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Point location)
		{
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, legend, legend, new HitRegion(new RectangleF(location.X, location.Y, textSize.Width, textSize.Height)));
			renderer.DrawText(text, legend.DXFont.DpiScale(), legend.ActualTextColor, legend, location);
		}
	}
	public class LegendViewData
	{
		private readonly LegendBase legend;

		private readonly LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups;

		private readonly LegendTitleViewData titleViewData;

		private readonly EmptyLegendTextViewData emptyLegendTextViewData;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		private Rectangle outerBounds;

		public LegendBase Legend => legend;

		public LegendItemGroup[] ItemGroups => itemGroups;

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public Rectangle OuterBounds => outerBounds;

		public LegendTitleViewData TitleViewData => titleViewData;

		public EmptyLegendTextViewData EmptyLegendTextViewData => emptyLegendTextViewData;

		private static Size CalculateTitleData(LegendTitle title, int availableWidth, out LegendTitleViewData titleViewData)
		{
			titleViewData = (title.Visible ? new LegendTitleViewData(title, availableWidth) : null);
			if (titleViewData == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			return titleViewData.Size.ToSize();
		}

		private static Size CalculateGroups(LegendBase legend, List<LegendItemViewData> itemsData, Shadow shadow, Size availableSize, out LegendItemGroup[] groups)
		{
			groups = LegendItemGroupingAlgorithm.Calculate(legend, itemsData, shadow.Visible ? shadow.DecreaseSize(availableSize) : availableSize);
			LegendCrosshairContentOffsetCalculator.Calculate(legend, groups);
			LegendItemsOffsetCalculator.Calculate(legend, groups);
			return LegendSizeCalculator.Calculate(legend, groups);
		}

		private static Size CalculateViewDataParams(LegendBase legend, Size maxLegendSize, List<LegendItemViewData> itemsData, out LegendTitleViewData titleViewData, out LegendItemGroup[] groups)
		{
			titleViewData = null;
			groups = null;
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = legend.ActualPadding.DpiScaledThickness;
			int num = dpiScaledThickness.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Right;
			Size result = maxLegendSize;
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (++num2 < 3)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					Size size2 = CalculateTitleData(legend.Title, result.Width - num, out titleViewData);
					flag2 = size2 != size || groups == null;
					flag = false;
					size = size2;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					Size size3 = CalculateGroups(legend, itemsData, legend.Shadow, new Size(maxLegendSize.Width, maxLegendSize.Height - size.Height), out groups);
					flag = size3.Width < size.Width && legend.Title.Visible && legend.Title.WordWrap;
					flag2 = false;
					result = size3;
				}
				if (!flag && !flag2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (titleViewData != null)
			{
				size = CalculateTitleData(legend.Title, result.Width - num, out titleViewData);
				int val = size.Width + num;
				result = new Size(Math.Max(result.Width, val), result.Height + size.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static LegendViewData Create(LegendBase legend, IList<ILegendItemData> legendItems, Rectangle arrangeBounds)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = legend != null && legend.ChartContainer != null && (legend.ChartContainer.DesignMode || legend.ChartContainer.IsDesignControl);
			if ((int)legend.Visibility == 1 || (legendItems.Count == 0 && !flag))
			{
				legend.Bounds = default(GRealRect2D);
				return null;
			}
			int num = legend.Border.ActualThickness * 2;
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = legend.Margins.DpiScaledThickness;
			int width = (int)((double)arrangeBounds.Width * legend.MaxHorizontalPercentage / 100.0) - num - dpiScaledThickness.Left - dpiScaledThickness.Right;
			int height = (int)((double)arrangeBounds.Height * legend.MaxVerticalPercentage / 100.0) - num - dpiScaledThickness.Top - dpiScaledThickness.Bottom;
			Size size = new Size(width, height);
			if (!GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(size))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LegendItemViewData> list = new List<LegendItemViewData>(legendItems.Count);
			foreach (ILegendItemData legendItem in legendItems)
			{
				LegendItemViewData legendItemViewData = legend.CreateLegendItemViewData(legendItem);
				legendItemViewData.CalculateSize();
				list.Add(legendItemViewData);
			}
			LegendTitleViewData legendTitleViewData;
			LegendItemGroup[] groups;
			Size size2 = CalculateViewDataParams(legend, size, list, out legendTitleViewData, out groups);
			groups = groups ?? new LegendItemGroup[0];
			EmptyLegendTextViewData emptyLegendTextViewData = null;
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness2 = legend.ActualPadding.DpiScaledThickness;
			int num2 = dpiScaledThickness2.Top + dpiScaledThickness2.Bottom;
			if (flag && legendItems.Count == 0)
			{
				emptyLegendTextViewData = new EmptyLegendTextViewData(legend);
				int num3 = dpiScaledThickness2.Left + dpiScaledThickness2.Right;
				int val = emptyLegendTextViewData.Size.Width + num3;
				size2 = new Size(Math.Max(size2.Width, val), size2.Height + emptyLegendTextViewData.Size.Height + num2);
			}
			LegendViewData legendViewData = null;
			if (GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(size2))
			{
				legendViewData = new LegendViewData(legend, groups, legendTitleViewData, emptyLegendTextViewData, arrangeBounds, size, size2);
			}
			if (legendViewData != null)
			{
				legend.Bounds = new GRealRect2D(legendViewData.Bounds.Left, legendViewData.Bounds.Top, legendViewData.Bounds.Width, legendViewData.Bounds.Height);
			}
			if (!legend.ActualVisibility)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return legendViewData;
		}

		private LegendViewData(LegendBase legend, LegendItemGroup[] itemGroups, LegendTitleViewData titleViewData, EmptyLegendTextViewData emptyLegendTextViewData, Rectangle arrangeBounds, Size maxLegendSize, Size innerSize)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
			this.itemGroups = itemGroups;
			this.titleViewData = titleViewData;
			this.emptyLegendTextViewData = emptyLegendTextViewData;
			RectangularBorder border = legend.Border;
			int num = border.ActualThickness * 2;
			Size size = border.CalcBorderedSize(innerSize);
			Size size2 = size;
			Shadow shadow = legend.Shadow;
			if (shadow.Visible)
			{
				size2 = shadow.IncreaseSize(size);
				size2 = new Size(Math.Min(maxLegendSize.Width + num, size2.Width), Math.Min(maxLegendSize.Height + num, size2.Height));
				size = shadow.DecreaseSize(size2);
			}
			else
			{
				size2 = new Size(Math.Min(maxLegendSize.Width + num, size2.Width), Math.Min(maxLegendSize.Height + num, size2.Height));
				size = size2;
			}
			size2 = legend.Margins.IncreaseSize(size2);
			int num2 = AlignRectangleX(arrangeBounds, size2, legend.AlignmentHorizontal);
			int num3 = AlignRectangleY(arrangeBounds, size2, legend.AlignmentVertical);
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = legend.Margins.DpiScaledThickness;
			Point location = new Point(num2 + dpiScaledThickness.Left, num3 + dpiScaledThickness.Top);
			bounds = new Rectangle(location, size);
			outerBounds = new Rectangle(location, size2);
		}

		private int AlignRectangleX(Rectangle outerRect, Size innerRectSize, LegendAlignmentHorizontal alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside:
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Left:
				return outerRect.Left;
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Center:
				return outerRect.Left + (outerRect.Width - innerRectSize.Width) / 2;
			default:
				return outerRect.Right - innerRectSize.Width;
			}
		}

		private int AlignRectangleY(Rectangle outerRect, Size innerRectSize, LegendAlignmentVertical alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.Center:
				return outerRect.Top + (outerRect.Height - innerRectSize.Height) / 2;
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.Bottom:
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside:
				return outerRect.Bottom - innerRectSize.Height;
			default:
				return outerRect.Top;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			Rectangle b = correction.Bounds;
			if (legend.AlignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside)
			{
				b.X -= outerBounds.Width + correction.Left;
			}
			if (legend.AlignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.LeftOutside || legend.AlignmentHorizontal == LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside)
			{
				b.Width += outerBounds.Width + correction.Right;
			}
			if (legend.AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside)
			{
				b.Y -= outerBounds.Height + correction.Top;
			}
			if (legend.AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside || legend.AlignmentVertical == LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside)
			{
				b.Height += outerBounds.Height + correction.Bottom;
			}
			correction.Update(b);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			RectangularBorder border = legend.Border;
			int actualThickness = border.ActualThickness;
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Inflate(bounds, -actualThickness, -actualThickness);
			if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!legend.IsOutside)
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(mappingBounds);
			}
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(legend.Chart.HitTestController, legend, null, new HitRegion(bounds));
			legend.Shadow.Render(renderer, bounds);
			LegendAppearance appearance = legend.Appearance;
			if (legend.BackImage == null || !legend.BackImage.Render(renderer, rectangle))
			{
				BackgroundImage backImage = appearance.BackImage;
				if (backImage == null || backImage.Render(renderer, rectangle))
				{
					legend.ActualFillStyle.RenderRectangle(renderer, rectangle, legend.ActualBackColor);
				}
			}
			HitTestState state = ((IHitTest)legend).State;
			Color actualColor = BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, appearance.BorderColor, state);
			BorderHelper.RenderBorder(renderer, border, rectangle, state, actualThickness, actualColor);
			renderer.SetClipping(rectangle);
			Point location = rectangle.Location;
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = legend.ActualPadding.DpiScaledThickness;
			location.Offset(dpiScaledThickness.Left, dpiScaledThickness.Top);
			if (titleViewData != null)
			{
				titleViewData.Render(renderer, location);
				location.Offset(0, (int)titleViewData.Size.Height);
			}
			if (emptyLegendTextViewData != null)
			{
				emptyLegendTextViewData.Render(renderer, location);
			}
			else
			{
				legend.ClearLegendItemsInfos();
				LegendItemGroup[] array = itemGroups;
				foreach (LegendItemGroup legendItemGroup in array)
				{
					legendItemGroup.Render(renderer, location);
					foreach (LegendItemViewData item in (IEnumerable)legendItemGroup)
					{
						legend.AddLegendItemInfo(item);
					}
				}
			}
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			if (!legend.IsOutside)
			{
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
			}
		}

		public void MoveRight(LegendViewData otherLegendViewData)
		{
			int x = outerBounds.X + otherLegendViewData.outerBounds.Width;
			outerBounds = new Rectangle(x, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height);
			x = bounds.X + otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Width + (otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Right - otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Right) + (otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Left - otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Left);
			bounds = new Rectangle(x, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}

		public void MoveLeft(LegendViewData otherLegendViewData)
		{
			int x = outerBounds.X - otherLegendViewData.outerBounds.Width;
			outerBounds = new Rectangle(x, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height);
			x = bounds.X - otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Width - (otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Right - otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Right) - (otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Left - otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Left);
			bounds = new Rectangle(x, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}

		public void MoveDown(LegendViewData otherLegendViewData)
		{
			int y = outerBounds.Y + otherLegendViewData.outerBounds.Height;
			outerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height);
			y = bounds.Y + otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Height + (otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Bottom - otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Bottom) + (otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Top - otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Top);
			bounds = new Rectangle(bounds.X, y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}

		public void MoveUp(LegendViewData otherLegendViewData)
		{
			int y = outerBounds.Y - otherLegendViewData.outerBounds.Height;
			outerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height);
			y = bounds.Y - otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Height - (otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Bottom - otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Bottom) - (otherLegendViewData.Bounds.Top - otherLegendViewData.OuterBounds.Top);
			bounds = new Rectangle(bounds.X, y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}

		public void UpdateLocationAfterDiagramCorrection(Rectangle diagramBounds, int verticalOffset, int diagramBottomCorrection)
		{
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = Legend.Margins.DpiScaledThickness;
			int x = OuterBounds.X;
			switch (Legend.AlignmentHorizontal)
			{
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Left:
				x = diagramBounds.Left + dpiScaledThickness.Left;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Right:
				x = diagramBounds.Right - OuterBounds.Width + dpiScaledThickness.Left;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.RightOutside:
				x = diagramBounds.Right + dpiScaledThickness.Left;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Center:
				x = diagramBounds.X + diagramBounds.Width / 2 - OuterBounds.Width / 2 + dpiScaledThickness.Left;
				break;
			}
			int y = OuterBounds.Y;
			switch (Legend.AlignmentVertical)
			{
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.TopOutside:
				y = OuterBounds.Location.Y + verticalOffset;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.Top:
				y = diagramBounds.Top + verticalOffset + dpiScaledThickness.Top;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.Bottom:
				y = diagramBounds.Bottom - verticalOffset - OuterBounds.Height;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.BottomOutside:
				y = diagramBounds.Bottom + diagramBottomCorrection - verticalOffset - OuterBounds.Height + dpiScaledThickness.Top;
				break;
			case LegendAlignmentVertical.Center:
				y = diagramBounds.Y + diagramBounds.Height / 2 - OuterBounds.Height / 2 + verticalOffset + dpiScaledThickness.Top;
				break;
			}
			Point location = new Point(x, y);
			bounds.Location = location;
			outerBounds.Location = location;
		}
	}

	public class ColorHSL
	{
		private const float minLuminance = 0.5f;

		private const float maxLuminance = 0.8f;

		private float hue;

		private float saturation;

		private float luminance;

		public float Hue
		{
			get
			{
				return hue;
			}
			set
			{
				hue = value;
			}
		}

		public float Saturation
		{
			get
			{
				return saturation;
			}
			set
			{
				saturation = value;
			}
		}

		public float Luminance
		{
			get
			{
				return luminance;
			}
			set
			{
				luminance = value;
			}
		}

		public float MinLuminance => Math.Min(0.5f, luminance * 0.9f);

		public float MaxLuminance => Math.Max(0.8f, luminance + (1f - luminance) * 0.15f);

		private static byte GetComponent(float q, float p, float t)
		{
			while (t < 0f)
			{
				t += 1f;
			}
			while (t > 1f)
			{
				t -= 1f;
			}
			float num = ((t < 1f / 6f) ? (p + (q - p) * 6f * t) : ((t < 0.5f) ? q : ((!(t < 2f / 3f)) ? p : (p + (q - p) * (2f / 3f - t) * 6f))));
			return (byte)Math.Round(num * 255f);
		}

		public static explicit operator ColorHSL(Color color)
		{
			return new ColorHSL(color.GetHue(), color.GetSaturation(), color.GetBrightness());
		}

		public static explicit operator Color(ColorHSL color)
		{
			float num = ((color.luminance < 0.5f) ? (color.luminance * (1f + color.saturation)) : (color.luminance + color.saturation - color.luminance * color.saturation));
			float p = 2f * color.luminance - num;
			float num2 = color.hue / 360f;
			return Color.FromArgb(255, GetComponent(num, p, num2 + 1f / 3f), GetComponent(num, p, num2), GetComponent(num, p, num2 - 1f / 3f));
		}

		public ColorHSL(float hue, float saturation, float luminance)
		{
			this.hue = hue;
			this.saturation = saturation;
			this.luminance = luminance;
		}
	}
	public static class PaletteUtils
	{
		public static DXImage CreateEditorImage(Palette palette, int maxPaletteEntriesCount = 0)
		{
			return CreateEditorImage(palette, 1f, maxPaletteEntriesCount);
		}

		public static DXImage CreateEditorImage(Palette palette, float scaleFactor, int maxPaletteEntriesCount = 0)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(10f * scaleFactor);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = null;
			try
			{
				int num2 = palette.Count;
				if (maxPaletteEntriesCount != 0)
				{
					num2 = Math.Min(maxPaletteEntriesCount, palette.Count);
				}
				dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(num2 * (num + 1) - 1, num);
				using DXGraphics dXGraphics = DXGraphics.FromImage(dXBitmap);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, new Size(num, num));
				int num3 = 0;
				while (num3 < num2)
				{
					using (DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(palette[num3].Color))
					{
						dXGraphics.FillRectangle(brush, rectangle);
					}
					Rectangle rectangle2 = rectangle;
					rectangle2.Width--;
					rectangle2.Height--;
					using (DXPen pen = new DXPen(Color.Gray))
					{
						dXGraphics.DrawRectangle(pen, rectangle2);
					}
					num3++;
					rectangle.X += num + 1;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				if (dXBitmap != null)
				{
					dXBitmap.Dispose();
					dXBitmap = null;
				}
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}
	}
	public static class PivotGridDataSourceUtils
	{
		public static bool HasDataSource(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options)
		{
			return options.DataSource != null;
		}

		public static bool HasPivotGrid(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options)
		{
			return options.DataSource is IPivotGrid;
		}

		public static IPivotGrid GetPivotGrid(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options)
		{
			IChartDataSource dataSource = options.DataSource;
			return (IPivotGrid)(object)((dataSource is IPivotGrid) ? dataSource : null);
		}

		public static bool IsAutoBindingSettingsUsed(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options, SeriesBase series)
		{
			Chart chart = options.Chart;
			if (series != null && object.Equals(series, chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate) && options.HasDataSource)
			{
				return options.AutoBindingSettingsEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options, SeriesBase series)
		{
			Chart chart = options.Chart;
			if (series != null && options.AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled && object.Equals(series, chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate))
			{
				return options.HasDataSource;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabledForSimpleView(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options, SeriesBase series)
		{
			if (series.View is ISimpleSeriesView)
			{
				return IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(options, series);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabledForSimpleView(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options)
		{
			Chart chart = options.Chart;
			if (chart.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View is ISimpleSeriesView && options.HasDataSource)
			{
				return options.AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAutoLayoutSettingsEnabled(PivotGridDataSourceOptions options, AxisBase axis, bool checkAxisY)
		{
			bool flag = object.Equals(axis, options.GetAxisX());
			if (!flag && checkAxisY)
			{
				flag = object.Equals(axis, options.GetAxisY());
			}
			if (axis != null && flag && options.HasDataSource)
			{
				return options.AutoLayoutSettingsEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class RangeControlBehavior
	{
		private const int MaxRangeSnapIterationsCount = 5;

		private readonly List<object> rangeControlRuler = new List<object>();

		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private RangeControlMapping rangeControlMap;

		private ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions ActualGridOptions => diagram.ActualRangeControlClientGridOptions;

		private Axis2D Axis => diagram.ActualAxisX;

		protected RangeControlMapping RangeControlMap
		{
			get
			{
				if (rangeControlMap == null)
				{
					rangeControlMap = RangeControlMapping.Create(Axis, excludeSideMargins: true);
				}
				return rangeControlMap;
			}
		}

		protected AxisScaleTypeMap ScaleMap => Axis.ScaleTypeMap;

		public static RangeControlBehavior Create(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			if (diagram.ActualAxisX.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				return new DiscreteRangeControlBehavior(diagram);
			}
			return new ContinuousRangeControlBehavior(diagram);
		}

		protected RangeControlBehavior(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
		}

		private string FormatRangeControlValue(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(string))
				{
					return (string)value;
				}
				ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions actualGridOptions = ActualGridOptions;
				try
				{
					return string.Format(actualGridOptions.ActualLabelFormatProvider, actualGridOptions.ActualLabelFormat, new object[1] { value });
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private MinMaxValues SnapRange(double min, double max)
		{
			ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions actualGridOptions = ActualGridOptions;
			RangeControlMapping mapping = RangeControlMap;
			RangeControlClientSnapCalculator rangeControlClientSnapCalculator = new RangeControlClientSnapCalculator(actualGridOptions.ClientGridMapping, mapping);
			return rangeControlClientSnapCalculator.SnapRange(min, max, RangeValidationBase.Average, actualGridOptions.SnapUnit, limitValuesByWholeRange: true);
		}

		private void UpdateAxisRange(MinMaxValues refinedValues)
		{
			AxisBase axis = Axis;
			AxisScaleTypeMap scaleTypeMap = axis.ScaleTypeMap;
			IVisualAxisRangeData visualRangeData = axis.VisualRangeData;
			if (refinedValues.Min != scaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(visualRangeData.Min) || refinedValues.Max != scaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(visualRangeData.Max))
			{
				MinMaxValues other = refinedValues;
				int num = 0;
				MinMaxValues minMaxValues;
				do
				{
					minMaxValues = SnapRange(other.Min, other.Max);
					SetAxisRange(minMaxValues.Min, minMaxValues.Max, axis);
					diagram.ApplyCumulativeUpdates();
					scaleTypeMap = axis.ScaleTypeMap;
					double min = scaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(visualRangeData.Min);
					double max = scaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(visualRangeData.Max);
					other = new MinMaxValues(min, max);
					num++;
				}
				while (5 > num && !minMaxValues.Equals(other));
			}
		}

		private void SetAxisRange(double minValueRefined, double maxValueRefined, AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (minValueRefined != maxValueRefined)
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap scaleTypeMap = axis.ScaleTypeMap;
				double internalMin = scaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternalExact(minValueRefined);
				double internalMax = scaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternalExact(maxValueRefined);
				object min = scaleTypeMap.RefinedToNative(minValueRefined);
				object max = scaleTypeMap.RefinedToNative(maxValueRefined);
				axis.VisualRangeData.ScrollOrZoomRange(min, max, internalMin, internalMax, notifyUpdate: true);
				axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit(throwUpdate: true);
			}
		}

		public object ProjectBackValue(double normalOffset)
		{
			return RefinedToNative(RangeControlMap.NormalValueToValue(normalOffset));
		}

		protected abstract object RefinedToNative(double refinedValue);

		protected abstract MinMaxValues CalculateRefinedValues(object minValue, object maxValue);

		public abstract bool Validate(ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType);

		public virtual MinMaxValues ValidateNormalRange(MinMaxValues range, RangeValidationBase validationBase)
		{
			ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions actualGridOptions = ActualGridOptions;
			RangeControlClientSnapCalculator rangeControlClientSnapCalculator = new RangeControlClientSnapCalculator(actualGridOptions.ClientGridMapping, RangeControlMap);
			return rangeControlClientSnapCalculator.SnapNormalRange(range, validationBase, actualGridOptions.SnapUnit);
		}

		public virtual double ProjectValue(object value)
		{
			double value2 = ScaleMap.NativeToRefined(value);
			return RangeControlMap.ValueToNormalValue(value2);
		}

		public List<object> GenerateRuler(object min, object max, int scaleLength)
		{
			rangeControlRuler.Clear();
			AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap = ScaleMap;
			double num = scaleMap.NativeToRefined(min);
			double num2 = scaleMap.NativeToRefined(max);
			bool flag = !double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num);
			bool flag2 = !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num2);
			if (flag && flag2 && num < num2 && scaleLength > 0)
			{
				ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions actualGridOptions = ActualGridOptions;
				if (actualGridOptions.GridMode == ChartRangeControlClientGridMode.Auto)
				{
					double refinedWholeRange = num2 - num;
					actualGridOptions.UpdateAutoGridSettings(refinedWholeRange, scaleLength);
				}
				GridGenerator gridGenerator = new GridGenerator();
				List<double> list = gridGenerator.GenerateGridValues(num, num2, actualGridOptions.GridUnit, actualGridOptions.ClientGridMapping, RangeControlMap);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					rangeControlRuler.Add(scaleMap.RefinedToNative(list[i]));
				}
			}
			return rangeControlRuler;
		}

		public string ValueToString(double normalizedValue)
		{
			object value = ProjectBackValue(normalizedValue);
			return FormatRangeControlValue(value);
		}

		public string RulerToString(int rulerIndex)
		{
			if (rulerIndex < rangeControlRuler.Count)
			{
				object value = rangeControlRuler[rulerIndex];
				return FormatRangeControlValue(value);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public virtual NativeRange InvalidateRange()
		{
			rangeControlMap = null;
			AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap = ScaleMap;
			IVisualAxisRangeData visualRangeData = Axis.VisualRangeData;
			double num = scaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(visualRangeData.Min);
			double num2 = scaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(visualRangeData.Max);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = scaleMap.InternalToRefined(0.0);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num2 = scaleMap.InternalToRefined(1.0);
			}
			object min = RefinedToNative(num);
			object max = RefinedToNative(num2);
			return new NativeRange(min, max);
		}

		public void RangeChanged(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			RangeControlMapping rangeControlMapping = RangeControlMap;
			MinMaxValues refinedValues = CalculateRefinedValues(minValue, maxValue);
			if (double.IsNaN(refinedValues.Min))
			{
				refinedValues.Min = rangeControlMapping.NormalValueToValue(0.0);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(refinedValues.Max))
			{
				refinedValues.Max = rangeControlMapping.NormalValueToValue(1.0);
			}
			UpdateAxisRange(refinedValues);
		}
	}
	public class ContinuousRangeControlBehavior : RangeControlBehavior
	{
		public ContinuousRangeControlBehavior(XYDiagram2D diagram)
			: base(diagram)
		{
		}

		public override bool Validate(ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;
		}

		protected override object RefinedToNative(double refinedValue)
		{
			return base.ScaleMap.RefinedToNative(refinedValue);
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues CalculateRefinedValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap = base.ScaleMap;
			double min = ((minValue == null || !scaleMap.IsCompatible(minValue)) ? double.NaN : scaleMap.NativeToRefined(minValue));
			double max = ((maxValue == null || !scaleMap.IsCompatible(maxValue)) ? double.NaN : scaleMap.NativeToRefined(maxValue));
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}
	}
	public class DiscreteRangeControlBehavior : RangeControlBehavior
	{
		private MinMaxValues normalRange;

		private bool isInvalidate;

		private object FirstValue => base.ScaleMap.RefinedToNative(0.0);

		private object LastValue => base.ScaleMap.RefinedToNative(((AxisQualitativeMap)base.ScaleMap).UniqueValuesCount - 1);

		public DiscreteRangeControlBehavior(XYDiagram2D diagram)
			: base(diagram)
		{
		}

		public override bool Validate(ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;
		}

		public override MinMaxValues ValidateNormalRange(MinMaxValues range, RangeValidationBase validationBase)
		{
			normalRange = base.ValidateNormalRange(range, validationBase);
			return normalRange;
		}

		protected override object RefinedToNative(double refinedValue)
		{
			string text = base.ScaleMap.RefinedToNative(refinedValue) as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (!(refinedValue < 0.0))
				{
					return LastValue;
				}
				return FirstValue;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override double ProjectValue(object value)
		{
			if (isInvalidate)
			{
				if (value == FirstValue)
				{
					return normalRange.Min;
				}
				if (value == LastValue)
				{
					return normalRange.Max;
				}
			}
			return base.ProjectValue(value);
		}

		public override NativeRange InvalidateRange()
		{
			isInvalidate = true;
			NativeRange result = base.InvalidateRange();
			isInvalidate = false;
			return result;
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues CalculateRefinedValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			double min = base.RangeControlMap.NormalValueToValue(normalRange.Min);
			double max = base.RangeControlMap.NormalValueToValue(normalRange.Max);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}
	}

	public class RegressionLineBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private GRealPoint2D p1;

		private GRealPoint2D p2;

		private RegressionLineCalculator calculator = new RegressionLineCalculator();

		private RegressionLine RegressionLine => (RegressionLine)base.Indicator;

		internal GRealPoint2D P1 => p1;

		internal GRealPoint2D P2 => p2;

		public override bool HasPoints => true;

		public RegressionLineBehavior(RegressionLine regressionLine)
			: base(regressionLine)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			if (RegressionLine.Visible)
			{
				double minArgument = refinedSeries.GetMinArgument(RegressionLine.View.ActualAxisX.ScaleTypeMap);
				double maxArgument = refinedSeries.GetMaxArgument(RegressionLine.View.ActualAxisX.ScaleTypeMap);
				Tuple<GRealPoint2D, GRealPoint2D> tuple = calculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, minArgument, maxArgument, (ValueLevelInternal)RegressionLine.ValueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
				if (tuple != null)
				{
					p1 = tuple.Item1;
					p2 = tuple.Item2;
					base.Visible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					base.Visible = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!RegressionLine.Visible)
			{
				base.Visible = false;
				return null;
			}
			double min = RegressionLine.View.ActualAxisY.VisualRangeData.Min;
			double max = RegressionLine.View.ActualAxisY.VisualRangeData.Max;
			base.Visible = (!(p1.Y < min) || !(p2.Y < min)) && (!(p1.Y > max) || !(p2.Y > max));
			if (!base.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GRealRect2D rect = CalculateLayoutBounds(diagramMapping);
			GRealLine2D? gRealLine2D = TruncatedLineCalculator.Truncate(diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(p1.X, p1.Y), diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(p2.X, p2.Y), rect.ToRectangle(), LineKind.Line);
			if (!gRealLine2D.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new LineIndicatorLayout(RegressionLine, gRealLine2D.Value);
		}

		public override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			double value = CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorArgument, cursorValue, p1.X, p2.X, p1.Y, p2.Y, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity: true, extrapolateToPositiveInfinity: true);
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> { 
			{
				IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value,
				value
			} };
		}

		public override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorValue, cursorArgument, p1.Y, p2.Y, p1.X, p2.X, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity: true, extrapolateToPositiveInfinity: true);
		}

		private GRealRect2D CalculateLayoutBounds(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			GRealRect2D result = diagramMapping.Bounds.ToGRealRect2D();
			if (RegressionLine.ForecastBackwardPeriods < 0.0 && RegressionLine.ForecastForwardPeriods < 0.0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			double x = result.Left;
			double x2 = result.Right;
			DateTimeMeasureUnit measureUnit = diagramMapping.AxisX.DateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
			if (RegressionLine.ForecastBackwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double refinedMin = diagramMapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.RefinedMin;
				double num = diagramMapping.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMin);
				double value = num - RegressionLine.ForecastBackwardPeriods;
				x = diagramMapping.MappingX.GetCoord(value) + (double)diagramMapping.MappingBounds.Left;
			}
			if (RegressionLine.ForecastForwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double refinedMax = diagramMapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.RefinedMax;
				double num2 = diagramMapping.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMax);
				double value2 = num2 + RegressionLine.ForecastForwardPeriods;
				x2 = diagramMapping.MappingX.GetCoord(value2) + (double)diagramMapping.MappingBounds.Left;
			}
			return new GRealRect2D(new GRealPoint2D(x, result.Top), new GRealPoint2D(x2, result.Bottom));
		}
	}
	public class AxisGridAndTextData : Dictionary<AxisInterval, GridAndTextData>
	{
		private readonly Axis2D axis;

		private readonly Rectangle maxBounds;

		public Axis2D Axis => axis;

		public Rectangle MaxBounds => maxBounds;

		public AxisGridAndTextData(Axis2D axis, Rectangle maxBounds)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.maxBounds = maxBounds;
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in AxisIntervalLayout.CreateIntervalsLayout(axis, axis.IsVertical ? maxBounds.Height : maxBounds.Width))
			{
				AxisInterval interval = item.Interval;
				Add(interval, new GridAndTextData(axis.GetSeries(), axis, axis.XYDiagram2D.IsScrollingEnabled, interval.Range, item.Bounds.Length, staggered: false));
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisViewDataCalculator
	{
		private const int SecondaryAxisIndent = 8;

		private const int ScrollBarIndent = 3;

		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		private readonly AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository;

		private readonly ScrollBarPositions scrollBarPositions;

		private readonly IAxisData primaryAxisX;

		private readonly IAxisData primaryAxisY;

		private readonly AxisMapping primaryAxisXMapping;

		private readonly AxisMapping primaryAxisYMapping;

		private readonly int scrollBarThickness;

		private readonly AxesLayoutInteractionManager axesInteraction;

		public static List<AxisViewData> Calculate(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData, ScrollBarPositions scrollBarPositions, List<AxisGridAndTextData> axisGridAndTextDataList)
		{
			AxisViewDataCalculator axisViewDataCalculator = new AxisViewDataCalculator(pane, intervalsLayoutRepository, scrollBarPositions, paneAxesData);
			return axisViewDataCalculator.Calculate(axisGridAndTextDataList);
		}

		private AxisViewDataCalculator(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, ScrollBarPositions scrollBarPositions, PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.intervalsLayoutRepository = intervalsLayoutRepository;
			this.scrollBarPositions = scrollBarPositions;
			primaryAxisX = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
			primaryAxisY = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
			Axis2D axis2D = primaryAxisX as Axis2D;
			Axis2D axis2D2 = primaryAxisY as Axis2D;
			primaryAxisXMapping = new AxisMapping(intervalsLayoutRepository, axis2D);
			primaryAxisYMapping = new AxisMapping(intervalsLayoutRepository, axis2D2);
			axesInteraction = AxesLayoutInteractionManager.Create(axis2D, axis2D2, primaryAxisXMapping, primaryAxisYMapping, intervalsLayoutRepository, pane);
			scrollBarThickness = pane.ScrollBarOptions.ActualBarThickness;
		}

		private bool IsAxisVisible(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (axis.ActualVisibility)
			{
				return axis.VisibleInPane(pane);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private AxisMapping GetAxisMapping(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (axis == primaryAxisX)
			{
				return primaryAxisXMapping;
			}
			if (axis == primaryAxisY)
			{
				return primaryAxisYMapping;
			}
			return new AxisMapping(intervalsLayoutRepository, axis);
		}

		private List<AxisIntervalMapping> GetAxisIntervalMapping(Axis2D axis, AxisMapping axisMapping)
		{
			List<AxisIntervalMapping> list = new List<AxisIntervalMapping>();
			List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout = intervalsLayoutRepository.GetIntervalsLayout(axis);
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in intervalsLayout)
			{
				AxisIntervalMapping axisIntervalMapping = new AxisIntervalMapping(axis, item, axisMapping.MappingBounds, axisMapping.ActualAlignment);
				axisIntervalMapping.SetNormalValues(axisMapping.NormalZeroCoord, axisMapping.NormalCenterAxisValue);
				list.Add(axisIntervalMapping);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private AxisViewData CalculateViewData(AxisGridAndTextData gridAndTextData, bool axisVisible, bool scrollBarVisible, int? axisOffset)
		{
			Axis2D axis = gridAndTextData.Axis;
			int elementsOffset = 0;
			int num = axisOffset ?? 0;
			if (axisVisible)
			{
				if (axisOffset.HasValue)
				{
					num += 8;
					if (axis.Tickmarks.CrossAxis)
					{
						num += axis.Tickmarks.MaxLength;
					}
				}
				else if (scrollBarVisible && axis.LabelInOutsidePosition)
				{
					elementsOffset = scrollBarThickness + 3;
				}
			}
			AxisMapping axisMapping = GetAxisMapping(axis);
			return new AxisViewData(axis, gridAndTextData, axisMapping, GetAxisIntervalMapping(axis, axisMapping), axisVisible, num, elementsOffset, axesInteraction, pane);
		}

		private List<AxisViewData> Calculate(List<AxisGridAndTextData> axisGridAndTextDataList)
		{
			int? axisOffset = null;
			int? axisOffset2 = null;
			int? axisOffset3 = null;
			int? axisOffset4 = null;
			List<AxisViewData> list = new List<AxisViewData>();
			foreach (AxisGridAndTextData axisGridAndTextData in axisGridAndTextDataList)
			{
				Axis2D axis = axisGridAndTextData.Axis;
				AxisMapping axisMapping = GetAxisMapping(axis);
				bool flag = IsAxisVisible(axis);
				AxisViewData axisViewData = null;
				switch (axisMapping.ActualAlignment)
				{
				case AxisAlignment.Far:
					if (axis.IsVertical)
					{
						bool scrollBarVisible3 = (scrollBarPositions & ScrollBarPositions.Right) != 0;
						axisViewData = CalculateViewData(axisGridAndTextData, flag, scrollBarVisible3, axisOffset3);
						if (flag)
						{
							axisOffset3 = axisViewData.NextAxisOffset;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool scrollBarVisible4 = (scrollBarPositions & ScrollBarPositions.Top) != 0;
						axisViewData = CalculateViewData(axisGridAndTextData, flag, scrollBarVisible4, axisOffset2);
						if (flag)
						{
							axisOffset2 = axisViewData.NextAxisOffset;
						}
					}
					break;
				case AxisAlignment.Zero:
				case AxisAlignment.Center:
					axisViewData = CalculateViewData(axisGridAndTextData, flag, scrollBarVisible: false, null);
					break;
				default:
					if (axis.IsVertical)
					{
						bool scrollBarVisible = (scrollBarPositions & ScrollBarPositions.Left) != 0;
						axisViewData = CalculateViewData(axisGridAndTextData, flag, scrollBarVisible, axisOffset);
						if (flag)
						{
							axisOffset = axisViewData.NextAxisOffset;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool scrollBarVisible2 = (scrollBarPositions & ScrollBarPositions.Bottom) != 0;
						axisViewData = CalculateViewData(axisGridAndTextData, flag, scrollBarVisible2, axisOffset4);
						if (flag)
						{
							axisOffset4 = axisViewData.NextAxisOffset;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				list.Add(axisViewData);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class AxesLayoutInteractionManager : AxesLayoutInteractionManagerBase
	{
		private readonly AxisMapping axisXMapping;

		private readonly AxisMapping axisYMapping;

		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		public static AxesLayoutInteractionManager Create(Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY, AxisMapping axisXMapping, AxisMapping axisYMapping, AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			if (axisX != null && axisY != null)
			{
				return new AxesLayoutInteractionManager(axisX, axisY, axisXMapping, axisYMapping, intervalsLayoutRepository, pane);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private AxesLayoutInteractionManager(Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY, AxisMapping axisXMapping, AxisMapping axisYMapping, AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository repository, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
			: base(axisX, axisY, axisXMapping.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Zero && axisYMapping.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Zero)
		{
			this.axisXMapping = axisXMapping;
			this.axisYMapping = axisYMapping;
			this.pane = pane;
			InitInsideValues(axisXMapping, axisY, axisYMapping, repository);
			InitInsideValues(axisYMapping, axisX, axisXMapping, repository);
		}

		private void InitInsideValues(AxisMapping axisMapping, Axis2D oppositeAxis, AxisMapping oppositeAxisMapping, AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository repository)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle mappingBounds = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(repository.MappingBounds);
			bool outOfRange;
			double? zeroCoord = InterimValueCalculator.Calculate(0.0, oppositeAxis, mappingBounds, repository.GetIntervalsLayout(oppositeAxis), out outOfRange);
			axisMapping.SetNormalValues(zeroCoord, oppositeAxis.CalculateInternalValue(pane, (oppositeAxis.IsVertical ? ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Height : ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Width) / 2, oppositeAxisMapping.Length), outOfRange);
		}

		protected override double? GetIntersectionValueX()
		{
			return ProcessAxis(base.PrimaryAxisX, base.PrimaryAxisY, axisXMapping, axisYMapping, pane);
		}

		protected override double? GetIntersectionValueY()
		{
			return ProcessAxis(base.PrimaryAxisY, base.PrimaryAxisX, axisYMapping, axisXMapping, pane);
		}

		private double? ProcessAxis(IAxisData firstAxis, IAxisData secondAxis, AxisMapping firstAxisMapping, AxisMapping secondAxisMapping, XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)firstAxis;
			if ((firstAxisMapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram && secondAxisMapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram) || (!axis2D.LabelInOutsidePosition && secondAxisMapping.ActualPositionInsideDiagram))
			{
				if (((Axis2D)secondAxis).Alignment == AxisAlignment.Zero)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return axis2D.CalculateInternalValue(pane, (int)secondAxisMapping.ActualNormalCoord, firstAxisMapping.Length);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public double? GetIntersectionInternalValue(Axis2D axis)
		{
			return GetIntersectionInternalValue((IAxisData)axis);
		}

		public void ProcessLabelLayout(Axis2D axis, List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, AxisLabelOverlappingResolver resolver, bool outsideLabels)
		{
			ProcessIntersectionLabelLayout(axis, labels.Find((IAxisLabelLayout x) => x.IsIntersectionAutoLabel), resolver, outsideLabels, axis.Thickness, axis.Tickmarks, 3.0);
		}

		public void CacheAxisLabelBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			CacheAxisLabelBounds(bounds.IsEmpty ? GRealRect2D.Empty : bounds.ToGRealRect2D());
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisMappingBase
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axisData;

		private readonly int length;

		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		private readonly int normalLength;

		private AxisAlignment alignment;

		private double? normalZeroCoord;

		private double? normalCenterAxisValue;

		protected IAxisData AxisData => axisData;

		public AxisAlignment ActualAlignment => alignment;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => mappingBounds;

		public int Length => length;

		public int NormalLength => normalLength;

		public double? NormalZeroCoord => normalZeroCoord;

		public double? NormalCenterAxisValue => normalCenterAxisValue;

		public double ActualNormalCoord => GetNormalCoord(alignment);

		public bool ActualPositionInsideDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualAlignment != AxisAlignment.Zero)
				{
					return ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Center;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected AxisMappingBase(IAxisData axis, Rectangle mappingBounds, AxisAlignment alignment)
		{
			axisData = axis;
			this.alignment = alignment;
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
			length = (axis.IsVertical ? mappingBounds.Height : mappingBounds.Width);
			normalLength = (axis.IsVertical ? mappingBounds.Width : mappingBounds.Height);
		}

		private DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double value, AxisAlignment alignment, int offset, int normalOffset, bool isClampedCoord)
		{
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = GetInterimPoint(value, alignment, isClampedCoord);
			return new DiagramPoint(interimPoint.X + (double)offset, interimPoint.Y + (double)normalOffset, interimPoint.Z);
		}

		private DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(double value, AxisAlignment alignment, int offset, int normalOffset, bool isClampedCoord)
		{
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = GetInterimPoint(value, alignment, offset, normalOffset, isClampedCoord);
			return GetTransformPoint(interimPoint);
		}

		protected abstract DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double value, AxisAlignment alignment, bool isClampedCoord);

		protected DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double value, AxisAlignment alignment, int selfOffset, int normalOffset, bool isClampedCoord)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = GetDiagramPoint(value, alignment, selfOffset, normalOffset, isClampedCoord);
			return MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint, MappingBounds);
		}

		protected double GetNormalCoord(AxisAlignment alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case AxisAlignment.Near:
				return 0.0;
			case AxisAlignment.Far:
				return normalLength;
			case AxisAlignment.Zero:
				return normalZeroCoord.GetValueOrDefault();
			case AxisAlignment.Center:
				if (!normalCenterAxisValue.HasValue)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return (double)normalLength / 2.0;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown axis alignment.");
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		protected internal DiagramPoint GetTransformPoint(DiagramPoint interimPoint)
		{
			if (axisData.IsVertical)
			{
				double y = interimPoint.Y;
				interimPoint.Y = interimPoint.X;
				interimPoint.X = y;
				if (axisData.Reverse)
				{
					interimPoint.Y = interimPoint.Y * -1.0 + (double)MappingBounds.Height;
				}
			}
			else if (axisData.Reverse)
			{
				interimPoint.X = interimPoint.X * -1.0 + (double)MappingBounds.Width;
			}
			return interimPoint;
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double value, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(value, ActualAlignment, selfOffset, normalOffset, isClampedCoord: true);
		}

		public DiagramPoint InterimPointToScreenPoint(DiagramPoint interimPoint)
		{
			DiagramPoint transformPoint = GetTransformPoint(interimPoint);
			return MatrixTransform.Project(transformPoint, MappingBounds);
		}

		public void SetNormalValues(double? zeroCoord, double? centerAxisValue, bool isOutOfRange = false)
		{
			normalZeroCoord = zeroCoord;
			normalCenterAxisValue = centerAxisValue;
			if (isOutOfRange && alignment == AxisAlignment.Zero && zeroCoord.HasValue)
			{
				alignment = ((zeroCoord.Value != 0.0) ? AxisAlignment.Far : AxisAlignment.Near);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisIntervalMapping : AxisMappingBase
	{
		private readonly AxisIntervalLayout intervalLayout;

		private readonly AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mapping;

		public AxisIntervalLayout IntervalLayout => intervalLayout;

		public IMinMaxValues Limits => intervalLayout.Range;

		public AxisIntervalMapping(IAxisData axis, AxisIntervalLayout intervalLayout, Rectangle mappingBounds, AxisAlignment alignment)
			: base(axis, mappingBounds, alignment)
		{
			this.intervalLayout = intervalLayout;
			mapping = new AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(intervalLayout, base.AxisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double value, AxisAlignment alignment, bool isClampedCoord)
		{
			double a = (isClampedCoord ? mapping.GetClampedCoord(value) : mapping.GetCoord(value));
			double normalCoord = GetNormalCoord(alignment);
			return new DiagramPoint((int)Math.Round(a), (int)Math.Round(normalCoord));
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetNearScreenPoint(double value, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(value, AxisAlignment.Near, selfOffset, normalOffset, isClampedCoord: true);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetFarScreenPoint(double value, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(value, AxisAlignment.Far, selfOffset, normalOffset, isClampedCoord: true);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetNotClampedScreenPoint(double value, int selfOffset, int normalOffset)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(value, base.ActualAlignment, selfOffset, normalOffset, isClampedCoord: false);
		}
	}
	public class AxisMapping : AxisMappingBase
	{
		public AxisMapping(Rectangle mappingBounds, Axis2D axis, AxisAlignment alignment)
			: base(axis, mappingBounds, alignment)
		{
		}

		public AxisMapping(AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, Axis2D axis)
			: this(intervalsLayoutRepository.MappingBounds, axis, axis.Alignment)
		{
		}

		public AxisMapping(AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, Axis2D axis, AxisAlignment alignment)
			: this(intervalsLayoutRepository.MappingBounds, axis, alignment)
		{
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double value, AxisAlignment alignment, bool isClampedCoord)
		{
			double coord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(base.AxisData.VisualRange, value, base.Length, isClampedCoord);
			double normalCoord = GetNormalCoord(alignment);
			return new DiagramPoint((int)Math.Round(coord), (int)Math.Round(normalCoord));
		}
	}
	public abstract class MatrixTransform
	{
		public static DiagramPoint Project(DiagramPoint diagramPoint, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			diagramPoint.Y *= -1.0;
			diagramPoint.X += bounds.Left;
			diagramPoint.Y += bounds.Bottom;
			return diagramPoint;
		}

		public abstract DiagramPoint Apply(DiagramPoint diagramPoint);
	}
	public class ProjectTransform : MatrixTransform
	{
		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		public ProjectTransform(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		public override DiagramPoint Apply(DiagramPoint diagramPoint)
		{
			return MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint, bounds);
		}
	}
	public class MappingTransform : MatrixTransform
	{
		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		private readonly bool rotated;

		private readonly bool horizontalReverse;

		private readonly bool verticalReverse;

		public MappingTransform(Rectangle mappingBounds, bool rotated, bool horizontalReverse, bool verticalReverse)
		{
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
			this.rotated = rotated;
			this.horizontalReverse = horizontalReverse;
			this.verticalReverse = verticalReverse;
		}

		public DiagramPoint Map(DiagramPoint diagramPoint)
		{
			if (rotated)
			{
				double x = diagramPoint.X;
				diagramPoint.X = diagramPoint.Y;
				diagramPoint.Y = x;
			}
			if (horizontalReverse)
			{
				diagramPoint.X = (double)mappingBounds.Width - diagramPoint.X;
			}
			if (verticalReverse)
			{
				diagramPoint.Y = (double)mappingBounds.Height - diagramPoint.Y;
			}
			return diagramPoint;
		}

		public override DiagramPoint Apply(DiagramPoint diagramPoint)
		{
			return MatrixTransform.Project(Map(diagramPoint), mappingBounds);
		}
	}
	public interface IInterimValueCalculator
	{
		double CalculateInterimValue(AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mapping, double value);

		double CalculateInterimValue(AxisIntervalLayout intervalLayout, double value, ITransformation transformation);
	}
	public class XYDiagramMappingContainer : List<XYDiagramMappingBase>
	{
		private readonly Axis2D axisX;

		private readonly Axis2D axisY;

		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private readonly AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository;

		private readonly List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayoutX;

		private readonly List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayoutY;

		private readonly List<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> mappingsX;

		private readonly List<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> mappingsY;

		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		private readonly MappingTransform transform;

		public bool Rotated => diagram.ActualRotated;

		public Axis2D AxisX => axisX;

		public Axis2D AxisY => axisY;

		public AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository IntervalsLayoutRepository => intervalsLayoutRepository;

		public IList<AxisIntervalLayout> IntervalsLayoutX => intervalsLayoutX;

		public IList<AxisIntervalLayout> IntervalsLayoutY => intervalsLayoutY;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => mappingBounds;

		public MappingTransform Transform => transform;

		public XYDiagramMappingBase MappingForScrolling
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Count == 1)
				{
					return base[0];
				}
				ChartDebug.Fail("Only one mapping for scrolling expected.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxInterimValues(IList<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout, IList<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> mappings, IInterimValueCalculator interimValueCalculator, bool clipBySideLimits, double value1, double value2, ITransformation transformation)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsLayout.Count; i++)
			{
				AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = intervalsLayout[i];
				double val;
				double val2;
				if (interimValueCalculator != null)
				{
					val = interimValueCalculator.CalculateInterimValue(axisIntervalLayout, value1, transformation);
					val2 = interimValueCalculator.CalculateInterimValue(axisIntervalLayout, value2, transformation);
				}
				else
				{
					val = mappings[i].GetInterimCoord(value1, clip: false, round: true);
					val2 = mappings[i].GetInterimCoord(value2, clip: false, round: true);
				}
				double num = Math.Min(val, val2);
				double num2 = Math.Max(val, val2);
				if (!(num2 < axisIntervalLayout.Start) && !(num > axisIntervalLayout.End))
				{
					if ((clipBySideLimits || i != 0) && num < axisIntervalLayout.Start)
					{
						num = axisIntervalLayout.Start;
					}
					if ((clipBySideLimits || i != intervalsLayout.Count - 1) && num2 > axisIntervalLayout.End)
					{
						num2 = axisIntervalLayout.End;
					}
					if (result.IsEmpty)
					{
						result = new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
						continue;
					}
					result.Min = Math.Min(result.Min, num);
					result.Max = Math.Max(result.Max, num2);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> FindIntervalLayout(List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout, List<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> mappings, double value)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsLayout.Count; i++)
			{
				if (intervalsLayout[i].ValueWithinRange(value))
				{
					return new Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping>(intervalsLayout[i], mappings[i]);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static List<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> CreateMappings(List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout, Transformation transformation)
		{
			List<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> list = new List<AxisIntervalLayoutMapping>();
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsLayout.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(intervalsLayout[i], transformation));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingContainer(AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository, XYDiagram2D diagram, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.axisX = axisX;
			this.axisY = axisY;
			this.intervalsLayoutRepository = intervalsLayoutRepository;
			intervalsLayoutX = intervalsLayoutRepository.GetIntervalsLayout(axisX);
			intervalsLayoutY = intervalsLayoutRepository.GetIntervalsLayout(axisY);
			mappingsX = CreateMappings(intervalsLayoutX, axisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
			mappingsY = CreateMappings(intervalsLayoutY, axisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in intervalsLayoutX)
			{
				foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item2 in intervalsLayoutY)
				{
					Add(CreateDiagramMapping(item, item2));
				}
			}
			mappingBounds = intervalsLayoutRepository.MappingBounds;
			transform = XYDiagramMappingHelper.CreateTransform(intervalsLayoutRepository.MappingBounds, diagram.ActualRotated, axisX.ActualReverse, axisY.ActualReverse);
		}

		public MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxInterimX(IInterimValueCalculator interimValueCalculator, bool clipBySideLimits, double argument1, double argument2)
		{
			return CalculateMinMaxInterimValues(intervalsLayoutX, mappingsX, interimValueCalculator, clipBySideLimits, argument1, argument2, axisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
		}

		public MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxInterimY(IInterimValueCalculator interimValueCalculator, bool clipBySideLimits, double value1, double value2)
		{
			return CalculateMinMaxInterimValues(intervalsLayoutY, mappingsY, interimValueCalculator, clipBySideLimits, value1, value2, axisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingBase CreateDiagramMapping(AxisIntervalLayout layoutX, AxisIntervalLayout layoutY)
		{
			return diagram.CreateDiagramMapping(this, layoutX, layoutY);
		}

		public Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> GetIntervalLayoutX(double argument)
		{
			return FindIntervalLayout(intervalsLayoutX, mappingsX, argument);
		}

		public Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> GetIntervalLayoutY(double value)
		{
			return FindIntervalLayout(intervalsLayoutY, mappingsY, value);
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingBase GetMapping(double argument, double value)
		{
			Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> intervalLayoutX = GetIntervalLayoutX(argument);
			if (intervalLayoutX == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> intervalLayoutY = GetIntervalLayoutY(value);
			if (intervalLayoutY == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateDiagramMapping(intervalLayoutX.Item1, intervalLayoutY.Item1);
		}
	}
	public abstract class XYDiagramMappingBase : IXYDiagramMapping
	{
		private readonly XYDiagramMappingContainer container;

		private readonly AxisIntervalLayout layoutX;

		private readonly AxisIntervalLayout layoutY;

		public Axis2D AxisX => container.AxisX;

		public abstract Rectangle Bounds { get; }

		public AxisIntervalLayout LayoutX => layoutX;

		public AxisIntervalLayout LayoutY => layoutY;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => container.MappingBounds;

		public AxisIntervalLayoutMapping MappingX { get; internal set; }

		public AxisIntervalLayoutMapping MappingY { get; internal set; }

		public bool Rotated => container.Rotated;

		public MappingTransform Transform => container.Transform;

		public bool XReverse => container.AxisX.ActualReverse;

		public bool YReverse => container.AxisY.ActualReverse;

		bool IXYDiagramMapping.IsRotatedDiagram => container.Rotated;

		public XYDiagramMappingBase(XYDiagramMappingContainer container, AxisIntervalLayout layoutX, AxisIntervalLayout layoutY)
		{
			this.container = container;
			this.layoutX = layoutX;
			this.layoutY = layoutY;
			UpdateMapping();
		}

		DiagramPoint IXYDiagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool round)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value, round);
		}

		protected abstract DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool round);

		public DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double argument, double value, bool clip, bool round)
		{
			double interimCoord = MappingX.GetInterimCoord(argument, clip, round);
			double interimCoord2 = MappingY.GetInterimCoord(value, clip, round);
			return new DiagramPoint(interimCoord, interimCoord2);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value, round: true);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPointNoRound(double argument, double value)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value, round: false);
		}

		public void UpdateMapping()
		{
			MappingX = new AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(LayoutX, AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
			MappingY = new AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(LayoutY, AxisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramMapping : XYDiagramMappingBase
	{
		private Rectangle? bounds;

		public override Rectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!bounds.HasValue)
				{
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(base.LayoutX.Bounds.Start, base.LayoutY.Bounds.Start);
					DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(base.LayoutX.Bounds.Start + base.LayoutX.Bounds.Length, base.LayoutY.Bounds.Start + base.LayoutY.Bounds.Length);
					diagramPoint = base.Transform.Map(diagramPoint);
					diagramPoint2 = base.Transform.Map(diagramPoint2);
					diagramPoint = MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint, base.MappingBounds);
					diagramPoint2 = MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint2, base.MappingBounds);
					bounds = GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2);
				}
				return bounds.Value;
			}
		}

		public XYDiagramMapping(XYDiagramMappingContainer container, AxisIntervalLayout layoutX, AxisIntervalLayout layoutY)
			: base(container, layoutX, layoutY)
		{
		}

		private DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(double argument, double value, bool round)
		{
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = GetInterimPoint(argument, value, clip: false, round);
			return base.Transform.Map(interimPoint);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool round)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = GetDiagramPoint(argument, value, round);
			return MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint, base.MappingBounds);
		}
	}
	public class SwiftPlotDiagramMapping : XYDiagramMappingBase
	{
		private readonly Transformation argumentTransformation;

		private readonly int bottom;

		private readonly double factorX;

		private readonly double factorY;

		private readonly int left;

		private readonly double minX;

		private readonly double minY;

		private readonly Transformation valueTransformation;

		public override Rectangle Bounds => base.Container.IntervalsLayoutRepository.MappingBounds;

		public SwiftPlotDiagramMapping(XYDiagramMappingContainer container, AxisIntervalLayout layoutX, AxisIntervalLayout layoutY)
			: base(container, layoutX, layoutY)
		{
			left = Bounds.Left;
			bottom = Bounds.Bottom;
			argumentTransformation = base.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			valueTransformation = base.AxisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			minX = argumentTransformation.TransformForward(layoutX.Range.Min);
			minY = valueTransformation.TransformForward(layoutY.Range.Min);
			factorX = layoutX.Bounds.Length / (argumentTransformation.TransformForward(layoutX.Range.Max) - minX);
			factorY = layoutY.Bounds.Length / (valueTransformation.TransformForward(layoutY.Range.Max) - minY);
		}

		private double GetInterimArgument(double argument)
		{
			if (argumentTransformation.IsIdentity)
			{
				return (argument - minX) * factorX;
			}
			return (argumentTransformation.TransformForward(argument) - minX) * factorX;
		}

		private double GetInterimValue(double value)
		{
			if (valueTransformation.IsIdentity)
			{
				return (value - minY) * factorY;
			}
			return (valueTransformation.TransformForward(value) - minY) * factorY;
		}

		internal double GetRoundedScreenArgument(double argument)
		{
			return Math.Round(GetInterimArgument(argument));
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool round)
		{
			double num = GetInterimArgument(argument);
			double num2 = GetInterimValue(value);
			if (round)
			{
				num = Math.Round(num);
				num2 = Math.Round(num2);
			}
			return new DiagramPoint((double)left + num, (double)bottom - num2);
		}

		public Point GetRoundedScreenPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return new Point(left + (int)Math.Round(GetInterimArgument(argument)), bottom - (int)Math.Round(GetInterimValue(value)));
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramWholeMapping
	{
		private readonly Axis2D axisX;

		private readonly int axisXLength;

		private readonly Axis2D axisY;

		private readonly int axisYLength;

		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		private readonly MappingTransform transform;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => mappingBounds;

		public XYDiagramWholeMapping(Rectangle mappingBounds, bool rotated, Axis2D axisX, Axis2D axisY)
		{
			this.axisX = axisX;
			this.axisY = axisY;
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
			axisXLength = (rotated ? mappingBounds.Height : mappingBounds.Width);
			axisYLength = (rotated ? mappingBounds.Width : mappingBounds.Height);
			transform = XYDiagramMappingHelper.CreateTransform(mappingBounds, rotated, axisX.ActualReverse, axisY.ActualReverse);
		}

		private DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double argument, double value, bool clip, bool round)
		{
			double num = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(axisX.VisualRangeData, argument, axisXLength, clip);
			double num2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(axisY.VisualRangeData, value, axisYLength, clip);
			if (round)
			{
				num = Math.Round(num);
				num2 = Math.Round(num2);
			}
			return new DiagramPoint(num, num2);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(double argument, double value, bool clip, bool round)
		{
			return transform.Map(GetInterimPoint(argument, value, clip, round));
		}
	}
	public abstract class FibonacciIndicatorBehavior : FinancialIndicatorBehavior
	{
		private const double level0 = 0.0;

		private const double level100 = 1.0;

		private const double level23_6 = 0.236;

		private const double level76_4 = 0.764;

		private static readonly double[] defaultLevels = new double[3] { 0.382, 0.5, 0.618 };

		private static readonly double[] additionalLevels = new double[3] { 1.618, 2.618, 4.236 };

		private Color baseLevelColor;

		protected FibonacciIndicator FibonacciIndicator => (FibonacciIndicator)base.Indicator;

		public abstract bool DefaultShowLevel0 { get; }

		public abstract bool DefaultShowLevel100 { get; }

		public abstract bool DefaultShowLevel23_6 { get; }

		public abstract bool DefaultShowLevel76_4 { get; }

		public abstract bool DefaultShowAdditionalLevels { get; }

		public abstract bool ShowLevel0PropertyEnabled { get; }

		public abstract bool ShowLevel100PropertyEnabled { get; }

		public abstract bool ShowAdditionalLevelsPropertyEnabled { get; }

		public override bool HasPoints => false;

		public override int PointsCount => 0;

		public Color BaseLevelColor => baseLevelColor;

		protected static string ConstructLevelText(double level)
		{
			return level * 100.0 + "%";
		}

		public static FibonacciIndicatorBehavior CreateInstance(FibonacciIndicatorKind kind, FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator)
		{
			return kind switch
			{
				FibonacciIndicatorKind.FibonacciArcs => new FibonacciArcsBehavior(fibonacciIndicator), 
				FibonacciIndicatorKind.FibonacciFans => new FibonacciFansBehavior(fibonacciIndicator), 
				FibonacciIndicatorKind.FibonacciRetracement => new FibonacciRetracementBehavior(fibonacciIndicator), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		public FibonacciIndicatorBehavior(FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator)
			: base(fibonacciIndicator)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateColorInternal(Color generatedColor)
		{
			base.UpdateColorInternal(generatedColor);
			baseLevelColor = FibonacciIndicator.BaseLevelColor;
			if (baseLevelColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				baseLevelColor = base.Color;
			}
		}

		public List<double> GetBaseLevels()
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if ((ShowLevel0PropertyEnabled && FibonacciIndicator.ShowLevel0) || (!ShowLevel0PropertyEnabled && DefaultShowLevel0))
			{
				list.Add(0.0);
			}
			if ((ShowLevel100PropertyEnabled && FibonacciIndicator.ShowLevel100) || (!ShowLevel100PropertyEnabled && DefaultShowLevel100))
			{
				list.Add(1.0);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public List<double> GetLevels()
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>(defaultLevels);
			if (FibonacciIndicator.ShowLevel23_6)
			{
				list.Add(0.236);
			}
			if (FibonacciIndicator.ShowLevel76_4)
			{
				list.Add(0.764);
			}
			if ((ShowAdditionalLevelsPropertyEnabled && FibonacciIndicator.ShowAdditionalLevels) || (!ShowAdditionalLevelsPropertyEnabled && DefaultShowAdditionalLevels))
			{
				list.AddRange(additionalLevels);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
