	public abstract class FinancialIndicatorBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private DiagramPoint minPoint;

		private DiagramPoint maxPoint;

		protected DiagramPoint MinPoint => minPoint;

		protected DiagramPoint MaxPoint => maxPoint;

		public FinancialIndicatorBehavior(FinancialIndicator financialIndicator)
			: base(financialIndicator)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			if (!(base.Indicator is FinancialIndicator { Visible: not false, Point1: var point, Point2: var point2 } financialIndicator))
			{
				return;
			}
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)financialIndicator.View.ActualAxisX).AxisScaleTypeMap;
			object argument = point.Argument;
			object argument2 = point2.Argument;
			if (!axisScaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(argument) || !axisScaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(argument2))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(argument);
			double num2 = axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(argument2);
			if (num != num2 && !double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				RefinedPoint pointByArgument;
				RefinedPoint pointByArgument2;
				ValueLevel valueLevel;
				ValueLevel valueLevel2;
				if (num < num2)
				{
					pointByArgument = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: false, axisScaleTypeMap, refinedSeries, argument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					pointByArgument2 = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: true, axisScaleTypeMap, refinedSeries, argument2, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					valueLevel = point.ValueLevel;
					valueLevel2 = point2.ValueLevel;
				}
				else
				{
					pointByArgument = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: false, axisScaleTypeMap, refinedSeries, argument2, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					pointByArgument2 = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: true, axisScaleTypeMap, refinedSeries, argument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					valueLevel = point2.ValueLevel;
					valueLevel2 = point.ValueLevel;
				}
				if (pointByArgument != null && pointByArgument2 != null)
				{
					minPoint = new DiagramPoint(pointByArgument.Argument, pointByArgument.GetValue((ValueLevelInternal)valueLevel));
					maxPoint = new DiagramPoint(pointByArgument2.Argument, pointByArgument2.GetValue((ValueLevelInternal)valueLevel2));
					base.Visible = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TrendLineBehavior : IndicatorBehavior
	{
		private readonly TrendLineCalculator calculator = new TrendLineCalculator();

		private GRealLine2D indicatorLine;

		private TrendLine TrendLine => (TrendLine)base.Indicator;

		internal GRealLine2D IndicatorLine => indicatorLine;

		public override bool HasPoints => true;

		public TrendLineBehavior(TrendLine trendLine)
			: base(trendLine)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicatorData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			base.Visible = false;
			if (base.Indicator is FinancialIndicator { Visible: not false, Point1: var point, Point2: var point2 } financialIndicator)
			{
				double maxArgument = refinedSeries.GetMaxArgument(TrendLine.View.ActualAxisX.ScaleTypeMap);
				double minArgument = refinedSeries.GetMinArgument(TrendLine.View.ActualAxisX.ScaleTypeMap);
				AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)financialIndicator.View.ActualAxisX).AxisScaleTypeMap;
				indicatorLine = calculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, axisScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, point.Argument, (ValueLevelInternal)point.ValueLevel, point2.Argument, (ValueLevelInternal)point2.ValueLevel, TrendLine.ExtrapolateToInfinity, maxArgument, TrendLine.ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity, minArgument, base.ValueProvider);
				base.Visible = calculator.Calculated;
			}
		}

		protected override IndicatorLayout CreateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			if (!base.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(indicatorLine.Start.X, indicatorLine.Start.Y);
			DiagramPoint screenPointNoRound2 = diagramMapping.GetScreenPointNoRound(indicatorLine.End.X, indicatorLine.End.Y);
			GRealLine2D? gRealLine2D = TruncatedLineCalculator.Truncate(lineKind: (!TrendLine.ExtrapolateToInfinity || !TrendLine.ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity) ? ((!TrendLine.ExtrapolateToInfinity && !TrendLine.ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity) ? LineKind.Segment : LineKind.Ray) : LineKind.Line, start: screenPointNoRound, end: screenPointNoRound2, bounds: diagramMapping.Bounds);
			if (!gRealLine2D.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new LineIndicatorLayout(TrendLine, gRealLine2D.Value);
		}

		public override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			double value = CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorArgument, cursorValue, indicatorLine.Start.X, indicatorLine.End.X, indicatorLine.Start.Y, indicatorLine.End.Y, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity: false, TrendLine.ExtrapolateToInfinity);
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> { 
			{
				IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value,
				value
			} };
		}

		public override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorValue, cursorArgument, indicatorLine.Start.Y, indicatorLine.End.Y, indicatorLine.Start.X, indicatorLine.End.X, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity: false, TrendLine.ExtrapolateToInfinity);
		}
	}
	public struct DiagramVector : IEquatable<DiagramVector>
	{
		private double dx;

		private double dy;

		private double dz;

		public static DiagramVector Zero => new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

		public double DX
		{
			get
			{
				return dx;
			}
			set
			{
				dx = value;
			}
		}

		public double DY
		{
			get
			{
				return dy;
			}
			set
			{
				dy = value;
			}
		}

		public double DZ
		{
			get
			{
				return dz;
			}
			set
			{
				dz = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsZero
		{
			get
			{
				if (dx == 0.0 && dy == 0.0)
				{
					return dz == 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double SquaredLength => dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;

		public double Length => Math.Sqrt(SquaredLength);

		public static DiagramVector operator +(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(v1.dx + v2.dx, v1.dy + v2.dy, v1.dz + v2.dz);
		}

		public static DiagramVector operator *(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(v1.dy * v2.dz - v1.dz * v2.dy, v1.dz * v2.dx - v1.dx * v2.dz, v1.dx * v2.dy - v1.dy * v2.dx);
		}

		public static DiagramVector CreateNormalized(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			DiagramVector result = new DiagramVector(dx, dy, dz);
			result.Normalize();
			return result;
		}

		public DiagramVector(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			this.dx = dx;
			this.dy = dy;
			this.dz = dz;
		}

		public void Normalize()
		{
			double length = Length;
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(length, 0.0, 1E-05) == 0)
			{
				dx = 0.0;
				dy = 0.0;
				dz = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				dx /= length;
				dy /= length;
				dz /= length;
			}
		}

		public void Revert()
		{
			dx = 0.0 - dx;
			dy = 0.0 - dy;
			dz = 0.0 - dz;
		}

		public bool Equals(DiagramVector other)
		{
			if (other.dx == dx && other.dy == dy)
			{
				return other.dz == dz;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DiagramVector other))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double, double>(dx, dy, dz);
		}
	}
	public static class StripsUtils
	{
		private static void AddScreenStrip(IXYDiagramMapping mapping, OptimizedLineStrip screenStrip, bool round, double argument, double startValue, double lastValue, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, startValue, round);
			GRealPoint2D item = new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y);
			screenStrip.Add(item);
			if (minValue != maxValue)
			{
				screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, lastValue, round);
				item.X = screenPoint.X;
				item.Y = screenPoint.Y;
				DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = mapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, minValue, round);
				DiagramPoint screenPoint3 = mapping.GetScreenPoint(argument, maxValue, round);
				if (minValue != startValue && minValue != lastValue)
				{
					screenStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint2.X, screenPoint2.Y));
				}
				if (maxValue != startValue && maxValue != lastValue)
				{
					screenStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint3.X, screenPoint3.Y));
				}
				screenStrip.Add(item);
				if (screenStrip.OptimizedByXCoordinate)
				{
					double top = Math.Min(screenPoint3.Y, screenPoint2.Y);
					double height = Math.Abs(screenPoint2.Y - screenPoint3.Y);
					screenStrip.Rectangles.Add(new GRealRect2D(screenPoint.X, top, 1.0, height));
				}
				else
				{
					double left = Math.Min(screenPoint2.X, screenPoint3.X);
					double width = Math.Abs(screenPoint3.X - screenPoint2.X);
					screenStrip.Rectangles.Add(new GRealRect2D(left, screenPoint.Y, width, 1.0));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void MapBezierStrip(IXYDiagramMapping mapping, LineStrip lineStrip, LineStrip screenStrip, bool round)
		{
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = lineStrip as BezierStrip;
			BezierStrip bezierStrip2 = screenStrip as BezierStrip;
			if (bezierStrip == null || bezierStrip2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bezierStrip2.Style.Assign(bezierStrip.Style);
			IList<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = bezierStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: false, clip: false);
			if (pointsForDrawing == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>(pointsForDrawing.Count);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in pointsForDrawing)
			{
				DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(item.X, item.Y, round: false);
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y));
			}
			if (round)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = list[0];
				list[0] = new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.X), Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.Y));
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = list[list.Count - 1];
				list[list.Count - 1] = new GRealPoint2D(Math.Round(gRealPoint2D2.X), Math.Round(gRealPoint2D2.Y));
			}
			bezierStrip2.SetPointsForDrawing(list);
		}

		private static void AddChunk(List<List<PointF>> chunks, List<PointF> chunk, bool isLastChunk)
		{
			if (chunk.Count == 1 && chunks.Count > 0)
			{
				if (!isLastChunk)
				{
					chunks[chunk.Count - 1].Add(chunk[0]);
				}
			}
			else if (chunk.Count > 0)
			{
				chunks.Add(chunk);
			}
		}

		private static IGeometryStrip MapBoxPlotMeanLineStrip(BoxPlotMeanLineStrip strip, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			for (int i = 0; i < strip.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D point = strip.GetPoint(i);
				DiagramPoint screenPoint = diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(point.X, point.Y);
				double x = screenPoint.X + (double)strip.GetPixelOffset(i);
				double y = screenPoint.Y;
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, y));
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D CalcStepPoint(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2, bool invertedStep)
		{
			if (!invertedStep)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(p2.X, p1.Y);
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(p1.X, p2.Y);
		}

		public static LineStrip CalcLegendStepLinePoints(Rectangle bounds, bool invertedStep)
		{
			int num = bounds.Top + (bounds.Height - 1) / 2;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left + bounds.Width / 2, num);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right - 1, bounds.Bottom - 1);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = CalcStepPoint(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2, invertedStep);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D5 = CalcStepPoint(gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D3, invertedStep);
			return new LineStrip(new GRealPoint2D[5] { gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D4, gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D5, gRealPoint2D3 });
		}

		public static PointF[] Convert(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			return Convert(points, skipEqualPoints: false);
		}

		public static PointF[] Convert(IList<GRealPoint2D> points, bool skipEqualPoints)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>(count);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				PointF pointF = new PointF((float)points[0].X, (float)points[0].Y);
				list.Add(pointF);
				for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
				{
					PointF pointF2 = new PointF((float)points[i].X, (float)points[i].Y);
					if (!skipEqualPoints || !(pointF2 == pointF))
					{
						list.Add(pointF2);
						pointF = pointF2;
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static List<List<PointF>> OptimizeAndConvert(IList<GRealPoint2D> points, int chunkSize)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return new List<List<PointF>>();
			}
			int capacity = Math.Max(1, points.Count / chunkSize);
			List<List<PointF>> list = new List<List<PointF>>(capacity);
			List<PointF> list2 = new List<PointF>(chunkSize);
			PointF item = new PointF((float)points[0].X, (float)points[0].Y);
			PointF pointF = new PointF((int)item.X, (int)item.Y);
			list2.Add(item);
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF2 = new PointF((float)points[i].X, (float)points[i].Y);
				PointF pointF3 = new PointF((int)pointF2.X, (int)pointF2.Y);
				if (!(pointF3 == pointF))
				{
					list2.Add(pointF2);
					item = pointF2;
					pointF = pointF3;
					if (list2.Count % chunkSize == 0 && i > 0)
					{
						AddChunk(list, list2, isLastChunk: false);
						list2 = new List<PointF>(chunkSize);
						list2.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			AddChunk(list, list2, isLastChunk: true);
			return list;
		}

		public static PointF[] GetClosedPath(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>(points.Count + 1);
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(points[i].ToPointF());
			}
			list.Add(list[0]);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static RangeStrip CreateAreaMarkerStrip(IGeometryStripCreator creator, Rectangle bounds, bool pointMarkerVisible)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(bounds.Location, bounds.Size);
			double num = (double)rectangleF.Left + (double)rectangleF.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = rectangleF.Top;
			if (pointMarkerVisible)
			{
				num2 += (double)rectangleF.Height / 4.0;
			}
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = creator.CreateStrip() as RangeStrip;
			if (rangeStrip != null)
			{
				rangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Left, rectangleF.Bottom), new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Left, rectangleF.Bottom)));
				if (rangeStrip is BezierRangeStrip)
				{
					double num3 = rectangleF.Width / 7f;
					num2 += (double)(rectangleF.Height / 16f);
					rangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(new GRealPoint2D(num - num3, num2), new GRealPoint2D(num - num3, rectangleF.Bottom)));
					rangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(new GRealPoint2D(num + num3, num2), new GRealPoint2D(num + num3, rectangleF.Bottom)));
				}
				else
				{
					rangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(new GRealPoint2D(num, num2), new GRealPoint2D(num, rectangleF.Bottom)));
				}
				rangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Right, rectangleF.Bottom), new GRealPoint2D(rectangleF.Right, rectangleF.Bottom)));
				rangeStrip.CompleteFilling(null, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			}
			return rangeStrip;
		}

		public static LineStrip FillVertices(RangeStrip rangeStrip, out ZPlaneRectangle boundingRectangle)
		{
			boundingRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.Empty;
			if (rangeStrip.Count == 0)
			{
				return new LineStrip();
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			lineStrip.AddRange(rangeStrip.TopStrip);
			for (int num = rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(rangeStrip.BottomStrip[num]);
			}
			LargeScaleHelper.Validate(lineStrip);
			boundingRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(lineStrip);
			boundingRectangle = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(boundingRectangle);
			if (boundingRectangle.Width < 0.5 || boundingRectangle.Height < 0.5)
			{
				if (boundingRectangle.Width < 0.5)
				{
					boundingRectangle.Inflate(0.5, 0.0);
				}
				if (boundingRectangle.Height < 0.5)
				{
					boundingRectangle.Inflate(0.0, 0.5);
				}
				lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Location.X, boundingRectangle.Location.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Location.X + boundingRectangle.Width, boundingRectangle.Location.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Location.X + boundingRectangle.Width, boundingRectangle.Location.Y + boundingRectangle.Height));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Location.X, boundingRectangle.Location.Y + boundingRectangle.Height));
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath GetPath(RangeStrip rangeStrip)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			if (!(rangeStrip is BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip))
			{
				ZPlaneRectangle boundingRectangle;
				LineStrip lineStrip = FillVertices(rangeStrip, out boundingRectangle);
				if (lineStrip.Count > 1)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(Convert(lineStrip));
				}
			}
			else if (bezierRangeStrip.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (bezierRangeStrip.Count == 1)
				{
					GRealRect2D boundingRectangle2 = bezierRangeStrip.GetBoundingRectangle();
					RectangleF rect = new RectangleF((float)boundingRectangle2.Left, (float)boundingRectangle2.Top, (float)boundingRectangle2.Width, (float)boundingRectangle2.Height);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle(rect);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bezierRangeStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints);
				dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(Convert(topPoints));
				dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(Convert(bottomPoints));
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath GetPath(LineStrip lineStrip, int thickness)
		{
			return GetPath(lineStrip, thickness, null);
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath GetPath(LineStrip lineStrip, int thickness, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			if (!(lineStrip is BezierStrip bezierStrip))
			{
				LineStrip points = lineStrip.CreateUniqueStrip();
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(points);
				if (zPlaneRectangle.Width < 0.5 && zPlaneRectangle.Height < 0.5)
				{
					return dXGraphicsPath;
				}
				dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(Convert(points));
			}
			else
			{
				if (bezierStrip.IsEmpty)
				{
					return dXGraphicsPath;
				}
				List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = bezierStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true);
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle2 = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(pointsForDrawing);
				if (zPlaneRectangle2.Width < 0.5 && zPlaneRectangle2.Height < 0.5)
				{
					return dXGraphicsPath;
				}
				dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(Convert(pointsForDrawing));
			}
			using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, thickness);
			if (lineStyle != null)
			{
				dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)lineStyle.LineJoin;
			}
			dXGraphicsPath.Widen(dXPen);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public static PointF[] GetPathPoints(LineStrip lineStrip)
		{
			if (!(lineStrip is BezierStrip bezierStrip))
			{
				LineStrip points = lineStrip.CreateUniqueStrip();
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(points);
				if (zPlaneRectangle.Width >= 0.5 || zPlaneRectangle.Height >= 0.5)
				{
					return Convert(points);
				}
			}
			else if (!bezierStrip.IsEmpty)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = bezierStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true);
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle2 = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(pointsForDrawing);
				if (zPlaneRectangle2.Width >= 0.5 || zPlaneRectangle2.Height >= 0.5)
				{
					using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
					dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(Convert(pointsForDrawing));
					dXGraphicsPath.Flatten();
					if (dXGraphicsPath.PointCount != 0)
					{
						return dXGraphicsPath.PathPoints.ToArray();
					}
				}
			}
			return new PointF[0];
		}

		public static PointF[] GetPathPoints(RangeStrip rangeStrip)
		{
			if (!(rangeStrip is BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip))
			{
				ZPlaneRectangle boundingRectangle;
				LineStrip lineStrip = FillVertices(rangeStrip, out boundingRectangle);
				if (lineStrip.Count > 1)
				{
					return Convert(lineStrip);
				}
			}
			else if (bezierRangeStrip.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (bezierRangeStrip.Count == 1)
				{
					GRealRect2D boundingRectangle2 = bezierRangeStrip.GetBoundingRectangle();
					RectangleF thisRect = new RectangleF((float)boundingRectangle2.Left, (float)boundingRectangle2.Top, (float)boundingRectangle2.Width, (float)boundingRectangle2.Height);
					return new PointF[4]
					{
						thisRect.LeftTop(),
						thisRect.RightTop(),
						thisRect.RightBottom(),
						thisRect.LeftBottom()
					};
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bezierRangeStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints);
				using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
				dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(Convert(topPoints));
				dXGraphicsPath.AddBeziers(Convert(bottomPoints));
				dXGraphicsPath.Flatten();
				if (dXGraphicsPath.PointCount != 0)
				{
					return dXGraphicsPath.PathPoints.ToArray();
				}
			}
			return new PointF[0];
		}

		public static LineStrip MapAndOptimizeStrip(IXYDiagramMapping mapping, LineStrip lineStrip)
		{
			return MapAndOptimizeStrip(mapping, lineStrip, round: false);
		}

		public static LineStrip MapAndOptimizeStrip(IXYDiagramMapping mapping, LineStrip lineStrip, bool round)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = lineStrip[0];
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = lineStrip[lineStrip.Count - 1];
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = mapping.GetScreenPoint(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y, round);
			DiagramPoint screenPoint2 = mapping.GetScreenPoint(gRealPoint2D2.X, gRealPoint2D2.Y, round);
			double num = Math.Abs(mapping.IsRotatedDiagram ? (screenPoint.Y - screenPoint2.Y) : (screenPoint2.X - screenPoint.X));
			double num2 = (gRealPoint2D2.X - gRealPoint2D.X) / num;
			double num3 = gRealPoint2D.X;
			double num4 = gRealPoint2D.Y;
			double lastValue = num4;
			double num5 = num4;
			double num6 = num5;
			OptimizedLineStrip optimizedLineStrip = new OptimizedLineStrip(!mapping.IsRotatedDiagram);
			optimizedLineStrip.Style.Assign(lineStrip.Style);
			for (int i = 1; i < lineStrip.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = lineStrip[i];
				double x = gRealPoint2D3.X;
				double y = gRealPoint2D3.Y;
				if (x - num3 > num2)
				{
					AddScreenStrip(mapping, optimizedLineStrip, round, num3, num4, lastValue, num5, num6);
					num3 = x;
					num4 = (lastValue = (num5 = (num6 = y)));
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = Math.Min(num5, y);
					num6 = Math.Max(num6, y);
					lastValue = y;
				}
			}
			AddScreenStrip(mapping, optimizedLineStrip, round, num3, num4, lastValue, num5, num6);
			return optimizedLineStrip;
		}

		public static RangeStrip MapAndOptimizeStrip(IXYDiagramMapping mapping, RangeStrip rangeStrip, bool round = false)
		{
			RangeStrip rangeStrip2 = rangeStrip.CreateInstance();
			rangeStrip2.Style.Assign(rangeStrip.Style);
			rangeStrip2.TopStrip = MapAndOptimizeStrip(mapping, rangeStrip.TopStrip, round);
			rangeStrip2.BottomStrip = MapAndOptimizeStrip(mapping, rangeStrip.BottomStrip, round);
			return rangeStrip2;
		}

		public static LineStrip MapStrip(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, LineStrip lineStrip)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip2 = lineStrip.CreateInstance();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in lineStrip)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(item.X, item.Y, clipping: false);
				lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y));
			}
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = lineStrip as BezierStrip;
			BezierStrip bezierStrip2 = lineStrip2 as BezierStrip;
			if (bezierStrip != null && bezierStrip2 != null)
			{
				IList<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = bezierStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: false, clip: false);
				if (pointsForDrawing != null)
				{
					List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>(pointsForDrawing.Count);
					foreach (GRealPoint2D item2 in pointsForDrawing)
					{
						DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(item2.X, item2.Y, clipping: false);
						list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(diagramPoint2.X, diagramPoint2.Y));
					}
					bezierStrip2.SetPointsForDrawing(list);
				}
			}
			return lineStrip2;
		}

		public static List<LineStrip> OptimizeScreenStrip(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, LineStrip unoptimizedLineStrip)
		{
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = diagramMapping.Bounds.ToGRealRect2D();
			GRealPoint2D leftTopRectPoint = new GRealPoint2D(gRealRect2D.Left, gRealRect2D.Top);
			GRealPoint2D rightBottomRectPoint = new GRealPoint2D(gRealRect2D.Right, gRealRect2D.Bottom);
			GRealPoint2D segmentPoint = default(GRealPoint2D);
			bool flag = false;
			List<LineStrip> list = new List<LineStrip>();
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			for (int i = 0; i < unoptimizedLineStrip.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = unoptimizedLineStrip[i];
				if (gRealRect2D.Contains(gRealPoint2D))
				{
					if (i == 0 || flag)
					{
						lineStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(lineStrip);
						lineStrip = new LineStrip();
						lineStrip.Add(GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(segmentPoint, gRealPoint2D, leftTopRectPoint, rightBottomRectPoint).IntersectionPoint);
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						lineStrip.Add(GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(segmentPoint, gRealPoint2D, leftTopRectPoint, rightBottomRectPoint).IntersectionPoint);
					}
					flag = false;
				}
				segmentPoint = gRealPoint2D;
			}
			list.Add(lineStrip);
			return list;
		}

		public static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RangeStrip rangeStrip, Color color)
		{
			if (!(rangeStrip is BezierRangeStrip strip))
			{
				ZPlaneRectangle boundingRectangle;
				LineStrip strip2 = FillVertices(rangeStrip, out boundingRectangle);
				renderer.FillPolygon(strip2, color);
			}
			else
			{
				renderer.FillBezier(strip, color);
			}
		}

		public static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, LineStrip lineStrip, Color color, int thickness)
		{
			if (!(lineStrip is BezierStrip strip))
			{
				renderer.DrawLines(lineStrip, color, thickness, null, LineCap.Flat);
			}
			else
			{
				renderer.DrawBezier(strip, color, thickness);
			}
		}

		public static void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, RangeStrip rangeStrip, FillOptionsBase fillOptions, Color color, Color color2, SeriesHitTestState hitTestState, ZPlaneRectangle mappingBounds, SelectionState selectionState, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			if (!(rangeStrip is BezierRangeStrip strip))
			{
				if (rangeStrip != null)
				{
					ZPlaneRectangle boundingRectangle;
					LineStrip lineStrip = FillVertices(rangeStrip, out boundingRectangle);
					PolygonGradientFillOptions polygonGradientFillOptions = fillOptions as PolygonGradientFillOptions;
					if (mappingBounds != null && polygonGradientFillOptions != null && (polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == PolygonGradientMode.ToCenter || polygonGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == PolygonGradientMode.FromCenter))
					{
						boundingRectangle = mappingBounds;
					}
					fillOptions.Render(renderer, lineStrip, (RectangleF)boundingRectangle, color, color2, isSplittedStrip);
					if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
					{
						renderer.FillPolygon(lineStrip, hitTestState.HatchStyle, hitTestState.GetPointHatchColor(selectionState));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				fillOptions.Render(renderer, strip, color, color2, isSplittedStrip);
				if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
				{
					renderer.FillBezier(strip, hitTestState.HatchStyle, hitTestState.GetPointHatchColor(selectionState));
				}
			}
		}

		public static List<IGeometryStrip> MapBoxPlotMeanLineStrips(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, IList<IGeometryStrip> boxPlotStrips)
		{
			List<IGeometryStrip> list = new List<IGeometryStrip>();
			foreach (BoxPlotMeanLineStrip boxPlotStrip in boxPlotStrips)
			{
				IGeometryStrip item = MapBoxPlotMeanLineStrip(boxPlotStrip, diagramMapping);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public enum SelectionAction
	{
		None,
		Reset,
		Add,
		Remove,
		Replace
	}
	public class SelectedItemInfo
	{
		private int seriesIndex;

		private int seriesPointIndex;

		public bool IsSeriesSelection => seriesPointIndex < 0;

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int SeriesIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				seriesIndex = value;
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int SeriesPointIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesPointIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				seriesPointIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public SelectedItemInfo()
		{
		}

		public SelectedItemInfo(int seriesIndex)
			: this(seriesIndex, -1)
		{
		}

		public SelectedItemInfo(int seriesIndex, int refinedPointIndex)
		{
			this.seriesIndex = seriesIndex;
			seriesPointIndex = refinedPointIndex;
		}
	}
	public class SelectionController
	{
		private const ElementSelectionMode DefaultElementSelectionMode = ElementSelectionMode.None;

		private const SeriesSelectionMode DefaultSeriesSelectionMode = SeriesSelectionMode.Series;

		private readonly SelectedItemCollection selectedItems;

		private readonly List<IHitTest> internalSelectedItems;

		private readonly List<SelectedItemsChangedAction> lastSelectOperations;

		private readonly List<object> oldItems = new List<object>();

		private readonly Dictionary<object, object> selectedItemsCache = new Dictionary<object, object>();

		private ElementSelectionMode elementSelectionMode;

		private SeriesSelectionMode seriesSelectionMode;

		private SelectedItemsInfos selectedItemsInfos;

		private IHitTest prevHitElement;

		private object previousAdditionalHitObject;

		protected Chart Chart { get; }

		internal SeriesSelectionMode ActualSeriesSelectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Chart.ChartContainer.DesignMode)
				{
					return seriesSelectionMode;
				}
				return SeriesSelectionMode.Series;
			}
		}

		public ElementSelectionMode ElementSelectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return elementSelectionMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (elementSelectionMode != value)
				{
					elementSelectionMode = value;
					Chart.ClearCache();
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesSelectionMode SeriesSelectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesSelectionMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (seriesSelectionMode != value)
				{
					seriesSelectionMode = value;
					Chart.ClearCache();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual IList SelectedItems => selectedItems;

		public SelectedItemsInfos SelectedItemsInfos => selectedItemsInfos;

		public SelectionController(Chart chart)
		{
			Chart = chart;
			selectedItems = new SelectedItemCollection(this);
			selectedItemsInfos = new SelectedItemsInfos();
			internalSelectedItems = new List<IHitTest>();
			lastSelectOperations = new List<SelectedItemsChangedAction>();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeElementSelectionMode()
		{
			return elementSelectionMode != ElementSelectionMode.None;
		}

		public void ResetElementSelectionMode()
		{
			ElementSelectionMode = ElementSelectionMode.None;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeSeriesSelectionMode()
		{
			return seriesSelectionMode != SeriesSelectionMode.Series;
		}

		public void ResetSeriesSelectionMode()
		{
			SeriesSelectionMode = SeriesSelectionMode.Series;
		}

		private bool CalculateItemsSelection(IList<object> itemsToSelect)
		{
			foreach (object item in itemsToSelect)
			{
				if (ContainsInSelectedItems(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SelectionAction CalculateSelectionAction(ElementSelectionMode selectionMode, ElementsSelectionState state, bool isItemSelected, bool forceSelect)
		{
			if (Chart.ChartContainer.DesignMode)
			{
				return state.CalculateDesignModeSelectionAction();
			}
			switch (selectionMode)
			{
			case ElementSelectionMode.Single:
				return state.CalculateSelectionActionSingleMode(isItemSelected);
			case ElementSelectionMode.Multiple:
				return state.CalculateSelectionActionMultipleMode(isItemSelected);
			case ElementSelectionMode.Extended:
				return state.CalculateSelectionActionExtendedMode(isItemSelected);
			default:
				if (!forceSelect)
				{
					return SelectionAction.None;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Add;
			}
		}

		private RefinedPoint FindRefinedPoint(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			ISeries series = FindSeriesByPoint(seriesPoint);
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = Chart.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(series);
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
				{
					if (point.SeriesPoint == seriesPoint)
					{
						return point;
					}
					if (point.Children == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (RefinedPoint child in point.Children)
					{
						if (child.SeriesPoint == seriesPoint)
						{
							return child;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<object> FindFinalRefinedPoints(object point)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = null;
			if (point is ISeriesPoint)
			{
				refinedPoint = FindRefinedPoint((ISeriesPoint)point);
			}
			else if (point is RefinedPoint)
			{
				refinedPoint = point as RefinedPoint;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				ViewController viewController = Chart.ViewController;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(refinedPoint.Argument, 0.0);
				if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint)
				{
					foreach (RefinedSeries item in viewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
					{
						SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPointsSortedByArgument = item.FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
						int num = finalPointsSortedByArgument.BinarySearch(refinedPoint2);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							list.Add(finalPointsSortedByArgument[num]);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in viewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
					{
						List<RefinedPoint> list2 = ((IRefinedSeries)item2).FindAllPointsWithSameArgument(refinedPoint2);
						if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
						{
							list.AddRange(list2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<object> FindFinalRefinedPointsByArgument(double argument)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			ViewController viewController = Chart.ViewController;
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in viewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				List<RefinedPoint> list2 = ((IRefinedSeries)item).FindAllPointsWithSameArgument(refinedPoint);
				if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(list2);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<object> GetSeriesPoints(object point)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = null;
			if (point is ISeriesPoint)
			{
				seriesPoint = (ISeriesPoint)point;
			}
			else if (point is RefinedPoint)
			{
				seriesPoint = ((RefinedPoint)point).SeriesPoint;
			}
			if (seriesPoint is SeriesPoint { SourcePoints: not null } seriesPoint2 && seriesPoint2.SourcePoints.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint sourcePoint in seriesPoint2.SourcePoints)
				{
					list.Add(GetSelectedItem(sourcePoint));
				}
			}
			else if (seriesPoint is SeriesPoint)
			{
				object selectedItem = GetSelectedItem((SeriesPoint)seriesPoint);
				if (selectedItem is TagList)
				{
					((TagList)selectedItem).CopyTo(list);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(selectedItem);
				}
			}
			else if (seriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint)
			{
				AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint = seriesPoint as AggregatedSeriesPoint;
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint2 in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper((Series)aggregatedSeriesPoint.Series);
					list.Add(GetSelectedItem(dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(sourcePoint2)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private object GetSelectedItem(SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint.Tag == null)
			{
				return seriesPoint;
			}
			return seriesPoint.Tag;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedItems(SelectionAction action, IList<object> itemsToSelect)
		{
			selectedItems.LockUpdates();
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			switch (action)
			{
			case SelectionAction.Replace:
				foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
				{
					list2.Add(selectedItem);
				}
				foreach (object item in itemsToSelect)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				if (!OnSelectionChanging(action, list, list2))
				{
					break;
				}
				selectedItems.Clear();
				internalSelectedItems.Clear();
				foreach (object item2 in list)
				{
					if (!ContainsInSelectedItems(item2))
					{
						SelectedItems.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				OnSelectionChanged(action, list, list2);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.Add:
				foreach (object item3 in itemsToSelect)
				{
					if (!ContainsInSelectedItems(item3))
					{
						list.Add(item3);
					}
				}
				if (!OnSelectionChanging(action, list, list2))
				{
					break;
				}
				foreach (object item4 in list)
				{
					SelectedItems.Add(item4);
				}
				OnSelectionChanged(action, list, list2);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.Remove:
				foreach (object item5 in itemsToSelect)
				{
					if (selectedItems.Contains(item5))
					{
						list2.Add(item5);
					}
				}
				if (!OnSelectionChanging(action, list, list2))
				{
					break;
				}
				foreach (object item6 in list2)
				{
					selectedItems.Remove(item6);
				}
				OnSelectionChanged(action, list, list2);
				break;
			}
			selectedItems.UnlockUpdates();
		}

		private bool OnSelectionChanging(SelectionAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems)
		{
			SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs((SelectedItemsChangedAction)action, newItems, oldItems);
			Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnSelectedItemsChanging(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		private void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems)
		{
			SelectedItemsChangedEventArgs e = new SelectedItemsChangedEventArgs((SelectedItemsChangedAction)action, newItems, oldItems);
			Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnSelectedItemsChanged(e);
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionHitStates(SelectionAction action, IEnumerable itemsToSelect)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case SelectionAction.Replace:
				UndoSelectAll(leaveSeriesSelection: false, clearHot: false);
				{
					foreach (object item in itemsToSelect)
					{
						ChangeSelectionState(item, needSelect: true);
					}
					break;
				}
			case SelectionAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object item2 in itemsToSelect)
				{
					ChangeSelectionState(item2, needSelect: true);
				}
				break;
			}
			case SelectionAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (object item3 in itemsToSelect)
				{
					ChangeSelectionState(item3, needSelect: false);
				}
				break;
			}
			case SelectionAction.Reset:
				UndoSelectAll(leaveSeriesSelection: false, clearHot: false);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.None:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHighlightingHitStates(IEnumerable<object> itemsToSelect)
		{
			foreach (object item in itemsToSelect)
			{
				ChangeHighlightingState(item);
			}
		}

		private ISeriesPoint ConvertToSeriesPoint(object pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem is RefinedPoint)
			{
				return ((RefinedPoint)pointItem).SeriesPoint;
			}
			return pointItem as ISeriesPoint;
		}

		private ISeries FindSeriesByPoint(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			return seriesPoint?.Owner;
		}

		private void ChangeHighlightingState(object item)
		{
			if (item is ISeriesBase)
			{
				((IHitTest)item).State.DoEnter(null);
				return;
			}
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = ConvertToSeriesPoint(item);
			ISeries series = FindSeriesByPoint(seriesPoint);
			if (series != null)
			{
				((IHitTest)series).State.DoEnter(seriesPoint);
			}
		}

		private void ChangeDrillDownHighlightingState(object item)
		{
			if (item is ISeriesBase)
			{
				((IHitTest)item).State.DoDrillDownEnter(null);
				return;
			}
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = ConvertToSeriesPoint(item);
			ISeries series = FindSeriesByPoint(seriesPoint);
			if (series != null)
			{
				((IHitTest)series).State.DoDrillDownEnter(seriesPoint);
			}
		}

		private void ChangeSelectionState(object item, bool needSelect)
		{
			if (item is ISeriesBase)
			{
				if (needSelect)
				{
					((IHitTest)item).State.DoSelect(item, setMasterSelection: true);
				}
				else
				{
					((IHitTest)item).State.UndoSelect(item, clearHot: false);
				}
				return;
			}
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = ConvertToSeriesPoint(item);
			ISeries series = FindSeriesByPoint(seriesPoint);
			HitTestState hitTestState = null;
			if (series != null)
			{
				hitTestState = ((IHitTest)series).State;
			}
			if (hitTestState != null)
			{
				if (needSelect)
				{
					hitTestState.DoSelect(seriesPoint, setMasterSelection: true);
				}
				else
				{
					hitTestState.UndoSelect(seriesPoint, clearHot: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UndoSelectAll(bool leaveSeriesSelection, bool clearHot)
		{
			foreach (IHitTest item in (IEnumerable)new ChartHitTestEnumerator(Chart))
			{
				if (!leaveSeriesSelection || (!(item is ISeriesBase) && !(item is ISeriesPoint) && !(item is RefinedPoint)))
				{
					item.State.UndoSelect(clearHot);
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<object> GetItemsForChangeHitState(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			switch (ActualSeriesSelectionMode)
			{
			case SeriesSelectionMode.Series:
				list.Add(hitElement);
				break;
			case SeriesSelectionMode.Point:
				if (additionalHitObject != null)
				{
					list.Add(additionalHitObject);
				}
				break;
			case SeriesSelectionMode.Argument:
				if (additionalHitObject != null)
				{
					return FindFinalRefinedPoints(additionalHitObject);
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<object> GetItemsForChangeDrillDownHitState(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			if (hitElement is AxisLabelItem)
			{
				return FindFinalRefinedPointsByArgument(((AxisLabelItem)hitElement).AxisValueInternal);
			}
			if (hitElement is Series)
			{
				if (additionalHitObject == null)
				{
					list.Add(hitElement);
				}
				else if (Chart.DataContainer.CanDrillDownToPoint)
				{
					list.Add(additionalHitObject);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(hitElement);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<object> GetItemsForChangeSelection(IList<object> itemsToChangeHitState)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			if (itemsToChangeHitState != null && itemsToChangeHitState.Count > 0)
			{
				switch (ActualSeriesSelectionMode)
				{
				case SeriesSelectionMode.Series:
					list.Add(itemsToChangeHitState[0]);
					break;
				case SeriesSelectionMode.Point:
					list.AddRange(GetSeriesPoints(itemsToChangeHitState[0]));
					break;
				case SeriesSelectionMode.Argument:
					foreach (RefinedPoint item in itemsToChangeHitState)
					{
						list.AddRange(GetSeriesPoints(item));
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void SyncSelectedItemsWithHitTestState()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				object obj = FindItemForChangeHitTestState(selectedItem);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					list.Add(obj);
				}
			}
			UpdateSelectionHitStates(SelectionAction.Replace, list);
		}

		private void SyncInternalSelectedItemsWithHitTestState()
		{
			foreach (IHitTest internalSelectedItem in internalSelectedItems)
			{
				internalSelectedItem.State.DoSelect(internalSelectedItem, setMasterSelection: true);
			}
		}

		private object FindItemForChangeHitTestState(object item)
		{
			if (item is Series)
			{
				return item;
			}
			if (selectedItemsCache.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				return selectedItemsCache[item];
			}
			if (item is SeriesPoint)
			{
				return FindPointForSeriesPoint((SeriesPoint)item);
			}
			if (!(item is ChartElement))
			{
				return FindPointForUserObject(item);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsAggregationEnabled(IScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions)
		{
			if (scaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return scaleOptions.AggregateFunction != AggregateFunctionNative.None;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAggregationEnabled(Series series)
		{
			if (series != null && series.View is IXYSeriesView)
			{
				IAxisData axisXData = ((IXYSeriesView)series.View).AxisXData;
				if (axisXData != null)
				{
					switch (axisXData.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType)
					{
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
						if (IsAggregationEnabled(axisXData.NumericScaleOptions))
						{
							return !double.IsNaN(axisXData.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit);
						}
						return false;
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
						return IsAggregationEnabled(axisXData.DateTimeScaleOptions);
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
						return IsAggregationEnabled(axisXData.TimeSpanScaleOptions);
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ISeriesPoint FindPointForSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			Series series = seriesPoint.Series;
			if (!IsAggregationEnabled(series))
			{
				return seriesPoint;
			}
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = Chart.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(series);
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
				{
					if (point.SeriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint)
					{
						foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
						{
							if ((SeriesPoint)sourcePoint.SeriesPoint == seriesPoint)
							{
								return aggregatedSeriesPoint;
							}
						}
					}
					else if ((SeriesPoint)point.SeriesPoint == seriesPoint)
					{
						return point.SeriesPoint;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ISeriesPoint FindPointForUserObject(object userObject)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in Chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in ((IRefinedSeries)item).Points)
				{
					if (point.SeriesPoint is SeriesPoint)
					{
						SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)point.SeriesPoint;
						if (TagList.ContainsTag(seriesPoint.Tag, userObject) || seriesPoint.Tag == userObject)
						{
							return seriesPoint;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(point.SeriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
						{
							DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper((Series)aggregatedSeriesPoint.Series);
							object tag = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(sourcePoint).Tag;
							if (TagList.ContainsTag(tag, userObject) || tag == userObject)
							{
								return aggregatedSeriesPoint;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SelectedItemsChangedAction GetActualSelectionAction()
		{
			int count = lastSelectOperations.Count;
			if (count == 1)
			{
				return lastSelectOperations[0];
			}
			if (lastSelectOperations[count - 1] == SelectedItemsChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				return SelectedItemsChangedAction.Reset;
			}
			SelectedItemsChangedAction selectedItemsChangedAction = lastSelectOperations[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (lastSelectOperations[i] != selectedItemsChangedAction)
				{
					return SelectedItemsChangedAction.Replace;
				}
			}
			return selectedItemsChangedAction;
		}

		protected virtual bool ContainsInSelectedItems(object itemToSelect)
		{
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				if (selectedItem == itemToSelect)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (selectedItem is SeriesPoint seriesPoint && (seriesPoint.Tag == itemToSelect || TagList.ContainsTag(seriesPoint.Tag, itemToSelect)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (itemToSelect is SeriesPoint seriesPoint2 && (seriesPoint2.Tag == selectedItem || TagList.ContainsTag(seriesPoint2.Tag, selectedItem)))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void SelectHitElementInternalBase(IList<object> itemsToSelect, bool forceSelect, ElementsSelectionState state)
		{
			SelectionAction action = CalculateSelectionAction(Chart.SelectionMode, state, CalculateItemsSelection(itemsToSelect), forceSelect);
			UpdateSelectedItems(action, itemsToSelect);
			OnSelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		internal virtual void SelectHitElementInternal(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject, bool forceSelect, ElementsSelectionState state, ChartFocusedArea focusedArea)
		{
			if (!forceSelect && !Chart.ContainerAdapter.SelectionEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (hitElement is ISeriesBase)
			{
				RestoreSelectedItems();
				UndoSelectAll(leaveSeriesSelection: true, clearHot: true);
				IList<object> itemsForChangeHitState = GetItemsForChangeHitState(hitElement, additionalHitObject);
				IList<object> itemsForChangeSelection = GetItemsForChangeSelection(itemsForChangeHitState);
				SelectHitElementInternalBase(itemsForChangeSelection, forceSelect, state);
				return;
			}
			if (hitElement is Legend { CheckBoxesVisible: not false } && focusedArea != null && focusedArea.Element is LegendItemViewData)
			{
				UpdateSelectedItemsForLegend();
				return;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(selectedItems.Count);
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				list.Add(selectedItem);
			}
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			if (additionalHitObject != null)
			{
				list2.Add(additionalHitObject);
			}
			if (OnSelectionChanging(SelectionAction.Reset, list2, list))
			{
				selectedItems.Clear();
				internalSelectedItems.Clear();
				new ChartHitTestEnumerator(Chart).UndoSelect(hitElement, clearHot: true);
				if (hitElement != null)
				{
					hitElement.State.DoSelect(additionalHitObject, setMasterSelection: true);
					internalSelectedItems.Add(hitElement);
				}
				OnSelectionChanged(SelectionAction.Reset, list2, list);
				OnSelectedItemsChanged();
			}
		}

		public void RaiseSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			if (lastSelectOperations.Count > 0)
			{
				SelectedItemsChangedEventArgs e = new SelectedItemsChangedEventArgs(GetActualSelectionAction(), selectedItems, oldItems);
				Chart.ContainerAdapter.OnSelectedItemsChanged(e);
			}
			lastSelectOperations.Clear();
			oldItems.Clear();
		}

		public void FillSelectedItemInfos()
		{
			selectedItemsInfos.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < Chart.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = Chart.Series[i];
				foreach (object selectedObject in series.HitState.SelectedObjects)
				{
					if (selectedObject is ISeries)
					{
						((IList)selectedItemsInfos).Add((object)new SelectedItemInfo(i));
					}
					else if (selectedObject is SeriesPoint)
					{
						IEnumerable<IDataPoint> source = new DataAdapterHelper(series).CreateSeriesPoints(series.ActualPoints);
						int num = source.ToList().IndexOf((SeriesPoint)selectedObject);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							((IList)selectedItemsInfos).Add((object)new SelectedItemInfo(i, num));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(selectedObject is AggregatedSeriesPoint))
						{
							continue;
						}
						AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint = selectedObject as AggregatedSeriesPoint;
						foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
						{
							int num2 = series.ActualPoints.IndexOf((SeriesPoint)sourcePoint.SeriesPoint);
							if (num2 >= 0)
							{
								((IList)selectedItemsInfos).Add((object)new SelectedItemInfo(i, num2));
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			Chart.RaiseControlChanged(new SelectionUpdateInfo(this), ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes | ChartElementChange.UpdateIndicators);
		}

		public void OnSelectedItemsChanging(SelectedItemsChangedAction operation)
		{
			if (lastSelectOperations.Count == 0)
			{
				foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
				{
					oldItems.Add(selectedItem);
				}
			}
			lastSelectOperations.Add(operation);
		}

		public void RestoreSelectedItems()
		{
			foreach (SelectedItemInfo selectedItemsInfo in selectedItemsInfos)
			{
				if (selectedItemsInfo.SeriesIndex >= Chart.Series.Count)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Series series = Chart.Series[selectedItemsInfo.SeriesIndex];
				if (selectedItemsInfo.IsSeriesSelection)
				{
					if (!ContainsInSelectedItems(series))
					{
						SelectedItems.Add(series);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (selectedItemsInfo.SeriesPointIndex >= series.ActualPoints.Count)
					{
						continue;
					}
					SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new DataAdapterHelper(series).CreateSeriesPoint(series.ActualPoints[selectedItemsInfo.SeriesPointIndex]);
					if (!ContainsInSelectedItems(seriesPoint))
					{
						object tag = seriesPoint.Tag;
						if (tag is TagList tagList)
						{
							tagList.CopyTo(selectedItems);
						}
						else
						{
							SelectedItems.Add((tag == null) ? seriesPoint : tag);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSelectedItemsForLegend()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				if (selectedItem is Series { ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram: false } series)
				{
					list.Add(series);
					break;
				}
				if (selectedItem is SeriesPoint { Series: not null } seriesPoint && !seriesPoint.Series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
				{
					list.Add(seriesPoint);
				}
			}
			if (!OnSelectionChanging(SelectionAction.Reset, new List<object>(), list))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				selectedItems.Remove(item);
			}
			OnSelectionChanged(SelectionAction.Reset, new List<object>(), list);
		}

		public void SelectHitElementInternal(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject, bool forceSelect, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SelectHitElementInternal(hitElement, additionalHitObject, forceSelect, modifierKeys, null);
		}

		public void SelectHitElementInternal(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject, bool forceSelect, PortableKeys modifierKeys, ChartFocusedArea focusedArea)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SelectHitElementInternal(hitElement, additionalHitObject, forceSelect, (ElementsSelectionState)new DefaultElementsSelectionState(modifierKeys), focusedArea);
		}

		public void SelectSeries(List<object> itemsToSelect)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>(selectedItems.Count);
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				list.Add(selectedItem);
			}
			if (OnSelectionChanging(SelectionAction.Replace, itemsToSelect, list))
			{
				UndoSelectAll(leaveSeriesSelection: true, clearHot: true);
				selectedItems.Clear();
				internalSelectedItems.Clear();
				selectedItems.LockUpdates();
				foreach (object item in itemsToSelect)
				{
					if (!ContainsInSelectedItems(item))
					{
						SelectedItems.Add(item);
					}
				}
				selectedItems.UnlockUpdates();
			}
			OnSelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		public void SelectPoints(List<object> itemsToSelect)
		{
			selectedItemsCache.Clear();
			List<object> list = new List<object>(selectedItems.Count);
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				list.Add(selectedItem);
			}
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>(itemsToSelect.Count);
			foreach (object item in itemsToSelect)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = null;
				if (item is SeriesPoint)
				{
					seriesPoint = FindPointForSeriesPoint((SeriesPoint)item);
				}
				else if (item is RefinedPoint)
				{
					seriesPoint = ((RefinedPoint)item).SeriesPoint;
				}
				else if (!(item is ChartElement))
				{
					seriesPoint = FindPointForUserObject(item);
				}
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				List<object> list3 = new List<object>();
				if (ActualSeriesSelectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Argument)
				{
					List<object> list4 = FindFinalRefinedPoints(seriesPoint);
					foreach (RefinedPoint item2 in list4)
					{
						list3.AddRange(GetSeriesPoints(item2));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list3.AddRange(GetSeriesPoints(seriesPoint));
				}
				foreach (object item3 in list3)
				{
					if (!selectedItemsCache.ContainsKey(item3))
					{
						selectedItemsCache.Add(item3, seriesPoint);
					}
				}
				list2.AddRange(list3);
			}
			if (OnSelectionChanging(SelectionAction.Replace, list2, list))
			{
				UndoSelectAll(leaveSeriesSelection: true, clearHot: true);
				selectedItems.Clear();
				internalSelectedItems.Clear();
				selectedItems.LockUpdates();
				foreach (object item4 in list2)
				{
					if (!ContainsInSelectedItems(item4))
					{
						SelectedItems.Add(item4);
					}
				}
				selectedItems.UnlockUpdates();
			}
			OnSelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		public void HotHitElementInternal(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			new ChartHitTestEnumerator(Chart).DoLeave(hitElement);
			if (hitElement != null && !hitElement.CanBeHot)
			{
				if (Chart.SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.None && prevHitElement != hitElement)
				{
					Chart.ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
					prevHitElement = hitElement;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (hitElement is ISeriesBase)
			{
				IList<object> itemsForChangeHitState = GetItemsForChangeHitState(hitElement, additionalHitObject);
				UpdateHighlightingHitStates(itemsForChangeHitState);
			}
			else
			{
				hitElement?.State.DoEnter(additionalHitObject);
			}
			if (prevHitElement != hitElement || previousAdditionalHitObject != additionalHitObject)
			{
				Chart.ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
				prevHitElement = hitElement;
				previousAdditionalHitObject = additionalHitObject;
			}
		}

		public void DrillDownHotElement(IHitTest hitElement, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			new ChartHitTestEnumerator(Chart).DoLeave(hitElement);
			IList<object> itemsForChangeDrillDownHitState = GetItemsForChangeDrillDownHitState(hitElement, additionalHitObject);
			foreach (object item in itemsForChangeDrillDownHitState)
			{
				ChangeDrillDownHighlightingState(item);
			}
			Chart.ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
		}

		public void SyncSelectionStates()
		{
			SyncSelectedItemsWithHitTestState();
			SyncInternalSelectedItemsWithHitTestState();
		}

		public void ClearSelection(bool clearHot)
		{
			selectedItemsCache.Clear();
			UndoSelectAll(leaveSeriesSelection: false, clearHot);
			selectedItems.LockUpdates();
			selectedItems.Clear();
			internalSelectedItems.Clear();
			selectedItems.UnlockUpdates();
			OnSelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		public void SetObjectSelection(object obj, bool forceSelect, Action<IHitTest, object, bool> action)
		{
			if ((SeriesSelectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series || !(obj is Series)) && (SeriesSelectionMode != SeriesSelectionMode.Series || !(obj is SeriesPoint)))
			{
				if (obj is IHitTest arg)
				{
					action(arg, null, forceSelect);
				}
				else if (obj is SeriesPoint { Series: not null } seriesPoint)
				{
					action(seriesPoint.Series, seriesPoint, forceSelect);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ReplaceSelectedItems(params object[] items)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>(items.Length);
			if (SeriesSelectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series)
			{
				foreach (object obj in items)
				{
					if (obj is Series item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				SelectSeries(list);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (object item2 in items)
				{
					list.Add(item2);
				}
				SelectPoints(list);
			}
		}

		public void Assign(SelectionController selectionController)
		{
			selectedItemsCache.Clear();
			selectedItemsInfos = new SelectedItemsInfos();
			foreach (object selectedItemsInfo in selectionController.selectedItemsInfos)
			{
				((IList)selectedItemsInfos).Add(selectedItemsInfo);
			}
			RestoreSelectedItems();
		}
	}

		public HeatmapSelectionController(HeatmapChart heatmap)
			: base(heatmap)

		}

		private object GetTag(object item)
		{
			return (item as HeatmapCell)?.Tag ?? item;
		}

		protected override bool ContainsInSelectedItems(object itemToSelect)
		{
			return SelectedItems.Contains(itemToSelect);
		}

		internal void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (object selectedItem in SelectedItems)
			{
				renderer.FillRectangle(GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(Heatmap.HitTestController.HeatmapGeometry.GetCellBounds(Heatmap.DataController.GetCellIndexByTag(selectedItem))), HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal, HatchColor);

			}

	public class SelectedItemCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		private readonly SelectionController controller;

		private bool lockUpdates;

		internal SelectedItemCollection(SelectionController controller)
		{
			this.controller = controller;
		}

		private void SelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			if (!lockUpdates)
			{
				controller.OnSelectedItemsChanged();
			}
		}

		private void SelectedItemsChanging(SelectedItemsChangedAction operation)
		{
			if (!lockUpdates)
			{
				controller.OnSelectedItemsChanging(operation);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsertComplete(index, value);
			SelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnInsert(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsert(index, value);
			SelectedItemsChanging(SelectedItemsChangedAction.Add);
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemoveComplete(index, value);
			SelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemove(index, value);
			SelectedItemsChanging(SelectedItemsChangedAction.Remove);
		}

		protected override void OnClearComplete()
		{
			base.OnClearComplete();
			SelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			base.OnClear();
			SelectedItemsChanging(SelectedItemsChangedAction.Reset);
		}

		internal bool Remove(object item)
		{
			if (base.List.Contains(item))
			{
				base.List.Remove(item);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Contains(object item)
		{
			return base.List.Contains(item);
		}

		internal void LockUpdates()
		{
			lockUpdates = true;
		}

		internal void UnlockUpdates()
		{
			lockUpdates = false;
		}
	}
	public class ElementsSelectionState
	{
		public ISelectionBindings SelectionBindings { get; }

		public PortableKeys ModifierKeys { get; }

		public PortableMouseButtons PressedButton { get; }

		public ElementsSelectionState(ISelectionBindings selectionBindings, PortableKeys modifierKeys, PortableMouseButtons pressedButton)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SelectionBindings = selectionBindings;
			ModifierKeys = modifierKeys;
			PressedButton = pressedButton;
		}

		public SelectionAction CalculateDesignModeSelectionAction()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((PressedButton & 0x200000) > 0)
			{
				return SelectionAction.None;
			}
			return SelectionAction.Replace;
		}

		public virtual SelectionAction CalculateSelectionActionSingleMode(bool isItemSelected)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (isItemSelected || !ChartNavigationControllerBase.CheckAction(SelectionBindings.MouseAction, ModifierKeys, PressedButton))
			{
				return SelectionAction.None;
			}
			return SelectionAction.Replace;
		}

		public virtual SelectionAction CalculateSelectionActionMultipleMode(bool isItemSelected)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ChartNavigationControllerBase.CheckAction(SelectionBindings.MouseAction, ModifierKeys, PressedButton))
			{
				return SelectionAction.None;
			}
			if (!isItemSelected)
			{
				return SelectionAction.Add;
			}
			return SelectionAction.Remove;
		}

		public virtual SelectionAction CalculateSelectionActionExtendedMode(bool isItemSelected)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ChartNavigationControllerBase.CheckAction(SelectionBindings.MouseAction, ModifierKeys, PressedButton))
			{
				return SelectionAction.Replace;
			}
			if (ChartNavigationControllerBase.CheckAction(SelectionBindings.ExtendedModeMouseAction, ModifierKeys, PressedButton))
			{
				if (!isItemSelected)
				{
					return SelectionAction.Add;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Remove;
			}
			return SelectionAction.None;
		}
	}

			if ((int)base.ModifierKeys == 131072)
			{
				if (!isItemSelected)
				{
					return SelectionAction.Add;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Remove;

			if ((int)base.ModifierKeys == 0)

		}
