	public abstract class ConnectorPainterBase
	{
		private readonly DiagramPoint startPoint;

		private readonly ZPlaneRectangle bounds;

		private DiagramPoint finishPoint;

		public DiagramPoint StartPoint => startPoint;

		protected DiagramPoint FinishPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return finishPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				finishPoint = value;
			}
		}

		protected ZPlaneRectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public ConnectorPainterBase(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			this.startPoint = startPoint;
			this.finishPoint = finishPoint;
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		protected abstract void Calculate();

		public abstract void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, double opacity);

		public abstract void FillPrimitives(ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, PrimitivesContainer container);

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy)
		{
			if (bounds != null)
			{
				bounds.Offset(dx, dy, 0.0);
			}
			finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset(finishPoint, dx, dy, 0.0);
			Calculate();
		}
	}
	public class LineConnectorPainter : ConnectorPainterBase
	{
		private enum RelativeLocation
		{
			LessThan,
			Center,
			GreaterThan
		}

		private readonly bool flat;

		private double angle;

		protected double Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return angle;
			}
			set
			{
				angle = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool Flat => flat;

		public LineConnectorPainter(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, double angle, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, bool flat)
			: base(startPoint, finishPoint, bounds)
		{
			this.angle = angle;
			this.flat = flat;
		}

		protected void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double angle, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle = label.LineStyle;
			Color color2 = label.GetActualConnectorColor(color);
			if (opacity < 1.0)
			{
				color2 = HitTestColors.MixAlphaChanel(color2, (byte)(opacity * 255.0));
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = DiagramPoint.Round(p1);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = DiagramPoint.Round(p2);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(double.IsNaN(angle) || !MathUtils.IsAngleNormal(angle));
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2, color2, lineStyle.Thickness, lineStyle, LineCap.Round);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		protected virtual DiagramPoint GetCalculationPoint()
		{
			return base.StartPoint;
		}

		protected override void Calculate()
		{
			if (flat)
			{
				DiagramPoint calculationPoint = GetCalculationPoint();
				RelativeLocation relativeLocation = ((calculationPoint.X >= base.Bounds.RightCenter.X) ? RelativeLocation.GreaterThan : ((!(calculationPoint.X <= base.Bounds.LeftCenter.X)) ? RelativeLocation.Center : RelativeLocation.LessThan));
				RelativeLocation relativeLocation2 = ((calculationPoint.Y >= base.Bounds.TopCenter.Y) ? RelativeLocation.GreaterThan : ((!(calculationPoint.Y <= base.Bounds.BottomCenter.Y)) ? RelativeLocation.Center : RelativeLocation.LessThan));
				if (relativeLocation == RelativeLocation.Center && relativeLocation2 == RelativeLocation.Center)
				{
					base.FinishPoint = DiagramPoint.StrongRound(base.StartPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					base.FinishPoint = DiagramPoint.StrongRound(new DiagramPoint(relativeLocation switch
					{
						RelativeLocation.GreaterThan => base.Bounds.RightCenter.X - 1.0, 
						RelativeLocation.LessThan => base.Bounds.LeftCenter.X, 
						_ => base.Bounds.Center.X, 
					}, relativeLocation2 switch
					{
						RelativeLocation.GreaterThan => base.Bounds.TopCenter.Y - 1.0, 
						RelativeLocation.LessThan => base.Bounds.BottomCenter.Y, 
						_ => base.Bounds.Center.Y, 
					}));
				}
				angle = Math.Atan2(base.StartPoint.Y - base.FinishPoint.Y, base.FinishPoint.X - base.StartPoint.X);
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			if (flat)
			{
				Render(renderer, base.StartPoint, base.FinishPoint, angle, label, color, opacity);
			}
		}

		public override void FillPrimitives(ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			if (!flat)
			{
				Color actualConnectorColor = label.GetActualConnectorColor(color);
				DiagramPoint p = DiagramPoint.StrongRound(base.StartPoint);
				DiagramPoint p2 = DiagramPoint.StrongRound(base.FinishPoint);
				Line line = new Line(p, p2, sameNormals: true, sameColors: true, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), actualConnectorColor, LineCap.Round);
				label.LineStyle.SetLineStyle(line);
				container.Add(new Line[1] { line }, null);
			}
		}
	}
	public class OriginBaseLineConnectorPainter : LineConnectorPainter
	{
		private DiagramPoint origin;

		public OriginBaseLineConnectorPainter(DiagramPoint origin, DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, double angle, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, bool flat)
			: base(startPoint, finishPoint, angle, bounds, flat)
		{
			this.origin = origin;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint GetCalculationPoint()
		{
			return origin;
		}
	}
	public class BrokenLineConnectorPainter : LineConnectorPainter
	{
		private DiagramPoint? middlePoint;

		private double startAngle;

		public double StartAngle => startAngle;

		public BrokenLineConnectorPainter(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint? middlePoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, double angle)
			: base(startPoint, finishPoint, angle, null, flat: true)
		{
			this.middlePoint = middlePoint;
			startAngle = angle;
		}

		protected override void Calculate()
		{
			if (!base.Flat)
			{
				return;
			}
			DiagramPoint p = base.StartPoint;
			DiagramPoint intersectionPoint;
			switch (IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(p2: new DiagramPoint(p.X + Math.Cos(startAngle), p.Y - Math.Sin(startAngle)), p1: p, p3: base.FinishPoint, p4: DiagramPoint.Offset(base.FinishPoint, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0), intervalMode: false, epsilon: 1E-05, intersectionPoint: out intersectionPoint))
			{
			case Intersection.Yes:
				if ((intersectionPoint.X >= base.StartPoint.X && intersectionPoint.X < base.FinishPoint.X) || (intersectionPoint.X <= base.StartPoint.X && intersectionPoint.X > base.FinishPoint.X))
				{
					middlePoint = intersectionPoint;
					break;
				}
				goto case Intersection.No;
			case Intersection.No:
			case Intersection.Match:
				middlePoint = null;
				base.Angle = Math.Atan2(base.StartPoint.Y - base.FinishPoint.Y, base.FinishPoint.X - base.StartPoint.X);
				break;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			if (base.Flat)
			{
				if (!middlePoint.HasValue)
				{
					Render(renderer, base.StartPoint, base.FinishPoint, base.Angle, label, color, opacity);
					return;
				}
				Render(renderer, base.StartPoint, middlePoint.Value, base.Angle, label, color, opacity);
				Render(renderer, middlePoint.Value, base.FinishPoint, 0.0, label, color, opacity);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class BoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator
	{
		private const int indent = 3;

		private List<RefinedPointData> filteredPointsData;

		private Rectangle labelBounds;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		private FunnelSeriesLabel label;

		private float heightOfPolygon;

		private float currentY;

		private bool alignToCenter;

		private bool isAutoSize;

		private int actualPointDistance;

		public BoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(List<RefinedPointData> filteredPointsData, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle labelBounds, FunnelSeriesLabel label)
		{
			this.filteredPointsData = filteredPointsData;
			this.labelBounds = labelBounds;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.label = label;
			currentY = bounds.Top;
			FunnelSeriesView funnelSeriesView = (FunnelSeriesView)label.View;
			heightOfPolygon = funnelSeriesView.CalculateHeightOfPolygon(bounds.Height, filteredPointsData, out actualPointDistance, out var _, out var _);
			actualPointDistance = funnelSeriesView.PointDistance;
			alignToCenter = funnelSeriesView.AlignToCenter;
			isAutoSize = funnelSeriesView.HeightToWidthRatioAuto;
		}

		private void CalcAdditionalLengthForTopPolygon(RefinedPointData seriesPointData, double normalValue, double upNormalValue, float halfOfLabelHeight)
		{
			if (halfOfLabelHeight <= (float)actualPointDistance)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = currentY - halfOfLabelHeight;
			int num2 = bounds.Width / 2;
			float num3 = (float)num2 + GetWidth((float)((double)bounds.Width * normalValue / 2.0 + (double)label.LineLength));
			float num4 = (float)num2 + GetWidth((float)((double)bounds.Width * normalValue / 2.0));
			float num5 = (float)num2 + GetWidth((float)((double)bounds.Width * upNormalValue / 2.0));
			float num6 = currentY - (float)actualPointDistance;
			float num7 = num6 - heightOfPolygon;
			float num8 = (num6 - currentY) / (num7 - currentY) * (num5 - num4) + num4;
			float num9 = (num3 - num8) / (num5 - num8) * (num7 - num6) + num6;
			if (num < num9 && IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(num3, num8, num5))
			{
				float num10 = (num - num6) / (num7 - num6) * (num5 - num8) + num8;
				if (!IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(num10, num8, num5))
				{
					num10 = GetNewLabelX(num8, num5);
				}
				if (seriesPointData.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength < Math.Abs(num10 - num3))
				{
					seriesPointData.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength = Math.Abs(num10 - num3);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalcAdditionalLengthForBottomPolygon(RefinedPointData pointData, double normalValue, double downNormalValue, float halfOfLabelHeight)
		{
			float num = currentY + halfOfLabelHeight;
			int num2 = bounds.Width / 2;
			float num3 = (float)num2 + GetWidth((float)((double)bounds.Width * normalValue / 2.0 + (double)label.LineLength));
			float num4 = (float)num2 + GetWidth((float)((double)bounds.Width * normalValue / 2.0));
			float num5 = currentY;
			float num6 = currentY + heightOfPolygon;
			float num7 = (float)num2 + GetWidth((float)((double)bounds.Width * downNormalValue / 2.0)) - num4;
			float num8 = num6 + (float)actualPointDistance - num5;
			float num9 = (num6 - num5) / num8 * num7 + num4;
			float num10 = (num3 - num4) / (num9 - num4) * (num6 - num5) + num5;
			if (num > num10 && IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(num3, num4, num9))
			{
				float num11 = (num - num5) / (num6 - num5) * (num9 - num4) + num4;
				if (!IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(num11, num4, num9))
				{
					num11 = GetNewLabelX(num4, num9);
				}
				if (pointData.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength < Math.Abs(num11 - num3))
				{
					pointData.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength = Math.Abs(num11 - num3);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CorrectAdditionalLength(RectangleF correctBounds)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < filteredPointsData.Count; i++)
			{
				IFunnelPoint refinedPoint = filteredPointsData[i].RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = filteredPointsData[i].LabelViewData[0];
				if (seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength != 0f && (double)correctBounds.Width * 0.5 * refinedPoint.NormalizedValue + (double)label.LineLength + (double)seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength > (double)correctBounds.Width * 0.5)
				{
					double num = (double)correctBounds.Width * 0.5 - (double)correctBounds.Width * 0.5 * refinedPoint.NormalizedValue - (double)label.LineLength;
					if (num > 0.0)
					{
						seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength = MathUtils.StrongRound(num);
					}
					else
					{
						seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength = 0f;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private int CalculateAdditionalLength()
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			IFunnelPoint funnelPoint = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < filteredPointsData.Count; i++)
			{
				IFunnelPoint refinedPoint = filteredPointsData[i].RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = filteredPointsData[i].LabelViewData[0];
				int num3 = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize.Height / 2 + label.Border.ActualThickness + 3;
				if (funnelPoint != null)
				{
					CalcAdditionalLengthForTopPolygon(filteredPointsData[i], refinedPoint.NormalizedValue, funnelPoint.NormalizedValue, num3);
				}
				if (i < filteredPointsData.Count - 1)
				{
					IFunnelPoint refinedPoint2 = filteredPointsData[i + 1].RefinedPoint;
					if (refinedPoint2 != null)
					{
						CalcAdditionalLengthForBottomPolygon(filteredPointsData[i], refinedPoint.NormalizedValue, refinedPoint2.NormalizedValue, num3);
					}
				}
				currentY += heightOfPolygon + (float)actualPointDistance;
				if (isAutoSize)
				{
					double num4 = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize.Width + label.Border.ActualThickness * 2 + label.LineLength;
					if (refinedPoint.NormalizedValue * (double)bounds.Width + 2.0 * (num4 + (double)seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength) > (double)bounds.Width)
					{
						num = ((!alignToCenter) ? ((float)(((double)bounds.Width - num4) / ((1.0 + refinedPoint.NormalizedValue) / 2.0 + (double)(seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength / (float)bounds.Width)))) : ((float)(((double)bounds.Width - 2.0 * num4) / (refinedPoint.NormalizedValue + (double)(2f * seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength / (float)bounds.Width)))));
						if (num == 0f)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						if (num < num2 || num2 == 0f)
						{
							num2 = num;
						}
					}
				}
				funnelPoint = refinedPoint;
			}
			return (int)num2;
		}

		private double CorrectInflation(double dx, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, double normalValue)
		{
			double result = dx;
			double num = (double)bounds.Width - 2.0 * dx;
			if (labelViewData.AdditionalLength != 0f && num / 2.0 - num * normalValue / 2.0 < (double)(labelViewData.AdditionalLength + (float)label.LineLength))
			{
				double num2 = labelViewData.TextSize.Width + label.Border.ActualThickness * 2;
				double num3 = (alignToCenter ? ((double)labelBounds.Width - 2.0 * num2) : ((double)labelBounds.Width - num2));
				if (num3 / 2.0 * normalValue + (double)label.LineLength < num3 / 2.0)
				{
					return ((double)bounds.Width - num3) / 2.0;
				}
				double num4 = (alignToCenter ? normalValue : (1.0 + normalValue));
				int num5 = labelBounds.Width / 2;
				int num6 = bounds.Width / 2;
				return (normalValue * (double)num6 + num2 + (double)label.LineLength - (double)num5) / num4;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CalculateParams(out int deltaX, out int offset)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = (double)(labelBounds.Width - bounds.Width) * 0.5;
			for (int i = 0; i < filteredPointsData.Count; i++)
			{
				IFunnelPoint refinedPoint = filteredPointsData[i].RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = filteredPointsData[i].LabelViewData[0];
				double num5 = seriesLabelViewData.TextSize.Width + label.Border.ActualThickness * 2 + label.LineLength;
				int num6 = bounds.Width / 2;
				int num7 = labelBounds.Width / 2;
				double num8 = refinedPoint.NormalizedValue * (double)num6 + num5 + (double)seriesLabelViewData.AdditionalLength - (double)num7;
				if (!alignToCenter)
				{
					double num9 = 0.0;
					double num10 = 0.0;
					if (num8 < num4)
					{
						num9 = num8;
					}
					else
					{
						num10 = (num8 - num4) / (1.0 + refinedPoint.NormalizedValue);
						num10 = CorrectInflation(num10, seriesLabelViewData, refinedPoint.NormalizedValue);
						num9 = num4 + num10;
					}
					if (num9 + num10 > num3)
					{
						num3 = num9 + num10;
						num = num10;
						num2 = num9;
					}
				}
				else if (refinedPoint.NormalizedValue > 0.0)
				{
					num8 /= refinedPoint.NormalizedValue;
					num8 = CorrectInflation(num8, seriesLabelViewData, refinedPoint.NormalizedValue);
					if (num8 > num)
					{
						num = num8;
					}
				}
			}
			deltaX = (int)num;
			offset = (int)num2;
		}

		protected abstract float GetWidth(float width);

		protected abstract bool IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(float labelX, float x1, float x2);

		protected abstract float GetNewLabelX(float x1, float x2);

		protected abstract int GetOffset(int offset);

		public Rectangle CalculateBounds()
		{
			if (heightOfPolygon == 0f)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			if (isAutoSize)
			{
				int num = CalculateAdditionalLength();
				foreach (RefinedPointData filteredPointsDatum in filteredPointsData)
				{
					if (filteredPointsDatum.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength != 0f)
					{
						filteredPointsDatum.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength = filteredPointsDatum.LabelViewData[0].AdditionalLength * (float)num / (float)bounds.Width;
					}
				}
				int num2 = bounds.Width - num;
				if (alignToCenter)
				{
					bounds.Offset(num2 / 2, 0);
					bounds.Width = num;
				}
				else
				{
					if (label.Position == FunnelSeriesLabelPosition.Left)
					{
						bounds.Offset(num2, 0);
					}
					bounds.Width = num;
				}
				return bounds;
			}
			CalculateAdditionalLength();
			CalculateParams(out var deltaX, out var offset);
			bounds.Offset(GetOffset(offset), 0);
			bounds.Inflate(-deltaX, 0);
			CorrectAdditionalLength(bounds);
			return bounds;
		}
	}
	public class RightBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator : BoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator
	{
		public RightBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(List<RefinedPointData> filteredPointsData, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle labelBounds, FunnelSeriesLabel label)
			: base(filteredPointsData, bounds, labelBounds, label)
		{
		}

		protected override float GetWidth(float width)
		{
			return width;
		}

		protected override bool IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(float labelX, float x1, float x2)
		{
			if (!(labelX < x1))
			{
				return labelX < x2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override float GetNewLabelX(float x1, float x2)
		{
			return Math.Max(x1, x2);
		}

		protected override int GetOffset(int offset)
		{
			return -offset;
		}
	}
	public class LeftBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator : BoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator
	{
		public LeftBoundsAndAdditionalLengthCalculator(List<RefinedPointData> filteredPointsData, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle labelBounds, FunnelSeriesLabel label)
			: base(filteredPointsData, bounds, labelBounds, label)
		{
		}

		protected override float GetWidth(float width)
		{
			return 0f - width;
		}

		protected override bool IsLabelXInFunnelPolygon(float labelX, float x1, float x2)
		{
			if (!(labelX > x1))
			{
				return labelX > x2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override float GetNewLabelX(float x1, float x2)
		{
			return Math.Min(x1, x2);
		}

		protected override int GetOffset(int offset)
		{
			return offset;
		}
	}

	[DebuggerDisplay("Text = {Painter.Text}")]
	public class SeriesLabelLayout : IBoundsProvider
	{
		private readonly RefinedPointData pointData;

		private readonly ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label;

		private readonly Color color;

		private readonly TextPainterBase textPainter;

		private readonly ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter;

		private readonly ResolveOverlappingMode resolveOverlappingMode;

		private bool visible = true;

		private bool ShouldApplyCorrection
		{
			get
			{
				if (resolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None)
				{
					return resolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected Series Series => pointData?.Series;

		protected DiagramPoint? ToolTipRelativePosition => pointData?.ToolTipRelativePosition;

		protected ResolveOverlappingMode OverlappingMode => resolveOverlappingMode;

		public ISeriesPoint Point => pointData?.SeriesPoint;

		public TextPainterBase Painter => textPainter;

		public ConnectorPainterBase ConnectorPainter => connectorPainter;

		public RectangleF Bounds => textPainter.Bounds;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
			}
		}

		public DXRectangle LabelBounds
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle((!(this.textPainter is TextPainter textPainter)) ? this.textPainter.Bounds : textPainter.BoundsWithBorder));
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				int left = ((DXRectangle)(ref value)).Left;
				DXRectangle labelBounds = LabelBounds;
				double dx = left - ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left;
				int top = ((DXRectangle)(ref value)).Top;
				labelBounds = LabelBounds;
				Offset(dx, top - ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top);
			}
		}

		public SeriesLabelLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, Color color, TextPainterBase textPainter, ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter, ResolveOverlappingMode resolveOverlappingMode)
		{
			this.pointData = pointData;
			this.label = label;
			this.color = color;
			this.textPainter = textPainter;
			this.connectorPainter = connectorPainter;
			this.resolveOverlappingMode = resolveOverlappingMode;
		}

		private void Offset(double dx, double dy)
		{
			if (dx != 0.0 || dy != 0.0)
			{
				textPainter.Offset(dx, dy);
				if (connectorPainter != null)
				{
					connectorPainter.Offset(dx, dy);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (ShouldApplyCorrection)
			{
				correction.Update(textPainter.RoundedBounds);
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, double opacity)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				textPainter.RenderWithOffsetIfTextParsed(renderer, hitTestController, null, pointData?.RefinedPoint, color, opacity);
				if (Series != null && Series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled && !(label is StackedBarTotalLabel))
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, textPainter.PropertiesProvider, new ChartFocusedArea(Point, ToolTipRelativePosition), textPainter.GetHitRegion(), force: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, Rectangle clipBounds, double opacity)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				textPainter.Render(renderer, hitTestController, pointData?.RefinedPoint, color, clipBounds, opacity);
				if (Series != null && Series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled)
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, textPainter.PropertiesProvider, new ChartFocusedArea(Point, ToolTipRelativePosition), textPainter.GetHitRegion(), force: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderConnector(ChartRenderer renderer, double opacity)
		{
			if (visible && connectorPainter != null)
			{
				connectorPainter.Render(renderer, label, color, opacity);
			}
		}

		public void FillPrimitives(PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			if (visible && connectorPainter != null)
			{
				connectorPainter.FillPrimitives(label, color, container);
			}
		}

		public bool InBounds(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			if (!bounds.IntersectsWith(Bounds))
			{
				if (ConnectorPainter != null)
				{
					return bounds.Contains((PointF)ConnectorPainter.StartPoint);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IBoundsProvider.IsEnableInBounds(DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ShouldApplyCorrection)
			{
				return InBounds(GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(bounds));
			}
			return false;
		}

		GRealRect2D IBoundsProvider.GetBounds()
		{
			RectangleF bounds = textPainter.Bounds;
			return new GRealRect2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
		}
	}
	public abstract class LabelLayoutListBase : List<SeriesLabelLayout>
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData;

		protected virtual Series Series => seriesData.Series;

		private SeriesViewBase View => Series.View;

		protected RefinedSeriesDataBase SeriesData => seriesData;

		public abstract ResolveOverlappingMode ResolveOverlappingMode { get; }

		public LabelLayoutListBase(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			this.seriesData = seriesData;
		}

		private double GetActualAnimationProgress(int pointIndex)
		{
			AnimationBase actualLabelAnimation = View.ActualLabelAnimation;
			if (actualLabelAnimation == null || !Series.Chart.AnimationInProgress)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return actualLabelAnimation.GetLabelAnimationProgress(View.Chart.AnimationTimeMs, base.Count, pointIndex);
		}

		public void CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesLabelLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Visible)
				{
					current.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderSeriesLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = View.HitTestController;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				base[i].Render(renderer, hitTestController, GetActualAnimationProgress(i));
			}
		}

		public void RenderSeriesLabels(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle clipBounds)
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = View.HitTestController;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				base[i].Render(renderer, hitTestController, clipBounds, GetActualAnimationProgress(i));
			}
		}

		public void RenderSeriesLabelConnectors(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				base[i].RenderConnector(renderer, GetActualAnimationProgress(i));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesLabelLayoutList : LabelLayoutListBase
	{
		public SeriesLabelBase Label => Series.Label;

		public override ResolveOverlappingMode ResolveOverlappingMode => Label.ResolveOverlappingMode;

		public SeriesLabelLayoutList(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
			: base(seriesData)
		{
		}

		protected IEnumerable<RefinedPointData> CollectEdgeLabels(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			RefinedPointData firstPoint = null;
			if (Series.View.GetSideLabelVisible(value: true))
			{
				firstPoint = FindEdgePointData(seriesData, isFirst: true);
				if (firstPoint.LabelViewData.Length != 0)
				{
					yield return firstPoint;
				}
			}
			if (Series.View.GetSideLabelVisible(value: false))
			{
				RefinedPointData refinedPointData = FindEdgePointData(seriesData, isFirst: false);
				if (refinedPointData != firstPoint && refinedPointData.LabelViewData.Length != 0)
				{
					yield return refinedPointData;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<RefinedPointData> GetPointDataAccordingEdgeLabel(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			if (!Series.ActualLabelsVisibility)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			List<RefinedPointData> edgePointData = new List<RefinedPointData>();
			foreach (RefinedPointData item in CollectEdgeLabels(seriesData))
			{
				edgePointData.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in seriesData)
			{
				if (!edgePointData.Contains(seriesDatum))
				{
					yield return seriesDatum;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual RefinedPointData FindEdgePointData(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				return seriesData[seriesData.Count - 1];
			}
			return seriesData[0];
		}

		protected void CalculateLabelsLayout()
		{
			if (base.SeriesData.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<RefinedPointData> pointDataAccordingEdgeLabel = GetPointDataAccordingEdgeLabel(base.SeriesData);
			foreach (RefinedPointData item in pointDataAccordingEdgeLabel)
			{
				if (item.RefinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData = item.LabelViewData;
				foreach (SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData in labelViewData)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesLabelViewData.Text))
					{
						((SeriesLabelBase)seriesLabelViewData.Label).CalculateLayout(this, item);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldCalculateCollapsedPointLabel()
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class XYDiagramDiscreteEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis : XYDiagramEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis
	{
		public XYDiagramDiscreteEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
			: base(seriesData, mappingContainer)
		{
		}

		private int GetMaxIndex(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			double max = base.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling.MappingX.Max;
			int num = seriesData.Count - 1;
			for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (base.View.CalcArgumentRange(seriesData[num2].RefinedPoint).Min <= max)
				{
					return num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetMinIndex(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			double min = base.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling.MappingX.Min;
			for (int i = 0; i < seriesData.Count; i++)
			{
				if (min <= base.View.CalcArgumentRange(seriesData[i].RefinedPoint).Max)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected override RefinedPointData FindEdgePointData(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				return seriesData[GetMaxIndex(seriesData)];
			}
			return seriesData[GetMinIndex(seriesData)];
		}

		public override TextPainterBase CreateTextPainter(RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, DiagramPoint anchorPoint, bool isCenterPosition)
		{
			if (GetMinIndex(base.SeriesData) == base.SeriesData.IndexOf(pointData) && base.View.FirstPointInternal != null && base.View.FirstPointInternal.LabelDisplayMode == SidePointDisplayMode.DiagramEdge)
			{
				return labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(anchorPoint, Math.PI);
			}
			if (GetMaxIndex(base.SeriesData) == base.SeriesData.IndexOf(pointData) && base.View.LastPointInternal != null && base.View.LastPointInternal.LabelDisplayMode == SidePointDisplayMode.DiagramEdge)
			{
				return labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(anchorPoint, 0.0);
			}
			return base.CreateTextPainter(pointData, labelViewData, anchorPoint, isCenterPosition);
		}

		public override double GetCorrectAngle(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, bool isNegativeValue)
		{
			bool flag = GetMinIndex(base.SeriesData) == base.SeriesData.IndexOf(pointData);
			SidePointDisplayMode sidePointDisplayMode = (flag ? base.View.FirstPointInternal.LabelDisplayMode : base.View.LastPointInternal.LabelDisplayMode);
			if (sidePointDisplayMode != SidePointDisplayMode.DiagramEdge)
			{
				return base.GetCorrectAngle(diagramMapping, pointData, isNegativeValue);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.PI;
		}
	}

	public class ResolveOverlappingCache : List<ResolveOverlappingCacheItem>
	{
		public ResolveOverlappingCache(IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists)
		{
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				foreach (SeriesLabelLayout item in labelLayoutList)
				{
					if (item is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout labelLayout)
					{
						Add(new ResolveOverlappingCacheItem(labelLayout));
						continue;
					}
					ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout is expected.");
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Apply(IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				foreach (SeriesLabelLayout item in labelLayoutList)
				{
					if (num < base.Count)
					{
						if (item is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout labelLayout)
						{
							base[num++].Apply(labelLayout);
							continue;
						}
						ChartDebug.Fail("XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout is expected.");
						return;
					}
					ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid ResolveOverlappingCacheItem count.");
					return;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class ResolveOverlappingHelper
	{
		public static void ProcessForSimpleDiagram(IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			foreach (SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				if (!(labelLayoutList.View is PieSeriesViewBase pieSeriesViewBase))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (labelLayoutList.Domain == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D;
				switch (((PieSeriesLabel)pieSeriesViewBase.Label).Position)
				{
				case PieSeriesLabelPosition.TwoColumns:
				{
					List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
					foreach (ILabelLayout item in labelLayoutList)
					{
						list.Add(item as IPieLabelLayout);
					}
					gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Left, labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Top, labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Width, labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Height);
					SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping.ArrangeByColumn(list, gRealRect2D, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
					break;
				}
				case PieSeriesLabelPosition.Outside:
				{
					ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)labelLayoutList.Domain.ElementBounds;
					int lineLength = ((PieSeriesLabel)pieSeriesViewBase.Label).LineLength;
					PointsSweepDirection sweepDirection = (PointsSweepDirection)pieSeriesViewBase.SweepDirection;
					zPlaneRectangle.Inflate(lineLength, lineLength);
					List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
					foreach (ILabelLayout item2 in labelLayoutList)
					{
						list.Add(item2 as IPieLabelLayout);
					}
					gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Left, labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Top, labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Width, labelLayoutList.Domain.LabelsBounds.Height);
					SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping.ArrangeByEllipse(list, new GRealEllipse(new GRealPoint2D(zPlaneRectangle.Center.X, zPlaneRectangle.Center.Y), zPlaneRectangle.Width / 2.0, zPlaneRectangle.Height / 2.0), resolveOverlappingMinIndent, sweepDirection, gRealRect2D);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramResolveOverlappingHelper
	{
		private static void FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels, LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList)
		{
			int num = labelLayoutList.Count / 2;
			if (labelLayoutList.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = labelLayoutList.Count - 1;
				while (num2 <= num3)
				{
					labels.Add((IXYDiagramLabelLayout)labelLayoutList[num2]);
					if (num3 != num2)
					{
						labels.Add((IXYDiagramLabelLayout)labelLayoutList[num3]);
					}
					num2++;
					num3--;
				}
				return;
			}
			int num4 = num;
			int num5 = num - 1;
			while (num4 < labelLayoutList.Count || num5 >= 0)
			{
				if (num4 < labelLayoutList.Count)
				{
					labels.Add((IXYDiagramLabelLayout)labelLayoutList[num4]);
				}
				if (num5 >= 0)
				{
					labels.Add((IXYDiagramLabelLayout)labelLayoutList[num5]);
				}
				num4++;
				num5--;
			}
		}

		public static void Process(IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, ZPlaneRectangle bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> list = new List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout>();
			int num = labelLayoutLists.Count / 2;
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = num - 1;
			while (num2 < labelLayoutLists.Count || num3 >= 0)
			{
				if (num2 < labelLayoutLists.Count)
				{
					FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(list, labelLayoutLists[num2]);
				}
				if (num3 >= 0)
				{
					FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(list, labelLayoutLists[num3]);
				}
				num2++;
				num3--;
			}
			IEnumerable<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels = list.OrderBy((IXYDiagramLabelLayout x) => x, new LabelLayoutByAreaComparer());
			XYDiagramResolveOverlappingAlgorithm.Process(labels, (bounds == null) ? DXRectangle.Empty : ((DXRectangle)bounds), resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
		}
	}
	public static class SeriesLabelHelper
	{
		private static DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPointWithScrolling(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutListBase xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, MinMaxValues values)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingBase mappingForScrolling = xyLabelLayoutList.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling;
			if (mappingForScrolling == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = MinMaxValues.Intersection(mappingForScrolling.AxisY.WholeRangeData, values).CalculateCenter();
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return xyLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mappingForScrolling, pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument, num);
		}

		private static DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPoint(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutListBase xyLabelLayoutList, double argument, MinMaxValues values)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = xyLabelLayoutList.MappingContainer;
			Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> intervalLayoutX = mappingContainer.GetIntervalLayoutX(argument);
			if (intervalLayoutX == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double interimCoord = intervalLayoutX.Item2.GetInterimCoord(argument, clip: false, round: true);
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = mappingContainer.CalculateMinMaxInterimY(null, clipBySideLimits: true, values.Min, values.Max);
			if (minMaxValues.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double y = (minMaxValues.Min + minMaxValues.Max) / 2.0;
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = new DiagramPoint(interimCoord, y);
			return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, mappingContainer);
		}

		private static double CalculateIntersection(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2, double x)
		{
			if (p1.X != p2.X)
			{
				return (p2.Y - p1.Y) * (x - p1.X) / (p2.X - p1.X) + p1.Y;
			}
			return p1.Y;
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D CalcBezierIntersection(List<GRealPoint2D> bezierPoints, double x)
		{
			BezierSplitCalculator bezierSplitCalculator = new BezierSplitCalculator(bezierPoints);
			return new GRealPoint2D(x, bezierSplitCalculator.CalcCoordinateY(bezierSplitCalculator.CalcParameterTForX(Math.Round(x, 15))[0]));
		}

		public static List<GRealPoint2D> CalculateSeriesYIntersection(AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mappingX, bool isFirst, List<LineStrip> strips)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			foreach (LineStrip strip in strips)
			{
				int num = ((!isFirst) ? (strip.Count - 1) : 0);
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = strip[num];
				if (isFirst && gRealPoint2D.X < mappingX.Min)
				{
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(mappingX.Min, CalculateIntersection(gRealPoint2D, strip[num + 1], mappingX.Min)));
				}
				else if (!isFirst && gRealPoint2D.X > mappingX.Max)
				{
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(mappingX.Max, CalculateIntersection(strip[num - 1], gRealPoint2D, mappingX.Max)));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(gRealPoint2D);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateSeriesYIntersectionBezier(AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mappingX, bool isFirst, BezierStrip strip)
		{
			if (isFirst)
			{
				if (strip[0].X >= mappingX.Min)
				{
					return strip[0];
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < strip.Count; i++)
				{
					if (strip[i].X > mappingX.Min)
					{
						return CalcBezierIntersection(strip.DrawingPoints.GetRange(3 * (i - 1), 4), mappingX.Min);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GRealPoint2D result = strip[strip.Count - 1];
				if (result.X <= mappingX.Max)
				{
					return result;
				}
				for (int num = strip.Count - 2; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (strip[num].X < mappingX.Max)
					{
						return CalcBezierIntersection(strip.DrawingPoints.GetRange(3 * num, 4), mappingX.Max);
					}
				}
			}
			return default(GRealPoint2D);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(DiagramPoint anchorPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData[] seriesLabelViewData, SeriesLabelBase label)
		{
			SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData2 = seriesLabelViewData[0];
			TextPainter textPainter = seriesLabelViewData2.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(anchorPoint);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, label, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, null, label.ResolveOverlappingMode, anchorPoint);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutListBase xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData[] seriesLabelViewData, SeriesLabelBase label, MinMaxValues values)
		{
			return CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(xyLabelLayoutList, pointData, seriesLabelViewData, label, pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument, values);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutListBase xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData[] seriesLabelViewData, SeriesLabelBase label, double argument, MinMaxValues values)
		{
			DiagramPoint? diagramPoint = (xyLabelLayoutList.View.IsScrollingEnabled ? CalculateAnchorPointWithScrolling(xyLabelLayoutList, pointData, values) : CalculateAnchorPoint(xyLabelLayoutList, argument, values));
			if (!diagramPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CalculateLayoutForCenterAreaPosition(diagramPoint.Value, pointData, seriesLabelViewData, label);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenterBarPosition(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, Color color, SeriesLabelBase label)
		{
			return CalculateLayoutForInsideBarPosition(labelLayoutList, barData, pointData, labelViewData, BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center, 0, color, label);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForInsideBarPosition(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, BarSeriesLabelPosition position, int indent, Color color, SeriesLabelBase label)
		{
			DiagramPoint? diagramPoint = (labelLayoutList.View.IsScrollingEnabled ? barData.CalculateAnchorPointForInsideBarPositionWithScrolling(labelLayoutList.MappingContainer, labelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData), labelLayoutList.Label, position, indent, labelViewData.TextSize) : barData.CalculateAnchorPointForInsideLabelPosition(labelLayoutList.MappingContainer, labelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData), position, indent, labelViewData.TextSize, labelLayoutList.Label.Border.Thickness));
			if (!diagramPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RectangleF validRectangle = RectangleF.Empty;
			if (!labelLayoutList.View.IsScrollingEnabled)
			{
				validRectangle = barData.GetTotalRect(labelLayoutList.MappingContainer);
			}
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithValidRectangle(pointData, label, color, labelLayoutList.CreateTextPainter(pointData, labelViewData, diagramPoint.Value, isCenterPosition: true), null, labelLayoutList.Label.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint.Value, validRectangle);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForTopBarPosition(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, double angle, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, Color color, ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = pointCalculator.CorrectValuesByViewport(barData.ActualArgument, barData.ZeroValue, barData.ActualValue);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double x = list[0].X;
			DiagramPoint screenPoint;
			if (pointCalculator.UseArgumentOffset)
			{
				bool useFixedOffset = x != diagramMapping.MappingX.Min && x != diagramMapping.MappingX.Max;
				screenPoint = barData.GetScreenPoint(list[0].X, list[1].Y, diagramMapping, useOffset: false, useFixedOffset);
			}
			else
			{
				screenPoint = barData.GetScreenPoint(x, list[1].Y, diagramMapping, useOffset: false);
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = CalculateFinishPoint(angle, screenPoint, label.LineLength);
			TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint, angle);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, label, color, textPainter, label.ActualLineVisible ? new LineConnectorPainter(screenPoint, diagramPoint, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flat: true) : null, label.ResolveOverlappingMode, screenPoint);
		}

		public static RectangleF CalcAnchorHoleForPoint(DiagramPoint anchor, double lineLength)
		{
			return new RectangleF((PointF)DiagramPoint.Offset(anchor, 0.0 - lineLength, 0.0 - lineLength, 0.0), new SizeF((float)lineLength * 2f, (float)lineLength * 2f));
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForPoint(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutListBase xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, SeriesLabelBase label, double pointValue, int angleDegree)
		{
			double argument = pointData.RefinedPoint.Argument;
			XYDiagramMappingBase mapping = xyLabelLayoutList.GetMapping(argument, pointValue);
			if (mapping == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint startPoint = xyLabelLayoutList.GetScreenPointCalculator(pointData).CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, pointValue);
			return CalculateLayoutForPoint(mapping, startPoint, pointData, labelViewData, label, angleDegree);
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForPoint(XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, DiagramPoint startPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, SeriesLabelBase label, int angleDegree)
		{
			double angle = XYDiagramMappingHelper.CorrectAngle(mapping, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(angleDegree)));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = label.CalculateFinishPoint(angle, startPoint);
			TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint, angle);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithExcludedRectangle(pointData, label, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, label.ActualLineVisible ? new LineConnectorPainter(startPoint, diagramPoint, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flat: true) : null, label.ResolveOverlappingMode, startPoint, CalcAnchorHoleForPoint(startPoint, label.LineLength));
		}

		public static DiagramPoint CalculateFinishPoint(double angle, DiagramPoint startPoint, double connectorLength)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(startPoint.X + Math.Cos(angle) * connectorLength, startPoint.Y - Math.Sin(angle) * connectorLength, startPoint.Z);
		}

		public static RectangleF CalculateValidRectangleForCenterPosition(DiagramPoint centerPoint, double markerSize)
		{
			return new RectangleF(new PointF((float)(centerPoint.X - markerSize / 2.0), (float)(centerPoint.Y - markerSize / 2.0)), new SizeF((float)markerSize, (float)markerSize));
		}

		public static void CalculateLayoutForLine3DLabel(XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, double value, double connectorAngle, DiagramVector connectorDirection)
		{
			SeriesLabelBase label = xyLabelLayoutList.Label;
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = xyLabelLayoutList.CoordsCalculator;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(xyLabelLayoutList.View.Series, ((IArgumentPoint)pointData.RefinedPoint).Argument, value, clipping: false);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = CalculateFinishPoint(0.0 - connectorAngle, diagramPoint, label.LineLength);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint2);
			double angle = coordsCalculator.CalcConnectorAngle(connectorDirection);
			SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = pointData.LabelViewData[0];
			TextPainter textPainter = seriesLabelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint3, angle);
			ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter;
			if (label.ActualLineVisible)
			{
				bool flag = label.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
				if (flag)
				{
					diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint);
					diagramPoint2 = diagramPoint3;
				}
				connectorPainter = new LineConnectorPainter(diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flag);
			}
			else
			{
				connectorPainter = null;
			}
			XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout layout = XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, label, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, connectorPainter, label.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint);
			xyLabelLayoutList.AddLabelLayout(layout);
		}

		public static void CalculateLayoutForStackedArea3DLabel(XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList xyLabelLayoutList, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, double labelPosition)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(labelPosition))
			{
				IXYPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
				SeriesLabelBase label = xyLabelLayoutList.Label;
				XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator = xyLabelLayoutList.CoordsCalculator;
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(xyLabelLayoutList.View.Series, refinedPoint.Argument, labelPosition, clipping: false);
				diagramPoint.Z += (double)(((coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes() & BoxPlane.Back) > (BoxPlane)0) ? 1 : (-1)) * coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesWidth(xyLabelLayoutList.View) / 2.0;
				TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(coordsCalculator.Project(diagramPoint));
				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout layout = XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(pointData, label, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, null, label.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint);
				xyLabelLayoutList.AddLabelLayout(layout);
			}
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForOutside(DiagramPoint startPoint, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, SeriesLabelBase label, int angleDegree)
		{
			double angle = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(angleDegree));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = label.CalculateFinishPoint(angle, startPoint);
			TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(diagramPoint, angle);
			ConnectorPainterBase connectorPainter = (label.ActualLineVisible ? new LineConnectorPainter(startPoint, diagramPoint, angle, (ZPlaneRectangle)textPainter.BoundsWithBorder, flat: true) : null);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithExcludedRectangle(pointData, label, pointData.DrawOptions.Color, textPainter, connectorPainter, label.ResolveOverlappingMode, startPoint, CalcAnchorHoleForPoint(startPoint, label.LineLength));
		}

		public static XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutForCenterHeatmapCellPosition(Rectangle cellRect, HeatmapSeriesLabelViewData labelViewData)
		{
			Point point = cellRect.Center();
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(point.X, point.Y);
			TextPainter textPainter = labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(diagramPoint);
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.Create(null, labelViewData.Label, labelViewData.Color, textPainter, null, labelViewData.Label.ResolveOverlappingMode, diagramPoint);
		}
	}
	public class SeriesLabelViewData
	{
		private const int labelMaxLineCount = 3;

		public const double InertAngle = Math.PI / 18.0;

		private readonly ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label;

		private int lineCount;

		private string text;

		private Size textSize;

		private float additionalLength;

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				text = value;
			}
		}

		public Size TextSize => textSize;

		public float AdditionalLength
		{
			get
			{
				return additionalLength;
			}
			set
			{
				additionalLength = value;
			}
		}

		public ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider Label => label;

		public Color TotalLabelCustomizedTextColor { get; set; }

		public SeriesLabelViewData(ISeriesLabelPropertiesProvider label, string text)
		{
			this.label = label;
			this.text = text;
		}

		private PointF CalcLocationForCenterDrawing(DiagramPoint center)
		{
			return new PointF(MathUtils.StrongRound(center.X - (double)textSize.Width / 2.0), MathUtils.StrongRound(center.Y - (double)textSize.Height / 2.0));
		}

		private PointF CalcLocationForFlankDrawing(DiagramPoint anchorPoint, double angle, Size textSize, int borderThickness)
		{
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(angle))
			{
				return CalcLocationForCenterDrawing(anchorPoint);
			}
			angle = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(angle);
			if (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			double num = textSize.Width + borderThickness * 2;
			double num2 = textSize.Height + borderThickness * 2;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(angle, 0.0, Math.PI / 18.0) == 0) ? new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X, (double)MathUtils.StrongRound(anchorPoint.Y) - num2 / 2.0) : ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(angle, Math.PI / 2.0, Math.PI / 18.0) == 0) ? new DiagramPoint((double)MathUtils.StrongRound(anchorPoint.X) - num / 2.0, anchorPoint.Y - num2 + 1.0) : ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(angle, Math.PI, Math.PI / 18.0) == 0) ? new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X - num + 1.0, (double)MathUtils.StrongRound(anchorPoint.Y) - num2 / 2.0) : ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(angle, 4.71238898038469, Math.PI / 18.0) == 0) ? new DiagramPoint((double)MathUtils.StrongRound(anchorPoint.X) - num / 2.0, anchorPoint.Y) : ((angle > 0.0 && angle < Math.PI / 2.0) ? new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X, anchorPoint.Y - num2 + 1.0) : ((angle > Math.PI / 2.0 && angle < Math.PI) ? new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X - num + 1.0, anchorPoint.Y - num2 + 1.0) : ((!(angle > Math.PI) || !(angle < 4.71238898038469)) ? new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X, anchorPoint.Y) : new DiagramPoint(anchorPoint.X - num + 1.0, anchorPoint.Y))))))));
			return new PointF(MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.X) + borderThickness, MathUtils.StrongRound(diagramPoint.Y) + borderThickness);
		}

		private TextPainter CreateTextPainter(PointF location)
		{
			if (label.TextOrientation == TextOrientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new TextPainter(text, textSize, label, location, label.MaxWidth, label.MaxLineCount, wordWrap: false);
			}
			bool topToBottom = label.TextOrientation == TextOrientation.TopToBottom;
			return new VerticalRotatedTextPainter(text, textSize, label, location, topToBottom, label.MaxWidth, label.MaxLineCount, wordWrap: false);
		}

		private RectangleF CalculateLabelAllowedBounds(double angle, RectangleF labelBounds, RectangleF allowedBounds)
		{
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(angle))
			{
				return labelBounds;
			}
			angle = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(angle);
			float height;
			float num;
			if (angle <= Math.PI)
			{
				height = labelBounds.Bottom - allowedBounds.Top;
				num = allowedBounds.Top - labelBounds.Top;
			}
			else
			{
				num = 0f;
				height = allowedBounds.Bottom - labelBounds.Top;
			}
			return new RectangleF(labelBounds.X, labelBounds.Y + num, labelBounds.Width, height);
		}

		private void CorrectTextPainterLocation(TextPainter textPainter, RectangleF allowedBounds, double angle)
		{
			if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(angle))
			{
				angle = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(angle);
				float num = 0f;
				float num2 = 0f;
				if (angle <= Math.PI)
				{
					num2 = textPainter.BoundsWithBorder.Bottom - allowedBounds.Top - allowedBounds.Height;
				}
				if (angle >= Math.PI / 2.0 && angle <= 4.71238898038469)
				{
					num = textPainter.BoundsWithBorder.Right - allowedBounds.Left - allowedBounds.Width;
				}
				textPainter.Offset(0f - num, 0f - num2);
			}
		}

		public void CalculateTextSize()
		{
			DXFont font = label.Font;
			SizeF sizeF = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, font, int.MaxValue, label.Alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, out lineCount);
			TextPainter textPainter = new TextPainter(text, sizeF, label, new PointF(0f, 0f), label.MaxWidth, label.MaxLineCount, wordWrap: false);
			textSize = ((label.TextOrientation == TextOrientation.Horizontal) ? new Size(textPainter.RoundedBounds.Width, textPainter.RoundedBounds.Height) : new Size(textPainter.RoundedBounds.Height, textPainter.RoundedBounds.Width));
		}

		public TextPainter CreateTextPainterForBoundedDrawing(DiagramPoint anchorPoint, double angle, RectangleF allowedBounds)
		{
			PointF location = CalcLocationForFlankDrawing(anchorPoint, angle, TextSize, label.Border.ActualThickness);
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(location, textSize);
			rectangleF.Inflate(label.Border.Thickness, label.Border.Thickness);
			RectangleF rectangleF2 = RectangleF.Intersect(rectangleF, allowedBounds);
			if (rectangleF2 == rectangleF)
			{
				return CreateTextPainter(location);
			}
			if (rectangleF2 == RectangleF.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			allowedBounds = CalculateLabelAllowedBounds(angle, rectangleF2, allowedBounds);
			location = rectangleF2.Location.Offset(label.Border.Thickness, label.Border.Thickness);
			int maxWidth = MathUtils.Ceiling(allowedBounds.Width);
			int maxLineCount = Math.Min(3, MathUtils.Ceiling(allowedBounds.Height * (float)lineCount / rectangleF.Height));
			TextPainter textPainter = new TextPainter(text, textSize, label, maxWidth, maxLineCount, location);
			CorrectTextPainterLocation(textPainter, allowedBounds, angle);
			if (textPainter.Height < label.Border.Thickness || textPainter.Width < label.Border.Thickness)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return textPainter;
		}

		public TextPainter CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(DiagramPoint center)
		{
			PointF location = CalcLocationForCenterDrawing(center);
			return CreateTextPainter(location);
		}

		public TextPainter CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(DiagramPoint anchorPoint, double angle)
		{
			PointF location = CalcLocationForFlankDrawing(anchorPoint, angle, TextSize, label.Border.ActualThickness);
			return CreateTextPainter(location);
		}
	}
	public class PieTotalLabelViewData
	{
		private readonly PieTotalLabel totalLabel;

		private readonly TextPainter textPainter;

		private readonly Color textColor;

		internal TextPainter TextPainter => textPainter;

		private double GetActualAnimationProgress(int pointIndex, Series series)
		{
			AnimationBase actualLabelAnimation = series.View.ActualLabelAnimation;
			if (actualLabelAnimation == null || !series.Chart.AnimationInProgress)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return actualLabelAnimation.GetLabelAnimationProgress(series.Chart.AnimationTimeMs, pointIndex + 1, pointIndex);
		}

		public PieTotalLabelViewData(string text, Rectangle pieBounds, PieTotalLabel totalLabel, Color textColor)
		{
			this.totalLabel = totalLabel;
			this.textColor = textColor;
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Sqrt(2.0) * 0.5 * (double)pieBounds.Width);
			int num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Sqrt(2.0) * 0.5 * (double)pieBounds.Height);
			int x = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)pieBounds.X + (double)(pieBounds.Width - num) * 0.5);
			int y = MathUtils.StrongRound((double)pieBounds.Y + (double)(pieBounds.Height - num2) * 0.5);
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(x, y, num, num2);
			if (totalLabel.Border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				rectangle.Inflate(-2 * totalLabel.Border.Thickness, -2 * totalLabel.Border.Thickness);
			}
			SizeF sizeF = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, ((ITextPropertiesProvider)totalLabel).Font);
			Size size = new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Width), (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Height));
			int maxWidth = rectangle.Width;
			if (totalLabel.MaxWidth > 0)
			{
				maxWidth = Math.Min(totalLabel.MaxWidth, rectangle.Width);
			}
			bool wordWrap = ((ITextPropertiesProvider)totalLabel).CanWrapText(sizeF.Width);
			textPainter = new TextPainter(text, size, totalLabel, rectangle.Location, maxWidth, totalLabel.MaxLineCount, wordWrap);
			SizeF sizeF2 = textPainter.RoundedBounds.Size;
			PointF location;
			if (sizeF2.Height <= (float)rectangle.Height)
			{
				location = new PointF((float)rectangle.X + 0.5f * ((float)rectangle.Width - sizeF2.Width), (float)rectangle.Y + 0.5f * ((float)rectangle.Height - sizeF2.Height));
			}
			else
			{
				location = new PointF((float)rectangle.X + 0.5f * ((float)rectangle.Width - sizeF2.Width), rectangle.Y);
				textPainter.SetHeight(rectangle.Height);
			}
			textPainter.SetLocation(location);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController controller, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			double opacity = 1.0;
			Series series = ((PieSeriesView)totalLabel.Owner).Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				int pointIndex = series.ActualSeriesPoints.Count - 1;
				opacity = GetActualAnimationProgress(pointIndex, series);
			}
			textPainter.Render(renderer, controller, null, additionalHitObject, textColor, opacity);
		}
	}
	public class RadarDiagramSeriesLayout : SeriesLayout
	{
		private readonly RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping;

		private WholeSeriesLayout wholeLayout;

		protected Rectangle MappingBounds => diagramMapping.MappingBounds;

		protected Chart Chart => View.Chart;

		public RadarDiagramMapping DiagramMapping => diagramMapping;

		public new RadarSeriesViewBase View => (RadarSeriesViewBase)base.SeriesData.Series.View;

		public override WholeSeriesLayout WholeLayout => wholeLayout;

		protected override HitTestController HitTestController => View.HitTestController;

		public override WholeSeriesViewData WholeViewData => base.SeriesData.WholeViewData;

		public override DrawOptions DrawOptions => base.SeriesData.DrawOptions;

		public RadarDiagramSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping)
			: base(seriesData)
		{
			this.diagramMapping = diagramMapping;
		}

		private void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (WholeLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 1.0;
			if (Chart.AnimationInProgress && View.CanAnimate && View.ActualSeriesAnimation != null)
			{
				num = View.ActualSeriesAnimation.CalculateAnimationProgress(View.Chart.AnimationTimeMs);
				if (num > 0.0 && num < 1.0)
				{
					View.ActualSeriesAnimation.Apply(renderer, MappingBounds, num);
				}
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				View.RenderWholeSeries(renderer, MappingBounds, WholeLayout);
			}
			if (Chart.AnimationInProgress && View.CanAnimate && num > 0.0 && num < 1.0 && View.ActualSeriesAnimation != null)
			{
				View.ActualSeriesAnimation.RestoreState();
			}
			HitTestController hitTestController = HitTestController;
			bool actualSeriesToolTipEnabled = base.SeriesData.Series.ActualSeriesToolTipEnabled;
			if (!(hitTestController.Enabled || actualSeriesToolTipEnabled))
			{
				return;
			}
			using HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = WholeLayout.CalculateHitRegion(base.SeriesData.DrawOptions);
			hitRegionContainer.Intersect(new HitRegion(MappingBounds));
			IHitRegion underlying = hitRegionContainer.Underlying;
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, View.Series, null, (IHitRegion)underlying.Clone());
			if (actualSeriesToolTipEnabled)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, View.Series, new ChartFocusedArea(View.Series), (IHitRegion)underlying.Clone(), force: true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderPoints(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			bool flag = Chart.AnimationInProgress && View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation != null && View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.CanAnimate;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				double num = 1.0;
				if (flag)
				{
					int animatingPointIndex = View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.GetAnimatingPointIndex(base.Count, i);
					num = View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.CalculateAnimationProgress(View.Chart.AnimationTimeMs, animatingPointIndex);
					if (num != 1.0)
					{
						View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.Apply(renderer, MappingBounds, base[i], num);
					}
				}
				View.Render(renderer, MappingBounds, base[i], base[i].DrawOptions);
				if (flag && num != 1.0)
				{
					View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.RestoreState();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Calculate()
		{
			foreach (RefinedPointData seriesDatum in base.SeriesData)
			{
				if (!seriesDatum.RefinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = View.CalculateSeriesPointLayout(DiagramMapping, seriesDatum);
					if (seriesPointLayout != null)
					{
						seriesDatum.ToolTipRelativePosition = View.CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(diagramMapping, seriesDatum);
						Add(seriesPointLayout);
					}
				}
			}
			wholeLayout = View.CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(DiagramMapping, this);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RenderWholeSeries(renderer);
			RenderPoints(renderer);
			HitTestController hitTestController = HitTestController;
			bool actualPointToolTipEnabled = base.SeriesData.Series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled;
			if (!(hitTestController.Enabled || actualPointToolTipEnabled))
			{
				return;
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = current.CalculateHitRegion();
				if (hitRegionContainer == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				using (hitRegionContainer)
				{
					hitRegionContainer.Intersect(new HitRegion(MappingBounds));
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = current.SeriesPoint;
					IHitRegion underlying = hitRegionContainer.Underlying;
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, View.Series, current.PointData.RefinedPoint, (IHitRegion)underlying.Clone());
					if (actualPointToolTipEnabled)
					{
						HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, View.Series, new ChartFocusedArea(seriesPoint, current.ToolTipRelativePosition), (IHitRegion)underlying.Clone(), force: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateShadowGraphicsCommand()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (WholeLayout != null)
			{
				View.RenderWholeSeriesShadow(renderer, MappingBounds, WholeLayout);
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				View.RenderShadow(renderer, MappingBounds, current, current.DrawOptions);
			}
		}
	}

			if (!base.Chart.AnimationInProgress || ActualAnimation == null || !ActualAnimation.CanAnimate)

					base.View.Render(renderer, base.MappingBounds, base[i], base[i].PointData.DrawOptions);

				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < base.Count; j++)
			{
				double num = 1.0;
				int animatingPointIndex = ActualAnimation.GetAnimatingPointIndex(base.Count, j);
				num = ActualAnimation.CalculateAnimationProgress(base.View.Chart.AnimationTimeMs, animatingPointIndex);
				if (num != 0.0 && num != 1.0)

					ActualAnimation.Apply(renderer, base.MappingBounds, base[j], num);

				if (num != 0.0)
				{
					RangeAreaView.Painter.RenderMarker2(renderer, base.MappingBounds, base[j], base[j].PointData.DrawOptions);
				}
				if (num != 0.0 && num != 1.0)
				{
					ActualAnimation.RestoreState();
				}
				if (num != 0.0 && num != 1.0)
				{
					ActualAnimation.ApplyForRangeAreaMarker1(renderer, base.MappingBounds, (RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout)base[j], num);
				}
				if (num != 0.0)
				{
					RangeAreaView.Painter.RenderMarker1(renderer, base.MappingBounds, base[j], base[j].PointData.DrawOptions);
				}
				if (num != 0.0 && num != 1.0)
				{
					ActualAnimation.RestoreState();
				}
			}
		}

	public class BarSeriesContainerLayout : SeriesContainerLayout
	{
		private const int LayoutCountToOptimize = 1000;

		public BarSeriesContainerLayout(SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
			: base(seriesContainerData, mapping, singleLayout)

		}

		private bool CanOptimize(BarSeriesView view)
		{
			if (base.Count > 1000 && view.Transparency == 0)
			{
				return !view.ActualColorEach;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void RenderAllSeriesPoints(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Rectangle inflatedBounds = base.Mapping.InflatedBounds;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				BarSeriesView barSeriesView = (BarSeriesView)current.View;
				bool flag = CalcShouldAnimate(barSeriesView);
				if (flag || !CanOptimize(barSeriesView))
				{
					RenderSeriesPoints(renderer, inflatedBounds, current, barSeriesView, flag);
					continue;
				}
				int count = current.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					BarSeriesPointLayout barSeriesPointLayout = null;
					int num = 0;
					for (int j = 0; j < current.Count; j++)
					{
						if (barSeriesPointLayout == null)
						{
							barSeriesPointLayout = (BarSeriesPointLayout)current[j];
							num = j;
							continue;
						}
						BarSeriesPointLayout barSeriesPointLayout2 = (BarSeriesPointLayout)current[j];
						if (!barSeriesPointLayout.ScreenRect.Contains(barSeriesPointLayout2.ScreenRect))
						{
							if (barSeriesPointLayout2.ScreenRect.Contains(barSeriesPointLayout.ScreenRect))
							{
								barSeriesPointLayout = barSeriesPointLayout2;
								num = j;
							}
							else
							{
								barSeriesView.Render(renderer, inflatedBounds, barSeriesPointLayout, barSeriesPointLayout.PointData.DrawOptions);
								barSeriesPointLayout = barSeriesPointLayout2;
								num = j;
							}
						}
					}
					if (barSeriesPointLayout != null)
					{
						barSeriesView.Render(renderer, inflatedBounds, barSeriesPointLayout, barSeriesPointLayout.PointData.DrawOptions);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class PointsRenderOptimizer
	{
		private const int PointsCountToOptimize = 1000;

		private readonly Rectangle mappingBounds;

		private readonly int maxX;

		private readonly int maxY;

		private readonly byte alpha;

		private readonly byte[,] renderGrid;

		private readonly float width;

		private readonly float height;

		public static bool ShouldOptimize(int pointsCount)
		{
			return pointsCount > 1000;
		}

		public PointsRenderOptimizer(Rectangle mappingBounds, SizeF pointSize, byte alpha)
		{
			width = Math.Max(1f, pointSize.Width / 2f);
			height = Math.Max(1f, pointSize.Height / 2f);
			maxX = (int)((float)mappingBounds.Width / width);
			maxY = (int)((float)mappingBounds.Height / height);
			renderGrid = new byte[maxX, maxY];
			this.alpha = (byte)Math.Min(255, 255 / (alpha + 1));
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
		}

		public bool EmulateRender(RectangleF pointBounds)
		{
			PointF rectCenter = pointBounds.CalculateCenter();
			return EmulateRender(rectCenter);
		}

		public bool EmulateRender(PointF rectCenter)
		{
			int num = (int)((rectCenter.X - (float)mappingBounds.X) / width);
			int num2 = (int)((rectCenter.Y - (float)mappingBounds.Y) / height);
			if (num < 0 || num2 < 0 || num >= maxX || num2 >= maxY || renderGrid[num, num2] > alpha)
			{
				return false;
			}
			renderGrid[num, num2]++;
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class PointSeriesContainerLayout : SeriesContainerLayout
	{
		public PointSeriesContainerLayout(SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
			: base(seriesContainerData, mapping, singleLayout)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderAllSeriesPoints(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Rectangle inflatedBounds = base.Mapping.InflatedBounds;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				int count = current.Count;
				if (count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SeriesViewBase view = current.View;
				bool shouldAnimate = CalcShouldAnimate(view);
				PointSeriesPointLayout pointSeriesPointLayout = (PointSeriesPointLayout)current[0];
				PointsRenderOptimizer pointsRenderOptimizer = null;
				if (pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon != null && PointsRenderOptimizer.ShouldOptimize(current.Count))
				{
					pointsRenderOptimizer = new PointsRenderOptimizer(inflatedBounds, pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.Rect.Size, pointSeriesPointLayout.DrawOptions.Color.A);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					pointSeriesPointLayout = (PointSeriesPointLayout)current[i];
					if (pointsRenderOptimizer == null || pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon == null || pointsRenderOptimizer.EmulateRender(pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.Rect))
					{
						RenderSeriesPointLayout(renderer, inflatedBounds, pointSeriesPointLayout, i, count, view, shouldAnimate, null);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
