	public class SeriesContainerLayout : List<SeriesLayout>
	{
		private readonly SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData;

		private HitTestController HitTestController
		{
			get
			{
				if (PrimaryView == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PrimaryView.HitTestController;
			}
		}

		protected SeriesViewBase PrimaryView => seriesContainerData.PrimaryView;

		public XYDiagramMappingBase Mapping { get; }

		public bool ShowInFront => base[0].WholeLayout?.ShowInFront ?? false;

		public SeriesContainerLayout(SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
		{
			this.seriesContainerData = seriesContainerData;
			Mapping = mapping;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData in seriesContainerData.SeriesDataList)
			{
				Add(seriesData.CreateSeriesLayout(seriesData, Mapping, singleLayout));
			}
		}

		protected bool CalcShouldAnimate(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.Chart.AnimationInProgress && view.ActualSeriesPointAnimation != null)
			{
				return view.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.CanAnimate;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void RenderSeriesPointLayout(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout spl, int pointIndex, int pointCount, SeriesViewBase view, bool shouldAnimate, DrawOptions commonDrawOptions)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			if (shouldAnimate)
			{
				int animatingPointIndex = view.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.GetAnimatingPointIndex(pointCount, pointIndex);
				num = view.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.CalculateAnimationProgress(view.Chart.AnimationTimeMs, animatingPointIndex);
				if (num != 1.0)
				{
					view.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.Apply(renderer, mappingBounds, spl, num);
				}
			}
			view.Render(renderer, mappingBounds, spl, (commonDrawOptions == null) ? spl.PointData.DrawOptions : commonDrawOptions);
			if (shouldAnimate && num != 1.0)
			{
				view.ActualSeriesPointAnimation.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		protected void RenderSeriesPoints(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesLayout seriesLayout, SeriesViewBase view, bool shouldAnimate)
		{
			int count = seriesLayout.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RenderSeriesPointLayout(renderer, mappingBounds, seriesLayout[i], i, count, view, shouldAnimate, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderInteractions(ChartRenderer renderer, IList<IPointInteraction> interactions)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RenderAllSeriesPoints(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Rectangle inflatedBounds = Mapping.InflatedBounds;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				SeriesViewBase view = current.View;
				bool shouldAnimate = CalcShouldAnimate(view);
				RenderSeriesPoints(renderer, inflatedBounds, current, view, shouldAnimate);
			}
		}

		public void RenderSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneAreas paneAreas)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = paneAreas.SeriesClipRegions[Mapping];
			if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(dXGraphicsPath);
			}
			HitRegionContainer seriesHitRegion = paneAreas.GetSeriesHitRegion(Mapping);
			List<XYDiagramSeriesLayout> list = new List<XYDiagramSeriesLayout>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					XYDiagramSeriesLayout xYDiagramSeriesLayout = (XYDiagramSeriesLayout)enumerator.Current;
					if (xYDiagramSeriesLayout.WholeLayout != null)
					{
						if (xYDiagramSeriesLayout.WholeLayout.IsOverPoints)
						{
							list.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLayout);
						}
						else
						{
							xYDiagramSeriesLayout.RenderWholeSeries(renderer, seriesHitRegion);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			RenderInteractions(renderer, seriesContainerData.Container.PointInteractions);
			RenderAllSeriesPoints(renderer);
			foreach (XYDiagramSeriesLayout item in list)
			{
				item.RenderWholeSeries(renderer, seriesHitRegion);
			}
			HitTestController hitTestController = HitTestController;
			using (Enumerator enumerator3 = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator3.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesLayout current2 = enumerator3.Current;
					Series series = current2.SeriesData.Series;
					bool actualPointToolTipEnabled = series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled;
					bool hitTestingSupported = ((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)series.View).HitTestingSupported;
					if (!((hitTestController.Enabled && hitTestingSupported) || actualPointToolTipEnabled))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (SeriesPointLayout item2 in current2)
					{
						HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = item2.CalculateHitRegion();
						if (hitRegionContainer == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						using (hitRegionContainer)
						{
							if (seriesHitRegion != null)
							{
								hitRegionContainer.Intersect(seriesHitRegion);
							}
							ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = item2.PointData.SeriesPoint;
							if (seriesPoint == null)
							{
								DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series);
								seriesPoint = dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(item2.PointData.RefinedPoint);
							}
							if (hitTestController.Enabled && hitTestingSupported)
							{
								HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, series, item2.PointData.RefinedPoint, (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone());
							}
							if (actualPointToolTipEnabled)
							{
								HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, series, new ChartFocusedArea(seriesPoint, item2.PointData.ToolTipRelativePosition), (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone(), force: true);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
			{
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
			}
		}

		public void RenderSeriesAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, XYDiagramPaneAreas paneAreas)
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				XYDiagramSeriesLayout xYDiagramSeriesLayout = (XYDiagramSeriesLayout)enumerator.Current;
				xYDiagramSeriesLayout.RenderWholeSeriesAbove(renderer);
			}
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallSeriesContainerLayout : SeriesContainerLayout
	{
		public WaterfallSeriesContainerLayout(SeriesContainerData seriesContainerData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
			: base(seriesContainerData, mapping, singleLayout)
		{
		}

		protected override void RenderInteractions(ChartRenderer renderer, IList<IPointInteraction> interactions)
		{
			if (base.PrimaryView.Chart.AnimationInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			WaterfallSeriesView waterfallSeriesView = (WaterfallSeriesView)base.PrimaryView;
			for (int i = 0; i < interactions.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction = (WaterfallPointInteraction)interactions[i];
				if (waterfallPointInteraction.HasOnlyEmptyPoints)
				{
					continue;
				}
				WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction2 = null;
				for (int j = i + 1; j < interactions.Count; j++)
				{
					WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction3 = (WaterfallPointInteraction)interactions[j];
					if (!waterfallPointInteraction3.HasOnlyEmptyPoints)
					{
						waterfallPointInteraction2 = waterfallPointInteraction3;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (waterfallPointInteraction2 == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				double totalValue = waterfallPointInteraction.GetTotalValue();
				double value = (waterfallPointInteraction2.IsSubtotal ? waterfallPointInteraction2.GetTotalValue() : totalValue);
				Point p = (Point)base.Mapping.GetScreenPoint(waterfallPointInteraction2.Argument - waterfallSeriesView.BarWidth / 2.0, value);
				Point p2 = (Point)base.Mapping.GetScreenPoint(waterfallPointInteraction.Argument + waterfallSeriesView.BarWidth / 2.0, totalValue);
				if (p2.X == p.X || p2.Y == p.Y)
				{
					renderer.DrawLine(p2, p, waterfallSeriesView.ConnectorColor, waterfallSeriesView.ConnectorStyle);
					continue;
				}
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				renderer.DrawLine(p2, p, waterfallSeriesView.ConnectorColor, waterfallSeriesView.ConnectorStyle);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		internal void RenderInteractionsTest(ChartRenderer renderer, IList<IPointInteraction> interactions)
		{
			RenderInteractions(renderer, interactions);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase : SeriesLayout
	{
		protected const System.Drawing.StringAlignment ExclamationAlignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		protected const System.Drawing.StringAlignment ExclamationLineAlignment = System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center;

		protected static readonly string ExclamationFontFamilyName = "Microsoft Sans Serif";

		protected static readonly string ExclamationText = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.PieIncorrectValuesText);

		private readonly RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData;

		private IList<DockableTitleViewData> titlesViewData;

		private List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		protected override HitTestController HitTestController => View.HitTestController;

		public new RefinedSeriesDataBase SeriesData => seriesData;

		protected internal IList<DockableTitleViewData> TitlesViewData
		{
			get
			{
				return titlesViewData;
			}
			set
			{
				titlesViewData = value;
			}
		}

		public new SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase View => (SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)seriesData.Series.View;

		public List<AnnotationLayout> AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout
		{
			get
			{
				return annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;
			}
			protected set
			{
				annotationsAnchorPointsLayout = value;
			}
		}

		public SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.seriesData = seriesData;
		}

		private void CalculateBoundsOffsets(out int xOffset, out int yOffset)
		{
			xOffset = (yOffset = 0);
			bool isVerticalTitle = titlesViewData[titlesViewData.Count - 1].IsVerticalTitle;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = titlesViewData.Count - 1;
			while (num3 > -1 && isVerticalTitle == titlesViewData[num3].IsVerticalTitle)
			{
				double num4 = (double)titlesViewData[num3].Size / 2.0;
				switch (titlesViewData[num3].Title.Dock)
				{
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Left:
					num -= num4;
					break;
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Right:
					num += num4;
					break;
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Top:
					num2 -= num4;
					break;
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Bottom:
					num2 += num4;
					break;
				}
				num3--;
			}
			xOffset = (int)num;
			yOffset = (int)num2;
		}

		private void CalculateTitleOffsets(Rectangle domainBounds, Rectangle labelsBounds, out int leftOffset, out int topOffset, out int rightOffset, out int bottomOffset)
		{
			topOffset = labelsBounds.Top - domainBounds.Top;
			leftOffset = labelsBounds.Left - domainBounds.Left;
			bottomOffset = domainBounds.Bottom - labelsBounds.Bottom;
			rightOffset = domainBounds.Right - labelsBounds.Right;
		}

		private void CorrectBoundsOffsets(int topOffset, int leftOffset, int bottomOffset, int rightOffset, ref int xOffset, ref int yOffset)
		{
			if (xOffset != 0)
			{
				if (xOffset > 0)
				{
					if (xOffset > rightOffset)
					{
						xOffset = rightOffset;
					}
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(xOffset) > leftOffset)
				{
					xOffset = -leftOffset;
				}
			}
			if (yOffset == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (yOffset > 0)
			{
				if (yOffset > bottomOffset)
				{
					yOffset = bottomOffset;
				}
			}
			else if (Math.Abs(yOffset) > topOffset)
			{
				yOffset = -topOffset;
			}
		}

		private void CorrectTitlesPosition(int topOffset, int leftOffset, int bottomOffset, int rightOffset, out bool isLeftOffset, out bool isTopOffset)
		{
			isLeftOffset = (isTopOffset = false);
			bool isVerticalTitle = titlesViewData[titlesViewData.Count - 1].IsVerticalTitle;
			int num = titlesViewData.Count - 1;
			while (num > -1 && isVerticalTitle == titlesViewData[num].IsVerticalTitle)
			{
				switch (titlesViewData[num].Title.Dock)
				{
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Left:
					if (leftOffset > 0)
					{
						titlesViewData[num].Offset(leftOffset, 0);
						isLeftOffset = true;
					}
					break;
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Right:
					if (rightOffset > 0)
					{
						titlesViewData[num].Offset(-rightOffset, 0);
					}
					break;
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Top:
					if (topOffset > 0)
					{
						titlesViewData[num].Offset(0, topOffset);
						isTopOffset = true;
					}
					break;
				case ChartTitleDockStyle.Bottom:
					if (bottomOffset > 0)
					{
						titlesViewData[num].Offset(0, -bottomOffset);
					}
					break;
				}
				num--;
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectDomainBounds(Rectangle domainBounds, Rectangle enlargedLabelsBounds, bool isLeftOffset, bool isTopOffset, int xBoundsOffset, int yBoundsOffset)
		{
			int x = ((xBoundsOffset <= 0) ? (isLeftOffset ? (enlargedLabelsBounds.Left - domainBounds.Left) : 0) : (xBoundsOffset + (domainBounds.Width - enlargedLabelsBounds.Width) / 2));
			int y = ((yBoundsOffset <= 0) ? (isTopOffset ? (enlargedLabelsBounds.Top - domainBounds.Top) : 0) : (yBoundsOffset + (domainBounds.Height - enlargedLabelsBounds.Height) / 2));
			if (xBoundsOffset != 0)
			{
				domainBounds.Width = enlargedLabelsBounds.Width;
			}
			if (yBoundsOffset != 0)
			{
				domainBounds.Height = enlargedLabelsBounds.Height;
			}
			domainBounds.Offset(x, y);
			return domainBounds;
		}

		protected IList<DockableTitleViewData> CalculateTitlesViewDataAndCorrectDomainBounds(ref Rectangle domainBounds)
		{
			if (View.Titles.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return View.Titles.CalculateViewDataAndBoundsWithoutTitle(ref domainBounds);
		}

		protected Rectangle CorrectBoundsAndTitlesPosition(Rectangle domainBounds, ref Rectangle labelsBounds, ref Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			if (titlesViewData == null || titlesViewData.Count < 1)
			{
				return domainBounds;
			}
			int xOffset = 0;
			int yOffset = 0;
			CalculateBoundsOffsets(out xOffset, out yOffset);
			CalculateTitleOffsets(domainBounds, labelsBounds, out var leftOffset, out var topOffset, out var rightOffset, out var bottomOffset);
			CorrectBoundsOffsets(topOffset, leftOffset, bottomOffset, rightOffset, ref xOffset, ref yOffset);
			labelsBounds.Offset(xOffset, yOffset);
			diagramBounds.Offset(xOffset, yOffset);
			CalculateTitleOffsets(domainBounds, labelsBounds, out leftOffset, out topOffset, out rightOffset, out bottomOffset);
			CorrectTitlesPosition(topOffset, leftOffset, bottomOffset, rightOffset, out var isLeftOffset, out var isTopOffset);
			return CorrectDomainBounds(domainBounds, labelsBounds, isLeftOffset, isTopOffset, xOffset, yOffset);
		}
	}
	public sealed class RefinedPointData : ILegendItemData
	{
		private readonly int pointIndex;

		private readonly DrawOptions drawOptions;

		private readonly DrawOptions legendDrawOptions;

		private readonly ILegendItemOptions legendItemOptions;

		private readonly RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData;

		private readonly SeriesLabelViewData stackedBarTotalLabelViewData;

		private LegendBase ActualLegend => Series.ActualLegend;

		internal RefinedSeriesDataBase SeriesData => seriesData;

		public Series Series => seriesData.Series;

		public bool DisposeFont
		{
			get
			{
				return legendItemOptions.DisposeLegendFont;
			}
			set

				legendItemOptions.DisposeLegendFont = value;
			}
		}

		public bool DisposeLegendMarkerImage
		{
			get
			{
				return legendItemOptions.DisposeLegendMarkerImage;
			}
			set
			{
				legendItemOptions.DisposeLegendMarkerImage = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsValidLegendItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (!refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(legendItemOptions.LegendText);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool MarkerVisible => legendItemOptions.LegendMarkerVisible;

		public bool TextVisible => legendItemOptions.LegendTextVisible;

		public string LegendText => legendItemOptions.LegendText;

		public ChartImageSizeMode MarkerImageSizeMode => legendItemOptions.LegendMarkerImageSizeMode;

		{

			}
			set
			{
				toolTipRelativePosition = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawOptions DrawOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (drawOptions == null)
				{
					return seriesData.GetPointDrawOptions(this, pointIndex);
				}
				return drawOptions;
			}
		}

		public DrawOptions LegendDrawOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (legendDrawOptions == null)
				{
					return seriesData.GetPointLegendDrawOptions(this, pointIndex);
				}
				return legendDrawOptions;
			}
		}

		public DXImage MarkerImage => legendItemOptions.DXLegendMarkerImage;

		public ISeriesPoint SeriesPoint => refinedPoint.SeriesPoint;

		public DXFont Font => legendItemOptions.LegendFont;

		public SeriesLabelViewData[] LabelViewData => labelViewData;

		public SeriesLabelViewData StackedBarTotalLabelViewData => stackedBarTotalLabelViewData;

		public Size MarkerSize => Series.Chart.ScaleSize(legendItemOptions.LegendMarkerSize);

		public SelectionState SelectionState => selectionState;

		public RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => refinedPoint;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenText => ActualLegend.TextVisible;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarker => ActualLegend.MarkersVisible;

		string ILegendItemData.Text => legendItemOptions.LegendText;

		ILegendItem ILegendItemData.RepresentedObject => refinedPoint;

		LegendBase ILegendItemData.Legend => ActualLegend;

		private static bool HasColor(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint is SeriesPoint { Color: var color })
			{
				return !color.IsEmpty;
			}
			AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint = (AggregatedSeriesPoint)refinedPoint.SeriesPoint;
			if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.ColorStatus == 0)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (HasColor(sourcePoint))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.ColorStatus == 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public RefinedPointData(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int pointIndex, ILegendItemOptions legendItemOptions, DrawOptions drawOptions, DrawOptions legendDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState, SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData, SeriesLabelViewData stackedBarTotalLabelViewData)
		{
			this.drawOptions = drawOptions;
			this.legendDrawOptions = legendDrawOptions;
			this.seriesData = seriesData;
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
			this.legendItemOptions = legendItemOptions;
			this.labelViewData = labelViewData;
			this.stackedBarTotalLabelViewData = stackedBarTotalLabelViewData;
			this.selectionState = selectionState;
			this.pointIndex = pointIndex;
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Series.RenderLegendItem(renderer, bounds, LegendDrawOptions, seriesData.LegendDrawOptions, null, this);
		}

		public void DisposeCustomFont()
		{
			if (legendItemOptions != null)
			{
				legendItemOptions.DisposeCustomFont(ActualLegend);
			}
		}

		public void DisposeCustomMarkerImage()
		{
			if (legendItemOptions != null)
			{
				legendItemOptions.DisposeCustomMarkerImage();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldUpdateColors()
		{
			if (!HasColor(refinedPoint))
			{
				return refinedPoint.IsEmpty;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public BarData GetBarData(BarSeriesView view)
		{
			if (barData == null || actualViewForBarData != view)
			{
				barData = view.CreateBarData(RefinedPoint);
				actualViewForBarData = view;
			}
			return barData;
		}
	}

	public class ValueLevelItem
	{
		private readonly ValueLevel valueLevel;

		private readonly string text;

		public ValueLevel ValueLevel => valueLevel;

		public ValueLevelItem(ValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			this.valueLevel = valueLevel;
			switch (valueLevel)
			{
			case ValueLevel.Value:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelValue);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.Value_1:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelValue_1);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.Value_2:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelValue_2);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.Low:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelLow);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.High:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelHigh);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.Open:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelOpen);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.Close:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelClose);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.Weight:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelWeight);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMin:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelBoxPlotMin);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_1:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelBoxPlotQuartile1);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMedian:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelBoxPlotMedian);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotQuartile_3:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelBoxPlotQuartile3);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMax:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelBoxPlotMax);
				break;
			case ValueLevel.BoxPlotMean:
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelBoxPlotMean);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown value level: " + valueLevel);
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.WizValueLevelValue);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return text;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ValueLevelItem))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ValueLevelItem valueLevelItem = (ValueLevelItem)obj;
			return valueLevel == valueLevelItem.valueLevel;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return valueLevel.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class RangeAreaSeriesViewPainter : AreaSeriesViewPainter
	{
		private IRangeAreaSeriesView RangeAreaView => (IRangeAreaSeriesView)base.View;

		public static RangeStrip CreateRangeAreaLegendMarkerStrip(IGeometryStripCreator creator, Rectangle bounds, bool pointMarkerVisible)
		{
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = StripsUtils.CreateAreaMarkerStrip(creator, bounds, pointMarkerVisible);
			LineStrip bottomStrip = new LineStrip
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom),
				new GRealPoint2D((double)bounds.Left + (double)bounds.Width / 3.0, bounds.Bottom),
				new GRealPoint2D((double)bounds.Left + (double)bounds.Width / 2.0, (double)bounds.Top + (double)bounds.Height / 2.0),
				new GRealPoint2D((double)bounds.Left + (double)(2 * bounds.Width) / 3.0, bounds.Bottom),
				new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom)
			};
			rangeStrip.BottomStrip = bottomStrip;
			return rangeStrip;
		}

		public RangeAreaSeriesViewPainter(IAreaSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private Color GetMarkerDrawColor(Marker marker, RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			Color selfColor = (marker.Color.IsEmpty ? rangeAreaDrawOptions.Color : marker.Color);
			return MixSelfColor(selfColor, selectionState);
		}

		private void RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Marker marker, IPolygon polygon, RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			Color markerDrawColor = GetMarkerDrawColor(marker, rangeAreaDrawOptions, selectionState);
			Color borderDrawColor = GetBorderDrawColor(rangeAreaDrawOptions, marker);
			int borderThickness = (marker.BorderVisible ? marker.Border.Thickness : 0);
			marker.RenderWithAntialiasing(renderer, polygon, markerDrawColor, rangeAreaDrawOptions.ActualColor2, borderDrawColor, borderThickness);
		}

		protected override IPolygon CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override RangeStrip CreateLegendMarkerStrip(Rectangle bounds, bool pointMarkerVisible)
		{
			return CreateRangeAreaLegendMarkerStrip(base.View, bounds, pointMarkerVisible);
		}

		protected override void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, AreaDrawOptions drawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds, RangeStrip strip, bool isLegendBorder, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			if (drawOptions is RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions)
			{
				RenderAreaBorder(renderer, strip.Style.IsEmptyPointStyle ? rangeAreaDrawOptions.EmptyPointBorder : rangeAreaDrawOptions.Border1, rangeAreaDrawOptions, strip.BottomStrip, null, isLegendBorder);
				RenderAreaBorder(renderer, strip.Style.IsEmptyPointStyle ? rangeAreaDrawOptions.EmptyPointBorder : rangeAreaDrawOptions.Border2, rangeAreaDrawOptions, strip.TopStrip, null, isLegendBorder);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout;
			RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions = drawOptions as RangeAreaDrawOptions;
			if (rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout != null && rangeAreaDrawOptions != null)
			{
				if (RangeAreaView.Marker2 != null && rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.Polygon != null && !RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.Rect).IsEmpty)
				{
					rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.RenderShadow(renderer, rangeAreaDrawOptions.Shadow, -1);
				}
				if (RangeAreaView.Marker1 != null && rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon != null && !RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon.Rect).IsEmpty)
				{
					rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon.RenderShadow(renderer, rangeAreaDrawOptions.Shadow, -1);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			RenderMarker2(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
			RenderMarker1(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
		}

		public void RenderMarker1(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout;
			RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions = drawOptions as RangeAreaDrawOptions;
			if (rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout != null && rangeAreaDrawOptions != null && RangeAreaView.Marker1 != null && rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon != null && !RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon.Rect).IsEmpty)
			{
				RenderMarker(renderer, rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker1, rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.ZeroPolygon, rangeAreaDrawOptions, pointLayout.PointData.SelectionState);
			}
		}

		public void RenderMarker2(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout;
			RangeAreaDrawOptions rangeAreaDrawOptions = drawOptions as RangeAreaDrawOptions;
			if (rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout != null && rangeAreaDrawOptions != null && RangeAreaView.Marker2 != null && rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.Polygon != null && !RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.Rect).IsEmpty)
			{
				RenderMarker(renderer, rangeAreaDrawOptions.Marker2, rangeAreaSeriesPointLayout.Polygon, rangeAreaDrawOptions, pointLayout.PointData.SelectionState);
			}
		}
	}
	public class StepAreaSeriesViewPainter : AreaSeriesViewPainter

		public static RangeStrip CreateStepAreaMarkerStrip(IGeometryStripCreator creator, Rectangle bounds, bool invertedStep)
		{
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = creator.CreateStrip() as RangeStrip;
			if (rangeStrip != null)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = StripsUtils.CalcLegendStepLinePoints(bounds, invertedStep);
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = new LineStrip();
				foreach (GRealPoint2D item in lineStrip)
				{
					lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(item.X, bounds.Bottom));
				}
				rangeStrip.TopStrip = lineStrip;
				rangeStrip.BottomStrip = lineStrip2;
			}
			return rangeStrip;
		}

		public StepAreaSeriesViewPainter(IAreaSeriesView view, IStepSeriesView stepView)
			: base(view)
		{
			this.stepView = stepView;
		}

		protected override Rectangle CalculateBoundsForLegendMarker(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			return GraphicUtils.InflateRect(bounds, -2, -2);
		}

		protected override RangeStrip CreateLegendMarkerStrip(Rectangle bounds, bool pointMarkerVisible)
		{
			return CreateStepAreaMarkerStrip(base.View, bounds, stepView.InvertedStep);
		}
	}
	public class StepLineSeriesViewPainter : LineSeriesViewPainter
	{
		private StepLineSeriesView StepLineView => (StepLineSeriesView)base.View;

		protected override LineCap LineCap => LineCap.Square;

		public StepLineSeriesViewPainter(StepLineSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void RenderLineLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			LineStrip strip = StripsUtils.CalcLegendStepLinePoints(bounds, StepLineView.InvertedStep);
			Shadow shadow = lineDrawOptions.Shadow;
			LineStyle lineStyle = lineDrawOptions.LineStyle;
			shadow.BeforeShadowRender(renderer);
			renderer.DrawLines(strip, lineDrawOptions.Shadow.Color, 1, lineStyle, LineCap.Flat);
			shadow.AfterShadowRender(renderer);
			renderer.DrawLines(strip, GetLineColor(lineDrawOptions, selectionState), 1, lineStyle, LineCap);
		}
	}
	public static class SwiftPointSeriesViewPainter
	{
		private static Color GetMarkerColor(SwiftPointDrawOptions drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			return GraphicUtils.CorrectColorBySelectionState(drawOptions.Color, selectionState);
		}

		private static Color GetBorderColor(SwiftPointDrawOptions drawOptions, IChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!drawOptions.Marker.BorderVisible)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			CustomBorder border = drawOptions.Marker.Border;
			if (border.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				Color borderColor = appearance.MarkerAppearance.BorderColor;
				if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return borderColor;
				}
			}
			Color automaticBorderColor = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(20, 0, 0, 0), drawOptions.Color);
			return BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, automaticBorderColor);
		}

		public static void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, SwiftPointDrawOptions drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState, IChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (drawOptions != null)
			{
				IPolygon polygon = drawOptions.Marker.CalculatePolygon(bounds);
				if (polygon != null)
				{
					Color markerColor = GetMarkerColor(drawOptions, selectionState);
					Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(drawOptions, appearance);
					int borderThickness = (drawOptions.Marker.BorderVisible ? drawOptions.Marker.Border.Thickness : 0);
					drawOptions.Marker.RenderWithAntialiasing(renderer, polygon, markerColor, drawOptions.ActualColor2, borderColor, borderThickness);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RenderMarkers(ChartRenderer renderer, SwiftPointWholeSeriesLayout layout, SwiftPointDrawOptions drawOptions, IChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (layout != null && drawOptions != null && layout.Points.Count != 0)
			{
				SelectionState selectionState = layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState;
				Color markerColor = GetMarkerColor(drawOptions, selectionState);
				Color actualColor = drawOptions.ActualColor2;
				Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(drawOptions, appearance);
				int borderThickness = (drawOptions.Marker.BorderVisible ? drawOptions.Marker.Border.Thickness : 0);
				int size = drawOptions.Marker.Size;
				bool isSelected = selectionState != SelectionState.Normal;
				IPolygon polygon = drawOptions.Marker.CalculatePolygon(layout.Points[0], isSelected, size);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(polygon.EnableAntialiasing);
				for (int i = 0; i < layout.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					polygon = drawOptions.Marker.CalculatePolygon(layout.Points[i], isSelected, size);
					drawOptions.Marker.Render(renderer, polygon, markerColor, actualColor, borderColor, borderThickness);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}
	}
	public class RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout : AreaSeriesPointLayout
	{
		private IPolygon zeroPolygon;

		public IPolygon ZeroPolygon => zeroPolygon;

		public RangeAreaSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, DiagramPoint actualPoint, IPolygon polygon, DiagramPoint zeroPoint, IPolygon zeroPolygon)
			: base(pointData, actualPoint, polygon, zeroPoint)
		{
			this.zeroPolygon = zeroPolygon;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			IHitRegion hitRegion = GraphicUtils.MakeHitRegion(zeroPolygon);
			hitRegionContainer.Union(hitRegion);
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}
	public class Bar3DRepresentationCalculator
	{
		private const int segmentsCountMin = 5;

		private const int segmentsCountMax = 36;

		private const double facetPercent = 0.05;

		private readonly Bar3DSeriesView view;

		private bool IsCenterVerticalGradientMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (view.FillStyle.FillMode != FillMode3D.Gradient)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(view.FillStyle.Options is RectangleGradientFillOptions rectangleGradientFillOptions))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode != RectangleGradientMode.ToCenterVertical)
				{
					return rectangleGradientFillOptions.GradientMode == RectangleGradientMode.FromCenterVertical;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public Bar3DRepresentationCalculator(Bar3DSeriesView view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		private int CalcSegmentsCount(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData)
		{
			view.CalcWidthAndDepth(coordsCalculator, barData.Width, out var width, out var depth);
			int num = (int)(Math.Max(width, depth) * 0.004 * (double)coordsCalculator.Diagram.ZoomPercent);
			if (num < 5)
			{
				num = 5;
			}
			else if (num > 36)
			{
				num = 36;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcFacetSize(YPlaneRectangle barBase, double barHeight)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(barBase.Height, barBase.Width);
			double num2 = num * 0.05;
			if (num2 > Math.Abs(barHeight))
			{
				num2 = Math.Abs(barHeight);
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private void CalcPointParams(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData, out YPlaneRectangle barBase, out double height, out double beginHeight, out double endHeight)
		{
			double displayArgument = barData.DisplayArgument;
			view.CalcWidthAndDepth(coordsCalculator, barData.Width, out var width, out var depth);
			double num = width / 2.0;
			double num2 = depth / 2.0;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(view.Series, displayArgument, 0.0, clipping: false);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(view.Series, displayArgument, barData.ZeroValue, clipping: false);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(view.Series, displayArgument, barData.ActualValue, clipping: false);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint4 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPoint(view.Series, displayArgument, barData.MaxValue, clipping: false);
			diagramPoint.X += barData.FixedOffset;
			DiagramPoint point = DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, 0.0 - num, 0.0, 0.0 - num2);
			height = diagramPoint4.Y - diagramPoint.Y;
			beginHeight = diagramPoint2.Y - diagramPoint.Y;
			endHeight = diagramPoint3.Y - diagramPoint.Y;
			barBase = new YPlaneRectangle(point, depth, width);
		}

		private void CalcPointParams(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData, out YPlaneRectangle barBase, out double height)
		{
			CalcPointParams(coordsCalculator, barData, out barBase, out height, out var beginHeight, out var endHeight);
			barBase.Offset(0.0, beginHeight, 0.0);
			height = endHeight - beginHeight;
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ConstructBox(YPlaneRectangle boxBase, double height, bool constructWithTopBase, bool constructWithBottomBase)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			Box box = new Box(boxBase, height);
			list.AddRange(box.GetLaterals());
			YPlaneRectangle yPlaneRectangle = ((height > 0.0) ? box.Bottom : box.Top);
			if (constructWithBottomBase)
			{
				list.Add(yPlaneRectangle.CalcTopHalf());
				list.Add(yPlaneRectangle.CalcBottomHalf());
			}
			YPlaneRectangle yPlaneRectangle2 = ((height > 0.0) ? box.Top : box.Bottom);
			if (constructWithTopBase)
			{
				list.Add(yPlaneRectangle2.CalcTopHalf());
				list.Add(yPlaneRectangle2.CalcBottomHalf());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ConstructFacetBox(YPlaneRectangle boxBase, double height, bool constructWithBottomBase)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			double num = CalcFacetSize(boxBase, height);
			double num2 = ((height > 0.0) ? (height - num) : (height + num));
			Box box = new Box(boxBase, num2);
			YPlaneRectangle yPlaneRectangle = ((num2 > 0.0) ? box.Bottom : box.Top);
			if (constructWithBottomBase)
			{
				list.Add(yPlaneRectangle.CalcTopHalf());
				list.Add(yPlaneRectangle.CalcBottomHalf());
			}
			list.AddRange(box.GetLaterals());
			YPlaneRectangle bottomPyramidBase = (YPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(boxBase, 0.0, num2, 0.0);
			YPlaneRectangle yPlaneRectangle2 = (YPlaneRectangle)PlaneRectangle.Inflate(boxBase, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			yPlaneRectangle2.Offset(0.0, height, 0.0);
			Pyramid pyramid = new Pyramid(bottomPyramidBase, yPlaneRectangle2);
			list.AddRange(pyramid.Laterals);
			if (pyramid.TopBase != null)
			{
				list.Add(pyramid.TopBase);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] CalcBoxRepresentation(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData, out Box boundingBox)
		{
			CalcPointParams(coordsCalculator, barData, out var barBase, out var height);
			boundingBox = new Box(barBase, height);
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			if (IsCenterVerticalGradientMode)
			{
				list.AddRange(ConstructBox(barBase, height / 2.0, constructWithTopBase: false, constructWithBottomBase: true));
				YPlaneRectangle boxBase = (YPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(barBase, 0.0, height / 2.0, 0.0);
				if (barData.ShowFacet)
				{
					list.AddRange(ConstructFacetBox(boxBase, height / 2.0, constructWithBottomBase: false));
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(ConstructBox(boxBase, height / 2.0, constructWithTopBase: true, constructWithBottomBase: false));
				}
			}
			else if (barData.ShowFacet)
			{
				list.AddRange(ConstructFacetBox(barBase, height, constructWithBottomBase: true));
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(ConstructBox(barBase, height, constructWithTopBase: true, constructWithBottomBase: true));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ConstructCylinder(YPlaneRectangle cylinderBase, double height, int segmentsCount, bool constructWithTopBase, bool constructWithBottomBase)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			Cylinder cylinder = new Cylinder(cylinderBase, height, segmentsCount);
			list.AddRange(cylinder.Laterals);
			if (constructWithBottomBase)
			{
				list.Add(cylinder.BottomBase);
			}
			if (constructWithTopBase)
			{
				list.Add(cylinder.TopBase);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ConstructFacetCylinder(YPlaneRectangle cylinderBase, double height, int segmentsCount, bool constructWithBottomBase)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			double num = CalcFacetSize(cylinderBase, height);
			double num2 = ((height > 0.0) ? (height - num) : (height + num));
			Cylinder cylinder = new Cylinder(cylinderBase, num2, segmentsCount);
			if (constructWithBottomBase)
			{
				list.Add(cylinder.BottomBase);
			}
			list.AddRange(cylinder.Laterals);
			YPlaneRectangle bottomBase = (YPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(cylinderBase, 0.0, num2, 0.0);
			YPlaneRectangle yPlaneRectangle = (YPlaneRectangle)PlaneRectangle.Inflate(cylinderBase, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			yPlaneRectangle.Offset(0.0, height, 0.0);
			Cone cone = new Cone(bottomBase, yPlaneRectangle, segmentsCount);
			list.AddRange(cone.Laterals);
			if (cone.TopBase != null)
			{
				list.Add(cone.TopBase);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] CalcCylinderRepresentation(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData, out Box boundingBox)
		{
			CalcPointParams(coordsCalculator, barData, out var barBase, out var height);
			boundingBox = new Box(barBase, height);
			int segmentsCount = CalcSegmentsCount(coordsCalculator, barData);
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			if (IsCenterVerticalGradientMode)
			{
				list.AddRange(ConstructCylinder(barBase, height / 2.0, segmentsCount, constructWithTopBase: false, constructWithBottomBase: true));
				YPlaneRectangle cylinderBase = (YPlaneRectangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(barBase, 0.0, height / 2.0, 0.0);
				if (barData.ShowFacet)
				{
					list.AddRange(ConstructFacetCylinder(cylinderBase, height / 2.0, segmentsCount, constructWithBottomBase: false));
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(ConstructCylinder(cylinderBase, height / 2.0, segmentsCount, constructWithTopBase: true, constructWithBottomBase: false));
				}
			}
			else if (barData.ShowFacet)
			{
				list.AddRange(ConstructFacetCylinder(barBase, height, segmentsCount, constructWithBottomBase: true));
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(ConstructCylinder(barBase, height, segmentsCount, constructWithTopBase: true, constructWithBottomBase: true));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ConstructConeOrPyramid(YPlaneRectangle barBase, double height, double beginHeight, double endHeight, int segmentsCount, bool constructWithTopBase, bool constructWithBottomBase)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			Cone cone = ((view.Model != Bar3DModel.Cone) ? new Pyramid(barBase, height, beginHeight, endHeight) : new Cone(barBase, height, beginHeight, endHeight, segmentsCount));
			list.AddRange(cone.Laterals);
			if (constructWithBottomBase)
			{
				list.Add(cone.BottomBase);
			}
			if (constructWithTopBase && cone.TopBase != null)
			{
				list.Add(cone.TopBase);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] CalcConeOrPyramidRepresentation(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData, out Box boundingBox)
		{
			CalcPointParams(coordsCalculator, barData, out var barBase, out var height, out var beginHeight, out var endHeight);
			int segmentsCount = CalcSegmentsCount(coordsCalculator, barData);
			double num = barBase.Height * (height - beginHeight) / height;
			double depth = barBase.Width * (height - beginHeight) / height;
			DiagramPoint point = DiagramPoint.Offset(barBase.Location, (barBase.Height - num) / 2.0, beginHeight, 0.0);
			boundingBox = new Box(point, num, endHeight - beginHeight, depth);
			if (IsCenterVerticalGradientMode)
			{
				List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
				double num2 = (beginHeight + endHeight) / 2.0;
				list.AddRange(ConstructConeOrPyramid(barBase, height, num2, endHeight, segmentsCount, constructWithTopBase: true, constructWithBottomBase: false));
				list.AddRange(ConstructConeOrPyramid(barBase, height, beginHeight, num2, segmentsCount, constructWithTopBase: false, constructWithBottomBase: true));
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return ConstructConeOrPyramid(barBase, height, beginHeight, endHeight, segmentsCount, constructWithTopBase: true, constructWithBottomBase: true);
		}

		public PlanePolygon[] CalcRepresentation(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Bar3DData barData, out Box boundingBox)
		{
			switch (view.Model)
			{
			case Bar3DModel.Box:
				return CalcBoxRepresentation(coordsCalculator, barData, out boundingBox);
			case Bar3DModel.Cone:
				return CalcConeOrPyramidRepresentation(coordsCalculator, barData, out boundingBox);
			case Bar3DModel.Cylinder:
				return CalcCylinderRepresentation(coordsCalculator, barData, out boundingBox);
			case Bar3DModel.Pyramid:
				return CalcConeOrPyramidRepresentation(coordsCalculator, barData, out boundingBox);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Bar3D model.");
				boundingBox = null;
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class WaterfallHelper
	{
		public static Series FindWaterfallSeries(Chart chart)
		{
			if (chart != null)
			{
				SeriesCollection series = chart.Series;
				foreach (Series item in series)
				{
					if (item.View is WaterfallSeriesView)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool IsMultipleWaterfallSeries(Chart chart)
		{
			if (chart != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				SeriesCollection series = chart.Series;
				foreach (Series item in series)
				{
					if (item.View is WaterfallSeriesView && ++num > 1)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class BoxPlotRenderer
	{
		private static readonly PolygonFillStyle MeanMarkerFillStyle = new PolygonFillStyle(null)
		{
			FillMode = FillMode.Solid
		};

		private const int LegendMarkerBorderThickness = 1;

		internal const int StarPointCount = 5;

		private const int SelectedOutlierInflateValue = 1;

		private readonly BoxPlotSeriesView boxPlotView;

		private BarSeriesViewAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(boxPlotView)?.BarSeriesViewAppearance;
		}

		public BoxPlotRenderer(BoxPlotSeriesView boxPlotView)
		{
			if (boxPlotView == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.boxPlotView = boxPlotView;
		}

		private Color GetBorderColor(BoxPlotDrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			BarSeriesViewAppearance appearance = GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null && drawOptions.Border.Color == Color.Empty && appearance.BorderColor != Color.Empty)
			{
				return appearance.BorderColor;
			}
			Color baseColor = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(100, 0, 0, 0), drawOptions.Color);
			baseColor = Color.FromArgb(90, baseColor);
			return BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(drawOptions.Border, baseColor);
		}

		private Color GetMixedBorderAndBoxColor(BoxPlotDrawOptions boxPlotDrawOptions)
		{
			Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(boxPlotDrawOptions);
			Color color = HitTestColors.MixColors(borderColor, boxPlotDrawOptions.Color);
			if (boxPlotDrawOptions.Color.A != byte.MaxValue)
			{
				byte alpha = (byte)((boxPlotDrawOptions.Color.A + borderColor.A) / 2);
				color = Color.FromArgb(alpha, color);
			}
			return color;
		}

		private void RenderBoxSelection(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (boxPlotView.Series != null && boxPlotView.Series.Chart != null && selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				IHitTest series = boxPlotView.Series;
				if (series != null)
				{
					Color pointHatchColor = boxPlotView.HitTestState.GetPointHatchColor(boxPlotView.Series.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode, selectionState);
					renderer.FillRectangle(rect, boxPlotView.HitTestState.HatchStyle, pointHatchColor);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderBox(ChartRenderer renderer, RectangleF rect, BoxPlotDrawOptions boxPlotDrawOptions, int borderThickness, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			bool flag = rect.Width < 3f || rect.Height < 3f;
			SeriesBase series = boxPlotView.Series;
			if (series == null || series.Chart == null || series.Chart.Diagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool rotated = ((XYDiagram)series.Chart.Diagram).Rotated;
			if (flag && boxPlotDrawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Solid)
			{
				Color color = boxPlotDrawOptions.Color;
				if (boxPlotDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility)
				{
					color = GetMixedBorderAndBoxColor(boxPlotDrawOptions);
				}
				renderer.FillRectangle(rect, color);
				if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
				{
					RenderBoxSelection(renderer, rect, selectionState);
				}
				return;
			}
			RectangleFillStyle fillStyle = boxPlotDrawOptions.FillStyle;
			bool flag2 = fillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient && rotated;
			RectangleGradientMode gradientMode = RectangleGradientMode.TopToBottom;
			if (flag2)
			{
				gradientMode = ((RectangleGradientFillOptions)fillStyle.Options).GradientMode;
				((RectangleGradientFillOptions)fillStyle.Options).RotateGradientMode();
			}
			fillStyle.Render(renderer, rect, rect, boxPlotDrawOptions.Color, boxPlotDrawOptions.ActualColor2);
			if (flag2)
			{
				((RectangleGradientFillOptions)fillStyle.Options).RestoreGradientOrientation(gradientMode);
			}
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				RenderBoxSelection(renderer, rect, selectionState);
			}
			if (borderThickness <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(boxPlotDrawOptions);
			bool actualVisibility = boxPlotDrawOptions.Border.ActualVisibility;
			if (actualVisibility)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					boxPlotDrawOptions.Border.Render(renderer, rect, actualVisibility, borderThickness, borderColor);
				}
				else
				{
					renderer.FillRectangle(rect, borderColor);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, BoxPlotDrawOptions drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			RenderBox(renderer, bounds, drawOptions, 1, selectionState);
		}

		public void RenderCrosshairMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, BoxPlotDrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			RenderBox(renderer, bounds, drawOptions, 1, SelectionState.Normal);
		}

		public void RenderBoxPlotPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout pointLayout, BoxPlotDrawOptions drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState, int highlightedBorderThickness)
		{
			int borderThickness = ((selectionState == SelectionState.Normal) ? drawOptions.Border.Thickness : highlightedBorderThickness);
			RenderBox(renderer, pointLayout.Box, drawOptions, borderThickness, selectionState);
			Color color = (boxPlotView.Border.ActualVisibility ? GetMixedBorderAndBoxColor(drawOptions) : drawOptions.Color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(pointLayout.TopWhiskerHorizontal, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(pointLayout.TopWhiskerVertical, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(pointLayout.BottomWhiskerHorizontal, color);
			renderer.FillRectangle(pointLayout.BottomWhiskerVertical, color);
			Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(drawOptions);
			Color color2 = ((drawOptions.MeanAndMedianColor == Color.Empty) ? borderColor : drawOptions.MeanAndMedianColor);
			renderer.FillRectangle(pointLayout.MedianRectangle, color2);
			if (pointLayout.IsMeanMarkerVisible)
			{
				MarkerBase.Render(renderer, pointLayout.MeanMarkerPolygon, MeanMarkerFillStyle, color2, Color.Empty, Color.Empty, 0);
			}
			if (pointLayout.OutlierPolygons == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int borderThickness2 = (boxPlotView.Border.ActualVisibility ? boxPlotView.Border.ActualThickness : 0);
			PolygonFillStyle polygonFillStyle = new PolygonFillStyle(null, drawOptions.ActualColor2);
			polygonFillStyle.FillMode = drawOptions.FillStyle.FillMode;
			polygonFillStyle.Options.Assign(drawOptions.FillStyle.Options);
			Color color3 = GraphicUtils.CorrectColorBySelectionState(drawOptions.Color, selectionState);
			foreach (IPolygon outlierPolygon in pointLayout.OutlierPolygons)
			{
				IPolygon polygon;
				if (selectionState == SelectionState.Selected)
				{
					RectangleF rect = outlierPolygon.Rect;
					rect.Inflate(1f, 1f);
					polygon = MarkerBase.CalculatorBase.CreatePolygon(pointLayout.OutlierMarkerKind, 5, rect);
				}
				else
				{
					polygon = outlierPolygon;
				}
				MarkerBase.Render(renderer, polygon, polygonFillStyle, color3, drawOptions.ActualColor2, borderColor, borderThickness2);
			}
		}

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout boxPlotPointLayout, BoxPlotDrawOptions boxPlotDrawOptions)
		{
			Shadow shadow = boxPlotDrawOptions.Shadow;
			if (!shadow.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			int actualSize = shadow.GetActualSize(-1);
			shadow.Render(renderer, boxPlotPointLayout.Box, actualSize);
			shadow.Render(renderer, boxPlotPointLayout.TopWhiskerHorizontal, actualSize);
			shadow.Render(renderer, boxPlotPointLayout.TopWhiskerVertical, actualSize);
			shadow.Render(renderer, boxPlotPointLayout.BottomWhiskerHorizontal, actualSize);
			shadow.Render(renderer, boxPlotPointLayout.BottomWhiskerVertical, actualSize);
			if (boxPlotPointLayout.OutlierPolygons == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IPolygon outlierPolygon in boxPlotPointLayout.OutlierPolygons)
			{
				outlierPolygon.RenderShadow(renderer, shadow, -1);
			}
		}

		public void RenderMeanLine(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, List<IGeometryStrip> layoutStrips, LineStyle lineStyle, BoxPlotDrawOptions drawOptions, LineCap lineCap)
		{
			List<LineStrip> list = new List<LineStrip>();
			if (!LargeScaleHelper.IsValid(layoutStrips))
			{
				foreach (LineStrip layoutStrip in layoutStrips)
				{
					list.AddRange(TruncatedLineCalculator.SplitLineStrip(layoutStrip, mappingBounds));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (LineStrip layoutStrip2 in layoutStrips)
				{
					list.Add(layoutStrip2);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool antiAlias = lineStyle.AntiAlias;
			foreach (LineStrip item in list)
			{
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(antiAlias);
				Color borderColor = GetBorderColor(drawOptions);
				Color color = HitTestColors.MixColors(borderColor, drawOptions.Color);
				renderer.DrawLines(item, color, lineStyle.Thickness, lineStyle, lineCap);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}
	}
	public class BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		public RectangleF Box { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF TopWhiskerHorizontal { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF TopWhiskerVertical { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF BottomWhiskerHorizontal { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF BottomWhiskerVertical { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF MedianRectangle { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF WholeBounds { get; private set; }

		public bool IsMeanMarkerVisible { get; private set; }

		public IPolygon MeanMarkerPolygon { get; private set; }

		public ReadOnlyCollection<IPolygon> OutlierPolygons { get; private set; }

		public int OutlierMarkerSizePixels { get; }

		public int MeanMarkerSizePixels { get; }

		public int LineThicknessPixels { get; }

		public MarkerKind OutlierMarkerKind { get; }

		public MarkerKind MeanMarkerKind { get; }

		public BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, BoxPlotSeriesView seriesView, XYDiagramMapping diagramMapping)
			: base(pointData)
		{
			OutlierMarkerSizePixels = seriesView.OutlierMarkerSize;
			MeanMarkerSizePixels = seriesView.MeanMarkerSize;
			MeanMarkerKind = seriesView.MeanMarkerKind;
			LineThicknessPixels = seriesView.LineThickness;
			OutlierMarkerKind = seriesView.OutlierMarkerKind;
			Calculate(pointData.RefinedPoint, seriesView.CapWidthPercentage, diagramMapping);
		}

		public BoxPlotSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, BoxPlotSeriesView seriesView, XYDiagramMapping diagramMapping)
			: base(null)
		{
			OutlierMarkerSizePixels = seriesView.OutlierMarkerSize;
			MeanMarkerSizePixels = seriesView.MeanMarkerSize;
			MeanMarkerKind = seriesView.MeanMarkerKind;
			LineThicknessPixels = seriesView.LineThickness;
			OutlierMarkerKind = seriesView.OutlierMarkerKind;
			Calculate(refinedPoint, seriesView.CapWidthPercentage, diagramMapping);
		}

		private double GetMappedCoord(AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mapping, double coord, int offset = 0)
		{
			double coordCore = mapping.GetCoordCore(coord);
			double value = coordCore + (double)offset;
			return LargeScaleHelper.Validate(value);
		}

		private RectangleF CalculateRectangle(MappingTransform transform, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(x1, y1);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(x2, y2);
			DiagramPoint corner = transform.Apply(diagramPoint);
			DiagramPoint corner2 = transform.Apply(diagramPoint2);
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle(corner, corner2);
		}

		private void CalculateTopWhisker(MappingTransform transform, double whiskerLeft, double centerX, double whiskerRight, double maxY, double quartile3Y, int topLeftThicknessPart, int bottomRightThicknessPart)
		{
			double y = maxY + (double)topLeftThicknessPart;
			double y2 = maxY - (double)bottomRightThicknessPart;
			TopWhiskerHorizontal = CalculateRectangle(transform, whiskerLeft, y, whiskerRight, y2);
			double x = centerX - (double)topLeftThicknessPart;
			double y3 = maxY - (double)bottomRightThicknessPart;
			double x2 = centerX + (double)bottomRightThicknessPart;
			TopWhiskerVertical = CalculateRectangle(transform, x, y3, x2, quartile3Y);
		}

		private void CalculateBottomWhisker(MappingTransform transform, double whiskerLeft, double centerX, double whiskerRight, double minY, double quartile1Y, int topLeftThicknessPart, int bottomRightThicknessPart)
		{
			double y = minY + (double)topLeftThicknessPart;
			double y2 = minY - (double)bottomRightThicknessPart;
			BottomWhiskerHorizontal = CalculateRectangle(transform, whiskerLeft, y, whiskerRight, y2);
			double x = centerX - (double)topLeftThicknessPart;
			double x2 = centerX + (double)bottomRightThicknessPart;
			double y3 = minY + (double)topLeftThicknessPart;
			BottomWhiskerVertical = CalculateRectangle(transform, x, quartile1Y, x2, y3);
		}

		private void CalculateMedian(MappingTransform transform, double boxLeft, double boxRight, double medianY, int topLeftThicknessPart, int bottomRightThicknessPart)
		{
			double y = medianY + (double)topLeftThicknessPart;
			double y2 = medianY - (double)bottomRightThicknessPart;
			MedianRectangle = CalculateRectangle(transform, boxLeft, y, boxRight, y2);
		}

		private void CalculateMean(MappingTransform transform, double? meanY, double centerX)
		{
			if (meanY.HasValue)
			{
				IsMeanMarkerVisible = true;
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = transform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(centerX - (double)(LineThicknessPixels / 2), meanY.Value));
				int num = MeanMarkerSizePixels / 2;
				int x = (int)(diagramPoint.X - (double)num);
				int y = (int)(diagramPoint.Y - (double)num);
				MeanMarkerPolygon = MarkerBase.CalculatorBase.CreatePolygon(bounds: new Rectangle(x, y, MeanMarkerSizePixels, MeanMarkerSizePixels), kind: MeanMarkerKind, starPointCount: 5);
			}
			else
			{
				IsMeanMarkerVisible = false;
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CreateOutlierRectangle(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			double num = 0.5 * (double)OutlierMarkerSizePixels;
			int x = (int)(point.X - num);
			int y = (int)(point.Y - num);
			return new Rectangle(x, y, OutlierMarkerSizePixels, OutlierMarkerSizePixels);
		}

		private void CalculateOutliers(XYDiagramMapping diagramMapping, double centerX, double[] outliers)
		{
			if (outliers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IPolygon> list = new List<IPolygon>(outliers.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < outliers.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(outliers[i]))
				{
					double mappedCoord = GetMappedCoord(diagramMapping.MappingY, outliers[i]);
					DiagramPoint point = diagramMapping.Transform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(centerX, mappedCoord));
					Rectangle rectangle = CreateOutlierRectangle(point);
					IPolygon item = MarkerBase.CalculatorBase.CreatePolygon(OutlierMarkerKind, 5, rectangle);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			OutlierPolygons = list.AsReadOnly();
		}

		private void CalculateWholeBounds()
		{
			RectangleF a = RectangleF.Union(Box, TopWhiskerVertical);
			a = RectangleF.Union(a, TopWhiskerHorizontal);
			a = RectangleF.Union(a, BottomWhiskerHorizontal);
			a = RectangleF.Union(a, BottomWhiskerVertical);
			if (OutlierPolygons != null)
			{
				foreach (IPolygon outlierPolygon in OutlierPolygons)
				{
					a = RectangleF.Union(a, outlierPolygon.Rect);
				}
			}
			WholeBounds = a;
		}

		private RectangleF CenterizeRect(RectangleF rect, RectangleF center)
		{
			double num = center.Left - rect.Left;
			double num2 = rect.Right - center.Right;
			if (num2 - num > 1.0)
			{
				rect.Offset(-1f, 0f);
				return rect;
			}
			if (num - num2 > 1.0)
			{
				rect.Offset(1f, 0f);
				return rect;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private void Calculate(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, double capWidthPercentage, XYDiagramMapping diagramMapping)
		{
			AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mappingX = diagramMapping.MappingX;
			AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mappingY = diagramMapping.MappingY;
			double num = 0.01 * capWidthPercentage;
			double num2 = 0.5 * ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).BarWidth * num;
			double num3 = 0.5 * ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).BarWidth;
			int num4 = LineThicknessPixels / 2;
			int bottomRightThicknessPart = LineThicknessPixels - num4;
			double num5 = ((IArgumentPoint)refinedPoint).Argument + ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).Offset;
			double coord = num5 - num3;
			double coord2 = num5 + num3;
			double coord3 = num5 - num2;
			double coord4 = num5 + num2;
			int fixedOffset = ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).FixedOffset;
			double mappedCoord = GetMappedCoord(mappingX, num5, fixedOffset);
			double mappedCoord2 = GetMappedCoord(mappingX, coord, fixedOffset);
			double num6 = GetMappedCoord(mappingX, coord2, fixedOffset) + 1.0;
			double mappedCoord3 = GetMappedCoord(mappingX, coord3, fixedOffset);
			double whiskerRight = GetMappedCoord(mappingX, coord4, fixedOffset) + 1.0;
			double mappedCoord4 = GetMappedCoord(mappingY, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Min);
			double mappedCoord5 = GetMappedCoord(mappingY, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Quartile1);
			double mappedCoord6 = GetMappedCoord(mappingY, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Median);
			double mappedCoord7 = GetMappedCoord(mappingY, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Quartile3);
			double mappedCoord8 = GetMappedCoord(mappingY, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Max);
			double? meanY = (double.IsNaN(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Mean) ? ((double?)null) : new double?(GetMappedCoord(mappingY, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Mean)));
			MappingTransform transform = diagramMapping.Transform;
			CalculateTopWhisker(transform, mappedCoord3, mappedCoord, whiskerRight, mappedCoord8, mappedCoord7, num4, bottomRightThicknessPart);
			Box = CalculateRectangle(transform, mappedCoord2, mappedCoord7, num6, mappedCoord5);
			CalculateBottomWhisker(transform, mappedCoord3, mappedCoord, whiskerRight, mappedCoord4, mappedCoord5, num4, bottomRightThicknessPart);
			TopWhiskerHorizontal = CenterizeRect(TopWhiskerHorizontal, TopWhiskerVertical);
			BottomWhiskerHorizontal = CenterizeRect(BottomWhiskerHorizontal, BottomWhiskerVertical);
			Box = CenterizeRect(Box, TopWhiskerVertical);
			CalculateMedian(transform, mappedCoord2, num6, mappedCoord6, num4, bottomRightThicknessPart);
			CalculateMean(transform, meanY, mappedCoord);
			CalculateOutliers(diagramMapping, mappedCoord, ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Outliers);
			CalculateWholeBounds();
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(Box));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(BottomWhiskerHorizontal));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(BottomWhiskerVertical));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(TopWhiskerHorizontal));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(TopWhiskerVertical));
			if (OutlierPolygons != null)
			{
				foreach (IPolygon outlierPolygon in OutlierPolygons)
				{
					DXGraphicsPath path = outlierPolygon.GetPath();
					hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(path));
				}
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}

		public BoxPlotMeanLineWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, int lineThickness, Rectangle bounds, bool optimizeHitTesting)

		}
	}
