	public class Ellipse : IEllipse
	{
		private GRealPoint2D center;

		private double majorSemiaxis;

		private double minorSemiaxis;

		private double majorMinorRatio;

		private double minorMajorRatio;

		private double majorMinorProduct;

		private double area;

		public GRealPoint2D Center => center;

		public double MajorSemiaxis => majorSemiaxis;

		public double MinorSemiaxis => minorSemiaxis;

		public double Area => area;

		private static GRealPoint2D Polar2Cartesian(double angle, double radius)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(radius * Math.Cos(angle), (0.0 - radius) * Math.Sin(angle));
		}

		private static double CalculateOffsetAngle(PointF destinationPoint, int thickness)
		{
			float num = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(destinationPoint, PointF.Empty);
			return Math.Asin((float)thickness / num);
		}

		private static double AtanMulTan(double multiplier, double tanAngle)
		{
			double num = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(tanAngle);
			double num2 = tanAngle;
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(num), Math.PI / 2.0, 1E-05) != 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(num), 4.71238898038469, 1E-05) != 0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Atan(multiplier * Math.Tan(num)) + tanAngle - num;
				if (Math.Abs(num) > Math.PI / 2.0 && Math.Abs(num) < 4.71238898038469)
				{
					num2 += (double)Math.Sign(tanAngle) * Math.PI;
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(num) > 4.71238898038469)
				{
					num2 += (double)(Math.Sign(tanAngle) * 2) * Math.PI;
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public Ellipse(GRealPoint2D center, double majorSemiaxis, double minorSemiaxis)
		{
			this.center = center;
			this.majorSemiaxis = majorSemiaxis;
			this.minorSemiaxis = minorSemiaxis;
			majorMinorRatio = majorSemiaxis / minorSemiaxis;
			minorMajorRatio = minorSemiaxis / majorSemiaxis;
			majorMinorProduct = majorSemiaxis * minorSemiaxis;
			area = Math.PI * majorMinorProduct;
		}

		private PointF? CalculateCrossPoint(PointF nearestEllipsePoint, int offset)
		{
			return Line2D.CreateParallelLine(PointF.Empty, nearestEllipsePoint, offset).CalculateCrossWithEllipse(nearestEllipsePoint, this);
		}

		public Ellipse Inflate(double dx, double dy)
		{
			return new Ellipse(center, majorSemiaxis + dx, minorSemiaxis + dy);
		}

		public LineStrip GetContour()
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			int num = 150;
			double num2 = Math.PI * 2.0;
			double num3 = num2 / (double)num;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(CalcEllipsePoint(num2));
				num2 -= num3;
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public double CalcEllipseRadius(double angle)
		{
			return majorMinorProduct / Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(majorSemiaxis * Math.Sin(angle), 2.0) + Math.Pow(minorSemiaxis * Math.Cos(angle), 2.0));
		}

		public GRealPoint2D CalcEllipsePoint(double angle)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalcAbsoluteEllipsePoint(angle);
			return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X + center.X, gRealPoint2D.Y + center.Y);
		}

		public GRealPoint2D CalcAbsoluteEllipsePoint(double angle)
		{
			return Polar2Cartesian(angle, CalcEllipseRadius(angle));
		}

		public double CalcEllipseAngleFromCircleAngle(double angle)
		{
			return AtanMulTan(minorMajorRatio, angle);
		}

		public double CalcEllipseSectorFinishAngle(double areaSector, double startAngle)
		{
			return AtanMulTan(minorMajorRatio, areaSector * 2.0 / majorMinorProduct + AtanMulTan(majorMinorRatio, startAngle));
		}

		public double CalcEllipseSectorArea(double startAngle, double finishAngle)
		{
			return majorMinorProduct * (AtanMulTan(majorMinorRatio, finishAngle) - AtanMulTan(majorMinorRatio, startAngle)) / 2.0;
		}

		public Rectangle GetEllipseBounds()
		{
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle((int)Math.Round(center.X), (int)Math.Round(center.Y), 0, 0);
			return Rectangle.Inflate(rect, Convert.ToInt32(majorSemiaxis), Convert.ToInt32(minorSemiaxis));
		}

		public GRealPoint2D GetEllipsePointByY(double y)
		{
			double x = Math.Sqrt(1.0 - y * y / (minorSemiaxis * minorSemiaxis)) * majorSemiaxis;
			return new GRealPoint2D(x, y);
		}

		public EllipseArc2D? CalculateArc(double startAngle, double finishAngle, GRealPoint2D startAngleNearestPoint, GRealPoint2D finishAngleNearestPoint, int offset)
		{
			PointF? pointF = CalculateCrossPoint(startAngleNearestPoint.ToPointF(), offset);
			PointF? pointF2 = CalculateCrossPoint(finishAngleNearestPoint.ToPointF(), -offset);
			if (pointF.HasValue && pointF2.HasValue)
			{
				double num = startAngle + CalculateOffsetAngle(pointF.Value, offset);
				double num2 = finishAngle - CalculateOffsetAngle(pointF2.Value, offset);
				return new EllipseArc2D(num, num2 - num, this);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public struct Line2D
	{
		private const float horizontalTolerance = 1E-08f;

		private readonly float factorA;

		private readonly float factorB;

		private readonly float factorC;

		public float FactorA => factorA;

		public float FactorB => factorB;

		public float FactorC => factorC;

		public bool IsHorizontal => Math.Abs(factorA) < 1E-08f;

		public static Line2D CreateParallelLine(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint, float parallelOffset)
		{
			return new Line2D(startPoint, endPoint).GetParallelLine(parallelOffset);
		}

		public Line2D(float factorA, float factorB, float factorC)
		{
			this.factorA = factorA;
			this.factorB = factorB;
			this.factorC = factorC;
		}

		public Line2D(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			factorA = startPoint.Y - endPoint.Y;
			factorB = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			factorC = startPoint.X * endPoint.Y - endPoint.X * startPoint.Y;
		}

		private Line2D GetParallelLine(float offset)
		{
			float num = (float)Math.Sqrt(factorA * factorA + factorB * factorB) * offset;
			return new Line2D(factorA, factorB, factorC + num);
		}

		public PointF GetPointByY(float y)
		{
			return new PointF(((0f - factorB) * y - factorC) / factorA, y);
		}

		public PointF? CalculateCrossWithEllipse(PointF nearestEllipsePoint, Ellipse ellipse)
		{
			float num = factorA * factorA;
			float num2 = factorB * factorB;
			float num3 = (float)ellipse.MajorSemiaxis;
			float num4 = (float)ellipse.MinorSemiaxis;
			float num5 = num3 * num3;
			float num6 = num4 * num4;
			float num7 = num6 * num2 - factorC * factorC + num5 * num;
			if (num7 < 0f)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float num8 = (0f - factorC) * factorB * num6;
			float num9 = num3 * num4 * factorA * (float)Math.Sqrt(num7);
			float num10 = num6 * num2 + num5 * num;
			PointF pointF;
			PointF pointF2;
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				pointF = ellipse.GetEllipsePointByY((num8 - num9) / num10).ToPointF();
				pointF2 = new PointF(0f - pointF.X, pointF.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				pointF = GetPointByY((num8 - num9) / num10);
				pointF2 = GetPointByY((num8 + num9) / num10);
			}
			float num11 = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(nearestEllipsePoint, pointF);
			float num12 = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(nearestEllipsePoint, pointF2);
			return (num11 > num12) ? pointF2 : pointF;
		}
	}
	public struct EllipseArc2D
	{
		private readonly double startAngle;

		private readonly double sweepAngle;

		private readonly Rectangle ellipseBounds;

		public double StartAngle => startAngle;

		public double SweepAngle => sweepAngle;

		public float StartAngleDegree => 0f - (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(startAngle);

		public float SweepAngleDegree => 0f - (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(sweepAngle);

		public float FinishAngleDegree => StartAngleDegree + SweepAngleDegree;

		public Rectangle EllipseBounds => ellipseBounds;

		public EllipseArc2D(double startAngle, double sweepAngle, Ellipse ellipse)
		{
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.sweepAngle = sweepAngle;
			ellipseBounds = ellipse.GetEllipseBounds();
		}
	}
	public class Pie
	{
		private readonly double finishAngle;

		private readonly Ellipse ellipse;

		private readonly int depthPercent;

		private readonly double holePercent;

		private readonly double halfAngle;

		private readonly GRealPoint2D finishPoint;

		private readonly RectangleF anchorBounds;

		private readonly float depth;

		private readonly float holeFraction;

		private double startAngle;

		private double sweepAngle;

		public double StartAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return startAngle;
			}
			set
			{
				startAngle = value;
			}
		}

		public double SweepAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return sweepAngle;
			}
			set
			{
				sweepAngle = value;
			}
		}

		public double HalfAngle => halfAngle;

		public double FinishAngle => finishAngle;

		public GRealPoint2D FinishPoint => finishPoint;

		public GRealPoint2D CenterPoint => ellipse.Center;

		public float StartAngleInDegrees => 0f - (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(startAngle);

		public float SweepAngleInDegrees => 0f - (float)MathUtils.Radian2Degree(sweepAngle);

		public Ellipse Ellipse => ellipse;

		public float MajorSemiaxis => (float)ellipse.MajorSemiaxis;

		public float MinorSemiaxis => (float)ellipse.MinorSemiaxis;

		public float HoleFraction => holeFraction;

		public int DepthPercent => depthPercent;

		public double HolePercent => holePercent;

		public Pie(double startAngle, double finishAngle, Ellipse ellipse, int depthPercent, double holePercent)
		{
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.finishAngle = finishAngle;
			this.ellipse = ellipse;
			this.depthPercent = depthPercent;
			this.holePercent = holePercent;
			sweepAngle = finishAngle - startAngle;
			halfAngle = ellipse.CalcEllipseSectorFinishAngle(ellipse.CalcEllipseSectorArea(startAngle, finishAngle) / 2.0, startAngle);
			finishPoint = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(finishAngle);
			depth = MajorSemiaxis * (float)depthPercent / 50f;
			holeFraction = (float)(holePercent / 100.0);
			bool flag = holePercent > 0.0;
			LineStrip lineStrip = GraphicUtils.FillAnchorPoints(ellipse, startAngle, sweepAngle, !flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse(ellipse.Center, ellipse.MajorSemiaxis * (double)holeFraction, ellipse.MinorSemiaxis * (double)holeFraction);
				lineStrip.AddRange(GraphicUtils.FillAnchorPoints(ellipse2, startAngle, sweepAngle, addCenter: false));
			}
			anchorBounds = GraphicUtils.BoundsFromPointsArray(lineStrip);
		}

		private GRealPoint2D CalculateExplodedOffset(double explodedDistance, double angle)
		{
			double x = explodedDistance * Math.Cos(angle);
			double y = (0.0 - explodedDistance) * Math.Sin(angle);
			return new GRealPoint2D(x, y);
		}

		private GRealPoint2D CalculateExplodedCenter(GRealPoint2D centerPoint, int offset)
		{
			if (SweepAngle > MathUtils.Degree2Radian(189.9))
			{
				offset = 0;
			}
			double explodedDistance = (double)offset / Math.Sin(SweepAngle / 2.0);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalculateExplodedOffset(explodedDistance, StartAngle + SweepAngle / 2.0);
			return new GRealPoint2D(centerPoint.X + gRealPoint2D.X, centerPoint.Y + gRealPoint2D.Y);
		}

		private EllipseArc2D? CalculateArc(Ellipse ellipse, int offset)
		{
			GRealPoint2D startAngleNearestPoint = this.ellipse.CalcAbsoluteEllipsePoint(startAngle);
			GRealPoint2D finishAngleNearestPoint = this.ellipse.CalcAbsoluteEllipsePoint(finishAngle);
			return ellipse.CalculateArc(StartAngle, FinishAngle, startAngleNearestPoint, finishAngleNearestPoint, offset);
		}

		public bool ShouldCreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (MajorSemiaxis >= 0.5f && MinorSemiaxis >= 0.5f && SweepAngleInDegrees != 0f && anchorBounds.Width > 0f)
			{
				return anchorBounds.Height > 0f;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public GRealPoint2D CalculateCenter(PointF basePoint)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(ellipse.Center.X + (double)basePoint.X, ellipse.Center.Y + (double)basePoint.Y);
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(Color color, Color color2, FillStyleBase fillStyle, PointF basePoint)
		{
			RectangleF gradientBounds = anchorBounds;
			gradientBounds.Offset(basePoint);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SimpleAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(fillStyle.Options.CreatePieGraphicsCommand(CalculateCenter(basePoint), MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees, depth, holeFraction, gradientBounds, color, color2));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color, Color color2, FillStyleBase fillStyle, PointF basePoint)
		{
			RectangleF gradientBounds = anchorBounds;
			gradientBounds.Offset(basePoint);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalculateCenter(basePoint);
			fillStyle.Options.RenderPie(renderer, new PointF((float)gRealPoint2D.X, (float)gRealPoint2D.Y), MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees, depth, holeFraction, gradientBounds, color, color2);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateBorderGraphicsCommand(int thickness, PointF basePoint)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SimpleAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			GRealPoint2D center = CalculateCenter(basePoint);
			if (thickness <= 1)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new BoundedPieGraphicsCommand(center, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees, depth, holeFraction));
				return graphicsCommand;
			}
			DXRegion clipRegion;
			using (DXGraphicsPath path = GraphicUtils.CreatePieGraphicsPath(center, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, holeFraction, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees))
			{
				clipRegion = new DXRegion(path);
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new ClippingGraphicsCommand(clipRegion);
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(new BoundedPieGraphicsCommand(center, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees, depth, holeFraction));
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(new BoundedPieGraphicsCommand(center, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, 0f, -360f, depth, holeFraction));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new BoundedPieGraphicsCommand(center, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees, depth, holeFraction));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, Color borderColor, int thickness, PointF basePoint)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			if (thickness > 1)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalculateCenter(basePoint);
				using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GraphicUtils.CreatePieGraphicsPath(gRealPoint2D, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, holeFraction, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees);
				Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(gRealPoint2D, this.ellipse.MajorSemiaxis - (double)thickness, this.ellipse.MinorSemiaxis - (double)thickness);
				EllipseArc2D? ellipseArc2D = CalculateArc(ellipse, thickness);
				if (ellipseArc2D.HasValue)
				{
					float num = MajorSemiaxis * holeFraction + (float)thickness;
					float num2 = MinorSemiaxis * holeFraction + (float)thickness;
					EllipseArc2D? innerArc = null;
					if (holeFraction > 0f && num >= 1f && num2 >= 1f)
					{
						Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse(gRealPoint2D, num, num2);
						innerArc = CalculateArc(ellipse2, thickness);
					}
					GRealPoint2D explodedCenter = CalculateExplodedCenter(gRealPoint2D, thickness);
					using DXGraphicsPath path = GraphicUtils.CreateExplodedPieGraphicsPath(ellipseArc2D.Value, innerArc, explodedCenter);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
				}
				renderer.FillPath(dXGraphicsPath, borderColor);
			}
			renderer.DrawPie(this, basePoint, borderColor, 1);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateHatchGraphicsCommand(PointF basePoint)
		{
			return new HatchedPieGraphicsCommand(CalculateCenter(basePoint), MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis, StartAngleInDegrees, SweepAngleInDegrees, depth, holeFraction);
		}

		public void RenderHatch(ChartRenderer renderer, Color color, PointF basePoint)
		{
			renderer.FillPie(this, basePoint, HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal, color, Color.Empty);
		}

		public Pie Explode(double explodedFactor)
		{
			double explodedDistance = explodedFactor * Ellipse.CalcEllipseRadius(HalfAngle);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalculateExplodedOffset(explodedDistance, HalfAngle);
			GRealPoint2D center = new GRealPoint2D(CenterPoint.X + gRealPoint2D.X, CenterPoint.Y + gRealPoint2D.Y);
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(center, MajorSemiaxis, MinorSemiaxis);
			return new Pie(StartAngle, FinishAngle, ellipse, DepthPercent, HolePercent);
		}
	}
	public class PieSeriesPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		private readonly Pie pie;

		private readonly bool negativeValuesPresents;

		private readonly int positiveValuesCount;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		private PointF basePoint;

		private RectangleF pieBounds;

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public Pie Pie => pie;

		public PointF BasePoint => basePoint;

		public RectangleF PieBounds => pieBounds;

		public bool NegativeValuesPresents => negativeValuesPresents;

		public int PositiveValuesCount => positiveValuesCount;

		public PieSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, Rectangle bounds, Pie pie, PointF basePoint, RectangleF pieBounds, bool negativeValuesPresents, int positiveValuesCount)
			: base(pointData)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.pie = pie;
			this.basePoint = basePoint;
			this.pieBounds = pieBounds;
			this.negativeValuesPresents = negativeValuesPresents;
			this.positiveValuesCount = positiveValuesCount;
		}

		private SizeF CalculatePathSize(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (path.PointCount == 0)
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			float num2;
			float num = (num2 = path.PathPoints[0].X);
			float num4;
			float num3 = (num4 = path.PathPoints[0].Y);
			for (int i = 1; i < path.PointCount; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = path.PathPoints[i];
				num = Math.Min(num, pointF.X);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, pointF.X);
				num3 = Math.Min(num3, pointF.Y);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, pointF.Y);
			}
			return new SizeF(num2 - num, num4 - num3);
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			if (pie.HolePercent == 100.0)
			{
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
				dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(pieBounds, pie.StartAngleInDegrees, pie.SweepAngleInDegrees);
				SizeF sizeF = CalculatePathSize(dXGraphicsPath);
				if (sizeF.Width > 1f || sizeF.Height > 1f)
				{
					using (DXPen pen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, 1f))
					{
						dXGraphicsPath.Widen(pen);
					}
					hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath));
				}
				else
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DXGraphicsPath path = GraphicUtils.CreatePieGraphicsPath(GraphicUtils.CalcCenter((ZPlaneRectangle)pieBounds, roundToInteger: false), pie.MajorSemiaxis, pie.MinorSemiaxis, pie.HoleFraction, pie.StartAngleInDegrees, pie.SweepAngleInDegrees);
				hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(path));
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}

	public class SeriesViewFactory
	{
		private class SeriesViewEntry
		{
			private readonly ViewType viewType;

			private readonly Type type;

			private readonly string stringId;

			public ViewType ViewType => viewType;

			public Type Type => type;

			public string StringID => stringId;

			public SeriesViewEntry(ViewType viewType, Type type, string stringId)
			{
				this.viewType = viewType;
				this.type = type;
				this.stringId = stringId;
			}
		}

		private class SeriesViewList : ArrayList
		{
			public Type this[ViewType viewType]
			{
				get
				{
					int index = GetIndex(viewType);
					if (index != -1)
					{
						return ((SeriesViewEntry)this[index]).Type;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public bool ContainsViewType(ViewType viewType)
			{
				return GetIndex(viewType) != -1;
			}

			public void Add(SeriesViewEntry entry)
			{
				base.Add(entry);
			}

			public void Remove(ViewType viewType)
			{
				int index = GetIndex(viewType);
				if (index != -1)
				{
					RemoveAt(index);
				}
			}

			private int GetIndex(ViewType viewType)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (((SeriesViewEntry)this[i]).ViewType == viewType)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		private static ViewType defaultViewType;

		private static SeriesViewFactory factory;

		private SeriesViewList list = new SeriesViewList();

		private static SeriesViewFactory Factory
		{
			get
			{
				if (factory == null)
				{
					factory = new SeriesViewFactory();
				}
				return factory;
			}
		}

		public static ViewType DefaultViewType => defaultViewType;

		public static ViewType[] ViewTypes
		{
			get
			{
				ViewType[] array = new ViewType[Factory.list.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (SeriesViewEntry item in Factory.list)
				{
					array[num] = item.ViewType;
					num++;
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public static string[] StringIDs
		{
			get
			{
				string[] array = new string[Factory.list.Count];
				IEnumerator enumerator = Factory.list.GetEnumerator();
				int num = 0;
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && num < array.Length)
				{
					array[num++] = ((SeriesViewEntry)enumerator.Current).StringID;
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public static SvgImage[] SeriesViewSvgImages
		{
			get
			{
				SvgImage[] array = (SvgImage[])(object)new SvgImage[Factory.list.Count];
				IEnumerator enumerator = Factory.list.GetEnumerator();
				int num = 0;
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && num < array.Length)
				{
					array[num++] = ImageResourcesUtils.GetImageFromResources(((SeriesViewEntry)enumerator.Current).ViewType);
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterSeriesView(ViewType viewType, SeriesViewBase seriesView)
		{
			RegisterSeriesView(viewType, seriesView, setAsDefault: false);
		}

		public static void RegisterSeriesView(ViewType viewType, SeriesViewBase seriesView, bool setAsDefault)
		{
			if (seriesView != null)
			{
				Factory.Add(viewType, seriesView.GetType(), seriesView.StringId);
				if (setAsDefault)
				{
					defaultViewType = viewType;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UnregisterSeriesView(ViewType viewType)
		{
			Factory.Remove(viewType);
		}

		public static SeriesViewBase CreateInstance(ViewType viewType)
		{
			Type type = Factory[viewType];
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new SeriesViewFactoryException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSeriesViewDoesNotExist), viewType.ToString()));
			}
			return (SeriesViewBase)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
		}

		public static SeriesViewBase CreateInstance(SeriesViewBase templateView)
		{
			ViewType viewType = GetViewType(templateView);
			return CreateInstance(viewType);
		}

		public static SeriesViewBase CreateInstance(string stringId)
		{
			ViewType viewType = GetViewType(stringId);
			return CreateInstance(viewType);
		}

		public static ViewType GetViewType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null || !type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(SeriesViewBase)) || type.IsAbstract)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Passed type must be not abstract descendant of the SeriesViewBase class.");
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = Factory.list.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesViewEntry seriesViewEntry = (SeriesViewEntry)enumerator.Current;
				if (type.Equals(seriesViewEntry.Type))
				{
					return seriesViewEntry.ViewType;
				}
			}
			throw new SeriesViewFactoryException();
		}

		public static ViewType GetViewType(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			return GetViewType(view.GetType());
		}

		public static ViewType GetViewType(string stringId)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = Factory.list.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesViewEntry seriesViewEntry = (SeriesViewEntry)enumerator.Current;
				if (stringId == seriesViewEntry.StringID)
				{
					return seriesViewEntry.ViewType;
				}
			}
			throw new SeriesViewFactoryException();
		}

		public static string GetStringID(ViewType viewType)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = Factory.list.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesViewEntry seriesViewEntry = (SeriesViewEntry)enumerator.Current;
				if (viewType == seriesViewEntry.ViewType)
				{
					return seriesViewEntry.StringID;
				}
			}
			throw new SeriesViewFactoryException();
		}

		public static Type GetType(ViewType viewType)
		{
			return Factory[viewType];
		}

		private SeriesViewFactory()
		{
		}

		private void Add(ViewType viewType, Type type, string stringId)
		{
			if (type != null && type.IsClass && !list.ContainsViewType(viewType))
			{
				list.Add(new SeriesViewEntry(viewType, type, stringId));
			}
		}

		private void Remove(ViewType viewType)
		{
			list.Remove(viewType);
		}
	}
	public class SwiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout : LineWholeSeriesLayoutBase
	{
		private List<List<Point>> strips;

		protected override bool IsStripsNullOrEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (strips != null)
				{
					return strips.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public List<List<Point>> Strips => strips;

		public SwiftPlotWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, List<List<Point>> strips, int lineThickness, Rectangle bounds)
			: base(seriesLayout, lineThickness, bounds, optimizeHitTesting: true)
		{
			this.strips = strips;
		}

		protected override void FillHitTestingGraphicsPath(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			foreach (List<Point> strip in strips)
			{
				if (strip.Count > 1 && strip[0] != strip[strip.Count - 1])
				{
					DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(strip);
					path.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath, connect: false);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SwiftPointWholeSeriesLayout : WholeSeriesLayout
	{
		private readonly IList<GRealPoint2D> points;

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> Points => points;

		public SwiftPointWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
			: base(seriesLayout)
		{
			this.points = points;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion(DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion(drawOptions);
			if (drawOptions is SwiftPointDrawOptions { Marker: var marker } swiftPointDrawOptions)
			{
				bool isSelected = base.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState != SelectionState.Normal;
				int size = marker.Size;
				foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
				{
					IPolygon polygon = swiftPointDrawOptions.Marker.CalculatePolygon(point, isSelected, size);
					hitRegionContainer.Union(GraphicUtils.MakeHitRegion(polygon));
				}
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}

	public interface IChartPaletteProvider

		bool Loading { get; }

		PaletteRepository PaletteRepository { get; }

		Palette DefaultColorizerPalette { get; }
	}
	internal class ColorProvider
	{
		private IColorizer colorizer;

		private IEmptyPointColorizer emptyPointColorizer;

		private Palette palette;

		private static Palette GetPaletteFromRoot(ChartElement owner)
		{
			Chart chart = owner.Chart;
			if (chart != null)
			{
				return chart.Palette;
			}
			if (owner is Series)
			{
				return ((Series)owner).ChartPaletteProvider?.DefaultColorizerPalette;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Palette GetPaletteFromChart(ChartElement owner, string colorizerPaletteName)
		{
			IChartPaletteProvider chart = owner.Chart;
			IChartPaletteProvider chartPaletteProvider = chart ?? (owner as Series)?.ChartPaletteProvider;
			if (chartPaletteProvider != null && !chartPaletteProvider.Loading)
			{
				if (colorizerPaletteName == DefaultPalette.DefaultPaletteName)
				{
					return chartPaletteProvider.DefaultPalette;
				}
				Palette paletteByName = chartPaletteProvider.PaletteRepository.GetPaletteByName(colorizerPaletteName);
				if (paletteByName == null)
				{
					return chartPaletteProvider.DefaultPalette;
				}
				return paletteByName;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Palette GetPalette(IPaletteProvider colorizer, ChartElement owner)
		{
			if (colorizer != null)
			{
				Palette palette = colorizer.GetPalette();
				if (palette != null)
				{
					return palette;
				}
				string paletteName = colorizer.GetPaletteName();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(paletteName))
				{
					return GetPaletteFromChart(owner, paletteName);
				}
			}
			return GetPaletteFromRoot(owner);
		}

		public static Color ParseColor(object color)
		{
			if (color is int)
			{
				return Color.FromArgb((int)color);
			}
			if (color is double)
			{
				try
				{
					return Color.FromArgb(Convert.ToInt32(color));
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (color is Color)
			{
				return (Color)color;
			}
			if (color is string)
			{
				try
				{
					return ColorTranslator.FromHtml((string)color);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return Color.Empty;
		}

		public static void SetupDrawOptions(Color color, DrawOptions drawOptions, Color? color2 = null)
		{
			if (!color.IsEmpty)
			{
				drawOptions.SetColor(color);
				if (color2.HasValue)
				{
					drawOptions.ActualColor2 = color2.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					drawOptions.ActualColor2 = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(128, 50, 50, 50), color);
				}
			}
		}

		public static Color ApplyTransparency(Color pointColor, SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (!pointColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				SeriesViewTransparencyContainer transparencyContainer = view.TransparencyContainer;
				if (transparencyContainer != null)
				{
					return transparencyContainer.GetTransparentColor(pointColor);
				}
			}
			return pointColor;
		}

		public ColorProvider(IColorizer colorizer, IEmptyPointColorizer emptyPointColorizer)
		{
			this.colorizer = colorizer;
			this.emptyPointColorizer = emptyPointColorizer;
		}

		public Color GetColor(object argument, object[] values, object colorKey, ChartElement owner)
		{
			Palette palette = GetPalette(colorizer as IPaletteProvider, owner);
			if (palette == null)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			if (colorKey is object[] colorKeys)
			{
				return colorizer.GetPointColor(argument, values, colorKeys, palette);
			}
			return colorizer.GetPointColor(argument, values, colorKey, palette);
		}

		public Color GetColor(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point == null)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			if (point is SeriesPoint)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)point;
				if (!seriesPoint.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					return seriesPoint.Color;
				}
				if (seriesPoint.IsEmpty && emptyPointColorizer != null && emptyPointColorizer.Color.HasValue)
				{
					return Color.FromArgb(emptyPointColorizer.Color.Value);
				}
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint = (AggregatedSeriesPoint)point;
			if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.IsEmpty && emptyPointColorizer != null && emptyPointColorizer.Color.HasValue)
			{
				return Color.FromArgb(emptyPointColorizer.Color.Value);
			}
			if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.ColorStatus == 0)
			{
				List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					SeriesPoint seriesPoint2 = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(sourcePoint.SeriesPoint);
					if (seriesPoint2 != null)
					{
						list.Add(seriesPoint2);
					}
				}
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				switch (aggregatedSeriesPoint.Series.ValueScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
				{
					double[] numericalValues = aggregatedSeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues;
					foreach (double num in numericalValues)
					{
						list2.Add(num);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Scale.DateTime:
				{
					DateTime[] dateTimeValues = aggregatedSeriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues;
					foreach (DateTime dateTime in dateTimeValues)
					{
						list2.Add(dateTime);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
				{
					TimeSpan[] timeSpanValues = aggregatedSeriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues;
					foreach (TimeSpan timeSpan in timeSpanValues)
					{
						list2.Add(timeSpan);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				Color aggregatedPointColor = colorizer.GetAggregatedPointColor(aggregatedSeriesPoint.ArgumentX.Argument, list2.ToArray(), list.ToArray(), palette);
				aggregatedSeriesPoint.Color = aggregatedPointColor.ToArgb();
				aggregatedSeriesPoint.ColorStatus = (aggregatedPointColor.IsEmpty ? 1 : 2);
			}
			if (aggregatedSeriesPoint.ColorStatus != 1)
			{
				return Color.FromArgb(aggregatedSeriesPoint.Color);
			}
			return Color.Empty;
		}

		public List<LegendItem> GetLegendItemsForColorizer(ChartElement owner, LegendBase legend, ILegendItemProvider legendItemProvider)
		{
			Palette palette = GetPalette(legendItemProvider as IPaletteProvider, owner);
			List<LegendItem> legendItems = legendItemProvider.GetLegendItems(palette, legend.TextVisible, legend.ActualTextColor, legend.MarkersVisible, legend.MarkerSize);
			foreach (LegendItem item in legendItems)
			{
				item.SetLegend(legend);
			}
			return legendItems;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PaletteColorizerBehavior : NotificationElement
	{

		private string paletteName;

		private bool showInLegend = true;

		private string legendPattern;

		private string ActualLegendPattern
		{
			get

				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(legendPattern))
				{
					return DefaultLegendPattern;
				}
				return legendPattern;
			}
		}

		protected ISupportPropertyChanged Colorizer => colorizer;

		protected abstract string DefaultLegendPattern { get; }

		public Palette Palette
		{
			get
			{
				if (palette?.Name != paletteName)
				{
					lock (colorizer)
					{
						if (palette?.Name != paletteName)
						{
							palette = colorizer.GetPaletteByName(paletteName);
						}
					}
				}
				return palette;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(palette, value, delegate
				{
					palette = value;
					paletteName = ((palette != null) ? palette.Name : string.Empty);
				}, "Palette");
			}
		}

		public string PaletteName
		{
			get
			{
				return paletteName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (SetProperty(ref paletteName, value, "PaletteName"))

					palette = colorizer.GetPaletteByName(paletteName);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowInLegend
		{
			get

			}
			set

			}
		}

		public string LegendItemPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return legendPattern;
			}
			set

				SetProperty(ref legendPattern, value, "LegendItemPattern");
			}
		}

		public PaletteColorizerBehavior(IPaletteRepositoryHolder colorizer)

			this.colorizer = colorizer;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeLegendItemPattern()

		}

		internal void ResetLegendItemPattern()
		{
			LegendItemPattern = null;
		}

		{
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(ActualLegendPattern, (IPatternHolder)Colorizer);
			patternParser.SetContext(value);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		{
			colorizer.PropertyChanging();
		}

		protected override void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{

		}

		public virtual PatternDataProvider CreateDataProvider(string patternConstant)

		}

	public class KeyColorizerBehavior : PaletteColorizerBehavior
	{
		private readonly KeyCollection keys;

		private readonly Dictionary<object, int> indexList;

		private List<ObjectSerializable> keysSerializable;

		private int currentIndex;

		private IColorizerKeyProvider keyProvider;

		protected override string DefaultLegendPattern => "{V}";

		public KeyCollection Keys => keys;

		public IList KeysSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				if (keysSerializable == null)
				{
					keysSerializable = keys.CreateSerializableKeys();
				}
				return keysSerializable;
			}
		}

		public IColorizerKeyProvider KeyProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return keyProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref keyProvider, value, "KeyProvider");
			}
		}

		public KeyColorizerBehavior(IPaletteRepositoryHolder colorizer)
			: base(colorizer)
		{
			indexList = new Dictionary<object, int>();
			keys = new KeyCollection();
			((NotificationCollection<object>)keys).CollectionChanged += KeysChanged;
			((NotificationCollection<object>)keys).CollectionChanging += KeysChanging;
		}

		private void KeysChanged(object sender, CollectionChangedEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			base.Colorizer.PropertyChanged("Keys");
		}

		private void KeysChanging(object sender, CollectionChangingEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			base.Colorizer.PropertyChanging();
		}

		public void OnEndLoading()
		{
			if (keysSerializable != null)
			{
				keys.LoadSerializableKeys(keysSerializable);
				keysSerializable = null;
			}
		}

		public Color GetColor(object colorKey, Palette palette)
		{
			int num = -1;
			object obj = null;
			obj = ((keyProvider == null) ? colorKey : keyProvider.GetKey(colorKey));
			if (((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)keys).Count > 0)
			{
				num = ((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)keys).IndexOf(obj);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return Color.Empty;
				}
				return palette.GetEntry(num, ((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)keys).Count, 0).Color;
			}
			if (!indexList.ContainsKey(obj))
			{
				lock (indexList)
				{
					if (!indexList.ContainsKey(obj))
					{
						indexList.Add(obj, currentIndex);
						currentIndex++;
					}
				}
			}
			num = indexList[obj] % palette.Count;
			return palette[num].Color;
		}

		public List<LegendItem> GetLegendItems(Palette palette, bool textVisible, Color textColor, bool markerVisible, Size markerSize)
		{
			List<LegendItem> list = new List<LegendItem>();
			if (palette == null || palette.Count == 0 || (((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)keys).Count == 0 && indexList.Keys.Count == 0))
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)keys).Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ((DXCollectionBase<object>)(object)keys).Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(new LegendItem(GetText(((DXCollection<object>)(object)keys)[i].ToString()), palette[i % palette.Count].Color, textColor, markerSize, markerVisible, textVisible));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (object key in indexList.Keys)
				{
					list.Add(new LegendItem(GetText(key.ToString()), palette[indexList[key] % palette.Count].Color, textColor, markerSize, markerVisible, textVisible));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseRangeColorizerBehavior<T> : PaletteColorizerBehavior
	{
		private readonly NotificationCollection<T> rangeStops;

		private readonly List<double> sortedRangeStops = new List<double>();

		private bool approximateColors;

		private bool dirty = true;

		protected override string DefaultLegendPattern => "{V1} - {V2}";

		public NotificationCollection<T> RangeStops => rangeStops;

		public bool ApproximateColors
		{
			get
			{
				return approximateColors;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref approximateColors, value, "ApproximateColors");
			}
		}

		private static byte MixChannel(byte fromValue, byte toValue, double ratio)
		{
			return (byte)MathUtilsCore.MinMax((double)(int)fromValue * (1.0 - ratio) + (double)(int)toValue * ratio, (int)fromValue, (int)toValue);
		}

		internal static Color MixColors(Color fromUnit, Color toUnit, double ratio)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(MixChannel(fromUnit.A, toUnit.A, ratio), MixChannel(fromUnit.R, toUnit.R, ratio), MixChannel(fromUnit.G, toUnit.G, ratio), MixChannel(fromUnit.B, toUnit.B, ratio));
		}

		public BaseRangeColorizerBehavior(IPaletteRepositoryHolder colorizer)
			: base(colorizer)
		{
			rangeStops = CreateRangeStops();
			rangeStops.CollectionChanged += RangeStops_CollectionChanged;
		}

		private void RangeStops_CollectionChanged(object sender, CollectionChangedEventArgs<T> e)
		{
			dirty = true;
			base.Colorizer.PropertyChanged("RangeStops");
		}

		protected void CheckSortedRangeStops(Func<T, double> selector = null)
		{
			if (!dirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (sortedRangeStops)
			{
				if (dirty)
				{
					sortedRangeStops.Clear();
					sortedRangeStops.AddRange(ConvertRangesToAbsoluteValues(selector));
					sortedRangeStops.Remove(double.NaN);
					sortedRangeStops.Remove(double.MaxValue);
					sortedRangeStops.Remove(double.MinValue);
					sortedRangeStops.Sort(Comparer<double>.Default);
					dirty = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected Color GetColorCore(double value, Palette palette, Func<T, double> selector, out bool findColor)
		{
			findColor = false;
			int num = ((DXCollectionBase<T>)(object)rangeStops).Count - 1;
			if (palette.Count > 0 && num > 0 && !double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				CheckSortedRangeStops(selector);
				int rangeIndex = GetRangeIndex(value);
				if (rangeIndex >= 0 && rangeIndex < ((DXCollectionBase<T>)(object)rangeStops).Count)
				{
					findColor = true;
					if (ApproximateColors)
					{
						double num2 = sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex];
						double num3 = sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex + 1];
						Color fromUnit = ((palette.Count > num) ? palette[rangeIndex].Color : CalculateApproximatedColor((double)rangeIndex / (double)num, palette));
						Color toUnit = ((palette.Count > num) ? palette[rangeIndex + 1].Color : CalculateApproximatedColor((double)(rangeIndex + 1) / (double)num, palette));
						return MixColors(fromUnit, toUnit, (value - num2) / (num3 - num2));
					}
					if (palette.Count < num)
					{
						return CalculateApproximatedColor((double)rangeIndex / (double)(num - 1), palette);
					}
					if (rangeIndex < palette.Count)
					{
						return palette[rangeIndex].Color;
					}
				}
			}
			return Color.Empty;
		}

		protected abstract NotificationCollection<T> CreateRangeStops();

		protected abstract List<T> GetSortedRangeStopsForLegend(MinMaxValues valueRange);

		protected List<LegendItem> GetLegendItemsCore(Palette palette, bool textVisible, Color textColor, bool markerVisible, Size markerSize, MinMaxValues valueRange, Func<T, T, object> createContext)
		{
			List<LegendItem> list = new List<LegendItem>();
			List<T> sortedRangeStopsForLegend = GetSortedRangeStopsForLegend(valueRange);
			int num = sortedRangeStopsForLegend.Count - 1;
			if (palette.Count == 0 || num == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Color empty = Color.Empty;
				empty = ((palette.Count >= num) ? palette[i].Color : CalculateApproximatedColor((double)i / (double)(num - 1), palette));
				T arg = sortedRangeStopsForLegend[i];
				T arg2 = sortedRangeStopsForLegend[i + 1];
				string text = GetText(createContext(arg, arg2));
				list.Add(new LegendItem(text, empty, textColor, markerSize, markerVisible, textVisible));
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void InvalidateRangeStops()
		{
			dirty = true;
		}

		public abstract IList<double> ConvertRangesToAbsoluteValues(Func<T, double> selector);

		public virtual int GetRangeIndex(double value)
		{
			List<double> list = GetSortedRangeStops();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (list[i] <= value && value <= list[i + 1])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public List<double> GetSortedRangeStops(Func<T, double> selector = null)
		{
			CheckSortedRangeStops(selector);
			return sortedRangeStops;
		}

		public Color CalculateApproximatedColor(double normalized, Palette palette)
		{
			double num = normalized * (double)(palette.Count - 1);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(num);
			if (num2 == palette.Count - 1)
			{
				return palette[num2].Color;
			}
			double ratio = num - (double)num2;
			return MixColors(palette[num2].Color, palette[num2 + 1].Color, ratio);
		}

		public Color GetColor(double value, Palette palette, out bool findColor)
		{
			return GetColorCore(value, palette, null, out findColor);
		}

		public Color GetColor(double value, Palette palette)
		{
			bool findColor;
			return GetColor(value, palette, out findColor);
		}
	}

	public class SegmentRangeColorizerBehavior : RangeColorizerBehavior
	{
		public SegmentRangeColorizerBehavior(IPaletteRepositoryHolder colorizer)
			: base(colorizer)
		{
		}

		public override int GetRangeIndex(double value)
		{
			List<double> list = GetSortedRangeStops();
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(list.ToArray(), value);
			if (num < -1)
			{
				num = ~num;
				if (num != list.Count)
				{
					return num - 1;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	public static class CriteriaToDataFilterConverter
	{
		private static ConjunctionTypes Convert(GroupOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)operatorType != 0)
			{
				if ((int)operatorType == 1)
				{
					return ConjunctionTypes.Or;
				}
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
			return ConjunctionTypes.And;
		}

		private static DataFilterCondition? Convert(BinaryOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)operatorType switch
			{
				0 => DataFilterCondition.Equal, 
				2 => DataFilterCondition.GreaterThan, 
				5 => DataFilterCondition.GreaterThanOrEqual, 
				3 => DataFilterCondition.LessThan, 
				4 => DataFilterCondition.LessThanOrEqual, 
				1 => DataFilterCondition.NotEqual, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static DataFilter Convert(BinaryOperator binaryOperator)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (binaryOperator != null)
			{
				CriteriaOperator leftOperand = binaryOperator.LeftOperand;
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((leftOperand is OperandProperty) ? leftOperand : null);
				CriteriaOperator rightOperand = binaryOperator.RightOperand;
				OperandValue val2 = (OperandValue)(object)((rightOperand is OperandValue) ? rightOperand : null);
				if (val != null && val2 != null)
				{
					DataFilterCondition? dataFilterCondition = Convert(binaryOperator.OperatorType);
					if (dataFilterCondition.HasValue)
					{
						string dataTypeName = ((val2.Value != null) ? val2.Value.GetType().Name : typeof(string).Name);
						return new DataFilter(val.PropertyName, dataTypeName, dataFilterCondition.Value, val2.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static List<DataFilter> Convert(GroupOperator groupOperator, out ConjunctionTypes conjunction)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			conjunction = Convert(groupOperator.OperatorType);
			List<DataFilter> list = new List<DataFilter>();
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)groupOperator.Operands)
			{
				DataFilter dataFilter = Convert((BinaryOperator)(object)((item is BinaryOperator) ? item : null));
				if (dataFilter == null)
				{
					return new List<DataFilter>();
				}
				list.Add(dataFilter);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static List<DataFilter> Convert(CriteriaOperator criteria, out ConjunctionTypes conjunction)
		{
			GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((criteria is GroupOperator) ? criteria : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return Convert(val, out conjunction);
			}
			DataFilter dataFilter = Convert((BinaryOperator)(object)((criteria is BinaryOperator) ? criteria : null));
			if (dataFilter != null)
			{
				conjunction = ConjunctionTypes.And;
				return new List<DataFilter> { dataFilter };
			}
			conjunction = ConjunctionTypes.And;
			return new List<DataFilter>();
		}
	}

	public abstract class RefinedSeriesDataBase : List<RefinedPointData>, ICheckableLegendItemData, ILegendItemData
	{
		private readonly DrawOptions drawOptions;

		private readonly DrawOptions legendDrawOptions;

		private readonly IRefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		private readonly IList<RefinedPoint> points;

		private readonly int minVisiblePointIndex;

		private readonly int maxVisiblePointIndex;

		private readonly WholeSeriesViewData wholeViewData;

		private readonly Size legendCheckBoxSize;

		private readonly bool legendCheckBoxVisible;

		private readonly bool disposeLegendCheckBoxImage;

		private readonly ILegendItemOptions legendItemOptions;

		private bool shouldUpdateDrawOptions;

		private ChartImageSizeMode legendCheckBoxImageSizeMode;

		private DrawOptions pointDrawOptions;

		private DrawOptions pointLegendDrawOptions;

		private DXImage legendCheckBoxImage;

		private XYDiagramPaneBase Pane
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Series.View is XYDiagramSeriesViewBase xYDiagramSeriesViewBase))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return xYDiagramSeriesViewBase.Pane;
			}
		}

		protected LegendBase Legend => Series.ActualLegend;

		public bool DisposeFont => legendItemOptions.DisposeLegendFont;

		public bool DisposeLegendMarkerImage => legendItemOptions.DisposeLegendMarkerImage;

		public bool MarkerVisible => legendItemOptions.LegendMarkerVisible;

		public bool TextVisible => legendItemOptions.LegendTextVisible;

		public Color TextColor => legendItemOptions.LegendTextColor;

		public string LegendText => legendItemOptions.LegendText;

		public DrawOptions DrawOptions => drawOptions;

		public DrawOptions LegendDrawOptions => legendDrawOptions;

		public DXFont Font => legendItemOptions.LegendFont;

		public DXImage MarkerImage => legendItemOptions.DXLegendMarkerImage;

		public ChartImageSizeMode MarkerImageSizeMode => legendItemOptions.LegendMarkerImageSizeMode;

		public Series Series => (Series)refinedSeries.Series;

		public IList<RefinedPoint> Points => points;

		public int MinVisiblePointIndex => minVisiblePointIndex;

		public int MaxVisiblePointIndex => maxVisiblePointIndex;

		public IRefinedSeries RefinedSeries => refinedSeries;

		public Size MarkerSize => Series.Chart.ScaleSize(legendItemOptions.LegendMarkerSize);

		public Size CheckBoxSize => Series.Chart.ScaleSize(legendCheckBoxSize);

		public WholeSeriesViewData WholeViewData => wholeViewData;

		public SelectionState SelectionState { get; set; }

		string ILegendItemData.Text => legendItemOptions.LegendText;

		ILegendItem ILegendItemData.RepresentedObject => Series;

		LegendBase ILegendItemData.Legend => Legend;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenText => Legend.TextVisible;

		bool ILegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenMarker
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Legend.MarkersVisible)
				{
					if (Legend.CheckBoxesVisible)
					{
						return !Series.CheckableInLegend;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series.ActualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible && Series.CheckableInLegend)
				{
					return legendCheckBoxVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckedInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return Series.CheckedInLegend;
			}
			set
			{
				Series.CheckedInLegend = value;
			}
		}

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxEnabled => true;

		bool ICheckableLegendItemData.ReserveSpaceForHiddenCheckBox => Legend.CheckBoxesVisible;

		Size ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxSize => legendCheckBoxSize;

		ChartImageSizeMode ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxImageSizeMode => legendCheckBoxImageSizeMode;

		DXImage ICheckableLegendItemData.CheckBoxImage => legendCheckBoxImage;

		Color ICheckableLegendItemData.MainColor => legendDrawOptions.Color;

		public RefinedSeriesDataBase(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, SeriesContainerData containerData, int seriesIndexInContainer = 0)
		{
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			points = refinedSeries.GetDrawingPoints();
			base.Capacity = points.Count;
			SeriesViewBase view = Series.View;
			minVisiblePointIndex = refinedSeries.GetMinVisiblePointIndex(!view.GetSideLabelVisible(value: true) && !view.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: true));
			maxVisiblePointIndex = refinedSeries.GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(!view.GetSideLabelVisible(value: false) && !view.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: false));
			Series series = Series;
			drawOptions = view.CreateSeriesDrawOptions();
			CustomDrawSeriesEventArgs e;
			if (series.ActualLegend != null)
			{
				legendDrawOptions = (DrawOptions)drawOptions.Clone();
				bool flag = Legend.CheckBoxesVisible && Series.CheckableInLegend;
				e = new CustomDrawSeriesEventArgs(drawOptions, series, legendDrawOptions, Legend, series.ActualLegendText, flag, Legend.MarkerSize);
			}
			else
			{
				e = new CustomDrawSeriesEventArgs(drawOptions, series);
			}
			if (series.ContainerAdapter != null)
			{
				series.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomDrawSeries(e);
			}
			legendItemOptions = e;
			legendCheckBoxVisible = e.LegendCheckBoxVisible;
			legendCheckBoxImage = e.LegendCheckBoxDXImage;
			legendCheckBoxImageSizeMode = e.LegendCheckBoxImageSizeMode;
			legendCheckBoxSize = Series.Chart.ScaleSize(e.LegendCheckBoxSize);
			disposeLegendCheckBoxImage = e.DisposeLegendCheckBoxImage;
			SetSelectionMode();
			if (!series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (minVisiblePointIndex > -1 && (view.ShouldCalculatePointsData || view.ActualColorEach))
			{
				StackedInteractionContainer seriesContainer = ((containerData != null) ? (containerData.Container as StackedInteractionContainer) : null);
				if (series.ContainerAdapter != null && (series.ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawSeriesPoints || series.ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomizeStackedBarTotalLabel))
				{
					CalculatePointsData(seriesContainer, seriesIndexInContainer);
				}
				else
				{
					CalculatePointsDataWithoutEvents(seriesContainer, seriesIndexInContainer);
				}
				using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RefinedPointData current = enumerator.Current;
					CalculateLabelSize(current.LabelViewData);
					if (current.StackedBarTotalLabelViewData != null)
					{
						current.StackedBarTotalLabelViewData.CalculateTextSize();
						containerData.TotalLabelPoints.Add(current);
					}
				}
			}
			wholeViewData = view.CalculateWholeSeriesViewData(this, geometryCalculator);
		}

		private void CalculateLabelSize(SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < labelViewData.Length; i++)
			{
				labelViewData[i].CalculateTextSize();
			}
		}

		void ILegendItemData.RenderMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Series.RenderLegendItem(renderer, bounds, legendDrawOptions, legendDrawOptions, this, null);
		}

		private void SetSelectionMode()
		{
			SeriesSelectionMode seriesSelectionMode = Series.View.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode;
			if (Series.HitState.IsSeriesHot(seriesSelectionMode))
			{
				SelectionState = SelectionState.HotTracked;
			}
			else if (Series.HitState.IsSeriesSelect(seriesSelectionMode))
			{
				SelectionState = SelectionState.Selected;
			}
			else if (Series.HitState.IsSeriesDrillDownHot())
			{
				SelectionState = SelectionState.DrillDownHotTracked;
			}
			else
			{
				SelectionState = SelectionState.Normal;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<int> CalculateIndexes(Series series, bool colorEach)
		{
			if (minVisiblePointIndex < 0 || maxVisiblePointIndex < 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (colorEach || series.View.ActualMarkerVisible || series.ActualLabelsVisibility)
			{
				for (int i = minVisiblePointIndex; i <= maxVisiblePointIndex; i++)
				{
					yield return i;
				}
				yield break;
			}
			if (series.View.FirstPointInternal.Enabled)
			{
				yield return minVisiblePointIndex;
			}
			if (series.View.LastPointInternal.Enabled)
			{
				yield return maxVisiblePointIndex;
			}
		}

		private void CalculatePointsDataWithoutEvents(StackedInteractionContainer seriesContainer, int seriesIndex)
		{
			LegendBase legend = Legend;
			Series series = Series;
			SeriesLabelBase label = series.Label;
			XYDiagramPaneBase pane = Pane;
			Series.HitState.LegendSelectionState = SelectionState.Normal;
			pointDrawOptions = (DrawOptions)drawOptions.Clone();
			pointLegendDrawOptions = ((legendDrawOptions != null) ? ((DrawOptions)legendDrawOptions.Clone()) : null);
			LegendItemOptions legendItemOptions = new LegendItemOptions(legend, series, string.Empty);
			bool actualColorEach = series.View.ActualColorEach;
			bool isLabelVisible = label != null && series.ActualLabelsVisibility;
			bool flag = seriesContainer != null && pane != null && pane.StackedBarTotalLabel.Visible && series.View is StackedBarSeriesView;
			foreach (int item in CalculateIndexes(series, actualColorEach))
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[item];
				SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData = CalcLabelViewData(label, isLabelVisible, Series.View, refinedPoint, item);
				SeriesLabelViewData stackedBarTotalLabelViewData = null;
				if (flag && seriesContainer.ShouldCreateTotalLabel(seriesIndex, refinedPoint))
				{
					stackedBarTotalLabelViewData = pane.StackedBarTotalLabel.CalculateViewData(refinedPoint, series);
				}
				SelectionState selectionState = CalculateSelectionState(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
				LegendItemOptions legendItemOptions2 = (actualColorEach ? new LegendItemOptions(legend, series, ConstructPointLegendText(refinedPoint)) : legendItemOptions);
				Add(new RefinedPointData(this, refinedPoint, item, legendItemOptions2, null, null, selectionState, labelViewData, stackedBarTotalLabelViewData));
			}
		}

		private SeriesLabelViewData[] CalcLabelViewData(SeriesLabelBase label, bool isLabelVisible, SeriesViewBase view, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int index)
		{
			if (view.GetSideLabelVisible(value: true))
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> viewportEdgePoints = view.ViewportIntersectionHolder.GetViewportEdgePoints(index, isLeft: true);
				if (viewportEdgePoints != null)
				{
					return view.FirstPointInternal.Label.CalculateViewData(refinedSeries.GetCorrectRefinedPointForLabel(refinedPoint, viewportEdgePoints), edgeLabel: true);
				}
			}
			if (view.GetSideLabelVisible(value: false))
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> viewportEdgePoints2 = view.ViewportIntersectionHolder.GetViewportEdgePoints(index, isLeft: false);
				if (viewportEdgePoints2 != null)
				{
					return view.LastPointInternal.Label.CalculateViewData(refinedSeries.GetCorrectRefinedPointForLabel(refinedPoint, viewportEdgePoints2), edgeLabel: true);
				}
			}
			if (!isLabelVisible)
			{
				return new SeriesLabelViewData[0];
			}
			return label.CalculateViewData(refinedPoint, edgeLabel: false);
		}

		private void CalculatePointsData(StackedInteractionContainer seriesContainer, int seriesIndex)
		{
			Series.HitState.LegendSelectionState = SelectionState.Normal;
			DrawOptions drawOptions = ((Series.View.ActualColorEach || legendDrawOptions == null) ? null : ((DrawOptions)legendDrawOptions.Clone()));
			XYDiagramPaneBase pane = Pane;
			Series series = Series;
			bool flag = seriesContainer != null && pane != null && pane.StackedBarTotalLabel.Visible && series.View is StackedBarSeriesView;
			SeriesLabelBase label = series.Label;
			bool sideMarkerVisible = series.View.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: true);
			bool sideMarkerVisible2 = series.View.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: false);
			for (int i = minVisiblePointIndex; i <= maxVisiblePointIndex; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[i];
				DrawOptions drawOptions2 = (DrawOptions)this.drawOptions.Clone();
				drawOptions2.Initialize(series.View, points, i, (sideMarkerVisible && i == minVisiblePointIndex) || (sideMarkerVisible2 && i == maxVisiblePointIndex));
				DrawOptions drawOptions3 = null;
				if (legendDrawOptions != null)
				{
					if (series.View.ActualColorEach)
					{
						drawOptions3 = (DrawOptions)legendDrawOptions.Clone();
						drawOptions3.Initialize(series.View, points, i);
					}
					else
					{
						drawOptions3 = drawOptions;
					}
				}
				string labelText = string.Empty;
				string secondLabelText = string.Empty;
				SeriesLabelViewData[] array = ((label != null) ? CalcLabelViewData(label, isLabelVisible: true, Series.View, refinedPoint, i) : new SeriesLabelViewData[0]);
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					labelText = array[0].Text;
					if (array.Length > 1)
					{
						secondLabelText = array[1].Text;
					}
				}
				SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData = null;
				string totalLabelText = string.Empty;
				if (flag && seriesContainer.ShouldCreateTotalLabel(seriesIndex, refinedPoint))
				{
					seriesLabelViewData = pane.StackedBarTotalLabel.CalculateViewData(refinedPoint, series);
					totalLabelText = seriesLabelViewData.Text;
				}
				string legendText = ConstructPointLegendText(refinedPoint);
				SelectionState selectionState = CalculateSelectionState(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
				DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series);
				dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
				CustomDrawSeriesPointEventArgs e = new CustomDrawSeriesPointEventArgs(drawOptions2, series, drawOptions3, legendItemOptions, legendText, refinedPoint, labelText, secondLabelText, totalLabelText, selectionState);
				series.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomDrawSeriesPoint(e);
				refinedPoint.SeriesPoint.ToolTipHint = e.SeriesPoint.ToolTipHint;
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					array[0].Text = e.LabelText;
					if (array.Length > 1)
					{
						array[1].Text = e.SecondLabelText;
					}
				}
				if (seriesLabelViewData != null)
				{
					CustomizeStackedBarTotalLabel(refinedPoint, seriesLabelViewData, e.TotalLabelText);
				}
				if ((series.HitState.LegendSelectionState == SelectionState.Normal && e.SelectionState != SelectionState.Normal) || (series.HitState.LegendSelectionState == SelectionState.Selected && e.SelectionState == SelectionState.HotTracked))
				{
					series.HitState.LegendSelectionState = e.SelectionState;
				}
				if (series.View.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series && ((SelectionState == SelectionState.Normal && e.SelectionState != SelectionState.Normal) || (SelectionState == SelectionState.Selected && e.SelectionState == SelectionState.HotTracked)))
				{
					SelectionState = e.SelectionState;
				}
				Add(new RefinedPointData(this, refinedPoint, i, e, drawOptions2, drawOptions3, e.SelectionState, array, seriesLabelViewData));
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeStackedBarTotalLabel(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, SeriesLabelViewData totalLabelViewData, string obsoleteCustomDrawText)
		{
			string text = totalLabelViewData.Text;
			if (text != obsoleteCustomDrawText)
			{
				totalLabelViewData.Text = obsoleteCustomDrawText;
			}
			double totalValue = ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint).TotalValue;
			Color textColor = totalLabelViewData.Label.GetTextColor(Color.Empty);
			CustomizeStackedBarTotalLabelEventArgs e = new CustomizeStackedBarTotalLabelEventArgs(totalValue, text, textColor, refinedPoint.SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument);
			Series.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomizeStackedBarTotalLabel(e);
			if (text != e.Text)
			{
				totalLabelViewData.Text = e.Text;
			}
			if (textColor != e.TextColor)
			{
				totalLabelViewData.TotalLabelCustomizedTextColor = e.TextColor;
			}
		}

		private string ConstructPointLegendText(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (Series.ShowInLegend && Series.View.ActualColorEach)
			{
				PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(Series.ActualLegendTextPattern, Series.View);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, Series);
				result = patternParser.GetText();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private DrawOptions GetPointDrawOptions(DrawOptions drawOptions, RefinedPointData pointData, int pointIndex)
		{
			bool flag = (pointIndex == minVisiblePointIndex && Series.View.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: true)) || (pointIndex == maxVisiblePointIndex && Series.View.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: false));
			if (Series.View.ActualColorEach || drawOptions.ShouldUpdateColors || flag)
			{
				drawOptions.Initialize(Series.View, points, pointIndex, flag);
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag2 = pointData.ShouldUpdateColors();
				if (shouldUpdateDrawOptions || flag2)
				{
					drawOptions.Initialize(Series.View, points, pointIndex);
					shouldUpdateDrawOptions = flag2;
				}
			}
			return drawOptions;
		}

		private SelectionState CalculateSelectionState(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			SelectionState result = SelectionState.Normal;
			Series series = Series;
			IChartContainer chartContainer = series.ChartContainer;
			if (chartContainer != null)
			{
				if (series.HitState.IsPointHot(point, chartContainer.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode))
				{
					result = SelectionState.HotTracked;
				}
				else if (series.HitState.IsPointSelect(point, chartContainer.Chart.SeriesSelectionMode))
				{
					result = SelectionState.Selected;
				}
				else if (series.HitState.IsPointDrillDownHot(point))
				{
					result = SelectionState.DrillDownHotTracked;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private List<ILegendItemData> GetSeriesPointsLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				RefinedPointData current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.IsValidLegendItem)
				{
					list.Add(current);
					if (DisposeFont && current.Font != null && current.Font == legendItemOptions.LegendFont)
					{
						current.DisposeFont = true;
					}
					if (DisposeLegendMarkerImage && current.MarkerImage != null && current.MarkerImage == legendItemOptions.DXLegendMarkerImage)
					{
						current.DisposeLegendMarkerImage = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<ILegendItemData> GetIndicatorLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			if (Series.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)
			{
				foreach (Indicator indicator in xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.Indicators)
				{
					Legend actualLegend = indicator.ActualLegend;
					if (indicator.Visible && indicator.ShowInLegend && actualLegend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
					{
						IndicatorBehavior indicatorBehavior = indicator.IndicatorBehavior;
						bool checkBoxesVisible = actualLegend.CheckBoxesVisible;
						if ((!checkBoxesVisible && indicatorBehavior.Visible) || (checkBoxesVisible && indicator.CheckableInLegend) || (checkBoxesVisible && !indicator.CheckableInLegend && indicator.OwningSeries.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram))
						{
							list.Add(indicatorBehavior);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal RefinedPoint GetRefinedPoint(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleTypeMap, SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			return refinedSeries.GetRefinedPoint(scaleTypeMap, seriesPoint);
		}

		internal virtual SeriesLayout CreateSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, XYDiagramMappingBase mapping, bool singleLayout)
		{
			return new XYDiagramSeriesLayout(seriesData, mapping, singleLayout);
		}

		public void DisposeCustomImageAndFont()
		{
			if (legendItemOptions != null)
			{
				using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						RefinedPointData current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current != null)
						{
							if (current.MarkerImage != legendItemOptions.DXLegendMarkerImage)
							{
								current.DisposeCustomMarkerImage();
							}
							if (current.Font != legendItemOptions.LegendFont)
							{
								current.DisposeCustomFont();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				legendItemOptions.DisposeCustomFont(Legend);
				legendItemOptions.DisposeCustomMarkerImage();
			}
			if (disposeLegendCheckBoxImage && legendCheckBoxImage != null)
			{
				legendCheckBoxImage.Dispose();
				legendCheckBoxImage = null;
			}
		}

		public ILegendItemData GetSeriesLegendItem()
		{
			if (Series.View is ILegendItemProvider { ShowInLegend: not false } legendItemProvider)
			{
				return legendItemProvider.GetLegendItems(null, TextVisible, TextColor, MarkerVisible, MarkerSize)[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual List<ILegendItemData> GetLegendItems()
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			Series series = Series;
			if (Legend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
			{
				List<ILegendItemData> list2 = ColorizerLegendItemsCreator.CreateItems(series);
				if (series.ShowInLegend && list2.Count == 0)
				{
					if (series.View.ShouldAddSeriesPointsInLegend)
					{
						list.AddRange(GetSeriesPointsLegendItems());
					}
					else if (Series.View is ILegendItemProvider { ShowInLegend: not false } legendItemProvider)
					{
						list.AddRange(legendItemProvider.GetLegendItems(null, TextVisible, TextColor, MarkerVisible, MarkerSize));
					}
					else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LegendText))
					{
						list.Add(this);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(list2);
				}
			}
			list.AddRange(GetIndicatorLegendItems());
			return list;
		}

		public DrawOptions GetPointDrawOptions(RefinedPointData pointData, int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetPointDrawOptions(pointDrawOptions, pointData, pointIndex);
		}

		public DrawOptions GetPointLegendDrawOptions(RefinedPointData pointData, int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetPointDrawOptions(legendDrawOptions, pointData, pointIndex);
		}
	}
	public sealed class RefinedSeriesData : RefinedSeriesDataBase
	{
		public RefinedSeriesData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, SeriesContainerData containerData, int seriesIndexInContainer = 0)
			: base(refinedSeries, geometryCalculator, containerData, seriesIndexInContainer)
		{
		}
	}
	public static class ColorizerLegendItemsCreator
	{
		private static void AddLegendItems(SeriesBase series, SeriesViewBase view, List<ILegendItemData> colorizerLegendItems, ILegendItemProvider colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer != null && colorizer.ShowInLegend)
			{
				colorizerLegendItems.AddRange(view.ColorProvider.GetLegendItemsForColorizer(series, series.ActualLegend, colorizer));
			}
		}

		public static List<ILegendItemData> CreateItems(SeriesBase series)
		{
			List<ILegendItemData> list = new List<ILegendItemData>();
			SeriesViewBase view = series.View;
			LineSeriesView lineSeriesView = view as LineSeriesView;
			if (series.ShowInLegend)
			{
				AddLegendItems(series, view, list, lineSeriesView?.SegmentColorizer as ILegendItemProvider);
				AddLegendItems(series, view, list, view.Colorizer as ILegendItemProvider);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class ScreenPointCalculator
	{
		public virtual bool UseArgumentOffset => false;

		public virtual DiagramPoint CalculatePoint(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isValue1 = true)
		{
			return diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(pointArgument, pointValue);
		}

		public virtual List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectValuesByViewport(double pointArgument, double zeroValue, double pointValue)
		{
			return new List<GRealPoint2D>
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, zeroValue),
				new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, pointValue)
			};
		}
	}
	public class EdgeScreenPointCalculator : ScreenPointCalculator
	{
		private readonly ViewportIntersectionHolder intersectionHolder;

		private readonly bool alwaysOnDiagram;

		public override bool UseArgumentOffset => true;

		public EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder intersectionHolder, bool alwaysOnDiagram)
		{
			this.intersectionHolder = intersectionHolder;
			this.alwaysOnDiagram = alwaysOnDiagram;
		}

		public override DiagramPoint CalculatePoint(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isValue1 = true)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = (alwaysOnDiagram ? intersectionHolder.GetEdgePointOnDiagram(pointArgument, pointValue, isValue1) : intersectionHolder.GetEdgePoint(pointArgument, pointValue, isValue1));
			return diagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y);
		}

		public override List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectValuesByViewport(double pointArgument, double zeroValue, double pointValue)
		{
			return intersectionHolder.CorrectValuesByViewport(pointArgument, zeroValue, pointValue, alwaysOnDiagram);
		}
	}
	public class SeriesCollectionEnumerator : IEnumerator<ISeries>, IDisposable, IEnumerator, IEnumerator<Series>
	{
		private const int startIndexValue = -1;

		private readonly int actualCount;

		private readonly IList series;

		private int currentIndex;

		object IEnumerator.Current => series[currentIndex];

		Series IEnumerator<Series>.Current => (Series)series[currentIndex];

		ISeries IEnumerator<ISeries>.Current => (ISeries)series[currentIndex];

		public SeriesCollectionEnumerator(IList series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			currentIndex = -1;
			actualCount = series.Count;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			if (currentIndex < actualCount - 1)
			{
				currentIndex++;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			currentIndex = -1;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeriesLayout : List<SeriesPointLayout>
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData;

		protected virtual HitTestController HitTestController => View.HitTestController;

		public RefinedSeriesDataBase SeriesData => seriesData;

		public SeriesViewBase View => seriesData.Series.View;

		public virtual WholeSeriesLayout WholeLayout => null;

		public virtual WholeSeriesViewData WholeViewData => seriesData.WholeViewData;

		public virtual DrawOptions DrawOptions => seriesData.DrawOptions;

		public virtual DrawOptions LegendDrawOptions => seriesData.LegendDrawOptions;

		public SeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData)
		{
			this.seriesData = seriesData;
		}

		protected void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			if (View.Chart.AnimationInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (WholeLayout != null)
			{
				View.RenderWholeSeriesShadow(renderer, mappingBounds, WholeLayout);
			}
			if (!(View is IShadowSupportView))
			{
				return;
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				View.RenderShadow(renderer, mappingBounds, current, current.PointData.DrawOptions);
			}
		}

		public abstract void Render(ChartRenderer renderer);
	}
