	public class SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout : SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase
	{
		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private readonly SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList;

		private readonly List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;

		private readonly ISimpleDiagramDomain domain;

		private readonly float exclamationTextSize;

		public SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList LabelLayoutList => labelLayoutList;

		public ISimpleDiagramDomain Domain => domain;

		private void ProcessHitTesting()
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = HitTestController;
			bool actualPointToolTipEnabled = base.SeriesData.Series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled;
			if (!(hitTestController.Enabled || actualPointToolTipEnabled))
			{
				return;
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = current.CalculateHitRegion();
				if (hitRegionContainer == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				using (hitRegionContainer)
				{
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, base.SeriesData.Series, current.PointData.RefinedPoint, (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone());
					if (actualPointToolTipEnabled)
					{
						SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(current.PointData.SeriesPoint);
						ChartFocusedArea additionalObject = new ChartFocusedArea(seriesPoint, current.PointData.ToolTipRelativePosition);
						IHitRegion region = (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone();
						HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, base.SeriesData.Series, additionalObject, region, force: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public SimpleDiagram3DSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, DXRectangle bounds)
			: base(seriesData)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle rectangle = (this.bounds = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(bounds));
			if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle domainBounds = rectangle;
			base.TitlesViewData = CalculateTitlesViewDataAndCorrectDomainBounds(ref domainBounds);
			if (base.View.CalculateBounds(base.SeriesData, domainBounds, out var innerBounds, out var labelBounds))
			{
				domainBounds = CorrectBoundsAndTitlesPosition(domainBounds, ref labelBounds, ref innerBounds);
				if (innerBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive() && domainBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					domain = CreateDiagramDomain(domainBounds, labelBounds, innerBounds);
				}
			}
			labelLayoutList = new SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(seriesData, domain);
			if (domain == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.SeriesData.WholeViewData is SimpleDiagramWholeSeriesViewData { NegativeValuePresents: not false })
			{
				exclamationTextSize = GraphicUtils.CalcFontEmSize(domain.ElementBounds, SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationText, SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationFontFamilyName, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
			AddRange(base.View.CalculatePointsLayout(domain, seriesData));
			base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.IsEmpty)
					{
						SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData = current.LabelViewData;
						foreach (SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData in labelViewData)
						{
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesLabelViewData.Text))
							{
								base.SeriesData.Series.Label.CalculateLayout(labelLayoutList, current);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout.AddRange(base.View.CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(domain, current));
				}
			}
			annotationsViewData = AnnotationHelper.CreateInnerAnnotationsViewDataClipped(base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout, domain.LabelsBounds);
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreatePointsGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(base.View.CreateGraphicsCommand(Domain.Bounds, current, current.DrawOptions));
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected SimpleDiagram3DDomain CreateDiagramDomain(Rectangle domainBounds, Rectangle labelsBounds, Rectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			SimpleDiagram3D simpleDiagram3D = base.SeriesData.Series.Chart.Diagram as SimpleDiagram3D;
			ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView simpleDiagram3DSeriesView = base.View as ISimpleDiagram3DSeriesView;
			if (simpleDiagram3D != null && simpleDiagram3DSeriesView != null)
			{
				return SimpleDiagram3DDomain.Create(simpleDiagram3D, domainBounds, labelsBounds, diagramBounds, simpleDiagram3DSeriesView);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (!(Domain is SimpleDiagram3DDomain simpleDiagram3DDomain))
			{
				return null;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ViewPortGraphicsCommand(simpleDiagram3DDomain.Bounds);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(simpleDiagram3DDomain.CreateGraphicsCommand(out var innerCommand, out var _));
			innerCommand.AddChildCommand(CreatePointsGraphicsCommand());
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current != null)
					{
						base.View.Render(renderer, domain.Bounds, current, current.PointData.DrawOptions);
					}
				}
			}
			ProcessHitTesting();
		}

		public void RenderExclamation(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (domain != null && !((double)exclamationTextSize < 0.4))
			{
				DXFont font = new DXFont(SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationFontFamilyName, exclamationTextSize);
				renderer.DrawBoundedText(SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationText, font.DpiScale(), base.View.ExclamationTextColor, base.View, domain.ElementBounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
		}

		public void RenderAnnotations(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (annotationsViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			renderer.SetClipping(Domain.Bounds);
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		public void RenderTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (base.TitlesViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, bounds.Top), bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			renderer.SetClipping((RectangleF)zPlaneRectangle);
			foreach (DockableTitleViewData titlesViewDatum in base.TitlesViewData)
			{
				titlesViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout : SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase
	{
		private readonly SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList;

		private readonly PieTotalLabelViewData pieTotalLabelViewData;

		private readonly List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;

		private readonly SimpleDiagramDomain domain;

		private readonly float exclamationTextSize;

		private Chart Chart => base.View.Chart;

		public SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList LabelLayoutList => labelLayoutList;

		public PieTotalLabelViewData PieTotalLabelViewData => pieTotalLabelViewData;

		public SimpleDiagramDomain Domain => domain;

		public SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, Rectangle diagramBounds, Rectangle initialDomainBounds)
			: base(seriesData)
		{
			if (!initialDomainBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle domainBounds = initialDomainBounds;
			base.TitlesViewData = CalculateTitlesViewDataAndCorrectDomainBounds(ref domainBounds);
			if (base.View.CalculateBounds(base.SeriesData, domainBounds, out var innerBounds, out var labelBounds))
			{
				domainBounds = CorrectBoundsAndTitlesPosition(domainBounds, ref labelBounds, ref innerBounds);
				if (innerBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive() && domainBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					domain = new SimpleDiagramDomain(diagramBounds, initialDomainBounds, domainBounds, labelBounds, innerBounds);
				}
			}
			labelLayoutList = new SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(seriesData, domain);
			if (domain == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.SeriesData.WholeViewData is SimpleDiagramWholeSeriesViewData { NegativeValuePresents: not false })
			{
				exclamationTextSize = GraphicUtils.CalcFontEmSize(domain.ElementBounds, SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationText, SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationFontFamilyName, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
			AddRange(base.View.CalculatePointsLayout(domain, seriesData));
			base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.IsEmpty)
					{
						SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData = current.LabelViewData;
						foreach (SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData in labelViewData)
						{
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesLabelViewData.Text))
							{
								base.SeriesData.Series.Label.CalculateLayout(labelLayoutList, current);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout.AddRange(base.View.CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(domain, current));
				}
			}
			annotationsViewData = AnnotationHelper.CreateInnerAnnotationsViewDataClipped(base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout, domain.LabelsBounds);
		}

		public SimpleDiagramSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, IList<DockableTitleViewData> titlesViewData, Rectangle diagramBounds, Rectangle domainBounds, Rectangle elementWithLabelsBounds, Rectangle elementBounds)
			: base(seriesData)
		{
			base.TitlesViewData = titlesViewData;
			Rectangle bounds = CorrectBoundsAndTitlesPosition(domainBounds, ref elementWithLabelsBounds, ref elementBounds);
			domain = new SimpleDiagramDomain(diagramBounds, domainBounds, bounds, elementWithLabelsBounds, elementBounds);
			labelLayoutList = new SimpleDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(seriesData, domain);
			if (base.SeriesData.WholeViewData is SimpleDiagramWholeSeriesViewData { NegativeValuePresents: not false })
			{
				exclamationTextSize = GraphicUtils.CalcFontEmSize(domain.ElementBounds, SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationText, SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationFontFamilyName, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
			AddRange(base.View.CalculatePointsLayout(domain, seriesData));
			base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			Series series = base.SeriesData.Series;
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.IsEmpty)
					{
						SeriesLabelViewData[] labelViewData = current.LabelViewData;
						foreach (SeriesLabelViewData seriesLabelViewData in labelViewData)
						{
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesLabelViewData.Text))
							{
								series.Label.CalculateLayout(labelLayoutList, current);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout.AddRange(base.View.CalculateAnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout(domain, current));
				}
			}
			annotationsViewData = AnnotationHelper.CreateInnerAnnotationsViewDataClipped(base.AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout, domain.DiagramBounds);
			PieTotalLabel actualTotalLabel = base.View.ActualTotalLabel;
			if (actualTotalLabel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string totalLabelText = GetTotalLabelText(actualTotalLabel.ActualTextPattern, seriesData.RefinedSeries);
			Rectangle pieBounds = elementBounds;
			if (base.View is PieSeriesView { RuntimeExploding: not false } pieSeriesView)
			{
				int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(0.01 * pieSeriesView.ExplodedDistancePercentage * (double)pieBounds.Width * 0.5);
				int num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(0.01 * pieSeriesView.ExplodedDistancePercentage * (double)pieBounds.Height * 0.5);
				pieBounds.Inflate(-num, -num2);
			}
			if (actualTotalLabel.Visible)
			{
				double totalValue = double.NaN;
				if (seriesData.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					totalValue = ((IPiePoint)seriesData.Points[0]).TotalValue;
				}
				if (series.ContainerAdapter.ShouldCustomizePieTotalLabel)
				{
					CustomizePieTotalLabelEventArgs e = new CustomizePieTotalLabelEventArgs(series, totalValue, totalLabelText, actualTotalLabel.ActualTextColor);
					series.ContainerAdapter.OnCustomizePieTotalLabel(e);
					pieTotalLabelViewData = new PieTotalLabelViewData(e.Text, pieBounds, base.View.ActualTotalLabel, e.TextColor);
				}
				else
				{
					pieTotalLabelViewData = new PieTotalLabelViewData(totalLabelText, pieBounds, base.View.ActualTotalLabel, actualTotalLabel.ActualTextColor);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pieTotalLabelViewData = null;
			}
		}

		private string GetTotalLabelText(string pattern, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(pattern, (IPatternHolder)refinedSeries.SeriesView);
			if (refinedSeries.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedSeries.Points[0], refinedSeries.Series);
			}
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		private void ProcessHitTesting()
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = HitTestController;
			bool actualPointToolTipEnabled = base.SeriesData.Series.ActualPointToolTipEnabled;
			if (!(hitTestController.Enabled || actualPointToolTipEnabled))
			{
				return;
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SeriesPointLayout current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = current.CalculateHitRegion();
				hitRegionContainer.Intersect(new HitRegion(domain.DiagramBounds));
				if (hitRegionContainer == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				using (hitRegionContainer)
				{
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = current.SeriesPoint;
					HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, base.SeriesData.Series, current.PointData.RefinedPoint, (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone());
					if (actualPointToolTipEnabled)
					{
						ChartFocusedArea additionalObject = new ChartFocusedArea(seriesPoint, current.ToolTipRelativePosition);
						IHitRegion region = (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone();
						HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, base.SeriesData.Series, additionalObject, region, force: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (base.TitlesViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockableTitleViewData titlesViewDatum in base.TitlesViewData)
			{
				titlesViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderTotalLabel(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController controller, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			if (pieTotalLabelViewData != null)
			{
				pieTotalLabelViewData.Render(renderer, controller, additionalHitObject);
			}
		}

		public void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Render(renderer);
			RenderTitles(renderer);
			RenderTotalLabel(renderer, HitTestController, base.View.Series);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			SeriesPointAnimationBase actualSeriesPointAnimation = base.View.ActualSeriesPointAnimation;
			bool flag = actualSeriesPointAnimation != null && actualSeriesPointAnimation.CanAnimate && Chart.AnimationInProgress;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = base[i];
				if (seriesPointLayout == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num = 1.0;
				if (flag)
				{
					int animatingPointIndex = actualSeriesPointAnimation.GetAnimatingPointIndex(base.Count, i);
					num = actualSeriesPointAnimation.CalculateAnimationProgress(base.View.Chart.AnimationTimeMs, animatingPointIndex);
					if (num != 1.0)
					{
						actualSeriesPointAnimation.Apply(renderer, domain.Bounds, seriesPointLayout, num);
					}
				}
				base.View.Render(renderer, domain.Bounds, seriesPointLayout, seriesPointLayout.DrawOptions);
				if (flag && num != 1.0)
				{
					actualSeriesPointAnimation.RestoreState();
				}
			}
			ProcessHitTesting();
		}

		public void RenderExclamation(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (domain != null && !((double)exclamationTextSize < 0.4))
			{
				DXFont font = new DXFont(SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationFontFamilyName, exclamationTextSize);
				renderer.DrawBoundedText(SimpleDiagramSeriesLayoutBase.ExclamationText, font.DpiScale(), base.View.ExclamationTextColor, base.View, domain.ElementBounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
			}
		}

		public void RenderAnnotations(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (annotationsViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}
	}

	public class XYDiagramSeriesLayout : SeriesLayout
	{
		public class PointCalculatorBehavior
		{
			protected ScreenPointCalculator PointCalculator { get; } = new ScreenPointCalculator();

			public virtual SeriesPointLayout CalcLayout(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, int i)
			{
				return view.CalculateSeriesPointLayout(diagramMapping, pointData, PointCalculator);
			}
		}

		public class EdgePointCalculatorBehavior : PointCalculatorBehavior
		{
			private readonly int lastIndex;

			public EdgePointCalculatorBehavior(int lastIndex)
			{
				this.lastIndex = lastIndex;
			}

			public override SeriesPointLayout CalcLayout(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, RefinedPointData pointData, int i)
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					return view.CalculateSeriesPointLayout(diagramMapping, pointData, view.CreateScreenPointMarkerCalculator(isFirstPoint: true));
				}
				if (i == lastIndex)
				{
					return view.CalculateSeriesPointLayout(diagramMapping, pointData, view.CreateScreenPointMarkerCalculator(isFirstPoint: false));
				}
				return view.CalculateSeriesPointLayout(diagramMapping, pointData, base.PointCalculator);
			}
		}

		private readonly XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping;

		private readonly bool singleLayout;

		private WholeSeriesLayout wholeLayout;

		protected Rectangle MappingBounds => diagramMapping.InflatedBounds;

		protected Chart Chart => View.Chart;

		public XYDiagramMappingBase DiagramMapping => diagramMapping;

		public bool SingleLayout => singleLayout;

		public new XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase View => (XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)base.View;

		public override WholeSeriesLayout WholeLayout => wholeLayout;

		public XYDiagramSeriesLayout(RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, bool singleLayout)
			: base(seriesData)
		{
			this.diagramMapping = diagramMapping;
			this.singleLayout = singleLayout;
		}

		private void ProcessSeriesHitTestRegion(HitRegionContainer seriesHitRegion, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			bool actualSeriesToolTipEnabled = base.SeriesData.Series.ActualSeriesToolTipEnabled;
			if (!((hitTestController.Enabled && View.HitTestingSupported) || actualSeriesToolTipEnabled))
			{
				return;
			}
			using HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = WholeLayout.CalculateHitRegion(base.SeriesData.DrawOptions);
			if (seriesHitRegion != null)
			{
				hitRegionContainer.Intersect(seriesHitRegion);
			}
			if (hitTestController.Enabled && View.HitTestingSupported)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, View.Series, null, (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone());
			}
			if (actualSeriesToolTipEnabled)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, View.Series, new ChartFocusedArea(View.Series), (IHitRegion)hitRegionContainer.Underlying.Clone(), force: true);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Calculate(bool allowOptimization)
		{
			diagramMapping.UpdateMapping();
			View.BeforeCalculate(this);
			if (View.ShouldCalculatePointsData)
			{
				bool flag = base.SeriesData.Count > 0 && Chart.ActualPointToolTipEnabled;
				PointCalculatorBehavior pointCalculatorBehavior = ((View.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: true) || View.GetSideMarkerVisible(value: false)) ? new EdgePointCalculatorBehavior(base.SeriesData.Count - 1) : new PointCalculatorBehavior());
				for (int i = 0; i < base.SeriesData.Count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPointData refinedPointData = base.SeriesData[i];
					if (!refinedPointData.RefinedPoint.HasValues)
					{
						continue;
					}
					SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = pointCalculatorBehavior.CalcLayout(View, diagramMapping, refinedPointData, i);
					if (seriesPointLayout != null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							refinedPointData.ToolTipRelativePosition = View.CalculateRelativeToolTipPosition(diagramMapping, refinedPointData);
						}
						Add(seriesPointLayout);
					}
				}
			}
			wholeLayout = View.CalculateWholeSeriesLayout(diagramMapping, this, allowOptimization);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, HitRegionContainer seriesHitRegion)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			if (Chart.AnimationInProgress && View.ActualSeriesAnimation != null && View.ActualSeriesAnimation.CanAnimate)
			{
				num = View.ActualSeriesAnimation.CalculateAnimationProgress(View.Chart.AnimationTimeMs);
				if (num > 0.0 && num < 1.0)
				{
					View.ActualSeriesAnimation.Apply(renderer, MappingBounds, num);
				}
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				View.RenderWholeSeries(renderer, MappingBounds, WholeLayout);
			}
			if (Chart.AnimationInProgress && View.ActualSeriesAnimation != null && View.ActualSeriesAnimation.CanAnimate && num > 0.0 && num < 1.0)
			{
				View.ActualSeriesAnimation.RestoreState();
			}
			ProcessSeriesHitTestRegion(seriesHitRegion, HitTestController);
		}

		public void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RenderShadow(renderer, MappingBounds);
		}

		public virtual void RenderWholeSeriesAbove(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}
	}

	public class FunnelSeriesPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		private readonly LineStrip points;

		private readonly VariousPolygon polygon;

		private readonly bool isNegativeValuePresents;

		private readonly PointOrder pointOrder;

		public VariousPolygon Polygon => polygon;

		public bool IsNegativeValuePresents => isNegativeValuePresents;

		public GRealPoint2D LeftUpPoint => points[0];

		public GRealPoint2D RightUpPoint => points[1];

		public GRealPoint2D RightDownPoint => points[2];

		public GRealPoint2D LeftDownPoint => points[3];

		public PointOrder PointOrder => pointOrder;

		public FunnelSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, LineStrip points, RectangleF rectangle, bool isNegativeValuePresents, PointOrder pointOrder)
			: base(pointData)
		{
			this.points = points;
			polygon = new VariousPolygon(points, rectangle);
			this.isNegativeValuePresents = isNegativeValuePresents;
			this.pointOrder = pointOrder;
		}

		private void CorrectWidth(int correction)
		{
			points[1] = new GRealPoint2D(points[1].X + (double)correction, points[1].Y);
			points[2] = new GRealPoint2D(points[2].X + (double)correction, points[2].Y);
		}

		public bool CheckWidth()
		{
			if (points[0].X == points[1].X && points[2].X == points[3].X)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			if (CheckWidth())
			{
				hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(polygon));
			}
			else
			{
				CorrectWidth(1);
				hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(polygon));
				CorrectWidth(-1);
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}
	public static class SeriesView3DHelper
	{
		public static List<PlanePolygon> GetPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Prism prism, int seriesWeight, Color color)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			PlanePolygon[] array = coordsCalculator.ClipPolyhedron(prism.Polygons);
			if (array != null)
			{
				PlanePolygon[] array2 = coordsCalculator.ClipPolyhedron(prism.Polygons);
				foreach (PlanePolygon planePolygon in array2)
				{
					if (planePolygon.Visible)
					{
						planePolygon.Weight = seriesWeight;
						planePolygon.Color = color;
						planePolygon.SameColors = true;
						list.Add(planePolygon);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static List<PlanePolygon> GetPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Line topLine, Line bottomLine, bool leftVisible, bool rightVisible, double seriesWidth, int seriesWeight, Color color)
		{
			Prism prism = new Prism(new PlanePolygon(new DiagramPoint[4] { topLine.V2, topLine.V1, bottomLine.V1, bottomLine.V2 }), seriesWidth);
			prism.Laterals[1].Visible = leftVisible;
			prism.Laterals[3].Visible = rightVisible;
			return GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, prism, seriesWeight, color);
		}

		public static List<PlanePolygon> GetPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, DiagramPoint point, Line line, bool lineVisible, bool sidesVisible, double seriesWidth, int seriesWeight, Color color)
		{
			Prism prism = new Prism(new PlanePolygon(new DiagramPoint[3] { point, line.V1, line.V2 }), seriesWidth);
			prism.Laterals[0].Visible = sidesVisible;
			prism.Laterals[1].Visible = lineVisible;
			prism.Laterals[2].Visible = sidesVisible;
			return GetPolygons(coordsCalculator, prism, seriesWeight, color);
		}

		public static List<PlanePolygon> GetPolygons(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Series series, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips, double minLimit, double maxLimit, Color color)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			if (!(series.View is XYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase view))
			{
				return list;
			}
			double z = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesOffset(series);
			double zoomingFactor = (double)coordsCalculator.Diagram.ZoomPercent / 100.0;
			double depth = coordsCalculator.CalcSeriesWidth(view);
			int seriesWeight = coordsCalculator.GetSeriesWeight(series);
			foreach (RangeStrip item in StripsUtils.MapRangeStrips(coordsCalculator, strips))
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> list2 = BezierUtils.CalcBezier(item.TopStrip as BezierStrip, zoomingFactor);
				List<GRealPoint2D> list3 = BezierUtils.CalcBezier(item.BottomStrip as BezierStrip, zoomingFactor);
				List<DiagramPoint> list4 = new List<DiagramPoint>();
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					list4.Add(new DiagramPoint(list2[0].X, list2[0].Y, z));
					foreach (GRealPoint2D item2 in list2)
					{
						list4.Add(new DiagramPoint(item2.X, item2.Y, z));
					}
					list4.Add(new DiagramPoint(list2[list2.Count - 1].X, list2[list2.Count - 1].Y, z));
				}
				if (list3.Count > 0)
				{
					int num = list3.Count - 1;
					list4.Add(new DiagramPoint(list3[num].X, list3[num].Y, z));
					for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						list4.Add(new DiagramPoint(list3[num2].X, list3[num2].Y, z));
					}
					list4.Add(new DiagramPoint(list3[0].X, list3[0].Y, z));
				}
				List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list5 = ContourUtils.CalcIntersection(list4, new List<DiagramPoint>(coordsCalculator.GetSeriesBounds(series, minLimit, maxLimit)), doubleIntersections: true, 0.01);
				if (list5 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (List<DiagramPoint> item3 in list5)
				{
					list.AddRange(ZExtendedCalculator.CalculateFigure(item3, depth, curving: true, color, seriesWeight));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class SplineWholeSeriesLayout : LineWholeSeriesLayout
	{
		public SplineWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, int lineThickness, Rectangle bounds, bool optimizeHitTesting)
			: base(seriesLayout, strips, lineThickness, bounds, optimizeHitTesting)
		{
		}

		protected override void AddStrips(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			foreach (BezierStrip strip in base.Strips)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = strip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true);
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(pointsForDrawing);
				if (zPlaneRectangle.Width >= 0.5 || zPlaneRectangle.Height >= 0.5)
				{
					path.AddBeziers(StripsUtils.Convert(pointsForDrawing));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SplineSeriesViewPainter : LineSeriesViewPainter
	{
		public static BezierStrip CreateStripForLegendMarker(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = new BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal, 0.8);
			if (bounds.Width < 4 || bounds.Height < 4)
			{
				return bezierStrip;
			}
			int num = 3;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left + 1, bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 3);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left + 1, bounds.Top + 2);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left + bounds.Width / 3, bounds.Top + 2);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right - bounds.Width / 3, bounds.Bottom - num);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D5 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right - 1, bounds.Bottom - num);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D6 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right - 1, bounds.Bottom - bounds.Height / 3 - 1);
			bezierStrip.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[6] { gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D3, gRealPoint2D4, gRealPoint2D5, gRealPoint2D6 });
			return bezierStrip;
		}

		public SplineSeriesViewPainter(SeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private static void RenderBezier(ChartRenderer renderer, LineWholeSeriesLayout lineLayout, LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, Color lineColor)
		{
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			foreach (BezierStrip strip in lineLayout.Strips)
			{
				Color color = (strip.Style.Color.HasValue ? Color.FromArgb(strip.Style.Color.Value) : lineColor);
				LineStyle actualStripLineStyle = lineDrawOptions.GetActualStripLineStyle(strip.Style);
				int actualStripLineThickness = lineDrawOptions.GetActualStripLineThickness(strip.Style, lineLayout);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(actualStripLineStyle.AntiAlias);
				renderer.DrawBezier(strip, color, actualStripLineThickness, actualStripLineStyle);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		protected internal override void RenderLineLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			BezierStrip strip = CreateStripForLegendMarker(bounds);
			LineStyle lineStyle = lineDrawOptions.LineStyle;
			Shadow shadow = lineDrawOptions.Shadow;
			shadow.BeforeShadowRender(renderer, 1);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
			renderer.DrawBezier(strip, lineDrawOptions.Shadow.Color, 1f, lineStyle);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			shadow.AfterShadowRender(renderer);
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(lineStyle.AntiAlias);
			renderer.DrawBezier(strip, GetLineColor(lineDrawOptions, selectionState), 1f, lineStyle);
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions = layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions as LineDrawOptions;
			LineWholeSeriesLayout lineWholeSeriesLayout = layout as LineWholeSeriesLayout;
			if (lineDrawOptions != null && lineWholeSeriesLayout != null && lineWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count != 0)
			{
				RenderBezier(renderer, lineWholeSeriesLayout, lineDrawOptions, GetLineColor(lineDrawOptions, layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState));
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeriesShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions = layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.DrawOptions as LineDrawOptions;
			LineWholeSeriesLayout lineWholeSeriesLayout = layout as LineWholeSeriesLayout;
			if (lineDrawOptions != null && lineWholeSeriesLayout != null && lineWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count != 0)
			{
				Shadow shadow = lineDrawOptions.Shadow;
				shadow.BeforeShadowRender(renderer);
				RenderBezier(renderer, lineWholeSeriesLayout, lineDrawOptions, lineDrawOptions.Shadow.Color);
				shadow.AfterShadowRender(renderer);
			}
		}
	}

	public interface ISummaryOptionsOwner
	{
		IChartContainer ChartContainer { get; }

		object DataSource { get; }

		string ChartDataMember { get; }

		string SummaryFunction { get; set; }

		ScaleType ValueScaleType { get; }
	}
	public class SummaryBindingProvider : ISummaryBindingProvider
	{
		private readonly SummaryFunction customFunction;

		private readonly SummaryFunctionInternal predefinedFunction;

		private readonly SummaryOptionsBase options;

		public ISummaryOptionsBase Options => options;

		public string IncorrectSummaryFunctionMessage => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSummaryFunction);

		string ISummaryBindingProvider.FunctionString => options.SummaryFunction;

		public SummaryBindingProvider(SummaryFunction customFunction, SummaryFunctionInternal predefinedFunction, SummaryOptionsBase options)
		{
			this.customFunction = customFunction;
			this.predefinedFunction = predefinedFunction;
			this.options = options;
		}

		public DataSourceValuesCore CreateDataSourceValues()
		{
			return new DataSourceValues();
		}

		public IDataPoint[] CreatePoints(ISeries series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (customFunction != null)
			{
				return customFunction(series as Series, argument, functionArguments, values.OfType<DataSourceValues>().ToArray(), colors).Cast<IDataPoint>().ToArray();
			}
			return predefinedFunction(series, argument, functionArguments, values, colors);
		}
	}
	public class SummaryFunctionDescription
	{
		private string name;

		private string displayName;

		private ScaleType? resultScaleType;

		private int resultDimension;

		private SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[] argumentDescriptions;

		private SummaryFunction customFunction;

		private SummaryFunctionInternal predefinedFunction;

		private bool isStandard;

		public string Name => name;

		public string DisplayName => displayName;

		public ScaleType? ResultScaleType => resultScaleType;

		public int ResultDimension => resultDimension;

		public SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[] ArgumentDescriptions => argumentDescriptions;

		public SummaryFunction CustomFunction => customFunction;

		public SummaryFunctionInternal PredefinedFunction => predefinedFunction;

		public bool IsStandard => isStandard;

		public SummaryFunctionDescription(string name, string displayName, ScaleType? resultScaleType, int resultDimension, SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[] argumentDescriptions, SummaryFunction customFunction, SummaryFunctionInternal predefinedFunction, bool isStandard)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.displayName = displayName;
			this.resultScaleType = resultScaleType;
			this.resultDimension = resultDimension;
			this.argumentDescriptions = ((argumentDescriptions == null) ? new SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[0] : argumentDescriptions);
			this.customFunction = customFunction;
			this.predefinedFunction = predefinedFunction;
			this.isStandard = isStandard;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return displayName;
		}
	}
	public class SummaryFunctionsStorage : IEnumerable<SummaryFunctionDescription>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<SummaryFunctionDescription> innerList = new List<SummaryFunctionDescription>();

		public SummaryFunctionDescription this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (SummaryFunctionDescription inner in innerList)
				{
					if (inner.Name == name)
					{
						return inner;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void Add(SummaryFunctionDescription description)
		{
			Remove(description.Name);
			innerList.Add(description);
		}

		public void Remove(string name)
		{
			SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = this[name];
			if (summaryFunctionDescription != null)
			{
				innerList.Remove(summaryFunctionDescription);
			}
		}

		public void Assign(SummaryFunctionsStorage storage)
		{
			innerList.Clear();
			innerList.AddRange(storage.innerList);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<SummaryFunctionDescription> IEnumerable<SummaryFunctionDescription>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class SummaryFunctionParser : SummaryFunctionParserCore
	{
		public SummaryFunctionParser(string functionString)
			: base(functionString, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSummaryFunction))
		{
		}

		public bool UpdateFunctionName(string functionName, SummaryFunctionsStorage storage)
		{
			functionName = functionName.Trim();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(functionName))
			{
				base.FunctionName = string.Empty;
				return true;
			}
			if (!SummaryFunctionParserCore.CheckIdentifier(functionName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.FunctionName = functionName;
			SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = storage[functionName];
			if (summaryFunctionDescription != null)
			{
				functionName = summaryFunctionDescription.Name;
				ResizeArguments(summaryFunctionDescription.ArgumentDescriptions.Length);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public string GetSummaryFunction()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.FunctionName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = base.FunctionName + "(";
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Arguments[i]))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSummaryFunctionParameterIsNotSpecified));
				}
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += ",";
				}
				text = text + "[" + base.Arguments[i] + "]";
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public string GetDisplayText(SummaryFunctionsStorage functions, DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string chartDataMember, ChartCalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.FunctionName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			SummaryFunctionDescription summaryFunctionDescription = functions[base.FunctionName];
			string text = ((summaryFunctionDescription == null) ? base.FunctionName : summaryFunctionDescription.DisplayName) + "(";
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Arguments[i]))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSummaryFunctionParameterIsNotSpecified));
				}
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += ",";
				}
				text = text + "[" + BindingHelper.GetDataMemberName(dataContext, dataSource, chartDataMember, base.Arguments[i], calculatedFields) + "]";
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public void AddNewArgument()
		{
			ResizeArguments(base.Arguments.Length + 1);
		}

		public void RemoveArgument(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= base.Arguments.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			if (index < base.Arguments.Length - 1)
			{
				Array.Copy(base.Arguments, index + 1, base.Arguments, index, base.Arguments.Length - index - 1);
			}
			ResizeArguments(base.Arguments.Length - 1);
		}
	}
	public static class DefaultSummaryFunctions
	{
		private static bool CheckArgument(object argument)
		{
			if (argument is string text)
			{
				return text.Length != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static IList<object> ConstructTag(DataSourceValuesCore[] values)
		{
			TagList tagList = new TagList();
			foreach (DataSourceValuesCore dataSourceValuesCore in values)
			{
				if (dataSourceValuesCore.TryGetValue(string.Empty, out var value))
				{
					tagList.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return tagList;
		}

		private static IDataPoint[] CalcMin(ISeries series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			int minIndex;
			object obj = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcMin(series, functionArguments, values, out minIndex);
			return CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, (obj == null) ? null : new object[1] { obj }, ConstructTag(values), (colors == null || colors.Length == 0 || minIndex < 0) ? null : new object[1] { colors[minIndex] });
		}

		private static IDataPoint[] CalcMax(ISeries series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			int maxIndex;
			object obj = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcMax(series, functionArguments, values, out maxIndex);
			return CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, (obj == null) ? null : new object[1] { obj }, ConstructTag(values), (colors == null || colors.Length == 0 || maxIndex < 0) ? null : new object[1] { colors[maxIndex] });
		}

		private static IDataPoint[] CalcSum(ISeries series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			double num = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcSum(functionArguments, values);
			return CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, new object[1] { num }, ConstructTag(values), colors);
		}

		private static IDataPoint[] CalcAverage(ISeries series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			double num = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcAverage(functionArguments, values);
			return CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, new object[1] { num }, ConstructTag(values), colors);
		}

		private static IDataPoint[] CalcCount(ISeries series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			double num = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcCount(values);
			return CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, new object[1] { num }, ConstructTag(values), colors);
		}

		private static IDataPoint[] CreateSeriesPoint(ISeries series, object argument, object[] values, object tag, object[] colors)
		{
			return new IDataPoint[1] { series.CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, values, tag, colors) };
		}

		public static SummaryFunctionsStorage CreateStorage()
		{
			SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[] argumentDescriptions = new SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[1]
			{
				new SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionArgumentName))
			};
			SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[] argumentDescriptions2 = new SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription[1]
			{
				new SummaryFunctionArgumentDescription(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionArgumentName), ScaleType.Numerical)
			};
			SummaryFunctionsStorage summaryFunctionsStorage = new SummaryFunctionsStorage();
			summaryFunctionsStorage.Add(new SummaryFunctionDescription("MIN", ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionNameMin), null, 1, argumentDescriptions, null, CalcMin, isStandard: true));
			summaryFunctionsStorage.Add(new SummaryFunctionDescription("MAX", ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionNameMax), null, 1, argumentDescriptions, null, CalcMax, isStandard: true));
			summaryFunctionsStorage.Add(new SummaryFunctionDescription("SUM", ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionNameSum), ScaleType.Numerical, 1, argumentDescriptions2, null, CalcSum, isStandard: true));
			summaryFunctionsStorage.Add(new SummaryFunctionDescription("AVERAGE", ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionNameAverage), ScaleType.Numerical, 1, argumentDescriptions2, null, CalcAverage, isStandard: true));
			summaryFunctionsStorage.Add(new SummaryFunctionDescription("COUNT", ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FunctionNameCount), ScaleType.Numerical, 1, null, null, CalcCount, isStandard: true));
			return summaryFunctionsStorage;
		}
	}
	internal class TagList : List<object>
	{
		public static bool ContainsTag(object tagList, object tagToFind)
		{
			if (tagList is TagList tagList2)
			{
				return tagList2.ContainsTag(tagToFind);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ContainsTag(object tagToFind)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					if (object.Equals(current, tagToFind))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CopyTo(IList destination)
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = enumerator.Current;
				destination.Add(current);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent : RotatedTextPainterNearCircle
	{
		private bool TopHalfCircle => RotatedTextPainterBase.IsTopHalfCircle(base.AngleOnCircleDegree);

		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState)
			: this(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText: false, 0, 0)
		{
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTangent(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: base(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateActualTextAngle()
		{
			if (!TopHalfCircle)
			{
				return base.AngleOnCircleDegree - 180f;
			}
			return base.AngleOnCircleDegree;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			if (!TopHalfCircle)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			if (!TopHalfCircle)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterTop;
			}
			return TextRotation.CenterBottom;
		}
	}
	public class RadarAxisYTextPainter : RotatedTextPainterBase
	{
		private const string ErrorMessage = "RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition";

		private const int CloseAngleEpsilon = 10;

		private readonly float angleOfLineDegree;

		private readonly float labelAngleDegree;

		private readonly NearTextPosition nearPosition;

		private readonly bool isTopHalfOfCircle;

		public RadarAxisYTextPainter(double angleOfLineDegree, double labelAngle, NearTextPosition nearPosition, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState)
			: base(basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState)
		{
			if (nearPosition != NearTextPosition.Left && nearPosition != NearTextPosition.Right)
			{
				throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition");
			}
			this.angleOfLineDegree = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle((float)angleOfLineDegree);
			labelAngleDegree = (float)labelAngle;
			isTopHalfOfCircle = RotatedTextPainterBase.IsTopHalfCircle(this.angleOfLineDegree);
			this.nearPosition = (isTopHalfOfCircle ? nearPosition : AxisLabelPositionHelper.Opposite(nearPosition));
			SetTextAngle((isTopHalfOfCircle ? this.angleOfLineDegree : (this.angleOfLineDegree - 180f)) + labelAngleDegree);
		}

		private bool IsAngleCloseTo(double angle, double closeTo)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(angle - closeTo);
			return num < 10.0;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			double a = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(labelAngleDegree);
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(0.5 * (double)base.Height * Math.Sin(a));
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound(0.5 * (double)base.Width * Math.Sin(a));
			switch (nearPosition)
			{
			case NearTextPosition.Left:
				if (IsAngleCloseTo(angleOfLineDegree, 270.0))
				{
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 90.0) && isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 270.0) && !isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = -1;
					}
				}
				if (IsAngleCloseTo(angleOfLineDegree, 90.0))
				{
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 90.0) && !isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 270.0) && isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = -1;
					}
				}
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width + num2 * num3, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2 + num);
			case NearTextPosition.Right:
				if (IsAngleCloseTo(angleOfLineDegree, 270.0))
				{
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 90.0) && isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = -1;
					}
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 270.0) && !isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
				}
				if (IsAngleCloseTo(angleOfLineDegree, 90.0))
				{
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 90.0) && !isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = -1;
					}
					if (IsAngleCloseTo(labelAngleDegree, 270.0) && isTopHalfOfCircle)
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
				}
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X + num2 * num3, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2 - num);
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException("RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition");
			}
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			return nearPosition switch
			{
				NearTextPosition.Left => TextRotation.RightCenter, 
				NearTextPosition.Right => TextRotation.LeftCenter, 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException("RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition"), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine : RotatedTextPainterBase
	{
		private const string errorMessage = "RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition";

		private readonly float angleOfLineDegree;

		private readonly NearTextPosition nearPosition;

		private bool TopHalfCircle => RotatedTextPainterBase.IsTopHalfCircle(angleOfLineDegree);

		public RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine(float angleOfLineDegree, NearTextPosition nearPosition, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState)
			: base(basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState)
		{
			if (nearPosition != NearTextPosition.Left && nearPosition != NearTextPosition.Right)
			{
				throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition");
			}
			this.angleOfLineDegree = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle(angleOfLineDegree);
			this.nearPosition = CalculateActualNearTextPosition(nearPosition);
			SetTextAngle(CalculateActualTextAngle());
		}

		private float CalculateActualTextAngle()
		{
			if (!TopHalfCircle)
			{
				return angleOfLineDegree - 180f;
			}
			return angleOfLineDegree;
		}

		private NearTextPosition CalculateActualNearTextPosition(NearTextPosition nearPosition)
		{
			if (!TopHalfCircle)
			{
				return AxisLabelPositionHelper.Opposite(nearPosition);
			}
			return nearPosition;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			return nearPosition switch
			{
				NearTextPosition.Left => new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2), 
				NearTextPosition.Right => new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2), 
				_ => throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition"), 
			};
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			return nearPosition switch
			{
				NearTextPosition.Left => TextRotation.RightCenter, 
				NearTextPosition.Right => TextRotation.LeftCenter, 
				_ => throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearRotatedLine error: Unsupported NearTextPosition"), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent : RotatedTextPainterOnCircle

		public RotatedTextPainterOnCircleTangent(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool shouldCorrectAngle, bool parseText)
			: base(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, shouldCorrectAngle, parseText)

	public class RotatedTextPainterOnCircleRadial : RotatedTextPainterOnCircle
	{

		{
			get
			{
				if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f)

					return base.AngleOnCircleDegree <= 180f;
				}
				return false;
			}

				return base.AngleOnCircleDegree - 90f;

		}
	}
	public abstract class RotatedTextPainterOnCircle : RotatedTextPainterBase
	{
		private readonly bool shouldCorrectAngle;

		private readonly float angleOnCircleDegree;

		protected float AngleOnCircleDegree => angleOnCircleDegree;

		protected bool ShouldCorrectAngle => shouldCorrectAngle;

		public RotatedTextPainterOnCircle(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool shouldCorrectAngle)
			: this(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, shouldCorrectAngle, parseText: false)
		{
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterOnCircle(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool shouldCorrectAngle, bool parseText)
			: base(basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, 0, 0, wordWrap: false)
		{
			this.shouldCorrectAngle = shouldCorrectAngle;
			this.angleOnCircleDegree = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle(angleOnCircleDegree);
			SetTextAngle(CalculateActualTextAngle());
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterOnCircle(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool shouldCorrectAngle, int maxWidth, int maxHeight)
			: base(basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, maxWidth, maxHeight)
		{
			this.shouldCorrectAngle = shouldCorrectAngle;
			this.angleOnCircleDegree = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle(angleOnCircleDegree);
			SetTextAngle(CalculateActualTextAngle());
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			return TextRotation.CenterCenter;
		}

		protected abstract float CalculateActualTextAngle();
	}
	public abstract class TextPainterBase
	{
		private readonly string text;

		private readonly ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider;

		private readonly bool parseText;

		private readonly bool mixColorByHitTestState;

		private readonly StringInfo parsedText;

		private readonly RectangleIndents borderMargins;

		private SizeF textSize;

		private int width;

		private int height;

		private RectangleF? bounds;

		private Rectangle? roundedBounds;

		protected int BorderThickness
		{
			get
			{
				if (propertiesProvider.Border != null)
				{
					return propertiesProvider.Border.ActualThickness;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected Shadow Shadow => propertiesProvider.Shadow;

		public string Text => text;

		public RectangleF Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!bounds.HasValue)
				{
					CalculateBounds();
				}
				return bounds.Value;
			}
		}

		public ITextPropertiesProvider PropertiesProvider => propertiesProvider;

		public Rectangle RoundedBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!roundedBounds.HasValue)
				{
					CalculateBounds();
				}
				return roundedBounds.Value;
			}
		}

		public int Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			protected set
			{
				width = value;
			}
		}

		public int Height
		{
			get
			{
				return height;
			}
			protected set
			{
				height = value;
			}
		}

		public StringInfo ParsedText => parsedText;

		public bool UseSpecificCursor { get; set; }

		private static System.Drawing.StringAlignment CalcAlignment(ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider)
		{
			if (!(propertiesProvider is ITextRTLPropertiesProvider textRTLPropertiesProvider))
			{
				return propertiesProvider.Alignment;
			}
			return textRTLPropertiesProvider.AlignmentRTL;
		}

		private TextPainterBase(string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, RectangleIndents borderMargins)
		{
			this.text = text;
			this.textSize = textSize;
			this.propertiesProvider = propertiesProvider;
			this.mixColorByHitTestState = mixColorByHitTestState;
			this.parseText = parseText;
			this.borderMargins = borderMargins;
		}

		public TextPainterBase(string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, int maxWidth, float maxHeight)
			: this(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText: true, null)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat
			{
				Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)CalcAlignment(propertiesProvider)
			};
			if (TextMeasurer.Default.RTL)
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft;
			}
			SimpleTextPropertiesProvider simpleTextPropertiesProvider = new SimpleTextPropertiesProvider(propertiesProvider.Font, dXStringFormat)
			{
				AvailableBounds = new AvailableTextBounds(maxWidth, maxHeight),
				TextColor = propertiesProvider.GetTextColor(Color.Empty)
			};
			TextMeasurer textMeasurer = TextMeasurer.Default;
			if (propertiesProvider != null)
			{
				textMeasurer.SetTextRenderingHint(AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(propertiesProvider));
			}
			parsedText = new StringInfo(text, simpleTextPropertiesProvider, textMeasurer);
			if (propertiesProvider != null)
			{
				textMeasurer.RestoreTextRenderingHint();
			}
			width = MathUtils.Ceiling(parsedText.Size.Width);
			height = RoundHeight(parsedText.Size.Height);
			CorrectSizeByBorder();
		}

		public TextPainterBase(string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, bool wordWrap)
			: this(text, textSize, null, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount, wordWrap)
		{
		}

		public TextPainterBase(string text, SizeF textSize, RectangleIndents borderMargins, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, bool wordWrap)
			: this(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, borderMargins)
		{
			if (parseText)
			{
				DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat();
				if (!wordWrap)
				{
					dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
				}
				if (TextMeasurer.Default.RTL)
				{
					dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft;
				}
				dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)CalcAlignment(propertiesProvider);
				SimpleTextPropertiesProvider simpleTextPropertiesProvider = new SimpleTextPropertiesProvider(propertiesProvider.Font, dXStringFormat);
				if (maxWidth > 0)
				{
					simpleTextPropertiesProvider.AvailableBounds = new AvailableTextBounds(maxWidth, maxLineCount);
				}
				simpleTextPropertiesProvider.TextColor = propertiesProvider.GetTextColor(Color.Empty);
				TextMeasurer textMeasurer = TextMeasurer.Default;
				if (propertiesProvider != null)
				{
					textMeasurer.SetTextRenderingHint(AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(propertiesProvider));
				}
				parsedText = new StringInfo(text, simpleTextPropertiesProvider, textMeasurer);
				if (propertiesProvider != null)
				{
					textMeasurer.RestoreTextRenderingHint();
				}
				width = MathUtils.Ceiling(parsedText.Size.Width);
				height = RoundHeight(parsedText.Size.Height);
			}
			else if (maxWidth > 0 && (float)maxWidth < textSize.Width)
			{
				int linesFilled;
				SizeF sizeF = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, propertiesProvider.Font, maxWidth, propertiesProvider.Alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, out linesFilled);
				width = (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Width);
				if (maxLineCount > 0 && linesFilled > maxLineCount)
				{
					height = RoundHeight(sizeF.Height / (float)linesFilled * (float)maxLineCount);
				}
				else
				{
					height = RoundHeight(sizeF.Height);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				width = MathUtils.Ceiling(textSize.Width);
				height = RoundHeight(textSize.Height);
			}
			CorrectSizeByBorder();
		}

		private void CorrectSizeByBorder()
		{
			if (propertiesProvider.CorrectBoundsByBorder)
			{
				int num = BorderThickness * 2;
				width += num;
				height += num;
			}
		}

		private HitRegion CalculateHitRegion(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			VariousPolygon variousPolygon = CalculateHitPolygon(bounds);
			if (variousPolygon != null)
			{
				return new HitRegion(variousPolygon);
			}
			return new HitRegion(bounds);
		}

		private Color CorrectColor(Color color, double opacity)
		{
			if (opacity < 1.0)
			{
				return HitTestColors.MixAlphaChanel(color, (byte)(opacity * 255.0));
			}
			return color;
		}

		private Color GetHitTestColor(Color textColor)
		{
			if (mixColorByHitTestState)
			{
				return GraphicUtils.CorrectColorByHitTestState(textColor, propertiesProvider.State);
			}
			return GraphicUtils.GetColor(textColor, propertiesProvider.State);
		}

		private RectangleF CorrectSelectedBorderBounds(RectangleF borderBounds)
		{
			if (!propertiesProvider.CorrectBoundsByBorder)
			{
				return new RectangleF(borderBounds.Left - 1f, borderBounds.Top - 1f, borderBounds.Width + 1f, borderBounds.Height + 1f);
			}
			return borderBounds;
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Render(renderer, null);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, null, null, Color.Empty, 1.0);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalObject)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, null, additionalObject, Color.Empty, 1.0);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, null, additionalHitObject, color, 1.0);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, null, additionalHitObject, color, opacity);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color, Rectangle clipBounds, double opacity)
		{
			RenderWithClipping(renderer, hitTestController, additionalHitObject, color, clipBounds, opacity);
		}

		public abstract void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity);

		public abstract void RenderWithClipping(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color, Rectangle clipBounds, double opacity);

		public abstract void RenderWithOffsetIfTextParsed(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity, bool processHitTest = true);

		protected abstract RectangleF GetBounds();

		protected virtual VariousPolygon GetPolygon()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual VariousPolygon CalculateHitPolygon(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual int RoundHeight(float height)
		{
			return MathUtils.Ceiling(height);
		}

		protected void ProcessHitTesting(HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject)
		{
			IHitRegion region = hitRegion ?? GetHitRegion();
			object additionalObject = additionalHitObject ?? (UseSpecificCursor ? new ChartFocusedArea(PropertiesProvider) : null);
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, propertiesProvider, additionalObject, UseSpecificCursor, region, null, UseSpecificCursor);
		}

		protected void RenderInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, RectangleF rectangle, Color color, bool antialiasedBorder, double opacity, PointF offset)
		{
			Color color2 = CorrectColor(propertiesProvider.GetTextColor(color), opacity);
			Rectangle rectangle2 = rectangle.ToRectangle();
			if (borderMargins != null)
			{
				rectangle2 = borderMargins.IncreaseRectangle(rectangle.ToGRealRect2D()).ToRectangle();
			}
			if (!propertiesProvider.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				Color color3 = CorrectColor(propertiesProvider.BackColor, opacity);
				propertiesProvider.FillStyle.RenderRectangle(renderer, rectangle2, color3);
			}
			RectangularBorder border = propertiesProvider.Border;
			if (border != null)
			{
				bool antialiasingEnabled = AntialiasingSupport.GetAntialiasingEnabled(propertiesProvider);
				if (antialiasedBorder && antialiasingEnabled)
				{
					renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				}
				Color actualColor = CorrectColor(propertiesProvider.GetBorderColor(color), opacity);
				BorderHelper.RenderBorder(renderer, border, rectangle2, propertiesProvider.State, propertiesProvider.Border.ActualThickness, actualColor);
				if (antialiasedBorder && antialiasingEnabled)
				{
					renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
				}
			}
			else if (!propertiesProvider.State.Normal && propertiesProvider.ChangeSelectedBorder)
			{
				Color hitTestColor = GetHitTestColor(color2);
				renderer.DrawRectangle(CorrectSelectedBorderBounds(rectangle2), hitTestColor, 1f);
			}
			if (parseText)
			{
				foreach (TextLineInfo line in parsedText.Lines)
				{
					bool flag = line.TextBlocks.Count != 1;
					foreach (TextBlockInfo textBlock in line.TextBlocks)
					{
						System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment = ((!flag) ? propertiesProvider.Alignment : System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near);
						System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment = ((!flag) ? propertiesProvider.Alignment : System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near);
						RectangleF rectangleF = textBlock.Bounds;
						if (!textBlock.BackColor.IsEmpty)
						{
							renderer.FillRectangle(textBlock.FillBounds, textBlock.BackColor);
						}
						Color color4 = (textBlock.FontColor.IsEmpty ? color2 : textBlock.FontColor);
						renderer.DrawBoundedText(textBlock.Text, textBlock.Font.DpiScale(), color4, propertiesProvider, rectangleF, alignment, lineAlignment, textSize.Height, allowWrap: false);
						if (textBlock.IsHyperlink)
						{
							rectangleF.Offset(offset);
							HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, propertiesProvider, new HyperlinkSource(textBlock.Hyperlink), CalculateHitRegion(rectangleF));
						}
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			renderer.DrawBoundedText(text, propertiesProvider.Font.DpiScale(), color2, propertiesProvider, rectangle, propertiesProvider.Alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, textSize.Height, propertiesProvider.CanWrapText(textSize.Width));
		}

		protected void CalculateBounds()
		{
			bounds = GetBounds();
			roundedBounds = GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(bounds.Value);
		}

		public HitRegion GetHitRegion()
		{
			VariousPolygon polygon = GetPolygon();
			if (polygon != null)
			{
				return new HitRegion(polygon);
			}
			return new HitRegion(Bounds);
		}

		public abstract void Offset(double dx, double dy);

		public abstract void Rotate(double angle);
	}
	public class TextPainter : TextPainterBase
	{
		private PointF location;

		private RectangleF? boundsWithBorder;

		public RectangleF BoundsWithBorder
		{
			get
			{
				if (!boundsWithBorder.HasValue)
				{
					int borderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
					boundsWithBorder = RectangleF.Inflate(base.Bounds, borderThickness, borderThickness);
				}
				return boundsWithBorder.Value;
			}
		}

		public TextPainter(string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, PointF location, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, bool wordWrap)
			: this(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, parseText: false, location, maxWidth, maxLineCount, wordWrap)
		{
		}

		public TextPainter(string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool parseText, PointF location, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, bool wordWrap)
			: base(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount, wordWrap)
		{
			this.location = location;
		}

		public TextPainter(string text, Size textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, PointF location)
			: base(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: true, maxWidth, maxLineCount, wordWrap: true)
		{
			this.location = location;
		}

		protected override int RoundHeight(float height)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(height);
		}

		protected override RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			return new RectangleF(location.X, location.Y, base.Width, base.Height);
		}

		public void SetLocation(PointF location)
		{
			this.location = location;
			CalculateBounds();
			boundsWithBorder = null;
		}

		public void RenderWithOffset(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController)
		{
			RenderWithOffsetIfTextParsed(renderer, hitTestController, null, null, Color.Empty, 1.0, processHitTest: false);
		}

		public override void RenderWithOffsetIfTextParsed(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity, bool processHitTest = true)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = base.Bounds;
			if (rectangleF.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				if (processHitTest)
				{
					ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
				}
				if (base.Shadow != null && base.Shadow.Visible)
				{
					base.Shadow.Render(renderer, rectangleF);
				}
				PointF offset = default(PointF);
				if (base.ParsedText != null)
				{
					renderer.SaveState();
					offset = rectangleF.CalculateCenter();
					rectangleF.Offset(0f - offset.X, 0f - offset.Y);
					renderer.TranslateModel(offset.X, offset.Y);
				}
				RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, rectangleF, color, antialiasedBorder: false, opacity, offset);
				if (base.ParsedText != null)
				{
					renderer.RestoreState();
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetHeight(int newHeight)
		{
			base.Height = newHeight;
		}

		public void SetWidth(int newWidth)
		{
			base.Width = newWidth;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = base.Bounds;
			if (rectangleF.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
				if (base.Shadow != null && base.Shadow.Visible)
				{
					base.Shadow.Render(renderer, rectangleF);
				}
				RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, rectangleF, color, antialiasedBorder: false, opacity, default(PointF));
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWithClipping(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color, Rectangle clipBounds, double opacity)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = base.Bounds;
			if (rectangleF.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(clipBounds);
				RectangleF rect = RectangleF.Intersect(rectangleF, clipBounds);
				HitRegion hitRegion = new HitRegion(rect);
				ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
				if (base.Shadow != null && base.Shadow.Visible)
				{
					base.Shadow.Render(renderer, rectangleF);
				}
				if (base.ParsedText != null)
				{
					PointF pointF = rectangleF.CalculateCenter();
					rectangleF.Offset(0f - pointF.X, 0f - pointF.Y);
					renderer.SaveState();
					renderer.TranslateModel(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
				}
				RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, rectangleF, color, antialiasedBorder: false, opacity, default(PointF));
				if (base.ParsedText != null)
				{
					renderer.RestoreState();
				}
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
			}
		}

		public override void Offset(double dx, double dy)
		{
			location.X += (float)dx;
			location.Y += (float)dy;
			SetLocation(location);
		}

		public override void Rotate(double angle)
		{
		}
	}
	public class VerticalRotatedTextPainter : TextPainter
	{
		private RectangleF boundsBeforeRotation;

		private readonly bool topToBottom;

		public VerticalRotatedTextPainter(string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, PointF location, bool topToBottom, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, bool wordWrap)
			: base(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, location, maxWidth, maxLineCount, wordWrap)
		{
			boundsBeforeRotation = new RectangleF(0f, 0f, textSize.Height, textSize.Width);
			boundsBeforeRotation = GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(boundsBeforeRotation);
			this.topToBottom = topToBottom;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = boundsBeforeRotation;
			RectangleF rectangleF2 = base.Bounds;
			if (GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(rectangleF.Size) && GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(rectangleF2.Size))
			{
				ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
				renderer.SaveState();
				double num;
				double num2;
				float angle;
				if (topToBottom)
				{
					num = rectangleF2.Left + rectangleF.Height;
					num2 = rectangleF2.Top;
					angle = 90f;
				}
				else
				{
					num = rectangleF2.Left;
					num2 = rectangleF2.Top + rectangleF.Width;
					angle = -90f;
				}
				PointF offset = new PointF((float)num, (float)num2);
				renderer.TranslateModel(offset.X, offset.Y);
				renderer.RotateModel(angle);
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)rectangleF;
				if (base.Shadow != null && base.Shadow.Visible)
				{
					base.Shadow.Render(renderer, (Rectangle)zPlaneRectangle);
				}
				RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, (Rectangle)zPlaneRectangle, color, antialiasedBorder: true, opacity, offset);
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWithClipping(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color, Rectangle clipBounds, double opacity)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = boundsBeforeRotation;
			RectangleF rectangleF2 = base.Bounds;
			if (GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(rectangleF.Size) && GraphicUtils.CheckIsSizePositive(rectangleF2.Size))
			{
				RectangleF rect = RectangleF.Intersect(base.Bounds, clipBounds);
				HitRegion hitRegion = new HitRegion(rect);
				ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
				renderer.SaveState();
				renderer.SetClipping(clipBounds);
				double num;
				double num2;
				float angle;
				if (topToBottom)
				{
					num = rectangleF2.Left + rectangleF.Height;
					num2 = rectangleF2.Top;
					angle = 90f;
				}
				else
				{
					num = rectangleF2.Left;
					num2 = rectangleF2.Top + rectangleF.Width;
					angle = -90f;
				}
				PointF offset = new PointF((float)num, (float)num2);
				renderer.TranslateModel(offset.X, offset.Y);
				renderer.RotateModel(angle);
				ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)rectangleF;
				if (base.Shadow != null && base.Shadow.Visible)
				{
					base.Shadow.Render(renderer, (Rectangle)zPlaneRectangle);
				}
				RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, (Rectangle)zPlaneRectangle, color, antialiasedBorder: true, opacity, offset);
				renderer.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWithOffsetIfTextParsed(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity, bool processHitTest = true)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, additionalHitObject, color, opacity);
		}
	}

		public RotatedTextPainterNearLine(Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, NearTextPosition nearPosition, float angleDegree, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount, bool wordWrap)
