	public abstract class RotatedTextPainterNearCircle : RotatedTextPainterBase
	{
		private readonly float angleOnCircleDegree;

		protected float AngleOnCircleDegree => angleOnCircleDegree;

		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircle(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: base(basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount, wordWrap: false)
		{
			this.angleOnCircleDegree = RotatedTextPainterBase.CancelAngle(angleOnCircleDegree);
			SetTextAngle(CalculateActualTextAngle());
		}

		protected abstract float CalculateActualTextAngle();
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterNearCircleRadial : RotatedTextPainterNearCircle
	{
		private bool RightHalfCircle
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f)
				{
					return base.AngleOnCircleDegree <= 180f;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircleRadial(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: base(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateActualTextAngle()
		{
			if (!RightHalfCircle)
			{
				return base.AngleOnCircleDegree + 90f;
			}
			return base.AngleOnCircleDegree - 90f;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			if (!RightHalfCircle)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
			}
			return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			if (!RightHalfCircle)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightCenter;
			}
			return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
		}
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterNearCircleBottomToTop : RotatedTextPainterNearCircle
	{
		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircleBottomToTop(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: base(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateActualTextAngle()
		{
			return -90f;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 0f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 90f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 90f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 90f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 180f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 180f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 180f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 270f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 270f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 270f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 360f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearCircleBottomToTop error");
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 0f)
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 90f)
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftTop;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 90f)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterTop;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 90f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 180f)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightTop;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 180f)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightCenter;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 180f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 270f)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightBottom;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 270f)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterBottom;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 270f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 360f)
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftBottom;
			}
			throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTopToBottom error");
		}
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTopToBottom : RotatedTextPainterNearCircle
	{
		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTopToBottom(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: base(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateActualTextAngle()
		{
			return 90f;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 0f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 90f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 90f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 90f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 180f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 180f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 180f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 270f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 270f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 270f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 360f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTopToBottom error");
		}

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()
		{
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 0f)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightCenter;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 90f)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightBottom;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 90f)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterBottom;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 90f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 180f)
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftBottom;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 180f)
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 180f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 270f)
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftTop;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 270f)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterTop;
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 270f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 360f)
			{
				return TextRotation.RightTop;
			}
			throw new InternalException("RotatedTextPainterNearCircleTopToBottom error");
		}
	}
	public class RotatedTextPainterNearCircleLeftToRight : RotatedTextPainterNearCircle
	{
		public RotatedTextPainterNearCircleLeftToRight(float angleOnCircleDegree, Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: base(angleOnCircleDegree, basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maxLineCount)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateActualTextAngle()
		{
			return 0f;
		}

		protected override Point CalculateLeftTopPoint()
		{
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 0f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 0f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 90f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 90f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y - base.Height / 2);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 90f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 180f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree == 180f)
			{
				return new Point(base.BasePoint.X - base.Width / 2, base.BasePoint.Y);
			}
			if (base.AngleOnCircleDegree > 180f && base.AngleOnCircleDegree < 270f)

		protected override TextRotation CalculateRotation()

		}
	}
	public abstract class RotatedTextPainterBase : TextPainterBase
	{
		private Point basePoint;

		private double radianAngle;

		private double degreeAngle;

		private Rectangle InitialTextRect => new Rectangle(CalculateLeftTopPoint(), new Size(base.Width, base.Height));

		internal double TextAngleRadian => radianAngle;

		internal double TextAngleDegree => degreeAngle;

		public Point BasePoint => basePoint;

		private static LineStrip CalculatePoints(TextRotation rotation, Rectangle rect, double angle)
		{
			GRealRect2D rect2 = new GRealRect2D(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			GRealPoint2D[] array = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotatedItemPoints(rect2, angle);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateOffset(rotation, rect2, angle);
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
			GRealPoint2D[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = array2[i];
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D2.X + gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.Y + gRealPoint2D.Y));
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		private Point GetOffset(ref Rectangle rect, ref Point center)
		{
			return CalculateRotation() switch
			{
				TextRotation.LeftTop => new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top), 
				TextRotation.CenterTop => new Point(center.X, rect.Top), 
				TextRotation.RightTop => new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top), 
				TextRotation.LeftCenter => new Point(rect.Left, center.Y), 
				TextRotation.CenterCenter => new Point(center.X, center.Y), 
				TextRotation.RightCenter => new Point(rect.Right, center.Y), 
				TextRotation.LeftBottom => new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), 
				TextRotation.CenterBottom => new Point(center.X, rect.Bottom), 
				TextRotation.RightBottom => new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), 
				_ => new Point(0, 0), 
			};
		}

		public static float CancelAngle(float angle)
		{
			int num = (int)angle / 360;
			float num2 = angle - (float)(360 * num);
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 += 360f;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public static bool IsTopHalfCircle(float angle)
		{
			if (!(angle >= 0f) || !(angle <= 90f))
			{
				if (angle >= 270f)
				{
					return angle <= 360f;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterBase(Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState)
			: this(basePoint, text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText: false, 0, 0, wordWrap: false)
		{
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterBase(Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maximumLinesCount, bool wordWrap)
			: this(basePoint, text, textSize, null, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maximumLinesCount, wordWrap)
		{
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterBase(Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, RectangleIndents borderMargins, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, bool parseText, int maxWidth, int maximumLinesCount, bool wordWrap)
			: base(text, textSize, borderMargins, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, parseText, maxWidth, maximumLinesCount, wordWrap)
		{
			this.basePoint = basePoint;
		}

		public RotatedTextPainterBase(Point basePoint, string text, SizeF textSize, ITextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, bool mixColorByHitTestState, int maxWidth, int maxHeight)
			: base(text, textSize, propertiesProvider, mixColorByHitTestState, maxWidth, maxHeight)
		{
			this.basePoint = basePoint;
		}

		protected override RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in CalculatePoints(CalculateRotation(), InitialTextRect, radianAngle))
			{
				if (item.X < num)
				{
					num = item.X;
				}
				if (item.X > num3)
				{
					num3 = item.X;
				}
				if (item.Y < num2)
				{
					num2 = item.Y;
				}
				if (item.Y > num4)
				{
					num4 = item.Y;
				}
			}
			return new RectangleF((float)num, (float)num2, (float)(num3 - num), (float)(num4 - num2));
		}

		protected override VariousPolygon GetPolygon()
		{
			TextRotation rotation = CalculateRotation();
			Rectangle rect = Rectangle.Inflate(InitialTextRect, 1, 1);
			LineStrip vertices = CalculatePoints(rotation, rect, radianAngle);
			return new VariousPolygon(vertices, GetBounds());
		}

		protected override VariousPolygon CalculateHitPolygon(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			GRealRect2D rectangle = new GRealRect2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			Point point = CalculateLeftTopPoint();
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D((double)point.X + (double)InitialTextRect.Width / 2.0, (double)point.Y + (double)InitialTextRect.Height / 2.0);
			LineStrip vertices = AxisLabelRotationHelper.RotateRectangleOverPoint(rectangle, gRealPoint2D, radianAngle);
			return new VariousPolygon(vertices, bounds);
		}

		protected abstract Point CalculateLeftTopPoint();

		protected abstract TextRotation CalculateRotation();

		protected void SetTextAngle(double angle)
		{
			degreeAngle = angle;
			radianAngle = angle * Math.PI / 180.0;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity)
		{
			Rectangle rect = InitialTextRect;
			Point center = new Point(rect.X + rect.Width / 2, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2);
			Point offset = GetOffset(ref rect, ref center);
			rect.Offset(-offset.X, -offset.Y);
			ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
			renderer.SaveState();
			renderer.TranslateModel(offset.X, offset.Y);
			renderer.RotateModel((float)degreeAngle);
			base.Shadow?.Render(renderer, rect);
			RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, rect, color, antialiasedBorder: true, opacity, offset);
			renderer.RestoreState();
		}

		public override void RenderWithClipping(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, object additionalHitObject, Color color, Rectangle clipBounds, double opacity)
		{
			Rectangle rect = InitialTextRect;
			Point center = new Point(rect.X + rect.Width / 2, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2);
			Point offset = GetOffset(ref rect, ref center);
			rect.Offset(-offset.X, -offset.Y);
			VariousPolygon polygon = GetPolygon();
			VariousPolygon polygon2 = VariousPolygon.Intersect(polygon, clipBounds);
			HitRegion hitRegion = new HitRegion(polygon2);
			ProcessHitTesting(hitTestController, hitRegion, additionalHitObject);
			renderer.SaveState();
			renderer.TranslateModel(offset.X, offset.Y);
			renderer.RotateModel((float)degreeAngle);
			base.Shadow?.Render(renderer, rect);
			RenderInternal(renderer, hitTestController, rect, color, antialiasedBorder: true, opacity, offset);
			renderer.RestoreState();
		}

		public override void RenderWithOffsetIfTextParsed(ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, IHitRegion hitRegion, object additionalHitObject, Color color, double opacity, bool processHitTest = true)
		{
			Render(renderer, hitTestController, additionalHitObject, color, opacity);
		}

		public override void Offset(double dx, double dy)
		{
			basePoint.X += (int)dx;
			basePoint.Y += (int)dy;
			CalculateBounds();
		}

		public override void Rotate(double angle)
		{
			SetTextAngle(CancelAngle((float)angle));
			CalculateBounds();
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData : IClickableElement
	{
		private readonly PaneTitle title;

		private readonly Point arrowOffset;

		private readonly RectangleIndents margins;

		private readonly Size textSize;

		private readonly Size titleSize;

		private readonly Chart chart;

		private DockableTitle.DockingBase docking;

		private Rectangle titleMaxBounds;

		internal PaneTitle Title => title;

		public Size Size => titleSize;

		public XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData(PaneTitle title)
		{
			this.title = title;
			RotatedTextPainterNearLine rotatedTextPainterNearLine = new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(Point.Empty, title.ActualText, Size.Empty, title, NearTextPosition.Top, 0f, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: true, int.MaxValue, 0, wordWrap: false);
			textSize = rotatedTextPainterNearLine.RoundedBounds.Size;
			arrowOffset = title.GetArrowOffset(textSize);
			margins = title.ActualMargins;
			Size size = margins.IncreaseSize(textSize);
			chart = title.Chart;
			int num = GetArrowImageSize(isRotated: false).Width;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				num += arrowOffset.X;
			}
			titleSize = new Size(Math.Max(textSize.Width, size.Width) + num, Math.Max(textSize.Height, size.Height));
		}

		bool IClickableElement.ProcessLeftButtonClick()
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase pane = title.Pane;
			if (title.CanProcessLeftButtonClick)
			{
				pane.Visibility = ((pane.Visibility == ChartElementVisibility.Visible) ? ChartElementVisibility.Collapsed : ChartElementVisibility.Visible);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Size GetArrowImageSize(bool isRotated)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (title.ArrowVisible)
			{
				SvgImage svgImage = title.GetArrowImage(isRotated).SvgImage;
				num = (int)svgImage.Width;
				num2 = (int)svgImage.Height;
				if (num2 > textSize.Height)
				{
					double num3 = (double)textSize.Height / (double)num2;
					num = (int)((double)num * num3);
					num2 = (int)((double)num2 * num3);
				}
				if (chart != null)
				{
					num = chart.ScaleX(num);
					num2 = chart.ScaleY(num2);
				}
			}
			return new Size(num, num2);
		}

		private DockableTitle.DockingBase GetDocking(Rectangle maxBounds)
		{
			ChartTitleDockStyle dock = ChartTitleDockStyle.Top;
			if (title.Pane.Collapsed && maxBounds.Height > maxBounds.Width)
			{
				dock = ChartTitleDockStyle.Left;
			}
			return DockableTitle.DockingBase.CreateInstance(dock);
		}

		public void UpdateCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction, Rectangle paneBounds, Rectangle initialPaneBounds, Rectangle maxPaneBounds)
		{
			docking = GetDocking(paneBounds);
			int num = paneBounds.Top - initialPaneBounds.Top;
			if (num < Size.Height)
			{
				titleMaxBounds = margins.DecreaseRectangle(new Rectangle(paneBounds.Left, maxPaneBounds.Top - (Size.Height - num), paneBounds.Width, Size.Height));
			}
			else
			{
				titleMaxBounds = margins.DecreaseRectangle(new Rectangle(paneBounds.Left, paneBounds.Top - Size.Height, paneBounds.Width, Size.Height));
			}
			title.Bounds = titleMaxBounds.ToGRealRect2D();
			correction.Update(margins.IncreaseRectangle(titleMaxBounds));
		}

		public void CalculateCollapsedPaneTitleBounds(Rectangle paneBounds)
		{
			docking = GetDocking(paneBounds);
			if (docking.IsVertical)
			{
				RectangleIndents rectangleIndents = new RectangleIndents(null, title.Chart)
				{
					All = margins.All,
					Left = margins.Top,
					Top = margins.Right,
					Right = margins.Bottom,
					Bottom = margins.Left
				};
				titleMaxBounds = rectangleIndents.DecreaseRectangle(paneBounds);
			}
			else
			{
				titleMaxBounds = margins.DecreaseRectangle(paneBounds);
			}
			title.Bounds = titleMaxBounds.ToGRealRect2D();
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			bool flag = !docking.IsVertical && title.Pane.Collapsed;
			Size arrowImageSize = GetArrowImageSize(flag);
			int num = (title.ArrowVisible ? (arrowOffset.X + arrowImageSize.Width) : 0);
			int num2;
			Point basePoint;
			if (!docking.IsVertical)
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(textSize.Width, titleMaxBounds.Width - num);
				basePoint = docking.CalcOrigin(titleMaxBounds, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, new Size(num2, textSize.Height)), title.Alignment);
				if (title.Alignment == System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far)
				{
					basePoint.X -= num;
				}
				else if (title.Alignment == System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center)
				{
					basePoint.X -= num / 2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(textSize.Width, titleMaxBounds.Height - num);
				basePoint = docking.CalcOrigin(titleMaxBounds, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, new Size(textSize.Height, num2)), System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far);
				basePoint.Y += num;
			}
			RectangleIndents borderMargins = new RectangleIndents(null, 0, title.Chart)
			{
				Right = num
			};
			RotatedTextPainterNearLine rotatedTextPainterNearLine = new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(basePoint, title.ActualText, textSize, borderMargins, title, docking.NearPosition, docking.TextAngle, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: true, num2, 0, wordWrap: false);
			rotatedTextPainterNearLine.Render(renderer);
			Rectangle roundedBounds = rotatedTextPainterNearLine.RoundedBounds;
			Point position;
			if (!docking.IsVertical)
			{
				roundedBounds.Width += num;
				position = new Point(roundedBounds.Right - arrowImageSize.Width, roundedBounds.Top + arrowOffset.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				roundedBounds.Y -= num;
				roundedBounds.Height += num;
				position = new Point(roundedBounds.Left + arrowOffset.Y, roundedBounds.Top);
			}
			if (title.ArrowVisible)
			{
				SvgBitmap arrowImage = title.GetArrowImage(flag);
				SimpleColorSvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider = new SimpleColorSvgPaletteProvider(title.ArrowOpacity, ((ITextPropertiesProvider)title).GetTextColor(Color.Empty));
				renderer.DrawSvgImage(arrowImage, position, arrowImageSize, (ISvgPaletteProvider)(object)paletteProvider);
			}
			if (chart != null)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(chart.HitTestController, title, title, new HitRegion(roundedBounds), force: true);
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(chart.HitTestController, title, new ChartFocusedArea(this), new HitRegion(roundedBounds), force: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public class HitRegionContainer : IDisposable
	{
		private IHitRegion underlying;

		public IHitRegion Underlying => underlying;

		public HitRegionContainer()
			: this(new HitRegion())
		{
		}

		public HitRegionContainer(IHitRegion underlying)
		{
			if (underlying == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("underlying");
			}
			this.underlying = underlying;
		}

		public void Union(HitRegionContainer container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				Union((IHitRegion)container.Underlying.Clone());
			}
		}

		public void Union(IHitRegion hitRegion)
		{
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				underlying = new HitRegionUnionExpression(underlying, hitRegion);
			}
		}

		public void Intersect(HitRegionContainer container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				Intersect((IHitRegion)container.Underlying.Clone());
			}
		}

		public void Intersect(IHitRegion hitRegion)
		{
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				underlying = new HitRegionIntersectionExpression(underlying, hitRegion);
			}
		}

		public void Exclude(HitRegionContainer container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				Exclude((IHitRegion)container.Underlying.Clone());
			}
		}

		public void Exclude(IHitRegion hitRegion)
		{
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				underlying = new HitRegionExclusionExpression(underlying, hitRegion);
			}
		}

		public void Xor(HitRegionContainer container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				Xor((IHitRegion)container.Underlying.Clone());
			}
		}

		public void Xor(IHitRegion hitRegion)
		{
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				underlying = new HitRegionXorExpression(underlying, hitRegion);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (underlying != null)
			{
				underlying.Dispose();
				underlying = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class HitRegion : IHitRegion, IDisposable, ICloneable
	{
		private DXBitmap bitmap;

		private RectangleF rect;

		private DXGraphicsPath path;

		private InnerPath innerPath;

		private DXRegion pathRegion;

		private bool ContainsRect => !rect.IsEmpty;

		private bool ContainsPath => path != null;

		private bool ContainsInnerPath => innerPath != null;

		public RectangleF Rect => rect;

		public DXGraphicsPath Path => path;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (rect.IsEmpty && path == null)
				{
					return innerPath == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DXBitmap Bitmap => bitmap;

		public HitRegion()
			: this(RectangleF.Empty, null, null)
		{
		}

		public HitRegion(RectangleF rect)
			: this(rect, null, null)
		{
		}

		public HitRegion(DXGraphicsPath path)
			: this(RectangleF.Empty, path)
		{
		}

		public HitRegion(InnerPath innerPath)
			: this(RectangleF.Empty, null, innerPath)
		{
		}

		public HitRegion(VariousPolygon polygon)
			: this(Rectangle.Empty, polygon.GetPath())
		{
		}

		public HitRegion(RectangleF rect, DXGraphicsPath path)
			: this(rect, path, null)
		{
		}

		private HitRegion(RectangleF rect, DXGraphicsPath path, InnerPath innerPath)
		{
			this.innerPath = innerPath;
			this.rect = rect;
			this.path = path;
			pathRegion = null;
			CreateBitmap();
		}

		private void CreateBitmap()
		{
			if (ContainsRect && ContainsPath)
			{
				bitmap = new DXBitmap(MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Abs(rect.X) + rect.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Abs(rect.Y) + rect.Height));
				using ChartGraphicsBase chartGraphicsBase = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(bitmap);
				INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = chartGraphicsBase.CreateNativeRenderer();
				nativeRenderer.SetClip(rect.ToRectangle());
				nativeRenderer.FillRectangle(DXBrushes.White, new Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height));
				nativeRenderer.FillPath(DXBrushes.Black, path);
			}
		}

		public bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			if (ContainsPath && !ContainsRect)
			{
				if (pathRegion == null && path.PointCount < 1000)
				{
					pathRegion = new DXRegion(path);
				}
				if (pathRegion == null)
				{
					return path.IsVisible(hitPoint);
				}
				return pathRegion.IsVisible(hitPoint);
			}
			if (ContainsInnerPath)
			{
				return innerPath.IsVisible(hitPoint);
			}
			if (ContainsRect)
			{
				if (ContainsPath)
				{
					int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(hitPoint.X);
					int num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(hitPoint.Y);
					if (num < 0 || num2 < 0 || num >= bitmap.Width || num2 >= bitmap.Height)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return bitmap.GetPixel(num, num2).ToArgb() != Color.White.ToArgb();
				}
				return rect.Contains(hitPoint);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DXRegion GetRegion()
		{
			if (ContainsRect && !ContainsPath)
			{
				return new DXRegion(rect);
			}
			if (ContainsInnerPath && !ContainsPath)
			{
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPolygon(innerPath.Points);
				return new DXRegion(dXGraphicsPath);
			}
			if (ContainsPath)
			{
				return new DXRegion(path);
			}
			DXRegion dXRegion = new DXRegion();
			dXRegion.MakeEmpty();
			return dXRegion;
		}

		public void Serialize(IHitRegionSerializer serializer)
		{
			if (ContainsPath)
			{
				serializer.SerializePath(path);
			}
			else if (ContainsRect)
			{
				serializer.SerializeRectangle(rect);
			}
			else
			{
				serializer.SerializeEmptyRegion();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			path?.Dispose();
			path = null;
			pathRegion?.Dispose();
			pathRegion = null;
			bitmap?.Dispose();
			bitmap = null;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			if (ContainsInnerPath)
			{
				return new HitRegion(innerPath);
			}
			if (ContainsRect)
			{
				if (ContainsPath)
				{
					return new HitRegion(rect, path.Clone());
				}
				return new HitRegion(rect);
			}
			if (ContainsPath)
			{
				return new HitRegion(path.Clone());
			}
			return new HitRegion();
		}
	}
	public abstract class HitRegionExpressionBase : IHitRegion, IDisposable, ICloneable
	{
		private IHitRegion leftOperand;

		private IHitRegion rightOperand;

		public IHitRegion LeftOperand => leftOperand;

		public IHitRegion RightOperand => rightOperand;

		public HitRegionExpressionBase(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
		{
			this.leftOperand = leftOperand;
			this.rightOperand = rightOperand;
		}

		protected abstract void ApplyOperationToRegion(DXRegion leftRegion, DXRegion rightRegion);

		protected abstract HitRegionExpressionBase Clone(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand);

		public abstract bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint);

		public DXRegion GetRegion()
		{
			DXRegion region = LeftOperand.GetRegion();
			using DXRegion rightRegion = RightOperand.GetRegion();
			ApplyOperationToRegion(region, rightRegion);
			return region;
		}

		public abstract void Serialize(IHitRegionSerializer serializer);

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (leftOperand != null)
			{
				leftOperand.Dispose();
				leftOperand = null;
			}
			if (rightOperand != null)
			{
				rightOperand.Dispose();
				rightOperand = null;
			}
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return Clone((IHitRegion)leftOperand.Clone(), (IHitRegion)rightOperand.Clone());
		}
	}
	public class HitRegionUnionExpression : HitRegionExpressionBase
	{
		public HitRegionUnionExpression(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
			: base(leftOperand, rightOperand)
		{
		}

		protected override HitRegionExpressionBase Clone(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
		{
			return new HitRegionUnionExpression(leftOperand, rightOperand);
		}

		protected override void ApplyOperationToRegion(DXRegion leftRegion, DXRegion rightRegion)
		{
			leftRegion.Union(rightRegion);
		}

		public override bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			if (!base.LeftOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint))
			{
				return base.RightOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Serialize(IHitRegionSerializer serializer)
		{
			serializer.SerializeUnionExpression(base.LeftOperand, base.RightOperand);
		}
	}
	public class HitRegionIntersectionExpression : HitRegionExpressionBase
	{
		public HitRegionIntersectionExpression(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
			: base(leftOperand, rightOperand)
		{
		}

		protected override HitRegionExpressionBase Clone(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
		{
			return new HitRegionIntersectionExpression(leftOperand, rightOperand);
		}

		protected override void ApplyOperationToRegion(DXRegion leftRegion, DXRegion rightRegion)
		{
			leftRegion.Intersect(rightRegion);
		}

		public override bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			if (base.LeftOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint))
			{
				return base.RightOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Serialize(IHitRegionSerializer serializer)
		{
			serializer.SerializeIntersectExpression(base.LeftOperand, base.RightOperand);
		}
	}
	public class HitRegionExclusionExpression : HitRegionExpressionBase
	{
		public HitRegionExclusionExpression(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
			: base(leftOperand, rightOperand)
		{
		}

		protected override HitRegionExpressionBase Clone(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
		{
			return new HitRegionExclusionExpression(leftOperand, rightOperand);
		}

		protected override void ApplyOperationToRegion(DXRegion leftRegion, DXRegion rightRegion)
		{
			leftRegion.Exclude(rightRegion);
		}

		public override bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			if (base.LeftOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint))
			{
				return !base.RightOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Serialize(IHitRegionSerializer serializer)
		{
			serializer.SerializeExcludeExpression(base.LeftOperand, base.RightOperand);
		}
	}
	public class HitRegionXorExpression : HitRegionExpressionBase
	{
		public HitRegionXorExpression(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
			: base(leftOperand, rightOperand)
		{
		}

		protected override HitRegionExpressionBase Clone(IHitRegion leftOperand, IHitRegion rightOperand)
		{
			return new HitRegionXorExpression(leftOperand, rightOperand);
		}

		protected override void ApplyOperationToRegion(DXRegion leftRegion, DXRegion rightRegion)
		{
			leftRegion.Xor(rightRegion);
		}

		public override bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			return base.LeftOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint) ^ base.RightOperand.IsVisible(hitPoint);
		}

		public override void Serialize(IHitRegionSerializer serializer)
		{
			serializer.SerializeXorExpression(base.LeftOperand, base.RightOperand);
		}
	}
	public class PolylinePath : InnerPath
	{
		public PolylinePath(PointF[] sourcePoints, int thickness)
			: base(sourcePoints, thickness)
		{
		}

		protected override PointF[] GetPoints(PointF[] sourcePoints, int strokeThickness)
		{
			PolylineToPolygonConverter polylineToPolygonConverter = new PolylineToPolygonConverter();
			return polylineToPolygonConverter.Convert(sourcePoints, strokeThickness);
		}
	}
	public class PolygonPath : InnerPath
	{
		public PolygonPath(PointF[] sourcePoints)
			: base(sourcePoints, 0)
		{
		}

		protected override PointF[] GetPoints(PointF[] sourcePoints, int strokeThickness)
		{
			return sourcePoints;
		}
	}
	public abstract class InnerPath
	{
		private readonly PointF[] points;

		public PointF[] Points => points;

		protected InnerPath(PointF[] points, int strokeThickness)
		{
			this.points = GetPoints(points, strokeThickness);
		}

		protected abstract PointF[] GetPoints(PointF[] sourcePoints, int strokeThickness);

		public bool IsVisible(PointF point)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 0;
			PointF pointF = points[points.Length - 1];
			float y = point.Y;
			float x = point.X;
			bool flag = pointF.Y < y;
			PointF[] array = points;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF2 = array[i];
				bool flag2 = pointF2.Y < y;
				PointF pointF3 = new PointF(pointF.X - x, pointF.Y - y);
				PointF pointF4 = new PointF(pointF2.X - x, pointF2.Y - y);
				PointF pointF5 = new PointF(pointF4.Y - pointF3.Y, pointF4.X - pointF3.X);
				float num2 = pointF3.X * pointF5.X - pointF3.Y * pointF5.Y;
				bool flag3 = flag2 && !flag && num2 >= 0f;
				bool flag4 = !flag2 && flag && num2 <= 0f;
				if (flag3 || flag4)
				{
					num++;
				}
				pointF = pointF2;
				flag = flag2;
			}
			return (num & 1) != 0;
		}
	}
	public class PolylineToPolygonConverter
	{
		private void InitPointsFromFirstToCurrent(int currentPointIndex, PointF[] values, PointF[] result)
		{
			int num = result.Length - 1;
			for (int i = 0; i <= currentPointIndex; i++)
			{
				result[i] = values[0];
				result[num - i] = values[1];
			}
		}

		private PointF[] CreateSinglePointPath(PointF point, float lineThickness)
		{
			float x = point.X - lineThickness;
			float x2 = point.X + lineThickness;
			float y = point.Y - lineThickness;
			float y2 = point.Y + lineThickness;
			return new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(x, y2),
				new PointF(x, y),
				new PointF(x2, y),
				new PointF(x2, y2)
			};
		}

		private PointF[] GetPreviousPoints(int index, PointF[] points, int pointsCount)
		{
			return new PointF[2]
			{
				points[index - 1],
				points[pointsCount - index]
			};
		}

		private PointF[] CalcCrossPoints(float coefA1, float coefA2, float coefB1, float coefB2, PointF crossPoint, float line1Distance, float line2Distance, float denominator)
		{
			float[] array = CalcParallelCoeffsC(crossPoint, coefA1, coefB1, line1Distance);
			float[] array2 = CalcParallelCoeffsC(crossPoint, coefA2, coefB2, line2Distance);
			float num = array[0];
			float num2 = array2[0];
			float num3 = array[1];
			float num4 = array2[1];
			float num5 = (coefA2 * num - coefA1 * num2) / denominator;
			float num6 = (coefA2 * num3 - coefA1 * num4) / denominator;
			float x;
			float x2;
			if (coefA1 != 0f)
			{
				x = ((0f - coefB1) * num5 - num) / coefA1;
				x2 = ((0f - coefB1) * num6 - num3) / coefA1;
			}
			else if (coefA2 != 0f)
			{
				x = ((0f - coefB2) * num5 - num2) / coefA2;
				x2 = ((0f - coefB2) * num6 - num4) / coefA2;
			}
			else
			{
				x = crossPoint.X;
				x2 = crossPoint.X;
			}
			return new PointF[2]
			{
				new PointF(x, num5),
				new PointF(x2, num6)
			};
		}

		private float GetDenominator(float coefA1, float coefA2, float coefB1, float coefB2)
		{
			return coefA1 * coefB2 - coefA2 * coefB1;
		}

		private PointF[] CalcParallelLinesCross(PointF startPoint, PointF crossPoint, PointF endPoint, float distance)
		{
			float coefA = crossPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			float coefB = startPoint.X - crossPoint.X;
			float coefA2 = endPoint.Y - crossPoint.Y;
			float coefB2 = crossPoint.X - endPoint.X;
			float denominator = GetDenominator(coefA, coefA2, coefB, coefB2);
			if (denominator == 0f)
			{
				return CalcCrossAtExtremePoints(startPoint, crossPoint, crossPoint, distance);
			}
			return CalcCrossPoints(coefA, coefA2, coefB, coefB2, crossPoint, distance, distance, denominator);
		}

		private PointF[] CalcCrossAtExtremePoints(PointF startPoint, PointF crossPoint, PointF endPoint, float distance)
		{
			float num = endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			float num2 = startPoint.X - endPoint.X;
			float coefA = num2;
			float coefB = 0f - num;
			float denominator = GetDenominator(num, coefA, num2, coefB);
			return CalcCrossPoints(num, coefA, num2, coefB, crossPoint, distance, 0f, denominator);
		}

		private float[] CalcParallelCoeffsC(PointF point, float coefA, float coefB, float thickness)
		{
			float num = (float)Math.Sqrt(coefA * coefA + coefB * coefB) * thickness;
			float num2 = coefA * point.X + coefB * point.Y;
			return new float[2]
			{
				num - num2,
				0f - num2 - num
			};
		}

		public PointF[] Convert(PointF[] points, float lineThickness)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Length == 0)
			{
				return points;
			}
			int num = points.Length - 1;
			int num2 = points.Length * 2;
			int num3 = num2 - 1;
			float num4 = lineThickness / 2f;
			bool flag = points[0] == points[num];
			PointF[] array = new PointF[num2];
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = points[i];
				if (i == 0 || flag2)
				{
					if (i == num)
					{
						array = CreateSinglePointPath(pointF, num4);
						break;
					}
					PointF pointF2 = points[i + 1];
					flag2 = pointF == pointF2;
					if (!flag2)
					{
						PointF[] values = ((!flag) ? CalcCrossAtExtremePoints(pointF, pointF, pointF2, num4) : CalcParallelLinesCross(points[num - 1], pointF, pointF2, num4));
						InitPointsFromFirstToCurrent(i, values, array);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					PointF pointF3 = points[i - 1];
					PointF[] array2 = ((pointF == pointF3) ? GetPreviousPoints(i, array, num2) : ((i != num) ? CalcParallelLinesCross(pointF3, pointF, points[i + 1], num4) : ((!flag) ? CalcCrossAtExtremePoints(pointF3, pointF, pointF, num4) : CalcParallelLinesCross(pointF3, pointF, points[1], num4))));
					array[i] = array2[0];
					array[num3 - i] = array2[1];
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class HitTestParams : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IHitTest obj;

		private readonly object additionalObj;

		private readonly bool useSpecificCursor;

		private IHitRegion hitRegion;

		private IHitRegion specificCursorHitRegion;

		public IHitTest Object => obj;

		public object AdditionalObj => additionalObj;

		public IHitRegion HitRegion => hitRegion;

		public IHitRegion SpecificCursorHitRegion => specificCursorHitRegion;

		public bool UseSpecificCursor => useSpecificCursor;

		public HitTestParams(IHitTest obj, object additionalObj, bool useSpecificCursor, IHitRegion hitRegion, IHitRegion specificCursorHitRegion = null)
		{
			this.obj = obj;
			this.additionalObj = additionalObj;
			this.hitRegion = hitRegion;
			this.useSpecificCursor = useSpecificCursor;
			if (specificCursorHitRegion == null)
			{
				this.specificCursorHitRegion = hitRegion;
			}
			else
			{
				this.specificCursorHitRegion = specificCursorHitRegion;
			}
		}

		public HitTestParams(IHitTest obj, object additionalObj, IHitRegion hitRegion)
			: this(obj, additionalObj, useSpecificCursor: false, hitRegion)
		{
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				hitRegion.Dispose();
				hitRegion = null;
			}
		}

		public bool HitTest(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			return hitRegion.IsVisible(hitPoint);
		}

		public bool SpecificCursorAreaHitTest(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			return specificCursorHitRegion.IsVisible(hitPoint);
		}

		public bool HitTest(Rectangle rect)
		{
			return hitRegion.GetRegion()?.IsVisible(rect) ?? false;
		}
	}
	public class HitTestController
	{
		private ISupportHitTesting rootControl;

		private List<HitTestParams> objects;

		private List<HitTestParams> specificCursorObjects;

		internal List<HitTestParams> Objects => objects;

		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (rootControl != null)
				{
					return rootControl.HitTestEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IHitTest Selected
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (HitTestParams @object in objects)
				{
					if (@object.Object.State.Select)
					{
						return @object.Object;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public IHitTest Hot
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (HitTestParams @object in objects)
				{
					if (@object.Object.State.Hot)
					{
						return @object.Object;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public IList<HitTestParams> Items => GetItems(filterInternalHitTestObjects: false);

		public static void ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController hitTestController, IHitTest hitTestObject, object additionalObject, IHitRegion region)
		{
			ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, hitTestObject, additionalObject, region, force: false);
		}

		public static void ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController hitTestController, IHitTest hitTestObject, object additionalObject, IHitRegion region, bool force)
		{
			ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, hitTestObject, additionalObject, useSpecificCursor: false, region, null, force);
		}

		public static void ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController hitTestController, IHitTest hitTestObject, object additionalObject, bool useSpecificCursor, IHitRegion region, IHitRegion specificCursorRegion, bool force)
		{
			if (hitTestController != null && hitTestObject != null && region != null && (hitTestController.Enabled || force))
			{
				HitTestParams parameters = new HitTestParams(hitTestObject, additionalObject, useSpecificCursor, region, specificCursorRegion);
				hitTestController.Register(parameters);
			}
		}

		public HitTestController(ISupportHitTesting rootControl)
		{
			this.rootControl = rootControl;
			objects = new List<HitTestParams>();
			specificCursorObjects = new List<HitTestParams>();
		}

		private static object FindInternalHitTestObject(List<HitTestParams> hitTestObjects, Point point, Type type)
		{
			for (int num = hitTestObjects.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				HitTestParams hitTestParams = hitTestObjects[num];
				if (hitTestParams.SpecificCursorAreaHitTest(point) && hitTestParams.AdditionalObj != null && hitTestParams.AdditionalObj.GetType().Equals(type))
				{
					return hitTestParams.AdditionalObj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<HitTestParams> FilterInternalHitTestObjects(IList<HitTestParams> list, Type type)
		{
			List<HitTestParams> list2 = new List<HitTestParams>();
			int num = 0;
			while (num < list.Count)
			{
				if (list[num].AdditionalObj != null && list[num].AdditionalObj.GetType().Equals(type))
				{
					list2.Add(list[num]);
					list.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private List<HitTestParams> FilterInternalHitTestObjects(IList<HitTestParams> list)
		{
			FilterInternalHitTestObjects(list, typeof(XYDiagram2DScrollParameters));
			return FilterInternalHitTestObjects(list, typeof(ChartFocusedArea));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (HitTestParams @object in objects)
			{
				@object.Dispose();
			}
			objects.Clear();
			specificCursorObjects.Clear();
		}

		public void Register(HitTestParams parameters)
		{
			objects.Add(parameters);
			if (parameters.UseSpecificCursor)
			{
				specificCursorObjects.Add(parameters);
			}
		}

		public void Unregister(HitTestParams parameters)
		{
			objects.Remove(parameters);
			if (parameters.UseSpecificCursor)
			{
				specificCursorObjects.Remove(parameters);
			}
		}

		public XYDiagram2DScrollParameters FindScrollCommand(Point point)
		{
			return (XYDiagram2DScrollParameters)FindInternalHitTestObject(objects, point, typeof(XYDiagram2DScrollParameters));
		}

		public ChartFocusedArea FindFocusedArea(Point point)
		{
			return (ChartFocusedArea)FindInternalHitTestObject(objects, point, typeof(ChartFocusedArea));
		}

		public ChartFocusedArea FindSpecificCursorArea(Point point)
		{
			return (ChartFocusedArea)FindInternalHitTestObject(specificCursorObjects, point, typeof(ChartFocusedArea));
		}

		public IList<HitTestParams> Find(Point point)
		{
			List<HitTestParams> list = new List<HitTestParams>();
			for (int num = objects.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				HitTestParams hitTestParams = objects[num];
				if (hitTestParams.HitTest(point))
				{
					list.Add(hitTestParams);
				}
			}
			FilterInternalHitTestObjects(list);
			return list;
		}

		public IList<HitTestParams> Find(Rectangle rect)
		{
			List<HitTestParams> list = new List<HitTestParams>();
			for (int num = objects.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				HitTestParams hitTestParams = objects[num];
				if (hitTestParams.HitTest(rect))
				{
					list.Add(hitTestParams);
				}
			}
			FilterInternalHitTestObjects(list);
			return list;
		}

		public IList<HitTestParams> GetItems(bool filterInternalHitTestObjects)
		{
			List<HitTestParams> list = new List<HitTestParams>(objects);
			if (filterInternalHitTestObjects)
			{
				FilterInternalHitTestObjects(list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IList<HitTestParams> GetItems(bool filterInternalHitTestObjects, out List<HitTestParams> filteredItems)
		{
			List<HitTestParams> list = new List<HitTestParams>(objects);
			if (filterInternalHitTestObjects)
			{
				filteredItems = FilterInternalHitTestObjects(list);
			}
			else
			{
				filteredItems = null;
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class HitTestState
	{
		private readonly HashSet<object> selectObjects = new HashSet<object>();

		private readonly List<object> drillDownHotObjects = new List<object>();

		private bool hot;

		private bool select;

		private bool masterSelect;

		private bool drillDownHot;

		private object hotObject;

		private bool objectMasterSelect;

		protected bool IsHot => hot;

		protected object HotObject => hotObject;

		protected bool ObjectMasterSelect => objectMasterSelect;

		protected bool MasterSelect => masterSelect;

		protected List<object> DrillDownHotObjects => drillDownHotObjects;

		internal HashSet<object> SelectedObjects => selectObjects;

		public HatchStyle HatchStyle => HatchStyle.WideUpwardDiagonal;

		public bool Hot
		{
			get
			{
				if (hot)
				{
					return !masterSelect;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Select
		{
			get
			{
				if ((hot || select || !masterSelect) && (hot || !select))
				{
					if (hot)
					{
						return masterSelect;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool Normal
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Hot && !Select)
				{
					return !DrillDownHot;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool DrillDownHot => drillDownHot;

		public Color ActualColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (Hot)
				{
					return HitTestColors.Hot;
				}
				if (Select)
				{
					return HitTestColors.Selected;
				}
				return Color.Empty;
			}
		}

		public Color HatchColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (Hot)
				{
					return HitTestColors.HotHatch;
				}
				if (Select)
				{
					return HitTestColors.SelectHatch;
				}
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
		}

		public Color HatchColorLight
		{
			get
			{
				if (Hot)
				{
					return HitTestColors.HotHatchLight;
				}
				if (Select)
				{
					return HitTestColors.SelectHatchLight;
				}
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDrillDownHot(object innerObject)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < drillDownHotObjects.Count; i++)
			{
				if (innerObject == drillDownHotObjects[i])
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsSelected(object innerObject)
		{
			return SelectedObjects.Contains(innerObject);
		}

		public void DoEnter(object innerObject)
		{
			hot = true;
			if (innerObject != null)
			{
				if (innerObject != hotObject)
				{
					objectMasterSelect = false;
				}
				hotObject = innerObject;
			}
		}

		public void DoSelect(object innerObject)
		{
			DoSelect(innerObject, setMasterSelection: true);
		}

		public void DoSelect(object innerObject, bool setMasterSelection)
		{
			masterSelect = setMasterSelection;
			select = true;
			if (innerObject != null)
			{
				if (!IsSelected(innerObject))
				{
					selectObjects.Add(innerObject);
				}
				objectMasterSelect = setMasterSelection;
			}
		}

		public void DoDrillDownEnter(object innerObject)
		{
			drillDownHot = true;
			if (innerObject != null && !IsDrillDownHot(innerObject))
			{
				drillDownHotObjects.Add(innerObject);
			}
		}

		public void DoLeave()
		{
			hot = false;
			hotObject = null;
			masterSelect = false;
			objectMasterSelect = false;
			drillDownHot = false;
			drillDownHotObjects.Clear();
		}

		public void UndoSelect(bool clearHot)
		{
			if (clearHot)
			{
				hot = false;
				hotObject = null;
			}
			select = false;
			masterSelect = false;
			objectMasterSelect = false;
			selectObjects.Clear();
		}

		public void UndoSelect(object innerObject, bool clearHot)
		{
			if (innerObject != null)
			{
				if (clearHot && innerObject == hotObject)
				{
					hot = false;
					hotObject = null;
				}
				if (IsSelected(innerObject))
				{
					select = false;
					masterSelect = false;
					objectMasterSelect = false;
					selectObjects.Remove(innerObject);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SeriesHitTestState : HitTestState
	{
		private SelectionState legendSelectionState;

		public ISeriesBase Series { get; set; }

		public override bool Select
		{
			get
			{
				if ((base.Hot || IsSelected(Series) || !base.MasterSelect) && (base.Hot || !IsSelected(Series)))
				{
					if (base.Hot)
					{
						return base.MasterSelect;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public SelectionState LegendSelectionState
		{
			get
			{
				if (legendSelectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
				{
					return legendSelectionState;
				}
				if (base.Hot)
				{
					return SelectionState.HotTracked;
				}
				if (base.SelectedObjects.Count > 0)
				{
					return SelectionState.Selected;
				}
				if (base.DrillDownHot || base.DrillDownHotObjects.Count > 0)
				{
					return SelectionState.DrillDownHotTracked;
				}
				return SelectionState.Normal;
			}
			set
			{
				legendSelectionState = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSeriesHot(SeriesSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			if (selectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series && base.IsHot)
			{
				return !base.MasterSelect;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsSeriesSelect(SeriesSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			bool flag = IsSeriesHot(selectionMode);
			bool flag2 = IsSelected(Series);
			if (!(!flag && flag2))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return base.MasterSelect;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsSeriesDrillDownHot()
		{
			if (base.DrillDownHot)
			{
				return base.DrillDownHotObjects.Count == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool IsPointHot(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, SeriesSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			if (selectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series)
			{
				return base.Hot;
			}
			if (seriesPoint != null && seriesPoint == base.HotObject)
			{
				return !base.ObjectMasterSelect;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool IsPointSelect(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, SeriesSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return Select;
			}
			if (!IsSelected(seriesPoint) || IsPointHot(seriesPoint, selectionMode))
			{
				if (selectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series && IsSeriesSelect(selectionMode))
				{
					return !IsSeriesHot(selectionMode);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsPointDrillDownHot(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (!base.DrillDownHot || base.DrillDownHotObjects.Count != 0)
			{
				if (seriesPoint != null)
				{
					return base.DrillDownHotObjects.Contains(seriesPoint);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public Color GetPointHatchColor(SeriesSelectionMode mode, SelectionState state)
		{
			if (IsSeriesSelect(mode))
			{
				return base.HatchColor;
			}
			switch (state)
			{
			case SelectionState.HotTracked:
			case SelectionState.DrillDownHotTracked:
				return HitTestColors.HotHatch;
			case SelectionState.Selected:
				return HitTestColors.SelectHatch;
			default:
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
		}

		public Color GetPointHatchColor(SelectionState state)
		{
			if (Select)
			{
				return base.HatchColor;
			}
			switch (state)
			{
			case SelectionState.HotTracked:
			case SelectionState.DrillDownHotTracked:
				return HitTestColors.HotHatch;
			case SelectionState.Selected:
				return HitTestColors.SelectHatch;
			default:
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
		}

		public Color GetHatchColorLight(SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			return selectionState switch
			{
				SelectionState.HotTracked => HitTestColors.HotHatchLight, 
				SelectionState.Selected => HitTestColors.SelectHatchLight, 
				_ => Color.Transparent, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class PointHitTestState : SeriesHitTestState
	{
		public override bool IsPointSelect(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, SeriesSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			bool flag = Select && (base.SelectedObjects.Count == 0 || IsSelected(base.Series));
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return Select;
			}
			if (flag || IsSelected(seriesPoint))
			{
				return !IsPointHot(seriesPoint, selectionMode);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsPointHot(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, SeriesSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			if (selectionMode == SeriesSelectionMode.Series)
			{
				return base.Hot;
			}
			if (seriesPoint != null && seriesPoint == base.HotObject)
			{
				return !base.ObjectMasterSelect;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ChartHitTestEnumerator : IEnumerator, IEnumerable
	{
		private abstract class HitTestEnumeratorItem
		{
			private IHitTest rootElement;

			private ArrayList childrenList = new ArrayList();

			private HitTestEnumeratorItem childEnumeratorItem;

			private int index = -1;

			protected IHitTest RootElement => rootElement;

			protected ArrayList ChildrenList => childrenList;

			private static HitTestEnumeratorItem CreateEnumeratorItem(IHitTest hitElement)
			{
				if (hitElement is Chart)
				{
					return new ChartHitTestEnumeratorItem((Chart)hitElement);
				}
				if (hitElement is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					return new XYDiagram2DHitTestEnumeratorItem((XYDiagram2D)hitElement);
				}
				if (hitElement is RadarDiagram)
				{
					return new RadarDiagramHitTestEnumeratorItem((RadarDiagram)hitElement);
				}
				if (hitElement is Axis2D)
				{
					return new Axis2DHitTestEnumeratorItem((Axis2D)hitElement);
				}
				if (hitElement is Series)
				{
					return new SeriesHitTestEnumeratorItem((Series)hitElement);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public HitTestEnumeratorItem(IHitTest rootElement)
			{
				this.rootElement = rootElement;
				FillChildrenList();
			}

			protected abstract void FillChildrenList();

			public IHitTest NextElement()
			{
				if (index == -1)
				{
					index++;
					return rootElement;
				}
				if (childEnumeratorItem != null)
				{
					IHitTest hitTest = childEnumeratorItem.NextElement();
					if (hitTest != null)
					{
						return hitTest;
					}
				}
				if (index < childrenList.Count)
				{
					IHitTest hitTest2 = (IHitTest)childrenList[index++];
					childEnumeratorItem = CreateEnumeratorItem(hitTest2);
					if (childEnumeratorItem != null)
					{
						return childEnumeratorItem.NextElement();
					}
					return hitTest2;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class ChartHitTestEnumeratorItem : HitTestEnumeratorItem
		{
			protected Chart Chart => (Chart)base.RootElement;

			protected DataContainer DataContainer => Chart.DataContainer;

			public ChartHitTestEnumeratorItem(Chart chart)
				: base(chart)
			{
			}

			protected override void FillChildrenList()
			{
				if (Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D value)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(value);
				}
				if (Chart.Diagram is RadarDiagram value2)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(value2);
				}
				base.ChildrenList.Add(DataContainer.SeriesTemplate);
				foreach (Series item in Chart.Series)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(item);
				}
				foreach (ChartTitle title in Chart.Titles)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(title);
				}
				foreach (Annotation item2 in Chart.AnnotationRepository)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(item2);
				}
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Chart.ActualLegend);
				foreach (Legend legend in Chart.Legends)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(legend);
				}
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Chart.Breadcrumbs);
				foreach (BreadcrumbItem item3 in Chart.Breadcrumbs.Items)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(item3);
				}
			}
		}

		private class XYDiagram2DHitTestEnumeratorItem : HitTestEnumeratorItem
		{
			protected XYDiagram2D Diagram => (XYDiagram2D)base.RootElement;

			public XYDiagram2DHitTestEnumeratorItem(XYDiagram2D diagram)
				: base(diagram)
			{
			}

			protected override void FillChildrenList()
			{
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Diagram.ActualAxisX);
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Diagram.ActualAxisY);
				foreach (Axis2D item in Diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesX)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(item);
				}
				foreach (Axis2D item2 in Diagram.ActualSecondaryAxesY)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(item2);
				}
				foreach (XYDiagramPane pane in Diagram.Panes)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(pane);
					base.ChildrenList.Add(pane.StackedBarTotalLabel);
					base.ChildrenList.Add(pane.Title);
				}
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Diagram.DefaultPane.StackedBarTotalLabel);
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Diagram.DefaultPane.Title);
			}
		}

		private class RadarDiagramHitTestEnumeratorItem : HitTestEnumeratorItem
		{
			protected RadarDiagram Diagram => (RadarDiagram)base.RootElement;

			public RadarDiagramHitTestEnumeratorItem(RadarDiagram diagram)
				: base(diagram)
			{
			}

			protected override void FillChildrenList()
			{
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Diagram.AxisX);
				base.ChildrenList.Add(Diagram.AxisY);
			}
		}

		private class Axis2DHitTestEnumeratorItem : HitTestEnumeratorItem
		{
			protected Axis2D Axis => (Axis2D)base.RootElement;

			public Axis2DHitTestEnumeratorItem(Axis2D axis)
				: base(axis)
			{
			}

			protected override void FillChildrenList()
			{
				foreach (ConstantLine constantLine in Axis.ConstantLines)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(constantLine);
				}
			}
		}

		private class SeriesHitTestEnumeratorItem : HitTestEnumeratorItem
		{
			protected Series Series => (Series)base.RootElement;

			public SeriesHitTestEnumeratorItem(Series series)
				: base(series)
			{
			}

			private void FillChildrenListForSimpleDiagram(SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase view)
			{
				foreach (SeriesTitle title in view.Titles)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(title);
				}
				if (view is PieSeriesView pieSeriesView)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(pieSeriesView.TotalLabel);
				}
			}

			private void FillChildrenListForXYDiagram(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
			{
				foreach (Indicator indicator in view.Indicators)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(indicator);
				}
				if (view.FirstPointInternal != null)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(view.FirstPointInternal.Label);
				}
				if (view.LastPointInternal != null)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(view.LastPointInternal.Label);
				}
			}

			protected override void FillChildrenList()
			{
				if (Series.Label != null)
				{
					base.ChildrenList.Add(Series.Label);
				}
				if (Series.View is SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)
				{
					FillChildrenListForSimpleDiagram((SimpleDiagramSeriesViewBase)Series.View);
				}
				else if (Series.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)
				{
					FillChildrenListForXYDiagram((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)Series.View);
				}
			}
		}

		private Chart chart;

		private ChartHitTestEnumeratorItem chartEnumeratorItem;

		private IHitTest currentElement;

		object IEnumerator.Current => currentElement;

		public ChartHitTestEnumerator(Chart chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			((IEnumerator)this).Reset();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			((IEnumerator)this).Reset();
			return this;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			currentElement = null;
			chartEnumeratorItem = new ChartHitTestEnumeratorItem(chart);
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			currentElement = chartEnumeratorItem.NextElement();
			return currentElement != null;
		}

		public void DoLeave(IHitTest exceptElement)
		{
			foreach (IHitTest item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (exceptElement == null || item.Object != exceptElement.Object)
				{
					item.State.DoLeave();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UndoSelect(IHitTest exceptElement, bool clearHot)
		{
			foreach (IHitTest item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (exceptElement == null || item.Object != exceptElement.Object)
				{
					item.State.UndoSelect(clearHot);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class HitTestColors
	{
		public static Color Selected => Color.FromArgb(227, 66, 30);

		public static Color Hot => Color.FromArgb(23, 135, 238);

		public static Color SelectHatch => Color.FromArgb(110, 255, 255, 255);

		public static Color HotHatch => Color.FromArgb(50, 255, 255, 255);

		public static Color SelectHatchLight => Color.FromArgb(120, 255, 255, 255);

		public static Color HotHatchLight => Color.FromArgb(90, 255, 255, 255);

		public static Color MixColors(Color c1, Color c2)
		{
			double num = (double)(int)c1.A / 255.0;
			int red = (int)(num * (double)(int)c1.R + (1.0 - num) * (double)(int)c2.R);
			int green = (int)(num * (double)(int)c1.G + (1.0 - num) * (double)(int)c2.G);
			int blue = (int)(num * (double)(int)c1.B + (1.0 - num) * (double)(int)c2.B);
			return Color.FromArgb(red, green, blue);
		}

		public static Color MixAlphaChanel(Color color, byte alpha)
		{
			double num = (double)(int)color.A / 255.0;
			double num2 = (double)(int)alpha / 255.0;
			byte alpha2 = (byte)(num * num2 * 255.0);
			return Color.FromArgb(alpha2, color);
		}
	}
