	public class PrimitivesContainer
	{
		private readonly List<Line> lines = new List<Line>();

		private readonly List<PlanePolygon> polygons = new List<PlanePolygon>();

		public List<Line> Lines => lines;

		public List<PlanePolygon> Polygons => polygons;

		public PrimitivesContainer()
		{
		}

		public PrimitivesContainer(IList<Line> lines, IList<PlanePolygon> polygons)
		{
			Add(lines, polygons);
		}

		public void Add(IList<Line> lines, IList<PlanePolygon> polygons)
		{
			if (lines != null)
			{
				this.lines.AddRange(lines);
			}
			if (polygons != null)
			{
				this.polygons.AddRange(polygons);
			}
		}

		public void Add(PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				Add(container.lines, container.polygons);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class PlaneGroup
	{
		protected class PlaneTriangleComparer : IComparer<PlaneTriangle>
		{
			int IComparer<PlaneTriangle>.Compare(PlaneTriangle triangle1, PlaneTriangle triangle2)
			{
				return triangle1.Weight.CompareTo(triangle2.Weight);
			}
		}

		protected class LineComparer : IComparer<Line>
		{
			int IComparer<Line>.Compare(Line line1, Line line2)
			{
				return line1.Weight.CompareTo(line2.Weight);
			}
		}

		protected static readonly LineComparer lineComparerByWeight = new LineComparer();

		protected static readonly PlaneTriangleComparer triangleComparerByWeight = new PlaneTriangleComparer();

		private PlaneEquation plane;

		private List<Line> lines = new List<Line>();

		private List<PlaneTriangle> triangles = new List<PlaneTriangle>();

		private int groupId;

		public List<Line> Lines => lines;

		public List<PlaneTriangle> Triangles => triangles;

		public PlaneGroup(PlaneTriangle triangle, int groupId)
		{
			this.groupId = groupId;
			plane = MathUtils.CalcPlaneEquation(triangle);
			triangles.Add(triangle);
		}

		public PlaneGroup(PlaneTriangle triangle)
			: this(triangle, 0)
		{
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateLinesGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			foreach (Line line in lines)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(line.CreateGraphicsCommandWithPainter());
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateTrianglesGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			foreach (PlaneTriangle triangle in triangles)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(triangle.CreateGraphicsCommandWithPainter());
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommandInternal(bool stencilBuffer)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = (stencilBuffer ? ((GraphicsCommand)new StencilFuncGraphicsCommand(groupId)) : ((GraphicsCommand)new ContainerGraphicsCommand()));
			if (stencilBuffer)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateLinesGraphicsCommand());
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateTrianglesGraphicsCommand());
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateTrianglesGraphicsCommand());
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateLinesGraphicsCommand());
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public bool Add(PlaneTriangle triangle)
		{
			if (MathUtils.IsTriangleOnPlane(plane, triangle, 0.01))
			{
				triangles.Add(triangle);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Add(Line line)
		{
			if (MathUtils.IsLineOnPlane(plane, line, 0.01))
			{
				Lines.Add(line);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Sort()
		{
			lines.Sort(lineComparerByWeight);
			triangles.Sort(triangleComparerByWeight);
		}
	}
	public class Group : PlaneGroup
	{
		public Group(PlaneTriangle triangle, int groupId)
			: base(triangle, groupId)
		{
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			return CreateGraphicsCommandInternal(stencilBuffer: true);
		}
	}
	public class Node : PlaneGroup
	{
		private PlaneEquation plane;

		private Node front;

		private Node back;

		private List<Line> backLines = new List<Line>();

		private List<Line> frontLines = new List<Line>();

		public PlaneEquation Plane => plane;

		public Node Back
		{
			get
			{
				return back;
			}
			set
			{
				back = value;
			}
		}

		public Node Front
		{
			get
			{
				return front;
			}
			set
			{
				front = value;
			}
		}

		public Node(PlaneTriangle triangle)
			: base(triangle)
		{
			plane = MathUtils.CalcPlaneEquation(triangle);
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateBackGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint eye)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			foreach (Line backLine in backLines)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(backLine.CreateGraphicsCommandWithPainter());
			}
			if (back != null)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(back.CreateGraphicsCommand(eye));
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateFrontGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint eye)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			foreach (Line frontLine in frontLines)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(frontLine.CreateGraphicsCommandWithPainter());
			}
			if (front != null)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(front.CreateGraphicsCommand(eye));
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateRootGraphicsCommand()
		{
			return CreateGraphicsCommandInternal(stencilBuffer: false);
		}

		public void AddRootLines(List<Line> lines)
		{
			if (lines == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Line line in lines)
			{
				Add(line);
			}
		}

		public void AddBackLines(List<Line> lines)
		{
			if (lines != null)
			{
				backLines.AddRange(lines);
			}
		}

		public void AddFrontLines(List<Line> lines)
		{
			if (lines != null)
			{
				frontLines.AddRange(lines);
			}
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint eye)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			int num = MathUtils.IsPointOnPlane(plane, eye, 0.01);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateBackGraphicsCommand(eye));
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateFrontGraphicsCommand(eye));
			}
			else if (num > 0)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateBackGraphicsCommand(eye));
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateRootGraphicsCommand());
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateFrontGraphicsCommand(eye));
			}
			else if (num < 0)
			{
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateFrontGraphicsCommand(eye));
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateRootGraphicsCommand());
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateBackGraphicsCommand(eye));
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public override void Sort()
		{
			base.Sort();
			backLines.Sort(PlaneGroup.lineComparerByWeight);
			frontLines.Sort(PlaneGroup.lineComparerByWeight);
			if (back != null)
			{
				back.Sort();
			}
			if (front != null)
			{
				front.Sort();
			}
		}
	}
	public class PolygonGroups
	{
		private List<Group> groups;

		private List<Line> notGroupedLines;

		public PolygonGroups(List<Group> groups, List<Line> notGroupedLines)
		{
			this.groups = groups;
			this.notGroupedLines = notGroupedLines;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			if (groups != null)
			{
				StencilBufferGraphicsCommand stencilBufferGraphicsCommand = new StencilBufferGraphicsCommand();
				graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(stencilBufferGraphicsCommand);
				foreach (Group group in groups)
				{
					stencilBufferGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(group.CreateGraphicsCommand());
				}
			}
			if (notGroupedLines != null)
			{
				foreach (Line notGroupedLine in notGroupedLines)
				{
					graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(notGroupedLine.CreateGraphicsCommandWithPainter());
				}
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			if (groups == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Group group in groups)
			{
				group.Sort();
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class GraphicsHelper
	{
		private static int currentGroupId = 1;

		private static List<PlaneTriangle> Triangulate(PlanePolygon polygon)
		{
			List<PlaneTriangle> list = new List<PlaneTriangle>();
			if (polygon == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (polygon is PlaneTriangle)
			{
				list.Add((PlaneTriangle)polygon);
				return list;
			}
			Vertex v = polygon.Vertices[0];
			int num = 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num < polygon.Vertices.Length - 1)
			{
				Vertex v2 = polygon.Vertices[num];
				Vertex v3 = polygon.Vertices[num + 1];
				PlaneTriangle planeTriangle = polygon.CreateTriangle(v, v2, v3);
				if (IsTriangleValid(planeTriangle))
				{
					list.Add(planeTriangle);
				}
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PlaneTriangle> Triangulate(List<PlanePolygon> polygons)
		{
			if (polygons == null || polygons.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PlaneTriangle> list = new List<PlaneTriangle>();
			foreach (PlanePolygon polygon in polygons)
			{
				list.AddRange(Triangulate(polygon));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static bool IsTriangleValid(PlaneTriangle triangle)
		{
			return !MathUtils.CalcNormal(triangle).IsZero;
		}

		private static bool IsLineValid(Line line)
		{
			return !MathUtils.ArePointsEquals(line.V1, line.V2, 0.01);
		}

		private static List<Group> CreateGroups(List<PlaneTriangle> triangles)
		{
			if (triangles == null || triangles.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<Group> list = new List<Group>();
			foreach (PlaneTriangle triangle in triangles)
			{
				if (!IsTriangleValid(triangle))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (Group item2 in list)
				{
					if (item2.Add(triangle))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					Group item = new Group(triangle, currentGroupId);
					list.Add(item);
					currentGroupId++;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void CalcBackAndFrontTriangles(Node root, List<PlaneTriangle> triangles, out List<PlaneTriangle> backTriangles, out List<PlaneTriangle> frontTriangles)
		{
			backTriangles = new List<PlaneTriangle>();
			frontTriangles = new List<PlaneTriangle>();
			if (triangles == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < triangles.Count; i++)
			{
				if (root.Add(triangles[i]))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Vertex[] intersectionVertices;
				PlanePolygon frontPolygon;
				PlanePolygon backPolygon;
				switch (IntersectionUtils.CalcPolygonIntersection3D(root.Plane, triangles[i], 0.01, out intersectionVertices, out frontPolygon, out backPolygon))
				{
				case Intersection.Yes:
				case Intersection.No:
				{
					List<PlaneTriangle> list = Triangulate(frontPolygon);
					if (list != null)
					{
						frontTriangles.AddRange(list);
					}
					list = Triangulate(backPolygon);
					if (list != null)
					{
						backTriangles.AddRange(list);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Intersection.Match:
					root.Add(triangles[i]);
					break;
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CalcBackAndFrontLines(Node root, List<Line> lines, out List<Line> backLines, out List<Line> frontLines)
		{
			backLines = new List<Line>();
			frontLines = new List<Line>();
			if (lines == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
			{
				if (root.Add(lines[i]))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Vertex intersectionVertex;
				Line frontLine;
				Line backLine;
				switch (IntersectionUtils.CalcLineIntersection3D(root.Plane, lines[i], 0.01, out intersectionVertex, out frontLine, out backLine))
				{
				case Intersection.Yes:
				case Intersection.No:
					if (frontLine != null)
					{
						frontLines.Add(frontLine);
					}
					if (backLine != null)
					{
						backLines.Add(backLine);
					}
					break;
				case Intersection.Match:
					root.Add(lines[i]);
					break;
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException();
				}
			}
		}

		private static Node BuildTree(List<PlaneTriangle> triangles, List<Line> lines)
		{
			if (triangles == null || triangles.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Node node = new Node(triangles[0]);
			CalcBackAndFrontTriangles(node, triangles, out var backTriangles, out var frontTriangles);
			CalcBackAndFrontLines(node, lines, out var backLines, out var frontLines);
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			list.AddRange(node.Lines);
			list.AddRange(backLines);
			node.Back = BuildTree(backTriangles, list);
			if (node.Back == null)
			{
				node.AddBackLines(backLines);
			}
			list = new List<Line>();
			list.AddRange(node.Lines);
			list.AddRange(frontLines);
			node.Front = BuildTree(frontTriangles, list);
			if (node.Front == null)
			{
				node.AddFrontLines(frontLines);
			}
			return node;
		}

		private static List<PlaneTriangle> GetValidTriangles(List<PlaneTriangle> triangles)
		{
			if (triangles == null || triangles.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PlaneTriangle> list = new List<PlaneTriangle>();
			foreach (PlaneTriangle triangle in triangles)
			{
				if (IsTriangleValid(triangle))
				{
					list.Add(triangle);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<Line> GetValidLines(List<Line> lines)
		{
			if (lines == null || lines.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			foreach (Line line in lines)
			{
				if (IsLineValid(line))
				{
					list.Add(line);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<Line> AddLines(List<Group> groups, List<Line> lines)
		{
			if (groups == null)
			{
				if (lines != null)
				{
					return new List<Line>(lines);
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (lines == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			foreach (Line line in lines)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (Group group in groups)
				{
					if (group.Add(line))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					list.Add(line);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static Node BuildGraphicsTree(PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			try
			{
				if (container == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				List<Line> validLines = GetValidLines(container.Lines);
				List<PlaneTriangle> validTriangles = GetValidTriangles(Triangulate(container.Polygons));
				Node node = BuildTree(validTriangles, validLines);
				node?.Sort();
				return node;
			}
			catch (ArithmeticException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static PolygonGroups BuildGroups(PrimitivesContainer container)
		{
			try
			{
				List<Group> groups = CreateGroups(Triangulate(container.Polygons));
				return new PolygonGroups(groups, AddLines(groups, container.Lines));
			}
			catch (ArithmeticException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class PlanePrimitive
	{
		public delegate GraphicsCommand PaintingMethod(PlanePrimitive primitive);

		private Vertex[] vertices;

		private DiagramVector normal;

		private Color color;

		private bool sameNormals;

		private bool sameColors;

		private int weight;

		private bool visible = true;

		private PaintingMethod paintingMethod;

		public Vertex[] Vertices
		{
			get
			{
				return vertices;
			}
			set
			{
				SetVertices(value);
			}
		}

		public DiagramVector Normal
		{
			get
			{
				return normal;
			}
			set
			{
				normal = value;
			}
		}

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				color = value;
			}
		}

		public bool SameNormals
		{
			get
			{
				return sameNormals;
			}
			set
			{
				sameNormals = value;
			}
		}

		public bool SameColors
		{
			get
			{
				return sameColors;
			}
			set
			{
				sameColors = value;
			}
		}

		public int Weight
		{
			get
			{
				return weight;
			}
			set
			{
				weight = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
			}
		}

		public static PlanePrimitive Offset(PlanePrimitive primitive, double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			PlanePrimitive planePrimitive = primitive.CreateInstance();
			planePrimitive.Assign(primitive);
			planePrimitive.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			return planePrimitive;
		}

		protected PlanePrimitive()
		{
		}

		public PlanePrimitive(IList<DiagramPoint> points)
		{
			SetVertices(points);
		}

		public PlanePrimitive(DiagramPoint[] points, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
		{
			this.sameNormals = sameNormals;
			this.sameColors = sameColors;
			this.normal = normal;
			this.color = color;
			SetVertices(points);
		}

		public PlanePrimitive(Vertex[] vertices)
		{
			SetVertices(vertices);
		}

		public PlanePrimitive(Vertex[] vertices, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
		{
			this.sameNormals = sameNormals;
			this.sameColors = sameColors;
			this.normal = normal;
			this.color = color;
			SetVertices(vertices);
		}

		public virtual void AssignProperties(PlanePrimitive primitive)
		{
			if (primitive == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("primitive");
			}
			sameNormals = primitive.sameNormals;
			sameColors = primitive.sameColors;
			normal = primitive.normal;
			color = primitive.color;
			weight = primitive.weight;
			visible = primitive.visible;
			paintingMethod = primitive.paintingMethod;
		}

		protected void Assign(PlanePrimitive primitive)
		{
			if (primitive == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("primitive");
			}
			Vertex[] array = new Vertex[primitive.vertices.Length];
			primitive.vertices.CopyTo(array, 0);
			SetVertices(array);
			AssignProperties(primitive);
		}

		private DiagramPoint[] MakePointsArray(Vertex[] vertices)
		{
			if (vertices == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[vertices.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = vertices[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected void SetVertices(Vertex[] vertices)
		{
			this.vertices = vertices;
		}

		protected void SetVertices(IList<DiagramPoint> points)
		{
			vertices = new Vertex[points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				vertices[i].Point = points[i];
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool IsVerticesCountValid(int count);

		protected abstract PlanePrimitive CreateInstance();

		protected internal abstract GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand();

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!GetType().Equals(obj.GetType()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PlanePrimitive planePrimitive = (PlanePrimitive)obj;
			if (sameNormals != planePrimitive.sameNormals || sameColors != planePrimitive.sameColors || !normal.Equals(planePrimitive.normal) || !color.Equals(planePrimitive.color) || weight != planePrimitive.weight || visible != planePrimitive.visible || paintingMethod != planePrimitive.paintingMethod || vertices.Length != planePrimitive.vertices.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!vertices[i].Equals(planePrimitive.vertices[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				vertices[i].Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			}
		}

		public void SetPaintingMethod(PaintingMethod paintingMethod)
		{
			this.paintingMethod = paintingMethod;
		}

		public void Offset(DiagramPoint offset)
		{
			Offset(offset.X, offset.Y, offset.Z);
		}

		public void InvertVerticesDirection()
		{
			Vertex[] array = new Vertex[vertices.Length];
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = vertices.Length - 1;
			while (num < vertices.Length)
			{
				array[num2] = vertices[num];
				num++;
				num2--;
			}
			vertices = array;
			normal.Revert();
		}

		public IList<DiagramPoint> GetContour()
		{
			List<DiagramPoint> list = new List<DiagramPoint>();
			Vertex[] array = vertices;
			foreach (DiagramPoint item in array)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommandWithPainter()
		{
			if (paintingMethod != null)
			{
				return paintingMethod(this);
			}
			return CreateGraphicsCommand();
		}
	}
	public class PlaneTriangle : PlanePolygon
	{
		public PlaneTriangle()
		{
		}

		public PlaneTriangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3)
			: base(new DiagramPoint[3] { p1, p2, p3 })
		{
		}

		public PlaneTriangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
			: base(new DiagramPoint[3] { p1, p2, p3 }, sameNormals, sameColors, normal, color)
		{
		}

		public PlaneTriangle(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, Vertex v3)
			: base(new Vertex[3] { v1, v2, v3 })
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsVerticesCountValid(int count)
		{
			return count == 3;
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new PlaneTriangle();
		}

		private PlaneTriangle CreateInstance(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, Vertex v3)
		{
			PlaneTriangle planeTriangle = (PlaneTriangle)CreateInstance();
			planeTriangle.AssignProperties(this);
			planeTriangle.SetVertices(new Vertex[3] { v1, v2, v3 });
			return planeTriangle;
		}

		public PlaneTriangle CalcLeftHalf()
		{
			Vertex v = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter3D(base.Vertices[0], base.Vertices[1], 0.01);
			return CreateInstance(v, base.Vertices[1], base.Vertices[2]);
		}

		public PlaneTriangle CalcRightHalf()
		{
			Vertex v = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter3D(base.Vertices[0], base.Vertices[1], 0.01);
			return CreateInstance(base.Vertices[0], v, base.Vertices[2]);
		}
	}
	public class RangeValueToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		public enum Mode
		{
			All,
			Max,
			Min,
			Duration
		}

		private Mode mode;

		private TimeSpanFormat durationFormat;

		protected Mode ConverterMode => mode;

		protected virtual bool ShouldSortValues => true;

		public RangeValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, Mode mode, TimeSpanFormat durationFormat)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
			this.mode = mode;
			this.durationFormat = durationFormat;
		}

		private string GetDurationString(double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			return NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText(Math.Abs(maxValue - minValue), base.NumericOptions);
		}

		private string GetDurationString(DateTime minValue, DateTime maxValue)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = maxValue - minValue;
			return durationFormat switch
			{
				TimeSpanFormat.Standard => timeSpan.ToString(), 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalDays => NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText(timeSpan.TotalDays, base.NumericOptions), 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalHours => NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText(timeSpan.TotalHours, base.NumericOptions), 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalMinutes => NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText(timeSpan.TotalMinutes, base.NumericOptions), 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalSeconds => NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText(timeSpan.TotalSeconds, base.NumericOptions), 
				TimeSpanFormat.TotalMilliseconds => NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText(timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds, base.NumericOptions), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		private string GetDurationString(object[] values)
		{
			if (values[0] is double && values[1] is double)
			{
				return GetDurationString((double)values[0], (double)values[1]);
			}
			if (values[0] is DateTime && values[1] is DateTime)
			{
				return GetDurationString((DateTime)values[0], (DateTime)values[1]);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		private object[] SortValues(object[] values)
		{
			object[] array = new object[2];
			Array.Copy(values, 0, array, 0, 2);
			Array.Sort(array);
			return array;
		}

		private object[] FilterValues(object[] values)
		{
			if (ShouldSortValues)
			{
				values = SortValues(values);
			}
			switch (mode)
			{
			case Mode.All:
			case Mode.Duration:
				return values;
			case Mode.Max:
				return new object[1] { values[1] };
			case Mode.Min:
				return new object[1] { values[0] };
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public override string ConvertTo(object[] values)
		{
			values = FilterValues(values);
			if (mode == Mode.Duration)
			{
				return GetDurationString(values);
			}
			string text = GetValueText(values[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				text = text + ", " + GetValueText(values[i]);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public class RangeAreaValueToStringConverter : RangeValueToStringConverter
	{
		protected override bool ShouldSortValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ConverterMode == Mode.All)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.ShouldSortValues;
			}
		}

		public RangeAreaValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, Mode mode, TimeSpanFormat durationFormat)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions, mode, durationFormat)
		{
		}
	}
	public class StockValueToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		private readonly StockLevel valueLevel;

		public StockValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, StockLevel valueLevel)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
			this.valueLevel = valueLevel;
		}

		protected override object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			return valueLevel switch
			{
				StockLevel.Low => values[0], 
				StockLevel.High => values[1], 
				StockLevel.Open => values[2], 
				StockLevel.Close => values[3], 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class RadarDiagramMapping : IXYDiagramMapping, IEllipse
	{
		public struct Vertex
		{
			private readonly double argument;

			private readonly double x;

			private readonly double y;

			public double Argument => argument;

			public double X => x;

			public double Y => y;

			public Vertex(double argument, double x, double y)
			{
				this.argument = argument;
				this.x = x;
				this.y = y;
			}
		}

		private const double PI = Math.PI;

		private readonly Rectangle bounds;

		private readonly bool clipArgument;

		private readonly GRealPoint2D center;

		private readonly double radius;

		private readonly double startAngle;

		private readonly bool revertAngle;

		private readonly double minArgument;

		private readonly double maxArgument;

		private readonly double argumentDiapason;

		private readonly double argumentDelta;

		private readonly Vertex[] vertices;

		private readonly double minValue;

		private readonly double maxValue;

		private readonly double valueScaleFactor;

		private readonly RadarDiagramDrawingStyle drawingStyle;

		private readonly double diagramStartAngle;

		private readonly bool isQualitativeScale;

		private readonly Transformation valueTransformation;

		private readonly Transformation argumentTransformation;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => bounds;

		public bool ClipArgument => clipArgument;

		public GRealPoint2D Center => center;

		public double Radius => radius;

		public double StartAngle => startAngle;

		public bool RevertAngle => revertAngle;

		public double MinArgument => minArgument;

		public double MaxArgument => maxArgument;

		public double MinValue => minValue;

		public double MaxValue => maxValue;

		public bool IsValid => argumentDiapason > 0.0;

		public int VerticesCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (vertices != null)
				{
					return vertices.Length - 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public double DiagramStartAngle => diagramStartAngle;

		public double ValueScaleFactor => valueScaleFactor;

		public double ArgumentDiapason => argumentDiapason;

		public double ArgumentDelta => argumentDelta;

		public Vertex[] Vertices => vertices;

		bool IXYDiagramMapping.IsRotatedDiagram => false;

		public RadarDiagramMapping(RadarDiagram diagram, RectangleF bounds, IList<double> values)
		{
			this.bounds = Rectangle.Truncate(bounds);
			drawingStyle = diagram.DrawingStyle;
			clipArgument = diagram.ClipArgument;
			diagramStartAngle = diagram.StartAngleInDegrees * Math.PI / 180.0;
			startAngle = diagram.ActualStartAngle - Math.PI / 2.0;
			revertAngle = diagram.RotationDirection == RadarDiagramRotationDirection.Counterclockwise;
			argumentTransformation = diagram.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			if (values.Count > 1)
			{
				int num = values.Count - 1;
				maxArgument = values[num];
				minArgument = values[0];
				argumentDiapason = maxArgument - minArgument;
				argumentDelta = argumentDiapason / (double)num;
				if (diagram.DrawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Polygon)
				{
					vertices = new Vertex[values.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						double argument = values[i];
						double num2 = CalcAngle(argument);
						vertices[i] = new Vertex(argument, Math.Cos(num2), Math.Sin(num2));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				minArgument = 0.0;
				maxArgument = 0.0;
				argumentDiapason = 0.0;
			}
			valueTransformation = diagram.AxisY.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			minValue = diagram.AxisY.VisualRangeData.Min;
			maxValue = diagram.AxisY.VisualRangeData.Max;
			center = GraphicUtils.CalcCenter((ZPlaneRectangle)bounds, roundToInteger: true);
			radius = GraphicUtils.CalcRadius(Math.Min(bounds.Width, bounds.Height), roundToInteger: true);
			valueScaleFactor = radius / (valueTransformation.TransformForward(maxValue) - valueTransformation.TransformForward(minValue));
			isQualitativeScale = diagram.AxisX.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;
		}

		private double GetNormalDistance(double normalIndent)
		{
			return revertAngle ? (0.0 - normalIndent) : normalIndent;
		}

		private double GetNormalAngle(double angle)
		{
			return angle + Math.PI / 2.0;
		}

		private double GetValue(double distance)
		{
			return distance / valueScaleFactor + valueTransformation.TransformForward(minValue);
		}

		private double CorrectAngle(double angle)
		{
			if (revertAngle && angle != 0.0)
			{
				angle = Math.PI * 2.0 - angle;
			}
			angle = ((diagramStartAngle >= 0.0) ? ((!(angle >= diagramStartAngle)) ? (Math.PI * 2.0 - diagramStartAngle + angle) : (angle - diagramStartAngle)) : ((!(angle < Math.PI * 2.0 + diagramStartAngle)) ? (angle - Math.PI * 2.0 - diagramStartAngle) : (angle - diagramStartAngle)));
			return angle;
		}

		private bool CalcArgumentAndValueForPolygon(double angle, double dx, double dy, out double argumentInternal, out double valueInternal)
		{
			argumentInternal = 0.0;
			valueInternal = 0.0;
			if (vertices.Length <= 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double d = angle / (Math.PI * 2.0 / (double)(vertices.Length - 1));
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(d);
			if (num < 0 || num >= vertices.Length - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Vertex vertex = vertices[num];
			Vertex vertex2 = vertices[num + 1];
			double num2 = (vertex.X - vertex2.X) * dy - (vertex.Y - vertex2.Y) * dx;
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num3 = (vertex.X * dy - vertex.Y * dx) / num2;
			double num4 = (vertex.X - vertex2.X) * num3 - vertex.X;
			double num5 = (vertex.Y - vertex2.Y) * num3 - vertex.Y;
			double num6;
			if (dx != 0.0 && num4 != 0.0)
			{
				num6 = dx / num4;
			}
			else
			{
				if (dy == 0.0 || num5 == 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				num6 = dy / num5;
			}
			if (num6 > radius)
			{
				return false;
			}
			valueInternal = GetValue(num6);
			argumentInternal = (vertex2.Argument - vertex.Argument) * num3 + vertex.Argument;
			return true;
		}

		public GRealPoint2D CalcEllipsePoint(double angle)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(Math.Cos(angle) * radius + center.X, Math.Sin(angle) * radius + center.Y);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool clipValue, int indent, int normalIndent)
		{
			if (value == double.PositiveInfinity || value == double.MaxValue)
			{
				value = maxValue;
			}
			if ((clipArgument && (argument < minArgument || argument > maxArgument)) || (clipValue && (value < minValue || value > maxValue)))
			{
				return DiagramPoint.Zero;
			}
			while (argument < minArgument)
			{
				argument += argumentDiapason;
			}
			while (argument > maxArgument)
			{
				argument -= argumentDiapason;
			}
			if (value < minValue)
			{
				value = minValue;
			}
			if (drawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
			{
				double distance = GetDistance(value, indent);
				double num = CalcAngle(argument);
				double normalDistance = GetNormalDistance(normalIndent);
				double normalAngle = GetNormalAngle(num);
				return new DiagramPoint(Math.Cos(num) * distance + Math.Cos(normalAngle) * normalDistance + center.X, Math.Sin(num) * distance + Math.Sin(normalAngle) * normalDistance + center.Y);
			}
			double distance2 = GetDistance(value, 0);
			double d = (argument - minArgument) / argumentDelta;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(d);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			else if (num2 >= vertices.Length - 1)
			{
				num2 = vertices.Length - 2;
			}
			Vertex vertex = vertices[num2];
			Vertex vertex2 = vertices[num2 + 1];
			double num3 = (argument - vertex.Argument) / (vertex2.Argument - vertex.Argument);
			double num4 = 1.0 - num3;
			DiagramPoint result = new DiagramPoint((vertex.X * num4 + vertex2.X * num3) * distance2 + center.X, (vertex.Y * num4 + vertex2.Y * num3) * distance2 + center.Y);
			if (indent != 0 || normalIndent != 0)
			{
				double num5 = CalcAngle(argument);
				double normalAngle2 = GetNormalAngle(num5);
				double normalDistance2 = GetNormalDistance(normalIndent);
				result.X += Math.Cos(num5) * (double)indent + Math.Cos(normalAngle2) * normalDistance2;
				result.Y += Math.Sin(num5) * (double)indent + Math.Sin(normalAngle2) * normalDistance2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool clipValue, int indent)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value, clipValue, indent, 0);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool clipValue)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value, clipValue, 0);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value, clipValue: false);
		}

		public double GetDistance(double value, int indent)
		{
			return (valueTransformation.TransformForward(value) - valueTransformation.TransformForward(minValue)) * valueScaleFactor + (double)indent;
		}

		public double GetDistance(double value)
		{
			return GetDistance(value, 0);
		}

		public double CalcAngle(double argument)
		{
			double num = (argumentTransformation.TransformForward(argument) - argumentTransformation.TransformForward(minArgument)) / argumentTransformation.TransformForward(argumentDiapason) * Math.PI * 2.0;
			if (revertAngle)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			return num + startAngle;
		}

		public bool CalcArgumentAndValue(Point p, out double argumentInternal, out double valueInternal)
		{
			argumentInternal = 0.0;
			valueInternal = 0.0;
			double num = center.Y - (double)p.Y;
			double num2 = center.X - (double)p.X;
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			if (radius == 0.0 || num3 > radius)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num3 == 0.0)
			{
				argumentInternal = minArgument;
				valueInternal = minValue;
				return true;
			}
			double num4 = num / num3;
			if (num4 > 1.0 || num4 < -1.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num5 = Math.Acos(num4);
			if ((double)p.X < center.X)
			{
				num5 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num5;
			}
			num5 = CorrectAngle(num5);
			if (drawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
			{
				valueInternal = GetValue(num3);
				argumentInternal = num5 / Math.PI / 2.0 * argumentTransformation.TransformForward(argumentDiapason) + argumentTransformation.TransformForward(minArgument);
			}
			else if (!CalcArgumentAndValueForPolygon(num5, num2, num, out argumentInternal, out valueInternal))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (isQualitativeScale && argumentInternal > maxArgument - argumentDelta / 2.0)
			{
				argumentInternal -= argumentDiapason;
			}
			return true;
		}

		DiagramPoint IXYDiagramMapping.GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, bool round)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(argument, value);
		}
	}

	public class RadarDiagramViewData : PaneViewData
	{
		private readonly List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		private readonly List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;

		private readonly RadarDiagram diagram;

		private readonly RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping;

		private readonly RectangleF actualBounds;

		private readonly RadarAxisXViewData axisXViewData;

		private readonly RadarAxisYViewData axisYViewData;

		private readonly int borderThickness;

		private readonly Color borderColor;

		private readonly Rectangle maxBounds;

		private readonly List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList;

		private readonly IList<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList;

		private HitTestController HitTestController => diagram.Chart.HitTestController;

		public RectangleF ActualBounds => actualBounds;

		public RadarAxisXViewData AxisXViewData => axisXViewData;

		public RadarAxisYViewData AxisYViewData => axisYViewData;

		public GRealPoint2D Center => diagramMapping.Center;

		public float Radius => (float)diagramMapping.Radius;

		public float BorderRadius => Radius + (float)borderThickness / 2f;

		public int BorderThickness => borderThickness;

		public Color BorderColor => borderColor;

		public RadarDiagramMapping DiagramMapping => diagramMapping;

		public Rectangle MaxBounds => maxBounds;

		public IList<SeriesLayout> SeriesLayoutList => seriesLayoutList;

		public override bool IsEmpty => false;

		public override List<AnnotationLayout> AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout => annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		public override List<LegendViewData> LegendViewDataList => legendViewDataList;

		public RadarDiagramViewData(RadarDiagram diagram, RadarDiagramMapping diagramMapping, Rectangle bounds, RectangleF actualBounds, RadarAxisXViewData axisXViewData, RadarAxisYViewData axisYViewData, int borderThickness, Color borderColor, List<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList, List<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData, List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList, Rectangle maxBounds)
			: base(diagram, bounds, labelLayoutLists)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.diagramMapping = diagramMapping;
			this.actualBounds = actualBounds;
			this.axisXViewData = axisXViewData;
			this.axisYViewData = axisYViewData;
			this.borderThickness = borderThickness;
			this.borderColor = borderColor;
			this.maxBounds = maxBounds;
			this.annotationsAnchorPointsLayout = annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;
			this.annotationsViewData = annotationsViewData;
			this.legendViewDataList = legendViewDataList;
			this.seriesLayoutList = seriesLayoutList;
			base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping = CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(labelLayoutLists);
		}

		private double CalcPolygonStartAngle()
		{
			double num = ((diagram.RotationDirection == RadarDiagramRotationDirection.Counterclockwise) ? ((0.0 - diagram.StartAngleInDegrees) * Math.PI / 180.0) : (diagram.StartAngleInDegrees * Math.PI / 180.0));
			return num - Math.PI / 2.0;
		}

		private void ProcessOverlappingAxisLabels()
		{
			RadarAxisXLabel label = axisXViewData.Axis.Label;
			RadarAxisYLabel label2 = axisYViewData.Axis.Label;
			if ((!label.ActualVisibility || !label.ResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide) && (!label2.ActualVisibility || !label2.ResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IAxisLabelLayout> list = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();
			if (axisXViewData.LabelItems != null)
			{
				list.Clear();
				foreach (AxisLabelItemBase labelItem in axisXViewData.LabelItems)
				{
					if (labelItem is IAxisLabelLayout item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				AxisLabelsResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(list, axisXViewData.Axis);
			}
			if (axisYViewData.LabelItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			list.Clear();
			foreach (AxisLabelItemBase labelItem2 in axisYViewData.LabelItems)
			{
				if (labelItem2 is IAxisLabelLayout item2)
				{
					list.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			AxisLabelsResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(list, axisYViewData.Axis);
		}

		private void RenderContent(ChartRenderer renderer, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			RadarAxisXMapping axisMapping = new RadarAxisXMapping(diagramMapping);
			if (axisXViewData != null)
			{
				axisXViewData.RenderInterlacedAreas(renderer, diagramMapping);
				axisYViewData.RenderInterlacedAreas(renderer, diagramMapping, this);
				axisXViewData.RenderMinorGridLines(renderer, axisMapping, appearance);
				axisYViewData.RenderMinorGridLines(renderer, diagramMapping, this, appearance);
				axisXViewData.RenderGridLines(renderer, axisMapping, appearance);
				axisYViewData.RenderGridLines(renderer, diagramMapping, this, appearance);
			}
		}

		private void RenderAxes(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			axisYViewData.Render(renderer, this);
			axisXViewData.RenderLabels(renderer);
			if (axisYViewData.LabelData != null)
			{
				axisYViewData.LabelData.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		public IPolygon CreatePolygon(GRealPoint2D center, float radius, int verticesCount, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			if (diagram.DrawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
			{
				return new CirclePolygon(center, radius);
			}
			LineStrip vertices = GraphicUtils.CalcPolygon(CalcPolygonStartAngle(), verticesCount, center, radius);
			return new VariousPolygon(vertices, bounds);
		}

		public override void CalculateSeriesAndLabelLayout(ChartDrawingHelper drawingHelper, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			foreach (RadarDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout in SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				seriesLayout.Calculate();
			}
			if (base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping)
			{
				XYDiagramResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping(), (ZPlaneRectangle)MaxBounds, base.Diagram.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			}
			ProcessOverlappingAxisLabels();
		}

		public override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			GRealPoint2D center = Center;
			IPolygon polygon = CreatePolygon(new GRealPoint2D(center.X, center.Y), Radius, DiagramMapping.VerticesCount, ActualBounds);
			VariousPolygon variousPolygon = polygon as VariousPolygon;
			if (diagram.DrawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
			{
				diagram.Shadow.Render(renderer, center, Radius);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				if (diagram.BackImage.DXImage == null)
				{
					diagram.ActualFillStyle.Options.FillCircle(renderer, new PointF((float)center.X, (float)center.Y), Radius, diagram.ActualBackColor, Color.Empty);
				}
				else
				{
					diagram.BackImage.Render(renderer, polygon);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			else if (variousPolygon != null)
			{
				diagram.Shadow.Render(renderer, variousPolygon);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				if (diagram.BackImage.DXImage == null)
				{
					diagram.ActualFillStyle.Options.Render(renderer, variousPolygon.Vertices, ActualBounds, diagram.ActualBackColor, Color.Empty);
				}
				else
				{
					diagram.BackImage.Render(renderer, polygon);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
			renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
			RenderContent(renderer, CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(diagram).RadarDiagramAppearance);
			if (diagram.DrawingStyle == RadarDiagramDrawingStyle.Circle)
			{
				if (BorderThickness > 0)
				{
					renderer.DrawCircle(new Point((int)center.X, (int)center.Y), (int)BorderRadius, BorderColor, BorderThickness);
				}
			}
			else if (variousPolygon != null && BorderThickness > 0 && DiagramMapping.VerticesCount > 1)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = GraphicUtils.CalcPolygon(CalcPolygonStartAngle(), DiagramMapping.VerticesCount, new GRealPoint2D(center.X, center.Y), BorderRadius);
				if (lineStrip.Count > 3)
				{
					renderer.DrawPolygon(lineStrip, BorderColor, BorderThickness);
				}
			}
			renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			if (!diagram.AxisY.TopLevel)
			{
				RenderAxes(renderer);
			}
			using (DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = polygon.GetPath())
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(HitTestController, diagram, null, new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath.Clone()));
				if (SeriesLayoutList.Count > 0)
				{
					renderer.SetClipping(dXGraphicsPath);
					foreach (RadarDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout in SeriesLayoutList)
					{
						seriesLayout.RenderShadow(renderer);
					}
					foreach (RadarDiagramSeriesLayout seriesLayout2 in SeriesLayoutList)
					{
						seriesLayout2.Render(renderer);
					}
					renderer.RestoreClipping();
				}
			}
			RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
			if (diagram.AxisY.TopLevel)
			{
				RenderAxes(renderer);
			}
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public override void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext, bool renderInOverlays)
		{
			foreach (LegendViewData legendViewData in legendViewDataList)
			{
				legendViewData.Render(renderer, MaxBounds);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class RangeBarSeriesLabelView
	{
		private readonly RangeBarSeriesLabel label;

		protected RangeBarSeriesLabel Label => label;

		public static RangeBarSeriesLabelView CreateInstance(RangeBarSeriesLabel label)
		{
			return label.Kind switch
			{
				RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel => new OneRangeBarSeriesLabelView(label), 
				RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel => new MinRangeBarSeriesLabelView(label), 
				RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel => new MaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView(label), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		public RangeBarSeriesLabelView(RangeBarSeriesLabel label)
		{
			this.label = label;
		}

		protected abstract XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, Color color);

		public void CalculateLayout(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, Color color)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelViewData.Text))
			{
				XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout = CalculateLayoutInternal(labelLayoutList, barData, pointData, labelViewData, color);
				if (xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout != null)
				{
					labelLayoutList.Add(xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class MinMaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView : RangeBarSeriesLabelView
	{
		public MinMaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView(RangeBarSeriesLabel label)
			: base(label)
		{
		}

		protected abstract double GetLabelPositionValue(BarData barData);

		protected abstract int GetLabelOffset();

		protected abstract double GetLabelAngle();

		protected override XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, Color color)
		{
			XYDiagramMappingBase xYDiagramMappingBase = (labelLayoutList.View.IsScrollingEnabled ? labelLayoutList.MappingContainer.MappingForScrolling : barData.GetMappingForExtremeLabelPosition(labelLayoutList.MappingContainer, GetLabelPositionValue(barData)));
			if (xYDiagramMappingBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double angle = XYDiagramMappingHelper.CorrectAngle(xYDiagramMappingBase, GetLabelAngle());
			DiagramPoint screenPoint = barData.GetScreenPoint(barData.Argument, GetLabelPositionValue(barData), xYDiagramMappingBase);
			screenPoint = XYDiagramMappingHelper.ApplyYOffsetToPoint(xYDiagramMappingBase, screenPoint, GetLabelOffset());
			TextPainter textPainter = ((base.Label.Position == RangeBarLabelPosition.Center) ? labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForCenterDrawing(screenPoint) : labelViewData.CreateTextPainterForFlankDrawing(screenPoint, angle));
			RectangleF validRectangle = RectangleF.Empty;
			if (base.Label.Position == RangeBarLabelPosition.Inside)
			{
				validRectangle = barData.GetTotalRect(labelLayoutList.MappingContainer);
			}
			return XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout.CreateWithValidRectangle(pointData, base.Label, color, textPainter, null, base.Label.ResolveOverlappingMode, screenPoint, validRectangle);
		}
	}
	public class MinRangeBarSeriesLabelView : MinMaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView
	{
		public MinRangeBarSeriesLabelView(RangeBarSeriesLabel label)
			: base(label)
		{
		}

		protected override double GetLabelPositionValue(BarData barData)
		{
			if (barData.ZeroValue < barData.ActualValue)
			{
				return barData.ZeroValue;
			}
			return barData.ActualValue;
		}

		protected override int GetLabelOffset()
		{
			return base.Label.Position switch
			{
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Center => 0, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Inside => base.Label.Indent, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Outside => -base.Label.Indent, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		protected override double GetLabelAngle()
		{
			return base.Label.Position switch
			{
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Center => 0.0, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Inside => Math.PI / 2.0, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Outside => -Math.PI / 2.0, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class MaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView : MinMaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView
	{
		public MaxRangeBarSeriesLabelView(RangeBarSeriesLabel label)
			: base(label)
		{
		}

		protected override double GetLabelPositionValue(BarData barData)
		{
			if (barData.ActualValue > barData.ZeroValue)
			{
				return barData.ActualValue;
			}
			return barData.ZeroValue;
		}

		protected override int GetLabelOffset()
		{
			return base.Label.Position switch
			{
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Center => 0, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Inside => -base.Label.Indent, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Outside => base.Label.Indent, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		protected override double GetLabelAngle()
		{
			return base.Label.Position switch
			{
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Center => 0.0, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Inside => -Math.PI / 2.0, 
				RangeBarLabelPosition.Outside => Math.PI / 2.0, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}
	}

		protected override XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayout CalculateLayoutInternal(XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList, BarData barData, RefinedPointData pointData, SeriesLabelViewData labelViewData, Color color)

	public interface ILabelBehaviorProvider
	{
		bool ConnectorSupported { get; }

		bool ConnectorEnabled { get; }

		bool ShadowSupported { get; }

		bool ResolveOverlappingEnabled { get; }

		bool ResolveOverlappingSupported { get; }
