	public class AreaSeriesViewPainter : PointSeriesViewPainter
	{
		private const int maxMarkerInLegendSize = 20;

		private readonly IAreaSeriesView view;

		protected new IAreaSeriesView View => view;

		protected virtual bool CanOptimizePolygons => true;

		public AreaSeriesViewPainter(IAreaSeriesView view)
			: base((SeriesViewBase)view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		private Color GetActualBorderColor(CustomBorder border, Color color)
		{
			if (border.Color == Color.Empty && view.Appearance.BorderColor != Color.Empty)
			{
				return view.Appearance.BorderColor;
			}
			Color baseColor = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(100, 0, 0, 0), color);
			baseColor = Color.FromArgb(90, baseColor);
			return BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, baseColor);
		}

		private void RenderLegendMarkerInternal(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions pointDrawOptions, DrawOptions drawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (pointDrawOptions is AreaDrawOptions areaDrawOptions)
			{
				IPolygon polygon = CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(areaDrawOptions, CalculateBoundsForLegendMarker(bounds));
				RangeStrip rangeStrip = CreateLegendMarkerStrip(bounds, polygon != null);
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable: true);
				StripsUtils.Render(renderer, rangeStrip, areaDrawOptions.FillStyle.Options, drawOptions.Color, drawOptions.ActualColor2, base.HitTestState, null, selectionState);
				RenderBorder(renderer, areaDrawOptions, Rectangle.Empty, rangeStrip, isLegendBorder: true);
				if (polygon != null)
				{
					RenderPoint(renderer, polygon, areaDrawOptions, selectionState);
				}
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		private void RenderShadowForLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			if (drawOptions is AreaDrawOptions areaDrawOptions)
			{
				IPolygon polygon = CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(areaDrawOptions, CalculateBoundsForLegendMarker(bounds));
				RangeStrip rangeStrip = CreateLegendMarkerStrip(bounds, polygon != null);
				areaDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, rangeStrip, 1);
				areaDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, rangeStrip.TopStrip, 1, 1);
				polygon?.RenderShadow(renderer, areaDrawOptions.Shadow, 1);
			}
		}

		private void RenderSplittedBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, int borderThickness, Color drawingColor, LineStrip borderStrip)
		{
			renderer.SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetMode.Half);
			StripsUtils.Render(renderer, borderStrip, drawingColor, borderThickness);
			renderer.RestorePixelOffsetMode();
		}

		protected void RenderAreaBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, CustomBorder border, AreaDrawOptions drawOptions, LineStrip lineStrip, int? stripColor, bool isLegendBorder, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			if (border != null && border.ActualVisibility)
			{
				int num = (isLegendBorder ? 1 : border.Thickness);
				Color color = (stripColor.HasValue ? GetActualBorderColor(border, ColorProvider.ApplyTransparency(Color.FromArgb(stripColor.Value), (SeriesViewBase)view)) : GetActualBorderColor(border, drawOptions.Color));
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = lineStrip.CreateUniqueStrip();
				LargeScaleHelper.Validate(lineStrip2);
				if (view.Closed && !lineStrip2.IsEmpty)
				{
					lineStrip2.Add(new GRealPoint2D(lineStrip2[0].X, lineStrip2[0].Y));
				}
				if (isSplittedStrip)
				{
					RenderSplittedBorder(renderer, num, color, lineStrip2);
				}
				else
				{
					StripsUtils.Render(renderer, lineStrip2, color, num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderBorder(ChartRenderer renderer, AreaDrawOptions drawOptions, Rectangle mappingBounds, RangeStrip strip, bool isLegendBorder, bool isSplittedStrip = false)
		{
			RenderAreaBorder(renderer, strip.Style.IsEmptyPointStyle ? drawOptions.EmptyPointBorder : drawOptions.Border, drawOptions, strip.TopStrip, strip.Style.Color, isLegendBorder, isSplittedStrip);
		}

		protected virtual Rectangle CalculateBoundsForLegendMarker(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Rectangle result = new Rectangle(bounds.Location.X, bounds.Location.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height * 3 / 4);
			if (Math.Min(result.Width, result.Height) > 20)
			{
				int num = ((result.Width - 20 > 0) ? ((result.Width - 20) / 2) : 0);
				int num2 = ((result.Height - 20 > 0) ? ((result.Height - 20) / 2) : 0);
				result.Inflate(-num, -num2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual RangeStrip CreateLegendMarkerStrip(Rectangle bounds, bool pointMarkerVisible)
		{
			return StripsUtils.CreateAreaMarkerStrip(View, bounds, pointMarkerVisible);
		}

		protected internal override Color GetMarkerSelfColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			Color color = ((AreaDrawOptions)drawOptions).Marker.Color;
			if (!(color != Color.Empty))
			{
				return base.GetMarkerSelfColor(drawOptions);
			}
			return color;
		}

		protected override IPolygon CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (View.MarkerOptions != null)
			{
				return base.CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(drawOptions, bounds);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			if (View.MarkerOptions != null)
			{
				base.Render(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			if (View.MarkerOptions != null)
			{
				base.RenderShadow(renderer, mappingBounds, pointLayout, drawOptions);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			if (!(layout is AreaWholeSeriesLayout areaWholeSeriesLayout) || areaWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count == 0 || !(layout.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions is AreaDrawOptions areaDrawOptions))
			{
				return;
			}
			PolygonFillStyle polygonFillStyle = (PolygonFillStyle)areaDrawOptions.FillStyle.Clone();
			PolygonFillStyle emptyPointFillStyle = areaDrawOptions.EmptyPointFillStyle;
			if (view.Rotated)
			{
				if (polygonFillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient)
				{
					((PolygonGradientFillOptions)polygonFillStyle.Options).RotateGradientMode();
				}
				if (emptyPointFillStyle != null && emptyPointFillStyle.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient)
				{
					((PolygonGradientFillOptions)emptyPointFillStyle.Options).RotateGradientMode();
				}
			}
			bool isSplittedStrip = areaWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count > 1;
			foreach (RangeStrip strip in areaWholeSeriesLayout.Strips)
			{
				PolygonFillStyle polygonFillStyle2 = ((strip.Style.IsEmptyPointStyle && emptyPointFillStyle != null) ? emptyPointFillStyle : polygonFillStyle);
				bool actualAntialiasing = View.GetActualAntialiasing(Math.Max(strip.TopStrip.Count, strip.BottomStrip.Count));
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(actualAntialiasing);
				renderer.EnablePolygonOptimization(CanOptimizePolygons);
				Color color = (strip.Style.Color.HasValue ? ColorProvider.ApplyTransparency(Color.FromArgb(strip.Style.Color.Value), (SeriesViewBase)view) : areaDrawOptions.Color);
				StripsUtils.Render(renderer, strip, polygonFillStyle2.Options, color, areaDrawOptions.ActualColor2, base.HitTestState, (ZPlaneRectangle)mappingBounds, layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState, isSplittedStrip);
				RenderBorder(renderer, areaDrawOptions, mappingBounds, strip, isLegendBorder: false, isSplittedStrip);
				renderer.RestorePolygonOptimization();
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeriesShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			AreaWholeSeriesLayout areaWholeSeriesLayout = (AreaWholeSeriesLayout)layout;
			if (areaWholeSeriesLayout == null || areaWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count == 0 || !(areaWholeSeriesLayout.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions is AreaDrawOptions areaDrawOptions))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = View.Border != null;
			foreach (RangeStrip strip in areaWholeSeriesLayout.Strips)
			{
				areaDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, strip);
				if (flag)
				{
					LineStrip lineStrip = strip.TopStrip.CreateUniqueStrip();
					LargeScaleHelper.Validate(lineStrip);
					areaDrawOptions.Shadow.Render(renderer, lineStrip, 1);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			RenderShadowForLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, seriesDrawOptions);
			RenderLegendMarkerInternal(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, seriesDrawOptions, selectionState);
		}
	}
	public class LineSeriesViewPainter : PointSeriesViewPainter
	{
		protected virtual LineCap LineCap => LineCap.Round;

		public static void RenderLine(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, LineWholeSeriesLayout lineLayout, LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, Color lineColor, LineCap lineCap, LineSeriesView lineView)
		{
			List<LineStrip> list = new List<LineStrip>();
			if (!LargeScaleHelper.IsValid(lineLayout.Strips))
			{
				foreach (LineStrip strip in lineLayout.Strips)
				{
					list.AddRange(TruncatedLineCalculator.SplitLineStrip(strip, mappingBounds));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (LineStrip strip2 in lineLayout.Strips)
				{
					list.Add(strip2);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LineStrip item in list)
			{
				Color color = (item.Style.Color.HasValue ? Color.FromArgb(item.Style.Color.Value) : lineColor);
				LineStyle actualStripLineStyle = lineDrawOptions.GetActualStripLineStyle(item.Style);
				int actualStripLineThickness = lineDrawOptions.GetActualStripLineThickness(item.Style, lineLayout);
				bool enable = lineView?.GetActualAntialiasing(item.Count) ?? actualStripLineStyle.AntiAlias;
				renderer.EnableAntialiasing(enable);
				renderer.DrawLines(item, color, actualStripLineThickness, actualStripLineStyle, lineCap);
				renderer.RestoreAntialiasing();
			}
		}

		public static void RenderLineLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, LineStyle lineStyle, Color lineColor, LineCap lineCap, Shadow shadow)
		{
			int num = bounds.Top + (bounds.Height - 1) / 2;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = new DiagramPoint(bounds.Left, num);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(bounds.Right - 1, num);
			if (shadow != null)
			{
				shadow.BeforeShadowRender(renderer, 1);
				renderer.DrawLine((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2, shadow.Color, 1, lineStyle, lineCap);
				shadow.AfterShadowRender(renderer);
			}
			renderer.DrawLine((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2, lineColor, 1, lineStyle, lineCap);
		}

		public LineSeriesViewPainter(SeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private void RenderLine(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout, LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, Color lineColor)
		{
			if (layout is LineWholeSeriesLayout lineWholeSeriesLayout && lineWholeSeriesLayout.Strips.Count > 0)
			{
				RenderLine(renderer, mappingBounds, lineWholeSeriesLayout, lineDrawOptions, lineColor, LineCap, base.View as LineSeriesView);
			}
		}

		protected Color GetLineColor(LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			return MixSelfColor(lineDrawOptions.Color, selectionState);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderLineLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			RenderLineLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, lineDrawOptions.LineStyle, GetLineColor(lineDrawOptions, selectionState), LineCap, lineDrawOptions.Shadow);
		}

		protected internal override Color GetMarkerSelfColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			Color color = ((LineDrawOptions)drawOptions).Marker.Color;
			if (!(color != Color.Empty))
			{
				return base.GetMarkerSelfColor(drawOptions);
			}
			return color;
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			if (layout.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions is LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions)
			{
				Color lineColor = GetLineColor(lineDrawOptions, layout.SeriesLayout.SeriesData.SelectionState);
				RenderLine(renderer, mappingBounds, layout, lineDrawOptions, lineColor);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderWholeSeriesShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
			if (layout.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions is LineDrawOptions { Shadow: { Visible: not false } shadow } lineDrawOptions)
			{
				shadow.BeforeShadowRender(renderer);
				RenderLine(renderer, mappingBounds, layout, lineDrawOptions, lineDrawOptions.Shadow.Color);
				shadow.AfterShadowRender(renderer);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			PointDrawOptions pointDrawOptions = seriesPointDrawOptions as PointDrawOptions;
			LineDrawOptions lineDrawOptions = seriesDrawOptions as LineDrawOptions;
			if (pointDrawOptions != null && lineDrawOptions != null)
			{
				RenderLineLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, lineDrawOptions, selectionState);
				int num = ((bounds.Height % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 2);
				int num2 = ((bounds.Width % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 2);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(bounds.X + num2, bounds.Y + num, bounds.Width - 4, bounds.Height - 4);
				if (rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					RenderPointLegendMarker(renderer, rectangle, pointDrawOptions, selectionState);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class RadarLineWholeSeriesLayout : LineWholeSeriesLayout
	{
		private readonly bool closed;

		public RadarLineWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, int lineThickness, bool closed)
			: base(seriesLayout, strips, lineThickness, Rectangle.Empty, optimizeHitTesting: true)
		{
			this.closed = closed;
		}

		protected override void AddStrips(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			foreach (LineStrip strip in base.Strips)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = strip.CreateUniqueStrip();
				if (!lineStrip2.IsEmpty)
				{
					using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
					FillPath(lineStrip2, dXGraphicsPath);
					path.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath, connect: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void FillPath(LineStrip uniqueStrip, DXGraphicsPath stripPath)
		{
			base.FillPath(uniqueStrip, stripPath);
			if (closed)
			{
				stripPath.AddLine(new PointF((float)uniqueStrip[0].X, (float)uniqueStrip[0].Y), new PointF((float)uniqueStrip[uniqueStrip.Count - 1].X, (float)uniqueStrip[uniqueStrip.Count - 1].Y));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ExplodeFilter
	{
		private PieSeriesViewBase view;

		protected PieSeriesViewBase View => view;

		public static ExplodeFilter CreateInstance(PieSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			switch (view.ExplodeMode)
			{
			case PieExplodeMode.MinValue:
				return new MinExplodeFilter(view);
			case PieExplodeMode.MaxValue:
				return new MaxExplodeFilter(view);
			case PieExplodeMode.All:
				return new AllExplodeFilter(view);
			case PieExplodeMode.UseFilters:
				return new UseFiltersExplodeFilter(view);
			case PieExplodeMode.UsePoints:
				if (view.ExplodedPointsIndices != null)
				{
					return new UsePointsIndicesFilter(view);
				}
				return new UsePointsExplodeFilter(view);
			case PieExplodeMode.Others:
				return new OthersExplodeFilter(view);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected ExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public abstract List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points);

		public abstract bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point);
	}
	public class MinExplodeFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public MinExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					double num2 = point.Values[0];
					if (num2 < num)
					{
						num = num2;
					}
				}
			}
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			foreach (SeriesPoint point2 in points)
			{
				if (!point2.IsEmpty && point2.Values[0] == num)
				{
					list.Add(point2);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IPiePoint)point).IsMinPoint;
		}
	}
	public class MaxExplodeFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public MaxExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					double num2 = point.Values[0];
					if (num2 > num)
					{
						num = num2;
					}
				}
			}
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			foreach (SeriesPoint point2 in points)
			{
				if (!point2.IsEmpty && point2.Values[0] == num)
				{
					list.Add(point2);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IPiePoint)point).IsMaxPoint;
		}
	}
	public class AllExplodeFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public AllExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			return new List<ISeriesPoint>(points);
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class UseFiltersExplodeFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public UseFiltersExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				if (base.View.ExplodedPointsFilters.CheckSeriesPoint(point))
				{
					list.Add(point);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return base.View.ExplodedPointsFilters.CheckSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(point.SeriesPoint));
		}
	}
	public class UsePointsExplodeFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public UsePointsExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private bool ContainsInFilter(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint explodedPoint in base.View.ExplodedPoints)
			{
				if (SeriesPoint.EqualsBySourcePoints(explodedPoint, point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				if (ContainsInFilter(point))
				{
					list.Add(point);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (point.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(point.SeriesPoint);
			return ContainsInFilter(seriesPoint);
		}
	}
	public class OthersExplodeFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public OthersExplodeFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				if (point.IsAuxiliary)
				{
					list.Add(point);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(point.SeriesPoint).IsAuxiliary;
		}
	}
	public class UsePointsIndicesFilter : ExplodeFilter
	{
		public UsePointsIndicesFilter(PieSeriesViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override List<ISeriesPoint> FilterPoints(IList<ISeriesPoint> points)
		{
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			foreach (int explodedPointsIndex in base.View.ExplodedPointsIndices)
			{
				list.Add(points[explodedPointsIndex]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CheckPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (point.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(point.SeriesPoint);
			foreach (SeriesPoint explodedPoint in base.View.ExplodedPoints)
			{
				if (SeriesPoint.EqualsBySourcePoints(explodedPoint, seriesPoint))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class PointSeriesViewPainter
	{
		private readonly SeriesViewBase view;

		private bool MarkerVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (view is PointSeriesViewBase pointSeriesViewBase)
				{
					return pointSeriesViewBase.ActualMarkerVisible;
				}
				if (view is RadarPointSeriesView radarPointSeriesView)
				{
					return radarPointSeriesView.ActualMarkerVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected SeriesViewBase View => view;

		protected SeriesHitTestState HitTestState => view.HitTestState;

		protected IChartAppearance ActualAppearance => view.ActualAppearance;

		public PointSeriesViewPainter(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		private Color GetMarkerDrawColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, SelectionState renderSelectionState)
		{
			Color markerSelfColor = GetMarkerSelfColor(drawOptions);
			return GraphicUtils.CorrectColorBySelectionState(markerSelfColor, renderSelectionState);
		}

		protected internal Color GetBorderDrawColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, MarkerBase marker)
		{
			CustomBorder border = marker.Border;
			if (border.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				Color borderColor = ActualAppearance.MarkerAppearance.BorderColor;
				if (!borderColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return borderColor;
				}
			}
			Color automaticBorderColor = HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(20, 0, 0, 0), drawOptions.Color);
			return BorderHelper.CalculateBorderColor(border, automaticBorderColor);
		}

		protected virtual IPolygon CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (!MarkerVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return drawOptions.Marker.CalculatePolygon(bounds);
		}

		protected internal virtual Color GetMarkerSelfColor(PointDrawOptionsBase drawOptions)
		{
			return drawOptions.Color;
		}

		protected Color MixSelfColor(Color selfColor, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			return GraphicUtils.CorrectColorBySelectionState(selfColor, selectionState);
		}

		protected void RenderPointLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			PointDrawOptionsBase pointDrawOptionsBase = seriesPointDrawOptions as PointDrawOptionsBase;
			IPolygon polygon = CalculateLegendMarkerPolygon(pointDrawOptionsBase, bounds);
			if (polygon != null)
			{
				polygon.RenderShadow(renderer, pointDrawOptionsBase.Shadow, 1);
				RenderPoint(renderer, polygon, pointDrawOptionsBase, selectionState);
			}
		}

		protected void RenderPoint(ChartRenderer renderer, IPolygon polygon, PointDrawOptionsBase pointDrawOptions, SelectionState renderSelectionState)
		{
			Color markerDrawColor = GetMarkerDrawColor(pointDrawOptions, renderSelectionState);
			Color borderDrawColor = GetBorderDrawColor(pointDrawOptions, pointDrawOptions.Marker);
			int borderThickness = (pointDrawOptions.Marker.BorderVisible ? pointDrawOptions.Marker.Border.Thickness : 0);
			pointDrawOptions.Marker.RenderWithAntialiasing(renderer, polygon, markerDrawColor, pointDrawOptions.ActualColor2, borderDrawColor, borderThickness);
		}

		public virtual void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			PointSeriesPointLayout pointSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as PointSeriesPointLayout;
			PointDrawOptionsBase pointDrawOptionsBase = drawOptions as PointDrawOptionsBase;
			if (pointSeriesPointLayout != null && pointDrawOptionsBase != null && pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon != null && !RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.Rect).IsEmpty)
			{
				RenderPoint(renderer, pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon, pointDrawOptionsBase, pointSeriesPointLayout.PointData.SelectionState);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RenderWholeSeries(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
		}

		public virtual void RenderShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, SeriesPointLayout pointLayout, DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			PointSeriesPointLayout pointSeriesPointLayout = pointLayout as PointSeriesPointLayout;
			PointDrawOptionsBase pointDrawOptionsBase = drawOptions as PointDrawOptionsBase;
			if (pointSeriesPointLayout != null && pointDrawOptionsBase != null && pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon != null && !RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.Rect).IsEmpty)
			{
				pointSeriesPointLayout.Polygon.RenderShadow(renderer, pointDrawOptionsBase.Shadow, -1);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RenderWholeSeriesShadow(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds, WholeSeriesLayout layout)
		{
		}

		public virtual void RenderLegendMarker(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, DrawOptions seriesPointDrawOptions, DrawOptions seriesDrawOptions, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			RenderPointLegendMarker(renderer, bounds, seriesPointDrawOptions, selectionState);
		}
	}
	public class DockableTitleViewData : IDisposable
	{
		private DockableTitle title;

		private IHitRegion excludeRegion;

		private HitRegionContainer hitRegion;

		private RotatedTextPainterNearLine painter;

		private int size;

		internal RotatedTextPainterNearLine TextPainter => painter;

		public DockableTitle Title => title;

		public bool IsVerticalTitle
		{
			get
			{
				if (title.Dock != ChartTitleDockStyle.Left)
				{
					return title.Dock == ChartTitleDockStyle.Right;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public int Size => size;

		public DockableTitleViewData(DockableTitle title, string actualText, IHitRegion excludeRegion, HitRegionContainer hitRegion, Point origin, int maxWidth, int size, bool wordWrap)
		{
			this.title = title;
			this.excludeRegion = excludeRegion;
			this.hitRegion = hitRegion;
			this.size = size;
			SizeF textSize = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(actualText, title.DXFont, title);
			painter = new RotatedTextPainterNearLine(origin, actualText, textSize, title, title.Docking.NearPosition, title.Docking.TextAngle, mixColorByHitTestState: false, parseText: true, maxWidth, title.MaxLineCount, wordWrap);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (excludeRegion != null)
			{
				excludeRegion.Dispose();
				excludeRegion = null;
			}
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				hitRegion.Dispose();
				hitRegion = null;
			}
		}

		public void Offset(int xOffset, int yOffset)
		{
			painter.Offset(xOffset, yOffset);
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				hitRegion.Dispose();
			}
			hitRegion = new HitRegionContainer(new HitRegion(painter.RoundedBounds));
			hitRegion.Exclude(excludeRegion);
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			HitTestController hitTestController = title.Chart.HitTestController;
			IHitRegion hitRegion = (IHitRegion)this.hitRegion.Underlying.Clone();
			painter.Render(renderer, hitTestController, hitRegion, null, Color.Empty, 1.0);
		}
	}
	public class LegendTitleViewData
	{
		private readonly LegendTitle title;

		private readonly TextPainter painter;

		private readonly float correctionX;

		private readonly float correctionY;

		internal TextPainter TextPainter => painter;

		public LegendTitle Title => title;

		public SizeF Size => title.Margins.IncreaseSizeF(painter.Bounds.Size);

		public float CorrectionX => correctionX;

		public float CorrectionY => correctionY;

		public LegendTitleViewData(LegendTitle title, int width)
		{
			this.title = title;
			RectThickness dpiScaledThickness = title.Margins.DpiScaledThickness;
			int num = width - dpiScaledThickness.Left - dpiScaledThickness.Right;
			int maxWidth = (title.WordWrap ? num : int.MaxValue);
			painter = new TextPainter(title.Text, SizeF.Empty, title, parseText: true, default(PointF), maxWidth, title.MaxLineCount, title.WordWrap);
			correctionX = CalculateCorrectionX(title.WordWrap ? num : Math.Max(num, painter.Width)) + (float)dpiScaledThickness.Left;
			correctionY = dpiScaledThickness.Top;
		}

		private float CalculateCorrectionX(int maxTextSize)
		{
			return RtlHelper.GetAlignment(title.Alignment, title.Chart) switch
			{
				System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near => 0f, 
				System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far => maxTextSize - painter.Width, 
				_ => (float)maxTextSize / 2f - (float)painter.Width / 2f, 
			};
		}

		public void Render(ChartRenderer renderer, PointF location)
		{
			float num = location.X + correctionX;
			float num2 = location.Y + correctionY;
			painter.Offset(num, num2);
			painter.RenderWithOffset(renderer, title.Chart.HitTestController);
			painter.Offset(0f - num, 0f - num2);
		}
	}

	public delegate T GetPropertyValue<T>();
	public delegate void SetPropertyValue<T>(T value);
	public class AspxSerializerWrapper<T> : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable where T : ChartElement
	{
		private readonly GetPropertyValue<T> getter;

		private readonly SetPropertyValue<T> setter;

		private readonly bool shouldSerialize = true;

		int ICollection.Count => GetCount();

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => null;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => true;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return getter();
			}
			set
			{
				setter(value as T);
			}
		}

		public AspxSerializerWrapper(GetPropertyValue<T> getter, SetPropertyValue<T> setter, bool shouldSerialize)
			: this(getter, setter)
		{
			this.shouldSerialize = shouldSerialize;
		}

		public AspxSerializerWrapper(GetPropertyValue<T> getter, SetPropertyValue<T> setter)
		{
			this.getter = getter;
			this.setter = setter;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			ChartElement chartElement = getter();
			if (chartElement != null && chartElement.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				yield return chartElement;
			}
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			array.SetValue(getter(), index);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return value == getter();
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (!((IList)this).Contains(value))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value is T value2)
			{
				setter(value2);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
		}

		private int GetCount()
		{
			ChartElement chartElement = getter();
			if (!shouldSerialize || chartElement == null || !chartElement.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}
	}

	public static class ContourUtils
	{
		private class VertexDescriptor
		{
			private readonly int contourIndex;

			private DiagramPoint point;

			private VertexDescriptor prev;

			private VertexDescriptor next;

			private EdgeDescriptor inEdge;

			private EdgeDescriptor outEdge;

			private ContourMark contourMark;

			private EdgeMark edgeMark;

			private bool passed;

			private bool doubled;

			public DiagramPoint Point => point;

			public VertexDescriptor Next
			{
				get
				{
					return next;
				}
				set
				{
					next = value;
				}
			}

			public VertexDescriptor Prev
			{
				get
				{
					return prev;
				}
				set
				{
					prev = value;
				}
			}

			public EdgeDescriptor InEdge
			{
				get
				{
					return inEdge;
				}
				set
				{
					inEdge = value;
				}
			}

			public EdgeDescriptor OutEdge
			{
				get
				{
					return outEdge;
				}
				set
				{
					outEdge = value;
				}
			}

			public ContourMark ContourMark
			{
				get
				{
					return contourMark;
				}
				set
				{
					contourMark = value;
				}
			}

			public EdgeMark EdgeMark
			{
				get
				{
					return edgeMark;
				}
				set
				{
					edgeMark = value;
				}
			}

			public int ContourIndex => contourIndex;

			public bool Passed
			{
				get
				{
					return passed;
				}
				set
				{
					passed = value;
				}
			}

			public bool Doubled
			{
				get
				{
					return doubled;
				}
				set
				{
					doubled = value;
				}
			}

			public VertexDescriptor(DiagramPoint point, int contourIndex)
			{
				this.point = point;
				this.contourIndex = contourIndex;
			}

			public List<VertexDescriptor> GetCrossVertices()
			{
				List<VertexDescriptor> list = new List<VertexDescriptor>();
				if (inEdge != null)
				{
					EdgeDescriptor edgeDescriptor = inEdge;
					do
					{
						if (edgeDescriptor.IsIn && edgeDescriptor.VertexDescriptor.ContourIndex != contourIndex)
						{
							list.Add(edgeDescriptor.VertexDescriptor);
						}
						edgeDescriptor = edgeDescriptor.Next;
					}
					while (edgeDescriptor != inEdge);
				}
				return list;
			}

			public IList<DiagramPoint> GetContour(bool forward)
			{
				List<DiagramPoint> list = new List<DiagramPoint>();
				VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = this;
				do
				{
					list.Add(vertexDescriptor.point);
					if (vertexDescriptor.Doubled)
					{
						list.Add(vertexDescriptor.point);
					}
					vertexDescriptor = (forward ? vertexDescriptor.next : vertexDescriptor.prev);
				}
				while (vertexDescriptor != this);
				return list;
			}

			public VertexDescriptor GetEdgeVertex(bool forward)
			{
				if (!forward)
				{
					return prev;
				}
				return this;
			}
		}

		private class EdgeDescriptor : IComparable
		{
			private double angle;

			private bool isIn;

			private VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor;

			private EdgeDescriptor prev;

			private EdgeDescriptor next;

			public double Angle => angle;

			public bool IsIn => isIn;

			public VertexDescriptor VertexDescriptor => vertexDescriptor;

			public EdgeDescriptor Prev
			{
				get
				{
					return prev;
				}
				set
				{
					prev = value;
				}
			}

			public EdgeDescriptor Next
			{
				get
				{
					return next;
				}
				set
				{
					next = value;
				}
			}

			public EdgeDescriptor(VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor, double angle, bool isIn)
			{
				this.vertexDescriptor = vertexDescriptor;
				this.angle = angle;
				this.isIn = isIn;
			}

			int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
			{
				EdgeDescriptor edgeDescriptor = (EdgeDescriptor)obj;
				return angle.CompareTo(edgeDescriptor.angle);
			}
		}

		private enum ContourMark
		{
			Inside,
			Outside,
			Intersected
		}

		private enum EdgeMark
		{
			Shared1,
			Shared2,
			Inside,
			Outside
		}

		private enum Operation
		{
			Intersection,
			Union
		}

		private static VertexDescriptor AddVertex(VertexDescriptor vertex1, VertexDescriptor vertex2, DiagramPoint point, double epsilon)
		{
			for (VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = vertex1; vertexDescriptor != vertex2; vertexDescriptor = vertexDescriptor.Next)
			{
				if (IntersectionUtils.IsPointOnInterval2D(vertexDescriptor.Point, vertexDescriptor.Next.Point, point, epsilon, out var position))
				{
					switch (position)
					{
					case PointIntervalPosition.FirstPoint:
						return vertexDescriptor;
					case PointIntervalPosition.LastPoint:
						return vertexDescriptor.Next;
					case PointIntervalPosition.Inside:
					{
						VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor2 = new VertexDescriptor(point, vertex1.ContourIndex);
						vertexDescriptor2.Next = vertexDescriptor.Next;
						vertexDescriptor2.Prev = vertexDescriptor;
						vertexDescriptor.Next = vertexDescriptor2;
						vertexDescriptor2.Next.Prev = vertexDescriptor2;
						return vertexDescriptor2;
					}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static List<EdgeDescriptor> GetEdges(VertexDescriptor vertex)
		{
			if (vertex.InEdge == null)
			{
				double angle = MathUtils.CalcAxisXAngle2D(vertex.Point, vertex.Prev.Point);
				vertex.InEdge = new EdgeDescriptor(vertex, angle, isIn: true);
				angle = MathUtils.CalcAxisXAngle2D(vertex.Point, vertex.Next.Point);
				vertex.OutEdge = new EdgeDescriptor(vertex, angle, isIn: false);
				vertex.InEdge.Next = vertex.OutEdge;
				vertex.InEdge.Prev = vertex.OutEdge;
				vertex.OutEdge.Next = vertex.InEdge;
				vertex.OutEdge.Prev = vertex.InEdge;
			}
			List<EdgeDescriptor> list = new List<EdgeDescriptor>();
			EdgeDescriptor edgeDescriptor = vertex.InEdge;
			do
			{
				list.Add(edgeDescriptor);
				edgeDescriptor = edgeDescriptor.Next;
			}
			while (edgeDescriptor != vertex.InEdge);
			return list;
		}

		private static void Combine(VertexDescriptor v1, VertexDescriptor v2)
		{
			if (v1 == null || v2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<EdgeDescriptor> edges = GetEdges(v1);
			List<EdgeDescriptor> edges2 = GetEdges(v2);
			foreach (EdgeDescriptor item in edges)
			{
				if (item.VertexDescriptor == v2)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			edges.AddRange(edges2);
			edges.Sort();
			for (int i = 0; i < edges.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				edges[i].Next = edges[i + 1];
				edges[i + 1].Prev = edges[i];
			}
			edges[edges.Count - 1].Next = edges[0];
			edges[0].Prev = edges[edges.Count - 1];
		}

		private static bool CalcIntersections(VertexDescriptor vertexA, VertexDescriptor vertexB, bool doubleIntersections, double epsilon)
		{
			bool result = false;
			VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = vertexA;
			VertexDescriptor next = vertexA.Next;
			do
			{
				VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor2 = vertexB;
				VertexDescriptor next2 = vertexB.Next;
				do
				{
					IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(vertexDescriptor.Point, next.Point, vertexDescriptor2.Point, next2.Point, epsilon, out var points);
					if (points != null && points.Count > 0)
					{
						result = true;
						foreach (DiagramPoint item in points)
						{
							VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor3 = AddVertex(vertexDescriptor, next, item, epsilon);
							VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor4 = AddVertex(vertexDescriptor2, next2, item, epsilon);
							if (vertexDescriptor3 != null && vertexDescriptor4 != null)
							{
								bool doubled;
								if (doubleIntersections)
								{
									doubled = (vertexDescriptor4.Doubled = true);
									vertexDescriptor3.Doubled = doubled;
								}
								doubled = (vertexDescriptor4.Doubled = vertexDescriptor4.Doubled || vertexDescriptor3.Doubled);
								vertexDescriptor3.Doubled = doubled;
								Combine(vertexDescriptor3, vertexDescriptor4);
							}
						}
					}
					vertexDescriptor2 = next2;
					next2 = next2.Next;
				}
				while (vertexDescriptor2 != vertexB);
				vertexDescriptor = next;
				next = next.Next;
			}
			while (vertexDescriptor != vertexA);
			return result;
		}

		private static VertexDescriptor BuildContour(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, int contourIndex, double epsilon)
		{
			VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = new VertexDescriptor(contour[0], contourIndex);
			VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor2 = vertexDescriptor;
			for (int i = 1; i < contour.Count; i++)
			{
				if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(vertexDescriptor2.Point, contour[i], epsilon))
				{
					vertexDescriptor2.Doubled = true;
					continue;
				}
				vertexDescriptor2.Next = new VertexDescriptor(contour[i], contourIndex);
				vertexDescriptor2.Next.Prev = vertexDescriptor2;
				vertexDescriptor2 = vertexDescriptor2.Next;
			}
			if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(vertexDescriptor2.Point, vertexDescriptor.Point, epsilon))
			{
				vertexDescriptor.Doubled = true;
				vertexDescriptor2 = vertexDescriptor2.Prev;
			}
			vertexDescriptor2.Next = vertexDescriptor;
			vertexDescriptor2.Next.Prev = vertexDescriptor2;
			return vertexDescriptor;
		}

		private static bool IsContourValid(IList<DiagramPoint> contour)
		{
			if (contour != null)
			{
				return contour.Count >= 3;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void MarkContours(VertexDescriptor vertexA, VertexDescriptor vertexB, IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, bool intersected, double epsilon)
		{
			if (intersected)
			{
				vertexA.ContourMark = ContourMark.Intersected;
				vertexB.ContourMark = ContourMark.Intersected;
				return;
			}
			vertexA.ContourMark = ((!IntersectionUtils.IsPointInPolygon(vertexA.Point, contourB, epsilon)) ? ContourMark.Outside : ContourMark.Inside);
			if (vertexA.ContourMark == ContourMark.Inside)
			{
				vertexB.ContourMark = ContourMark.Outside;
			}
			else
			{
				vertexB.ContourMark = ((!IntersectionUtils.IsPointInPolygon(vertexB.Point, contourA, epsilon)) ? ContourMark.Outside : ContourMark.Inside);
			}
		}

		private static bool MarkNotIntersected(VertexDescriptor vertex, IList<VertexDescriptor> vertices1, IList<VertexDescriptor> vertices2, IList<DiagramPoint> contour, bool first, double epsilon)
		{
			if (vertices1.Count > 0 || vertices2.Count > 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (first)
			{
				vertex.EdgeMark = (IntersectionUtils.IsPointInPolygon(vertex.Point, contour, epsilon) ? EdgeMark.Inside : EdgeMark.Outside);
			}
			else
			{
				vertex.EdgeMark = vertex.Prev.EdgeMark;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool MarkShared(VertexDescriptor vertex, IList<VertexDescriptor> vertices1, IList<VertexDescriptor> vertices2)
		{
			if (vertices1.Count == 0 || vertices2.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (VertexDescriptor item in vertices1)
			{
				if (vertices2.Contains(item.Next))
				{
					vertex.EdgeMark = EdgeMark.Shared1;
					return true;
				}
				if (vertices2.Contains(item.Prev))
				{
					vertex.EdgeMark = EdgeMark.Shared2;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool MarkInsideByAngles(VertexDescriptor vertex, List<VertexDescriptor> vertices, bool firstVertex)
		{
			foreach (VertexDescriptor vertex2 in vertices)
			{
				double num = (firstVertex ? vertex.OutEdge.Angle : vertex.Next.InEdge.Angle);
				double angle = vertex2.InEdge.Angle;
				double angle2 = vertex2.OutEdge.Angle;
				if (num == angle || num == angle2 || (angle2 > angle && (num > angle2 || num < angle)) || (angle > angle2 && num < angle && num > angle2))
				{
					vertex.EdgeMark = EdgeMark.Inside;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void MarkEdges(VertexDescriptor vertex, IList<DiagramPoint> contour, double epsilon)
		{
			VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = vertex;
			List<VertexDescriptor> list = vertex.GetCrossVertices();
			do
			{
				List<VertexDescriptor> crossVertices = vertexDescriptor.Next.GetCrossVertices();
				if (!MarkNotIntersected(vertexDescriptor, list, crossVertices, contour, vertexDescriptor == vertex, epsilon) && !MarkShared(vertexDescriptor, list, crossVertices) && !MarkInsideByAngles(vertexDescriptor, list, firstVertex: true) && !MarkInsideByAngles(vertexDescriptor, crossVertices, firstVertex: false))
				{
					vertexDescriptor.EdgeMark = EdgeMark.Outside;
				}
				vertexDescriptor = vertexDescriptor.Next;
				list = crossVertices;
			}
			while (vertexDescriptor != vertex);
		}

		private static bool AreIntersects(VertexDescriptor vertexA, VertexDescriptor vertexB)
		{
			Combine(vertexA, vertexB);
			bool result = vertexA.InEdge.Angle != vertexB.InEdge.Angle && vertexA.InEdge.Angle != vertexB.OutEdge.Angle && vertexA.OutEdge.Angle != vertexB.InEdge.Angle && vertexA.OutEdge.Angle != vertexB.OutEdge.Angle && vertexA.InEdge.Next != vertexA.OutEdge && vertexA.InEdge.Prev != vertexA.OutEdge;
			vertexA.InEdge = null;
			vertexA.OutEdge = null;
			vertexB.InEdge = null;
			vertexB.OutEdge = null;
			return result;
		}

		private static bool CalcSelfContacts(VertexDescriptor vertex, double epsilon)
		{
			VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = vertex;
			do
			{
				VertexDescriptor next = vertexDescriptor.Next;
				DiagramPoint point = vertexDescriptor.Point;
				DiagramPoint point2 = next.Point;
				VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor2 = next;
				do
				{
					VertexDescriptor next2 = vertexDescriptor2.Next;
					DiagramPoint point3 = vertexDescriptor2.Point;
					DiagramPoint point4 = next2.Point;
					List<DiagramPoint> points;
					switch (IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(point, point2, point3, point4, epsilon, out points))
					{
					case Intersection.Yes:
						if (!MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(point2, points[0], epsilon))
						{
							VertexDescriptor vertexA = AddVertex(vertexDescriptor, next, points[0], epsilon);
							VertexDescriptor vertexB = AddVertex(vertexDescriptor2, next2, points[0], epsilon);
							if (AreIntersects(vertexA, vertexB))
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						break;
					case Intersection.Match:
						if (points.Count > 1)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (points.Count == 1)
						{
							AddVertex(vertexDescriptor, next, points[0], epsilon);
							AddVertex(vertexDescriptor2, next2, points[0], epsilon);
						}
						break;
					}
					vertexDescriptor2 = vertexDescriptor2.Next;
				}
				while (vertexDescriptor2 != vertexDescriptor);
				vertexDescriptor = vertexDescriptor.Next;
			}
			while (vertexDescriptor != vertex);
			return true;
		}

		private static bool CalcContours(IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, bool doubleIntersection, double epsilon, out VertexDescriptor vertexA, out VertexDescriptor vertexB)
		{
			vertexA = null;
			vertexB = null;
			if (!IsContourValid(contourA) || !IsContourValid(contourB))
			{
				return false;
			}
			vertexA = BuildContour(contourA, 1, epsilon);
			if (!CalcSelfContacts(vertexA, epsilon))
			{
				return false;
			}
			vertexB = BuildContour(contourB, 2, epsilon);
			if (!CalcSelfContacts(vertexB, epsilon))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool intersected = CalcIntersections(vertexA, vertexB, doubleIntersection, epsilon);
			MarkContours(vertexA, vertexB, contourA, contourB, intersected, epsilon);
			MarkEdges(vertexA, contourB, epsilon);
			MarkEdges(vertexB, contourA, epsilon);
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsEdgeValid(Operation operation, VertexDescriptor vertex, out bool forward)
		{
			switch (operation)
			{
			case Operation.Intersection:
				forward = true;
				if (vertex.EdgeMark != EdgeMark.Inside)
				{
					return vertex.EdgeMark == EdgeMark.Shared1;
				}
				return true;
			case Operation.Union:
				forward = true;
				if (vertex.EdgeMark != EdgeMark.Outside)
				{
					return vertex.EdgeMark == EdgeMark.Shared1;
				}
				return true;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		private static bool Jump(Operation operation, ref VertexDescriptor vertex, ref bool forward)
		{
			EdgeDescriptor edgeDescriptor = (forward ? vertex.InEdge.Prev : vertex.OutEdge.Prev);
			EdgeDescriptor edgeDescriptor2 = edgeDescriptor;
			do
			{
				VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = edgeDescriptor2.VertexDescriptor;
				if (!vertexDescriptor.Passed && IsEdgeValid(operation, vertexDescriptor, out var forward2) && ((edgeDescriptor2.IsIn && !forward2) || (!edgeDescriptor2.IsIn && forward2)))
				{
					forward = forward2;
					vertex = vertexDescriptor;
					return true;
				}
				edgeDescriptor2 = edgeDescriptor2.Prev;
			}
			while (edgeDescriptor2 != edgeDescriptor);
			return false;
		}

		private static IList<DiagramPoint> ConstructContour(Operation operation, VertexDescriptor vertex, bool forward)
		{
			List<DiagramPoint> list = new List<DiagramPoint>();
			VertexDescriptor edgeVertex = vertex.GetEdgeVertex(forward);
			VertexDescriptor vertex2 = vertex;
			do
			{
				list.Add(vertex2.Point);
				if (vertex2.Doubled)
				{
					list.Add(vertex2.Point);
				}
				edgeVertex.Passed = true;
				if (edgeVertex.EdgeMark == EdgeMark.Shared1 || edgeVertex.EdgeMark == EdgeMark.Shared2)
				{
					List<VertexDescriptor> crossVertices = edgeVertex.GetCrossVertices();
					List<VertexDescriptor> crossVertices2 = edgeVertex.Next.GetCrossVertices();
					foreach (VertexDescriptor item in crossVertices)
					{
						if (edgeVertex.EdgeMark == EdgeMark.Shared1 && crossVertices2.Contains(item.Next))
						{
							item.Passed = true;
						}
						if (edgeVertex.EdgeMark == EdgeMark.Shared2 && crossVertices2.Contains(item.Prev))
						{
							item.Prev.Passed = true;
						}
					}
				}
				vertex2 = (forward ? vertex2.Next : vertex2.Prev);
				if (vertex2.InEdge != null && !Jump(operation, ref vertex2, ref forward))
				{
					break;
				}
				edgeVertex = vertex2.GetEdgeVertex(forward);
			}
			while (!edgeVertex.Passed);
			return list;
		}

		private static void ConstructIntersectedContours(Operation operation, VertexDescriptor vertex, IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> contours)
		{
			VertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor = vertex;
			do
			{
				if (!vertexDescriptor.Passed && IsEdgeValid(operation, vertexDescriptor, out var forward))
				{
					IList<DiagramPoint> list = ConstructContour(operation, forward ? vertexDescriptor : vertexDescriptor.Next, forward);
					if (list != null && list.Count >= 3)
					{
						contours.Add(list);
					}
				}
				vertexDescriptor = vertexDescriptor.Next;
			}
			while (vertexDescriptor != vertex);
		}

		private static void ConstructNotIntersectedContours(Operation operation, VertexDescriptor vertexA, VertexDescriptor vertexB, List<IList<DiagramPoint>> contours)
		{
			switch (operation)
			{
			case Operation.Intersection:
				if (vertexA.ContourMark == ContourMark.Inside)
				{
					contours.Add(vertexA.GetContour(forward: true));
				}
				else if (vertexB.ContourMark == ContourMark.Inside)
				{
					contours.Add(vertexB.GetContour(forward: true));
				}
				break;
			case Operation.Union:
				if (vertexA.ContourMark == ContourMark.Outside)
				{
					contours.Add(vertexA.GetContour(forward: true));
					contours.Add(vertexB.GetContour(forward: true));
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		private static IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> CalcOperation(Operation operation, IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, bool doubleIntersections, double epsilon)
		{
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			if (!CalcContours(contourA, contourB, doubleIntersections, epsilon, out var vertexA, out var vertexB))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (vertexA.ContourMark == ContourMark.Intersected)
			{
				ConstructIntersectedContours(operation, vertexA, list);
				ConstructIntersectedContours(operation, vertexB, list);
			}
			else
			{
				ConstructNotIntersectedContours(operation, vertexA, vertexB, list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static List<IList<DiagramPoint>> CalcIntersection(IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, DiagramVector normal, bool doubleIntersections, bool adjacentEdges, double epsilon)
		{
			using Tessellator tessellator = new Tessellator();
			IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> list = tessellator.Prepare(contourA, normal, adjacentEdges, epsilon);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> list2 = tessellator.Prepare(contourB, normal, adjacentEdges, epsilon);
			if (list2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list3 = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			foreach (IList<DiagramPoint> item in list)
			{
				foreach (IList<DiagramPoint> item2 in list2)
				{
					IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> list4 = CalcOperation(Operation.Intersection, item, item2, doubleIntersections, epsilon);
					if (list4 != null)
					{
						list3.AddRange(list4);
					}
				}
			}
			return list3;
		}

		public static List<IList<DiagramPoint>> CalcIntersection(IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, double epsilon)
		{
			return CalcIntersection(contourA, contourB, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), doubleIntersections: false, adjacentEdges: true, epsilon);
		}

		public static List<IList<DiagramPoint>> CalcIntersection(IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, bool doubleIntersections, double epsilon)
		{
			return CalcIntersection(contourA, contourB, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), doubleIntersections, adjacentEdges: true, epsilon);
		}

		public static IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> Union(IList<DiagramPoint> contourA, IList<DiagramPoint> contourB, double epsilon)
		{
			return CalcOperation(Operation.Union, contourA, contourB, doubleIntersections: false, epsilon);
		}

		public static IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> Union(IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> contours, double epsilon)
		{
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>(contours);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (list[i] == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					if (list[j] != null && list[j] != list[i])
					{
						IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> list2 = Union(list[i], list[j], epsilon);
						if (list2 == null || list2.Count == 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						if (list2.Count == 1)
						{
							list[i] = list2[0];
							list[j] = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list3 = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			foreach (IList<DiagramPoint> item in list)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					list3.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list3;
		}
	}
	public static class DefaultAlternateTextBuilder
	{
		public static string BuildTextForChart(Chart chart)
		{
			string arg = string.Empty;
			string arg2 = string.Empty;
			ChartTitleCollection titles = chart.Titles;
			if (titles.Count > 0)
			{
				string[] lines = titles[0].Lines;
				if (lines.Length != 0)
				{
					string[] array = lines;
					foreach (string text in array)
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							arg = " " + text;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries.Count > 0)
			{
				string format = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AlternateTextSeriesText);
				arg2 = string.Format(format, chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries[0].Series);
				for (int j = 1; j < chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries.Count; j++)
				{
					arg2 = arg2 + ", " + string.Format(format, chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries[j].Series);
				}
				arg2 = string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AlternateTextSeriesPlaceholder), arg2);
			}
			return string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AlternateTextPlaceholder), arg, arg2);
		}
	}
	public class DiagramCache : List<Diagram>
	{
		private Diagram FindByType(Type diagramType)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Diagram current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.GetType().Equals(diagramType))
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Save(Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				Diagram diagram2 = FindByType(diagram.GetType());
				if (diagram2 != null && diagram != diagram2)
				{
					Remove(diagram2);
				}
				Add(diagram);
			}
		}

		public Diagram Load(Type diagramType)
		{
			return FindByType(diagramType);
		}
	}
	public class Drawing2DCache
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<int, GraphicsCommand> commandCache = new Dictionary<int, GraphicsCommand>();

		private readonly Dictionary<int, CoordinatesConversionCache> coordinatesConversionCache = new Dictionary<int, CoordinatesConversionCache>();

		private int lastImageKey;

		private Bitmap lastImage;

		public GraphicsCommand this[int key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!commandCache.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return commandCache[key];
			}
		}

		public Bitmap LastImage => lastImage;

		public Bitmap GetLastImage(int key)
		{
			if (lastImage == null || lastImageKey != key)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return lastImage;
		}

		public CoordinatesConversionCache GetCoordinatesConversionCache(int key)
		{
			if (!coordinatesConversionCache.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return coordinatesConversionCache[key];
		}

		public void Add(int key, GraphicsCommand command, Bitmap lastImage, CoordinatesConversionCache cache)
		{
			commandCache[key] = command;
			coordinatesConversionCache[key] = cache;
			if (this.lastImage != null)
			{
				this.lastImage.Dispose();
			}
			this.lastImage = lastImage;
			lastImageKey = key;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (GraphicsCommand value in commandCache.Values)
			{
				value.Dispose();
			}
			commandCache.Clear();
			coordinatesConversionCache.Clear();
			if (lastImage != null)
			{
				lastImage.Dispose();
				lastImage = null;
			}
			lastImageKey = 0;
		}
	}

		{
			if (!paneCaches.TryGetValue(pane, out var value))

				return null;
			}
			return value;

		public void Register(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, XYDiagramMappingList mappingList, Rectangle? lastMappingBounds)
		{
			if (paneCaches.TryGetValue(pane, out var value))

				value.SetValues(mappingList, lastMappingBounds);
			}
			else
			{
				paneCaches.Add(pane, new PaneCoordinatesConversionCache(mappingList, lastMappingBounds));
			}
		}
	}

		public ChartGraphicsBase(IDisposable canvas, IDisposable canvasSource)
		{
			Canvas = canvas;
			CanvasSource = canvasSource;
			if (canvas is Graphics)
			{
				GdiGraphics = (Graphics)Canvas;
			}
			else if (canvas is DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.GdiPlusGraphics)
			{
				GdiGraphics = ((DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.GdiPlusGraphics)Canvas).Graphics;
			}
			DXGraphics = (canvas as IDXGraphics) ?? new DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.GdiPlusGraphics(canvas as Graphics);

			DXGraphics?.Dispose();

			GdiGraphics?.ReleaseHdcInternal(intPtr);
		}

		{

			{
				Bitmap source = (CanvasSource as Bitmap) ?? ((CanvasSource as DXBitmap)?.NativeImage as Bitmap);
				return DrawingUtils.CreateGdiBasedNativeRenderer(DXGraphics, GdiGraphics, source);
			}
			return new CommonChartRenderer(DXGraphics);
		}

		public static Rectangle GetTheSameRectPlacedInCenterOf(this Rectangle thisRectangle, Rectangle otherRectangle)
		{
			Rectangle result = default(Rectangle);
			int num = (otherRectangle.Width - thisRectangle.Width) / 2;
			int num2 = (otherRectangle.Height - thisRectangle.Height) / 2;
			result.Size = thisRectangle.Size;
			result.X = otherRectangle.X + num;
			result.Y = otherRectangle.Y + num2;
			return result;
		}

			return false;

	public class BackCompatibilityFontController
	{
		private readonly ChartElement owner;

		private DXFont defaultDXFont;

		private DXFont userDXFont;

		private DXFont dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont;

		private Font defaultFont;

		private Font userFont;

		private Font fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont;

		public bool IsDefaultFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (userFont == null)
				{
					return userDXFont == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DXFont DefaultDXFont
		{
			get
			{
				return defaultDXFont;
			}
			set
			{
				if (defaultDXFont != value)
				{
					defaultFont?.Dispose();
					defaultFont = null;
					defaultDXFont = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				if (userFont != null)
				{
					return userFont;
				}
				if (userDXFont != null)
				{
					fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont = fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont ?? SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(userDXFont);
					return fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont;
				}
				if (defaultFont == null && defaultDXFont != null)
				{
					defaultFont = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(defaultDXFont);
				}
				return defaultFont;
			}
			set
			{
				if (userFont != value)
				{
					fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont?.Dispose();
					fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont = null;
					dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont = null;
					userDXFont = null;
					owner?.RaiseControlChanging();
					userFont = value;
					owner?.RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public DXFont DXFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (userDXFont != null)
				{
					return userDXFont;
				}
				if (userFont != null)
				{
					dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont = dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont ?? SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXFont(userFont);
					return dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont;
				}
				return defaultDXFont;
			}
			set
			{
				if (userDXFont != value)
				{
					userFont = null;
					fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont?.Dispose();
					fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont = null;
					dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont = null;
					owner?.RaiseControlChanging();
					userDXFont = value;
					owner?.RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public BackCompatibilityFontController(DXFont defaultDXFont, ChartElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			this.defaultDXFont = defaultDXFont;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return !IsDefaultFont;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			owner?.RaiseControlChanging();
			userFont = null;
			userDXFont = null;
			fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont?.Dispose();
			fontGeneratedFromUserDXFont = null;
			dxFontGeneratedFromUserFont = null;
			owner?.RaiseControlChanged();
		}

		public void Assign(BackCompatibilityFontController fontController)
		{
			defaultDXFont = fontController.defaultDXFont;
			userFont = fontController.userFont;
			userDXFont = fontController.userDXFont;
		}
	}

	{
		private PrimitivesContainer container;

		private PolygonGroups polygonGroups;

		public PrimitivesContainer Container

		public PolygonGroups PolygonGroups
		{
			get
			{
				return polygonGroups;
			}
			set
			{
				polygonGroups = value;
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			container = null;
			graphicsTree = null;
			polygonGroups = null;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator calculator)
		{
			if (graphicsTree == null)
			{
				if (polygonGroups != null)
				{
					return polygonGroups.CreateGraphicsCommand();
				}
				return null;
			}
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new MaskDepthBufferGraphicsCommand();
			DiagramPoint eye = calculator.UnProject(new DiagramPoint((double)calculator.Bounds.Left + (double)calculator.Bounds.Width / 2.0, (double)calculator.Bounds.Bottom - (double)calculator.Bounds.Height / 2.0, -2147483647.0));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsTree.CreateGraphicsCommand(eye));
			return graphicsCommand;
		}
	}
