	public enum Intersection
	{
		Yes,
		No,
		Match
	}
	public enum PointIntervalPosition
	{
		Inside,
		Outside,
		FirstPoint,
		LastPoint
	}
	public class LineEquation
	{
		private readonly double k;

		private readonly double b;

		public double K => k;

		public double B => b;

		public LineEquation(double k, double b)
		{
			this.k = k;
			this.b = b;
		}

		public double GetValue(double argument)
		{
			return argument * k + b;
		}

		public double GetArgument(double value)
		{
			return (value - b) / k;
		}
	}
	public class PlaneEquation
	{
		private double[] eq = new double[4];

		public double A => eq[0];

		public double B => eq[1];

		public double C => eq[2];

		public double D => eq[3];

		public double[] Equation => eq;

		public PlaneEquation(double a, double b, double c, double d)
		{
			eq[0] = a;
			eq[1] = b;
			eq[2] = c;
			eq[3] = d;
		}
	}
	public static class IntersectionUtils
	{
		private class VertexItem
		{
			private Vertex vertex;

			private double angle;

			private double length;

			public Vertex Vertex => vertex;

			public double Angle => angle;

			public double Length => length;

			public VertexItem(Vertex vertex, double angle, double length)
			{
				this.vertex = vertex;
				this.angle = angle;
				this.length = length;
			}
		}

		private class VertexItemComparer : IComparer<VertexItem>
		{
			int IComparer<VertexItem>.Compare(VertexItem item1, VertexItem item2)
			{
				if (item1.Angle < item2.Angle)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (item1.Angle > item2.Angle)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				double num = ((item1.Angle <= 0.0) ? (item1.Length - item2.Length) : (item2.Length - item1.Length));
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num > 0.0)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private static bool ContainsVertex(IEnumerable<Vertex> vertices, Vertex vertex, double epsilon)
		{
			foreach (Vertex vertex2 in vertices)
			{
				if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals(vertex2, vertex, epsilon))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void LocateVertexByPlane(PlaneEquation plane, Vertex vertex, List<Vertex> frontVertices, List<Vertex> backVertices, double epsilon)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.IsPointOnPlane(plane, vertex, epsilon);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				frontVertices.Add(vertex);
				backVertices.Add(vertex);
			}
			else if (num > 0)
			{
				frontVertices.Add(vertex);
			}
			else
			{
				backVertices.Add(vertex);
			}
		}

		private static void AddIntersectionVertex(List<Vertex> intersectionVertices, Vertex vertex, double epsilon)
		{
			if (intersectionVertices.Count == 0 || (!MathUtils.ArePointsEquals(intersectionVertices[0], vertex, epsilon) && !MathUtils.ArePointsEquals(intersectionVertices[intersectionVertices.Count - 1], vertex, epsilon)))
			{
				intersectionVertices.Add(vertex);
			}
		}

		private static PlanePolygon ConstructConvexPolygon(Vertex[] vertices, double epsilon)
		{
			List<Vertex> list = new List<Vertex>();
			foreach (Vertex vertex in vertices)
			{
				if (!ContainsVertex(list, vertex, epsilon))
				{
					list.Add(vertex);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count < 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<VertexItem> list2 = new List<VertexItem>();
			Vertex vertex2 = list[0];
			Vertex vertex3 = list[1];
			DiagramVector v = vertex3.Point - vertex2.Point;
			list2.Add(new VertexItem(vertex3, 0.0, v.Length));
			DiagramVector v2 = DiagramVector.Zero;
			for (int j = 2; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				Vertex vertex4 = list[j];
				DiagramVector v3 = vertex4.Point - vertex2.Point;
				double num = MathUtils.CalcAngle(v, v3);
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 0.0, epsilon) == 0 || ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, Math.PI, epsilon) == 0)
				{
					list2.Add(new VertexItem(vertex4, num, v3.Length));
					continue;
				}
				DiagramVector diagramVector = MathUtils.CalcNormal(v, v3);
				if (v2.IsZero)
				{
					v2 = diagramVector;
					list2.Add(new VertexItem(vertex4, num, v3.Length));
				}
				else
				{
					double num2 = MathUtils.CalcAngle(v2, diagramVector);
					int num3 = ((ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num2, 0.0, epsilon) == 0) ? 1 : (-1));
					list2.Add(new VertexItem(vertex4, (double)num3 * num, v3.Length));
				}
			}
			list2.Sort(new VertexItemComparer());
			Vertex[] array = new Vertex[list2.Count + 1];
			array[0] = vertex2;
			int num4 = 0;
			int num5 = 1;
			while (num4 < list2.Count)
			{
				array[num5] = list2[num4].Vertex;
				num4++;
				num5++;
			}
			return new PlanePolygon(array);
		}

		private static PlanePolygon ConstructIntersectionPolygon(PlaneEquation plane, Vertex[] intersectionVertices, bool front, double epsilon)
		{
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = ConstructConvexPolygon(intersectionVertices, epsilon);
			if (planePolygon != null)
			{
				DiagramVector diagramVector = (front ? DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(0.0 - plane.A, 0.0 - plane.B, 0.0 - plane.C) : DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(plane.A, plane.B, plane.C));
				planePolygon.SameNormals = true;
				DiagramVector v = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planePolygon);
				double num = MathUtils.CalcAngle(v, diagramVector);
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 0.0, epsilon) != 0)
				{
					planePolygon.InvertVerticesDirection();
				}
				planePolygon.Normal = diagramVector;
			}
			return planePolygon;
		}

		private static Intersection CalcLineIntersection3D(PlaneEquation plane, DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon, out DiagramPoint intersectionPoint)
		{
			intersectionPoint = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			int num = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(plane.A * p1.X + plane.B * p1.Y + plane.C * p1.Z + plane.D, 0.0, epsilon);
			int num2 = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(plane.A * p2.X + plane.B * p2.Y + plane.C * p2.Z + plane.D, 0.0, epsilon);
			if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
			{
				return Intersection.Match;
			}
			DiagramVector diagramVector = p2 - p1;
			double num3 = plane.A * diagramVector.DX + plane.B * diagramVector.DY + plane.C * diagramVector.DZ;
			if (Math.Abs(num3) >= epsilon)
			{
				double num4 = (0.0 - (plane.D + plane.A * p1.X + plane.B * p1.Y + plane.C * p1.Z)) / num3;
				if (num4 >= 0.0 && num4 <= 1.0)
				{
					intersectionPoint = new DiagramPoint(p1.X + num4 * diagramVector.DX, p1.Y + num4 * diagramVector.DY, p1.Z + num4 * diagramVector.DZ);
					return Intersection.Yes;
				}
			}
			return Intersection.No;
		}

		public static bool IsPointOnInterval2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p, double epsilon, out PointIntervalPosition position)
		{
			if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(p, p1, epsilon))
			{
				position = PointIntervalPosition.FirstPoint;
			}
			else if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(p, p2, epsilon))
			{
				position = PointIntervalPosition.LastPoint;
			}
			else
			{
				position = ((MathUtils.CalcCos(p1 - p, p2 - p) > 0.0) ? PointIntervalPosition.Outside : PointIntervalPosition.Inside);
			}
			return position != PointIntervalPosition.Outside;
		}

		public static Intersection CalcLinesIntersection2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, DiagramPoint p4, double epsilon, out List<DiagramPoint> points)
		{
			points = new List<DiagramPoint>();
			DiagramPoint intersectionPoint;
			Intersection intersection = CalcLinesIntersection2D(p1, p2, p3, p4, intervalMode: true, epsilon, out intersectionPoint);
			switch (intersection)
			{
			case Intersection.Yes:
				points.Add(intersectionPoint);
				break;
			case Intersection.Match:
			{
				if (IsPointOnInterval2D(p1, p2, p3, epsilon, out var position))
				{
					points.Add(p3);
				}
				if (IsPointOnInterval2D(p1, p2, p4, epsilon, out position))
				{
					points.Add(p4);
				}
				if (points.Count < 2)
				{
					if (IsPointOnInterval2D(p3, p4, p1, epsilon, out position))
					{
						points.Add(p1);
					}
					if (points.Count < 2 && IsPointOnInterval2D(p3, p4, p2, epsilon, out position))
					{
						points.Add(p2);
					}
				}
				if (points.Count == 2 && MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(points[0], points[1], epsilon))
				{
					points.Remove(points[1]);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return intersection;
		}

		public static Intersection CalcLinesIntersection2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, DiagramPoint p4, bool intervalMode, double epsilon, out DiagramPoint intersectionPoint)
		{
			intersectionPoint = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			double num = (p4.Y - p3.Y) * (p2.X - p1.X) - (p4.X - p3.X) * (p2.Y - p1.Y);
			double num2 = (p4.X - p3.X) * (p1.Y - p3.Y) - (p4.Y - p3.Y) * (p1.X - p3.X);
			double num3 = (p2.X - p1.X) * (p1.Y - p3.Y) - (p2.Y - p1.Y) * (p1.X - p3.X);
			bool flag = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
			bool flag2 = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num2, 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
			bool flag3 = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num3, 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
			if (flag && (flag2 || flag3))
			{
				return Intersection.Match;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return Intersection.No;
			}
			double num4 = num2 / num;
			double x = p1.X + num4 * (p2.X - p1.X);
			double y = p1.Y + num4 * (p2.Y - p1.Y);
			intersectionPoint = new DiagramPoint(x, y, p1.Z);
			if (intervalMode)
			{
				double num5 = num3 / num;
				if (!(num4 >= 0.0) || !(num4 <= 1.0) || !(num5 >= 0.0) || !(num5 <= 1.0))
				{
					return Intersection.No;
				}
				return Intersection.Yes;
			}
			return Intersection.Yes;
		}

		public static Tuple<Point, Point> CalcIntersection(RectangleF currentClippingBounds, Point point1, Point point2)
		{
			CohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm cohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm = new CohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm(currentClippingBounds.X, currentClippingBounds.Y, currentClippingBounds.X + currentClippingBounds.Width, currentClippingBounds.Y + currentClippingBounds.Height);
			Tuple<double, double, double, double> cutLine = cohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm.GetCutLine(point1.X, point1.Y, point2.X, point2.Y);
			if (cutLine == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int x = MathUtils.StrongRound(cutLine.Item1);
			int y = MathUtils.StrongRound(cutLine.Item2);
			int x2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(cutLine.Item3);
			int y2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(cutLine.Item4);
			return new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(x, y), new Point(x2, y2));
		}

		public static Tuple<PointF, PointF> CalcIntersection(RectangleF currentClippingBounds, PointF point1, PointF point2)
		{
			CohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm cohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm = new CohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm(currentClippingBounds.X, currentClippingBounds.Y, currentClippingBounds.X + currentClippingBounds.Width, currentClippingBounds.Y + currentClippingBounds.Height);
			Tuple<double, double, double, double> cutLine = cohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm.GetCutLine(point1.X, point1.Y, point2.X, point2.Y);
			if (cutLine == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float x = (float)cutLine.Item1;
			float y = (float)cutLine.Item2;
			float x2 = (float)cutLine.Item3;
			float y2 = (float)cutLine.Item4;
			return new Tuple<PointF, PointF>(new PointF(x, y), new PointF(x2, y2));
		}

		public static Intersection CalcLineIntersection3D(PlaneEquation plane, Line line, double epsilon, out Vertex intersectionVertex, out Line frontLine, out Line backLine)
		{
			intersectionVertex = default(Vertex);
			frontLine = null;
			backLine = null;
			DiagramPoint intersectionPoint;
			switch (CalcLineIntersection3D(plane, line.V1, line.V2, epsilon, out intersectionPoint))
			{
			case Intersection.Yes:
			{
				DiagramVector normal = MathUtils.InterpolateNormal(line.V1.Normal, line.V2.Normal, MathUtils.CalcRelativePosition(line.V1, line.V2, intersectionPoint));
				Color color = MathUtils.InterpolateColor(line.V1.Color, line.V2.Color, MathUtils.CalcRelativePosition(line.V1, line.V2, intersectionPoint));
				intersectionVertex = new Vertex(intersectionPoint, normal, color);
				int num = MathUtils.IsPointOnPlane(plane, line.V1, epsilon);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					frontLine = Line.CreateFromLine(new Vertex[2] { line.V1, intersectionVertex }, line);
				}
				else if (num < 0)
				{
					backLine = Line.CreateFromLine(new Vertex[2] { line.V1, intersectionVertex }, line);
				}
				num = MathUtils.IsPointOnPlane(plane, line.V2, epsilon);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					frontLine = Line.CreateFromLine(new Vertex[2] { intersectionVertex, line.V2 }, line);
				}
				else if (num < 0)
				{
					backLine = Line.CreateFromLine(new Vertex[2] { intersectionVertex, line.V2 }, line);
				}
				return Intersection.Yes;
			}
			case Intersection.No:
				if (MathUtils.IsPointOnPlane(plane, line.V1, epsilon) > 0)
				{
					frontLine = line;
				}
				else
				{
					backLine = line;
				}
				return Intersection.No;
			case Intersection.Match:
				return Intersection.Match;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
		}

		public static Intersection CalcPolygonIntersection3D(PlaneEquation plane, PlanePolygon polygon, double epsilon, out Vertex[] intersectionVertices, out PlanePolygon frontPolygon, out PlanePolygon backPolygon)
		{
			List<Vertex> list = new List<Vertex>();
			List<Vertex> list2 = new List<Vertex>();
			List<Vertex> list3 = new List<Vertex>();
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				Vertex vertex = polygon.Vertices[i];
				Vertex v = polygon.Vertices[(i != polygon.Vertices.Length - 1) ? (i + 1) : 0];
				LocateVertexByPlane(plane, vertex, list, list2, epsilon);
				Line line = new Line(vertex, v, polygon.SameNormals, polygon.SameColors, polygon.Normal, polygon.Color);
				Vertex intersectionVertex;
				Line frontLine;
				Line backLine;
				switch (CalcLineIntersection3D(plane, line, epsilon, out intersectionVertex, out frontLine, out backLine))
				{
				case Intersection.Yes:
					if (frontLine != null && backLine != null)
					{
						LocateVertexByPlane(plane, intersectionVertex, list, list2, epsilon);
					}
					AddIntersectionVertex(list3, intersectionVertex, epsilon);
					break;
				case Intersection.Match:
					AddIntersectionVertex(list3, vertex, epsilon);
					break;
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException();
				case Intersection.No:
					break;
				}
			}
			frontPolygon = polygon.CreateInstance(list.ToArray());
			backPolygon = polygon.CreateInstance(list2.ToArray());
			intersectionVertices = ((list3.Count > 0) ? list3.ToArray() : null);
			if (frontPolygon != null && backPolygon != null && frontPolygon.Equals(backPolygon))
			{
				frontPolygon = null;
				backPolygon = null;
				return Intersection.Match;
			}
			if (intersectionVertices == null || intersectionVertices.Length == 0)
			{
				return Intersection.No;
			}
			return Intersection.Yes;
		}

		public static void CalcPolyhedronIntersection(PlaneEquation plane, PlanePolygon[] polyhedron, double epsilon, out List<PlanePolygon> frontPolyhedron, out List<PlanePolygon> backPolyhedron, out PlanePolygon frontIntersection, out PlanePolygon backIntersection)
		{
			frontIntersection = null;
			backIntersection = null;
			frontPolyhedron = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			backPolyhedron = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			List<Vertex> list = new List<Vertex>();
			List<Vertex> list2 = new List<Vertex>();
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = null;
			foreach (PlanePolygon planePolygon2 in polyhedron)
			{
				Vertex[] intersectionVertices;
				PlanePolygon frontPolygon;
				PlanePolygon backPolygon;
				switch (CalcPolygonIntersection3D(plane, planePolygon2, epsilon, out intersectionVertices, out frontPolygon, out backPolygon))
				{
				case Intersection.Yes:
					if (frontPolygon != null)
					{
						frontPolyhedron.Add(frontPolygon);
						list.AddRange(intersectionVertices);
					}
					if (backPolygon != null)
					{
						backPolyhedron.Add(backPolygon);
						list2.AddRange(intersectionVertices);
					}
					break;
				case Intersection.No:
					if (frontPolygon != null)
					{
						frontPolyhedron.Add(frontPolygon);
					}
					if (backPolygon != null)
					{
						backPolyhedron.Add(backPolygon);
					}
					break;
				case Intersection.Match:
					planePolygon = planePolygon2;
					break;
				default:
					throw new DefaultSwitchException();
				}
			}
			if (planePolygon == null)
			{
				frontIntersection = ConstructIntersectionPolygon(plane, list.ToArray(), front: true, epsilon);
				backIntersection = ConstructIntersectionPolygon(plane, list2.ToArray(), front: false, epsilon);
			}
			else if (frontPolyhedron.Count > 1)
			{
				frontIntersection = planePolygon;
			}
			else
			{
				backIntersection = planePolygon;
			}
			if (frontPolyhedron.Count < 2)
			{
				frontPolyhedron = null;
			}
			if (backPolyhedron.Count < 2)
			{
				backPolyhedron = null;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsPointInPolygon(DiagramPoint point, IList<DiagramPoint> polygon, double epsilon)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			DiagramPoint p = new DiagramPoint(point.X + 10.0, point.Y);
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Count; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = polygon[i];
				DiagramPoint p2 = polygon[(i != polygon.Count - 1) ? (i + 1) : 0];
				if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(diagramPoint, point, epsilon))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(diagramPoint, p2, epsilon))
				{
					if (i == polygon.Count - 1 && ((num3 < 0.0 && num2 > 0.0) || (num3 > 0.0 && num2 < 0.0)))
					{
						num++;
					}
					continue;
				}
				DiagramPoint intersectionPoint;
				switch (CalcLinesIntersection2D(diagramPoint, p2, point, p, intervalMode: false, epsilon, out intersectionPoint))
				{
				case Intersection.Match:
					if ((point.X > diagramPoint.X && point.X < p2.X) || (point.X > p2.X && point.X < diagramPoint.X))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (i == polygon.Count - 1 && ((num3 < 0.0 && num2 > 0.0) || (num3 > 0.0 && num2 < 0.0)))
					{
						num++;
					}
					break;
				case Intersection.Yes:
				{
					if (!IsPointOnInterval2D(diagramPoint, p2, intersectionPoint, epsilon, out var _))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(point, intersectionPoint, epsilon))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (intersectionPoint.X < point.X)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(intersectionPoint, diagramPoint, epsilon))
					{
						double num4 = p2.Y - point.Y;
						if (num2 == 0.0)
						{
							num2 = num4;
						}
						if ((num3 < 0.0 && num4 > 0.0) || (num3 > 0.0 && num4 < 0.0))
						{
							num++;
							num3 = 0.0;
						}
					}
					else if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(intersectionPoint, p2, epsilon))
					{
						double num5 = diagramPoint.Y - point.Y;
						num3 = num5;
						if (i == polygon.Count - 1 && ((num2 < 0.0 && num5 > 0.0) || (num2 > 0.0 && num5 < 0.0)))
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
					else if ((diagramPoint.Y < point.Y && p2.Y > point.Y) || (diagramPoint.Y > point.Y && p2.Y < point.Y))
					{
						num++;
						num3 = 0.0;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return num % 2 != 0;
		}
	}
	public class RangeControlPainter
	{
		private const double verticalMargin = 0.1;

		private readonly ChartRenderer renderer;

		private readonly RangeControlMapping mapping;

		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private readonly double rangeY;

		private readonly double minY;

		private readonly IRangeControlPaint paint;

		private ChartRenderer Renderer => renderer;

		private XYDiagram2D Diagram => diagram;

		private double RangeY => rangeY;

		private AxisScaleTypeMap AxisXScaleMap => diagram.ActualAxisX.ScaleTypeMap;

		public RangeControlPainter(XYDiagram2D diagram, IRangeControlPaint paint)
		{
			renderer = new ChartRenderer();
			this.paint = paint;
			this.diagram = diagram;
			Axis2D actualAxisX = diagram.ActualAxisX;
			Axis2D actualAxisY = diagram.ActualAxisY;
			mapping = RangeControlMapping.Create(actualAxisX, excludeSideMargins: true);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = FitYRange(Diagram.ViewController.GetAxisRange(actualAxisY));
			rangeY = minMaxValues.Delta;
			minY = minMaxValues.Min;
		}

		private IMinMaxValues FitYRange(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			double num = range.Delta * 0.1;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.5;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(range.Min - num, range.Max + num);
		}

		private double ProjectValue(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase seriesView, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			double num = ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value;
			if (seriesView is FinancialSeriesViewBase)
			{
				switch (seriesView.RangeControlOptions.ValueLevel)
				{
				case ValueLevel.Open:
					num = ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Open;
					break;
				case ValueLevel.Close:
					num = ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Close;
					break;
				case ValueLevel.Low:
					num = ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Low;
					break;
				case ValueLevel.High:
					num = ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).High;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (seriesView is IStackedView)
			{
				num = ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint).MaxValue;
			}
			return MathUtils.StrongRound((double)paint.ContentBounds.Top + ((double)paint.ContentBounds.Height - (num - minY) / RangeY * (double)paint.ContentBounds.Height));
		}

		private void DrawLineSeries(IRefinedSeries series, byte alpha)
		{
			if (!(series.SeriesView is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			PointF? pointF = null;
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(alpha, xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualColor);
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in series.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					PointF pointF2 = default(PointF);
					double value = AxisXScaleMap.InternalToRefined(point.Argument);
					pointF2.X = paint.CalcX(mapping.ValueToNormalValue(value));
					pointF2.Y = (float)ProjectValue(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase, point);
					if (pointF.HasValue)
					{
						Renderer.DrawLine(pointF.Value, pointF2, color, 1);
					}
					pointF = pointF2;
				}
				else
				{
					pointF = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawAreaSeries(IRefinedSeries series, byte alpha)
		{
			if (!(series.SeriesView is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			Color polygonColor = Color.FromArgb(alpha, xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualColor);
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in series.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					double value = AxisXScaleMap.InternalToRefined(point.Argument);
					GRealPoint2D item = new GRealPoint2D(paint.CalcX(mapping.ValueToNormalValue(value)), ProjectValue(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase, point));
					if (lineStrip.IsEmpty)
					{
						lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(item.X, paint.ContentBounds.Bottom));
					}
					lineStrip.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawPolygon(polygonColor, lineStrip);
					lineStrip.Clear();
				}
			}
			DrawPolygon(polygonColor, lineStrip);
		}

		private void DrawPolygon(Color polygonColor, LineStrip polygon)
		{
			if (!polygon.IsEmpty)
			{
				polygon.Add(new GRealPoint2D(polygon[polygon.Count - 1].X, paint.ContentBounds.Bottom));
				Renderer.FillPolygon(polygon, polygonColor);
			}
		}

		private void DrawSeries(IRefinedSeries series, byte alpha)
		{
			XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase = series.SeriesView as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
			switch (xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.RangeControlOptions.ViewType)
			{
			case RangeControlViewType.Area:
				DrawAreaSeries(series, alpha);
				break;
			case RangeControlViewType.Line:
				DrawLineSeries(series, alpha);
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldDrawSeries(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (view != null && view.RangeControlOptions != null && view.RangeControlOptions.Visible)
			{
				if (view.ActualAxisX == Diagram.ActualAxisX)
				{
					return view.ActualAxisY == Diagram.ActualAxisY;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private byte GetSeriesAlpha(int numStacked)
		{
			int num = Diagram.ViewController.ActiveSeriesCount - numStacked;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return (byte)(255.0 / (double)num);
			}
			return byte.MaxValue;
		}

		private byte GetSeriesTransparency(XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view, byte defaultTransparency)
		{
			byte? seriesTransparency = view.RangeControlOptions.SeriesTransparency;
			if (seriesTransparency.HasValue)
			{
				return seriesTransparency.Value;
			}
			return defaultTransparency;
		}

		private void PrepareDrawing()
		{
			GraphicsCacheNativeRenderer nativeRenderer = new GraphicsCacheNativeRenderer(paint.GraphicsCache);
			Renderer.SetNativeRenderer(nativeRenderer);
		}

		private void FinishDrawing()
		{
			Renderer.Present();
		}

		public void Draw()
		{
			PrepareDrawing();
			int num = 0;
			IList<RefinedSeries> activeRefinedSeries = Diagram.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries;
			if (activeRefinedSeries != null)
			{
				for (int num2 = activeRefinedSeries.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = activeRefinedSeries[num2];
					XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase = refinedSeries.SeriesView as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
					if (ShouldDrawSeries(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase) && xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase is IStackedView && xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.RangeControlOptions.ViewType == RangeControlViewType.Area)
					{
						DrawSeries(refinedSeries, GetSeriesTransparency(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase, byte.MaxValue));
						num++;
					}
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < activeRefinedSeries.Count; i++)
				{
					IRefinedSeries refinedSeries2 = activeRefinedSeries[i];
					XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2 = refinedSeries2.SeriesView as XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase;
					if (ShouldDrawSeries(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2) && (!(refinedSeries2.SeriesView is IStackedView) || xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2.RangeControlOptions.ViewType != RangeControlViewType.Area))
					{
						byte defaultTransparency = ((xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2.RangeControlOptions.ViewType == RangeControlViewType.Area) ? GetSeriesAlpha(num) : byte.MaxValue);
						DrawSeries(refinedSeries2, GetSeriesTransparency(xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase2, defaultTransparency));
					}
				}
			}
			FinishDrawing();
		}
	}
	public static class LargeScaleHelper
	{
		private const int mistakeCriterion = 8388600;

		private static bool IsValid(double value)
		{
			if (value <= 8388600.0)
			{
				return value >= -8388600.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValid(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				return IsValid(point.Y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static float ValidateFloat(float value)
		{
			if (!(value > 8388600f))
			{
				if (!(value < -8388600f))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return -8388600f;
			}
			return 8388600f;
		}

		private static int ValidateInt(int value)
		{
			if (value <= 8388600)
			{
				if (value >= -8388600)
				{
					return value;
				}
				return -8388600;
			}
			return 8388600;
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D Validate(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				if (!IsValid(point.Y))
				{
					return new GRealPoint2D(point.X, Validate(point.Y));
				}
				return point;
			}
			if (IsValid(point.Y))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(Validate(point.X), point.Y);
			}
			if (!(Math.Abs(point.X) > Math.Abs(point.Y)))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(point.X * Math.Abs(8388600.0 / point.Y), Validate(point.Y));
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(Validate(point.X), point.Y * Math.Abs(8388600.0 / point.X));
		}

		public static bool IsValid(LineStrip strip)
		{
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in strip)
			{
				if (!IsValid(item))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsValid(List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			foreach (LineStrip strip in strips)
			{
				if (!IsValid(strip))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void Validate(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!IsValid(points[i]))
				{
					points[i] = Validate(points[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle Validate(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			if (!(rect.Width <= 8388600.0) || !(rect.Height <= 8388600.0))
			{
				return new ZPlaneRectangle(rect.Location, Validate(rect.Width), Validate(rect.Height));
			}
			return rect;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint Validate(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				if (!IsValid(point.Y))
				{
					return new DiagramPoint(point.X, Validate(point.Y));
				}
				return point;
			}
			if (IsValid(point.Y))
			{
				return new DiagramPoint(Validate(point.X), point.Y);
			}
			if (!(Math.Abs(point.X) > Math.Abs(point.Y)))
			{
				return new DiagramPoint(point.X * Math.Abs(8388600.0 / point.Y), Validate(point.Y));
			}
			return new DiagramPoint(Validate(point.X), point.Y * Math.Abs(8388600.0 / point.X));
		}

		public static PointF Validate(PointF point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				if (!IsValid(point.Y))
				{
					return new PointF(point.X, ValidateFloat(point.Y));
				}
				return point;
			}
			if (IsValid(point.Y))
			{
				return new PointF(ValidateFloat(point.X), point.Y);
			}
			if (!(Math.Abs(point.X) > Math.Abs(point.Y)))
			{
				return new PointF(point.X * Math.Abs(8388600f / point.Y), ValidateFloat(point.Y));
			}
			return new PointF(ValidateFloat(point.X), point.Y * Math.Abs(8388600f / point.X));
		}

		public static Point Validate(Point point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				if (!IsValid(point.Y))
				{
					return new Point(point.X, ValidateInt(point.Y));
				}
				return point;
			}
			if (IsValid(point.Y))
			{
				return new Point(ValidateInt(point.X), point.Y);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(point.X) <= Math.Abs(point.Y))
			{
				return new Point(point.X * Math.Abs(8388600 / point.Y), ValidateInt(point.Y));
			}
			return new Point(ValidateInt(point.X), point.Y * Math.Abs(8388600 / point.X));
		}

		public static double Validate(double value)
		{
			if (!(value > 8388600.0))
			{
				if (!(value < -8388600.0))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return -8388600.0;
			}
			return 8388600.0;
		}
	}
	public class LocalizableCollectionTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private static DXDisplayNameAttribute defaultAttr = new DXDisplayNameAttribute(typeof(ResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "System.Collections.CollectionBase", "(Collection)");

		public static string DefaultDisplayName => ((DisplayNameAttribute)(object)defaultAttr).DisplayName;

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				DXDisplayNameAttribute customAttribute = ((MemberInfo)value.GetType()).GetCustomAttribute<DXDisplayNameAttribute>();
				if (customAttribute != null)
				{
					return $"({((DisplayNameAttribute)(object)customAttribute).DisplayName})";
				}
				return DefaultDisplayName;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ContainedGraphicsInnerTextMeasurer : IInnerTextMeasurer, IDisposable
	{
		private const float DefaultDpi = 96f;

		private bool canGetFontAscentHeight = true;

		private Bitmap bitmap;

		protected Graphics MeasureGraphics { get; set; }

		protected float Dpi { get; }

		protected abstract bool IsMeasuring { get; }

		bool IInnerTextMeasurer.IsMeasuring => IsMeasuring;

		protected ContainedGraphicsInnerTextMeasurer(float? dpi)
		{
			bool flag = dpi.HasValue && dpi.Value > 0f;
			Dpi = (flag ? dpi.Value : 96f);
			bitmap = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			if (flag)
			{
				bitmap.SetResolution(Dpi, Dpi);
			}
			MeasureGraphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			if (flag)
			{
				MeasureGraphics.PageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			}
		}

		int IInnerTextMeasurer.GetFontAscentHeight(DXFont font)
		{
			return GetFontAscentHeight(font);
		}

		RectangleF IInnerTextMeasurer.MeasureTextCharacterRange(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			return MeasureTextCharacterRange(text, font, stringFormat);
		}

		SizeF IInnerTextMeasurer.MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, int width, DXStringFormat format)
		{
			return MeasureString(text, font, width, format);
		}

		SizeF IInnerTextMeasurer.MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF layoutArea, DXStringFormat stringFormat, out int linesFilled)
		{
			return MeasureString(text, font, layoutArea, stringFormat, out linesFilled);
		}

		void IInnerTextMeasurer.SetTextRenderingHint(TextRenderingHint textHint)
		{
			TextRenderingHintHelper.SetTextRenderingHint(MeasureGraphics, textHint);
		}

		void IInnerTextMeasurer.RestoreTextRenderingHint()
		{
			TextRenderingHintHelper.RestoreDefault(MeasureGraphics);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Dispose();
		}

		protected abstract RectangleF MeasureTextCharacterRange(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat);

		protected abstract SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, int width, DXStringFormat format);

		protected abstract SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF layoutArea, DXStringFormat stringFormat, out int linesFilled);

		private int GetFontAscentHeight(DXFont font)
		{
			try
			{
				if (canGetFontAscentHeight)
				{
					using (Font font2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font))
					{
						return TextUtils.GetFontAscentHeight(MeasureGraphics, font2);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				MeasureGraphics?.Dispose();
				MeasureGraphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
				canGetFontAscentHeight = false;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose()
		{
			MeasureGraphics?.Dispose();
			MeasureGraphics = null;
			bitmap?.Dispose();
			bitmap = null;
		}
	}

		public bool IsMeasuring => false;

		{
		}

		public void SetTextRenderingHint(TextRenderingHint textHint)

		}

	public class InnerGdiTextMeasurer : ContainedGraphicsInnerTextMeasurer
	{
		protected override bool IsMeasuring => false;

		public InnerGdiTextMeasurer(float? dpi)
			: base(dpi)
		{
		}

		protected override RectangleF MeasureTextCharacterRange(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			using StringFormat stringFormat = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(dxStringFormat);
			using Font font2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font);
			stringFormat.SetMeasurableCharacterRanges(new CharacterRange[1]
			{
				new CharacterRange(0, text.Length)
			});
			Region[] array = base.MeasureGraphics.MeasureCharacterRanges(text, font2, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue), stringFormat);
			return array[0].GetBounds(base.MeasureGraphics);
		}

		protected override SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, int width, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			using StringFormat format = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(dxStringFormat);
			using Font font2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font);
			return base.MeasureGraphics.MeasureString(text, font2, width, format);
		}

		protected override SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF layoutArea, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat, out int linesFilled)
		{
			using StringFormat stringFormat = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(dxStringFormat);
			using Font font2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font);
			int charactersFitted;
			return base.MeasureGraphics.MeasureString(text, font2, layoutArea, stringFormat, out charactersFitted, out linesFilled);
		}
	}
	public class InnerPrintingDrawingEngineTextMeasurer : ContainedGraphicsInnerTextMeasurer
	{
		private IMeasurer measurer;

		protected override bool IsMeasuring => false;

		public static InnerPrintingDrawingEngineTextMeasurer TryCreate(float? dpi)
		{
			object customEngine = CustomEngineHelper.GetCustomEngine((Type)null);
			if (customEngine != null)
			{
				IMeasurer val = CustomEngineHelper.GetMeasurer(customEngine);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return new InnerPrintingDrawingEngineTextMeasurer(val, dpi);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private InnerPrintingDrawingEngineTextMeasurer(IMeasurer measurer, float? dpi)
			: base(dpi)
		{
			this.measurer = measurer;
		}

		private SizeF Scale(SizeF size)
		{
			if (base.Dpi > 0f)
			{
				float num = base.Dpi / 96f;
				size = new SizeF(size.Width * num, size.Height * num);
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override RectangleF MeasureTextCharacterRange(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			SizeF size = MeasureString(text, font, int.MaxValue, DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
			return new RectangleF(PointF.Empty, size);
		}

		protected override SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, int width, DXStringFormat format)
		{
			if (measurer == null)
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			return Scale(((IDXMeasurer)measurer).MeasureString(text, font, (float)width, format, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel));
		}

		protected override SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF layoutArea, DXStringFormat stringFormat, out int linesFilled)
		{
			SizeF result = SizeF.Empty;
			linesFilled = 0;
			if (measurer != null)
			{
				result = ((IDXMeasurer)measurer).MeasureString(text, font, layoutArea, stringFormat, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				SizeF sizeF = ((IDXMeasurer)measurer).MeasureString(text, font, SizeF.Empty, stringFormat, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				linesFilled = MathUtils.Ceiling(result.Height / sizeF.Height);
				result = Scale(result);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void Dispose()
		{
			base.Dispose();
			((IDisposable)measurer)?.Dispose();
			measurer = null;
		}
	}
	public static class TextRenderingHintHelper
	{
		private static Font font;

		private static Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				if (font == null)
				{
					font = new Font("Tahoma", 10f);
				}
				return font;
			}
		}

		public static void SetTextRenderingHint(Graphics graphics, TextRenderingHint textRenderingHint)
		{
			graphics.MeasureString(".", Font);
			graphics.TextRenderingHint = textRenderingHint;
		}

		public static void RestoreDefault(Graphics graphics)
		{
			graphics.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.SystemDefault;
		}
	}
	public class AvailableTextBounds
	{
		public enum HeightLimitMode
		{
			MaxHeight,
			MaxLineCount,
			None
		}

		public float MaxWidth { get; } = -1f;

		public float MaxHeight { get; } = -1f;

		public int MaxLineCount { get; } = -1;

		public HeightLimitMode Mode { get; } = HeightLimitMode.None;

		public AvailableTextBounds(float maxWidth)
		{
			if (maxWidth <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			MaxWidth = maxWidth;
		}

		public AvailableTextBounds(float maxWidth, float maxHeight)
			: this(maxWidth)
		{
			if (maxHeight > 0f)
			{
				MaxHeight = maxHeight;
				Mode = HeightLimitMode.MaxHeight;
			}
		}

		public AvailableTextBounds(float maxWidth, int maxLineCount)
			: this(maxWidth)
		{
			if (maxLineCount > 0)
			{
				MaxLineCount = maxLineCount;
				Mode = HeightLimitMode.MaxLineCount;
			}
		}
	}

	{
		DXFont Font { get; }

		Color TextColor { get; }

		DXStringFormat StringFormat { get; }

		AvailableTextBounds AvailableBounds { get; }

		bool ReserveLineBreak { get; }
	}

	{
		public bool ReserveLineBreak { get; set; }

		public DXFont Font { get; set; }

		public Color TextColor { get; set; }

		public DXStringFormat StringFormat { get; set; }

		public AvailableTextBounds AvailableBounds { get; set; }

		public SimpleTextPropertiesProvider(DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			Font = font;
			StringFormat = stringFormat;
		}
	}
	public class TextBlockInfo
	{
		private const int noBreakSpaceCode = 160;

		private bool isEmpty;

		private float redLineOffset;

		private float parentRedLineOffset;

		private string text;

		private Color fontColor;

		private Color backColor;

		private DXFont font;

		private RectangleF? parentBounds;

		private TextBlockLayout layout;

		private List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo> modifiers;

		public bool IsFirstBlock { get; set; }

		public bool IsLastBlock { get; set; }

		public bool IsEmpty => isEmpty;

		public bool IsHyperlink { get; set; }

		public bool HasModifiers
		{
			get
			{
				if (modifiers != null)
				{
					return modifiers.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public float BlockWidth => layout.BlockWidth;

		public float RedLineOffset => redLineOffset;

		public float OffsetAfter => layout.OffsetAfter;

		public float OffsetBefore => layout.OffsetBefore;

		public string Text => text;

		public string Hyperlink { get; set; }

		public Color FontColor => fontColor;

		public Color BackColor => backColor;

		public DXFont Font => font;

		public RectangleF Bounds => layout.RenderBounds;

		public RectangleF FillBounds => layout.GetFillBounds();

		public RectangleF TotalBounds
		{
			get
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(0f, layout.VerticalOffset, layout.RenderSize.Width, layout.RenderSize.Height);
				if (!parentBounds.HasValue)
				{
					return rectangleF;
				}
				return RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, parentBounds.Value);
			}
		}

		public TextBlockInfo(string text, DXFont font, Color fontColor, Color backColor, bool isFirstBlockInLine, bool isLastBlockInLine)
		{
			IsFirstBlock = isFirstBlockInLine;
			IsLastBlock = isLastBlockInLine;
			this.text = text;
			this.fontColor = fontColor;
			this.backColor = backColor;
			this.font = font;
			isEmpty = string.IsNullOrEmpty(text.Trim());
		}

		public TextBlockInfo(TextBlockInfo sourceBlock, string text, bool isFirstBlock, bool isLastBlock)
			: this(text, sourceBlock.font, sourceBlock.fontColor, sourceBlock.backColor, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock)
		{
			IsHyperlink = sourceBlock.IsHyperlink;
			Hyperlink = sourceBlock.Hyperlink;
		}

		internal void SetLayout(TextBlockLayout layout)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
		}

		internal void SetLocation(PointF location)
		{
			layout.SetRenderOrigin(location);
		}

		internal float CalculateTop(float bottom, float lineRedLineOffset)
		{
			if (HasModifiers)
			{
				return bottom - parentBounds.Value.Height - lineRedLineOffset + parentRedLineOffset + layout.VerticalOffset;
			}
			return bottom - Bounds.Height - lineRedLineOffset + redLineOffset;
		}

		internal TextBlockInfo Trim(float maxWidth, string ellipsis, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < Text.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = Text.Substring(0, i + 1);
				TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo2 = new TextBlockInfo(this, text + ellipsis, IsFirstBlock, isLastBlock: false);
				textBlockInfo2.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				if (!(textBlockInfo2.BlockWidth <= maxWidth))
				{
					break;
				}
				textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(this, text, IsFirstBlock, isLastBlock: false);
				textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
			}
			return textBlockInfo;
		}

		internal void SetModifiers(List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo> modifiers)
		{
			this.modifiers = modifiers;
		}

		public void CalculateLayout(IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			DXStringFormat stringFormat = DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic();
			RectangleF textBounds = measurer.MeasureString(Text, Font, stringFormat);
			bool isRTL = (propertiesProvider.StringFormat.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft) != 0;
			layout = TextBlockLayout.Create(isRTL, textBounds, IsFirstBlock, IsLastBlock);
			if (HasModifiers)
			{
				DXFont dXFont = new DXFont(font.Name, modifiers[0].Size + 2f, font.Style);
				parentBounds = measurer.MeasureString(text, dXFont, stringFormat);
				parentRedLineOffset = (redLineOffset = parentBounds.Value.Bottom - measurer.GetFontAscentHeight(dXFont));
				RectangleF value = parentBounds.Value;
				RectangleF rectangleF = value;
				{
					foreach (StringBlockTextModifierInfo modifier in modifiers)
					{
						DXFont dXFont2 = new DXFont(font.Name, modifier.Size, font.Style);
						value = measurer.MeasureString(text, dXFont2, stringFormat);
						if (modifier.Modifier == StringBlockTextModifier.SuperScript)
						{
							value.Offset(0f, rectangleF.Y + 0.5f * rectangleF.Height - value.Height);
						}
						else if (modifier.Modifier == StringBlockTextModifier.SubScript)
						{
							value.Offset(0f, rectangleF.Y + 0.5f * rectangleF.Height);
							redLineOffset += value.Height - 0.5f * rectangleF.Height;
						}
						rectangleF = value;
						layout.VerticalOffset = value.Y;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			redLineOffset = textBounds.Height - measurer.GetFontAscentHeight(font);
		}

		public List<TextBlockInfo> SplitByWords()
		{
			List<TextBlockInfo> list = new List<TextBlockInfo>();
			if (this.text.Length == 1)
			{
				list.Add(this);
			}
			else
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				for (int i = 0; i < this.text.Length; i++)
				{
					bool isFirstBlock = IsFirstBlock && i == 0;
					if (this.text[i] != '\u00a0' && string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.text[i].ToString().Trim()))
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							list.Add(new TextBlockInfo(this, text, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock: false));
						}
						text = string.Empty;
						list.Add(new TextBlockInfo(this, this.text[i].ToString(), isFirstBlock, isLastBlock: false));
					}
					else
					{
						text += this.text[i];
					}
					if (i == this.text.Length - 1 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						list.Add(new TextBlockInfo(this, text, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock: false));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TextBlockLayout
	{
		private readonly RectangleF textBounds;

		private readonly bool isFirstBlock;

		private readonly bool isLastBlock;

		private readonly float blockWidth;

		private readonly float leftPadding;

		private readonly float offsetAfter;

		private readonly float offsetBefore;

		private readonly SizeF renderSize;

		private PointF renderOrigin = new PointF(0f, 0f);

		protected bool IsFirstBlock => isFirstBlock;

		protected bool IsLastBlock => isLastBlock;

		protected RectangleF TextBounds => textBounds;

		protected float LeftPadding => leftPadding;

		public float OffsetAfter => offsetAfter;

		public float OffsetBefore => offsetBefore;

		public float BlockWidth => blockWidth;

		public float VerticalOffset { get; set; }

		public SizeF RenderSize => renderSize;

		public RectangleF RenderBounds => new RectangleF(renderOrigin, renderSize);

		public static TextBlockLayout Create(bool isRTL, RectangleF textBounds, bool isFirstBlock, bool isLastBlock)
		{
			if (isRTL)
			{
				return new RightToLeftTextBlockLayout(textBounds, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock);
			}
			return new LeftToRightTextBlockLayout(textBounds, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock);
		}

		protected TextBlockLayout(RectangleF textBounds, bool isFirstBlock, bool isLastBlock)
		{
			this.textBounds = textBounds;
			this.isFirstBlock = isFirstBlock;
			this.isLastBlock = isLastBlock;
			leftPadding = CalculateLeftPadding();
			blockWidth = CalculateBlockWidth();
			offsetAfter = CalculateOffsetAfter();
			offsetBefore = CalculateOffsetBefore();
			float width = CalculateRenderWidth();
			renderSize = new SizeF(width, textBounds.Height);
		}

		private float CalculateBlockWidth()
		{
			if (isFirstBlock && isLastBlock)
			{
				return TextBounds.Width + 2f * LeftPadding;
			}
			if (isFirstBlock || isLastBlock)
			{
				return TextBounds.Width + LeftPadding;
			}
			return TextBounds.Width;
		}

		private float CalculateOffsetAfter()
		{
			if (IsLastBlock)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			if (IsFirstBlock)
			{
				return TextBounds.Width + LeftPadding;
			}
			return TextBounds.Width;
		}

		protected abstract float CalculateLeftPadding();

		protected abstract float CalculateRenderWidth();

		protected abstract float CalculateOffsetBefore();

		internal void SetRenderOrigin(PointF renderOrigin)
		{
			this.renderOrigin = renderOrigin;
		}

		public abstract RectangleF GetFillBounds();
	}
	internal class LeftToRightTextBlockLayout : TextBlockLayout
	{
		internal LeftToRightTextBlockLayout(RectangleF textBounds, bool isFirstBlock, bool isLastBlock)
			: base(textBounds, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateLeftPadding()
		{
			return base.TextBounds.Left;
		}

		protected override float CalculateRenderWidth()
		{
			if (!base.IsLastBlock)
			{
				return base.TextBounds.Width + base.LeftPadding;
			}
			return base.TextBounds.Width + 2f * base.LeftPadding;
		}

		protected override float CalculateOffsetBefore()
		{
			if (!base.IsFirstBlock)
			{
				return 0f - base.LeftPadding;
			}
			return 0f;
		}

		public override RectangleF GetFillBounds()
		{
			RectangleF renderBounds = base.RenderBounds;
			float height = MathUtils.Ceiling(renderBounds.Height);
			if (base.IsFirstBlock)
			{
				return new RectangleF(renderBounds.Location, new SizeF(renderBounds.Width, height));
			}
			return new RectangleF(renderBounds.X + base.LeftPadding, renderBounds.Y, renderBounds.Width - base.LeftPadding, height);
		}
	}
	internal class RightToLeftTextBlockLayout : TextBlockLayout
	{
		internal RightToLeftTextBlockLayout(RectangleF textBounds, bool isFirstBlock, bool isLastBlock)
			: base(textBounds, isFirstBlock, isLastBlock)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateLeftPadding()
		{
			return 0f - base.TextBounds.Width - base.TextBounds.Left;
		}

		protected override float CalculateRenderWidth()
		{
			if (!base.IsFirstBlock)
			{
				return base.TextBounds.Width + base.LeftPadding;
			}
			return base.TextBounds.Width + 2f * base.LeftPadding;
		}

		protected override float CalculateOffsetBefore()
		{
			return 0f;
		}

		public override RectangleF GetFillBounds()
		{
			RectangleF renderBounds = base.RenderBounds;
			float height = MathUtils.Ceiling(renderBounds.Height);
			if (base.IsLastBlock)
			{
				return new RectangleF(renderBounds.Location, new SizeF(renderBounds.Width, height));
			}
			return new RectangleF(renderBounds.Location, new SizeF(renderBounds.Width - base.LeftPadding, height));
		}
	}
	public class TextLineInfo
	{
		private const string ellipsis = "...";

		private float redLineOffset;

		private float width;

		private float height;

		private float reservedWidth;

		private List<TextBlockInfo> textBlocks = new List<TextBlockInfo>();

		private bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (textBlocks.Count == 1)
				{
					return textBlocks[0].IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public float RedLineOffset => redLineOffset;

		public float Width => width;

		public float Height => height;

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (TextBlocks.Count == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (TextBlocks.Count == 1)
				{
					return TextBlocks[0].Text;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				StringInfo.AppendLine(stringBuilder, this);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public List<TextBlockInfo> TextBlocks => textBlocks;

		public TextLineInfo()
			: this(0f)
		{
		}

		public TextLineInfo(float reservedWidth)
		{
			this.reservedWidth = reservedWidth;
		}

		private void AddLine(List<TextLineInfo> lines, List<TextBlockInfo> lineBlocks)
		{
			TextLineInfo textLineInfo = new TextLineInfo();
			textLineInfo.TextBlocks.AddRange(lineBlocks);
			if (textLineInfo.TextBlocks.Count > 0)
			{
				textLineInfo.TextBlocks[textLineInfo.textBlocks.Count - 1].IsLastBlock = true;
				lines.Add(textLineInfo);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveEmptyBlocks(List<TextBlockInfo> blocks)
		{
			int num = blocks.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && blocks[num].IsEmpty)
			{
				blocks.RemoveAt(num);
				num--;
			}
		}

		private List<TextBlockInfo> WrapWord(TextBlockInfo textBlock, float maxWidth, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			List<TextBlockInfo> list = new List<TextBlockInfo>();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < textBlock.Text.Length)
			{
				bool flag = num2 == textBlock.Text.Length - 1;
				string text = textBlock.Text.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1);
				TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(textBlock, text, isFirstBlock: true, isLastBlock: true);
				textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				if (textBlockInfo.BlockWidth > maxWidth)
				{
					textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(textBlock, textBlock.Text.Substring(num, Math.Max(1, num2 - num)), isFirstBlock: true, isLastBlock: true);
					textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
					list.Add(textBlockInfo);
					num = ((num2 != num) ? num2 : (num2 + 1));
				}
				else if (flag && num <= num2)
				{
					textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(textBlock, textBlock.Text.Substring(num, Math.Max(1, textBlock.Text.Length - num)), isFirstBlock: true, isLastBlock: false);
					textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
					list.Add(textBlockInfo);
					num2++;
				}
				else
				{
					num2++;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void Trim(float maxWidth, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			if (textBlocks.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = reservedWidth;
			TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = null;
			List<TextBlockInfo> list = new List<TextBlockInfo>();
			foreach (TextBlockInfo textBlock in textBlocks)
			{
				textBlock.IsLastBlock = false;
				float num2 = maxWidth - num;
				float blockWidth = textBlock.BlockWidth;
				textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(textBlock, "...", isFirstBlock: false, isLastBlock: true);
				textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				float blockWidth2 = textBlockInfo.BlockWidth;
				if (num2 >= blockWidth2 + blockWidth)
				{
					num += blockWidth;
					list.Add(textBlock);
					continue;
				}
				TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo2 = textBlock.Trim(num2, "...", propertiesProvider, measurer);
				if (textBlockInfo2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(textBlockInfo2);
				}
				break;
			}
			RemoveEmptyBlocks(list);
			list.Add(textBlockInfo);
			textBlocks = list;
		}

		public void Calculate(IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			redLineOffset = (width = (height = 0f));
			RectangleF a = RectangleF.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < textBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = textBlocks[i];
				textBlockInfo.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					a = textBlockInfo.TotalBounds;
					redLineOffset = textBlockInfo.RedLineOffset;
				}
				else
				{
					a = RectangleF.Union(a, textBlockInfo.TotalBounds);
					if (redLineOffset < textBlockInfo.RedLineOffset)
					{
						redLineOffset = textBlockInfo.RedLineOffset;
					}
				}
				width += textBlockInfo.BlockWidth;
			}
			height = a.Height;
		}

		public List<TextLineInfo> Wrap(float maxWidth, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			List<TextLineInfo> list = new List<TextLineInfo>();
			List<TextBlockInfo> list2 = new List<TextBlockInfo>();
			foreach (TextBlockInfo textBlock in textBlocks)
			{
				List<TextBlockInfo> list3 = textBlock.SplitByWords();
				foreach (TextBlockInfo item in list3)
				{
					item.CalculateLayout(propertiesProvider, measurer);
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (list2.Count > 0)
			{
				list2[0].IsFirstBlock = true;
				list2[list2.Count - 1].IsLastBlock = true;
			}
			List<TextBlockInfo> list4 = new List<TextBlockInfo>();
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (TextBlockInfo item2 in list2)
			{
				float blockWidth = item2.BlockWidth;
				float num2 = maxWidth - num;
				if (blockWidth <= num2)
				{
					num += blockWidth;
					list4.Add(item2);
					continue;
				}
				if (list4.Count > 0)
				{
					AddLine(list, list4);
					list4.Clear();
				}
				if (blockWidth > maxWidth)
				{
					List<TextBlockInfo> list5 = WrapWord(item2, maxWidth, propertiesProvider, measurer);
					if (list5.Count > 0)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < list5.Count - 1; i++)
						{
							AddLine(list, new List<TextBlockInfo> { list5[i] });
						}
						TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = list5[list5.Count - 1];
						num = textBlockInfo.BlockWidth;
						list4.Add(textBlockInfo);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list4.Add(item2);
					item2.IsFirstBlock = true;
					num = item2.BlockWidth;
				}
			}
			if (list4.Count > 0)
			{
				AddLine(list, list4);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				if ((j == 0 || j == list.Count - 1 || !list[j + 1].IsEmpty) && list[j].IsEmpty)
				{
					list.RemoveAt(j);
					j--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public static class ImageResourcesUtils
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, SvgBitmap> svgImagesCache = new Dictionary<string, SvgBitmap>();

		public static string ImagePath => "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Images.";

		public static string WizardImagePath => "DevExpress.XtraCharts.Design.Wizard.Images.";

		public static string SvgImagePath => "DevExpress.XtraCharts.SvgImages.";

		private static Assembly Assembly => Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ImageResourcesUtils));

		private static SvgBitmap GetSvgBitmapFromResources(string path)
		{
			if (!svgImagesCache.TryGetValue(path, out var value))
			{
				try
				{
					Assembly assembly = Assembly;
					using (Stream stream = ResourceImageHelperCore.FindStream(path, assembly))
					{
						value = SvgBitmap.FromStream(stream);
					}
					lock (svgImagesCache)
					{
						svgImagesCache.Add(path, value);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					value = null;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static Image GetImageFromResources(SeriesViewBase view, SeriesViewImageType imageType)
		{
			try
			{
				Assembly assembly = Assembly;
				return imageType switch
				{
					SeriesViewImageType.Image => ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(ImagePath + view.ImageNameBase.ToLower() + ".png", assembly), 
					SeriesViewImageType.SmallImage => ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(ImagePath + view.ImageNameBase.ToLower() + "_s.png", assembly), 
					SeriesViewImageType.WizardImage => ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(WizardImagePath + view.ImageNameBase.ToLower() + ".png", assembly), 
					_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
				};
			}
			catch
			{
				return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(WizardImagePath + "empty.png", Assembly);
			}
		}

		public static SvgImage GetImageFromResources(SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateSvgImageFromResources(SvgImagePath + "SeriesView." + view.ImageNameBase + ".svg", Assembly);
		}

		public static Image GetImageFromResources(AnnotationShapePosition position)
		{
			Type type = position.GetType();
			Assembly assembly = Assembly;
			if (type == typeof(RelativePosition))
			{
				return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationRelativePosition.png", assembly);
			}
			if (type == typeof(FreePosition))
			{
				return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationFreePosition.png", assembly);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Image GetImageFromResources(AnnotationAnchorPoint point, bool isEnabledImage)
		{
			Type type = point.GetType();
			Assembly assembly = Assembly;
			if (isEnabledImage)
			{
				if (type == typeof(ChartAnchorPoint))
				{
					return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationChartAnchorPoint.png", assembly);
				}
				if (type == typeof(SeriesPointAnchorPoint))
				{
					return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPoint.png", assembly);
				}
				if (type == typeof(PaneAnchorPoint))
				{
					return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationPaneAnchorPoint.png", assembly);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (type == typeof(ChartAnchorPoint))
				{
					return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationChartAnchorPoint.png", assembly);
				}
				if (type == typeof(SeriesPointAnchorPoint))
				{
					return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPoint_Disabled.png", assembly);
				}
				if (type == typeof(PaneAnchorPoint))
				{
					return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateImageFromResources(ImagePath + "AnnotationPaneAnchorPoint_Disabled.png", assembly);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Image GetImageFromResources(Indicator indicator, bool isSmallImage)
		{
			Assembly assembly = Assembly;
			string text = ((indicator is FibonacciIndicator { Kind: var kind }) ? kind.ToString() : indicator.GetType().Name);
			text = text.ToLower();
			text += (isSmallImage ? "_s.png" : ".png");
			return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(ImagePath + text, assembly);
		}

		public static Image GetImageFromResources(AnnotationType annotationType)
		{
			Assembly assembly = Assembly;
			string text;
			switch (annotationType)
			{
			case AnnotationType.Image:
				text = "ImageAnnotation.png";
				break;
			case AnnotationType.Text:
				text = "TextAnnotation.png";
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown annotation type: " + annotationType);
				return null;
			}
			return ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(ImagePath + text, assembly);
		}

		public static SvgImage GetImageFromDesignerResources(AnnotationType annotationType)
		{
			string text;
			switch (annotationType)
			{
			case AnnotationType.Image:
				text = "ImageAnnotation.svg";
				break;
			case AnnotationType.Text:
				text = "TextAnnotation.svg";
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown annotation type: " + annotationType);
				return null;
			}

		}

	public static class ScaleTypeUtils
	{
		public static string GetName(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.Qualitative => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ScaleTypeQualitative), 
				ScaleType.Numerical => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ScaleTypeNumerical), 
				ScaleType.DateTime => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ScaleTypeDateTime), 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ScaleTypeTimeSpan), 
				ScaleType.Auto => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ScaleTypeAuto), 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		public static Scale GetScaleByType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return Scale.Auto;
			}
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsDateTimeType(type))
			{
				return Scale.DateTime;
			}
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type))
			{
				return Scale.Numerical;
			}
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsTimeSpanType(type))
			{
				return Scale.TimeSpan;
			}
			return Scale.Qualitative;
		}

		public static ActualScaleType ScaleTypeToActualScaleType(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			return ScaleToActualScaleType((Scale)scaleType);
		}

		public static ActualScaleType ScaleToActualScaleType(Scale scale)
		{
			return scale switch
			{
				Scale.Numerical => ActualScaleType.Numerical, 
				Scale.DateTime => ActualScaleType.DateTime, 
				Scale.TimeSpan => ActualScaleType.TimeSpan, 
				Scale.Qualitative => ActualScaleType.Qualitative, 
				_ => ActualScaleType.Numerical, 
			};
		}
	}
