	public static class SeriesScaleTypeUtils
	{
		public static void CheckScaleTypes(SeriesBase series, SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (series.View == null || !(series.View.GetType() == view.GetType()))
			{
				if (series.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal != ScaleType.Numerical && !view.NonNumericArgumentSupported)
				{
					series.ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(ScaleType.Numerical, allowEmptyDataSource: false);
				}
				if ((series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan) && !view.DateTimeValuesSupported)
				{
					series.ValidatePointsByValueScaleType(ScaleType.Numerical);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateScaleTypes(SeriesBase series, SeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (series.ArgumentScaleType != ScaleType.Numerical && !view.NonNumericArgumentSupported)
			{
				series.SetArgumentScaleType(ScaleType.Numerical);
			}
			if (!view.DateTimeValuesSupported && (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan))
			{
				series.ValueScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			}
		}

		public static bool ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(SeriesBase series, ScaleType argumentScaleType, bool allowEmptyDataSource, bool throwException = true)
		{
			return series.ValidatePointsByArgumentScaleType(argumentScaleType, allowEmptyDataSource, throwException);
		}

		public static void ValidatePointsByValueScaleType(SeriesBase series, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			series.ValidatePointsByValueScaleType(valueScaleType);
		}
	}
	public class StringInfo
	{
		private List<TextLineInfo> lines = new List<TextLineInfo>();

		private SizeF size;

		public List<TextLineInfo> Lines => lines;

		public SizeF Size => size;

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (lines.Count == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (lines.Count == 1)
				{
					return lines[0].Text;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				AppendLine(stringBuilder, lines[0]);
				for (int i = 1; i < lines.Count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
					AppendLine(stringBuilder, lines[i]);
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public static void AppendLine(StringBuilder stringBuilder, TextLineInfo line)
		{
			foreach (TextBlockInfo textBlock in line.TextBlocks)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(textBlock.Text);
			}
		}

		public StringInfo(string text, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			SplitLines(text, propertiesProvider, measurer);
			Arrange(propertiesProvider, measurer);
			if (propertiesProvider.AvailableBounds == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			float maxWidth = propertiesProvider.AvailableBounds.MaxWidth;
			if ((propertiesProvider.StringFormat.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap) == 0)
			{
				WrapLines(maxWidth, propertiesProvider, measurer);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (TextLineInfo line in lines)
				{
					if (line.Width > maxWidth)
					{
						line.Trim(maxWidth, propertiesProvider, measurer);
					}
				}
			}
			Arrange(propertiesProvider, measurer);
			switch (propertiesProvider.AvailableBounds.Mode)
			{
			case AvailableTextBounds.HeightLimitMode.MaxHeight:
			{
				float maxHeight = propertiesProvider.AvailableBounds.MaxHeight;
				if (!(maxHeight < size.Height))
				{
					break;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
				{
					if (num + (double)lines[i].Height < (double)maxHeight)
					{
						num += (double)lines[i].Height;
						continue;
					}
					num2 = i;
					break;
				}
				lines.RemoveRange(num2, lines.Count - num2);
				if (lines.Count > 0)
				{
					lines[lines.Count - 1].Trim(maxWidth, propertiesProvider, measurer);
				}
				Arrange(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				break;
			}
			case AvailableTextBounds.HeightLimitMode.MaxLineCount:
			{
				int maxLineCount = propertiesProvider.AvailableBounds.MaxLineCount;
				if (maxLineCount > 0 && maxLineCount < lines.Count)
				{
					lines.RemoveRange(maxLineCount, lines.Count - maxLineCount);
					if (lines.Count > 0)
					{
						lines[lines.Count - 1].Trim(maxWidth, propertiesProvider, measurer);
					}
					Arrange(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void WrapLines(float maxWidth, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			List<TextLineInfo> list = new List<TextLineInfo>();
			foreach (TextLineInfo line in lines)
			{
				if (line.Width > maxWidth)
				{
					list.AddRange(line.Wrap(maxWidth, propertiesProvider, measurer));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(line);
				}
			}
			lines = list;
		}

		private void SplitLines(string text, IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			DXFont font = propertiesProvider.Font;
			List<StringBlock> list = StringParser.Parse(font.Size, text, allowNewLineSymbols: true);
			float reservedWidth = (propertiesProvider.ReserveLineBreak ? measurer.MeasureString(Environment.NewLine, font, propertiesProvider.StringFormat).Width : 0f);
			TextLineInfo textLineInfo = new TextLineInfo(reservedWidth);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0 && list[i].LineNumber != list[i - 1].LineNumber)
				{
					lines.Add(textLineInfo);
					textLineInfo = new TextLineInfo(reservedWidth);
				}
				textLineInfo.TextBlocks.Add(CalculateTextBlockInfo(list, i, propertiesProvider.TextColor, propertiesProvider.Font));
			}
			lines.Add(textLineInfo);
		}

		private TextBlockInfo CalculateTextBlockInfo(List<StringBlock> stringBlocks, int currentIndex, Color elementTextColor, DXFont elementFont)
		{
			StringBlock stringBlock = stringBlocks[currentIndex];
			Color fontColor = (stringBlock.FontSettings.Color.IsEmpty ? elementTextColor : stringBlock.FontSettings.Color);
			Color backColor = stringBlock.FontSettings.BackColor;
			DXFont font = CalculateTextBlockFont(elementFont, stringBlock);
			bool isFirstBlockInLine = currentIndex == 0 || stringBlocks[currentIndex - 1].LineNumber != stringBlocks[currentIndex].LineNumber;
			bool isLastBlockInLine = currentIndex == stringBlocks.Count - 1 || stringBlocks[currentIndex].LineNumber != stringBlocks[currentIndex + 1].LineNumber;
			TextBlockInfo textBlockInfo = new TextBlockInfo(stringBlock.Text, font, fontColor, backColor, isFirstBlockInLine, isLastBlockInLine);
			if (stringBlock.FontSettings != null && stringBlock.FontSettings.HasModifiers)
			{
				textBlockInfo.SetModifiers(stringBlock.FontSettings.Modifiers);
			}
			textBlockInfo.IsHyperlink = stringBlock.Type == StringBlockType.Link;
			textBlockInfo.Hyperlink = stringBlock.Link;
			return textBlockInfo;
		}

		private DXFont CalculateTextBlockFont(DXFont elementFont, StringBlock currentBlock)
		{
			DXFontStyle style = elementFont.Style | currentBlock.FontSettings.Style;
			string name = currentBlock.FontSettings.FontFamily ?? elementFont.Name;
			return new DXFont(name, currentBlock.FontSettings.Size, style, elementFont.Unit);
		}

		private void Arrange(IDXTextPropertiesProvider propertiesProvider, ITextMeasurer measurer)
		{
			DXStringAlignment alignment = propertiesProvider.StringFormat.Alignment;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			foreach (TextLineInfo line in lines)
			{
				line.Calculate(propertiesProvider, measurer);
				num2 += line.Height;
				if (num < line.Width)
				{
					num = line.Width;
				}
			}
			size = new SizeF(num, num2);
			float num3 = (0f - size.Height) * 0.5f;
			foreach (TextLineInfo line2 in lines)
			{
				num3 += line2.Height;
				float num4 = CalculateLineLeft(line2, alignment);
				foreach (TextBlockInfo textBlock in line2.TextBlocks)
				{
					float y = textBlock.CalculateTop(num3, line2.RedLineOffset);
					num4 = (float)Math.Round(num4);
					textBlock.SetLocation(new PointF(num4 + textBlock.OffsetBefore, y));
					num4 += textBlock.OffsetAfter;
				}
			}
		}

		private float CalculateLineLeft(TextLineInfo line, DXStringAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => (0f - line.Width) * 0.5f, 
				DXStringAlignment.Near => (0f - size.Width) * 0.5f, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => size.Width * 0.5f - line.Width, 
				_ => 0f, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class StringCacheItem
	{
		public int FontHash { get; set; }

		public string String { get; set; }

		public TextRenderingHint TextRenderingHint { get; set; }

		public StringCacheItem(string text, int fontHash, TextRenderingHint textRenderingHint)
		{
			String = text;
			FontHash = fontHash;
			TextRenderingHint = textRenderingHint;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is StringCacheItem stringCacheItem))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (String.Equals(stringCacheItem.String) && FontHash.Equals(stringCacheItem.FontHash))
			{
				return TextRenderingHint.Equals(stringCacheItem.TextRenderingHint);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, int, int>(String, FontHash, (int)TextRenderingHint);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return String + FontHash + TextRenderingHint;
		}
	}
	public class StringSizeCache : IDisposable
	{
		private Dictionary<StringCacheItem, SizeF> sizeCache = new Dictionary<StringCacheItem, SizeF>();

		private static int CalculateFontHash(DXFont font)
		{
			return font.Name.GetHashCode() ^ font.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void Add(string text, DXFont font, TextRenderingHint textHint, SizeF size)
		{
			sizeCache.Add(new StringCacheItem(text, CalculateFontHash(font), textHint), size);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			sizeCache.Clear();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Clear();
			sizeCache = null;
		}

		public SizeF? Get(string text, DXFont font, TextRenderingHint textHint)
		{
			if (sizeCache.TryGetValue(new StringCacheItem(text, CalculateFontHash(font), textHint), out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public static class StripLimitsUtils
	{
		public static bool CheckLimits(Axis2D axis, object minAxisValue, object maxAxisValue)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (axis == null || minAxisValue == null || maxAxisValue == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					double difference = DateTimeUtils.GetDifference(axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.GetActualMeasureUnit(), (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.GetActualGridAlignment(), Convert.ToDateTime(minAxisValue), Convert.ToDateTime(maxAxisValue), axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions);
					return difference >= 0.0;
				}
				if (axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
				{
					return Convert.ToDouble(minAxisValue) <= Convert.ToDouble(maxAxisValue);
				}
				if (axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
				{
					return (TimeSpan)minAxisValue <= (TimeSpan)maxAxisValue;
				}
				if (axis.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
				{
					double num = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(minAxisValue);
					double num2 = axis.ScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(maxAxisValue);
					if (double.IsNaN(num) && double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						return string.Compare(minAxisValue.ToString(), maxAxisValue.ToString()) != 0;
					}
					return double.IsNaN(num2) || num < 0.0 || double.IsNaN(num) || num2 < 0.0 || num <= num2;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public interface ITextMeasurer
	{
		bool RTL { get; }

		float GetFontAscentHeight(DXFont font);

		RectangleF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat);
	}
	public class TextMeasurer : ITextMeasurer, IDisposable
	{
		public enum TextMeasuringMode
		{
			Strict,
			Fast
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static TextMeasurer measurerInstance;

		private static Type directXMeasurerType;

		private const float TabStop = 20f;

		private IInnerTextMeasurer measurerCore;

		private StringSizeCache textSizeCache;

		private WeakReference<IChartDpiProvider> dpiProvider;

		private bool isAddingToCache;

		public static TextMeasurer Default
		{
			get
			{
				if (measurerInstance == null)
				{
					RecreateDefault();
				}
				return measurerInstance;
			}
		}

		public bool RTL { get; }

		public TextMeasuringMode Mode { get; set; }

		public IChartDpiProvider DPIProvider
		{
			get
			{
				IChartDpiProvider target = null;
				dpiProvider?.TryGetTarget(out target);
				return target;
			}
			set
			{
				if (DPIProvider != value)
				{
					dpiProvider = new WeakReference<IChartDpiProvider>(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsMeasuring => measurerCore.IsMeasuring;

		public static void RegisterDirectXMeasurer(Type measurerType)
		{
			directXMeasurerType = measurerType;
		}

		public static void RecreateDefault(IChartDpiProvider dpiProvider = null, float? dpi = null, bool isRightToLeft = false, bool isDirectXRendering = false)
		{
			measurerInstance?.Dispose();
			measurerInstance = new TextMeasurer(isDirectXRendering, dpi, isRightToLeft, dpiProvider);
		}

		public static DXStringFormat CreateFormatWithTabs()
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat();
			dXStringFormat.TabStops = new float[1] { 20f };
			return dXStringFormat;
		}

		public TextMeasurer(bool isDirectXRendering, float? dpi, bool isRightToLeft, IChartDpiProvider dpiProvider)
		{
			measurerCore = CreateInnerMeasurer(isDirectXRendering, dpi);
			RTL = isRightToLeft;
			if (dpiProvider != null)
			{
				this.dpiProvider = new WeakReference<IChartDpiProvider>(dpiProvider);
			}
			textSizeCache = new StringSizeCache();
		}

		float ITextMeasurer.GetFontAscentHeight(DXFont font)
		{
			return measurerCore.GetFontAscentHeight(font);
		}

		RectangleF ITextMeasurer.MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			TextMeasuringMode mode = Mode;
			if (mode != TextMeasuringMode.Strict && mode == TextMeasuringMode.Fast)
			{
				return MeasureFast(text, font);
			}
			return MeasureStrict(text, font);
		}

		private IInnerTextMeasurer CreateInnerMeasurer(bool isDirectXRendering, float? dpi)
		{
			if (isDirectXRendering)
			{
				return (IInnerTextMeasurer)Activator.CreateInstance(directXMeasurerType, dpi);
			}
			return DrawingUtils.CreateInnerTextMeasurer(dpi);
		}

		private DXFont ScaleFont(DXFont font)
		{
			return DPIProvider?.ScaleFont(font) ?? font;
		}

		private RectangleF MeasureFast(string text, DXFont font)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = MeasureString(text, font);
			SizeF sizeF2 = MeasureStringTypographic(text, font);
			float height = sizeF.Height;
			float width = sizeF2.Width;
			float num = (sizeF.Width - sizeF2.Width) / 2f;
			float x = (RTL ? (0f - sizeF.Width) : num);
			return new RectangleF(x, 0f, width + num, height);
		}

		private RectangleF MeasureStrict(string text, DXFont font)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = CreateFormatWithTabs();
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces;
			if (RTL)
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft;
			}
			SizeF dirtySize;
			return MeasureStringBounds(text, font, dXStringFormat, out dirtySize);
		}

		private SizeF MeasureStringTypographic(string str, DXFont font)
		{
			DXStringFormat format = DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic();
			return measurerCore.MeasureString(str, ScaleFont(font), int.MaxValue, format);
		}

		private RectangleF MeasureStringBounds(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat, out SizeF dirtySize)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				dirtySize = default(SizeF);
				return default(RectangleF);
			}
			if (text.Length > 32000)
			{
				string text2 = text.Substring(0, 16000);
				string text3 = text.Substring(16000);
				SizeF dirtySize2 = default(SizeF);
				RectangleF rectangleF = MeasureStringBounds(text2, font, stringFormat, out dirtySize2);
				SizeF dirtySize3 = default(SizeF);
				RectangleF rectangleF2 = MeasureStringBounds(text3, font, stringFormat, out dirtySize3);
				dirtySize = new SizeF(dirtySize2.Width + dirtySize3.Width, Math.Max(dirtySize2.Height, dirtySize3.Height));
				return new RectangleF(rectangleF.Location, new SizeF(rectangleF.Width + rectangleF2.X + rectangleF2.Width, Math.Max(rectangleF.Height, rectangleF2.Height)));
			}
			dirtySize = measurerCore.MeasureString(text, ScaleFont(font), int.MaxValue, stringFormat);
			RectangleF rectangleF3 = measurerCore.MeasureTextCharacterRange(text, ScaleFont(font), stringFormat);
			return new RectangleF(rectangleF3.Location, new SizeF(rectangleF3.Width, dirtySize.Height));
		}

		private SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			SizeF dirtySize;
			RectangleF rectangleF = MeasureStringBounds(text, font, stringFormat, out dirtySize);
			float width = Math.Max(rectangleF.Width + rectangleF.Left * 2f, dirtySize.Width);
			return new SizeF(width, rectangleF.Height);
		}

		internal SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, TextRenderingHint textHint)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			SizeF? sizeF = textSizeCache.Get(text, ScaleFont(font), textHint);
			if (sizeF.HasValue)
			{
				return sizeF.Value;
			}
			lock (textSizeCache)
			{
				sizeF = textSizeCache.Get(text, ScaleFont(font), textHint);
				if (sizeF.HasValue)
				{
					return sizeF.Value;
				}
				if (isAddingToCache)
				{
					throw new Exception();
				}
				isAddingToCache = true;
				SetTextRenderingHint(textHint);
				DXStringFormat stringFormat = CreateFormatWithTabs();
				SizeF sizeF2 = MeasureString(text, font, stringFormat);
				textSizeCache.Add(text, ScaleFont(font), textHint, sizeF2);
				isAddingToCache = false;
				RestoreTextRenderingHint();
				return sizeF2;
			}
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingProvider)
		{
			return MeasureString(text, font, AntialiasingSupport.GetRenderHint(antialiasingProvider));
		}

		public Size MeasureStringRounded(string text, DXFont font, ISupportTextAntialiasing antialiasingProvider)
		{
			return Size.Round(MeasureString(text, font, antialiasingProvider));
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string str, DXFont font, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = CreateFormatWithTabs();
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)alignment;
			dXStringFormat.LineAlignment = (DXStringAlignment)lineAlignment;
			return measurerCore.MeasureString(str, ScaleFont(font), 10000, dXStringFormat);
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string str, DXFont font, int width, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment, out int linesFilled)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = CreateFormatWithTabs();
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)alignment;
			dXStringFormat.LineAlignment = (DXStringAlignment)lineAlignment;
			return measurerCore.MeasureString(str, ScaleFont(font), new SizeF(width, float.MaxValue), dXStringFormat, out linesFilled);
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string str, DXFont font)
		{
			DXStringFormat format = CreateFormatWithTabs();
			return measurerCore.MeasureString(str, ScaleFont(font), int.MaxValue, format);
		}

		public void SetTextRenderingHint(TextRenderingHint textHint)
		{
			measurerCore.SetTextRenderingHint(textHint);
		}

		public void RestoreTextRenderingHint()
		{
			measurerCore.RestoreTextRenderingHint();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			measurerCore.Dispose();
			measurerCore = null;
			if (this == measurerInstance)
			{
				measurerInstance = null;
			}
			textSizeCache?.Dispose();
			textSizeCache = null;
		}
	}
	public enum LineKind
	{
		Line,
		Segment,
		Ray
	}
	public class TruncatedLineCalculator
	{
		private static bool BothIsInfinity(double x1, double x2)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(x1))
			{
				return double.IsInfinity(x2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static GRealLine2D? Truncate(GRealLine2D line, Rectangle bounds, LineKind lineKind)
		{
			double num = line.End.X - line.Start.X;
			double num2 = line.End.Y - line.Start.Y;
			if ((num == 0.0 && num2 == 0.0) || BothIsInfinity(line.End.X, line.Start.X) || BothIsInfinity(line.End.Y, line.Start.Y))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num3;
			double num4;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2;
			if (Math.Abs(num) > Math.Abs(num2))
			{
				num3 = ((double)bounds.Left - line.Start.X) / num;
				num4 = ((double)bounds.Right - line.Start.X) / num;
				double num5 = line.Start.Y + num2 * num3;
				double num6 = line.Start.Y + num2 * num4;
				if ((num5 < (double)bounds.Top && num6 < (double)bounds.Top) || (num5 > (double)bounds.Bottom && num6 > (double)bounds.Bottom))
				{
					return null;
				}
				gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, num5);
				gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right, num6);
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = ((double)bounds.Top - line.Start.Y) / num2;
				num4 = ((double)bounds.Bottom - line.Start.Y) / num2;
				double num7 = line.Start.X + num * num3;
				double num8 = line.Start.X + num * num4;
				if ((num7 < (double)bounds.Left && num8 < (double)bounds.Left) || (num7 > (double)bounds.Right && num8 > (double)bounds.Right))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(num2))
				{
					gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(num7, bounds.Bottom);
					gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(num8, bounds.Top);
				}
				else
				{
					gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(num7, bounds.Top);
					gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(num8, bounds.Bottom);
				}
			}
			switch (lineKind)
			{
			case LineKind.Line:
				return new GRealLine2D(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2);
			case LineKind.Ray:
				if (num3 < 0.0 && num4 < 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new GRealLine2D((num3 >= 0.0) ? gRealPoint2D : line.Start, (num4 >= 0.0) ? gRealPoint2D2 : line.Start);
			case LineKind.Segment:
			{
				if ((num3 < 0.0 && num4 < 0.0) || (num3 > 1.0 && num4 > 1.0))
				{
					return null;
				}
				GRealPoint2D start = ((num3 < 0.0) ? line.Start : ((!(num3 <= 1.0)) ? line.End : gRealPoint2D));
				GRealPoint2D end = ((num4 < 0.0) ? line.Start : ((!(num4 <= 1.0)) ? line.End : gRealPoint2D2));
				return new GRealLine2D(start, end);
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown line kind.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static GRealLine2D? Truncate(DiagramPoint start, DiagramPoint end, Rectangle bounds, LineKind lineKind)
		{
			return Truncate(new GRealLine2D(new GRealPoint2D(start.X, start.Y), new GRealPoint2D(end.X, end.Y)), bounds, lineKind);
		}

		public static GRealLine2D? Truncate(GRealPoint2D start, GRealPoint2D end, Rectangle bounds, LineKind lineKind)
		{
			return Truncate(new GRealLine2D(start, end), bounds, lineKind);
		}

		public static List<LineStrip> SplitLineStrip(LineStrip strip, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			List<LineStrip> list = new List<LineStrip>();
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = strip[0];
			int count = strip.Count;
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = gRealPoint2D;
				gRealPoint2D = strip[i];
				Point pt = new Point((int)Math.Round(gRealPoint2D2.X), (int)Math.Round(gRealPoint2D2.Y));
				Point pt2 = new Point((int)Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.X), (int)Math.Round(gRealPoint2D.Y));
				if (bounds.Contains(pt) && bounds.Contains(pt2))
				{
					lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(gRealPoint2D2);
					lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(gRealPoint2D);
					continue;
				}
				GRealLine2D? gRealLine2D = Truncate(new GRealLine2D(gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D), bounds, LineKind.Segment);
				if (gRealLine2D.HasValue)
				{
					GRealLine2D value = gRealLine2D.Value;
					if (bounds.Contains(pt))
					{
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(gRealPoint2D2);
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint((gRealPoint2D2 == value.Start) ? value.End : value.Start);
						continue;
					}
					if (bounds.Contains(pt2))
					{
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint((gRealPoint2D == value.Start) ? value.End : value.Start);
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(gRealPoint2D);
						continue;
					}
					double num = value.Start.X - gRealPoint2D2.X;
					double num2 = value.Start.Y - gRealPoint2D2.Y;
					double num3 = value.End.X - gRealPoint2D2.X;
					double num4 = value.End.Y - gRealPoint2D2.Y;
					if (num * num + num2 * num2 < num3 * num3 + num4 * num4)
					{
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(value.Start);
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(value.End);
					}
					else
					{
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(value.End);
						lineStrip.AddUniquePoint(value.Start);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (lineStrip.Count > 1)
					{
						list.Add(lineStrip);
					}
					lineStrip = new LineStrip();
				}
			}
			if (lineStrip.Count > 1)
			{
				list.Add(lineStrip);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public sealed class ZExtendedCalculator
	{
		private static void CalcBackAndFore(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, double depth, out List<DiagramPoint> backContour, out List<DiagramPoint> foreContour)
		{
			backContour = new List<DiagramPoint>(contour.Count);
			foreContour = new List<DiagramPoint>(contour.Count);
			double num = depth / 2.0;
			foreach (DiagramPoint item in contour)
			{
				backContour.Add(DiagramPoint.Offset(item, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - num));
				foreContour.Add(DiagramPoint.Offset(item, 0.0, 0.0, num));
			}
		}

		private static void CalcVerticesNormals(IList<PlanePolygon> envelope)
		{
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = envelope[envelope.Count - 1];
			foreach (PlanePolygon item in envelope)
			{
				item.SameNormals = false;
				DiagramVector normal = planePolygon.Normal + item.Normal;
				normal.Normalize();
				planePolygon.Vertices[2].Normal = normal;
				planePolygon.Vertices[3].Normal = normal;
				item.Vertices[0].Normal = normal;
				item.Vertices[1].Normal = normal;
				planePolygon = item;
			}
		}

		private static List<PlanePolygon> CalculateEnvelope(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, double depth, bool curving, Color color, int polygonWeight)
		{
			if (contour == null && contour.Count < 2)
			{
				return new List<PlanePolygon>();
			}
			CalcBackAndFore(contour, depth, out var backContour, out var foreContour);
			int count = contour.Count;
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>(count);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 1;
			while (num < count)
			{
				if (num2 == count)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				PlaneQuadrangle planeQuadrangle = new PlaneQuadrangle(backContour[num], foreContour[num], foreContour[num2], backContour[num2]);
				planeQuadrangle.Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(planeQuadrangle);
				planeQuadrangle.Color = color;
				planeQuadrangle.SameColors = true;
				planeQuadrangle.Weight = polygonWeight;
				planeQuadrangle.SameNormals = true;
				list.Add(planeQuadrangle);
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			if (curving)
			{
				CalcVerticesNormals(list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PlanePolygon> CalculateLaterals(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, double depth, Color color, int polygonWeight)
		{
			if (contour == null || contour.Count < 3)
			{
				return new List<PlanePolygon>();
			}
			using Tessellator tessellator = new Tessellator();
			IList<PlaneTriangle> list = tessellator.Triangulate(contour, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), color);
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new List<PlanePolygon>();
			}
			List<PlanePolygon> list2 = new List<PlanePolygon>(list.Count * 2);
			double num = depth / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list[i].Weight = polygonWeight;
				PlaneTriangle planeTriangle = (PlaneTriangle)PlanePrimitive.Offset(list[i], 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - num);
				planeTriangle.InvertVerticesDirection();
				list2.Add(planeTriangle);
				list2.Add((PlanePolygon)PlanePrimitive.Offset(list[i], 0.0, 0.0, num));
			}
			return list2;
		}

		public static List<PlanePolygon> CalculateFigure(List<DiagramPoint> contour, double depth, bool curving, Color color, int polygonWeight)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			list.AddRange(CalculateEnvelope(contour, depth, curving, color, polygonWeight));
			list.AddRange(CalculateLaterals(contour, depth, color, polygonWeight));
			return list;
		}
	}
	public static class BezierUtils
	{
		private const double magic = 0.045;

		private const int maxStepCount = 15;

		public static int CalcStepCount(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2, double zoomingFactor)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.CalcLength2D(p1, p2);
			double num2 = num * 0.045 * zoomingFactor;
			if (!(num2 > 15.0))
			{
				return (int)Math.Round(num2);
			}
			return 15;
		}

		public static void CalcBezier(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2, GRealPoint2D p3, GRealPoint2D p4, int stepCount, IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			double num = 1.0 / (double)(stepCount + 1);
			double num2 = num * num;
			double num3 = num * num * num;
			double num4 = num * 3.0;
			double num5 = num2 * 3.0;
			double num6 = num2 * 6.0;
			double num7 = num3 * 6.0;
			double num8 = p1.X - p2.X * 2.0 + p3.X;
			double num9 = p1.Y - p2.Y * 2.0 + p3.Y;
			double num10 = (p2.X - p3.X) * 3.0 - p1.X + p4.X;
			double num11 = (p2.Y - p3.Y) * 3.0 - p1.Y + p4.Y;
			double num12 = (p2.X - p1.X) * num4 + num8 * num5 + num10 * num3;
			double num13 = (p2.Y - p1.Y) * num4 + num9 * num5 + num11 * num3;
			double num14 = num8 * num6 + num10 * num7;
			double num15 = num9 * num6 + num11 * num7;
			double num16 = num10 * num7;
			double num17 = num11 * num7;
			double num18 = p1.X;
			double num19 = p1.Y;
			for (int i = 0; i < stepCount; i++)
			{
				num18 += num12;
				num19 += num13;
				points.Add(new GRealPoint2D(num18, num19));
				num12 += num14;
				num13 += num15;
				num14 += num16;
				num15 += num17;
			}
			points.Add(p4);
		}

		public static LineStrip CalcBezier(BezierStrip strip, double zoomingFactor)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			if (strip == null || strip.Count == 0)
			{
				return lineStrip;
			}
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(strip[0].X, strip[0].Y);
			lineStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
			if (strip.IsEmpty)
			{
				return lineStrip;
			}
			List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = strip.GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: false);
			for (int i = 3; i < pointsForDrawing.Count; i += 3)
			{
				GRealPoint2D p = pointsForDrawing[i - 2];
				GRealPoint2D p2 = pointsForDrawing[i - 1];
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = pointsForDrawing[i];
				int stepCount = CalcStepCount(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2, zoomingFactor);
				CalcBezier(gRealPoint2D, p, p2, gRealPoint2D2, stepCount, lineStrip);
				gRealPoint2D = gRealPoint2D2;
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public class Tessellator : IDisposable
	{
		private struct VertexData
		{
			private readonly bool doubled;

			private DiagramPoint point;

			public DiagramPoint Point => point;

			public bool Doubled => doubled;

			public VertexData(DiagramPoint point, bool doubled)
			{
				this.point = point;
				this.doubled = doubled;
			}

			public VertexData(DiagramPoint point)
				: this(point, doubled: false)
			{
			}
		}

		private delegate void ErrorCallbackDelegate(int errNo);

		private delegate void BeginCallbackDelegate(int type);

		private delegate void EndCallbackDelegate();

		private delegate void VertexCallbackDelegate(IntPtr vertex_data);

		private delegate void CombineCallbackDelegate(IntPtr coords, IntPtr[] vertex_data, IntPtr weight, ref IntPtr outData);

		private IntPtr tess;

		private Delegate errorDelegate;

		private Delegate beginDelegate;

		private Delegate endDelegate;

		private Delegate vertexDelegate;

		private Delegate combineDelegate;

		private List<PlaneTriangle> resultTriangles;

		private List<IList<DiagramPoint>> resultContours;

		private List<DiagramPoint> points = new List<DiagramPoint>();

		private List<IntPtr> memory = new List<IntPtr>();

		private DiagramVector normal;

		private Color color;

		private int type;

		private bool doubleCombined;

		private bool disposedValue;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void EnsureInitialization()
		{
			if (tess == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				errorDelegate = new ErrorCallbackDelegate(Error);
				beginDelegate = new BeginCallbackDelegate(Begin);
				endDelegate = new EndCallbackDelegate(End);
				vertexDelegate = new VertexCallbackDelegate(Vertex);
				combineDelegate = new CombineCallbackDelegate(Combine);
				tess = GLU.NewTess();
				GLU.TessCallback(tess, 100103, Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(errorDelegate));
				GLU.TessCallback(tess, 100100, Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(beginDelegate));
				GLU.TessCallback(tess, 100102, Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(endDelegate));
				GLU.TessCallback(tess, 100101, Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(vertexDelegate));
				GLU.TessCallback(tess, 100105, Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(combineDelegate));
				GLU.TessProperty(tess, 100142, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private void Init(bool boundaryOnly, int windingRule, bool doubleCombined, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
		{
			EnsureInitialization();
			GLU.TessProperty(tess, 100141, boundaryOnly ? 1 : 0);
			GLU.TessProperty(tess, 100140, windingRule);
			this.doubleCombined = doubleCombined;
			this.normal = normal;
			this.color = color;
			resultContours = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			resultTriangles = new List<PlaneTriangle>();
		}

		private void Error(int errNo)
		{
			throw new OpenGLException("tessellator");
		}

		private void Begin(int type)
		{
			points.Clear();
			this.type = type;
		}

		private void End()
		{
			if (type == 2 && points.Count > 0)
			{
				List<DiagramPoint> item = new List<DiagramPoint>(points);
				resultContours.Add(item);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void Vertex(IntPtr vertex_data)
		{
			VertexData vertexData = (VertexData)Marshal.PtrToStructure(vertex_data, typeof(VertexData));
			points.Add(vertexData.Point);
			if (vertexData.Doubled)
			{
				points.Add(vertexData.Point);
			}
			if (points.Count < 3)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num;
			int index;
			int index2;
			switch (type)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case 6:
				num = 0;
				index = points.Count - 2;
				index2 = points.Count - 1;
				break;
			case 5:
				index2 = points.Count - 1;
				if (points.Count % 2 == 0)
				{
					num = points.Count - 2;
					index = num - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num = points.Count - 3;
					index = num + 1;
				}
				break;
			case 4:
				if (points.Count % 3 == 0)
				{
					num = points.Count - 3;
					index = num + 1;
					index2 = num + 2;
					break;
				}
				return;
			}
			resultTriangles.Add(new PlaneTriangle(points[num], points[index], points[index2], sameNormals: true, sameColors: true, normal, color));
		}

		private VertexData Combine(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new VertexData(point, doubleCombined);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void Combine(IntPtr coords, IntPtr[] vertex_data, IntPtr weight, ref IntPtr outData)
		{
			List<VertexData> list = new List<VertexData>();
			foreach (IntPtr intPtr in vertex_data)
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					VertexData item = (VertexData)Marshal.PtrToStructure(vertex_data[0], typeof(VertexData));
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			DiagramPoint point = (DiagramPoint)Marshal.PtrToStructure(coords, typeof(DiagramPoint));
			VertexData structure = Combine(point);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(structure));
			Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, intPtr2, fDeleteOld: false);
			memory.Add(intPtr2);
			outData = intPtr2;
		}

		private IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> CalcAdjacentEdges(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, double epsilon)
		{
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			if (contour != null && contour.Count >= 3)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < contour.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					DiagramPoint p = contour[i];
					DiagramPoint p2 = contour[i + 1];
					if (MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(p, p2, epsilon))
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int j = i + 1; j < contour.Count; j++)
					{
						DiagramPoint diagramPoint = contour[j];
						DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = contour[(j != contour.Count - 1) ? (j + 1) : 0];
						if (!MathUtils.ArePointsEquals2D(diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, epsilon))
						{
							Intersection intersection = IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(p, p2, diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, epsilon, out points);
							if (intersection == Intersection.Match && points.Count == 2)
							{
								List<DiagramPoint> item = new List<DiagramPoint>(points);
								list.Add(item);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> CalcAdjacentContours(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, double epsilon)
		{
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> list2 = CalcAdjacentEdges(contour, epsilon);
			foreach (IList<DiagramPoint> item2 in list2)
			{
				IList<DiagramPoint> item = MathUtils.MakeRectangle(item2[0], item2[1], doublePoints: true, epsilon * 3.0);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<VertexData> GetVerticesData(IList<DiagramPoint> contour)
		{
			List<VertexData> list = new List<VertexData>();
			foreach (DiagramPoint item in contour)
			{
				list.Add(new VertexData(item));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ProcessPolygon(params IList<DiagramPoint>[] contours)
		{
			ProcessPolygon((IList<IList<DiagramPoint>>)contours);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void ProcessPolygon(IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> contours)
		{
			try
			{
				GLU.TessNormal(tess, normal.DX, normal.DY, normal.DZ);
				GLU.TessBeginPolygon(tess, IntPtr.Zero);
				foreach (IList<DiagramPoint> contour in contours)
				{
					List<VertexData> verticesData = GetVerticesData(contour);
					GLU.TessBeginContour(tess);
					foreach (VertexData item in verticesData)
					{
						IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(item));
						Marshal.StructureToPtr(item, intPtr, fDeleteOld: false);
						memory.Add(intPtr);
						GLU.TessVertex(tess, new double[3]
						{
							item.Point.X,
							item.Point.Y,
							item.Point.Z
						}, intPtr);
					}
					GLU.TessEndContour(tess);
				}
				GLU.TessEndPolygon(tess);
			}
			finally
			{
				foreach (IntPtr item2 in memory)
				{
					Marshal.FreeHGlobal(item2);
				}
				memory.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void DeleteTess()
		{
			GLU.DeleteTess(tess);
			tess = IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		public List<PlaneTriangle> Triangulate(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
		{
			if (contour == null || contour.Count < 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Init(boundaryOnly: false, 100131, doubleCombined: false, normal, color);
			ProcessPolygon(new List<DiagramPoint>(contour));
			return resultTriangles;
		}

		public IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> Prepare(IList<DiagramPoint> contour, DiagramVector normal, bool adjacentEdges, double epsilon)
		{
			if (contour == null || contour.Count < 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Init(boundaryOnly: true, 100131, doubleCombined: true, normal, Color.Empty);
			ProcessPolygon(new List<DiagramPoint>(contour));
			if (adjacentEdges)
			{
				IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> collection = CalcAdjacentContours(contour, epsilon);
				resultContours.AddRange(collection);
			}
			return resultContours;
		}

		public IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> Union(IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> contours, DiagramVector normal)
		{
			if (contours == null || contours.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Init(boundaryOnly: true, 100131, doubleCombined: false, normal, Color.Empty);
			ProcessPolygon(contours);
			return resultContours;
		}

		public IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> Difference(IList<DiagramPoint> minuend, IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> subtrahend, DiagramVector normal)
		{
			if (minuend == null || subtrahend == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<IList<DiagramPoint>> list = new List<IList<DiagramPoint>>();
			list.Add(minuend);
			list.AddRange(subtrahend);
			return Difference(list, normal);
		}

		public IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> Difference(IList<IList<DiagramPoint>> contours, DiagramVector normal)
		{
			if (contours == null || contours.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Init(boundaryOnly: true, 100132, doubleCombined: false, normal, Color.Empty);
			ProcessPolygon(contours);
			return resultContours;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposedValue)
			{
				if (tess != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					DeleteTess();
				}
				disposedValue = true;
			}
		}

		~Tessellator()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public class ViewController : ChartElement, IDiagramProvider, IChartWithDataViewController
	{
		private const int maxUpdatesBeforeReset = 1000;

		private readonly Chart chart;

		private readonly Locker boundDataChangedLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly Locker changedLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly Locker changingLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly Locker rangeChangedLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly Locker selectedItemsChangedLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

		private bool applyChangesImmediately;

		private bool bindingChanged;

		private bool dataInUpdating;

		private bool endLoading;

		private bool shouldStartAnimationTimers;

		private bool transactionApplying;

		private ChartUpdateType updateType;

		private SeriesControllerChanges resamplingForceUpdateChanges;

		private IChartWithData ChartWithData => chart;

		CompatibleViewType? IDiagramProvider.CompatibleViewFormDiagram => null;

		private DataContainer DataContainer => chart.DataContainer;

		IDiagram IDiagramProvider.Diagram => chart.Diagram;

		private bool Drawing { get; set; }

		bool IDiagramProvider.IsDiagram3D => false;

		internal bool IsChartEmpty { get; private set; }

		public IList<RefinedSeries> ActiveRefinedSeries => seriesController.ActiveRefinedSeries;

		public int ActiveSeriesCount => seriesController.ActiveRefinedSeries.Count;

		public bool HasDataToPresent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!seriesController.IsContainsProcessedSeries)
				{
					return DataContainer.ShouldUseSeriesTemplate;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool HasProcessedNotEmptyPoints => seriesController.IsContainsProcessedNotEmptyPoints;

		public bool HasProcessedPoints => seriesController.IsContainsProcessedPoints;

		public bool IsDesignMode => chart.Container.DesignMode;

		public bool IsTransactionOpen => seriesController.IsTransactionOpen;

		public IList<RefinedSeries> RefinedSeries => seriesController.RefinedSeries;

		public IList<RefinedSeries> RefinedSeriesForLegend => seriesController.SeriesForLegend;

		public SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics => seriesController.SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics;

		public bool InBoundDataChanged => boundDataChangedLocker.IsLocked;

		private static DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection GetUpdatesCache(Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> cache, IBindingProvider sender)
		{
			if (!cache.TryGetValue(sender, out var value))
			{
				value = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
				cache.Add(sender, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void RenderAboveLayer(ChartRenderer renderer, ChartViewData viewData, CrosshairViewData crosshairViewData)
		{

			crosshairViewData?.RenderAbove(renderer);
		}

			viewData.Render(renderer);
			crosshairViewData?.RenderHighlighting(renderer);
		}

		{
			viewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
			crosshairViewData?.Render(renderer);
		}

		public static RefinedPoint FindRefinedPoint(Chart chart, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, Series ownerSeries)
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = chart.ViewController.FindRefinedSeries(ownerSeries);
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (point.SeriesPoint == seriesPoint)
				{
					return point;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ViewController(Chart chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			seriesController = new SeriesController(DataContainer, this, chart);
		}

		private ChartUpdateType ProcessUpdateInfo(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			ChartUpdateType chartUpdateType = ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate;
			ChartElementChange change = updateInfo.Change;
			if ((change & ChartElementChange.UpdateIndicators) <= ChartElementChange.None)
			{
				chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.ThrowChanged;
				if ((change & ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache) != ChartElementChange.None)
				{
					chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.ClearTextureCache;
				}
				if ((change & ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly) != ChartElementChange.None)
				{
					chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.InvalidateRangeControl;
				}
				if ((change & ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems) != ChartElementChange.None)
				{
					chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.UpdateSeriesColorizer;
				}
				chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.ClearDiagramCache;
				if (updateInfo.UpdateInfo != null && (updateInfo.UpdateInfo.Sender is RangeControlOptions || updateInfo.UpdateInfo.Sender is ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions))
				{
					chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.InvalidateRangeControl;
				}
			}
			if (updateInfo.UpdateInfo is PropertyUpdateInfo)
			{
				PropertyUpdateInfo propertyUpdateInfo = updateInfo.UpdateInfo as PropertyUpdateInfo;
				if (propertyUpdateInfo.Name == Series.CheckedInLegendProperty)
				{
					chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.UpdateSelectionStateForLegend;
				}
			}
			if (updateInfo.UpdateInfo is SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo || updateInfo.UpdateInfo is SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.ThrowChanged;
				chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.UpdateSeriesColorizer;
			}
			if (updateInfo.UpdateInfo is OnLoadEndUpdateInfo || (change & ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes) != ChartElementChange.None)
			{
				chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.UpdateSelectionState;
			}
			if (!(updateInfo.UpdateInfo is ReplaceSeriesPointUpdateInfo))
			{
				chartUpdateType |= ChartUpdateType.ClearCaches;
			}
			return chartUpdateType;
		}

		private Type DetectDiagramType()
		{
			if (DataContainer.ShouldUseSeriesTemplate)
			{
				return DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.View.DiagramType;
			}
			foreach (Series item in DataContainer.Series)
			{
				if (item.Visible && item.View != null)
				{
					return item.View.DiagramType;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ApplyChangesCore()
		{
			if (seriesController.IsTransactionOpen && !transactionApplying)
			{
				transactionApplying = true;
				ClearCaches();
				Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> dictionary = ChartWithData?.DataSourceUpdateCache;
				bindingChanged |= dictionary != null && dictionary.Count > 0;
				if (bindingChanged && !InBoundDataChanged)
				{
					bool flag = applyChangesImmediately;
					applyChangesImmediately = false;
					chart.DataContainer.UpdateBinding(dictionary);
					DataContainer.LoadDrillDownStates();
					chart.RestoreAutoSeriesUncheckedState();
					applyChangesImmediately = flag;
				}
				LockAllChanges();
				SeriesControllerChanges seriesControllerChanges = seriesController.CommitTransaction(chart.Loading);
				transactionApplying = false;
				seriesControllerChanges |= resamplingForceUpdateChanges;
				resamplingForceUpdateChanges = SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
				if ((seriesControllerChanges & SeriesControllerChanges.RefinedDataUpdated) != SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges)
				{
					UpdateAccordingDataChanges(seriesControllerChanges);
				}
				if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.ThrowChanged) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate && chart.Container != null)
				{
					chart.Container.RaiseUIUpdated();
				}
				if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.InvalidateRangeControl) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate)
				{
					chart.ActualRangeSupport.Invalidate(redraw: true);
				}
				if ((seriesControllerChanges & SeriesControllerChanges.VisualArgumentRangeUpdated) != SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges)
				{
					chart.ActualRangeSupport.Invalidate(redraw: false);
				}
				else if ((seriesControllerChanges & SeriesControllerChanges.WholeArgumentRangeUpdated) != SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges)
				{
					chart.ActualRangeSupport.Invalidate(redraw: true);
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.UpdateSelectionState) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate)
				{
					chart.SelectionController.SyncSelectionStates();
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.UpdateSelectionStateForLegend) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate)
				{
					chart.SelectionController.UpdateSelectedItemsForLegend();
				}
				if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.UpdateSeriesColorizer) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate || bindingChanged)
				{
					DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ColorizeSeries();
				}
				if ((seriesControllerChanges & SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldResetSelectedItems) != SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges && !flag2)
				{
					chart.SelectionController.ClearSelection(clearHot: false);
				}
				UnlockAllChanges();
				updateType = ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate;
				RaiseEvent(chart.SelectionController.RaiseSelectedItemsChanged, selectedItemsChangedLocker);
				if (bindingChanged)
				{
					RaiseEvent(RaiseBoundDataChanged, boundDataChangedLocker);
					bindingChanged = false;
				}
				RaiseEvent(RaiseRangeChangedEventsIfNecessary, rangeChangedLocker);
				if ((seriesControllerChanges & SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldAnimateChart) != SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges && chart.AnimationStartMode == ChartAnimationMode.OnDataChanged)
				{
					chart.Animate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearCaches()
		{
			if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.ClearCaches) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate)
			{
				chart.ResetGraphicsCache();
				chart.InvalidateDrawingHelper();
				chart.ClearCache();
				chart.ClearSeriesViewCache();
				chart.HitTestController.Clear();
			}
			if (chart.Diagram != null && (updateType & ChartUpdateType.ClearDiagramCache) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate)
			{
				chart.Diagram.ClearZoomCache();
				chart.Diagram.ClearResolveOverlappingCache();
			}
			if ((updateType & ChartUpdateType.ClearTextureCache) != ChartUpdateType.NonUpdate)
			{
				chart.TextureCache.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseBoundDataChanged()
		{
			chart.ContainerAdapter.DataProvider?.OnBoundDataChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void RaiseEvent(Action raiseEventAction, Locker eventLocker)
		{
			if (!eventLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				bool isLocked = changedLocker.IsLocked;
				if (isLocked)
				{
					changedLocker.Unlock();
				}
				eventLocker.Lock();
				raiseEventAction();
				ApplyChangesCore();
				eventLocker.Unlock();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					changedLocker.Lock();
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseRangeChangedEventsIfNecessary()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup in seriesController.RefinedSeriesGroupList)
			{
				if (refinedSeriesGroup.GroupKey.AxisData != null)
				{
					RangeDataBase rangeDataBase = refinedSeriesGroup.GroupKey.AxisData.VisualRange as RangeDataBase;
					RangeDataBase rangeDataBase2 = refinedSeriesGroup.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange as RangeDataBase;
					rangeDataBase?.RaiseChangedEventIfNecessary();
					rangeDataBase2?.RaiseChangedEventIfNecessary();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartAnimationTimersIfEnqueued()
		{
			if (shouldStartAnimationTimers)
			{
				if (chart.Container is IChartAnimationProvider chartAnimationProvider)
				{
					chartAnimationProvider.StartAnimationTimers();
				}
				shouldStartAnimationTimers = false;
			}
		}

		private void Update(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (Drawing || chart.Disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!chart.Loading && !endLoading)
			{
				chart.StopAnimation();
				chart.HideForcedCrosshair();
				LockAllChanges();
				updateType |= ProcessUpdateInfo(updateInfo);
				seriesController.OpenTransaction();
				seriesController.ProcessUpdate(updateInfo.UpdateInfo);
				Type diagramType = DetectDiagramType();
				ChartUpdateInfoBase chartUpdateInfoBase = chart.EnsureDiagramType(diagramType);
				if (chartUpdateInfoBase != null)
				{
					seriesController.ProcessUpdate(chartUpdateInfoBase);
				}
				if (updateInfo.UpdateInfo is OnLoadEndUpdateInfo || applyChangesImmediately || seriesController.ShouldForceUpdate())
				{
					ApplyChangesCore();
				}
				UnlockAllChanges();
				if (updateInfo.UpdateInfo is SelectionUpdateInfo)
				{
					chart.Container.LockChangeService();
					chart.Container.Changed();
					chart.Container.UnlockChangeService();
				}
				else if (!(updateInfo.UpdateInfo is OnLoadEndUpdateInfo))
				{
					chart.Container.Changed();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				seriesController.ProcessUpdate(updateInfo.UpdateInfo, loading: true);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAccordingDataChanges(SeriesControllerChanges changes)
		{
			changedLocker.Lock();
			if (chart.Diagram != null && !endLoading)
			{
				chart.Diagram.Update(ActiveRefinedSeries);
			}
			if ((changes & SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldUpdateMeasureUnits) != SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges && !endLoading && chart.Diagram != null)
			{
				chart.Diagram.CheckUpdateMeasureUnits((changes & SeriesControllerChanges.ValueRangeChanged) != 0);
				if (chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D && !endLoading)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.Update(ActiveRefinedSeries);
				}
			}
			chart.ActualRangeSupport.Invalidate(redraw: true);
			changedLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected override ChartElement CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("ViewController should not be cloned.");
		}

		protected internal List<Series> GetActiveSeriesList()
		{
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				list.Add((Series)((IRefinedSeries)item).Series);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void ApplyChanges()
		{
			if (!endLoading && !chart.Loading)
			{
				ApplyChangesCore();
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyChangesBeforeRender()
		{
			RefreshData(DataContainer.GetDataSourceUpdates());
			applyChangesImmediately = true;
			ApplyChanges();
			applyChangesImmediately = false;
		}

		internal void ApplyChangesOnPropertyRequest()
		{
			ApplyChanges();
		}

		internal void ForceUpdateForResampling()
		{
			LockAllChanges();
			resamplingForceUpdateChanges = seriesController.CommitTransaction(chart.Loading);
			UnlockAllChanges();
		}

		internal void BeginDrawing()
		{
			Drawing = true;
		}

		internal void EndDrawing()
		{
			Drawing = false;
		}

		internal void LockAllChanges()
		{
			changingLocker.Lock();
			changedLocker.Lock();
		}

		internal void RaiseChanged(ChartUpdate change)
		{
			if (changedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				if (dataInUpdating)
				{
					seriesController.ProcessUpdate(change.UpdateInfo, loading: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Update(change);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseChanging()
		{
			if (!chart.Loading && !chart.Disposed && !Drawing && !changingLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				chart.Container.Changing();
			}
		}

		internal void UnlockAllChanges()
		{
			changingLocker.Unlock();
			changedLocker.Unlock();
		}

		public bool RefreshData(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			return RefreshData(updates, raiseChanged: true);
		}

		public bool RefreshData(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			bool flag = updates != null && ChartWithData.DataSourceUpdateCache.Count > 0;
			foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<IBindingProvider> updatesCache = GetUpdatesCache(ChartWithData.DataSourceUpdateCache, update.Sender);
				updatesCache.Add(update);
			}
			if (Drawing || chart.Loading || ChartWithData.DataSourceUpdateCache.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (raiseChanged)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					chart.Container.LockChangeService();
					RaiseChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
					chart.Container.UnlockChangeService();
				}
				else
				{
					RaiseChanged(new ChartUpdate(this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool RefreshData(bool resetSmartBinding, bool resetSeriesBinding, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			if (resetSmartBinding)
			{
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(DataContainer);
			}
			if (resetSeriesBinding)
			{
				foreach (Series item in DataContainer.Series)
				{
					if (!item.IsAutoCreated)
					{
						dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return RefreshData(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection, raiseChanged);
		}

		public ChartViewData CreateAnimationViewDataAndCalcLayout(ZPlaneRectangle bounds)
		{
			ChartViewData chartViewData = ChartViewData.Create(chart, bounds, performRangeCorrection: false);
			chartViewData?.CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper: true, allowOptimization: true);
			StartAnimationTimersIfEnqueued();
			return chartViewData;
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ChartDrawingContext context, bool lockDrawingHelper)
		{
			ChartViewData viewData = ChartViewData.Create(chart, (ZPlaneRectangle)new Rectangle(default(Point), context.Viewport.Size), performRangeCorrection: false);
			return CreateGraphicsCommand(context, lockDrawingHelper, viewData);
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand(ChartDrawingContext context, bool lockDrawingHelper, ChartViewData viewData)
		{
			Drawing = true;
			try
			{
				if (viewData == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				viewData.CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper, allowOptimization: true);
				GraphicsCommand result = viewData.CreateGraphicsCommand(new Rectangle(default(Point), context.Viewport.Size));
				viewData.Dispose();
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				Drawing = false;
			}
		}

		public IList<RefinedSeries> GetRefinedSeriesByAxis(AxisBase axis)
		{
			return seriesController.GetRefinedSeriesByAxis(axis);
		}

		public void RenderAnimatedChart(ChartViewData viewData, ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Drawing = true;
			try
			{
				viewData.Render(renderer);
				viewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
				viewData.RenderAbove(renderer, null);
				renderer.Present();
			}
			finally
			{
				Drawing = false;
			}
		}

		public void RenderChart(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds, bool lockDrawingHelper, IRenderContext renderContext, ChartViewData viewData, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			Drawing = true;
			try
			{
				if (viewData == null)
				{
					viewData = ChartViewData.Create(chart, (ZPlaneRectangle)bounds, performRangeCorrection: false, autoLayoutUpdated);
					if (viewData == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					IsChartEmpty = viewData.IsEmpty;
					viewData.CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper, !renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing);
				}
				using (viewData)
				{
					StartAnimationTimersIfEnqueued();
					renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.Renderer);
					viewData.Render(renderer);
					if (chart.ActualCrosshairHighlightPoints)
					{
						renderer.Present();
						renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.RendererMiddle);
					}
					viewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
					renderer.Present();
					viewData.RenderAbove(renderer, renderContext);
					renderer.Present();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Drawing = false;
			}
		}

		public void RenderChartEx(ChartRenderer renderer, INativeRenderer nativeRenderer, ChartViewData viewData, ChartBitmapCache chartBitmapCache)
		{
			Drawing = true;
			if (renderer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("renderer parameter is null");
			}
			if (nativeRenderer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("nativeRenderer parameter is null");
			}
			try
			{
				StartAnimationTimersIfEnqueued();
				renderer.SetNativeRenderer(nativeRenderer);
				if (chartBitmapCache != null)
				{
					chartBitmapCache.Image = nativeRenderer.DrawToImage(chartBitmapCache.Bounds.Size, chartBitmapCache.Bounds.Location, chartBitmapCache.Image, delegate
					{
						RenderBaseLayer(renderer, viewData, null);
					}, allowClearType: true, chart.BackColor);
					chartBitmapCache.ImageMiddle = nativeRenderer.DrawToImage(chartBitmapCache.Bounds.Size, chartBitmapCache.Bounds.Location, chartBitmapCache.ImageMiddle, delegate
					{
						RenderMiddleLayer(renderer, viewData, null);
					}, allowClearType: true, Color.Transparent);
					chartBitmapCache.ImageAbove = nativeRenderer.DrawToImage(chartBitmapCache.Bounds.Size, chartBitmapCache.Bounds.Location, chartBitmapCache.ImageAbove, delegate
					{
						RenderAboveLayer(renderer, viewData, null);
					}, allowClearType: true, Color.Transparent);
				}
				else
				{
					CrosshairViewData crosshairViewData = chart.CalculateCrosshairViewData();
					RenderBaseLayer(renderer, viewData, crosshairViewData);
					RenderMiddleLayer(renderer, viewData, crosshairViewData);
					RenderAboveLayer(renderer, viewData, crosshairViewData);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Drawing = false;
			}
		}

		public void RenderWholeChart(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Drawing = true;
			try
			{
				CrosshairViewData crosshairViewData = chart.CalculateCrosshairViewData();
				ChartViewData chartViewData = ChartViewData.Create(chart, (ZPlaneRectangle)bounds, performRangeCorrection: false);
				chartViewData.CalculateLayout(lockDrawingHelper: true, !renderer.IsGdiMetafileDrawing);
				chartViewData.Render(renderer);
				crosshairViewData?.RenderHighlighting(renderer);
				chartViewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
				crosshairViewData?.Render(renderer);
				chartViewData.RenderAbove(renderer, null);
				crosshairViewData?.RenderAbove(renderer);
			}
			finally
			{
				Drawing = false;
			}
		}

		public void ResetLoadingFlag()
		{
			endLoading = false;
		}

		public void SendDataAggregationUpdates(IList<AxisBase> axes)
		{
			SendUpdates(GetUpdateInfos(axes, "DataAggregation"));
		}

		public void SendUpdates(IList<PropertyUpdateInfo> infos)
		{
			bool isTransactionOpen = seriesController.IsTransactionOpen;
			if (!isTransactionOpen)
			{
				seriesController.OpenTransaction();
			}
			foreach (PropertyUpdateInfo info in infos)
			{
				seriesController.ProcessUpdate(info, Loading);
			}
			if (!isTransactionOpen)
			{
				seriesController.CommitTransaction(Loading);
			}
			if (infos.Count > 0)
			{
				chart.ActualRangeSupport.Invalidate(redraw: true);
			}
		}

		public void StartOnEndLoading()
		{
			endLoading = true;
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			Update(new ChartUpdate(null, ChartElementChange.UpdateIndicators));
		}
	}

	public class ChartXmlSerializer : XmlXtraSerializer
	{
		private class ChartXmlPropertyInfo : XmlXtraPropertyInfo
		{
			public ChartXmlPropertyInfo(string name, Type propertyType, object val, bool isKey)
				: base(name, propertyType, val, isKey)
			{
			}
		}

		private const string collectionItemNamePrefix = "Item";

		public const string Name = "ChartXmlSerializer";

		private readonly bool serializeVersion = true;

		protected override string SerializerName => "ChartXmlSerializer";

		protected override string Version
		{
			get
			{
				if (!serializeVersion)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return "23.2.4.0";
			}
		}

		private static bool IsCollectionItem(string name)
		{
			int result;
			if (name.StartsWith("Item"))
			{
				return int.TryParse(name.Substring("Item".Length), out result);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static XtraPropertyInfo ReadInfo(XmlReader xmlReader, bool skipZeroDepth)
		{
			xmlReader.Read();
			if (xmlReader.IsStartElement())
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo val = (XtraPropertyInfo)(object)new ChartXmlPropertyInfo(xmlReader.Name, null, null, isKey: true);
				bool isEmptyElement = xmlReader.IsEmptyElement;
				if (!skipZeroDepth || xmlReader.Depth != 0)
				{
					while (xmlReader.MoveToNextAttribute())
					{
						Type propertyType = null;
						if (xmlReader.Name.EndsWith("_type"))
						{
							propertyType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(xmlReader.Value, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)false);
							xmlReader.MoveToNextAttribute();
						}
						val.ChildProperties.Add((XtraPropertyInfo)(object)new ChartXmlPropertyInfo(xmlReader.Name, propertyType, xmlReader.Value, isKey: false));
					}
				}
				if (isEmptyElement)
				{
					return val;
				}
				do
				{
					XtraPropertyInfo val2 = ReadInfo(xmlReader, skipZeroDepth);
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						val.ChildProperties.Add(val2);
					}
				}
				while (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement);
				xmlReader.Read();
				return val;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ChartXmlSerializer()
			: this(serializeVersion: true)
		{
		}

		public ChartXmlSerializer(bool serializeVersion)
		{
			this.serializeVersion = serializeVersion;
		}

		protected override void WriteApplicationAttribute(string appName, XmlWriter xmlWriter)
		{
		}

		protected override void WriteStartDocument(XmlWriter xmlWriter)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteStartDocument();
		}

		protected override void SerializeLevelCore(XmlWriter xmlWriter, IXtraPropertyCollection props)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!props.IsSinglePass)
			{
				foreach (XtraPropertyInfo item in (IEnumerable)props)
				{
					XtraPropertyInfo val = item;
					if (!val.IsKey)
					{
						SerializeAttributeProperty(xmlWriter, val);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XtraPropertyInfo item2 in (IEnumerable)props)
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo val2 = item2;
				if (val2.IsKey)
				{
					SerializeContentProperty(xmlWriter, val2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SerializeAttributeProperty(XmlWriter xmlWriter, XtraPropertyInfo pInfo)
		{
			object obj = pInfo.Value;
			if (obj != null)
			{
				Type type = obj.GetType();
				if (!type.IsPrimitive)
				{
					obj = ((XtraSerializer)this).ObjectConverterImpl.ObjectToString(obj);
				}
			}
			if (pInfo.Value != null)
			{
				string value = default(string);
				if (XtraPropertyInfo.ShouldSerializePropertyType(pInfo, ref value, (Func<object, string>)((object v) => v.GetType().FullName)))
				{
					xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString(pInfo.Name + "_type", value);
				}
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString(pInfo.Name, XmlXtraSerializer.XmlObjectToString(obj));
			}
		}

		private void SerializeContentProperty(XmlWriter xmlWriter, XtraPropertyInfo p)
		{
			if (((ICollection)p.ChildProperties).Count > 0 || IsCollectionItem(p.Name))
			{
				xmlWriter.WriteStartElement(p.Name.Replace("$", string.Empty));
				((XmlXtraSerializer)this).SerializeLevel(xmlWriter, p.ChildProperties);
				xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected override IXtraPropertyCollection DeserializeCore(Stream stream, string appName, IList objects)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IXtraPropertyCollection val = (IXtraPropertyCollection)new XtraPropertyCollection();
			XmlReader xmlReader = ((XmlXtraSerializer)this).CreateReader(stream);
			XtraPropertyInfo val2 = ReadInfo(xmlReader, skipZeroDepth: true);
			val.Add(val2);
			return val;
		}

		protected override XmlWriterSettings CreateXmlWriterSettings()
		{
			return new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				Indent = true,
				CheckCharacters = false,
				OmitXmlDeclaration = false,
				Encoding = Encoding.UTF8
			};
		}
	}

	public class ChartSerializationContext : SerializationContext
	{
		private static XtraPropertyInfo GetRootPropertyInfo(IXtraPropertyCollection store)
		{
			if (((ICollection)store).Count == 1)
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo val = store[0];
				if (((ICollection)val.ChildProperties).Count == 1)
				{
					return val.ChildProperties[0];
				}
				if (((ICollection)val.ChildProperties).Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			else if (((ICollection)store).Count == 2)
			{
				return store[0];
			}
			throw new XmlException();
		}

		protected override int GetCollectionItemsCount(XtraPropertyInfo root)
		{
			return ((ICollection)root.ChildProperties).Count;
		}

		protected override object InvokeCreateCollectionItem(DeserializeHelper helper, string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			object owner = e.Owner;
			IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem val = (IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem)((owner is IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem) ? owner : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.CreateCollectionItem(propertyName, e);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override object InvokeCreateContentPropertyValueMethod(DeserializeHelper helper, XtraItemEventArgs e, PropertyDescriptor prop)
		{
			object owner = e.Owner;
			IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue val = (IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue)((owner is IXtraSupportCreateContentPropertyValue) ? owner : null);
			object obj = null;
			if (val != null)
			{
				obj = val.Create(e);
				prop.SetValue(e.Owner, obj);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected override void InvokeAfterDeserialize(DeserializeHelper helper, object obj, XtraPropertyInfo bp, object value)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IXtraSupportAfterDeserialize val = (IXtraSupportAfterDeserialize)((obj is IXtraSupportAfterDeserialize) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				bp.Value = value;
				val.AfterDeserialize(new XtraItemEventArgs((object)null, obj, (object)null, bp));
			}
		}

		protected override void DeserializeObjectsCore(DeserializeHelper helper, IList objects, IXtraPropertyCollection store, OptionsLayoutBase options)
		{
			if (objects.Count == 1)
			{
				object obj = objects[0];
				XtraObjectInfo val = (XtraObjectInfo)((obj is XtraObjectInfo) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					XtraPropertyInfo rootPropertyInfo = GetRootPropertyInfo(store);
					if (rootPropertyInfo == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (val.Name == rootPropertyInfo.Name)
					{
						helper.DeserializeObject(val.Instance, rootPropertyInfo.ChildProperties, options);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			throw new XmlException();
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSerializeCollectionItem(SerializeHelper helper, object owner, MethodInfo mi, XtraPropertyInfo itemProperty, object item, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			IXtraSupportShouldSerializeCollectionItem val = (IXtraSupportShouldSerializeCollectionItem)((owner is IXtraSupportShouldSerializeCollectionItem) ? owner : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				itemProperty.Value = item;
				try
				{
					return val.ShouldSerializeCollectionItem(e);
				}
				finally
				{
					itemProperty.Value = null;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public static class XtraSerializingHelper
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		public static bool XtraSerializing;

		private static List<XtraObjectInfo> CreateSerializeInfo(object control, string name)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<XtraObjectInfo> list = new List<XtraObjectInfo>();
			list.Add(new XtraObjectInfo(name, control));
			return list;
		}

		private static bool TryReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				return reader.Read();
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool TryReadAndOmitWhitespace(XmlReader reader)
		{
			do
			{
				if (!TryReadXml(reader))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			while (reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace);
			return true;
		}

		public static void LoadLayoutFromStream(object control, Stream stream, string name, XtraSerializer serializer)
		{
			List<XtraObjectInfo> list = CreateSerializeInfo(control, name);
			serializer.DeserializeObjects(control, (IList)list.ToArray(), stream, "", (OptionsLayoutBase)null);
		}

		public static void SaveLayoutToStream(object control, Stream stream, string name, XtraSerializer serializer)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<XtraObjectInfo> list = CreateSerializeInfo(control, name);
			list.Add(new XtraObjectInfo("", (object)null));
			serializer.SerializeObjects(control, (IList)list.ToArray(), stream, "", (OptionsLayoutBase)null);
		}

		public static void LoadLayoutFromStream(Chart chart, Stream stream)
		{
			LoadLayoutFromStream(chart, stream, "Chart", (XtraSerializer)(object)new ChartXmlSerializer());
		}

		public static void SaveLayoutToStream(Chart chart, Stream stream)
		{
			SaveLayoutToStream(chart, stream, "Chart", (XtraSerializer)(object)new ChartXmlSerializer());
		}

		public static void LoadLayoutFromStream(SankeyDiagram sankey, Stream stream)
		{
			LoadLayoutFromStream(sankey, stream, "SankeyDiagram", (XtraSerializer)(object)new SankeyXmlSerializer());
		}

		public static void SaveLayoutToStream(SankeyDiagram sankey, Stream stream)
		{
			SaveLayoutToStream(sankey, stream, "SankeyDiagram", (XtraSerializer)(object)new SankeyXmlSerializer());
		}

		private static bool IsValidXml(Stream stream, string readerName)
		{
			using (XmlReader xmlReader = SafeXml.CreateReader(stream))
			{
				if (!TryReadAndOmitWhitespace(xmlReader))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.XmlDeclaration)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!TryReadAndOmitWhitespace(xmlReader))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || xmlReader.Name != readerName)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsValidXml(Stream stream)
		{
			return IsValidXml(stream, "ChartXmlSerializer");
		}

		public static bool IsValidSankeyXml(Stream stream)
		{
			return IsValidXml(stream, "SankeyXmlSerializer");
		}
	}

	public class TaskLinkLayout
	{
		private readonly TaskLink link;

		private readonly List<ZPlaneRectangle> lineRects;

		private readonly LineStrip arrowPoints;

		private readonly BarSeriesPointLayout childLayout;

		public TaskLink Link => link;

		public List<ZPlaneRectangle> LineRects => lineRects;

		public LineStrip ArrowPoints => arrowPoints;

		public BarSeriesPointLayout ChildLayout => childLayout;

		private static int GetNearOffset(int size)
		{
			if (size % 2 != 0)
			{
				return (size - 1) / 2;
			}
			return size / 2;
		}

		private static int GetFarOffset(int size)
		{
			if (size % 2 != 0)
			{
				return (size - 1) / 2;
			}
			return size / 2 - 1;
		}

		internal static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsBottomToTop(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, int startIndent, int finishIndent, int thickness)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[6];
			array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(startPoint, 0.0, -GetFarOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[1] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[0], 0.0, -startIndent, 0.0);
			array[5] = DiagramPoint.Offset(finishPoint, 0.0, GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[4] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[5], 0.0, finishIndent, 0.0);
			int size = (int)Math.Abs(startPoint.X - finishPoint.X) + 1;
			if (startPoint.X > finishPoint.X)
			{
				array[2] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[1], -GetFarOffset(size), 0.0, 0.0);
				array[3] = new DiagramPoint(array[2].X, array[4].Y);
			}
			else
			{
				array[2] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[1], GetNearOffset(size), 0.0, 0.0);
				array[3] = new DiagramPoint(array[2].X, array[4].Y);
			}
			if (array[2].Y > array[3].Y)
			{
				int size2 = (int)Math.Abs(array[2].Y - array[3].Y) + 1;
				double num = GetFarOffset(size2);
				array[1].Y -= num;
				array[2].Y -= num;
				double num2 = GetNearOffset(size2);
				array[3].Y += num2;
				array[4].Y += num2;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsBottomToBottom(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, int startIndent, int finishIndent, int thickness)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[4];
			array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(startPoint, 0.0, -GetFarOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[1] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[0], 0.0, -startIndent, 0.0);
			array[3] = DiagramPoint.Offset(finishPoint, 0.0, -GetFarOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[2] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[3], 0.0, -finishIndent, 0.0);
			int num = (int)Math.Abs(array[1].Y - array[2].Y);
			if (array[1].Y > array[2].Y)
			{
				array[1].Y -= num;
			}
			else
			{
				array[2].Y -= num;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsTopToTop(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, int startIndent, int finishIndent, int thickness)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[4];
			array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(startPoint, 0.0, GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[1] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[0], 0.0, startIndent, 0.0);
			array[3] = DiagramPoint.Offset(finishPoint, 0.0, GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[2] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[3], 0.0, finishIndent, 0.0);
			int num = (int)Math.Abs(array[1].Y - array[2].Y);
			if (array[1].Y > array[2].Y)
			{
				array[2].Y += num;
			}
			else
			{
				array[1].Y += num;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsTopToRight(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, int minIndent, int thickness)
		{
			if (startPoint.X > finishPoint.X || finishPoint.Y + 1.0 < startPoint.Y)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[3];
