			array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(startPoint, 0.0, GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[1] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[0], 0.0, minIndent, 0.0);
			if (finishPoint.Y > array[1].Y)
			{
				array[1].Y += (int)Math.Abs(finishPoint.Y - array[1].Y);
			}
			array[2] = new DiagramPoint(finishPoint.X - (double)GetFarOffset(thickness), array[1].Y, 0.0);
			return array;
		}

		private static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsTopToLeft(DiagramPoint startPoint, DiagramPoint finishPoint, int minIndent, int thickness)
		{
			if (startPoint.X < finishPoint.X || finishPoint.Y + 1.0 < startPoint.Y)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[3];
			array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(startPoint, 0.0, GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0);
			array[1] = DiagramPoint.Offset(array[0], 0.0, minIndent, 0.0);
			if (finishPoint.Y > array[1].Y)
			{
				array[1].Y += (int)Math.Abs(finishPoint.Y - array[1].Y);
			}
			array[2] = new DiagramPoint(finishPoint.X + (double)GetNearOffset(thickness), array[1].Y, 0.0);
			return array;
		}

		private static ZPlaneRectangle CreateHorizontalRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, int thickness)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(p1.Y == p2.Y);
			DiagramPoint point;
			DiagramPoint point2;
			if (p1.X > p2.X)
			{
				point = p2;
				point2 = p1;
			}
			else
			{
				point = p1;
				point2 = p2;
			}
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, -GetNearOffset(thickness), -GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(point2, GetFarOffset(thickness), GetFarOffset(thickness), 0.0));
		}

		private static ZPlaneRectangle CreateVerticalRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, int thickness)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(p1.X == p2.X);
			DiagramPoint point;
			DiagramPoint point2;
			if (p1.Y > p2.Y)
			{
				point = p2;
				point2 = p1;
			}
			else
			{
				point = p1;
				point2 = p2;
			}
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, -GetNearOffset(thickness), -GetNearOffset(thickness), 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(point2, GetFarOffset(thickness), GetFarOffset(thickness), 0.0));
		}

		private static bool CalcIntersection(double x11, double x12, double x21, double x22, out double x1, out double x2)
		{
			x1 = double.NaN;
			x2 = double.NaN;
			if (x21 >= x11 && x21 <= x12)
			{
				x1 = x21;
				x2 = ((x22 > x12) ? x12 : x22);
				return true;
			}
			if (x22 >= x11 && x22 <= x12)
			{
				x1 = x22;
				x2 = ((x21 < x11) ? x11 : x21);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static ZPlaneRectangle CalcIntersection(ZPlaneRectangle rect1, ZPlaneRectangle rect2)
		{
			if (!CalcIntersection(rect1.LeftBottom.X, rect1.RightBottom.X, rect2.LeftBottom.X, rect2.RightBottom.X, out var x, out var x2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CalcIntersection(rect1.LeftBottom.Y, rect1.LeftTop.Y, rect2.LeftBottom.Y, rect2.LeftTop.Y, out var x3, out var x4))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(x, x3, 0.0), new DiagramPoint(x2, x4, 0.0));
		}

		private static List<ZPlaneRectangle> SubtractRectangles(ZPlaneRectangle rect1, ZPlaneRectangle rect2)
		{
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>();
			if (CalcIntersection(rect1, rect2) == null)
			{
				list.Add(rect1);
			}
			else
			{
				if (rect1.RightBottom.X > rect2.RightBottom.X)
				{
					list.Add(new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(rect2.RightBottom.X + 1.0, rect1.LeftBottom.Y, 0.0), new DiagramPoint(rect1.RightBottom.X, rect1.LeftTop.Y, 0.0)));
				}
				if (rect1.LeftBottom.X < rect2.LeftBottom.X)
				{
					list.Add(new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(rect1.LeftBottom.X, rect1.LeftBottom.Y, 0.0), new DiagramPoint(rect2.LeftBottom.X - 1.0, rect1.LeftTop.Y, 0.0)));
				}
				double x = ((rect2.LeftBottom.X > rect1.LeftBottom.X) ? rect2.LeftBottom.X : rect1.LeftBottom.X);
				double x2 = ((rect2.RightBottom.X > rect1.RightBottom.X) ? rect1.RightBottom.X : rect2.RightBottom.X);
				if (rect1.LeftTop.Y > rect2.LeftTop.Y)
				{
					list.Add(new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(x, rect1.LeftTop.Y, 0.0), new DiagramPoint(x2, rect2.LeftTop.Y + 1.0, 0.0)));
				}
				if (rect1.LeftBottom.Y < rect2.LeftBottom.Y)
				{
					list.Add(new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(x, rect1.LeftBottom.Y, 0.0), new DiagramPoint(x2, rect2.LeftBottom.Y - 1.0, 0.0)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<ZPlaneRectangle> SubtractRectangles(List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects, ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>();
			foreach (ZPlaneRectangle rect2 in rects)
			{
				list.AddRange(SubtractRectangles(rect2, rect));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<ZPlaneRectangle> UnionRectangles(List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects)
		{
			if (rects == null || rects.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>();
			list.Add(rects[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < rects.Count; i++)
			{
				List<ZPlaneRectangle> list2 = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>();
				list2.Add(rects[i]);
				for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
				{
					list2 = SubtractRectangles(list2, rects[j]);
					if (list2.Count == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				list.AddRange(list2);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<ZPlaneRectangle> CreateRectangles(DiagramPoint[] points, int thickness)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>();
			if (points.Length == 1)
			{
				list.Add(CreateHorizontalRectangle(points[0], points[0], thickness));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint p = MathUtils.StrongRoundXY(points[i]);
				DiagramPoint p2 = MathUtils.StrongRoundXY(points[i + 1]);
				if (p.Y == p2.Y)
				{
					list.Add(CreateHorizontalRectangle(p, p2, thickness));
				}
				else if (p.X == p2.X)
				{
					list.Add(CreateVerticalRectangle(p, p2, thickness));
				}
				else
				{
					ChartDebug.Assert(condition: false);
				}
			}
			return UnionRectangles(list);
		}

		private static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsArrow(ZPlaneRectangle rect, Direction direction)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[3];
			switch (direction)
			{
			case Direction.LeftToRight:
				array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(rect.RightBottom, 0.0, GetNearOffset((int)rect.Height + 1), 0.0);
				array[1] = rect.LeftBottom;
				array[2] = rect.LeftTop;
				break;
			case Direction.RightToLeft:
				array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(rect.LeftBottom, 0.0, GetNearOffset((int)rect.Height + 1), 0.0);
				array[1] = rect.RightTop;
				array[2] = rect.RightBottom;
				break;
			case Direction.BottomToTop:
				array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(rect.LeftTop, GetNearOffset((int)rect.Width + 1), 0.0, 0.0);
				array[1] = rect.RightBottom;
				array[2] = rect.LeftBottom;
				break;
			case Direction.TopToBottom:
				array[0] = DiagramPoint.Offset(rect.LeftBottom, GetNearOffset((int)rect.Width + 1), 0.0, 0.0);
				array[1] = rect.LeftTop;
				array[2] = rect.RightTop;
				break;
			default:
				throw new DefaultSwitchException();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static DiagramPoint[] CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint point, int width, int height, Direction direction)
		{
			return CreatePointsArrow(direction switch
			{
				Direction.LeftToRight => new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, 0.0, -GetNearOffset(width), 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(point, height - 1, GetFarOffset(width), 0.0)), 
				Direction.RightToLeft => new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, 0.0, -GetNearOffset(width), 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(point, -(height - 1), GetFarOffset(width), 0.0)), 
				Direction.BottomToTop => new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, -GetNearOffset(width), 0.0, 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(point, GetFarOffset(width), height - 1, 0.0)), 
				Direction.TopToBottom => new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, GetFarOffset(width), 0.0, 0.0), DiagramPoint.Offset(point, -GetNearOffset(width), -(height - 1), 0.0)), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			}, direction);
		}

		private static DiagramPoint GetRectangleCenter(RectangleF rect)
		{
			return DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)rect.LeftTop(), GetNearOffset((int)rect.Width + 1), GetNearOffset((int)rect.Height + 1), 0.0);
		}

		private static LineStrip TransformPoints(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, DiagramPoint[] points)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MatrixTransform transform = diagramMapping.Transform;
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(points.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				lineStrip.Add((GRealPoint2D)transform.Apply(points[i]));
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		private static List<ZPlaneRectangle> TransformRectangles(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects)
		{
			if (rects == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> list = new List<ZPlaneRectangle>(rects.Count);
			foreach (ZPlaneRectangle rect in rects)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip = TransformPoints(diagramMapping, new DiagramPoint[2] { rect.LeftBottom, rect.RightTop });
				ZPlaneRectangle item = ZPlaneRectangle.MakeRectangle(new DiagramPoint(lineStrip[0].X, lineStrip[0].Y), new DiagramPoint(lineStrip[1].X, lineStrip[1].Y));
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static object GetMinSeriesPointValue(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			object valueObject = point.GetValueObject(0);
			object valueObject2 = point.GetValueObject(1);
			if (valueObject is DateTime)
			{
				if (!((DateTime)valueObject > (DateTime)valueObject2))
				{
					return valueObject;
				}
				return valueObject2;
			}
			if (!((double)valueObject > (double)valueObject2))
			{
				return valueObject;
			}
			return valueObject2;
		}

		private static object GetMaxSeriesPointValue(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			object valueObject = point.GetValueObject(0);
			object valueObject2 = point.GetValueObject(1);
			if (valueObject is DateTime)
			{
				if (!((DateTime)valueObject > (DateTime)valueObject2))
				{
					return valueObject2;
				}
				return valueObject;
			}
			if (!((double)valueObject > (double)valueObject2))
			{
				return valueObject2;
			}
			return valueObject;
		}

		private static bool IsNormalFinishToStartLink(SeriesPoint parentPoint, SeriesPoint childPoint)
		{
			object minSeriesPointValue = GetMinSeriesPointValue(parentPoint);
			object maxSeriesPointValue = GetMaxSeriesPointValue(childPoint);
			if (minSeriesPointValue is DateTime)
			{
				return (DateTime)maxSeriesPointValue <= (DateTime)minSeriesPointValue;
			}
			return (double)maxSeriesPointValue <= (double)minSeriesPointValue;
		}

		private static int GetFinishPointMinIndent(TaskLinkOptions options)
		{
			if (options.MinIndent <= options.ArrowHeight + 2)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			return options.MinIndent - options.ArrowHeight;
		}

		private static int GetStartPointMinIndent(TaskLinkOptions options)
		{
			return options.MinIndent;
		}

		private static TaskLinkLayout CreateLayoutFinishToFinish(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, TaskLinkOptions options, TaskLink link, GanttSeriesPointLayout parentLayout, GanttSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			RectangleF diagramRect = parentLayout.DiagramRect;
			RectangleF diagramRect2 = childLayout.DiagramRect;
			DiagramPoint startPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect2.LeftBottom(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect2.Width + 1), 1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect.LeftBottom(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect.Width + 1), 1 + options.ArrowHeight, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint[] array = CreatePointsTopToTop(startPoint, finishPoint, GetStartPointMinIndent(options), GetFinishPointMinIndent(options), options.Thickness);
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects = CreateRectangles(array, options.Thickness);
			DiagramPoint[] points = CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint.Offset(array[array.Length - 1], 0.0, -(GetNearOffset(options.Thickness) + 1), 0.0), options.ArrowWidth, options.ArrowHeight, Direction.TopToBottom);
			return new TaskLinkLayout(link, TransformRectangles(diagramMapping, rects), TransformPoints(diagramMapping, points), childLayout);
		}

		private static TaskLinkLayout CreateLayoutNormalFinishToStart(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, TaskLinkOptions options, TaskLink link, GanttSeriesPointLayout parentLayout, GanttSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			RectangleF diagramRect = parentLayout.DiagramRect;
			RectangleF diagramRect2 = childLayout.DiagramRect;
			DiagramPoint startPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect2.LeftBottom(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect2.Width + 1), 1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint rectangleCenter = GetRectangleCenter(diagramRect2);
			DiagramPoint[] array = null;
			DiagramPoint[] points = null;
			if (rectangleCenter.X < (double)diagramRect.LeftBottom().X)
			{
				DiagramPoint finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect.LeftTop(), -(1 + options.ArrowHeight), 0.0, 0.0);
				array = CreatePointsTopToRight(startPoint, finishPoint, GetStartPointMinIndent(options), options.Thickness);
				if (array != null)
				{
					points = CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint.Offset(array[array.Length - 1], 1 + GetFarOffset(options.Thickness), 0.0, 0.0), options.ArrowWidth, options.ArrowHeight, Direction.LeftToRight);
				}
			}
			else if (rectangleCenter.X > (double)diagramRect.RightBottom().X)
			{
				DiagramPoint finishPoint2 = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect.RightTop(), 1 + options.ArrowHeight, 0.0, 0.0);
				array = CreatePointsTopToLeft(startPoint, finishPoint2, GetStartPointMinIndent(options), options.Thickness);
				if (array != null)
				{
					points = CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint.Offset(array[array.Length - 1], -(1 + GetNearOffset(options.Thickness)), 0.0, 0.0), options.ArrowWidth, options.ArrowHeight, Direction.RightToLeft);
				}
			}
			if (array == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects = CreateRectangles(array, options.Thickness);
			return new TaskLinkLayout(link, TransformRectangles(diagramMapping, rects), TransformPoints(diagramMapping, points), childLayout);
		}

		private static TaskLinkLayout CreateLayoutFinishToStart(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, TaskLinkOptions options, TaskLink link, GanttSeriesPointLayout parentLayout, GanttSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			if (IsNormalFinishToStartLink((SeriesPoint)parentLayout.PointData.SeriesPoint, (SeriesPoint)childLayout.PointData.SeriesPoint))
			{
				TaskLinkLayout taskLinkLayout = CreateLayoutNormalFinishToStart(diagramMapping, options, link, parentLayout, childLayout);
				if (taskLinkLayout != null)
				{
					return taskLinkLayout;
				}
			}
			RectangleF diagramRect = parentLayout.DiagramRect;
			RectangleF diagramRect2 = childLayout.DiagramRect;
			PointF pointF = diagramRect2.LeftBottom().Offset(GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect2.Width + 1), 1f);
			PointF pointF2 = diagramRect.LeftTop().Offset(GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect.Width + 1), -(1 + options.ArrowHeight));
			DiagramPoint[] array = CreatePointsBottomToTop((DiagramPoint)pointF2, (DiagramPoint)pointF, GetFinishPointMinIndent(options), GetStartPointMinIndent(options), options.Thickness);
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects = CreateRectangles(array, options.Thickness);
			DiagramPoint[] points = CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint.Offset(array[0], 0.0, GetFarOffset(options.Thickness) + 1, 0.0), options.ArrowWidth, options.ArrowHeight, Direction.BottomToTop);
			return new TaskLinkLayout(link, TransformRectangles(diagramMapping, rects), TransformPoints(diagramMapping, points), childLayout);
		}

		private static TaskLinkLayout CreateLayoutStartToFinish(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, TaskLinkOptions options, TaskLink link, GanttSeriesPointLayout parentLayout, GanttSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			RectangleF diagramRect = parentLayout.DiagramRect;
			RectangleF diagramRect2 = childLayout.DiagramRect;
			DiagramPoint startPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect2.LeftTop(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect2.Width + 1), -1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect.LeftBottom(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect.Width + 1), 1 + options.ArrowHeight, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint[] array = CreatePointsBottomToTop(startPoint, finishPoint, GetStartPointMinIndent(options), GetFinishPointMinIndent(options), options.Thickness);
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects = CreateRectangles(array, options.Thickness);
			DiagramPoint[] points = CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint.Offset(array[array.Length - 1], 0.0, -(GetNearOffset(options.Thickness) + 1), 0.0), options.ArrowWidth, options.ArrowHeight, Direction.TopToBottom);
			return new TaskLinkLayout(link, TransformRectangles(diagramMapping, rects), TransformPoints(diagramMapping, points), childLayout);
		}

		private static TaskLinkLayout CreateLayoutStartToStart(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, TaskLinkOptions options, TaskLink link, GanttSeriesPointLayout parentLayout, GanttSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			RectangleF diagramRect = parentLayout.DiagramRect;
			RectangleF diagramRect2 = childLayout.DiagramRect;
			DiagramPoint startPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect2.LeftTop(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect2.Width + 1), -1.0, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint finishPoint = DiagramPoint.Offset((DiagramPoint)diagramRect.LeftTop(), GetNearOffset((int)diagramRect.Width + 1), -(1 + options.ArrowHeight), 0.0);
			DiagramPoint[] array = CreatePointsBottomToBottom(startPoint, finishPoint, GetStartPointMinIndent(options), GetFinishPointMinIndent(options), options.Thickness);
			List<ZPlaneRectangle> rects = CreateRectangles(array, options.Thickness);
			DiagramPoint[] points = CreatePointsArrow(DiagramPoint.Offset(array[array.Length - 1], 0.0, GetFarOffset(options.Thickness) + 1, 0.0), options.ArrowWidth, options.ArrowHeight, Direction.BottomToTop);
			return new TaskLinkLayout(link, TransformRectangles(diagramMapping, rects), TransformPoints(diagramMapping, points), childLayout);
		}

		public static TaskLinkLayout CreateLayout(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, TaskLinkOptions options, TaskLink link, GanttSeriesPointLayout parentLayout, GanttSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			return link.LinkType switch
			{
				TaskLinkType.FinishToFinish => CreateLayoutFinishToFinish(diagramMapping, options, link, parentLayout, childLayout), 
				TaskLinkType.FinishToStart => CreateLayoutFinishToStart(diagramMapping, options, link, parentLayout, childLayout), 
				TaskLinkType.StartToFinish => CreateLayoutStartToFinish(diagramMapping, options, link, parentLayout, childLayout), 
				TaskLinkType.StartToStart => CreateLayoutStartToStart(diagramMapping, options, link, parentLayout, childLayout), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		private TaskLinkLayout(TaskLink link, List<ZPlaneRectangle> lineRects, LineStrip arrowPoints, BarSeriesPointLayout childLayout)
		{
			this.link = link;
			this.lineRects = lineRects;
			this.arrowPoints = arrowPoints;
			this.childLayout = childLayout;
		}
	}
	public static class MathUtils
	{
		private static bool IsPointOnPlane(DiagramPoint p, DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, double epsilon)
		{
			double num = (p2.Y - p1.Y) * (p3.Z - p1.Z) - (p3.Y - p1.Y) * (p2.Z - p1.Z);
			double num2 = (p3.X - p1.X) * (p2.Z - p1.Z) - (p2.X - p1.X) * (p3.Z - p1.Z);
			double num3 = (p2.X - p1.X) * (p3.Y - p1.Y) - (p3.X - p1.X) * (p2.Y - p1.Y);
			double num4 = num * p1.X + num2 * p1.Y + num3 * p1.Z;
			return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(num * p.X + num2 * p.Y + num3 * p.Z - num4), 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
		}

		private static int InterpolateColorComponent(int comp1, int comp2, double ratio)
		{
			if (ratio == 0.0)
			{
				return comp1;
			}
			return (int)((double)comp1 + (double)(comp2 - comp1) * ratio);
		}

		public static bool IsValidNumber(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double CalcRelativePosition(DiagramPoint start, DiagramPoint end, DiagramPoint p)
		{
			double length = (end - start).Length;
			if (length != 0.0)
			{
				return (p - start).Length / length;
			}
			return 0.5;
		}

		public static DiagramVector CalcNormal(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			DiagramVector result = v1 * v2;
			result.Normalize();
			return result;
		}

		public static DiagramVector CalcNormal(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3)
		{
			return CalcNormal(p2 - p1, p3 - p1);
		}

		public static bool IsPointOnLine(DiagramPoint p, DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon)
		{
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(p1.X - p2.X), 0.0, epsilon) == 0)
			{
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(p.X - p1.X), 0.0, epsilon) != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(p1.Y - p2.Y), 0.0, epsilon) == 0)
				{
					return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(p.Y - p1.Y), 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
				}
				return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs((p.Z - p1.Z) * (p2.Y - p1.Y) - (p2.Z - p1.Z) * (p.Y - p1.Y)), 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
			}
			double num = (p.X - p1.X) / (p2.X - p1.X);
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(p.Y - (p1.Y + num * (p2.Y - p1.Y))), 0.0, epsilon) == 0)
			{
				return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Math.Abs(p.Z - (p1.Z + num * (p2.Z - p1.Z))), 0.0, epsilon) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsPointInsideEllipse(DiagramPoint p, ZPlaneRectangle ellipseRect)
		{
			p.X -= ellipseRect.Center.X;
			p.Y -= ellipseRect.Center.Y;
			double num = ellipseRect.Width * ellipseRect.Width / 4.0;
			double num2 = ellipseRect.Height * ellipseRect.Height / 4.0;
			return p.X * p.X / num + p.Y * p.Y / num2 <= 1.0;
		}

		public static bool IsOnePlanePoints(IList<DiagramPoint> points, double epsilon)
		{
			if (points.Count < 4)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			DiagramPoint p = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			DiagramPoint p2 = DiagramPoint.Zero;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DiagramPoint point in points)
			{
				switch (num)
				{
				case 0:
					diagramPoint = point;
					num++;
					break;
				case 1:
					if (!ArePointsEquals(point, diagramPoint, epsilon))
					{
						p = point;
						num++;
					}
					break;
				case 2:
					if (!ArePointsEquals(point, diagramPoint, epsilon) && !ArePointsEquals(point, p, epsilon) && !IsPointOnLine(point, diagramPoint, p, epsilon))
					{
						p2 = point;
						num++;
					}
					break;
				default:
					if (!IsPointOnPlane(point, diagramPoint, p, p2, epsilon))
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Color InterpolateColor(Color color1, Color color2, double ratio)
		{
			int red = InterpolateColorComponent(color1.R, color2.R, ratio);
			int green = InterpolateColorComponent(color1.G, color2.G, ratio);
			int blue = InterpolateColorComponent(color1.B, color2.B, ratio);
			int alpha = InterpolateColorComponent(color1.A, color2.A, ratio);
			return Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
		}

		public static double ScalarProduct(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			return v1.DX * v2.DX + v1.DY * v2.DY + v1.DZ * v2.DZ;
		}

		public static double CalcAxisXAngle2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return Math.Atan2(p2.Y - p1.Y, p2.X - p1.X);
		}

		public static int IsPointOnPlane(PlaneEquation plane, DiagramPoint point, double epsilon)
		{
			double num = plane.A * point.X + plane.B * point.Y + plane.C * point.Z + plane.D;
			return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 0.0, epsilon);
		}

		public static bool IsTriangleOnPlane(PlaneEquation plane, PlaneTriangle triangle, double epsilon)
		{
			if (IsPointOnPlane(plane, triangle.Vertices[0], epsilon) == 0 && IsPointOnPlane(plane, triangle.Vertices[1], epsilon) == 0)
			{
				return IsPointOnPlane(plane, triangle.Vertices[2], epsilon) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsLineOnPlane(PlaneEquation plane, Line line, double epsilon)
		{
			if (IsPointOnPlane(plane, line.V1, epsilon) == 0)
			{
				return IsPointOnPlane(plane, line.V2, epsilon) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double CalcAngle(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			return Math.Acos(CalcCos(v1, v2));
		}

		public static double CalcCos(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			double num = ScalarProduct(v1, v2) / (v1.Length * v2.Length);
			if (num > 1.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (num < -1.0)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static double CalcSquaredCos(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2)
		{
			double num = ScalarProduct(v1, v2);
			double num2 = num * num / (v1.SquaredLength * v2.SquaredLength);
			if (!(num2 > 1.0))
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		public static DiagramVector InterpolateNormal(DiagramVector n1, DiagramVector n2, double ratio)
		{
			return DiagramVector.CreateNormalized((n2.DX - n1.DX) * ratio + n1.DX, (n2.DY - n1.DY) * ratio + n1.DY, (n2.DZ - n1.DZ) * ratio + n1.DZ);
		}

		public static double CalcLength2D(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p2.X - p1.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Y - p1.Y, 2.0));
		}

		public static float CalcLength2D(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return (float)Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p2.X - p1.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Y - p1.Y, 2.0));
		}

		public static double CalcLength2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p2.X - p1.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Y - p1.Y, 2.0));
		}

		public static double CalcLength(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p2.X - p1.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Y - p1.Y, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Z - p1.Z, 2.0));
		}

		public static bool ArePointsEquals(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon)
		{
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(p1.X, p2.X, epsilon) == 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(p1.Y, p2.Y, epsilon) == 0)
			{
				return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(p1.Z, p2.Z, epsilon) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double CalcSquaredLength(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			double num = p1.X - p2.X;
			double num2 = p1.Y - p2.Y;
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		public static bool ArePointsEquals(DiagramPoint[] points, double epsilon)
		{
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!ArePointsEquals(points[0], points[i], epsilon))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool ArePointsEquals2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(Math.Pow(p2.X - p1.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Y - p1.Y, 2.0));
			return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 0.0, epsilon * epsilon) == 0;
		}

		public static bool AreVectorsEquals(DiagramVector v1, DiagramVector v2, double epsilon)
		{
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(v1.DX, v2.DX, epsilon) == 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(v1.DY, v2.DY, epsilon) == 0)
			{
				return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(v1.DZ, v2.DZ, epsilon) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double NormalizeDegree(double angleDegree)
		{
			return Radian2Degree(GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(Degree2Radian(angleDegree)));
		}

		public static double Degree2Radian(double angleDegree)
		{
			return angleDegree * Math.PI / 180.0;
		}

		public static double Radian2Degree(double angleRadian)
		{
			return angleRadian * 180.0 / Math.PI;
		}

		public static DXMatrix CalcTranslateMatrix(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Reset();
			double angleRadian = CalcAxisXAngle2D(p1, p2);
			dXMatrix.Rotate((float)Radian2Degree(angleRadian), DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.Translate((float)p1.X, (float)p1.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public static bool IsOnePlanePrimitives(PlanePrimitive primitive1, PlanePrimitive primitive2)
		{
			Vertex[] vertices = primitive1.Vertices;
			Vertex[] vertices2 = primitive2.Vertices;
			if (vertices.Length > 2 && vertices2.Length == 2)
			{
				DiagramVector v = CalcNormal(vertices[0], vertices[1], vertices[2]);
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(ScalarProduct(vertices2[0].Point - vertices[0].Point, v), 0.0, 0.01) == 0)
				{
					return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(ScalarProduct(vertices2[1].Point - vertices[1].Point, v), 0.0, 0.01) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (vertices.Length > 2 && vertices2.Length > 2)
			{
				DiagramVector v2 = CalcNormal(vertices[0], vertices[1], vertices[2]);
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(ScalarProduct(vertices2[0].Point - vertices[0].Point, v2), 0.0, 0.01) == 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(ScalarProduct(vertices2[1].Point - vertices[1].Point, v2), 0.0, 0.01) == 0)
				{
					return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(ScalarProduct(vertices2[2].Point - vertices[2].Point, v2), 0.0, 0.01) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		public static double CalcAngleBetweenLines2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, DiagramPoint p4)
		{
			double num = CalcAxisXAngle2D(p1, p2);
			double num2 = CalcAxisXAngle2D(p3, p4);
			return num2 - num;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint CalcIntervalCenter2D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon)
		{
			if (ArePointsEquals2D(p1, p2, epsilon))
			{
				return p1;
			}
			double num = Math.Min(p1.X, p2.X);
			double num2 = Math.Max(p1.X, p2.X);
			double num3 = Math.Min(p1.Y, p2.Y);
			double num4 = Math.Max(p1.Y, p2.Y);
			double x = num + (num2 - num) / 2.0;
			double y = num3 + (num4 - num3) / 2.0;
			return new DiagramPoint(x, y, p1.Z);
		}

		public static DiagramPoint CalcIntervalCenter3D(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon)
		{
			if (ArePointsEquals2D(p1, p2, epsilon))
			{
				return p1;
			}
			double num = Math.Min(p1.X, p2.X);
			double num2 = Math.Max(p1.X, p2.X);
			double num3 = Math.Min(p1.Y, p2.Y);
			double num4 = Math.Max(p1.Y, p2.Y);
			double num5 = Math.Min(p1.Z, p2.Z);
			double num6 = Math.Max(p1.Z, p2.Z);
			double x = num + (num2 - num) / 2.0;
			double y = num3 + (num4 - num3) / 2.0;
			double z = num5 + (num6 - num5) / 2.0;
			return new DiagramPoint(x, y, z);
		}

		public static Vertex CalcIntervalCenter3D(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, double epsilon)
		{
			DiagramPoint point = CalcIntervalCenter3D((DiagramPoint)v1, (DiagramPoint)v2, epsilon);
			DiagramVector normal = InterpolateNormal(v1.Normal, v2.Normal, 0.5);
			Color color = InterpolateColor(v1.Color, v2.Color, 0.5);
			return new Vertex(point, normal, color);
		}

		public static PlaneEquation CalcPlaneEquation(PlanePolygon polygon)
		{
			DiagramVector diagramVector = CalcNormal(polygon.Vertices[0], polygon.Vertices[1], polygon.Vertices[2]);
			double d = 0.0 - (diagramVector.DX * polygon.Vertices[0].X + diagramVector.DY * polygon.Vertices[0].Y + diagramVector.DZ * polygon.Vertices[0].Z);
			return new PlaneEquation(diagramVector.DX, diagramVector.DY, diagramVector.DZ, d);
		}

		public static double CalcSquaredLength(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return (p2 - p1).SquaredLength;
		}

		public static DiagramVector CalcNormal(PlanePolygon polygon)
		{
			Vertex[] vertices = polygon.Vertices;
			if (vertices == null)
			{
				return DiagramVector.Zero;
			}
			for (int i = 2; i < vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!IsPointOnLine(vertices[i], vertices[0], vertices[1], 0.01))
				{
					return CalcNormal(vertices[i], vertices[0], vertices[1]);
				}
			}
			return DiagramVector.Zero;
		}

		public static DiagramVector CalcNormal(IList<DiagramPoint> points)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Count == 0)
			{
				return DiagramVector.Zero;
			}
			List<DiagramPoint> list = new List<DiagramPoint>();
			foreach (DiagramPoint point in points)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (DiagramPoint item in list)
				{
					if (ArePointsEquals(item, point, 0.01))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (list.Count == 2)
				{
					flag = !IsPointOnLine(point, list[0], list[1], 0.01);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(point);
				}
				if (list.Count == 3)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (list.Count < 3)
			{
				return DiagramVector.Zero;
			}
			return CalcNormal(list[0], list[1], list[2]);
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D GetPointInDirection2D(GRealPoint2D sourcePoint, DiagramVector direction, double length)
		{
			direction.DZ = 0.0;
			direction.Normalize();
			return new GRealPoint2D(sourcePoint.X + length * direction.DX, sourcePoint.Y + length * direction.DY);
		}

		public static DiagramPoint StrongRoundXY(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(StrongRound(point.X), StrongRound(point.Y));
		}

		public static int StrongRound(double value)
		{
			return Math.Sign(value) * (int)(Math.Abs(value) + 0.5);
		}

		public static Rectangle StrongRound(RectangleF rect)
		{
			return new Rectangle(StrongRound(rect.X), StrongRound(rect.Y), StrongRound(rect.Width), StrongRound(rect.Height));
		}

		public static Size StrongRound(SizeF size)
		{
			return new Size(StrongRound(size.Width), StrongRound(size.Height));
		}

		public static DXRectangle MakeDxRect(RectangleF rect)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new DXRectangle(StrongRound(rect.X), StrongRound(rect.Y), StrongRound(rect.Width), StrongRound(rect.Height));
		}

		public static List<DiagramPoint> MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, bool doublePoints, double width)
		{
			GRealPoint2D pointInDirection2D = GetPointInDirection2D(new GRealPoint2D(0.0, 0.0), CalcNormal(p2 - p1, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)), width / 2.0);
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Translate((float)pointInDirection2D.X, (float)pointInDirection2D.Y);
			DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix2.Translate((float)(0.0 - pointInDirection2D.X), (float)(0.0 - pointInDirection2D.Y));
			PointF[] array = new PointF[2]
			{
				(PointF)p1,
				(PointF)p2
			};
			PointF[] array2 = new PointF[2]
			{
				(PointF)p1,
				(PointF)p2
			};
			dXMatrix.TransformPoints(array);
			dXMatrix2.TransformPoints(array2);
			List<DiagramPoint> list = new List<DiagramPoint>();
			list.Add(new DiagramPoint(array[0].X, array[0].Y, p1.Z));
			if (doublePoints)
			{
				list.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
			}
			list.Add(new DiagramPoint(array[1].X, array[1].Y, p1.Z));
			if (doublePoints)
			{
				list.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
			}
			list.Add(new DiagramPoint(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y, p1.Z));
			if (doublePoints)
			{
				list.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
			}
			list.Add(new DiagramPoint(array2[0].X, array2[0].Y, p1.Z));
			if (doublePoints)
			{
				list.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint center, SizeF size)
		{
			DiagramPoint point = DiagramPoint.Offset(center, (double)(0f - size.Width) / 2.0, (double)(0f - size.Height) / 2.0, 0.0);
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(point, size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		public static RectangleF MakeRectangle(PointF corner1, PointF corner2)
		{
			return MakeRectangle(corner1, corner2, 0f);
		}

		public static RectangleF MakeRectangle(PointF corner1, PointF corner2, float extend)
		{
			float x = ((corner1.X < corner2.X) ? corner1.X : corner2.X);
			float y = ((corner1.Y < corner2.Y) ? corner1.Y : corner2.Y);
			float width = Math.Abs(corner1.X - corner2.X) + extend;
			float height = Math.Abs(corner1.Y - corner2.Y) + extend;
			return new RectangleF(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static RectangleF MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint corner1, DiagramPoint corner2, double extend)
		{
			double num = ((corner1.X < corner2.X) ? corner1.X : corner2.X);
			double num2 = ((corner1.Y < corner2.Y) ? corner1.Y : corner2.Y);
			double num3 = Math.Abs(corner1.X - corner2.X) + extend;
			double num4 = Math.Abs(corner1.Y - corner2.Y) + extend;
			return new RectangleF((float)num, (float)num2, (float)num3, (float)num4);
		}

		public static RectangleF MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint corner1, DiagramPoint corner2)
		{
			double num = ((corner1.X < corner2.X) ? corner1.X : corner2.X);
			double num2 = ((corner1.Y < corner2.Y) ? corner1.Y : corner2.Y);
			double num3 = Math.Abs(corner1.X - corner2.X);
			double num4 = Math.Abs(corner1.Y - corner2.Y);
			return new RectangleF((float)num, (float)num2, (float)num3, (float)num4);
		}

		public static Rectangle MakeRoundedRectangle(DiagramPoint corner1, DiagramPoint corner2)
		{
			double value = ((corner1.X < corner2.X) ? corner1.X : corner2.X);
			double value2 = ((corner1.Y < corner2.Y) ? corner1.Y : corner2.Y);
			double value3 = Math.Abs(corner1.X - corner2.X);
			double value4 = Math.Abs(corner1.Y - corner2.Y);
			return new Rectangle(StrongRound(value), StrongRound(value2), StrongRound(value3), StrongRound(value4));
		}

		public static bool IsAngleNormal(double angle)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(angle) / (Math.PI / 2.0);
			return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, Math.Round(num), 1E-05) == 0;
		}

		public static DiagramVector Multiply(DiagramVector v, double[] matrix)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(v.DX * matrix[0] + v.DY * matrix[4] + v.DZ * matrix[8], v.DX * matrix[1] + v.DY * matrix[5] + v.DZ * matrix[9], v.DX * matrix[2] + v.DY * matrix[6] + v.DZ * matrix[10]);
		}

		public static DiagramPoint CalcMinDistancePoint2D(DiagramPoint point, DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, double epsilon, out double squaredDistance)
		{
			squaredDistance = 0.0;
			if (ArePointsEquals2D(p1, p2, epsilon))
			{
				squaredDistance = CalcSquaredLength(point, p1);
				return p1;
			}
			DiagramVector diagramVector = p2 - p1;
			IntersectionUtils.CalcLinesIntersection2D(p2: new DiagramPoint(point.X + diagramVector.DY, point.Y - diagramVector.DX), p1: point, p3: p1, p4: p2, intervalMode: false, epsilon: epsilon, intersectionPoint: out var intersectionPoint);
			DiagramPoint result;
			if (IntersectionUtils.IsPointOnInterval2D(p1, p2, intersectionPoint, epsilon, out var _))
			{
				result = intersectionPoint;
				squaredDistance = CalcSquaredLength(point, intersectionPoint);
			}
			else
			{
				double num = CalcSquaredLength(point, p1);
				double num2 = CalcSquaredLength(point, p2);
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					result = p1;
					squaredDistance = num;
				}
				else
				{
					result = p2;
					squaredDistance = num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint[] CalcInscribedEllipsePoints(YPlaneRectangle plane, double startAngle, int pointsCount)
		{
			double num = plane.Height / 2.0;
			double num2 = plane.Width / 2.0;
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[pointsCount];
			double num3 = Math.PI * 2.0 / (double)pointsCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < pointsCount; i++)
			{
				double num4 = (double)i * num3 + startAngle;
				double num5 = num * Math.Cos(num4);
				double num6 = num2 * Math.Sin(num4);
				array[i] = new DiagramPoint(num5 + plane.Center.X, plane.Center.Y, num6 + plane.Center.Z);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static bool CalcEllipseTangentLines(ZPlaneRectangle ellipseRect, DiagramPoint point, out double angle1, out double angle2)
		{
			angle1 = (angle2 = 0.0);
			if (IsPointInsideEllipse(point, ellipseRect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = point.X - ellipseRect.Center.X;
			double num2 = point.Y - ellipseRect.Center.Y;
			double num3 = num * num;
			double num4 = num2 * num2;
			double num5 = ellipseRect.Width * ellipseRect.Width / 4.0;
			double num6 = ellipseRect.Height * ellipseRect.Height / 4.0;
			double a;
			double b;
			double c;
			if (num3 < num4)
			{
				a = num4 * num5 + num6 * num3;
				b = -2.0 * num5 * num6 * num;
				c = num6 * num5 * num5 - num4 * num5 * num5;
			}
			else
			{
				a = num3 * num6 + num4 * num5;
				b = -2.0 * num5 * num6 * num2;
				c = num6 * num6 * num5 - num3 * num6 * num6;
			}
			List<double> list = GeometricUtils.CalcQuadraticEquation(a, b, c);
			if (list.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num7;
			double num8;
			double num9;
			double num10;
			if (num3 < num4)
			{
				num7 = list[0];
				num8 = num6 * (num5 - list[0] * num) / (num2 * num5);
				num9 = list[1];
				num10 = num6 * (num5 - list[1] * num) / (num2 * num5);
			}
			else
			{
				num8 = list[0];
				num7 = num5 * (num6 - list[0] * num2) / (num * num6);
				num10 = list[1];
				num9 = num5 * (num6 - list[1] * num2) / (num * num6);
			}
			angle1 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(Math.Atan2(num8 - num2, num7 - num));
			angle2 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(Math.Atan2(num10 - num2, num9 - num));
			return true;
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle CalcBounds(ZPlaneRectangle rect, int rotationAngleInDegrees)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.RotateAt(rotationAngleInDegrees, (PointF)rect.Center);
			double num2;
			double num = (num2 = double.MaxValue);
			double num4;
			double num3 = (num4 = double.MinValue);
			Vertex[] vertices = rect.Vertices;
			foreach (Vertex vertex in vertices)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = TransformUtils.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, vertex.Point);
				if (diagramPoint.X < num)
				{
					num = diagramPoint.X;
				}
				if (diagramPoint.X > num3)
				{
					num3 = diagramPoint.X;
				}
				if (diagramPoint.Y < num2)
				{
					num2 = diagramPoint.Y;
				}
				if (diagramPoint.Y > num4)
				{
					num4 = diagramPoint.Y;
				}
			}
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(num, num2), new DiagramPoint(num3, num4));
		}

		public static int Ceiling(double doubleNumber)
		{
			return (int)Math.Ceiling(doubleNumber);
		}

		public static bool IsNanOrInfinity(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return double.IsInfinity(value);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public static class TransformUtils
	{
		public static DiagramPoint ApplyTransform(DXMatrix matrix, DiagramPoint diagramPoint)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[1] { (PointF)diagramPoint };
			matrix.TransformPoints(array);
			return (DiagramPoint)array[0];
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator : Diagram3DDomain
	{
		private const int diagramCorrection = 1;

		private const int seriesWeightStep = 10000;

		private readonly SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList;

		private List<List<Series>> seriesGroups = new List<List<Series>>();

		private IAxisRangeData VisualRangeX => Diagram.AxisX.VisualRangeData;

		public new XYDiagram3D Diagram => (XYDiagram3D)base.Diagram;

		public new double Depth => base.Depth - PlaneDepth * 2.0;

		public double PlaneDepth => Diagram.PlaneDepthFixed;

		public Rectangle MappingBounds => base.Bounds;

		public override Rectangle ElementBounds => base.Bounds;

		public static XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator Create(XYDiagram3D diagram, Rectangle bounds, SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList)
		{
			XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator xYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator = new XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator(diagram, bounds, containerDataList);
			xYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator.CalculateParameters();
			return xYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator;
		}

		public static PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedron(PlaneEquation clippingPlane, PlaneEquation separatingPlane, PlanePolygon[] polyhedron)
		{
			IntersectionUtils.CalcPolyhedronIntersection(clippingPlane, polyhedron, 0.01, out var frontPolyhedron, out var _, out var frontIntersection, out var _);
			if (frontIntersection != null)
			{
				frontIntersection.Visible = true;
				if (separatingPlane != null && IntersectionUtils.CalcPolygonIntersection3D(separatingPlane, frontIntersection, 0.01, out var _, out var frontPolygon, out var backPolygon) == Intersection.Yes)
				{
					if (frontPolygon != null)
					{
						frontPolyhedron.Add(frontPolygon);
					}
					if (backPolygon != null)
					{
						frontPolyhedron.Add(backPolygon);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					frontPolyhedron.Add(frontIntersection);
				}
			}
			return frontPolyhedron?.ToArray();
		}

		private XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator(XYDiagram3D diagram, Rectangle bounds, SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList)
			: base(diagram, bounds)
		{
			this.containerDataList = containerDataList;
		}

		private int GetSeriesGroupIndex(Series series)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < seriesGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				if (seriesGroups[i].Contains(series))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("series");
		}

		private int GetSeriesIndex(Series series)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in containerDataList.AllSeriesData)
			{
				if (allSeriesDatum.Series == series)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void CalcSeriesGroups()
		{
			seriesGroups.Clear();
			foreach (SeriesContainerData containerData in containerDataList)
			{
				List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
				foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData in containerData.SeriesDataList)
				{
					list.Add(seriesData.Series);
				}
				seriesGroups.Add(list);
			}
		}

		private double CalcSeriesDepth()
		{
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in containerDataList.AllSeriesData)
			{
				if (allSeriesDatum.Series.View is XYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase)
				{
					double seriesDepth = xYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase.GetSeriesDepth();
					if (!double.IsInfinity(seriesDepth) && (double.IsInfinity(num) || seriesDepth > num))
					{
						num = seriesDepth;
					}
					int seriesDepthFixed = xYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase.GetSeriesDepthFixed();
					if (seriesDepthFixed > num2)
					{
						num2 = seriesDepthFixed;
					}
				}
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(num))
			{
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				int num3 = containerDataList.AllSeriesData.Count();
				if (num3 <= 0)
				{
					num3 = 1;
				}
				return (double)base.Bounds.Width * 0.3 / (double)num3;
			}
			double coord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(VisualRangeX, 0.0, base.Bounds.Width);
			double coord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(VisualRangeX, num, base.Bounds.Width);
			return Math.Abs(coord2 - coord) + (double)num2;
		}

		private double CalcSeriesDistance()
		{
			double coord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(VisualRangeX, 0.0, base.Bounds.Width);
			double coord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(VisualRangeX, Diagram.SeriesDistance, base.Bounds.Width);
			return Math.Abs(coord2 - coord) + (double)Diagram.SeriesDistanceFixed;
		}

		private double CalcDiagramDepth()
		{
			double num = CalcSeriesDepth();
			if (seriesGroups.Count == 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			double num2 = CalcSeriesDistance();
			return num * (double)seriesGroups.Count + num2 * (double)(seriesGroups.Count - 1) + (double)(Diagram.SeriesIndentFixed * 2);
		}

		private PlaneEquation GetLeftPlaneEquation()
		{
			return new PlaneEquation(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private PlaneEquation GetRightPlaneEquation()
		{
			double clampedCoord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(Diagram.AxisX.VisualRangeData, double.PositiveInfinity, base.Bounds.Width);
			int num = (int)Math.Round(clampedCoord);
			return new PlaneEquation(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0, num);
		}

		private PlaneEquation GetBottomPlaneEquation()
		{
			return new PlaneEquation(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private PlaneEquation GetTopPlaneEquation()
		{
			double clampedCoord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(Diagram.AxisY.VisualRangeData, double.PositiveInfinity, base.Bounds.Height);
			int num = (int)Math.Round(clampedCoord);
			return new PlaneEquation(0.0, -1.0, 0.0, num);
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedronByLeftPlane(PlanePolygon[] polyhedron, Box boundingBox, PlaneEquation separatingPlane)
		{
			if (polyhedron == null || polyhedron.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PlaneEquation leftPlaneEquation = GetLeftPlaneEquation();
			if (boundingBox != null)
			{
				if (boundingBox.Location.X + boundingBox.Width < leftPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (boundingBox.Location.X >= leftPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return polyhedron;
				}
			}
			return ClipPolyhedron(leftPlaneEquation, separatingPlane, polyhedron);
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedronByRightPlane(PlanePolygon[] polyhedron, Box boundingBox, PlaneEquation separatingPlane)
		{
			if (polyhedron == null || polyhedron.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PlaneEquation rightPlaneEquation = GetRightPlaneEquation();
			if (boundingBox != null)
			{
				if (boundingBox.Location.X + boundingBox.Width <= rightPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return polyhedron;
				}
				if (boundingBox.Location.X > rightPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return ClipPolyhedron(rightPlaneEquation, separatingPlane, polyhedron);
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedronByBottomPlane(PlanePolygon[] polyhedron, Box boundingBox, PlaneEquation separatingPlane)
		{
			if (polyhedron == null || polyhedron.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PlaneEquation bottomPlaneEquation = GetBottomPlaneEquation();
			if (boundingBox != null)
			{
				if (boundingBox.Location.Y + boundingBox.Height < bottomPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (boundingBox.Location.Y >= bottomPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return polyhedron;
				}
			}
			return ClipPolyhedron(bottomPlaneEquation, separatingPlane, polyhedron);
		}

		private PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedronByTopPlane(PlanePolygon[] polyhedron, Box boundingBox, PlaneEquation separatingPlane)
		{
			if (polyhedron == null || polyhedron.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PlaneEquation topPlaneEquation = GetTopPlaneEquation();
			if (boundingBox != null)
			{
				if (boundingBox.Location.Y + boundingBox.Height <= topPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return polyhedron;
				}
				if (boundingBox.Location.Y > topPlaneEquation.D)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return ClipPolyhedron(topPlaneEquation, separatingPlane, polyhedron);
		}

		private IList<PlanePolygon> ClipPolygons(PlaneEquation plane, IList<PlanePolygon> polygons)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			foreach (PlanePolygon polygon in polygons)
			{
				Vertex[] intersectionVertices;
				PlanePolygon frontPolygon;
				PlanePolygon backPolygon;
				Intersection intersection = IntersectionUtils.CalcPolygonIntersection3D(plane, polygon, 0.01, out intersectionVertices, out frontPolygon, out backPolygon);
				if (intersection == Intersection.Match)
				{
					list.Add(polygon);
				}
				else if (frontPolygon != null)
				{
					list.Add(frontPolygon);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Line[] ClipLines(PlaneEquation plane, Line[] lines)
		{
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			foreach (Line line in lines)
			{
				Vertex intersectionVertex;
				Line frontLine;
				Line backLine;
				Intersection intersection = IntersectionUtils.CalcLineIntersection3D(plane, line, 0.01, out intersectionVertex, out frontLine, out backLine);
				if (intersection == Intersection.Match)
				{
					list.Add(line);
				}
				else if (frontLine != null)
				{
					list.Add(frontLine);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private IMinMaxValues TransformAxisRange(IAxisData axis)
		{
			ITransformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			IMinMaxValues visualRange = axis.VisualRange;
			return new MinMaxValues(transformation.TransformForward(visualRange.Min), transformation.TransformForward(visualRange.Max));
		}

		private double TransformValue(double source, IAxisData axis)
		{
			ITransformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			return transformation.TransformForward(source);
		}

		internal GraphicsCommand CreateDiagramLightingCommand(out GraphicsCommand innerLightingCommand)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new LightingGraphicsCommand(Color.FromArgb(255, 160, 160, 160), Color.White, Color.Black, 2f);
			DiagramPoint position = new DiagramPoint(0.0 - base.ViewRadius, base.ViewRadius, base.ViewRadius * 1.25);
			innerLightingCommand = new LightGraphicsCommand(0, Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), Color.FromArgb(255, 140, 140, 140), Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), position, DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(base.ViewRadius - position.X, 0.0 - position.Y, 0.0 - position.Z));
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(innerLightingCommand);
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		protected override void SetDimensions()
		{
			CalcSeriesGroups();
			double num = (PlaneDepth + 1.0) * 2.0;
			SetWidth((double)base.Bounds.Width + num);
			SetHeight((double)base.Bounds.Height + num);
			SetDepth(CalcDiagramDepth() + num);
		}

		protected override GraphicsCommand CreateAdditionalModelViewCommand()
		{
			return new TranslateGraphicsCommand(PlaneDepth + 1.0 - base.Width * 0.5, PlaneDepth + 1.0 - base.Height * 0.5, (0.0 - Depth) * 0.5);
		}

		public GraphicsCommand CreateLightingCommand(out GraphicsCommand innerLightingCommand)
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new LightingGraphicsCommand(Color.FromArgb(255, 105, 105, 105), Color.White, Color.Black, 2f);
			DiagramPoint position = new DiagramPoint((0.0 - base.ViewRadius) * 1.1, base.ViewRadius, base.ViewRadius * 1.8);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new LightGraphicsCommand(0, Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), Color.FromArgb(255, 225, 225, 225), Color.FromArgb(255, 20, 20, 20), position, DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(base.ViewRadius - position.X, 0.0 - position.Y, 0.0 - position.Z), 8f, 180f, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			position = new DiagramPoint(base.ViewRadius, base.ViewRadius * 1.6, base.ViewRadius);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand3 = new LightGraphicsCommand(1, Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), Color.FromArgb(255, 125, 125, 125), Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0), position, DiagramVector.CreateNormalized(0.0 - position.X, 0.0 - position.Y, 0.0 - position.Z), 0f, 180f, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand3);
			innerLightingCommand = graphicsCommand3;
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public double CalcSeriesWidth(XYDiagram3DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			double coord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(VisualRangeX, 0.0, base.Bounds.Width, clamped: false);
			double coord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(VisualRangeX, view.GetSeriesDepth(), base.Bounds.Width, clamped: false);
			return Math.Abs(coord - coord2);
		}

		public double CalcSeriesOffset(Series series)
		{
			int seriesGroupIndex = GetSeriesGroupIndex(series);
			if (seriesGroupIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("series");
			}
			double num = CalcSeriesDepth();
			double num2 = CalcSeriesDistance();
			return (double)seriesGroupIndex * (num2 + num) + (double)Diagram.SeriesIndentFixed + num / 2.0;
		}

		public BoxPlane CalcVisiblePlanes()
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = Project(DiagramPoint.Zero);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = Project(new DiagramPoint(base.Width, 0.0, 0.0));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = Project(new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0, Depth));
			BoxPlane boxPlane = BoxPlane.Bottom;
			boxPlane = (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((diagramPoint.Z >= diagramPoint3.Z) ? 1 : 2));
			return (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((diagramPoint.Z >= diagramPoint2.Z) ? 16 : 32));
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(double argument, double value, bool clipping)
		{
			double coord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(TransformAxisRange(Diagram.AxisX), TransformValue(argument, Diagram.AxisX), base.Bounds.Width, clipping);
			double coord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(TransformAxisRange(Diagram.AxisY), TransformValue(value, Diagram.AxisY), base.Bounds.Height, clipping);
			return new DiagramPoint(Math.Round(coord), Math.Round(coord2));
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetDiagramPoint(Series series, double argument, double value, bool clipping)
		{
			return DiagramPoint.Offset(GetDiagramPoint(argument, value, clipping), 0.0, 0.0, CalcSeriesOffset(series));
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetDiagramPointForDiagram(double argument, double value)
		{
			double clampedCoord = AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(TransformAxisRange(Diagram.AxisX), TransformValue(argument, Diagram.AxisX), base.Bounds.Width + 2);
			double clampedCoord2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(TransformAxisRange(Diagram.AxisY), TransformValue(value, Diagram.AxisY), base.Bounds.Height + 2);
			int num = (int)Math.Round(clampedCoord) - 1;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round(clampedCoord2) - 1;
			return new DiagramPoint(num, num2, -1.0);
		}

		public List<DiagramPoint> GetSeriesBounds(Series series, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = GetDiagramPoint(series, double.NegativeInfinity, minValue, clipping: true);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = GetDiagramPoint(series, double.PositiveInfinity, minValue, clipping: true);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = GetDiagramPoint(series, double.PositiveInfinity, maxValue, clipping: true);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint4 = GetDiagramPoint(series, double.NegativeInfinity, maxValue, clipping: true);
			return new List<DiagramPoint>(new DiagramPoint[8] { diagramPoint, diagramPoint, diagramPoint2, diagramPoint2, diagramPoint3, diagramPoint3, diagramPoint4, diagramPoint4 });
		}

		public PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedron(PlanePolygon[] polyhedron)
		{
			return ClipPolyhedron(polyhedron, null, null);
		}

		public PlanePolygon[] ClipPolyhedron(PlanePolygon[] polyhedron, Box boundingBox, PlaneEquation separatingPlane)
		{
			polyhedron = ClipPolyhedronByLeftPlane(polyhedron, boundingBox, separatingPlane);
			if (polyhedron == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			polyhedron = ClipPolyhedronByRightPlane(polyhedron, boundingBox, separatingPlane);
			if (polyhedron == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			polyhedron = ClipPolyhedronByBottomPlane(polyhedron, boundingBox, separatingPlane);
			if (polyhedron == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ClipPolyhedronByTopPlane(polyhedron, boundingBox, separatingPlane);
		}

		public IList<PlanePolygon> ClipPolygons(IList<PlanePolygon> polygons)
		{
			if (polygons == null || polygons.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			polygons = ClipPolygons(GetLeftPlaneEquation(), polygons);
			if (polygons == null || polygons.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			polygons = ClipPolygons(GetRightPlaneEquation(), polygons);
			if (polygons == null || polygons.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			polygons = ClipPolygons(GetBottomPlaneEquation(), polygons);
			if (polygons == null || polygons.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ClipPolygons(GetTopPlaneEquation(), polygons);
		}

		public Line[] ClipLines(Line[] lines)
		{
			if (lines == null || lines.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lines = ClipLines(GetLeftPlaneEquation(), lines);
			if (lines == null || lines.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lines = ClipLines(GetRightPlaneEquation(), lines);
			if (lines == null || lines.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lines = ClipLines(GetBottomPlaneEquation(), lines);
			if (lines == null || lines.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ClipLines(GetTopPlaneEquation(), lines);
		}

		public int GetSeriesWeight(Series series)
		{
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(series);
			if (seriesIndex != -1)
			{
				return seriesIndex * 10000;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public double CalcConnectorAngle(DiagramVector direction)
		{
			DiagramVector v = MathUtils.Multiply(direction, Diagram.RotationMatrix);
			double num = MathUtils.CalcAngle(v, new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, 0.0, Math.PI / 18.0) != 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num, Math.PI, Math.PI / 18.0) != 0)
			{
				return Math.Atan2(v.DY, v.DX);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram3DViewData : PaneViewData
	{
		public const int BackImageWeight = 0;

		public const int GridLinesYWeight = 1;

		public const int GridLinesXWeight = 2;

		public const int MinorGridLinesYWeight = 3;

		public const int MinorGridLinesXWeight = 4;

		public const int InterlacedYWeight = 5;

		public const int InterlacedXWeight = 6;

		public const int DiagramWeight = 7;

		private readonly List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		private readonly List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;

		private readonly XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator;

		private readonly Axis3DViewData axisXViewData;

		private readonly Axis3DViewData axisYViewData;

		private readonly Graphics3DCache graphicsCache;

		private readonly Box inner;

		private readonly List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList;

		private readonly IList<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList;

		private Box back;

		private Box fore;

		private Box left;

		private Box right;

		private Box bottom;

		private new XYDiagram3D Diagram => (XYDiagram3D)base.Diagram;

		public XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator CoordsCalculator => coordsCalculator;

		public Axis3DViewData AxisXViewData => axisXViewData;

		public Axis3DViewData AxisYViewData => axisYViewData;

		public Box Inner => inner;

		public Box Back => back;

		public Box Fore => fore;

		public Box Left => left;

		public Box Right => right;

		public Box Bottom => bottom;

		public IList<SeriesLayout> SeriesLayoutList => seriesLayoutList;

		public override List<AnnotationLayout> AnnotationsAnchorPointsLayout => annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		public override List<LegendViewData> LegendViewDataList => legendViewDataList;

		private static GraphicsCommand CreateImageBackgroundGraphicsCommand(PlanePrimitive primitive)
		{
			if (!(primitive is PlanePolygon polygon))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("primitive");
			}
			MaskColorBufferGraphicsCommand maskColorBufferGraphicsCommand = new MaskColorBufferGraphicsCommand();
			MaskDepthBufferGraphicsCommand maskDepthBufferGraphicsCommand = new MaskDepthBufferGraphicsCommand();
			maskColorBufferGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(maskDepthBufferGraphicsCommand);
			maskDepthBufferGraphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(new PolygonGraphicsCommand(polygon));
			return maskColorBufferGraphicsCommand;
		}

		public XYDiagram3DViewData(XYDiagram3DCoordsCalculator coordsCalculator, Graphics3DCache graphicsCache, List<SeriesLayout> seriesLayoutList, List<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData, List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList)
			: base(coordsCalculator.Diagram, coordsCalculator.Bounds, labelLayoutLists)
		{
			this.coordsCalculator = coordsCalculator;
			this.graphicsCache = graphicsCache;
			inner = CalcInnerBox();
			CalcPlaneBoxes(coordsCalculator.CalcVisiblePlanes());
			XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D = coordsCalculator.Diagram;
			axisXViewData = new Axis3DViewData(xYDiagram3D.AxisX, this);
			axisYViewData = new Axis3DViewData(xYDiagram3D.AxisY, this);
			this.annotationsAnchorPointsLayout = annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;
			this.annotationsViewData = annotationsViewData;
			this.legendViewDataList = legendViewDataList;
			this.seriesLayoutList = seriesLayoutList;
			base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping = CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(labelLayoutLists);
		}

		private Box CalcInnerBox()
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPointForDiagram = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPointForDiagram(double.NegativeInfinity, double.NegativeInfinity);
			DiagramPoint diagramPointForDiagram2 = coordsCalculator.GetDiagramPointForDiagram(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(diagramPointForDiagram, diagramPointForDiagram2);
			return new Box(zPlaneRectangle.Location, zPlaneRectangle.Width, zPlaneRectangle.Height, coordsCalculator.Depth);
		}

		private void CalcPlaneBoxes(BoxPlane plane)
		{
			double num = coordsCalculator.Diagram.PlaneDepthFixed;
			if ((plane & BoxPlane.Back) > (BoxPlane)0)
			{
				back = new Box(inner.Back, 0.0 - num);
			}
			if ((plane & BoxPlane.Fore) > (BoxPlane)0)
			{
				fore = new Box(inner.Fore, num);
			}
			if ((plane & BoxPlane.Left) > (BoxPlane)0)
			{
				left = new Box(inner.Left, 0.0 - num);
			}
			if ((plane & BoxPlane.Right) > (BoxPlane)0)
			{
				right = new Box(inner.Right, num);
			}
			bottom = new Box(inner.Bottom, 0.0 - num);
		}

		private void CalculateLayout(ChartDrawingHelper drawingHelper)
		{
			if (graphicsCache == null || graphicsCache.Container != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout in SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				seriesLayout.Calculate();
			}
			PrimitivesContainer primitivesContainer = GetPrimitivesContainer();
			graphicsCache.Container = primitivesContainer;
			graphicsCache.GraphicsTree = ((drawingHelper == null) ? GraphicsHelper.BuildGraphicsTree(primitivesContainer) : drawingHelper.GetGraphicsTree(primitivesContainer));
			PolygonGroups polygonGroups = GraphicsHelper.BuildGroups(primitivesContainer);
			polygonGroups.Sort();
			graphicsCache.PolygonGroups = polygonGroups;
		}

		private List<Line> GetDiagramGridLines()
		{
			List<Line> list = new List<Line>();
			list.AddRange(axisXViewData.GridLines);
			list.AddRange(axisYViewData.GridLines);
			return list;
		}

		private PrimitivesContainer GetPrimitivesContainer()
		{
			PrimitivesContainer primitivesContainer = new PrimitivesContainer();
			foreach (XYDiagram3DSeriesLayout seriesLayout in SeriesLayoutList)
			{
				seriesLayout.FillPrimitivesContainer(primitivesContainer);
			}
			foreach (XYDiagram3DSeriesLabelLayoutList labelLayoutList in LabelLayoutLists)
			{
				labelLayoutList.FillPrimitivesContainer(primitivesContainer);
			}
			return primitivesContainer;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateCachedGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (graphicsCache != null)
			{
				return graphicsCache.CreateGraphicsCommand(coordsCalculator);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateDiagramGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CoordsCalculator.CreateDiagramLightingCommand(out var innerLightingCommand));
			innerLightingCommand.AddChildCommand(CoordsCalculator.CreateModelViewGraphicsCommand());
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(Diagram.BackImage.CreateGraphicsCommand((back == null) ? inner.Fore : inner.Back, reverseY: true));
			PrimitivesContainer container = new PrimitivesContainer(GetDiagramGridLines(), GetDiagramPolygons());
			PolygonGroups polygonGroups = GraphicsHelper.BuildGroups(container);
			if (polygonGroups != null)
			{
				polygonGroups.Sort();
				innerLightingCommand.AddChildCommand(polygonGroups.CreateGraphicsCommand());
			}
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateSeriesGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CoordsCalculator.CreateLightingCommand(out var innerLightingCommand));
			innerLightingCommand.AddChildCommand(CoordsCalculator.CreateModelViewGraphicsCommand());
			innerLightingCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateCachedGraphicsCommand());
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private GraphicsCommand CreateContentGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new DepthTestGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateDiagramGraphicsCommand());
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(CreateSeriesGraphicsCommand());
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		private void RenderAxisLabels(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			axisXViewData.RenderLabels(renderer);
			axisYViewData.RenderLabels(renderer);
		}

		private void RenderAnnotations(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (annotationsViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		public override void CalculateSeriesAndLabelLayout(ChartDrawingHelper drawingHelper, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			CalculateLayout(drawingHelper);
			if (base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping)
			{
				XYDiagramResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping(), null, Diagram.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			}
		}

		public override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand = new ContainerGraphicsCommand();
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand2 = new ViewPortGraphicsCommand(coordsCalculator.Bounds);
			graphicsCommand.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand2);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand3 = new DepthTestGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand3);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand4 = new SaveStateGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand3.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand4);
			graphicsCommand2.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand4);
			graphicsCommand4.AddChildCommand(new IdentityTransformGraphicsCommand(TransformMatrix.ModelView));
			graphicsCommand4.AddChildCommand(new IdentityTransformGraphicsCommand(TransformMatrix.Projection));
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand5 = coordsCalculator.CreateProjectionGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand4.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand5);
			GraphicsCommand graphicsCommand6 = new PolygonAntialiasingGraphicsCommand();
			graphicsCommand5.AddChildCommand(graphicsCommand6);
			graphicsCommand6.AddChildCommand(CreateContentGraphicsCommand());
			return graphicsCommand;
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public override void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public override void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext, bool renderInOverlays)
		{
			renderer.SetClipping(base.Bounds);
			RenderAxisLabels(renderer);
			RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
			RenderAnnotations(renderer);
			foreach (LegendViewData legendViewData in legendViewDataList)
			{
				legendViewData.Render(renderer, base.Bounds);
			}
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		public IList<PlanePolygon> GetDiagramPolygons()
		{
			RectangleFillStyle3D actualFillStyle = coordsCalculator.Diagram.ActualFillStyle;
			Color actualBackColor = coordsCalculator.Diagram.ActualBackColor;
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			ZPlaneRectangle gradientRect = new ZPlaneRectangle(inner.Fore.Location, inner.Fore.Width, inner.Fore.Height);
			if (left == null)
			{
				list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(right.GetRepresentation(), gradientRect, actualFillStyle, actualBackColor, 7));
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(left.GetRepresentation(), gradientRect, actualFillStyle, actualBackColor, 7));
			}
			if (back == null)
			{
				list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(fore.GetRepresentation(), gradientRect, actualFillStyle, actualBackColor, 7));
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(back.GetRepresentation(), gradientRect, actualFillStyle, actualBackColor, 7));
			}
			list.AddRange(XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper.FillPlanePolygons(bottom.GetRepresentation(), gradientRect, actualFillStyle, actualBackColor, 7));
			if (coordsCalculator.Diagram.BackImage.DXImage != null)
			{
				PlaneRectangle planeRectangle = ((back == null) ? inner.Fore : inner.Back);
				planeRectangle.SameColors = true;
				planeRectangle.Color = Color.Black;
				planeRectangle.Weight = 0;
				planeRectangle.SetPaintingMethod(CreateImageBackgroundGraphicsCommand);
				list.Add(planeRectangle);
			}
			list.AddRange(axisXViewData.InterlacedPolygons);
			list.AddRange(axisYViewData.InterlacedPolygons);
			return list;
		}
	}
	public sealed class XYDiagram3DFillStyleHelper
	{
		public static IList<PlanePolygon> FillPlanePolygons(PlanePolygon[] rects, PlaneRectangle gradientRect, RectangleFillStyle3D fillStyle, Color color, int weight)
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			Color color2 = Color.Empty;
			if (fillStyle.FillMode == FillMode3D.Gradient)
			{
				RectangleGradientFillOptions rectangleGradientFillOptions = (RectangleGradientFillOptions)fillStyle.Options;
				color2 = rectangleGradientFillOptions.CalculateActualColor2(color, color2);
			}
			foreach (PlanePolygon polygon in rects)
			{
				IList<PlanePolygon> list2 = fillStyle.FillPlanePolygon(polygon, gradientRect, color, color2);
				foreach (PlanePolygon item in list2)
				{
					item.Weight = weight;
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class LimitsCorrection
	{
		private readonly StartLimitCorrection startLimit;

		private readonly EndLimitCorrection endLimit;

		public bool ShouldCorrect
		{
			get
			{
				if (!startLimit.ShouldCorrect)
				{
					return endLimit.ShouldCorrect;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldCorrectOutside
		{
			get
			{
				if (!startLimit.ShouldCorrectOutside)
				{
					return endLimit.ShouldCorrectOutside;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public LimitsCorrection()
		{
			startLimit = new StartLimitCorrection();
			endLimit = new EndLimitCorrection();
		}

		public LimitsCorrection(StartLimitCorrection startLimit, EndLimitCorrection endLimit)
		{
			this.startLimit = startLimit;
			this.endLimit = endLimit;
		}

		public Limits Correct(Limits limits)
		{
			limits = startLimit.Correct(limits);
			limits = endLimit.Correct(limits);
			return limits;
		}

		public Limits CorrectOutside(Limits limits)
		{
			limits = startLimit.CorrectOutside(limits);
			limits = endLimit.CorrectOutside(limits);
			return limits;
		}

		public void ApplyHorizontalCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			startLimit.ApplyHorizontalCorrection(correction);
			endLimit.ApplyHorizontalCorrection(correction);
		}

		public void ApplyVerticalCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			startLimit.ApplyVerticalCorrection(correction);
			endLimit.ApplyVerticalCorrection(correction);
		}

		public void ApplyHorizontalOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			startLimit.ApplyHorizontalOutsideCorrection(correction);
			endLimit.ApplyHorizontalOutsideCorrection(correction);
		}

		public void ApplyVerticalOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			startLimit.ApplyVerticalOutsideCorrection(correction);
			endLimit.ApplyVerticalOutsideCorrection(correction);
		}
	}
	public class StartLimitCorrection
	{
		private int start;

		private int outsideStart;

		public int Start
		{
			get
			{
				return start;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value > 0)
				{
					start = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int OutsideStart
		{
			get
			{
				return outsideStart;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value > 0)
				{
					outsideStart = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldCorrect => start > 0;

		public bool ShouldCorrectOutside => outsideStart > 0;

		public Limits Correct(Limits limit)
		{
			limit.Start += start;
			return CorrectOutside(limit);
		}

		public Limits CorrectOutside(Limits limit)
		{
			limit.Start += outsideStart;
			return limit;
		}

		public void ApplyHorizontalCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			start += correction.Left;
		}

		public void ApplyVerticalCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			start += correction.Top;
		}

		public void ApplyHorizontalOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			outsideStart = Math.Max(outsideStart, correction.Left);
		}

		public void ApplyVerticalOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			outsideStart = Math.Max(outsideStart, correction.Top);
		}
	}
	public class EndLimitCorrection
	{
		private int end;

		private int outsideEnd;

		public int End
		{
			get
			{
				return end;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value > 0)
				{
					end = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int OutsideEnd
		{
			get
			{
				return outsideEnd;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value > 0)
				{
					outsideEnd = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldCorrect => end > 0;

		public bool ShouldCorrectOutside => outsideEnd > 0;

		public Limits Correct(Limits limit)
		{
			limit.End -= end;
			return CorrectOutside(limit);
		}

		public Limits CorrectOutside(Limits limit)
		{
			limit.End -= outsideEnd;
			return limit;
		}

		public void ApplyHorizontalCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			end += correction.Right;
		}

		public void ApplyVerticalCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			end += correction.Bottom;
		}

		public void ApplyHorizontalOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			outsideEnd = Math.Max(outsideEnd, correction.Right);
		}

		public void ApplyVerticalOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			outsideEnd = Math.Max(outsideEnd, correction.Bottom);
		}
	}

	public class LineAntialiasingGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Hint(3154, 4354);
			GL.Enable(2848);
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Disable(2848);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}
