	public class PolygonAntialiasingGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private double[] projectionMatrix = new double[16];

		private byte[] pixelData;

		private int[] viewport = new int[4];

		private double[] shifts;

		private int shiftCount;

		public PolygonAntialiasingGraphicsCommand()
		{
			shiftCount = 4;
			shifts = new double[shiftCount];
		}

		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (gr.GraphicsQuality >= GraphicsQuality.Highest)
			{
				GL.ClearAccum(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f);
				GL.Clear(512);
				GL.GetIntegerv(2978, viewport);
				GL.GetDoublev(2983, projectionMatrix);
				for (int i = 0; i < shiftCount; i++)
				{
					shifts[i] = (double)i / (double)shiftCount;
				}
				pixelData = new byte[gr.Size.Width * gr.Size.Height * 4];
				GL.Finish();
				GL.PixelStorei(3317, 1);
				GL.ReadPixels(gr.Bounds.X, gr.Bounds.Y, gr.Bounds.Width, gr.Bounds.Height, 6408, 5120, pixelData);
			}
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (gr.GraphicsQuality >= GraphicsQuality.Highest)
			{
				GL.Accum(258, 1f);
				GL.MatrixMode(5889);
				GL.LoadMatrixd(projectionMatrix);
				pixelData = null;
			}
		}

		public override void Execute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (gr.NativeDrawing)
			{
				ExecuteNative(gr);
				return;
			}
			BeforeExecute(gr);
			try
			{
				if (gr.GraphicsQuality >= GraphicsQuality.Highest)
				{
					GL.PixelStorei(3333, 1);
					float val = 0.5f / (float)shiftCount;
					for (int i = 0; i < shiftCount; i++)
					{
						RestoreImage(gr);
						GL.MatrixMode(5889);
						GL.LoadIdentity();
						GL.Translated(2.0 / (double)viewport[2] * shifts[i], 2.0 / (double)viewport[3] * shifts[i], 0.0);
						GL.MultMatrixd(projectionMatrix);
						ExecuteChildrenCommands(gr);
						GL.Accum(256, val);
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < shiftCount; j++)
					{
						RestoreImage(gr);
						GL.MatrixMode(5889);
						GL.LoadIdentity();
						GL.Translated(2.0 / (double)viewport[2] * shifts[j], 2.0 / (double)viewport[3] * (1.0 - shifts[j]), 0.0);
						GL.MultMatrixd(projectionMatrix);
						ExecuteChildrenCommands(gr);
						GL.Accum(256, val);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ExecuteChildrenCommands(gr);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				AfterExecute(gr);
			}
		}

		private void RestoreImage(OpenGLGraphics graphics)
		{
			GL.Viewport(graphics.Bounds.X, graphics.Bounds.Y, graphics.Bounds.Width, graphics.Bounds.Height);
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.PushMatrix();
			GL.LoadIdentity();
			GL.MatrixMode(5889);
			GL.PushMatrix();
			GL.LoadIdentity();
			GL.Ortho(0.0, viewport[2], 0.0, viewport[3], -1.0, 1.0);
			GL.RasterPosi(graphics.Bounds.X, graphics.Bounds.Y);
			GL.DrawPixels(graphics.Bounds.Width, graphics.Bounds.Height, 6408, 5120, pixelData);
			GL.Viewport(viewport[0], viewport[1], viewport[2], viewport[3]);
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.PopMatrix();
			GL.MatrixMode(5889);
			GL.PopMatrix();
			GL.Clear(1280);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class GraphicsCommand : IDisposable
	{
		private List<GraphicsCommand> children;

		private bool disposed;

		internal bool Disposed => disposed;

		public List<GraphicsCommand> Children => children;

		public GraphicsCommand()
		{
		}

		protected void ExecuteNative(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			ExecuteChildrenCommands(gr);
		}

		private void ExecuteOpenGL(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			BeforeExecute(gr);
			try
			{
				ExecuteInternal(gr);
				ExecuteChildrenCommands(gr);
			}
			finally
			{
				AfterExecute(gr);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr);

		protected virtual void DisposeInternal()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		public void AddChildCommand(GraphicsCommand command)
		{
			if (command != null)
			{
				if (children == null)
				{
					children = new List<GraphicsCommand>();
				}
				children.Add(command);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Execute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (gr.NativeDrawing)
			{
				ExecuteNative(gr);
			}
			else
			{
				ExecuteOpenGL(gr);
			}
		}

		protected void ExecuteChildrenCommands(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (children == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GraphicsCommand child in children)
			{
				child.Execute(gr);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeInternal();
			if (children != null)
			{
				foreach (GraphicsCommand child in children)
				{
					child.Dispose();
				}
				children = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			disposed = true;
		}
	}

	public class ClippingGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private PlaneRectangle clipRectangle;

		private DXRegion clipRegion;

		private DXGraphicsPath clipPath;

		private int plane;

		protected virtual CombineMode ActualCombineMode => CombineMode.Replace;

		public ZPlaneRectangle ClipRectangle => clipRectangle as ZPlaneRectangle;

		public DXRegion ClipRegion => clipRegion;

		public DXGraphicsPath ClipPath => clipPath;

		public ClippingGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle clipRectangle)
		{
			Initialize(clipRectangle, null, null);
		}

		public ClippingGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle clipRectangle, int plane)
		{
			this.plane = plane;
			Initialize(clipRectangle, null, null);
		}

		public ClippingGraphicsCommand(DXRegion clipRegion)
		{
			Initialize(ZPlaneRectangle.Empty, clipRegion, null);
		}

		public ClippingGraphicsCommand(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Initialize(ZPlaneRectangle.Empty, null, path);
		}

		private void Initialize(PlaneRectangle clipRectangle, DXRegion clipRegion, DXGraphicsPath clipPath)
		{
			this.clipRectangle = clipRectangle;
			this.clipRegion = clipRegion;
			this.clipPath = clipPath;
		}

		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			PlaneEquation planeEquation = MathUtils.CalcPlaneEquation(clipRectangle);
			GL.ClipPlane(plane, planeEquation.Equation);
			GL.Enable(plane);
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Disable(plane);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		protected override void DisposeInternal()
		{
			clipRegion?.Dispose();
			clipRegion = null;
			clipPath?.Dispose();
			clipPath = null;
		}
	}

	public class LightingGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private Color ambientColor;

		private Color materialSpecularColor;

		private Color materialEmissionColor;

		private float materialShininess;

		public LightingGraphicsCommand(Color ambientColor, Color materialSpecularColor, Color materialEmissionColor, float materialShininess)
		{
			this.ambientColor = ambientColor;
			this.materialSpecularColor = materialSpecularColor;
			this.materialEmissionColor = materialEmissionColor;
			this.materialShininess = materialShininess;
		}

		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Disable(2896);
			GL.Disable(2903);
			GL.Disable(2977);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			float[] array = new float[4];
			GL.LightModeli(2898, 1);
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(ambientColor, array);
			GL.LightModelfv(2899, array);
			GL.ColorMaterial(1032, 5634);
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(materialSpecularColor, array);
			GL.Materialfv(1032, 4610, array);
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(materialEmissionColor, array);
			GL.Materialfv(1032, 5632, array);
			GL.Materialf(1032, 5633, materialShininess);
			GL.BlendFunc(770, 771);
			GL.Enable(2977);
			GL.Enable(2896);
			GL.Enable(2903);
		}
	}
	public class LightGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private int index;

		private Color ambientColor;

		private Color diffuseColor;

		private Color specularColor;

		private DiagramPoint position;

		private DiagramVector spotDirection;

		private float spotExponent;

		private float spotCutoff;

		private float constantAttenuation;

		private float linearAttenuation;

		private float quadraticAttenuation;

		private bool directional;

		public LightGraphicsCommand(int index, Color ambientColor, Color diffuseColor, Color specularColor, DiagramPoint position, DiagramVector spotDirection, float spotExponent, float spotCutoff, float constantAttenuation, float linearAttenuation, float quadraticAttenuation)
		{
			this.index = index;
			this.ambientColor = ambientColor;
			this.diffuseColor = diffuseColor;
			this.specularColor = specularColor;
			this.position = position;
			this.spotDirection = spotDirection;
			this.spotExponent = spotExponent;
			this.spotCutoff = spotCutoff;
			this.constantAttenuation = constantAttenuation;
			this.linearAttenuation = linearAttenuation;
			this.quadraticAttenuation = quadraticAttenuation;
			directional = false;
		}

		public LightGraphicsCommand(int index, Color ambientColor, Color diffuseColor, Color specularColor, DiagramPoint position, DiagramVector spotDirection)
			: this(index, ambientColor, diffuseColor, specularColor, position, spotDirection, 0f, 180f, 1f, 0f, 0f)
		{
			directional = true;
		}

		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Disable(16384 + index);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			int light = 16384 + index;
			float[] array = new float[4];
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(ambientColor, array);
			GL.Lightfv(light, 4608, array);
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(diffuseColor, array);
			GL.Lightfv(light, 4609, array);
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(specularColor, array);
			GL.Lightfv(light, 4610, array);
			GL.Lightfv(light, 4611, new float[4]
			{
				(float)position.X,
				(float)position.Y,
				(float)position.Z,
				directional ? 0f : 1f
			});
			GL.Lightfv(light, 4612, new float[4]
			{
				(float)spotDirection.DX,
				(float)spotDirection.DY,
				(float)spotDirection.DZ,
				0f
			});
			GL.Lightf(light, 4613, spotExponent);
			GL.Lightf(light, 4614, spotCutoff);
			GL.Lightf(light, 4615, constantAttenuation);
			GL.Lightf(light, 4616, linearAttenuation);
			GL.Lightf(light, 4617, quadraticAttenuation);
			GL.Enable(16384 + index);
		}
	}

	public class StencilFuncGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private readonly int groupId;

		{
			this.groupId = groupId;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (gr.StencilBufferMaxValue != 0)
			{
				int num = groupId % gr.StencilBufferMaxValue;
				if (num == 0)
				{
					GL.Clear(1024);
				}
				num++;
				GL.StencilFunc(517, num, (uint)num);
			}
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}
	}

	public class OpenGLGraphics : INativeGraphics, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly OpenGLGraphicsTextureCache textureCache;

		private int stencilBufferMaxValue;

		private bool nativeDrawing;

		private DXBitmap bitmap;

		private IDXGraphics nativeGraphics;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		private IPlatformContext platformContext;

		public GraphicsQuality GraphicsQuality { get; set; }

		public bool Initialized
		{
			get
			{
				if (platformContext != null)
				{
					return platformContext.Initialized;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IDXGraphics NativeGraphics => nativeGraphics;

		public Rectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(bounds == value))
				{
					bounds = value;
					CreateNativeObjects(bounds.Size);
				}
			}
		}

		public Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				return bounds.Size;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(bounds.Size == value))
				{
					Bounds = new Rectangle(bounds.Location, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public OpenGLGraphicsTextureCache TextureCache => textureCache;

		public bool NativeDrawing => nativeDrawing;

		public int StencilBufferMaxValue => stencilBufferMaxValue;

		static OpenGLGraphics()
		{
			try
			{
				GL.Finish();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateColorComponents(Color color, float[] result)
		{
			if (result.Length < 3)
			{
				throw new InternalException("Incorrect array size.");
			}
			result[0] = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			result[1] = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			result[2] = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			if (result.Length > 3)
			{
				result[3] = (float)(int)color.A / 255f;
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateColorComponents(Color color, out float red, out float green, out float blue)
		{
			red = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			green = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			blue = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
		}

		public static void CalculateColorComponents(Color color, out float red, out float green, out float blue, out float alpha)
		{
			CalculateColorComponents(color, out red, out green, out blue);
			alpha = (float)(int)color.A / 255f;
		}

		public OpenGLGraphics(ChartGraphicsBase graphics, IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, OpenGLGraphicsTextureCache textureCache)
		{
			GraphicsQuality = GraphicsQuality.Highest;
			lock (typeof(OpenGLGraphics))
			{
				CreateNativeObjects(bounds.Size);
				this.bounds = bounds;
				this.textureCache = textureCache;
				platformContext = PlatformContextUtils.CreatePlatformContext(graphics, bounds, hdc);
			}
		}

		private void FinishDrawing()
		{
			GL.Finish();
			platformContext.FinishDrawing();
			platformContext.ReleaseCurrent();
		}

		private void Prepare()
		{
			platformContext.MakeCurrent();
			GL.MatrixMode(5889);
			GL.PushMatrix();
			GL.LoadIdentity();
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.PushMatrix();
			GL.LoadIdentity();
		}

		private void Restore()
		{
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.PopMatrix();
			GL.MatrixMode(5889);
			GL.PopMatrix();
			platformContext.ReleaseCurrent();
		}

		private void DisposeNativeGraphics()
		{
			if (nativeGraphics != null)
			{
				nativeGraphics.Dispose();
				nativeGraphics = null;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeBitmap()
		{
			if (bitmap != null)
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
				bitmap = null;
			}
		}

		private void DrawBitmap()
		{
			if (bitmap == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int[] array = new int[1];
			GL.GetIntegerv(3379, array);
			uint[] array2 = new uint[1];
			GL.GenTextures(1, array2);
			GL.BindTexture(3553, array2[0]);
			GL.PixelStorei(3317, 1);
			GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10242, 10497);
			GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10243, 10497);
			GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10240, 9728);
			GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10241, 9728);
			GL.TexEnvf(8960, 8704, 7681f);
			GL.Enable(3553);
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.LoadIdentity();
			GL.MatrixMode(5889);
			GL.LoadIdentity();
			GL.Ortho(0.0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height, 0.0, -1.0, 1.0);
			GL.Disable(2929);
			GL.Enable(3042);
			GL.BlendFunc(770, 771);
			GL.Color4f(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f);
			IDXBitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.GetBitmapData();
			TextureInfo[] array3 = TextureInfo.CalcTextureInfos(bitmapData, bitmap.Size, array[0]);
			TextureInfo[] array4 = array3;
			foreach (TextureInfo textureInfo in array4)
			{
				if (textureInfo.TexturePointer == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					GL.TexImage2D(3553, 0, 6408, textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Height, 0, 32993, 5121, textureInfo.TextureArray);
				}
				else
				{
					GL.TexImage2D(3553, 0, 6408, textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Height, 0, 32993, 5121, textureInfo.TexturePointer);
				}
				GL.Begin(7);
				GL.TexCoord2d(0.0, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(textureInfo.X, textureInfo.Y, 0.0);
				GL.TexCoord2d(0.0, 1.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(textureInfo.X, textureInfo.Y + textureInfo.Height, 0.0);
				GL.TexCoord2d(1.0, 1.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(textureInfo.X + textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Y + textureInfo.Height, 0.0);
				GL.TexCoord2d(1.0, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(textureInfo.X + textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Y, 0.0);
				GL.End();
			}
			bitmapData.Dispose();
			GL.Disable(3553);
			GL.DeleteTextures(1, array2);
		}

		private void CreateNativeObjects(Size size)
		{
			DisposeBitmap();
			DisposeNativeGraphics();
			if (size.Width == 0)
			{
				size.Width = 1;
			}
			if (size.Height == 0)
			{
				size.Height = 1;
			}
			bitmap = new DXBitmap(GraphicUtils.CalcAlignedTextureSize(size.Width), GraphicUtils.CalcAlignedTextureSize(size.Height), DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			nativeGraphics = bitmap.CreateGraphics();
		}

		public void SetDrawingType(bool nativeDrawing)
		{
			if (nativeDrawing != this.nativeDrawing)
			{
				this.nativeDrawing = nativeDrawing;
			}
			if (nativeDrawing)
			{
				nativeGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
			}
		}

		public void Execute(GraphicsCommand command)
		{
			if (command == null || !Initialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				if (!platformContext.MakeCurrent())
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					platformContext.Lock();
					GL.Viewport(Bounds.X, bounds.Y, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height);
					Color control = SystemColors.Control;
					CalculateColorComponents(control, out var red, out var green, out var blue, out var alpha);
					GL.ClearColor(red, green, blue, alpha);
					GL.Clear(17664);
					GL.Enable(3042);
					GL.BlendFunc(770, 771);
					GL.ShadeModel(7425);
					GL.MatrixMode(5888);
					GL.LoadIdentity();
					GL.MatrixMode(5889);
					GL.LoadIdentity();
					GL.Ortho(0.0, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height, 0.0, -1.0, 1.0);
					int[] array = new int[1];
					GL.GetIntegerv(3415, array);
					stencilBufferMaxValue = (int)Math.Pow(2.0, array[0]) - 1;
					nativeDrawing = false;
					command.Execute(this);
					DrawBitmap();
				}
				catch (ThreadAbortException)
				{
					platformContext.ReleaseCurrent();
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					platformContext.Unlock();
					FinishDrawing();
					nativeDrawing = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public void CalculateTransformationMatrix(GraphicsCommand command, double[] matrix)
		{
			double[] projection = new double[16];
			CalculateMatrices(command, matrix, projection);
		}

		public void CalculateMatrices(GraphicsCommand command, double[] modelView, double[] projection)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				Prepare();
				try
				{
					command.Execute(this);
					GL.GetDoublev(2982, modelView);
					GL.GetDoublev(2983, projection);
				}
				finally
				{
					Restore();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (platformContext != null)
			{
				platformContext.Dispose();
				platformContext = null;
			}
			DisposeBitmap();
			DisposeNativeGraphics();
		}
	}
	public class SolidLineGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private readonly Color color;

		private readonly int thickness;

		private readonly LineCap lineCap;

		private DiagramPoint p1;

		private DiagramPoint p2;

		private DiagramVector normal = DiagramVector.Zero;

		protected DiagramPoint P1 => p1;

		protected DiagramPoint P2 => p2;

		protected int Thickness => thickness;

		public SolidLineGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, Color color, int thickness)
		{
			this.p1 = p1;
			this.p2 = p2;
			this.color = color;
			this.thickness = thickness;
		}

		public SolidLineGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, Color color, int thickness, LineCap lineCap)
			: this(p1, p2, color, thickness)
		{
			this.lineCap = lineCap;
		}

		public SolidLineGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramVector normal, Color color, int thickness, LineCap lineCap)
			: this(p1, p2, color, thickness, lineCap)
		{
			normal.Normalize();
			this.normal = normal;
		}

		protected virtual DXPen CreatePen()
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color, thickness);
			dXPen.StartCap = (DXLineCap)lineCap;
			dXPen.EndCap = (DXLineCap)lineCap;
			return dXPen;
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeGL()
		{
			OpenGLGraphics.CalculateColorComponents(color, out var red, out var green, out var blue, out var alpha);
			GL.Color4f(red, green, blue, alpha);
			GL.LineWidth(thickness);
			if (lineCap == LineCap.Round)
			{
				GL.PointSize(thickness);
				GL.Enable(2832);
				GL.Hint(3153, 4354);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void FinalizeGL()
		{
			if (lineCap == LineCap.Round)
			{
				GL.Disable(2832);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			InitializeGL();
			if (!normal.IsZero)
			{
				GL.Normal3d(normal.DX, normal.DY, normal.DZ);
			}
			GL.Begin(1);
			GL.Vertex3d(p1.X, p1.Y, p1.Z);
			GL.Vertex3d(p2.X, p2.Y, p2.Z);
			GL.End();
			if (lineCap == LineCap.Round)
			{
				GL.Begin(0);
				GL.Vertex3d(p1.X, p1.Y, p1.Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(p2.X, p2.Y, p2.Z);
				GL.End();
			}
			FinalizeGL();
		}
	}
	public class DashedLineGraphicsCommand : SolidLineGraphicsCommand
	{
		private DashStyle dashStyle;

		public DashedLineGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, Color color, int thickness, LineCap lineCap, DashStyle dashStyle)
			: this(p1, p2, DiagramVector.Zero, color, thickness, lineCap, dashStyle)
		{
		}

		public DashedLineGraphicsCommand(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramVector normal, Color color, int thickness, LineCap lineCap, DashStyle dashStyle)
			: base(p1, p2, normal, color, thickness, lineCap)
		{
			this.dashStyle = dashStyle;
		}

		protected override DXPen CreatePen()
		{
			DXPen dXPen = base.CreatePen();
			DashStyleHelper.ApplyDashStyle(dXPen, dashStyle);
			return dXPen;
		}

		protected override void InitializeGL()
		{
			base.InitializeGL();
			if (dashStyle != DashStyle.Solid)
			{
				GL.LineStipple(base.Thickness, GetGLDashStyle(dashStyle));
				GL.Enable(2852);
			}
		}

		protected override void FinalizeGL()
		{
			if (dashStyle != DashStyle.Solid)
			{
				GL.Disable(2852);
			}
			base.FinalizeGL();
		}

		private ushort GetGLDashStyle(DashStyle dashStyle)
		{
			return dashStyle switch
			{
				DashStyle.Solid => ushort.MaxValue, 
				DashStyle.Dash => 61166, 
				DashStyle.Dot => 43690, 
				DashStyle.DashDot => 64250, 
				DashStyle.DashDotDot => 60138, 
				_ => ushort.MaxValue, 
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class PieGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		public const float FacetPercent = 0.02f;

		private GRealPoint2D center;

		private readonly float majorSemiAxis;

		private readonly float minorSemiAxis;

		private readonly float startAngle;

		private readonly float sweepAngle;

		private readonly float depth;

		private readonly float holePercent;

		private readonly float innerMajorSemiAxis;

		private readonly float innerMinorSemiAxis;

		private readonly float radius;

		private readonly float innerRadius;

		private readonly float facetSize;

		private readonly float correctedDepth;

		private readonly bool isDoughnut;

		protected GRealPoint2D Center => center;

		protected float MajorSemiAxis => majorSemiAxis;

		protected float MinorSemiAxis => minorSemiAxis;

		protected float StartAngle => startAngle;

		protected float SweepAngle => sweepAngle;

		protected float Depth => depth;

		protected float HolePercent => holePercent;

		protected float InnerMajorSemiAxis => innerMajorSemiAxis;

		protected float InnerMinorSemiAxis => innerMinorSemiAxis;

		protected float FacetSize => facetSize;

		protected float Radius => radius;

		protected float InnerRadius => innerRadius;

		protected float CorrectedDepth => correctedDepth;

		protected bool IsDoughnut => isDoughnut;

		public PieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent)
		{
			this.center = center;
			this.majorSemiAxis = majorSemiAxis;
			this.minorSemiAxis = minorSemiAxis;
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.sweepAngle = sweepAngle;
			this.depth = depth;
			this.holePercent = holePercent;
			if (holePercent > 0f)
			{
				isDoughnut = true;
				float num = minorSemiAxis * (1f - holePercent);
				innerMajorSemiAxis = majorSemiAxis - num;
				innerMinorSemiAxis = minorSemiAxis - num;
			}
			if (!(depth > 0f))
			{
				return;
			}
			facetSize = majorSemiAxis * 0.02f;
			if (facetSize > depth / 2f)
			{
				facetSize = depth / 2f;
			}
			radius = majorSemiAxis - facetSize;
			float num2 = radius - innerMajorSemiAxis;
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				radius -= num2;
				facetSize += num2;
			}
			correctedDepth = depth - facetSize * 2f;
			if (isDoughnut)
			{
				innerRadius = innerMajorSemiAxis + facetSize;
				if (innerRadius > radius)
				{
					innerRadius = radius;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PerformPieDrawing()
		{
			ExecutePie();
			if ((double)depth != 0.0)
			{
				GL.PushMatrix();
				try
				{
					GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, depth);
					ExecutePie();
				}
				finally
				{
					GL.PopMatrix();
				}
			}
			if (facetSize > 0f)
			{
				ExecuteFacet(Radius, MajorSemiAxis);
				GL.PushMatrix();
				try
				{
					GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, facetSize);
					if (correctedDepth > 0f)
					{
						ExecuteCylinder(MajorSemiAxis);
						GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, correctedDepth);
					}
					ExecuteFacet(MajorSemiAxis, Radius);
				}
				finally
				{
					GL.PopMatrix();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ExecuteCylinder(MajorSemiAxis);
			}
			ExecuteSections(0f, MajorSemiAxis);
		}

		private void PerformDoughnutDrawing()
		{
			if (innerRadius < radius)
			{
				ExecuteDoughnut();
				if ((double)depth != 0.0)
				{
					GL.PushMatrix();
					try
					{
						GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, depth);
						ExecuteDoughnut();
					}
					finally
					{
						GL.PopMatrix();
					}
				}
			}
			if (facetSize > 0f)
			{
				ExecuteFacet(Radius, MajorSemiAxis);
				ExecuteFacet(InnerRadius, InnerMajorSemiAxis);
				GL.PushMatrix();
				try
				{
					GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, facetSize);
					if (correctedDepth > 0f)
					{
						ExecuteCylinder(MajorSemiAxis);
						ExecuteCylinder(InnerMajorSemiAxis);
						GL.Translated(0.0, 0.0, correctedDepth);
					}
					ExecuteFacet(MajorSemiAxis, Radius);
					ExecuteFacet(InnerMajorSemiAxis, InnerRadius);
				}
				finally
				{
					GL.PopMatrix();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ExecuteCylinder(MajorSemiAxis);
				ExecuteCylinder(InnerMajorSemiAxis);
			}
			ExecuteSections(InnerMajorSemiAxis, MajorSemiAxis);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.MatrixMode(5888);
			GL.PushMatrix();
			try
			{
				GL.Translated(center.X, 0.0 - center.Y, (double)(0f - depth) * 0.5);
				if (isDoughnut)
				{
					PerformDoughnutDrawing();
				}
				else
				{
					PerformPieDrawing();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				GL.PopMatrix();
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteSections(float innerRadius, float outerRadius);

		protected abstract void ExecutePie();

		protected abstract void ExecuteDoughnut();

		protected abstract void ExecuteCylinder(float radius);

		protected abstract void ExecuteFacet(float radius1, float radius2);
	}

		{
		}

		protected override void ExecuteDoughnut()
		{
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCylinder(float radius)
		{
		}

		protected override void ExecuteFacet(float radius1, float radius2)
		{
		}
	}
	public class SolidPieGraphicsCommand : PieGraphicsCommand
	{
		private Color color;

		public SolidPieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, Color color)
			: base(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent)
		{
			this.color = color;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteSections(float innerRadius, float outerRadius)
		{
			GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
			GLHelper.PieSections(base.Depth, innerRadius, outerRadius, base.FacetSize, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - (base.StartAngle + base.SweepAngle));
		}

		protected override void ExecutePie()
		{
			GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
			GLHelper.PartialDisk(base.Radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteDoughnut()
		{
			GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
			GLHelper.PartialDisk(base.InnerRadius, base.Radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCylinder(float radius)
		{
			GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
			GLHelper.PartialCylinder(base.CorrectedDepth, radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteFacet(float radius1, float radius2)
		{
			GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
			GLHelper.PartialCone(base.FacetSize, radius1, radius2, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle);
		}
	}
	public class GradientPieGraphicsCommand : PieGraphicsCommand
	{
		private RectangleF gradientBounds;

		private Color color;

		private Color color2;

		private LinearGradientMode gradientMode;

		public GradientPieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, RectangleF gradientBounds, Color color, Color color2, LinearGradientMode gradientMode)
			: base(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent)
		{
			this.gradientBounds = gradientBounds;
			this.color = color;
			this.color2 = color2;
			this.gradientMode = gradientMode;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteSections(float innerRadius, float outerRadius)
		{
			GLHelper.PieSections(base.Depth, innerRadius, outerRadius, base.FacetSize, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - (base.StartAngle + base.SweepAngle), GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), TextureGenerator);
		}

		protected override void ExecutePie()
		{
			GLHelper.PartialDisk(base.Radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), TextureGenerator);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteDoughnut()
		{
			GLHelper.PartialDisk(base.InnerRadius, base.Radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), TextureGenerator);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCylinder(float radius)
		{
			GLHelper.PartialCylinder(base.CorrectedDepth, radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), TextureGenerator);
		}

		protected override void ExecuteFacet(float radius1, float radius2)
		{
			GLHelper.PartialCone(base.FacetSize, radius1, radius2, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), TextureGenerator);
		}

		private int TextureGenerator(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = gradientBounds;
			rectangleF.Offset(0f - (float)base.Center.X, 0f - (float)base.Center.Y);
			float texCoord = gradientMode switch
			{
				LinearGradientMode.Horizontal => (float)((0.0 - ((double)rectangleF.Left - x)) / (double)rectangleF.Width), 
				LinearGradientMode.Vertical => (float)((0.0 - ((double)rectangleF.Top + y)) / (double)rectangleF.Height), 
				LinearGradientMode.ForwardDiagonal => (float)((0.0 - ((double)rectangleF.Top + y)) * (double)rectangleF.Height - ((double)rectangleF.Left - x) * (double)rectangleF.Width) / (rectangleF.Width * rectangleF.Width + rectangleF.Height * rectangleF.Height), 
				LinearGradientMode.BackwardDiagonal => 1f - (float)(((double)(rectangleF.Height + rectangleF.Top) + y) * (double)rectangleF.Height - ((double)rectangleF.Left - x) * (double)rectangleF.Width) / (rectangleF.Width * rectangleF.Width + rectangleF.Height * rectangleF.Height), 
				_ => 0f, 
			};
			try
			{
				return GLHelper.ConvertTexCoord(texCoord);
			}
			catch
			{
				return 127;
			}
		}
	}
	public class CenterGradientPieGraphicsCommand : PieGraphicsCommand
	{
		private Color color;

		private Color color2;

		private float textureDiff;

		public CenterGradientPieGraphicsCommand(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiAxis, float minorSemiAxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float depth, float holePercent, Color color, Color color2)
			: base(center, majorSemiAxis, minorSemiAxis, startAngle, sweepAngle, depth, holePercent)
		{
			this.color = color;
			this.color2 = color2;
			if (base.IsDoughnut)
			{
				textureDiff = base.MajorSemiAxis - base.InnerMajorSemiAxis;
			}
		}

		protected override void ExecuteSections(float innerRadius, float outerRadius)
		{
			GLHelper.PieSections(base.Depth, innerRadius, outerRadius, base.FacetSize, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - (base.StartAngle + base.SweepAngle), GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), CreateTextureGenerator());
		}

		protected override void ExecutePie()
		{
			GLHelper.PartialDisk(base.Radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), CreateTextureGenerator());
		}

		protected override void ExecuteDoughnut()
		{
			GLHelper.PartialDisk(base.InnerRadius, base.Radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), CreateTextureGenerator());
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCylinder(float radius)
		{
			GLHelper.PartialCylinder(base.CorrectedDepth, radius, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), CreateTextureGenerator());
		}

		protected override void ExecuteFacet(float radius1, float radius2)
		{
			GLHelper.PartialCone(base.FacetSize, radius1, radius2, 0f - base.StartAngle, 0f - base.SweepAngle, GLHelper.Create1DTexture(color, color2), CreateTextureGenerator());
		}

		private int PieTextureGenerator(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			return GLHelper.ConvertTexCoord((float)(Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y) / (double)base.MajorSemiAxis));
		}

		private int DoughnutTextureGenerator(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			return GLHelper.ConvertTexCoord((float)((Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y) - (double)base.InnerMajorSemiAxis) / (double)textureDiff));
		}

		private GLHelper.Gen1DTextureCoord CreateTextureGenerator()
		{
			if (!base.IsDoughnut)
			{
				return PieTextureGenerator;
			}
			return DoughnutTextureGenerator;
		}
	}

	public class PolygonGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private PlanePolygon polygon;

		public PolygonGraphicsCommand(PlanePolygon polygon)
		{
			if (polygon.Vertices.Length < 3)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("polygon");
			}
			this.polygon = polygon;
		}

		private void DrawVertices()
		{
			if (polygon.SameNormals)
			{
				GL.Normal3d(polygon.Normal.DX, polygon.Normal.DY, polygon.Normal.DZ);
			}
			if (polygon.SameColors)
			{
				GL.Color4ub(polygon.Color.R, polygon.Color.G, polygon.Color.B, polygon.Color.A);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!polygon.SameColors)
				{
					Color color = polygon.Vertices[i].Color;
					GL.Color4ub(color.R, color.G, color.B, color.A);
				}
				if (!polygon.SameNormals)
				{
					DiagramVector normal = polygon.Vertices[i].Normal;
					GL.Normal3d(normal.DX, normal.DY, normal.DZ);
				}
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = polygon.Vertices[i];
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint.Z);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			int mode = ((polygon.Vertices.Length == 3) ? 4 : ((polygon.Vertices.Length != 4) ? 9 : 7));
			GL.Begin(mode);
			DrawVertices();
			GL.End();
		}
	}
	public abstract class RectangleGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private readonly PlaneRectangle rect;

		protected internal PlaneRectangle Rect => rect;

		protected internal ZPlaneRectangle ZRect
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(rect is ZPlaneRectangle result))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("ZRect");
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public RectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			this.rect = rect;
		}
	}
	public class SolidRectangleGraphicsCommand : RectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		private Color color;

		internal Color Color => color;

		public SolidRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, Color color)
			: base(rect)
		{
			this.color = color;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			GL.Color4ub(Color.R, Color.G, Color.B, Color.A);
			DiagramVector normal = base.Rect.Normal;
			GL.Normal3f((float)normal.DX, (float)normal.DY, (float)normal.DZ);
			Vertex[] vertices = base.Rect.Vertices;
			GL.Begin(7);
			Vertex[] array = vertices;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = array[i];
				GL.Vertex3d(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint.Z);
			}
			GL.End();
		}
	}
	public class BackgroundSolidRectangleGraphicsCommand : SolidRectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		private bool blendingEnabled;

		public BackgroundSolidRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, Color color)
			: base(rect, color)
		{
		}

		protected override void BeforeExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (base.Color.A == byte.MaxValue)
			{
				bool[] array = new bool[1];
				GL.GetBooleanv(3042, array);
				if (array[0])
				{
					GL.Disable(3042);
					blendingEnabled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void AfterExecute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			if (blendingEnabled)
			{
				GL.Enable(3042);
				blendingEnabled = false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class GradientRectangleGraphicsCommand : RectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		private Color color;

		private Color color2;

		private double colorCoord;

		private double color2Coord;

		private LinearGradientMode gradientMode;

		internal int ActualStartTexCoord
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(colorCoord))
				{
					return GLHelper.ConvertTexCoord((float)colorCoord);
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal int ActualEndTexCoord
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(color2Coord))
				{
					return GLHelper.ConvertTexCoord((float)color2Coord);
				}
				return 255;
			}
		}

		internal int ActualMidTexCoord => Math.Abs(ActualStartTexCoord - ActualEndTexCoord) / 2;

		internal Color Color => color;

		internal Color Color2 => color2;

		internal LinearGradientMode GradientMode => gradientMode;

		public GradientRectangleGraphicsCommand(ZPlaneRectangle rect, Color color, Color color2, LinearGradientMode gradientMode)
			: this(rect, color, color2, double.NaN, double.NaN, gradientMode)
		{
		}

		public GradientRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, Color color, Color color2, double colorCoord, double color2Coord, LinearGradientMode gradientMode)
			: base(rect)
		{
			this.colorCoord = colorCoord;
			this.color2Coord = color2Coord;
			this.color = color;
			this.color2 = color2;
			this.gradientMode = gradientMode;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			float[] texture = GLHelper.Create1DTexture(Color, Color2);
			GL.Begin(7);
			DiagramVector normal = base.Rect.Normal;
			GL.Normal3f((float)normal.DX, (float)normal.DY, (float)normal.DZ);
			Vertex[] vertices = base.Rect.Vertices;
			switch (GradientMode)
			{
			case LinearGradientMode.Horizontal:
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualStartTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[0].X, vertices[0].Y, vertices[0].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualEndTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[1].X, vertices[1].Y, vertices[1].Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[2].X, vertices[2].Y, vertices[2].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualStartTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[3].X, vertices[3].Y, vertices[3].Z);
				break;
			case LinearGradientMode.Vertical:
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualEndTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[0].X, vertices[0].Y, vertices[0].Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[1].X, vertices[1].Y, vertices[1].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualStartTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[2].X, vertices[2].Y, vertices[2].Z);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[3].X, vertices[3].Y, vertices[3].Z);
				break;
			case LinearGradientMode.BackwardDiagonal:
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualEndTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[0].X, vertices[0].Y, vertices[0].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualMidTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[1].X, vertices[1].Y, vertices[1].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualStartTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[2].X, vertices[2].Y, vertices[2].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualMidTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[3].X, vertices[3].Y, vertices[3].Z);
				break;
			case LinearGradientMode.ForwardDiagonal:
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualMidTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[0].X, vertices[0].Y, vertices[0].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualEndTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[1].X, vertices[1].Y, vertices[1].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualMidTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[2].X, vertices[2].Y, vertices[2].Z);
				GLHelper.SetColor(texture, ActualStartTexCoord);
				GL.Vertex3d(vertices[3].X, vertices[3].Y, vertices[3].Z);
				break;
			}
			GL.End();
		}
	}
	public class HatchedRectangleGraphicsCommand : RectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		private Color color;

		private Color backColor;

		private HatchStyle hatchStyle;

		public HatchedRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, HatchStyle hatchStyle, Color color, Color backColor)
			: base(rect)
		{
			this.hatchStyle = hatchStyle;
			this.color = color;
			this.backColor = backColor;
		}

		public HatchedRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, HatchStyle hatchStyle, Color color)
			: this(rect, hatchStyle, color, Color.Transparent)
		{
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			int num = 128;
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(num, num);
			using ChartGraphicsBase chartGraphicsBase = DrawingUtils.CreateGraphics(dXBitmap);
			using (DXHatchBrush brush = new DXHatchBrush((DXHatchStyle)hatchStyle, color, backColor))
			{
				INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = chartGraphicsBase.CreateNativeRenderer();
				nativeRenderer.FillRectangle(brush, new Rectangle(0, 0, dXBitmap.Width, dXBitmap.Height));
			}
			Vertex location = base.ZRect.Location;
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(base.ZRect);
			zPlaneRectangle.Offset(0.0 - location.X, 0.0 - location.Y, 0.0);
			zPlaneRectangle.Width = ((zPlaneRectangle.Width < (double)num) ? ((double)num) : (zPlaneRectangle.Width + location.X));
			zPlaneRectangle.Height = ((zPlaneRectangle.Height < (double)num) ? ((double)num) : (zPlaneRectangle.Height + location.Y));
			using TiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand tiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand = new TiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(zPlaneRectangle, dXBitmap, disposeImage: false);
			tiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand.Execute(gr);
		}
	}
	public class GdiImageGraphicsCommand : GraphicsCommand
	{
		private Rectangle rect;

		private DXImage image;

		public GdiImageGraphicsCommand(Rectangle rect, DXImage image)
		{
			this.rect = rect;
			this.image = image;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
		}

		public override void Execute(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			gr.SetDrawingType(nativeDrawing: true);
			lock (image)
			{
				gr.NativeGraphics.DrawImage(image, rect);
			}
			gr.SetDrawingType(nativeDrawing: false);
		}

		protected override void DisposeInternal()
		{
			base.DisposeInternal();
			image.Dispose();
			image = null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ImageRectangleGraphicsCommand : RectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		private DXImage image;

		private bool disposeImage;

		private bool reverseY;

		protected internal DXImage Image => image;

		protected bool ReverseY => reverseY;

		public ImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, DXImage image, bool disposeImage, bool reverseY)
			: base(rect)
		{
			this.image = image;
			this.reverseY = reverseY;
			this.disposeImage = disposeImage;
		}

		public ImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, DXImage image, bool disposeImage)
			: this(rect, image, disposeImage, reverseY: false)
		{
		}

		private TextureInfo[] CreateTexture(OpenGLGraphics gr, DXImage image, int maxTexSize)
		{
			TextureInfo[] texture = gr.TextureCache.GetTexture(image, maxTexSize);
			if (texture != null)
			{
				return texture;
			}
			texture = TextureInfo.CalcTextureInfos(image, maxTexSize, new Size((int)base.Rect.Width, (int)base.Rect.Height));
			gr.TextureCache.Add(image, maxTexSize, texture);
			return texture;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteInternal(OpenGLGraphics gr)
		{
			lock (Image)
			{
				int[] array = new int[1];
				GL.GetIntegerv(3379, array);
				uint[] array2 = new uint[1];
				GL.GenTextures(1, array2);
				GL.BindTexture(3553, array2[0]);
				GL.PixelStorei(3317, 1);
				GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10242, 10497);
				GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10243, 10497);
				GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10240, 9728);
				GL.TexParameteri(3553, 10241, 9728);
				GL.TexEnvf(8960, 8704, 7681f);
				GL.Enable(3553);
				TextureInfo[] infos = CreateTexture(gr, image, array[0]);
				DrawTexture(infos);
				GL.Disable(3553);
				GL.DeleteTextures(1, array2);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawTexture(TextureInfo[] infos)
		{
		}

		protected override void DisposeInternal()
		{
			if (disposeImage && image != null)
			{
				image.Dispose();
				image = null;
			}
			base.DisposeInternal();
		}
	}
	public class StretchedImageRectangleGraphicsCommand : ImageRectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		public StretchedImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, DXImage image, bool disposeImage, bool reverseY)
			: base(rect, image, disposeImage, reverseY)
		{
		}

		public StretchedImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, DXImage image, bool disposeImage)
			: this(rect, image, disposeImage, reverseY: false)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawTexture(TextureInfo[] infos)
		{
			double num = base.Rect.Width / (double)infos[0].TexWidth;
			double num2 = base.Rect.Height / (double)infos[0].TexHeight;
			Vertex[] vertices = base.Rect.Vertices;
			foreach (TextureInfo textureInfo in infos)
			{
				if (textureInfo.TexturePointer == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					GL.TexImage2D(3553, 0, 6408, textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Height, 0, 32993, 5121, textureInfo.TextureArray);
				}
				else
				{
					GL.TexImage2D(3553, 0, 6408, textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Height, 0, 32993, 5121, textureInfo.TexturePointer);
				}
				GL.Begin(7);
				DiagramVector normal = base.Rect.Normal;
				GL.Normal3f((float)normal.DX, (float)normal.DY, (float)normal.DZ);
				double x = (double)textureInfo.X * num;
				double x2 = (double)(textureInfo.X + textureInfo.Width) * num;
				double y = (base.ReverseY ? (base.Rect.Location.Y + base.Rect.Height - (double)textureInfo.Y * num2) : ((double)textureInfo.Y * num2));
				double y2 = (base.ReverseY ? (base.Rect.Location.Y + base.Rect.Height - (double)(textureInfo.Y + textureInfo.Height) * num2) : ((double)(textureInfo.Y + textureInfo.Height) * num2));
				GL.TexCoord2d(0.0, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x, y, vertices[0].Z);
				GL.TexCoord2d(0.0, 1.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x, y2, vertices[0].Z);
				GL.TexCoord2d(1.0, 1.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x2, y2, vertices[0].Z);
				GL.TexCoord2d(1.0, 0.0);
				GL.Vertex3d(x2, y, vertices[0].Z);
				GL.End();
			}
		}
	}
	public class TiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand : ImageRectangleGraphicsCommand
	{
		public TiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, DXImage image, bool disposeImage, bool reverseY)
			: base(rect, image, disposeImage, reverseY)
		{
		}

		public TiledImageRectangleGraphicsCommand(PlaneRectangle rect, DXImage image, bool disposeImage)
			: this(rect, image, disposeImage, reverseY: false)
		{
		}

		private double GetTexMaxX(TextureInfo info, ZPlaneRectangle rect, double scaleRatio)
		{
			if ((double)info.X * scaleRatio > rect.Width)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = (double)(info.X + info.Width) * scaleRatio;
			if (num > rect.Width)
			{
				return (rect.Width - (double)info.X * scaleRatio) / ((double)info.Width * scaleRatio);
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		private double GetTexMaxY(TextureInfo info, ZPlaneRectangle rect, double scaleRatio)
		{
			if ((double)info.Y * scaleRatio > rect.Height)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = (double)(info.Y + info.Height) * scaleRatio;
			if (num > rect.Height)
			{
				return (rect.Height - (double)info.Y * scaleRatio) / ((double)info.Height * scaleRatio);
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		private ZPlaneRectangle[] SplitRectangle(ZPlaneRectangle rect, double width, double height, bool reverseY)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (double num = rect.Location.Y; num < rect.Location.Y + rect.Height; num += height)
			{
				for (double num2 = rect.Location.X; num2 < rect.Location.X + rect.Width; num2 += width)
				{
					double width2 = ((num2 + width > rect.Location.X + rect.Width) ? (rect.Location.X + rect.Width - num2) : width);
					double height2 = ((num + height > rect.Location.Y + rect.Height) ? (rect.Location.Y + rect.Height - num) : height);
					arrayList.Add(new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(num2, num, rect.Location.Z), width2, height2));
				}
			}
			if (reverseY)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					Vertex[] vertices = ((ZPlaneRectangle)arrayList[i]).Vertices;
					DiagramPoint p = new DiagramPoint(vertices[0].X, rect.Location.Y + rect.Height - vertices[0].Y, vertices[0].Z);
					DiagramPoint p2 = new DiagramPoint(vertices[2].X, rect.Location.Y + rect.Height - vertices[2].Y, vertices[2].Z);
					arrayList[i] = new ZPlaneRectangle(p, p2);
				}
			}
			return (ZPlaneRectangle[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(ZPlaneRectangle));
		}

		protected override void DrawTexture(TextureInfo[] infos)
		{
			double num = (double)base.Image.Width / (double)infos[0].TexWidth;
			double num2 = (double)base.Image.Height / (double)infos[0].TexHeight;
			ZPlaneRectangle[] array = SplitRectangle(base.ZRect, base.Image.Width, base.Image.Height, base.ReverseY);
			ZPlaneRectangle[] array2 = array;
			foreach (ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle in array2)
			{
				foreach (TextureInfo textureInfo in infos)
				{
					double texMaxX = GetTexMaxX(textureInfo, zPlaneRectangle, num);
					double texMaxY = GetTexMaxY(textureInfo, zPlaneRectangle, num2);
					if (!double.IsNaN(texMaxX) && !double.IsNaN(texMaxY))
					{
						double num3 = zPlaneRectangle.Location.X + (double)textureInfo.X * num;
						double x = num3 + (double)textureInfo.Width * texMaxX * num;
						double num4 = (base.ReverseY ? (zPlaneRectangle.Location.Y + zPlaneRectangle.Height - (double)textureInfo.Y * num2) : (zPlaneRectangle.Location.Y + (double)textureInfo.Y * num2));
						double y = (base.ReverseY ? (num4 - (double)textureInfo.Height * num2 * texMaxY) : (num4 + (double)textureInfo.Height * num2 * texMaxY));
						if (textureInfo.TexturePointer == IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							GL.TexImage2D(3553, 0, 6408, textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Height, 0, 32993, 5121, textureInfo.TextureArray);
						}
						else
						{
							GL.TexImage2D(3553, 0, 6408, textureInfo.Width, textureInfo.Height, 0, 32993, 5121, textureInfo.TexturePointer);
						}
						GL.Begin(7);
						DiagramVector normal = base.Rect.Normal;
						GL.Normal3f((float)normal.DX, (float)normal.DY, (float)normal.DZ);
						GL.TexCoord2d(0.0, 0.0);
						GL.Vertex3d(num3, num4, base.Rect.Location.Z);
						GL.TexCoord2d(0.0, texMaxY);
						GL.Vertex3d(num3, y, base.Rect.Location.Z);
						GL.TexCoord2d(texMaxX, texMaxY);
						GL.Vertex3d(x, y, base.Rect.Location.Z);
						GL.TexCoord2d(texMaxX, 0.0);
						GL.Vertex3d(x, num4, base.Rect.Location.Z);
						GL.End();
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class OpenGLGraphicsTextureCache
	{
		private readonly Hashtable cache = new Hashtable();

		private readonly Hashtable cache1 = new Hashtable();

		private int CalcHash(DXImage image, int maxTexSize)
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<DXImage, int>(image, maxTexSize);
		}

		public byte[] GetTexture(DXImage image)
		{
			return (byte[])cache[image];
		}

		public TextureInfo[] GetTexture(DXImage image, int maxTexSize)
		{
			int num = CalcHash(image, maxTexSize);
			return (TextureInfo[])cache1[num];
		}

		public void Add(DXImage image, byte[] texture)
		{
			cache[image] = texture;
		}

		public void Add(DXImage image, int maxTexSize, TextureInfo[] texInfos)
		{
			int num = CalcHash(image, maxTexSize);
			cache1[num] = texInfos;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			cache.Clear();
			cache1.Clear();
		}
	}

		}
	}
