	public class Box
	{
		private readonly ZPlaneRectangle back;

		private readonly ZPlaneRectangle fore;

		private readonly XPlaneRectangle left;

		private readonly XPlaneRectangle right;

		private readonly YPlaneRectangle bottom;

		private readonly YPlaneRectangle top;

		public ZPlaneRectangle Back => back;

		public ZPlaneRectangle Fore => fore;

		public XPlaneRectangle Left => left;

		public XPlaneRectangle Right => right;

		public YPlaneRectangle Bottom => bottom;

		public YPlaneRectangle Top => top;

		public DiagramPoint Location => back.Location;

		public double Width => top.Height;

		public double Height
		{
			get
			{
				return fore.Height;
			}
			set
			{
				top.Offset(0.0, value - Height, 0.0);
				back.Height = value;
				fore.Height = value;
				left.Width = value;
				right.Width = value;
			}
		}

		public double Depth => top.Width;

		public static bool Contains(Box box, PlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			if (rect != null && box != null)
			{
				return box.Contains(rect);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Box(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height)
			: this(point, width, height, width)
		{
		}

		public Box(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, double depth)
		{
			if (width < 0.0)
			{
				point.X += width;
				width = Math.Abs(width);
			}
			if (height < 0.0)
			{
				point.Y += height;
				height = Math.Abs(height);
			}
			if (depth < 0.0)
			{
				point.Z += depth;
				depth = Math.Abs(depth);
			}
			bottom = new YPlaneRectangle(point, depth, width, this);
			top = new YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, 0.0, height, 0.0), depth, width, this);
			left = new XPlaneRectangle(point, height, depth, this);
			right = new XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, width, 0.0, 0.0), height, depth, this);
			back = new ZPlaneRectangle(point, width, height, this);
			fore = new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Offset(point, 0.0, 0.0, depth), width, height, this);
		}

		public Box(XPlaneRectangle rect, double depth)
			: this(rect.Location, depth, rect.Width, rect.Height)
		{
		}

		public Box(YPlaneRectangle rect, double height)
			: this(rect.Location, rect.Height, height, rect.Width)
		{
		}

		public Box(ZPlaneRectangle rect, double depth)
			: this(rect.Location, rect.Width, rect.Height, depth)
		{
		}

		public PlaneRectangle[] GetPlanes()
		{
			return new PlaneRectangle[6] { bottom, top, left, right, back, fore };
		}

		public PlanePolygon[] GetLaterals()
		{
			return new PlanePolygon[6]
			{
				left,
				right,
				back.CalcLeftHalf(),
				back.CalcRightHalf(),
				fore.CalcLeftHalf(),
				fore.CalcRightHalf()
			};
		}

		public BoxPlane GetBoxPlane(PlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			if (rect == null)
			{
				return (BoxPlane)0;
			}
			if (rect == back)
			{
				return BoxPlane.Back;
			}
			if (rect == fore)
			{
				return BoxPlane.Fore;
			}
			if (rect == left)
			{
				return BoxPlane.Left;
			}
			if (rect == right)
			{
				return BoxPlane.Right;
			}
			if (rect == bottom)
			{
				return BoxPlane.Bottom;
			}
			if (rect == top)
			{
				return BoxPlane.Top;
			}
			return (BoxPlane)0;
		}

		public bool Contains(PlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			if (rect == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int hashCode = rect.GetHashCode();
			if (hashCode != bottom.GetHashCode() && hashCode != top.GetHashCode() && hashCode != back.GetHashCode() && hashCode != fore.GetHashCode() && hashCode != left.GetHashCode())
			{
				return hashCode == right.GetHashCode();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			back.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			fore.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			left.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			right.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			bottom.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			top.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
		}

		public List<PlaneQuadrangle> FilterPlanes(Box box)
		{
			List<PlaneQuadrangle> list = new List<PlaneQuadrangle>();
			IList<PlaneRectangle> planes = GetPlanes();
			PlaneRectangle[] planes2 = box.GetPlanes();
			foreach (PlaneRectangle planeRectangle in planes2)
			{
				foreach (PlaneRectangle item in planes)
				{
					if (MathUtils.IsOnePlanePrimitives(planeRectangle, item))
					{
						list.AddRange(planeRectangle.SeparateByCenter());
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public PlanePolygon[] GetRepresentation()
		{
			List<PlanePolygon> list = new List<PlanePolygon>();
			list.Add(top.CalcTopHalf());
			list.Add(top.CalcBottomHalf());
			list.Add(bottom.CalcTopHalf());
			list.Add(bottom.CalcBottomHalf());
			list.AddRange(fore.SeparateByCenter());
			list.AddRange(back.SeparateByCenter());
			list.Add(left.CalcLeftHalf());
			list.Add(left.CalcRightHalf());
			list.Add(right.CalcLeftHalf());
			list.Add(right.CalcRightHalf());
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public enum BoxPlane
	{
		Back = 1,
		Fore = 2,
		Bottom = 4,
		Top = 8,
		Left = 0x10,
		Right = 0x20
	}
	public struct DiagramPoint : IEquatable<DiagramPoint>
	{
		private double x;

		private double y;

		private double z;

		public static DiagramPoint Zero => new DiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

		public double X
		{
			get
			{
				return x;
			}
			set
			{
				x = value;
			}
		}

		public double Y
		{
			get
			{
				return y;
			}
			set
			{
				y = value;
			}
		}

		public double Z
		{
			get
			{
				return z;
			}
			set
			{
				z = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsZero
		{
			get
			{
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(x, 0.0, 1E-15) == 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(y, 0.0, 1E-15) == 0)
				{
					return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(z, 0.0, 1E-15) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static PointF[] Convert(IList<DiagramPoint> diagramPoints)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[diagramPoints.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < diagramPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (PointF)diagramPoints[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint Round(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(Math.Round(point.X), Math.Round(point.Y), Math.Round(point.Z));
		}

		public static DiagramPoint StrongRound(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(MathUtils.StrongRound(point.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(point.Y), MathUtils.StrongRound(point.Z));
		}

		public static DiagramPoint Offset(DiagramPoint point, double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(point.X + dx, point.Y + dy, point.Z + dz);
		}

		public static explicit operator Point(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(point.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(point.Y));
		}

		public static explicit operator PointF(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new PointF(System.Convert.ToSingle(point.X), System.Convert.ToSingle(point.Y));
		}

		public static explicit operator DiagramPoint(Point point)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static explicit operator DiagramPoint(PointF point)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static explicit operator GRealPoint2D(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static explicit operator DiagramPoint(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DiagramPoint left, DiagramPoint right)
		{
			if (left.X == right.X && left.Y == right.Y)
			{
				return left.Z == right.Z;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DiagramPoint left, DiagramPoint right)
		{
			return !(left == right);
		}

		public static DiagramVector operator -(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(p1.x - p2.x, p1.y - p2.y, p1.z - p2.z);
		}

		public DiagramPoint(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
			this.z = z;
		}

		public DiagramPoint(double x, double y)
			: this(x, y, 0.0)
		{
		}

		public bool Equals(DiagramPoint other)
		{
			if (other.X == x && other.Y == Y)
			{
				return other.Z == z;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DiagramPoint other))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double, double>(x, y, z);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return x + ";" + y + ";" + z;
		}
	}
	public class Line : PlanePrimitive
	{
		private DashStyle dashStyle = DashStyle.Solid;

		private int thickness = 1;

		private LineCap lineCap;

		public Vertex V1 => base.Vertices[0];

		public Vertex V2 => base.Vertices[1];

		public static Line CreateFromLine(Vertex[] vertices, Line baseLine)
		{
			if (vertices.Length == 2)
			{
				Line line = new Line();
				line.Assign(baseLine);
				line.Vertices = vertices;
				return line;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected Line()
		{
		}

		public Line(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
			: base(new DiagramPoint[2] { p1, p2 })
		{
		}

		public Line(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color, LineCap lineCap)
			: base(new DiagramPoint[2] { p1, p2 }, sameNormals, sameColors, normal, color)
		{
			this.lineCap = lineCap;
		}

		public Line(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
			: this(p1, p2, sameNormals, sameColors, normal, color, LineCap.Flat)
		{
		}

		public Line(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramVector normal)
			: this(p1, p2, sameNormals: true, sameColors: false, normal, Color.Empty)
		{
		}

		public Line(Vertex v1, Vertex v2)
			: base(new Vertex[2] { v1, v2 })
		{
		}

		public Line(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
			: base(new Vertex[2] { v1, v2 }, sameNormals, sameColors, normal, color)
		{
		}

		public Line(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, DiagramVector normal)
			: this(v1, v2, sameNormals: true, sameColors: false, normal, Color.Empty)
		{
		}

		public void SetParameters(DashStyle dashStyle, int thickness)
		{
			this.dashStyle = dashStyle;
			this.thickness = thickness;
		}

		protected override bool IsVerticesCountValid(int count)
		{
			return count == 2;
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new Line();
		}

		public override void AssignProperties(PlanePrimitive primitive)
		{
			base.AssignProperties(primitive);
			if (primitive is Line line)
			{
				dashStyle = line.dashStyle;
				thickness = line.thickness;
				lineCap = line.lineCap;
			}
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			if (dashStyle != DashStyle.Solid)
			{
				return new DashedLineGraphicsCommand(V1, V2, base.Normal, base.Color, thickness, lineCap, dashStyle);
			}
			return new SolidLineGraphicsCommand(V1, V2, base.Normal, base.Color, thickness, lineCap);
		}
	}
	public class PlaneQuadrangle : PlanePolygon
	{
		private readonly BoxPlane boxPlane;

		public virtual BoxPlane BoxPlane => boxPlane;

		protected PlaneQuadrangle()
		{
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, DiagramPoint p4, BoxPlane boxPlane)
			: base(new DiagramPoint[4] { p1, p2, p3, p4 })
		{
			this.boxPlane = boxPlane;
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2, DiagramPoint p3, DiagramPoint p4)
			: base(new DiagramPoint[4] { p1, p2, p3, p4 })
		{
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, Vertex v3, Vertex v4, BoxPlane boxPlane)
			: base(new Vertex[4] { v1, v2, v3, v4 })
		{
			this.boxPlane = boxPlane;
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, Vertex v3, Vertex v4)
			: base(new Vertex[4] { v1, v2, v3, v4 })
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsVerticesCountValid(int count)
		{
			return count == 4;
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new PlaneQuadrangle();
		}

		private void CalcCenterVerticalVertices(out Vertex v1, out Vertex v2)
		{
			v1 = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter3D(base.Vertices[0], base.Vertices[1], 0.01);
			v2 = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter3D(base.Vertices[2], base.Vertices[3], 0.01);
		}

		private void CalcCenterHorizontalVertices(out Vertex v1, out Vertex v2)
		{
			v1 = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter3D(base.Vertices[0], base.Vertices[3], 0.01);
			v2 = MathUtils.CalcIntervalCenter3D(base.Vertices[1], base.Vertices[2], 0.01);
		}

		private PlaneQuadrangle CreateInstance(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, Vertex v3, Vertex v4)
		{
			PlaneQuadrangle planeQuadrangle = (PlaneQuadrangle)CreateInstance();
			planeQuadrangle.AssignProperties(this);
			planeQuadrangle.SetVertices(new Vertex[4] { v1, v2, v3, v4 });
			return planeQuadrangle;
		}

		private void CreateHorizontalHalves(out PlaneQuadrangle leftHalf, out PlaneQuadrangle rightHalf)
		{
			leftHalf = CalcLeftHalf();
			rightHalf = CalcRightHalf();
		}

		private void CreateVerticalHalves(out PlaneQuadrangle topHalf, out PlaneQuadrangle bottomHalf)
		{
			bottomHalf = CalcBottomHalf();
			topHalf = CalcTopHalf();
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle CalcLeftHalf()
		{
			CalcCenterVerticalVertices(out var v, out var v2);
			return CreateInstance(base.Vertices[0], v, v2, base.Vertices[3]);
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle CalcRightHalf()
		{
			CalcCenterVerticalVertices(out var v, out var v2);
			return CreateInstance(v, base.Vertices[1], base.Vertices[2], v2);
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle CalcBottomHalf()
		{
			CalcCenterHorizontalVertices(out var v, out var v2);
			return CreateInstance(base.Vertices[0], base.Vertices[1], v2, v);
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle CalcTopHalf()
		{
			CalcCenterHorizontalVertices(out var v, out var v2);
			return CreateInstance(v, v2, base.Vertices[2], base.Vertices[3]);
		}

		public PlaneQuadrangle[] SeparateByCenter()
		{
			CreateHorizontalHalves(out var leftHalf, out var rightHalf);
			leftHalf.CreateVerticalHalves(out var topHalf, out var bottomHalf);
			rightHalf.CreateVerticalHalves(out var topHalf2, out var bottomHalf2);
			return new PlaneQuadrangle[4] { topHalf, bottomHalf, topHalf2, bottomHalf2 };
		}
	}
	public abstract class PlaneRectangle : PlaneQuadrangle
	{
		private readonly Box box;

		private readonly BoxPlane boxPlane;

		private DiagramPoint RelativeLeftBottom => AbsoluteToRelative(LeftBottom);

		private DiagramPoint RelativeRightTop => AbsoluteToRelative(RightTop);

		public Vertex LeftBottom => base.Vertices[0];

		public Vertex LeftTop => base.Vertices[3];

		public Vertex RightBottom => base.Vertices[1];

		public Vertex RightTop => base.Vertices[2];

		public Vertex Location => base.Vertices[0];

		public DiagramPoint Center => RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeLeftBottom, Width / 2.0, Height / 2.0, 0.0));

		public DiagramPoint LeftCenter => RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeLeftBottom, 0.0, Height / 2.0, 0.0));

		public DiagramPoint RightCenter => RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeRightTop, 0.0, (0.0 - Height) / 2.0, 0.0));

		public DiagramPoint BottomCenter => RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeLeftBottom, Width / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0));

		public DiagramPoint TopCenter => RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeRightTop, (0.0 - Width) / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0));

		public double Left => LeftCenter.X;

		public double Right => RightCenter.X;

		public double Bottom => BottomCenter.Y;

		public double Top => TopCenter.Y;

		public SizeF Size => new SizeF(Convert.ToSingle(Width), Convert.ToSingle(Height));

		public double Width
		{
			get
			{
				return AbsoluteToRelative(RightTop).X - AbsoluteToRelative(LeftBottom).X;
			}
			set
			{
				DiagramPoint p = AbsoluteToRelative(LeftBottom);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = AbsoluteToRelative(RightTop);
				Init(p2: new DiagramPoint(p.X + value, diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint.Z), p1: p);
			}
		}

		public double Height
		{
			get
			{
				return AbsoluteToRelative(RightTop).Y - AbsoluteToRelative(LeftBottom).Y;
			}
			set
			{
				DiagramPoint p = AbsoluteToRelative(LeftBottom);
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = AbsoluteToRelative(RightTop);
				Init(p2: new DiagramPoint(diagramPoint.X, p.Y + value, diagramPoint.Z), p1: p);
			}
		}

		public Box Box => box;

		public override BoxPlane BoxPlane
		{
			get
			{
				if (boxPlane != 0)
				{
					return boxPlane;
				}
				if (box != null)
				{
					return box.GetBoxPlane(this);
				}
				return (BoxPlane)0;
			}
		}

		public bool IsZero
		{
			get
			{
				if (Width != 0.0)
				{
					return Height == 0.0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static PlaneRectangle Inflate(PlaneRectangle rect, double dx, double dy)
		{
			PlaneRectangle planeRectangle = (PlaneRectangle)rect.CreateInstance();
			planeRectangle.Assign(rect);
			planeRectangle.Inflate(dx, dy);
			return planeRectangle;
		}

		protected PlaneRectangle()
		{
		}

		public PlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			DiagramPoint p3 = AbsoluteToRelative(p1);
			DiagramPoint p4 = AbsoluteToRelative(p2);
			Init(p3, p4);
		}

		public PlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, Box box)
			: this(point, width, height)
		{
			this.box = box;
		}

		public PlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, BoxPlane boxPlane)
			: this(point, width, height)
		{
			this.boxPlane = boxPlane;
		}

		public PlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = AbsoluteToRelative(point);
			DiagramPoint p = DiagramPoint.Offset(diagramPoint, width, height, 0.0);
			Init(diagramPoint, p);
		}

		private void Init(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			DiagramPoint p3 = new DiagramPoint(Math.Min(p1.X, p2.X), Math.Min(p1.Y, p2.Y), Math.Min(p1.Z, p2.Z));
			DiagramPoint p4 = new DiagramPoint(Math.Max(p1.X, p2.X), Math.Max(p1.Y, p2.Y), p3.Z);
			DiagramPoint p5 = new DiagramPoint(p4.X, p3.Y, p4.Z);
			DiagramPoint p6 = new DiagramPoint(p3.X, p4.Y, p4.Z);
			SetVertices(new DiagramPoint[4]
			{
				RelativeToAbsolute(p3),
				RelativeToAbsolute(p5),
				RelativeToAbsolute(p4),
				RelativeToAbsolute(p6)
			});
			base.Normal = RelativeToAbsolute(new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
			base.SameNormals = true;
		}

		private Line CreateLine(DiagramPoint vertex1, DiagramPoint vertex2)
		{
			return new Line(vertex1, vertex2, sameNormals: true, sameColors: false, MathUtils.CalcNormal(vertex2 - vertex1, base.Normal), Color.Empty);
		}

		protected abstract bool ArePointsCorrect(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2);

		protected abstract DiagramPoint AbsoluteToRelative(DiagramPoint p);

		protected abstract DiagramPoint RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint p);

		protected abstract DiagramVector RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramVector v);

		public void Inflate(double dx, double dy)
		{
			DiagramPoint p = DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeLeftBottom, 0.0 - dx, 0.0 - dy, 0.0);
			DiagramPoint p2 = DiagramPoint.Offset(RelativeRightTop, dx, dy, 0.0);
			if (p2.X < p.X)
			{
				p2.X = p.X;
			}
			if (p2.Y < p.Y)
			{
				p2.Y = p.Y;
			}
			Init(p, p2);
		}

		public void Round()
		{
			Init(DiagramPoint.Round(RelativeLeftBottom), DiagramPoint.Round(RelativeRightTop));
		}

		protected void IncSize()
		{
			DiagramPoint relativeRightTop = RelativeRightTop;
			relativeRightTop.X++;
			relativeRightTop.Y++;
			Init(RelativeLeftBottom, relativeRightTop);
		}

		public Line[] GetPerimeter()
		{
			return new Line[4]
			{
				CreateLine(base.Vertices[0], base.Vertices[1]),
				CreateLine(base.Vertices[1], base.Vertices[2]),
				CreateLine(base.Vertices[2], base.Vertices[3]),
				CreateLine(base.Vertices[3], base.Vertices[0])
			};
		}

		public bool Contains(DiagramPoint point)
		{
			DiagramPoint relativeLeftBottom = RelativeLeftBottom;
			DiagramPoint relativeRightTop = RelativeRightTop;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = AbsoluteToRelative(point);
			if (diagramPoint.X >= relativeLeftBottom.X && diagramPoint.X <= relativeRightTop.X && diagramPoint.Y >= relativeLeftBottom.Y)
			{
				return diagramPoint.Y <= relativeRightTop.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class XPlaneRectangle : PlaneRectangle
	{
		public static XPlaneRectangle Empty => new XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Zero, DiagramPoint.Zero);

		public static XPlaneRectangle MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint corner1, DiagramPoint corner2)
		{
			XPlaneRectangle xPlaneRectangle = new XPlaneRectangle(corner1, corner2);
			xPlaneRectangle.IncSize();
			return xPlaneRectangle;
		}

		protected XPlaneRectangle()
		{
		}

		public XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
			: base(p1, p2)
		{
		}

		public XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height)
			: base(point, width, height)
		{
		}

		public XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, Box box)
			: base(point, width, height, box)
		{
		}

		public XPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, BoxPlane boxPlane)
			: base(point, width, height, boxPlane)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ArePointsCorrect(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return p1.X == p2.X;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint AbsoluteToRelative(DiagramPoint p)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(p.Y, p.Z, p.X);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint p)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(p.Z, p.X, p.Y);
		}

		protected override DiagramVector RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramVector v)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(v.DZ, v.DX, v.DY);
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new XPlaneRectangle();
		}
	}
	public class YPlaneRectangle : PlaneRectangle
	{
		public static YPlaneRectangle Empty => new YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Zero, DiagramPoint.Zero);

		public static YPlaneRectangle MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint corner1, DiagramPoint corner2)
		{
			YPlaneRectangle yPlaneRectangle = new YPlaneRectangle(corner1, corner2);
			yPlaneRectangle.IncSize();
			return yPlaneRectangle;
		}

		protected YPlaneRectangle()
		{
		}

		public YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
			: base(p1, p2)
		{
		}

		public YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height)
			: base(point, width, height)
		{
		}

		public YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, Box box)
			: base(point, width, height, box)
		{
		}

		public YPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, BoxPlane boxPlane)
			: base(point, width, height, boxPlane)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ArePointsCorrect(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return p1.Y == p2.Y;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint AbsoluteToRelative(DiagramPoint p)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(p.Z, p.X, p.Y);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint p)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(p.Y, p.Z, p.X);
		}

		protected override DiagramVector RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramVector v)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(v.DY, v.DZ, v.DX);
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new YPlaneRectangle();
		}
	}
	public class ZPlaneRectangle : PlaneRectangle
	{
		public static ZPlaneRectangle Empty => new ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint.Zero, DiagramPoint.Zero);

		public static ZPlaneRectangle Inflate(ZPlaneRectangle rect, double dx, double dy)
		{
			return (ZPlaneRectangle)PlaneRectangle.Inflate(rect, dx, dy);
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle MakeRectangle(DiagramPoint corner1, DiagramPoint corner2)
		{
			ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = new ZPlaneRectangle(corner1, corner2);
			zPlaneRectangle.IncSize();
			return zPlaneRectangle;
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle MakeRectangle(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			double x = points[0].X;
			double x2 = points[0].X;
			double y = points[0].Y;
			double y2 = points[0].Y;
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = points[i];
				if (gRealPoint2D.X < x)
				{
					x = gRealPoint2D.X;
				}
				else if (gRealPoint2D.X > x2)
				{
					x2 = gRealPoint2D.X;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.Y < y)
				{
					y = gRealPoint2D.Y;
				}
				else if (gRealPoint2D.Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = gRealPoint2D.Y;
				}
			}
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(x, y), new DiagramPoint(x2, y2));
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle MakeRectangle(IList<DiagramPoint> points)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			double x = points[0].X;
			double x2 = points[0].X;
			double y = points[0].Y;
			double y2 = points[0].Y;
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				DiagramPoint diagramPoint = points[i];
				if (diagramPoint.X < x)
				{
					x = diagramPoint.X;
				}
				else if (diagramPoint.X > x2)
				{
					x2 = diagramPoint.X;
				}
				if (diagramPoint.Y < y)
				{
					y = diagramPoint.Y;
				}
				else if (diagramPoint.Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = diagramPoint.Y;
				}
			}
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(x, y), new DiagramPoint(x2, y2));
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle Intersect(ZPlaneRectangle rect1, ZPlaneRectangle rect2)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = rect1.LeftBottom;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = rect2.LeftBottom;
			DiagramPoint p = new DiagramPoint(Math.Max(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint2.X), Math.Max(diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint2.Y));
			diagramPoint = rect1.RightTop;
			diagramPoint2 = rect2.RightTop;
			DiagramPoint p2 = new DiagramPoint(Math.Min(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint2.X), Math.Min(diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint2.Y));
			if (!(p2.X <= p.X) && !(p2.Y <= p.Y))
			{
				return new ZPlaneRectangle(p, p2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static ZPlaneRectangle Union(ZPlaneRectangle rect1, ZPlaneRectangle rect2)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = rect1.LeftBottom;
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = rect2.LeftBottom;
			DiagramPoint p = new DiagramPoint(Math.Min(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint2.X), Math.Min(diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint2.Y));
			diagramPoint = rect1.RightTop;
			diagramPoint2 = rect2.RightTop;
			DiagramPoint p2 = new DiagramPoint(Math.Max(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint2.X), Math.Max(diagramPoint.Y, diagramPoint2.Y));
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(p, p2);
		}

		public static explicit operator ZPlaneRectangle(Rectangle rect)
		{
			return new ZPlaneRectangle((DiagramPoint)rect.Location, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public static explicit operator ZPlaneRectangle(RectangleF rect)
		{
			return new ZPlaneRectangle((DiagramPoint)rect.Location, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public static explicit operator ZPlaneRectangle(DXRectangle rect)
		{
			return new ZPlaneRectangle(new DiagramPoint(((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top), ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height);
		}

		public static explicit operator Rectangle(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			Point location = (Point)rect.LeftBottom.Point;
			Point point = (Point)rect.RightTop.Point;
			return new Rectangle(location, new Size(point.X - location.X, point.Y - location.Y));
		}

		public static explicit operator RectangleF(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			PointF location = (PointF)rect.LeftBottom.Point;
			PointF pointF = (PointF)rect.RightTop.Point;
			return new RectangleF(location, new SizeF(pointF.X - location.X, pointF.Y - location.Y));
		}

		public static explicit operator DXRectangle(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return GraphicUtils.ConvertRect((Rectangle)rect);
		}

		protected ZPlaneRectangle()
		{
		}

		public ZPlaneRectangle(ZPlaneRectangle rect)
			: base(rect.LeftBottom, rect.RightTop)
		{
		}

		public ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
			: base(p1, p2)
		{
		}

		public ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height)
			: base(point, width, height)
		{
		}

		public ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, Box box)
			: base(point, width, height, box)
		{
		}

		public ZPlaneRectangle(DiagramPoint point, double width, double height, BoxPlane boxPlane)
			: base(point, width, height, boxPlane)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ArePointsCorrect(DiagramPoint p1, DiagramPoint p2)
		{
			return p1.Z == p2.Z;
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint AbsoluteToRelative(DiagramPoint p)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(p.X, p.Y, p.Z);
		}

		protected override DiagramPoint RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramPoint p)
		{
			return new DiagramPoint(p.X, p.Y, p.Z);
		}

		protected override DiagramVector RelativeToAbsolute(DiagramVector v)
		{
			return new DiagramVector(v.DX, v.DY, v.DZ);
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new ZPlaneRectangle();
		}

		public bool AreWidthAndHeightPositive()
		{
			if (base.Width > 0.0)
			{
				return base.Height > 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Rectangle RoundToRectangle()
		{
			int x = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Location.X);
			int y = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Location.Y);
			int width = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Width);
			int height = MathUtils.StrongRound(base.Height);
			return new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}
	public class PlanePolygon : PlanePrimitive
	{
		protected PlanePolygon()
		{
		}

		public PlanePolygon(IList<DiagramPoint> points)
			: base(points)
		{
		}

		public PlanePolygon(DiagramPoint[] points, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
			: base(points, sameNormals, sameColors, normal, color)
		{
		}

		public PlanePolygon(Vertex[] vertices)
			: base(vertices)
		{
		}

		public PlanePolygon(Vertex[] vertices, bool sameNormals, bool sameColors, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
			: base(vertices, sameNormals, sameColors, normal, color)
		{
		}

		public PlanePolygon CreateInstance(Vertex[] vertices)
		{
			if (vertices.Length < 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = new PlanePolygon();
			planePolygon.AssignProperties(this);
			planePolygon.SetVertices(vertices);
			return planePolygon;
		}

		public PlaneTriangle CreateTriangle(Vertex v1, Vertex v2, Vertex v3)
		{
			PlaneTriangle planeTriangle = new PlaneTriangle();
			planeTriangle.AssignProperties(this);
			planeTriangle.SetVertices(new Vertex[3] { v1, v2, v3 });
			return planeTriangle;
		}

		protected override bool IsVerticesCountValid(int count)
		{
			return count > 2;
		}

		protected override PlanePrimitive CreateInstance()
		{
			return new PlanePolygon();
		}

		protected internal override GraphicsCommand CreateGraphicsCommand()
		{
			return new PolygonGraphicsCommand(this);
		}
	}
	public class Prism
	{
		private readonly PlanePolygon[] polygons;

		private readonly PlanePolygon[] bases;

		private readonly PlanePolygon[] laterals;

		public PlanePolygon[] Polygons => polygons;

		public PlanePolygon[] Bases => bases;

		public PlanePolygon[] Laterals => laterals;

		public Prism(PlanePolygon polygon, double height)
		{
			DiagramPoint[] array = new DiagramPoint[polygon.Vertices.Length];
			DiagramPoint[] array2 = new DiagramPoint[polygon.Vertices.Length];
			double dz = (0.0 - height) / 2.0;
			double dz2 = height / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = DiagramPoint.Offset(polygon.Vertices[i], 0.0, 0.0, dz);
				array2[i] = DiagramPoint.Offset(polygon.Vertices[i], 0.0, 0.0, dz2);
			}
			bases = new PlanePolygon[2];
			bases[0] = new PlanePolygon(array);
			bases[1] = new PlanePolygon(array2);
			laterals = new PlanePolygon[polygon.Vertices.Length];
			for (int j = 0; j < polygon.Vertices.Length; j++)
			{
				int num = j;
				int num2 = ((j != polygon.Vertices.Length - 1) ? (j + 1) : 0);
				laterals[j] = new PlanePolygon(new DiagramPoint[4]
				{
					array[num],
					array[num2],
					array2[num2],
					array2[num]
				});
				laterals[j].Normal = MathUtils.CalcNormal(laterals[j]);
				laterals[j].SameNormals = true;
			}
			bases[0].InvertVerticesDirection();
			bases[0].Normal = new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
			bases[0].SameNormals = true;
			bases[1].Normal = new DiagramVector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			bases[1].SameNormals = true;
			polygons = new PlanePolygon[bases.Length + laterals.Length];
			Array.Copy(bases, 0, polygons, 0, bases.Length);
			Array.Copy(laterals, 0, polygons, 2, laterals.Length);
		}
	}
	public struct Vertex
	{
		private DiagramPoint point;

		private DiagramVector normal;

		private Color color;

		public DiagramPoint Point
		{
			get
			{
				return point;
			}
			set
			{
				point = value;
			}
		}

		public DiagramVector Normal
		{
			get
			{
				return normal;
			}
			set
			{
				normal = value;
			}
		}

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				color = value;
			}
		}

		public double X
		{
			get
			{
				return point.X;
			}
			set
			{
				point.X = value;
			}
		}

		public double Y
		{
			get
			{
				return point.Y;
			}
			set
			{
				point.Y = value;
			}
		}

		public double Z
		{
			get
			{
				return point.Z;
			}
			set
			{
				point.Z = value;
			}
		}

		public static implicit operator DiagramPoint(Vertex vertex)
		{
			return vertex.point;
		}

		public Vertex(DiagramPoint point, DiagramVector normal, Color color)
		{
			this.point = point;
			this.normal = normal;
			this.color = color;
		}

		public Vertex(DiagramPoint point, DiagramVector normal)
			: this(point, normal, Color.Black)
		{
		}

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			point = DiagramPoint.Offset(point, dx, dy, dz);
		}
	}

	public interface ICursorHolder

	public abstract class ChartNavigationControllerBase : IDisposable
	{
		private class SimpleQueryCursorEventArgs : IQueryCursorEventArgs
		{
			public object Cursor { get; private set; }

			public CursorType CursorType { get; }

			public SimpleQueryCursorEventArgs(object cursor, CursorType cursorType)
			{
				Cursor = cursor;
				CursorType = cursorType;
			}

			public void CopyFrom(IQueryCursorEventArgs source)
			{
				Cursor = source.Cursor;
			}
		}

		private class CursorManager
		{
			private readonly ChartNavigationControllerBase controller;

			private readonly ICursorHolder cursorHolder;

			private bool isCursorInitializing;

			private object userCursor;

			private CursorType currentDragCursorType;

			public CursorManager(ChartNavigationControllerBase controller, object defaultCursor)
			{
				this.controller = controller;
				userCursor = defaultCursor;
				cursorHolder = controller.container as ICursorHolder;
			}

			private void SetCursor(object cursor, CursorType cursorType)
			{
				IQueryCursorEventArgs e = new SimpleQueryCursorEventArgs(cursor, cursorType);
				controller.container.InteractionProvider?.OnQueryCursor(e);
				if (controller.container.DesignMode)
				{
					return;
				}
				isCursorInitializing = true;
				try
				{
					if (cursorHolder != null && cursorHolder.Cursor != e.Cursor)
					{
						cursorHolder.Cursor = e.Cursor;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					isCursorInitializing = false;
				}
			}

			private void SetCursor(CursorType cursorType)
			{
				object cursor = ((cursorType == CursorType.None) ? userCursor : controller.GetCursorByType(cursorType));
				SetCursor(cursor, cursorType);
			}

			private bool IsDrillDownAvailable(NavigationState navigationState, Point location)
			{
				if (controller.Chart.DataContainer.IsDrillDownAvailable)
				{
					if (IsDrillDown(navigationState))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (IsFree(navigationState))
					{
						IDrillDownBindings drillDownBindings = ((controller.ScrollingZoomingOptions != null) ? controller.ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings : null);
						if (drillDownBindings != null && drillDownBindings.UseMouse && controller.Chart.CanDrillDown(location))
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (controller.FindCurrentSpecificCursorArea(location) is BreadcrumbItem breadcrumbItem)
						{
							return breadcrumbItem.IsActive;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void UpdateCursor(Point location, NavigationState navigationState)
			{
				CursorType cursorType = CursorType.None;
				if (IsMouseDragging(navigationState))
				{
					cursorType = ((currentDragCursorType != CursorType.None) ? currentDragCursorType : (currentDragCursorType = (controller.FindCurrentSpecificCursorArea(location) as IDragPoint)?.DragCursorType ?? (cursorType = CursorType.Grab)));
				}
				else
				{
					currentDragCursorType = CursorType.None;
					object specificCursorPoint;
					if (IsZoomingInMode(navigationState) || IsZoomingIn(navigationState))
					{
						cursorType = ((!controller.Chart.CanZoomIn) ? CursorType.ZoomLimit : CursorType.ZoomIn);
					}
					else if (IsZoomingOut(navigationState))
					{
						cursorType = ((!controller.Chart.CanZoomOut) ? CursorType.ZoomLimit : CursorType.ZoomOut);
					}
					else if (IsDrillDownAvailable(navigationState, location))
					{
						cursorType = CursorType.Link;
					}
					else if (IsFree(navigationState) && controller.CanDrag(location, (PortableMouseButtons)0, out specificCursorPoint))
					{
						cursorType = ((specificCursorPoint is IDragPoint dragPoint) ? dragPoint.CanDragCursorType : CursorType.Hand);
					}
					else if (!controller.container.DesignMode && (cursorType == CursorType.ZoomIn || cursorType == CursorType.ZoomLimit || cursorType == CursorType.Hand || cursorType == CursorType.ZoomOut || cursorType == CursorType.SizeAll))
					{
						SetCursor(userCursor, CursorType.None);
						return;
					}
				}
				SetCursor(cursorType);
			}

			public void ChangeUserCursor(object cursor)
			{
				if (!isCursorInitializing)
				{
					userCursor = cursor;
				}
			}
		}

		public class ScrollbarManager : IDisposable
		{
			private const int firstScrollInterval = 200;

			private const int scrollInterval = 50;

			private const int smallScrollStep = 1;

			private readonly ChartNavigationControllerBase controller;

			private readonly PortableDispatchedTimer scrollTimer = new PortableDispatchedTimer();

			private XYDiagram2DScrollParameters scrollParameters;

			private XYDiagramPaneBase focusedPane;

			public bool IsActive { get; private set; }

			public ScrollingOrientation Orientation => scrollParameters.Orientation;

			public XYDiagramPaneBase FocusedPane => focusedPane;

			public ScrollbarManager(ChartNavigationControllerBase controller)
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
				this.controller = controller;
				scrollTimer.Enabled = false;
				scrollTimer.Tick += ScrollTimerTick;
			}

			private void ScrollTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				scrollTimer.Interval = 50;
				XYDiagram2DScrollParameters parameters = controller.Chart.HitTestController.FindScrollCommand(controller.ClientPoint);
				if (scrollParameters.AreSame(parameters) && controller.Enabled)
				{
					PerformScroll(scrollParameters.Orientation, scrollParameters.NavigationType);
					return;
				}
				focusedPane = null;
				Release();
			}

			private void PerformScroll(ScrollingOrientation scrollingOrientation, NavigationType navigationType)
			{
				XYDiagram2D diagram = focusedPane.Diagram;
				PaneAxesManager axesManager = diagram.GetAxesManager(focusedPane);
				if (axesManager == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = (scrollingOrientation == ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll) ^ diagram.ActualRotated;
				Rectangle displayBounds = controller.ContainerAdapter.DisplayBounds;
				int num = Math.Min(displayBounds.Width, displayBounds.Height) - 1;
				if (flag)
				{
					switch (navigationType)
					{
					case NavigationType.LargeDecrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(num, 0, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					case NavigationType.LargeIncrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(-num, 0, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					case NavigationType.SmallDecrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(1, 0, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					case NavigationType.SmallIncrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(-1, 0, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					switch (navigationType)
					{
					case NavigationType.LargeDecrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(0, -num, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					case NavigationType.LargeIncrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(0, num, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					case NavigationType.SmallDecrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(0, -1, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					case NavigationType.SmallIncrement:
						axesManager.Scroll(0, 1, useReverse: false, navigationType);
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool Initialize(Point location)
			{
				IsActive = false;
				if (controller.Chart.Diagram != null && controller.Chart.Diagram.CanScroll)
				{
					scrollParameters = controller.Chart.HitTestController.FindScrollCommand(location);
					if (scrollParameters != null)
					{
						focusedPane = scrollParameters.Pane;
						IsActive = true;
					}
				}
				return IsActive;
			}

			public void Release()
			{
				if (IsActive)
				{
					IsActive = false;
				}
				if (scrollTimer.Enabled)
				{
					scrollTimer.Enabled = false;
				}
			}

			public void Scroll()
			{
				if (((XYDiagram2D)controller.Chart.Diagram).ScrollingOptions.UseScrollBars && controller.Enabled)
				{
					if (scrollParameters.NavigationType != NavigationType.ThumbPosition)
					{
						scrollTimer.Enabled = true;
						scrollTimer.Interval = 200;
					}
					PerformScroll(scrollParameters.Orientation, scrollParameters.NavigationType);
				}
			}

			public void ScrollTo(Point location, Point previousLocation)
			{
				if (focusedPane != null && scrollParameters.NavigationType == NavigationType.ThumbPosition)
				{
					XYDiagram2D diagram = focusedPane.Diagram;
					PaneAxesManager axesManager = diagram.GetAxesManager(focusedPane);
					if (axesManager != null)
					{
						double num = (((Orientation == ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll) ^ diagram.ActualRotated) ? (location.X - previousLocation.X) : (previousLocation.Y - location.Y));
						axesManager.ScrollTo(scrollParameters.RelativePosition + num / (double)scrollParameters.Range, Orientation, NavigationType.ThumbPosition);
					}
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				scrollTimer.Tick -= ScrollTimerTick;
				scrollTimer.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private static bool IsFree(NavigationState state)
		{
			if (state != NavigationState.Free)
			{
				return state == NavigationState.FreeClick;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsFreeClick(NavigationState state)
		{
			return (state & NavigationState.FreeClick) > NavigationState.Free;
		}

		private static bool IsScrollbarDragging(NavigationState state)

			return (state & NavigationState.ZoomingInMode) > NavigationState.Free;
		}

		private static bool IsSelection(NavigationState state)
		{
			return (state & NavigationState.Selection) > NavigationState.Free;
		}

		private static bool IsGesturePan(NavigationState state)

		private static bool IsLeftMouseButton(PortableMouseButtons buttons)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (buttons & 0x100000) > 0;
		}

		private static bool IsMiddleMouseButton(PortableMouseButtons buttons)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (buttons & 0x400000) > 0;
		}

		private static bool CheckAction(ChartModifierKeys exceptedModifierKeys, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (exceptedModifierKeys == ChartModifierKeys.None)
			{
				return (int)modifierKeys == 0;
			}
			bool flag = (exceptedModifierKeys & ChartModifierKeys.Alt) == ChartModifierKeys.Alt;
			bool flag2 = (modifierKeys & 0x40000) == 262144;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			flag = (exceptedModifierKeys & ChartModifierKeys.Control) == ChartModifierKeys.Control;
			flag2 = (modifierKeys & 0x20000) == 131072;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			flag = (exceptedModifierKeys & ChartModifierKeys.Shift) == ChartModifierKeys.Shift;
			flag2 = (modifierKeys & 0x10000) == 65536;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool CheckAction(ChartMouseAction mouseAction, PortableKeys modifierKeys, PortableMouseButtons mouseButton)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (CheckAction(mouseAction.ModifierKeys, modifierKeys))
			{
				if ((int)mouseButton != 0)
				{
					return (PortableMouseButtons)(mouseAction.MouseButton & mouseButton) == mouseButton;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ChartNavigationControllerBase(IChartContainer container, object defaultCursor)
		{
			this.container = container;
			cursorManager = new CursorManager(this, defaultCursor);
			scrollbarManager = new ScrollbarManager(this);
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshair(Point cursorLocation)
		{
			Chart chart = Chart;
			if (chart.Diagram != null && Enabled && !chart.CrosshairForced)
			{
				CrosshairPointLocation location = new CrosshairPointLocation(chart.ActualCrosshairEnabled ? cursorLocation : Point.Empty);
				if (chart.Diagram.UpdateCrosshairLocation(location) && chart.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
				{
					ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeFocusedElement(Point location)
		{
			clientPoint = location;
			focusedElement = null;
			if (scrollbarManager.Initialize(location))
			{
				focusedElement = scrollbarManager.FocusedPane;
				return;
			}
			ChartFocusedArea chartFocusedArea = Chart.HitTestController.FindFocusedArea(location);
			if (chartFocusedArea != null)
			{
				focusedElement = chartFocusedArea.Element;
			}
		}

		private void BeginDrag(Point location, PortableMouseButtons buttons)
		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState) || IsMouseDragging(navigationState) || focusedElement is IAnnotationDragElement || Chart.CanDrag(location, buttons))
			{
				try
				{
					container.Changing();
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
					return;
				}
				clientPoint = location;
			}
		}

		private void EndDrag(Point location)
		{
			if (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState) || IsMouseDragging(navigationState))
			{
				container.Changed();
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = false;
			}
			if (IsZoomingIn(navigationState))
			{
				if (!Chart.CanZoomInViaRect || firstDragPoint == clientPoint)
				{
					Chart.PerformZoomIn(clientPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle rect = GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(firstDragPoint, clientPoint);
					rect.Width--;
					rect.Height--;
					Chart.PerformZoomIn(rect);
				}
				firstDragPoint = Point.Empty;
				clientPoint = Point.Empty;
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = false;
			}
			if (IsSelection(navigationState))
			{
				if (firstDragPoint == clientPoint)
				{
					Chart.SelectObjectsAt(clientPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle rect2 = GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(firstDragPoint, clientPoint);
					rect2.Width--;
					rect2.Height--;
					Chart.SelectObjectsAt(rect2);
				}
				firstDragPoint = Point.Empty;
				clientPoint = Point.Empty;
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = false;
			}
			if (IsZoomingOut(navigationState))
			{
				if (!location.IsEmpty && Chart.CanZoom(location))
				{
					Chart.PerformZoomOut(location);
				}
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = false;
			}
			scrollbarManager.Release();
		}

		private void UpdateToolTip(PortableMouseEventArgs args)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ContainerAdapter.CanShowTooltips)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((int)args.Button == 0 && container.ShowDesignerHints && CanDrag(args.Location, args.Button, out var specificCursorPoint))
			{
				string text = ((specificCursorPoint is IAnnotationDragPoint annotationDragPoint) ? annotationDragPoint.DesignerHint : Chart.GetDesignerHint(args.Location));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					ShowHint(text, ContainerAdapter.PointToCanvas(args.Location));
					return;
				}
			}
			HideHint();
		}

		private bool CanDrag(Point location, PortableMouseButtons mouseButtons, out object specificCursorPoint)
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			specificCursorPoint = null;
			if (Chart.IsPointInLegend(location))
			{
				return false;
			}
			specificCursorPoint = FindCurrentSpecificCursorArea(location);
			if (specificCursorPoint is IDragPoint dragPoint && dragPoint.CanDrag())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Chart.Diagram != null)
			{
				return Chart.Diagram.CanDrag(location, mouseButtons);
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object specificCursorPoint;

		}

		private Point GetOverPan(Point delta)
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = focusedElement as XYDiagramPaneBase;
			bool flag = IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState);
			if (xYDiagramPaneBase == null || delta.IsEmpty || (!xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.ScrollingOptions.UseScrollBars && flag))
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.GetPaneAxesData(xYDiagramPaneBase);
			if (paneAxesData == null)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				delta = new Point(-delta.X, -delta.Y);
			}
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
			Axis2D axis2D2 = (Axis2D)paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (xYDiagramPaneBase.MappingList == null)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = xYDiagramPaneBase.MappingList.GetMappingContainer(axis2D, axis2D2);
			if (mappingContainer == null)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			Point point = DiagramToPointCalculator.CalculateCoords(xYDiagramPaneBase, mappingContainer, axis2D.VisualRangeData.Min, axis2D2.VisualRangeData.Min).Point;
			Point point2 = DiagramToPointCalculator.CalculateCoords(xYDiagramPaneBase, mappingContainer, axis2D.VisualRangeData.Max, axis2D2.VisualRangeData.Max).Point;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Math.Min(point.X, point2.X), Math.Min(point.Y, point2.Y), Math.Abs(point.X - point2.X), Math.Abs(point.Y - point2.Y));
			rectangle.Offset(delta);
			point = DiagramToPointCalculator.CalculateCoords(xYDiagramPaneBase, mappingContainer, axis2D.WholeRangeData.Min, axis2D2.WholeRangeData.Min).Point;
			point2 = DiagramToPointCalculator.CalculateCoords(xYDiagramPaneBase, mappingContainer, axis2D.WholeRangeData.Max, axis2D2.WholeRangeData.Max).Point;
			Rectangle rectangle2 = new Rectangle(Math.Min(point.X, point2.X), Math.Min(point.Y, point2.Y), Math.Abs(point.X - point2.X), Math.Abs(point.Y - point2.Y));
			int x = 0;
			int y = 0;
			if (rectangle.Left < rectangle2.Left)
			{
				x = (flag ? (rectangle.Left - rectangle2.Left) : (rectangle2.Left - rectangle.Left));
			}
			else if (rectangle.Right > rectangle2.Right)
			{
				x = (flag ? (rectangle.Right - rectangle2.Right) : (rectangle2.Right - rectangle.Right));
			}
			if (rectangle.Top < rectangle2.Top)
			{
				y = (flag ? (rectangle.Top - rectangle2.Top) : (rectangle2.Top - rectangle.Top));
			}
			else if (rectangle.Bottom > rectangle2.Bottom)
			{
				y = (flag ? (rectangle.Bottom - rectangle2.Bottom) : (rectangle2.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if ((scrollbarManager.Orientation == ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll) ^ xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.ActualRotated)
				{
					return new Point(x, 0);
				}
				return new Point(0, y);
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		private KeyAction GetKeyAction(PortableKeys keyData)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null)
			{
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ScrollingBindings != null)
				{
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ScrollingBindings.ScrollLeft.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.ScrollLeft;
					}
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ScrollingBindings.ScrollRight.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.ScrollRight;
					}
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ScrollingBindings.ScrollUp.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.ScrollUp;
					}
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ScrollingBindings.ScrollDown.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.ScrollDown;
					}
				}
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ZoomingBindings != null)
				{
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ZoomingBindings.UndoZoom.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.UndoZoom;
					}
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ZoomingBindings.ZoomIn.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.ZoomIn;
					}
					if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.ZoomingBindings.ZoomOut.Contains(keyData))
					{
						return KeyAction.ZoomOut;
					}
				}
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings.DrillUp.Contains(keyData))
				{
					return KeyAction.DrillUp;
				}
			}
			return KeyAction.None;
		}

		private NavigationState GetDefaultState(bool onMouseDown, Point location)
		{
			if (onMouseDown)
			{
				return NavigationState.FreeClick;
			}
			if (!(lastPoint == location) || navigationState != NavigationState.FreeClick)
			{
				return NavigationState.Free;
			}
			return NavigationState.FreeClick;
		}

		private NavigationState GetNavigationState(Point location, PortableKeys modifierKeys, bool onMouseDown = false)
		{
			//IL_027a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0296: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0287: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0200: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0202: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0231: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0151: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0153: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_023e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0142: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0263: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0189: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0165: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0167: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01af: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (scrollbarManager.IsActive)
			{
				return NavigationState.ScrollbarDragging;
			}
			NavigationState navigationState = GetDefaultState(onMouseDown, location);
			lastPoint = location;
			if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null)
			{
				IDrillDownBindings drillDownBindings = ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings;
				if (!IsMouseDragging(this.navigationState) && drillDownBindings != null && drillDownBindings.UseMouse && CheckAction(drillDownBindings.DrillDownMouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons) && Chart.CanDrillDown(location))
				{
					navigationState |= NavigationState.DrillDown;
				}
				ISelectionBindings selectionBindings = ScrollingZoomingOptions.SelectionBindings;
				if (selectionBindings != null && CheckAction(selectionBindings.RectangleSelectionMouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons) && Chart.Diagram.CanSelect(location) && Chart.SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.Multiple)
				{
					navigationState |= NavigationState.Selection;
					if (!IsSelection(this.navigationState))
					{
						firstDragPoint = location;
					}
				}
				IZoomingBindings zoomingBindings = ScrollingZoomingOptions.ZoomingBindings;
				if (zoomingBindings != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardWithMouseZooming && Chart.CanZoom(location) && !container.DesignMode)
				{
					ChartMouseAction zoomToRectangleMouseAction = zoomingBindings.ZoomToRectangleMouseAction;
					if (CheckAction(zoomingBindings.ZoomInMouseAction.ModifierKeys, modifierKeys) || (zoomToRectangleMouseAction != null && CheckAction(zoomToRectangleMouseAction.ModifierKeys, modifierKeys)))
					{
						if (CheckAction(zoomingBindings.ZoomInMouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons) || (zoomToRectangleMouseAction != null && CheckAction(zoomToRectangleMouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons)))
						{
							if (!IsZoomingIn(this.navigationState))
							{
								firstDragPoint = location;
							}
							return NavigationState.ZoomingIn;
						}
						if ((int)modifierKeys != 0)
						{
							navigationState |= NavigationState.ZoomingInMode;
						}
					}
					if ((CheckAction(zoomingBindings.ZoomOutMouseAction.ModifierKeys, modifierKeys) && (int)modifierKeys != 0) || CheckAction(zoomingBindings.ZoomOutMouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons))
					{
						navigationState |= NavigationState.ZoomingOut;
					}
				}
				IScrollingBindings scrollingBindings = ScrollingZoomingOptions.ScrollingBindings;
				IRotationBindings rotationBindings = ScrollingZoomingOptions.RotationBindings;
				if ((((scrollingBindings != null && CheckAction(scrollingBindings.ScrollMouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons)) || (rotationBindings != null && CheckAction(rotationBindings.MouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons))) && !IsZoomingIn(this.navigationState) && !IsSelection(this.navigationState)) || (scrollingBindings == null && rotationBindings == null && (IsLeftMouseButton(mouseButtons) || IsMiddleMouseButton(mouseButtons))))
				{
					if (IsMouseDragging(this.navigationState))
					{
						return NavigationState.MouseDragging;
					}
					if (onMouseDown && CanDrag(location, mouseButtons))
					{
						navigationState |= NavigationState.MouseDragging;
					}
					return navigationState;
				}
			}
			else if ((IsLeftMouseButton(mouseButtons) || IsMiddleMouseButton(mouseButtons)) && CanDrag(location, mouseButtons))
			{
				return NavigationState.MouseDragging;
			}
			bool flag = IsZoomingIn(this.navigationState) || IsSelection(this.navigationState);
			if (!(IsFree(navigationState) && flag) || (int)mouseButtons == 0)
			{
				return navigationState;
			}
			return this.navigationState;
		}

		private bool ProcessDrillDown(Point location)
		{
			if (container.DesignMode || container.IsDesignControl || container.IsEndUserDesigner)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Chart.ClearHot();
			ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = Chart.CalcHitInfo(location);
			if (chartHitInfo.InSeriesPoint)
			{
				object tag = chartHitInfo.SeriesPoint.Tag;
				if (tag is IList list)
				{
					return Chart.DrillDownToSeriesPoint(list[0]);
				}
				if (tag != null)
				{
					return Chart.DrillDownToSeriesPoint(tag);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (chartHitInfo.InSeries)
				{
					return Chart.DrillDownToSeries(chartHitInfo.Series);
				}
				if (chartHitInfo.InAxis && !chartHitInfo.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return Chart.DrillDownToArgument(chartHitInfo.AxisLabelItem.AxisValue);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void TryBeginInlineEditing(Point mouseLocation)
		{
			object obj = FindCurrentSpecificCursorArea(mouseLocation);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				TryInlineAnnotationEditing(obj);
				TryInlineConstantLineTitleEditing(obj);
			}
		}

		private void TryInlineAnnotationEditing(object obj)
		{
			Annotation annotation = null;
			if (obj is ShapeMovingDragPoint shapeMovingDragPoint)
			{
				annotation = shapeMovingDragPoint.Annotation;
			}
			if (obj is Annotation annotation2)
			{
				annotation = annotation2;
			}
			if (annotation == null || !annotation.RuntimeEditing)
			{
				return;
			}
			TextAnnotation textAnnotation = annotation as TextAnnotation;
			if (textAnnotation != null)
			{
				Action<string> afterEditAction = delegate(string t)
				{
					AnnotationTextEditingEventArgs e = new AnnotationTextEditingEventArgs(textAnnotation, t);
					ContainerAdapter.OnAnnotationRepositoryChanging(e);
					if (!e.Cancel)
					{
						textAnnotation.Text = e.NewText;
						AnnotationRepositoryChangedEventArgs e2 = new AnnotationRepositoryChangedEventArgs(textAnnotation, AnnotationRepositoryChange.Text);
						ContainerAdapter.OnAnnotationRepositoryChanged(e2);
					}
				};
				ContainerAdapter.ShowEditor(textAnnotation.ContentRenderBounds, multiline: true, textAnnotation.Text, afterEditAction, alignToCenter: true);
			}
			else if (annotation is ImageAnnotation annotation3)
			{
				ContainerAdapter.SelectImage(annotation3);
			}
		}

		private void TryInlineConstantLineTitleEditing(object obj)
		{
			ConstantLineTitle constantLineTitle = obj as ConstantLineTitle;
			if (constantLineTitle != null && constantLineTitle.ConstantLine.RuntimeTitleEditing)
			{
				Rectangle boundsControlCoord = constantLineTitle.RenderBounds;
				if (!constantLineTitle.ConstantLine.Axis.IsVertical)
				{
					boundsControlCoord = new Rectangle(boundsControlCoord.Location, new Size(boundsControlCoord.Height, boundsControlCoord.Width));
				}
				ContainerAdapter.ShowEditor(boundsControlCoord, multiline: false, constantLineTitle.Text, delegate(string t)
				{
					constantLineTitle.Text = t;
				}, alignToCenter: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnGestureZoom(Point center, double zoomDelta, bool isBegin)
		{
			clientPoint = center;
			if (Chart.Diagram.CanZoomWithTouch)
			{
				if (isBegin)
				{
					Chart.BeginGestureZoom(center, zoomDelta, AnnotationDragPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					Chart.PerformGestureZoom(zoomDelta, AnnotationDragPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		public Point OnGesturePan(Point start, Point delta, bool isBegin, bool isEnd)
		{
			if (!Chart.Diagram.CanPan)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			if (isBegin)
			{
				InitializeFocusedElement(start);
				if (focusedElement == null && Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					return Point.Empty;
				}
				navigationState = (scrollbarManager.IsActive ? NavigationState.ScrollbarDragging : NavigationState.GesturePan);
				overPan = (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState) ? GetOverPan(delta) : Point.Empty);
				firstDragPoint = start;
			}
			if (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState))
			{
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseScrollBarsScrolling)
				{
					scrollbarManager.ScrollTo(new Point(start.X + delta.X, start.Y + delta.Y), firstDragPoint);
				}
			}
			else if (IsGesturePan(navigationState))
			{
				Point point = GetOverPan(delta);
				Chart.PerformDragging(start.X, start.Y, delta.X, delta.Y, ChartScrollEventType.Gesture, focusedElement);
				overPan.X += point.X;
				overPan.Y += point.Y;
			}
			if (isEnd)
			{
				if (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState))
				{
					ContainerAdapter.Capture = false;
					navigationState = NavigationState.Free;
					scrollbarManager.Release();
				}
				else
				{
					InitializeFocusedElement(start);
				}
			}
			return overPan;
		}

		}

		public void DrawDragRectangle(Graphics gr)
		{
			DrawDragRectangle(gr, 1f);
		}

		public void DrawDragRectangle(Graphics gr, float zoomFactor)
		{
			if (IsZoomingIn(navigationState) && Chart.CanZoomInViaRect)
			{
				PointF corner = firstDragPoint;
				corner.X *= zoomFactor;
				corner.Y *= zoomFactor;
				PointF corner2 = clientPoint;
				corner2.X *= zoomFactor;
				corner2.Y *= zoomFactor;
				Rectangle rect = GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(corner, corner2));
				Chart.DrawZoomRectangle(rect);
			}
			else if (IsSelection(navigationState))
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = GraphicUtils.RoundRectangle(GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle(firstDragPoint, clientPoint));
				Chart.DrawSelectionRectangle(rect2);
			}
		}

		public void OnKeyDown(PortableKeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			navigationState = GetNavigationState(clientPoint, e.Modifiers);
			switch (GetKeyAction(e.KeyData))
			{
			case KeyAction.UndoZoom:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null)
				{
					Chart.UndoZoom();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.ZoomIn:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardZooming)
				{
					Chart.Zoom(1, ZoomingKind.Keyboard, focusedElement);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.ZoomOut:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardZooming)
				{
					Chart.Zoom(-1, ZoomingKind.Keyboard, focusedElement);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.ScrollRight:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardScrolling)
				{
					Chart.PerformDragging(-1, -1, 10, 0, ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys, focusedElement);
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.ScrollLeft:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardScrolling)
				{
					Chart.PerformDragging(-1, -1, -10, 0, ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys, focusedElement);
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.ScrollUp:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardScrolling)
				{
					Chart.PerformDragging(-1, -1, 0, -10, ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys, focusedElement);
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.ScrollDown:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardScrolling)
				{
					Chart.PerformDragging(-1, -1, 0, 10, ChartScrollEventType.ArrowKeys, focusedElement);
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.DrillUp:
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings.UseKeyboard)
				{
					Chart.DrillUp();
				}
				break;
			case KeyAction.None:
				cursorManager.UpdateCursor(ClientPoint, navigationState);
				break;
			}
		}

		public void OnKeyUp(PortableKeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Enabled)
			{
				if ((int)e.KeyData == 46)
				{
					Chart.AnnotationNavigation.RemoveSelectedAnnotation();
					Chart.ConstantLineNavigation.RemoveSelectedConstantLine();
				}
				navigationState = GetNavigationState(clientPoint, e.Modifiers);
				cursorManager.UpdateCursor(ClientPoint, navigationState);
			}
		}

		}

		public void OnMouseWheel(PortableMouseEventArgs e, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (e.Delta == 0 || Chart.AnimationInProgress || (!IsFree(navigationState) && IsMouseDragging(navigationState)))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool handled = false;
			bool isTransactionOpen = Chart.ViewController.IsTransactionOpen;
			if (container.DesignMode)
			{
				if (ContainerAdapter.DragCtrlKeyRequired && (modifierKeys & 0x20000) == 131072 && Chart.CanZoom(e.Location))
				{
					if (!isTransactionOpen)
					{
						Chart.Zoom(e.Location, Math.Sign(e.Delta), ZoomingKind.MouseWheel, focusedElement);
					}
					handled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (Chart.CanZoom(e.Location) && ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseMouseWheelZooming)
			{
				if (!isTransactionOpen)
				{
					Chart.Zoom(e.Location, Math.Sign(e.Delta), ZoomingKind.MouseWheel, focusedElement);
				}
				handled = true;
			}
			PortableHandledMouseEventArgs e2 = (PortableHandledMouseEventArgs)(object)((e is PortableHandledMouseEventArgs) ? e : null);
			if (e2 != null)
			{
				e2.Handled = handled;
			}
			if (!isTransactionOpen)
			{
				cursorManager.UpdateCursor(e.Location, navigationState);
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseDown(PortableMouseEventArgs e, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			InitializeFocusedElement(e.Location);
			if (IsLeftMouseButton(e.Button) && focusedElement is IClickableElement clickableElement && clickableElement.ProcessLeftButtonClick())
			{
				Chart.ClearHot();
				navigationState = NavigationState.ClickableElementClick;
				return;
			}
			mouseButtons = e.Button;
			navigationState = GetNavigationState(e.Location, modifierKeys, onMouseDown: true);
			Chart.AnnotationNavigation.DoSelect(focusedElement as IAnnotationDragElement, container);
			Chart.ConstantLineNavigation.ResetSelection(container);
			bool flag = false;
			if (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState))
			{
				scrollbarManager.Scroll();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (IsMouseDragging(navigationState))
			{
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = true;
				BeginDrag(e.Location, e.Button);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (IsZoomingIn(navigationState) && ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardWithMouseZooming)
			{
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = true;
				firstDragPoint = (clientPoint = e.Location);
				ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (IsSelection(navigationState))
			{
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = true;
				firstDragPoint = (clientPoint = e.Location);
				ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (IsZoomingOut(navigationState) && ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseKeyboardWithMouseZooming)
			{
				ContainerAdapter.Capture = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				EndDrag(Point.Empty);
			}
			cursorManager.UpdateCursor(e.Location, navigationState);
			UpdateToolTip(e);
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(PortableMouseEventArgs e, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			navigationState = GetNavigationState(e.Location, modifierKeys);
			if (IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState) && ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.UseScrollBarsScrolling && Enabled)
			{
				scrollbarManager.ScrollTo(e.Location, clientPoint);
			}
			if (IsMouseDragging(navigationState) && e.Location != clientPoint && Enabled)
			{
				UpdateCrosshair(Point.Empty);
				IRotationBindings rotationBindings = ((ScrollingZoomingOptions != null) ? ScrollingZoomingOptions.RotationBindings : null);
				ChartScrollEventType scrollEventType = ((IsLeftMouseButton(e.Button) || (rotationBindings != null && CheckAction(rotationBindings.MouseAction, modifierKeys, mouseButtons))) ? ChartScrollEventType.LeftButtonMouseDrag : ChartScrollEventType.MiddleButtonMouseDrag);
				int dx = e.Location.X - clientPoint.X;
				int dy = e.Location.Y - clientPoint.Y;
				Chart.PerformDragging(clientPoint.X, clientPoint.Y, dx, dy, scrollEventType, focusedElement);
			}
			if (IsSelection(navigationState) || IsZoomingIn(navigationState) || IsZoomingInMode(navigationState) || IsZoomingOut(navigationState))
			{
				ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
			}
			if (!IsScrollbarDragging(navigationState))
			{
				clientPoint = e.Location;
			}
			cursorManager.UpdateCursor(e.Location, navigationState);
			if (IsFree(navigationState))
			{
				Chart.HighlightObjectsAt(e.Location);
				if (ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.DrillDownBindings.UseMouse && Chart.CanDrillDown(e.Location))
				{
					Chart.DrillDownHighlightObjectAt(e.Location);
				}
				UpdateToolTip(e);
				UpdateCrosshair(e.Location);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateCrosshair(Point.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseUp(PortableMouseEventArgs e, PortableKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0104: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			mouseButtons = (PortableMouseButtons)0;
			InitializeFocusedElement(e.Location);
			EndDrag(e.Location);
			if (IsDrillDown(navigationState))
			{
				ProcessDrillDown(e.Location);
			}
			else if (IsClickableElementClick(navigationState))
			{
				Chart.HighlightObjectsAt(e.Location);
				ContainerAdapter.Invalidate();
			}
			else if (Chart.Container.DesignMode)
			{
				Chart.SelectObjectsAt(new DefaultElementsSelectionState(modifierKeys), e.Location, isMouseDown: true);
			}
			else if (IsFreeClick(navigationState) && ScrollingZoomingOptions != null && ScrollingZoomingOptions.SelectionBindings != null)
			{
				Chart.SelectObjectsAt(new ElementsSelectionState(ScrollingZoomingOptions.SelectionBindings, modifierKeys, e.Button), e.Location, isMouseDown: true);
			}
			Chart.ConstantLineNavigation.Select(focusedElement, container);
			navigationState = GetNavigationState(e.Location, modifierKeys);
			cursorManager.UpdateCursor(e.Location, navigationState);
			UpdateToolTip(e);
		}

		public void OnMouseDoubleClick(PortableMouseEventArgs e)
		{
			TryBeginInlineEditing(e.Location);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			scrollbarManager.Dispose();
		}
	}

			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IChartRenderProvider chartRenderProvider = RenderProvider;
			ComponentExporter val = chartRenderProvider?.CreateComponentPrinter(chartRenderProvider.Printable);
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = ((chartRenderProvider != null) ? new ComponentExporter(chartRenderProvider.Printable) : new ComponentExporter((IBasePrintable)null));
			}
			return val;
		}

		public void Initialize(PrintingSystemBase ps, LinkBase link)
		{

			this.link = link;

		{
