		}

		private void OnPrintingSystem_AfterChange(object sender, ChangeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.EventName == "PageSettingsChanged" || e.EventName == "AfterMarginsChange")
			{
				link.Margins = printingSystem.PageMargins;
				link.CreateDocument();
			}
		}

		private void SetPS(PrintingSystemBase ps)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (printingSystem != null)
			{
				printingSystem.AfterChange -= new ChangeEventHandler(OnPrintingSystem_AfterChange);
			}
			printingSystem = ps;
			if (printingSystem != null)
			{
				UpdateCommands((IPrintingSystem)(object)ps);
				printingSystem.AfterChange += new ChangeEventHandler(OnPrintingSystem_AfterChange);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCommands(IPrintingSystem ps)
		{
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)29, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)38, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)33, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)30, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)36, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)34, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)35, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)37, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)40, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)44, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)41, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)47, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)45, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)46, true);
			ps.SetCommandVisibility((PrintingSystemCommand)48, true);
		}

		private SizeF GetPSSize()
		{
			Rectangle pageBounds = printingSystem.PageBounds;
			DXMargins pageMargins = printingSystem.PageMargins;
			float width = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert((float)pageBounds.Width - pageMargins.Left - pageMargins.Right - 1f, 100f, GraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(GraphicsUnit.Pixel));
			float height = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert((float)pageBounds.Height - pageMargins.Top - pageMargins.Bottom - 1f, 100f, GraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(GraphicsUnit.Pixel));
			return new SizeF(width, height);
		}

		private Rectangle CalculatePrintBounds()
		{
			if (RenderProvider == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			switch (sizeMode)
			{
			case PrintSizeMode.Stretch:
				return new Rectangle(Point.Empty, Size.Truncate(GetPSSize()));
			case PrintSizeMode.Zoom:
			{
				Rectangle displayBounds = RenderProvider.DisplayBounds;
				float num = (float)displayBounds.Width / (float)displayBounds.Height;
				SizeF pSSize = GetPSSize();
				if (pSSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				if (num > pSSize.Width / pSSize.Height)
				{
					pSSize.Height = pSSize.Width / num;
				}
				else
				{
					pSSize.Width = pSSize.Height * num;
				}
				return new Rectangle(Point.Empty, Size.Truncate(pSSize));
			}
			default:
				return RenderProvider.DisplayBounds;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle GetPrintBounds()
		{
			return lastPrintBounds = CalculatePrintBounds();
		}
	}

	public static class SeriesIncompatibilityHelper
	{
		private const string delimiter = ",\n";

		private const SeriesIncompatibilityType notDisplayedIncompatibilityType = SeriesIncompatibilityType.Invisible;

		private static string SeriesIncompatibilityTypeToString(SeriesIncompatibilityType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case SeriesIncompatibilityType.ByViewType:
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleByViewType);
			case SeriesIncompatibilityType.ByArgumentScaleType:
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleByArgumentScaleType);
			case SeriesIncompatibilityType.ByValueScaleType:
				return ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleByValueScaleType);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect series incompatibility type");
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private static string ConstructMessage(SeriesIncompatibilityType type, ISeries series)
		{
			return string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.IncompatibleSeriesMessage), SeriesIncompatibilityTypeToString(type), (series == null) ? ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.AutocreatedSeriesName) : series.Name);
		}

		public static string ConstructMessage(SeriesIncompatibilityInfo incompatibilityInfo)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SeriesIncompatibilityType, ISeries> item in incompatibilityInfo)
			{
				if (SeriesIncompatibilityType.Invisible == item.Key)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string value = ConstructMessage(item.Key, item.Value);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					if (stringBuilder.Length != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendLine(",\n");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(value);
				}
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(".");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class SeriesPointComparer : IComparer<ISeriesPoint>
	{
		private int valueIndex;

		private SortingMode mode;

		int IComparer<ISeriesPoint>.Compare(ISeriesPoint x, ISeriesPoint y)
		{
			if (mode == SortingMode.None)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = (SeriesPoint)x;
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint2 = (SeriesPoint)y;
			if (valueIndex < 0 || seriesPoint.Values.Length < valueIndex)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num;
			if (valueIndex == 0)
			{
				num = x.ArgumentX.ArgumentScaleType switch
				{
					Scale.Numerical => (seriesPoint.NumericalArgument != seriesPoint2.NumericalArgument) ? ((seriesPoint.NumericalArgument > seriesPoint2.NumericalArgument) ? 1 : (-1)) : 0, 
					Scale.DateTime => DateTime.Compare(seriesPoint.DateTimeArgument, seriesPoint2.DateTimeArgument), 
					Scale.TimeSpan => TimeSpan.Compare(seriesPoint.TimeSpanArgument, seriesPoint2.TimeSpanArgument), 
					_ => string.Compare(seriesPoint.Argument, seriesPoint2.Argument), 
				};
			}
			else if (seriesPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				num = ((!seriesPoint2.IsEmpty) ? (-1) : 0);
			}
			else if (seriesPoint2.IsEmpty)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				if (seriesPoint.ValueScaleType != seriesPoint2.ValueScaleType)
				{
					throw new InternalException("ValueScaleType");
				}
				if (seriesPoint.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
				{
					long ticks = (seriesPoint.DateTimeValues[valueIndex - 1] - seriesPoint2.DateTimeValues[valueIndex - 1]).Ticks;
					num = ((ticks != 0L) ? ((ticks >= 0) ? 1 : (-1)) : 0);
				}
				else if (seriesPoint.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
				{
					long ticks2 = (seriesPoint.TimeSpanValues[valueIndex - 1] - seriesPoint2.TimeSpanValues[valueIndex - 1]).Ticks;
					num = ((ticks2 != 0L) ? ((ticks2 >= 0) ? 1 : (-1)) : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					double num2 = seriesPoint.Values[valueIndex - 1] - seriesPoint2.Values[valueIndex - 1];
					num = ((num2 != 0.0) ? ((!(num2 < 0.0)) ? 1 : (-1)) : 0);
				}
			}
			if (mode != SortingMode.Ascending)
			{
				return -num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public SeriesPointComparer(SortingMode mode, int valueIndex)
		{
			this.mode = mode;
			this.valueIndex = valueIndex;
		}
	}

	public class AreaWholeSeriesLayout : WholeSeriesLayout
	{
		private List<IGeometryStrip> strips;

		public List<IGeometryStrip> Strips => strips;

		public AreaWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
			: base(seriesLayout)
		{
			this.strips = strips;
		}

		private HitRegion CreateStripHitRegion(RangeStrip strip, AreaDrawOptions areaOptions)
		{
			if (areaOptions.HitTestGDIPlusPath)
			{
				return new HitRegion(StripsUtils.GetPath(strip));
			}
			InnerPath innerPath = new PolygonPath(StripsUtils.GetPathPoints(strip));
			return new HitRegion(innerPath);
		}

		private HitRegion CreateTopStripHitRegion(RangeStrip strip, AreaDrawOptions areaOptions)
		{
			int thickness = ((areaOptions.Border == null) ? 1 : areaOptions.Border.ActualThickness);
			if (areaOptions.HitTestGDIPlusPath)
			{
				return new HitRegion(StripsUtils.GetPath(strip.TopStrip, thickness));
			}
			InnerPath innerPath = new PolylinePath(StripsUtils.GetPathPoints(strip.TopStrip), thickness);
			return new HitRegion(innerPath);
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion(DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion(drawOptions);
			foreach (RangeStrip strip in strips)
			{
				AreaDrawOptions areaOptions = (AreaDrawOptions)drawOptions;
				hitRegionContainer.Union(CreateStripHitRegion(strip, areaOptions));
				hitRegionContainer.Union(CreateTopStripHitRegion(strip, areaOptions));
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}

	public class BarData : IInterimValueCalculator
	{
		private readonly double argument;

		private readonly double zeroValue;

		private readonly double actualValue;

		private readonly double displayOffset;

		private readonly int fixedOffset;

		private readonly double leftArgument;

		private readonly double rightArgument;

		public double Argument => argument;

		public double ActualArgument => argument + displayOffset;

		public double ZeroValue => zeroValue;

		public double ActualValue => actualValue;

		public bool SideBySideInteracted { get; }

		public BarData(double argument, double zeroValue, double actualValue, double width, double displayOffset, int fixedOffset, bool sideBySideInteracted)
		{
			this.argument = argument;
			this.zeroValue = zeroValue;
			this.actualValue = actualValue;
			this.displayOffset = displayOffset;
			this.fixedOffset = fixedOffset;
			leftArgument = argument - width / 2.0;
			rightArgument = argument + width / 2.0;
			SideBySideInteracted = sideBySideInteracted;
		}

		double IInterimValueCalculator.CalculateInterimValue(AxisIntervalLayout intervalLayout, double value, ITransformation transformation)
		{
			return CalculateInterimValue(intervalLayout, value, transformation);
		}

		double IInterimValueCalculator.CalculateInterimValue(AxisIntervalLayoutMapping mapping, double value)
		{
			return mapping.GetInterimCoordCore(value + displayOffset, clip: false, round: false) + (double)fixedOffset;
		}

		private double CalculateInterimValue(AxisIntervalLayout intervalLayout, double value, ITransformation transformation, bool useOffset = true, bool useFixedOffset = true)
		{
			AxisIntervalLayoutMapping axisIntervalLayoutMapping = new AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(intervalLayout, transformation);
			return axisIntervalLayoutMapping.GetInterimCoord(value + (useOffset ? displayOffset : 0.0), clip: false, round: false) + (double)(useFixedOffset ? fixedOffset : 0);
		}

		private double GetInterimX(double argument, AxisIntervalLayout layoutX, ITransformation transformation, bool useOffset = true, bool useFixedOffset = true)
		{
			return Math.Round(CalculateInterimValue(layoutX, argument, transformation, useOffset, useFixedOffset));
		}

		private double CalculateInterimYAnchorPoint(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, Size textSize, int indent, int borderThickness, double interimMin, double interimMax, BarSeriesLabelPosition position)
		{
			int num = (mappingContainer.Rotated ? textSize.Width : textSize.Height);
			int num2 = (indent + borderThickness) * 2 + num;
			double num3 = (double)num2 / 2.0;
			if ((position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.TopInside && zeroValue <= ActualValue) || (position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.BottomInside && zeroValue > ActualValue))
			{
				return interimMax - num3;
			}
			return interimMin + num3;
		}

		private DiagramPoint GetInterimPoint(double argument, double value, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, bool useOffset = true, bool useFixedOffset = true)
		{
			double x = diagramMapping.MappingX.GetCoord(argument + (useOffset ? displayOffset : 0.0)) + (double)(useFixedOffset ? fixedOffset : 0);
			double coord = diagramMapping.MappingY.GetCoord(value);
			return new DiagramPoint(x, coord);
		}

		private AxisIntervalLayout FindIntervalLayoutX(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in mappingContainer.IntervalsLayoutX)
			{
				double interimX = GetInterimX(argument, item, mappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
				if (interimX >= item.Start && interimX <= item.End)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void CalculateBarRects(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, out RectangleF diagramRect, out RectangleF screenRect)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(GetInterimPoint(leftArgument, actualValue, diagramMapping));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(GetInterimPoint(rightArgument, zeroValue, diagramMapping));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint3 = XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(diagramPoint, diagramMapping.Container);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint4 = XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(diagramPoint2, diagramMapping.Container);
			diagramRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2);
			screenRect = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint3, (PointF)diagramPoint4, 1f);
			screenRect = RectangleF.Intersect(diagramMapping.InflatedBounds, screenRect);
		}

		public DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPointForCenterLabelPosition(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator)
		{
			return CalculateAnchorPointForInsideLabelPosition(mappingContainer, pointCalculator, BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center, 0, Size.Empty, 0);
		}

		public DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPointForInsideLabelPosition(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator, BarSeriesLabelPosition position, int indent, Size textSize, int borderThickness)
		{
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = FindIntervalLayoutX(mappingContainer);
			if (axisIntervalLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = pointCalculator.CorrectValuesByViewport(ActualArgument, zeroValue, actualValue);
			double x = list[0].X;
			double interimX;
			if (pointCalculator.UseArgumentOffset)
			{
				bool useFixedOffset = x != axisIntervalLayout.Range.Min && x != axisIntervalLayout.Range.Max;
				interimX = GetInterimX(list[0].X, axisIntervalLayout, mappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation, !pointCalculator.UseArgumentOffset, useFixedOffset);
			}
			else
			{
				interimX = GetInterimX(list[0].X, axisIntervalLayout, mappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation, useOffset: false);
			}
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = mappingContainer.CalculateMinMaxInterimY(null, clipBySideLimits: true, list[0].Y, list[1].Y);
			if (minMaxValues.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.TopInside || position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.BottomInside)
			{
				double y = CalculateInterimYAnchorPoint(mappingContainer, textSize, indent, borderThickness, minMaxValues.Min, minMaxValues.Max, position);
				return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(new DiagramPoint(interimX, y), mappingContainer);
			}
			ChartDebug.Assert(position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center, "Incorrect position");
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = new DiagramPoint(interimX, (minMaxValues.Min + minMaxValues.Max) / 2.0);
			return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, mappingContainer);
		}

		public DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPointForToolTipTopPosition(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = FindIntervalLayoutX(mappingContainer);
			if (axisIntervalLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double interimX = GetInterimX(argument, axisIntervalLayout, mappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = mappingContainer.CalculateMinMaxInterimY(null, clipBySideLimits: true, zeroValue, actualValue);
			if (minMaxValues.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = new DiagramPoint(interimX, minMaxValues.Max);
			return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, mappingContainer);
		}

		public DiagramPoint? CalculateAnchorPointForInsideBarPositionWithScrolling(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, ScreenPointCalculator pointCalculator, SeriesLabelBase seriesLabel, BarSeriesLabelPosition position, int indent, Size textSize)
		{
			if (mappingContainer.MappingForScrolling == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(seriesLabel.SeriesBase.View is BarSeriesView))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = pointCalculator.CorrectValuesByViewport(ActualArgument, zeroValue, actualValue);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double x = list[0].X;
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = ((ActualValue < 0.0) ? new MinMaxValues(list[1].Y, list[0].Y) : new MinMaxValues(list[0].Y, list[1].Y));
			XYDiagramMappingBase mappingForScrolling = mappingContainer.MappingForScrolling;
			if (position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.TopInside || position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.BottomInside)
			{
				minMaxValues.Intersection(mappingForScrolling.AxisY.WholeRangeData);
				if (double.IsNaN(minMaxValues.Max))
				{
					return null;
				}
				double interimX;
				if (pointCalculator.UseArgumentOffset)
				{
					bool useFixedOffset = x != mappingForScrolling.MappingX.Min && x != mappingForScrolling.MappingX.Max;
					interimX = GetInterimX(list[0].X, mappingForScrolling.LayoutX, mappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation, useOffset: false, useFixedOffset);
				}
				else
				{
					interimX = GetInterimX(list[0].X, mappingForScrolling.LayoutX, mappingContainer.AxisX.ScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
				}
				DiagramPoint interimPoint = mappingForScrolling.GetInterimPoint(list[0].X, minMaxValues.Max, clip: false, round: true);
				DiagramPoint interimPoint2 = mappingForScrolling.GetInterimPoint(list[0].X, minMaxValues.Min, clip: false, round: true);
				double y = CalculateInterimYAnchorPoint(mappingContainer, textSize, indent, seriesLabel.Border.Thickness, interimPoint2.Y, interimPoint.Y, position);
				return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(new DiagramPoint(interimX, y), mappingContainer);
			}
			ChartDebug.Assert(position == BarSeriesLabelPosition.Center, "Incorrect position");
			double num = MinMaxValues.Intersection(mappingForScrolling.AxisY.WholeRangeData, minMaxValues).CalculateCenter();
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (pointCalculator.UseArgumentOffset)
			{
				bool useFixedOffset2 = x != mappingForScrolling.MappingX.Min && x != mappingForScrolling.MappingX.Max;
				return GetScreenPoint(x, num, mappingForScrolling, useOffset: false, useFixedOffset2);
			}
			return GetScreenPoint(x, num, mappingForScrolling, useOffset: false);
		}

		public DiagramPoint GetScreenPoint(double argument, double value, XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, bool useOffset = true, bool useFixedOffset = true)
		{
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = GetInterimPoint(argument, value, diagramMapping, useOffset, useFixedOffset);
			return XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, diagramMapping.Container);
		}

		public RectangleF CalculateBarRect(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping)
		{
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(GetInterimPoint(leftArgument, actualValue, diagramMapping));
			DiagramPoint interimPoint2 = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(GetInterimPoint(rightArgument, zeroValue, diagramMapping));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, diagramMapping.Container);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint2, diagramMapping.Container);
			RectangleF b = MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2);
			b.Width = Math.Max(1f, b.Width);
			b.Height = Math.Max(1f, b.Height);
			RectangleF b2 = RectangleF.Intersect(diagramMapping.InflatedBounds, b);
			Rectangle mappingBounds = diagramMapping.MappingBounds;
			mappingBounds.Inflate(1, 1);
			return RectangleF.Intersect(mappingBounds, b2);
		}

		public RectangleF GetTotalRect(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = mappingContainer.CalculateMinMaxInterimX(this, clipBySideLimits: false, leftArgument, rightArgument);
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = mappingContainer.CalculateMinMaxInterimY(null, clipBySideLimits: false, zeroValue, actualValue);
			if (minMaxValues.IsEmpty || minMaxValues2.IsEmpty)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			DiagramPoint interimPoint = new DiagramPoint(minMaxValues.Min, minMaxValues2.Min);
			DiagramPoint interimPoint2 = new DiagramPoint(minMaxValues.Max, minMaxValues2.Max);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint, mappingContainer));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = LargeScaleHelper.Validate(XYDiagramMappingHelper.InterimPointToScreenPoint(interimPoint2, mappingContainer));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2);
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingBase GetMappingForExtremeLabelPosition(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer, double value)
		{
			AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = FindIntervalLayoutX(mappingContainer);
			if (axisIntervalLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Tuple<AxisIntervalLayout, AxisIntervalLayoutMapping> intervalLayoutY = mappingContainer.GetIntervalLayoutY(value);
			if (intervalLayoutY == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return mappingContainer.CreateDiagramMapping(axisIntervalLayout, intervalLayoutY.Item1);
		}

		public XYDiagramMappingBase GetMappingForTopLabelPosition(XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			return GetMappingForExtremeLabelPosition(mappingContainer, actualValue);
		}
	}

	public class CandleStickSeriesPointLayout : FinancialSeriesPointLayout
	{
		private RectangleF bodyRect;

		private RectangleF stockLowRect;

		private RectangleF stockHighRect;

		public RectangleF StockLowRect => stockLowRect;

		public RectangleF StockHighRect => stockHighRect;

		public RectangleF BodyRect => bodyRect;

		public RectangleF StockHighLowRect => new RectangleF(stockHighRect.X, stockHighRect.Y, stockHighRect.Width, stockLowRect.Bottom - stockHighRect.Top);

		public CandleStickSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, int lineThickness, Direction direction)
			: base(pointData, lineThickness, direction)
		{
		}

		private RectangleF CalcBodyRect(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X - NearCorrection - base.LevelLineLengthOpen, base.Open.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X + FarCorrection + base.LevelLineLengthClose, base.Close.Y));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2, 1f);
		}

		private RectangleF CalcStockLowRect(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(base.Open.Y, base.Close.Y);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X - NearCorrection, base.Low.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X + FarCorrection, num));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2, 1f);
		}

		private RectangleF CalcStockHighRect(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.Open.Y, base.Close.Y);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.High.X - NearCorrection, base.High.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.High.X + FarCorrection, num));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2, 1f);
		}

		private bool CalcIsFilled(CandleStickFillMode fillMode)
		{
			return fillMode switch
			{
				CandleStickFillMode.FilledOnReduction => base.Open.Y > base.Close.Y, 
				CandleStickFillMode.FilledOnIncrease => base.Open.Y <= base.Close.Y, 
				CandleStickFillMode.AlwaysEmpty => false, 
				CandleStickFillMode.AlwaysFilled => true, 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException("Unknown CandleStickFillMode: " + fillMode), 
			};
		}

		protected override void CalculateInternal(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			bodyRect = StockSeriesPointLayout.CorrectRect(CalcBodyRect(matrixTransform));
			stockLowRect = StockSeriesPointLayout.CorrectRect(CalcStockLowRect(matrixTransform));
			stockHighRect = StockSeriesPointLayout.CorrectRect(CalcStockHighRect(matrixTransform));
		}

		internal RectangleF[] SplitBodyRect(CandleStickFillMode fillMode)
		{
			if (!CalcIsFilled(fillMode) && !((float)(base.LineThickness * 2) >= bodyRect.Height) && !((float)(base.LineThickness * 2) >= bodyRect.Width))
			{
				float num = bodyRect.Location.Y + (float)base.LineThickness;
				RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(bodyRect.Location.X, bodyRect.Location.Y, bodyRect.Width, base.LineThickness);
				RectangleF rectangleF2 = new RectangleF(bodyRect.Location.X, num, base.LineThickness, bodyRect.Height - (float)(2 * base.LineThickness));
				RectangleF rectangleF3 = new RectangleF(bodyRect.Location.X, num + bodyRect.Height - (float)(2 * base.LineThickness), bodyRect.Width, base.LineThickness);
				RectangleF rectangleF4 = new RectangleF(bodyRect.Location.X + bodyRect.Width - (float)base.LineThickness, num, base.LineThickness, rectangleF2.Height);
				return new RectangleF[4] { rectangleF, rectangleF2, rectangleF3, rectangleF4 };
			}
			return new RectangleF[1] { bodyRect };
		}

		public override RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = bodyRect;
			if (!stockLowRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, stockLowRect);
			}
			if (!stockHighRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, stockHighRect);
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicUtils.InflateRect(bodyRect, 1f, 1f)));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicUtils.InflateRect(stockLowRect, 1f, 1f)));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicUtils.InflateRect(stockHighRect, 1f, 1f)));
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}
	public abstract class FinancialSeriesPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		private int lineThickness;

		private int levelLineLengthOpen;

		private int levelLineLengthClose;

		private Point low;

		private Point high;

		private Point open;

		private Point close;

		private Direction direction;

		protected int NearCorrection;

		protected int FarCorrection;

		public int LineThickness => lineThickness;

		public int LevelLineLengthOpen => levelLineLengthOpen;

		public int LevelLineLengthClose => levelLineLengthClose;

		public Point Low => low;

		public Point High => high;

		public Point Open => open;

		public Point Close => close;

		public Direction Direction => direction;

		public FinancialSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, int lineThickness, Direction direction)
			: base(pointData)
		{
			this.lineThickness = lineThickness;
			this.direction = direction;
			NearCorrection = ((lineThickness % 2 == 0) ? lineThickness : (lineThickness - 1)) / 2;
			FarCorrection = ((lineThickness % 2 == 0) ? (lineThickness / 2 - 1) : ((lineThickness - 1) / 2));
		}

		protected abstract void CalculateInternal(MatrixTransform matrixTransform);

		public abstract RectangleF GetBounds();

		public void Calculate(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double argument, double lowValue, double highValue, double openValue, double closeValue, double levelLineLength)
		{
			lowValue = diagramMapping.MappingY.GetCoordCoreRound(lowValue);
			highValue = diagramMapping.MappingY.GetCoordCoreRound(highValue);
			openValue = diagramMapping.MappingY.GetCoordCoreRound(openValue);
			closeValue = diagramMapping.MappingY.GetCoordCoreRound(closeValue);
			double coordCoreRound = diagramMapping.MappingX.GetCoordCoreRound(argument);
			levelLineLengthClose = (levelLineLengthOpen = (int)(levelLineLength + 0.5));
			int x = (int)(coordCoreRound + 0.5);
			low = new Point(x, (int)(lowValue + 0.5));
			high = new Point(x, (int)(highValue + 0.5));
			open = new Point(x, (int)(openValue + 0.5));
			close = new Point(x, (int)(closeValue + 0.5));
			CalculateInternal(diagramMapping.Transform);
		}

		public void CalculateForLegend(MatrixTransform matrixTransform, Point low, Point high, Point open, Point close, int levelLineLength)
		{
			this.low = low;
			this.high = high;
			this.open = open;
			this.close = close;
			levelLineLengthOpen = levelLineLength;
			levelLineLengthClose = levelLineLength;
			CalculateInternal(matrixTransform);
		}
	}
	public class GanttWholeSeriesLayout : WholeSeriesLayout
	{
		private Hashtable links = new Hashtable();

		public override bool ShowInFront
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesLayout.View is GanttSeriesView ganttSeriesView)
				{
					return ganttSeriesView.LinkOptions.InFront;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegionForTaskLinks(TaskLinkLayout[] linkLayouts)
		{
			if (linkLayouts.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = new HitRegionContainer();
			foreach (TaskLinkLayout taskLinkLayout in linkLayouts)
			{
				if (taskLinkLayout.LineRects != null)
				{
					foreach (ZPlaneRectangle lineRect in taskLinkLayout.LineRects)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle = GraphicUtils.InflateRect((Rectangle)lineRect, 1, 1);
						hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(rectangle));
					}
				}
				if (taskLinkLayout.ArrowPoints != null)
				{
					DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPolygon(StripsUtils.Convert(taskLinkLayout.ArrowPoints));
					hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath));
				}
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}

		public GanttWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout)
			: base(seriesLayout)
		{
		}

		public void Add(SeriesPointLayout parentLayout, TaskLinkLayout[] linkLayouts)
		{
			if (links.Contains(parentLayout))
			{
				throw new InternalException("TaskLink error");
			}
			links.Add(parentLayout, linkLayouts);
		}

		public IDictionaryEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return links.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion(DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion(drawOptions);
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				TaskLinkLayout[] linkLayouts = (TaskLinkLayout[])enumerator.Value;
				HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer2 = CalculateHitRegionForTaskLinks(linkLayouts);
				if (hitRegionContainer2 != null)
				{
					using (hitRegionContainer2)
					{
						hitRegionContainer.Union(hitRegionContainer2);
					}
				}
			}
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}

	public abstract class LineWholeSeriesLayoutBase : WholeSeriesLayout
	{
		private int lineThickness;

		private bool optimizeHitTesting;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		protected abstract bool IsStripsNullOrEmpty { get; }

		protected Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public int LineThickness => lineThickness;

		public LineWholeSeriesLayoutBase(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, int lineThickness, Rectangle bounds, bool optimizeHitTesting)
			: base(seriesLayout)
		{
			this.lineThickness = lineThickness;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.optimizeHitTesting = optimizeHitTesting;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreateHitTestingGraphicsPath()
		{
			if (IsStripsNullOrEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				FillHitTestingGraphicsPath(dXGraphicsPath);
				if (dXGraphicsPath.PointCount == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DXGraphicsPath result = dXGraphicsPath;
				dXGraphicsPath = null;
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				dXGraphicsPath?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private IHitRegion CalculateLineHitRegion()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateHitTestingGraphicsPath();
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return new HitRegion();
			}
			if (dXGraphicsPath.PointCount > 1)
			{
				LineStyle lineStyle = null;
				if (base.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions is SwiftPlotDrawOptions)
				{
					lineStyle = ((SwiftPlotDrawOptions)base.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions).LineStyle;
				}
				else if (base.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions is LineDrawOptions)
				{
					lineStyle = ((LineDrawOptions)base.SeriesLayout.DrawOptions).LineStyle;
				}
				using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, lineThickness);
				if (lineStyle != null)
				{
					dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)lineStyle.LineJoin;
				}
				dXGraphicsPath.Widen(dXPen);
			}
			if (optimizeHitTesting && !base.OptimizeByPointsCount)
			{
				return new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath);
			}
			return new HitRegion(bounds, dXGraphicsPath);
		}

		protected abstract void FillHitTestingGraphicsPath(DXGraphicsPath path);

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion(DrawOptions drawOptions)
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion(drawOptions);
			hitRegionContainer.Union(CalculateLineHitRegion());
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}
	public class LineWholeSeriesLayout : LineWholeSeriesLayoutBase
	{
		private List<IGeometryStrip> strips;

		protected override bool IsStripsNullOrEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (strips != null)
				{
					return strips.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public List<IGeometryStrip> Strips => strips;

		public LineWholeSeriesLayout(SeriesLayout seriesLayout, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, int lineThickness, Rectangle bounds, bool optimizeHitTesting)
			: base(seriesLayout, lineThickness, bounds, optimizeHitTesting)
		{
			this.strips = strips;
		}

		protected virtual void AddStrips(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			foreach (LineStrip strip in strips)
			{
				LineStrip lineStrip2 = strip.CreateUniqueStrip();
				if (lineStrip2.IsEmpty)
				{
					continue;
				}
				List<LineStrip> list = TruncatedLineCalculator.SplitLineStrip(lineStrip2, base.Bounds);
				foreach (LineStrip item in list)
				{
					using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
					FillPath(item, dXGraphicsPath);
					path.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath, connect: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void FillPath(LineStrip uniqueStrip, DXGraphicsPath stripPath)
		{
			stripPath.AddLines(StripsUtils.Convert(uniqueStrip, skipEqualPoints: true));
		}

		protected override void FillHitTestingGraphicsPath(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			AddStrips(path);
		}
	}
	internal enum DirectionOfContactPieWithBounds
	{
		Horizontal,
		Vertical
	}
	public class PointSeriesPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		private DiagramPoint point;

		private IPolygon polygon;

		public DiagramPoint Point => point;

		public IPolygon Polygon => polygon;

		public PointSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, DiagramPoint point, IPolygon polygon)
			: base(pointData)
		{
			this.point = point;
			this.polygon = polygon;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			IHitRegion hitRegion = GraphicUtils.MakeHitRegion(polygon);
			hitRegionContainer.Union(hitRegion);
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}
	public class RangeBarSeriesPointLayout : BarSeriesPointLayout

		}

	public class SeriesViewTransparencyContainer
	{
		private const byte maxTransparency = byte.MaxValue;

		private readonly SeriesViewBase seriesView;

		private readonly byte defaultOpacity;

		private byte opacity;

		public byte Transparency
		{
			get
			{
				return ConvertBetweenOpacityAndTransparency(Opacity);
			}
			set
			{
				Opacity = ConvertBetweenOpacityAndTransparency(value);
			}
		}

		public byte Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				seriesView.RaiseControlChanging();
				opacity = value;
				seriesView.RaiseControlChanged();
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefaultValue => Opacity == defaultOpacity;

		private static byte ConvertBetweenOpacityAndTransparency(byte value)
		{
			return (byte)(255 - value);
		}

		public SeriesViewTransparencyContainer(SeriesViewBase seriesView, byte defaultValue)
		{
			defaultOpacity = ConvertBetweenOpacityAndTransparency(defaultValue);
			this.seriesView = seriesView;
			opacity = defaultOpacity;
		}

		public Color GetTransparentColor(Color color)
		{
			byte b = Opacity;
			if (b == byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return color;
			}
			if (color.A == byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return Color.FromArgb(b, color);
			}
			return HitTestColors.MixAlphaChanel(color, b);
		}

		public void Assign(SeriesViewTransparencyContainer container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				opacity = container.opacity;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeTransparency()
		{
			return !IsDefaultValue;
		}

		public void ResetTransparency()
		{
			Opacity = defaultOpacity;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is SeriesViewTransparencyContainer)
			{
				return ((SeriesViewTransparencyContainer)obj).opacity == opacity;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<byte>(Opacity);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Transparency.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class StockSeriesPointLayout : FinancialSeriesPointLayout
	{
		private StockType stockType;

		private RectangleF stockRect;

		private RectangleF openRect;

		private RectangleF closeRect;

		public RectangleF StockRect => stockRect;

		public RectangleF OpenRect => openRect;

		public RectangleF CloseRect => closeRect;

		public StockSeriesPointLayout(RefinedPointData pointData, StockType stockType, int lineThickness, Direction direction)
			: base(pointData, lineThickness, direction)
		{
			this.stockType = stockType;
		}

		private RectangleF CalcStock(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X - NearCorrection, base.High.Y));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X + FarCorrection, base.Low.Y));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2, 1f);
		}

		private RectangleF CalcOpen(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			if (stockType == StockType.Close)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X - NearCorrection - base.LevelLineLengthOpen, base.Open.Y + NearCorrection));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X + FarCorrection, base.Open.Y - FarCorrection));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2, 1f);
		}

		private RectangleF CalcClose(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			if (stockType == StockType.Open)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X - NearCorrection, base.Close.Y + NearCorrection));
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = matrixTransform.Apply(new DiagramPoint(base.Low.X + FarCorrection + base.LevelLineLengthClose, base.Close.Y - FarCorrection));
			return MathUtils.MakeRectangle((PointF)diagramPoint, (PointF)diagramPoint2, 1f);
		}

		internal static RectangleF CorrectRect(RectangleF rect)
		{
			if (rect.Width < 4f)
			{
				return rect;
			}
			int num = 0;
			num = ((rect.Width >= 4f && rect.Width < 15f) ? 1 : ((!(rect.Width >= 15f)) ? 3 : 2));
			return new RectangleF(rect.X + (float)num, rect.Y, rect.Width - (float)(2 * num), rect.Height);
		}

		protected override void CalculateInternal(MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
		{
			stockRect = CorrectRect(CalcStock(matrixTransform));
			openRect = CorrectRect(CalcOpen(matrixTransform));
			closeRect = CorrectRect(CalcClose(matrixTransform));
		}

		public override RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = stockRect;
			if (!openRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, openRect);
			}
			if (!closeRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, closeRect);
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}

		public override HitRegionContainer CalculateHitRegion()
		{
			HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = base.CalculateHitRegion();
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicUtils.InflateRect(stockRect, 1f, 1f)));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicUtils.InflateRect(openRect, 1f, 1f)));
			hitRegionContainer.Union(new HitRegion(GraphicUtils.InflateRect(closeRect, 1f, 1f)));
			return hitRegionContainer;
		}
	}

	public class ChartElementSynchronizer
	{
		private ChartElement destination;

		private ChartElement source;

		private bool synchronize;

		public ChartElement Destination
		{
			get
			{
				return destination;
			}
			set
			{
				if (destination != value)
				{
					destination = value;
					Synchronize();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsSynchronized
		{
			get
			{
				return synchronize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (synchronize != value)
				{
					synchronize = value;
					if (synchronize)
					{
						Synchronize();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartElement Source
		{
			get
			{
				return source;
			}
			set
			{
				if (source != value)
				{
					source = value;
					Synchronize();
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartElementSynchronizer()
		{
			synchronize = true;
		}

		private void Synchronize()
		{
			if (synchronize && Source != null && Destination != null && !Source.Loading && !Destination.Loading)
			{
				Destination.Assign(source);
			}
		}

		public void ElementChanged(ChartElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && synchronize)
			{
				if (element == Destination)
				{
					synchronize = false;
				}
				if (element == Source)
				{
					Synchronize();
				}
			}
		}

		public void EndLoading()
		{
			Synchronize();
		}
	}
	public class WebLoadingHelper
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static bool globalLoadingStatic;

		private static WebLoadingHelper helper;

		private GetLoadingDelegate getLoadingCallback;

		private SetLoadingDelegate setLoadingCallback;

		private static WebLoadingHelper Helper
		{
			get
			{
				if (helper == null)
				{
					helper = new WebLoadingHelper();
				}
				return helper;
			}
		}

		public static bool GlobalLoading
		{
			get
			{
				return Helper.GetLoading();
			}
			set
			{
				Helper.SetLoading(value);
			}
		}

		public static bool GlobalLoadingStatic
		{
			get
			{
				return globalLoadingStatic;
			}
			set
			{
				globalLoadingStatic = value;
			}
		}

		private WebLoadingHelper()
		{
		}

		private bool GetLoading()
		{
			return ((getLoadingCallback != null) ? getLoadingCallback() : ((bool?)null)) ?? globalLoadingStatic;
		}

		private void SetLoading(bool loading)
		{
			if (setLoadingCallback != null)
			{
				setLoadingCallback(loading);
			}
		}

		public static void Initialize(GetLoadingDelegate getLoadingCallback, SetLoadingDelegate setLoadingCallback)
		{
			Helper.getLoadingCallback = getLoadingCallback;
			Helper.setLoadingCallback = setLoadingCallback;
		}
	}
	public enum SplitRectangleMode

	public static class GraphicUtils
	{
		private static void AddAnchorPoint(LineStrip anchorPoints, GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(point.X) && !double.IsNaN(point.Y))
			{
				anchorPoints.Add(point);
			}
		}

		private static byte CalcGradientColorComponent(byte comp1, byte comp2, double ratio)
		{
			byte b = (byte)Math.Round((double)Math.Abs(comp1 - comp2) * ratio);
			if (comp1 >= comp2)
			{
				return (byte)(comp1 - b);
			}
			return (byte)(comp1 + b);
		}

		private static bool IsGrayColor(Color c)
		{
			if (IsGrayComponent(c.R) && IsGrayComponent(c.G))
			{
				return IsGrayComponent(c.B);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsGrayComponent(int colorComponent)
		{
			if (colorComponent >= 110)
			{
				return colorComponent <= 150;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static RectangleF BoundsFromPointsArray(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, point.X);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.Y);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			return RectangleF.FromLTRB((float)num, (float)num2, (float)num3, (float)num4);
		}

		public static int CalcAlignedTextureSize(int size)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.Ceiling(Math.Log(size, 2.0));
			return (int)Math.Pow(2.0, num);
		}

		public static int CalcAlignedTextureSize(int size, int maxSize)
		{
			int num = CalcAlignedTextureSize(size);
			if (num <= maxSize)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return maxSize;
		}

		public static RectangleF CalcBoundRectangle(GRealPoint2D center, float semiAxis1, float semiAxis2)
		{
			return RectangleF.Inflate(new RectangleF((float)center.X, (float)center.Y, 0f, 0f), semiAxis1, semiAxis2);
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalcCenter(ZPlaneRectangle rect, bool roundToInteger)
		{
			GRealPoint2D result = new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left + rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Bottom + rect.Height / 2.0);
			if (!roundToInteger)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(Math.Floor(result.X), Math.Floor(result.Y));
		}

		public static PointF CalcCenter(RectangleF rect, bool roundToInteger)
		{
			PointF result = new PointF(rect.Left + rect.Width / 2f, rect.Bottom - rect.Height / 2f);
			if (!roundToInteger)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return new PointF((float)Math.Floor(result.X), (float)Math.Floor(result.Y));
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalcCirclePoint(GRealPoint2D center, double radius, double angle)
		{
			double num = radius * Math.Cos(angle);
			double num2 = radius * Math.Sin(angle);
			return new GRealPoint2D(center.X + num, center.Y + num2);
		}

		public static float CalcFontEmSize(RectangleF bounds, string text, string familyName, System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment)
		{
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			float num = 300f;
			DXFont font = new DXFont(familyName, num);
			SizeF sizeF = TextMeasurer.Default.MeasureString(text, font, alignment, lineAlignment);
			return (bounds.Height / bounds.Width > sizeF.Height / sizeF.Width) ? (num * bounds.Width / sizeF.Width) : (num * bounds.Height / sizeF.Height);
		}

		public static Color CalcGradientColor(Color color1, Color color2, double ratio)
		{
			if (ratio < 0.0)
			{
				ratio = 0.0;
			}
			if (ratio > 1.0)
			{
				ratio = 1.0;
			}
			byte red = CalcGradientColorComponent(color1.R, color2.R, ratio);
			byte green = CalcGradientColorComponent(color1.G, color2.G, ratio);
			byte blue = CalcGradientColorComponent(color1.B, color2.B, ratio);
			byte alpha = CalcGradientColorComponent(color1.A, color2.A, ratio);
			return Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
		}

		public static LineStrip CalcPolygon(double startAngle, int verticesCount, GRealPoint2D center, float radius)
		{
			double num = Math.PI * 2.0 / (double)verticesCount;
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(verticesCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < verticesCount; i++)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(CalcCirclePoint(center, radius, startAngle + num * (double)i));
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public static double CalcRadius(double diameter, bool roundToInteger)
		{
			double num = diameter / 2.0;
			if (roundToInteger)
			{
				num = Math.Floor(num);
			}
			if (num < 1.0)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static void CalculateStartFinishPoints(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiaxis, float minorSemiaxis, float startAngle, float sweepAngle, out GRealPoint2D startPoint, out GRealPoint2D finishPoint)
		{
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(center, majorSemiaxis, minorSemiaxis);
			startPoint = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(0.0 - MathUtils.Degree2Radian(startAngle));
			finishPoint = ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(0.0 - MathUtils.Degree2Radian(startAngle + sweepAngle));
		}

		public static Point Central2Screen(RectangleF bounds, PointF point)
		{
			return new Point((int)Math.Round(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2f + point.X), (int)Math.Round(bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2f - point.Y));
		}

		public static bool CheckIsSizePositive(Size size)
		{
			if (size.Width > 0)
			{
				return size.Height > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckIsSizePositive(SizeF size)
		{
			if (size.Width > 0f)
			{
				return size.Height > 0f;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static DXPoint ConvertPoint(Point point)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new DXPoint(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static DXRectangle ConvertRect(Rectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new DXRectangle(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public static DXRectangle ConvertRect(RectangleF rect)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ConvertRect(RoundRectangle(rect));
		}

		public static Color CorrectColorByHitTestState(Color color, HitTestState hitState)
		{
			if (hitState.Hot)
			{
				return HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(100, 255, 255, 255), color);
			}
			if (hitState.Select)
			{
				return HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(75, 0, 0, 0), color);
			}
			return color;
		}

		public static Color CorrectColorBySelectionState(Color color, SelectionState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case SelectionState.Selected:
				return HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(75, 0, 0, 0), color);
			case SelectionState.HotTracked:
			case SelectionState.DrillDownHotTracked:
				return HitTestColors.MixColors(Color.FromArgb(100, 255, 255, 255), color);
			default:
				return color;
			}
		}

		public static RectangleF CorrectRectangle(RectangleF rect, PointF positionCorrection, SizeF sizeCorrection)
		{
			return new RectangleF(rect.X + positionCorrection.X, rect.Y + positionCorrection.Y, rect.Width + sizeCorrection.Width, rect.Height + sizeCorrection.Height);
		}

		public static int CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(int thickness, HitTestState hitState)
		{
			return CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(thickness, hitState, 2);
		}

		public static int CorrectThicknessByHitTestState(int thickness, HitTestState hitState, int increment)
		{
			if (!hitState.Normal)
			{
				thickness += increment;
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		public static int CorrectThicknessBySelectionState(int thickness, SelectionState selectionState)
		{
			if (selectionState != SelectionState.Normal)
			{
				thickness += 2;
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath CreatePieGraphicsPath(GRealPoint2D center, float majorSemiaxis, float minorSemiaxis, float holePercent, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle((int)Math.Round(center.X), (int)Math.Round(center.Y), 0, 0);
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Inflate(rect, Convert.ToInt32(majorSemiaxis), Convert.ToInt32(minorSemiaxis));
				if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					return dXGraphicsPath;
				}
				bool flag = (double)sweepAngle != -360.0;
				float num = majorSemiaxis * holePercent;
				float num2 = minorSemiaxis * holePercent;
				if (num >= 1f && num2 >= 1f)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = Rectangle.Inflate(rect, Convert.ToInt32(num), Convert.ToInt32(num2));
					dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(rectangle, startAngle, sweepAngle);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(rectangle2, startAngle + sweepAngle, 0f - sweepAngle);
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPie(rectangle, startAngle, sweepAngle);
				}
				else
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddEllipse(rectangle);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath CreateExplodedPieGraphicsPath(EllipseArc2D outerArc, EllipseArc2D? innerArc, GRealPoint2D explodedCenter)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			try
			{
				Rectangle ellipseBounds = outerArc.EllipseBounds;
				if (!ellipseBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
				{
					return dXGraphicsPath;
				}
				bool flag = (double)outerArc.SweepAngleDegree != -360.0;
				if (innerArc.HasValue)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(ellipseBounds, outerArc.StartAngleDegree, outerArc.SweepAngleDegree);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(innerArc.Value.EllipseBounds, innerArc.Value.FinishAngleDegree, 0f - innerArc.Value.SweepAngleDegree);
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(new PointF[1] { explodedCenter.ToPointF() });
					dXGraphicsPath.AddArc(ellipseBounds, outerArc.StartAngleDegree, outerArc.SweepAngleDegree);
				}
				else
				{
					dXGraphicsPath.AddEllipse(ellipseBounds);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public static LineStrip FillAnchorPoints(IEllipse ellipse, double startAngle, double sweepAngle, bool addCenter)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip();
			AddAnchorPoint(lineStrip, ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(startAngle));
			AddAnchorPoint(lineStrip, ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(startAngle + sweepAngle));
			if (addCenter)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(ellipse.Center);
			}
			double num = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(startAngle);
			double num2 = num + sweepAngle;
			if (num2 < num)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				num = num2;
				num2 = num3;
			}
			double num4 = Math.PI * -4.0;
			double num5 = Math.PI * 4.0;
			int num6 = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				double num7 = num4 + (double)num6 * Math.PI / 2.0;
				if (num7 > num5)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (num7 > num && num7 < num2)
				{
					AddAnchorPoint(lineStrip, ellipse.CalcEllipsePoint(num7));
				}
				num6++;
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public static Color GetColor(Color color, HitTestState hitTestState)
		{
			Color actualColor = hitTestState.ActualColor;
			if (!(actualColor == Color.Empty))
			{
				return actualColor;
			}
			return color;
		}

		public static RectangleF InflateRect(RectangleF rect, float dx, float dy)
		{
			rect.Offset(0f - dx, 0f - dy);
			float num = rect.Width + dx * 2f;
			float num2 = rect.Height + dy * 2f;
			rect.Width = ((num > 0f) ? num : 0f);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 0f) ? num2 : 0f);
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rectangle InflateRect(Rectangle rect, int dx, int dy)
		{
			rect.Offset(-dx, -dy);
			int num = rect.Width + dx * 2;
			int num2 = rect.Height + dy * 2;
			rect.Width = ((num > 0) ? num : 0);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 0) ? num2 : 0);
			return rect;
		}

		public static IHitRegion MakeHitRegion(IPolygon polygon)
		{
			if (polygon == null)
			{
				return new HitRegion();
			}
			return new HitRegion(polygon.GetPath());
		}

		public static Rectangle MakeRectangle(Point corner1, Point corner2)
		{
			int x = ((corner1.X < corner2.X) ? corner1.X : corner2.X);
			int y = ((corner1.Y < corner2.Y) ? corner1.Y : corner2.Y);
			int width = Math.Abs(corner1.X - corner2.X) + 1;
			int height = Math.Abs(corner1.Y - corner2.Y) + 1;
			return new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static RectangleF MakeRectangle(PointF corner1, PointF corner2)
		{
			float x = ((corner1.X < corner2.X) ? corner1.X : corner2.X);
			float y = ((corner1.Y < corner2.Y) ? corner1.Y : corner2.Y);
			float width = Math.Abs(corner1.X - corner2.X);
			float height = Math.Abs(corner1.Y - corner2.Y);
			return new RectangleF(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static Rectangle RoundRectangle(RectangleF rect)
		{
			Point location = new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Left), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Top));
			Point point = new Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Right), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Bottom));
			return new Rectangle(size: new Size(point.X - location.X, point.Y - location.Y), location: location);
		}

		public static Rectangle[] SplitRectangle(Rectangle rect, SplitRectangleMode mode, bool weld)
		{
			int num = (weld ? 1 : 0);
			switch (mode)
			{
			case SplitRectangleMode.Vertical:
			{
				int num3 = rect.Height >> 1;
				return new Rectangle[2]
				{
					new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, num3),
					new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y + num3 - num, rect.Width, rect.Height - num3 + num)
				};
			}
			case SplitRectangleMode.Horizontal:
			{
				int num2 = rect.Width >> 1;
				return new Rectangle[2]
				{
					new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y, num2, rect.Height),
					new Rectangle(rect.X + num2 - num, rect.Y, rect.Width - num2 + num, rect.Height)
				};
			}
			default:
				return new Rectangle[2]
				{
					Rectangle.Empty,
					Rectangle.Empty
				};
			}
		}

		public static RectangleF[] SplitRectangle(RectangleF rect, SplitRectangleMode mode, bool weld)
		{
			int num = (weld ? 1 : 0);
			switch (mode)
			{
			case SplitRectangleMode.Vertical:
			{
				float num3 = (float)Math.Floor(rect.Height / 2f);
				return new RectangleF[2]
				{
					new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, num3),
					new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y + num3 - (float)num, rect.Width, rect.Height - num3 + (float)num)
				};
			}
			case SplitRectangleMode.Horizontal:
			{
				float num2 = (float)Math.Floor(rect.Width / 2f);
				return new RectangleF[2]
				{
					new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y, num2, rect.Height),
					new RectangleF(rect.X + num2 - (float)num, rect.Y, rect.Width - num2 + (float)num, rect.Height)
				};
			}
			default:
				return new RectangleF[2]
				{
					RectangleF.Empty,
					RectangleF.Empty
				};
			}
		}

		public static Rectangle UnionRectangle(Rectangle rect1, Rectangle rect2)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(rect1.X, rect2.X);
			int num2 = Math.Min(rect1.Y, rect2.Y);
			int num3 = Math.Max(rect1.X + rect1.Width, rect2.X + rect2.Width);
			int num4 = Math.Max(rect1.Y + rect1.Height, rect2.Y + rect2.Height);
			int width = ((num3 - num >= 0) ? (num3 - num) : int.MaxValue);
			int height = ((num4 - num2 >= 0) ? (num4 - num2) : int.MaxValue);
			return new Rectangle(num, num2, width, height);
		}

		public static RectangleF UnionRectangle(RectangleF rect1, RectangleF rect2)
		{
			float num = Math.Min(rect1.X, rect2.X);
			float num2 = Math.Min(rect1.Y, rect2.Y);
			float num3 = Math.Max(rect1.X + rect1.Width, rect2.X + rect2.Width);
			float num4 = Math.Max(rect1.Y + rect1.Height, rect2.Y + rect2.Height);
			float width = ((num3 - num >= 0f) ? (num3 - num) : float.MaxValue);
			float height = ((num4 - num2 >= 0f) ? (num4 - num2) : float.MaxValue);
			return new RectangleF(num, num2, width, height);
		}

		public static Color XorColor(Color color)
		{
			if (IsGrayColor(color))
			{
				return Color.White;
			}
			return Color.FromArgb(255, color.R ^ 0xFF, color.G ^ 0xFF, color.B ^ 0xFF);
		}
	}
	public class TextureInfo
	{
		private readonly byte[] pixels;

		private readonly IntPtr texture;

		private readonly int x;

		private readonly int y;

		private readonly int width;

		private readonly int height;

		private readonly int texWidth;

		private readonly int texHeight;

		public int Height => height;

		public int TexHeight => texHeight;

		public byte[] TextureArray => pixels;

		public IntPtr TexturePointer => texture;

		public int TexWidth => texWidth;

		public int Width => width;

		public int X => x;

		public int Y => y;

		public TextureInfo(IntPtr texture, byte[] pixels, int x, int y, int width, int height, int texWidth, int texHeight)
		{
			this.texture = texture;
			this.pixels = pixels;
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
			this.texWidth = texWidth;
			this.texHeight = texHeight;
		}

		private static int CalcTexSize(int texSize, int maxTexSize)
		{
			if (texSize <= maxTexSize || maxTexSize <= 0)
			{
				return texSize;
			}
			while (texSize > maxTexSize)
			{
				texSize /= 2;
			}
			return texSize;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static TextureInfo[] CalcTextureInfos(IDXBitmapData data, Size dataSize, int frameWidth, int frameHeight)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < dataSize.Height; i += frameHeight)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < dataSize.Width; j += frameWidth)
				{
					byte[] destination = new byte[frameWidth * frameHeight * 4];
					for (int k = 0; k < frameHeight; k++)
					{
						int num = i * dataSize.Width * 4 + j * 4 + k * dataSize.Width * 4;
						long num2 = ((IntPtr.Size == 4) ? data.DataPointer.ToInt32() : data.DataPointer.ToInt64());
						Marshal.Copy((IntPtr)(num2 + num), destination, k * frameWidth * 4, frameWidth * 4);
					}
					arrayList.Add(new TextureInfo(IntPtr.Zero, destination, j, i, frameWidth, frameHeight, dataSize.Width, dataSize.Height));
				}
			}
			return (TextureInfo[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(TextureInfo));
		}

		private static TextureInfo[] CalcTextureInfos(byte[] texPixels, int frameWidth, int frameHeight, int texWidth, int texHeight)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < texHeight; i += frameHeight)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < texWidth; j += frameWidth)
				{
					byte[] destinationArray = new byte[frameWidth * frameHeight * 4];
					for (int k = 0; k < frameHeight; k++)
					{
						int sourceIndex = i * texWidth * 4 + j * 4 + k * texWidth * 4;
						Array.Copy(texPixels, sourceIndex, destinationArray, k * frameWidth * 4, frameWidth * 4);
					}
					arrayList.Add(new TextureInfo(IntPtr.Zero, destinationArray, j, i, frameWidth, frameHeight, texWidth, texHeight));
				}
			}
			return (TextureInfo[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(TextureInfo));
		}

		public static TextureInfo[] CalcTextureInfos(IDXBitmapData data, Size dataSize, int maxTexSize)
		{
			int num = CalcTexSize(dataSize.Width, maxTexSize);
			int num2 = CalcTexSize(dataSize.Height, maxTexSize);
			if (num == dataSize.Width && num2 == dataSize.Height)
			{
				return new TextureInfo[1]
				{
					new TextureInfo(data.DataPointer, null, 0, 0, num, num2, dataSize.Width, dataSize.Height)
				};
			}
			return CalcTextureInfos(data, dataSize, num, num2);
		}

		public static TextureInfo[] CalcTextureInfos(DXImage image, int maxTexSize, Size bounds)
		{
			int size = ((image.Width > bounds.Width) ? bounds.Width : image.Width);
			int size2 = ((image.Height > bounds.Height) ? bounds.Height : image.Height);
			int num = GraphicUtils.CalcAlignedTextureSize(size);
			int num2 = GraphicUtils.CalcAlignedTextureSize(size2);
			byte[] array = new byte[num * num2 * 4];
			using (DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(image))
			{
				using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = dXBitmap.GetBitmapData();
				GLU.ScaleImage(32993, dXBitmap.Width, dXBitmap.Height, 5121, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, num, num2, 5121, array);
			}
			int frameWidth = CalcTexSize(num, maxTexSize);
			int frameHeight = CalcTexSize(num2, maxTexSize);
			return CalcTextureInfos(array, frameWidth, frameHeight, num, num2);
		}
	}
	public static class ThicknessUtils
	{
		public const int Correction = 1;

		public static int CorrectThicknessByHitState(int thickness, HitTestState hitState)
		{
			if (thickness < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("thickness must be >= 0");
			}
			if (hitState == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("hitState");
			}
			if (!hitState.Normal)
			{
				return thickness + 1;
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		public static void SplitToHalves(int thickness, out int firstHalf, out int secondHalf)
		{
			int num = ThicknessToOffset(thickness);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				firstHalf = ((num % 2 == 0) ? (num / 2) : MathUtils.Ceiling((double)num / 2.0));
				secondHalf = num - firstHalf;
			}
			else
			{
				firstHalf = 0;
				secondHalf = 0;
			}
		}

		public static void SplitToHalves(int thickness, HitTestState hitState, out int firstHalf, out int secondHalf)
		{
			int thickness2 = CorrectThicknessByHitState(thickness, hitState);
			SplitToHalves(thickness2, out firstHalf, out secondHalf);
		}

		public static int ThicknessToOffset(int thickness)
		{
			if (thickness == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("thickness must be > 0");
			}
			return thickness - 1;
		}

		public static int ThicknessToOffset(int thickness, HitTestState hitState)
		{
			int thickness2 = CorrectThicknessByHitState(thickness, hitState);
			return ThicknessToOffset(thickness2);
		}
	}
	public static class StringUtils
	{
		public static string StringArrayToString(string[] array)
		{
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(array[0]);
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
				stringBuilder.Append(array[i]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string[] StringToStringArray(string str)
		{
			if (str == null)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			return Regex.Split(str, Environment.NewLine);
		}
	}

		public static bool GetActualMarkerVisible(SeriesViewBase view, MarkerBase marker)
		{
			if (view is RangeAreaSeriesView rangeAreaSeriesView)
			{
				if (marker == rangeAreaSeriesView.Marker1)
				{
					return rangeAreaSeriesView.ActualMarker1Visible;
				}
				if (marker == rangeAreaSeriesView.Marker2)
				{
					return rangeAreaSeriesView.ActualMarker2Visible;
				}
			}
			if (view is RangeBarSeriesView rangeBarSeriesView)
			{
				if (marker == rangeBarSeriesView.MinValueMarker)
				{
					return rangeBarSeriesView.ActualMinValueMarkerVisible;
				}
				if (marker == rangeBarSeriesView.MaxValueMarker)
				{
					return rangeBarSeriesView.ActualMaxValueMarkerVisible;
				}
			}
			if (view is RadarRangeAreaSeriesView radarRangeAreaSeriesView)
			{
				if (marker == radarRangeAreaSeriesView.Marker1)
				{
					return radarRangeAreaSeriesView.ActualMarker1Visible;
				}
				if (marker == radarRangeAreaSeriesView.Marker2)
				{
					return radarRangeAreaSeriesView.ActualMarker2Visible;
				}
			}
			if (view is LineSeriesView lineSeriesView)
			{
				return lineSeriesView.ActualMarkerVisible;
			}
			if (view is RadarLineSeriesView radarLineSeriesView)
			{
				return radarLineSeriesView.ActualMarkerVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void Validate(Indicator indicator, XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.Owner is Series)
			{
				ValidateIndicator(indicator, view.Series);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(view.Owner is SeriesBase))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Series item in view.Chart.DataContainer.AutocreatedSeries)
				{
					ValidateIndicator(indicator, item);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public static Dictionary<object, string> GetIndicatorTypes()
		{
			Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(Chart));
			List<Type> list = (from t in assembly.GetTypes()
				where t.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Indicator)) && !t.IsAbstract
				select t).ToList();
			list.Sort(new TypeComparer());
			Dictionary<object, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, string>();
			foreach (Type item in list)
			{
				if (item == typeof(FibonacciIndicator))
				{
					dictionary.Add(FibonacciIndicatorKind.FibonacciArcs, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FibonacciArcs));
					dictionary.Add(FibonacciIndicatorKind.FibonacciFans, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FibonacciFans));
					dictionary.Add(FibonacciIndicatorKind.FibonacciRetracement, ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.FibonacciRetracement));
				}
				else
				{
					ChartStringId id = (ChartStringId)Enum.Parse(typeof(ChartStringId), "Ind" + item.Name);
					dictionary.Add(item, ChartLocalizer.GetString(id));
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static Indicator CreateIndicatorInstance(object type, ChartElementNamedCollection indicatorCollection)
		{
			Indicator indicator = null;
			if (type is Type)
			{
				indicator = (Indicator)Activator.CreateInstance(type as Type);
			}
			else if (type is FibonacciIndicatorKind)
			{
				indicator = new FibonacciIndicator((FibonacciIndicatorKind)type);
			}
			if (indicator != null)
			{
				indicator.Name = ((indicatorCollection != null) ? indicatorCollection.GenerateName(indicator.IndicatorName + " ") : indicator.IndicatorName);
			}
			return indicator;
		}
	}
	internal class TypeComparer : IComparer<Type>
	{
		public int Compare(Type x, Type y)
		{
			return string.Compare(x.Name, y.Name);
		}
	}

	public class Locker
	{
		private int lockCount;

		public bool IsLocked => lockCount > 0;

		public void Lock()
		{
			lockCount++;
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			if (IsLocked)
			{
				lockCount--;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class XYDiagramMappingHelper
	{
		private static double CorrectAngleNotRotated(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double angle)
		{
			double num = angle;
			if (diagramMapping.XReverse)
			{
				num = Math.PI - num;
			}
			if (diagramMapping.YReverse)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double CorrectAngleRotated(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double angle)
		{
			double num = Math.PI / 2.0 - angle;
			if (diagramMapping.XReverse)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			if (diagramMapping.YReverse)
			{
				num = Math.PI - num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static DiagramPoint ApplyYOffsetToPoint(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, DiagramPoint point, int offset)
		{
			DiagramPoint result = point;
			if (diagramMapping.Rotated)
			{
				result.X += (diagramMapping.YReverse ? (-offset) : offset);
			}
			else
			{
				result.Y += (diagramMapping.YReverse ? offset : (-offset));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static double CorrectAngle(XYDiagramMappingBase diagramMapping, double angle)
		{
			if (diagramMapping.Rotated)
			{
				return CorrectAngleRotated(diagramMapping, angle);
			}
			return CorrectAngleNotRotated(diagramMapping, angle);
		}

		public static MappingTransform CreateTransform(Rectangle mappingBounds, bool rotated, bool xReverse, bool yReverse)
		{
			bool horizontalReverse = (rotated ? yReverse : xReverse);
			bool verticalReverse = (rotated ? xReverse : yReverse);
			return new MappingTransform(mappingBounds, rotated, horizontalReverse, verticalReverse);
		}

		public static DiagramPoint InterimPointToScreenPoint(DiagramPoint interimPoint, XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer)
		{
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = mappingContainer.Transform.Map(interimPoint);
			return MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint, mappingContainer.MappingBounds);
		}

		public static bool PointInMappingBounds(Rectangle mappingBounds, DXPoint point)
		{
			if (((DXPoint)(ref point)).X >= mappingBounds.Left && ((DXPoint)(ref point)).X <= mappingBounds.Right && ((DXPoint)(ref point)).Y >= mappingBounds.Top)
			{
				return ((DXPoint)(ref point)).Y <= mappingBounds.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static class SerializingUtils
	{
		private const char separator = ';';

		public const string SerializableDateTimeFormat = "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff";

		public const string SerializableTimeSpanFormat = "c";

		public static object ConvertFromSerializable(string value)
		{
			try
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(value, NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
			}
			catch
			{
				try
				{
					return Convert.ToDateTime(value, DateTimeFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				}
				catch
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static string ConvertToSerializable(object value)
		{
			if (value is double num)
			{
				return num.ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
			}
			if (value is DateTime dateTime)
			{
				return dateTime.ToString("MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff", DateTimeFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
			}
			if (value is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				return timeSpan.ToString("c", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				return (string)value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static string StringArrayToString(string[] values)
		{
			if (values.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Join(new string(';', 1), values);
		}

		public static string[] StringToStringArray(string value, string emptyValueString = null)
		{
			if (value.Trim() == string.Empty)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(emptyValueString))
				{
					return new string[0];
				}
				return new string[1] { emptyValueString };
			}
			string[] array = value.Split(';');
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = array[i].Trim();
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

	public static class DefaultBooleanUtils
	{
		public static bool ToBoolean(DefaultBoolean value, bool defaultValue)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)value != 2)
			{
				if ((int)value != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static DefaultBoolean ToDefaultBoolean(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				return (DefaultBoolean)0;
			}
			return (DefaultBoolean)1;
		}
	}

		{
			DateTimeFormatParts dateTimeFormatParts = DateTimeUtilsExt.SelectFormat((DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)measureUnit);
			format = (DateTimeFormat)dateTimeFormatParts.Format;
			formatString = dateTimeFormatParts.FormatString;
		}

	public static class ToolTipUtils
	{
		public static double GetPointPercentValue(RefinedPoint point, Series series)
		{
			if (series.View is PieSeriesViewBase)
			{
				return ((IPiePoint)point).NormalizedValue;
			}
			if (series.View is FunnelSeriesViewBase)
			{
				return ((IFunnelPoint)point).NormalizedValue;
			}
			double minValue = ((IStackedPoint)point).MinValue;
			double maxValue = ((IStackedPoint)point).MaxValue;
			if (double.IsNaN(minValue) || double.IsNaN(maxValue))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return maxValue - minValue;
		}
	}
