	public static class PatternEditorUtils
	{
		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceForTotalLabel(TotalLabel label)
		{
			Chart chart = label.ChartContainer.Chart;
			if (chart.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromSeries(chart.Series[0]);
			}
			Series series = chart.DataContainer.CreateSeries(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SeriesPrefix));
			return CreateValuesSourceFromSeries(series);
		}

		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceFromAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return new PatternEditorValuesSource(axis.VisualRange);
		}

		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceFromCrosshairOptions(CrosshairOptions options)
		{
			Chart chart = options.ChartContainer.Chart;
			if (chart.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				return new PatternEditorValuesSource(GetPointArgument(chart.Series[0]), GetPointValue(chart.Series[0]));
			}
			Series series = chart.DataContainer.CreateSeries(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SeriesPrefix));
			return new PatternEditorValuesSource(GetPointArgument(series), GetPointValue(series));
		}

		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceFromRangeColorizer()
		{
			return new PatternEditorValuesSource(0, 100);
		}

		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceFromRangeKeyColorColorizer()
		{
			return new PatternEditorValuesSource("key");
		}

		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceFromSeries(SeriesBase series)
		{
			Series seriesForClone = series.GetSeriesForClone();
			object seriesGroup = ((seriesForClone.View is ISideBySideStackedBarSeriesView sideBySideStackedBarSeriesView) ? sideBySideStackedBarSeriesView.StackedGroup : ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.StackedGroupPrefix));
			return new PatternEditorValuesSource(GetPointArgument(seriesForClone), GetPointValue(seriesForClone), seriesForClone.Name, seriesGroup);
		}

		private static IPatternValuesSource CreateValuesSourceFromSeriesLabel(SeriesLabelBase label)
		{
			return CreateValuesSourceFromSeries(label.SeriesBase);
		}

		private static object GetPointArgument(Series series)
		{
			object obj = null;
			switch (series.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				return 12.3456789;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				return DateTime.Now;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				return new TimeSpan(1, 2, 3, 456);
			case ScaleType.Qualitative:
				if (series.ActualSeriesPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					DataAdapterHelper dataAdapterHelper = new DataAdapterHelper(series);
					return dataAdapterHelper.CreateSeriesPoint(series.ActualPoints[0]).Argument;
				}
				return "A";
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static object GetPointValue(Series series)
		{
			object obj = null;
			return series.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.Numerical => 12.3456789, 
				ScaleType.DateTime => DateTime.Now, 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => new TimeSpan(1, 2, 3, 456), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static void AddHintPatternIfNecessary(ref string[] basePatterns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < basePatterns.Length; i++)
			{
				if (basePatterns[i].Equals("HINT"))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			Array.Resize(ref basePatterns, basePatterns.Length + 1);
			basePatterns[basePatterns.Length - 1] = "HINT";
		}

		public static IPatternValuesSource CreatePatternValuesSource(object instance)
		{
			if (instance is SeriesBase)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromSeries((SeriesBase)instance);
			}
			if (instance is CrosshairOptions)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromCrosshairOptions((CrosshairOptions)instance);
			}
			if (instance is CrosshairAxisLabelOptions)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromAxis(((CrosshairAxisLabelOptions)instance).Axis);
			}
			if (instance is SeriesLabelBase)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromSeriesLabel((SeriesLabelBase)instance);
			}
			if (instance is AxisLabel)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromAxis(((AxisLabel)instance).Axis);
			}
			if (instance is IAxisData)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromAxis((IAxisData)instance);
			}
			if (instance is RangeColorizer || instance is RangeSegmentColorizer || instance is HeatmapRangeColorProvider)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromRangeColorizer();
			}
			if (instance is KeyColorColorizer || instance is HeatmapKeyColorProvider)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromRangeKeyColorColorizer();
			}
			if (instance is TotalLabel)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceForTotalLabel((TotalLabel)instance);
			}
			if (instance is IntervalOptionsBase)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromAxis(((IntervalOptionsBase)instance).Axis);
			}
			if (instance is Indicator)
			{
				return CreateValuesSourceFromSeries(((Indicator)instance).OwningSeries);
			}
			return null;
		}

				return ((AxisLabel)element).ActualTextPattern;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static string GetDescriptionForPatternPlaceholder(string pattern)

				"S" => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.SeriesNamePatternDescription),

				"V1" => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.Value1PatternDescription), 
				"V2" => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.Value2PatternDescription),

	public static class SafeBitmapCreator
	{
		public static DXBitmap CreateBitmap(Size size, float? dpi)
		{
			try
			{
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(size.Width, size.Height);
				if (dpi.HasValue)
				{
					dXBitmap.SetResolution(dpi.Value, dpi.Value);
				}
				return dXBitmap;
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new Exception($"Could not create a bitmap image with the size: {size}.", innerException);
			}
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateBitmap(Size size)
		{
			return CreateBitmap(size, null);
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int width, int height)
		{
			return CreateBitmap(new Size(width, height));
		}
	}

	public static class RtlHelper
	{
		private static System.Drawing.StringAlignment GetOppositeAlignment(System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near => System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far, 
				System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far => System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near, 
				_ => alignment, 
			};
		}

		private static System.Drawing.StringAlignment GetAlignment(System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, bool isRightToLeft)
		{
			if (!isRightToLeft)
			{
				return alignment;
			}
			return GetOppositeAlignment(alignment);
		}

		public static System.Drawing.StringAlignment GetAlignment(System.Drawing.StringAlignment alignment, Chart chart)
		{
			return GetAlignment(alignment, chart.Container.GetActualRightToLeft());
		}
	}
	public sealed class XmlUtils
	{
		private const string emptyColorName = "Empty";

		private const string xmlFontName = "Name";

		private const string xmlFontSize = "Size";

		private const string xmlFontBold = "Bold";

		private const string xmlFontItalic = "Italic";

		private const string xmlFontUnderline = "Underline";

		private const string xmlFontStrikeout = "Strikeout";

		private static Regex regex = new Regex("^(\\d+),\\s*(\\d+),\\s*(\\d+),\\s*(\\d+)$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

		public static string Color2String(Color color)
		{
			if (color.IsEmpty)
			{
				return "Empty";
			}
			if (color.IsKnownColor)
			{
				return color.Name;
			}
			return color.A + ", " + color.R + ", " + color.G + ", " + color.B;
		}

		public static Color String2Color(string colorString)
		{
			if (colorString == "Empty")
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			Match match = regex.Match(colorString);
			if (match.Success)
			{
				int alpha = int.Parse(match.Groups[1].Value);
				int red = int.Parse(match.Groups[2].Value);
				int green = int.Parse(match.Groups[3].Value);
				int blue = int.Parse(match.Groups[4].Value);
				return Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
			}
			return Color.FromName(colorString);
		}

		public static string Enum2String(Enum enumValue)
		{
			return Enum.GetName(enumValue.GetType(), enumValue);
		}

		public static object String2Enum(string enumString, Type enumType)
		{
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(enumType);
			foreach (object item in values)
			{
				string name = Enum.GetName(enumType, item);
				if (name == enumString)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException();
		}

		public static void WriteColor(XmlWriter xmlWriter, Color color, string key)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString(key, Color2String(color));
		}

		public static Color ReadColor(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			string colorString = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			return String2Color(colorString);
		}

		public static void WriteEnum(XmlWriter xmlWriter, Enum enumValue, string key)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString(key, Enum2String(enumValue));
		}

		public static object ReadEnum(XmlReader xmlReader, string key, Type enumType)
		{
			string enumString = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			return String2Enum(enumString, enumType);
		}

		public static void WriteInteger(XmlWriter xmlWriter, int value, string key)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString(key, value.ToString());
		}

		public static int ReadInteger(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			string value = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			return Convert.ToInt32(value);
		}

		public static float ReadFloat(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			string value = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			return Convert.ToSingle(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public static void WriteBoolean(XmlWriter xmlWriter, bool value, string key)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString(key, value.ToString());
		}

		public static bool ReadBoolean(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			string value = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			return Convert.ToBoolean(value);
		}

		public static void WriteFont(XmlWriter xmlWriter, Font font, string key)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteStartElement(key);
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Name", font.Name);
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Size", font.Size.ToString());
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Bold", font.Bold.ToString());
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Italic", font.Italic.ToString());
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Underline", font.Underline.ToString());
			xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Strikeout", font.Strikeout.ToString());
			xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static DXFont ReadFont(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement(key);
			string name = xmlReader.ReadElementString("Name");
			float size = ReadFloat(xmlReader, "Size");
			bool flag = ReadBoolean(xmlReader, "Bold");
			bool flag2 = ReadBoolean(xmlReader, "Italic");
			bool flag3 = ReadBoolean(xmlReader, "Underline");
			bool flag4 = ReadBoolean(xmlReader, "Strikeout");
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			if (flag)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Underline;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			return new DXFont(name, size, dXFontStyle);
		}

		public static void ReadFillStyle(XmlReader xmlReader, FillStyleBase fillStyle, string key)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement(key);
			fillStyle.ReadFromXml(xmlReader);
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		public static void ReadRectangleIndents(XmlReader xmlReader, RectangleIndents indents, string key)
		{
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement(key);
			int left = ReadInteger(xmlReader, "Left");
			int top = ReadInteger(xmlReader, "Top");
			int right = ReadInteger(xmlReader, "Right");
			int bottom = ReadInteger(xmlReader, "Bottom");
			indents.SetIndents(left, top, right, bottom);
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		public static Size ReadSize(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			string text = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			string[] array = text.Split(',');
			return new Size(int.Parse(array[0]), int.Parse(array[1]));
		}

		public static SvgBitmap ReadSvg(XmlReader xmlReader, string prefix, string key)
		{
			string text = xmlReader.ReadElementString(key);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return LoadSvg(prefix + text);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static SvgBitmap LoadSvg(string resName)
		{
			try
			{
				using Stream stream = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(XmlUtils)).GetManifestResourceStream(resName);
				return SvgBitmap.FromStream(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static ChartSvgPalette ReadChartSvgPalette(XmlReader xmlReader, string key)
		{
			ChartSvgPalette chartSvgPalette = new ChartSvgPalette();
			xmlReader.ReadStartElement(key);
			chartSvgPalette.Opacity = ReadFloat(xmlReader, "Opacity");
			while (xmlReader.Read() && xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
			{
				string name = xmlReader.Name;
				string colorString = xmlReader.ReadElementString();
				chartSvgPalette.AddColor(name, String2Color(colorString));
			}
			xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
			return chartSvgPalette;
		}

		private XmlUtils()
		{
		}
	}
	public class RectangleCorrection
	{
		private Rectangle bounds;

		private int left;

		private int right;

		private int top;

		private int bottom;

		public int Left => left;

		public int Right => right;

		public int Top => top;

		public int Bottom => bottom;

		public bool ShouldCorrect
		{
			get
			{
				if (left <= 0 && right <= 0 && top <= 0)
				{
					return bottom > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			set
			{
				bounds = value;
			}
		}

		public static RectangleCorrection Combine(RectangleCorrection originalCorrection, RectangleCorrection newCorrection)
		{
			if (originalCorrection == null)
			{
				return newCorrection;
			}
			originalCorrection.Add(newCorrection);
			return originalCorrection;
		}

		public RectangleCorrection(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		public Rectangle Correct(Rectangle rect)
		{
			rect.X += left;
			rect.Width -= left + right;
			rect.Y += top;
			rect.Height -= top + bottom;
			return rect;
		}

		public void Add(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			left += correction.left;
			right += correction.right;
			top += correction.top;
			bottom += correction.bottom;
		}

		public void AddBottomCorrection(int additionalBottomCorrection)
		{
			bottom += additionalBottomCorrection;
		}

		public void AddLeftCorrection(int additionalLeftCorrection)
		{
			left += additionalLeftCorrection;
		}

		public void Update(Rectangle b)
		{
			UpdateWidth(b);
			UpdateHeight(b);
		}

		public void UpdateWithoutBottom(Rectangle b)
		{
			UpdateWidth(b);
		}

		public void UpdateWidth(Rectangle b)
		{
			if (b.Width > 0)
			{
				int num = bounds.Left - b.Left;
				if (num > left)
				{
					left = num;
				}
				num = b.Right - bounds.Right;
				if (num > right)
				{
					right = num;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateHeight(Rectangle b)
		{
			if (b.Height > 0)
			{
				int num = bounds.Top - b.Top;
				if (num > top)
				{
					top = num;
				}
				num = b.Bottom - bounds.Bottom;
				if (num > bottom)
				{
					bottom = num;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Update(IEnumerable<Rectangle> list)
		{
			foreach (Rectangle item in list)
			{
				Update(item);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Left={Left},Right={Right},Top={Top},Bottom={Bottom}";
		}
	}
	public static class PaneSizeInPixelsToWeightConverter
	{
		public static double CalculateWeight(XYDiagramPaneBase currentPane, IList<IPane> panes)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			int num3 = 0;
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in panes)
			{
				LayoutDefinition linearLayoutOptions = pane.LinearLayoutOptions;
				if (!linearLayoutOptions.Fixed && pane != currentPane)
				{
					num += linearLayoutOptions.Weight;
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, linearLayoutOptions.Weight);
					num3 += linearLayoutOptions.SizeInPixels;
				}
			}
			LayoutDefinition linearLayoutOptions2 = currentPane.LinearLayoutOptions;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return linearLayoutOptions2.Weight;
			}
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				if (linearLayoutOptions2.SizeInPixels == 0)
				{
					return linearLayoutOptions2.Weight;
				}
				return num * (double)linearLayoutOptions2.SizeInPixels / (double)num3;
			}
			ChartDebug.Assert(num2 != double.MaxValue);
			return num2;
		}
	}

		public override XYDiagramMappingList DiagramMappingList => diagramMappingList;

		public override XYDiagramPaneAreas PaneAreas => paneAreas;

		public XYDiagramPaneViewData(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, List<SeriesContainerLayout> seriesContainerLayouts, List<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists, List<XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList> edgeLabels, XYDiagramMappingList diagramMappingList, ScrollBarViewData xAxisScrollBarViewData, ScrollBarViewData yAxisScrollBarViewData, List<AxisViewData> axisViewDataList, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsShapesLayout, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData, List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList, Rectangle maxBounds, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData titleViewData, DataTableViewData dataTableViewData)
			: base(pane, diagramMappingList.MappingBounds, labelLayoutLists)
		{
			this.seriesContainerLayouts = seriesContainerLayouts;
			this.diagramMappingList = diagramMappingList;
			this.xAxisScrollBarViewData = xAxisScrollBarViewData;
			this.yAxisScrollBarViewData = yAxisScrollBarViewData;
			this.axisViewDataList = axisViewDataList;
			this.annotationsAnchorPointsLayout = annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;
			this.annotationsShapesLayout = annotationsShapesLayout;
			this.annotationsViewData = annotationsViewData;
			this.legendViewDataList = legendViewDataList;
			this.maxBounds = maxBounds;
			this.titleViewData = titleViewData;
			this.dataTableViewData = dataTableViewData;
			EdgeLabels = edgeLabels;
			indicatorsLayout = new IndicatorLayoutList(diagramMappingList);
			paneAreas = new XYDiagramPaneAreas(axisViewDataList, seriesContainerLayouts, base.Diagram.Chart.HitTestingEnabled);
			base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping = CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(labelLayoutLists);
		}

		private void RenderAnnotations(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (annotationsViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
			{
				annotationsViewDatum.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderBackConstantLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderBackConstantLines(renderer, paneAreas.HitRegion);
			}
		}

		private void RenderBackConstantLinesTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderBackConstantLinesTitles(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderFrontConstantLines(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderFrontConstantLines(renderer, paneAreas.HitRegion);
			}
		}

		private void RenderFrontConstantLinesTitles(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderFrontConstantLinesTitles(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderStrips(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderStrips(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderInterlacedGraphics(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderInterlacedGraphics(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderGridLines(ChartRenderer renderer, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.RenderGridLines(renderer, appearance);
			}
		}

		private void RenderAxes(ChartRenderer renderer, bool showBehind)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				if (axisViewData.Axis.ShowBehind == showBehind)
				{
					axisViewData.Render(renderer);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderAxesMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer, bool showBehind)
		{
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				if (axisViewData.Axis.ShowBehind == showBehind)
				{
					axisViewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderTitle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (titleViewData != null)
			{
				titleViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
		}

		private void RenderSeries(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RenderShadows(renderer);
			List<SeriesContainerLayout> list = new List<SeriesContainerLayout>();
			foreach (SeriesContainerLayout seriesContainerLayout in seriesContainerLayouts)
			{
				if (seriesContainerLayout.ShowInFront)
				{
					list.Add(seriesContainerLayout);
				}
				else
				{
					seriesContainerLayout.RenderSeries(renderer, paneAreas);
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesContainerLayout item in list)
			{
				item.RenderSeries(renderer, paneAreas);
			}
		}

		private void RenderShadows(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			ChartContainerAdapter containerAdapter = base.Pane.ContainerAdapter;
			bool flag = containerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawSeries || containerAdapter.ShouldCustomDrawSeriesPoints;
			foreach (SeriesContainerLayout seriesContainerLayout in seriesContainerLayouts)
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramSeriesLayout item in seriesContainerLayout)
				{
					if (item.View is IShadowSupportView shadowSupportView && (shadowSupportView.Shadow.Visible || flag))
					{
						DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = paneAreas.SeriesClipRegions[seriesContainerLayout.Mapping];
						if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
						{
							renderer.SetClipping(dXGraphicsPath);
						}
						item.RenderShadow(renderer);
						if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
						{
							renderer.RestoreClipping();
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderSeriesAbove(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (SeriesContainerLayout seriesContainerLayout in seriesContainerLayouts)
			{
				seriesContainerLayout.RenderSeriesAbove(renderer, paneAreas);
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateMappingBounds()
		{
			Rectangle result = base.Bounds;
			result.Width++;
			result.Height++;
			return result;
		}

		private void RenderConstantLinesTitles(ChartRenderer renderer, Rectangle mappingBounds)
		{
			renderer.SetClipping(mappingBounds);
			RenderBackConstantLinesTitles(renderer);
			RenderFrontConstantLinesTitles(renderer);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
		}

		private void CalculateIndicatorsLayout()
		{
			List<Indicator> indicatorsByPane = base.Diagram.GetIndicatorsByPane(base.Pane);
			if (indicatorsByPane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Indicator item in indicatorsByPane)
			{
				if (item.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
				{
					indicatorsLayout.Initialize(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessIndicatorHitRegion(IndicatorLayout layout, HitTestController hitTestController, HitRegionContainer seriesHitRegion)
		{
			if (layout.Indicator.OwningSeries.View is SwiftPlotSeriesViewBase || !hitTestController.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = layout.CalculateHitTestGraphicsPath();
			IHitRegion hitRegion;
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				hitRegion = new HitRegion();
			}
			else
			{
				hitRegion = new HitRegion(dXGraphicsPath);
				if (seriesHitRegion != null)
				{
					HitRegionContainer hitRegionContainer = new HitRegionContainer(hitRegion);
					hitRegionContainer.Intersect(seriesHitRegion);
					hitRegion = hitRegionContainer.Underlying;
				}
			}
			HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(hitTestController, layout.Indicator, null, hitRegion);
		}

		private bool CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlappingEdgeLabels()
		{
			if (EdgeLabels != null)
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList edgeLabel in EdgeLabels)
				{
					if (IsResolveOverlappingEnabled(edgeLabel.Label))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists)
		{
			if (!base.CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlapping(labelLayoutLists))
			{
				return CalcIsLabelsResolveOverlappingEdgeLabels();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override IList<LabelLayoutListBase> GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping()
		{
			IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelsForResolveOverlapping = base.GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping();
			foreach (XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList edgeLabel in EdgeLabels)
			{
				labelsForResolveOverlapping.Add(edgeLabel);
			}
			return labelsForResolveOverlapping;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !Disposed)
			{
				Disposed = true;
				paneAreas?.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				Disposed = true;
			}
		}

		public void RenderIndicator(IndicatorLayout layout, ChartRenderer renderer, HitTestController hitTestController, HitRegionContainer seriesHitRegion)
		{
			ProcessIndicatorHitRegion(layout, hitTestController, seriesHitRegion);
			double num = 1.0;
			Chart chart = base.Pane.Diagram.Chart;
			Rectangle mappingBounds = base.Pane.MappingList.MappingBounds;
			IndicatorAnimationBase animation = layout.Indicator.Animation;
			if (chart.AnimationInProgress && animation != null && animation.CanAnimate)
			{
				num = animation.CalculateAnimationProgress(chart.AnimationTimeMs);
				if (num > 0.0 && num < 1.0)
				{
					animation.Apply(renderer, mappingBounds, num);
				}
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				layout.Render(renderer);
			}
			if (chart.AnimationInProgress && animation != null && animation.CanAnimate && num > 0.0 && num < 1.0)
			{
				animation.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		public override void CalculateSeriesAndLabelLayout(ChartDrawingHelper drawingHelper, bool allowOptimization)
		{
			foreach (SeriesContainerLayout seriesContainerLayout in seriesContainerLayouts)
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramSeriesLayout item in seriesContainerLayout)
				{
					item.Calculate(allowOptimization);
				}
			}
			CalculateIndicatorsLayout();
			paneAreas.UpdateClipRegions(IndicatorsLayout);
			IList<LabelLayoutListBase> labelsForResolveOverlapping = GetLabelsForResolveOverlapping();
			if (base.IsLabelsResolveOverlapping)
			{
				if (base.Pane.ResolveOverlappingCache != null)
				{
					base.Pane.ResolveOverlappingCache.Apply(labelsForResolveOverlapping);
				}
				else
				{
					ZPlaneRectangle zPlaneRectangle = (ZPlaneRectangle)((!EnableScrolling && !EnableZooming) ? maxBounds : ((EdgeLabels.Count > 0) ? maxBounds : diagramMappingList.MaximumMappingBounds));
					XYDiagramResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(labelsForResolveOverlapping, zPlaneRectangle, base.Diagram.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
					base.Pane.ResolveOverlappingCache = new ResolveOverlappingCache(labelsForResolveOverlapping);
				}
			}
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase item2 in labelsForResolveOverlapping)
			{
				if (item2 is XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList)
				{
					xYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList.CalculateLabelsVisibility();
				}
				else if (item2 is StackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList stackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList)
				{
					stackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList.CalculateLabelsVisibility();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			Rectangle mappingBounds = CalculateMappingBounds();
			base.Pane.RenderBeforeContent(renderer, mappingBounds, maxBounds, paneAreas.ClipRegion);
			RenderTitle(renderer);
			renderer.SetClipping(paneAreas.ClipRegion);
			RenderInterlacedGraphics(renderer);
			RenderStrips(renderer);
			RenderGridLines(renderer, CommonUtils.GetActualAppearance(base.Diagram).XYDiagramAppearance);
			RenderBackConstantLines(renderer);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			RenderAxes(renderer, showBehind: true);
			RenderAxesMiddle(renderer, showBehind: true);
			RenderSeries(renderer);
			RenderAxes(renderer, showBehind: false);
			RenderConstantLinesTitles(renderer, mappingBounds);
			dataTableViewData?.Render(renderer);
		}

		public override void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			foreach (IndicatorLayout item in indicatorsLayout)
			{
				DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = paneAreas.SeriesClipRegions[item.DiagramMapping];
				if (dXGraphicsPath != null)
				{
					renderer.SetClipping(dXGraphicsPath);
					RenderIndicator(item, renderer, base.Diagram.Chart.HitTestController, paneAreas.GetSeriesHitRegion(item.DiagramMapping));
					renderer.RestoreClipping();
				}
			}
			renderer.SetClipping(paneAreas.ClipRegion);
			RenderFrontConstantLines(renderer);
			renderer.RestoreClipping();
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea in paneAreas)
			{
				base.Pane.RenderBorder(renderer, paneArea);
			}
			RenderAxesMiddle(renderer, showBehind: false);
			if (XAxisScrollBarViewData != null)
			{
				XAxisScrollBarViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
			if (YAxisScrollBarViewData != null)
			{
				YAxisScrollBarViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea2 in paneAreas)
			{
				base.Pane.RenderHitBorder(renderer, paneArea2);
			}
			bool enableScrolling = EnableScrolling;
			Rectangle rectangle = CalculateMappingBounds();
			if (enableScrolling)
			{
				renderer.SetClipping(rectangle);
			}
			RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
			RenderAnnotations(renderer);
			if (enableScrolling)
			{
				renderer.RestoreClipping();
			}
		}

		public override void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext, bool renderInOverlays)
		{
			bool flag = renderInOverlays && renderContext != null && renderContext.SupportOverlays;
			if (renderContext != null && !flag)
			{
				renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.RendererAbove);
			}
			RenderSeriesAbove(renderer);
			foreach (XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList edgeLabel in EdgeLabels)
			{
				edgeLabel.RenderSeriesLabelConnectors(renderer);
				edgeLabel.RenderSeriesLabels(renderer);
			}
			foreach (LegendViewData legendViewData in legendViewDataList)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					INativeRenderer nativeRenderer = renderContext.CreateOverlayRenderer(legendViewData.Bounds);
					renderer.SetNativeRenderer(nativeRenderer);
				}
				legendViewData.Render(renderer, DiagramMappingList.MappingBounds);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				renderer.SetNativeRenderer(renderContext.Renderer);
			}
		}

		public override void StoreAxesBounds(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			pane.AxesBounds.Clear();
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				Axis2D axis = axisViewData.Axis;
				if (axis.VisibleInPane(pane))
				{
					pane.AxesBounds.Add(new Tuple<Axis2D, Rectangle>(axis, axisViewData.Bounds));
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramEmptyPaneViewData : XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase
	{
		private const int splitRectDistance = 10;

		private readonly List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsShapesLayout;

		private readonly Rectangle maxBounds;

		private readonly XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData titleViewData;

		public override List<AnnotationLayout> AnnotationsShapesLayout => annotationsShapesLayout;

		public Rectangle MaxBounds => maxBounds;

		private static bool SplitRectByHeight(Rectangle rect, out Rectangle topHalfRect, out Rectangle bottomHalfRect)
		{
			topHalfRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			bottomHalfRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			int height = rect.Height;
			if (height <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			height -= 10;
			if (height <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor((double)height / 2.0);
			int num2 = height - num;
			if (num <= 0 || num2 <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			topHalfRect = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Top, rect.Width, num);
			bottomHalfRect = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Bottom - num2, rect.Width, num2);
			return true;
		}

		public XYDiagramEmptyPaneViewData(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsShapesLayout, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle maxBounds, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData titleViewData)
			: base(pane, bounds)
		{
			this.annotationsShapesLayout = annotationsShapesLayout;
			this.maxBounds = maxBounds;
			this.titleViewData = titleViewData;
		}

		private string GetDesignTimeText()
		{
			return base.Diagram.PaneLayout.Direction switch
			{
				PaneLayoutDirection.Vertical => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyPaneTextForVerticalLayout), 
				PaneLayoutDirection.Horizontal => ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgEmptyPaneTextForHorizontalLayout), 
				_ => throw new DefaultSwitchException(), 
			};
		}

		private void RenderPaneName(ChartRenderer renderer, string paneName, Rectangle bounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment lineAlignment)
		{
			renderer.DrawBoundedText(paneName, DefaultFonts.Tahoma12.DpiScale(), base.Diagram.Appearance.TextColor, base.Pane, bounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, lineAlignment);
		}

		private void RenderDesignTime(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (SplitRectByHeight(base.Bounds, out var topHalfRect, out var bottomHalfRect))
			{
				string designTimeText = GetDesignTimeText();
				RenderPaneName(renderer, base.Pane.Name, topHalfRect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Far);
				renderer.DrawBoundedText(designTimeText, DefaultFonts.Tahoma8.DpiScale(), base.Diagram.Appearance.TextColor, new AntialiasingSupport(base.Pane, defaultAntialiasing: false), bottomHalfRect, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Near);
			}
		}

		private void RenderRuntime(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			RenderPaneName(renderer, base.Pane.Name, base.Bounds, System.Drawing.StringAlignment.Center);
		}

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (base.Bounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				base.Pane.RenderBeforeContent(renderer, base.Bounds, MaxBounds, null);
				if (titleViewData != null)
				{
					titleViewData.Render(renderer);
				}
				if (base.Diagram.Chart.Container.DesignMode)
				{
					RenderDesignTime(renderer);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderRuntime(renderer);
				}
				base.Pane.RenderBorder(renderer, base.Bounds);
			}
		}

		public override void RenderMiddle(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
		}

		public override void RenderAbove(ChartRenderer renderer, IRenderContext renderContext, bool renderInOverlays)
		{
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public abstract class XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private readonly XYDiagramPaneBase pane;

		private readonly Rectangle outerElementsBounds;

		private readonly Rectangle axesBounds;

		private readonly Rectangle initialMappingBounds;

		private readonly LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionH;

		private readonly LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionV;

		private Limits mappingLimitsH;

		private Limits mappingLimitsV;

		private Limits maxLimitsH;

		private Limits maxLimitsV;

		private bool isNull;

		protected XYDiagramPaneBase Pane => pane;

		protected XYDiagram2D Diagram => diagram;

		protected Rectangle InitialMappingBounds => initialMappingBounds;

		protected Rectangle MappingBounds
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle result = FromLimits(mappingLimitsH, mappingLimitsV);
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width - 1, 0);
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height - 1, 0);
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected Rectangle MappingBoundsExpanded => FromLimits(mappingLimitsH, mappingLimitsV);

		protected Rectangle InitialOuterBounds => outerElementsBounds;

		protected Rectangle OuterElementsBounds => FromLimits(maxLimitsH, maxLimitsV);

		protected Rectangle AxesMaxBounds => axesBounds;

		public bool IsNull
		{
			get
			{
				return isNull;
			}
			protected set
			{
				isNull = value;
			}
		}

		private static bool CheckLimits(Limits limits)
		{
			return limits.Length > 0;
		}

		private static Rectangle FromLimits(Limits limitsH, Limits limitsV)
		{
			return new Rectangle(limitsH.Start, limitsV.Start, limitsH.Length, limitsV.Length);
		}

		public static XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase CreateInstance(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, LayoutInfo paneLayout, SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionH, LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionV, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData titleViewData)
		{
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (pane.Collapsed)
			{
				bool isLinearLayout = pane.Diagram.PaneLayout.IsLinearLayout;
				return new XYDiagramCollapsedPaneViewDataCalculator(pane, paneLayout, isLinearLayout ? mappingLimitsCorrectionH : new LimitsCorrection(), isLinearLayout ? mappingLimitsCorrectionV : new LimitsCorrection(), titleViewData);
			}
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData = pane.Diagram.GetPaneAxesData(pane);
			if (paneAxesData == null)
			{
				return new XYDiagramEmptyPaneViewDataCalculator(pane, paneLayout, mappingLimitsCorrectionH, mappingLimitsCorrectionV, titleViewData);
			}
			DataTableViewData dataTableViewData = null;
			if (pane.ChartDataTable.Visible)
			{
				dataTableViewData = new DataTableViewData(pane.ChartDataTable, paneLayout.MappingBounds, containerDataList.AllSeriesData);
			}
			return new XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculator(pane, paneLayout, paneAxesData, containerDataList, mappingLimitsCorrectionH, mappingLimitsCorrectionV, performRangeCorrection, legendItems, titleViewData, dataTableViewData);
		}

		protected XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, LayoutInfo paneLayout, LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionH, LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionV)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			diagram = pane.Diagram;
			this.pane = pane;
			outerElementsBounds = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(paneLayout.OuterBounds);
			axesBounds = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(paneLayout.OuterBoundsWithItemsDistance);
			initialMappingBounds = GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToRectangle(paneLayout.MappingBounds);
			this.mappingLimitsCorrectionH = mappingLimitsCorrectionH;
			this.mappingLimitsCorrectionV = mappingLimitsCorrectionV;
		}

		protected bool PrepareAndCheckMappingLimits()
		{
			mappingLimitsH = new Limits(initialMappingBounds.Left, initialMappingBounds.Right);
			if (mappingLimitsCorrectionH.ShouldCorrect || mappingLimitsCorrectionH.ShouldCorrectOutside)
			{
				mappingLimitsH = mappingLimitsCorrectionH.Correct(mappingLimitsH);
			}
			maxLimitsH = new Limits(outerElementsBounds.Left, outerElementsBounds.Right);
			if (mappingLimitsCorrectionH.ShouldCorrectOutside)
			{
				maxLimitsH = mappingLimitsCorrectionH.CorrectOutside(maxLimitsH);
			}
			mappingLimitsV = new Limits(initialMappingBounds.Top, initialMappingBounds.Bottom);
			if (mappingLimitsCorrectionV.ShouldCorrect || mappingLimitsCorrectionV.ShouldCorrectOutside)
			{
				mappingLimitsV = mappingLimitsCorrectionV.Correct(mappingLimitsV);
			}
			maxLimitsV = new Limits(outerElementsBounds.Top, outerElementsBounds.Bottom);
			if (mappingLimitsCorrectionV.ShouldCorrectOutside)
			{
				maxLimitsV = mappingLimitsCorrectionV.CorrectOutside(maxLimitsV);
			}
			if (CheckLimits(mappingLimitsH) && CheckLimits(mappingLimitsV) && CheckLimits(maxLimitsH))
			{
				return CheckLimits(maxLimitsV);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void ApplyMappingLimitsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			mappingLimitsCorrectionH.ApplyHorizontalCorrection(correction);
			mappingLimitsCorrectionV.ApplyVerticalCorrection(correction);
		}

		protected void ApplyMappingLimitsOutsideCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			mappingLimitsCorrectionH.ApplyHorizontalOutsideCorrection(correction);
			mappingLimitsCorrectionV.ApplyVerticalOutsideCorrection(correction);
		}

		public abstract XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase CreateViewData();

		public abstract bool Calculate();

		public virtual Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> CalculateCorrectedAxisRange()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void UpdateGridAndTextData()
		{
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculator : XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer;

		private readonly SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList;

		private readonly List<AxisGridAndTextData> axisGridAndTextDataList = new List<AxisGridAndTextData>();

		private readonly Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems;

		private readonly Dictionary<LegendBase, LegendViewData> legendViewDataDictionary = new Dictionary<LegendBase, LegendViewData>();

		private readonly bool performRangeCorrection;

		private readonly XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData titleViewData;

		private List<LabelLayoutListBase> labelLayoutLists;

		private AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository intervalsLayoutRepository;

		private List<AxisViewData> axisViewDataList;

		private DataTableViewData dataTableViewData;

		private List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsShapesLayout;

		private List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsAnchorPointsLayout;

		private List<AnnotationViewData> annotationsViewData;

		private ScrollBarViewData xAxisScrollBarViewData;

		private ScrollBarViewData yAxisScrollBarViewData;

		private ScrollBarPositions scrollBarPositions;

		private XYDiagramMappingList diagramMappingList;

		private List<XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList> edgeLabels;

		private bool EnableScrolling
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Pane.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling)
				{
					return base.Pane.ActualEnableAxisYScrolling;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Axis2D PrimaryAxisX => (Axis2D)paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX;

		private Axis2D PrimaryAxisY => (Axis2D)paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;

		public AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository => intervalsLayoutRepository;

		public XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculator(XYDiagramPaneBase pane, LayoutInfo paneLayout, PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer, SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionH, LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionV, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData titleViewData, DataTableViewData dataTableViewData)
			: base(pane, paneLayout, mappingLimitsCorrectionH, mappingLimitsCorrectionV)
		{
			this.dataTableViewData = dataTableViewData;
			this.paneAxesContainer = paneAxesContainer;
			this.containerDataList = containerDataList;
			this.legendItems = legendItems;
			this.performRangeCorrection = performRangeCorrection;
			this.titleViewData = titleViewData;
			CalculateOutsideViewDataCorrection(base.InitialOuterBounds);
			FillAxisGridAndTextDataList(paneAxesContainer.AxesX);
			FillAxisGridAndTextDataList(paneAxesContainer.AxesY);
		}

		private void AddSeriesPointAnnotationsToScrollBars()
		{
			if ((xAxisScrollBarViewData == null || !base.Pane.ScrollBarOptions.XAxisAnnotationOptions.ShowSeriesPointAnnotations) && (yAxisScrollBarViewData == null || !base.Pane.ScrollBarOptions.YAxisAnnotationOptions.ShowSeriesPointAnnotations))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IScrollBarAnnotation> list = new List<IScrollBarAnnotation>();
			List<IScrollBarAnnotation> list2 = new List<IScrollBarAnnotation>();
			foreach (AnnotationLayout item in annotationsAnchorPointsLayout)
			{
				if (!(item.Annotation.AnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (xAxisScrollBarViewData != null && base.Pane.ScrollBarOptions.XAxisAnnotationOptions.ShowSeriesPointAnnotations)
				{
					IScrollBarAnnotation scrollBarAnnotation = seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetScrollBarAnnotation(item.RefinedPoint, base.Pane, PrimaryAxisX);
					if (scrollBarAnnotation != null)
					{
						list.Add(scrollBarAnnotation);
					}
				}
				if (yAxisScrollBarViewData != null && base.Pane.ScrollBarOptions.YAxisAnnotationOptions.ShowSeriesPointAnnotations)
				{
					IScrollBarAnnotation scrollBarAnnotation2 = seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetScrollBarAnnotation(item.RefinedPoint, base.Pane, PrimaryAxisY);
					if (scrollBarAnnotation2 != null)
					{
						list2.Add(scrollBarAnnotation2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (xAxisScrollBarViewData != null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				xAxisScrollBarViewData.AddAnnotations(list);
			}
			if (yAxisScrollBarViewData != null && list2.Count > 0)
			{
				yAxisScrollBarViewData.AddAnnotations(list2);
			}
		}

		private void FillAxisGridAndTextDataList(IList<IAxisData> axes)
		{
			foreach (Axis2D axis in axes)
			{
				axisGridAndTextDataList.Add(new AxisGridAndTextData(axis, base.InitialOuterBounds));
			}
		}

		private void CalculateAnnotationsLayoutAndViewData()
		{
			annotationsAnchorPointsLayout = new List<AnnotationLayout>();
			XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = base.Pane;
			Dictionary<RefinedSeriesDataBase, List<Annotation>> dictionary = new Dictionary<RefinedSeriesDataBase, List<Annotation>>();
			if (xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.Chart.AnnotationRepository.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.Chart.AnnotationRepository.Count; i++)
				{
					Annotation annotation = xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.Chart.AnnotationRepository[i];
					annotation.IndexInRepository = i;
					if (annotation.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint && paneAnchorPoint.Pane == xYDiagramPaneBase)
					{
						AxisXCoordinate axisXCoordinate = paneAnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate;
						AxisYCoordinate axisYCoordinate = paneAnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate;
						if (!axisXCoordinate.Visible || !axisYCoordinate.Visible)
						{
							continue;
						}
						XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = diagramMappingList.GetMappingContainer(axisXCoordinate.Axis, axisYCoordinate.Axis);
						if (mappingContainer != null && !double.IsNaN(axisXCoordinate.Value))
						{
							double value = axisXCoordinate.Value;
							double value2 = axisYCoordinate.Value;
							XYDiagramMappingBase xYDiagramMappingBase = ((EnableScrolling && annotation.ScrollingSupported) ? mappingContainer.MappingForScrolling : mappingContainer.GetMapping(value, value2));
							if (xYDiagramMappingBase != null)
							{
								annotationsAnchorPointsLayout.Add(new AnnotationLayout(annotation, xYDiagramMappingBase.GetScreenPoint(value, value2)));
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(annotation.AnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint seriesPointAnchorPoint))
						{
							continue;
						}
						SeriesPoint userSeriesPoint = seriesPointAnchorPoint.GetUserSeriesPoint();
						if (userSeriesPoint == null || !(userSeriesPoint.Series?.View is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase) || xYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase.ActualPane != xYDiagramPaneBase)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase allSeriesDatum in containerDataList.AllSeriesData)
						{
							if (allSeriesDatum.Series == seriesPointAnchorPoint.Series)
							{
								List<Annotation> list = null;
								if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(allSeriesDatum))
								{
									list = new List<Annotation>();
									dictionary.Add(allSeriesDatum, list);
								}
								else
								{
									list = dictionary[allSeriesDatum];
								}
								list.Add(annotation);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase key in dictionary.Keys)
				{
					List<Annotation> annotations = dictionary[key];
					XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer2 = diagramMappingList.GetMappingContainer(key);
					annotationsAnchorPointsLayout.AddRange(new XYDiagramAnchorPointLayoutList(annotations, key, mappingContainer2));
				}
			}
			AddSeriesPointAnnotationsToScrollBars();
			annotationsViewData = AnnotationHelper.CreateInnerAnnotationsViewData(annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, base.MappingBoundsExpanded);
			annotationsShapesLayout = AnnotationHelper.CreateFreeAnnotationsShapesLayout(xYDiagramPaneBase.ChartContainer.Chart.AnnotationRepository, xYDiagramPaneBase, (ZPlaneRectangle)base.MappingBoundsExpanded);
		}

		private void CalculateScrollBarViewData()
		{
			xAxisScrollBarViewData = null;
			yAxisScrollBarViewData = null;
			XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = base.Pane;
			if (xYDiagramPaneBase.ActualEnableAxisXScrolling && xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions.XAxisScrollBarVisible && PaneAxesManager.CanZoomOutAxis(PrimaryAxisX) && xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.ScrollingOptions.HasWays)
			{
				xAxisScrollBarViewData = new ScrollBarViewData(PrimaryAxisX, xYDiagramPaneBase, base.MappingBounds, xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions);
			}
			if (xYDiagramPaneBase.ActualEnableAxisYScrolling && xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions.YAxisScrollBarVisible && PaneAxesManager.CanZoomOutAxis(PrimaryAxisY) && xYDiagramPaneBase.Diagram.ScrollingOptions.HasWays)
			{
				yAxisScrollBarViewData = new ScrollBarViewData(PrimaryAxisY, xYDiagramPaneBase, base.MappingBounds, xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateScrollBarPosition()
		{
			scrollBarPositions = ScrollBarPositions.None;
			XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = base.Pane;
			if (xAxisScrollBarViewData != null)
			{
				if (base.Diagram.ActualRotated)
				{
					scrollBarPositions |= (ScrollBarPositions)((xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions.XAxisScrollBarAlignment == ScrollBarAlignment.Near) ? 1 : 2);
				}
				else
				{
					scrollBarPositions |= (ScrollBarPositions)((xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions.XAxisScrollBarAlignment == ScrollBarAlignment.Near) ? 4 : 8);
				}
			}
			if (yAxisScrollBarViewData != null)
			{
				if (base.Diagram.ActualRotated)
				{
					scrollBarPositions |= (ScrollBarPositions)((xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions.YAxisScrollBarAlignment == ScrollBarAlignment.Near) ? 4 : 8);
				}
				else
				{
					scrollBarPositions |= (ScrollBarPositions)((xYDiagramPaneBase.ScrollBarOptions.YAxisScrollBarAlignment == ScrollBarAlignment.Near) ? 1 : 2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateScrollBarCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (xAxisScrollBarViewData != null)
			{
				xAxisScrollBarViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction);
			}
			if (yAxisScrollBarViewData != null)
			{
				yAxisScrollBarViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction);
			}
		}

		private bool CorrectAxes(bool isVerticalAxes)
		{
			Rectangle initialOuterBounds = base.InitialOuterBounds;
			Rectangle rectangle = base.OuterElementsBounds;
			Rectangle axesMaxBounds = base.AxesMaxBounds;
			RectangleCorrection rectangleCorrection = new RectangleCorrection(Rectangle.FromLTRB((!isVerticalAxes && initialOuterBounds.Left == rectangle.Left) ? axesMaxBounds.Left : rectangle.Left, (isVerticalAxes && initialOuterBounds.Top == rectangle.Top) ? axesMaxBounds.Top : rectangle.Top, (!isVerticalAxes && initialOuterBounds.Right == rectangle.Right) ? axesMaxBounds.Right : rectangle.Right, (isVerticalAxes && initialOuterBounds.Bottom == rectangle.Bottom) ? axesMaxBounds.Bottom : rectangle.Bottom));
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				if (axisViewData.Axis.IsVertical == isVerticalAxes)
				{
					bool doNotCorrectBottomByLabel = axisViewData.Axis.IsVertical && base.Pane.ChartDataTable.Visible;
					axisViewData.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(rectangleCorrection, doNotCorrectBottomByLabel);
				}
			}
			if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
			{
				ApplyMappingLimitsCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Rectangle GetMaximumMappingBounds()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(PrimaryAxisX.WholeRangeData.Min) || double.IsNaN(PrimaryAxisX.WholeRangeData.Max) || double.IsNaN(PrimaryAxisY.WholeRangeData.Min) || double.IsNaN(PrimaryAxisY.WholeRangeData.Max))
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			XYDiagramWholeMapping xYDiagramWholeMapping = new XYDiagramWholeMapping(base.MappingBounds, base.Diagram.ActualRotated, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint = xYDiagramWholeMapping.GetDiagramPoint(PrimaryAxisX.WholeRangeData.Min, PrimaryAxisY.WholeRangeData.Min, clip: false, round: true);
			DiagramPoint diagramPoint2 = xYDiagramWholeMapping.GetDiagramPoint(PrimaryAxisX.WholeRangeData.Max, PrimaryAxisY.WholeRangeData.Max, clip: false, round: true);
			Rectangle mappingBounds = xYDiagramWholeMapping.MappingBounds;
			diagramPoint = MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint, mappingBounds);
			diagramPoint2 = MatrixTransform.Project(diagramPoint2, mappingBounds);
			return GraphicUtils.MakeRectangle((Point)diagramPoint, (Point)diagramPoint2);
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesLabelsCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			if (EnableScrolling)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
			{
				labelLayoutList.CalculateDiagramBoundsCorrection(correction);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCache()
		{
			if (axisViewDataList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				axisViewData.UpdateCache();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateOutsideViewDataCorrection(Rectangle maxBounds)
		{
			legendViewDataDictionary.Clear();
			RectangleCorrection rectangleCorrection = new RectangleCorrection(maxBounds);
			foreach (LegendBase key in legendItems.Keys)
			{
				if (!key.IsOutside)
				{
					continue;
				}
				LegendViewData legendViewData = LegendViewData.Create(key, legendItems[key], rectangleCorrection.Bounds);
				if (legendViewData != null)
				{
					legendViewData.UpdateOutsideCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
					if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
					{
						rectangleCorrection.Bounds = rectangleCorrection.Correct(rectangleCorrection.Bounds);
					}
					legendViewDataDictionary[key] = legendViewData;
				}
			}
			if (dataTableViewData != null)
			{
				rectangleCorrection.AddBottomCorrection(dataTableViewData.OccupiedVerticalSpace);
			}
			if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
			{
				ApplyMappingLimitsOutsideCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateInsideLegendsViewData(Rectangle diagramMappingBounds)
		{
			List<LegendViewData> list = new List<LegendViewData>();
			foreach (LegendBase key in legendItems.Keys)
			{
				if (!key.IsOutside)
				{
					LegendViewData legendViewData = LegendViewData.Create(key, legendItems[key], diagramMappingBounds);
					if (legendViewData != null)
					{
						MoveIfIntersected(legendViewData, list);
						list.Add(legendViewData);
						legendViewDataDictionary[key] = legendViewData;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void MoveIfIntersected(LegendViewData legendViewData, IEnumerable<LegendViewData> viewDataList)
		{
			foreach (LegendViewData viewData in viewDataList)
			{
				if (legendViewData.Legend.AlignmentHorizontal != viewData.Legend.AlignmentHorizontal || legendViewData.Legend.AlignmentVertical != viewData.Legend.AlignmentVertical || !legendViewData.Bounds.IntersectsWith(viewData.Bounds))
				{
					continue;
				}
				switch (legendViewData.Legend.AlignmentHorizontal)
				{
				case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Left:
					legendViewData.MoveRight(viewData);
					break;
				case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Right:
					legendViewData.MoveLeft(viewData);
					break;
				case LegendAlignmentHorizontal.Center:
					switch (legendViewData.Legend.AlignmentVertical)
					{
					case LegendAlignmentVertical.Top:
						legendViewData.MoveDown(viewData);
						break;
					case LegendAlignmentVertical.Bottom:
						legendViewData.MoveUp(viewData);
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private IMinMaxValues GetAxisRange(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return intervalsLayoutRepository.GetIntervalsLayout((Axis2D)axis)[0].Interval.WholeRange;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateBoundsForPaneTitle()
		{
			int num = base.MappingBounds.Top;
			foreach (AxisViewData axisViewData in axisViewDataList)
			{
				Axis2D axis = axisViewData.Axis;
				if (axisViewData.Visible && !axis.IsVertical && axisViewData.Mapping.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far)
				{
					int val = ((axisViewData.TitleViewData != null) ? Math.Min(axisViewData.Bounds.Top, axisViewData.TitleViewData.Bounds.Top) : axisViewData.Bounds.Top);
					num = Math.Min(val, num);
				}
			}
			return Rectangle.FromLTRB(base.MappingBounds.Left, num, base.MappingBounds.Right, base.MappingBounds.Bottom);
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout()
		{
			labelLayoutLists = new List<LabelLayoutListBase>();
			diagramMappingList = new XYDiagramMappingList(base.Diagram, intervalsLayoutRepository, GetMaximumMappingBounds());
			foreach (SeriesContainerData containerData in containerDataList)
			{
				List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesDataList = containerData.SeriesDataList;
				RefinedSeriesDataBase seriesData = seriesDataList[0];
				XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = diagramMappingList.GetMappingContainer(seriesData);
				if (mappingContainer != null)
				{
					labelLayoutLists.Add(new XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(seriesData, mappingContainer, isFirstSeriesInInteraction: true));
					for (int i = 1; i < seriesDataList.Count; i++)
					{
						labelLayoutLists.Add(new XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList(seriesDataList[i], mappingContainer, isFirstSeriesInInteraction: false));
					}
					if (containerData.TotalLabelPoints.Count > 0)
					{
						labelLayoutLists.Add(new StackedBarTotalLabelLayoutList(containerData, mappingContainer));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateEdgeSeriesLabelsLayoutAndCorrection(RectangleCorrection correction)
		{
			edgeLabels = new List<XYDiagramSeriesLabelLayoutList>();
			diagramMappingList = new XYDiagramMappingList(base.Diagram, intervalsLayoutRepository, GetMaximumMappingBounds());
			foreach (SeriesContainerData containerData in containerDataList)
			{
				List<RefinedSeriesDataBase> seriesDataList = containerData.SeriesDataList;
				XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = diagramMappingList.GetMappingContainer(seriesDataList[0]);
				if (mappingContainer == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeriesDataBase item in seriesDataList)
				{
					Series series = item.Series;
					if (!series.View.GetSideLabelVisible(value: true) && !series.View.GetSideLabelVisible(value: false))
					{
						continue;
					}
					XYDiagramEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis xYDiagramEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis = ((XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase)series.View).CreateEdgeLabelLayoutList(item, mappingContainer);
					if (xYDiagramEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis.ShouldCorrectViewport)
					{
						foreach (SeriesLabelLayout item2 in xYDiagramEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis)
						{
							correction.Update(item2.Painter.RoundedBounds);
						}
					}
					edgeLabels.Add(xYDiagramEdgeSeriesLabelLayoutLis);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Calculate()
		{
			if (!PrepareAndCheckMappingLimits())
			{
				base.IsNull = true;
				dataTableViewData?.CalculateAfterAxesCorrection();
				return true;
			}
			CalculateScrollBarViewData();
			CalculateScrollBarPosition();
			intervalsLayoutRepository = new AxisIntervalsLayoutRepository(base.Pane, base.MappingBounds);
			axisViewDataList = AxisViewDataCalculator.Calculate(base.Pane, intervalsLayoutRepository, paneAxesContainer, scrollBarPositions, axisGridAndTextDataList);
			if (!CorrectAxes(isVerticalAxes: false) || !CorrectAxes(isVerticalAxes: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RectangleCorrection rectangleCorrection = new RectangleCorrection(base.OuterElementsBounds);
			CalculateScrollBarCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
			titleViewData?.UpdateCorrection(rectangleCorrection, CalculateBoundsForPaneTitle(), base.InitialMappingBounds, base.OuterElementsBounds);
			dataTableViewData?.UpdateCorrectionAndFirstColWidth(rectangleCorrection, base.InitialMappingBounds, base.MappingBounds, dataTableViewData);
			if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
			{
				ApplyMappingLimitsCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
				return false;
			}
			CalculateEdgeSeriesLabelsLayoutAndCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
			if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
			{
				ApplyMappingLimitsCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
				dataTableViewData?.CalculateAfterAxesCorrection();
				return false;
			}
			if (EnableScrolling)
			{
				CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout();
				CalculateAnnotationsLayoutAndViewData();
				CalculateInsideLegendsViewData(base.MappingBounds);
				UpdateCache();
				dataTableViewData?.CalculateAfterAxesCorrection();
				return true;
			}
			if (!PrepareAndCheckMappingLimits())
			{
				base.IsNull = true;
				UpdateCache();
				dataTableViewData?.CalculateAfterAxesCorrection();
				return true;
			}
			CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout();
			CalculateAnnotationsLayoutAndViewData();
			rectangleCorrection = new RectangleCorrection(base.OuterElementsBounds);
			CalculateSeriesLabelsCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
			AnnotationHelper.CalculateAnnotationsCorrection(annotationsViewData, rectangleCorrection);
			if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
			{
				ApplyMappingLimitsCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
				return false;
			}
			CalculateInsideLegendsViewData(base.MappingBounds);
			UpdateCache();
			dataTableViewData?.CalculateAfterAxesCorrection();
			return true;
		}

		public override void UpdateGridAndTextData()
		{
			axisGridAndTextDataList.Clear();
			FillAxisGridAndTextDataList(paneAxesContainer.AxesX);
			FillAxisGridAndTextDataList(paneAxesContainer.AxesY);
		}

		public override Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> CalculateCorrectedAxisRange()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0150: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (performRangeCorrection && EnableScrolling)
			{
				bool actualRotated = base.Diagram.ActualRotated;
				DXRectangle val = GraphicUtils.ConvertRect(base.MappingBounds);
				List<OutOfBoundsChecker> list = new List<OutOfBoundsChecker>
				{
					new OutOfBoundsChecker(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX, !actualRotated, val, GetAxisRange(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX)),
					new OutOfBoundsChecker(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY, actualRotated, val, GetAxisRange(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY))
				};
				foreach (IAxisData item in paneAxesContainer.SecondaryAxesX)
				{
					list.Add(new OutOfBoundsChecker(item, !actualRotated, val, GetAxisRange(item)));
				}
				foreach (IAxisData item2 in paneAxesContainer.SecondaryAxesY)
				{
					list.Add(new OutOfBoundsChecker(item2, actualRotated, val, GetAxisRange(item2)));
				}
				foreach (LabelLayoutListBase labelLayoutList in labelLayoutLists)
				{
					foreach (SeriesLabelLayout item3 in labelLayoutList)
					{
						if (!((IBoundsProvider)item3).IsEnableInBounds(val))
						{
							continue;
						}
						GRealRect2D bounds = ((IBoundsProvider)item3).GetBounds();
						foreach (OutOfBoundsChecker item4 in list)
						{
							item4.CheckOutOfBounds(bounds);
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (AnnotationViewData annotationsViewDatum in annotationsViewData)
				{
					if (!((IBoundsProvider)annotationsViewDatum).IsEnableInBounds(val))
					{
						continue;
					}
					GRealRect2D bounds2 = ((IBoundsProvider)annotationsViewDatum).GetBounds();
					foreach (OutOfBoundsChecker item5 in list)
					{
						item5.CheckOutOfBounds(bounds2);
					}
				}
				Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues>();
				{
					foreach (OutOfBoundsChecker item6 in list)
					{
						dictionary.Add(item6.Axis, item6.GetCorrectedWholeRange());
					}
					return dictionary;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase CreateViewData()
		{
			if (base.IsNull)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<SeriesContainerLayout> list = new List<SeriesContainerLayout>();
			foreach (SeriesContainerData containerData in containerDataList)
			{
				XYDiagramMappingContainer mappingContainer = diagramMappingList.GetMappingContainer(containerData.SeriesDataList[0]);
				foreach (XYDiagramMappingBase item in mappingContainer)
				{
					list.Add(containerData.PrimaryView.CreateSeriesContainerLayout(containerData, item, mappingContainer.Count == 1));
				}
			}
			List<LegendViewData> legendViewDataList = new List<LegendViewData>(legendViewDataDictionary.Values);
			return new XYDiagramPaneViewData(base.Pane, list, labelLayoutLists, edgeLabels, diagramMappingList, xAxisScrollBarViewData, yAxisScrollBarViewData, axisViewDataList, annotationsShapesLayout, annotationsAnchorPointsLayout, annotationsViewData, legendViewDataList, base.OuterElementsBounds, titleViewData, dataTableViewData);
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramEmptyPaneViewDataCalculator : XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase

		{
			this.titleViewData = titleViewData;
		}

		public override bool Calculate()
		{
			if (!PrepareAndCheckMappingLimits())
			{
				base.IsNull = true;
			}
			else if (titleViewData != null)
			{
				RectangleCorrection rectangleCorrection = new RectangleCorrection(base.OuterElementsBounds);
				titleViewData.UpdateCorrection(rectangleCorrection, base.MappingBounds, base.InitialMappingBounds, base.OuterElementsBounds);
				if (rectangleCorrection.ShouldCorrect)
				{
					ApplyMappingLimitsCorrection(rectangleCorrection);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase CreateViewData()

			if (base.IsNull)

				return null;
			}
			List<AnnotationLayout> annotationsShapesLayout = AnnotationHelper.CreateFreeAnnotationsShapesLayout(base.Diagram.Chart.AnnotationRepository, base.Pane, (ZPlaneRectangle)base.MappingBoundsExpanded);
			return new XYDiagramEmptyPaneViewData(base.Pane, annotationsShapesLayout, base.MappingBoundsExpanded, base.OuterElementsBounds, titleViewData);
		}
	}

			allPanesViewDataList = paneViewDataList;
			this.panesSeparators = panesSeparators;
		}

		public override Rectangle GetLegendMappingBounds(LegendBase legend)
		{
			XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase = null;
			ChartElement chartElement = legend?.ActualDockTarget;
			if (chartElement == null)
			{
				xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase = DefaultPaneViewData;
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase allPanesViewData in allPanesViewDataList)
				{
					if (allPanesViewData.Pane == chartElement)
					{
						xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase = allPanesViewData;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase != null)
			{
				return GraphicUtils.InflateRect(xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.Bounds, -1, -1);
			}
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}

			}

			return null;

		public override void Render(ChartRenderer renderer)
		{
			if (!IsCorrectPaneViewDataCount)

				return;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase allPanesViewData in AllPanesViewDataList)
			{
				allPanesViewData.Render(renderer);
			}
			foreach (PanesSeparator panesSeparator in panesSeparators)
			{
				HitTestController.ProcessHitTestRegion(diagram.Chart.HitTestController, panesSeparator, new ChartFocusedArea(panesSeparator), useSpecificCursor: true, new HitRegion(panesSeparator.Bounds), null, force: true);
			}
		}

				return;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase allPanesViewData in AllPanesViewDataList)

				allPanesViewData.RenderMiddle(renderer);
