	public class PaneSeriesRepository : Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, SeriesContainerDataList>
	{
		public void Register(SeriesContainerData containerData)
		{
			if (containerData.PrimaryView is XYDiagram2DSeriesViewBase { ActualPane: var actualPane })
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(actualPane, out var value))
				{
					value = new SeriesContainerDataList();
					Add(actualPane, value);
				}
				value.Add(containerData);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramViewDataCalculator
	{
		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private static int GetShadowActualSize(XYDiagramPaneBase pane)
		{
			return pane.Shadow.GetActualSize(-1);
		}

		private static PaneSeriesRepository CreatePaneSeriesRepository(SeriesContainerDataList seriesDataList)
		{
			PaneSeriesRepository paneSeriesRepository = new PaneSeriesRepository();
			foreach (SeriesContainerData seriesData in seriesDataList)
			{
				paneSeriesRepository.Register(seriesData);
			}
			return paneSeriesRepository;
		}

		private static void PerformPaneViewDataCalculation(List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase> paneViewDataCalculatorList, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase paneViewDataCalculator in paneViewDataCalculatorList)
				{
					if (paneViewDataCalculator != null && !paneViewDataCalculator.IsNull)
					{
						flag &= paneViewDataCalculator.Calculate();
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!autoLayoutUpdated)
				{
					break;
				}
				autoLayoutUpdated = false;
				CorrectRanges(paneViewDataCalculatorList);
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase paneViewDataCalculator2 in paneViewDataCalculatorList)
				{
					if (paneViewDataCalculator2 != null && !paneViewDataCalculator2.IsNull)
					{
						paneViewDataCalculator2.UpdateGridAndTextData();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CorrectRanges(List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase> paneViewDataCalculatorList)
		{
			Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues>();
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase paneViewDataCalculator in paneViewDataCalculatorList)
			{
				if (paneViewDataCalculator != null && !paneViewDataCalculator.IsNull)
				{
					Merge(dictionary, paneViewDataCalculator.CalculateCorrectedAxisRange());
				}
			}
			foreach (IAxisData key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				ApplyRangesStates(key, dictionary[key]);
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyRangesStates(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues correctedRange)
		{
			if (!correctedRange.HasValues)
			{
				return;
			}
			IVisualAxisRangeData visualRange = axis.VisualRange;
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			if (wholeRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
			{
				return;
			}
			IIntervalContainer intervalContainer = axis as IIntervalContainer;
			foreach (AxisInterval interval in intervalContainer.Intervals)
			{
				interval.WholeRange.Min = correctedRange.Min;
				interval.WholeRange.Max = correctedRange.Max;
				if (visualRange.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto || (wholeRange.Min == visualRange.Min && wholeRange.Max == visualRange.Max))
				{
					interval.Range.Min = correctedRange.Min;
					interval.Range.Max = correctedRange.Max;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void Merge(Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> main, Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> correctedRanges)
		{
			if (correctedRanges == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IAxisData key in correctedRanges.Keys)
			{
				if (main.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = value.Union(correctedRanges[key]);
					main.Remove(key);
					main.Add(key, value);
				}
				else
				{
					main.Add(key, correctedRanges[key]);
				}
			}
		}

		public XYDiagramViewDataCalculator(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
		}

		public XYDiagramViewData Calculate(Rectangle diagramBounds, SeriesContainerDataList containerDataList, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, bool autoLayoutUpdated)
		{
			PanesList panesForLayoutCalculation = diagram.GetPanesForLayoutCalculation();
			if (panesForLayoutCalculation.Count == 0)
			{
				return new XYDiagramViewData(diagram, diagramBounds, new List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase>(), new List<PanesSeparator>());
			}
			if (!diagramBounds.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = CorrectBoundsByShadowAndMargins(diagramBounds);
			if (!rectangle.AreWidthAndHeightPositive())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData> dictionary = CalculatePaneTitlesViewDataList(panesForLayoutCalculation);
			LayoutInfoList layoutInfos = GetLayoutInfos(dictionary, panesForLayoutCalculation, diagramBounds, rectangle);
			diagram.SetPaneLayoutInfo(layoutInfos);
			if (layoutInfos == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ApplyPaneSizes(panesForLayoutCalculation, layoutInfos.List);
			AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateIntervals(performRangeCorrection || autoLayoutUpdated, diagram);
			List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase> paneViewDataCalculatorList = PreparePaneViewDataCalculatorList(panesForLayoutCalculation, layoutInfos.List, containerDataList, performRangeCorrection || autoLayoutUpdated, legendItems, dictionary);
			PerformPaneViewDataCalculation(paneViewDataCalculatorList, autoLayoutUpdated);
			if (!autoLayoutUpdated)
			{
				CorrectRanges(paneViewDataCalculatorList);
			}
			List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase> paneViewDataList = CalculatePaneViewDataList(paneViewDataCalculatorList);
			return new XYDiagramViewData(diagram, diagramBounds, paneViewDataList, CreatePanesSeparators(layoutInfos.Separators));
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneBase GetMaxShadowPane()
		{
			PanesList panesForLayoutCalculation = diagram.GetPanesForLayoutCalculation();
			ChartDebug.Assert(panesForLayoutCalculation.Count > 0);
			XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = panesForLayoutCalculation[0];
			int num = GetShadowActualSize(xYDiagramPaneBase);
			for (int i = 1; i < panesForLayoutCalculation.Count; i++)
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase2 = panesForLayoutCalculation[i];
				int shadowActualSize = GetShadowActualSize(xYDiagramPaneBase2);
				if (shadowActualSize > num)
				{
					xYDiagramPaneBase = xYDiagramPaneBase2;
					num = shadowActualSize;
				}
			}
			return xYDiagramPaneBase;
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectBoundsByShadowAndMargins(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			XYDiagramPaneBase maxShadowPane = GetMaxShadowPane();
			if (maxShadowPane.Shadow.Visible)
			{
				return new Rectangle(diagram.Margins.DecreaseRectangle(bounds).Location, maxShadowPane.Shadow.DecreaseSize(diagram.Margins.DecreaseRectangle(bounds).Size));
			}
			return diagram.Margins.DecreaseRectangle(bounds);
		}

		private List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase> CalculatePaneViewDataList(List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase> paneViewDataCalculatorList)
		{
			List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase> list = new List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase>();
			for (int i = 0; i < paneViewDataCalculatorList.Count; i++)
			{
				XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase xYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase = paneViewDataCalculatorList[i];
				XYDiagramPaneViewDataBase xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase = xYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase.CreateViewData();
				if (xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase != null)
				{
					XYDiagramPaneBase pane = xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.Pane;
					list.Add(xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase);
					pane.PublicPaneBounds = xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.Bounds;
					if (xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase is XYDiagramEmptyPaneViewData)
					{
						pane.LastMappingBounds = null;
						pane.AxesBounds.Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						pane.LastMappingBounds = xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.Bounds;
						xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.StoreAxesBounds(pane);
					}
					pane.MappingList = xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.DiagramMappingList;
					pane.SeriesClipRegions = ((xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.PaneAreas != null) ? xYDiagramPaneViewDataBase.PaneAreas.SeriesClipRegions : null);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase> PreparePaneViewDataCalculatorList(IList<XYDiagramPaneBase> actualPanes, List<LayoutInfo> paneLayoutList, SeriesContainerDataList seriesDataList, bool performRangeCorrection, Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> legendItems, Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData> titleViewDataList)
		{
			//IL_00d0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase> list = new List<XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase>();
			PaneSeriesRepository paneSeriesRepository = CreatePaneSeriesRepository(seriesDataList);
			Dictionary<int, StartLimitCorrection> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, StartLimitCorrection>();
			Dictionary<int, EndLimitCorrection> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<int, EndLimitCorrection>();
			Dictionary<int, StartLimitCorrection> dictionary3 = new Dictionary<int, StartLimitCorrection>();
			Dictionary<int, EndLimitCorrection> dictionary4 = new Dictionary<int, EndLimitCorrection>();
			for (int i = 0; i < paneLayoutList.Count; i++)
			{
				LayoutInfo layoutInfo = paneLayoutList[i];
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = actualPanes[i];
				if (!xYDiagramPaneBase.ActualVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>> dictionary5 = new Dictionary<LegendBase, List<ILegendItemData>>();
				foreach (LegendBase key in legendItems.Keys)
				{
					if (key.ActualDockTarget == xYDiagramPaneBase || (key.ActualDockTarget == null && !key.IsOutside && i == 0))
					{
						dictionary5.Add(key, legendItems[key]);
					}
				}
				if (!paneSeriesRepository.TryGetValue(xYDiagramPaneBase, out var value))
				{
					value = new SeriesContainerDataList();
				}
				DXRectangle mappingBounds = layoutInfo.MappingBounds;
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Top))
				{
					dictionary.Add(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Top, new StartLimitCorrection());
				}
				if (!dictionary2.ContainsKey(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Bottom))
				{
					dictionary2.Add(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Bottom, new EndLimitCorrection());
				}
				if (!dictionary3.ContainsKey(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Left))
				{
					dictionary3.Add(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Left, new StartLimitCorrection());
				}
				if (!dictionary4.ContainsKey(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Right))
				{
					dictionary4.Add(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Right, new EndLimitCorrection());
				}
				LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionH = new LimitsCorrection(dictionary3[((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Left], dictionary4[((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Right]);
				LimitsCorrection mappingLimitsCorrectionV = new LimitsCorrection(dictionary[((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Top], dictionary2[((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Bottom]);
				titleViewDataList.TryGetValue(xYDiagramPaneBase, out var value2);
				XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase item = XYDiagramPaneViewDataCalculatorBase.CreateInstance(xYDiagramPaneBase, layoutInfo, value, mappingLimitsCorrectionH, mappingLimitsCorrectionV, performRangeCorrection, dictionary5, value2);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData> CalculatePaneTitlesViewDataList(IList<IPane> panes)
		{
			Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData> dictionary = new Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData>();
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in panes)
			{
				if (pane.ActualVisible && pane.Title.ActualVisibility)
				{
					dictionary.Add(pane, new XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData(pane.Title));
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private LayoutInfoList GetLayoutInfos(Dictionary<XYDiagramPaneBase, XYDiagramPaneTitleViewData> paneTitleViewDataList, PanesList panes, Rectangle diagramBounds, Rectangle maxBounds)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0123: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<LayoutItem> list = new List<LayoutItem>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneBase pane in panes)
			{
				if (pane.Collapsed)
				{
					Size size = paneTitleViewDataList[pane].Size;
					list.Add(new LayoutItem(num, new DXRectangle(0, 0, size.Width, size.Height)));
				}
				num++;
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(LayoutItem first, LayoutItem second)
			{
				int num2 = diagram.PanesCollapsingOrder.IndexOf(panes[first.Index]);
				int num3 = diagram.PanesCollapsingOrder.IndexOf(panes[second.Index]);
				return (num2 >= 0 && num3 >= 0) ? num2.CompareTo(num3) : num3.CompareTo(num2);
			});
			LayoutInfoList layoutInfoList = null;
			GridPaneLayout paneLayout = diagram.PaneLayout;
			if (paneLayout.AutoLayoutMode == PaneAutoLayoutMode.Linear)
			{
				return LinearNonProportionalLayoutCalculator.Calculate(panes, paneLayout, diagram.PaneDistance, GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(diagramBounds), GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(maxBounds), list);
			}
			if (paneLayout.IsLinearLayout)
			{
				return GridAsLinearLayoutCalculator.Calculate(panes, paneLayout, diagram.PaneDistance, GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(diagramBounds), GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(maxBounds), list);
			}
			return GridLayoutCalculator.Calculate(panes, paneLayout, diagram.PaneDistance, GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(diagramBounds), GeometricPrimitiveExtensions.ToDXRectangle(maxBounds), list);
		}

		private void ApplyPaneSizes(IList<IPane> actualPanes, List<LayoutInfo> paneLayoutList)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < paneLayoutList.Count; i++)
			{
				XYDiagramPaneBase xYDiagramPaneBase = actualPanes[i] as XYDiagramPaneBase;
				if (xYDiagramPaneBase.ActualVisible && !xYDiagramPaneBase.LinearLayoutOptions.Fixed)
				{
					xYDiagramPaneBase.LinearLayoutOptions.SetSizeInPixelsScaled(paneLayoutList[i].LinearSizeInPixels);
				}
				xYDiagramPaneBase.VisibleInLayout = paneLayoutList[i].LinearSizeInPixels > 0;
			}
		}

		private List<PanesSeparator> CreatePanesSeparators(List<SeparatorInfo> list)
		{
			bool isRuntimeResizeAvailable = diagram.RuntimePaneResize && diagram.ChartContainer.DesignMode;
			List<PanesSeparator> list2 = new List<PanesSeparator>();
			for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				list2.Add(new PanesSeparator(list[num], isRuntimeResizeAvailable));
			}
			return list2;
		}
	}
}
